name: Confidenciaal  Fiftyseven
desc_en_short: Phenomenal full-body cigar, revealing a mouthful of nutty and woody flavours combined with essences of rich cocoa and toffee. Perfect at the end of a hard or successful day.

name: Confidenciaal  Fiftytwo
desc_en_short: A private blend concepted by Eric Piras, initially reserved for family Excellent Robusto with a light to medium body, showing soft spices and well-balanced aromas of nutmeg and cedar wood, and just a touch of chocolate. A superb everyday-cigar.

name: Confidenciaal  Lancero
desc_en_short: An admired medium to full-bodied cigar, with suggestions of toasted nuts and spicy savours developing into coffee and cinnamon. A celebrated and delightful vitola.

name: Vegafina  Nicaragua Robusto Pigtail
desc_en_short: With a beautiful construction, this Vegafina Pigtail seduces us at first sight. It exalts exquisite aromas of chocolate and nuts. The first puffs are generous and invade the palate with chocolate and nuts notes. Throughout the tasting, this cigar offers a beautiful balance of aromas and power. The second and last thirds offer slightly more intense aromas, with notes of pink pepper and sweet spices. A very aromatic cigar that will delight both beginners and experienced cigar lovers.

name: Vegafina  10 Perlas 10'S
desc_en_short: VegaFina Classic Perla is a Petit Corona entirely hand-made at the famous Tabacalera de García, the world's largest premium cigar factory. Moreover, the VegaFina Classic premium blend boasts a luxurious, hand-selected Ecuadorian Connecticut Shade wrapper known for its golden-brown color and mild taste profile. Also, this wrapper is packed with a flavorful combination of Dominican, Colombian, and Honduran long-filler tobaccos with an Indonesian binder.

name: Vegafina  Nicaragua 8-9-8 25'S
desc_en_short: The Vega fina Nicaragua 898 is well balanced. Its finish is long with strong notes of hay. The pepperiness became very shy but still present reminding you what you are smoking is coming from Nicaragua. This leads the blend to an interesting complexity.

name: Chesa Veglia  Infinitos
desc_en_short: The profile is leathery with teases of coffee and wooden oak accompanied with reliable consistency until the end. The first line of Chesa Veglia, Infinto is strictly limited and once gone may never be available in the market again.

name: Aladino  Petit Corona
desc_en_short: "A refined smoke, this medium-strength cigar delivers notes of cedar, almonds and spice.Itt is a Honduran puro made from 100% Corojo tobacco. This savory blend creates a smooth traditional smoke. The Aladino Petit Corona is handmade in Honduras."

name: Plasencia   AIma Fuerte Sixo II Hexagano
desc_en_short: A medium to full-strength cigar that delivers notes of dark chocolate, plum, and cinnamon with an oak and molasses finish. This puro features aged tobaccos from four of Nicaragua’s top-tobacco regions: Esteli, Jalapa, Condega, and Ometepe. Handmade by Plasencia Cigars in Nicaragua. The Plasencia family has been growing tobacco for over 100 years, and they are one of the largest producers of premium cigars in Nicaragua.

name: Umnum  Bond
desc_en_short: Umnum pays tribute to Central America's indigenous culture. Tobacco was the axis of the initiation rituals of millenary Amerindian culture, from Cabo Cameron in Honduras, Rio Grande in Nicaragua. But only the Chamans or Sukia had the privilege of consuming it. Umnum's ring displays the image of the Sukia spirit, the black background represents the world of dreams while the gold represents the fire and ash, indivisible elements of cigars. These medium bodied cigars use long filler Seco and Viso leaves from Jalapa and Ometepe, Indonesian leaves for the binder and an oily Nicaraguan Sungrown Colorado wrappe

name: AJ Fernandez  Last Call Habano Geniales
desc_en_short: AJ Fernandez Last Call Habano Cigars A smooth, medium-bodied corona extra that offers satisfying notes of sweetness and spice with touches of vanilla. Its Nicaraguan binder and filler are covered by an enticing Ecuadorian wrapper. Handmade in Nicaragua, the AJ Fernandez Last Call Habano Geniales is a box-worthy, wallet-friendly smoke.

name: Jose L. Piedra  Petit Caballeros (3 Sticks per Box)
desc_en_short: Jose L. Piedra  Petit Caballeros is a pleasant smoke with notes of pepper, wood and coffee with a smooth draw.

name: Romeo Y Julieta  Puritos (5 Sticks per Box)
desc_en_short: Romeo y Julieta Puritos are an excellent cigar for those with little time on their hands to enjoy a puff of Cuban magic. Well balanced and aromatic, with a light-medium flavour.

name: Hoyo De Monterrey  Petit Robusto
desc_en_short: The flavour of Hoyo de Monterrey's blend makes it an attractive choice for those who seek a delicate yet aromatic Habano that is lighter to the taste but with great elegance and complexity.

name: H.Upmann  Half Corona
desc_en_short: The H. Upmann Half Corona cigar is truly a delight for the senses, offering a remarkable tasting experience. This particular cigar showcases a creamy profile that envelops the palate, creating a smooth and luxurious sensation. Amidst the creamy notes, subtle hints of coffee emerge, adding depth and richness to the overall flavor profile.

name: H.Upmann  Magnum 54

name: Riedel  Sommeliers : Vintage Champagne Glass
desc_en_short:
Champagne is the most northerly wine-growing region of France. Its chalky soil and unique climate both contribute to the naturally effervescent white wines for which it is so famous. It was not until the 19th century that the technique of secondary fermentation in the bottle was finally perfected. The traditional coupe glass was actually developed for the particular style of sweet, bubbly dessert champagne popular at this period, obtained by adding an extra measure of 'dosage' (a mixture of wine and syrup), although fluted glasses were also used to avoid spillage when champagne was served at standing receptions. It was only around 1930 that the now familiar dry style of champagne became established. Riedel recommends serving dry champagne in flutes, since these best bring out the fine aromas of the high-quality base wines from which it is made. Many wine-lovers unfortunately are quite unaware of this superb bouquet, since champagne is all too often served either in coupes or in glasses that are too small (and thus filled to the brim) - neither of which can convey any aromas at all. This flute, filled with four ounces of champagne, concentrates the unique, yeasty bouquet of great champagnes, while emphasising their creamy texture on the palate. The bubbles are not allowed to dominate, but are part of the overall pleasure.

Recommended for: Cava, Champagne, Franciacorta, Prosecco, Sekt, Sparkling wine

desc_en_short: La Fee Bohemian Absinth is a premium distilled spirit that is a modern Absinth originally created in Bohemia following the velvet revolution, with subtle herbal undertones of fennel, mint and rather less aniseed than that absinthe produced in France at the end of the 19th Century.

name: La Fee  Parisienne (700 ml)

name: La Maison Fontaine  Chocolate Absinthe Liqueur (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Sweet richness, combined with subtle notes of absinthe and chocolate create a uniquely soft liqueur. Fontaine Chocolat is a perfect digestif to be enjoyed neat or poured over ice.

name: La Maison Fontaine  Absinthe Verte (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Pontarlier-grown Grande Absinthe in combination with the natural herbal colouration creates a classic complex floral Verte with rich herbal & peppery notes. By adding chilled water to Fontaine Verte, a stimulating and refreshing drink is created with a vintage green louche. Some prefer a more intense flavour and sip it neat or pour it over ice.

name: St. George  Absinthe Verte (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
The Experience

A heady, herbaceous smack to the senses. It opens with spicy black licorice and then slowly evolves into citrus and grass profiles with a dose of sarsaparilla. Because of the abundance of essential oils, it’s rich and viscous on the palate—even at 120 proof (60% alcohol).

To bring out another level of vivid flavors and a lovely louche (milky cloudiness) that seems to glow from within, a single large ice cube is ideal. Adding water further releases botanical oils into solution, deepening the louche and intensifying the heady, floral aroma.

We developed our formulation over years of patient experimentation and think it’s pretty much perfect just as it is. We don’t advocate adding sugar to our absinthe—or to any other artisanally distilled absinthe for that matter.

In cocktails that call for an anise spirit, St. George Absinthe Verte adds complexity and depth of flavor.

You won’t hallucinate when you drink our absinthe, but you might fall in love. Everyone else has.

name: Moyet  Cognac Des Grande Champagne Extrad Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Moyet's Grande Champagne Extra is a wonderfull composition of cognacs from 1904,1905, 1906, the middle of the 1930's and 1962.

name: Martell  Cordon Bleu (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
First introduced in 1912 by Edouard Martell, Martell Cordon Bleu has become a true symbol of excellence in the world of cognac. The name “Cordon Bleu” reflects prestige, refinement, and mastery—qualities that have made it a favorite among royalty, collectors, and fine spirit enthusiasts.

What sets it apart is the generous use of eaux-de-vie from Borderies, the smallest and most exclusive cru in Cognac, known for its elegant floral notes and refined richness. Martell Cordon Bleu is a blend that exemplifies timeless luxury.

name: Meukow  X.O. (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: Established in Cognac for over 150 years, Meukow has built a strong reputation as masters in the art of distillation, ageing and blending of fine Brandy. Meukow XO is a luxury Cognac; its harmonious and smooth taste the result of meticulous fruit selection, traditional double distillation, prestige oak usage and a long ageing process.

name: Sempe Vieil Armagnac  V.S.O.P. (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Sempe V.S.O.P. is produced from a single distillation of white wine (A blend of Folle Blanche, Ugni Blanc and other regional grape varieties from the Bas-Armagnac and Ténarèze regions) in a typical alambic copper-still. As soon as it emerges from the still, the Armagnac is put into oak casks, known as 'Armagnac pièces' for a minimum of six years (50% longer than is required by French law). Most of the oak timber which is used comes from the Armagnac forest. The resulting spirit possesses astonishingly smooth and fragrant character that has won it the title of the 'velvet flame.' An excellent digestif, Sempé V.S.O.P. will also complement apple and almond desserts, flourless chocolate cakes or coffee after a meal.

name: Chatelle Napoleon  Finest Brandy (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: Selected and blended with the greatest care, Chatelle Napoleon is aged in small oak barrels under the supervision of a master blender.This smooth, premium brandy offers a generous medley of fruit, spices and oak.

name: Laine Napoleon  V.S.O.P. (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The brandy is light gold, very pleasing to the eye. On the nose you will find herbal notes with sweet undertones. The palate is robust blend of nut and fruit flavors with a minty finish. Perfect for brandy cocktails and high end culinary purposes.

name: Calvados Pere Magloire  12 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Softer, single distillation reflects integrally the essence of the apple favours and aromas, giving to Calvados an intense and strong taste of its origin. A perfect balance between the wood and matured apple aromas, subtlety and silkiness, blossom and orange trees with fruity aftertaste.

name: Calvados Pere Magloire  X.O. (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: The X.O. is the cornerstone of the collection. Connoisseurs appreciate the perfect balance between the fruitiness of the apple and the flavours absorbed during more than nine years of ageing in century-old oak barrels.

name: Calvados Roger  Groult 15 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: 15 year old Calvados from Pays d'Auge, made by Roger Groult, a highly respect name in the Calvados industry. An elegant and intense Calvados, rich with spiced apple pastries and vanilla.

name: Calvados Roger  Groult 8 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This is Groult's 8 year old expression, matured in old French oak casks. Alongside the ripe, intense apple notes on the nose, you'll fine hints of rancio, raisins, cinnamon spice and a subtle nuttiness.

name: Hennessy  V.S.O.P (Mini-Bar) (200 ml)
desc_en_short: The highlight of tasting Hennessy V.S.O.P is the long-lasting finish, revealing the natural balance of the blend – testament to a superior cognac. The natural balance of strength and smoothness creates a harmonious blend in which maturity combines with vigour. The structure is softened by a suggestion of fresh grape character.

name: Hennessy  Paradis Extra (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: Hennessy Paradis was created in 1979 by Maurice Fillioux. Drawing from the legacy of his grandfather eaux de vie, Maurice Fillioux gave life to this perfectly harmonious cognac. It takes its name from the Paradis cellar, a legendary place at the Hennessy Maison.

name: Hennessy  Paradis Imperial (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: A cognac of absolute elegance and refinement, Hennessy Paradis Impérial is a tribute to the blend created originally by Jean Fillioux following a request made in 1818 by the Russian Imperial Court for Tsar Alexander I, which was recreated by Yann Fillioux in 2010.

name: Hennessy  Richard (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Created by Yann Fillioux for true connoisseurs of great cognac, Richard Hennessy forms a bridge between the past and the present. This superb blend is a living testament to almost 250 years of history, talent, knowledge and expertise, encapsulating the Hennessy savoirfaire.

name: Beneroy Calvados  Fine (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Wonderful fresh apple aroma, but a very uncomplicated taste, with little blurring between the classic brandy-esque alcaholic blast and the smooth sweetness of fresh apple juice.

name: Beneroy Calvados  VSOP (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: Calvados Berneroy VSOP is rich and full-bodied with ripe apple flavours and notes of vanilla oak. Enjoy as an after-dinner drink, over ice or in variety of cocktails.

name: Beneroy Calvados  XO (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: Rich golden amber. aroma is Vanilla and butterscotch notes with a hint of citrus and light rancio. flavor is Baked and caramelized apples with buttery, slightly nutty notes and a touch of cinnamon and spice. Smooth, round and lingering.

name: Villa Zarri  10 years blened brandy (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Ancient colour, with topaz reflections shifting towards a clear mahogany colour. In its complex and fine bouquet, it is possible to identify pearl barley, sweet licorice and dried banana. As oxygenation evolves, a sensation of toasted pine kernel and soft toffee, with a vanilla ending, is sensed. When it enters the mouth it is sweet and soft, with taste sensations which remind of strawberry tree honey and candied orange, with a persistent and clean ending. A brandy endowed with an extreme personality.

name: Massenez  Pomme Prisonniere Calvados ( Prisoner Apple ) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: When it ripens, the fruit and the bottle are carefully detached. Then the bottles are cleaned and filled with Calvados. Long year of meceration gently blend the flavours of the apple and the spirit.

name: Massenez  Vieille Prune (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Clear and colourless, may acquire yellow green highlights with age; Intense, complex nose, spicy aromas assert themselves. A complex bouquet offset by sweet aromatic smoothness., At the level of aromas, the classical grasation of fruit brandies.

name: Massenez  Poire William ( William Pear ) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This Williams Pear Liqueur is part of the highly renowned specialities of the ‘SIGNATURE’ Range. The ‘’Maître Liquoriste’’ savoir-faire is evident in this Williams Pear Liqueur, exclusively presented in the emblematic pear-shaped bottle.

name: Hennessy  250 th anniversary Collector Blend (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Commemorating our 250th anniversary, The Hennessy 250 Collector Blend pays full tribute to two-and-a-half centuries of excellence, international expansion, and visionary passion. Rich and expressive on the nose, developing complex aromatic tones ranging from vegetal to spicy: bitter orange and freshly grated nutmeg, liquorice, dried peppermint leaf and delicate spices, in particular saffron. While exhibiting its power on the palate, this cognac also possesses great elegance, with wonderful persistence on the finish, a delightful nuance of spicy complexity.

name: Villa Zarri  23 years blened Brandy (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Beautiful deep amber colour with golden reflections. Intense and persistent aromas of rich tobacco, cocoa bean and leather aromas on a background od sweet vanilla. Finishes in fruity notes of plum, date and dry figs. Taste reveals a vibrant richness which is deep, round and smooth. Forceful but not aggressive. This is a spirit of full body; warm persistent entry leading to spicy Kentucky tobacco and nicotine aromas with fruity notes in support.

name: Villa Zarri  22 years Anniversary Blended Brandy (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Possessing a marvellous topaz colour with a flash of mahogany. Offering an elegant range of aromas, of which the most evident are a sensation of toffee, beeswax, crème brulée, nuts, licorice root and torrone. On the palate a soft power unfolds: the body is rich and involving, slightly spicy and carrying itself with warmth. The taste lingers aristocratically with a finale of spices and leather.

name: Villa Zarri  Cherry Brandy (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Extremely bright and transparent, it shows a ruby red colour with lively copper shades. Its scent is enveloping, full, ripe and warm fruits do not conceal a calibrated and stimulating spicy feeling. When it is smelled for a second time, its aromatic repertoire increases and an ethereal and vanilla-flavoured note hints at what will be tasted. When it is introduced into the mouth it is, indeed, sweet and seducing, its flavour combines ripe cherries with citron fruit freshness, only to return to sweet spices: first and foremost, pipe tobacco and caramel. The ending is pleasant, harmonic and underlines full and extremely refined olfactive-gustative consistency.Suggestions: our suggestion is to taste it at room temperature (18-20 degrees Celsius) at the end of a meal, either alone or along with dry cookies, desserts containing fruit jam or plain chocolate. In summer it is excellent cold, with some ice cubes. It is an excellent basis for cocktails and long drinks.

name: Villa Zarri  Nocino Liqueur (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Its colour appears to be old copper with caramel shades. When it is poured into a glass, it moves slowly, thus hinting at a very rich scent. The first olfactive impression is intense but discreet, the alcohol is not aggressive and the typical sensations of husks are well defined. Later, its aromatic potential expresses itself as a more complex bouquet, containing licorice, arugula, nutmeg and a smoked note. This bastion of Emilian traditions conquers those who taste it thanks to its refinement and aromaticity, whereas the final taste in their mouths is long, with pleasant and enveloping husk aftertaste.

name: Villa Zarri  Brandy and cofee Liquer (500 ml)
desc_en_short: As soon as it is poured into a glass, it expresses an enveloping feeling and great personality. It has a dark mahogany colour; in order to assess its transparency, it was necessary to cast some light on it: only then does it show bright cinnamon-colour shades. Its scent is striking due to its excellent refinement and complexity. Toasting is well-defined and the aromatic sensations of coffee fully exert their seduction. Its description is completed by the “sweet” sensations of soft toffee and coconut milk. When it is tasted, what had already been sensed by means of olfaction is finally experienced… sensations are mitigated and magnified by a certain discreet and charming sweetness, the end is based on a sweet/bitter marriage which makes you feel like tasting it.

name: Grand Marnier  Cuvee de Centenaire (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner

The harmonious marriage of exotic bitter orange with XO cognacs gives this Vintage remarkable finesse.

Cocktails are always an option, but will not optimize the full flavor. Hennessy V.S.O.P Privilège Limited Edition bottle has a limited supply and will only be available as they last. It is expected to sell out at a higher rate than usual.

The full, rounded taste is reflected in this sensual curves of the bottle, distinctively Baroque in its grandeur. Savour in splendid isolation or blend at will to create a distinctive cocktail.

With the prestige and class of a prized antique, it combines a rich dichotomy of flavors mingling cinnamon, floral notes, honey, spice and oak in a one of a kind blend that is exceptional after dinner or in any assortment of cocktails

An orchard is bathed in the long rays of a late September sun. It is early evening and the air is still warm, tempered by a gentle breeze. name: Pierre Ferrand  Reserve 20 Year Cognac (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Pierre Ferrand Reserve Cognac is blended solely from aged eaux de vie produced within the 1st Cru de Cognac, specifically from the Ugni Blanc and Colombard grapes grown within the Grande Champagne Cognac appellation (region) of France. Although the final spirit has no age statement, according to Guillaume Lamy, (Vice President – North America for Cognac Ferrand), this is because the spirit is blended to meet an age profile that represents a 20-year-old spirit. To maintain product consistency from year to year, the actual average age of the blended cognac will vary depending upon the cellar conditions during maturation and the interactions between the oak and the aging eaux de vie. The aroma from the glass brings forward impressions of lightly musty leather and oak spice alongside indications of dry fruit and raisins. Some lighter aromas akin to Granny Smith apples and fresh green grapes are apparent as well; but it is the darker dry fruit which is more dominant. Some honeycomb reaches up into the breezes giving an impression of light sweetness, and impressions of almond and crushed walnut round out the aroma.

name: Hine  Troimphe XO (700 ml)
desc_en_short:

An initial sip invokes a respectful silence, like a cue to take your seats at the theatre. The opening is timorous and silken with delicate suggestions of white cedar and fresh vanilla leading into a more intense palate of liquorice, chocolate and mild spices. The fruits rally in a languorous finale of caramelised apples and plums, prolonging the last delicious mouthful almost indefinitely.

name: Chatelle Napoleon  Finest Brandy (1 L)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner

In 1828, Abel Planat created CHATELLE, a rare French Brandy 
whose distinctive blend and elegant design have made it a favourite 
of connoisseurs. Planat named CHATELLE after his great-grand
father, the Châtelain (Lord) of La Faye Castle, and inscribed 
an “N” on the CHATELLE coat of arms to commemorate his 
brother’s close friendship with Emperor Napoleon I.

name: Carlos I Pedro Ximénez (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Carlos I Pedro Ximénez (PX) is a rare and luxurious expression from the legendary Bodegas Osborne, one of Spain’s most historic producers in the heart of Jerez de la Frontera. It represents the perfect harmony between aged brandy and sweet sherry, blending two of Spain’s most noble traditions into one extraordinary creation.

Named in honor of King Carlos I of Spain, this brandy is crafted through the traditional Solera Gran Reserva system, where each drop passes through layers of time and oak, maturing in sherry-seasoned casks that once held Pedro Ximénez — one of the sweetest, richest wines of Andalusia.

Over the years, the brandy absorbs the deep, luscious character of PX wine, resulting in an indulgent spirit that unites the warmth of oak with the opulence of dried fruit and caramelized sweetness.

Carlos I PX is the epitome of refinement — elegant, silky, and profoundly Spanish.

name: Domaine Trapet  Marc de Bourgogne de Chambertin 1996 (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Domaine Trapet Marc de Bourgogne de Chambertin 1996 is a masterpiece born from one of Burgundy’s most revered biodynamic estates — Domaine Trapet Père et Fils, whose roots trace back to the 19th century in Gevrey-Chambertin. Known for crafting profound, terroir-driven wines from Grand Cru vineyards, the estate carries the same philosophy into this rare Marc de Bourgogne — the distilled soul of Pinot Noir.

Produced from the pomace of Grand Cru Chambertin grapes, the marc is distilled in traditional copper alembic stills and aged patiently in oak barrels for decades. The 1996 vintage embodies time, purity, and the profound minerality of Chambertin itself — a spirit of quiet power and timeless grace.

This Marc is not merely an afterthought of winemaking; it is a liquid legacy — where the essence of Burgundy is reborn through fire and patience.

name: Domaine Trapet Marc de Bourgogne de Chambertin 1997 (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Domaine Trapet Marc de Bourgogne de Chambertin 1997 is a rare and noble expression of Burgundy’s terroir, distilled from the revered Grand Cru vineyards of Chambertin, where Domaine Trapet Père et Fils has cultivated vines biodynamically for generations.

Founded in the 19th century in Gevrey-Chambertin, Domaine Trapet is one of the few estates to carry the spirit of Burgundy beyond wine — into the art of distillation. This Marc de Bourgogne is crafted from the pomace of Pinot Noir grapes used in their legendary Chambertin wines, then distilled in traditional copper alembic stills and aged slowly in oak casks for decades.

The 1997 vintage captures a unique equilibrium — a spirit matured in silence, where time, patience, and the living energy of biodynamic viticulture intertwine to create something profoundly elegant.

Each bottle is a quiet reflection of nature’s rhythm — the spirit of Chambertin, reborn in liquid form.

name: Philippe Pacalet  Marc de Bourgogne (500 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short:
Philippe Pacalet Marc de Bourgogne is the distilled echo of Burgundy’s terroir — a rare spirit crafted by one of the region’s most respected natural winemakers, Philippe Pacalet, whose philosophy blends tradition, intuition, and authenticity.

As the nephew of legendary natural wine pioneer Marcel Lapierre, Pacalet has become a leading figure in biodynamic and non-interventionist viticulture. His wines — expressive, living, and soulful — speak of place rather than technique. This Marc de Bourgogne extends that same philosophy into distillation, transforming the pomace of Pinot Noir from Burgundy’s finest vineyards into a spirit that captures the vineyard’s true essence.

Distilled slowly in traditional copper stills and aged in neutral oak, it embodies the purity of fruit, the hum of the soil, and the quiet depth of time. It is Burgundy’s voice — distilled, not silenced.

name: Coutanseaux Aîné  Hors d'Age Cognac (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Coutanseaux Aîné is one of the historic houses of Cognac, with origins tracing back to the 18th century in Jarnac — one of the two key towns along the Charente River where France’s most prestigious brandy was born. Situated between oceanic and continental climates, the terroir of Charente offers chalk-rich soils that nurture Ugni Blanc grapes with remarkable acidity — ideal for distillation into fine eaux-de-vie. The house has long upheld the craftsmanship of double distillation in small copper pot stills (alambic charentais), aging its spirit in fine-grained Limousin oak casks. The “Hors d’Âge” expression represents its pinnacle — a blend of venerable eaux-de-vie, some matured well beyond 30 years, capturing centuries of savoir-faire and patience passed down through generations.

name: Coutanseaux Aîné XO Cognac (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Founded in 1767 in Jarnac, along the serene Charente River, Maison Coutanseaux Aîné stands among the oldest Cognac houses in France. For more than two centuries, it has remained faithful to the artistry of traditional alambic charentais distillation and the long, patient aging in fine-grained Limousin oak casks — where time, wood, and air converge in quiet perfection.

The XO (Extra Old) expression reflects the house’s mastery of balance — where youthful energy meets the grace of maturity. Each blend contains eaux-de-vie aged no less than 10 years, many of which have rested far longer. The result is a Cognac that captures both vitality and wisdom — a timeless dialogue between fruit, oak, and air.

Coutanseaux Aîné XO is not just a fine spirit; it is time, transformed into liquid poetry — a reflection of patience, tradition, and the natural rhythm of the Charente.

In 1870, the Master Blender Emile Fillioux crafted a special blend for Maurice Hennessy. More than 150 years later, Hennessy's powerful, balanced "Extra Old" blend remains the cognac of choice for sharing with one's inner circle.

Hennessy celebrates Lunar New Year 2026 with a limited edition X.O, honoring the Year of the Horse. The artistic design captures the animal's energy and grace with equine motifs on a dark red neck capsule and an eco-designed cream gift box with gold accents. The X.O carafe, adorned with a vibrant red and gold label, is an ideal gift for art and exceptional cognac lovers.

The disruptive personality of Martell Noblige Flame is expressed to perfection in its design, with the iconic, drop-shaped bottle of Martell Noblige seemingly consumed by fire. Scorching orange flames and swirls of deep blue smoke curl up its smooth surfaces, anticipating the sensations inside.

name: Dartigalongue Diva  Hors d' Age (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Dartigalongue Diva Hors d' Age is a premium Bas Armagnac from the historic Dartigalongue distillery, known for its "beyond age" (Hors d'Âge) blend of eaux-de-vie aged at least 10 years in Gascony oak, offering rich notes of vanilla, dried fruits (plums, figs), caramel, and spices, presented in a distinctive Diva carafe, making it an elegant, complex spirit for sipping neat or with desserts like chocolate fondant.

name: Drouet Cognac X.O. Ulysse  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Drouet Cognac X.O. Ulysse is a premium Grande Champagne Premier Cru cognac produced by the fourth-generation family estate, Domaine Drouet. Named in honor of the current director’s great-grandfather, Ulysse Dumargue, this cuvée is a blend of aged eaux-de-vie representing the work of several generations.

name: Baron De Sigognac Carafe 25 Ans  (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short:
Baron de Sigognac is one of the historic names of Bas-Armagnac, rooted in Gascony, southwestern France—a region often described as the “soulful counterpart” to Cognac. Unlike many large houses, Baron de Sigognac has long focused on estate-grown grapes, traditional column distillation, and extended aging in local oak, allowing time to shape character rather than chasing uniformity.

The Carafe 25 Ans represents decades of patience. Distilled from carefully selected eaux-de-vie and aged slowly in oak cellars, this Armagnac reflects a philosophy where oxidation, evaporation, and time are collaborators. The carafe presentation itself echoes old-world hospitality—designed not to impress loudly, but to signal maturity, confidence, and respect for tradition.

name: Francois Voyer Hors d'Age Cristal  (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
François Voyer Hors d’Âge Cristal is a Cognac that speaks quietly—but with authority. Crafted exclusively from Grande Champagne, the most prestigious cru of Cognac, this expression is built on time, patience, and restraint rather than power or intensity.

The eaux-de-vie selected for Hors d’Âge Cristal are aged far beyond the minimum requirement, distilled on the lees and matured slowly in French oak. Instead of pushing oak influence, François Voyer allows oxygen, chalky terroir, and long aging to shape the spirit naturally. The result is a Cognac of clarity and balance—pure, precise, and deeply composed, true to the name Cristal.

This is not a Cognac designed to impress instantly, but one that reveals itself gradually, rewarding attention and stillness.

name: Primator  Double  500ml x 20

Exact proportions of ingredients (five kinds of malt - Czech, Bavarian, caramel, coloring and wheat) give the foundation of the taste, which is dominated by roasted malts. The high content of pure extract cause a burst of energy and enlivens the senses. Therefore, it is recommended as a "beer aperitif". A jet-black rich dark brew with a creamy head comes into its own in tall stemmed glasses to highlight this unique jewel of the Náchod brewery. Great for desserts and cakes and surprisingly suitable for spicy foods. It is a sensual gourmet taste.

name: Phuket  Lagar  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: This is Thailand’s first regional beer. Brewed with premium German hops and high-quality Thai jasmine rice, Phuket Beer is the first Thai beer to win a gold medal in competition. It smells similar to a European lager with an aroma of cereal grains, sweet malts, and grassy hops. Phuket Beer is ultra-light and easy to drink with a slightly metallic finish.

name: Founders  Porter (355 ml) (Pack 12)
desc_en_short: Pours silky black with a creamy tan head. The nose is sweet with strong chocolate and caramel malt presence. No absence of hops gives Founders’ robust porter the full flavor you deserve and expect. Cozy like velvet. It’s a lover, not a fighter.

name: Stone  IPA (355 ml) (Pack 12) (Can)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: This is the IPA that initiated our reputation for hops and exposed a budding world of craft beer enthusiasts to our unique brewing style. Distinguished by bright, hop-driven flavours, this is the IPA that launched generations of hop fanatics in the U.S. We now present our hoppy standard-bearer to those in Europe eager to worship at the altar of the almighty hop.

name: Stone  Delicious IPA (355 ml) (Pack 12)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Stone Delicious IPA is a tangible example of why continual IPA and hop exploration are so fulfilling. With the Lemondrop varietal as a centerpiece and a massive dry hop composed exclusively of lemony El Dorado hops from Washington State, this beer lives up to its name behind a plethora of tart, citrusy notes and a stunning grove-like, lemon tree bouquet, providing a graceful yet in no way subtle one-two punch to the senses.

name: Bussaba  Ex Weisse  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short:
The German’s weissbier style from Wheat, Pilsner and Munich malts. Golden hue in color, pours white foamy heads with great bodied. Refreshing ripe tropical fruit and clove notes with a hint of fresh-cut bouquet aroma befitting its name:“Bussaba”, the most beautifully scented woman in Thai literature.
Smooth and crisp with character.

name: Leffe  Vieille Cuvee  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Pours a dark amber colour with a large, thick, white head. Aroma of strong dark fruits and alcohol. Flavour of caramel malts, strong plums, orange and bitter hops. Medium bodied, quite rich mouthfeel and a finish of plums and caramel. Overall a rich Belgian strong ale with loads of fruitiness.

name: Stone Head  7 Day Witbier  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: A belgian witbier brewed with seven diffent kinds of thai origin orange peel giving the beer very fruity complex outstanding tropical flavour..

name: Stone Head  Butterfly Pea Wheat  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: This wheat beer will surprise you with its strange violet color brewed violet chicken pea flower which commonly use in Thailand to make refreshing sweet lime tea as a welcoming gesture.

name: Stone Head  Koh Kong Pale Ale  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Koh Kong is the name of a cambodian border town that we refuge to brew here away from Thailand. Nice gloden color come with strong malt character from speciality malt and balanced with new world hops to give a good bitterness backbone.

name: Stone Head  Tire Burning Weizen  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Classic refreshing Weizen give the nose of banana a little bit of clove. it's a kind of beer you can drink all night long.

name: Stone Head  Tuk Tuk Cream Ale  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: With in-between lager and ale styles, this cream ale presents a well balanced and refreshing taste with fine aroma from Hallertau and Sazz hops. After all, with a familiar taste yet new mouth-feel and aroma make Tuk Tuk Cream Ale a great first step to step into the craftbeers' world.

name: Stone Head  Coconut Cream Ale  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Stone Head  Coconut Cream Ale is  Good mouthfeel, nice and smooth with a mellow taste. The coconut, however.

name: Stone Head  Lemon Grass Kolsch  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Poured a clear straw colour with a thin broken white head. The aroma is yeast, lemongrass, light hop. The flavour is light bitter sweet with a light, watery, dry, mineral, lemongrass, hop bitter palate. Medium to light bodied with average carbonation.

name: Stone Head  The Dark Side Stout  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Poured a clear dark brown with a frothy tan head. The aroma is roasty, light smoke malt, some chocolate, liqourice. The flavour is liqourice bitter, light sweet with a rich, smooth, roasty liqourice, light floral hop bitter palate. Medium to full bodied with soft carbonation.

name: Mahanakorn  White Ale CAN 330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Poured a hazy straw colour with a bubbly round white head. The aroma is light banana light fruit, some grainy yeast. The flavour is light acid citrus with a light grainy earthly light floral hop palate. Medium bodied with soft carbonation.

name: Triple Pearl  Weisse Peral  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Poured a hazy medium amber with a bubbly round head. The aroma is banana grainy sweet malt. The flavour is moderate sweet with a light malty yeast crushed banana palate. Medium bodied with soft carbonation. Super sweet for a Weizen. Becomes a little sickly after a while.

name: Spacecraft  Liberty One  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: The Liberty One is a Wheat Beer and IPA hybrid. It takes its sweetness from the wheat and its bitterness from the hops of the IPA. It results in a refreshing bitter-sweet blond beer.

name: Beat  A-Go-Go IPA  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Poured a hazy medium amber with a thin white head. The aroma is malt, citrus fruit, resin hops. The flavour is moderate bitter, light sweet with a rich, resin, light floral toothpaste hop bitter palate. Medium bodied with average carbonation.

name: Mystic  Cherry  250ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: It smells fresh and tasty and has the full flavour of summer cherries combined with wheat beer. Mystic lets you enjoy the taste of cherries all year round.

name: Mystic  Radler  250ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: An extremely refreshing combination of wheat beer, lemon juice and lime juice. Easily drinkable because of its low alcohol percentage. No preservatives.

name: Mystic  Peach  250ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: It smells fresh and tasty and has the full flavour of sun-ripened peaches combined with wheat beer. Contains 26% peach juice. No preservatives..

name: Tongerlo  Prior  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: A full-bodied beer with fruity notes that develop into a spicy and slightly flowery bitterness of hops.

name: Tongerlo  Blonde  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine

name: Tongerlo  Brune  330ml x 24

name: Charles Quint  Blonde  330ml x 24

name: Charles Quint  Red Ruby  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Charles Quint Ruby Red is a dark, top-fermented specialty beer with a smooth and fruity aroma that ends in a mildly sweet aftertaste of hops.

name: Charles Quint  Ommegang  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Ommegang is a bright yellow-coloured, top-fermented beer with a delicate aroma of citrus fruits. The flowery and spicy taste of the Belgian hops develops into a complex bitterness. Re-fermentation in the bottle ensures that the taste and aromas come perfectly to the fore.

name: San Miguel  Light  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Clear golden colour with one finger frothy white head, retention is actually not bad. Aroma: pale malts, cereal, the beginnings of skunkiness. Taste: light sweet malt, faint fruity note, strange aftertaste. Light watery body, average carbonation.

The aroma is slightly hoppy with a little sour citrus feel. It’s quite light in its taste with some hints of smooth malts and white rice. Kirin Ichiban has low to zero bitterness.

name: Mandrin Walnut  330ml x 12
desc_en_short: The walnut beer was the first Mandrin beer, created after years of research and trials. and no flavoring but only real walnuts inside! Deep amber, round and flavorful this real ale will reveal at 10 Celsius being a delicacy with subtle nutty aftertaste on its long finish.

name: Mandrin Wheat Beer 7 Alphine Plants  330ml x 12
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Harvested in the Alps, the 7 aromatic plants provide an amazing flavor to the lightest Mandrin beer. Wheat and oat bring lightness and cloudy dress. This wheat beer is thirst-quenching and refreshing, and its delicately acidic flavor makes it suitable for drinking fresh (5 Celsius) at any time of the day.

name: Mandrin  Triple Hop  330ml x 12
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Inspired of IPA style (Indian Pale Ale), it is a bitter and aromatic beer that stays perfectly balanced. Initially supposed to be a unique brew celebrating the 10th anniversary of the brewery, this IPA has become a must taste. The type of hop added during lagering (dry hopping) varies from brew to brew, bringing either citrus or exotic fruits or red fruits aromas. This amber ale lets discover around 6 Celsius a hoppy aromatic explosion enhanced by fine oak nuances.

name: Mandrin  Spruce Strong Ale  330ml x 12
desc_en_short: Surprising resinous and spicy flavors of this strong ale let us travel into the forests of the Alps. The nice amber dress lets discover around 8 Celsius a hot temper sweetened by its round body with virtually no bitterness.

name: Mandrin  Honey Pale Ale  330ml x 12
desc_en_short: The honey is used by the yeast during bottle conditioning to provide the tiny bubbles. Behind the sweet flavors of chestnut honey, hides a spicy personality to be discovered around 5 Celsius.

name: Mandrin  Hemp Pale Ale  330ml x 12
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Hemp is a fascinating plant. Such as hops, it is part of the family Cannabinaceae. Used by human being for 8000 years in paper, clothes, buildings... From a gustatory point of view it brings some grapefruit, citrus aromas, such as some American hops. The Mandrin Hemp beer is a golden pale ale being both refreshing and relaxing. Its delicate bitterness and subtle citrus notes will be best felt around 5 Celsius.

name: Hoegaarden  Radler Lemon&Lime  250ml x 24
desc_en_short: Hoegaarden Radler Lemon and Lime is blond coloured and has quite a full and creamy head. This glorious craft beer has a beautiful body and a wonderful aroma.

name: Hoegaarden  Wit Blanche  500ml x 24
desc_en_short: Hoegaarden Wit-Blanche Original is a distinctive and unfiltered Belgian wheat beer. With an aroma of orange peel, coriander, and spice, its characteristic taste is entirely unique: smooth, light-bodied, and simultaneously sweet and sour, with a subtle, spiced citrus flavour.

name: Hoegaarden  Witbier Bottle Set of 5 with Glass 330ml x 1
desc_en_short:
4 X Hoegaarden Witbier Bottle (330 ml) & 1 X Hoegaarden Glass

Hoegaarden Witbier Bottle (330 ml)

500 years of hard work went into making this beer that features the aroma of orange peel, coriander and herbs that the merry monks imported from sunny Curacao. Speaking of which: pouring Hoegaarden is just like letting the sun fall into your glass: light yellow and naturally murky. And the soft foam adds a cloudy finish. And then there’s the soft taste, light and slightly sweet and sour and with subtle citrus notes… ah, just go ahead and taste it instead of reading about it!

Hoegaarden Glass
