name: Hawkshead  Windermere Pale  330ml x 12
desc_en_short: A highly refreshing, very pale ale, bursting with hop character and a fine fruity aroma. Brewed with soft Lakeland water, Maris Otter malted barley and full flower hops - blending three traditional English hops and the modern American hop, Citra.

name: Hawkshead  NZPA (New Zealand Pale Ale ) 330ml x 12
desc_en_short: Brewed with several varieties of New Zealand hops and created by a Kiwi, Head Brewer Matt Clarke. Passionfruit, mango and apricot aromas and a citrus bitterness are balanced by the sweetness of English Maris Otter barley to produce an extraordinary beer which showcases the unique hops of New Zealand.

name: Super Bock  Original  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Winner of 28 consecutive gold medals at the prestigious Monde Selection competition, SUPER BOCK Original is recognized internationally for its high quality. Despite these credentials brewers, true conquest of Super Bock is the millions of loyal fans around the world who can not resist its unique taste.

name: Super Bock  Abadia  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Super Bock Abadia is the first beer produced in Portugal using the traditional recipe. Super Bock Abadia is characterised by a rich aroma, stronger and embodied, fruited and alive, with a smooth and comforting taste and the most intense colour due to the use of special varieties of malt.

name: Super Bock  Stout  330ml x 24
desc_en_short: Super Bock Stout is Super Bock's special black beer, produced from special pale malt, caramel malt and chocolate malt, which gives it a distinct flavour and aroma, and a long-lasting creamy head.

name: Chao Siam  Wit Bier  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: This is a Wit Bier that was made for the Thai palate. This beer has been made to compliment the hot tropical climate of Thailand through the beer having low bitterness level with a clean aroma of Citrus. We made the body of this beer to very light, so the drinker can continue drinking with out being full. This is a beer that appeals to Males and Females.

name: Chao Siam  India Pale Ale  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Light IPA compared to everyone else in the market place. Tropical fruits aroma really pairs with the tropical weather in Thailand. The body of the IPA is light, which means the consumer can drink a few instead of just one. The beer has a low IBU because Thai don’t like their beers too bitter. Great beer to food paired with. High growing segment in the Craft Beer category.

name: Chao Siam  Pale Ale  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Very light mouth feel, Passion fruit aroma, very sessionable, suits to drink the beer in the hot tropical climate without feeling too full, the beer was specially made for Thai people to enjoy. The beer has a low IBU because Thai don’t like their beers too bitter. Great beer to be food paired with. High growing segment in the Craft Beer category.

name: La Chouffe  1.5L x 1
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: The Magnum bottle of La Chouffe (1.5 l) is an original gift that is unanimously appreciated. The back of the silk-screen printed bottle has a decorative feature created by a different designer each year. Create a collection.

name: Andaman  Phuket Dark Ale  330ml x 24
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: This year, we celebrate our origins with the relaunch of our 2009 Andaman Phuket Dark Ale, the British-inspired ale, taking us back in time to when it all started. Andaman Phuket Dark Ale was our brewery's very first recipe. Now we have reinvented it with new twist. This treasure for beer lovers is brewed with No.19 Floor-Malting Maris Otter, the rarest malt in the world today due to the niche artisanal process involved in its production. Experience the rich malty aroma and flavour - light biscuit and caramel, softly accentuated with an espresso finish. The ale boasts medium carbonation, just enough to invigorate in the tropical heat. Andaman Phuket Dark Ale is for those who hunt for the adventures of taste, always yearn for more, and appreciate styles with substances.

name: Brothers Cider  Rhubarb & Custard  500ml x 12
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Made by 4 brothers in Somerset. Working together, finding the perfect balance and making ciders that are wondrously irreplaceable. This unique combination delivers the flavours of crisp, tangy rhubarb and smooth, creamy custard. Curiously original. Serve chilled over ice.

name: Duvel  Barrel Aged Batch No.4 (750 ml)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: The Duvel brewers have not been sitting still in recent months, but their specialty beer has been doing just that. Around three hundred barrels from well-known American bourbon distilleries found their way to Belgium and were given a second life at the brewery. The oak barrels from Heaven Hill, Woodford Reserve, Four Roses, George Dickel and Jack Daniels were christened by the Duvel brewers with the golden specialty beer and the Duvel beers will rest in the barrels for nine months. This fall, you can end a cosy dinner by a crackling fire with a glass of Duvel Barrel Aged. This powerful taste sensation from Duvel with bourbon aromas can be tasted as of now And because the Duvel brewers like to spoil their fans, Duvel Barrel Aged comes in a new, revamped gift box.

name: Chouffe  Cherry  330ml x 12
desc_en_short: This is the latest addition to the Achouffe Brewery... The aroma of Cherry CHOUFFE gives pride of place to cherries. It also reveals notes of strawberry, almond, spices and sweet Port. Round-bodied, soft and delicate, Cherry CHOUFFE delights the gourmands among us. It has a satisfying finish, with a very slight bitterness.

name: Weihenstephaner  1516 Kellerbier (500 ml) (Pack 20)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: 1516 Kellerbier is full-bodied with a pleasant caramel note and a rich amber color. During the extended maturation period, the bottom-fermenting yeast sediments at the bottom of the tank, leaving the beer with a slightly opalescent cloudiness, part of its characteristic appearance. The balanced hop note rounds out the flavor perfectly.

name: Birra Morena  Classica (330 ml) (Pack 24 )
desc_en_short:
Birra Morena is an Italian brewery belonging to Tarricone family. It is the winning combination of a love history with raw materials and an uncontaminated territory. It is Lucania a region of southern Italy that is capable of producing high quality beers, internationally award.

Tasting Notes :

Well structured, with flavour notes of biscuit and a good balance between sweet malt and bitter hop.

name: Deschutes  Fresh Haze IPA (355 ml) (Pack 12) (Can)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: 91 Rating - "Haze with a 1990s craft throwback nose—malty, with more estery fruit notes than hops. The sip highlights berry with a bit of orange and tropical fruit. Fun in its retro-malty simplicity." —Craft Beer and Brewing

name: Rogue  Dreamland American Lager (355 ml) (Pack 12) (Can)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: This beer was born from a dream. A dream to renovate our hometown skatepark in Newport, Oregon to give our community a safe and clean place to skate. The incredible people at Dreamland Skateparks helped make our dream a reality and with them we want to help others realize their dream. So we brewed Dreamland American Lager, a simple, crisp lager from which a portion of the proceeds will go toward building skateparks around the world. Welcome to Dreamland.

name: Stone  Tangerine Express Hazy IPA (355 ml) (Pack 12) (Can)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Working with fruit can be amazing and so using amazing quality fruit is key to achieving that wonderful freshness. The high-end pureed fruit selected here blends exceptionally well with the aroma and flavors from the hops, creating a multi-layered IPA that also has fresh hoppy dankness and bitterness that superbly rounds out this beer.

name: Founders  Solid Gold (355 ml) (Pack 12) (Can)
food_matching: Pizza, Burgers, Fried Food, Spicy Cuisine
desc_en_short: Our brewery was built on an attitude of no regrets. An attitude of taking risks to bring the best beer possible to our fellow renegades and rebels. Never brewing to style, but always brewing what we want to drink. Our take on a classic, Solid Gold is a drinkable premium lager brewed with the highest quality ingredients. Challenging what a lager can be? That’s something we won’t regret.

name: Founders  Moon Rambler IPA (355 ml) (Pack 12) (Can)
desc_en_short: Moon Rambler IPA touches down with a big dose of Azacca, Mosaic and Cascade hops that provide a blast of tropical fruitiness, assisted by a classic foundation of wheat and oats. Milk sugar is added to create a sweet yet slight creaminess; giving it a round mouth feel, remarkably less bitter taste and fuller body than your typical IPA. Ramble on.

name: Chalong Bay  Tropical Set (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Chalong Bay Tropical Notes defies convention by releasing the aroma of each ingredient in a profoundly authentic and balanced way. Each flavor is given full expression in its purest form that’s both exotic and subtle.

name: Leblon Cachaca  Superior De Cana (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Combining traditional approaches with creative European winemaking techniques to create a Cachaça that is extra special. Gilles Merlet, famous master distiller from the Cognac region of France, takes Cachaça to a whole new level with his ‘French touch,’ transforming our distillery in Patos de Minas to the state-of-the-art Maison Leblon.

name: Cachaca  Aguacana (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: The Aguacana Cachaça originally from Brazil, comes exclusively from the sugarcane juice of sun-kissed plantations. Enjoy its bouquet of rich, fruity aromas. Ideal for the preparation of cocktails, such as the famous Caipirinha.

name: Abelha  Silver Cachaca (750 ml)
desc_en_short: aromatic rich fruity nose; full body with light sweetness of fresh sugar cane and hints of plantain....perfect for caipirinhas, ultimately mixable. Unmistakable

name: Weber Haus  Aged Organic Cachaca (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Pure golden color, sweet, wood bouquet, complex, impressive finish.Aged 1 year in amburana wood barrels. To be enjoyed neat, after dinner or with a cigar. Organic Product

name: Engenho  Cachaca Tradicional (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Produced only 10 000 liters a year, Engenho da Vertente is undeniably the best cachaça in the region of São Paulo. For this, it is distilled in copper stills from canes growing on the property.Finally it is completely unfiltered before bottling to preserve the character

name: Sagatiba  Preciosa 21 Year (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Preciosa as 'an elegant and poised aged cane spirit with a great balance subtlety, power, and finesse,' and awarded it 96 out of 100 points; making it the only cachaca in the world in the Superlative Category of 96 points and over.

name: Capucana  Cachaca (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: CapuCana translates as 'sugar-cane house'. Distilled in the Piracicaba region of Brazil and aged for three years, this is a citrusy style of cachaça that is excellent as a base for cocktails.

name: Yaguara  Branca Cachaca (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Yaguara Branca is our classic small batch white cachaça. Having taken the heart of the distillation process we rest the liquid in inox for 8 months to breathe. The result is a smooth rustic cachaça making it perfect for Brazil’s most famous cocktail the caipirinha.

name: Yaguara  Blue Cachaca (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: The finest white cachaça in the world (at least we think so). Yaguara blended is an organic artisanal blend of 10 month rested cachaça and the Meneghel family recipe of aging it in European Oak barrels for 5 to 6 years. The result is an refined award winning liquid which aims to take cachaça into the wider cocktail world and push the boundaries of Brazils national spirit.

name: Yaguara  Ouro Cachaca (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Yaguara’s first expression of aged cachaça. Ouro follows on our passion for exploring the new flavours and taste profiles that Brazilian woods can provide. Ouro is a blend of two native woods Cabreúva and Amburana together with American Oak. Lovely for sipping neat but also and an extremely funky liquid to play with in cocktails.

name: Sagatiba Cristalina Cachaca (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: The world's first premium Cachaça is multi-distilled to retain distinct flavour characteristics with a soft aroma that's fresh, lively and delicate. Sagatiba is highly versatile in classic cocktails and is crafted to inspire creative mixology.

name: Cachaca Maracatu (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Maracatu Cachaça is hand crafted in small batches in a boutique distillery based on century old techniques in a copper pot still. The distillery is located in the Paraty region of Brazil which is known to produce the best cachaça in the world. Maracatu Cachaça – The true flavour of Brazilian Cachaça!

name: Sluar Major Johnson  Gin  (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes

name: Cambridge  Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Cambridge Gin, Spring – Summer 2013, is the first in a series of seasonal blends from The Cambridge Distillery, a nano-distillery here in the university town of Cambridge.

name: Larios  Dry Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Larios is the number one gin in spain and continental Europe, and is the fourth best-selling gin world-wide. Light, floral and fruity nose with subdued juniper and citrus in aromas. Very mellow palate with delicate juniper, pronounced coriander and orange zest. Very light spice. Peppery orange lightly juniper finish. Overall lacks personality but difficult to fault.

name: Ginebra Xoriguer (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Xoriguer Gin is a designation of origin Mahon-Menorca, 38.0% alc. / Vol., Which was first manufactured in the early twentieth century. The final taste is brilliant and transparent, light-bodied, with soft scent of juniper, herbs and fruit, and flavor of juniper wood and herbs like rosemary and thyme with prolonged taste.

name: Ginebra Xoriguer  Caneca (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Xoriguer Mahon, in its tradicional clay jar Caneca, is the product of the distillation, at the old copper stills, of ethyl alcohol of high quality with juniper berry selected from mountains of the Mediterranean surrounding lands, and other aromatic herbs

name: Bitter Truth  Pink Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The nose of this flavoured gin is dominated by complex fruity and floral aromas. The taste is very smooth with distinctive flavors of juniper berries in the foreground surrounded by spicy flavors of licorice, caraway and fennel.

name: Dictador  Ortodoxy (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Gin is full of light and body, proof of its quality and clarity. On the nose it displays a balance of the bitterness of the roots, the freshness of the botanicals In the mouth it is flavourful and smooth, along with the astringency

name: Dictador  Treasure (700 ml)
desc_en_short: In the glass it has a slight amber colour The initial aroma is of tangerine enhanced with lemon notes. The secondary aroma is of the botanicals that provide the freshness and balance. The pleasant notes and roundness from the tangerine, lemon, mint and pepper, with the traditional flavours of gin

name: Boxer  (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The main balance of flavours is between fresh juniper and our triumvirate of citrus - lemon, orange and bergamot. This extra dry balance is set against a background of rich, woody spice and aromatic floral roots.

name: Martin Miller's  Westbourne Strength (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The Westbourne strength is bottled at 45.2% ABV (90 Proof), and this means the juniper will dominate this time, with a richer, spicier mouthfeel, though it then ends with the same soft and gentle finish. I think they are both bloody marvelous, and hope you do too!”

name: Damrak Gin  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Damrak Gin has a sweet orange aroma giving way to candied pine. On the palate, the citrus leads followed by licorice, coriander, and a subtle juniper glavour.

name: Hanami Dry Gin  (Sakura Gin) (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: It's not for nothing that the Samurai have chosen their true symbol of the fragile cherry blossom. Like a petal dropping in the morning sun and serene floating to earth , so must the gin courageously apart from life, silent and inwardly unmoved let. Hanami dry gin is a unique dry gin distilled from traditional botanicals such as coriander , angelica, juniper berries and bitter orange. In addition, the cherry blossom is exceptional and balanced gin for all lovers of gin.

name: Filliers  Dry Gin 28 (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Originally created in 1928 by Firmin Filliers, Filliers Dry Gin 28 also uses 28 botanicals in addition to juniper. It is a small batch gin created in copper stills.

name: Filliers Dry Gin 28  "Barrels Aged" (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Very subtle nose. Hints of juniper, mint, garden peas, vanilla and light mentholated note are apparent. A touch of vanilla. Very subtle botanicals – juniper, coriander, orange and a touch of bitter spice. Medium length with lingering juniper..

name: Filliers Dry Gin 28  "Targerine" (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Based on the original Filliers Dry Gin 28 recipe, this seasonal edition has been created by Master Distiller Pedro Saez Del Burgo using the finest tangerines from Valencia, harvested exclusively between November and January.This limited edition, small batch, copper pot-distilled gin is produced at the Filliers distillery, where top quality genever and other spirits have been created under the watchful eye of 5 generations of the Filliers family for well over a century.

name: Filliers Dry Gin 28  "Pine Blossom" (500 ml)
desc_en_short: From Belgian distillers Filliers' comes another variation on their Dry Gin 28, this time featuring a fresh breeze of pine blossom running through its centre. Rich and earthy, the Filliers' Dry Gin 28 Pine Blossom is intensely refreshing and easily stands out in cocktails.

name: Christie's  London Dry Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Christie's London Dry Gin made from fine spirits of the best cereals, flavored with juniper berries together. Has aroma and intense flavors that make it great drunk neat and particularly suitable as a base for cocktails and long drinks.

name: Kristall  Thai Spirit Gin Limited Batch (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Kristall Thai Spirit  producing a molasses-based white rum, as well as premium vodka and gin made from organic rice, this beverage company employs Nikolaus Prachensky — of Chiang Mai’s award-winning Edelbrand distillery — as their master distiller.

name: Burnett’s  London Dry Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Burnett’s Gin is a true London distilled dry gin produced according to the original recipe established in 1770 by Sir Robert Burnett. Spirits and selected botanicals are distilled together to deliver a distinctive flavor. Burnett’s is a full-flavored gin that delivers a crisp, refreshing taste. Explore the world of Burnett’s Gin with recipes that are adventurous and relaxed.

name: Rogue Society  Dry Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: From the bottom of the world comes a gin that's turned tradition upside down! Big, fresh nose with pronounced aromatic intensity. A place where juniper, orange peel and deep spice dominate. Vibrant in the mouth. Citrus and juniper enjoy dominance. Smooth but crisp on the palate. Long and flavor filled finish.

name: Ungava  Canadian Premium Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Its particular aroma can be traced back to six rare botanicals, native to the Arctic region, from which it is made. Handpicked in the wild during the fleeting summer season, then infused the traditional way, they are handcrafted into an authentic gin with a unique taste.

name: Grandma Jinn (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The love child/ experimental collaboration effort between the people behind Lamai Thai rums and the uber nerds over at Bootleggers. With their powers combined they have brought forth the idea of a gin that is mainly meant for mixing. Not your typical of gins from the get go but do not fear! The idea was to create a gin that just has the flavors of Thailand itself. Using local ingredients such as the safflower on top of its sugarcane base. With its earthy notes yet sweet taste should be a great base for those who are into or are thinking of taking a try at mixing.

name: Citadelle  Reserve Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
“Barrel aging tends to tame the flower and citrus feel of the gin and enhances the rounder, softer notes”

“It is important to know that our goal is not to use as many botanicals as possible but instead, the botanicals are used to bring forward and enhance the classic taste of juniper berries that make a classic gin.” - Alexandre Gabriel, Five generations of master distillers.

Award : 

World Gin Awards - Category Gold 2019

name: X-Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: X-Gin combines juniper berry with 15 herbs and several of the best spices known to man. It has the taste of passion with a hint of cocoa and the tiniest whiff of vanilla. Its pure and soft aromas provoke an intense feeling of pleasure.

name: Ferdinand's  Saar Dry Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Ferdinand's Saar Dry Gin features a particularly intricate recipe, with 30 different botanicals in the mix, including thyme, sloe and rose hip, among (many) others. As if that wasn't enough, the German distillers add a very specific amount of fruity, semi-sweet Riesling. There's lots going on in Ferdinand's Saar Dry Gin, but it's all well balanced and yummy - it's really quite an experience!

name: Ferdinand's  Saar Quince Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: The Quince Gin is infused with 2011 Rausch Kabinett, which in 2013 was awarded 92 points by Gault Millau and was distinguished as the best cabinet wine of the year. The Royal Prussian District Forester Ferdinand Geltz not only gave his name to this Riesling-infused Saar Dry Gin but he was also the historical co-founder of the VDP Mosel-Saar-Ruwer growers’ group. This golden gin from the Saar symbolises the perfect balance between sweet, sour and bitter.

name: Gin Mare  Mediterranean Gin (1.75 L)
desc_en_short: The finest botanicals are selected from across the Mediterranean, coming together to create a carefully hand-crafted gin that stands out as being savory and unique. Herbaceous on the nose, with thyme and juniper dominating, but also a presence of olives, and a wonderful explosion of rosemary, basil & coriander when tasted

name: Ungava  Canadian Premium Gin (1 L)
desc_en_short: Its particular aroma can be traced back to six rare botanicals, native to the Arctic region, from which it is made. Handpicked in the wild during the fleeting summer season, then infused the traditional way, they are handcrafted into an authentic gin with a unique taste.

name: Williams Chase  Great British Extra Dry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: To create Williams GB Extra Dry Gin, we first had to create the World’s Best Vodka. Made using potatoes from our family farm in Herefordshire, Williams GB Extra Dry Gin is unlike most other gins where a neutral grain spirit is simply redistilled. Juniper buds and berries are used to ensure the gin is as dry as possible, also infused with wild botanicals including cinnamon, nutmeg, ginger, almond, coriander, cardamom, cloves, liquorice and lemon to give the spirit a distinct and robust flavour.

name: Whitley Neill  Handcraft Dry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
WHITLEY NEILL is slightly softer than more traditional gins and very smooth with rich juniper and citrus, pot pourri and exotic spices. The finish is a long one with a subtle fade of herbs, cocoa and candied lemon peels, while the nose is both citrusy sweet and peppery, with a distinctive floral aroma. Suitable for both vegetarians and vegans.

Awards :

Gold - Gin 2020 : San Francisco World Spirits Competition

name: Whitley Neill  Quince Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A Handcrafted Gin of exceptional quality. Inspired by the timeless flavours of Persia. The juice of the Turkish Quince adds Apple-Sharp, Pear-Sweet high notes to the smooth English Gin base, for a unique Alluring Taste that's as rich as its Ancestry. Handcrafted dry gin, Inspired by Persia

name: J.J.Whitley  Elderflower Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This elderflower gin has soft scents of juniper, coriander and cinnamon to create a sweet velvety sensation and a fresh, floral bouquet.

name: Liverpool  Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: A fantastically sharp gin blended with hand picked botanicals and grain spirit. Made from the finest ingredients from the quayside including juniper berries, coriander, angelica roots and citrus fruits which results in an excellently balanced yet complex gin.

name: City of London  Dry Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
City of London is a one-shot connoisseur’s London Dry Gin, flavoured with a fine balance of juniper berries, angelica, liquorice and coriander seeds – with fresh orange, lemon and pink grapefruit added also to give the gin its distinctive zesty notes.

Awards :

Gold - Gin - 2020 : San Francisco World Spirits Competition

name: City of London  Old Tom (700 ml)
desc_en_short: City of London Old Tom Gin is an authentic Old Tom; it’s lightly sweetened and combines a hint of warm spice flavour with lingering zesty citrus notes.

name: City of London  Sloe Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: City of London Sloe Gin is rich in colour, rich in taste and made with London dry gin steeped for many months with blackthorn berries.

name: Belgravia  London Dry Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Belgravia Gin is a traditional London Dry Gin that is easy to drink and bursting with original gin flavours. It is easily mixable and adds a kick to a variety of clear gin based cocktails, it’s also wonderfully refreshing over ice.

name: MOM  God Save The Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A premium gin made with exotic botanicals and berries. Infused after four distillations to achieve an amazing purity and class. Produced and bottled in Great Britain. Carefully crafted to bring you a unique smoothness, vibrant berry taste and a distinctively sweet finish.

name: The London No.1  Original Blue Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The London No.1 was created to both be visually striking and to make the perfect G&T. The London No.1 is produced using the highest quality English grain spirit and the purest spring water found in the north of London with a unique blend of 12 botanicals. It is then triple distilled under the expert direction of Master Distiller, Charles Maxwell. (p) The unique blue colour of London No 1 comes from the inclusion of Gardenia flowers, a favourite plant of Queen Victoria.

name: Whitley Neill  Raspberry Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The Whitley Neill range continues to expand! Their very own Raspberry Gin was launched right at the start of 2018, featuring Scottish raspberries at its core alongside punchy notes of liquoirce and coriander in support. Destined to be splashed into a glass of sparkling wine, this stuff.

name: Liverpool   Rose Petal Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Proudly distilled in Liverpool, Liverpool Gin Rose Petal is created using a secret blend of botanicals. Combining the timeless decadence of rose petals to create a drink full of romance, with a tenderly fragrant nose and delicate brush of the palate awaiting every suitor.
 
Delicate and aromatic, a tenderly fragrant nose gives way to an enticingly soft mouthfeel and subtle flavours of rose and juniper on the palate. A deliciously different gin that is best enjoyed over ice with tonic.

name: Elephant  London Dry Gin (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
The gin’s nose yields a subtle juniper aroma with an undertone of mountain pine and other herbaceous notes. The taste is complex but strikingly smooth encompassing floral, fruity and spicy flavours which can be enjoyed both straight and in a cocktail.

Awards :

Country Winner - Navy Gin - 2021 : World Gin Awards

name: Elephant  Sloe Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: We have combined our award-winning Elephant London Dry Gin with the classic flavour of fresh sloe berries. Macerate in the gin for several months, these wild berries add a richly rounded, lightly sweet and exquisitely fruity bouquet as well as a typical warm red colour to the spirit.

name: Reginerate  Silk City Dry Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Powerful juniper rounded with ginger and Szechuan pepper. The consistent implementation of a Dry Gin - without much Chichi! A very powerful gin, which captivates by its taste and stands out from the classical gin. Light citrus notes and ginger make for an unusual but successful combination.

3-times distilled and gently macerated for 18 hours.

name: Reginerate  Sloe Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
We present to the world a real, a wholesome sloe gin!

A deep rich red sets the first optical highlite, followed by a fruity berry fragrance and crowned by its intense complex flavor.

For this we macerated fruit of the sloe thorn over 5 months in our fruity Artisan Gin. Afterwards the sloes were distilled again.

name: Granit  Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Alte Hausbrennerei Penninger is the leading distiller of traditional Bavarian speciality spirits. Utilising over 100 years of experience and using the Bavarian Forest's native roots and herbs we created GRANIT Bavarian Gin. It combines the distillery's traditional skills with the modern-day international market for spirits. Classic gin spices and herbs including lemon, coriander and cardamom are combined with plants native to the Bavarian Forest (such as melissa, bald-money and the gentian root) to give GRANIT its distinctive taste.

Awards :

Bronze - Classic Gin - 2020 - World Gin Awards

name: Rock Rose  Autumn Edition Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi
desc_en_short: Rock Rose's Autumn Edition has been distilled using lots of locally grown botanicals as well as their traditional Rock Rose botanicals. It is bursting with blackberries and raspberries from Caithness Summer Fruits and blaeberries from the Dunnet area. Grown in their own geodome, Vietnamese coriander and nasturtium flowers add to the spice of the gin.

name: Buss 509  Belgian Apple Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The result of this blend is a crispy and exquisite apple flavour with smooth woody accents, resulting from a short ageing on Calvados barrels. A true summer celebration from the land that really knows its apples. Feast your taste on this.

name: Buss 509  Midi Cut Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: All the way from Belgium comes this gin, named Buss No. 509 Midi Cut. It is released as part of the Buss Spirits’ Choice Cut Collection, and is a subtle, Mediterranean-inspired gin.

name: Buss 509  Rebel Cut Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Rebel Cut from Serge Buss' Buss No. 509 is made using 100% corn spirit as well as botanicals including juniper, lavender, white jasmine, white pepper, orange, lemon, cinnamon, coriander, cardamom, liquorice, angelica, orris root and vanilla.

name: Buss 101 Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
With this BUSS N°101 Emerald Export we offer you a superb & accessible gin base for fast mixes & on the fly improvisation. 

A new bartender’s favourite for everyone to enjoy. The best go-to basic gin for any occasion.

name: Bluecoat  American Dry Gin (750 ml)
desc_en_short: "Clear. Aromas of toasted Christmas fruit cake, roasted pecan, and delicate brown spices follow through on a supple entry to a dry-yet-fruity medium-to-full body with notes of herbal juniper, molasses, candied lemon and orange peels on the palate. Finishes with a bold wave of peppery spice, dusty minerals, banana taffy, and pine. An exciting, very different roller coaster of flavors that should inspire unique cocktails."

name: Bluecoat  Barrel Finished Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The barrel finishing process enhances the rounder, softer notes and introduces hints of caramel and whiskey without sacrificing juniper or pepper notes. The process marries the flavors together creating a truly unique gin providing an amazingly fragrant and vibrant yet mellow gin.

name: Peter in Florence  London Dry Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Peter in Florence is, in tribute to Florence, the "gin of elegance": it centers the iris, the icon of the city, of which not only the root is used, but also the petals, much more rare, which emphasizes the floral part of the distillate. It is a classic gin, in keeping with the rules of London Dry Gin, but innovative, also for the use of various botanicals.

Fourteen in all that compose it, almost every room: in addition to the juniper and the iris, the bergamot of fresh bergamot, that of dried lemon, rose berries, lavender flowers and fresh rosemary, the root of angelica, coriander, almonds to love. All of them come from specialized local and organic micro-producers.

name: 1836  Organic Pink Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The 1836 Organic Pink Gin is its amazing pink-infused cherry in a gin combining certified organic wheat distillate with roots and fruits such as juniper berry, orange peel, bergamot, cardamom, elderberry and lemon rind.

name: 1836  Organic Barrel Aged Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Made of an infusion with classic gin aromatics - juniper berries, coriander, orange and lemon peel, rosemary, aniseed and sweet-scented bedstraw - in a distillate of certified organic grain, the 1836 Organic Barrel Aged Gin rests for a period of 6 months in an oak barrel of the belgian whisky Lambertus.

name: Queensborough  Omakase Japanese Style Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Queensborough Omakase Japanese Style gin is a premium hand crafted Japanese Style Gin. Omakase, referring to the Japanese expression for chef’s choice, is a reference to our distiller’s selection of Japanese botanicals. Sansho pepper, yuzu lemon, cherry blossoms and Japanese tea add to traditional gin botanicals to create a citrus and floral gin that is great for sipping or featured in your favourite cocktail.

name: Brooklyn  Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Brooklyn Gin is a craft spirit made in New York with fresh citrus peels and hand-cracked juniper. Our gin is fresh, complex, and flavorful. It’s good enough to drink on its own and we’re proud of that.

name: Langley's  Old Tom Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Langley's Old Tom has a rich and rounded flavour with a light sweetness. More intensely botanical than the London Dry styles, with a distinguished character for long drinks and cocktails, this Victorian recipe reflects the era when its popularity peaked.

Awards

International Wine & Spirit Competition : Gold Gin - 2018

San Francisco World Spirits Competition : Gold Gin - 2018

name: Queensborough  Dry Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Queensborough Gin is a premium hand-crafted Gin, rooted in a 17th Century traditional London Dry recipe. It exhibits some citrus notes derived from the locally sourced Juniper from BC interior, and the Spruce Tips sourced from Vancouver Island. The nose offers a pleasant floral scent, and the first taste has clear pine, rosemary, jasmine and cassia notes. The finish is a smooth citrus lengthy taste brought about by the angelica roots and local spruce tips.

name: Del Professore  Monsieur (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The Gin Monsieur uses a distillate of wild juniper which is then mixed with a cold infusion of other herbs and spices, citrus peel and a secret ingredient. After the infusion, the gin is filtered extremely delicately in order not to lose any of the intense aromas gained from natural infusion.

Awards :

Silver - Contemporary - 2018 : The Gin Masters (The Spirits Business)

name: Del Professore  Madame (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Del Professore Madame is a unique gin for which only the Jerry Thomas Project has the secret recipe. It is composed entirely of berries picked in Italy. The 16 botanicals used are cold-infused in a juniper distillate with herbs and spices. It undergoes a final filtration that is gentle so as to maintain the maximum aromas.

name: Arctic  Blue Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Arctic Blue Gin has a predominant flavor of juniper followed by gentle cardamom, arctic bilberry, bilberry leaf and spruce needles. Finally appear the most subtle ones as coriander seed and fennel seed. Arctic Blue Gin tonic is served with plentiful of ice and top tonic, and decorated with the finest blueberries.

AWARD

The Spirit of the Year 2018 (World Spirit Awards).

Double-Gold classification in the World Spirits Award 2018.

Gold Outstanding Design and Artwork (IWSC London) 2018.

Gold (IWSC Cathay Pacific Hong Kong) 2018.

name: Arctic  Blue Navy Strength Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Arctic Blue Gin Navy Strength is for those who have it in them. Juniper gives it a sharp flavor with a hint of bitterness, and the sweet, almost floral flavor comes from the arctic bilberry. Arctic Blue Gin Navy Strength brings out the best in its companion. Try it in an arctic Negroni and you’ll taste what we mean.

AWARD

Silver (Gin & Tonic, IWSC London) 2019.

Silver (IWSC London) 2018.

Silver Design and Artwork (IWSC London) 2018.

Gold (IWSC Cathay Pacific Hong Kong) 2018.

Double-Gold & Best in Show (San Francisco International Spirits Competition) 2018.

name: Buss 509  (Author Collection)
desc_en_short:
Buss 509  (Author Collection)
1 X Buss 509 Raspberry Gin (200 ml)
1 X Buss 509 Pink Grapefruit Gin (200 ml)
1 X Buss 509 Elderflower Gin (200 ml)

name: Kavalan  Gin (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The Kavalan Gin - the very first Taiwan-inspired craft gin features botanicals sourced from the local area of Yilan, just outside Taipei. To showcase Taiwan’s reputation as a fruit paradise, the gin features local products: succulent starfruit, sweet red guava, and zesty kumquat peel, alongside several traditional gin botanicals.

name: Gibson’s  Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Gibson's London Dry Gin is an authentic London Dry Gin and is one of the most popular in Europe. This gin is the perfect base for excellent cocktails and its bitterness goes perfectly with citrus fruits. Its preparation in the still is unique and its aroma subtle and delicate.

name: Siderit  Classic London Dry Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: A Spanish London Dry Gin made in very small batches (25 litres at a time) and distilled in a fractional distillation column made entirely of borosilicate glass! The 12 botanicals include sideritis hyssopifolia, from which it takes its name, as well as juniper, coriander, cardamom, rock tea, angelica root, cinnamon, orange peel, hibiscus, pink pepper, almond and orris root.

name: Jodhpur  London Dry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Jodhpur Gin draws its name from Jodhpur, India which is located along the famous route used for the spice trade. Many merchants and caravans of camels passed through this city, also known as the Blue City because of the colour of the houses. Jodhpur Gin is a London Dry gin that is distilled in England in a distillery with more than 100 years of experience.

The recipe for Jodhpur Gin requires a special mix of 13 macerated botanicals: orris root, bitter almond, Saxony angelica, Bulgarian coriander, juniper berries, cinnamon bark, licorice root, lemon rind, Belgian angelica, Moroccan coriander, orange rind, grapefruit rind, ginger. This combination gives the gin its signature bitter, fresh, and sweet facets of flavour while the traditional stills make sure it retains its aromatic integrity. The gin goes through four distillations to provide a high-quality final product.

A fine, aromatic gin, Jodhpur Gin is great for mixing in any cocktail or with any mixer and is sure to result in an elegant and smooth combination. The variety of botanicals used in this gin makes it ideal for pairing with spiced food, such as Indian cuisine. It also pairs beautifully with smoked salmon. It also serves as an excellent aperitif.

name: Bobby's  Dry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
THE RECIPE

Bobby’s is a unique blend of Indonesian spice and traditional botanicals. Spicy and fragrant on the nose, a fresh burst of citrus and herbs at first sip and with a slight hum of pepper.

EAST

Traditional Indonesian botanicals and spices give Bobby’s Schiedam Dry Gin its unique flavor profile. Bobby’s Schiedam Dry Gin only uses organic ingredients to create its characteristic scent and taste.

WEST

Botanicals such as juniper, fennel and rose hips make Bobby’s a ‘Schiedam Dry Gin’ and create the balance between east and west.

name: Bobby's  Schiedam Jenever (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
THE RECIPE

Bobby’s Schiedam Jenever is a unique blend of Indonesian spice and traditional malt wine. The grandson cut, malt wine based and fragrant on the nose, a fresh burst of lemongrass and herbs at first sip.

EAST

Traditional Indonesian botanicals and spices give Bobby’s Schiedam Jenever its unique flavor profile. Bobby’s Schiedam Jenever only uses organic ingredients to create its characteristic scent and taste.

WEST

Botanicals such as juniper make Bobby’s a ‘Schiedam Jenever’ and create the balance between east and west.

name: Whitley Neill  Blackberry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This gin tastes of fresh plump berries and hints of floral hedgerow. Containing a smooth flavour, with a core of delicious, piney juniper followed by zesty sweet citrus and hints of wonderful black pepper. The finish has a little earthiness alongside the warming spice of cassia.

name: Beefeater  Pink Gin (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Beefeater Pink Strawberry is the vibrant new Pink Gin made using the original Beefeater London Dry Recipe with the addition of Natural Strawberry flavouring to give it a vibrant and delicious strawberry taste.

name: Old Duff  Blended Dutch Genever (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: This first expression is meant more for mixing in drinks both simple and complex. With a very high 53%malt wine base, the spirit is filled out with rye and neutral grain spirit and a classic mix of botanicals such as orange peel, lemon peel, coriander, juniper, licorice and star anise. No one ingredient or flavor takes center stage here. Instead the spirit adds up to something much greater than its individual parts that is actually quite pleasant on its own but is destined to become a must have staple on back bars everywhere.

name: Old Duff Single Malt Dutch Genever (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: A very old-school genever from the Netherlands, made using 100% malt wine, the rich grain spirit that gives genever its weighty character. While most genevers are lightened with some neutral spirit, this limited edition from Old Duff isn't, and its heavy and flavoursome character is unlike almost anything else out there. Excellent for making very classic cocktails – in the mid-1800s, this is what genever was – or just on its own.

name: Rogue  Spirits Pinot Spruce Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Pinot Spruce Gin carries a slightly more robust body and mouth-feel. It highlights the best of Spruce Gin’s already fruity esters and adds smooth, yet restrained flavors of vanilla, oak and tannins. With over 100 pounds of fresh, hand-peeled cucumber in every batch, Pinot Spruce Gin is Rogue’s Platinum award-winning Spruce Gin aged in Oregon Pinot Noir barrels for 4 – 6 months and is created using fresh Oregon spruce and other natural botanicals and spices.

Ingredients: Spruce, Natural Botanicals, Spices & Free Range Coastal Water.

name: Rogue  Spirits Spruce Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Rogue Spruce Gin received the Platinum medal and was named the “World’s Best Gin” at the World Beverage Competition in Geneva, Switzerland. Our Spruce Gin opens with an aroma of fresh juniper blossoms and subtle citrus notes. The fruity-yet-dry flavors of cucumber and tangerine transform into a distinct spruce finish. There are 100 pounds of fresh, hand-peeled cucumber in every batch, Spruce Gin is created using fresh Oregon spruce and other natural botanicals and spices.

Ingredients: Spruce, Natural Botanicals, Spices and Free Range Coastal Water.

name: St. George  Botanivore Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Botanivore, our “botanical eater,” is comprised of 19 different botanicals working in concert. Think of a meadow in bloom—herbaceous, fresh, and elegant.

What’s in it? Count with us... angelica root, bay laurel, bergamot peel, black peppercorn, caraway, cardamom, cilantro, cinnamon, citra hops, coriander, dill seed, fennel seed, ginger, juniper berries, lemon peel, lime peel, orris root, Seville orange peel, star anise!

name: St. George  Dry Rye Gin (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
A base of 100% pot-distilled rye makes this a gin for whiskey lovers—and for gin im-purists willing to take a walk on the rye side.

Think genever, then think again—and brace yourself for a gin with structure, spice, and an impossibly rich mouthfeel.

name: St. George  Terroir Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
An ode to the wild beauty of the Golden State.

Forest-driven and earthy, Terroir is a profoundly aromatic gin with a real sense of place. We wanted to make a spirit that conveyed what we love about the monumental groves of trees, moist and misty glens, and sun-baked chaparral of our favorite local parklands.

With Terroir Gin, we try to take you there with Douglas fir, California bay laurel, coastal sage, and other evocative botanicals. Sip it and be transported.

name: Windspiel  Premium Dry Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: A German gin made with lovingly well-crafted potato spirit, using potatoes grown in rich volcanic soil. For botanicals they use a combination of juniper, lemon, ginger, coriander, lavender, cinnamon and a few secrets selections.

name: Windspiel  Navy Strength (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: This burly German gin is distilled from potatoes! With lavender blossom, ginger and cinnamon among the botanical list, Windspiel Navy Strength is full of juniper and spice, with the higher strength making it a great contender for cocktails.

name: Edinburgh Gin  Rhubard & Ginger Gin (1 L)
desc_en_short:
With its unique recipe of 14 botanicals, we take our signature Edinburgh Gin Classic, and post-infuse it with rhubarb and ginger to create this full-strength expression.

Bottled at 40%, this perfectly balanced juniper-forward gin is full of natural flavour. Aromas of rhubarb are complemented by a lift of spice, leading to a smooth, full finish.

For a refreshing twist on a classic G&T, try it with premium Mediterranean tonic water, aromatic kaffir lime leaf and a lemon, or a rhubarb twist to garnish. Rhubarb & Ginger Gin is perfect in long summer serves, as well as shorter Martini and sour-style cocktails.

name: Edinburgh Gin  Classic (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Our classic London Dry style gin. A clean, zesty, juniper-forward gin which balances softness with bright citrus. Launched in 2010, this is our modern London Dry gin, with a nod to Scotland in its recipe including native plants and botanicals.

A unique blend of fourteen botanicals includes lavender, pine buds, mulberries and cobnuts. Orange peel, lemongrass and lime peel contribute lively citrus notes. Created by hand in our West End and Leith distilleries, this is a delightfully crisp gin with a distinctively smooth finish.

Bottled at 43% ABV, our classic Edinburgh Gin makes for a refreshing G&T, best served with a zesty orange twist and premium Indian tonic water. Its distinctive flavour lends itself perfectly to classic cocktails such as Martinis, Negronis, and Gimlets.

name: Rock Rose  Sherry Cask Edition Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: This limited edition gin was created around Dunnet Bay Distillers co-founder Claire Murray’s favourite Christmas tipple. Rock Rose Original Gin was aged in an Oloroso sherry cask, imbuing some its rich flavours from both the sherry and Oloroso cask. The result is a complex gin that has notes of classic gin botanicals along with nutty sherry notes.

name: Rock Rose  Coastal Edition Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
No.3 : Coastal Edition

The third in the series is the wonderful Coastal Edition gin, our most experimental edition to date! Inspired by the local Caithness coastline, it is distilled in a traditional vapour infusion still with kelp, locally foraged by Shore Seaweed, and liquorice salt from Hebridean Mustard Company.  The result is an incredibly smooth and delectably sweet gin with a delicious salted edge.

The Coastal Edition features the artwork of Kelly Munro, Scottish artist and jeweller, originally from the small fishing town of Wick.  Her most recent collection is inspired by the drifting tides of Caithness and seaweeds found on the northern Scottish coastline.

Martin Murray, Co-Founder Dunnet Bay Distillers, says, “As a distillery located in the spectacular bay of Dunnet, we have long been inspired by our beautiful coastline and the ingredients it’s home to.  Kelly’s work is also a celebration our unique location and so to feature her art on our latest gin is incredibly fitting. It was also great fun to experiment with such unusual ingredients and create our most daring gin to date!”

name: Rock Rose  Clootie Dumpling Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi
desc_en_short:
No.1 : Clootie Dumpling

Clootie Dumpling gin is the first in the series of our new Creative Collection.

Contemporary artist Lindsey Gallacher created this unique artwork on a scratchboard layered with china clay and coated with India ink. The image, which shows a Caithness “wifey” making clootie dumpling in her kitchen, was then meticulously etched out using fine points and scalpels.

Lindsey’s creativity sparks from her childhood growing up in Caithness and her illustration evokes memories of the traditional steamed Scottish pudding, laden with fruits and spices, which we have used as inspiration for our clootie dumpling gin.

Clootie Dumpling gin is made in Elizabeth, our vapour infusion still to extract the botanical flavours and create a delicious gin inspired by a traditional Scottish pudding. Actual clootie dumplings, made by Claire’s mam, are placed in the vapour basket along with juniper, raisins and the additional spices of nutmeg and allspice.

name: Sakurao  Japanese Craft Dry Gin Limited (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
17 specially selected botanicals that feature the riches of the land and sea from Hiroshima are used as ingredients and distilled using a combination of steeping and vapor methods to create this craft gin.

Awards :

Gold - Gin - Contemporary Styles - 2019 : International Wine & Spirit Competition

name: Edinburgh Gin  Gooseberry & Elderflower (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A deliciously refreshing and aromatic gin that harmonises tangy Gooseberry with sweet Elderflower creating a refreshing and balanced gin. Perfect with a light tonic garnished with fresh mint or as a base for summery cocktails. Whatever the weather this naturally flavoured gin will brighten up your day!

name: Edinburgh Gin  Raspberry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Our full-strength (40%) Raspberry gin is bursting with natural flavour from start to finish. It is distilled with five traditional gin botanicals and a combination of fresh Scottish raspberries and raspberry leaves to a create a perfectly balanced gin with an incredible depth of flavour. Bright, fresh and best served with a raspberry or two – of course!

Serving Suggestion - Perfect with tonic garnished with fresh basil and raspberries. It’s also a perfect base for summery cocktails and is equally enjoyable served over ice.

name: Valamo  Black Tea Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Journey through time to a candle-lit cabinet where Russian tsars were served Valamo’s traditional Black Tea. Now a gin has been created from this historic tea, so that everyone can experience the tea of the tsars in the form of an artisanal distilled spirit.

Made from juniper berries and Valamo’s Black Tea, the gin also contains sage, black pepper, black currant leaves and berries, pine cones, angelica and honeycomb. The spicy and herby tones of the aroma combine in a resinous beeswax scent, which takes the mind to the tranquil peace of the Orthodox monastery.

name: Rock Rose  Citrus Coastal Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi
desc_en_short: Flavourful and fresh, zesty with a bracing sea air finish. Originally distilled as an exclusive edition for the Craft Gin Club in August 2020, it was so well received we decided to make it part of our core range. Our most experimental edition to date was inspired by the Caithness coastline and is distilled using locally foraged kelp from Shore Seaweed and liquorice salt from Hebridean Mustard Company.

name: Rock Rose  Sauternes Cask Edition Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The flavoursome wine complements our original recipe gin and brings with it complex notes of honey, apricot and butterscotch.  The result is a lovely golden coloured spirit packed with flavour and a hint of sweetness. Our signature bottle artwork has been beautifully redesigned using golden hues to complement the liquid colour.  The bottle is sealed and dressed with a hessian cover before being carefully presented in a gorgeous wrap around box!

name: Hawthorn’s  London Dry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Hawthorn’s is produced at a distillery that has been in operation since the early 1900s. Our Master Distiller has 50 years’ experience, so we know Hawthorn’s is made by the best. Our base spirit is derived from quadruple distilled 100% English wheat. We steep our botanicals in our century-old copper pot still for 24 hours to ensure the essential oils that sit just beneath the surface of the skin, peel or berry seeds are all released. The fabric of a gin is, after all, woven by its botanicals. Every batch of Hawthorn’s is a single batch and once finished it will have been distilled five times.

Awards :

Hawthorn’s is as well decorated as the man who inspired it. It has just won a Gold Medal for the third year running at the San Francisco World Spirits Competition. Over three years we have beaten a huge field of gins, including Hendrick’s, Sipsmith, Martin Miller’s, Beefeater and Bulldog.

name: Cross Keys  Black Currant Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Our journey goes on! Unlock the essence of the Baltic region with a blush of Black Currant and experience the unique taste of handcrafted Cross Keys Gin. It is a contemporary twist of the four key ingredients of Juniper, Rosemary, Chamomile, and Linden blossoms, now enriched with Black Currant flavours.

BEST ENJOYED  

Cross Keys Gin with a blush of black currant pleases the taste buds with a palette of northern summer flavours and light sweetness for easy enjoyment. We recommend to try it with two parts of tonic water and just one or two ice cubes. No need for garnishing – enjoying pink Cross Keys Gin simplicity is the key.

name: Generous  Aromatic Craft Gin Azur (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
"A FRENCH GIN WITH AZUR SCENTS"

Generous Azur is a new fresh, sophisticated and floral gin inspired by the fragrances and eternal blue skies of the mythical Côte d'Azur.

 It was designed to be unanimous in both connoisseurs and casual consumers.

 By combining seductive packaging, a beach lifestyle brand universe evocative for consumers 25 35 H/F, a taste with complex flavors, 

Generous Azur has all the assets to be a success thanks to a reasonable price positioning.

name: Windspiel  Premium Sloe Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The finest hand-picked sloes from the Eifel give Windspiel Premium Sloe Gin its very special character. Macerated in Windspiel Premium Dry Gin with the addition of natural sloe juice, the result is a Sloe Gin with an intensive juniper character enhanced by the aromatic flavor of the sloes and perfected with floral citrus notes. The distinctive and delicately mild flavours of the potato alcohol complement this special gin. Simply a perfect combination of potatoes, the known and awarded Windspiel Premium Dry Gin aromas and sloes – the ideal sundowner

name: Hoos  London Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Elegant gin with fine forest notes. Aromas of chamomile and lavender are discreetly coming from the deep, with the citrus tones in the treble they add up to a multifaceted overall picture. Delightful in the nose with featherlight floral tones, on the palate creamy juniper texture, refreshing accents, multilayered. The secret of the wonderful forest walk on the tongue is the pine buds. A characteristic key element, precisely interwoven with the other botanicals, creates wonderful dreams.

name: Hoos  Lapsang Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: The sophisticated Hoos Lapsang Gin combines classic juniper with rare smoked tea, thus building a bridge from west to east. Lapsang Souchong is a tea speciality from China. It originates from the mountains and is also called smoked tea, because the black tea is smoked over ignited spruce wood with resin. It is also roasted and naturally fermented. While it is possible to drink Lapsang Souchong tea, it is often mixed with other teas or products. The Hoos Lapsang Gin is sometimes peppery. Lemon peels balance the Chinese tea. Towards the finish, the gin reveals a hint of chamomile.

name: Hoos  Pink Grapefruits (500 ml)
desc_en_short: The basis for this product is the classic Hoos Gin. This is infused for two months with the juice and peels of fully ripe grapefruits and fresh lemon balm. A small amount of sugar rounds off the taste. After filtration, the Hoos Pink Grapefruit Gin is raised to an alcohol content of 30.5% by volume.Genuine grapefruit peel, as if you would smell the fruit itself, followed by a strong creamy candy aroma, followed by citrus fruit and juniper. A mild sweetness, clear grapefruit, in addition orange and juniper, some honey. In the finish again the fruity-bitter grapefruit, which stays in the palate for a long time.

name: Rubus  Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The Rubus Gin is the result of the collaboration of two renowned barkeepers and one of the best distillers in Germany. The distiller Florian Faude distils also extraordinary fruit brandies. This experience and craftsmanship is also reflected in this Gin. We are totally thrilled by the natural, fruity taste of raspberry and gooseberry in this product.

name: Ventura  Wilder Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Wilder Gin is distilled with wild-harvested, native California botanicals including sagebrush, purple sage, bay, yerba santa, pixie mandarin peel and chuchupate. This dynamic mix of the wild and the cultivated bursts with fresh, savory aromas, like taking a walk through the mountains of the central coast. Drink Wilder straight, or use it to bring out the wilder side of gin cocktails. This is not the Queen’s gin, it’s Wilder.

name: Faradaí  Electric Spirit (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
FARADAÍ stimulates the senses and takes you into completely new worlds of taste.The Paracress flowers are effervescent and electrifying, refined with four other hand-picked ingredients.The fresh, stimulating taste of the paracress flowers is enhanced by bergamot, bourbon vanilla, jasmine flowers and Ceylon tea. 

The multi-layered aromas unfold slowly in the mouth and flood all taste senses - a mixture of fresh acidity, bitter sweetness and the slight spiciness that the paracress blossoms bring into play, finally rounded off by finely bitter aromas.

name: Komasa  Hojicha Japanese Craft Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: This perfectly refined Komasa Hojicha Gin is an artisanal gin infused with juniper berries, authentic shochu, and roasted tea leaves from Kagoshima, one of Japan's most famous tea producing regions.

name: Komasa  Komikan Japanese Craft Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Made with Sakurajima komikan (Japanese mandarin orange), juniper berries and various other botanicals.

A new Japanese craft gin with the subtle, delicate fragrance of citrus. This botanical gin hails from Kagoshima, Japan, home to both the Komasa Gin Distillery and a tiny type of local mandarin orange called the Sakurajima komikan.

name: Haymans  London Dry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Perfectly balanced, with a bold juniper backbone and notes of fresh citrus. Bursting with fresh juniper, crisp citrus and a subtly warming spice, this is a true English London Dry Gin, made in exactly the same way it was back in 1863.

Award

Gold Medal : International Review of Spirits Award

name: Haymans  Old Tom Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A rich, smooth gin with rounded citrus and bold juniper pine notes, our Old Tom ends in a beautifully delicate finish with a subtle sweetness, making it the best gin for mixing true, classic gin cocktails.

name: Haymans  Sloe Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Warming, dark and fruity, with intense plummy flavours and hints of almond. Rich, smooth and intense plum with a true juniper backbone. On the nose, Bold stone fruits and mild almond nuttiness.

name: G'Vine  Nouaison Gin Reserve (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Nouaison Gin Reserve is distilled from French grapes with a unique selection of botanicals that brings an exceptional rich bouquet. This fine gin isthen matured in Cognac casks from our estate, Le Perat.

Nouaison Gin Reserve combines two unique know -how: the art of gin distillation and maturation in cognac casks. Simply on ice or in classiccocktails, this gin will reveal its exceptional, r ich and spicy character.

name: Stranger & Sons  Festive Set
desc_en_short:
Made at Third Eye Distillery, Stranger & Sons gin hails from Goa, India. Made with botanicals such as Gondhoraj limes, coriander, black pepper and cassia bark, as well as plenty of juniper, it has an aromatic, citrussy character with notes of warm pepper, nutmeg and Gondhoraj limes throughout the palate.

In The Box

1 X Stranger & Sons Gin (700 ml)

3 X Fever-Tree Premium Indian Tonic Water (200 ml)

2 X Stranger & Sons Glass

name: Cotswolds  Dry Gin  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Clean, pine juniper spice with fresh citrusy grapefruit. A touch of dryness from the angelica root, with eucalyptus notes from bay leaf. Subtle lime and lavender. On the nose, fresh notes of grapefruit with earthy coriander backed-up by sweet, piney juniper.

name: Cotswolds  Exotic Gin  (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Small batch, will take you on a journey from the Middle East to India. Baharat is the Turkish word for ""spice blend"". In addition to hints of juniper berries and coriander, this wheat-based gin also offers more exotic notes in the form of cardamom, cumin, cinnamon, black pepper, chilli pepper, cloves and Jaffa oranges.

name: Yomeishu  Cocktail Grapefruit & Herb Craft Gin (300 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Extremely high-quality cocktail based with craft gin, “Ka-no-Shizuku”, which has great scent of Lindera umbellata.White and Red grapefruits juice and Yuzu juice make it slightly bitter taste. To put Lindera umbellata, Rosemary, Citrus unshiu peel, and Lemon into original gin, we have succeeded rich aroma and taste. You can enjoy it any style you want such as on the rock and with soda.

name: Yomeishu  Ginger And Herbs Craft Gin (300 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Extremely high-quality cocktail based with craft gin, "KANOSHIZUKU GIN", which has great scent of Lindera umbellata. 3 kinds of ginger(raw, extract, dry) make it authentic taste. To put Lindera umbellata, Cardamom, Sichuan pepper, Japanese pepper, Black pepper into original gin, we have succeeded rich aroma and taste. You can enjoy it any style you want such as on the rock and with soda.

name: Hendrick's  Neptunia Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Infused with Coastal Botanicals and a Smooth Citrus Finish. Distilled from Grain. Kosher.From our Cabinet of Curiosities Hendrick's Neptunia is a limited release that captures the magic of the sea, in a gin. Master Distiller Ms. Lesley Gracie's creation is as refreshing as her muse, the mighty waves that lash the Ayrshire coast. Infused with an exquisite blend of coastal botanicals and with a remarkable smooth citrus finish, it is sublime with tonic and a slice of cucumber - or perhaps a Neptuna Fizz.

name: Siderit  Hibiscus London Dry Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Siderit Hibiscus Gin is a Floral Gin made in Cantabria, northern Spain, distilled from rye alcohol. Its main feature is the floral character arising from a double maceration and a triple distillation in a fractional distillation column with reflux, in a complete glass equipment that eliminates foreign tastes and odors. Every distillation in these equipments of own design is equivalent to five distillations of a traditional alembic.

name: Peter in Florence  Navy Strength Gin "Peter in the Navy" (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Peter in the Navy Gin is navy strength gin, a recipe with ancient origins. Long before it was possible to measure the alcohol by volume of a drink, the Royal Navy was faced with the problem of making sure that gunpowder remained flammable even if a barrel of gin broke in transit. In the days of cannonballs and muskets, wet gunpowder was a death sentence in battle.

name: Portofino  Dry Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Portofino Dry Gin is an award winning gin from the Italian town of Portofino, it features 21 ingredients carefully selected for their intense aromatic properties. Juniper, lemon, lavender, rosemary, marjoram, sage, iris, roses – together with other local delicacies – are handpicked in our botanical sanctuary on the hills of Portofino.

name: Askur  Yggdrasil Gin (Alc. Volume 37.5%) (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: This unique gin is a true Nordic sensatin! The purest water from Iceland combined with 6 botanicals from different sides of the world cause this premium Nordic Gin to express a unique flavor profile on your taste-pallet and impress younger audiences as well as old school Gin connoisseurs alike! May the Norse Gods be by your side when you experience this unique Nordic force of nature for the first time!

food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: This unique gin is a true Nordic sensatin! name: Lady Trieu  Lab Series Sapa Citrus Tea Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
The latest release from The Lab Series, for this fourth edition we explore the beauty of Northern Vietnam, taking inspiration from the endless breathtaking landscapes of the mountainous region of Sapa.

A heady, aromatic gin, blending herbal notes of oolong tea with layered citrus tones and warming pepper. Handcrafted in small batches using 12 Vietnamese botanicals, plus the finest Italian juniper.

Ideal served with your favourite tonic water garnished with fresh pomelo zest. For cocktails we recommend a Dry Martini or Gin Julep

name: The Botanist  Islay Dry Gin (Gift Box)
desc_en_short:
The Botanist Islay Dry Gin (Gift Box) Includes :

The Botanist Islay Dry Gin (700 ml) x 1

The botanist is a gin of layered complexity. A progressive exploration of the botanical heritage of our isle of islay. Nine classic gin botanicals are augmented by 22 local herbs and flowers, foraged responsibly and by hand from the hills, shores and bogs of this fertile hebridean island by our own team of botanical scientists. The result is a gin as much for the mind as the palate; a thinking person’s gin. a roller coaster botanical odyssey in a glass.

Botanist Highball Glass x 1

name: Silver Top  Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: A classic gin from Dutch distillers, Bols. Silver Top London Dry Gin has been enjoyed in Europe for decades - we've previously had some bottles from years gone by in our Antique Spirits collection.

name: O’ndina Gin Small Batch Distilled (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Described as the “Spirit of the Italian Riviera”, O’ndina Gin is distilled using spring water from the Alps and nineteen botanicals, including juniper from the Apennine Mountains, Grande Verde di Genova basil from Liguria, lemons and oranges from Southern Italy, orris root from Tuscany, liquorice from Calabria, and sage, marjoram, thyme and fennel from Piemonte and its neighbours.

 

On the nose juniper blends with green herbs, citrus and spice effortlessly. It’s a seductive aroma, subtle yet flirty, with images of Italy planted firmly in mind prior to the first sip.

 

To taste oily juniper takes control, with basil and a beautiful bouquet of Italian herbs making themselves known. Orange, lemon and pepper provide balance. To finish, the citrus and spice begin subside to leave you with fresh basil in all its glory. Surprisingly, the gin is actually quite creamy in texture, which only adds to the charm.

name: Cross Keys  Original Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
ORIGINAL & REFRESHING NORDIC FLAVOUR

Classical gin flavour tenderly enriched by Nordic region specific botanicals – chamomile & linden blossoms.

name: Cross Keys  Sea Buckthorn Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Sour & refreshing notes of Sea Buckthron combine with the sweetness of linden blossom and chamomile and the spicy character of juniper in this complex aroma.

name: Zafiro Orange Blossom Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: It has a very intense aroma, in which you can recognize especially juniper, white flowers, fresh orange. The taste is soft and elegant, with bright citrus and juniper tones with a pleasant orange finish. We recommend drinking as a long drink in combination with lime and soda or tonic.

name: Portobello Road Gin  Savoury (700 ml)
desc_en_short: As with a few of our other expressions, our Savoury Gin started life as a Distillery product, served exclusively at our home at 186 Portobello Road. It started out as a gin we called King Theodore of Corsica, an experiment which was once again inspired by our delving into the history of gin drinking in London.

name: Portobello Road Gin  London Dry No.171 (700 ml)
desc_en_short: On the front of the palate, Portobello Road Gin has a generous slug of juniper, the mid-palate has a sustained, fresh citrus character from our use of lemon, bitter orange and coriander, which then develops into a sweet peppery finish, achieved by the use of liquorice and nutmeg.

name: Broker's  London Dry Pink Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Broker's Pink Gin is a magical symbiosis of the multiple award-winning Brokers London dry gin and natural strawberry flavors. The result is an extremely gentle, complex and refreshing gin, with very subtle nuances and aromas of hand-selected, finest herbs, spices and fruits, married with a wonderfully fruity, summery strawberry scent.

name: Ki No Bi  Sei Kyoto Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: KI NO BI SEI is made according to the same intricate production method as the original KI NO BI, using 11 botanicals distilled in six distinct flavour categories, known as the 6 Elements. The final blend has been recalibrated by our distilling team to bring out the best of each botanical at the higher strength.

name: Henkes  Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: HENKES Gin has aromas of citrus and orange zest. On the palate it has spicy with herbs under tones, and a little lemon and fennel. This pairs well with smoked salmon, prawns and shrimp, fish and chips, lamb curry, cheese and chocolate

name: Gibson’s  Blood Orange (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: GIBSON’S BLOOD ORANGE is a tasty and well balanced gin that perfectly combines GIBSON'S finest botanicals made of juniper berries, coriander, angelica with the freshness and bitterness of sun-filled blood oranges. This distilled gin will bring an original touch to your cocktails!

name: Glendalough  Wild Botanical Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: The botanicals in Glendalough Wild Botanical Gin are foraged from the Wicklow mountains just south of Dublin, Ireland. This gin seeks to evoke the aroma, scent and feel of this part of Ireland. The botanicals are distilled as close as possible to being picked, and are separated into two groups: some botanicals are macerated before distillation; others are suspended in a basket and their flavors are imparted via vapor.

name: Glendalough Rose Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi
desc_en_short: To make this very special, small-batch Gin we completely rebalance our Wild Gin recipe and redistill it with extra fruit, flowers and spices... and of course a lot of fresh rose petals.

name: Bombay Sapphire  Premier Cru Murcian Lemon (750 ml)
desc_en_short: A small-batch handcrafted gin, Bombay Sapphire Premier Cru celebrates Murcia's world-renowned citrus and is made with sustainably-sourced Murcian Fino lemons, mandarins and sweet navel oranges, hand-picked and hand-peeled from the late harvest. The aromatic character and opulent citrus notes imparted by these botanicals make the London Dry Gin a stand out in cocktails such as the Martini or French 75.

name: Short Story  Dry Gin (750 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Immerse your senses in the uniquely smooth character of this gin, where intricate flavor notes converge to create a symphony of taste.

Whether raising a toast to special occasions or unwinding with a quiet night in, Short Story Gin transforms every sip into a memorable experience.

Enjoy the artistry of flavor in every bottle, as this gin weaves a narrative of craftsmanship, care, and delight for your discerning palate.

name: Jason Kong Mekong Butterfly Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Floral notes from Jasmine, Rose-apples, Butterfly pea  & Hibiscus with bright Southeast Asian aromas.

name: Seekers Mekong Gold Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Wood-finished for a silk-smooth texture and the finest spice notes of cinnamon, coconut and vanilla

AWARDS
