name: Paper Lantern (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Paper Lantern is an award-winning Premium Asian Gin crafted with select botanicals sourced from the region. Gin Reimagined with the silkiness of rice, warmth from Sichuan pepper, citrus from lemongrass, finished off with the sweetness from honey. A contemporary international award-winning gin with earthy and floral notes. The flavours are infinitely versatile in cocktails and cited as a reason to keep coming back for more by bartenders and consumers around the world.

name: Bobby's  Schiedam Pinang Raci (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Pinang Raci literally translates as a mishmash of spices. Grandfather Jacobus ‘Bobby’ Alfons, the inspiration and namesake of Bobby’s Gin, was well known for skilfully infusing Dutch jenever with spices that reminded him of home: Naku on the island of Ambon. As a result, he created and spiced up his own jenever!

name: Strange Luve Quince Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Love is strange. Love is wild. Love is beautiful. And when it comes knocking on your door, there's nothing you can do to prepare for it. It just invades your life and turns everything upside down. Like a sip of good gin, lifted by the cool taste of juniper and enveloped in the warm embrace of alcohol. That's what Strange Luve gin is all about.

name: Lassies Toast Gin (500 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
A deliciously herbal gin with elements of citrus and hints of tea.

Lassies Toast Gin is inspired by the Moorland Tea that the poet Robert Burns is reputed to have enjoyed and is made to a unique recipe designed in-house.

Whether it’s women raising a glass to – and with – other women or men toasting the ‘lassies’ as is traditional on Burns Night, this wee dram has been designed as a drink for anyone, at any time. It features bilberry leaves, strawberry leaves, heather tops, speedwell and wild thyme, ingredients found in the Moorland Tea recipe. Elegant and delicious, this very special gin is the perfect tipple for any celebration whether that be weddings, engagement parties, hen parties, Mother’s Day, or just any time you want to raise a glass and toast the women in your life.

name: Rivo  Foraged Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Staying true to its Italian roots, RIVO Gin is an artisan product made with passion and love. The distillation happens in small batches and using only the finest botanicals.

There are no additives, sugars or artificial ingredients. RIVO Gin is 43% alcohol by volume and is made from Italian grain alcohol.

name: Rivo  Sloe Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
RIVO Sloe Gin is slightly sweet with fruit and almond notes that are balanced and give a round, yet delicate flavor.
RIVO Sloe Gin is versittile at 30% VOL and can be enjoyed neat or mixed in cocktails.

name: Goldcock  Czech Republic Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Many whisky brands around the world start making or ad GIN in their portfolio because it just makes sense. We had a different a pproach. Only after having our twenty year old whisky in our portfolio, we produced the first GOLD COCK GIN. But the logic behind these steps is similar.

Juniper has been distilled in our factory for more than one hundred and twenty years, which means that we do have the experience. GIN and his other botanicals have been produced a t RUDOLF JELÍNEK since the 1970 s. Its production ended only at the end of the 1990 s, when the market, even here in the Czech Republic, was already dominated by GINS from Great Britain.

We now have used the same composition of herbs as a few decades ago, because as with GOLD COCK whisky, we concentrate on keeping the traditions alive. So our Gin contains coriander, cardamom, angelica, iris, licorice, wormwood, orange and lemon peel and of course black ju niper. Everything is macerated in fine alcohol and afterwards "stretch" distilled.

name: Sikkim  Privee London Dry Gin - Indian British Tea (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Sikkim Privée is a London Dry Gin with juniper, red tea, flower essences, cilantro, a touch of herbs, and a soft velvety red tea flavor.

name: Sikkim  Fraise Distilled Gin - Indian British Tea (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Sikkim Fraise is a Distilled Gin with juniper, red tea, flower essences, strawberries of the forest, red cranberries, coriander, iris, reed and bitter skin of orange, fruity, sweet flavor in mouth, with aromas from strawberries of the forest.

name: Sikkim  Greenery Distilled Gin - Indian British Tea (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Sikkim Greenery is a Distilled Gin with juniper, red tea, flower essences, Granny Smith, Golden Delicious and other green apple varieties with refreshing menthol notes, coriander, iris, calamus and bitter orange peel.

name: The Gardener Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
FRENCH RIVIERA GIN

Handcrafted by Brad Pitt, Tom Nichol and the Famille Perrin.

A CRAFT

Using his know how of distilling traditional London Dry Gin, Tom created The Gardener with a modern twist.

To achieve his vision of a perfect gin, he chose each of The Gardener’s ingredients with an uncompromising sense of quality. Tom’s recipe is a unique creation distilled with fresh citruses – bitter orange Bigarade, sweet orange and pink grapefruit – grown locally in the heart of the French Riviera.

Fresh and soft, subtle and pure, The Gardener is a study in elegance and harmony—the very image of nature itself.

name: Hoxton  Dry Gin  (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: A classic dry gin with real modern, botanical flair. Leading with Juniper, delicately balanced with 100% natural botanicals such as grapefruit, orris root, ginger and tarragon. Great for your G&Ts.

name: Hoxton  Tropical Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Made with coconut, grapefruit, juniper, ginger, tarragon, and orris root, this blend offers rich coconut flavor bal anced with bright citrus notes. The finish is subtly sweet with lingering tropical tones and refreshing hints of grapefruit, complemented by a bold aroma of coconut, grapefruit, and juniper berries.

name: Peddlers  Salted Plum Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: Peddlers Salted Plum Gin is a rare Chinese take on a traditional sloe gin. We take our award winning Shanghai Gin, infuse it with salted plum, mulberry, orange peel and osmanthus, and then age it for a month in Oloroso sherry barrels to give it a dry finish.

name: Perfume Trees  Gin (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
A marvellous gin from Perfume Trees. This breath-taking expression is inspired by the nature of Hong Kong and the botanicals used to create the gin are from Hong Kong's heritage. The result is a wonderfully balanced and elegant tipple. Enjoy this highly-awarded gin with some tonic water and a slice of orange to garnish.

Expect aromas of white champaca blossom and sandalwood on the warming and herbal nose. The palate brings more herbal notes alongside juniper and orange zest before leading into a finish full of green tea and Chinese angelica.

name: The Botanist  Islay Cask Aged Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The Botanist Cask Aged Gin showcases Bruichladdich distillery’s Botanical expertise and whisky-making heritage. Our Islay dry gin has been matured in fine casks for a minimum of three years, resulting in a rich copper cuvée.

Notes of dried fruit and toasted oats, rendered by time in wood, marry with fragrant botanicals. The result is a gin that defies convention.

name: Citadelle Juniper Decadence (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short: A Juniper cask-aged gin to celebrate the 25th anniversary of Citadelle and the inauguration of its new distillery. To amplify the aromatic's fresh, herbal and smoky aromas, the original gin recipe is aged in rare and small 100-litre juniper wood barrels, highly charred for extra flavour.

name: Citadelle Jardin dEte (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Inspired by the vibrant garden of Château de Bonbonnet, where flowers, fruits, and herbs thrive, this interpretation of our signature gin encapsulates the essence of summer in every drop.

With flavors of juicy Charentais melon, whole lemons, and refreshing yuzu and orange, it invites you to enjoy a delightful tasting experience.

name: Fabbri Dry Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Born in the heart of Emilia-Romagna, Italy, Fabbri Dry Gin carries the same artisanal spirit that made the Fabbri name legendary in Italian gastronomy. Founded in 1905, the Fabbri family first became renowned for their hand-crafted liqueurs, amaros, and syrups — symbols of Italian craftsmanship rooted in flavor, quality, and passion.

Over a century later, the house continues its creative journey with this exceptional Dry Gin, distilled in small batches using time-honored techniques and botanicals sourced from both Italian terroirs and beyond. Each distillation takes place in traditional copper stills, allowing for the delicate extraction of essential oils from juniper berries, citrus peels, and aromatic herbs. The result is a gin that bridges classic London Dry structure with a distinctly Italian soul — elegant, vibrant, and expressive.

Every bottle of Fabbri Dry Gin tells a story of legacy — where tradition meets innovation, and where the art of Italian flavor finds its purest, most aromatic form.

name: Nakano BC Craft Gin Kozue (700 ml)
food_matching: Tonic, Seafood Cocktails, Light Appetizers, Citrus Dishes
desc_en_short:
Nakano BC Craft Gin Kozue is born in Wakayama Prefecture, Japan — a land embraced by mountains, forests, and the Pacific breeze. It comes from Nakano BC Distillery, a house known for its mastery in sake, umeshu (plum wine), and craft spirits, carrying more than 70 years of brewing and distilling heritage.

“Kozue” (梢) means “tree treetop” in Japanese — a fitting name for a gin that celebrates the fragrance of Japan’s mountain forests. The heart of this gin is distilled from local juniper berries, Japanese cypress (Hinoki), bamboo leaves, and mandarin peel (Mikan) — botanicals that mirror the pure air and serenity of Wakayama’s sacred peaks.

Each small batch is crafted by hand in traditional copper stills, blending modern precision with the soul of Japanese craftsmanship. The result is a gin that captures the calm, clarity, and quiet power of nature itself — a harmony between forest aroma and citrus brightness.

name: Bes Gin (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short:
Bes Gin was born from the philosophy that simplicity is sophistication. It embodies the timeless craft of traditional gin-making while embracing a clean, modern sensibility — a spirit created to express freshness, precision, and purity in perfect harmony.

The name “Bes” derives from the idea of “Best” — representing the pursuit of perfection through balance and restraint. Each batch is small-batch distilled in classic copper pot stills, allowing every botanical to release its purest aroma and character.

The heart of Bes Gin lies in its elegant composition of juniper berries, lemon peel, coriander seed, and angelica root, enhanced by subtle Mediterranean herbs. The result is a gin that is refreshingly bright, beautifully smooth, and effortlessly drinkable — a bridge between old-world tradition and modern clarity.

Bes Gin is a “modern classic” — refined, versatile, and made for those who appreciate the quiet beauty of precision.

name: Gold 999.9 Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Gold 999.9 Finest Tangerines is a radiant expression of craftsmanship, inspired by the legend of the “Golden Still” — a mysterious alembic made entirely of gold, discovered in France at the turn of the 20th century. It is said that the still, with its perfect conductivity and purity, produced a gin so refined it was called “the liquid gold.”

Building upon that legend, Gold 999.9 Gin became known as “The Golden Gin of France,” and this special Finest Tangerines Edition captures the luminous essence of Mediterranean citrus. The spirit is distilled with juniper, angelica root, coriander, and fresh tangerine peel, creating a profile that glows with freshness, elegance, and sunshine.

Each bottle is a tribute to refinement and vitality — where French precision meets the cheerful brightness of citrus orchards.

name: Martin Miller's  Winterful Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Martin Miller’s Winterful Gin is a poetic tribute to the magic of winter — a season of warmth, comfort, and quiet indulgence. Born from the visionary spirit of Martin Miller, the gin is inspired by his love for Iceland and England, two worlds that together define the brand’s identity: purity and artistry.

Distilled in England using the finest botanicals and Icelandic spring water, Winterful is a special limited edition crafted to celebrate the cozy traditions of winter gatherings. Its recipe is based on the award-winning Martin Miller’s Original Gin, further infused with cinnamon, mandarin orange peel, and cardamom — evoking the aroma of mulled wine and festive spice.

The result is a gin that captures the essence of a fireside evening — crisp yet warming, refined yet comforting. Martin Miller’s Winterful transforms cold nights into golden moments of togetherness.

name: Martin Miller's  Summerful Gin (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Martin Miller’s Summerful Gin is a radiant homage to the joy and vibrance of summer — a season of blooming gardens, coastal air, and endless daylight. Created as a limited-edition counterpart to the acclaimed Winterful, it reflects the lighter, more playful side of Martin Miller’s Gin, a brand born between England and Iceland, where craftsmanship meets natural purity.

Distilled in England from the original Martin Miller’s Gin recipe, Summerful is further enhanced with Arctic thyme from Iceland and rosemary from the English countryside, delivering a delicate yet expressive botanical harmony. The result is a gin that feels like sunshine in a glass — crisp, aromatic, and elegantly herbaceous.

Every sip of Summerful tells the story of duality: the freshness of English gardens and the wild, cooling breeze of Iceland’s summer air.

name: Boatyard Sloe Boat (700 ml)

spirit – intense plum, almond and berry
fruitiness from the sloes and soft
sweetness from the honeysuckle paired
with our juniper forward gin

name: Donnafugata  Grappa di Ben Rye (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Its bouquet delivers typical citrus notes, followed by a superb aromatic range of fresh and candied fruit (citron, peach, apricot and exotic fruit) blended with a subtle aroma of vanilla.

name: Ruffino  Grappa Riserva Ducale ORO
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: Ruffino introduced Grappa Riserva Ducale Oro in 1993, produced from the marc of the company's flagship wine Riserva Ducale Oro.

name: Villa Sandi Grappa Bianca Superiore (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Villa Sandi Grappa Bianca Superiore is a celebration of simplicity perfected — a spirit born from the same vines that create Villa Sandi’s renowned Prosecco in the heart of Veneto, Italy. The Villa Sandi estate, long admired for its neoclassical architecture and centuries of winemaking artistry, brings that same dedication and finesse to the distillation of its grappa.

The word “Bianca”, meaning white, reflects the spirit’s crystalline purity. Unlike aged grappa, this version remains unwooded, allowing the true essence of the grape to shine. The term “Superiore” denotes its superior quality, achieved through careful selection of raw materials and expert distillation techniques.

Crafted from the pomace (vinacce) of the Glera grape — the very grape behind Villa Sandi’s finest Prosecco — the distillation is performed slowly in traditional copper pot stills, preserving the delicate, floral, and fruity aromas of the grape. Every drop embodies the connection between the art of winemaking and the precision of distillation.

Villa Sandi Grappa Bianca Superiore represents the second life of the vineyard, where time, craftsmanship, and purity merge into one elegant spirit.

name: Tommasi  Grappa Di Recioto Bianca (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Grappa "Recioto" Tommasi is distilled in the traditional manner and obtained with the dregs of wine Recioto della Valpolicella. It is generally distilled from the month of February, a period in which it is drawn off Recioto. The grapes Corvina, Rondinella and Molinara selected for Recioto are left to dry in the plateau, and crushed in January. The pomace high alcohol content, with lots of sugar residues give the grappa particular harmony and roundness of flavor on the palate.

name: Bottega  Alexander Grappa di Amarone (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Amarone is a robust and excellent Valpolicella wine that is aged in oak barrels for over 2 years. It is long-lived and characterized by its significant structure and the raisin scent. The grappa exactly reproduces the main characteristics of the wine. The distillation is carried out in steam alembics and is followed by a few months of refininement in stainless-steel tanks.

name: Alexander  Grappa Bianca (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short: This grappa is made from the grapes of the Pinot, Glera and Tocai vines, the most widespread in the eastern Veneto region. The marcs, still warm and winy, are steam distilled in alembics, so they conserve all the intensity of the fragrance and flavour of the original grapes. It produces a white, soft and fragranced grappa that is refined in steel barrels for 6 months so that all the aromas can mix together perfectly.

name: Bottega  Alexander Grappa Prosecco (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The name Prosecco calls to mind the wine well-known all over the world. The aromatic marc obtained from the typical yellow-green grapes of the vine Glera is distilled following Sandro Bottega's method when it is still fresh and vinous. The resulting grappa is then refined inside stainless steel containers for 3 to 6 months, in order to allow the different aromas to blend.

This grappa is made from the marc of fresh golden Moscato grapes. During steam-distillation inside stills, its alcohol content does not increase too much, in order to preserve its intense aromas.

desc_en_short: It is characterized by a moderate alcohol content and by an all-encompassing taste of chocolate. Its pervasive perfume whets the sense of smell, its softness satisfies the palate. The addition of Venetian grappa enhances the personality of this creamy liquor.

food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner

They have been kept in cellar during 10 years. A bouquet of honey and vanilla and an intense round taste with elegant scents of noble woods.

Due to its fruity elegance through the complex production process, it differs from grappa. The nobly formed, satin bottle visually underlines the freshness of the product.

name: Segnana  Grappa "Solera di Solera" (Chardonnay Barrrique) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: It comes from white pomace made from Chardonnay grapes, many of which come from the production of the fine Ferrari bubbles, which give the grappa elegance finesse, and red marcs that give strength and character. Of a fascinating amber color, Solera grappa from Solera stands out for its extraordinary complexity, which harmoniously blends vanilla and citrus notes with ethereal spicy scents. It seduces by its softness and its persuasive envelopment. To be enjoyed at room temperature (18-20 degrees), preferably in large "ballon" type glasses. 40% vol.

name: Granmonte  Red Jungle Grappa (700 ml)
food_matching: Chocolate, Dried Fruits, Cheese, After Dinner
desc_en_short:
Distilled spirit, made from 100% Thai- grown grape skins from GranMonte Vineyard and Winery in Khao Yai region.

Thailand's first ever Grappa, distilled from GranMonte precious grape skins. A uniquely aromatic spirit with dried-fruit character and a long, powerful finish.

name: Fattoria Le Pupille Grappa Di Poggio Valente	(500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Fattoria Le Pupille Grappa di Poggio Valente is born from the same vineyard that produces one of Tuscany’s most admired wines — Morellino di Scansano Poggio Valente. The grappa captures the pure spirit of the Sangiovese grape, distilled from the pomace (vinacce) left after fermentation, transforming what remains of the harvest into a new expression of elegance.

The house Fattoria Le Pupille, led by the visionary Elisabetta Geppetti, has long been a symbol of modern Maremma winemaking — bridging local Tuscan character with refinement and grace. With this grappa, Geppetti extends her philosophy of terroir into the world of spirits, revealing the soul of Poggio Valente in its purest, most essential form.

The distillation takes place in small copper stills under controlled temperature, preserving the aromatic integrity of Sangiovese skins. The resulting distillate rests patiently, gaining softness and roundness while maintaining its aromatic purity.

This is not merely a grappa — it’s the essence of Tuscany, distilled from sun, soil, and passion.

name: Villa Sandi Grappa Oris Invecchiata (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Villa Sandi Grappa Oris Invecchiata is the distilled soul of Veneto — a region where art, architecture, and winemaking intertwine seamlessly. Produced by the renowned Villa Sandi Estate, a symbol of Venetian refinement and craftsmanship, this Grappa captures the essence of Prosecco’s noble origins and the patience of aging (Invecchiata) in fine oak casks.

The name “Oris”, meaning “essence” in Latin, reflects the spirit’s purity and its deep connection to nature. Crafted from the pomace (vinacce) of the Glera grapes used to make Villa Sandi’s acclaimed Prosecco, the distillate undergoes slow copper still distillation to preserve aromatic delicacy and freshness.

After distillation, the Grappa rests quietly in small oak barrels, where time softens its edges and infuses subtle notes of spice, vanilla, and toasted wood. The result is a spirit that blends the vibrancy of youth with the wisdom of age — elegant, aromatic, and unmistakably Italian.

Every drop of Grappa Oris Invecchiata is a celebration of Venetian heritage, transformed by time into liquid gold.

name: Cristiani Grappa Alambicco (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Cristiani Grappa Alambicco is a tribute to Italy’s oldest distilling traditions — where grappa was born from both ingenuity and respect for the vineyard. Distilled from the pomace of premium Italian grapes, this spirit embodies the idea of transforming what remains of winemaking into a new creation of purity and character.

The name “Alambicco” refers to the traditional copper pot still (alembic) used to distill the grappa — a symbol of patience, precision, and craftsmanship. Produced in small batches in Northern Italy, Cristiani Grappa honors artisanal methods passed down through generations, where each distillation captures the aromatic essence of the grape skins and seeds.

Unaged and crystal clear, Cristiani Grappa Alambicco reveals a refined and authentic expression of Italian spirit-making — clean, aromatic, and gently warming, a perfect reflection of its origin and artistry.

name: Carlo Pellegrino Grappa Di Moscato Passito Nes (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Carlo Pellegrino Grappa di Moscato Passito NES is an exquisite interpretation of Sicilian elegance — born from the island’s most celebrated dessert wine, Passito di Pantelleria, made with sun-dried Zibibbo (Moscato) grapes.

Produced by Casa Pellegrino, a historic Marsala house founded in 1880, this grappa captures the aromatic intensity and warmth of Sicily’s volcanic lands. After the precious Moscato grapes are pressed for the NES Passito wine, the remaining pomace — still rich with sugar and perfume — is distilled slowly in traditional copper stills, preserving the floral sweetness and golden character of the fruit.

The result is a grappa that radiates sunshine and refinement — rich, fragrant, and silky, echoing the same sensuality that defines the wines of Pantelleria.

name: Damilano Grappa Di Nebbiolo Di Barolo (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Damilano Grappa di Nebbiolo di Barolo is a noble expression of Italian distilling tradition — a spirit born from the same Nebbiolo grapes that create the legendary wines of Barolo, known as “the King of Wines.” Crafted by Damilano, one of the oldest and most respected producers in Piedmont since 1890, this grappa captures the essence of Barolo’s terroir in its purest form.

After the Barolo wines are pressed, the remaining grape pomace — rich with aroma and structure — is carefully distilled in small copper stills using a slow, artisanal process. The result is a refined grappa that retains the fragrance, elegance, and complexity of Nebbiolo while transforming into a spirit of remarkable clarity and finesse.

Every sip of Damilano Grappa di Nebbiolo di Barolo is a tribute to the harmony between vineyard and craftsmanship — a continuation of the Barolo legacy, reborn through fire and distillation.

name: Kook Soon Dang   Ssal Makgeollii (750 ml) (Pack 20 Bottles)
desc_en_short: Makgeolli is an alcoholic drink made and mostly enjoyed in Korea. Made from a mixture of wheat and rice, is it sweet and milky with a clean and smooth taste. Classified and described as a ‘sparkling rice wine.’ Very traditional! Low alcohol (3%), serve chilled, and gently shake before drinking for better taste and richer flavor.

name: Kook Soon Dang   Peach Makgeollii (750 ml) (Pack 20 Bottles)
food_matching: Red Meat, Pasta, Grilled Vegetables, Cheese
desc_en_short: This authentic makgeolli from Korea’s No.1 rice wine brand is made with low- temperature pasteurisation to retain nutrients. Kooksoondang’s Peach Makgeolli adds fresh peach extract delivering a fragrant fruit aroma and a clean, smooth taste; it is laden with beneficial amino acids and dietary fibre and is gluten and sugar- free. Best serve chilled.

name: Kook Soon Dang  Banana Makgeollii (750 ml) (Pack 20 Bottles)
food_matching: Red Meat, Pasta, Grilled Vegetables, Cheese
desc_en_short: A unique blend of fresh banana extract. Rich amino acids carefully fermented from only the highest quality ingredients available. Keep chilled and gently shake before drinking for better taste and rich flavor.

name: Kook Soon Dang  Grape Makgeollii (750 ml) (Pack 20 Bottles)
desc_en_short: A deliciously slightly sweet makgeolli rice wine with the taste of fresh white grape added for balance and texture. Kooksoondang’s low-pasteurisation retains nutrients such as amino acids and dietary fibre. It is a clean, smooth and refreshing drink. Best served chilled. Shake first before pouring.

name: Kook Soon Dang  Chesnut Makgeollii (750 ml) (Pack 20 Bottles)
desc_en_short: Elevate your taste buds with Kooksoondang Chestnut Makgeolli, a delightful fusion of tradition and innovation. This Korean rice wine, known for its cloudiness and natural sweetness, takes on a unique twist with the rich flavor of chestnuts. With each sip, you'll experience a harmonious blend of creamy rice wine and the nutty goodness of chestnuts.

name: Kook Soon Dang  Stawberry Makgeollii (750 ml) (Pack 20 Bottles)
desc_en_short: Smooth Indulgence - Strawberry Makgeolli, at 4% alcohol by volume, boasts a silky texture and a delightful sweetness akin to fresh strawberries.

name: Cristiani  Limoncello di Liguria Extra (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Every three months Mr. Cristiani makes a selection of the best Lemon, choosing them especially in our area that it is near the sea.
Distilleria Cristiani takes only the peel of lemon, making a long infusion that it is ready after 60 days, in this moment the Master Distiller is a protagonist of a long activity to have a best infusion from the lemon peel.

Select  Aperitivo Bitter (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Visiting Venice is a dream-like experience that stays in your heart for the rest of your life. Its absolute beauty and unique charm make visitors feel like their are floating through a magical world. Select, the Very Venetian aperitif, was born in 1920 on Murano, one of the many islands of the Venetian Lagoon, famous for producing the world’s finest glassware. After over 90 years, thanks to its smooth taste and perfect balance of sweetness and intensity, Select is still the aperitif of choice for all Venetians.

name: Benvenuti  Nocino (500 ml)
desc_en_short: The Walnut is an old liquor made from immature nuts. for tradition indicates the day, or rather, the night of St. John (24 June) for the collection of "nuts still green." To ensure the prerogatives of this liquor every year on the feast of St. Valentino is organized Palio of Walnut, a competition in which it is awarded a plaque of honor at the best walnut prepared the night of St. John of the previous year.

name: Joseph Cartron  Curacao (700 ml)

name: Joseph Cartron  Kiwi (700 ml)

name: Joseph Cartron  Pomme Verte (700 ml)

name: Joseph Cartron  Melon Verte (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Joseph Cartron’s Melon Vert Liqueur is the result of slow maceration of the fruits followed by the addition of a small quantity of Melon Vert aroma. The quality of this recipe gives all its fresh and unique summer fruit flavour to this liqueur.

name: Joseph Cartron  Poire William (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The little sugar added to our liqueur will then enhance all the freshness of the fresh fruit and will allow amateurs of Poire Williams to savour this delicacy with a moderate alcohol content and to appreciate all its richness and its aroma in a cocktail.

name: Joseph Cartron  Banane (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This variety of an intense yellow colour and very arched, is well-known for the quality of its flesh and its very rich and unique taste.

name: Joseph Cartron  Lychee (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The aromatic power, the energy of the fruit as well as its freshness are all faithfully reproduced in Joseph Cartron’s Lychee liqueur. Unusual, astonishing in the concoction of surprising cocktails.

name: Joseph Cartron  Curacao Orange (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The spirit of orange obtained after distillation gives its exceptional character to this liqueur and brings all the roundness, softness and flavour of the fresh orange just crushed in mouth.

name: Joseph Cartron  Apricot Brandy (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Joseph Cartron Company is very attached to this soft stone variety. Not only does it promise a spectacular aromatic power when in contact with the alcohol, but it also provides this liqueur with its light and subtle taste of almond. Finally, the added Cognac gives this Joseph Cartron Apricot Brandy Liqueur all its structure and delicately woody flavour.

name: Joseph Cartron  Creme De Peche De Vigne De Bourgogne (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Today, the fruits selected to make the Joseph Cartron Cr?me de P?che de Vigne de Bourgogne are grown on the neighbouring slopes of the Hautes C?tes de Bourgogne. These little white, red veined flesh peaches give its gorgeous golden colour and unequalled aromatic power to this Fruit Liqueur.

name: Joseph Cartron  Creme De Framboise De Bourgogne (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The excellence of this recipe requires the delicate blending of the Lloyd George and Rose de Plombi?res fruit varieties. The mixture of these little fragile berries guarantees the tasty authenticity of this fruit liqueur.

name: Joseph Cartron  Curacao Triple Sec (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The harmonious blending of the two varieties of fruit as well as the traditional character of this recipe ensure an extreme concentration of spirit of orange of a rare intensity.

name: Joseph Cartron  Cocody Coconut (700 ml)
desc_en_short: All the flavour of the Caribbean contained in this fresh and soft liqueur brings finesse and elegance to the most unctuous of tropical cocktails.

name: Joseph Cartron  Creme De Cassis De Bourgogne Double Creme (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Joseph Cartron, very attached to quality, to the local terroir and all its treasures, has patiently built up over several generations very strong connections with the local producers of the Noir de Bourgogne variety.

name: Joseph Cartron  Creme De Mure Des Roncieres(Blackberry) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Joseph Cartron insists on using only wild blackberries that, contrary to the insipid cultivated varieties, are the only ones with real aromatic power. The selected fruits give Joseph Cartron’s Crème de Mûre des Roncières (Wild Blackberry Liqueur) the soft acidulous flavour particular to the wild blackberries harvested along the country paths of our childhood.

name: Joseph Cartron  Crème De Myrtille De Montagne (Blueberry) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: All the bits of leaves and twigs are eliminated in order to keep only the fruit. This uncompromising process represents the unique guarantee to obtain perfect fruits, full of flavour and aromas, that give Joseph Cartrons Creme de Myrtille de Montagne an agreeable wild note.

name: Joseph Cartron  Pamplemousse Rose (pink Grapefruit) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: he quality of the fruits and the recipe bring all the flavour, aroma and beautiful colour of the pink grapefruit to this refined liqueur, very long in mouth.

name: Joseph Cartron  Cherry Brandy (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Cognac and Kirsch are added in very specific quantities and it is the blend of all these noble ingredients which results in a fine, harmonious and ample liqueur.

name: Joseph Cartron  Eau De Vie Poire Williams (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Fruity, round, light, of a delightful finesse, Joseph Cartron’s Eau-de-Vie de Poire Williams is produced from pears grown in the best Burgundy terroirs of the Hautes Côtes de Beaune and the Monts du Lyonnais (near Lyons).

name: Joseph Cartron  Eau De Vie Mirabelle (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Cherry-plums are harvested in Lorraine (in the East of France), the favourite land of this deliciously golden small plum. Between midaugust and mid-september, our producers pick the fruit brimming with sunshine by slightly shaking the trees.

name: Joseph Cartron  Eu De Vie Kirsch (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Harvested when fully ripe, bursting with sunshine, the cherries are picked with great delicacy: the tails are discarded to avoid any undesirable bitterness.

name: Joseph Cartron  P.W. Des Monts De La Cote D'Or (700 ml)
desc_en_short: With an exceptional aromatic finesse and an everlasting length in the mouth, the Joseph Cartron Eau-de-Vie de Poire Williams des Monts de la Côte d’Or, is reserved for connoisseurs and pear lovers.

name: Marie Brizard  Curacao Blue (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A subtle mixture of Haitian bitter oranges and sweet orange zest from Southern Spain, with the addition of aromatic plants to make the characteristic taste of Marie Brizard Blue Cura?ao. Carefully distilled, these ingredients are simply mixed with a food colouring to give it a deep blue colour in cocktails.

name: Marie Brizard  Creme De Menthe Verte (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Based of essential oils extracted from fresh mint leaves, this Liqueur is made by distillation of the plant, rectified three times to purify it and give it a more powerful taste.

name: Marie Brizard  Cacao Blanc (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The finesse of this liqueur comes from the meticulous distillation of cocoa beans from Venezuela or Ivory Coast and a vanilla infusion. A final touch to add originality to this recipe by the Marie Brizard Liqueur Master: a touch of spice.

name: Marie Brizard  Creme de Banane (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Strict selection of the fruit: bananas from Ecuador, particularly appreciated for their taste and aromatic richness. A specific recipe of the Liqueur Master Marie Brizard, with a personal touch provided by the addition of pineapple juice, herbs and spices such as cocoa, vanilla or tea, to top up the flavour of this Liqueur.

name: Marie Brizard  Peach (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Made from the infusion of the best peaches and a dose of nuances and tradition, this liqueur is a true jewel full of sun and flavours.

name: Marie Brizard  Amaretto (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The subtlety of the bitter almond so dear to the Italians, its finesse, melting in your mouth, roundness and fresh aromatic notes... The Marie Brizard Amaretto liqueur will instantly take you straight to the heart of the sweet Italian night.

name: Marie Brizard  Coconut (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Discover the exotisme of coconut sublimed by caribbean rum. This liqueur reveals on the palate a delicate and tasty flavour that will embellish all your cocktails.

name: Marie Brizard  Creme de Menthe Blanche (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Taste all the strength and freshness of the mint that fills the country air at the start of summer. Using essential oils extracted from the leaves of this aromatic plant, Marie Brizard white mint cream will allow you to make a number of tasty cocktails.

name: Marie Brizard  Curacao Orange (700 ml)
desc_en_short: An unexpected marriage of a distillation of bitter-orange peel and the nobility of cognac, Marie Brizard’s Orange Curaçao has unforgettable golden reflections.

name: Marie Brizard  Fraise Des Bois -Wild Strawberry (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The aromas and tranquil atmosphere of the undergrowth. A harmony of subtle flavours and aromas, the Wild strawberry liqueur is a great success for Marie Brizard’s liqueur makers.

name: Marie Brizard  Creme de Framboise -Raspberry (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This raspberry liqueur is made from infusing two varieties of raspberry (Rose de Plombi?res and Lloyd George) and owes its originality and its unique taste to the final touch: the addition of infusions of blackcurrant and cherry.

name: Marie Brizard  Creme De Mure Blackberry (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The blackberry infusion comes from the maceration of wild fruit. Marie Brizard’s master liqueur-maker refines this by adding blackberry juice. This exclusive recipe reveals a blackberry cream that is balanced and full of imagination

name: Luxardo  Passion Nera (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The flavor is different from traditional Sambuca, owing to a special blending of the spices focusing on cardamom, seeds of East Indian herbs and a member of the ginger family. The finish is long, medium-sweet, and licorice-like; very nice.

name: De Kuyper  Creme de Bananes (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Globally well over 100 billion bananas are consumed each year. And there’s a good reason for that. Not only do they contain all the nutrients you can think of, it’s also the only fruit certified to make you happy. Really, the amino acid in ripe bananas sends your serotonin levels through the roof. For this liqueur we used a distillate of top-grade, sugar spotted bananas. All to bring more joy.

name: De Kuyper  Creme de Cacao Brown (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Chocolate liquor left aside, our Crème de Cacao is as close as you can come to the original. In fact, we think it’s even better. This liqueur offers all that makes chocolate so tempting, and we added a little more. We went to Africa and back to find the finest cacao beans and enriched the extract with a touch of sweet vanilla and caramel. Resulting in a crème with a taste as intense as is colour.

name: De Kuyper  Creme de Menthe White (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The easiest way to freshen up a drink is to add some crisp mint leaves. But if you’re after a real minty experience nature falls short. A good mouthwash requires something stronger. By flavouring neutral spirit with fresh mint, lemon oil and sugar, we’ve jacked-up the taste. This menthe happens to be crystal clear, but you might as well pick the green variant, for both are flavoured the same.

name: De Kuyper  Creme de Cacao White (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Let’s be clear, there’s no such thing as white cacao. The only reason we named this crème white, is to set it apart from its darker and bitterer compeer. By using a crystal clear double distilled cacao extract we created the perfect cocktail ingredient, sweet and translucent. Without the brown this liqueur still qualifies as pure chocolate, offering a rich nose of cacao and a nice hint of butter.

name: Valentino  Sambuca (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A powerful but pleasant aroma and palate of liquorice and anise, mellowed by a subtle sweetness.

name: Luna Verde  Manzana (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Crafted according to a typically Spanish recipe, this green apple based liqueur has within the space of a few years made its mark for its freshness and originality. The Luna Verde Manzana Verde is crafted from the juice of green apples. To be enjoyed on the rocks or in a cocktail with soda, LUNA VERDE Manzana Verde reveals its subtle flavour and the delicate tang of its taste.

name: Pastis  Jean Canon (1 L)
desc_en_short: A delicious star anise flavor and herbs that create a flavour that cleans and refreshes the pallet. A refreshing aperitif that show's off it's subtle floral, fruit and spice notes. Serving : Mix it with water and ice.

name: Chambord Liqueur (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Chambord is the premium black raspberry liqueur with a fine French heritage. Chambord stands alone in its category — and in its iconic, captivating packaging. For the person who appreciates a life full of great experiences, Chambord is the essential spirit that elevates and brings magic to cocktailing and culinary experiences. Captivating to the most discerning palate, Chambord tempts and rewards experimentation.

name: Ambrosia  Honey Liqueur (500 ml)
desc_en_short: The Nose is dominated by Honey with hints of Orange and aniseed. In the mouth the Ambrosia is superbly rounded with the Honey and aniseed flavours dancing over the taste buds of the tongue. While drinking the feeling is that of liquid honey smoothly pouring down your throat providing a warming glow all over your body.

name: Illy  Illyquore (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Deep, lovely espresso taste. Like an Italian espresso. Sweet but not overly sweet. Great as is, on ice creams, on ice, and on cakes. Adds flavour to tiramisu. The best espresso liqueur tried so far.

name: Bob's Bitters  Ginger (100 ml)
desc_en_short: The natural aroma of ginger brought the root to celebrated acclaim in house-hold kitchens across the world – but now thanks to Bob's Bitters, ginger is finding its role as a cocktail ingredient as well. The sour spiciness of this bitter compliments sweet spirits wonderfully.

name: Bob's Bitters  Chocolate (100 ml)
desc_en_short: This chocolate bitter can be characterised by its deep and round flavor, and works wonderfully with cocktails with dark spirits as a base.It matches best with whiskey and rum, but clearer distilled spirits also harmonize excellently in combination with Bob's Chocolate Bitters.

name: Bob's Bitters  Lavender (100 ml)
desc_en_short: Bob's lavender bitters possess a fine combination of wood and flower notes.It suits well in any number of drinks or cocktails using Gin, Vodka and, Tequila.

name: Bob's Bitters  Cardamon (100 ml)
desc_en_short: Cardamom Bitters work excellently in combination with other bitters. Alone, cardamom bitters are produced at only 20% ABV and offer a decent sweet and spicy taste to your cocktails. The prize-winning Mocha Aqua cocktail from Andrea Patelli

name: Bob's Bitters  Peppermint (100 ml)
desc_en_short: Bob's peppermint bitters have a well-defined peppermint-menthol aroma and develop only later their light citrus flavor. A light woody tone can also be noted in the aftertaste.Stefano Cossio uses 4 to 6 dashes of the peppermint bitters in his prize-winning Pomme Allure cocktail

name: Bob's Bitters  Liquorice (100 ml)
desc_en_short: Bob's liquorice bitters have a bittersweet taste, accompanied by lightly woody notes. It harmonizes excellently with all sorts of spirits, rum, whiskey, gin, and Galliano.

name: Bob's Bitters  Orange And Mandarin (100 ml)
desc_en_short: This bitter has a juicy effect on the palate and the multi dimensional flavor develops only later. Therefore, the Orange & Mandarin Bitter is rarely noticeable on the surface flavor of a cocktail, but rather its herbal, bloomy tones develop only later making it an excellent accompaniment to bubbly champagne or gin cocktails

name: Bob's Bitters  Grapefruit (100 ml)
desc_en_short: Grapefruit Bitters work charmingly in sweet cocktails thanks for their sour but spicy qualities. Like Bob's ginger bitters, the grapefruit bitters harmonize especially well with martinis and all other cocktails with sweet spirits as a base.

name: Bob's Bitters  Vanilla (100 ml)
desc_en_short: Bob's Vanilla Bitters have a light cacao flavor, mixed with tahiti-vanilla and a breath of bitter chocolate. Vanilla Bitters are ideal for cocktails with gin or bourbon as a base. Prize-winning cocktails using vanilla bitters can be found in our cocktails section.

name: Bob's Bitters  Coriander (100 ml)
desc_en_short: The coriander bitters work wonderfully especially with gin, but can refine cocktails with any base to add a fine aroma and a mild hint of coriander. Working particularly well with gin-based drinks, these bitters bring a fine mild hint of coriander to any cocktail. Citrus with a sweet caramel finish.

name: Mr.Boston  White Creme De Menthe (1 L)
desc_en_short: Peppermint flavored with a cool, refreshing taste

name: Mr.Boston  Melon (1 L)
desc_en_short: Mr. Boston Melon has a vibrant green color with a soothing citrus aroma.   It has the light and refreshing taste of melon and when mixed within a cocktail, it has a deliciously smooth finish. Try this delicious liqueur in a fruit full cocktail and notice the vibrate and unique presentation and great taste.

name: Bitter Truth  Elderflower Liqueur (500 ml)
desc_en_short: This liqueur, which has a luminous golden color and a fresh rich bouquet, offers a great variety of flavors. Dominated by elderflowers, complemented by spicy aromas of honey, and fruity notes of quince and grape.

name: Bitter Truth  Violet Liqueur (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Slightly sweet and very flowery. The violet aroma is very subdued and natural.

name: Bitter Truth  Apricot Liqueur (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Sweet and fruity. The aroma of ripe apricots is dominant. In the background, a hint of almond from the apricot pit is noticeable.

name: Carpano  Antica Formula Vermouth (1 L)
desc_en_short: Carpano Antica Formula, the Vermouth with a unique, unmistakable taste and rich, multi-layered body, was created by Casa Carpano, the company that invented the Vermouth category in 1786 in Turin, Italy. Antica Formula’s complex, original and inimitable recipe has remained unchanged to this day, thanks to the passion and ability of Fratelli Branca Distillerie to stay faithful to its original recipe.

name: Carpano  Classico Vermouth (1 L)
desc_en_short: Carpano Classico is based on the original vermouth recipe invented by Antonio Benedetto Carpano. Compared to Antica Formula it has a less intense aromatic note of citrus fruits and particularly vanilla which give it a “robust” character. Its spicy, citrusy hints come together in a harmonious blend of flavours, complimenting the wormwood notes, to give this classic vermouth a balanced and smooth unique taste.

name: Carpano  Bianco Vermouth (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Carpano Bianco has a light yellow colour, a fresh and complex aroma and an easily identifiable winey note, in addition to citrussy and exotic fruit flavours. Fresh cocoa beans and almonds complete the bouquet of this delicious vermouth.

name: Carpano  Dry Vermouth (750 ml)
desc_en_short: “Carpano Dry” is the name of the new Carpano vermouth. It has a drier taste and a lower sugar content than the other vermouths. The product has its origins in the history of Carpano, enriched with the experience of the Branca brand in the choice and use of the raw materials. Indeed, the most valuable Italian wines are chosen to make this vermouth, helping the finished product to maintain its organoleptic properties for a long time, thanks also to the purification and standardization stages and rigorous quality controls.

name: Bitter Truth  Lemon Bitters (200 ml)
desc_en_short: Fresh and fruity-tangy with an unbelievably intense citrus note. They are bitter to the taste with flavorful notes of coriander and cardamom in the background.

name: Bitter Truth  Peach Bitters (200 ml)
desc_en_short: Delicate peach notes, balanced with hints of almonds and backed up with spices and balanced bitter nuances. Fruity with a faint almond bitterness from the pits. The natural aroma of fresh peaches dominates while it is completed by fresh citrus and unobtrusive spice flavors. The finish tails off with a herbaceous, nutty note, leaving more fizzy peach to linger.

name: Bitter Truth  Tonic Bitters (200 ml)
desc_en_short: Exotic notes of citrus and spice, balanced by a grassy-fresh Japanese green tea bouquet. Backed up with herbal notes from juniper berries, coriander seeds and mace.

name: Pages  Triple sec (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A true intense flavour to enhance your favourite cocktails. A great Triple Sec, ideal for successful margaritas.

name: Pages  Apricot (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A sweet gourmet liquor with nice fruity flavors and a hint of almond.

name: Pages  Caramel (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Sweet and soft notes of a fruity and aromatic caramel with a hint of vanilla flavour. Ideal for cocktails and desserts toppings.

name: Pages  Blue Caracao (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A magic colour with intense flavours or orange and citrus that delight eyes and palate for amazing cocktails!

name: Pages  Earl Grey (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A floral bouquet and a rich body of candied citrus peels with a hint of honey.

name: Pages  Banana (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A traditional liqueur with intense banana fragrances and fruity taste. For sweet fruity cocktails and over ice-creams.

name: Pages  Coconut (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A full range of flavors where everyone can find their favourite scent and can indulge in the discovery Enjoy it without restraint and in alcohol-free cocktails!

name: Pages  Ice mint  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A full range of flavors where everyone can find their favourite scent and can indulge in the discovery Enjoy it without restraint and in alcohol-free cocktails!

name: Pages  Strawberry (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A full range of flavors where everyone can find their favourite scent and can indulge in the discovery Enjoy it without restraint and in alcohol-free cocktails!

name: Pages  Green Apple (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A full range of flavors where everyone can find their favourite scent and can indulge in the discovery Enjoy it without restraint and in alcohol-free cocktails!

name: Vaccari  Sambuca (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Vaccari Sambuca is a crystal clear aniseed flavored after dinner liqueur of 38% vol. with a refreshing hint of mint when served neat and becomes opalescent when mixed with water or ice; the result of mixing essential oils with water.

name: Licor 43  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Licor 43 is a unique golden liquere based on a secret Spanish family recipe of selected herbs, citrus and other fruits from the Mediterranean sea. It delivers a delicious and underfined flavour, which suggests hints of vanilla and caramel.

name: King's Ginger  (500 ml)
desc_en_short: This liquere is seductively golden with an instantly warming aroma of ginger, zesty lemon, sherbet and golden syrup. Initial sweetness followed by bite of ginger and lemon tart. Deliciously and satisfying and warming mouthfeel. Finished with lingering and extremely long. Best served on the rocks; decent scotch and splashed into a dry ginger ale.

name: Cocalero  (Coca Leaf liquor) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Cocalero is a herbal spirit made with the South American coca leaf and 16 other botanicals including guarana, juniper and ginseng. This can be enjoyed ice-cold from the freezer, or in a variety of cocktails, for example as a replacement for rum in a Mojito.

name: Chocolais  (Milk Chocolate Cream liquor) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Rich dark chocolate flavour that will have customers craving to buy again and again.There's only one way to improve on the sensual experience of rich dark chocolate with a glass of fine red wine - put them in the same bottle. That's exactly what Chocolais does. And it gives you a niche to profit from, especially with women and the men who buy for them. The countries of origin for the ingredients of Chocolais is the unequalled dream team: rich Swiss chocolate; thick Dutch cream; fine Italian wine. And since it has the same proof as wine, it can be carried in every venue licensed to sell alcoholic beverages. With the impact of graphics that are almost as luxurious, Chocolais begins to sell itself at no additional cost as soon as it reaches your floor. Chocolais was recently voted the number one product of its type by drinks writers in the USA

name: Bittermens  Boston (125 ml)
desc_en_short: It’s citrus, citrus, citrus and more citrus, supported with a heavy dose of chamomile. We think it smells like summer. Try it in your favorite fizz, sour or bright tropical drink. It works extremely well with pisco and scotch as well.

name: Bittermens  Hellfire Habanero Shrub (125 ml)
desc_en_short: Bittermens love spiced food, as do we. This is where Hellfire Habanero Shrub comes into play! Sometimes flavor is lacking when spices are brought into the picture but Bittermens brings a spice to the cocktail creation without having to use hot sauces which can throw off the balance of a cocktail.

name: McCormick's  Irish cream (750 ml)
desc_en_short: McCormick's Irish Cream is a cream Liqueur from Ireland and has an alcohol percentage of 17%, which is around the average for a liqueur. The palate of this liqueur is characterized by Cream notes.

name: Bittermens   Orange Cream Citrate (125 ml)
desc_en_short: Instead of thinking about bitters, Bittermens started to explore the syrups and preparations used in soda shops, focusing on cream sodas and phosphates. Riffing on an orange cream soda syrup, they created a concentrated orange cream tincture and modified it with a heavy dose of citric acid

name: Carpano  Punt e Mes Vermouth (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Punt e Mes has a golden orange color with topaz tones, herby aromas and dark red, black dahlia with vermilion shades. The initial taste is one of sweetness, characterised by an intriguing accent of orange. This is followed by the characteristically bitter taste of the quina and ends on a sweet note.

name: Giffard  Hazelnut (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Giffard Hazelnut Liqueur made from the maceration of roasted hazelnut. Touches of fresh hazelnuts and almonds Sweet and smooth palate. Strong aromatic body. Vegetal and woody notes at the end.

name: Giffard  Parfait Triple Sec (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Giffard  Parfait Triple Sec Liqueur made from the distillation of bitter and sweet oranges.

name: Giffard  Crème De Menthe Verte (Green Mint) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Herbal liqueurs made with mint offer the crisp, refreshing quality pertained to by mint, and can be used to make a variety of fantastic cocktails.

name: Giffard  Crème De Peches (Peach) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Peach Liquor (Crème de Pêche) from the natural fruit made from a slow maceration of peaches in a neutral beet alcohol. Intensely peachy and fruity. Notes of a fresh compote finish with a hint of the fruits own stone aroma. Overall it is fresh and pleasant. A light yellow with golden shades

name: Giffard  Tropical Mango (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Liqueur made with mango juice and exotic fruits. Highly flavoured liqueur presented in a original, silk screen printed and frosted bottle.

name: Giffard  Vanille De Madagascar (Vanilla) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Vanilla Planifolia varietal  rich in sweet notes and Vanilla Tahitensis with more complex aromatic taste. The combination of both varietals gives this liqueur this typical taste

name: Giffard  Muroise (Blackberry & Raspberry) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Muroise is a hybrid berry with all of the strengths of black berries and raspberries, yet none of their weaknesses. In a fight it can beat all berries, except for Loganberries. The Muroise berries are slowly macerationg and the liqueur offers a rich and fascinating flavour.

name: La Quintinye  Vermouth Blanc
desc_en_short: The subtle combination of 18 plants and the blend of white wines and Pineau des Charentes Blanc.

name: Domaine De Canton  Ginger Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Clean, pale lemon colour; pronounced aromas of fresh grated ginger and spice; sweet with spicy ginger and honey flavours; long finish with a bit of heat.

name: Mathilde  Cassis Liqueur (350 ml)
desc_en_short:
Cassis has been referred to as the “Elixir of life” since the 18th century. Cassis liqueur has been made across several regions in France for decades. Some of the finest blackcurrant berries are found in Burgundy and are called Noir de Bourgogne, and we use those as well as berries from the Loire Valley, called the Royal de Naples.

Noir de Bourgogne blackcurrants have excellent aromatic qualities and are considered the tastiest blackcurrants to eat. We also use the Royal de Naples, which have a soft, sweet flavor.

name: Mathilde  Framboise Liqueur (350 ml)
desc_en_short:
Three varieties of raspberry are used to make Mathilde Framboise. The first, called Lloyd George, originates in Scotland and is particularly well known for its berry fruits. The other two berries, both from Burgundy, are the Rose de Plombières and the Violette de Boux.

The berries are pressed into a puree and are then added to the alcohol base for maceration. The Lloyd George raspberries are used primarily for their bright color, while the intense aromatics mainly come from the berries from Burgundy. We find that this blend of the three varieties produces an exquisite complexity.

name: Mathilde  Peche Liqueur (350 ml)
desc_en_short:
The vine peaches used for Mathilde Pêche are small, with a tough skin and moderately soft, white flesh with a particularly rich aroma. They are considered to be the most flavorful peach variety. Vine peaches are incredibly juicy, despite their small size, with an intense and seductive taste. We only use vine peaches cultivated in France that are hand selected to ensure their freshness.

The peaches – skin, flesh and pit – are macerated in alcohol. The entire peach is used to extract as much of its taste and aroma as possible. A small amount of sugar is incorporated and water is added to bring the liqueur to proof and round out the liqueur’s distinctly pleasing palate.

name: Bittermens  Orchard Street Celery Shrub (125 ml)
desc_en_short: Bittermens Orchard Street Celery Shrub was partially inspired by a pickle seller in New York, partially inspired by a vintage soda which was made with celery and partially inspired by picklebacks. Sounds pretty cool, right? To make it, they use a shrub, a vinegar-based drink, flavoured with apple and celery and concentrated so it can be used like you would regular cocktail bitters. They suggest trying it with aquavit.

name: Hiram Walker  Cherry Brandy (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Hiram Walker® Cherry Brandy is smooth and delicious. It has a brilliant, sparkling color, delicate bouquet and true, tart cherry flavor.

name: Hiram Walker  Amaretto (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Amaretto made from all natural ingredients including apricot and almond, Hiram Walker® Amaretto is warm golden brown liqueur with a strong almond and caramel flavor.

name: Hiram Walker  Kirschwasser (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Kirsch cherry pits are infused in this liqueur creating a crisp and tart spirit. Nose is fresh with a candied cherry aroma, leading to a sweet and tart palate. Perfect for cocktails.

name: Pimm's The Original No.1 (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The rich amber hue of PIMM'S No. 1 comes from infusing lots of lovely gin with herbal botanicals, caramelised orange and delicate spices.

name: Drambuie Scotch Whisky Liqueur (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Drambuie is an aged Scotch Whisky that has been blended with herbs, spices and heather honey to produce a decadent after-dinner drink. A classic and rich Scotch, no home-bar is ever complete until Drambuie sits along the shelf.

name: Solerno  Blood Orange Liqueur (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The nose bursts with whole-fruit blood orange, orange blossom and a hint of bright and zesty lemon. The palate yields a velvety sweetness, balancing tartness, and the full body of an 80 proof/ 40% abv spirit with a lasting, dry finish.

name: Dolin  Blanc Vermouth (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The Blanc has a beautiful nose of white cake, orange peel, flowers and cloves, with these flavors persisting on the palate, followed by a long, surprisingly fresh and acidic finish.

name: Dolin  Dry Vermouth (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The Dry has a subtle, slightly grassy nose, mingled with aromas of lime, thyme, and white wine. it is noticeably lighter in body, and lacks acrid sting on the finish.

name: Dolin  Rouge Vermouth (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The Rouge pours a golden-brown color like off-dry sherry. The nose gives one the immediate impression of oxidized pasta sauce, coming on strong with oregano and roasted tomatoes, along with sherry, sage, and red apple skin.

name: Blutwurz  Krauter Likor (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Penningers Blutwurz in the classic, brown bottle, is the star of Penningers specialties. Its popularity is way beyond Bavaria already.

name: Blutwurz  Black (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Redesigned Blutwurz in a black bottle, the classic taste and fresh design is worth two awards from the world drinks awards. The black ceramic bottle of Blutwurz black & red are representing modern Bavaria, the urban side.

name: Blutwurz  Red (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Blutwurz kisses cherry! In celebration of 111 years of Penninger, have found new style of drinking. The sister of Blutwurz-Black. Famous and loved Blutwurz-taste combined with a cherry note.

name: Elerlikor  Egg Yolk Liquer (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Penninger Eierlikör made from an old family-recipe based on egg yolk mixed with cherry-water, raspberry- liquor and more delicious ingredients. It’s a German classic. Not just for drinking, also to bake cakes and cookies.

name: Blutwurz  Black & Red Wooden Box
desc_en_short:
Blutwurz  Black & Red Wooden Box

1 X Blutwurz  Black

1 X Blutwurz  Red

name: Peeled  Orange Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Peeled Orange Liqueur is crafted using malted barley and is aged for three years in American oak. Infused with orange peels, this artisanal liqueur has a delicate sweetness and aromatic citrus character. Peeled is perfect on the rocks or in your favourite cocktail.

name: Del Professore  Vermouth Classico (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The luxurious amber colour of the Vermouth del Professore Classico is reminiscent of Marsala and the aromas on the nose fluctuate between hints of the liquorice and bitterness in absinthe, dried straw, mahogany and tea infusions. The medicinal quality in the flavour of the alcohol and its continual underlying bitterness manages to keep in balance with the refreshing flavours of herbs and spices, and is complemented by sweeter notes of ginger and citrus peel, making the Vermouth both slightly bitter and slightly sweet.

name: Del Professore  Vermouth Rosso (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The Vermouth has a pleasing amber color and an intriguing aroma of herbs, citrus and honey. As a Rosso, it is supposed to be sweet and that comes out on the palate but it is a a softer sweetness, well balanced with acidity, savory elements and a hint of bitterness.

name: Mr.Black  Cold Brew Coffee Liqueur (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Mr.Black is a bittersweet blend of top-grade Arabica coffees and Australian wheat vodka. Our roasters source specialty beans from the best growing regions to create a complex liqueur that is bold, balanced and unapologetically coffee.

Each and every bottle is made by hand at our coffee roastery and distillery just north of Sydney, Australia. With half the sugar and ten times the coffee of old- world liqueurs, Mr Black is the cold brew liqueur for coffee purists.

name: Mr.Black  Coffee Amaro Liqueur (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Mr.Black Coffee Amaro is a bitter liqueur inspired by Italy’s after-dinner drink tradition and Australia’s coffee culture. This special edition recipe captures the flavours and aromas found in both beverages: bright fruits, abundant herbs and seductive spices.

Handcrafted by Master Distiller Philip Moore, our Coffee Amaro combines his 30-year botanical obsession with our undying devotion to the pursuit of quality coffee. Coffee Amaro is available from specialty retailers in limited quantities.

name: Baileys  Strawberry (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Perfectly blending the fresh, sumptuous taste of strawberries with light and creamy vanilla, together with the luxurious taste of Baileys Original Irish Cream, this dreamy combination is a truly indulgent treat to enjoy with your friends on those long summer days.

name: Five Farms  Irish Cream (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Five Farms Irish Cream Liqueur has been awarded the Chairman’s Trophy at the 2018 Ultimate Spirits Challenge, the premier spirits competition in the world. The 97 score awarded to Five Farms is the highest that an Irish Cream Liqueur has ever received in this prestigious competition, signaling the arrival of a brand that is poised to elevate the category.

name: Pampelle  Ruby L'Apero (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
An aperitif made for you, only you, but also everyone else. With Ruby Red Grapefruits hand-picked in Corsica. And crafted on the banks of the River Charente. Cheers your Spritz to an artisanal contradiction of bitter-sweet citrus & natural botanicals.

Each boldly‐designed bottle is stamped with the seal of a Damselfly, a protected native species.

Pampelle is the worlds most versatile Aperitif. Whilst it makes an amazing Spritz, it also has become a favourite with bartenders as staple for numerous cocktails. Or to just sip away and enjoy the true flavor of Pampelle, just add tonic…..or don’t !

name: Italicus  Rosolio Bergamot (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Italicus Rosolio di Bergamotto is a blend of bergamot peel, Cedro lemons, chamomile, lavender, gentian, yellow roses and Melissa balm. An aromatic and lightly spicy liqueur which balances honeyed sweetness with rooty bitterness.

name: Scrappy's  Aromatic Bitters (300 ml)
desc_en_short: Scrappy's answer to the classic aromatic bitters.  These were created to be used in classic cocktail recipes, adding balance and spice to your favorite spirits.  Using the finest herbs, fresh citrus zested by hand, never using oils or extracts.  Every batch is made using organic ingredients of the highest quality with no artificial flavors, chemicals, or dyes.

name: Scrappy's  Orange Bitters (300 ml)
desc_en_short: A craft bar staple for over 150 years. Scrappy’s orange bitters continues the tradition with this unique blend of bright, fresh and bitter oranges, herbs, and spices.  Scrappy's selects the finest herbs and zests all their fresh citrus by hand, never using oils or extracts. Every batch is made using organic ingredients of the highest quality with no artificial flavors, chemicals, or dyes.

name: Molly's  Irish Cream Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Molly's Irish Cream Liquor is a premium blend of fresh dairy cream, aged Irish Whiskey, fine Irish Spirits, and natural chocolate flavours. Molly's uses the freshest possible, highest quality Irish cream which is sourced locally from grass fed cows- in fact, it is so fresh that it typically takes only 48 hours from cow to bottle. With a long history in cream liquor blending and using state of the art technology, Molly's is arguably the world's best tasting Irish Cream Liqueur. Today, Molly's is enjoyed in over 40 countries worldwide, spread across six continents.

name: St. George  NOLA Coffee Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
The Experience

We chose to work with Yirgacheffe coffee beans specifically for their bright berry, chocolate, and round fruity qualities. The coffee’s contribution is complemented by the chicory root’s plum/date notes and bitter undertones.

Sipped neat, NOLA is delicious alongside breakfast, dessert, and any meal in between—with each sip revealing more character. In cocktails, it provides a touch of sweetness, earthy depth, and that robust roasted flavor that coffee lovers crave.

name: St. George  Spiced Pear Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Genuinely juicy, with a vivid, ripe pear flavor, against a backdrop of cinnamon and clove. It’s rich and luscious on the tongue, and takes well to every spirit we can think of. — Food & Wine

name: St. George  Raspberry Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
A show-stopper. This is what all raspberry liqueurs aspire to, with a luxurious mouthfeel and just the right balance between sweet and tart.

Review

5 stars/Highest recommendation. Genuine and luscious beyond words. — Spirit Journal

The world's best raspberry liqueur — WNPR

name: Tatratea  Coconut Liqueur Slovakia (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Enriched with coconut extracts, which give it its dominant sweetness and aroma. It also contains extracts from first-class white tea derived from young tea leaves, which enhance the taste of the product with their fineness.

name: Tatratea  Citrus Liqueur Slovakia (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Enriched with extracts from citrus fruits (lemon and lime), which give it a distinct citrus flavour while keeping its wonderful tea and fruity aroma.

name: Tatratea  Peach Liqueur Slovakia (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Known for its wonderful tea and fruity aroma thanks to the additional white tea and peach extracts which leave it with a pleasant delicate and unmistakable scent. It is strong, elegant and drifting, with a flavor so rare that you will thank yourself for being in this moment.

name: Tatratea  Original Liqueur Slovakia (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Unique tea-based herbal liqueur made exclusively from natural ingredients. It is a concentrate of exceptionally fine purified alcohol, first-class black tea, natural extracts from high mountain herbs, fruit extracts and distillates, real sugar and pure water from the Tatra Mountains.

name: Wenneker  Hazelnut (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This distinctive liqueur can be classified as an exceptionally delightful treat. Wenneker Hazelnut is pre-eminently suited as a digestive, served with a fresh cup of coffee for example. This liqueur can also be used in cocktails or you may want to try warm Chocolate Milk with Wenneker Hazelnut. Use in desserts and cakes is also thoroughly recommended.

name: Wenneker  Lychee (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This is the newest flavour in the Wenneker range of liqueurs. The immediate taste experience is of real, ripe lychees. Originally a favourite in Asia, Lychees have recently become more and more popular in Western countries too. No wonder! It is a luscious fruit, with a really exotic taste. You can drink Wenneker Lychee straight, on the rocks, but this clear, adaptable liqueur is also ideal for creating fantastic cocktails.

name: Wenneker  Curacao Orange (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Curacao Orange is a particularly pleasant and fruity liqueur.

Sun ripened oranges and Curacao oranges are the main flavour enhancers for the homebrewed distillates of the authentic family recipe for Wenneker Curacao Orange. Whether straight or on the rocks, this liqueur is a successful aperitif or digestive. Curacao Orange is also ideal for use in cocktails.

name: Wenneker  Blue Curacao (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
This is a refreshing liqueur on the basis of our home distilled curaçao peels distillate. The various citrus fruits can be clearly recognised in the flavour.
Because of the bright blue colour, Blue Curacao is a popular and indispensable ingredient for many cocktails. However, straight, on-the-rocks or in a long-drink with orange juice or lemonade Blue Curacao is also exceptionally tasteful.

name: Wenneker  Cherry Brandy (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
One of the most popular liqueurs in our range is the Cherry Brandy. This liqueur is known for its distinct cherry flavour from concentrated Marasca cherry juice. The fruity distillate which is added gives a surprising finesse. T

The natural Cherry Brandy flavours are enjoyed best when drunk straight or with ice. Still, this liqueur is also indispensable in numerous cocktails and extremely suitable for long-drinks with orange juice, lemonade or carbonated mineral water. It is also very tasty to add a little Cherry Brandy to Advocaat or to pour it on ice-cream: a real treat!

name: Cointreau  Shaker Set (700 ml)
desc_en_short:

name: Carlo Pellegrino  Bato Amaro Siciliano (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Pellegrino Bato Amaro Siciliano is a heartfelt expression of Sicilian tradition — a blend of heritage, herbs, and Mediterranean sunshine, born from the legendary house of Carlo Pellegrino, founded in 1880 in Marsala.

For over a century, Pellegrino has celebrated the flavors of Sicily through its wines and spirits. Bato Amaro continues that legacy by distilling the island’s essence into a modern amaro — balancing the bitterness of local herbs with the brightness of Sicilian citrus.

Made using bitter orange peel, gentian root, myrtle, and Mediterranean botanicals, Bato evokes the rugged beauty of Sicily: sun-drenched, aromatic, and vibrant. Its name — Bato — pays homage to ancient myth and the strength of the earth, a nod to both tradition and modern craftsmanship.

The result is a refined amaro that captures Sicily’s soul — bittersweet, complex, and endlessly captivating.

name: Xopa Single Origin Coffee Liquer (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
XOPA Single Origin Coffee Liqueur is a tribute to the purity of coffee — crafted from hand-selected single-origin beans, this liqueur honors the world’s most beloved beverage through the lens of fine distillation.

Every bottle of XOPA begins with carefully sourced coffee from renowned high-altitude farms, where terroir defines flavor. The beans are freshly roasted and cold-infused into neutral spirit, preserving the aromatic intensity of espresso while creating a silky, complex depth of flavor.

Unlike many commercial liqueurs, XOPA is crafted with restraint — less sugar, more authenticity. It celebrates coffee’s natural bitterness, cocoa richness, and nutty undertones, resulting in a balanced and modern interpretation that feels both sophisticated and honest.

“XOPA” takes its name from an ancient word meaning “celebration” — fitting for a spirit that captures the ritual, passion, and poetry of coffee itself.

name: Rinomato Aperitivo (1 L)
desc_en_short:
Rinomato was born in Torino, the historic cradle of Italy’s aperitivo tradition — a city where craftsmanship, conversation, and the art of pleasure have long intertwined.

The name “Rinomato”, meaning renowned or celebrated in Italian, perfectly captures the brand’s purpose: to revive the glory of classic aperitivi with a modern sensibility. Created by a team of passionate Italian blenders, Rinomato is made from hand-selected Alpine herbs, roots, and citrus peels, including Calabrian bitter orange and rhubarb, using a slow maceration process to extract their full aromatic complexity.

The result is an aperitivo that bridges heritage and innovation — combining the bittersweet balance of old-world recipes with the brightness and precision of modern craft. It’s not just a drink; it’s an expression of La Dolce Vita — the sweet life of Italy, distilled.

name: Ratafia Rossi (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
Ratafia Rossi is a celebration of Italian tradition — a sweet, ruby-hued liqueur born from the union of fruit, herbs, and time. Originating from the Abruzzo and Piedmont regions of Italy, Ratafia has long been cherished as a digestivo shared among friends and family after hearty meals.

The name “Ratafia” is said to come from the Latin phrase “ut rata fiat” — meaning “so be it agreed” — referring to the old custom of sealing agreements with a toast of this crimson spirit.

Ratafia Rossi is crafted from freshly harvested cherries (Ciliegie Rosse) that are macerated in red wine and neutral spirit, enriched with aromatic herbs and natural spices. This slow infusion captures the vibrant sweetness of ripe fruit and the depth of Italian terroir, creating a drink that is as romantic as it is refined.

Each bottle embodies the art of patience and the warmth of Italian hospitality — a liqueur that turns every sip into a gesture of celebration.

name: Sambuca Lucano (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Sambuca Lucano is a creation of the Lucano family, renowned for crafting Italy’s iconic herbal liqueur, Amaro Lucano, since 1894 in the town of Pisticci, Basilicata — the heart of southern Italy.

This sambuca represents the family’s dedication to purity, tradition, and artisanal perfection, capturing the timeless Italian art of digestivo making. Inspired by classic Mediterranean recipes, Sambuca Lucano is distilled from star anise, elderflower, and select Mediterranean herbs, creating a liqueur that embodies the essence of Italian elegance — smooth, aromatic, and inviting.

Each bottle carries more than a century of heritage, perfected through patience and precision. It is a spirit that honors its roots while continuing to inspire new generations of Italian craftsmanship.
