With the pursuit of nature’s blessing and the sake brewery’s obsession, a flavor is finished with satisfaction. Please enjoy a “thick” feeling from condensing a fully ripe plum’s flavor and sourness. Because it is a natural product, plum flesh rarely floats or settles at the bottom. Anyway, there is no problem with quality at all. Please shake it well before drinking.

name: Sanage Momo Peach (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This drink contains only 3% alcohol. The fermentation of fresh peaches results in the fragrance and the richness of the flesh. You will feel as if you are eating the peach flesh and drinking the juice at the same time.

name: Yoguru Yoguru Yogurt (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Super milky! It is almost as if rich yogurt was turned into Sake. Best served cold, on the rocks or added to juices or plum wine.

name: Nakano BC  Kishu Shikuwasa Umeshu (1.8 L)
desc_en_short: An Umeshu mixed with the tropical citrus Shikwasa Lemon, unique to the Island of Okinawa. The sourness of the Shikuwasa balances the sweetness of the Umeshu in a way that it creates a new harmony unlike anything you have tasted before.

name: Nakano BC  Kishu Hassaku Umeshu (1.8 L)
desc_en_short:
An Umeshu mixed with the fresh fruit juice of Wakayama Prefecture's local Hassaku Orange. The Hassaku is not put
through heat sterilisation therefore it retains its freshness that can be felt through the Umeshu, making this the perfect
refreshment liqueur.

name: IICHIKO  Bar Fruits "Ume" (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Ume has a soothing sweet taste.  Using only natural ingredients with no artificial flavors, iichiko has achieved a clean and natural taste.  iickiko, the barley shochu with dedication to fine ingredients, presents Ume.  Keep it in room temperature and chill it in the refrigerator before drinking, also please it on ice. Goes great with light appetizers or with fresh fruits.

name: IICHIKO  Bar Fruits "Yuzu" (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Yuzu is soothing and sweet with a crisp citrus taste.  Using only natural ingredients with no artificial flavors, iichiko has achieved a clean and natural taste.  iickiko, the barley shochu with dedication to fine ingredients, presents Yuzu.  Keep it in room temperature and chill it in the refrigerator before drinking, also please it on ice. Goes great with light appetizers or with fresh fruits.

name: Komasa Jyozo  Akazaru Sparkling (300 ml)
desc_en_short: Fruity flavor and refreshing taste derived from Shochu "AKAZARU". AKAZARU is carefully brewed with the special sweet potato, Nourin No.56 Known as "The king of purple sweet potato" and white koji. Then, it is softly distilled and giving AKAZARU its refreshing flavor.

name: Niwa no Uguisu  Tomari (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Made from hand-selected plums which have been steeped in the brewery’s own kasutori shochu (distilled sake lees) for 10 months. Beautifully silky on the palate with a long finish

name: Daishichi Kimoto Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This is Daishichi's first sake-based plum wine. To guarantee a steady supply each year of large, top quality ume plums, we use selected Nankou plums from Japan's main ume growing region of Kiishu (Wakayama). Thanks to this lavish production method, we have produced an unrivalled, plum wine of the highest quality, with a rich, mellow flavor and velvety smoothness.

name: Genkai Shuzo  Wasanbon Umeshu (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Japan grown plum and Japanese sugarcane sugar added Iki Mugi shochu. Enjoy the gorgeous scent to full-flavor shochu, mellow and rich flavor.

name: Godo Shusei  Ohsyukubai Special Umeshu (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Plum more than usual was used so it finished in thick. Enjoy the refreshing sour taste and subtle sweetness of plum.

name: Godo Shusei  Tan-Taka-Tan no Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: High grade shochu, plum, shizo leaf were added without any flavoring or coloring additive. It is ruby color and rich flavor plum liqueur.

name: Hirooka Farm Agricultural  Yoi Umeko (360 ml)
desc_en_short: Immersed plum cultivated from Hirooka farm, plus the smooth mouthfeel of honey, refreshing aroma of herbs and finished it into rich plum liqueur. Drinking on the rock is recommended.

name: Kobayashi Shuzou Honten  Umesennin Banana (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Everyone goes banana for Banana Umeshu! Dense but refreshing fruitiness. At the bottom of the bottle you can see the banana puree. As you shake and pour gently, charming fragrance of banana can be felt. Its after taste is delightful. Please try on the rocks or 1:1 with champagne.

name: Kobayashi Shuzou Honten  Meromero Hokkaido Melon (720 ml)
desc_en_short: By Mt Aso, the world famous volcano, this fruity umeshu was created using the plump melons raised up in Shichijo town in Kumamoto prefecture. At the bottom of the umeshu bottle, you’ll find the soft chunks of melon flesh. Not too sweet but quite refreshing, with the uniquely delightful aroma of melon. Try it on the rocks or mixed with dry champagne or sparkling wine.

name: Kobayashi Shuzou Honten  Umesennin Yuzukosho (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Yuzukosho is a liqueur that once said is a secret medicine from mountain hermit. It is a taste that rarely seen today. Shaking well and serve on the rock is recommended.

name: Komasa Jyozo  Komasa no Mikanshu (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Orange shochu made of authentic shochu and satsuma orange from Kagoshima prefecture. Please enjoy an orange shochu with a well-balanced sweetness and sour taste.

name: Komasa Jyozo  Komasa no Umeshu (1800 ml)
desc_en_short: KOMASA NO UMESHU made by blended the real shochu of sweet potatoes, barley and rice. This homemade UMESHU does not contain any artificial perfumes and colors. The rich aroma makes you more healthful and helps your appetite.

name: Komasa Jyozo  Komasa no Sumomoshu (1800 ml)
desc_en_short: "Komasa no Sumomoshu" is a shochu based fruit liqueur using Peach & Plum from Amami Oshima in Japan. It has a naturally sweet and sour taste and is also refreshing.

name: Komasa Jyozo  Komasa no Sumomoshu (500 ml)
desc_en_short: "Komasa no Sumomoshu" is a shochu based fruit liqueur using Peach & Plum from Amami Oshima in Japan. It has a naturally sweet and sour taste and is also refreshing.

name: Shata Shuzou  Tengumai Umeshu (1800 ml)
desc_en_short: Plum liqueur that were blended of highest grade plum, fructose, natural sugar from fruit. Fructose is sweeter than normal sugar 1.5 times but healthy. Suitable for those who care for calorie intake. Dry plum liqueur can be drunk on the rock, straight or mix with hot water.

name: Hanafuda No Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Unripe plum, product of Nara prefecture is carefully pickled in genuine and elaborately blended shochu. We cannot produce this umeshu on a large scale but we wish that you can feel our spirit through water, local-grown plum and our brewery’s shochu. We produce it seriously without any compromise.

name: Akatan no Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: The sake brewery remaining in Nara town fermented unripe plum, product of Nishiyoshino, Nara prefecture, genuine homemade shochu and clear well water together. To express the original juicy taste of plum, we spare no time and effort. It is umeshu you will never get tired of drinking it.

name: Miyoshino no Sakura Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This delicious Sakura Umeshu is made from Miyoshino sakura from Nara Prefecture. The Umeshu will relieve the tension and make you feel relaxed.

name: Sun Sun  Kokuto Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This plum wine is made from brown sugar which is rare even in Japan. Starting with the idea "to create the product that summarizes the sensibility of women", we formed the project team consisted of women only and finally get a plum wine with gorgeous and adult cute feeling. Please enjoy the refreshing and tender sweetness with a fresh aroma that only Kokuto Shochu has.

name: Ooiri Nigori  Yuzu-Shu Daku-Daku (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Please enjoy the exquisite harmonization between "puply feeling" that will make you unexpectedly want to scoop it with a spoon and the hidden flavor using fully ripe plum pulp. Because the citrus pulp and the aroma is wrapped up in this "puply feeling", so the aftertaste lasts long in your mouth. We really want you to experience this richness. You can enjoy both "eating"and "drinking" at the same time.

name: Tamba  Miyama Budou (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Liqueur that gives a "grapeful feeling" only Kotsuzumi can provide. This is because it is "Grappa" based liqueur which only a few companies in Japan can produce. The reason why it is popular among women is its extremely surprised "grapeful feeling". This easy to drink grape liqueur tastes like juice and like wine, and contains low alcohol content.

name: Tamba  Miyama Shiso (720 ml)
desc_en_short: A combination between Nishiyama Brewery's homemade Grappa and Shiso (perilla). A brewer will boil Red Shiso and blend its boiled extract with Grappa. You will know that more than enough of Red Shiso extract is being used when the seal is cut and the aroma of Red Shiso spreads out. However, not to emphasize Red Shiso too much, the good balance of sweetness and sourness is being matched so the overall flavor becomes very mild.

name: Rose & Plum Sparkling  (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This is made from most famous rose “Damask rose” and Ume from Wakayama pref. Also supervised by Wine director at MGM hotel famous as Casino, loved by celebrity all of the world, it is impressive fresh rose and fruity aroma of Ume. Won a prize at Tenman Umeshu competition 2014 in Japan.

name: Kotsuzumi Plumtonic Baishin  (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: You can enjoy Plumtonic Baishin in many differenst ways. Because of the high alcohol content, you can either have it mixed or you can make it on the rock. Also, you can drink it by putting Nankobai pickled plum into it. The bottle includes one ladle.

name: Kotsuzumi Plumtonic Baishin  (3.85 L)
desc_en_short: You can enjoy Plumtonic Baishin in many differenst ways. Because of the high alcohol content, you can either have it mixed or you can make it on the rock. Also, you can drink it by putting Nankobai pickled plum into it. The bottle includes one ladle.

name: Kotsuzumi Baishinshunju Umeshu  (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This plum wine is filled with the deliciousness of materials and has a slightly thick texture. It is brewed with Pure water and made from plum that ripens under the sun. We deliver plum wine with a melting taste from the up-country of Tamba to you.

name: Shio  Ume (720 ml)
desc_en_short: At the first time you enjoy this plum wine, you can feel a perfect match between plum and mineral salt. Good pair with Japanese food and make your meals more special.

name: Shio  Lychee (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This is Lychee wine is different than normal. The scent and rich flavour from Lychee mixed with sourness of plum makes you feel fresh and it's hard to forget.

name: Amami  Sumomoshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: It’s flavorful liqueur. Japanese plum liqueur from Amami, a perfect balance between the best sourness and sweetness of quality Japanese plum and aged for a long time. Tender touch and flavourful.

name: Choya  Uji Green Tea (720 ml)
desc_en_short: This is a total new product from the world most famous Umeshu distiller CHOYA JAPAN. CHOYA blend 100% Japanese premium plum & Kyoto Uji's premium green tea leaves together to make this beautiful green tea flavour Umeshu. With its refreshing fragrance, light soft touch on your palate & smooth long semi dry finish, you would enjoy this unique umeshu with most of Japanese dishes. Drink straight in chill or mix with Ice. Lower in alcohol than the normal Choya.

name: Choya  Single Year (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Authentic ume liqueur Premium Nanko ume A blend of at least three ume liqueur batches aged between 1 and 2 years Stylish and easy-to-hold bottle

name: Kabosu Shibori (720 ml)
desc_en_short: A Japanese citrus fruit make you feel fresh and taste not too sweet. Perfect match with Japanese food like Nabe.

name: Imoume (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Using Imo (Sweet Potato) shochu from famous brewer “Meiri Shurui” as a base to ferment with Ume plum. The perfect combination between Imo shochu and Ume plum. It is a shochu that is rich and intense with a lovely sweet and sour taste of Ume plum.

name: Kyoto Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Very clear and light and reflesh with Umami taste. Kyoto made

name: Kyoto Yuzushu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Kyoto Yuzushu is a full-strength Yuzu liquor made of premium Daiginjo sake that is created by a sake brewery in kyoto that has been in business  for over 300 years with their main focus on yuzu liqueur that goes well with local cuisines from Kyoto.

name: Yuzu Wine (750 ml)
desc_en_short: An easy to drink wine that has a unique aroma, pleasant bitterness, and mellow sweetness due to our original method. Please cool well and drink.

name: Tsuruume Yuzu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Tsuruume Yuzu made from a delicious blend of sake and yuzu a lovingly cultivated citrus fruits from the Wakayama prefecture with its ideal mild climate. Heiwa Shuzou's TSURUUME YUZU is a veritable fruity discovery! Its very fruity, sweet notes similar to lemon and lime are extremely refreshing.

name: Teshibori Yuzu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Most of the yuzu liquor is mechanically squeezed and the fruit juice is 15%, but the "hand squeezed yuzu liquor" in this "Mukashibanashi" series is 30% hand squeezed! That luxury. The only Yuzu we use is the one produced by Yoshihiko Sato in Yoshii-cho, Okayama Prefecture. And this is the ultimate yuzu liquor based on the "Junmai Ginjo Bizen illusion" which won the Gold Award for 3 consecutive years at Monde Selection. The characteristic of hand squeezing is the lack of bitterness and acridness. Yuzu skin has astringency and bitterness appears when squeezed with a machine, but use hand squeeze

name: Ginyuuka Yuzu (375 ml)
desc_en_short: About 20% of Kyushu's natural yuzu fruit juice was luxuriously blended with Daiginjo. Just pour it into a glass to spread the scent of yuzu. A luxurious fruit liquor that preserves the natural flavor and aroma without adding any additives.

name: Born Yuzu (500 ml)
desc_en_short: BORN is acclaimed not only in Japan but also overseas. For the yuzu balls, we use plenty of yuzu from the Niyodo River basin in Kochi prefecture, which is said to be the highest ranked yuzu in Japan. Hokkaido sugar beet and sake with a gentle taste of Sanskrit are added as a base. A rich liqueur with a full flavor of yuzu and sweet rice. The taste is very soft, but the taste of condensed yuzu is not ordinary. The finest scent of yuzu brings healing, and if you drink it chilled, you can get the best resting time. It is the best liqueur that is particular about luxury.

name: Choya  Honkaku Kokuto Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Made with 100% brown sugar, a real umeshu made with Kishu Nankobai, brown sugar syrup, white liqueur and black rum. It has a strong aroma and intense flavor. It is a sweet liquor after eating. You can enjoy it in a number of ways, such as on the rock, mixed with soda, mixed with milk, and poured over vanilla ice cream.

name: Choya  Kishu nankobai Gensku (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Authentic umeshu made by a blender carefully selecting several types of umeshu liquor from the umeshu brewery held in about 450 storage tanks. We prepared 1.5 times the amount of ume that we usually pickle umeshu at home, and used 385g of ume per product (720ml). It has a strong acidity with a core peculiar to undiluted sake, a deep aftertaste, and a good and mellow finish, and is characterized by a well-balanced taste despite being undiluted.

name: Hakutsuru  Umeshu Genshu (300 ml)
desc_en_short: In-House brewed Umeshu with 100% Plum from Kishu. An undiluted plum wine being characterized for its richness, smooth and a well balance sweet & sour. No chemicals added. Very recommended for Umeshu’s lovers.

name: Kunizakari  Obaa-Chan No Yuzushu (300 ml)
desc_en_short: This bright yuzushu features 100% all-natural Japanese Yuzu bursting with sweet, tart acidity, citrus aromas of white grapefruit, lemon, and a kiss of peel bitterness. Best served chilled or with ice.

name: Hakutake  Umepon (720 ml)
desc_en_short: A perfect combination between plum and Japanese orange, Dekopon. A sweet, smooth, very easy to drink Orange & Plum Wine from Kumamoto.

name: Hakutake  Yuzumon (300 ml)
desc_en_short: A blend of lemon juice and Japanese grown yuzu, mixed with authentic rice shochu. The subtle bitterness of yuzu and the refreshing sourness of lemons creates a harmonious double citrus liquor.

name: Hakutake  Yuzumon (720 ml)
desc_en_short: A blend of lemon juice and Japanese grown yuzu, mixed with authentic rice shochu. The subtle bitterness of yuzu and the refreshing sourness of lemons creates a harmonious double citrus liquor.

name: Fukuume  Ebisu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: In fresh and airy also it taste feel the depth. it can not be in a year or two. in fact that was completed blend (blending of Mongaifushutsu) in exquisite balance the Umeshu which was soaked in more than 20 years ago this Ebisu Fukuume is golden shiny and pour into a glass. Very fragrant gentle mild. It is different. Taste is round the though it is very rich and light. Throat as well and drink plenty smooth enough to put away likely leaving the sweet and sour ume pleasant finish.

name: Fukuume  Hotei (720 ml)
desc_en_short: The full flavor of plum. Use aging Umeshu as a based for production. In the second method process, mix the plum jam made with the specially produced and plum together. It feel like a jelly. It is a best quality Umeshu ever.

name: Fukuume  Benten (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Benten Fukuume (Grape Additional) is a blend of sweet grape juice from Berry A, which is made to be eaten even in the winery's vineyards. The natural ruby color becomes even more beautiful when poured into a glass. This is a juicy plum wine that is very easy to drink, combining the bright and juicy juice of Berry A grown in-house with the richness of aged umeshu.

name: Fukuume  Daikoku (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Daikoku Fukuume (made with brown sugar) uses brown sugar from Hateruma, Okinawa Prefecture, and green ume from Ogakudo Farm in Nara. The brown sugar has been added to the deep, aged flavor, giving it a melting sweetness, and then the sourness and umami of the green ume are added. This is a umeshu that is sweet, thick, and intoxicating. The smiling face of Daikoku-sama holding ume is also cute!

name: Fukuume  Bishamon (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Bishamon Fukuume (delicious and sour) is a "Suppa!" umeshu with a refreshing and sharp taste. It is extracted and blended with highly acidic ume extract that is in the middle of ripening. It is characterized by the juicy sourness of ume, but the base is aged umeshu with the richness and umami of fukuume, so it is not only sour but also has a strong umami flavor. Its youthful sourness makes it a great match for cooking.

name: Fukuume  Fukurokujyu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: To put it simply, Fukurokujyu Fukuume (Barrel- based umeshu) is "Umeshu to enjoy the aroma" Umeshu, which is aged in fresh new French oak barrels, has a natural vanilla scent contained in the oak barrels and a bittersweet aroma similar to chocolate, so it is not enough to describe it as "Adult". It feels like an adult. Surrounded by a deep, voluminous aftertaste.

name: Kinmon Akita Plum Sake Shizuku (300 ml)
desc_en_short:
Umeshu that uses the popular Yamabuki Gold vintage sake as the base, this is an item that is deep in colour, aroma and flavour and
one can enjoy the complex sweetness balanced with the sourness of the plum.

name: Dassai Umeshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short: A refined Japanese plum liqueur crafted using premium Dassai Junmai Daiginjo sake, offering elegant sweetness, bright plum acidity, and a silky finish.

name: Signature Cocktail The Lychee Martini (Ready to drink) (1000 ml)
desc_en_short:
Premium Berlin Vodka, floral lychee liqueur, ginger & lime liqueur, hand-crafted blend of apple, grape, lemon. This drink is to be stirred with ice, then poured out neat, and garnished with lemon peel. As with all our drinks, the Lychee Martini can also simply be shaken and poured over ice. Philip Bischoff’s Lychee Martini is an elegant and highly sophisticated martini in a class of its own. 

Philip Bischoff is the Beverage Ambassador for a premium luxury hotel group, overseeing 5 bars in Asia’s 50 Best, and 2 in the World’s 50 Best Bars. 

CRAFTED WITH

Mise-en-Abyme Vodka – Massenez Liqueur de Litchi – Massenez Liqueur de Citron Vert & Gingembre – lime – lemon

Best served in a martini glass.

name: Signature Cocktail Sunset Aperitivo (Ready to drink) (1000 ml)
desc_en_short:
Hibiscus tea infused gin distilled with lavender and rose, Campari and Branca Menta, a famous Italian aperitivo developed in the 60ss in honor of Maria Callas. US West Coast native & LGBTQ+ icon Beckaly Franks created this refreshing aperitivo using herbal Italian bitters infused with hibiscus, expertly crafted to celebrate the deep rose red of the last bit of sunset, and the start of your glorious evening. 

Beckaly Franks has run a 50 Best Bar in Hong Kong for the last 7 years, amongst the longest serving mixologists on this list of award-winning prestigious bars, continuously adapting with her finger on the pulse of current culture. 

CRAFTED WITH

Hibiscus tea infused gin distilled with lavender and rose – Campari – Branca Menta

Best served in a rocks glass or topped with club soda in a highball glass.

name: Signature Cocktail The Raspberry Espresso Martini (Ready to drink) (1000 ml)
desc_en_short:
Raspberry-infused vodka, espresso tincture, raspberry liquor, raspberry syrup, dark chocolate bitters and saline solution. 

Keith Motsi has run 3 of Asia’s 50 Best Bars, and has been awarded the “Bartenders Bartender” award by 50 Best. His charisma and style has carried over to this complex and alluring take on an espresso martini, with the use of. Berlin vodka, small-batch macerated French raspberry liqueur, chocolate bitters, and select espresso tincture, ensuring a multi-layered fruity yet elegant creation, that would be the highlight of his previous world-class bars in both Seoul and Tokyo. 

CRAFTED WITH

Mise-en-Abyme Vodka – Massenez Creme de Framboise – Giffard Raspberry Syrup – Coffee Tincture – Dark Chocolate bitters. 

Best served in a martini glass.

name: Signature Cocktail The Rose & White Pepper Negroni (Ready to drink) (1000 ml)
desc_en_short:
Rose-petals and white pepper infused premium Berlin gin using floral botanicals such as lavender and rose, Campari and Cocchi vermouth, only one of two geographically protected appellation d’origine contrôlée vermouths in the world, infused with a secret recipe of locally sourced Italian botanicals. 

German native Maxim Schulte has worked behind the world’s most prestigious bars from London to Macau, and brings his love of Italy to this romantic Italian cultural heritage Negroni. Maxim Schulte, winner of British GQ Bartender of the year, has worked at 50 Best awarded bars from the Ritz-Carlton Macau to the American Bar at the Savoy in London, honoring true classics. 

CRAFTED WITH

Rose & white pepper infused gin distilled with lavender and rose – Campari – Cocchi Torino Vermouth 

Best served in a rocks glass.

name: Signature Cocktail The Coconut & Pineapple Daiquiri (Ready to drink) (1000 ml)
desc_en_short:
Born in Phuket and raised in Bali, Tamaryn Cooper is not only the youngest, but also the first-ever female winner of the Campari Thailand Bartending competition. Her talent and passion for craft has landed her jobs at several of Bangkok’s hottest and most celebrated bars listed on Asia’s 50 Best, as well as being featured on Netflix’s “Midnight in Asia”.

Tamaryn has now left for Asia Pacific’s most decorated cocktail destination, Singapore, where she is Head Bartender of the iconic 28 Hong Kong Street. This refreshing daiquiri reflects her journey across Asia-Pacific and will transport you straight to the tropical beaches of South-East Asia. 

CRAFTED WITH

Aged rum – Massenez pineapple and coconut liquor – lime – lemongrass. 

Best served in a coupe glass.

name: Appleton Estate  Special Jamaica Rum (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Appleton Special Jamaica Rum is estate distilled at Appleton Estate. It is a blend of full-flavored traditional pot still rums and lighter character modern column still rums

name: Appleton Estate  Reserve Blend Jamaica Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Appleton Estate Reserve Blend is rich with oak, nutmeg, and smoky spices. It’s an aromatic blend of 20 rums, with two from very rare ‘reserve stock’ that are managed by Joy and her team. It’s these rare and special rums that give Reserve Blend its delicious complexity, making it entirely versatile. It’s perfect for sipping, or transforming ordinary drinks into extraordinary cocktails.

name: Appleton Estate  21 Years Old (750 ml)
desc_en_short: A lavish blend of the finest aged rums, Appleton Estate 21 Year Old is an incredibly smooth sipping rum that will truly delight the palate. The rums that make up 21 Year Old are hand-selected for the unique character, flavour, and sensorial bouquet they bring to the blend, and each has been aged for at least 21 years.

name: El Dorado  12 Years old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
An International Gold Medal Winner with a golden character.
An elegant multi-award winning rum, El Dorado 12 Year Old typifies the smooth mellow sweetness of Demerara Rums .

name: El Dorado  White (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short:
A superior light, dry white rum – the “White Gold of Guyana”
This award-winning lightly aged rum is refined and blended to a smooth perfection, imparting a delicate subtlety of balanced flavours with an exotic freshness.

name: El Dorado  Dark (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short:
A sophisticated and versatile Dark Rum mixer
This award-winning lightly aged rum has the smooth strength and full bodied taste to appeal equally to both the traditional rum drinker and today’s young adventurous breed of rum discoverers – afloat or ashore.

name: El Dorado  White (1 L)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short:
A superior light, dry white rum – the “White Gold of Guyana”
This award-winning lightly aged rum is refined and blended to a smooth perfection, imparting a delicate subtlety of balanced flavours with an exotic freshness.

name: El Dorado  Dark (1 L)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short:
A sophisticated and versatile Dark Rum mixer
This award-winning lightly aged rum has the smooth strength and full bodied taste to appeal equally to both the traditional rum drinker and today’s young adventurous breed of rum discoverers – afloat or ashore.

name: Mount Gay  Rum Extra Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Mount Gay Rum Extra Old, an opulent blend of the finest spirits aged for 8 to 15 years. 
Slowly matured in Kentucky oak, this artfully crafted rum is the fruit of a unique, centuries-old distillation process. The result is one of the most award-winning rums in the world.

name: 10 Cane  Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A pot-distilled rum from Moet-Hennessy, 10 Cane is made with only the first pressing juice from virgin Trinidaian sugar cane, rather than the molasses that most white rums are derived from. 10 Cane rum is named after the tradition of hand-harvesting and bundling sugarcane stalks in groups of ten. The result is a very clean, airy, yet velvety rum, best compared to an aged cachaca.

name: Dillon Rhum  Blanc (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: An exceptional AOC Martinique agricultural rum in the terroir of Martinique since 1779. This is a fine white rum, rich and very full in flavour with a complex aromas of tropical fruits.

name: Dillon Rhum  Tres Vieux (750 ml)
desc_en_short: A superlative brown rhum agricole distilled from the finest sugarcane juice of Martinique. Rhum vieux is aged more than 6 years. Good body, marvelous complexity with delicate developed bouquet of chocolate, spices, vanilla and oak. Its taste is smooth, rich and very full with an expansive finish.

name: Gosling  Family Reserve Old Rum (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Appropriately called Gosling’s Family Reserve Old Rum, it’s crafted from the same incomparable Bermuda blend as our renowned Black Seal Rum. But, we age it in our dark barrels even longer, until it acquires an extra luscious, nuanced complexity much like a rare Scotch or Cognac. Consider it the ultimate sipping rum. We do.

name: Diplomatico  Ambassador (700 ml)
desc_en_short: An exceptional 47% ABV rum that has a wonderfully pungent nose, the subtle aromas of dried and candid fruit combining with the rich, powerful aromas of vanilla, spices and cane syrup with a little smokiness in the background. On the palate the characters from the aroma persist but give way to a powerful, complex combination of dark chocolate, aged dried fruit, coffee and vanilla, all with a lovely creamy mouth feel. The finish is long, warming and powerful.

name: Brugal  1888 (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Taste profile-charred oak, sultanas, dates and honey, with a touch of gentle smoke finishing in toffee apple and salty butter.

name: Mahiki  coconut liqueur red sleeve (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Mahiki Coconut Liqueur is the most vibrant and striking coconut liqueur on the market, made of delicious natural coconut flavours and fine Caribbean rum. Mahiki Coconut is deliciously versatile and tastes great mixed with pineapple juice, coke, or ginger beer.

name: Cruzan  Light Rum (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Cruzan® Aged Light Rum is a blend of rums aged one to four years in American oak casks—then treated to a ﬁltration process that brings out the full-bodied taste. The light color resembles that of chardonnay, a distinctive indication of its aging. And it’s smooth. Reaaallll smooootthhh.

name: Three Monkeys  Rum (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: It has a rich aroma with scents of dried bananas and butterscotch. Flavors of tropical fruits with hints of roasted coconut are experienced on the palate while the finish lasts long which is smooth & creamy.

name: Blackheart  Premium Spiced Rum (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Blackheart Premium Spiced Rum is crafted from only the finest imported rum, blended expertly with a hint of spice, lush caramel and other delicious natural flavors.

name: Cana Brava  Rum (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
Flavor : Dry with just a hint of sweetness, medium to full bodied with a silky mouth feel with a finish that is clean, long and surprisingly fruity.

Nose : Balanced nose of fresh cut green grass with floral honey and pure molasses on the back. Light oak shows with vanilla and coconut flavors.

Taste : The palate has great pure fresh sugar cane juice and citrus with notes of dark chocolate balanced with molasses, cacao butter, vanilla and spices hinting allspice and cinnamon. Dry with just a hint of sweetness, medium to full bodied with a silky mouthfeel and with a finish that is clean, long and surprisingly fruity.

name: Malai  Thai Rum  (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Started by two passionate individuals who have a heart for spirits. Using locally sourced sugar cane from the North of Thailand and without any use of additives. The rum is then distilled multiple times in order to ensure that it has the smoothest possible taste for the consumer. The rum is put in a classy looking ceramic bottle made in Lampang’s very own ceramic village.

name: Lamoon Lamai  Thai Rum  (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Started by 2 cousins with a passion for spirits, Lamai Thai White Spirits is a Lao Kao made with sugar cane locally sourced from the North of Thailand that are devoid from any sort of additives.  In addition, the rum is also double-distilled so the flavor of the sugar cane itself comes through. Lamoon is best in your facvorite cocktail, your next Daiquiri, Mojito, or Cuba Libre.

name: Don Papa  Small Batch Rum (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Don Papa Rum or the TheDon, was inspired by the story of one of the unsung heroes of the Philippine revolution: DionisioMagbuelas, better known locally as "Papa" Isio, who played a key role during the late 19th-century Philippine Revolution. Don Papa Rum embodies Papa Isio'sspirit of independence, irreverence and sense of justice. Distilled from some of the finest sugar cane in the world, Don Papa is first aged 7 years in oak barrels in the foothills of Mount Kanlaonbefore being blended to perfection.

name: Flor de Caña  Anejo Clasico 5 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: A splendid dark golden rum from Nicaraguan super-producers Flor de Cana, fully mature at 5 years old. Easy on the rocks or as a sipper.

name: Bacardi  Carta Negra (Black Rum) (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Bacardi Carta Negra is a medium-bodied black rum, expertly blended by the Maestros de Ron BACARDÍ using rum developed in heavily charred oak barrels and then shaped through a secret blend of charcoals.

name: Bayou  Satsuma Rum (750 ml)
desc_en_short: From the land where sugarcane and Satsuma oranges first arrived into the USA comes Bayou Satsuma Rum, a craft made all-American Rum flavored with Satsuma juice. Bright electric orange color. Lively aromas of orange sorbet and yogurt with a silky, moderately sweet body and a peppery, refreshing, medium length finish. A solid Curacao like liqueur for cocktails. Enjoy chilled neat, or over ice, as a floater.

name: Bayou  Silver Rum (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The New Gold Standard For Rum That Happens To Be Silver Awarded Double Gold. Medals from the 50 best white rums in 2014 and 2015, awarded as a Tasting Panel Magazine's Publisher's Pick, Bayou Silver Rum is handcrafted in the largest privately owned rum distillery in the USA. Crystal clear purity; colorless. Spumoni ice cream aroma and flavor, with a silky, yet dry medimum body and a caramel banana sundae with cherry accented finsh. A tasty confectionary white rum that does well in classic rum cocktails and juice blends.

name: Bayou  Select  Rum (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Bayou Select Rum is the finest expression so far of the unique Louisiana sugarcane rum born from the rich soils of the mighty Mississippi river delta. Fermented with cane yeast, distilled in American copper pot stills, and rested in American oak in the Louisiana heat, this classic dark rum is sure to excite rum lovers’ palates with its complex aroma, delicious flavors, and sensuous finish.

name: Pyrat Rum  XO Reserve (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Pyrat XO Reserve is a complex yet mellow blend of select caribbean rums, aged up to 15 years in french limousin and american sweet oak barrels. Its handcrafted decanter is fashioned after relic rum bottles once hoarded by pirates and ship captains in the 1800s. In tribute to the true Pyrat spirit of social enlightenment, each bottles is adorned with the image of hoti, pattron saint and protector of fortune-tellers and bartenders.

name: Liverpool  Rum Aged 16 Years(700 ml)
desc_en_short: A small batch single cask, 16 year old Trinidad Rum, crafted from the finest Caribbean sugar cane to deliver a rich, full bodied and outstandingly smooth rum.

name: Rum Sixty Six  6 YO (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Rum Sixty Six Extra Old 6 Year Old is a classic Bajan rum aged in an oak cask for 6 years by Master Distiller, Richard Seale. It was bottled at 40% ABV after it was distilled and matured at the renowned Foursquare Distillery in Barbados, which occupies the site of a former sugar factory that dates back to 1636.

name: Rum Sixty Six  12 YO Family Reserve (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: An aged blend of pot and column still rum, Rum Sixty-Six has been aged 12 years, and is made by the Foursquare distillery in Barbados, home of the splendid Doorly's rum. We reckon that this will be a big hit.

name: Rum Sixty Six  12 YO Cask Strength (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: A cask strength variation of Rum Sixty Six 12 year Old, produced by the Foursquare distillery in the warm Bajan climate. Impressive and powerful stuff (good value for money, too).

name: Malai  Cha Thai (375 ml)

name: Graphit  Rum (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: The nose shows the graphite with the typical notes of a Jamaican rum, at the same time very beautiful notes of honeydew melon, apple and plum come to fruition. On the palate, this richness of nuances is skillfully continued. Here are notes of coconut, caramel and melon that show up. There is also a slight trace of smoke in the background.

name: Shack Rum  Honey (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Shack Honey is a rum blend for trances that are related to matters of the heart. It wears the mark of The goddess of love & beauty, the fierce protector of women, who lives on the riverbanks, as her domain is water.  The colour associated with this goddess is blue.

name: Phraya  Gold Rum Private Reserve (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The only luxury rum from Asia, PHRAYA sits among the finest rum in the world, by using only carefully-selected top quality rums. It is distilled, aged, blended and bottled in the Kingdom of Thailand. Undergoing a deep maturation technique, developed in accordance with Southeast Asian climate, PHRAYA draws out an enticing exotic taste for the palate. Such that the style of this rum is as rich as the history and culture of its country of origin.

name: Rhum J.M.  Agricole Blanc (700 ml)
desc_en_short: J.M Blanc displays the raw power of what is regarded as the best sugarcane on the island. Extravagant cornucopia of ripening tropical fruit: mango, overripe bananas, and papaya; and a wild, funky earthiness combine for an aromatic explosion.

name: Rhum J.M.  Agricole E.S.B. Gold (700 ml)
desc_en_short: J.M. Gold displays a rich sugarcane flavor that has beautiful viscosity on the palate. The rich golden color is a simple result from the time it has been naturally aged in re-charred Bourbon barrels for a period of 12 months. Raw sugarcane and warm gingerbread flavors are softened by hints of vanilla and hazelnuts from this short time in oak. J.M Gold is a rum that demonstrates a brilliant balance of reservation of terroir with introduction of wood alchemy that works exceptionally well in cocktails.

name: Sparrow  Dak Barrel Aged Rum (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Made from molasses and aged for 4 years in premium oak barrels, Sparrow Rum has a velvety texture with notes of oak, vanilla and demerara. Crafted to be enjoyed on the rocks or in your favourite rum cocktail, Sparrow Rum is a Canadian craft take on an aged Caribbean style amber rum.

name: Cockspur  Balla Black Spiced Rum (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: COCKSPUR Spiced is an amazingly versatile blend that brings you the true taste of the Caribbean. This beautiful amber coloured rum is paired with exotic spices that come together to create an enticing, aromatic blend that is amazingly matched with almost any chaser due to its great mixability. Try COCKSPUR Spiced with your choice of any citrus flavoured drink.

name: Cockspur  Fine Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short: COCKSPUR Fine Rum is a gently aged rum that starts off with a distinct brown sugar taste then develops into a smooth, round, buttery blend that leaves a warm, spicy oak taste on the palate

name: Cockspur  Platinum Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short: COCKSPUR Falernum is the ultimate go-to Barbadian accessory for your perfect cocktail. We steep only the finest Caribbean spices and allow the enchanting flavours to marry using a time-honoured tradition that has been a Barbadian secret for over 100 years.

name: Rhum J.M.  Very Old Rhum (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Designed and priced with the cocktail community in mind, Rhum J.M V.O. has been aged for a minimum of 3 years. Unlike the V.S.O.P, this aged rhum sees some new oak, but is still finished in re-charred ex- bourbon barrels. The result is a rich, full-bodied rhum with notes of tobacco, oak and caramel, balanced with the complex, expressive character unique to Martinique’s famed sugar cane.

name: Ron Matusalem  Platino Rum (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Clear appearance. Fragrant cotton candy, mocha, and coconut cream aromas. A silky entry leads to a dryish, light-to medium body with fruity, toasted coconut and subtle spice notes. Finishes smoothly with a dry, yet fruity, aftertaste. A brilliantly balanced and flavorful white rum. 40% Alc./Vol.

name: Ron Matusalem  Solera 23 Year Old Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The ultimate expression of luxury rum. Matusalem 23 Gran Reserva is matured in a 23-year 'Solera' system developing the rum into a complex and smooth drinking rum to be savoured. Aromas of fresh honey, almonds and cedar wood with a rich and creamy palate and long luxurious finish. Enjoy neat as you would the finest cognac or scotch.

name: Angostura  Aged Five Years Superior Gold Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
For five years, this rum remains in oak barrels ageing so that when it’s ready to be enjoyed, it reveals its deep character.

It presents chocolate, spice, vanilla and toasted oak flavours and provides a remarkably warm and mellow finish. It can be enjoyed neat as a sipping rum, or over ice, but its deep character lends to being mixed with stronger mixes, spices and herbs.

name: Flor Santa Cruz  Ron Blanco Reserva (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Tasting Notes

Color : Transparent
Taste : Pleasant, balanced, tones of wood, almonds are felt, a sweet aftertaste is characteristic.
Scent : Fresh aroma of wood and wood.

Gastronomic combinations

Rum is perfect as a digestif in its pure form or with ice. You can also use rum as an ingredient for cocktails.

Production technology

Rum is created by distilling selected sugarcane and aged in oak barrels for six months.

name: Flor Santa Cruz  Ron Anejo Reserva (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: An special selection fo rums aged in american oak barrels, a singular golden character in cup and a long and warm tastle. Handmade by Republican Dominican people with sugar distillation.

name: Marama  Spiced Fiji Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The basic ingredients for Marama Spiced Fijian Rum are the most aromatic Fiji raw materials in a unique combination: the best sugar cane and the purest water, which seeks its way through deep volcanic rock after tropical rainfalls; extracts of exotic plants, spices and fruits and finally the perfect mixture of exquisite rum varieties, which have matured for 3 to 5 years in old oak barrels. The result is a rum with a complex taste, rounded off by a fine vanilla and citrus note.

name: Kristall  Thai Spirit Rum Limited Batch (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Kristall Thai Spirit  producing a molasses-based white rum, as well as premium vodka and gin made from organic rice, this beverage company employs Nikolaus Prachensky — of Chiang Mai’s award-winning Edelbrand distillery — as their master distiller.

name: Shack Rum  Red Spiced (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Shack Red Spiced is definitely setting a new quality standard for spiced mixer rums. The alpha rums used in the base blend of our Shack Red Spiced are aged between 3 and 5 years. The botanical maceration is finely tuned to the essential purpose of this rum: offering a great base for any mix or cocktail.

name: Appleton Estate  30 Years Old (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: The second 30-year-old rum produced by Appleton, an impressive feat that shows the depths of their excellent stocks. Master blender Joy Spence has pulled together rums aged for from 30 years to over 50, which were married for a year before bottling. The result is a worthy successor to the first edition 30-year-old, showing incredible depth and complexity.

name: Bacardi  Anejo Cuatro 4 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: It takes four years maturing in a barrel under the Caribbean sun to create the unique taste of BACARDÍ Añejo Cuatro. It's time well spent. Just like those special moments shared with friends enjoying Añejo Cuatro.

name: Bacardi  Gran Reserva Diez 10 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Expertly blended. Barrel-aged for a minimum of ten years under the Caribbean sun. Then filtered through charcoal for a smooth finish. BACARDÍ Gran Reserva Diez dark gold rum is worth the wait.

name: Rum & Cane Merchants  Asia Pacific XO (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Rum & Cane Asia Pacific XO Rum is alimited release blend of rum produced in Indonesia and Fiji, crafted from molasses and distilled using column stills then aged in ex-bourbon casks. This is a very limited release of 2,000 bottles worldwide. In Fiji, fresh sugar cane grown on the island is processed into sugar and molasses which is used to make Fiji rum.

name: Rum & Cane Merchants  British West Indies XO (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: British West Indies XO Rum features citrus, stewed prunes, a touch of smoke, vanilla, caramel, and cream. This is a selection of fine aged Single Barrels of rum from Trinidad Distillers & Four Square Distillery in Trinidad and Barbados.

name: Rum & Cane Merchants  Central America XO (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Rum & Cane Central America XO Rum comes from Guatemala and Nicaragua, two of the most prolific producers of world class rum. Its silky, smooth and has candied top notes. A great sipper, it makes a fabulous base for classic cocktails like Daiquiris where the spirit shines without overpowering the drink. Crafted from molasses and distilled using column stills then aged in ex bourbon casks this has a very limited release of 2,000 bottles worldwide.

name: Rum & Cane Merchants  French Overseas XO (700 ml)

If youve tried these types of rums before and didnt like them, then its time to try again!Crafted from cane sugar and distilled using column stills then aged in American and French oak casks there is a very limited release of 2,000 bottles worldwide.

name: Rum & Cane Merchants  Spanish Caribbean XO (700 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate

name: Charles Merser & Co  Double Barrel Rum
desc_en_short: On the nose, you will find an alluring vanilla sweetness with flashes of vibrant tropical fruit and a wonderful toasty oak character. The palate is mouth-coating, warming and generous with soft notes of vanilla, more of that tropical fruit and some wine-like notes created through the cask maturation process. Toasty oak returns on the finish alongside sweet vanilla and hints of pastry cream.

name: Saint James  Vieux XO "Rhum (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
“A blend of different agricole rums aged for between six and ten years in rigorously selected small oak casks, this XO cuvée is a must for connoisseurs of very old agricole rums.”
Marc Sassier, Saint James oenologist

name: Dictador  Aurum Rum (700 ml)

name: Dictador  Platinum Rum (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Dictador Platinum Rum is made from the fermentation of unique virgin sugar cane honey, then distilled in a modern stainless steel alembic. It is then aged in pre-used quality oak barrels from Jerez and Port that now and again reburn to caramelize the interior to achieve sweet flavours coming from the oak.

name: Short Story  White Rum (750 ml)
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate

name: Plantation Extreme No.5 Barbados 2007 Rum (700 ml)

name: Flor de Caña  18 years Centenario Rum Box Set
food_matching: Tropical Fruit, BBQ, Spiced Desserts, Chocolate
desc_en_short: Aromas of cacao nib, tobacco leaf, toasty caramelized Brazil and macadamia nuts, and fig follow through on a round, silky entry to a dryish medium-to-full body with elegant depth and balance.

name: Flor de Caña  25 years Centenario Rum Box Set
desc_en_short:

name: SATSUMA MURA  "Potato Shochu" (720 ml)
desc_en_short: Satsuma Mura, a traditionally distilled honkaku imojochu from Kagoshima (home of the most famous imo shochus), is a mouthful of contradictions and complications. A fragrant, earthy nose as if you’d just sliced open a freshly unearthed sweet potato promises a rich flavor that this shochu delivers without reservation. The first sip is sharp, spiced and biting on the palate. This mellows into herbal undertones followed by a flood of sweetness before a lingering herbal tartness settles onto the tongue.  The earthiness infuses the mouth, especially toward the back where bitterness is most apparent. If you manage to keep the spirit forward on your tongue you’ll miss this bitter complexity, but will be rewarded with a warm sweetness. It’s a tough call which way to go, but the great thing about it is you can alternate from sip to sip. You’re not committed to one experience.

desc_en_short: Unlike most breweries' current practice of adding commercially purchased lactic acid, the Kimoto method is a traditional and painstaking technique for cultivating robust yeast slowly and methodically by tapping the natural biological power of living lactic acid bacteria. Best enjoyed chilled in a wine glass, it pairs well with jamón ibérico, Niçoise salad, and fresh seafood.

name: Yamagata Masamune Malola (720 ml)
desc_en_short:
Yamagata Masamune Malola Junmai Ginjo is Japan's first sake
brewed with malo-lactic fermentation, giving a softer, rounder
profile. Made from 100% Dewasansan rice, it balances gentle
aroma, smooth acidity, sweetness, and umami. Versatile and
food-friendly, i t pairs beautifully with Japanese or Western cuisine.

name: Yoshidagura U Hyakumangoku no shiro Hire (720 ml)
desc_en_short:
Brewed with Yoshidagura's "Modern Yamahai" method using only rice,
water, and yeast, this sake features the new Ishikawa rice Hyakumangoku
no Shiro. Naturally fermented without additives, it has a clean, mineral
profile with a touch of effervescence. Light and refreshing, it balances
gentle sweetness, crisp acidity, and a hint of bitterness, with aromas 
muscat and melon. Best served chilled in a wine glass, it pairs well with
both casual and fine cuisine, representing the elegance of modern
Japanese sake.

name: Yoshidagura U Hyakumangoku no shiro Kijoshu (720 ml)
desc_en_short:

sake brewed with part  the water from Yoshidagura U. Naturally sweet,
lightly sparkling, and refreshing, it shows white peach aroma, citrus
acidity, and soft mineral balance. Best enjoyed chilled in a wine glass, it
pairs well with fruits, light cheeses, Peking duck, o r bright desserts.

name: Yoshidagura U Ishikawamon Hiire (720 ml)
desc_en_short:
Yoshidagura U is a natural, modern Yamahai sake made from Ishikawamon
rice, water, and yeast without additives. Bottled from the freshest press,
it has a light effervescence, gentle sweetness, and bright umami balanced
by subtle acidity. Fruity, sparkling, and elegant, it reflects Ishikawa's
terroir with both tradition and modern finesse.

desc_en_short: A gorgeous 100% agave Tequila from La Altena distillery, home of master distiller Carlos Camarena. A truly authentic handmade añejo, Tapatio is distilled to strength and bottled without dilution to retain the true flavours of the spirit. This añejo is aged for around 18 months in ex-bourbon casks.

name: Lunazul  Tequila Blanco (750 ml)
food_matching: Mexican Cuisine, Ceviche, Grilled Fish, Citrus
desc_en_short: Exceptionally smooth and balanced with bright color and silver highlights.

name: Lunazul  Tequila Reposado (750 ml)
desc_en_short: 100% agave tequila that’s “rested” in Bourbon barrels for smooth, rich flavor with subtle oak and vanilla notes.

name: Excellia Tequila  Blanco (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Excellia Blanco is the best example yet of a well-made blanco Highland tequila that dares to use, expertly, the sort of delicate flavours usually only seen in an añejo or extra-añejo, without losing the classic focus and strength which makes blanco the favourite tequila category among many connoisseurs.

name: Excellia Tequila  Reposado (700 ml)
desc_en_short: With its golden straw color, Excellia Reposado reveals a complex nose mixing honey, toasted wood, mushroom, dried lavender, jasmine and violet notes. The nine months ageing in grand cru sauternes wine casks and cognac barrels provide a round and extensive mouthfeel with rich honey, cigar-box, and caramelized-agave/pumkin notes mixed with subtle rancio and orchard fruits. The finish is long and satisfying with spicy and earthy notes.

name: Excellia Tequila  Anejo (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Excellia is a unique añejo tequila that spurns the easy, standard añejo-tequila road of vanilla-and-honey in favour of a great, challenging flavour profile that gives the añejo category what it has until now lacked: credibility as great, aged tequila, without concessions to sweetness.

name: Tequila Cabeza (750ml)
desc_en_short: On the nose there is a bouquet of highland agave that captures both the earthiness and the honey of the agave while adding complex layers of green vegetables and a nice dose of minerality. More of the green vegetables, earthiness and some green pepper enter softly on the palate at the start before you are hit with a robust and earthy agave bomb on the mid-palate that comes with a dash of light citrus on the sides of the palate. It is medium to fullbodied with a velvety mouth feel and finishes with a light bitter citrus, more cooked agave flavors and black pepper. This Tequila is all about earthy cooked & raw agave flavors.

name: Cimarron Tequila  Blanco (1 L)
desc_en_short: Cimarron Tequila Blanco has a crystal clear color, along with an an aroma of herbs, earthy vegetables and warm spices. The aroma gives way to notes of bright agave, pineapple and a hint of papaya, and leads to a warming, bold finish.

name: Ocho  Curado Blanco (500 ml)
food_matching: Mexican Cuisine, Ceviche, Grilled Fish, Citrus

name: Ocho  Anejo (700 ml)
food_matching: Mexican Cuisine, Ceviche, Grilled Fish, Citrus
desc_en_short: Aromas of wood with dried fruits and powdered sugar along with hints of cinnamon, orange peel, plum and caramel. Thick and smooth on the palate, initially opening up to spices then leading to softer plum, lavender and black olive flavors. Finishes with coffee and cacao accents.

name: Ocho  Single Barrel Anejo (700 ml)
food_matching: Mexican Cuisine, Ceviche, Grilled Fish, Citrus
desc_en_short: A rare single barrel bottling of Ocho's Añejo tequila, bottled at an almost unheard of cask strength. This is about as close to drinking tequila straight from the wood, and is a great example of the brand's spirit focused style.

name: Ocho  Extra Anejo (700 ml)
food_matching: Mexican Cuisine, Ceviche, Grilled Fish, Citrus
desc_en_short: The Extra Anejo tequila from Ocho, made by the famed Camarena family who are also behind Tapatio and El Tesoro. It's aged for 3 years and a day using a mix of refill casks and new French oak to give a tasty and easy drinking tequila with a slab of woody complexity.

name: Patron  XO Cafe Coffee Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Patrón XO Cafe is an extraordinary blend of ultra-premium Patrón Silver tequila and the pure, natural essence of fine coffee. The taste is dry, not sweet as with most low-proof coffee liqueurs with notes of chocolate and vanilla. Patrón XO Cafe is excellent for sipping, as a premium cocktail ingredient, or as a unique and delicious dessert topping.

name: Patron  Citronge Orange Liqueur (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Made in Jalisco, Mexico the all-natural Patron Citronge delivers a sweet and smooth fresh orange taste that is excellent straight or to enhance a premium cocktail.

name: Patron  Gran Patron Platinum (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Like all Patron tequilas, Gran Patron Platinum is produced from the highest-quality Weber blue agave plants grown in the Highlands of Jalisco.

name: Sauza  Silver (750 ml)
food_matching: Mexican Cuisine, Ceviche, Grilled Fish, Citrus
desc_en_short: Our ready-to-serve sparkling margarita is made with real tequila, and comes in Original Lime, Mango Peach, Wild Berry flavors and now Watermelon!

name: Sauza  Gold (750ml)
desc_en_short: Sauza Gold is a smooth tequila with the fresh agave taste you expect - A pale golden hue. Sweet aromas of vanilla and cooked agave layered with orange blossom and almond notes. Cooked agave and sweet caramel balanced with pepper notes. A medium bodied sweet finish with an almond like astringency.

name: Los Danzantes  Blanco Mezcal (750ml)
desc_en_short: Los Danzantes is an artisanal mezcal established by renowned restaurant owners and gastronomists in Mexico. Made of espadín agave from the central valley of Oaxaca, production is entirely artisanal. Piñas are cooked over mesquite wood in an underground oven, called a ‘palenque,’ and the juice is distillated in a copper pot still under direct fire. Mildly sweet and minty, with a smoky finish.

name: Los Danzantes  Reposado Mezcal (750ml)
desc_en_short: Los Danzantes is a brand of artisanal mezcal established by renowned restaurant owners and gastronomists in Mexico. Made from espadín agave harvested in the central valley of Oaxaca, production is entirely hand crafted and artisanal. The distillate is then rested for 11 months, first in American oak ex-bourbon barrels and 6 months in French oak casks to produce a sweet, smoky and earthy mezcal.

name: Los Danzantes  Anejo Mezcal (750ml)
food_matching: Mexican Cuisine, Ceviche, Grilled Fish, Citrus
desc_en_short: Los Danzantes is a brand of artisanal mezcal established by renowned restaurant owners and gastronomists in Mexico. Made from semi-wild espadin agave harvested in the central valley of Oaxaca, the añejo is made from the same base as the joven. Production is entirely traditional. Aged in French and American oak barrels that is floral and smoky, with vanilla maple syrup, tobacco and coconut flavors. Serve neat, and often.

name: Casa Noble  Crystal Tequila (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
The clean, crisp taste of our Blanco tequila celebrates the fresh flavor of the noble Blue Weber Agave. Enticing aromas set the palate for flavors of honey, buttery-sweet cooked agave and a hint of citrus. Triple distilled for a well-balanced and smoother-than-glass finish, this Blanco is in a class by itself.

The ABV ranges between 50% and 52%, depending on the conditions specific to each lot. This Mezcal has notes of orchard fruit and minty tarragon as well as the flavor the rabbit.

name: Clase Azul  Tequila Mezcal Guerrero (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
Clase Azul Mezcal Guerrero reveals one of Mexico's best-kept secrets: the wondrous state of Guerrero, a little-explored region that shows us yet another facet of Mexican culture. This member of the Clase Azul family was inspired by the singularity of Guerrero’s landscapes, gastronomy, art, and heritage –– but also by the strength and leadership of the women from this region.

Clase Azul Mezcal Guerrero is a truly unique piece. Beyond its beautiful decanter, its majestic flavor comes from a very rare variety of agave: the papalote agave. This plant grows wild in the mountain ranges in the state of Guerrero, where both the coastal climate and the freshness of green forests come through in its flavor profile.

Exquisiteness of Time

Crafted for true connoisseurs, our most time-intensive creation is defined by an exquisitely complex tequila and a decanter adorned by our most proficient artisans.

The sublime character of this extra añejo tequila is only possible through its extended aging period of five years: first in American whiskey casks then separated into amontillado, oloroso and pedro ximénez sherry casks before being recombined.

name: 1800 Tequila  Guachimonton  Anejo (750 ml)
desc_en_short: 1800 GuachiMonton celebrates the legacy and agriculture of the Tequila Valley. Inspired by the jewel of Jalisco, Los Guachimontones, these circular pyramids were built from the same rich, red clay soil from which today's best blue weber agave is grown, and our red ceramic bottle and circular wooden cap honors.

name: 1800 Milenio Tequila
desc_en_short: An expression of the finest craftsmanship. After a long and delicate aging process, the extra-aged tequila is matured for a short period in French Oak Cognac barrels creating a balanced, soft, and unique flavor with notes of vanilla, red fruit and cinnamon. A perfect expression of the land that nurtures the fine Weber blue agave and the hands that craft its final liquid, Milenio is considered the best representation of 1800® Tequila’s roots and worthy of only those who appreciate the finest tequila.

name: Casa Flamenco Reposado (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
Casa Flamenco Reposado is a tequila born from rhythm — the rhythm of the sun, the land, and the slow heartbeat of Jalisco’s blue agave. Crafted in the highlands of Tequila Valley, Mexico, it embodies the artistry and passion that define Mexican craftsmanship.

The name “Casa Flamenco” captures both tradition and movement — a house (casa) that celebrates the dance (flamenco) of flavors between agave, oak, and time. Every bottle begins with 100% Blue Weber Agave, harvested by hand at full maturity, then slow-roasted in stone ovens to release natural sweetness and depth. The fermented agave juice is double-distilled in copper pot stills, then aged (reposado) in American oak barrels for several months — long enough to gain smoothness and color, while preserving the fresh agave core.

The result is a tequila that moves with grace: golden, balanced, and full of character — a true expression of the Mexican spirit where craftsmanship meets soul.

name: Casa Flamenco Blanco (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
Casa Flamenco Blanco represents the purest expression of tequila — the soul of Mexico captured in its most honest form. Crafted from 100% Blue Weber Agave, grown in the mineral-rich volcanic soils of Tequila Valley, Jalisco, this tequila embodies the perfect harmony of land, sun, and tradition.

The name “Casa Flamenco” symbolizes a house of movement and rhythm — a dance between nature and craftsmanship. The Blanco (or Plata) expression is tequila in its purest state, unaged and unadorned, allowing the vibrant flavors of freshly harvested agave to shine.

The agave hearts (piñas) are slow-roasted in traditional stone ovens, then double-distilled in copper pot stills to preserve their natural sweetness and clean aromatic profile. The result is a tequila that’s crisp, lively, and elegantly balanced — the true essence of Mexico in liquid form.

desc_en_short:
Absolut wants to inspire people around the world to spread love with the launch of its latest limited edition bottle. In this new limited edition campaign, Absolut repurposed ink taken from hate signs around the world to spread a better message. Love

Love is the most powerful force in the world. This is why Absolut’s latest campaign celebrates the power that love has to create a more open world and make a real difference to people’s lives, especially in places where hate-speech and intolerance is widespread.

This was the inspiration behind the Absolut Drop limited edition bottle. The bottle design contains ink taken from hate signs around the world and repurposed to spread a message that radiates positivity. Absolut travelled to racist and anti- LGBTQ protests, collected hate signs, extracted the ink and reused the ink to create the mint and pink Absolut bottle outlines printed on the limited edition bottles. The bottle design also has the word love in multiple languages showing that love has no borders. Ink is not the only element that has been repurposed, as the bottle has also been made using 70% recycled glass including recycled glass from previous limited edition bottles.

name: Taiga Shtof Winter Rye Vodka (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Taiga Shtof Winter Rye Vodka is a tribute to the vast, untamed beauty of the northern Taiga — where snow-covered forests, icy rivers, and endless horizons define the landscape. This vodka captures that purity and power, crafted from 100% winter rye grown in the cold soils of Eastern Europe, where long winters and short summers forge grains of extraordinary strength and character.

The name “Shtof” comes from an old Russian term meaning a measure of spirit, a nod to tradition and precision. Distilled using five-time copper filtration and ultra-pure Arctic spring water, every drop of Taiga Shtof reflects meticulous craftsmanship and respect for nature’s extremes.

Unlike modern vodkas that chase neutrality, Taiga Shtof celebrates its origin — the earthy richness of rye, the chill of the north, and the clarity of snowmelt. It is a vodka that carries the silence of frozen forests and the strength of winter itself.

From the heritage elegance of Martell L’Or de Jean Martell, to the timeless depth of Hennessy Richard, the regal complexity of Rémy Martin Louis XIII, and the extraordinary intensity of Tesseron Extreme—each glass reveals decades of mastery, patience, and artistry.

From the subtle softness of Puncheon casks, to the gentle smokiness of Peated Malt, the richness of Spanish Oak, and the unmistakable incense-like elegance of Mizunara—each expression reveals a different dimension of Yamazaki’s craft.

From the pure and vibrant character of Candid, to the layered elegance of Blossoming Auld Sherried, and the profound concentration of the Very Sherried 25 Year Old, each dram unfolds with remarkable individuality.

An evocative experience for those drawn to bold character, oxidative depth, and the artistry of time.

From the maritime intensity of Talisker 8-Year-Old, to the powerful smokiness of Lagavulin 12-Year-Old, the rich elegance of Cardhu 14-Year-Old, the refined fruit character of The Singleton of Glendullan 19-Year-Old, and culminating in the profound depth of Lagavulin 26-Year-Old—each dram tells its own legendary story.

name: ISLAY FC @Blue Moon Siam Paragon
desc_en_short:
An intense journey to the rugged shores of Islay, this tasting flight brings together four legendary distilleries that define the island’s unmistakable character. From the balanced smoke of Bowmore 15 Years Old, to the deep, maritime richness of Lagavulin 16 Years, the medicinal peat of Laphroaig 10 Years, and the bold, sherry-driven power of Ardbeg Uigeadail—each dram captures a different face of Islay.

Expect waves of smoky peat, sea spray, charred oak, and dark sweetness, layered with spice and lingering warmth. This curated flight reveals how tradition, terroir, and cask influence shape some of the most iconic whiskies in the world.

A thrilling experience for peat lovers and those drawn to bold, smoky, and unforgettable whisky styles.
