name: Glenfiddich  21 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
By finishing our 21 Year Old in Caribbean rum casks it awakens the liquid, rousing it with extra exotic notes of ginger, fig, lime and banana and a vibrant spicy toดดee warmth, elevating it from something great to something extraordinary. 

Raised in Scotland. Roused by the Caribbean.

name: Glenfiddich  30 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
An exceptional expression that has spent at least 30 years in Spanish Oloroso and American bourbon oak. Every cask nosed, selected and married by our Malt Master. For the finest balance of hearty oak and honeyed warmth. 

A 30 Year Old with deep, layered flavours and a masterful finish. Handcrafted by the expert.

name: The Balvenie  Thirty 30 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Balvenie 30 Year Old is a rare and especially fine single malt for which Malt Master David C. Stewart MBE selects only exceptional casks that were laid down over 30 years ago. By marrying The Balvenie slowly, aged in traditional oak whisky casks with that aged in European oak sherry casks, David creates a rich, mellow aged whisky with unusual depth and complexity. ‘Thirty’ is bottled at 47.3% ABV to capture all the signature characteristics of The Balvenie.

name: McCormick  Whiskey American Blended (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: McCormick Distilling Company has a whiskey heritage that goes back to 1856. This Special Reserve American Blended Whiskey is a blend of whiskey and neutral-grain spirits, oﬀering a ﬁne product at a great value in the blended whiskey category.

name: Clan Gold  15 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Golden with brilliant clarity this selection of some of the best malt whiskies available gives a rich, malty depth with a hint of nutty oakiness on the nose. The Master Blender has added layers of complexity into the flavour which produces a mellow touch of spice and vanilla subtly balanced with a gentle hint of woodiness all ending with a smooth, long and soothing finish.

name: Wild Turkey  American Honey (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Wild Turkey American Honey is an exceptionally smooth 71 proof (35.5% alcohol) liqueur blended with pure honey and real Wild Turkey Bourbon Whiskey

name: Chivas Regal  Extra (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Chivas Regal Extra promises an exceptionally rich and generous Scotch whisky experience. The secret to its taste lies in selectively blending whiskies matured in sherry casks. Originally from Spain, these finest Oloroso sherry casks guarantee its prime quality, imparting the whiskies deeper amber colour along with rich, sweet and spicy flavours. The result is an outstanding expression of our master blender's craft.

name: Matisse  Old Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This accessible, fresh blended Scotch whisky is made with fine aged malt and grain whiskies, distilled and matured in quality American Bourbon casks. As our Master Blender has now greatly increased the percentage of Single malts in the bottle, making MATISSE Old even more complex and luxurious than ever before, while also retaining the smoothness of taste and character. The high quality malt whisky comes from distilleries in the Speyside region, the heartland of Scotch whisky. These Single malts are mixed with rich fruity whiskies, with a light floral touch. This is then blended with specially selected grain whiskies to give that sweet and fudge flavor.

name: Matisse  12 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The first three seconds of tasting this 12 years old Blended Scotch Whisky, you will feel a smoothness like no other. The longevity of these smooth flavors lingering in the mouth is the reason why MATISSE 12 Years Old Blended Scotch Whisky was awarded Best in its Class.

name: Matisse  12 Years Old Blend Malt (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Proud winner of five Gold medals from the IWSC and ISC 5 Gold medals for best Blended Malt Scotch whisky of the year and with numerous Silver medals can only mean one thing – MATISSE 12 Years Old Blended Malt have long won the hearts and palates of judges and whisky connoisseurs around the world. Give it a try and feel the wow!

name: Matisse  15 Years Old Single Malt (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A magnificent dram from the Highlands of Scotland.   At first glance of this fine dram, you cannot help but notice the wonderful honey, amber nectar color. When the sun shines on this dram the color reminds you of the golden sunset at the Highlands where this dram was born.   Once you savor this exceptional Highland Single Malt you will be more intrigued, as the palate can detect the complexity and yet note how well balanced it actually is.   The flavor of this complex yet well balanced MATISSE 15 Years Old Highland Single Malt is full with a slight sweetness to it. You can also detect a very slight spicy flavor; this is the taste of an older whisky.

name: Bowmore  18 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A masterful combination of ripe fruit, dark chocolate and Islay smoke. Breathe in classic Bowmore smokiness, perfectly tempered with creamy caramel, chocolate and ripe fruit aromas. Sip beautiful soft fruit and chocolate balanced with a light smokiness - incredibly complex. Savour the long and wonderfully balanced finish.

name: Laphroaig  18 years (750 ml)
desc_en_short: This 18 Year Old expression of Laphroaig is made in limited quantities each year and savoured by a fortunate few. A soft, sweet and spicy Islay peat smoke greets you when you first open the bottle. The immediate taste is an oak sweetness, from 18 years in the barrel. A faint hint of the sea can be detected, testimony to its time maturing on the remote island of Islay.

name: Laphroaig  25 years (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Laphroaig 25 Year Old is the perfect marriage of sherried, oaky flavours from the European Oloroso Sherry Casks and the creamy, smooth, sweet flavours from the ex-American Bourbon Barrels. The Oloroso Sherry Casks and ex-American Bourbon Barrels were filled with newly distilled Laphroaig spirit from day one.

name: Teacher's  Scotch (700 ml)
desc_en_short: It is said that William Teacher would not give his name to his blend until he had found perfection. Highland Cream was that whisky. At 45% it has one of the highest single malt contents of any blend and uses fully peated Ardmore whisky as it’s fingerprint malt. The combination is incredible depth and smoothness combined with a rich smokey undertones. Truely a masterpiece.

name: Matisse  19 Years Old Single Malt (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: A classic Highland Single Malt!  This rare Highland Single Malt has a delicate vanilla honey aroma of spiced oranges that comes from the finest oak casks in which the whisky was matured for over 19 years. You can also taste the floral top notes, which adds a delicate balance to the robust complexity of this dram.   On the palate, these aromas are supported by full-bodied structural tones of leather and toffee, which are characteristics of older whiskies that have taken on the full flavor of the oak casks. The complex taste gives way to a very long and lingering finish which lasts long in the memory and in the mouth. This single malt is prized by connoisseurs of a fine whisky, but is also ideal for all occasions and will delight anyone who savors it.

name: Provenance  Blair Athol - Sherry 14 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Sherry butt-matured Blair Athol single malt Scotch whisky, distilled in Spring 1999 and bottled in Summer 2013. It has been bottled at 14 years old, by Douglas Laing as part of their Provenance range of top-quality single malts, which give light to the seasons they were distilled or bottled in.

name: Provenance  Fettercairn 12 Years (Highland) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: When someone said Autumn to us, we used to think of colourful leaves, Halloween and the occasional (okay, maybe more than occasional) downpour. Now, after seeing this 12 year old Fettercairn which was distilled in Autumn 2000 and bottled for Douglas Laing's Provenance range, all those Autumn things have been overshadowed by this fantastic whisky!

name: Provenance  Bowmore 10 Years (Islay) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This was distilled at Bowmore in Autumn of 2000 and aged for 10 years in a single refill hogshead before bottling for the Provenance range from Douglas Laing in Autumn of 2010. Deliciously malty, gently smoked whisky.

name: Provenance  Bunnahabhain Y&F (Islay) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This whisky is indeed Young & Feisty (Y&F) as itÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s peatier than your average Bunna bottlings. Definitely a good young Bunna showing (most of the time) maturity beyond its age and with a reasonable price tag, itÃ¢â‚¬â„¢s a good addition to the whisky shelf. Slainte!

name: Provenance  Auchentoshan 13 Years (Lowland) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This Provenance bottling of 13 year old Auchentoshan single malt Scotch whisky honours the season of Spring, as it was in the Spring of 2000 that it was distilled. Another brilliant single cask release from Douglas Laing.

name: Provenance  Ledaig 7 Years (Island) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: An autumn distillation, this Ledaig may only be 7 years old but these peated malt whiskies produced in Tobermory are excellent at these younger ages. Part of Douglas Laing's Provenance range, this release was bottled in 2013 after a maturation period spent in a single refill hogshead.

name: Provenance  Auchroisk 10 Years (Speyside) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Provenance Auchroisk opens fresh and sweet on the nose carrying a floral style plus vanilla fudge and a malty quality. The palate opens with a sweet vanilla aspect and runs to spiced caramelised peaches. The finish is long and spicy and carries a soft chewed leather quality plus late honey.

name: Provenance  Glen Keith 15 Years (Speyside) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: A 15 years aged single cask bottling of Glen Keith whisky from the Provenance range by Douglas Laing.

name: Provenance  Inchgower - Sherry 12 Years (Speyside) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This was distilled at Inchgower in Summer 1999 and aged for 12 years in a sherry butt before bottling in Spring 2002 for the Provenance range from Douglas Laing.

name: Provenance  Mannochmore 14 Years (Speyside) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: A 14 year old single cask Mannochmore, distilled in 1999 before bottling in spring 2013 by Douglas Laing as part of their Provenance range. Interestingly, there is a dark grains plant next to Mannochmore, producing animal feed from the waste pot ale and draff from 21 distilleries.

name: Premier Barrel  Ben Nevis 12 Years (Highland) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: A 12 year old decantering of Ben Nevis single malt, hand filled by those wonderful Douglas Laing bunch for their Premier Barrel range.

name: Premier Barrel  Braeval - Sherry 12 Years (Speyside) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Presented in a decanter you wouldn't be surprised to see on the shelf of an eccentric in the 1800s, this sweet, honey'd Braeval single malt Scotch whisky looks rather dashing indeed. Matured in a single Sherry butt for 12 years before being bottled by Douglas Laing with an outturn of 423 bottles.

name: Premier Barrel  Miltonduff - Sherry 7 Years (Speyside) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: 7 year old bottling from Miltonduff, presented in a 19th century-style ceramic decanter. 448 were filled by hand from a single cask by Douglas Laing.

name: Old Malt Cask  Macduff 21 Years (Highland) (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Nose: Gristy and sweet, thick, rich with notes of boiled sweets, wine gums, peppermint.
Palate: Stewed fruits, vanilla and apple crumble. Manuka honey, cinnamon and cedar.
Finish: Long and spiced with notes of lemon zest and rhubarb.

name: Old Malt Cask  Bunnahabhain 16 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A 1997 vintage Bunnahabhain from independent bottlers Hunter Laing as part of their Old Malt Casks series. Aged for 16 years before bottling, this is a rich and sweet example of this Islay favourite.

name: Old Malt Cask  Auchentoshan 16 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Nose Sweet yet mellow with butterscotch,blackberries and citrus peel. Flavor is  Vanilla custard powder, pineapple and notes of butter and cream. Long, lingering and dry with a sweet hint of oak.

name: Old Malt Cask  Highland Park 17 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Golden barley in colour with a medium body. The nose is a gorgeous sweet vanilla with light woody influences followed by soft, warm honey flavours at the rear. The palate is initially woody, followed by hints of creamy vanilla with a light suggestion of tangerine zest and left feeling wonderfully cleansed and refreshed.

name: Old Malt Cask  Auchroisk 18 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: An 18 year old bottling of Auchroisk from the newly formed Hunter Laing (previously part of Douglas Laing). Cask 9877 (a refill hogshead) produced just 311 bottles of this wonderful whisky.

name: Old Malt Cask  Aultmore 21 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Part of Hunter Laing's Old Malt Cask, a range full of whiskies from well known distilleries that have been picked at their individual tastiest age. For cask 9869, which held whisky from the Speyside distillery Aultmore, this was deemed to be 21 years old.

name: Old Malt Cask  Cragganmore 16 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: An amazing Cragganmore single cask Speyside, part of Hunter Laing's Old Malt Cask range. Matured for 16 years in a refill hogshead, it was bottled in August 2013 with just 204 bottles produced.

name: Old Malt Cask  Craigellachie Sherry 18 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: 18 year old Craigellachie single malt Scotch whisky, released as part of the Old Malt Cask range by Hunter Laing. This Sherried Speysider was distilled back in November 1995 and left to mature in Sherry butt #10589 until June 2014. It was then bottled at 50% ABV with an outturn of 730 bottles.

name: Old Malt Cask  Blair Athol Sherry 18 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: After spending 18 long years relaxing in a Sherry butt, this Blair Athol single malt Scotch whisky was ready for the world. The Highland distillery produced the whisky in October 1995 and it was bottled by Hunter Laing for the Old Malt Cask range in February 2014. 585 bottles were made

name: Old Malt Cask  Dufftown 18 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Light and fruity on the nose with a touch of maltyness, there is a distinctive boiled sweet quality to this 18 year old Dufftown. On the palate it is sweet and also tangy, with tart apple, lemon zest and a creamy fudge flavour. There is a warming oaky background to all of this, making for a complex and delicious whisky from one of Speyside's iconic distilleries.

name: Old Malt Cask  Inchgower 18 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Maturation in a sherry butt for 18 years was long enough for this Inchgower whisky according to Hunter Laing. Their Old Malt Cask range is only bottled when they think it has reached the pinnacle of tastiness, and by Jove do they know tasty whisky! A single cask release of 242 bottles.

name: Old Malt Cask  Miltonduff 18 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Yummy 18 year old Miltonduff single malt Scotch whisky, bottled by Hunter Laing for the Old Malt Cask range. A limited release of 228 bottles.

name: Old Malt Cask  Fettercairn 18 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Part of Hunter Laing's famous Old Malt Cask range, this 18 year old single cask Fettercairn single malt is certainly a handsome addition to the range. It was distilled by Fettercairn in the Highlands during November 1995 and bottled by Hunter Laing in February 2014. 268 bottles were produced.

name: Compass Box (Signature range)  Asyla Blend Malt (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A blend of soft, fruity malt whiskies on a bed of rich, sweet grain whiskies. All whiskies aged in first-fill American oak casks to yield the trademark Compass Box style: soft, rich, vanilla-tinged, delicious. See why this, the lightest of our whiskies, wins the most awards!

name: Compass Box  Great King Street Blended Scotch Whisky (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Great King Street is a mission, mission dedicated to reviving interest in one style of whisky only: Blended Scotch Whisky. This is the style of Scotch whisky that combines flavourful single malt whiskies with delicate, elegant single grain whiskies. Well-made Blended Scotch Whiskies have an elegance and approachability that make them a joy to drink. They are far versatile than other styles of whisky equally enjoyable drunk on their own or with ice, soda water, or in cocktails.

name: Compass Box  Hedonism (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
"The first classic of its genre." Jim Murray. Our bottlings of Hedonism are made from a combination of eight to 15 casks of grain whisky from distilleries such as Cameron Bridge, one of the oldest continuously operating distilleries in Scotland, and Cambus. Most whisky in Hedonism has been aged in first-fill American oak casks. This ageing yields a very special whisky that is full and round with richly textured flavours of vanilla and toffee.

Awards :

Winner Best Scotch Grain - 2020 : World Whiskies Awards

Silver Scotch Whisky - Blended Grain - 2017 : International Wine & Spirit Competition

name: Compass Box  Oakcross (700 ml)
desc_en_short: "A delivery that makes you gasp out loud” – 92.5 points Jim Murray's Whisky Bible 2013. We call this whisky Oak Cross because it offers the best characteristics of both American and French oak aging. A rich, medium-bodied blended malt Scotch whisky, Oak Cross combines vanilla characters from American oak and spicy, clove-like characters from French oak.

name: Compass Box (Signature range)  The Spice Tree (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
"A stunning whisky… Highly recommended." Dave Broom. Our storied malt whisky The Spice Tree is made from Highland malt whiskies which we age in custom-made casks fitted with new French oak heads. We source this oak from a mill in the Vosges which produces some of the highest quality cooperage oak for winemakers. The result is a big malt whisky of richness and spice-like complexity. To discover the full story behind The Spice Tree see the links below.

Awards :

Gold Blended Malt - 2020 : World Whiskies Awards

Trophy Blended Malts - 2016 : International Spirits Challenge

Winner Best Blended Malt Scotch - 2015 : San Francisco World Spirits Competition

name: Johnnie Walker  Red Label (Mini-Bar 200 ml)
desc_en_short:
** (Minimum 6 Bottles or More)

The character of the whisky is defined by intense, spicy, zingy, edgy flavours. RED LABEL bursts onto the palate with the freshness of spray from a crashing wave, followed by the zing of aromatic spices and finally a long, lingering, smoky finish. The sensation in the mouth is complex – ‘sweet chilli’ is a good description of this taste and the tingling sensation on the tongue.

name: Johnnie Walker  Black Label (Mini-Bar 200 ml)
desc_en_short:
** (Minimum 6 Bottles or More)

A true icon, recognised as the benchmark for all other deluxe blends. Created using only whiskies aged for a minimum of 12 years from the four corners of Scotland, Johnnie Walker Black Label has an unmistakably smooth, deep, complex character. An impressive whisky to share on any occasion.

name: Johnnie Walker & Son  King George V (750 ml)
desc_en_short: It is an opulent and regal blend. Sensuous, layered and intense, the John Walker & Sons King George V is a kaleidoscope of flavours and aromas. Hints of roasted nuts, dark chocolate and an imposing sweet smokiness combine elegantly with suggestions of honey, citrus orange and rose petals. This is an extremely complex luxury whisky.

name: John Walker & Sons  Odyssey (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A new super-premium release from Johnnie Walker whose launch has been continuously celebrated by an extraordinary around the world journey of a 157 foot luxury yacht. The John Walker & Sons Voyager, as the yacht is called, has been holding parties at cities across Asia for the past few months and now it has reached Europe!

name: Oban  14 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A bustling seaside resort has grown up around the distillery in the two centuries since it was first built in the fishing town of Oban. The West Highland malt is still produced in the same unhurried, traditional fashion and this 14 year old is a classic dram from the distillery.

name: Dalwhinnie  15 Years (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This classic Highland malt, Dalwhinnie ages slowly to develop a remarkable character. Fifteen years of gentle aging make it a smooth and subtle malt. Take your time to discover creamy vanilla, heather honey and just a hint of Highland smoke.

name: Glenmorangie  25 Year Old Quarter Century (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Matured in a range of casks including American white oak, Oloroso sherry casks and French Burgundy casks before being blended back together in exact quantities, the Glenmorangie Quarter Century is complex, bursting with deep flavours, and a perfect testimony to our knowledge and experience.

name: Ardbeg  Corryvreckan (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
This is one of the legendary Islay malts. We loved the Committee release and we weren't disappointed with this incredible dram. This was released to replace Airigh Nam Beist, choosing a more medicinal style over the creamier style of the beastie.

Awards :

Winner - World's Best Single Malt - 2010 : World Whiskies Awards

name: Wild Turkey  101 (750 ml)
desc_en_short: This bottling of Wild Turkey has been aged for at least 6 years before coming out of the barrel at 109 proof, it is only diluted slightly before bottling at 101 proof with plenty of pep.

name: Black Velvet  Canadian Whisky (750ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Original Canadian whisky as distillation, rather than at bottling, he achieved a taste so smooth taste profile and clean finish, Black Velvet Whisky has become the preferred pour of discriminating whisky drinkers around the world.

name: Arran  14 Year Single Malt Whisky  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Rich warming spice and caramelized fruits with a layer of coffee and milk chocolate. The coastal influence on this liquid can be enjoyed in the waves of liquorice and pineapple on the palate.

name: Arran  Gold Cream Liqueur  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Single Malt Whisky Cream Liqueur. Voted the World’s Best whisky liqueur at The World Whiskies Awards. Smooth and creamy with a subtle hint of Arran malt. 17% abv.

name: Glenfarclas Single Highland Malt Whisky 21 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A heavily sherried 21 year old from the Glenfarclas distillery. This offers loads of depth, a really thick dram and great value for money too.

name: Spey  12 years old Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Spey is a brand owned by Harvey's of Edinburgh (who also own the Speyside distillery) and is primarily sold in Taiwan. This is their Reserve 12 year old, which is a sherried and peaty whisky

name: Spey  Chairman’s Choice Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Spey is a brand of single malts from the Speyside distillery. This Chairman's Choice bottling – aged in a combination of sherry and bourbon casks – follows a tradition whereby the chairman of the company would select his best casks to serve to his family on Christmas Day. The tradition continues and a small amount is released globally on this day each year.

name: Spey  18 years old Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Spey is a brand owned by Harvey's of Edinburgh (owners of the Speyside distillery) and is hugely popular in Taiwan. This is the 18 year old – aged in sherry butts and mellow but full of flavour.

name: Spey  Royal Choice Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: In 1815, when Lord Byron married Annabella Milbanke at Seaham Hall, he gave a cask of 'SPEY' whisky to King George III as a gift. The royal connection to SPEY whisky has continued in other ways, including this single malt from the Speyside Distillery - the SPEY Royal Choice. It was produced exclusively under licence for the charity Historic Royal Palaces, and features an image of the Tower of London on the label, as well as some classic Royal Blue. This deluxe single malt is presented in a handsome, wooden presentation box.

name: The Macallan  15 Year Old Triple Cask Matured (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Macallan Triple Cask Matured 15 Years Old forms part of our Triple Cask Matured range; a series of single malt whiskies crafted in a triple cask combination of European and American sherry seasoned oak casks and American ex-bourbon oak casks. An expert marriage of these three distinct cask types, this is a sublime single malt with vibrant orange and chocolate flavours.

name: Highland Park  18 Y.O. (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Highland Park 18 Years Old is natural burnished gold. Nose: Rich, mature oak, top note of aromatic smoke Palate: Rich, full flavor, honey & peat Finish: Soft, round & long

Awards :

Gold Distillers' Single Malts between 13 and 20 years old - 2020 : International Spirits Challenge

Gold Highlands & Islands 13-18yo - 2020 : The Scotch Whisky Masters (The Spirits Business)

Gold Highlands & Islands 13-18yo - 2019 : The Scotch Whisky Masters (The Spirits Business)

name: The Glenrothes  Vintage Reserve (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The combination of different Vintages aged in a variety of casks creates a balance of mature experience and vibrant youth. The oldest constituent brings mellow oak and dried fruits; the greatest proportion adds soft, mature, sweet vanilla; the more youthful add exuberance and lemon citrus, creating a sharp and uplifting taste.

name: The Glenrothes  2001 (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Orange comes to the foreground first, vanilla following shortly after. A tiny, spicy hint of apples dusted with cinnamon towards the end. Fairly long and dry, the spice lingering on the finish.

name: The Glenrothes  1998 (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A creamy, malt-driven palate with sweet winter spices, particularly cinnamon. Rhubarb crumble with hot custard and hints of black pepper. Good length with more vanilla and a suggestion of nutmeg on the tail.

name: The Glenrothes  1995 (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Glenrothes has always been universally acclaimed by blenders as an exceptional Speyside Malt. Only a small number of vintages have been released, such is the exceptional quality required. Each vintage is, by definition, rare and finite. Each has its own unique personality.

name: Jack Daniel's  No.27 Gold (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Only Jack Daniel's No.27 Gold is double barreled and double mellowed After its first barreling in oak, it continues to mature in maple barrels

This unique process offers Jack Daniel's No.27 Gold its. Unparalleled smoothness and complex finish. The Taste has delicate hints of chocolate and pralines and finishes smooth 80 proof

name: Clansman  Blended Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Clansman captures the heart and soul of Scotland in this fine whisky. A blend of our finest grain and malt whiskies aged to perfection in oak casks. This smooth and easy to drink whisky has hints of soft fruit, sweet vanilla overlaid with a touch of peat.

name: High Commissioner  Blended Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A blend selected from our finest grain and malt whiskies, High Commissoner has flavours of soft fruits, peach, pear and chewy caramel. Sweet and fruity with notes of malted barley. Well balanced and complex with a long smooth warming finish.

name: John Walker & Sons  Private Collection (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The John Walker & Sons Private Collection 2016 Edition is the third annual, limited release and once again showcases the craftsmanship and innovation of John Walker & Sons blended Scotch Whisky. It is another master class from our Master Blender, Jim Beveridge, who combined flavours from over a hundred casks to produce our most complex blend to date. Among the casks were rare single grain Scotch whiskies from five Johnnie Walker distilleries, four of which are now silent.

name: Johnnie Walker  EPIC Date 1920 Edition (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Only 540 bottles of Johnnie Walker The Commemorative 1920 Edition have been created, with each individually numbered and signed by Master Blender Jim Beveridge. The blend, crafted specially using a modern interpretation of a classic technique used in 1920

name: John Walker & Sons  King George V 80th Limited Edition (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: On the front of the gift box is a regal, Art Deco Inspired gold chandelier print. The liquid inside is a blend crafted from whiskies whose distilleries operated at the time of King George V, including “precious” casks of Port Ellen single malt from Islay. “We are proud to present a limited edition design of this exquisite, hand-crafted blend exclusively for luxury travellers,”

name: Glen Scotia  15 year old Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This is the 15 year old single malt Scotch whisky from Glen Scotia in the Campbeltown region, released in 2015 as part of a redesign for their range. The distillers use specially selected American oak casks to age this expression, which compliment the fruit-forward and subtly coastal whisky rather well.

name: MARS  Maltage Cosmo Blended Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This blended malt whisky expresses a rich and intensely greedy aromatic profile, which will bring you into a charming Japanese and Scottish taste universe, carefully built around the two producing countries craftmanship. The result is a tasty blend of sweet flavors such as honey, caramel and riped fruits, subtly highlighted by some woody and smoky hints.

name: MARS  Twin Alps Whisky (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Slightly harsh burnt grass and citrus, like sour mulch, with some sweetness. Grassy again, but more pleasant than the nose. More fruits and citrus with a touch of vanilla. Medium sour apple and mild chalky oak.

name: MARS  3&7 Whisky (720ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Blended grain 3 years and malt 7 years. It is a good value for money entry level blended whisky. It is full bodied with a oaky wood fragrance.

name: MARS  Iwai Tradition Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This is malt driven spirit is truly a reflection of contemporary Japanese whisky. Incredibly balanced, soft and layered. A blending of sherry, bourbon and wine casks with hints delicate hints of peat make for a harmonious whisky that would make Iwai-san proud. Ripe Cherry, honey toffee with a beautiful ginger spice.

name: MARS  Iwai Tradition Wine Cask Finish (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Many lush traits from the nose (Cherry Ripe / Turkish Delight). In addition spiced port wine, dried figs, ginger cookies, hot milk and honey, raspberry gums, and toffee. Certainly a dram that brings a glow to your face - I love it. Later on in the game, teasing salt and pepper played with my taste buds. Finish is medium to border-line long on mellow spiced port, ginger cookies, honey milk, and dried figs.

name: MARS  Komagatake Rindo Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: It is the series that put the harmony of the old and the new malt that this bottle is young, and nature weaves malt home brew with the dynamism in the main constituent to a bottle. A prefectural flower "gentian" of Nagano where the theme of the series 1st release makes the flower that the violet is beautiful bloom. It is batting with old liquor matured for a long term more than 20 years in 2012 by malt home brew of the distillation. It is molar tea, dried fruit, taste with the depth softly.

name: Douglas Laing's  Rock Island (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Rock Island is a magnificent maritime marvel made with single malts distilled on Scottish islands including Orkney, Jura, Arran and Islay. As ever from Douglas Laing, this tasty, coastal dram is very handsomely presented from top to bottom

name: Compass Box  Orangerie (700 ml)
desc_en_short: It is named after the citrus greenhouses that became the rage in 16th century England, introducing oranges to the aristocracy for the first time. To make Orangerie, Compass Box starts with Fife-sourced highland single malt and single grain whiskies. Then they infuse zest of Navalino orange peel, cloves, cassia bark and cinnamon

name: Georgia Moon  Corn Whiskey (Jar) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Clear in colour and features a sour tang alongside sweeter notes of corn. Presented in a mason jar and aged for less than 30 days.

name: Kavalan  Classic Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Kavalan Classic Single Malt Whisky exemplifies the sheer quality of whisky currently coming out of Taiwan. The skills of Master Blender Ian Chang work with the humid Taiwanese climate to create whisky that is diverse and complex. Fresh and clean, the spirit is rich with silky smoothness and hints of tropical fruits, mango in particular.

name: Kavalan  Podium Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Created from specially selected brand-new American oak casks and re-fill casks, the expression is surprisingly delicate and extremely complex. It is a further endorsement of the dedication of our rigorous wood policy.

name: Kavalan  Sherry Oak single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Kavalan Sherry Oak dilutes Solist Sherry with Kavalan spring water to 46% strength. It is easy to drink and could be a perfect malt whisky to share with friends and family on most occasions.

name: Kavalan  Bourbon Oak single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Kavalan ex-Bourbon Oak dilutes Solist ex-Bourbon with Kavalan spring water to 46% strength. It is incredibly smooth with a soft sweetness, losing the harshness and the alcohol edge and lingering over those unique flavours. It is clean and fresh tropical fruitiness with pleasant vanilla, coconut and spices.

name: Kavalan  ex-Bourbon Oak Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Kavalan ex-Bourbon Oak dilutes the Solist ex-Bourbon with Kavalan spring water to 46% alcoholic strength. It is incredibly smooth with a soft sweetness, losing the harshness of the alcohol's edge. It has a clean and fresh tropical fruitiness with lingering vanilla, coconut and spices.

name: Kavalan  Solist Vinho Barrique Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Vinho is fully matured in used American oak wine barrels that have been toasted and recharred in a way that brings out fruity vanilla notes from the whisky and wood overlaid on a delicate background of complex fruitiness.

name: Kavalan  Solist Port Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Kavalan Solist Port Cask is fully matured in Portuguese Port barriques under the subtropical climate to create the multiple fruity flavours such as plum, blueberry, blackberry and strawberry just to name a few, with chocolate as the main background note.

name: Kavalan  Solist PX Sherry Single Cask Strength Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: PX Sherry is one of the classic collection of Kavalan whisky. The new make spirit which matures in the PX sherry casks produces our unique and special characters and flavours with the classic fruity, nutty and chocolate aromas that are distinctive and phenomenal!

name: Kavalan  Moscatel Sherry Single Cask Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Moscatel is a special variety of sherry wines. The combination of Moscatel casks, Kavalan new make and our subtropical heat is simply magical in terms of maturation quality. This Kavalan single malt is packed with surprises to all of the sensory receptors that once again brings out the richness and complexity to the fullest.

name: Wild Turkey  Master's Keep Cornerstone Rye (750 ml)
desc_en_short: At 17 years-old and hand-selected by Master Distiller Eddie Russell for its perfectly balanced flavor, Master’s Keep is the longest-aged whiskey released by Wild Turkey in the United States. Aged in both brick and wood rickhouses and at 86.8 proof, it starts out smooth and silky, transforms into a caramel, vanilla sweetness, and finishes with savory spiciness and oak.

name: Maker's 46 (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: So Maker’s 46® actually begins as fully matured Maker’s Mark. And then we begin the inventive, handcrafted finishing process that creates a bourbon with bold vanilla, oak and caramel flavors – yet retains the easy drinkability of Maker’s Mark.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blenders’ Batch Red Rye Finish (White Label) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Smooth, sweet & smoky; designed to make the perfect Manhattan. In 2015, Jim and his team developed the limited release of Johnnie Walker Select Cask  Rye Finish

name: Laphroaig  Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky Select Cask (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This full bodied whisky is initially sweet up front- matching the nose, then the classic dry, peaty, ashy flavours come bounding in followed by a lovely rich finish arising from the rich fruits of the European casks.

name: StilltheOne Distillery  287 Single Malt Whisky (Limited Edition) (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Created from Freshchester Pale Ale, the "287" whiskey is named after the highway that connects StilltheOne Distillery and Captain Lawrence Brewery. 287 Single Malt Whiskey has been carefully distilled to capture the nuance of the malted barley, then aged in new charred American oak barrels for ten months. The resulting spirit is floral with harmonious notes of vanilla, caramel and sweet spice leading to a hint of dark chocolate on the finish.

name: StilltheOne Distillery  No. 3 Westchester Wheat Whisky (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Slightly sweet, notes of vanilla, honey, chocolate caramel finish. Westchester Wheat Whiskey is made from 100% organic wheat grown in New York State.

name: StilltheOne Distillery  No. 4 Westchester Rye Whisky (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The taste starts with sweet vanilla and caramel notes, transitions to cinnamon and floral rye flavors and gives a long spicy, but not overwhelming, rye finish.

name: Van Brunt Stillhouse  American Whisky (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Van Brunt Stillhouse American Whiskey does not fit neatly into typical whiskey categories.  It is a four grain whiskey made primarily from malted barley and wheat, with a little bit of corn and a touch of rye.  This unique whiskey has floral notes of a malt whiskey with the new barrel sweetness of a bourbon.

name: Van Brunt Stillhouse  Bourbon (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Van Brunt Stillhouse Bourbon Whiskey  is a wheated bourbon made with 65% organic NY state corn.   This American classic is carefully made with only the best ingredients.

name: Van Brunt Stillhouse  Moonshine (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Moonshine, White Lightning, New Make Whiskey. 19th Century New York City produced more Moonshine that the entire south combined. From industrial scale operations in Chelsea to mom and pop stills in Vinegar Hill to Red Hook's own streets, whiskey was once produced in large quantities in the City. Van Brunt Stillhouse is working to revive this proud tradition.

name: Ole Smoky  Original Moonshine Whiskey (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Ole Smoky® Original Moonshine is made with the same renegade attitude of its forefathers. Our hundred-year-old recipe produces a white whisky as smooth and bright as the promise of a Saturday night when anything can happen and likely will. Every shot, swig or slug of Ole Smoky Original Moonshine is highly drinkable and hardly pretentious. Don’t just start your night, fire it up.

name: Ole Smoky  Lemon Drop (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Shining like the dawn of Summer itself, Ole Smoky® Lemon Drop Moonshine is a tart and tangy wonderful concoction that combines our White Lightnin’ Moonshine with our favorite lemonade. Created to have a little more fun than just quenching your thirst, Ole Smoky Lemon Drop goes perfect with shenanigans in the sunshine.

name: Ole Smoky  Moonshine Cherries (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Cherry bombs. With a nod to Appalachian creativity, we took maraschino cherries and give them a good, long soak in our 100 proof original moonshine. This delicious marriage culminated in an explosion of sweet heat in every perfectly infused cherry. And, once the cherries are gone, the remaining moonshine offers a lingering sweet nectar that blends into cherry cola or ginger ale like long lost lovers.

name: Jefferson's  Very Small Batch Bourbon (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Jefferson’s Bourbon is made in very small batches. Actually, ridiculously small batches. We take up to four different Kentucky straight bourbon whiskies of different ages and marry them together. Doing this, we get a lot of complexity and balance while maintaining the consistency needed in a bourbon (one of the blends comprising of at least 55% of the total). We wanted to make it big enough for the connoisseur, yet approachable for people just getting into the premium bourbon field.

name: Jefferson's  Reserve Bourbon (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: “It seems appropriate that it was Jefferson himself who was at the heart of the Whiskey Rebellion in 1791, during which he repealed the tax on whiskey and turned Americans from rye to Bourbon.”

name: Jefferson's  Ocean Bourbon (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This bourbon started out as an experiment with just three bourbon barrels on Trey’s friend, Chris Fischer of OCEARCH’s ship, in a curious effort to discover what would happen if bourbon was left to weather the extreme elements: temperature fluctuations, salt air and the gentle rocking of the ship. The result was a thick, dark bourbon that showcases complex flavors reminiscent of other spirits; the almost black color and caramel flavors resemble a dark rum as the sugars within the barrels caramelized; the briny, savory taste from the barrels breathing the sea air is reminiscent of Islay Scotch; and at its core, it’s a true bourbon. Due to a massive demand from consumers, Trey has now commercialized this experiment and sent hundreds of barrels around the world. Each voyage of Jefferson’s Ocean typically crosses the equator four times, visits five continents and over 30 ports on an average sailing.

name: Teeling  Small Batch Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Teeling Irish Whiskey has an aroma of vanilla and warm spices that gives way to notes of caramel, toffee, butterscotch and molasses on the palate. The finish is slightly sweet yet spicy, with woody undertones. The whiskey was called a "standout" by Serious Eats, which said that it was "a meticulously crafted whiskey that's beguiling in its subtle new twist." In addition, the whiskey earned a score of 95 points from Drink Me Magazine.

name: Teeling  Single Malt Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Teeling Single Malt Irish Whiskey has a sunny gold color and an aroma of sweet melon, fig, toffee, oak and bitter apple. The palate is packed with deeper flavors of vanilla, cloves, fresh cookies and lemon tart, and leads to a finish accented by long, sweet notes of wine tannins and dry oak.

Awards :

Winner - Best Irish Single Malt - 2015 : World Whiskies Awards

name: John Walker & Sons  Private Collection 2017 Edition (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: The 2017 Edition of the John Walker & Sons Private Collection is the fourth annual release in the series of limited edition releases showcasing the innovative spirit and craft of blenders. With complete creative freedom, Master Blender Dr Jim Beveridge celebrates the richness that cask character brings to Johnnie Walker whiskies.

name: Bruichladdich  Octomore 09.1 Super Heavily Peated Islay Single Malt (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Each new octomore generates a huge amount of anticipation and excitement. connoisseurs of single malts from around the world have created a cult following for the world’s most heavily peated whisky series.

Each release is a powerful illustration of the art of the master distiller. each is necessarily unique, limited, finite, a celebration of nuance. it can never be reproduced. for 7.1 barley harvested from mainland scotland was peated to 208ppm. five years in american oak. bottled at 59.5%. octomore stands alone.

name: Dewar's  12 Years Old Blended Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
Sometimes the best things in life are as simple as they come. But going the extra mile in aging Scotch Whisky makes it even better. We pioneered our own double-aging process over a 100 years ago, putting our whisky back into butts after blending, to age it twice for a smoother taste, fuller flavour and longer finish. The longer the individual whiskies get to know each other, the better the glass of Scotch at the end of it. So after 12 years, you're getting a honeyed, fruity whisky that is pretty special.

Awards :

Silver Blends under 12 years old - 2019 : The Scotch Whisky Masters (The Spirits Business)

Silver Blended Scotch between 12 and 20 years old - 2019 : International Spirits Challenge

name: Dewar's  White Label Blended Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Dewar's White Label whisky was created in 1899 by our first Master Blender, A J Cameron. With a blend of up to 40 single malt and single grain whiskies in every bottle, getting a result that was well-rounded and smooth enough to enjoy neat was no easy feat. Crafted with the same care today as it was in the beginning, we're confident that if the great man himself walked into the blending room tomorrow, he'd recognise his signature Scotch Whisky.

name: Royal Salute  21 years (700 ml) (Red Wade Decanter)
desc_en_short: In 1953,Chivas Brothers paid tribute to Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II by creating a limited edition of a very special blended whisky. Only 2,500 cases were produced for worldwide distribution. The first Flagons, adorned with the royal crest, were sealed on the day of her coronation. The name chosen was considered a fitting tribute to the new monarch. It was called Royal Salute, after the 21-gun salute - the ultimate mark of respect, reserved for tributes to dignitaries and nations alike. Appropriately, each of the whiskies in the blend was at least 21 years old and thus, Royal Salute 21 Year Old was born.

name: Royal Salute  21 years (700 ml) (Green Wade Decanter)
desc_en_short: In 1953,Chivas Brothers paid tribute to Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II by creating a limited edition of a very special blended whisky. Appropriately, each of the whiskies in the blend was at least 21 years old and thus, Royal Salute 21 Year Old was born.

name: Jack Daniel's  Old No.7 (3 L) with Candle
desc_en_short: Jack Daniel’s® Tennessee Whiskey is made with the careful selection of the finest corn, rye and barley malt. These choice grains are mixed with the iron-free water that flows from the Cave Spring found on Distillery grounds. Our process includes the unique step of charcoal - mellowing, which give Jack Daniel’s its trademark smoothness and character and makes it a Tennessee Whiskey.

name: Douglas Laing's  The Epicurean (Whisky Glass Gift Pack) (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Douglas Laing’s The Epicurean Lowland Malt Scotch Whisky tells the story of a 1930s Glasgow man, a real cheeky chappy who was ever the life and soul of the party, and a real connoisseur of fine food and drink. A dram we describe as “city born and bred”, The Epicurean is a blend of some of the finest Lowland Malts; a marriage of the best that the East and the West of Scotland have to offer. This small batch bottling is proudly without colouring or chill-filtration and bottled at 46.2% ABV.

name: Great King Street Glasgow Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
In his 1930 book “Whisky”, Aeneas MacDonald teaches us that Glaswegians historically preferred fuller bodied and more flavourpacked whiskies than people in other parts of the world

So what better name for a whisky such as this? You’ll find here a rich vein of peaty-smokiness, underpinned by sherry cask-aged whiskies, full of dried fruit and wine character. The palate is full and round, with a sweetness typical of whiskies from our company

For decades, The Wellington Statue, outside Glasgow’s Gallery of Modern Art, has been cheekily topped by a traffic cone, something the local population has taken to heart as a symbol of their sense of humour.

It has become one of Glasgow’s most iconic images, and graces our label for the Glasgow Blend.

name: Suntory  Hibiki 17 Years Old Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Elegant. Poised. Slowly revealing a clear yet complex equilibrium. Peach, apricot, melon, rose, lily, lemon leaf on aromas. Toffee, black cherry, vanilla, and Mizunara (Japanese oak) on palate. The finish is sweet, fruity, and lychee aftertaste.

food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: A smooth, appley Japanese blended malt, almost certainly comprised of Hanyu & Chichibu (where it was matured, vatted and bottled). In a move that will likely enrage the more pernickety of the lickspittle jobsworths at the SWA, this has included the supposedly-not-allowed-anymore 'pure malt' term on its label. Naughty!

name: The Macallan  25 Year Old Sherry Oak (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Superlative Speysider from Macallan, this astonishing 25 year old is one of the most revered whiskies in the world. It received a perfect 100 out of 100 score from the Beverage Testing Institute in Chicago, 1999. It also received a Gold at the International Spirits Challenge.

name: Jack Daniel's  Red Dog Saloon (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This special edition marks the 125th anniversary when Mr. Jack Daniel opened the doors of his Red Dog SaloonTM. Formerly situated on the Lynchburg town square, all that remains of the Red Dog SaloonTM are myths and legends - until now.

name: Old Forester  Statesman (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Inspired by the dynamic characters in the upcoming film,”Kingsman: The Golden Circle,” Old Forester Statesman offers bold flavor blended to a smooth 95 proof from hand-selected casks of our famed Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whisky from the warmest places in the warehouse. Because true character is only revealed after a little heat, the Statesman product offers an exceptional balance of heat and spice. “Kingsman: The Golden Circle” will be in theaters on September 22, and Statesman will be available to enjoy in the U.S. in August 2017.

name: Aberlour  18 Year Old Double Cask Matured (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Founded in 1826 in the heart of Speyside, Scotland, Aberlour Distillery has long been known for producing rich, balanced single malts that beautifully reflect the character of the region.

The Aberlour 18 Year Old is aged in a combination of Oloroso sherry casks and traditional American oak bourbon barrels, allowing it to develop a deep profile of ripe fruits, spice, and velvety smoothness over nearly two decades.

name: Glengoyne  12 Year Old Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
A perfect balance of oak and sweetness - Lemon zest, toffee apples – and a scent of coconut. Our signature sherry wood brings intensity and richness, while first fill bourbon casks add fresh notes of citrus and vanilla.

Awards :

Gold Distillers' Single Malts 12 years and under - 2020 : International Spirits Challenge

name: Glengoyne  18 Year Old Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Fresh, malty and spicy - Spicy vanilla fruit, ripe apples and a rich, luxurious mouthfeel. This is the result of eighteen long years and a generous proportion of first-fill sherry casks.

Awards :

Gold Distillers' Single Malts between 13 and 20 years old - 2020 : International Spirits Challenge

Silver Outstanding Scotch Single Malt - Highland - 2014 : International Wine & Spirit Competition

name: Glengoyne  21 Year Old Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Sultanas and hazelnuts; dried fruits and rich spice - Christmas cake, honey, and rich fruit – with a long cinnamon finish. Matured exclusively in hand-selected sherry casks for 21 years. Perfect after dinner or, frankly, anytime.

Awards :

Gold Scotch Whisky - Single Malt - Age Statement - 2018 : The Asian Spirits Masters (The Spirits Business)

Gold Scotch Single Malt - Highland - 2013 : International Wine & Spirit Competition

Silver Distillers' Single Malts 21 years old and over - 2020 : International Spirits Challenge

name: Macleod's 8 Year Old Highland Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: "An undemanding 8 year old single malt from an unnamed Highland distillery, this was bottled by Ian Macleod. The nose is quite light and smooth. There is a vague spirity note with toffee, barley, a touch of peat smoke and a little oak. The palate is of medium-body. There are some honey notes, perhaps a little vanilla. The peat smoke is light and wistful with a little sweetness. The finish is dry and of medium-length." (Credit : www.masterofmalt.com)

name: Macleod's 8 Year Old Islay Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: "A peaty 8 year old Single Malt from a secret Islay, bottled by Ian Macleod as an introduction into malt whisky. The nose is quite smoky, there are some lovely maritime notes, the peat is quite evident though a little spirity. The palate is quite full and well-balanced. There are notes of sultanas, mixed peels, peat smoke and kelp. The oak develops with marked aridity, continuing into the finish with more smoke." (Credit : www.masterofmalt.com)

name: Macleod's 8 Year Old Lowland Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: "A fresh, fruity Lowland dram. This 8 year old was bottled by Ian Macleod. The nose is quite subdued and spirity. There are notes of fresh flowers and a little mixed peel character, a touch of cut hay and a little oak. The palate is quite light and subtle. There are notes of marmalade and orange zest, hints of cut hay and barley. The finish is of medium-length with an oaken note." (Credit : www.masterofmalt.com)

name: Macleod's 8 Year Old Speyside Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: "An introduction into malt whisky from Ian Macleod. This 8 year old is an unnamed single malt from Speyside. The nose is of medium-body. There are honey notes, hints of spice and mixed peels, a little sultana note and a touch of sherry. The palate is of good body with balance. There are notes of gentle smoke entangled with a sultana note, mixed peels and barley sweetness. The finish is of good length with oak and cut hay." (Credit : www.masterofmalt.com)

name: Smokehead  18 Year Old Extra Black Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A release of 6,000 bottles of 18 year old Smokehead, packaged smartly in an "extra black" bottle. Full bodied and rich.

name: Tamdhu  10 Year Old Speyside Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Tamdhu 10 Year Old is our signature malt and the first release in our slowly maturing range of exquisite whiskies.

Matured exclusively in sherry oak casks, the finest in the whisky industry, we ensure every drop is as magnificent now as our founders envisioned over a century ago.

Finally, 10 long years are required to allow these fine casks to do their work, giving Tamdhu its wondrous natural colour and award-winning quality.

Awards :

Gold Scotch Whisky - Single Malt - Age Statement - 2018 : The Asian Spirits Masters (The Spirits Business)

Silver Speyside Single Malts up to 12yo - 2018 : The Scotch Whisky Masters (The Spirits Business)

Silver Outstanding Scotch Single Malt - Speyside - 2017 : International Wine & Spirit Competition

Hibiki Whisky is a harmonious blend of innumerous malt and grain whiskies which are meticulously blended to create a full orchestra of flavors and aromas. It is 12 year old blended whisky.

name: Aberfeldy  16 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: 16 year old single malt from the fantastic Aberfeldy distillery, unveiled in the latter half of 2015 as part of the Last Great Malts series. This expression is finished in Oloroso Sherry casks, imparting juicy sweetness to the whisky.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blenders' Batch Wine Cask Blend (1 L)
desc_en_short: Created by Johnnie Walker blender Aimée Gibson, this release blends whiskies aged in wine casks which were filled over 10 years ago. It incorporates whisky from Cameronbridge and Clyenlish distilleries. Bottled at 40% ABV.

name: Glenmorangie  Signet (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A superb, beautifully packaged Glenmorangie. Signet is distilled from malt with a good portion of chocolate malt too. Chocolate malt is heavily roasted malted barley. Some of this whisky was also matured in virgin oak casks.

name: West Cork  10 YO Single Malt (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Single malt whiskey from Ireland matured in first fill bourbon barrels. It's supposedly non-chill filtered at 40% abv, so don't be surprised if it throws a cloudy haze in the bottle even at room temperature.

name: West Cork  12 YO Port Cask (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The West Cork 12 year old Port Cask Finish is a limited release Irish whiskey matured in bourbon casks followed by a finish in port casks. It was bottled at 43% ABV, chill filtered and with no added colour. Rich notes of wine, grapes and forest fruit with a hint of vanilla

name: West Cork  12 YO Sherry (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A limited release of 12YO Single Malt Irish whiskey aged in first fill Bourbon casks for 12 years and finished for circa 110 days in rum, sherry (Pedro Ximinez) or port (Douro Superior) casks. WCD polish matures in selected casks for a shorter period than other distilleries to avoid overpowering the bourbon cask maturation.

name: West Cork  12 YO Rum Cask Finish (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A rum-cask-finished single malt Irish whiskey from West Cork Distillers, produced as part of a trio of expressions each with a different cask finish (including a Sherry and a Port finish).

name: Tomintoul  21 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Our latest release - Tomintoul Speyside Glenlivet Single Malt Scotch Whisky Aged 21 Years has been lovingly crafted, from a careful selection of the finest mature whisky from bourbon casks, each aged for at least twenty-one years.

name: Eigashima  White Oak Akashi Blended Whisky (500 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: A Japanese blended whisky that has been the subject of some controversy. The bottling for the home market in Japan is made with malt whisky and molasses spirit, which would not be classed as 'whisky' in the EU. This export version, however, is made from malt and grain whiskies.

name: Craigellachie  13 Years Old Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
A range of Craigellachie single malts was released for the first time in 2014. The distillery is known for its meaty character, and the 13-year-old is sweet, spicy and slightly smoky.

Silver Distillers' Single Malts between 13 and 20 years old - 2019 : International Spirits Challenge

food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts

The “Best American Whiskey” according to Food & Wine magazine, our 10 Year Single Barrel Bourbon represents the culmination of over a decade of patient aging in specially chosen, new charred American white oak barrels

name: Michter's  10 Years Kentucky Straight Rye (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: One of Michter’s most limited production items, Michter’s 10 Year Single Barrel Kentucky Straight Rye is made from the highest quality American Rye and then aged for 10 years in fire-charred new American white oak barrels.

name: Auchentoshan  Single Malt Scotch Whisky 21 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Triple distilled and aged perfectly for over twenty one years in American bourbon and Spanish sherry casks. This creates a refined Lowland Single Malt Whisky, ripe with gooseberries, sweet creamy vanilla, a hint of oak, warm honey, and the signature smooth, delicate, Auchentoshan taste.

name: Auchentoshan  Single Malt Scotch Whisky 18 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Triple distilled and matured in American bourbon oak for over eighteen years. The result: a refreshing Lowland single malt whisky with the added infusion of ripe citrus and green tea, the warmth of toasted almonds and the signature smooth, delicate, Auchentoshan taste.

name: Suntory  Hibiki 21 Years Old Art Lable Fuji Limited Edition (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Considered one of the finest whiskies in the world, the Hibiki 21 Year Old Mt Fuji Whisky is, as the name suggests, a special bottling of the famous 21 Year Old blend honouring the highest mountain in Japan. As befits such a rare collector's item, the bottle is a thing to behold with the 24 seasons of the Japanese lunar calendar depicted on its 24 facets combined with a painting of the magnificent Mount Fuji at sunset. name: The Glenlivet  Code (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
“I’d like to introduce to you our latest challenge. this year’s limited edition is a labyrinth of flavours that will test the senses of even the most discerning whisky drinker. I invite you to take the ultimate test. Can you unlock the taste of The Glenlivet Code?” - Alan Winchester, Master Distiller.

The Glenlivet Code is encased in a black bottle with no information about casks used and tasting notes. Discover this whisky for yourself and challenge your senses to see if you can unlock it.

name: John Barr  Finest Red Label Blended Scotch Whisky (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: John Barr is a radiant gold color with an intense, rich nose. It is pleasing to the palate with a refined aftertaste.

name: John Barr  Finest Red Label Blended Scotch Whisky (1 L)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: John Barr is a radiant gold color with an intense, rich nose. It is pleasing to the palate with a refined aftertaste.

name: John Barr  Reserve Black Label Blended Scotch Whisky (750 ml)
desc_en_short: John Barr Reserve Blend is characterized by rich aromas of chocolate, baked sweet apple, and freshly baked bread, followed by notes of ripe apricot, gingerbread, and hazelnuts on the palate, and a lingering maple finish.

name: Johnnie Walker  White Walker Game Of Thrones Limited Edition (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Send a raven – Scotch has officially entered the realm. Johnnie Walker is proud to present this limited-edition Scotch whisky, inspired by the most enigmatic and feared characters on the hit HBO® show Game of Thrones - the White Walkers.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Bangkok (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This special limited edition reconnects Thai consumers to Johnnie Walkers rich heritage and credentials by celebrating our history in Thailand since 1924

name: Bushmills  Original Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
Bushmills Original Irish Whiskey is a blend of our own triple distilled malt whiskey and a lighter grain whiskey and has picked up 36 awards this year alone. You’ll notice it’s rich, smooth warming taste almost instantly. It’s an easy drinking, versatile whiskey that can be enjoyed neat, over ice or with your favorite mixer.

Awards :

Gold Irish Blended - Standard - 2013 : The Irish Whisky Masters (The Spirits Business)

Gold Blended Malted Irish Whiskey - 2013 : San Francisco World Spirits Competition

name: Suntory  Special Reserve Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A noble blend with superior complexity that easily keeps up with some Scottish single malts. A touch of fruit like bananas, cooked apples and pears, with a delicate spicy and fruity finish. It is matured in casks of American oak, main ingredient of this blend is famous Hakushu whisky.

name: Highland Park  30 Y.O. (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Released at the beginning of 2013, this 30 year old is the second oldest core expression in the Highland Park range. Bottled at a lower strength than previous editions, it exudes notes of aromatic spices, dark chocolate orange and the characteristic fudge sweetness that one has come to expect from older Highland Park bottlings.

desc_en_short:
* Not allowed Cash on delivery

Johnnie Walker®, the world’s number one blended Scotch Whisky, is releasing Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year of the Pig Limited Edition Design in celebration of Chinese New Year and 2019 as the Year of the Pig.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Ghost & Rare Port Ellen (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
* Not allowed Cash on delivery

Johnnie Walker Blue Label Ghost & Rare Port Ellen is the second in a series of special releases crafted using irreplaceable “ghost” whiskies and other incredibly rare whiskies from the Johnnie Walker Blue Label reserves. At the heart of this limited edition lies the highly sought-after Islay single malt, Port Ellen - a ‘ghost’ distillery that shut its doors in 1983.

name: Shinju  Blended Japanese Whisky (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Shinju was born from the slopes of the great Mt. Fuji, Japan’s highest and most sacred mountain. Our “white pearl” blend is a proprietary blend of this unique water source and four distinct whisky expressions crafted by our Master Distiller, each of which has been aged 2 – 4 years in new and mature White Oak barrels.

name: AnCnoc  24 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short: AnCnoc 24 Years Old has been bottled in its most natural form – neither chill-filtered nor coloured, and as a result may develop a light haze with the addition of water or if kept at a cold temperature. This haze is a natural characteristic of whisky that is non chill-filtered.

name: Lohin Mckinnon  Single Malt Whisky (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: The aroma is rich with darker fruity notes like cherry or grape, subtle honey, vanilla and pleasantly woody. The golden liquid sits on the palate with a touch of green apple skins, buttery notes, woody and soft textured mouthfeel and the finish is medium length, fruity and slightly drying at the end. Best enjoyed with a splash of cold filtered water to release the full flavour of this hand crafted gem.

name: Lohin Mckinnon  Peated Single malt Whisky (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Notes of earthy smoke add depth to this hand-crafted single malt whisky. The Lohin McKinnon Peated Whisky is a tribute to classic Scottish style with authentic Canadian craftsmanship.

name: Lohin Mckinnon  Tequila Barrel Finished Single Malt Whisky (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Finished in premium tequila barrels, this handcrafted single malt whisky takes on a unique flavour profile inspired by the spirit of Mexico. Taking roasted agave sweetness and toasted oak richness from best in class tequila barrels and melding it with the smooth Lohin McKinnon flavour makes this a distinct and internationally inspired Canadian whisky.

name: Blackburn  Reserve Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Color : Whiskey light golden color.

Aroma : Whisky has a well-balanced flavor with hints of spice and hints of vanilla.

Taste : Whisky has a bright spicy malty sweet tones of vanilla and warm aftertaste.

name: Lost Distillery  Lossit Classic Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This Lossit-inspired blended malt is fairly light and sweet, with something of a diluted Laphroaig. A profile for beginning malt lovers (although the story is perhaps more for advanced drinkers). Going up to 46% (or more) could make this a lot more interesting.

name: Lost Distillery  Gerston Archivist Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The story of Gerston whisky is a tale of two distilleries, known as Gerston One and Gerston Two. Gerston One was a family-owned farm- house scale distillery, with a typically small output, making high quality spirit that was in demand both at home and further afield. It was enjoyed by the great and good of London society and had customers as far apart as Brazil and India. It existed for over eighty years, and remained in the Swanson family for nearly all of that time.

name: Lost Distillery  Towiemore Vintage Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The Lost Distillery Company Towiemore Vintage Collection Batch 2 is a blended malt malt that comes close to the single malts from the Towiemore distillery over 100 years ago.

The Lost Distillery Company started in 2013 with reproducing this lost malts. This is a vintage version between 18 and 25 years old bottled in the 2nd batch.

name: Lost Distillery  Auchnagie Classic Whisky (700 ml)

name: Compass Box  The Lost Blened (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
desc_en_short:
“Yes, sir, the stuff was distilled elixir of battle, money and high life.” From The Lost Blend by O. Henry, 1907

I’ve had a name that I’ve been waiting to use for a whisky project like this—The Lost Blend, inspired by the O. Henry story of the same name. This sharp and witty portrait of life in a New York bar in the early 1900s was published in 1907 and centres around two business partners who try to recreate a blend of different spirits with close to supernatural properties.

Having been blending Scotch whiskies as an amateur and a professional for the better part of 20 years, I can say with confidence that I believe there exist “magic” combinations of whiskies. For me, they are like the whisky blending equivalent of spiritual truths. And what better name to lend to our lost blend, but “The Lost Blend”!

John Glaser, Whiskymaker

name: Compass Box  No Name (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
desc_en_short:
This whisky was given NO NAME to let the whisky speak for itself. It is massive in terms of the intensity and complexity of flavour; a whisky brimming with complex peatiness, but tempered with hints of fruit character and an underlying sweetness.

The recipe is primarily sourced from the Pier Road distillery. The tempering single malt is from the Islay distillery in Port Askaig, with its more elegant, restrained peaty malt whisky.

To add dimension, fruit character and an ethereal element, we have added a small portion of malt whisky from a much-loved distillery in the Northern Highlands village of Brora. We finished things off with just a touch of malt whisky finished in French oak, providing a lovely underlying sweetness and richness.

Above all, share & enjoy.

JOHN GLASER — Founder & Whiskymaker

name: Compass Box  Phenomenology (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
desc_en_short:
It’s a school of thought in psychology that focuses on phenomena, or, the experiences that we get from our senses – what we see, taste, smell, etc. Somehow we saw a link between phenomenology and whisky.

We’d long been working on a blend of single malts that combines seemingly dissonant flavour profiles, but together creates something compelling. We landed on a recipe that elicited a surprising range of reactions and descriptions, each person taking away something different from the whisky.

Rather than try to settle on whose perceptions were ‘right’ or ‘wrong’, we were inspired by the phenomenological school of thought to consider how different people experience the same phenomenon.

In celebration of the subjectivity of whisky tasting, we released this whisky in September 2017 without any tasting notes or flavour descriptors to invite people to first experience the whisky without preconception. As you explore this whisky for yourself, we invite you to describe the ‘phenomena’ in your own words and ideas. Your experience is your own, personal and subjective.

And, so, you have… PHENOMENOLOGY, a limited edition COMPASS BOX WHISKY.

Above all, share & enjoy.

JOHN GLASER — Founder & Whiskymaker

name: Compass Box  The Double Single Blended (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
desc_en_short:
For DOUBLE SINGLE, instead of using many tens of component whiskies we have used just two – one single grain whisky and one single malt whisky (hence the name). Both are beautiful liquids in their own right, but we believe they are elevated above the sum of their parts when combined in the correct proportions.

Such thinking runs strongly counter to the blending strategies evident in the larger, commercial Blended Scotch releases that dominate the whisky market worldwide, where many dozens of components can often be found within a single blend. So why do things differently?

We believe that when using components of the highest quality, less is often more. That the interaction between a single grain and a single malt can be every bit as good – better even – than either a more complex blend or the component tasted on its own.

Above all, share & enjoy.

JOHN GLASER — Founder & Whiskymaker
