name: Glencadam  Aged 19 Years Oloroso Cask Finish (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Glencadam Distillery launches limited edition of its Highland Single Malt – Oloroso Sherry Cask Finish Aged 19 Years.

A limited quantity of Glencadam Highland Single Malt, aged 19 years, has been released. The Sherry cask “Finish” has been created by the careful selection of mature whisky “finished” in Oloroso Sherry butts. The malt whisky was transferred from Bourbon casks into the hand-picked butts to “finish” its maturation for a generous period of time. This process of “finishing” bestows on the whisky refined characteristics, most notably, tones of Sherry sweetness. Our Master Distiller deemed that the time was right to bottle the whisky at 19 years of age when the malt whisky flavour notes had reached harmony with the rich, raisiny and fruit cake characteristics of the Sherry wood.

Just 6000 bottles were produced from the Sherry butts and each bottle is individually numbered. The result is an “enriched” and beautifully crafted Glencadam Highland Single Malt expression.

name: Omar  Single Malt Sherry Cask Strength Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Nantou Distillery in central Taiwan is one of a number of distilleries owned by the state, but the only one making whisky. They began to produce whisky back in 2008, and now we can finally get a taste of their single malt! This particularly expression was aged in Sherry casks, resulting in classic chocolate-coated raisin notes.

name: Omar  Single Malt Bourbon Cask Strength Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
A Taiwanese single malt whisky matured in bourbon casks, produced by Nantou, a state-owned distillery which began producing whisky back in 2008.

Awards :

Silver Whiskies Worldwide - Single Malt - 2019 : International Spirits Challenge

name: Omar  Single Malt Bourbon Type Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Non-chill fittered whisky is bottled at steangth of 46% abv to keep the best aroma and palate. The blending batch is done with careful cask selection and marked on the label. Silver color of label represents the smooyhess and skilkiness of the floral bourbon whisky.

name: Dewar's  12 Years Old Blended Scotch Whisky (1 L)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Sometimes the best things in life are as simple as they come. But going the extra mile in aging Scotch Whisky makes it even better. We pioneered our own double-aging process over a 100 years ago, putting our whisky back into butts after blending, to age it twice for a smoother taste, fuller flavour and longer finish. The longer the individual whiskies get to know each other, the better the glass of Scotch at the end of it. So after 12 years, you're getting a honeyed, fruity whisky that is pretty special.

name: Rogue  Spirits Dead Guy Whiskey (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
Crafted from the same malts as Rogue’s notorious Dead Guy Ale, malted two row barley, munich and crystal malts create a unique whiskey wash that offers an intriguing range of flavors. Aged more than two years, the finished whiskey has dark cocoa, coffee and caramel tones that are reminiscent of Dead Guy Ale. This whiskey is not only great to sip, but also holds up in a spirit-forward cocktail.

Barrel: New American Oak Char 3

Ingredients: 2-Row, Munich & C15 Malts; Distiller’s Yeast & Free Range Coastal Water.

name: Rogue  Spirits Oregon Rye Malt Whiskey (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
One of few malted rye whiskeys, the malting process in Rogue’s hand-crafted Oregon Rye Malt softens the spice notes typical of rye whiskeys and makes for a more approachable whiskey that builds in flavor. The barley in the mash bill (52% rye, 48% barley) further rounds out the taste and mouthfeel creating an easy sipping experience. Complex nuttiness is softened by light caramel and a hint of citrus leading to cinnamon, nutmeg and black pepper.

Barrel: New American Oak Char 3

Ingredients: 2-Row, Munich & Rye Malt; Pacman Yeast & Free Range Coastal Water.

name: Rogue  Spirits Oregon Single Malt Whiskey (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
Reflective of the Newport, Oregon climate, this hand-crafted whiskey provides a clear sense of our home along the Yaquina Bay with soft malt notes, subtle hints of smoke and briny sea air. Crafted from malted Two Row Barley that is 10% smoked with apple and alder, the wash is brewed at our brewery just yards from the distillery. After distillation, it is aged for a minimum of five years in char 3 new American Oak barrels.

Barrel: New American Char 3

Ingredients: Munich Malt, Free-Range Coastal Water & Rogue’s Proprietary Pacman Yeast.

name: Liverpool  Whiskey 10 Year Old (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Liverpool Whiskey is an elegant, triple distilled 10 years old single malt crafted from the finest malted barley. Aromas of tropical fruit and hints of spice, give way to a honeyed vanilla taste with a touch of citrus.

name: Peaky Blinder  Bourbon (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A sweet and spicy bourbon from Sadler's, Peaky Blinder has aromas of cinnamon, raisins and bananas on the nose, while the palate offers notes of Christmas cake, pecans, toffee and pastry.

name: Game of Thrones  Six Kingdoms Single Malts Scotch Whisky Aged 15 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Inspired by the series finale of HBO®’s iconic series, DIAGEO and HBO are proud to introduce the ninth and final bottling in the Game of Thrones Limited Edition Single Malt Scotch Whisky Collection, a rare malt that pays tribute to the three-eyed raven and the fate of Westeros, whose long-held Seven Kingdoms ultimately became six at the conclusion of the show’s climatic battle for the Iron Throne.

name: Suntory  Yamazaki 25 Year Old Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The Yamazaki 25 is an elite bottle for those who demand only the best. Being a winner of the World Whisky Awards in 2012 for ‘Best Single Malt’, the Yamazaki 25 is a coveted and increasingly rare item. If you want to know what Suntory really is capable of when it comes to whisky, then you must try this!

Award

  • 2012 – WWA World’s Best Single Malt Whisky
  • 1984 Limited Edition
  • 2009 – IWSC GOLD
  • 2009, 2011 – ISC GOLD
  • 2010 – SWSC DOUBLE GOLD
  • 2010, 2011 – IWSC GOLD (BEST IN CLASS)
  • 2010 – ISC TROPHY
  • 2010 – ISC SUPREME CHAMPION SPIRIT
  • 2011 – WWA WORLD’S BEST SINGLE MALT WHISKY

name: Moonshine Runners  North American Blended Whiskey (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: North American Blended Moonshine Runners Whiskey is made in Canada to the highest standards of the finest Scotch whiskey. The beverage label design incorporates graphic elements of craft whiskey to highlight the “dark” past of the contents. The manufacturer recommends enjoying the drink in its pure form, using it in cocktails, as an additive to tea or coffee.

name: Old Pulteney  21 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Old Pulteney 21 Year (700 ml) (Limited Stock)

Old Pulteney 21 Year Old has been voted 2012 World Whisky of the Year by the prestigious "Jim Murray's Whisky Bible."  Scoring a record-equalling 97.5 points out of 100, it is only the third time that a single malt has ever won the prestigious award, and we are just the second Scottish distillery to do so.

name: Old Pulteney  1989 (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Old Pulteney 1989 (700 ml) (Limited Stock)

Pronounced World’s Best Single Malt Whisky of 2016 by prestigious World Whiskies Awards, Old Pulteney 1989 Vintage is the result of maturation in casks previously filled with peaty whisky from, Isle of Islay. A thin veil of smoke complements Old Pulteney’s signature style to form an exceptionally complex expression of the Maritime Malt, complete with the elusive hint of the open sea.

name: The Six Isles  Blended Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: A superb vatted malt from Ian Macleod, Six Isles blends together six single malts, one from each of the whisky producing Scottish islands. Arran, Islay, Jura, Mull, Orkney and Skye are all represented here in this cracking blended Scotch whisky.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label 200th Anniversary (Limited Edition Design) (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

A gift of remarkable rarity with Johnnie Walker Blue Label 200th Anniversary Limited Edition Design, celebrating our 200-year journey from Scotland to the four corners of the world. Johnnie Walker Blue Label is a velvety smooth and vibrant Scotch - the result of every lesson we’ve learned since John Walker first opened the doors to a small grocery store in Scotland in 1820.

The design inspiration behind the limited edition whisky bottle

The new design illustrates a visual journey from 1820 to today, celebrating the first steps our founder took to start a journey that would take our whiskies from Scotland to the four corners of the globe, and celebrates some of the rare discoveries that shaped the world as we know it.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Legendary 8 Limited Edition Whisky (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

Johnnie Walker Blue Label Legendary Eight is a smooth, mellow Scotch made using some of our rarest whiskies from across the untamed wilds of Scotland, including exceptionally rare whiskies from ‘ghost’ distilleries. Each whisky is hand selected from eight legendary distilleries - featured on the bottle and pack - that existed when John Walker made his first steps embarking on our journey that began 200 years ago. 

Our small team of 12 expert whisky makers came together to create this exceptional Scotch inspired by rare whiskies from these iconic and pioneering distilleries. This new limited edition release of Johnnie Walker Blue Label is a rare jewel crafted using Scotch from the legendary distilleries of Oban, Blair Athol, Lagavulin, Teaninich, Brora, Cambus, Port Dundas and Carsebridge.

How passion drove this special edition blue label whisky

Since John Walker first opened the doors to the public in 1820, we’ve never stopped in the pursuit of excellence. This passion led to the exceptional quality and depth of flavour that we now find in every drop of Johnnie Walker whisky. This rare whisky embodies 200 years of bold and passionate craft, bottled for this moment.

“It’s fascinating to reflect on the idea that these famous distilleries also walked a 200-year journey and their whiskies still inspire us today. This new limited edition celebrates that shared experience and the contribution these rare whiskies continue to make to Johnnie Walker today and into tomorrow.”

Jim Beveridge, Johnnie Walker Master Blender

name: Ardbeg  An Oa (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
A welcome new addition to the Ultimate range. Ardbeg An Oa is singularly rounded, due in no small part to time spent in our newly established bespoke oak Gathering Vat where whiskies from several cask types - including; sweet Pedro Ximenez; spicy virgin charred oak; and intense ex-bourbon casks, amongst others - familiarise themselves with each other. The result is a dram with smoky power, mellowed by a delectable, smooth sweetness. Hallmark Ardbeg peat, dark chocolate and aniseed are wrapped in smooth, silky butterscotch, black pepper and clove, before rising to an intense crescendo of flavour.

Non chill-filtered with a strength of 46.6% ABV.

Awards :

Silver Scotch Single Malt - Islay - 2019 : International Wine & Spirit Competition

name: John Walker & Sons  Celebratory Blend Limited Edition (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

John Walker & Sons Celebratory Blend honours the past whilst being an invitation to raise a glass to the next 200 years.

The Story Behind The John Walker & Sons Celebratory Blend Limited Edition

The John Walker & Sons Celebratory Blend is inspired by a breakthrough moment, the release of ‘Old Highland Whisky’ in the 1860s, which was created primarily for export and became the first of our whiskies to travel from Scotland to the four corners of the world. With more whisky being sold overseas, the iconic design of the square bottle and uniquely slanted label were distinct and helped the name stand out against other whiskies.

“John Walker & Sons Celebratory Blend is a sensorial journey featuring notes of sweet dried raisins,subtle spice and marzipan, which develop into hints of roasted nuts, icing sugar sweetness and gentle peat, with a soft pepper finish. It celebrates an historic moment in the our story.”

Jim Beveridge, Johnnie Walker Master Blender

name: John Walker & Sons  Bicentenary Blend Limited Edition (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

Our founder John Walker first opened the doors of a small grocery store 200 years ago in Kilmarnock that would go on to change the world of whisky forever. John Walker & Sons Bicentenary Blend is an exclusive whisky that celebrates this journey.

About John Walker & Sons Bicentenary Blend Limited Edition

Master Blender Jim Beveridge and his small team of expert whisky makers have drawn inspiration from the thrilling flavours listed on an original inventory from John Walker’s store. Using this as a window into the world where John started, they have meticulously crafted a complex whisky with rich layers that re-imagines the kaleidoscope of exotic flavours that shaped our founder’s imagination.

Rare and exceptional whiskies, including ghost stocks from the distilleries of Pittyvaich, Cambus and Port Ellen, all at least 28 years old, have been explored to craft a whisky that reimagines the exotic flavours of the 1820s.

name: Grant's  Triple Wood Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Many whiskies take their flavour from just one cask, but we mature Grant’s Triple Wood in three different types of wood: Virgin Oak cask provides spicy robustness, American Oak lends subtle vanilla smoothness and Bourbon refill offers brown sugar sweetness, resulting in a smoother, richer, mellower taste.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Year Of The Ox (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

This Johnnie Walker Limited Edition design honours Chinese New Year and the year of the ox, paying homage to the ox as a symbol of prosperity and growth to welcome in the new years. This design features a majestic golden ox which symbolizes its finest qualities of diligence and honesty. Poised high above mountain clouds, alongside celebratory lanterns and cherry blossom, the ox heralds a year of good fortune and great achievements.

name: Amahagan  Edition No.1 (700 ml)
desc_en_short: From Nagahama, one of Japan’s newest and smallest distilleries, this Amahagan World Malt Edition No.1 release comes as a pleasant surprise. As the distillery only became operational last year, this is a new make expression, coming in at 47% ABV. This is one of the great releases from a distillery that stands within the new wave of small, passionate whisky distilleries opening across Japan.

name: Amahagan  Edition No.2 Red Wine Wood Finish (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The flavor from red wines such as raisins and berries is in perfect harmony with the unique malt flavour of Nagahama. A refreshing afterstate of orange peel can be enjoyed. The sweetness of grain carries through the finish with a long, moderate astringent taste.

name: Amahagan  Edition No.3 Mizunara Wood Finish (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This Amahagan World Malt Edition No.3 is a fantastic world blend produced at the Nagata distillery. It’s a smooth and mellow creation that brings gentle fruits, fragrant wood imparted by mizunara oak maturation, subtle peppery spice and sweet caramel. It’s a well-accomplished and carefully balanced creation that is further highlights the possibilities in the world blend category.

name: Amahagan  Edition Yamazakura Wood Finish (700 ml)
desc_en_short: This Amahagan Yamazakura Wood Finish is a fantastic blend of malts from the up and coming Nagahama distillery. The distillery now has a number of whiskies in its range and they have been well received in Japan and beyond. This one brings the essence of “Yamazakura” – Yama meaning mountains and Sakura referring to Cherry Blossom trees – to the bottle. Refreshing aromas of wild cherry blossom combine with hints of incense, orange peel and black honey to create a fantastic overall drinking experience. A whisky well worth trying!

name: Glenmorangie  A Tale Of Cake (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
desc_en_short:
Some time ago, our Director of Whisky Creation, Dr Bill, found himself musing over how some of his most joyful memories came from cake — from the pineapple upside down cake his daughter made for his birthday to baking with his Granny in her kitchen.

He devised this whisky to conjure the magic of a cake moment, finishing his favourite Glenmorangie Single Malt in the finest Tokaji dessert wine casks.

The liquid is a rich copper, but the taste is pure technicolour, luscious, sweet and complex with multi-layered bursts of honey, white chocolate and fruits with a lilting hint of mint. As you might expect, it tastes incredible when enjoyed with actual cake.

> For more information, click here!

name: Johnnie Walker  Black Label Islay Origin (1 L)
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

Johnnie Walker Black Label Islay Origin ... has a slight spice and is for people want to explore whiskies with a warming, smoky maritime flavour. It is made exclusively from exceptional Islay malts, including Lagavulin whisky and Caol Ila whisky.

Enjoy Islay Origin as part of a Smoke & Spice

The wonderful smoky and citrus notes of Johnnie Walker Islay Origins are tamed and complicated by spicy ginger and fresh orange in this complex and refreshing Highball.

name: Johnnie Walker & Son  King George V Chinese New Year Edition (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

A limited-edition King George V blended malt from the John Walker & Sons Collection that celebrates Chinese New Year 2021.

King George V celebrates the first Royal Warrant granted to John Walker and Sons Ltd to supply Scotch whisky to the British Royal Household in 1934, and is apparently designed to recreate how JW might have tasted back in the day. Some Port Ellen has been used, alongside Cardhu, Lochnagar and some very old grain whisky.

name: The Macallan  Edition No. 6 (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
WHISKY MAKER’S NOTES

Edition No.6 has been inspired by the natural world surrounding our distillery with so much to offer and enjoy; in particular the vibrant River Spey that borders our estate. The whisky itself has much to reveal. The antique brass natural colour derived from our casks hints to a richness of flavour awaiting you. Its aroma fills the room with fresh fruits, nutmeg, ginger, chocolate, toffee, and vanilla notes merged with oak. As you taste, you are rewarded with complex flavours of ripe plum, vibrant sweet oranges and cinnamon, developing into spicy fresh fruits with creamy chocolate followed by toasted oats at the finish.

name: Cardhu  12 Year Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Cardhu has over 200 years of malt whisky heritage, created by the skill and determination of 2 pioneering women. It was the first distillery bought by John Walker to secure a high quality malt whisky. The 12 year old expression boasts a spirity nose with sweet apple blossom and heathery aromas. Well-balanced on the palate with a warming, dryish finish.

Awards :

Gold Speyside Single Malts up to 12yo - 2014 : The Scotch Whisky Masters (The Spirits Business)

Gold Speyside Single Malts up to 12yo - 2013 : The Scotch Whisky Masters (The Spirits Business)

name: Old Pulteney  25 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Old Pulteney 25 Year, for a quarter of a century, casks of this rare expression of Old Pulteney Single Malt Scotch Whisky breathed the invigorating sea air of the Caithness coast. Sheltered from a fast-changing world by the darkened calm of a distillery warehouse, the spirit mellowed at its own steady pace, echoing the reassuring rhythm of its hometown port. Aged firstly in American oak, its spicy sweetness was later granted depth and colour by casks of Spanish oak. Elegant and charismatic, this wonderful whisky embodies both Wick’s spirit of endurance and Pulteney Distillery’s devotion to its craft.

name: Dewar's  25 Years Old (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Our oldest and rarest Whisky within our permanent range, matured for a minimum of 25 years in the finest oak casks, then double aged and finished in Royal Brackla Casks. A whisky that celebrates our signature style.

name: Dewar's  30 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Dewar's 30 Years Old Ne Plus Ultra is a small batch premium bottling of the oldest ever release from Dewar's in its enduring 170-year history.

"This Pedro Ximénez-finished blend is the oldest Dewar’s expression available. It offers a deliciously deep nose of chocolate-dipped biscuits, dried fruits, and orange peel ..." - Jonny McCormick, Whisky Advocate

name: Junenmyo  Rouge ( Japanese whiskey ) (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Junenmyo is distrilled with selected heavy peated malt of Scotland. It leads smoky flavor

name: Bellevoye  Rouge (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The nose reveals a rich aromatic palette with fruity and fresh notes. Malt mixes with aromas of Ente plums, ‘crème brûlée’ and the first autumn nuts.

The mouth recalls the generosity of Medjool’s dates. The presence of mint notes preserves the balance. The tannins are coated in a soft setting.

The fragrance of fine spices and brown sugar accompanies the tasty finish.

Awards :

2020: gold medal at "Concours Général Agricole de Paris".​
Since 2019: Air France first class whisky.

name: Bellevoye  Noir (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The intense nose reveals empyreumatic notes that evoke both ashes, toast and moka. Subtle touches of spices (cinnamon, nail clove) and liquorice reinforce its complexity.​

The mouth is thick, mellow and oily. Its salinity gives it a fresh and harmonious balance. Its structure is coated thanks to its elegant tannins.

The finish is long and persistent on aromas peat characteristics.​

Awards :

2020: "grand" gold medal at Brussels World Spirits competition, awarded "Spirit Selection Revelation ".
2020: gold medal at World Whiskies Awards competition, "Best French Blended Malt".
2019 and 2018: gold medal at Brussels World Spirits competition.

name: Old Particular  Teaninich 12 Years Old  (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Tasting Notes

Nose: Creamy mint thins and lemon shortbread, with malty cereal in milk.

Palate: Pretty weighty with a full-bodied, milky texture. I taste more green apples and pears alongside clover, birch wood, rice pudding and liquid honey on toast.

Finish: Slightly tropical notes of Bounty bars, with zesty madeleine cakes.

name: Old Particular  Fettercairn 15 Years Old  (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Nose: Opens with apricots and more dried fruit, mixed berries and blackcurrant preserve.

Palate: The palate is rich with gentle spice, cedarwood and an orange barley quality.

Finish: The finish takes more ginger and sweet tangerine peel with a soft nutmeg finale.

name: Aberfeldy  21 Years Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
Abounding in heather honey, creamy macadamia nuts and chewy beeswax. Plush with dried fruits, toasted coconut, silky oak and a wee trace of smoke.

Awards :

Winner - Best Highland Single Malt - 2014 : World Whiskies Awards

name: Lambay  Blended Malt Irish whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Lambay Malt Irish Whiskey consists of a minimum of three variants of high-quality Irish single malts.  An exquisite master blend of double & triple distilled malt whiskey, bourbon cask matured, cognac-cask finished and crafted with Lambay Trinity Well water before bottling.

Award-winning Whiskey

Recent double gold winner, our blended malt is rare in the world of Irish whiskey.

name: Glen Turner  Rum Cask Finish Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
A Single Malt aged for several months in cask of rum.

A true tribute to the craftsmanship of Glen Turner artisans, this new Single Malt, matured in barrels of AOC Rum from Martinique, offers a gourmet aromatic profile with notes of caremal, toastes vanilla and spicy nuts.

name: Benriach  The Original Ten Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Original Ten encapsulates the signature smooth and multi-layered character of Benriach. Three cask matured for at least ten years in bourbon barrels,sherry casks and virgin oak, to create layers of luscious orchard fruit, sumptuous honeyed malt and toasted oak, all interwoven with a subtle trace of smoke.The perfect introduction to our signature style and richly layered Speyside Single Malt.

name: Benriach  The Smoky Ten Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: In the early 1970s, Benriach broke convention in Speyside by returning to distilling batches of whisky in the old, 19th century style, using malted barley smoked with Highland peat. This wood rich Highland peat imparts distinctly sweet and smoky notes into Benriach peated whiskies. Benriach The Smoky Ten has been crafted from a combination of unpeated and peated spirit and three cask matured for at least ten years in a combination of bourbon barrels, Jamaican rum casks and toasted virgin oak. The whisky is then expertly married together to create sublimely smooth layers of sunripe fruit, aromatic smoke and toasted oak spice, lingering into the perfectly balanced sweet and smoky finish.

name: Benriach  The Twelve Speyside Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: To make Benriach Twelve, Benriach spirit is three cask matured for at least twelve years in sherry casks, bourbon barrels and port casks. The whisky from each cask is then expertly married together to create a smooth, sherry-rich single malt, layered with baked fruit, maple honey and cocoa, perfectly balanced with a lingering sultana and spiced mocha finish.

name: Glendronach  Original Aged 12 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
This superb richly sherried single malt is matured for at least 12 years in a combination of the finest Spanish Pedro Ximenez and Oloroso sherry casks. The GlenDronach 12 year old Original is a sweet, creamy dram bottled at 43% ABV and natural in colour.

Awards :

WORLD WHISKIES AWARDS 2017 - Silver award in "Highland Single Malt Aged 12 Years and under" category

INTERNATIONAL WINE & SPIRIT COMPETITION 2018 - Gold Medal

SAN FRANCISCO WORLD SPIRITS COMPETITION 2017 - Gold Medal

name: Glendronach  Tradititionally Peated (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Glendronach Traditionally Peated is a fruity, smoky single malt created to highlight the effect of adding peat at the end of the kiln fire rather than the start. The result is a warm, earthy smoke that complements aromas of toffee, treacle, dark honey and sweet barley on the nose. The palate offers notes of burnt orange and treacle over a blanket of cloves and smoked brambles.

name: Glendronach  Parliament Aged 21 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Matured in a combination of the finest Oloroso and Pedro Ximenez sherry casks for a minimum of 21 years and bottled at 48% ABV, the ‘Parliament’ continues the great GlenDronach tradition of offering fruit-laden intensity in its single malts. This rich expression has been named ‘Parliament’ after the colony, or ‘parliament’, of rooks that have been nesting in the trees that overlook the GlenDronach distillery for almost 200 years.

AWARDS :

WORLD WHISKIES AWARDS 2018 - Category winner in "Best Highland Single Malt" category

SAN FRANCISCO WORLD SPIRITS COMPETITION 2018 - Gold Medal

name: Jura  12 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
AN INTENSE AND VIBRANT JURA WHISKY, AGED FOR 12 YEARS FOR A REASSURINGLY RICH FLAVOUR

This is Jura at its most intense and muscular, yet it remains an approachable whisky that makes the perfect accompaniment to a gathering. That’s how our tiny island community enjoys it.

Bourbon cask maturation and an aged oloroso sherry finish produce a honeyed sweetness that offer notes of warm spice, banana, soft citrus and a finish of freshly ground coffee and dark chocolate.

Awards :

Gold Distillers' Single Malts 12 years and under - 2020 : International Spirits Challenge

Silver Distillers' Single Malts 12 years and under - 2019 : International Spirits Challenge

Bronze Single Malt 12 Year Old - 2019 : Scottish Whisky Awards

name: Shackleton  Blended Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Shackleton Blended Malt Scotch is based on the spirit supplied to the 1907 British Antarctic Expedition, expertly crafted using a selection of the finest Highland Single Malt Scotch Whiskies. Best enjoyed over ice.

name: Lagavulin  26 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The oldest, most exclusive single malt in the Special Releases 2021 is the Lagavulin 26 Year Old, a 1994 vintage matured in first fill sherry seasoned casks (both Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso). It has a nice, deep hue with brown and red hints.

Only Lagavulin, known by many as the pinnacle of Islay malts, could produce such a rare gem. The first 26 year old to be be released from the distille ekseed ry. this distinctive whisky ky bears a co a complexity honou nouring the triumphant path of this long surviving isday icon. strong and end nduning by nature, the fiery spint of Lagavulin burns bright in this coveted dram.

name: Johnnie Walker  Black Label Highland Origin (1 L)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Johnnie Walker Black Label Highlands Origins crafted for those who want to explore Scotch whiskeys with rich and fruity characteristics. It is crafted exclusively from a variety of quality single malts from the Highland region of Scotland, with whiskey from the distilleries of Clynelish and Teaninich at its core. It has prominent notes of orange rind, marmalade, and honey, with a long, soft spice finish. Johnnie Walker Black Label Highlands Origin is crafted exclusively from a variety of quality single malts from the Highland region of Scotland, with whiskey from the distilleries of Clynelish and Teaninich at its core.

name: Lambay  Small Batch Blend Irish whiskey Gift Set
desc_en_short: A fantastic gift for the whiskey enthusiast in your life, the limited edition Lambay Irish Whiskey Small Batch Blend Gift Pack which includes their signature cognac cask-finished Lambay Small Batch Blend 70cl & two bespoke Lambay whiskey glasses.

name: Yamazakura  Japanese Blended Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Japanese whiskey made from a combination of four carefully selected malt and grain whiskeys aged in American oak barrels that previously contained bourbon

name: Evade  France Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
The Évadé line of whiskies is aged and distilled in France. Non-chill-filtered and free of artificial additives and colors, Évadé is made exclusively from French raw materials.

Double distilled in Charente stills Blend of whiskies aged for four to seven years in bourbon casks (Heaven Hill) and American oak casks.

name: Evade  France Single Malt Peated Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Évadé line of whiskies is aged and distilled in France. Non-chill-filtered and free of artificial additives and colors, Évadé is made exclusively from French raw materials.

name: American Eagle 12 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
A fresh, spicy 12-year-old Tennessee bourbon from American Eagle, made from a marriage of corn, rye and malted barley. The nose is full of citrus aromas; dried orange, fresh lime and lemon zest, as well as sweet spices. The palate offers notes of cinnamon, dried orange peel and sweet raisins, as well as creamy vanilla.

GOLD OUTSTANDING MEDAL WINNER (98 points) at the International Wine & Spirits Competition 2020

name: American Eagle 4 Year (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Distilled from a mash bill comprising 84% corn, the four-year-old Bourbon has been matured in American oak barrels and underwent a charcoal-mellow filtration process. Rich and creamy with notes of toasted oak, vanilla and fudge, bitter sweet orange and warming white pepper spice.

• Gold Medal | International Wine and Spirits Competition
• 98 Points | International Wine and Spirits Competition.

name: The Naked Grouse  Gift Pack
desc_en_short:
The Naked Grouse enriches the flavours of Scotland’s favourite whisky by maturing in sun dried sherry oak casks. The influence of our quality first-fill sherry casks develops a deep russet appearance and an aroma that melds black cherries, cocoa and oak. The taste experience is sublimely smooth with famous trade-mark dried fruits yielding to cinnamon sticks and nutmeg. The sweet finale is rich in dark chocolate with a spicy, orange finish.

In The Box

1 X Famous Grouse Naked Grouse 700 ml

1 X Naked Grouse T-Shirt

1 X Naked Grouse Glass

name: Aberfeldy  20 Years Old Exceptional Cask Single Malt Scotch Whisky (750 ml)
desc_en_short: This 20 year old beauty from Aberfeldy is well worth snapping up before it’s too late. Part of the aptly named Exceptional Cask Series, spent the last nine years before being bottled maturing in casks that previously contained sherry casks.

name: Johnnie Walker & Son  King George V Chinese New Year Edition 2022 (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
A limited-edition King George V blended malt from the John Walker & Sons Collection that celebrates Chinese New Year 2022.

JW CNY series designed by Artist Jiang Shan and features the Baize, a mythical creature which is a symbol of virtuous, auspicious, might, nobleness, and protection from the evil.

King George V celebrates the first Royal Warrant granted to John Walker and Sons Ltd to supply Scotch whisky to the British Royal Household in 1934, and is apparently designed to recreate how JW might have tasted back in the day. Some Port Ellen has been used, alongside Cardhu, Lochnagar and some very old grain whisky.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Chinese New Year Of The Tiger (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
** Not allowed Cash on delivery

Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year Of The Tiger is a limited edition design from Johnnie Walker, bottled at 46% ABV in a 750mL bottle. From the celebration of an epic achievement to a simple and heartfelt 'thank you', there's a Johnnie Walker whisky gift to suit every occasion. Explore the ranges of exceptional blended Scotch whisky and try this Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year Of The Tiger release.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Ghost & Rare Pittyvaich (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
* Not allowed Cash on delivery

Johnnie Walker Blue Label Ghost and Rare Pittyvaich Blended Scotch Whisky is the fourth in a series of special releases crafted by Master Blender Jim Beveridge that blend irreplaceable "ghost" whiskies and other incredibly rare whiskies from the Johnnie Walker Blue Label reserves. The singularity of this limited edition is characterized by a gem from a lost time at the "ghost" Pittyvaich distillery, which closed its doors in 1993 after only 18 years.

name: Johnnie Walker  Gold Label XR 21 Chinese New Year 2022 (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Johnnie Walker XR21 New Year's Eve gift box 2022 is a wine crafted according to Alexander Walker's handwritten recipe with an extremely creative design inspired by the royal family of Johnnie Walker for the 2022 Lunar New Year season.

name: Royal Salute  21 years (700 ml) (Chinese New Year Limited Edition)
desc_en_short:
ROYAL SALUTE 2022 CNY Edition. This rich and complex whisky from Chivas is aged for 21 years in oak casks before bottling in handcrafted porcelain flagons.

Royal Salute was launched on 2nd June 1953 as a tribute to Her Majesty Queen Elizabeth II on her Coronation Day. The name of this exceptional Scotch Whisky comes from the 21 Gun Royal Salute, which is fired as a mark of respect for powerful dignitaries.

At her coronation, the crown of Queen Elizabeth II was set in rubies, sapphires and emeralds. These precious stones remain the inspiration for the colours of Royal Salute’s handcrafted flagons.

Awards :

Gold Best Blended Scotch Over 21 Years Old - 2020 : International Spirits Challenge

Silver Scotch Whisky - Blended - 2019 : International Wine & Spirit Competition

name: Cotswolds  Odyssey Barley Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
Cotswolds Single Malt Whisky is finally out of the cask and into the bottle.

The first whisky ever distilled in the Cotswolds, it uses 100% locally grown, floor-malted barley.

Matured in first-fill Kentucky ex-Bourbon barrels and reconditioned American Oak 225L red wine casks that had been shaved, toasted and re-charred.

Rich, fruity and sippable.

name: Cotswolds   Peated Cask Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Our cask strength Peated Cask Single Malt Whisky is hand-crafted in small batches using 100% locally grown, traditionally floor-malted barley. Aged fully in ex-peated quarter casks, this is a delightful and moreish whisky with subtle hints of peat smoke on the palate which complement the vanilla notes from the oak and the fruitiness of our spirit. Think 'smoky vanilla ice cream', as our distillers like to describe it!

Awards :

Bronze Best English Single Malt - 2020 : World Whiskies Awards

name: Cotswolds  Founder's Choice Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Our cask strength Founder's Choice Single Malt Whisky is made with 100% locally grown, floor-malted barley and aged exclusively in our founder Dan's favourite casks: STR (Shaved, Toasted and Re-charred) ex-red wine casks. These highly active casks were created by our mentor and renowned whisky consultant, the late Dr. Jim Swan, and give a rich and intense maturation to our fruity new make spirit, offering strong notes of toffee, chocolate and red fruits, as well as a beautiful, deep colour.

name: Glenmorangie  A Tale of Winter (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
desc_en_short: Following on from Glenmorangie's A Tale Of Cake, the magnificent distillery has gone and created A Tale of Winter (we do like the idea that "cake" is in fact a season and that it precedes winter, but we don't think that's what they're going for here)! Director of whisky creation Dr. Bill Lumsden wanted to evoke the feeling of winter, of sitting in front of a fireplace while the snow fall outside, and to do so, he finished a bourbon barrel-matured single malt in ex-Marsala wine casks. All those rich, comforting, chocolatey notes certainly put this one in the 'winter warmer' category.

name: Glenmorangie  Grand Vintage 1996 (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
The Collection’s sixth release, Glenmorangie Grand Vintage Malt 1996, is luxurious and creamy. Long aged in a handful of our first custom-designed casks, this quintessential Glenmorangie honours our pioneering quest to find the perfect casks for our whisky.

Awards :

Gold Distillers' Single Malts 21 years old and over - 2020 : International Spirits Challenge

name: Glenmorangie  Grand Vintage 1997 (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Glenmorangie Grand Vintage Malt 1997, is vivacious and floral. With a heart aged in rare Château Montrose red wine casks, from Saint-Estèphe in Bordeaux, this single malt recalls a radiant new dawn at Glenmorangie.

name: Loch Lomond  Single Grain Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Loch Lomond Single Grain Whisky is carefully distilled using only the finest malted barley.

Distilled in our continuous still, this single grain has a smooth and sweet character with added complexity not usually found in a single grain. Expect juicy fruit notes, creamy vanilla and lemon zest.

name: TOGOUCHI  Whisky 8 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short: It is a blend of grain spirits that have been matured over eight years in a Togouchi tunnel with a citrus aroma and a spiciness that reminds you of the fresh greenery in Togouchi and malt whisky with a well balanced peat fragrance and a soft sweetness like vanilla and chocolate. This whisky has been finished with a clear and dry taste and has earthy mineral characteristics and the fragrance of young grass.

name: HYDE  No.3 Aras Cask Single Grain Bourbon Cask Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Hyde No.3 is a triple distilled, Single grain, Irish whiskey from one single distillery location.

Originally distilled in a traditional “Coffey” Copper Column still from pure Corn / maize grain.

Made in small batches, It is matured for at least 6 years in flame charred, first fill, ex-bourbon casks from Kentucky in the U.S.A.

name: HYDE  No. 4 President's Cask Single Malt Rum Cask Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
This Single Malt Irish whiskey is tripled distilled on a traditional copper pot still from 100% malted Irish grain barley in one Irish distillery location.

Originally aged in 200 litre, flame charred, ex-bourbon, oak casks from Kentucky in the USA, before being transferred into 200 litre, flame charred, DARK RUM casks from Barbados in the Caribbean, for a further six months of finishing.

name: HYDE  No. 5 The Aras Cask Single Grain Burgundy Cask Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Hyde No.5 is a triple distilled, Single grain, Irish whiskey from one single distillery location. Originally distilled in a traditional “Coffey” Copper Column still from pure Corn / maize grain.

Matured for a minimum of 6 years in flame charred, first fill, ex-bourbon casks from Kentucky in the U.S.A. before being ‘finished’ for a further 6 months in vintage BURGUNDY French red wine casks.

These Pinot Noir red wine casks come from the BURGUNDY region of France from the Côte d’Or vineyards near Dijon, France.

name: HYDE  No.6 President's Reserve Blended Reserve Sherry Cask Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
18YO Single Malt & 8YO Single Grain Irish Whiskey with a Sherry Cask Finish

Hyde No.6 is created using 18 Year Old Single Malt and 8 Year Old Single Grain Irish whiskey which were both originally aged in flame charred American Bourbon barrels.

These two carefully chosen vintages are then married together for a further 9 months of ‘finishing’ in Spanish, Vintage, toasted, Oloroso sherry cask Butts, which is why we call it ‘Double Wood’. Each Oloroso Sherry butt is 491 Litres / 108 gallons in siz

name: HYDE  No.7 President's Cask Single Malt Sherry Cask Irish Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
This Single Malt Irish whiskey is tripled distilled on a traditional copper pot still from 100% malted Irish grain barley in one Irish distillery location. Aged for at least six years in toasted 250 litre, vintage, Oloroso, ‘Hogshead’

SHERRY casks, from Cadiz in the Andalusia region of South West Spain

name: Smokehead  Sherry Bomb Islay Single Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
that has well and truly earned its name. Blasted by rich, sweet and spicy Spanish sherry casks, it has emerged as fery, explosive, heavy hitting dram that has even turned our skull red.

It might well be the exact, highly unusual taste you've been waiting for. It might be a cannonball careering towards you that you're keen to avoid. Either way, we've taken our 'not for everyone' mantra to a whole new level.

name: Kurayoshi  8 Year Old Pure Malt Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
8 year old blended malt whisky from The Kurayoshi range, produced by Matsui Shuzou in the Tottori Prefecture. These whiskies are made with a blend of Scotch and Japanese malt whiskies, brought down to bottling strength with volcanic-stone-filtered water. Pink peppercorn, orange peel, lingering toasted oak warmth on the palate with a finish of macadamia nuts and strawberry jam. Very easy drinking expression of blended whisky.

AWARDS & MEDALS

World Spirits Awards 2019 Category Winner

International Spirits Challenge 2020 : Gold

San Francisco World spirits Competition 2020 : Double Gold

San Francisco World Whiskies Competiton2021 : Gold

name: The Matsui  Pure Malt Whisky Sakura Cask (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Matsui Sakura Cask Single Malt Japanese Whisky is single malt whisky distilled in the rich, natural environment of Tottori and aged in cherry wood casks. Combined with the malt aroma and bitter flavour of unblended whisky, a faint, sweet, crisp smell of cherry blossom spreads throughout the mouth. This masterpiece, carefully crafted with heart and passion, is brought to proof with high-quality natural spring water from Mt. Daisen.

AWARDS & MEDALS

Jim Murray Whisky Bible 2022 Japahese Single Malt Whisty of The Year

World Whisky Award 2019 Desizn Silver

name: The Matsui  Pure Malt Whisky The Peated (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
A peated whisky from the Kurayoshi Distillery, released as part of The Matsui series and dubbed The Peated! It's pot distilled and then matured in white oak bourbon casks, before bottling at 48% ABV. The bottle is adorned with Katsushika Hokusai’s famed piece, The Great Wave, chosen to represent the spirit and force of the whisky within.

AWARDS & MEDALS

AWARDS 2020

Jim Murray's Whisky Bible : 87.5 pts

San Francisco World Spirits Competition : Gold

AWARDS 2019

World Whisky Award : Design Bronze

San Francisco World Spirits Competition : Gold

International Whisky Contest: Best Japanese Whisky NAS 3nd Place

name: J.J Corry   The Gael Irish Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
JJ Corry is one of the most transparent (and tasty) whiskey brands in Ireland. The Gael is a blend of 40% 9 Year Old Single Grain, 30% 17 Year Old Single Malt, 26% 13 Year Old Single Malt and 4% 28 Year Old Single Malt. Named after a Bicycle J.J. Corry invented, The Gael took about two years to develop. Chapel Gate first sourced some high quality and very rare mature Irish Whiskey. They began blending to create a Classic Irish whiskey, one bursting with juicy fruit flavours.

Awards.

Gold Medal Winner - Best Irish Blended Whiskey 2017

Gold Medal Winner - Best Irish Blended Whiskey 2018

Irish Times - 92/100

name: J.J Corry   The Hanson Irish Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
JJ Corry 'The Hanson' is a meticulous blend of just three casks of Irish Grain Whiskey from different distilleries. Four and ten years old and all ex-bourbon barrel aged, each cask was selected to build complexity upon the sweet and fruity qualities of the grain whiskey.

The result is a classically bright and fruit-forward Irish Whiskey which is mellowed with deep oak, warm vanilla and toasted notes. Rich and surprisingly complex, this sip finishes with a touch of spice and a hint of oiliness on the finish. The Hanson, bottled at 46% abv and without any artificial colouring or chill-filtration, is perfect enjoyed by itself or in a refreshing high ball.

 

Awards.

Gold Medal Winner San Francisco World Spirits Awards 2018: Blended Irish Whiskey Category

Gold Medal Winner Irish Whiskey Awards 2017: Blended Irish Whiskey Over 60 Euros Category

Malt Review May 2018: Top Marks 10/10

name: The Macallan  The Harmony Collection Rich Cacao (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Crafted from a harmonious combination of European and American oak casks, this rich single malt whisky pairs in perfect harmony with fine chocolates for an elevated tasting experience.

name: Chivas Regal XV Balmain (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
Balmain X Chivas XV (Limited Edition)

Bringing to life Balmain’s recognisable silhouette through a symmetrical design of chains and belts, this bottle is directly inspired by the house’s recent collections.

name: Kilchoman  100% Islay (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Our 100% Islay range is the world’s only Single Farm Single Malt Scotch Whisky. It represents the revival of traditional farm distilling; growing our own barley before malting, distilling, maturing and bottling every bottle of our 100% Islay range on site.

name: Kilchoman  Madeira Cask  (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Kilchoman Special Release Madeira Cask limited edition was distilled in May 2016 and matured for 5 years and 3 months in 46 fresh Madeira hogsheads, before being bottled at 50% abv in August 2021. It was peated to 50ppm and is non chill filtered.

name: Royal Salute  30 Year Old Key To The Kingdom (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Key To The Kingdom is an outstanding 30 Year Old blended whisky that upholds the luxurious character synonymous with a Royal Salute blends. Enriched with hints of sweet smoke, candied walnuts, peaches in syrup and delicate ginger spice, this 30-Year-Old blend is the epitome of elegance and sophistication that delivers a tasting experience to remember. All of this comes packaged in one of the most beautiful boxes and bottles we have ever seen – dark green in colour with the famous Royal Salute crest adorning the front. If you’re a fan of top quality whisky, you must add this one to your collection.

name: Chivas Regal  18 Years X Lisa (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
desc_en_short: Meet the new Chivas Regal Asia Brand Ambassador. As a member of one of the world’s biggest groups BLACKPINK, there’s no doubt that LISA’s success breaks boundaries and borders. Leading in self-confidence and empowerment, LISA’s inspiring story blends seamlessly with the Chivas ethos of success and elevating those around you.

food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: In this box of 2 glasses, rediscover the great classic Black Label Johnnie Walker. A whiskey recognized for its gustatory excellence, thanks to its blends of luxury products . Developed and resulting from the aging of whiskeys of at least 12 years of age, Black Label is recognized for its velvety, deep and complex typicality. A delight, to offer or treat yourself, whatever the holidays!

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Chinese New Year Of The Rabbit (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Give the gift of precious depth this Lunar New Year with Johnnie Walker Blue Label Year of the Rabbit limited edition design. The stunningly vivid design, created by one of fashion’s brightest young talents, Angel Chen, features a dynamic, modern interpretation of 2023’s Zodiac animal, the sprightly rabbit. Symbolising mercy, elegance and beauty, the rabbit signifies longevity in traditional Asian culture and as an echo of the Johnnie Walker motto, Keep Walking, prancing rabbits are captured bounding amongst mountainous peaks.

name: Johnnie Walker  Blue Label Ghost & Rare Port Dundas (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: The fifth release in the award-winning Johnnie Walker Blue Label Ghost and Rare series of limited editions, Johnnie Walker Blue Label Ghost and Rare Port Dundas, explores the character of exceptional and rare whiskies from one of the world’s most famous Grain Whisky distilleries, the Glasgow “ghost” distillery of Port Dundas.

name: Johnnie Walker & Son  King George V Chinese New Year Of The Rabbit by Angel Chen (750 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
To mark the Lunar New Year, Johnnie Walker is releasing a limited edition bottle designed in collaboration with Chinese Artist Angel Chen.

Drawn from extremely rare, precious casks, including irreplaceable whiskies from the now silent distillery of Port Ellen. This elegantly rich and creamy whisky has rarity reflected in every drop, and its new limited edition design is the perfect gift to give to the one who never walks alone and to mark this year.

Precious and luxurious whiskies give John Walker & Sons King George V a rare blend of elegance and an indulgent depth of flavour. This limited edition design in celebration of the Lunar New Year is a perfect way to celebrate moments to appreciate of the year past, and to mark new connections with business partners and close friends.

name: Shinju  Whisky 3 Years Aged (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Premium Blended Whisky aged more than 3 years with Oak Barrel by using 100% natural water from Mt. Fuji. Caramel like taste in the first note with dry finish with good flavor at the end. Highly recommended to drink this Japanese whisky with non-sugar soda or as “High Ball”

name: Azabu Pure Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Azabu Pure Malt comes to us all the way from Japan, featuring peated malt and Fujisan water aged in bourbon barrels and finished in sherry casks. It packs a light, fragrant flavour profile with flashes of freshly ground spices.

name: Azabu Aged 12 Years Pure Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Azabu Pure Malt being aged for 12 Years - Combine with water from Yoro Moutain in Gifu prefecture. It has a gorgeous aroma and a mellow taste, and enjoyable in any situations.

name: Azabu Aged 18 Years Pure Malt Whisky (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: Azabu Pure Malt being aged for 18 Years - Combine with water from Yoro Moutain in Gifu prefecture. With well aged whisky makes it taste richer and mellow spreadout through your mouth with smoky aroma.

name: Bushmills  Black Bush Gift Pack
desc_en_short:
Bushmills Black Bush Gift Pack Includes :

Bushmills Black Bush (Matured in Sherry cask) (700 ml) x 1

Bushmills Black Bush Irish Whiskey combines a high amount of malt whiskey matured in former Oloroso Sherry casks, with a sweet, batch-distilled grain whiskey. This unique recipe means Black Bush has rich, fruity notes and a deep intense character, balanced by an incredibly unique smoothness. It’s best enjoyed neat, or over ice.

Bushmills Rock Glass x 2

name: Bruichladdich  Octomore 10.1 Super Heavily Peated Islay Single Malt (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Octomore is the super-heavily peated single malt produced by Bruichladdich distillery, the most routinely heavily peated in the world. The whisky is named after the farm of the same name, located on a hillside north of the town of Port Charlotte. Having been traditionally an un-peated single malt due to the needs of its former owners for their blends, Murray McDavid were quick to diversify the Bruichladdich portfolio, also introducing the more lightly peated Port Charlotte and Lochindaal.

name: Highland Park  15 Years Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
This is a wonderfully rich and complex single malt. Opening with rich and spicy aromas of crème brulee, heather honey and crumbled cinnamon, intensely fruity notes follow - fresh pineapple dressed with a scattering of sun-kissed lemon zest. There’s a hint of freshly-baked sponge cake too, warm from the oven, and you’ll find cinnamon again, but toasted shards this time. Citrus and vanilla notes linger in the aromatic waves of peat smoke.

To create 15 Year Old Viking Heart, Gordon Motion, our Master Whisky Maker, selected predominantly sherry seasoned European oak casks to deliver warm, spicy notes and sherry seasoned American oak casks to provide a balance of sweet vanilla. Expertly adding just a few refill casks to soften and smooth the flavours, Gordon chose to bottle at 44% ABV to allow the whisky’s vibrant fruitiness and distinctive heathery peat smoke to shine through.

name: Glenmorangie  A Tale Of The Forest (700 ml) (Limited Edition)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: This is a Glenmorangie as lush and leafy as the forest itself. With aromas of pine needles, woodland moss, juniper's sharpness, and tastes of eucalyptus, mint, bitter orange and distant smoke, this limited edition is a whisky to surround, delight and surprist you, whether you enjoy it deep in a forest or in cocktails at home.

name: Kentucky Owl  The Wiseman Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (700 ml)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short: The Wiseman Bourbon is an interesting release as it features bourbon Kentucky Owl contract distils with Bardstown Bourbon Company. Their 4-year-old wheat and high-rye bourbons are then blended with 5.5 years and 8.5-year-old Kentucky-sourced bourbons. The result is a traditional-tasting bourbon that features quite a bit of spice, surprising bouts of dryness, and a general lack of excitement. It also features hints of age throughout, yet those are quickly followed by cereal grain or light ethanol. It’s a very serviceable bourbon that doesn’t do anything to offend, and kind of just is.

name: Kentucky Owl  The Wiseman Kentucky Straight Rye Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short: The Wiseman Straight Rye is a 95% rye mash bill selected by Kentucky Owl Master Blender John Rhea. Bottled at 100.8 proof, The Wiseman Straight Rye has a rich and spicy nose with hints of fresh rye bread and slight hints of sweet caramel and cinnamon. The spicy character instantly fills the mouth with a rich rye flavour with a long finish that starts as fresh rye bread and slowly moves towards buttered cinnamon toast and ends with a hint of English walnut.

name: Kentucky Owl  Confiscated Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Kentucky Owl was founded in 1879 by a local pharmacist, Charles Mortimer Dedman. He and his new bride received a large parcel of land on the banks of the Kentucky River as a wedding gift from his adopted father, a town judge. After running it by his wife, he decided to build the C.M. Dedman Distillery. For decades, it produced "The Wise Man's Bourbon" under Distilled Spirits Plant Designation “No. 16,” one of Kentucky’s original distilleries and part of a booming industry.

name: Kentucky Owl  Batch 11 Kentucky Straight Bourbon Whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Batch 11 continues the celebrated lineage of barrel proof whiskies that rose Kentucky Owl to fame. Batch 11 opens your eyes with notes of bright citrus, velvety dark chocolate, and sticky toffee. The palate is a welcome mélange of mature oak, allspice, honeyed bread, and deep cinnamon. The finish is long with toasted oak, sultana, peppercorn, and fresh thyme.

name: Glenfiddich  12 Years Old with Hip Flask Gift Pack
desc_en_short:
The Glenfiddich 12 Year Old Single Malt Whisky is experiencing a remake. Finnish-born, New York-based artist Santtu Mustonen wraps the iconic bottlings in new and limited-edition packaging.

The limited edition is a fusion of creative interpretation and exquisite whisky taste and contains a 0.7l bottle of Glenfiddich 12 years and a hip flask that is also colorfully designed.

name: Glenfiddich  15 Years Old with Hip Flask Gift Pack
desc_en_short:
The Glenfiddich 15 Year Old Single Malt Whisky is experiencing a remake. Finnish-born, New York-based artist Santtu Mustonen wraps the iconic bottlings in new and limited-edition packaging.

The limited edition is a fusion of creative interpretation and exquisite whisky taste and contains a 0.7l bottle of Glenfiddich 15 years and a hip flask that is also colorfully designed.

name: Glenfiddich  18 Years Old with Hip Flask Gift Pack
desc_en_short:
The Glenfiddich 18 Year Old Single Malt Whisky is experiencing a remake. Finnish-born, New York-based artist Santtu Mustonen wraps the iconic bottlings in new and limited-edition packaging.

The limited edition is a fusion of creative interpretation and exquisite whisky taste and contains a 0.7l bottle of Glenfiddich 18 years and a hip flask that is also colorfully designed.

name: Jack Daniel's  Old No.7 Guitar Case Gift Pack
desc_en_short: Treat someone to a quirky gift with the Jack Daniel's Old No.7 with Guitar Case presentation box. JD are known for their great marketing, and this release with a guitar box is certainly typical of them. This wonderful dram is charcoal mellowed and then aged in their hand carved American white oak casks. The bottle even has a guitar head bottle top!

name: Lambay  Single Malt Batch #1 Irish whiskey (700 ml)
desc_en_short: A rich triple-distilled single malt, matured in bourbon barrels and finished in signature Camus cognac casks. Batch 01 contains a higher percentage of island matured Lambay Single Malt delivering a more intense salty note on the palette. This Single Malt consists of both first fill and second fill cognac cask finishing to deliver a more intense mouthfeel of spice, tobacco, and pepper on the palette. Blended with Single Malt from our Island warehouse, the whiskey has soft smoky attributes with slight salinity and a lingering finish that balances the rich oak and herb note.

name: Wolfburn  Aged 10 Years Single Malt Whisky (700 ml)

name: Moonshine Runners  Blended Scotch Whisky (700 ml)

name: Bruichladdich  Octomore 14.1 The Backbone Of The Series (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
THE BACKBONE OF THE SERIES

The backbone of the 14th annual Octomore series, the character of the 14.1 offers a necessary comparison from which the other expressions alternate and evolve.

The base for this latest series showcases the delicate and intricate balance between smoke, malt, cask and maturation – resulting in an all-encompassing drinking experience. Matured for five years in first-fill ex-American whiskey casks, the 14.1 shows the power and potential of its essential raw ingredients.

Sweet caramel and vanilla open on the nose, with bright citrus cutting through Octomore’s signature smoke - elevated with roasted coffee and subtle spice.

Distilled from 100% Scottish mainland barley and peated to 128.9 PPM, Octomore 14.1 is as youthful and dynamic as its predecessors.

name: Bruichladdich  Octomore 14.2 (Impeccable Balance Of Cask & Spirit) (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
IMPECCABLE BALANCE OF CASK & SPIRIT

With over 200 different cask types in the warehouses, Head Distiller, Adam Hannett, has selected casks that have previously held Oloroso and Amarone – with the distinct sweetness and nuttiness of this combination creating an exceptional single malt.

Hailing from the renowned wine regions of Spain and Italy respectively, the spirit is then brought together in French oak, adding remarkable depth and complexity to the single malt. Octomore’s signature peak smoke notoriously pairs well with Oloroso sherry casks, with the influence of the wood adding a robust, savoury flavour to the final spirit.

The oak from the Amarone casks also has a significant impact on the spirit, imparting rich, red fruit notes - giving structure and cohesion to the 14.2.

Octomore 14.2 uses the same barley varietal and is malted to the same PPM as the 14.1, but the liquids diverge profoundly with the influence of wine and sherry casks on the 14.2 spirit.

desc_en_short:
In 2023, GOLDCOCK proudly introduces GOLDCOCK BLENDED, a groundbreaking addition to its permanent portfolio. This captivating blend, featuring a three-year-old malt whisky and a six-year-old grain whisky, is crafted at 42% alc. vol.

GOLDOCK BLENDED offers a richly malty aroma, complemented by a trace of smoke and a robust wood influence. The taste is f ull- bodied, with dark fruit notes harmonizing seamlessly with warm wood. The medium-long and strong finish is characterized by prominent woody and malty elements.

This expression encapsulates Czech whisky craftsmanship, offering a sensory journey that blends tradition with innovation. GOLDOCK BLENDED is a distinguished addition to the GOLDCOCK collection, promising a unique and memorable whisky experience.

name: Singleton  Of Dufftown 21 Year Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Well, look at this! A glorious 21 year old single malt from the Singleton of Dufftown, this expression showcases the expertise of its Master of Malts, Maureen Robinson. Uniting a trio of different cask styles – Oloroso seasoned Pedro-Ximenez casks and ex-bourbon casks are hand-selected from the Dufftown archives and the single malt is married in European Oak casks, thus following the Singleton's 'Trinity Cask Harmony' process. The result is a gloriously rich and mesmerising dram with exceptional balance, amping up that Dufftown deliciousness delightfully!

name: Singleton  Of Dufftown 25 Year Old (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
This 25 Year Old Single Malt Scotch Whisky amplifies The Singleton’s signature vividness, in a harmony of exotic and full-bodied fruity notes forged by our Trinity Harmony Philosophy.

Three different cask styles have been united to create a Single Malt even greater than the sum of its parts. Maureen and her team painstakingly hand-selected and then harmonised slow crafted whiskies from European oak casks and Refill Ex-Bourbon casks, which had been resting in our private reserves for over a quarter of a century, then masterfully marrying the final liquid in American Oak casks. The vividness of these whiskies was given greater depth as layers of flavour were enhanced by this third expertly chosen cask.

name: Bruichladdich  30 Aged Years Old Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
RE/DEFINE THIRTY

"This 30 year old single malt not only celebrates the resurrection of our Victorian distillery but pays homage to the men who laid down this spirit three decades ago.

The future of Bruichladdich was uncertain in the early 1990s. From the brink of permanent closure to now the largest private employer on Islay, Bruichladdich Distillery and the local community has slowly rebuilt and flourished over the past three decades – all while this spirit has quietly matured.”

MATURATION PROFILE

100% bourbon cask matured in a combination of: 50% full-term maturation in refill hogsheads and 50% refill hogsheads recasked into fresh bourbon casks after 20 years. All casks are vatted together and further matured before married in refill bourbon barrels for three months before bottling.

name: Bruichladdich  Black Art Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
AN ENIGMATIC ALCHEMY

An enigmatic alchemy which relies on nature, craftsmanship and the quiet passing of time, what happens inside each cask under cover of darkness in the depths of the warehouse remains a mystery. Black Art 11 is a testament to this elusive mastery.

Using artisanal techniques passed down from one generation to the next; the spirit is pulled exclusively from Bruichladdich distillery pre-renaissance casks which have been patiently maturing on our island home for almost three decades. The finite single malt is created in secret by our head distiller, Adam Hannett, with the recipe only known to him.

Putting our trust in Adam, he is given creative freedom to bring this incredible whisky to life. Using pre-renaissance Bruichladdich stock, Black Art 11 is unique and unrepeatable.

A chance to experiment, take risks and push the boundaries of possibility; only Adam knows what has gone into creating the precious 24-year-old single malt. The barley and cask types are undisclosed, with the final recipe a mystery.

Matured in the finest oak, this eleventh edition of Black Art showcases the captivating marriage of faith and ingenuity and we invite you to put your trust in us.

name: Bruichladdich  Octomore 13.1 Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short: Octomore 13.1 is as youthful and dynamic as its super-heavily peated predecessors. Distilled patiently from the 2015 harvest of 100% Scottish Mainland barley, malted to a stratospheric 137.3PPM and matured in the highest quality American oak casks, this five-year-old spirit is truly remarkable. Acting as the backbone of the 13th Octomore series, the 13.1 offers a necessary comparison from which the other expressions alternate. Always balancing the strength of the Octomore spirit with a graceful, understated maturation in ex-American oak, this single malt is a testament to the trust our head distiller, Adam Hannett, has in the quality of his ingredients. Without more than patience and an understanding of how the flavours will evolve, this single malt perfectly personifies the courage of Octomore as a concept. After five aged years in first fill ex-American oak casks, Adam has offered a unique twist in this 13.1, having gathered and recasked the spirit in 2021 into yet more fresh, first fill ex-American oak casks. This final injection of flavour, taken from the interaction between the spirit and the oak offers additional flavours of dark toffee, coconut and vanilla.

name: Glencadam  17 Years Old PX Sherry Quarter Cask Finish

The single malt in these casks has been expertly married then finished in the finest Pedro Ximénez Sherry quarter casks from Andalucia, Spain.

These PX Sherry casks impart unique flavours, which give depth and complexity to our Glencadam Single Malt.

name: Glencadam  15 Years Old Medeira Cask Finish
desc_en_short:
Glencadam Reserva de Madeira has been specially created by our Master Distiller. From Glencadam's historic dunnage warehouses, he has carefully selected single malt distilled in 2008 and matured initially in exceptional ex-bourbon American oak casks.

The single malt in these casks has been expertly married then finished in the finest Madeira casks from Portugal's Madeira Islands.

These Madeira wine casks impart unique flavours, which give depth and complexity to our Glencadam Single Malt.

name: Tomintoul  Cigar Malt (700 ml)
desc_en_short:

The rich and sweet sherry notes, creamy malt profile and gentle peat smoke make this single malt the perfect accompaniment to the world’s finest cigars.

name: The Macallan  Time Space Mastery Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
TIME TRAVEL

At The Macallan, we believe whisky making is like time travel: what we bottle today was created many years in the past, and the spirit we lay down in casks now is destined for many years in the future. Through time travelling, we learn from the past and look to the future.

“It was an absolute privilege to be able to reach back in time and select stock from 1940 to honour and celebrate our 200 Year Anniversary. As a Whisky Mastery Team, our roles are unique in the sense that we get to time travel – selecting whisky from the past crafted by our predecessors, whilst simultaneously laying down casks for future generations of whisky makers and consumers.

"To nose, taste and select whisky created eight decades ago is an exceptionally rare occasion in the life of a whisky maker and one which I will treasure”.

Kirsteen Campbell

Master Whisky Maker, The Macallan

desc_en_short: The fourth release in the Macallan Harmony Collection is a vibrant and complex single malt that beautifully captures the influence of sherry casks on its spirit. Made in collaboration with Cirque du Soleil, Vibrant Oak has been matured in a combination of first-fill American oak sherry casks and refill sherry casks, creating a balance between the rich sherry character and the sweet spice and vanilla of American oak.

name: Compass Box  Flaming Heart 25th Anniversary Edition Blended Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
FLAMING HEART: REMASTERED

To toast 25 years of Compass Box, we present a remastered version of Flaming Heart that focuses on the flames and their protective chamber of oak. For this, our 8th rendition, we have sought the most complex range of flavour from the fewest possible components. Using only whiskies further matured in French oak custom barrels alongside peated malts, this combination hasn’t been seen since our second version of Flaming Heart, released in 2007.

FLAVOUR PROFILE

Rich, oily smoke appears on the nose, supported by zingy spice. Hints of raspberry and apricot encircled by impressions of tarry rope. The palate is immediately dense as spices like clove, pink and black pepper and nutmeg arrive. Medicinal peat notes duke it out with bright and winey fruit. Finally, concentrated smoke that is at once woody and ashy with menthol and citrus oils.

SERVING RECOMMENDATIONS

Raise a glass – and your hands – with us as we celebrate a quarter of a century of stories and deliciousness. We feel like the concert is only just getting going.

name: Compass Box  Hedonism 2025 Blended Grain Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Hedonism on our 25th Anniversary

Over the last 25 years Hedonism has remained a core part of the Compass Box range. Changing the landscape of Scotch whisky from first release, Hedonism 2025 takes on greater power and velvet at 46% ABV. Featuring single grain from the Cameronbridge distillery, further matured for two years in a first-fill Marsala barrique.

FLAVOUR PROFILE

Initial waves of caramel, leading into a heart of pure peach puree, cocoa and pear. Chocolate mousse arrives on the palate, joined by nutmeg-inflected custard. The finish freshens to white grape, Fuji apple and vanilla.

SERVING RECOMMENDATIONS

Indulge hedonistically with parmesan as always or indulge with some Pastel de Nata to play with the texture of the whisky. Dried fruit such as apricots help to draw out the fruit notes or dive straight in with some salted caramel pots de crème.

name: Compass Box  Secrets of Smoke Blended Malt Scotch Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
REVEAL THE CURIOUSLY SWEET

What if we told you that peated Scotch whiskies aren’t all they seem? We have long believed there was more to the story than smoke alone. A hint of honey, a flash of fruit – there have been signs of sweeter delights hiding in plain sight beneath the sootiness.

FLAVOUR PROFILE

Wine casks release the unexpected sweetness at the core of peated whiskies, enhancing toffee apple qualities of malt whisky from the Caol Ila Distillery. You’ll find bright cherry notes tempted out by refill red wine casks containing The Peat Monster, alongside blueberry flapjack flavours in whisky from the Laphroaig Distillery finished in Marsala barriques.

SERVING RECOMMENDATIONS

Add a small spritz of soda water to unlock further fruity and sweet flavours.

desc_en_short:
Aged for at least 10 years using traditional methods like direct charcoal toasting, this single malt reflects a perfect blend of Scottish tradition and Japanese finesse. After a seven-year pause, it returns with a rich, complex taste.

Nose : Fresh herbal profile with dried fruit, ripe banana, malted grain, and subtle hints of black pepper and peat smoke.

Palate : Crisp and smooth, featuring custard, smoky oak, and a touch of peat, ending in a warm, spicy, and woody balance.

name: Nikka The Grain Whisky (700 ml)
desc_en_short:

Nose : A rich blend of beeswax, aromatic herbs, and fresh fruit, intertwined with vanilla and cereal notes, creating a complex aromatic profile.

Palate : The creamy sweetness of almond and coconut milk combines with subtle vanilla, offering a dynamic attack. Surprising depth is added with notes of licorice, cinnamon, and ginger.

Finish : Smooth and balanced, with mint, acacia honey, and floral notes lingering.

desc_en_short: Matured in hand-selected American ex-Bourbon barrels from the distillation year of 2009, this whisky unfolds as a delightfully complex single malt. Its flavour profile is intricately layered, featuring nuanced highlights of rich vanilla, an array of luscious tropical fruits, and a subtle yet distinct hint of coconut. Aged for over fifteen years, this whisky is presented non-chill-filtered and at cask strength, perfectly preserving its full, natural flavour profile and its rich, balanced character.

name: Kavalan 15th Anniversary Vintage 2009 Oloroso Sherry Cask (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Matured in an exceptional quality Oloroso Sherry cask from Spain’s Sherry Triangle and hand-selected from the 2009 distillation year, this whisky offers a smooth and rich profile with a complex character. Each sip unveils a harmonious blend of dried fruits, rich nuttiness, and a bouquet of aromatic spices, all delicately laced with gentle whispers of marzipan and vanilla. Presented non-chill-filtered and at cask strength, this whisky retains a full, natural flavour profile, perfectly preserving its rich and fragrant essence.

Rich caramel and the sweetness of maltose are layered with the distillery's unique tropical fruits to create a delicate but distinct sherried whisky that can be enjoyed on easy-drinking occasions with friends.

name: Glenfiddich Suspended Time Aged 30 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Time is often believed to be an irrefutable
force. The seconds, minutes, hours fleeting
figures of a clockface, slipping steadily
away. But in the hands of a maverick, time
stands still. This is something our Malt
Master understands implicitly. Thirty years
ago, he laid down the spirit to create an
exemplary single malt. After three decades
of patient maturation, the decisive moment
arrived. Glenfiddich 30 is the pinnacle of
this process. More than simply a superlative
liquid, it is forethought, expectation,
anticipation embodied. Three decades,
captured. Time stilled, forever. Arrested,
and arresting. An experience to savour.
Thirty years of our maverick mindset,
suspended in time.

name: Glenfiddich Simultane Time Aged 50 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
Only When The Whisky Reaches 21 Years Old, Is It Considered Worthy To Be Suitable For Further Aging. Only Three Casks Out Of Thousands Reached Fifty Years. Three Malt Masters Have Overseen The Maturation Of This Whisky, Over The Past Five Decades.

The Glenfiddich 50 Year old defines a deeper meaning of a fifty year old whisky

As the years accumulated in a cask increase, so does the rarity of the whisky inside. This is the inextricable link between liquid and time. Glenfiddich 50 Year Old is not just another rare whisky, it is a maverick statement. Fifty years experienced not chronologically, but all at once.

name: Glenfiddich Cumulative Time Aged 40 Years (700 ml)
desc_en_short:
It is visible in a rocky valley’s many solid
strata; laid down over millennia, worn smooth
by wind and rain. And with layers comes
complexity. Which is why Glenfiddich 40 is so
much more than an exemplary single malt.
This rare single malt is made through remnant
vatting, a pioneering process in which our
Malt Master carries one batch over, time and
again, and marries it with the casks selected
for each subsequent release. Cask after cask,
season after season, it absorbs the evolving
flavours of the passing years. Melding the
many liquid layers of it’s four-decade
formulation to create an extraordinary
expression. It is time, age, experience
accumulated. Physical. Tangible. Layer upon
layer of maverick thinking, made manifest.

At The Belvanie we stay true to our Five Rare Craft, making whisky the way we always have. Our craftsmen have an intimate understanding of their materials and a desire to make the very best whisky possible. Our process is a combination of expertise, skill and ambition which gives The Balvenie its unique character.

The Balvenie Fifty First Edition represents the coming together of interwoven stories of craftsmanship at our Distillery, culminating in a single, fifty-year-old cask selected by our Malt Master, Kelsey McKechnie.

On the nose, expect aromas of deep fruits, cassis and candied apricots, layer delicate cedar and a warming nutty spice. On the palate the whisky presents flavours of caramelised fruits, rich spice and soft vanilla, which marry together with a delicate ginger spice and citrus zing.

The exceptional quality of The Balvenie Fifty is further enhanced by its exquisite packaging, developed in collaboration with Croglin, a bespoke craft workshop based in Cumbria. Each presentation is a work of art, featuring over 100 different elements.
