desc_en_short:
JOHNNIE WALKER VAULT x OLIVIER ROUSTEING - THE COUTURE BLEND

 INSPIRED BY OLIVIER ROUSTEING'S PROGRESSIVE COUTURE CREATIVITY, MASTER BLENDER DR. EMMA WALKER, LEANS INTO THE MOST EXPERIMENTAL WHISKIES & NEW FLAVOR EXPRESSIONS TO CREATE A FUTURE & FLAVOUR-FORWARD COUTURE BLEND.

OLIVIER ROUSTEING DRESSES THE ULTIMATE FUTURE WHISKY DECANTER IN HIS BOLD GOLD SIGNATURE STYLE. TOGETHER CREATING A BOUNDARY-PUSHING COUTURE BLEND OF THE FUTURE.

 

A SIGNATURE OF THEIR BOLD, BOUNDARY- PUSHING CREATIVE COLLABORATION

IN CRAFTING THE BLEND, DR EMMA WALKER SELECTED JUST 10 WHISKIES FROM THE JOHNNIE WALKER VAULT – AN EXQUISITE LIQUID LIBRARY OF 500 RARE AND EXCEPTIONAL WHISKIES, PERSONALLY CURATED AND ROTATED FROM THE VERY BEST OF THE 10 MILLION CASKS OF SCOTCH AVAILABLE TO HER AS MASTER BLENDER.


EMMA SELECTED GHOST WHISKIES FROM LONG-CLOSED DISTILLERIES SUCH AS PORT ELLEN, PORT DUNDAS AND CALEDONIAN - TO TELL A STORY OF TRADITION, HERITAGE AND RARITY. AROUND THESE

SHE LAYERED TRAILBLAZING WHISKIES FROM THE 80S AND 90S WHICH SHE BELIEVES PUSHED THE BOUNDARIES OF STYLE AND FLAVOUR DURING THIS ERA INCLUDING EXPRESSIONS FROM BENRINNES, CRAGGANMORE AND CAMERONBRIDGE.

FINALLY, EMMA CHOSE FOUR CONTEMPORARY EXPRESSIONS FROM THE LAST TWO DECADES WHICH EXPERIMENT WITH PROCESS AND FINISHES INCLUDING MALTS FROM CARDHU, ROSEISLE AND TEANINICH.

name: Lagavulin 12 Year Old (700 ml) (F26 Special Releases 2025)
food_matching: Dark Chocolate, Smoked Meats, Aged Cheese, Nuts
desc_en_short:
THROUGH THE FIRE BAKED SMOKE, TOASTED CEREAL AROMAS AND RICH FRUIT RISE

Matured in refill casks and Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso-seasoned European oak butts.

Journey beyond convention, into the fire-baked embers and smoke of an artisan bakery.

Like the aroma of artisan bread, this Lagavulin expression whispers the ways of its makers. Follow your curiosity to complex layers that lie beyond the fire baked smoke. Take your time with taste. Those nuances of generational skill and tradition will unfold.

The maturation in Pedro Ximénez and Oloroso-seasoned European oak casks imparts intense notes of rich dried fruit like raisins, figs and dates; expertly employed to enhance the signature smoke in Lagavulin and lengthen the finish.

The craft of kinship rises and a taste of heritage lives on in warm, toasted cereal aromas.

name: Oban 12 Year Old (700 ml) (F26 Special Releases 2025)
desc_en_short:
TOFFEE AND SPICE WARMLY EMBRACE NOTES OF CITRUS AND SEA BREEZE

Matured in ex-bourbon American oak casks.

Journey beyond convention, to explore sweeter depths of signature taste.

The comfort of home draws you back, like a warm welcome after a long journey. Like the highland gull that flies far but always returns. This is the taste of coming home. Maturation in ex-bourbon casks makes for an expression that is deeply warm, sweet and rich in character.

Discover delicious notes of sweet home baking and salty sea air. The American oak enriches fresh, fruity house style with the taste of tinned syrupy peaches and warm spices. Honeyed flavours notes marry with signature maritime style for a taste that brings the heart and soul of a harbour we call home.

name: Clynelish 18 Year Old (700 ml) (F26 Special Releases 2025)
desc_en_short:
SUNNY TROPICAL TASTE ENLIVENS WAXY HONEY CHARACTER

Matured in refill casks, with an inclusion of spirit from Clynelish's distillation cut point experiments.

Journey beyond convention, to the sunshine taste of a tropical paradise.

Discover a vibrant world enveloped by a soft sun. Like a warm memory of a tropical paradise, where vivid details dissolve into deep molten gold. This enigmatic expression is born of a process where a portion of experimental spirit is harnessed for unconventional delights.

The signature character of Clynelish Distillery is imbued with a sweet, tropical vibrancy from a unique experiment, in which a cut of the liquid is drawn early in the distillation process, when tropical flavour notes are prevalent. We call this the 'Pineapple Cut'. Matured for at least 18 years in refill casks, notes of lush, ripe pineapple enliven the taste of wax and honey. Experience the feeling of that perfect place in the sun.

name: Roseisle 14 Year Old (700 ml) (F26 Special Releases 2025)

VERDANT ELEGANCE ARTFULLY COMPOSED FOR REFINED BALANCE

Matured in an exquisite combination of refill and rejuvenated casks, for a complex layered spirit.

Journey beyond convention, to the pinnacle of balance and harmony.

Experience profound elegance of taste. Inspired by the precise and delicate arrangement of natural elements to create graceful beauty, this Roseisle expression is the result of nuanced composition and refinement. Masterful harmonization and meticulous attention to detail makes for an exquisite taste.

An artful combination of refill and rejuvenated casks presents a beautiful harmony of aromas and flavours. Fresh vibrant style, with layered notes of baked apple, toffee, vanilla and boiled sweets. Perfectly smooth anp balanced, born of complex precision, finesse and vision.

name: Dailuaine 21 Year Old (700 ml) (F26 Special Releases 2025)
desc_en_short:
A UNIQUE MARVEL OF RICH SPICE AND MESMERISING COMPLEXITY

Matured life-long in Spanish ex-sherry casks.

Journey beyond convention, through unprecedented complexity of taste.

Just like the marbled monotypes that adorn precious books, this 21 years old Single Malt Scotch Whisky is rich and unique. Slow and patient craft gives rise to complex and layered character. From the small reserves of Spanish ex-sherry casks of Dailuaine Distillery we bring a deeply unique expression, the likes of such we have never bottled before.

Long maturation imparts robust, fragrant flavour and creates generous mouthfeel. Luxuriously layered, and with powerful depths, marbled notes of dried fruit, baked apple and chilli pepper roll across the tongue. And only a fortunate few will get to experience such a truly exquisite and one-off release

name: Teaninich 8 Year Old (700 ml) (F26 Special Releases 2025)
desc_en_short:
SPICY SWEETNESS RICH IN HEADY HERBAL AROMAS

Our first Single Grain Scotch Whisky bottling made using rye. Matured in exbourbon casks.

Journey beyond convention, with the taste of a rebellious rye experiment.

From the distillery that dares to be different, to stand apart from tradition, discover the rebellious charm of the outlier: our first Single Grain Scotch Whisky bottling made using rye.

From a bold 2016 rye experiment using Teaninich Distillery's rare mash filter, we bring a standout Scotch. Malted rye and barley are mashed together for a distillation matured in ex-bourbon casks. This bold deviation yields flavours rich in subversive spicy toffee sweetness, and thick with deeр aromas of cinnamon and clove. A marvellous atypical taste, that proves fortune favours the brave.

name: GAO HANG Jasmine Rice Spirit

The Myth of Gao Hang, The Heavenly Origins of Thai Jasmine Rice

The inspiration for Gao Hang, our rice spirit, dates back to the 16th-century. This celebrated spirit was traditionally distilled from the finest rice imported from Siam (modern-day Thailand) and presented as a noble tribute to foreign kings.

Today, Gao Hang revitalizes this historic connection. We craft our spirit from 100% pure Thai Jasmine rice, meticulously fermented and distilled in Gao Hang style. This revered process yields a sublimely smooth, premium white spirit defined by its captivating character.

name: Bordeaux Easy Drinking Trio
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short:
A classic introduction to the elegant character of Bordeaux wines, carefully curated for everyday drinking. This trio highlights the balanced structure, smooth tannins, and charming fruit profile that have made Bordeaux one of the most approachable and food-friendly wine styles in the world.

Each bottle represents a slightly different expression of Bordeaux’s classic blend, offering variety while maintaining the region’s signature elegance. Perfect for casual dinners, relaxed evenings, or exploring French wine without complexity.

Inside the Set

Dourthe Grands Terroirs Bordeaux Rouge

A refined, classic Bordeaux from one of the region’s respected producers, offering aromas of ripe red berries, plum, and gentle spice. The palate is smooth and balanced with soft tannins and lively freshness, making it easy to enjoy with many dishes.

Comte Desclos Bordeaux

This fruit-forward Bordeaux opens with notes of blackcurrant, cherry, and subtle oak spice. The palate is round and silky with a pleasant structure, delivering an approachable and charming expression of the region.

Château La Rose Gadis Bordeaux Rouge

A slightly richer style of Bordeaux with flavors of dark berries, cocoa, and light earthy nuances. The wine shows gentle structure and a smooth finish, making it particularly enjoyable with savory meals.

name: Bordeaux Enthusiast Trio
desc_en_short:
A thoughtfully curated selection for those who appreciate the timeless elegance of Bordeaux wines. This set brings together three respected Bordeaux labels that showcase the region’s signature balance of fruit, structure, and refined character.

From well-established Bordeaux producers to globally recognized names, each bottle reflects the classic Bordeaux blend style—offering smooth tannins, vibrant dark fruit, and subtle spice. This collection is perfect for wine lovers who enjoy authentic French reds that pair beautifully with a wide range of dishes. .

Inside the Set

Baron de Lestac Bordeaux Rouge

A classic Bordeaux blend with inviting aromas of blackcurrant, red berries, and gentle spice. The palate is smooth and balanced with soft tannins and a pleasant freshness, making it an easy and enjoyable everyday Bordeaux.

Comte Desclos Bordeaux

This elegant Bordeaux offers notes of ripe cherry, blackcurrant, and subtle oak spice. The wine is round and silky on the palate with approachable tannins, delivering a charming and well-balanced drinking experience.

Baron Philippe de Rothschild Mouton Cadet Bordeaux Rouge

One of the most recognized Bordeaux wines worldwide, this classic blend reveals aromas of dark berries, plum, and delicate spice, supported by a refined structure and smooth, lingering finish.

name: Bordeaux Discovery Trio
food_matching: Charcuterie, Salmon, Mushroom Dishes, Soft Cheese
desc_en_short:
A curated trio designed for those who want to explore the deeper character of Bordeaux wines. This set highlights three distinctive expressions from the region, ranging from classic Bordeaux AOP to the richer structure of Bordeaux Supérieur, offering a broader view of the style and elegance that define this famous French wine region.

Each bottle reflects Bordeaux’s signature blend of grapes—typically Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon—bringing together ripe dark fruit, gentle spice, and balanced tannins. The selection provides a wonderful opportunity to discover how Bordeaux wines can range from smooth and approachable to slightly more structured and complex.

Inside the Set

Château Puy Favereau Bordeaux Supérieur

A refined Bordeaux Supérieur with aromas of blackcurrant, plum, and subtle toasted spice. The wine offers a richer structure and deeper concentration than typical Bordeaux, with smooth tannins and a long, elegant finish.

Baron Philippe de Rothschild Mouton Cadet Bordeaux Rouge

One of the most recognized Bordeaux wines worldwide, this classic blend shows notes of dark berries, plum, and delicate spice. The palate is balanced and polished, delivering a smooth texture and refined character.

Château Pericou AOP Bordeaux Rouge

A charming and approachable Bordeaux featuring aromas of red cherry, blackcurrant, and gentle herbal nuances. The palate is soft and fruit-driven with balanced acidity, making it an easy and versatile wine for many occasions.

name: Bordeaux Classic Appellation Trio
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short:
A curated selection that captures the timeless character of Bordeaux, bringing together three wines that reflect the region’s renowned tradition of elegance, balance, and structure. This set offers a journey through classic Bordeaux styles—from approachable regional expressions to the more refined complexity of Saint-Émilion Grand Cru.

Crafted from Bordeaux’s signature grape varieties such as Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, these wines deliver layered fruit, gentle spice, and polished tannins that make Bordeaux a favorite among wine lovers worldwide. Ideal for those who appreciate traditional French reds with depth and character.

Inside the Set

Château La Gasquerie AOP Bordeaux Rouge

A classic Bordeaux with aromas of blackcurrant, red berries, and subtle herbal notes. The wine is smooth and balanced with soft tannins and lively freshness, offering an elegant and easy-drinking expression of the region.

Baron Philippe de Rothschild Mouton Cadet Heritage Bordeaux Rouge

A refined Bordeaux from the legendary Rothschild family portfolio, showing notes of ripe dark fruit, plum, and gentle spice. The palate is round and polished with a harmonious structure and lingering finish.

Château Les Clavelines Saint-Émilion

Grand Cru A more structured and complex expression from the prestigious Saint-Émilion Grand Cru appellation. Expect aromas of black cherry, blackberry, cocoa, and subtle oak, supported by velvety tannins and impressive depth.

name: Bordeaux Authentic AOP Trio
food_matching: Charcuterie, Salmon, Mushroom Dishes, Soft Cheese
desc_en_short:
A carefully selected trio that highlights the authentic character of Bordeaux AOP wines, offering a closer look at the region’s classic style and heritage. This set brings together three château wines that represent the approachable elegance and balanced structure Bordeaux is known for.

Crafted mainly from traditional Bordeaux grape varieties such as Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon, these wines express vibrant fruit, subtle spice, and smooth tannins. The inclusion of Bordeaux Supérieur adds an extra layer of richness and structure, creating a well-rounded tasting experience for wine lovers who appreciate classic French reds. .

Inside the Set

Château de la Vieille Tour Bordeaux Supérieur AOP

A richer Bordeaux Supérieur with aromas of blackcurrant, ripe plum, and gentle oak spice. The palate shows deeper concentration with smooth tannins and a long, balanced finish.

Château La Gasquerie AOP Bordeaux Rouge

A classic Bordeaux expression featuring notes of red berries, blackcurrant, and subtle herbal tones. Smooth and well-balanced, the wine offers a fresh and elegant drinking experience.

Château Pericou AOP Bordeaux Rouge

An approachable Bordeaux with aromas of ripe cherry, dark berries, and delicate spice. The palate is soft and fruit-driven with balanced acidity, making it versatile and easy to enjoy.

name: Left Bank Cabernet Explorer Trio
food_matching: Charcuterie, Salmon, Mushroom Dishes, Soft Cheese
desc_en_short:
A curated collection designed to explore the prestigious Left Bank of Bordeaux, home to some of the world’s most structured and age-worthy wines. This set highlights the classic style of Left Bank appellations, where Cabernet Sauvignon plays a leading role, delivering powerful structure, refined tannins, and deep black-fruit character.

From the elegance of Margaux to the bold personality of Pauillac and the traditional charm of Médoc, this trio offers a wonderful introduction to the distinct character of Bordeaux’s Left Bank terroirs. Ideal for wine lovers who appreciate wines with structure, depth, and classic Bordeaux sophistication.

Inside the Set

Michel Lynch Médoc Réserve Red

A classic Médoc expression with aromas of blackcurrant, plum, cedar, and subtle spice. The wine shows firm yet polished tannins and a balanced structure, reflecting the traditional Left Bank style.

Baron Philippe de Rothschild Mouton Cadet Reserve Margaux

An elegant Margaux wine with fragrant notes of black cherry, violet, and delicate oak spice. The palate is silky and refined, offering graceful tannins and a long, balanced finish.

Duchesse De Pauillac

A structured and powerful Pauillac with aromas of blackberry, cassis, tobacco, and cedar. The wine displays depth and complexity with firm tannins and impressive concentration.

name: Right Bank Merlot Prestige Trio
desc_en_short:
A refined selection showcasing the elegant and expressive character of Bordeaux’s Right Bank. Known for its Merlot-dominant wines, this side of Bordeaux produces reds that are plush, velvety, and richly aromatic, often revealing layers of dark fruit, spice, and silky tannins.

This collection brings together wines from Lalande-de-Pomerol, Saint-Émilion, and Pomerol, three appellations celebrated for their depth and finesse. Together, they offer a wonderful exploration of the Right Bank’s signature style—wines that combine richness with elegance and remarkable drinkability.

Inside the Set

Château Tournefeuille Lalande-de-Pomerol

A charming Merlot-driven wine with aromas of black cherry, plum, and gentle spice. The palate is smooth and rounded with soft tannins, offering a rich yet approachable expression of the Right Bank.

Clarendelle Saint-Émilion Red

Crafted with the expertise associated with the Clarendelle by Haut-Brion family, this wine shows notes of ripe red berries, dark plum, and subtle oak spice. The texture is polished and balanced with elegant structure.

Château La Renaissance Pomerol 2020

A deeper and more luxurious expression from Pomerol, revealing aromas of blackberry, cassis, cocoa, and delicate earthy tones. The palate is rich and velvety with layered fruit and impressive depth.

name: Bordeaux Organic & Natural Trio
desc_en_short:
A thoughtfully curated selection highlighting the growing movement of organic and low-intervention wines from Bordeaux. This set brings together three wines crafted with respect for nature, focusing on sustainable vineyard practices and minimal intervention during winemaking.

These wines showcase the pure expression of Bordeaux’s traditional grape varieties—particularly Merlot, known for its smooth texture and vibrant fruit character. The collection offers a fresh perspective on Bordeaux, where environmental awareness meets classic French wine tradition.

Inside the Set

Michel Lynch Nature Merlot Bordeaux "Organic" AOC

An organic Merlot that reveals aromas of ripe cherry, plum, and soft spice. The palate is smooth and fruit-forward with gentle tannins and a clean, natural expression of Bordeaux.

Reserve Tradition du Château de la Vieille Tour Bordeaux Supérieur AOP

A richer Bordeaux Supérieur showing notes of blackcurrant, dark plum, and subtle toasted spice. The wine offers good structure and depth with balanced tannins and a lingering finish.

Vinum Terra Bordeaux AOP (No Sulfites Added)

A naturally crafted Bordeaux made without added sulfites, highlighting vibrant fruit and purity of flavor. Expect aromas of fresh red berries, blackberry, and light earthy notes, with a lively and smooth palate.

name: Quady  Electra
desc_en_short: Electra – With the first sip you feel the wine- light as springtime, delicately sweet, refreshingly crisp, a bouquet of flowers with the taste of peach and melon. Electra is electricity for the mouth!

name: Warre's  Heritage Ruby
style: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Barroca
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short: “Medium red. Smoky, high-toned aromas of cassis, marzipan and maple syrup. Smooth, fat and super ripe, with a generous texture and ample balancing acidity. Fresh ruby port but not at all aggressive”. Stephen Tanzer, The Wine Analyst

name: Batasiolo  Moscato D'Asti Bosc D'la Rei
desc_en_short: Pale yellow. Ample and very intense with a note of overripe fruit that is the unique aroma of Moscato. This palate is pleasant and very persistent, reflecting the richness of the bouquet. The wine's characteristics are particularly enhanced when served with dry or cream desserts and fresh fruit. It may also be consumed very well on its own, at any time of the day.

name: Lungarotti  Dulcis Vino Liquoroso
desc_en_short: The colour is intense topaz, the bouquet recalls orange blossoms with a delicate scent of almond and candied fruit, it is soft on the palate, warm and delicately alcoholic with a long finish of dried apricot and fig.

name: Cantine Pellegrino  Marsala Fine Rubino (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red. The ripe red fruit, with notes of cherries and plums on aromas. This palate is sweet, warm and harmonious, with a slight aftertaste of aged wine.

name: Sutter Home  Moscato
desc_en_short: A little sweet and very likeable, it speaks of the good life. Beautifully balanced, with good acidity, the creamy peach and honeydew melon will linger on your tongue. Serve while chilled, with light cheeses, desserts, fruits, and loved ones.

name: Donnafugata  Ben Rye' Passito Di Pantelleria (750 ml)
wine_color: The color is bright golden with amber glints.
desc_en_short: A particularly positive vintage producing grapes of an exceptional quality entirely appreciable in this Ben Ryé 2009. The color is bright golden with amber glints; to the nose it shows notes of apricot, fig, date, candied citrus and Mediterranean maquis. In the mouth its sweetness is perfectly balanced by freshness and minerality. Very long aromatic persistence. A wine of great complexity, harmony and elegance, iconic of the heroic viticulture of Pantelleria. It matches with caramelized duck, foie gras and blue cheeses. It goes well with pastries and gourmet chocolate like gianduja. Extraordinary alone, as a meditation wine.

name: Torres  Floralis Moscatel Oro
desc_en_short: Moscatel has an unmistakable aromatic perspective that is highly characteristic of its variety, with seductive floral perfumes (rose, geranium, lemon verbena). On the mouth it is voluptuous, concentrated yet light, full and with a delicate sensuality. Ideal as an aperitif or dessert wine. Serve at 8ºC

name: Chateau Le Thibaut  Monbrazillac  (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Appearing golden yellow with silver highlights, this viscous dessert wine does not give off the sugary or honeyed aromas one might expect. Instead, intriguing aromas of assorted nuts, marzipan, and yellow flowers come off the glass. A taste does introduce some sweetness, but again, short of honey, and more like a marzipan or agave level of sweetness. Almonds and walnut dominate the mid-palate, and the rich, yet delicate dance between the nutty flavors and the not-too-sweetness of this wine makes it a very attractive option for dessert, especially for those who tend to avoid extremely sweet wines.

name: Dow's  10 Years Old Tawny Port
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

"10 years" indicates and average age – this Aged Tawny Port is a blend of older wines, which offer complexity and younger wines, which bring fresh fruit flavors and vibrancy. During their long maturing period in oak casks, Aged Tawnies undergo subtle color changes: the deep red hue which characterizes Port's youth gradually gives way to a paler reddish amber color. Dow's is known for its characteristically drier house style. This 10 Year has a full, nutty bouquet with citrus and vanilla accents on the palate and a soft lingering finish.

Serving Suggestions

Dow's 10 Year is bottled ready to drink after an average of at least ten years of cask aging. It has a t-cap closure, which means that you don't need a corkscrew to open it and that it will stay fresh for two to four months if stored in a cool, dark place or refrigerator. Serve it in a glass with at least a six ounce capacity so that you may appreciate the wine's aromas. Dow's 10 Year is delicious when paired with soft ripened cheeses such as a double cream cow's milk cheese, flan or fruit tarts. In warmer months, try it chilled for a refreshing dessert in a glass.

name: Dow's  20 Years Old Tawny Port
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

"20 Years" indicates and average age – this Aged Tawny Port is a blend of older wines, which offer complexity and younger wines, which bring fresh fruit flavors and vibrancy. During their long maturing period in oak casks, Aged Tawnies undergo subtle color changes: the deep red hue which characterizes Port's youth gradually gives way to a paler golden amber color. Dow's is known for its characteristically drier house style. This 20 Year has a full, nutty bouquet, concentrated, citrus, almond and caramel notes on the palate and a lingering finish. Many consider the 20 Year to be the perfect blend of complexity and vibrant fruit when it comes to Aged Tawny.

Serving suggestions

Dow's 20 Year is bottled ready to drink after an average of at least 20 years of cask aging. It has a t-cap closure, which means that you don't need a corkscrew to open it and that it will stay fresh for four to six months if stored in a cool, dark place or refrigerator. Serve it in a glass with at least a six ounce capacity so that you may appreciate the wine's aromas. Dow's 20 Year is delicious when paired with soft ripened cheeses, flan or fruit tarts. In warmer months, try it chilled for a refreshing dessert in a glass.

name: Dow's  Late Bottled Vintage Port 2013
style: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Barroca, Tinta Roriz
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short:
Dow's Late Bottled Vintage Port is a wine of a single year but it is not a "declared" Vintage Port. Whereas Vintage Port spends only two years in oak cask and then matures in bottle, LBV is aged in seasoned oak casks and then bottled, when it is between four and six years old. At the time of bottling, Dow's LBV has completed its maturation and is ready for drinking without the need for decanting.

Dow's LBV has consistently won more awards that most other LBV Ports on the market and has earned a reputation for excellence.

The nose has intense lifted aromas of wild berry fruits and floral hints exploding from the glass. Full-bodied palate with excellent dark fruit flavors such as black plums, combined with nuances of dark chocolate. Ending with a long slightly dry finish. 
Dow's Late Bottled Vintage Port pairs wonderfully with chocolate desserts and hard cheeses like aged Cheddar or creamy blue.

name: Blandy's  Verdelho "5 Years Old"
desc_en_short: Clear, topaz colour, with a golden rim. Complex nose, revealing a fresh bouquet with raisins, dried fruits, wood and spices.

name: Cantine Florio  Marsala Superiore DOC "Vecchioflorio"
wine_color: The color is amber, with golden hues.
style: Grapes White Grapes Grillo And Cataratto
desc_en_short: This marsala wine dates back to 1915: the true wine Marsala Superiore, Old Florio Dry, is the most well-known marsala wine in the world and was founded by secular experience for over 170 years by the Cantine Florio.

name: Ruffino  Moscato D'asti
desc_en_short: Ruffino Moscato d’Asti is pleasantly sweet and fragrant with distinct notes of peach and orange blossoms. This wine is perfectly tempered by the freshness of its refined bubbles. Look for hints of elderberry and wisteria along with a sweet white-fruit finish. Moscato d’Asti’s low alcohol makes it a very versatile food companion. It pairs particularly well with almost any type of dessert. A classic Italian pairing is with fresh bread, salami, figs and melon. Moscato d’Asti also tastes wonderful with spicy Asian foods.

name: Chateau d'Yquem  1 er Grand Cru Classe Exceptionnel 2007
desc_en_short: All wine lovers agree that the delightful experience of tasting Chateau d'Yquem is difficult to express in words. Yquem offers a myriad of well-balanced, complex aromas and flavour that generate even more harmonies overtime.

name: Chateau Petite Borie
desc_en_short: It is a late harvest wine, meaning the grapes are left to overripe on the vine naturally, before being harvested. Quite sweet, yet with a good acidity and freshness. Food matching with rich dishes such as foie gras. For aperitif if chilled, or as dessert wine.

name: Chateau d'Arricaud  Moelleux
desc_en_short: Nose is powerful of flowery aromas with hints of honey and dry apricot. Smooth, round and very rich. Dessert wine.

name: Masseria Li Veli  Aleatico Passito (375 ml)
food_matching: Foie Gras, Blue Cheese, Fruit Tarts, Crème Brûlée
desc_en_short: This Aleatico is a very unique “meditation wine” with an intense amber color. On the nose it is immediately evident its aromatic structure with dried and candied fruits: apricot, dates and figs. On a second level there come liquorices and coffee notes. On the palate a balsamic note of typical Mediterranean herbs and spices is very predominant, whit sage and rosemary on the top. The consistence of the wine is dense and pleasantly “greasy”.

name: 1st Night Manuka Honey Wine
desc_en_short: The nose has a delicate yet full aroma of honey and citrus. In the mouth, First Night Manuka Honey Wine has a smooth, rounded body with intense and unique manuka honey flavors dominating the palate upfront, leading to a clean and balanced finish as the acidity complements the sweet honey aftertaste.

name: Osborne  Porto Tawny
wine_color: The wine has a beautiful, bright, brown-amber color with golden highlights.
style: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Barroca, Tinta Roriz
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short: The wine has a sweet, soft, pungent taste and leaves a pleasant long aftertaste.

name: Delas  Freres Muscat De Beaumes-De-Venise (375 ml)
wine_color: The wine has a pale golden hue.
desc_en_short: The wine has a pale golden hue. The bouquet of this Muscat de Beaumes-de-Venise shows intense fruity and floral aromas. On the palate, this wine has deliciously elegant freshness. It is full-bodied without excess, and has lingering fruity aromas on a melon and lemon-tinged finish.

name: Chateau Doisy Vedrines  2em Grand Cru Classe 1993
desc_en_short: Golden-orange color, appropriate for its age; nose has minerals, flowery white fruits, with swirling much more orange and baking spice; palate is refreshing, very high acid, slight caramel, vibrant fresh orange fruit, mouthwatering, clean minerals; medium-long finish. A perfect blend of youthful vibrance and maturity, surprisingly fresh and acidic

name: Joao Portugal  Conde Vimioso Colheita
style: Touriga Nacional, Aragonez, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short: Garnet colour set. Nose shows aromas of red fruit and jam. Soft tannins give it a very balanced structure, finishing with notes of ripe fruit.

name: Joao Portugal  Duorum Port 20° Late Bottled Vintage
wine_color: Deep red colour with dense violet tones
style: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Sousão, Tinto Cão
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short: Deep red colour with dense violet tones. Intense and elegant aroma dominated by ripe black fruits like blackberries, prune and cassis, also showing some floral aromas like violets and balsamic aromas of rock-rose, resin, cedar and other exotic woods. A first perception of tertiary aromas from its evolution and age. Good volume, from its ripe tannins, its discreet acidity, well integrated in its body. These characteristics make for a very persistent, harmonious and elegant finish.

name: Ferreira Porto  Branco
wine_color: Straw yellow with green hues, clean and bright
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short: Ferreira Porto Branco, as a straw yellow colour. Aroma fresh and intense, dominated by nuances of white flowers and very ripe fruit (apricot, peach) and notes of pine nuts. It has a smooth balance between acidity and sweetness with a lingering end.

name: Ferreira Porto  Tawny
style: Touriga Franca, Touriga Nacional, Tinta Barroca, Tinto Cão, Tinta Roriz, Tinta Amarela
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short: Porto Ferreira Tawny has a bright red colour Port Wine. It presents a fresh and delicate's aroma remembering spices and nuts. This wine, on the palate, is an elegant wine with a good balance of ripe tannins and sweetness. It reveals a pleasant ending.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Tio Pepe)  Sherry "Viña Ab" (Amontillado) (375 ml)
desc_en_short: An amber Amontillado, with a pungent hazelnut aroma, soft, full-bodied and very dry. An excellent aperitif, it is also a perfect match for white meat, oily fish and mature cheeses.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Tio Pepe)  Sherry "Leonor" (Palo Cortado) (375 ml)
wine_color: Amber with gold hues and an ochre rim
food_matching: Foie Gras, Blue Cheese, Fruit Tarts, Crème Brûlée
desc_en_short: Amber with gold hues and an ochre rim. Intense, with nutty aromas (toasted almonds and hazelnuts), enveloped in notes of old wood. An intense and persistent palate with a hint of toast. Long, balanced aftertaste, and a smooth palate.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Tio Pepe)  Sherry "Alfonso" (Oloroso - Dry) (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Golden amber in colour, with intense oaky, nutty aromas. Flavoursome and harmonious, with nut flavours and a hint of vanilla, it lingers on the palate. Goes perfectly with red meat and game.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Tio Pepe)  Sherry "Cristina" (Oloroso Abocado) (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Bright amber in colour. Clean aromas with notes of raisins and wood. Slightly sweet on the palate, with a long finish. Serve between 8ºC and 10 ºC with cheese or paté

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Tio Pepe)  Sherry "Solera 1847" (Cream) (375 ml)
desc_en_short: A deep mahogany colour. Aromas of raisins, vanilla and wood. Velvety on the palate, with sweet notes of figs, raisins and a touch of caramel and wood. Ideal as an aperitif and to accompany dessert.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Tio Pepe)  Sherry "Nectar" (Px) (375 ml)
wine_color: A very dark, intense mahogany colour
desc_en_short: A very dark, intense mahogany colour. Very sweet aromas of raisins and caramel, with hints of wood. Velvety and richly sweet on the palate, it is reminiscent of aged raisins and dates, with a long, vibrant finish. A dessert in itself, it is exquisite over fruit salad or with dried fruits and nuts.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Sherries & Fino's)  Sherry "Apostoles" (Palo Cortado 30 Years) (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Dark amber in colour, with aromas of concentrated fruit. A highly complex wine, soft and intense with notes of caramel and old oak, and a very long, smooth finish. Serve with patés, cheese and red meats.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Sherries & Fino's)  Sherry "Matusalem" (Cream) (375 ml)
desc_en_short: An intense mahogany colour, with deep aromas of dried fruits, dates, raisins, spice and old Wood. Smooth and sweet in the mouth, with a long, velvety finish. Elegant, complex and concentrated on the palate. Ideal with Christmas pudding, dessert cheeses and cakes.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Sherries & Fino's)  Sherry "Noe" (Px) (375 ml)
desc_en_short: A deep, thick ebony colour. Warm aromas of raisins and notes of roast coffee beans and spices. Very sweet, fresh and silky on the palate. A perfect dessert wine for drinking on its own, over vanilla ice-cream or with dark chocolate.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Sherries & Fino's)  Fino 1 Palma (500 ml)
wine_color: Pale golden colour with green tones.
food_matching: Foie Gras, Blue Cheese, Fruit Tarts, Crème Brûlée
desc_en_short: Pale golden colour with green tones. Clean and Bright. A sharp yet delicate nose showing its pirest state. Aromas with dried nuts and camomile, with saltiness and mineral notes from the albariza. On the mouth extremely dry with character, balanced, fresh, and persistent.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Sherries & Fino's)  Fino 2 Palmas (500 ml)
food_matching: Foie Gras, Blue Cheese, Fruit Tarts, Crème Brûlée
desc_en_short: Bright gold with green highlights and an intense, pungent nose. Because of its age, more aromas emerge from the oxidative than the biological aging. On the palate it is powerful, and slightly unctuous. Tart and salty.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Sherries & Fino's)  Fino 3 Palmas (500 ml)
wine_color: Old gold in colour, with green highlights.
desc_en_short: Old gold in colour, with green highlights. Very intense and pungent on the nose, revealing noticeable hints of oak. On the palate it is harmonious and full-bodied, dry, elegant, flavoursome and with a long finish. This wine might be described as a fino amontillado.

name: Gonzalez Byass Winery (Sherries & Fino's)  Fino 4 Palmas (Amontillado) (500 ml)
wine_color: Medium to dark mahogany in colour
food_matching: Foie Gras, Blue Cheese, Fruit Tarts, Crème Brûlée
desc_en_short: Medium to dark mahogany in colour, with chestnut highlights and a green meniscus. Very intense aromas, reminiscent of cedar, tobacco and antique furniture. On the palate is has a spectacular structure, and an acidity that blends superbly with the oak aromas.

name: Osborne  Fino Quinta Sherry
wine_color: pale gold colour and green sparkles at the rim
style: Palomino Fino. A Selection Of The Finest Palomino Grapes From The Best Pagos Of The Sherry Triangle
desc_en_short: “One of the most iconic Osborne brands. For more than 50 years, Fino Quinta has brought to people around the world the authentic spirit and flavour of the south of Spain. Pungent, fresh and extremely delicate wine”

name: Caprice de Bastor-Lamontagne  Sauternes
desc_en_short: The attack is round and smooth on the palate. The wine is fine, elegant, and supported by a great freshness: an harmonious balance between sweetness and acidity. An incredible length.

name: Santa Carolina  "Late Harvest" (Sweet) (500 ml)
desc_en_short: This Late Harvest is characterized by its bright yellow color. The nose opens up with elegant aromas like white peaches, citrus and honeysuckles. It has intense flavor and a silky palate. Elegant and complex wine with a well balanced acidity and a long lingering finish.

name: Met  Honey Wine (700 ml)
food_matching: Foie Gras, Blue Cheese, Fruit Tarts, Crème Brûlée
desc_en_short: A delicious honey wine produced by the fermentation of pure bee-honey. Even in Nordic mythology, the Met was the favourite drink of the gods. Just try a sip and you'll understand. This Bavarian mead is made according to a traditional recipe from our home and bottled with a modern label.

name: Livio Felluga  Picolit 2011 (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Intense golden yellow, varietal, elegant, with great character, intense notes of candied fruits, pastries, apricot and fig integrated to aromas of orange blossom, acacia honey and elegant spices. a wine with a great complexity; soft, savory, articulate, with balanced acidity and sweetness.

name: Poggio Al Tesoro - (Bolgheri)  Teos Passito IGT
desc_en_short: Teos, the ancient Greek city dedicated to Dionysus, is the name of this sweet wine by Poggio al Tesoro. Allegrini’s expertise in the appassimento technique has inspired the creation of this Petit Manseng made with partially dried grapes.

name: Velenosi  Querciantica Visciole (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Ruby red with amaranthine shades. Quite soft in the mouth, Enthralling, right body good flavour and acidity. Perfect with cherry, sour cherry tarts and pies.

name: Castello Di Bossi  Vin San Laurentino IGT (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Classic with its luminous, amber color. On the nose, the notes of dry figs and dry prunes open to those of almonds and hazelnuts, followed by tamarind and ending with the spicy hints of cloves and cinnamon. Mouth-filling palate. Creamy but not sugary, because vibrant and fresh-tasting. Very long finish with a fruity aftertaste.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Moscato D'Asti Nivole
desc_en_short: Brilliant straw yellow. Floral, typical aromas of Moscato, with notes of peach and apricot taste: creamy, fragrant, with a pleasant fine bubble and a finish which is particularly fresh.

name: Ornus dell Ornellaia  Toscana IGT 2017 (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Ornus dell’Ornellaia was inspired by passion for our terroir and by the desire to explore its potential in producing great sweet wines, favoured by the typically mild and particularly breezy autumn in Bolgheri. Ornus dell’Ornellaia 2017, with its typical bright golden-yellow colour, develops refined scents of bitter almond and dry apricot to the nose. The first impression on the palate is soft and enveloping and the acidic vein typical of Petit Manseng gives length and verticality to the finish.

name: Monemvasia	 Malvasia (375 ml)
desc_en_short: The naturally sweet wine Monemvasia-Malvasia was created with passion, persistence, and care. Amber-colored with golden shades, intense aromas and complexity with elements of dry fruit, caramel, nuts, and coconut. The concentrated sweetness of its flavor and the subtle tannins and distinctive high acidity are in perfect balance on the palate. Its aftertaste is delicious and lasting, as is its fascinating story.

name: Graham’s Blend No 5 White Port Meio Seco
grape_variety: Touriga Nacional, Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz
desc_en_short: A fresh, floral, and elegant white port crisp in structure, expressive in aroma, and lightly sweet.

name: I Veroni Vin Santo Del Chianti Rufina Riserva DOC (375 ml)
desc_en_short: A luxurious and traditional Italian dessert wine with rich dried fruit, honey, and nutty complexity—intense, elegant, and beautifully balanced.

name: AN EXCLUSIVE WINE DINNER INTRODUCING LES LICORNES DE CANTENAC BROWN - MARGAUX @EMILIA RISTORANTE  ITALIANO (28 NOVEMBER 2025)
desc_en_short:
La Soirée des Licornes – An Exclusive Wine Dinner with Château Cantenac Brown

Prepare for an unforgettable wine journey as we unveil Les Licornes de Cantenac Brown in Thailand for the very first time — the elegant second label from one of Margaux’s most iconic Grand Cru Classé estates (3rd Growth of the 1855 Classification).

Wine Highlights:
– Les Licornes de Cantenac Brown 2016 (Official debut in Thailand)
– Alto de Cantenac Brown (A refined white wine from the same estate)
– Château Cantenac Brown 2006 & 2020 (Special vertical tasting from two standout vintages)

Venue: Emilia Ristorante Italiano, 1st Floor, Gaysorn Tower

Date: 28 November 2025

Time: 18:30–21:00

Price: THB 3,900 per person (limited to 15 exclusive guests)

*** Complimentary access available with the purchase of 6 bottles (Les Licornes de Cantenac Brown 2016 or Marquis de Lascombes Margaux 2016)

Join us for a refined evening of storytelling and sensory discovery — where Margaux’s legendary terroir is brought to life through a curated wine-pairing dinner and expert-guided tasting experience.

Presented by DAD (Double A Distribution) — official importer and distributor in Thailand.

name: Joseph Mellot Tasting Day @Wine Empire (22 NOVEMBER 2025)
desc_en_short:
Joseph Mellot Tasting Day – A Prestigious Loire Valley Wine Experience

Step into the refined world of Joseph Mellot, one of the Loire Valley’s most historic and revered wine estates with over 500 years of winemaking legacy. Join us for an exclusive tasting event led by Mr. Patrick Tsu, Export Director of Joseph Mellot, who will guide you through the estate’s signature Sauvignon Blancs and rare Sancerre expressions.

Discover the elegance and terroir-driven character of the Upper Loire as you explore 5 specially selected cuvées — from crisp and vibrant Pouilly-Fumé to the iconic mineral-rich Sancerre that defines the house style.

Wine Highlights:

2023 Joseph Mellot Sincérité

2023 Joseph Mellot Sancerre La Chatellenie

2023 Joseph Mellot Pouilly-Fumé Le Troncsec

2022 Joseph Mellot Sancerre La Grande Chatellenie

2020 Joseph Mellot L’Original Sancerre Rouge

Venue: Wine Empire

Date: 22 November 2025

Time: 14:00

Ticket Price: 990 THB (Net per seat) Limited to 12–14 seats only

This is a rare opportunity to meet the export director in person and delve into the stories, soils, and savoir-faire of one of France’s most iconic Sauvignon Blanc producers. Whether you're a wine connoisseur or an enthusiastic learner, this tasting will leave your palate elevated and inspired.

*** Complimentary access available with the Purchase any Joseph Mellot 3,000 THB Get 1 ticket

** Reserve your seat now and be part of a journey through the heart of Loire.

name: Chateau Siran Wine dinner @Lyon French Restaurant (18 NOVEMBER 2025)
desc_en_short:
Château Siran Wine Dinner – An Exclusive Vertical Tasting Evening

Step into a refined evening of Bordeaux excellence as we welcome Mr. Edouard Miailhe, the proprietor of Château Siran, for a rare vertical wine dinner in Bangkok. Discover the depth, elegance, and evolution of this prestigious Margaux estate through three iconic vintages, expertly paired with a fine French dining experience.

Featured Vintages:

Château Siran 2015 – A structured vintage from a warm, classic year

Château Siran 2017 – Expressive and refined with Margaux’s signature charm

Château Siran 2020 – The latest vintage, vibrant and full of promise

This evening is more than a tasting — it's a journey through time, terroir, and tradition, led by the very hands that shape the estate’s legacy.

Date: November 18, 2025

Time: 18:30

Venue: Lyon French Restaurant

Presented by: Wine Diva

Don’t miss this rare opportunity to meet the family behind one of Margaux’s most beloved estates, and to taste side-by-side the evolution of its wines in an elegant and intimate setting.

name: La Paulee de Bangkok 2025 @Grand Ballroom, Anantara Siam Bangkok Hotel (28 NOVEMBER 2025)
desc_en_short:
La Paulée de Bangkok 2025

Burgundy Wine Symposium: A Celebration of Passion and Pouring Journeys

Join us for an elegant and convivial evening at La Paulée de Bangkok—the grandest Burgundy wine gathering of the year in Thailand. This exclusive celebration brings together wine collectors, importers, producers, and Burgundy enthusiasts to share their passion in true French spirit.

Experience a rich tapestry of Burgundy wines from diverse terroirs and appellations, paired with exquisite cuisine in a European-style contemporary dinner setting. In the true tradition of La Paulée, guests are encouraged to open and pour their favorite bottles to share among friends and fellow Burgundy lovers—celebrating the camaraderie and generosity that define this cherished wine ritual.

 

Date: Friday, 28th November 2025

Time: From 6:00 PM

Venue: Grand Ballroom, Anantara Siam Bangkok Hotel

 

Our Menu for the Event

 

Appetizer: Tuna and Salmon Tartar with Fennel, Green Apple, Horseradish Curd and Ginger Soy Vinaigrette

 

Soup: Mushroom Cappuccino with Crispy Chorizo

 

Entrée: Pan-Seared Duck Breast Glazed with Honey, Gratin Potatoes, Turnips and Carrot-Cardamom Emulsion

 

Dessert: Cheese and Nuts

 

*** Bring Your Own Bottle – Celebrate the Spirit of Burgundy

In true La Paulée tradition, this event is a Bring Your Own Bottle (BYOB) Burgundy wine celebration. Guests are warmly encouraged to bring their favorite bottle of Burgundy wine—whether a cherished Grand Cru or a personal discovery—to share and pour with fellow Burgundy lovers throughout the evening.

This spirit of generosity, sharing, and discovery lies at the heart of La Paulée. It is not just a dinner, but a celebration of wine culture, community, and conviviality.

Whether you're a passionate collector or a curious explorer, your bottle adds to the unique mosaic of stories and flavors that define this unforgettable night.

** If you have any dietary restrictions or food allergies, please kindly let us know.

 

* Limited seats available

name: A Sunset Winery Journey @Sirimahannop Asiatique The Riverfront (22 NOVEMBER 2025)
desc_en_short:
A Sunset Winery Journey – Discover Escudo Rojo with Chief Winemaker Gonzalo Castro

Join us for a golden-hour wine tasting event featuring the elegant wines of Escudo Rojo, the prestigious Chilean label founded by the legendary Baron Philippe de Rothschild. Set against the backdrop of a riverfront sunset at Sirimahannop, this exclusive evening invites wine lovers to explore the harmony between Chilean terroir and French winemaking know-how.

Meet the Maker
Gonzalo Castro – Chief Winemaker of Escudo Rojo – will personally guide guests through the stories, styles, and signature blends of the house.

Wines Served

WHITE
– Escudo Rojo Gran Reserva Chardonnay

RED
– Escudo Rojo Gran Reserva
– Escudo Rojo Origine
– Baronesa P.

Paired with Four Perfect Canapés

Venue: Sirimahannop, Asiatique The Riverfront
Date: Saturday, 22nd November 2025
Time: 16.00 – 18.00 hrs

This is your chance to meet the winemaker, sip across the Escudo Rojo range, and experience the magic of sunset wine tasting.

name: Saint-Emilion Grand Cru Classe Vertical Wine Dinner @TYME 4th Floor INN A DAY (Tue 17 March 2026)
desc_en_short:
SAINT-EMILION GRAND CRU CLASSE VERTICAL WINE DINNER

Featuring Chateau de Ferrand Saint-Emilion Grand Cru Classe with special pouring of Le Different

A guided tasting of six red wines from Saint-Emilion, hosted by Steven - Sales Director, Chateau de Ferrand

TUE 17 Mar 2026

TIME : 18.00-20.00 PM.

AT : TYME 4th Floor INN A DAY

WINE PARING

- Le Different 2019
- Chateau de Ferrand 2012
- Chateau de Ferrand 2014
- Chateau de Ferrand 2015
- Chateau de Ferrand 2016

Dress code : Burgandy / Black

name: Billabong  Red wine (De-Alcoholised)
food_matching: Charcuterie, Salmon, Mushroom Dishes, Soft Cheese
desc_en_short: Billabong Wines produce a red blend here that has been dealcoholised the remove the alcohol. Due to this process, the full-bodied nature of the wine is retained giving a great red wine experience without the accompanying alcohol.

name: Billabong  White (De-Alcoholised)
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Delicate Riesling aromas, mingle with Muscat flavours to give a wine of medium vinosity and palate. This is aclever wine that has a unique way of drying on the tongue. Exceptionally enjoyable for those whom prefer the wine a little drier than just a medium vinosity. This is a fantastic wine if you are used to cooking with wines, no alcohol, half the calories, a weight watchers delight.

name: Billabong  Brut (De-Alcoholised)
food_matching: Oysters, Caviar, Fried Foods, Appetizers, Celebration
desc_en_short: Billabong sparkling wine comes with a nimble floral nose and of medium/dry vinosity. A family celebration drink, perfect for all circumstances. Toast the good health on a festive occasion.  This is by far the very best non-alcoholic sparkling wine available today. It is so good, you would find it hard to tell the difference Made from an alcohol product. Children and young teenagers love the taste and parents particularly are worry free at family celebrated occasions.

name: Michelini brothers  Via Revolucionaria Torrontes Brutal D.O.
desc_en_short: This 100% Torrontes is open top macerated/fermented and oak aged, A different style of Torrontes, the wine punches through the glass with notes of peach, apricot, and bright stargazer lily’s and undertones of sage, chamomile,and sandalwood. It has a lifted profile on the palate with bright acid, citrus notes of lemon merengue, and jasmine.

name: Radikon  Jakot Friulano Bianco IGT (500 ml)
wine_color: Golden, vibrant orange in the glass.
food_matching: Rich Seafood, Spiced Dishes, Asian Cuisine, Aged Cheese
desc_en_short: Full and dense with fine round tannins. More tangerine, red apple skin, iron and citrusy acidity carries the long finish. More powerful than Oslavje but more focused than Ribolla. Delicious

name: Radikon  Vino Bianco Pinot Grigio IGT
desc_en_short: Complex, persistent with hints of ripe red fruits like cherry in particular. Full, persistant and savory at the same time slightly tannic, elegant and mineral. At the aftertaste you perceive hints of berries.

name: Radikon  Vino Bianco Slatnik IGT
desc_en_short: Made with 80% Chardonnay and 20% Friulano, this amber-colored wine boast more fruits richness than many other wines from the orange wine movement. Loaded with ripe apricot, candied citrus zest, dried herbs and crushed stone, this is brightened by lively acidity on the palate. A perfect introduction to the genre.

name: Radikon  Jakot IGT (500 ml)
desc_en_short: Orange yellow, bright and rich. The nose reveals intense aromas, with hints of almond and dehydrated fruit and some herbaceous notes. wide tasting, well balanced, fresh before a closure of infinite persistence on almond notes.

name: Radikon  Ribolla Gialla IGT (500 ml)
food_matching: Rich Seafood, Spiced Dishes, Asian Cuisine, Aged Cheese
desc_en_short: This was maybe the best bottle of Radikon Orange wine I have ever had. Had a apricot skin color in the glass and celestial, I kid you not, celestial aromas of brown sugar, red-Pinot-like fruit, minerals and stone fruit skins. The palate has dazzling babbling brook-like minerality along with stellar concentration, great delineation and a long fruit-soaked finish.

name: Radikon  Oslavje IGT (500 ml)
wine_color: yellow-orange wine with bright golden reflections.
desc_en_short: Radikon's Oslavje is a yellow-orange wine with bright golden reflections. The nose offers an intense and complex bouquet, in which the notes of peach and apricot alternate with elegant hints of dried fruit. In the mouth it is full and long, pleasantly sapid and elegant.

name: 2Naturkinder  Weinschwärmer
desc_en_short: Weinschwärmer from 2Naturkinder is named after the moth that lives around the vineyards, a delicacy for the local bats. The cuvée is made of 75% Pinot Gris and 25% Riesling. The first one is destemmed and fermented 1 week on the skins, whilst the second one is pressed directly. The outcome in the 2018 vintage is rather elegant and fresh. Peach aromas and the tiny oxidative note bring this orange to the next level!

name: Primosic  Pinot Grigio "Skin" (Orange wine)
wine_color: The intense coppery color is due to the fermentation on the coppery skins of the Pinot Gris.
desc_en_short: An “orange wine” with an intense coppery color, made with one week of fermentation in open vats in contact with the skins of overripe Pinot Grigio grapes. Powerful and complex, rich, this Pinot Pinot Grigio shows that it is not typically a white wine. Not to be confused with a rosé!

name: Santa Julia  Cuy Orange Natural Wine
wine_color: Golden yellow of great intensity with orange tones typical of its elaboration.
desc_en_short: It is a wine that stands out for its floral aromas. It presents aromas of tropical white fruits, It closes with aromas of orange peel. Its acidity is refreshing and bold, of medium intensity, long and of good acidity and freshness

name: Chateau La Tour L'Eveque Pétale de Rose Rosé AOP
desc_en_short: This delicate wine should be drunk around 14°C. Lovely for the aperitif. It is also a perfect match for white sauces, fish dishes, smoked salmon, soufflés and Asian cooking.

name: Gran Sasso  Montepulciano D' Abruzzo Cerasuolo DOC
desc_en_short: A Wine of Abruzzo,Italy By Gran Sasso. Made from grape combination of 100% Montepulciano. Vibrant cherry pink in colour with a lovely fragrance of cherries and strawberries with a touch of Mediterranean maquis. On the palate it is fresh and clean, with enough structure and acidity to support the fruit and keep it fresh to the finish.

name: PB Valley  PB Reserve Rose
desc_en_short: Fruit-driven along with suggestions of pineapple, peach, apple with a touch of mild red berries, surprisingly crisp on palate. The sweetness of its aroma together with the refreshing acid followed by a clean finish.

name: Callia  Alta Rose Shiraz
desc_en_short: It's color is pink intensidad media, seduces at first sight to be bright and great fear vivacity. With tropical fruit aromas and very scored in the forest. The palate is emphasizes freshness and balance, with great acid balance, which it mulled wine a harmonic ago, nice and refreshing.

name: Bodegas Salentein  Portillo Rose Malbec
desc_en_short: Highly aromatic, this inviting wine with its ruby red hints offers aromas of roses and red fruits such as cherry, strawberry and raspberry. The finish is crisp, refreshing and well-balanced. Drink on its own or enjoy with salads, seafood dishes and pizza.

name: Chateau Mas Neuf  Rhone Paradox Rose
wine_color: Soft Pink Colour, With Sky Coloured Highlights
desc_en_short: 87 points in Wine Advocate. Soft pink colour, with sky coloured highlights. On the nose, a balance of fresh strawberries with notes of tarragon and fennel. Uplifting on the palate with the same range of small red berries (strawberry, raspberry) and beautiful lingering flavours.

name: Garofoli  Komaros Marche, IGT Marche Rose
Batasiolo  Piemonte Rose Rosato
wine_color: A delicate pink color, clear and bright.
desc_en_short: Langhe Rose presented by Batasiolo from Italy. Wine with a delicate pink color, clear and bright. The nose offers floral and fruity scents of good elegance, intensity and persistence. On the palate is good acidity and, together, pleasing roundness with notes of fresh fruit, cherries, strawberries and raspberries.

name: Antares  Cabernet Sauvignon Rose
wine_color: a lively pink colour of medium intensity
desc_en_short: A wine with a lively pink colour of medium intensity, its aromas are intense, characterised by citric notes which combine perfectly with intense red fruit flavours such as strawberries and raspberries. On the palate the wine is fresh and silky and has a lovely finish. Ideal to serve as an aperitif or to accompany fish, fresh salads or grilled white meats.

name: Churchview  Silverleaf Rose
style: Blends White Grape Varieties With Red, Creating A Soft Pink Hue And Additional Flavours.
desc_en_short: Strawberries and Rasberries on the nose lead into a fresh fruity palate with hints of cranberries. A refreshing style of rose made in the Churchview House style.

name: E. Michel  Rose
desc_en_short: E. Michels Rosé Champagne is in very good salmon colored and with fine small bubbles in the glass. The fragrance features shades of dried fig and sun-ripened cherries. The taste is creamy and fruity colors. Serve well chilled in sleek champagne glass, either as a luxurious welcome or festival, or to accompany dishes with fish, shellfish, like poultry or pork. Do not forget to put an extra bottle in the fridge!

name: Estrella  White Zinfandel
desc_en_short: This beautifully colored and well balanced White Zinfandel has intense aromas and flavors of strawberry and melon with layers of honeysuckle, peach, and apricot in the background.

name: Pol Roger  Rose
style: Pinot Noir, 35% Chardonnay And 15% Is Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: "A delicate, soft pink with Pol Roger's hallmark fine mousse. The nose is fresh, lively and fruity. First impression are of red fruits, strawberry and raspberry, with a fresh but lingering bouquet. This is followed by warmer notes of wheat and dried cereals. Powerful and vinous in the mouth, the wine develops a fleshy texture underpinned by a firm backbone promising a long life."  Laurant D'Harcourt  (Pol Roger's Export manager)

name: Terra Antica  Grenache / Niellucciu
desc_en_short: Crisp and fresh with vibrant flavours of red currant, grenadine and rose buds. Light-bodied, fresh easy-to-drink Rosé wine.

name: Chateau de la Roulerie
desc_en_short: The bouquet is showing straightforward raspberries, strawberry and watermelon flavors and aromas, shaded with a hint of rainwater. Food pairing Can be drunk on its own or with light meals.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Pins Couches Rose
desc_en_short: This blend of Syrah and Mourvèdre offers an elegant, dry Rosé with spices and freshness at the same time. Perfect pairing for grilled sardines or as simply as an aperitif at a café terrace by the water’s edge!

name: Bottega  Spumante Rose
wine_color: Brilliant with fine and lasting perlage. Rose-colored
desc_en_short: Dry, soft, fresh and lively with intense flowery touches and a pleasant persistent aftertaste. Good as an aperitif, it goes particularly well with starters, first courses and fish

name: Nua  Rose Brut
style: Local Grapes Grow In The Production Area Or Erbaluce, Piedmont Region
desc_en_short: Bright scintillating rosè. Open, broad and intense aroma. Well-balanced, sapid and harmonic on the palate. Indicated as aperitif; It is perfect with fish dishes and hard cheeses

name: Laurent Miquel  Cinsault Syrah
desc_en_short: Harvesting in the cool air of the night time retains a superb crisp freshness to the Cinsault and Syrah grapes used in this delicious rosé. Full-flavoured and generous in style, there's plentiful raspberry and vibrant red cherry fruit on this Southern French gem. Perfect as an apéritif, it will also make a delightful accompaniment to lightly-spiced Asian dishes or even fresh fruit salads.

name: Delheim Pinotage Rose (Screw Cap)
desc_en_short: In the glass we see the Pinotage Rosé in a bright rose pink and seductive scent of strawberries, raspberries and some cassis. On the palate the wine impressed with his vigorous expression of his strength and his discreet fruit, almost tingly acidity. The disposal of Delheim Pinotage Rosé is long, fresh and fruity!

name: Ata Rangi  Rose Summer
desc_en_short: Light candyfloss pink, with peach hues. The nose is tight with delicate stonefruits, redcurrants herbs and quince, quite mouthwatering. Dry to taste, delicate red florals, redcurrants and herb flavours feature. The mouthfeel is light, lacy and fine, the phenolics leave the palate thirst-quenchingly dry. There's lively acidity and balance, and its subtlety is reminiscent of Provencal rosé.

name: Miguel Torres  Hemisferio Cabernet Sauvignon-Rose
desc_en_short: Cherry colour. Perfumed notes of plum and strawberry with hints of grapefruit. Full-bodied with fine acidity on the palate. Elegant and sensual with a prolonged aftertaste. Excellent as an aperitif or with cured meats such as ham, sausages and salami, and many pasta and vegetable dishes. Superb with Asian cuisine.

name: Miguel Torres  Tormenta Rose
desc_en_short: Delicate, sleek cherry colour. Fresh aroma reminiscent of red and black fruits. Intense palate with delicate acidity. Fresh, lingering aftertaste.

name: Lion's Cape  Coastal Rose' Cabernet Sauvignon (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

This is a light to medium bodied wine with a crisp acidity and a lingering finish. Red berries and citrus combined with some passion fruit

name: Chateau Cavalier  AOC Cotes de Provance
style: Grenache, 30% Syrah, 25% Cinsault, Cabernet, Mourvedre, Carignan
desc_en_short: Salmon-pink in color,with an appealing bouquet of fruits and florals. A hint of pepper in the background. Nicely rounded and supple on the palate with the tanginess of red berries and citrus fruit, particularly lemon and grapefruit. Good balance.

name: Sutter Home  White Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Refreshing White Zinfandel wine flirts with your tongue, as you taste essences of strawberry and melon. Perfect with all types of food, we recommend pairing it with something a little spicy such as Asian or Latin cuisine.

name: Sycamore Lane  White Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Sycamore Lane is a classic White Zinfandel, boasting attractive aromas of strawberries and watermelon; with light fruity flavors and a touch of cream. A versatile food pairing with seafood, poultry dishes, spicy Mexican, Thai and Chinese cuisine, and BBQ fare.

name: Chateau Saint-Maur  Cotes de Provence
wine_color: A fine, sparkling colour, of a slightly salmoned rosé.
style: Grenache, Syrah, Cinsaut, Carignan, Mourvedre, Rolle, Cabernet.
desc_en_short: A fine, sparkling colour, of a slightly salmoned rosé. An evocative nose, without restraint, with citrus (lemon, clementine) and floral aromas (wild tulip, poppy). A wine with a fine freshness, full-bodied, rich and round at the same time, with an acidulous and amylic finish.

name: Radio Boca  Rose
desc_en_short: Tune yourself into the latest broadcast of a 100% Spanish wine. This delicious Rosé is a mouth full of big Spanish fruit. Sweet wild strawberry, mouth-watering raspberries and an exciting hint of lavender will have you talking non stop.

name: Bolla  Bardolino Chiaretto DOC
desc_en_short: Corvina contributes to giving body to the wine, Rondinella shows the typical herbaceous scent while the other vines provide freshness, smoothness and tastiness. An excellent bright Chiaretto; an intense and fragrant perfume with notes of marasca cherry jam; dry to the palate without excesses.

name: Delas  Tavel "La Comballe"
wine_color: A very pure and pale pink that just shows a hint of orange.
desc_en_short: The colour is a very pure and pale pink that just shows a hint of orange. To the nose fruit aromas evolve with some touches of soft, stony fruit and a whiff of toasted almonds. The palate is attractively rounded, pleasantly fruity, and lifted by hints of spice.

name: Domaine de la Mordorée  Vin de France "La Remise" Rose
desc_en_short:
Deep pink, slightly orange color typical of Mordoree rose wines. Aromas of crystallized oranges and cherries, hints of aniseed. Very round palate, fresh and a long finish.
Pairs well with cold meats, poultry, white meats, grilled lamb with Provence herbs, fish soup, fried fish, pastas, pizzas and all Asian dishes.

name: Silverlake  S Series Rose
desc_en_short:
*Made from Australian Grapes and handcrafted in Thailand.

Sophisticate touched by a dry Shiraz Rose with delicate fruit. Vibrant pink in color, its aromas express cut flowers and candy that make it perfect for our tropical climate.

name: Moncigale  Grapefruit Rose Wine (Fruit wine blend)
style: Our Delicious Mix Of Rose Wine And Grapefruit Juice
desc_en_short: Fruits and Wine, the fruit of a unique recipe from the expertise of our Marie Brizard master disiller who is able to combine wine and fruits in  a perfect, balanced blened for an exceptional and fruity flavor profile. The secret of our original mixes rests in the use of juices and fruit infusions - it makes all the difference.

name: Sacha Lichine  Le Poussin Rose
desc_en_short: This wine combines the best of French winemaking Know-How with modern winemaking technology.Low temperature pre-fermentation. Gentle extraction and pumping-over. Vatting time: 12 to 18 days. Pale pink and gray color. Floral scents. Lots of fruits, soft tannins. Fresh, bold, alive and smooth. Try it with a tuna steak and black olives, or simply as an aperitif.

name: Black Oak  White Zinfandel
desc_en_short: The Black Oak White Zinfandel shines pink and pretty.  Lovely perfume aromas that remind one of ripe melons, honeysuckle in summer, and cherry blossoms in spring.  The flavors are bright and delicately sweet, with a very good balance of fresh acidity that lightens up the complex texture.  The succulent flavors are of juicy tangerine, white peaches and just picked strawberries.  All this with an additional hint of lemon-lime and sass that make this a very approachable and fun wine selection.  Enjoy chilled with friends.

name: Innovate  Pink Moscato
desc_en_short: This wine has slight musk aromas with fruity flavours of fresh strawberry, apple and notes finishing with a light fizz. Enjoy this wine now and serve it well chilled.

name: Jacob's Creek  Classic Shiraz Rose (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
A lusicous palate of spicy cherry with a hint of fruit sweetness.

Wine Score : 86 POINTS, Jane Faulkner - winecompanion.com (Aug-18)

Award : BLUE GOLD, Sydney International Wine Competition 2018

name: Ca’Dei Frati Rosa Dei Frati Riviera Del Garda Classico
desc_en_short: Fresh, delicate and incisive at the same time; the nose has notes of hawthorn, green apple, white almond and wild cherry.

name: Gazela  Vinho Verde Rose
desc_en_short: Raspberry pink in color, with a slight prickle of fizz that emphasises its bouquet of red fruits (strawberries) and tropical fruits (banana). In the mouth it is lively and fresh, intense in flavor and well balanced, the overall impression being of lightness and freshness, with an elegant finish.

name: Terra Franca  Rose
desc_en_short: It has a rosy-raspberry hue and an intense bouquet, with notes of red fruits, especially raspberry and strawberry, as well as of tropical fruits such as banana. In the mouth it has an intense and balanced flavour, a feeling of lightness and freshness with a very elegant finish.

name: Herdade Do Peso  Vinha Do Monte Rose
desc_en_short: Pink, strawberry-colored tones. The notes is an intense aroma of blackberry, cut grass and some spices. On the plalate there is nice body and a well balanced finish.

name: Domaine Houchart  Cotes de Provence A.O.C
desc_en_short: Salmon pink in color. Strawberries, red berrie. Lively and fresh, with citrus fruit aromas and plenty of fulness. Perfect drink with seafood, fish or cheese soufflés.

name: Terre Siciliane  Joyful Rose IGT
desc_en_short: This sparkling rosé wine is a pale pink color reminiscent of the pomegranate peel, accompanied by a pleasantly fine and persistent effervescence. The nose is full of aromas of wild strawberries and raspberries, enriched with fresh notes of smoky rose and aromatic herbs. On the palate it is broad and soft, with a nice freshness. Excellent to accompany pizza and all tomato-based preparations, it goes well with fish crudités.

name: Dreissigacker  Pinot & Co Rose
desc_en_short: Beautiful refreshing nose with strawberry, cherry and spices. On the palate, light and fruity with good mineral backend. Smooth body and lively acid with good middle long finish.

name: Domaine Attilon  Pinot Noir Rose IGP
desc_en_short: The vintage 2014, new in the range, Black Pinot grapes generally used in the north of France, have adapted well to the sunny climate of the south. Tasty Rosé, greedy, lively at the same time, salmon color, vibrant cherry flavor on the palate, acacia and caramel on the finish.

name: Angove  Nine Vines Grenache Shiraz Rose
desc_en_short: Bright pink: an early picked blend of grenache and shiraz with a fragrant bouquet of strawberry and raspberry, the palate providing a replay via its display of juicy fruit; it's not complex, purity being its game. One of the most reliable roses on the market.

name: Valestrel  Cotes de Provence
desc_en_short: The wines are vinified at low temperature, depending on the yeast used. Once fermentation is completed, we age the wine on the gross lees or fine lees according to the potential of each vat. Malolactic fermenation is systematically prevented in order to retain as much freshness and tension in the wines as possible.

name: Zardetto  Private Rose
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi
desc_en_short: pink color with a wide and aromatic aroma with remarkable currant and marasca cherry hints. The taste has a good acidity and a pleasant and velvety tannin component.

name: Torres  Vina Esmeralda Rose
desc_en_short: Pale, ephemeral pink in color. Delicate, subtle aroma of confected rose and fruit (banana), The palate is light, airy, with an elegant citrus finish.

name: Cape Mentelle  Rose
wine_color: Bright and shiny watermelon juice colour
desc_en_short: Cape Mentelle Rosé is a fresh, vibrant expression of the traditional dry rosé style. Our 2017 vintage Rosé is a blend of shiraz, grenache, tempranillo and sangiovese. A combination of direct pressing and saignée methods deliver delicate, fresh aromas and colour. Framed by generous fruit and a refreshing acidity, it makes for a perfect summer beverage to be shared with friends

name: Poggio Al Tesoro - (Bolgheri)  Cassiopea Rosato DOC
desc_en_short: The Bolgheri area has a fine tradition of producing rosé wines, a practice which has almost been abandoned over the past twenty years, yet is capable of expressing, as in the case of Cassiopea, an intense and fragrant spiciness as well as an aroma of woodland berries. Its litheness and agility on the palate make it an ideal aperitif wines.

name: AOP Corbieres St. Felix De Castelmaure Rose
desc_en_short: This wine is aromatically fresh with cut strawberry and melon aromas with floral notes. The palate is vibrant ripe berry fruit, hints of stone and smoke, and a kiss of fresh mint.

name: Sutil  Reserve Cabernet Rose
wine_color: Light pink in color with a slightly orangish hue.
desc_en_short: Light pink in color with a slightly orangish hue. This wine has tremendous aromatic intensity and offers aromas of fresh red fruits such as white strawberries and raspberries along with floral notes recalling rose petals and acacia, plus some herbal notes. The refreshing palate presents fresh red-fruit flavors with a long, crisp finish.

name: Pink de Kressman  Bordeaux Rose AOC
desc_en_short: PINK DE KRESSMANN is as lively as its colour would suggest. Aromas of hawthorn and redcurrant on the bouquet, accompanied by zesty notes. Well-balanced on the finish, with abundant freshness. Enjoy as an aperitif with tapas and canapes, salad, fresh seafood platter, barbecues, exotic dishes and red-fruit based desserts

name: Mirabeau  Forever Summer Rosé
wine_color: A beautiful pale pink Rosé with luminous colour
desc_en_short: "Pale pink in colour, and boasting an elegant, summer fruit hit, balanced by peach and citrus notes. With all the moreishness of the dry rosés from the region, it’s elegant on the palate and a great food companion." - AFFINITY MAGAZINE

name: Mirabeau  Classic Provence Rosé
desc_en_short: A luminous pink colour with lavish aromas, expressive red summer fruit remains the essence of this bestselling rosé. Mirabeau Classic has a beautiful concentration, with raspberry, strawberry and redcurrant flavours taking centre stage, all finely balanced by refreshing acidity. A perfect aperitif for an alfresco moment, it’s also structured enough to accompany flavoursome food. Feel free to drink it as we do in Provence, anytime and with almost anything!.

name: Aliaga  Lagrima Garnacha Rose
wine_color: Raspberry pink, very clean and bright.
desc_en_short: Raspberry pink, very clean and bright. Red floral and fruity scent. Well balanced, fresh and smells of flowers. It has a long and soft taste in the mouth. Known as the best rosé. There are many flavor awards. It has been selected over the years.

name: Maison de Grand Esprit  L'Etre Magique Cotes De Provence Rose
desc_en_short: Complex, elegant and restrained, our Côtes de Provence 2016. Displays refined cherry, raspberry and strawberry fruit flavours creating a silky, mouth-watering wine that pairs perfectly with charcuteries, bouillabaisse and grilled fish on a sunny afternoon.

name: Ultimate Provence  Rose
wine_color: Star bright in color, vibrant pale pink that has flecks of copper reflections.
desc_en_short: We're proud to introduce the first rosé from the Ultimate Provence estate on the outskirts of St Tropez in the South of France. Called UP and with a unique, bold style, this is an exciting wine that packs something distinctly different.

name: Château Routas  Coteaux Varois en Provence Rosé (3 L)
desc_en_short: Freshly cut watermelon, ripe peach aromas and floral notes lead to a palate alive with wild strawberries and hints of mineral notes. Crisp acidity and a refreshing finish. A Decanter International Trophy winner for best Rose and 93 points from James Suckling, 2019

name: Chateau Vignelaure  Le Page de Vignelaure Rosé
desc_en_short: Made from AOC-level Cabernet Sauvignon old vines.The terroir is one of the coolest with good slope that adds extra vibrancy and complexity to the wine. Bright pink color. Nose of lynchee,white peach and grapefruit. Round and fresh in the mouth. With perfect balance.

name: Minuty  M Rosé (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: A splendid, pleasurable wine : The Grenache and Cinsault blend form an aromatic harmony offering notes of peach and candied orange. The flavor is crisp and round on the palate.

name: Castelli del Grevepesa  Maggese Rose Rosato Costa Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Bright pink color, good intensity fragrance with notes of fresh fruit. The taste has a slight acidity that gives it freshness and liveliness.

name: Cristo Di Campobello  Rosato DOC
desc_en_short: “Aromas of dog roses, wild strawberries, raspberries and plums, with hints of minerals. Pleasing on the palate, with fruit and aromatic herb flavors. Well-balanced, with fragrant acidity and a delicate, sapid finish.“

name: Masseria Li Veli  Askos Susumaniello Rosato Salento IGT
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi
desc_en_short: Pale pink, crystal and bright; elegant bouquet, persistent and aromatic notes of strawberry and cranberry. Light weight in the mouth with waves of flavor across the palate. Savory finish with a touch of acidity.

name: La Collection by Maison Boutinot  Cotes de Thau Rose
desc_en_short:
This luscious and textural blend is very much a food wine; rich currant flavours provided by Grenache and tangy raspberry from Cinsault before a dry and fresh finish.

Pasta dishes, barbeques and grilled chicken salads.

name: Luna Estate  Pinot Meunier Rose
wine_color: Pretty ‘copper wire’ colour with a clear and bright appearance
desc_en_short:
Pretty ‘copper wire’ colour with a clear and bright appearance. Lovely perfume here! Pink grapefruit zest with delicate rosewater and lilac florals. Real nice savoury/bready note and sort of berry cream cheese thing going on which really hits the spot too.


Texture, texture and texture! Super happy with the feel of this wine across my palate. Delicious and popping with bright red berry flavours. A fine bead of salivating acidity snaps everything to attention. Nice soft tannins and phenolics add body and a gentle, soft grip to the finish. Pretty darn tasty now and ready to enjoy all summer long.

name: Domaine Fontval  Rose Mediterranee IGP
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi

name: Torresella  Pinot Grigio Rose Venezia DOC
food_matching: Mediterranean, Grilled Vegetables, Light Salads, Sushi

name: Terres des Anges Rose AOP Cotes De Provence
desc_en_short: Made of Cinsault and Grenache, this wine is round, lively and fruity on intense exotic notes that is a consensual and seductive with finesse, complexity and freshness. Enjoy it as an aperitif or with a seafood risotto.

name: Feudi di San Gregorio  Visione Campania Rosato IGT
desc_en_short: Fresh with a bouquet of fresh cut flowers, small berries such as raspberry, red currant, gooseberry and blackberry. The palate is lean and satisfying with well balanced acidity and hints of red fruits.

name: Castello Banfi  Coste' Rose
wine_color: A wine with pale pink nuances
desc_en_short: An elegant and fine rosè that comes from the meeting of the Sangiovese from Montalcino and the Vermentino from the coast. A wine with pale pink nuances; the typical notes of red fruits of Sangiovese and the citrus and sage scents of Vermentino stand out on the nose. Fresh, with a good persistence.

name: La Cour Des Dames  Grenache Rose
desc_en_short: With its nice pale pink colour, it is a very well-balanced wine, fresh, vivid and round, with fruity flavours.

name: Pico Maccario  Lavignone Piemonte Rosato DOC (750 ml)
wine_color: The organoleptic test shows a pale pink color with orange reflections.
desc_en_short: The organoleptic test shows a pale pink color with orange reflections. The olfactory notes recall a floral and citrus bouquet; on the palate it is fresh and with an excellent balance.

name: Domaine de Pellehaut  Harmonie De Gascogne Rose
wine_color: A light and clear pinkish hue.
desc_en_short: A light and clear pinkish hue. An intense nose of red fruits, violets and roses. In the mouth, the freshness and roundness of the fruits intermingle. A wine with natural balance, which reveals the complexity of Gascony. To be enjoyed fresh all year round. An ideal wine for grilling, pizza and other evenings with friends. A pleasant wine to drink on any occasion.

name: Sky Walkers  Rose
desc_en_short:
