Fresh lifted aromas of spun sugar, tropical fruits and floral hints leap from the glass.
A refreshing and mouth-watering palate delivers flavours of passionfruit and nuances
of clove. Pair with tempura vegetables, fresh oysters or an antipasto platter.

name: Balthasar Ress  Pinot Noir Rose Trocken
Pietradolce  Etna Rosato
desc_en_short: Pietradolce Etna Rosato is obtained from a single vineyard, characterised by a unique microclimate. This is Contrada Zottorinoto at 750 meters above sea level. The Nerello Mascalese grapes, cultivated in the classic “sapling” shape on sandy-loam soil with abundant rock, are harvested at the beginning of October. The gentle pressing, followed by a short period in steel, and above all the unique character of the single vineyard, enhance its minerality and agreeableness on the palate.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Cuna De Piedra Estate Tannat Rose
desc_en_short: This is a yong, crisp, fruity and intense wine. Medium-bodied. On the nose red fruits and dried fruits aromas, mineral and refreshing.

name: Monemvasia	 Voltes Rose
desc_en_short: A fresh wine made in stainless steel, from Agiorgitiko, Roditis and Moschofilero varieties, with a name inspired by the twisting uphill pathway leading to the Upper Town of Monemvasia, called Voltes.

name: Domaine Jaume  Cotes du Rhone Rose
wine_color: Pale salmon pink with shimmering brilliance—inviting and radiant in the glass.
desc_en_short: A vibrant and elegant rosé from one of the Rhône Valley's respected family estates, Domaine Jaume captures the spirit of southern France in every sip. This Côtes du Rhône Rosé is a refreshing companion for warm days and flavorful cuisine, offering both delicacy and personality.

name: Chavost Rose de Saignee Brut Nature - Rose
Domaine Sylvain Pataille Marsannay "Fleur de Pinot" Rose
desc_en_short: Domaine Sylvain Pataille is a relatively new estate in Marsannay – the estate was established by Sylvain in the late 1990s and the first vintage was 1999. Sylvain Pataille is an exciting young grower in Marsannay. He trained as an oenologist in Bordeaux, and still consults to 15 or so domaines in Burgundy. He began in 2001 with 4 ha and now has 14 ha mainly en fermage, which are undergoing conversion to biodynamic cultivation. He makes white from aligote and a selection of chardonnay rose, whose skin turns pink when ripe, as well as rose and red. He aims for very low yields in the reds of 35 hl/ha.

name: Bodegas Nodus Chaval Rosado D. O. Utiel Requena
desc_en_short:
This organic Bobal rosé has
a vibrant pink hue with fresh,
fruity aromas. On the palate, it
is crisp and lively, showcasing
bright fruit flavors while
maintaining a smooth, wellrounded balance.

name: Bodegas Valoria Viña Valoria Rosado Rioja D.O.
desc_en_short:
Redcurrant color with violet
tinge. On the nose, it presents
intense aromas of fresh fruits
and raspberry with herbaceous
undertones. On the palate, it is
a smooth and well-balanced
wine which is both clean and
elegant, and full-bodied.

name: Astrale Vino Rosato D’Italia
desc_en_short:
Light, fresh and bright, displaying
aromas of raspberry, red currant
and delicate wild mint notes.
Good palate weight, with ripe
flavours of strawberry, raspberry
and red cherry. Well balanced and
clean finish.

name: Bulichella Sol Sera Costa Toscana Rosato I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Wild berries, black currants, and
subtle hints of white pepper.
Fresh and savory taste with good
persistency

name: Feudi Bizantini Passofino Rosé Terre Di Chieti I.G.P.
wine_color: Pretty pale color, petal pink, elegant with shiny reflections.
desc_en_short:
Pretty pale color, petal pink, elegant
with shiny reflections. Beautiful
and intense aromatic expression
of fresh fruit and spring flowers.
In the mouth, the acidity is
refreshing; a great elegance and
a nice balance dominate, with a
saline finish.

name: Tagaro Pinataro Rosato Puglia I.G.P.
wine_color: Light rosé wine with purple hues.
desc_en_short:
Light rosé wine with purple hues.
Intense, with aromas of exotic
fruits and slightly ripe red fruits.
Floral, fresh, spicy, and mineral.

name: Tagaro Muso Rosso Rosato Puglia I.G.P.
Criss Cross Rosé
desc_en_short: A light, crisp, and refreshing dry rosé, perfect for warm weather enjoyment.

name: Alto Los Romeros Rose
wine_color: Pale salmon colour, attractive and bright.
desc_en_short: A light, crisp, and refreshing dry rosé, perfect for warm weather enjoyment.

name: Apollonio Elfo Susumaniello Salento Rosato
desc_en_short: A rare, vibrant, and savoury Rosato made from the indigenous Susumaniello grape.

name: Fratelli Ponte Brachetto Fiore Di Loto DOC
wine_color: Bright ruby red with light sparkle
desc_en_short: A delicately sweet and aromatic red with floral elegance, fresh berries, and a gentle sparkle—light, fragrant, and irresistibly charming.

name: Finca Fella Cala Rey Tempranillo Rosado
desc_en_short: A vibrant and elegant Spanish rosé from Albacete that showcases Tempranillo’s red‑fruit charm in a polished, refreshing style.

name: Dohlmuhle Portugieser Weissherbst
desc_en_short:
Our Weissherbst rosé is crafted to express freshness, clarity and pure
fruit. Gentle pressing and cool fermentation preserve the delicate
aromatics and vibrant colour. The result is a crisp, elegant rosé that
reflects the light, refreshing side of Rheinhessen and invites
immediate enjoyment.

name: Villa Moncigale Cicada L'Eveil Cotes De Provence
wine_color: Very pale salmon pink with luminous clarity.
desc_en_short: A refined Provence rosé with delicate red berries, citrus freshness, and a subtle mineral lift—elegant, dry, and effortlessly Mediterranean.

name: Villa Moncigale Cicada Olympe Cotes De Provence
wine_color: Pale blush pink with crystalline clarity.
desc_en_short: A poised and expressive Provence rosé with vibrant red berries, citrus brightness, and refined minerality—dry, elegant, and distinctly Mediterranean.

name: Chateau L’Escarelle “Palm”
wine_color: Pale salmon pink with luminous clarity.
desc_en_short: A fresh and vibrant Provence rosé with delicate red berries, citrus brightness, and a clean mineral finish—light, elegant, and effortlessly Mediterranean.

name: Chateau L’Escarelle “Le Pacha”
wine_color: Pale salmon pink with brilliant clarity.
desc_en_short: A more structured and expressive Provence rosé with ripe red berries, refined texture, and mineral depth—elegant, layered, and distinctly sophisticated.

name: Chateau L’Escarelle “Les Deux Anges”
wine_color: Very pale salmon pink with luminous brilliance.
desc_en_short: A refined and aromatic Provence rosé with delicate red fruit, floral lift, and elegant minerality—fresh, poised, and beautifully balanced.

name: Chateau Sainte Marguerite  Symphonie Rosé
desc_en_short: Created in 1999, the Symphonie is the fruit of mastered know-how. A beautiful composition of aromas, perfect for discovering the style of château wines. Beyond its finesse and freshness, it stands out for its harmony. This rosé wine Cru Classé des Côtes-de-Provence - qualified organic and vegan in France - expresses the diversity and richness of the terroirs of the Côtes-de-Provence AOC. *Côtes-de-Provence controlled appellation

name: One By Penfolds Australia Rose
wine_color: Pale flamingo pink, glossy white gold edge.
desc_en_short: Introducing One by Penfolds. Designed in partnership with Human Made founder NIGO, One by Penfolds celebrates the idea of ‘oneness’. Oneness embraces what makes us all different and unique, but also the things that bring us together – as represented by the winemaking regions from where the One by Penfolds range is made around the world.

name: Santa Julia  Cuy Malbec Rose Natural Wine
desc_en_short: Attractive and delicate pale pink. Notes of fresh red fruits like strawberries, cherries, and raspberries with subtle floral touches. Light and rounded on the palate, with balanced acidity that adds freshness .

name: Vigneti Di Zabu  Syrah Sicilia
wine_color: Red ruby, clear, with crimson highlights
desc_en_short: This wine of French origins, became famous and popular around the world because of Australian producers. It was introduced in Sicily in early ‘90s. It has a very low quantity for hectare and the maceration of its grapes has to be at controlled temperature for about 10-12 days.

name: Finca La Celia  La Celia Reserve,Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Deep and intense red colours with black hints, which show its concentration. Aromatically it is honest, balanced and harmonic, and the unmistakable virtues of wood grant notes of coffee and smoke. It is possible to perceive mineral aromas like flint and emery, which emphasize the aroma complexity. Finally, in the mouth, the characteristic structure of this varietal stands out, with robust but soft and gentle tannins. The fruit, typical of the Uco Valley, is harmoniously combined with the oak, granting a kind sensation despite its concentration, and a long and intense ending.

name: Parker  Favourite son Cabernet Merlot
wine_color: Deep Red With A Red Tinge
desc_en_short: Parker Coonawarra's Favourite Son blends Cabernet Sauvignon's firm structure with Merlot's plush mid-palate generosity, delivering lifted black fruits, cedar, ink, and spice on the nose, followed by a swathe of sweet earthy fruit and beautifully integrated tannins on a persistent finish.

name: Chanson Pere & Fils  Bourgogne Pinot Noir
wine_color: Beautiful ruby colour with crimsons nuances.
desc_en_short: Chanson has been crafting regal Pinot Noir since its founding in 1750, during the reign of King Louis XV. This elegant red shows hints of sour cherry and spice. Food-friendly, it's perfect with grilled eggplant with veal cutlets, rotisserie chicken or rack of lamb.

name: Katnook  Founder's Block Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Deep ruby red with purple tinges.
desc_en_short: Supple, medium bodied wine with elegant aromas of red berries, violets and hints of mint. Well proportioned with generous fruit and a persistent finish. An easy partner to a wide range of foods including pasta, red meats, quail and dishes with spicy or smokey flavours.

name: Mastrojanni  Brunello di Montalcino Vigna Schiena D'Asino DOCG
desc_en_short: Distinctive red. Wild berries accompanied by fresh spices and dried leaf tobacco in aromas. The palate is full and austere entry, generous and tangy, and ready to face the passage of time. Also excellent on its own, enjoyed with friends.

name: Katnook  Founder's Block Shiraz
wine_color: Deep plum with vibrant purple tinges.
desc_en_short: A fruit-driven Coonawarra Shiraz from Katnook Estate's accessible Founder's Block range, delivering juicy raspberry and plum alongside pepper, spice, and sweet vanilla oak — honest, characterful drinking that honours one of Australia's most celebrated red wine regions.

name: Crane Lake  Malbec
desc_en_short: A deep burgundy red. On the nose is poured at warm room temperature and swirled vigorously, shows bold, sweet muddled red beets.  From the aroma, seems like this will be juicy, fruity and bright. The primary elements on the palate are in fact a sweet and rich middle of ripe blackberries.  But some light acids do follow along to accentuate the juiciness, making for a pleasant sip.  The finish is rapid, but clean with residue more of crisp acid than any tannins.

name: Robertson Winery  Pinotage
wine_color: A deep purple tint on the rim.
desc_en_short: A deep purple tint on the rim with delicious flavours of ripe strawberry, banana, juicy plums and rich, red cherry. Produced in an early drinking style with well-integrated wood and a soft, smooth finish. Enjoy now with roast beef, guinea fowl, roast chicken, stews, lamb, pizza and pasta.

name: Robertson Winery  Merlot
desc_en_short: Rich, dark red colour with ripe, punchy, plum flavours, sweet blackcherry and a velvet finish. Delicate wood does not mask the ripe fruit. Enjoy now with roast chicken, beef, lamb, pasta and steak.

name: Robertson Winery  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Robertson Winery's Cabernet Sauvignon from South Africa's Western Cape delivers a generous pour of mulberry, plum, and cassis with a smooth, full-bodied character and soft tannins — an approachable, food-friendly red built for everyday enjoyment.

name: Almaviva  2010
wine_color: Deep, Intense, Ruby Red Color With Purple Tones.
desc_en_short: The premium French-Chilean wine, Made from a blend of classic Bordeaux varieties, in which Cabernet Sauvignon predominates, Almaviva is the result of a felicitous encounter between two cultures.

name: Chanson Pere & Fils  Fleurie
desc_en_short: Deep ruby in colour, with intense aromas of red berries especially redcurrant, and a hint of sweet spices. The refined tannins integrate well into the sweet berry finish.

name: Chateau Belregard Figeac  AOC Saint Emilion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Deep garnet-red color. Clean and fresh on the nose with well-integrated oak. Lotus of tannin with a great deal of character and a good, long aftertaste of ripe fruit. A wine with good ageing potential. Perfect drink with red meats and dishes in sauce.

name: Clos du Clocher  AOC Pomerol
desc_en_short: Clos du Clocher?s 2008 punches well above its price ? a deliciously fleshy, succulent Pomerol style Made from a petite, underrated ch?teau that often slips under the radar of the Pomerol hierarchy.

name: Katnook  Estate Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Deep, very dark plum with purple tinged edges.
desc_en_short: Katnook Estate Cabernet Sauvignon is a benchmark expression of Coonawarra's celebrated terra rossa terroir — richly concentrated with blackcurrant and mulberry fruit, finely grained tannins, and the structure to reward patient cellaring for a decade or more.

name: Katnook  Limited Release Prodigy Shiraz
wine_color: Deep dark plum with crimson and purple hints
desc_en_short: A richly layered palate structure with ripe fruit, oak and maturation flavours seamlessly combined. Raspberry and plum fruit with sweet spices of licorice and light lingering pepper are a feature. Subtle oak with fine lingering tannins are in harmony with the palate structure.

name: Katnook  Limited Release Odyssey Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Dark plum reds with purple red tinges
desc_en_short: A richly laden palate structure of oak and ripe fruit flavours smoothly interwoven with extended oak maturation. Ripe dark berry fruits, hints of plum and dusty mulberry with subtle vanilla, mocha and chocolaty oak flavours are complemented with fine grained, softly assertive tannins.

name: Tim Smith  Barossa Shiraz
desc_en_short: A masterclass in Barossa regionality, Tim Smith's Shiraz draws from six distinct vineyard sites — some with vines over a century old — weaving together earthy depth, dark fruit intensity, and the layered complexity that only old-vine Barossa Shiraz can deliver.

name: Tim Smith  Mataro Grenache Shiraz (MGS)
desc_en_short: “I am a huge fan of the wines of Bandol, and I unashamedly draw inspiration from this Southern Rhone appellation. My Barossa Mataro Grenache Shiraz is made with Mataro being the dominant grape. This allows the Mataro fruit, which has a similar tannin structure as Shiraz, to be ready to drink upon release as well as having some serious cellaring potential.” Tim Smith

name: Tree Line  Cabernet Merlot
desc_en_short: Tree Line Cabernet Merlot from South Eastern Australia delivers an exuberant, smoky-spicy character loaded with ripe fruit, marmalade hints, and a peppery finish — a supple, lingering red that punches well above its approachable price point.

name: Tree Line  Shiraz Cabernet
desc_en_short: Medium bodied with strong undercurrent of spice and blackberry/plum notes. This wine has reasonable acid balance and a soft mouth feel. The oak is restrained and does not overpower the fruit.

name: Montes  Folly Syrah
desc_en_short:
Montes Folly is an adventurous wine of exceptional quality; at same level of excellence level as Montes Alpha M, but as different in styles as the untamed sound of a sax in a jazz concert is to a Stradivarius violin at the opera. One wild; one classical. Both stunning; both reaching wine heaven.

Montes Folly grapes are grown on the steepest, highest slopes of our Finca de Apalta estate, in the Apalta Valley, where the incline is greater than 45 degrees. At less than 4 tonnes per hectare, yields are extremely low; grapes and clusters are much smaller and thus more concentrated than those from the vineyard´s lower slopes.

name: Concha Y Toro  Sendero Merlot
desc_en_short: Ruby red with delicate violet tones. Sendero Merlot is a wine with notes of cherries, black pepper and a touch of cocoa. A well rounded wine with good body and a persistent finish.

name: Carpineto  Brunello Di Montalcino DOCG
wine_color: Intense ruby red, with pale pomegranate highlights.
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red, with pale pomegranate highlights. Decisive, fine, broad and lingering with hints of vanilla, cherry, raspberry, and licorice on aromas. Dry, warm, smooth, well textured and lingering on the palate. Great wine with roasts, grilled meats, wild game, and elaborate dishes, as well as rare T-bone steaks. It can also be served alone, as a “reflection” wine.

name: Concha Y Toro  Sunrise Merlot
desc_en_short: Elegant, full, and strong bodied, with a lengthy and agreeable final note. Its elegance puts a seal of distinction on formal or family gatherings. Ideal with white meats and fresh cheeses. A perfect complement for Mediterranean cuisine, from pizzas to risottos.

name: Feudo Principi de Butera  Surya Nero d'Avola Merlot
wine_color: Intense ruby red with garnet hues.
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red with garnet hues. Intense and full, expressed with pleasant hints of small woodland fruits, notes of Mediterranean shrub and spices. Well-structured, pleasantly fresh with a soft, persistent finale that reminds us of the fruit.

name: Fattoria Mantellassi  Mentore Morellino di Scansano
desc_en_short: Fattoria Mantellassi's Mentore Morellino di Scansano is a DOCG-certified Tuscan red built on 85% Sangiovese, blended with Cabernet Sauvignon and Canaiolo Nero, delivering classic Maremman character — ripe dark fruit, earthy depth, and supple Mediterranean warmth from one of Scansano's most respected estates.

name: Carpineto  Chianti Castaldo DOCG
style: Sangiovese And A Maximum Of 25% Of Canaiolo And Other Grape Varietals.
desc_en_short: Chianti, produced in Central Tuscany, is surely Italy's best known wine. From vineyards planted to a minimum of 75% Sangiovese and a maximum of 25% of Canaiolo and other grape varietals. Smooth, medium-bodied and very approachable on the palate. In the Tuscan tradition, this wine is enjoyed as an everyday wine, both young and aged, at room temperature as well as slightly chilled, and with any type of dish.

name: Abbazia di Novacella  Alto Adige Pinot Nero
desc_en_short: Brilliant medium ruby with a fresh, fruity nose, aromatic, supple and luscious with hints of red currants and damsons, velvety tannins and a discreet whiff of oak spice. Partner with light starters, roast partridge, rack of hare, Peking duck, even meaty fish.

name: Concha Y Toro  Trio - Cabernet Sauvignon / Cabernet Franc / Shiraz
desc_en_short: A boldly structured Chilean red from Concha y Toro's Trio range, blending Cabernet Sauvignon's dark-fruit concentration with Shiraz's aromatic lift and Cabernet Franc's polished elegance — delivering a well-balanced, food-friendly wine with a satisfying long finish.

name: Carpineto  Chianti Classico
wine_color: Ruby red, garnet reflections on aging.
desc_en_short: In the beautiful olive and cypress-studded countryside between Florence and Siena lay the quaint hilltop villages of the Chianti Classico region. The wine of the same name is produced exclusively in this charming and beautiful area.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Barbera d'Asti Le Orme Superiore
desc_en_short: 88 points in Wine spectator. This dry, medium-bodied and spicy red displays a simple and medium nose. On the palate, its lively acidity, smooth tannins, and broad texture precede a medium finish.

name: Wirra Wirra  Church Block, Cab Sauvignon/ Shiraz / Merlot
desc_en_short: Wirra Wirra's Church Block is a beloved South Australian classic — a supple, approachable blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz, and Merlot delivering ripe dark fruit, gentle spice, and soft tannins perfect for everyday enjoyment and weekend grilling alike.

name: Chanson Pere & Fils  Mercury Rouge
desc_en_short: From the esteemed Côte Chalonnaise appellation of Mercurey, Chanson Père & Fils crafts a Pinot Noir with vivid ruby colour, alluring raspberry fruit, and a gentle toast of oak spice — elegant, concentrated, and beautifully persistent on the palate.

name: Chanson Pere & Fils  Santenay
desc_en_short: A classic village-level Burgundy from the storied Côte de Beaune, Chanson Père & Fils Santenay delivers bright red berry aromas, gentle spice, and silky well-integrated tannins — an elegant, approachable expression of Pinot Noir with a satisfyingly long finish.

name: Chanson Pere & Fils  Cotes de Nuits Villages
desc_en_short: Bright ruby colour. Intense aromas of red berries mixed with liquorice and spices. Wellbalanced and dense. Well integrated tannins. Subdued minerality. Long aftertaste. To be enjoyed with warm starters, white and red meat, matured cheese

name: Chateau Cordeillan Bages  AOC Pauillac
wine_color: Ruby/Purple Colour Notes Of Tobacco Smoke
desc_en_short: "These are wines for the wine lover who does not want to wait to drink a wine which expresses not only the delicacy and richness of Bordeaux wines, but also the best terroirs and the best of the vintage."

name: Banfi Summus Sant' Antimo IGT Tuscany
wine_color: Deep Ruby Red, With Violet Reflections
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot, Sangiovese
desc_en_short: Banfi Summus conveys sweet and fruity aromas of cherries and plums, well-integrated with notes of vanilla and licorice. Very elegant and balanced with a beautiful structure, supported by muscular and persuasive tannins. Lingering flavors fill the palate.

name: Chateau Les Hauts De Pontet Canet
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 32% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: A second wine of the legendary Château Pontet-Canet in Pauillac, this Bordeaux blend from a challenging 2008 vintage showcases the estate's biodynamic commitment — including the historic return of horses to the vineyard — delivering earthy, structured Cabernet Sauvignon character with impressive depth.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Barolo Tortoniano
wine_color: Brilliant Garnet Red With Orange Highlights.
desc_en_short: Tortoniano is named for the tortonian-era soils in which the vines are planted, which contain a high percentage of magnesium and manganese. Grape clusters are thinned and are harvested somewhat later than usual so that the fruit attains higher concentration. Temperatures are strictly controlled during vinification and the wine is aged for two years in large oak casks and one year in bottle before release.

name: Correggia  Roero Red, Roche D'Ampsei
desc_en_short: Correggia's Roero Roche d'Ampsei is a benchmark expression of Nebbiolo from the sandy soils of Roero, Piedmont — delivering the grape's signature power and elegance with earthy complexity, vibrant acidity, and structured tannins built for the table.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Barolo Cerequio
wine_color: ruby and garnet red with brilliant hues
desc_en_short: Lively garnet red.Optimum density and fluidity. Ample, generous and with a marked personality. A splendid symphony of sensations, among which ripe fruit (blackcurrant, apricot,maraschino cherry),mint leaves, gentian roots and spices. All the seductive aromas are confirmed on the palate. It has a rich, aristocratic body of great character, a presence of delicate tannins; surprising is its delicacy,which caresses one's mouth.

name: Bodegas Palacios Remondo  Finca Dofi Priorat
style: Garnacha With The Balance Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, And Merlot
desc_en_short: From Álvaro Palacios's family estate in Priorat, Finca Dofi is a Garnacha-led blend of rare mineral intensity — grown on ancient llicorella schist soils and tended by mule, delivering velvety richness with an almost ethereal elegance that defines the appellation at its finest.

name: Allegrini  Belpasso Appassimento
desc_en_short: The flavour increase concentration with plummy and refreshing with notes of green herbs and black cherry, impressive underlying structure and a classic combination of acidity and fine- grained tannins.

name: Tenuta Guado al Tasso By Antinori  Bolgheri Superiore DOC
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Pian delle Vigne By Antinori  Brunello di Montalcino DOCG
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: "Tormaresca" By Antinori  Masserie Maime Salento IGT
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Batasiolo  Barbera D'Asti Sabri
wine_color: Red garnet, crystal clear and transparent.
desc_en_short: Dry, full of remarkable freshness and structure, in line with tradition. Intense and long-lasting aftertaste, reminiscent of the spectrum of aromas in the bouquet. Food paring with appetizers, pasta and risotto, main courses of red and white meats, ripe cheeses.

name: Batasiolo  Barolo Vigneto Cerequio
desc_en_short: Intense garnet red color with delicate orange highlights. The "nose" of the Cerequio, unmistakable and unique, presents balsamic notes, plants, floral and spicy notes. Memories of incense, wax, tobacco and coffee blend magically with delicacy. Palate of great persistence, full, elegant, harmonious and balanced. Ideal in combination with dishes based on red meats, game, roasts and cheeses and cured meats.

name: Batasiolo  Barolo Briccolina DOC
desc_en_short: The color is deep garnet red. It has intense and persistent aromas of ripe fruit, flowers and spices with delicate flavors of the wood. Its main characteristic is married to the typical aromas of the nebbiolo creating a feeling of rare elegance. Its power, elegance and charm, give fullness to the palate and great intensity. All the notes in the nose are enhanced harmonically and make it a wine to remember.

name: Cantina Di Montalcino  Brunello di Montalcino
desc_en_short: Clear, purple-red in colour, with good depth and 'legs' indicating the certain structure. Intensely perfumed on the nose, with fruit aromas including blackberries, blackcurrants and cherries a dominant theme. In the mouth, the wine is full bodied, with tremendous depth and richness, attractive fruit and well balanced acidity.

name: Finca La Celia  Angaro, Cabernet Tempranillo
desc_en_short: Intense ruby color. Ripe fruits like plum and cherry in aroma. Delicate flavor and a long finish on the palate.

name: Finca La Celia  La Celia Reserve,Syrah
desc_en_short: From Finca La Celia's high-altitude vineyards in San Carlos, Uco Valley, this 100% Syrah delivers intense raspberry, spice, and violet aromas underpinned by 12 months in French and American oak — a concentrated, well-structured Mendoza red with a long, persistent finish.

name: Finca La Celia  La Celia Supremo
desc_en_short: Ruby red color with garnet hues. Ripe black fruit, complemented by subtle floral notes like lavender and violet. Feel the contribution of wood notes of hazelnut and vanilla. Begins with sweet notes, its structure is very balanced and very pleasant taste.

name: Finca La Celia  La Consuta, Malbec
desc_en_short: Deep red colour with intense violet tints. Fruity aromas, full of blackberries, blueberries and plums define the nose. A soft, rich mouth-feel with sweet, subtle tannins, lead to a round, lingering finish.

name: Finca La Celia  La Consuta, Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Intense and deep bright red colour. Attractive aroma with clear varietal identity, reminds to red fruits such as plums and cherries, mixed with sweet peppers. The vanilla aromas that come from oak aging deliver hints of elegance and complexity. Its sweet and velvety tannins, together with a broad structure and a long finish, turns this wine in a really attractive option.

name: Lungarotti  Sagrantino Di Montefalco
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Lungarotti  Rubesco Torgiano Riserva Vigna Monticchio
wine_color: Intense ruby red with violet nuances
desc_en_short: An elegant wine with solid structure, deep ruby colour and complex aroma that recalls marasca cherries and blackberries, followed by notes of violet, light mentholated hints and a spicy finish. A wine of great concentration, fruity and slightly balsamic, it has soft and velvety tannins with a long, lingering finish.

name: Mount Langi Ghiran  Billi Billi Shiraz
desc_en_short: Highly perfumed red and blue fruit bouquet, with orange and cinnamon playing a pivotal role; the palate is fresh, lovely and lithe, with the spice coming to the fore on the medium-bodied finish.

name: Mount Langi Ghiran  Langi Shiraz Shiraz
wine_color: Vibrant purple with dense purple rim.
desc_en_short: Medium body and tightly wound acidity balance with structured tannins which build the palate. Showing great potential at bottling, the wine is brooding and restrained with years to go before its peak. On the palate the wine shows a core of ripe blueberry and raspberry fruits, overlayed with hints of perfumed “spice box” characters. Tight acidity adds length and definition.

name: Mastrojanni  Brunello di Montalcino Vigna Loreto DOCG
desc_en_short: Bright and deep ruby red. The oriental spices and the fresh tobacco leave enhance its ripe red fruit notes. Broad and enveloping entry, supported by a potent and ripe tannin, to conclude with a silky and elegant ending. Pair with: good company, to fully appreciate its elegance.

name: PB Valley  Sawasdee Khao Yai Shiraz
desc_en_short: PB Valley's Sawasdee Khao Yai Shiraz is a charming new-latitude Thai red that delivers glimpses of raspberry, plum, and cherry alongside gentle spice and a signature hint of roasted coconut — approachable, elegant, and distinctly Thai in character.

name: PB Valley  PB Reserve Shiraz
desc_en_short: Full body red, with complexity and good tannin support. This wine has intense aromas of red berries, black fruits, papaya, raisin and tobacco combined with a touch of pepper, roasted coconut and distinctive hint of oak.

name: PB Valley  Pirom Khao Yai Reserve Tempranillo
desc_en_short: A standout expression of Tempranillo from Khao Yai's cooler highlands, the PB Valley Pirom Reserve delivers plush plum, blackberry, and black cherry fruit with a distinctive touch of French oak, shaped by an exceptional growing season.

name: Poggio Al Tesoro  W DedIcato A Walter
desc_en_short: This is the winery’s most important wine, produced with 100% Cabernet Franc, and dedicated by Marilisa and Franco to their late brother Walter. Its richness is evident at first sight, confirmed on the nose by perfectly interwoven, profund aromas of black-berried fruit, pepper and balsamic hints of eucalyptus. The palate astonishes for its ability to sustain this imposing structure with a light tautness, making it both powerful and agile.

name: Parker  Favourite Son Shiraz
desc_en_short: Deep red-purple. It has a striking bouquet with intense black and white pepper and licorice, moving to an unexpectedly supple, medium-bodied palate, with blackberry to the fore; the oak and tannins are a positive part of the very good texture and structure of the wine.

name: Parker  First Growth
desc_en_short: Parker First Growth is a benchmark Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon-led blend delivering pure cassis, dark chocolate, and smoky cedar on a densely flavoured palate, structured by elegantly firm tannins and a beautifully persistent finish.

name: Cà Maiol  Negresco DOC
desc_en_short:
The choice of this name is linked to that of the famous “Le Negresco” Hotel at Nice on the French Riviera.

The fruit for our Negresco wine comes from the Valtènesi’s top-quality vineyards: Groppello, Marzemino, Sangiovese and Barbera  grapes are selected to produce, after a long fermentation on their skins, a wine that is modern but full of character. The product thus obtained has a rich, concentrated structure that allows it to be aged for about 18 months in specially selected 225-liter French oak barriques, so that it attains full maturation and the harmonization of all its nuances of taste and aroma.

Negresco was Cà Maiol’s first red wine, launched as it was with the 1988 vintage.

name: Chateau Moulin De Mallet  Bordeaux AOC Rouge
desc_en_short: Château Moulin de Mallet is situated in the commune of Pujols just south of Saint-Emilion. This plateau was originally dotted with windmills (Moulin) one of which forms the Château which is home to the Couderc family. The estate has been in the same family since 1898 and through five generations. Serge Couderc and his son Julien, a qualified viticulturalist and oenologist, have overseen a complete modernisation of this property.

name: La Dame De Malescot Margaux (Second wine of Château Malescot St-Exupéry)
desc_en_short:
Nose of black cherry,
blackcurrant and oak. The
palate is quite forward, medium
to full bodied and packed with
fragrant dark berry fruit. The
finish shows the tannic structure
of the vintage, but in this case is
moderately supple.

name: Chateaux Larcis Ducasse
style: Merlot, 20% Cabernet Franc, And 2% Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: "Here is the best Larcis Ducasse since Jacques-Olivier Gratiot entrusted the reins of the property in tandem Stéphane Derenoncourt-Nicolas Thienpont in 2002. I had a real heart for this wine announced by a beautiful dark garnet color. The nose is complex, elegant, combining notes of black fruit, violets with a mineral side and peppered. Very good play, wrapped, luscious. Complex pattern on a full mouth volume. Tannins lectures, velvety, sappy that extend the final length." Robert Parker Wine Advocate.

name: Velenosi  Breciarolo Gold, Rosso Piceno Superiore DOC
wine_color: Ruby red with a hint of garnet.
desc_en_short: Ruby red with a hint of garnet color. The palate is warm, lingering full-bodied and well-orchestrated. Pairing with tomato-base pasta and pizza sauces, heavier dishes such as steak.

name: Vigneti Di Zabu  IL Passo Nerello Mascalese Terre Siciiane IGT
desc_en_short: Bright ruby red, vivid, full and intense. Intense aroma of red fruits, spices and red flowers. Warm, full, soft and well-balanced. Pasta with rich sauces, meat and seasoned cheeses.

name: Wild Rock  Gravel Pit Red, Merlot/Malbec, Hawkes Bay
desc_en_short: Darkest red with violet hues. Lavish aromatics of blackberry and plum are lifted by undertones of florals, oregano and polished wood. Fresh acidity and fine dusty tannins of great length coat the sweet fruited core of this wine.

name: Xanadu  Estate Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A pretty, fragrant bouquet of violets, blackcurrants and black cherries heralds a palate at once fragrant and elegant, exactingly focused in its varietal precision and tight-grained and confident in its tannin profile. There are complex notes of sweet tobacco leaf, cedar and graphite. Impeccably honed, this is a beautiful and enduring Xanadu, the essence of Margaret River cabernet sauvignon, with a magnificent life stretching long before it.

name: Little Yering  Pinot Noir
wine_color: Bright ruby red with light garnet hues.
desc_en_short: Little Yering Pinot Noir from Yering Station delivers cool-climate Yarra Valley elegance in every glass — fresh red berries, silky texture, and a whisper of spice make this an effortlessly approachable yet genuinely refined expression of the variety.

name: Allegrini  Palazzo della Torre IGT (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: This is one of the wines that has made Allegrini famous throughout the world. The vineyard surrounds Villa della Torre, a splendid masterpiece of Renaissance architecture now owned by the family, and produces a full-bodied red wine that has an ageing potential of at least ten years. The blend is the historic combination of Corvina and Rondinella with the addition of a small quantity of Sangiovese. A small percentage of the harvested grapes are left to dry out until December and then added to the previously vinified fresh grapes. The result is a velvety, well-balanced red wine that proffers mature, pulpy fruit.

name: Poggio Al Tesoro  Bolgarello Rosso Sangiovese Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Dark, reddish-blue in color. Spicy, fruity aroma with hints of barrel, black cherry, blackberry, chocolate and herb on the palate.  Perfect drink with Dishes of lamb or beef.

name: Alois Lageder  The Farms LOWENGANG Cabernet (Biodynamic)
wine_color: Deep, quite intense cherry red colour.
style: Carmen?re, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot
desc_en_short: Deep, quite intense cherry red colour. Pronounced, clean aroma with fruity notes of cherry and blackcurrant. Also spice notes (white pepper) and oak. Full-bodied, with good fruit concentration on the palate. Long finish, accompanied by tannins that are well integrated in the structure of the wine. Still rather youthful. When stored properly, this wine will drink well for at least 8 to 10 years. Suggested food with red meat (roasted or grilled), lamb, venison, cheese.

name: Alois Lageder  The Farms ROMIGBERG Kalterersee Classico (Biodynamic)
wine_color: Brilliant ruby colour with purple tints.
desc_en_short: Brilliant ruby colour with purple tints. Quite pronounced, very fruity aroma with impressions of red fruit, cherries and violets. Medium-bodied, quite mild and soft though dry. Fresh and slightly spicy aftertaste with an elegant bitter note of bitter almonds. Lago di Caldaro is usually drunk in the year after production, but can also be cellared for at least 3 years. Suggested food with pasta, grilled or fried seafood, veal, barbeque.

name: Alois Lageder  The Farms KRAFUSS Pinot Noir (Biodynamic)
wine_color: Medium intense ruby colour with a garnet shimmer.
desc_en_short: Medium intense ruby colour with a garnet shimmer. Still somewhat closed, clean uplifted varietal aroma: impressions of red berry fruit, cherries along with oak spice (white pepper, cinnamon). Quite pronounced flavour, medium-bodied. Fresh finish with good length and a presence of spicy tannin. Elegant style. This wine will drink well, when cellared under proper conditions, for at least 4 to 6 years. Suggested food with white and red meat, poultry, duck, venison, cheeses.

name: Allegrini  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOC
desc_en_short:
Tasting notes :
The result of the Allegrini family’s expertise, a true classic of the appellation, this red wine embraces tradition, territory and the know-how of country ways. Corvina, Corvinone, Rondinella and Oseleta are left to air dry at least until December and are checked daily to ensure perfectly healthy grapes. Lengthy refining and ageing finally yields a red wine that has become emblematic of Italian oenology, alongside Barolo and Brunello di Montalcino. It has imposing structure and depth, as much in its aromas of mature fruit and spices, as on the palate, where the alcohol is sustained by the right degree of acidity and refined tannins.

Food pairings :
Traditionally enjoyed with game, roasted and grilled meats, casseroles and well matured cheeses. Excellent with hearty dishes. Amarone’s distinctive flavour compliments new and exotic sweet and sour dishes. It is therefore also perfect with Asian and middle-eastern dishes. Serve at 18°C (64°F) and open the bottle an hour before drinking. This wine has the potential to age for more than 20 years.

93 Points Decanter

"Allegrini's Amarone brings together grapes from hillside estate vineyards in the Classico zone, predominantly around the town of Fumane. It is rounded out with 5% Oseleta which amps up both colour and tannins. Vanilla, cedar and cherry are upfront and the oak is prominent yet polished. This is a compact, chewy Amarone that really bursts with dried cherry and plum skin on the long finish. It could do with a few years in the bottle to assimilate but has the backbone and concentration to age a decade beyond that. Drinking Window 2023 - 2033"

name: Corte Giara by Allegrini  Valpolicella DOC
desc_en_short: Intense and inviting ruby red. The characteristic hints of cherries and pepper are particularly enjoyable in this wine, followed by subtle nuances of officinal herbs. Dry and well-balanced. The traditional acidic note combines well with the softness of the fruit to form a satisfying contrast and produce a supple, feisty wine.

name: Corte Giara by Allegrini  Valpolicella DOC Ripasso
wine_color: Deep ruby red colour with good concentration.
desc_en_short: Plump red fruit combines well with sweet spices, then giving way to delicately spiced herbs. Full and satisfying. The harmonious balance struck by an excellent structure and vibrant acidity renders this wine both smooth and vivacious on the palate. Pairs well with pot roast and braised meats accompanied with polenta (corn meal), grilled fillet, quail, sliced beef with mushrooms, lamb spare ribs and medium-matured cheeses.

name: Corte Giara by Allegrini  Amarone Della Valpolicella "La Groletta" DOCG
desc_en_short: The characteristic hints of cherries and pepper are particularly enjoyable in this wine, followed by subtle nuances of officinal herbs. Dry and well-balanced. The traditional acidic note combines well with the softness of the fruit to form a satisfying contrast and produce a supple, feisty wine.

name: Cantina Di Montalcino  Rosso Di Montalcino
wine_color: Clear, purple-red in colour, with good depth and "legs" indicating the certain structure.
desc_en_short: Clear, purple-red in colour, with good depth and "legs" indicating the certain structure. Intensely perfumed on the nose, with aromas of fresh fruit such as cherries, blackberries and blackcurrants, with a spicy finish. In the mouth, the wine is full bodied, with good depth and richness, attractive fruit and well balanced acidity.

name: Cantine Leonardo Da Vinci  Chianti Riserva Da Vinci DOCG
wine_color: Deep purple red in color, with in-tense chromatic nuances.
desc_en_short: The Chianti Riserva has a distinctly fruity bouquet with dark cherry overtones that are balanced with hints of vanilla and cinnamon. Its flavor reflects the fruit of the bouquet and is supported by balanced tannins. You will notice flavors of concentrated black fruit, plums, and ripe cherry fruit with spicy undertones all balanced by fine soft tannins and a full mineral finish.

name: Cantina Di Montalcino  Merlot Poggio Del Sasso
desc_en_short: Intense red, on the nose ripe fruits (blackberry, cherry) prevail, with spicy hints aftertaste. In the mouth is it extremely palatable, with soft and round tannins.

name: Cantina Di Montalcino  Sangiovese Poggio Del Sasso
wine_color: Clear, purple-red in colour, with good depth and "legs" indicating a certain structure.
desc_en_short: Clear, purple-red in colour, with good depth and "legs" indicating a certain structure. On the nose, the wine has clear aromas of cherries and flowers, especially violets. On the palate, the wine is easy drinking, ripe and well balanced.

name: Chateaux Du Barry  Bordeaux Ac Rouge
wine_color: Garnet with purplish highlights in colour.
desc_en_short: A classic Bordeaux rouge from Château Du Barry, blending Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon into a garnet-hued wine brimming with ripe red fruits, cassis, and supple, meaty tannins — an approachable everyday Bordeaux with genuine regional character.

name: Mount Langi Ghiran  Cliff Edge Shiraz
desc_en_short: Blueberry, cherry and blackberry fruits are dominant with beautifully interwoven spice and pepper. Medium bodied silky tannins balance will with the fruits and fine oak. Good length with and spicy savoury finish.

name: Callia  Resevado Malbec
wine_color: Deep Red And Vivacious Wine, With Bright Purplish Tints
desc_en_short: A vivid, full-bodied Argentine Malbec from Callia, bursting with wildberries, raspberries, and cherries layered over vanilla and chocolate oak notes, with firm yet pleasantly sweet tannins and a long, satisfying finish.

name: Callia  Resevado Torrontes
wine_color: Greenish Yellow, With A Steely Tinge.
desc_en_short: Callia Reservado Torrontés from Argentina enchants with signature aromas of jasmine and orange peel, delivering a vibrant, citrus-fresh palate with an exotic floral character that earned a well-deserved 90 points from Wine Advocate.

name: Callia  Alta Shiraz/Malbec
wine_color: A Captivating Color Of Deep Purple With Ruby Tints
desc_en_short: Deep red, vivacious, with purplish tints-- the typicity of the Malbec meets the eye. Aromas reminiscent of ripe figs, cinnamon and liquorice, hinting at the presence of the Syrah in this blend, mingled with the full range of red fruits, such as plums and cherries, typical of the Malbec. Crispy, with a marked balance in the mouth, without edges, yet complex, wll-structured and silky,supported by sweet, ripe and harmonious tannins.

name: Signos  Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Deep Red Wine With Bluish Tints
desc_en_short: A bold Mendoza Cabernet Sauvignon from Signos, Argentina, offering an intense ruby-red colour with aromas of ripe dark fruit, herbs, and warming spice, backed by a structured palate of fine, polished tannins and a soft, satisfying finish.

name: Signos  Malbec Shiraz
wine_color: Intense Red Colour With Purplish Hues.
desc_en_short: Intense red colour with purplish hues. Fine and elegant aroma with notes of plums, red fruits, aniseed and spices. In the mouth, it shows very ripe mild tannins and a subtle sweet flavour. It is a light, gentle and easy-to-drink wine.

name: Signos  Shiraz
wine_color: This wine displays an intense red colour
desc_en_short: This wine displays an intense red colour. It is a modern wine with great liveliness. Its intense aromas are reminiscent of fig marmalade, typical of this variety. In the mouth, its tannins are mild and slightly sweet. This is a light, pleasant and easy-to-drink wine.

name: Signos  Shiraz/Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A vibrant Mendoza blend of Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon, Signos delivers a deep purplish-red pour brimming with prune, dark fruit, and Cabernet's signature spice — all wrapped in a creamy, medium-bodied palate with satisfying complexity.

name: Killka  Malbec
desc_en_short: A richly textured Mendoza Malbec from Killka, delivering dark plum, violet, and spice on a full-bodied frame with smooth medium tannins — a classic Argentine red built for the grill and the table alike.

name: Paso El Portillo  Tempranillo Selected Red
wine_color: An interesting ruby red color with purplish tints of great intensity, good shades and very deep hues.
desc_en_short: Wine with good structure, well-balanced acidity and long finish. It has an interesting tuby red color with purplish tints of great intensity, good shades and very deep hues. A nose rich in fruit, reminiscent of plums, dark fruits and blackberries. At the start of mouth its tannins evoke the softness of velvet, proceeding to a marked roundness towards the finish. An ideal accompaniment to bruschettas with green salad, red meats and pasta.

name: Gustave Lorentz  Pinot Noir d'Alsace Reserve
desc_en_short: Beautiful color of red fruit, this Pinot Black keeps the freshness of the grape while releasing a beautiful structure. Its aromas are floral. The palate is soft and nonexistent tannins. It is soft and pleasant.

name: Chateau Mas Neuf  Armonio Vin de Pays d'Oc
desc_en_short: A collaboration between Luc Baudet and Louis Mitjavile of Tertre-Rôteboeuf, Armonio is a southern French blend of Grenache, Mourvèdre, and Cabernet Sauvignon aged 24 months in new Bordeaux barrels — earning 92 points from Robert Parker for its concentrated depth and polished structure.

name: Chateau Mas Neuf  Chateauneuf du Pape
desc_en_short: On the nose, notes of black fruits (blackcurrant, blackberry) interlaced with provence herbal notes and a white-peppery feel. The palate is smooth and possesses a long finish, yet with a very fresh and surprisingly vibrant spiciness.To be consumed over the next decade. Serve at 16?C, with beef, duck, lamb, chicken and spicy dishes.

name: Chateau Mas Neuf  La Mourvache
desc_en_short: 89 in Wine Advocate. Garnet red. On the nose, red berries (raspberry, blackberry) from the Grenache come together with the Mourvèdre’s spicy, cocoa notes, the “terroir” reveals a very fresh bouquet of laurel and menthol. If on entry, the wine displays the typical fullness of old Grenache vines, the structure of the Mourvedre kicks in, firming up the finish with tight, long lasting tannins. The ripe fruit gives way to spicy notes (nutmeg, cloves) and roasted coffee.

name: Chateau Mas Neuf  Avec des Si
desc_en_short: 88 points in Wine Spectator. Deep ruby colour. Aromas on the nose are split between fresh berries (black currant, red currant) and flowers (violet, lily). The entry is clean and straightforward, with a very spicy, fresh finish. The tannin’s texture is fine and adds to the length of the wine.

name: Chateau Mas Neuf  Rhone Paradox Rouge
desc_en_short: 87 points in Wine Advocate. Dark, bright, garnet red. On the nose, notes of dark berries (blackcurrant, blackberry), pepper, cinnamon, nutmeg and bay leaf predominate. Gentle entry, full on the palate with a velvety, fresh finish. The fruit, mocha and spice aromas unfold with nice length.

name: Vecchia Cantina  Chianti DOCG
wine_color: Ruby red with good violet shades
desc_en_short: A classic Chianti DOCG from Vecchia Cantina, this Sangiovese-driven red pours deep ruby with violet hues, delivering vibrant red berry fruit, oak-kissed vanilla, and a firm, well-balanced tannic finish that makes it an ideal partner for rustic Italian fare.

name: Marques De Riscal  Baron de Chirel, DOC Rioja
wine_color: Clear and bright with a lovely cherry-red color and hints of violet.
desc_en_short: Marqués de Riscal's Baron de Chirel is a prestige Rioja built on old-vine Tempranillo, delivering dark berry richness, French oak spice, and polished tannins in a complex, elegantly structured package worthy of serious cellaring.

name: Torres  Atrium Cabernet
desc_en_short: Opening a bottle of Atrium is to enjoy a symphony of aromas. The notes of jams, dark fruits and toasted bread form a vibrant chord, thus composing a magic score.

name: Torres  Atrium Merlot
desc_en_short: Attractive dark cherry colour. Generous and intense varietal aroma, with hints of mature fruits, including jams (plums and bilberries), overlaying truffle and bay leaf aromas. The palate is ample and generous, with excellent sweet tannins that open out to fruit-laden nuances reminiscent of the nose. As the wine reaches chambré temperatures it exudes rich hints of leather and vanillin that evolve towards a sensuous and persistent, long finish.

name: Torres  Mas Rabell Red
desc_en_short: Born from a medieval farmhouse estate in the heart of Catalunya, Torres Mas Rabell is a sun-drenched Garnacha-Cariñena blend brimming with blackberry, forest fruits, and a whisper of liquorice — soft-tannined, velvety, and effortlessly food-friendly.

name: Torres  San Valentin Garnacha
wine_color: Dark cherry colour with the violet gleam of a young wine.
desc_en_short: Torres San Valentín Garnacha is a vibrant, fruit-forward Spanish red from Catalunya, bursting with blackberry jam, pomegranate, and floral violet notes. Silky soft tannins and a smooth finish make it effortlessly approachable for everyday drinking.

name: Torres  San Valentin Tempranillo
desc_en_short: Torres San Valentín is a vibrant, 100% Tempranillo from Catalunya that delivers ripe cherry, raspberry, and aromatic herbs on the nose, with a smooth, gently spiced palate of black pepper, tobacco, and jammy fruit, finishing with a distinctive lingering liquorice note.

name: Torres  Vina Brava Garnacha / Carinena
desc_en_short: Torres Viña Brava blends Garnacha Tinta and Cariñena from Catalunya into a ruby-hued red bursting with red fruit and warm spice, backed by smooth, silky tannins — an effortlessly approachable everyday Spanish red with real Mediterranean character.

name: Torres  Vina Brava Tempranillo
desc_en_short: Torres Viña Brava Tempranillo from Catalunya delivers a vibrant cherry-red wine bursting with forest fruits and liquorice, crafted in the classic Mediterranean tradition — approachable, well-rounded, and built for the table.

name: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)  Reserve Speciale Saint-Emilion
wine_color: Deep crimson with shades of black.
desc_en_short: Deep crimson with shades of black. Intense and aromatic on the nose, dominated by aromas of berries (blueberries, blackberries) and licorice. Generous and a full-bodied attack on the palate. Harmonious with dense, well-integrated tannins; fresh and fruity with good length.

name: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)  Chateau Peyre-Lebade Cru Bourgeois
wine_color: Beautiful crimson colour, tinged with dark purple.
style: Merlot 65 To 75%, Cabernet Sauvignon 15 To 25% And Cabernet Franc 10%.
desc_en_short: Château Peyre-Lebade wines feature the fruity and fleshy characteristics specific to the Haut-Médoc appellation. They are nonetheless distinguished by the high Merlot content, which makes them particularly supple.

name: Chateau Belrose  (Bordeaux superieur AOC)
desc_en_short: The wine has a smooth, creamy, fruity taste with refreshing hints of licorice and mint.

name: Chateau Potensac  (Medoc AOC)
style: Merlot, Cabernet Franc And Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A very fine wine with tight texture, great richness and wonderful freshness. On the palate, the wine is pure and powerful, the tannins dense and spicy, and the finish of great depth with glorious aromas. Because of these qualities, Château Potensac is often considered to represent the "pure Medoc style".

name: Lindeman's  Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Lindeman's Bin Series is internationally recognised as one of the best value for-money wine ranges available throughout the world. Renowned for consistency and quality, this is achieved by sourcing the best parcels of fruit available each vintage, Made from a wide array of premium growing areas throughout the southern states of Australia.The generous flavours and contemporary, easy-drinking style of Lindeman's Bin 45 Cabernet Sauvignon combines easily with food, family and friends

name: Springfield Estate  Whole Berry Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Springfield Estate's Whole Berry Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted using an ancient, pump-free gravity-flow cellar where uncrushed grapes ferment naturally — an unfiltered, unfined Western Cape red of velvety depth, classical varietal character, and surprisingly supple tannins.

name: Anwilka  Stellenbosch
style: Syrah And The Balance Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: "Fabulous... this is the finest red wine I have ever had from South Africa... This debut release, the 2005, a blend of 37% Syrah and the balance of Cabernet Sauvignon, is world class stuff, exceptional wine"  Robert Parker

name: Arnaldo Caprai  25 Anni Sagrantino Di Montefalco
desc_en_short: Sagrantino 25 Anni is the result of in-depth research and careful clonal selection of Sagrantino's best grapes. This jubilee wine was produced for the first time in 1993 to celebrate the 25th anniversary of the winery. Since then it has kept this name together with its unique character, power and elegance.

name: Arnaldo Caprai  Sagrantino Montefalco Collepiano DOCG
desc_en_short: Arnaldo Caprai's Collepiano is a benchmark expression of Sagrantino di Montefalco DOCG, drawn from the gently sloping Collepiano estate in Umbria — a wine that helped reawaken the world's attention to this ancient, rare Italian variety.

name: Rosemount Estate  Shiraz/Cabernet
desc_en_short: This wine says 'spicy and balanced' on the label. Deep red with purple hues. Rich blood plum flavours flood across the palate melding with delicious fruit cake notes. Well integrated oak flavours make for a persistent and stylish finish. A complex strong, dark fruit nose with black plum Shiraz aromas integrated with Cabernet beetroot notes.

name: Beringer  Knights Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This Cabernet is set each vintage as a Bordeaux blend, with soft and silky tannins and a plush, full mouth-feel setting it up for immediate enjoyment, although it’s built to age and develop further complexity. Aromas of dried herbs, cedar, clove and lavender join flavors of dark red fruit led by figs, black cherry, currants, boysenberry, huckleberry, raspberr, and evident oak spice are joined with more traditional Knights Valley tones of black olive, wild sage and mocha chocolate. Fine acidity and balance with an elegant structure lead to a lingering, memorable finish.

name: Castello Colle Massari  Lombrone Sangiovese Riserva
desc_en_short: A complex and full-bodied red wine with notes of menthol, bay leaf, black cherries, prunes and currants. The longer it is decanted, the more its aroma is revealed, so that in time hints of candied fruit and fragrant roses are discerned. Tannins are dense and velvety and tightly embrace the intense aromas.

name: Errazuriz  Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve
style: Cabernet Sauvignon 10% Carmen?re 10% Petit Verdot 5% Malbec
desc_en_short: Errazuriz Don Maximiano Founder's Reserve is Chile's benchmark Cabernet Sauvignon-led blend from the Aconcagua Valley, delivering layers of dark fruit, warming spice, and earthy complexity — a cellar-worthy icon built for long evolution and grand occasions.

name: Fairview  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Fairview's Paarl Shiraz delivers a plush, fruit-forward style with ripe plum, sweet raspberry, and a signature white pepper kick — full-bodied and approachable, with well-integrated tannins that make it an easy favourite for red meat and spiced dishes alike.

name: Fairview  Stellenbosch Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Bright ruby in the glass. A complex nose of blackcurrant leaf and mint, accompanied by squashed ripe black cherries. Palate is full displaying smoked 
dark fruits with hints of leather. Rounded by grippy tannins.

name: Frescobaldi  Castelgiocondo Brunello di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short:
Castelgiocondo Brunello is a wine of depth, complexity, and noble structure. Ripe red cherry and plum notes are beautifully balanced by hints of tobacco leaf, dried herbs, rose petals, and warm oak spice.

Its refined tannins and bright acidity ensure both immediate drinking pleasure and long-term cellaring potential, making it a benchmark Brunello for collectors and Italian wine lovers.

name: Frescobaldi  Nipozzano Mormoreto Toscana IGT
wine_color: A magnificent intense and brilliant ruby red colour with beautiful purple reflections.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot, Sangiovese
desc_en_short: As I walk between the rows of Cabernet and Petit Verdot, my mind always wanders back to 150 years ago, when my ancestors first planted these varieties, guided by their desire to create a truly great wine. In 1983, this dream became a reality with the creation of Cru Mormoreto, a wine with a vibrant, deep and harmonious character. Since 2013, it has also included a small amount of Sangiovese to underscore its elegance.

name: Jean Leon  Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva Penedes
desc_en_short: A landmark 100% Cabernet Sauvignon from Jean Leon's estate vineyards in Penedès, this Gran Reserva delivers layers of dark cherry, sweet tobacco, chocolate, and earthy spice — a structured, long-lived Spanish Cab with exceptional depth and elegance.

name: Jean Leon  Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva Penedes
desc_en_short: 86 points in wine spectator. This is a promising wine with a good deal of complexity involving blackberry, dark red rasberry and a bit of thick skinned purple plum but it all quickly dissolves into a bitter tannic woody finish leaving a feeling of disjointedness which rather disappoints.

name: Joseph Phelps  Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Malbec, 1% Petit Verdot And 1% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: The 2017 Cabernet Sauvignon has expressive aromatics of blueberry, boysenberry, baking spices and cardamom. A fresh and inviting wine with unfolding layers of raspberry, red cherry, nutmeg, cedar and graphite with a medium-full body, seamless integrated tannins and a lengthy finish.

name: La Capra  by Fairview Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Fairview presents the amazing tastes, sights and sounds of the La Capra festival. Each glass will transport you to a magical place where the wine flows freely, laughter fills the air and you dance until the sunrise.

name: La Capra  by Fairview Shiraz
desc_en_short: La Capra Shiraz from Fairview in Paarl delivers juicy red fruit, cracked black pepper, and Christmas cake spice in an approachable, full-bodied style that drinks well young yet has genuine cellaring potential for those willing to wait.

name: Errazuriz  La Cumbre Shiraz
desc_en_short: Errazuriz La Cumbre is a powerful, expressive Shiraz from Chile's Aconcagua Valley, delivering a concentrated core of blueberry and blackberry with layers of sweet spice, meaty depth, and a floral lift — all anchored by firm tannins and a luxuriously long finish.

name: Altivo  Classic Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The Altivo wines have a very distinctive character. They are bold in flavor, lush in texture and have great structure and length. The Altivo "Classic" wines are sourced from the younger blocks on the Estate, with the "Reserva" wines sourced from the mature blocks. Bold flavors. Lush texture. Great structure.

name: Altivo  Classic Malbec
desc_en_short: Altivo Classic Malbec delivers a deep red-violet pour with an elegant nose of lush red fruit and spice, leading into rich dark cherry flavours with a hint of quince, soft tannins, and a long, satisfying finish — approachable yet genuinely impressive.

name: Louis Latour  Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru
desc_en_short:
With a deep garnet colour, the Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru 2012
reveals an attractive nose of cassis, liquorice and cocoa. In the mouth it is delicious and
powerful with earthy aromas and an enjoyable persistence on the finish.

name: Pala  S'Arai Isola Dei Nuraghi IGT
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red colour and consisting of light very clear burgundy reflections. Intense persistent perfume with preponderous notes of mature fruit with light almond taste. Dry taste and soft with a good structure, hot and embracing. Food matching with Gamebirds roast and braised meats, seasoned cheeses but not too spicy. Serve at 18/20° C. uncorking one hour before decanting.

name: Ruffino  Greppone Mazzi Brunello Di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short: Ruffino's Greppone Mazzi estate delivers a benchmark Brunello di Montalcino from 100% Sangiovese — a full-bodied, powerfully structured red with marvellous polished tannins, a complex bouquet of ripe dark fruit, incense, and sweet tobacco, and an exceptionally long, elegant finish.

name: Ruffino  Modus Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Full-bodied and very well-balanced with a perfect union of the Sangiovese, the Merlot, and the Cabernet. Each grape adds distinct varietal traits to the taste. The impressive amount of silky tannins and the full, fruity character contribute to the rich texture and the aromatic persistence is long lingering with hints of vanilla and small red berries.

name: Ruffino  Riserva Ducale Oro Chianti DOCG
style: A Minimum Of 80% Sangiovese Plus Cabernet And Merlot.
desc_en_short: 91 points in Wine Advocate. Full bodied, with a generous, fruity core, where the notes of cherries and small berry fruits intertwine with sensations of Mediterranean herbs, such as rosemary and thyme, and hints of oak. The alcohol is well-integrated in the structure and the tannins are impressive, yet round and soft. The aftertaste is very long and reminiscent of violets, nutmeg, plums, and sweet tobacco.

name: Ruffino  Lodola Nuova Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano DOCG
desc_en_short: Ruffino's Lodola Nuova is a classic expression of Vino Nobile di Montepulciano DOCG, led by Sangiovese with Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot lending structure. Expect ripe plum, meadow flowers, leather, and nutmeg, with velvety tannins and a long, satisfying finish.

name: Ruffino  IL Ducale Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: A modern Tuscan blend from the storied house of Ruffino, Il Ducale weaves Sangiovese's vivid red-fruit character with the plush roundness of Merlot and the peppery lift of Syrah — earning 87 points from Wine Advocate for its harmony, full body, and long, balsamic-tinged finish.

name: Ruffino  Riserva Ducale Chianti Classico DOCG
style: A Minimum Of 80% Sangiovese Plus Cabernet And Merlot.
desc_en_short: 87 points in Wine spectator. Full-bodied, very powerful in its fruity notes, with elegant tannins perfectly supported by a good acidity. The finish is characterized by pleasant sensations of sweet tobacco. The aftertaste is particularly long and shows powerful notes of plums and lighter aromas of clove.

name: Ruffino  Chianti DOCG
style: A Minimum Of 70% Sangiovese Plus Other Red Varietals.
desc_en_short: Medium-bodied, Chianti Ruffino is characterized by harmony between a freshness that makes of Chianti Ruffino an easy to drink wine and a smoothness that elevates the pleasantness of the wine. Persistent fruity sensations feature a long aftertaste. Perfectly matched with a wide variety of traditional Tuscan and Italian dishes.

name: Ruffino  Fonte Al Sole Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Ruffino's Fonte Al Sole is a warmly inviting Toscana IGT that weaves Sangiovese's vibrant red fruit character with the plush softness of Merlot, delivering a velvety, harmonious finish that makes it an effortlessly crowd-pleasing Italian red.

name: Tommasi  Valpolicella DOC
desc_en_short: The color of this wine is bright ruby red, very fresh and fruity at nose, with lots of cherry notes, the taste is fairly intense with sweet cherry flavours. Perfect drinks with pasta, pizza, vegetables, white and red meats, fresh cheeses.

name: Jeseph Mellot  Destinea Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Joseph Mellot's Destinea Cabernet Franc from the Loire Valley delivers a clean, bright entry that opens into a supple, softly structured palate, with mellow, well-integrated tannins that speak to the variety's elegant, food-friendly character.

name: Haras de Pirque By Antinori  Cabernet Sauvignon Hussonet
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ

name: Springfield Estate  Firefinch Ripe Red
style: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon And Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: A ripe and juicy as the ripest plum, berries and currants. Fruit driven nose is upfront and pronounced. Tannins firm but inviting. A food wine - a must with pasta or chill for 15 minutes and enjoy with al fresco summer lunches.

name: Springfield Estate  Methode Ancienne Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Tiny berries — intense in colour and flavour, this meagre crop was vinified in the traditional way. No crushing of berries, no yeast but that from their skins, no fining — additives and no filters. Wine made by itself, kept for two years in the best new French-oak barrels

name: Opus One  Vintage 2015
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 4% Petit Verdot, 7% Cabernet Franc, 6% Merlot, 2% Malbec
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

The essence of time is expressed in Opus One by the character of each vintage. Place, often defined as terroir, represents the geography, the climate and the essential human element which is captured in the wine’s balance between power and finesse, structure and texture.

name: Gerard Bertrand  6eme Sens Rouge
wine_color: A light and very bright ruby-red colour.
desc_en_short: 6ème Sens Rouge develops an aromatic palette consisting of blackcurrants, fresh red fruit and vanilla. The tannins are fine and silky and contribute to the nice balance of this wine.

name: Chateau Mouton Rothschild  1998 (Premiers Crus)
wine_color: Deeply coloured, the wine is an attractive purple-red.
desc_en_short: Château Mouton Rothschild 1998 is a powerful, elegantly structured Pauillac Premier Cru, blending deep blackcurrant and leather aromatics with mocha-tinged oak, underpinned by smooth, authoritative tannins and a finish of remarkable length and poise.

name: 88th Drop  Cabernet Merlot
desc_en_short: This fruit driven Cabernet Merlot exhibits perfect fresh plum bouquet with complexities which lead to a rich, mouth filling palate of juicy berry fruit flavour and mint and violet characters of Cabernet. This medium bodied wine has a soft firm finish which will gain complexity over 3-5 years. Perfect drink with red meats, mushroom, pastas and black olives.

name: 88th Drop  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Brick red and crimsons hues – 88th DROP Shiraz is a warm, rich and approachable wine. Aromas of ripe berry fruit and smoky oak give way to a medium weight with a well rounded palate. Long soft oak tannins support varietal fruit and spicy black pepper flavour. Goes well with most red meat – lamb & mutton, and Asian curries.

name: Sena  2013
wine_color: A dark ruby-red colour with violet highlights.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Carmenere, 12% Malbec, 10% Merlot, 5% Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère, Malbec, Merlot, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: 99 Points in James Suckling - "Superb aromas of black currants, rose petal and mint. Lavender and stones too. Full body with incredible fruit density. Complex, yet it's agile and bright. Tannins are perfectly polished. It builds on the palate and shows the structure of a first growth Bordeaux but remains so Chilean. A blend of 58% cabernet sauvignon, 15% carmenere, 12% malbec, 10% merlot, and 5% petit verdot. From biodynamically grown grapes. This is a joy to taste now but it will show itself in 2019. Even better than the amazing 2012."

name: Robertson Winery  Pinot noir
wine_color: A purple tint on the rim.
desc_en_short: A purple tint on the rim with delicious flavours of ripe strawberry and rich red cherry. Produced in an early drinking style with a touch of wood and a soft smooth finish. Enjoy now with roast beef, guinea fowl, roast chicken, stews, lamb, pizza and pasta.

name: Robertson Winery  Pinotage "Phanto Ridge"
desc_en_short: Phanto Ridge Pinotage from Robertson Winery is a bold, terroir-driven South African red grown on north-facing shale slopes at the foot of the Langeberg Mountains, delivering concentrated dark fruit, earthy depth, and firm tannins ideal for the grill or a hearty beef feast.

name: Robertson Winery  Cabernet Sauvignon "Prospect Hill"
desc_en_short: The Prospect Hill vineyard is situated on a cool southeast-facing slope of the Zandvliet Mountains, at an altitude of 172 metres above sea level. This aspect exposes the vineyard to the warm morning sun and shades it in the hotter afternoons. These features combine deep, well-drained red Karoo soils with a generous lime content, to create the perfect balance for growing exceptional Cabernet Sauvignon. The farm has been owned by one of Robertson Winery’s 35 member families, the Bruwers. since 1956.

name: Robertson Winery  Number One Constitution Road Shiraz
desc_en_short: In 2004 Robertson Winery released a very special Shiraz to commemorate ten years of democracy in South Africa under the new constitution. This opulent wine is made from the best grapes sourced from Robertson Winery’s top Shiraz vineyards. Deep rich purple colour, intense aroma of dark ripe black berry with seductive spicy fruit and black pepper characteristics. Velvety palate with supple fine-grained tannins combining well with the French oak.

name: Tyrrell's  Cabernet Sauvignon "Moore's Creek"
desc_en_short: Tyrrell's Moore's Creek Cabernet Sauvignon is a generous, fruit-driven red blending selected parcels from Australia's premium growing regions, matured in French and American oak to deliver dark plum richness and firm, satisfying tannins.

name: Tyrrell's  Brokenback Shiraz (Hunter Valley)
desc_en_short: An incredibly vibrant purple colour and shows aromas of red berry fruits with only a very subtle lift of French oak. These characters then flow seamlessly onto the palate, with plush, sweet fruit balanced by soft acid and tannin resulting in a classic Hunter shiraz. A rich, classic wine of this nature is best served with rich, classic food accompaniments including roasted meats such as lamb or beef.

name: Tyrrell's  Rufus Stone Shiraz  (Mclaren Vale)
desc_en_short: A fine balance of power and finesse. Bright purple hue and lifted aromatics are accentuated by flavours of cherries, plums and chocolate. Fine, long tannins support the powerful fruit to give this wine its seamless palate structure.

name: Tyrrell's  Hunter Pinot Noir "Vat 6" (Hunter Valley)
desc_en_short: Light in colour, the Vat 6 Pinot Noir has a strawberry lift on the nose with stalk character from the whole bunch ferment adding complexity. The palate is delicate with bright berry fruit characters being the forerunner to the fine tannin structure. It is a wine that will age well in the medium term.

name: Stone Bay  Pinot Noir (Nelson)
desc_en_short: Stone Bay Pinot Noir draws from carefully selected Nelson vineyards in New Zealand's South Island, delivering a ruby-bright, easy-drinking red brimming with raspberries, red cherries, and subtle plum — balanced, fresh, and approachable in every glass.

name: Santa Ana  Malbec
wine_color: A lively red colour with violet hues.
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Malbec has a lively red colour with violet hues. Intense aromas of fruits such as plums and cherries, well balanced in the mouth, soft and nice finish. The ideal wine for grilled meat. Combines also very well with pasta, mild to spicy cuisine and semi-hard cheeses.

name: Santa Ana  Organic Malbec "Eco"
wine_color: An intense red coloured Malbec with elegant hints of violet.
desc_en_short: This is an intense red coloured Malbec with elegant hints of violet. Sweet aromas of blackberries and plums. Good structure and velvety texture, with soft tannins and long aftertaste. Ideal with turkey, pastas and grilled meats.

name: Antares  Carmenere
wine_color: A bright and intense ruby red colour.
desc_en_short: Our Carmenere has a bright and intense ruby red colour. Its aromas are full of character, particularly ripe black fruits, spices like pepper and accompanied by more subtle notes of vanilla and cinnamon. On the palate the wine is medium-bodied, full of character with ripe and soft tannins and a long lingering finish. Food paring with cold pasta, grilled red meats, white meats in sauce, meat and vegetable stew and smoked salmon. Serve at a temperature of 18°c

name: Antares  Merlot
desc_en_short: A plush, fruit-driven Chilean Merlot from the sun-drenched Central Valley, delivering ripe plum, cherry, and strawberry aromas lifted by warm cinnamon spice — an approachable, well-balanced red that pairs beautifully with everyday meals.

name: Yalumba  Y Series Shiraz
desc_en_short: Yalumba Y Series Shiraz delivers a generous South Australian red packed with blood plum, boysenberry, and Szechwan pepper spice, backed by sweet fruit depth and a hearty, satisfying finish — an approachable everyday Shiraz with genuine character.

name: Santa Ana  Merlot
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Merlot has a deep ruby red colour. Flavours of red ripe fruits with a subtle hint of black pepper. Medium-body, juicy and soft taste. Ideal to combine with red meat with vegetables and semi hard cheeses.

name: Santa Ana  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Cabernet Sauvignon has a deep red colour. Fruity and well-balanced in the mouth, with presence of black fruits and sweet tannins. Ideal to accompany grilled red meat with vapour- cooked vegetables and semi-hard cheeses.

name: Santa Ana  Shiraz Reserve
wine_color: A deep ruby red colour with purple hues.
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Shiraz Reserve shows a deep ruby red colour with purple hues. Complex aromas, with overt layers of blackberry fruit, smoked meatiness and spicy aromas underpinned by subtle oak. Mouth lling and well supported by rm ripe tannins and a rich lingering aftertaste. Ideal with pastas, lamb and beef.

name: Santa Ana  Malbec Reserve
wine_color: An intense red colour with elegant hints of violet.
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Malbec Reserve has an intense red colour with elegant hints of violet. Sweet aromas of blackberries and plums, well combined with a subtle vanilla touch. Good structure and velvety texture, with soft tannins and long aftertaste. Ideal with turkey, pastas, and for barbecue or stews.

name: Santa Ana  Organic Cabernet Sauvignon "Eco"
wine_color: A deep ruby red wine with violet hues.
desc_en_short: This is a deep ruby red wine with violet hues. On the nose it displays blackcurrant and red fruit aromas layered with green peppercorns and spicy complexity. Well balanced mouth filling wine textured with ripe tannins and a full lingering finish. It pairs very well with seasoned red meats, lamb and ripe chesses.

name: Antares  Shiraz
wine_color: A bright and intense ruby red colour.
desc_en_short: Antares Shiraz from Chile's Central Valley delivers rich aromas of blackberry, blackcurrant, chocolate, and spice, rounded out by smooth vanilla notes and an elegant, complex finish — a full-bodied red that punches well above its price point.

name: Antares  Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: A bright and intense ruby red colour.
desc_en_short: A approachable Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon from the sun-drenched Central Valley, delivering ripe raspberries, cherries, and warm notes of cinnamon and cocoa — fruit-forward, harmonious, and built for everyday enjoyment with food.

name: Two Vines  Cabernet Sauvignon Columbia Crest
desc_en_short: Aromas of strawberry, cherry and cola lead to a silky, soft palate that culminates into a long velvety finish. This Cabernet Sauvignon is elegant yet approachable and complex.

name: Planeta  La Segreta Rosso DOC Sicilia
wine_color: Ruby red with clear purple tones.
style: Nero D’avola, 25% Merlot, 20% Syrah, 5% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Ruby red with clear purple tones. Explosive aromas of cocoa, tobacco and fresh fruit. Mulberry, plum and slightly minty hints of balsam are apparent. Well ripened tannins without astringency are the foundation with a fresh alcoholic structure and well balanced tannin content.

name: Millaman  Condor Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A ripe, juicy wine, filled with notes of cassis, ripe plums and fresh berries. Smooth and velvety mouth. Excellent with a wide range of dishes, including beef, stews and mature cheeses.

name: Millaman Estate Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon Malbec
wine_color: Intense red color with purple tones
desc_en_short: Intense red color with purple tones. Sweet notes of blackberry, spices and delicate toasted tones that add a unique complexity to this wine. Ripe and sweet tannins of good structure, rich acidity with a long and friendly finish.

name: Millaman  Limited Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Intense red color, with violet tinges. Elegant aromas of red fruits, menthol, chocolate and spices. Great structure, soft, round and elegant tannins; excellent balance balanced finish. Pairings include strong chesses and red meat like beef, lamb and pork.

name: Campero  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Campero Shiraz is rich in black berries and cassic, with subtle chocolate notes. It is a great match for any kind of meat dish, sweet &sour dishes and cheese. To enjoy its full potentail, open one hour prior to serving at room temperature.

name: Churchview  Silverleaf Shiraz
desc_en_short: This wine is full flavoured and fruit driven with a touch of spice. The nose offers aromas of mullberries, black berries and  plums with subtle spicynotes. Tobacco and leather are further complexed by the white pepper and cloves complimenting those fruits.
