A full flavoured wine with soft tannins make this perfect style of wine to have with or without food. Enjoy with beef tomato and mushroom braise.

name: Cape Zebra  Pinotage
desc_en_short: This rich, robust red wine, which is packed with ripe, succulent berry fruits is brimming with good vibes and overflowing with flavour. Enjoy with chicken, pasta or red meat stews.

name: Vidal  Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
desc_en_short: This classic blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec and Cabernet Franc displays aromas of red fruits and spice. With flavours of plum, blackcurrant and cedar, the smooth finish on the palate is supported by supple, approachable tannins.

name: Santa Carolina  Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot "Vistana"
desc_en_short: Blackberries and cherries, accompanied of violet notes Palate: same flavors, round tannins and a pleasant finish.

name: Santa Carolina  Merlot
desc_en_short: Bright ruby red-violet colour. Aromas of plums and blackberries with a touch of spice and toast notes. The palate is soft, sweet tannins and a flavorful, full-bodied palate.

name: Santa Carolina  Merlot Reserva
desc_en_short: Deep, young violet. Mature black fruit, blackberries, and exotic spices such as cinnamon and nutmeg in aromas. Medium body, soft tannins, persistent. Ideal with grilled vegetables, lasagna, or meatloaf.

name: Santa Carolina  Gran Reserva Syrah
desc_en_short: Ruby violet. Blueberries, hints of spice, tobacco on aromas. Complex pear and chocolate liquor flavors that form a palate with tannins made to mature. Ideal with roasted lamb, barbecued meat.

name: Santa Carolina  Herencia "Carmenere"
desc_en_short: Being a true expression of the typical Peumo terroir, with a touch of the characteristic fruit notes from Los Lingues, this icon pairs the soul of two of Chile’s top Carmenère appellations. Its color is deep ruby red; the note offers fresh red and black fruit and spices like nutmeg. Herencia is a silky wine, structured, distinctly fresh, broad and deep.

name: Santa Carolina  Cabernet Sauvignon Gran Reserva
desc_en_short: Santa Carolina's Maipo Valley Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon delivers rich plum, cherry, and cassis fruit with a whisper of dark chocolate, framed by elegant fine-grained tannins — a classic Chilean red that punches well above its price point.

name: Santa Carolina  Reserva De Familia Malbec
desc_en_short: "Carmenere Reserva de Familia manages what is difficult to achieve with the grape: freshness. It does have the cigar ash, roasted pepper and chocolate aromas of the grape, but the palate is medium-bodied with fine tannins, good balance and that freshness."

name: Santa Carolina  Reserva De Familia Carmenere
desc_en_short: 89 Points in Wine Spectator. Full-bodied and ambitious, with judicious, toasty oak to the jammy blackberry, cassis and dark plum notes that remain fresh while hints of mesquite, cured olive and spice line the long finish.

name: Santa Carolina  V S C
wine_color: Deep red color with some violet hues.
style: Petit Verdot, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Carmen?re, 10% Mourv?dre, 5% Malbec
desc_en_short: 89 Points in Wine Spectator. VSC is an icon wine that embodies the philosophy and enological style of Santa Carolina. A wine of powerful personality and great concentration. With every new vintage, VSC seeks to offer new expressions of the best New World varieties that grow in the granite soil of the terroirs of Chile’s central zone.

name: Santa Carolina  Ekun Organic Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Intense ruby red with violet hues.
desc_en_short: Ekun – which means respect in Mapudungún – represents Santa Carolina’s strong commitment to sustainability and the environment. Each of the varieties in this range is made with limited production organic grapes: a full-bodied Cabernet Sauvignon, with a high fresh fruit concentration

name: Cantine Ivam  Barone di Bernaj Cerasuolo Di Vittoria DOCG
desc_en_short: Barone di Bernaj Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG blends Nero d'Avola and Frappato from the sun-drenched hills of Vittoria in southeastern Sicily, delivering a juicy, medium-bodied red with vivid cherry character, earthy warmth, and a naturally harmonious finish.

name: Cantine Ivam  Barone di Bernaj Nerello Mascalese Sicilia IGT
desc_en_short: Red wine caracterised by a ruby – red colour tending to garnet. Intense and spicy perfume, fruity and vanila scents. Taste of good Structure, lively character, persistent and austere tannin. Goes well with red meat and mature cheeses. Served at a temperature Of 18-20C.

name: Cantine Ivam  Barone di Bernaj Nero D'avola/Syrah Sicilia IGT
desc_en_short: A sun-drenched Sicilian blend from Cantine Ivam's Barone di Bernaj range, marrying equal parts native Nero d'Avola and Syrah for a richly fruited, spice-laced red with warm Mediterranean character and a smooth, immediately approachable finish.

name: Cantine Ivam  Nero D'avola Tralci Sicilia IGT
desc_en_short: A sun-drenched Sicilian red from Cantine Ivam, this 100% Nero d'Avola delivers a deep ruby pour loaded with ripe dark fruit, a whisper of Mediterranean herbs, and a well-rounded palate that punches well above its everyday price point.

name: Vecchia Cantina  Rosso Di Montepulciano DOC
wine_color: Medium intensity ruby red with violet shades.
desc_en_short: Medium intensity ruby red with violet shades. This aromas show red berry fruits, morello cherry and redcurrant, which enhances its fineness. The palate is full, with good vanilla notes, pleasant balance between tannin and acidity. Ideal service temperature: 16-18° C. Food pairing with red and white meat, cured meat and salami as well as medium aged cheese.

name: Vecchia Cantina  Merlot Cortona DOC
wine_color: Deep ruby red with blackberry hues.
desc_en_short: From Tuscany's Cortona DOC, Vecchia Cantina's Merlot delivers a smooth, full-bodied red layered with blackberry, red berry, vanilla oak, and classic Merlot herbal notes — a harmonious and spice-laced wine built for the table.

name: Vecchia Cantina  Umbria Rosso IGT
wine_color: Deep ruby red with blackberry hues.
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red with blackberry hues. Full, fresh and lingering with fruity notes and hints of licorice, revealing vegetal notes as it develops. Dry and harmonious with distinct notes of fruit, leather and confectionery; a pleasing balance of the characteristic qualities of its components. Pairs well with red meats, fresh cheeses and pasta dishes. Serving temperature is 16°-18° C.

name: Vecchia Cantina  Campaltino Toscana Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: A vibrant Tuscan everyday red from Vecchia Cantina, blending Sangiovese and Canaiolo into a fresh, fruit-driven wine with lively red berry character, a sapid, food-friendly palate, and the kind of honest Tuscan charm that makes every meal feel like an occasion.

name: Rothbury  Shiraz / Cabernet
desc_en_short: A rich and approachable Australian red blend, Rothbury Shiraz/Cabernet delivers dark plum, chocolate, and blackcurrant fruit framed by smooth French oak — an easy-drinking crowd-pleaser built for the barbecue or a casual weeknight dinner.

name: Rocca Delle Macie  Chianti "Vernaiolo" DOCG
desc_en_short: Rocca delle Macìe's Vernaiolo is a classic, approachable Chianti DOCG built on Sangiovese with touches of Merlot and Canaiolo — a lively, ruby-red everyday Italian red delivering fresh red fruit and vibrant acidity, ready to enjoy from the spring after harvest.

name: Rocca Delle Macie  Chianti Colli Senesi "Rubizzo" DOCG
wine_color: Brilliant ruby red with violet highlights
style: Sangiovese And A Small Percentage Of Merlot
desc_en_short: A wine with greater aromatic complexity, more smoothness and more coloring substances, but at the same time also an enjoyable drinkability that would make it suitable for any palate and situation.

name: Lindeman's  Bin 40 Merlot
wine_color: Medium red in colour with ruby hues
desc_en_short: Soft, fruity and highly sipable is the name of the game with this lush style of merlot from Lindemans. Dark fruits and spicy plums decorate the nose, and leap out onto the palate, with just a lick of toasty oak. The tannins and acidity are soft and mellow making this a satisfying drink anytime of day

name: Discovery Point  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: A classic Central Otago Pinot Noir bursting with dark berries, plum, and wild herb aromas, leading to a rich, plump palate of juicy cherry-stone fruit, clean acidity, and a soft, succulent finish — effortlessly food-friendly and endlessly approachable.

name: Bolla  Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico DOC
desc_en_short: Bolla Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOC is a powerfully concentrated red crafted from appassimento-dried Corvina and Rondinella grapes, delivering layers of wild cherry jam, dark chocolate, and cedar spice with a long, velvety finish that rewards patience and a special occasion.

name: Bolla  Amarone Riserva Della Valpolicella Classico DOC
wine_color: A deep and velvety garnet colour with a violet hue.
desc_en_short: A deep and velvety garnet colour with a violet hue. A perfume of wild cherries, jam, mature pear, vanilla, liquorice and cedar wood. Full-bodied, warm on the palate with clear hints of cocoa and spices. Perfect drinks with grilled red meats, T-bone steaks, fillet with pepper sauce, pastisada de caval, and game or hard, well-matured cheeses.

name: Bolla  Bardolino Classico
desc_en_short: This bright ruby red wine has hints of black cherry on the nose.  It is soft and fruit-forward, with black-fruit flavors followed by a bright and fresh finish. Serve it as the Italians do – young and lightly chilled. Pairs perfectly with fleshy fish, beef, lamb, red-sauced pastas and pizza.

name: Bolla  Valpolicella Classico DOC
wine_color: An intense ruby red colour with garnet hues.
desc_en_short: The combination of grapes indigenous to the region creates a superb traditional Valpolicella. It is garnet red in colour, with a fresh aroma of cherries, red currants and blackberries, with a hint of black pepper and walnuts. It is light to medium-bodied in style with soft tannins and pure fruit flavours.

name: Masi  Amarone "Vaio Armaron" Della Valpolicella Classico DOC Serego Alighieri
desc_en_short:
VAIO ARMARON AMARONE DELLA VALPOLICELLA CLASSICO

An important Amarone with extraordinary power and complexity: a classic in the Italian winemaking portfolio.

This is the icon wine of the historic Serego Alighieri estate and comes from the eponymous vineyard, the source it seems of the very name Amarone itself.

This noble wine is produced using time-honoured practices in the vineyard, in the ancient drying lofts and in the cellars.

Its elegant personality is enhanced by the use of the Serego Alighieri clone of the Molinara grape and by ageing in cherry-wood casks, as family tradition dictates.

name: Masi  Bardolino "Frescaripa" Classico DOC
desc_en_short: Bardolino Frescaripa is made with the traditional Veronese grapes Corvina, Rondinella and Molinara in the Bardolino Classico zone. A light red wine with an intense bouquet thanks to the beneficial climate of Lake Garda.

name: Citra  Cabernet Sauvignon "Terre Di Chieti"
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red. Rich fruit aromas with notes of black pepper. Round and full on the palate, with balanced tannins and a pleasant, lingering aftertaste. Enjoy with grilled meats, roast turkey, barbecue and hearty vegetarian fare.

name: Chateau Meyney  Cru Bourgeois Superieur
desc_en_short: The Merlots are very aromatic with fine and rounded tannins.The Cabernet Sauvignon are deep in colour and show the full aromatic spectrum of this variety, with strong whiffs of black berry fruit that are a hallmark of the best vintages.

name: Citra  Merlot "Terre Di Chieti"
desc_en_short: Vibrant ruby red. Intense fruit aromas with a pronounced violet notes. Pleasantly tannic, with round fruit flavors leading into a smooth finish. Excellent with flavorful pasta dishes, risottos, roasts and spicy fare. Serve at room temperature or slightly chilled.

name: Citra  Montepulciano D'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: Lush ruby with hints of purple. Pleasant, lingering fruit aromas. Dry, well-balanced and delightfully tannic, with concentrated berry flavors. A perfect accompaniment to grilled meats, rich pasta dishes and vegetarian entrees.

name: Citra  Sangiovese "Terre Di Chieti"
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red. Intense fruit and floral aromas. Medium-bodied and smooth, with a lingering finish. A perfect accompaniment to grilled meats, pasta in red sauce and assorted cheeses.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2017
wine_color: A dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints.
desc_en_short: "The Beaujolais-Villages Nouveau exhibits the same intense colour as the Beaujolais Nouveau. The wines have a dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints. The nose is very expressive with aromas of blackberry, licorice and blueberry. The palate is full, rather generous, and on these same fruity notes. Some slight acidity brings an agreeable freshness. The Beaujolais Nouveau 2017 is very flattering and can be enjoyed with pleasure as an aperitif, with cold meats, or simple dishes of regional specialties"

name: Rocca delle Macie  Chianti Classico DOCG
desc_en_short: 89 points in Wine Advocate - Robert Parker. A lively, ruby-red wine that expresses character, freshness and terroir, and is laden with aromas of cherry and violet. Savory and full bodied, it highlights the exceptional persistence of the bouquet. An exceptional match to all meats and pastas.

name: Rocca delle Macie  Chianti Classico Riserva DOCG
wine_color: ruby red, becoming garnet with age.
desc_en_short: 87 points in Wine Advocate - Robert Parker. This ruby-red wine with its aroma of blackcurrant and marasca cherries, with notes of Peruvian pepper and sweet spices. Its equilibrium makes it a suitable accompaniment for a range of dishes, but it is also a great match for a good seasoned cheese.

name: Rocca delle Macie  Roccato Toscana IGT
wine_color: Deep ruby red with garnet reflections
desc_en_short:
Roccato Toscana IGT

1988 saw the unveiling of the first bottle of Roccato. This wine, conceived and willed into being by Italo and Sergio and based on equal parts of Sangiovese and Cabernet Sauvignon grapes, represents the essence of the path undertaken by the winery itself.

Indeed, like Rocca delle Macìe, which started out from the tradition of Chianti Classico and has since opened up to innovation without ever forgetting its origins, Roccato represents the encounter of the most typical roots of Sangiovese with the modernity symbolized by Cabernet and by the barriques used for the aging process.

A mouth-filling, velvety wine that is rich in aromas of blackberry, plum and licorice, Roccato has a good mineral component and a tannic structure that is capable of supporting long-term aging.

name: Rocca delle Macie  Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano DOCG
wine_color: intense ruby red, becoming garnet  over time.
desc_en_short: A small area in the municipality of Montepulciano in south-eastern Tuscany – characterized by the extraordinary richness of a unique artistic legacy and natural heritage – is the birthplace of wines of quite exceptional quality, 'noble' wines indeed.

name: Fattoria dei Barbi  Rosso Di Montalcino DOC
desc_en_short: Brilliant ruby red. Clean and fresh with prevalence of red berries, redcurrant and cherry on the nose. Light scents of eucalyptus. The palate is warm and pleasant with smooth tannins. Savory. Mineral, a touch of menthol in the finish.

name: Danzante  Merlot
wine_color: An intense ruby red, with subtle purplish highlight.
desc_en_short: Danzante Merlot is an intense ruby red, with subtle purplish highlight. The nose initially reveals emphatic notes of wild red berryfruit, such as wild cherry and blueberry, which expand into a peppery amalgam of baker’s chocolate and black liquorice. The palate is warm and silky, displaying crisp fruit with dense-packed, glossy tannins. An almost endless finish provides the wine’s impressive conclusion.

name: La Gioiosa Etamorasa  Merlot Delle Venezie IGT
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red. Fruity with a predominance of blackberry, but also small red berries. Agreeable flowery hint of rose with a delicate pepper nuance. Dry and persistrntly flavoursome. Warm with a pleasantly bitter aftertaste. Enjoy drinks with roasted red meat and semi-hard cheese.

name: La Gioiosa Etamorasa  Cabernet Delle Venezie IGT
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red. Hints of small fruits of the forest, in particular raspberry, with a flowery sensation of violets and delicate pink pepper. It is dry, flavoursome, with an agreeable touch of tannin. Its fruity flavour is persistent and the finish slightly herbaceous.

name: Tahuna  Merlot Hawke's Bay
desc_en_short: Great colour and aromas of plum and dark berryfruit are typical of Hawke’s Bay Merlot. Silky tannins give it a soft finish for early drinkability and the depth of fruit gives it the ability to cellar for 4-5 years. Recommended serving temperature 18-20°C.

name: San Leonardo  Villa Gresti Di San Leonardo
desc_en_short: From Tenuta San Leonardo in Trentino-Alto Adige, Villa Gresti is a Merlot-dominant blend of quiet authority and velvet elegance — delivering notes of tobacco, vanilla, and cocoa powder with beautifully balanced tannins and a finish that lingers long after the last sip.

name: San Leonardo  2000
wine_color: Intense ruby red with garnet highlights.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Cabernet Franc And 10% Merlot.
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red with garnet highlights. A wine of remarkable intensity on the nose, which layers bell peppers and wild berries over a background note of vanilla. The palate is full, warm and impressively rounded, with intense aromatics that linger on the palate. Enjoy drinks with red meats, poultry, roasts, braised or stewed meats, game and mature cheeses.

name: Corvo  Rosso
wine_color: Lively ruby-red with light garnet red highlights.
desc_en_short: Corvo Rosso, a classic Sicilian wine, is produced from Sicilian vines cultivated on warm, sunny hills. Aged in oak barrels it is distinguished by its round, full-bodied and persistent flavour. Together with Corvo Bianco, Corvo Rosso was the first wine to be bottled in Sicily, back in 1824, and is now the best known red wine in Italy thanks to its excellent quality/price ratio and consistent quality.

name: Duca di Salaparuta  Duca Enrico
wine_color: Ruby red with garnet red highlights
desc_en_short: Duca Enrico is a wine of great charm; it is aged for 18 months in oak barrels, which lends it complexity, style and longevity, after which it is bottle aged for at least a year to complete the organoleptic qualities, enhancing the distinctive bouquet with aristocratic notes. Perfect with red meat, medium-aged cheeses and full-flavoured dishes. Perfect meditation wine. Serving temperature 18° C.

name: Valfieri  Barbaresco "Bric Mentina" DOCG
wine_color: Deep ruby red/garnet colour with orange reflections.
desc_en_short: A single-vineyard Barbaresco DOCG from the hilltop Bric Mentina site, this Valfieri Nebbiolo delivers classic Piedmontese grandeur — dried roses, truffle, and earth layered beneath firm tannins, aged a minimum of 24 months in oak for remarkable depth and elegance.

name: Valfieri  Barbera D'Asti DOC
desc_en_short: Deep ruby colour with violet reflections. Very rich, penetranting nose. Dry, with medium body, fresh and irrepressible. Excellent with meat dishes in gneral and with soft cheeses.

name: Sandrone  Dolcetto D'Alba DOC
desc_en_short: Dolcetto is traditionally an easy-to-drink, everyday wine. Sandrone’s Dolcetto shows great plum and berry fruit, deep minerality and good, firm, ripe tannins. It is more than a “sweet little one”, however, as it has good structure, with bright acid and the ability to age easily for five years or more. The 2015 vintage brought forth a Dolcetto of inky purple color, with an expressive nose of plum, black raspberries and black tea leaves. On the palate, it is forward and generous with black and red fruits, mountain thyme and garrigue, ripe tannins and bright, refreshing acid. 2015 gave them Dolcetto fruit of beautiful quality - among the best we have ever seen - and the resulting wine is harmonious and equilibrated.

name: Sandrone  Nebbiolo D'Alba "Valmaggiore" DOC
desc_en_short: An unexpected and surprising nose of red and yellow cherries, with sweet red grapefruit, mineral elements and notes of raspberry. Sweet fruit in a lighter structure and medium palate weight defined by the bright acids. Ripe tannins frame the very pure fruit – this is an elegant, easy-drinking wine, but still complex. Nice lingering finish. Delicious, with sauvage notes at the end. It is a completely different and unique style of Nebbiolo.

name: Sandrone  Barbera D'Alba DOC
desc_en_short: The Barbera d'Alba is a beautifully pointed, focused wine. Dark raspberries, flowers, minerals and smoke are woven together in a fabric of notable verve. The mid-weight, vibrant style is a bit of a departure from some of the bigger, lusher Barberas Sandrone has made in previous years, but I find the clean, driven personality of the wine highly attractive, not to mention incredibly food friendly.

name: Sandrone  Barolo "Le Vigne" DOCG
desc_en_short: A tight nose of dark fruits and black cherries with graphite and cedar box, hints of vanilla and dark chocolate emerges from the glass. On the palate, vanilla, chocolate and cassis combine with layers of fruit, acid and ripe tannins. It has a full-bodied mouthfeel and this wine will need 3-4 more years to reach its maturity plateau. Though the velvety tannins are still quite tight, this is a ripe and balanced Le Vigne. It has a good finish, with very fine and linear tannins, good length and balance.

name: Sandrone  Barolo "Cannubi Boschis" DOCG 2009
desc_en_short: Dark red color with hints of purple. Fat ripe black cherries on the nose, plush and forward with hints of vanilla, spices and clove. In the mouth, the fruit is forward and ripe, almost but not quite jammy, kept in harmony by the subtle acidity. It has good attack on the palate, and the mouthfeel is creamy, chocolately and soft with menthol notes. This wine shows the warm Cannubi Boschis terroir to great advantage. The tannins are very sweet and long, but will still require some patience to soften. Though it is more forward and ready than its sibling the Le Vigne Barolo, it still needs time. Finish is long and sweet with oak & spice notes over the black cherries and black fruits.

name: La Campagne  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Typical blackcurrant fruit flavours, the hallmark of Cabernet Sauvignon, show strongly on this wine. It has been purposely vinified to produce a soft, fruity, easy to drink style wine. Pair this wine with light pork dishes, roast chicken, turkey or salami to complement the characteristics of this wine.

name: La Campagne  Merlot
desc_en_short: A rich, juicy Merlot that has been personally selected from some of the best estates to the west of Narbonne. It shows all the true characteristics of the variety, with lots of full plummy fruit and soft, rounded tannins. Flavourful meats such as beef, pheasant and duck are perfectly paired to this wine or try it with a good sausage casserole and cured meats such as Parma ham.

name: Jean D'alibert  Pinot Noir "Domaine Saint Esteve"
desc_en_short: Ruby red color. Complex and elegant nose dominated by aromas of black fruit, cherries in brandy with hints of spice. The palace is melted, balanced and harmonious with remarkable persistence in the final.

name: Chateau Foncrose  Bordeaux Rouge
desc_en_short: Château Foncrose Bordeaux Rouge is an approachable, fruit-forward blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot delivering a garnet-bright pour with ripe, round fruit character, supple tannins, and a well-balanced finish that punches above its everyday price point.

name: Chateau Butte De Charlemagne  Bordeaux
desc_en_short: This wine comes from Cabara in Bordeaux. Made from old vines this wine is exceptionally smooth and satisfying.

name: Chateau Promis  Bordeaux Rouge
desc_en_short: This wine has an intense purplish colour, a powerful rich nose dominated by hints of ripe fruits and a structured mouth with a creamy attack and a velvety evolute. Enjoy drinks with grilled red meats, poultry or cheese with character.

name: Chateau Tour Des Graves
desc_en_short: This wine has a beautiful purple color develops a nose of ripe red fruits, discreetly woody and spicy. On the palate the tannins are present but very round.

name: Chateau Le Pin
desc_en_short: Solid Bordeaux flavour which is best at room temperature. Nice tannins which are slightly on the higher side but that’s because the wine is young. Long aftertaste which is not complex but quite solid. Unexpectedly good for ordinary Vin de Bordeaux and for the price.

name: Chateau Lalene  "Cuvee Prestige" Bordeaux Superieur
desc_en_short: Brilliant color, delicate aroma of cherries and blackberries, finesse-rich fruit spectrum, soft tannins, good potential.

name: Beau Rivage  Premium Grande Reserve Bordeaux Superieur
desc_en_short: Ruby red in color. Aromas of red and black berries, plums, redcurrant and raspberry, orange marmelade and black cherry, with a light touch of barrique notes. Elegant wine with soft tannins and pleasant finish. Pairs well with various dishes, such as lighter meats, red meat, venison veal, deer, turkey, cheese and some desserts.

name: Chateau Bel Air  Haut-Medoc Cru Bourgeois
desc_en_short: This Haut Medoc proposes liquorice notes and round and fine tannins. Deep and surprising, this red wine has a great maturity coming from the grapes, which means a wonderful strong matter.

name: Agricola Querciabella  Camartina Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Camartina is Querciabella's flagship Super Tuscan, a commanding blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Sangiovese from the arid sandstone slopes of Ruffoli, aged 18 months in French oak for a wine of extraordinary depth, structure, and elegance.

name: Chateau Haut Beychevelle Gloria  Saint Julien
desc_en_short: Chateau Haut Beychevelle Gloria is a classic Saint-Julien red from Bordeaux's prestigious Médoc, delivering intense aromas of red berry and cedarwood, ripe fruit on the palate, and silky tannins that capture the elegant character of this celebrated Left Bank appellation.

name: Chateau Meyney  Saint-Estephe
style: Cabernet Sauvignon (61%), Merlot  (26%) And Cabernet Franc (3%).
desc_en_short: Saint Estèphe de Meyney provides from younger vines from Château Meyney, on the prestigious appellation of Saint Estèphe. Made with the same care as the first wine, and using a similar blend, it comes from the younger vines on the estate. These have an average age of 15/20 years.

name: Chateau Laffitte Carcasset  Cru Bourgeois
desc_en_short:
History :

Chartreuse of the XVIII th. Century surrounded by vineyards planted in the center of the gravellous plateau of Saint Estèphe, the Château Laffitte Carcasset is producing wine since 1790 when Sir Joseph Laffitte, attorney of the King of France, brought the domain and created the vineyard. In 1955, the viscount Pierre de Padirac purchased the property. Since then the vineyard has expanded and many technical improvements have been brought for a good breeding of the wine.

Description :

Laffitte Carcasset combines the traditional method with the advanced techniques to produce the wines Fermentation is during 20 to 30 days, and the wine is in barrels
(30% new) for 14 months. The wine of Laffitte carcasset is typical of its appellation, both tannic and full-bodied, with the intense aroma.

name: Borie-Manoux Pauillac  Borie  Pauillac AOC
desc_en_short: Lightly smoky, fresh berry fruit, dry spices, the palate is on the lighter side, very fresh with tannins and a medium to long finish, quite closed at present, should get its share of bottle ageing time.

name: Chateau Tour Sieujean  Cru Bourgeois
desc_en_short: Silver Medal Concours de Bordeaux for year of 2007. The nose is light roasted notes that get a touch of juiciness of a black currant present. The palate holds its beautiful structure not back: Rich, silky tannins help to create an expressive, harmonious and finessereichen enjoyment.

name: Chateau Tayac  Cuvee Larauza Margaux
desc_en_short: An open and expressive nose of black fruits, with very subtle oak influence, and hints of forest floor and pine resin. The palate is firm but harmoniously structured, with ample fruit.

name: Borie-Manoux  Margaux
desc_en_short: An attractively intense crimson to the eye. Gently aromatic, fruity aromas. Pleasant mouthfeel, fruity, flavorful, with a soft/gentle texture. Aromatic and savory finish, without any hardness. A well-crafted wine.

name: Chateau Pontac Lynch  Cru Bourgeois
desc_en_short: A controlled maturation and a well ripe grapes’ picking are all the recipe of the excellent and elegant Château Pontac-Lynch. It is a fruits’ explosion in the nose and also in the mouth. Nice volume on the palate, soft tannins, long finish. The most feminine wine of our range, typical Margaux.

name: Chateau Moulin Du Terrier
desc_en_short: A blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, it is a beautiful example of a Bordeaux wine. Flavours of ripe cherry, plum and cassis with a little bit of oak influence. It is medium bodied, well structured with fine ripe tannins and a lingering finish.

name: Chateau La Fagnouse  Saint-Emilion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: A silky attack and a fleshy structure balanced and lively, on savory tannins and aromas reminding of flavors experienced nose. Good length.

name: Chateau Puy Blanquet  Saint-Emilion 2008
desc_en_short: This has always been considered one of the best Grand Cru of Saint Emilion. The current guv'nor, Roger Jacquet, gets advice from the Petrus owners and it shows in this wine's consistent class vintage to vintage. Mellow and soft already, like a melting Turkish Delight. Sticky fingers, indeed.

name: Chateau Nenin Pomerol  2008
desc_en_short: 89 Points in Wine Advocate. "This structured Pomerol reveals classic sweet cherry and kirsch liqueur-like notes intermixed with hints of minerals and flowers. Lovely ripeness, medium body, and a restrained but noble style suggest it will drink well for 10-15 years. Also tasted: 2004 Fugue de Nenin (86) "

name: Chateau La Conseillante  Pomerol 2018
desc_en_short: The 2018 La Conseillante is composed of 83% Merlot and 17% Cabernet Franc, with a 3.65 pH and 14% alcohol. Deep garnet-purple colored, it needs a lot of swirling and coaxing to lure out the youthfully shy, incredible perfume of black raspberries, boysenberries, ripe plums and cinnamon toast, leading to notions of lilacs, clove oil and forest floor, plus a waft of iron ore. The medium to full-bodied palate is a jaw-dropping exercise in finesse, slowly unfurling in the mouth to reveal layer upon layer of bright, crunchy red and black fruits, supported by a rock-solid frame of firm, fine-grained tannin's and tons of freshness, finishing long and with an impressive mineral and exotic spice firework display. It's an incredible expression of Pomerol that cannot fail to inspire a resounding "WOW" from whoever is fortunate to drink it. Tempting to broach now (albeit with a lot of air), try to keep your hands off it for a good 5 years and then drink it over the next 30 years or more.

name: Chateau L'Evangile  Pomerol 2015
desc_en_short: Deep, dense colour with glints of violet. Very expressive nose with black fruit and subtle notes of toast. On the palate, the attack is powerful, dense and structured. The mid-palate is full-bodied, with a fine, well-balanced tannic structure. The finish has plenty of volume with superbly ripened tannins, while remaining elegant and refined, thanks to the quality of the grapes of this exceptional vintage.

name: Chateau Maillard  Graves Rouge
desc_en_short: A classic Graves Rouge from Château Maillard, built on 80% Merlot with Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon lending structure. Expect deep blackcurrant, cedar, and tobacco aromas, a mineral, stony palate with fine-grained tannins, and a lingering, freshly earthy finish.

name: Chateau Baret  Pessac-Leognan
desc_en_short: Berry and plum fruit, herbs, oak, Graves smoke and a medicinal aroma. Nicely rounded with some flesh to it, fine acidity and a rewarding firm, dry finish. Drink now-2016

name: Chateau La Louviere
desc_en_short: Full and balanced, with elegance and structure. More of the toasty oak and berry character echoes the nose. Rich, very persistent. Ideal to accompany prime beef cuts such as fillet steak and boneless rib, as well as roast squab ; drink now and for at least twenty more years.

name: Chateau Carbonnieux  Grand Cru Classe
desc_en_short: The red wine seduces in its first youth, then delivers all its aromas and complexity of flavor after many years of aging. With its well-balanced and silky tannins in harmony with its fruit, Château Carbonnieux’s red is a wine of great, classic character.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Savigny Les Beaune
desc_en_short: "A delicate and elegant wine. On the nose, characteristic aromas of spice and violet, mingled with wild blackberry. On the palate, refined and supple. Persistent aftertaste, with delicious and subtle flavours that linger on for quite a long time".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Chassagne Montrachet Rouge
desc_en_short: "Vivid red colour. Intense and complex aromas, reminiscent of candied fruit or fruit jelly, raspberry, blackberry, and a light woody touch. As the wine ages, these aromas evolve towards subtle notes of mushroom and spices, such as nutmeg. When the wine is younger, the flavors highlight a nice framework marked by fine tannins. Long and persistent in the aftertaste, with lingering notes of candy and spice".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Beaune Premier Cru
desc_en_short: "Generous wine of intense and brilliant red colour, with a fleshy texture. Open and pleasant nose. The aromas, reminiscent of red fruit, humus and undergrowth, evolve with age towards touches of spice and vanilla".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Aloxe Corton
desc_en_short: "A well-structured wine, without any hardness. Beautiful intense red colour. Powerful nose, with aromas of candied fruit, evolving with age towards spicy and musky aromas. A solid framework is felt on the palate. Long aftertaste with flavours reminiscent of the same candied fruit aromas".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Beaune Clos Des Mouches Premier Cru
desc_en_short: "An exceptional wine.  Beautiful, deep-red ruby colour, with the bright sheen of great Burgundies. Intense and fresh nose for the young wines. Primary notes of red fruit dominate, such as Morello cherry ("griotte", or wild cherry), raspberry, blackberry. There are hints of complexity with smoky flavours evolving towards liquorice.  When the wine is maturing, aromas of pepper, tobacco, humus and undergrowth appear. When drinking the wine, the first impression is always clear-cut and the texture fleshy. The body is firm without being rough, well meshed without being heavy. There is great freshness in the younger wines. With age, the wine gets rounder. It takes on "gras" (velvety texture) and a more precise architecture, supported by silky tannins.  It is lively and refined at the same time.  There remains a final and most pleasing sensation of harmony, fullness and delicate tannins, as the wine lingers on the palate".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Pommard
desc_en_short: "A great Burgundy, worthy of its reputation. An intense, bright, red colour; a powerful nose, with notes of black cherry and spice, evolving towards aromas of young leather. On the palate, the tannins give a certain impression of firmness, somewhat softened by a nice, harmonious texture. Persistent flavors in the aftertaste".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Morey Saint Denis
desc_en_short: "A really great wine, appreciated by the Burgundy connoisseur for the diversity of its aromas and flavours.It has a beautiful ruby color, a seductive nose dominated by aromas of wild cherry and spice, evolving towards leather. A certain chewiness in the mouth, with fine and noble tannins providing the structure. Ample and fruity aftertaste".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Gevrey Chambertin
desc_en_short: "Gevrey-Chambertin is a wine with a beautiful, bright ruby colour. Intensely fruity on the nose, the aromas are reminiscent of black cherry, wild blackberry and liquorice. The woody character is subtle and marries delicately with the other aromas. As the wine evolves, there are more complex notes, such as mild spice, nutmeg and leather. Later still, mushroom and damp earth nuances make their appearance. Although present on the palate, tannin is never astringent but blends itself harmoniously with the natural freshness and "gras" (velvety texture) of the wine. The same aromas encountered earlier on the nose are found again in the aftertaste".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Nuits Saint Georges
desc_en_short: Joseph Drouhin's Nuits-Saint-Georges is a classic Côte de Nuits Pinot Noir delivering powerful yet elegant aromas of cherry, blackberry, and cedar, with a beautifully balanced palate of silky structure, lingering fruit syrup richness, and gentle spice on the finish.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Chambolle Musigny
desc_en_short: "Fine lace and silk are the words most often associated with this wine. Bright, intense colour and complex aromas evoking violet, black cherry and damp earth. According to the vintages, there are also notes of truffle and game. Refined tannins coat the palate. Good balance between texture and acidity. Long aftertaste, with notes of cherry and candied fruit".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Vosne Romanee
desc_en_short: "Supreme elegance! Beautiful colour, with intense and bright reflections. The diversity of the aromas is striking: wild cherry, nutmeg, camphor wood, fine leather...Later on, the wine takes on a subtle aroma of truffle, producing the most varied palette. With its perfect balance between tannin and acidity, the wine has a fleshy, sturdy body. Powerful and long aftertaste. A wealth of harmonious sensations characterizes this great Burgundy".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Clos Saint Denis Grand Cru
desc_en_short: "Deep ruby red colour. On the nose, aromas of ripe cherry, lightly spiced up by a touch of cigar and exotic wood. With age, the aromas take on animal or gamey notes. The best time to drink a Clos Saint Denis is when the wine is mature (5 to 10 years of age, depending on the vintages) in order to enjoy the perfect harmony that exists between acidity, "gras" (velvety texture) and tannin. A lingering aftertaste of candied fruit is characteristic of this delicious wine".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Clos De La Roche Grand Cru
desc_en_short: "A sumptuous wine ! The colour is a beautiful deep ruby. The nose is complex and brings to mind black cherries, with subtle notes of musk and cigar. The tannins seem coated by the velvety texture of the wine. The length of the aftertaste is exceptional: note of spices and candied fruit linger forever in the mouth. This wine gives a marvelous sensation of harmony and plenitude".

name: Nederburg  Manor House Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Ripe blackberry and currant, mocha and a hint of oak spices with firm, but supple tannins. A well-structured wine with a lush and roundmouthfeel.

name: Caliterra  Edicion Limitada A
desc_en_short: This wine has a deep cherry-red color with bluish nuances. Fresh aromas of forest fruits stand out on the nose along with spicy notes, black pepper,and tobacco leaf, complemented by elegant hints of coffee. The palate offers impressive elegance and volume. Barrel aging also lends finesse and persistence that promise tremendous aging potential.

name: Prego  Montepulciano d'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: A fresh medium bodied red wine with velvety fruit and soft tannis. Ripe berry fruit taste. Enjoy drink with pasta, fish in sauce, white meats cheeses and spicy food.

name: Chateau Mouton Rothschild  2007 (Premiers Crus)
wine_color: An intense garnet hue with glittering highlights.
desc_en_short: Château Mouton Rothschild 2007 is a masterful Pauillac Premier Cru from a carefully tended vintage, delivering a seamlessly structured wine of garnet depth, with aromas of vanilla, bitter almond, nutmeg, and mineral nuance, finishing long with spice and very ripe fruit.

name: Heitz Cellar  Martha's Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: From the historic Martha's Vineyard site in Oakville, this iconic Heitz Cellar Cabernet Sauvignon — Wine Spectator's #3 Wine of 2021 — delivers wild black fruit, eucalyptus, and polished tannins with the structure to age gracefully for two decades and beyond.

name: Sutter Home  Merlot
desc_en_short: Fresh and smooth with black cherry flavors and hints of smoke and spice, this wine with moderate tannins is your easygoing, low-maintenance friend for life. Perfect with tomato-based pastas, chicken, beef, lamb, and pizza.

name: Pighin  Merlot Grave Del Friuli DOC
wine_color: More or less intense ruby red, bright.
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red, bright. The bouquet is well defined, mouth-filling with clear aromas of morello cherry, blackberry and violet accompanied by spicy notes. Dry, good body, appropriately tannic, warm, well-developed, excellent finish. Pairs well with game and grilled meats, excellent with cured meats and aged cheeses.

name: Chateau Du Barrailh  Red Graves Bordeaux
style: Merlot Cabernet Franc And Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Château du Barrailh is a wood-aged Graves rouge from Bordeaux, blending Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Cabernet Sauvignon into a smooth, maturing red with plum fruit, tarry depth, and a gentle smokiness that rewards patience.

name: Chateau Vieux Longa
wine_color: Deep color ,intense color with purple reflection.

name: St. Hallett  Barossa Faith Shiraz
desc_en_short: This is the Shiraz which starts it all for many St Hallett lovers. Our Faith Shiraz is a vibrant and expressive example of Barossa Shiraz. An accessible, juicy and fruit driven wine, Faith's vibrant yet dense purple hue hints at the generosity of fruit within.

name: Umberto Cesari  Iove Sangiovese / Merlot
desc_en_short: Deep red with purple highlights. Captivating aromas of red berry fruit and subtle spice. Fresh and lingering on the palate. Ideal for all courses of a meal, from cold cuts and cheese starters through rich pasta dishes.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Moulin-A-Vent
desc_en_short: "Great breed. Beautiful dark garnet colour. Intense and elegant aromas, with notes of peony, tea rose and damson plum, often with nuances of liquorice. On the palate, beautiful structure, velvety texture ("gras") and majesty. The aftertaste is long, refined and appetizing in a subdued way. The Cru of Beaujolais that is the closest in style to the Burgundies of the Côte d'Or".

name: Le Petit  Chat-en-Oeuf Rouge (185 ml)
desc_en_short: A charming southern French red blending Grenache and Syrah, Le Petit Chat-en-Oeuf Rouge delivers juicy cherries and strawberries with a dusting of spice and silky soft tannins — utterly easy-drinking and made for sharing in its convenient 185 ml format.

name: Opera Prima  Merlot
desc_en_short: A dark garnet color leads to aromas of plum, raspberry and blackberry with hints of spice and vanilla. In the mouth, it is full bodied and rich with ripe plums, cherry and red currant flavors. The finish is smooth and round.

name: Terra Antica  Merlot / Niellucciu
desc_en_short: Rich aromas and flavours of dark cherry with hints of mocha and spices for a balanced mouth feel with a long fruit finish

name: PKNT  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Dark red color. In the nose it has red cherries and plums with a touch of toasty oak Hints of chocolate and berries. Round tannins, soft but well structured. Ideal to accompany red meats, pasta with Bolognese sauce, as well as mature cheeses.

name: PKNT  Carmenere
wine_color: Cherry red wine with violet notes.
desc_en_short: A unique Chilean wine blend, that is almost black in color, with hints of exotic spices and a long velvety finish. Although soft enough to be enjoyed on it’s own, this wine goes superbly with Tex-mex or spicy foods.

name: PKNT  Merlot
desc_en_short: Perfectly balanced, this soft and delicious Merlot is crammed with plummy red fruits. A touch of tannin, adds depth and weight. Perfect partner to lamb, game, and most red meats.

name: PKNT  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: PKNT Pinot Noir from Chile's Rapel Valley is a vibrant, easy-going red bursting with fresh cherry, plum, and strawberry fruit — a playful, crowd-pleasing bottle that brings Latin energy and genuine Pinot character to any table.

name: Grand Cape  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Dark red in color, this wine has aromas of black cherry, black berry and plum. Gentle spices with black pepper notes and smoke. The palate is rich and rounded. The medium tannins finally make a soft finish.

name: Antano Crianza
wine_color: A ruby color Rioja, with an upper-middle layer, limpid and bride.
desc_en_short: Antaño Crianza is a ruby color Rioja, with an upper-middle layer, limpid and bride. The feeling in the nose has reduced its own rest in the bottle, to finally show potent and complex between the first aromas of the varieties that compose it and the wood that make it older giving it some spicy aromas In the mouth is something tannic and slightly cinaro, giving way to a nice wine with a long end in the mouth complex and velvety.

name: Pigmentum  Malbec
desc_en_short: Powerful aromas on the nose of red and black fruits: raspberry, blackcurrant, blackberry, which continues in the mouth. Ripe tannins are supported by fruit flavours. A soft and easy wine to drink now or within two years. It is perfect accompaniment for red meat and goat cheese, but it is also recommended to open a bottle on its own and enjoy the pleasure that lies within. Tasting temperature 16/17°C

name: Pigmentum  Merlot Malbec
desc_en_short: Intensity of berries black crunchy surprise in the mouth. its spicy aromas and pepper flatter the palate giving the wine being greedy character. a wine while fruit that has inherited the roundness and finesse of Merlot focusing the characteristics of genes Malbec. Perfect drink with grilled or fried vegetables chic barbecue.

name: Norfolk Rise  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: This delicious Pinot Noir features aromas of forest floor, mushroom and red berry. It’s a pretty wine with a smooth, velvety texture, a lightweight palate with a juicy mouthfeel, light red berry core of fruit and mouth-watering persistence.

name: Norfolk Rise  Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Deep purple red with a bright magenta hue.
desc_en_short: Dense nicely ripened forest berry fruit with medium weight and extract. The wine finishes gently with integrated, creamy oak and soft, lingering chalky tannins. Food Suggestions with osso bucco, beef fillet, wood-fired pizza & aged cheddar.

name: Norfolk Rise  Merlot
desc_en_short: From the cool coastal hills of Mount Benson in South Australia, Norfolk Rise Merlot delivers ripe cherry, plum, and forest fruit aromas layered with chocolate and vanilla oak, finishing long and smooth with characteristic fine tannins.

name: Norfolk Rise  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Dark chocolate and cherry fruit, forest berries, a touch of peppery spice. An elegant structure and fine supple tannins, seamlessly integrated dark fruit and vanilla oak.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Forots Cotes du Rhone
desc_en_short: The color of the wine is ruby red, with an aroma redolent of violets, spices and licorice. The palate is harmonious with an elegant structure; appealing flavors of small ripe berry fruits (raspberries, blackberries and blueberries) and notes of licorice and spices dominate on the finish.

name: Circle of Life  Red
desc_en_short: A classically styled wine with notes of cassis and cedar. The seamless, elegant palate is encased by fine tannins. It is a wine that will increase in complexity with age.

name: Chateau d'Arricaud  Prestige
desc_en_short: This estate is located in the heart of the Graves Region. The vintage displays the aromas of spicy red fruits, gooseberries and blackberries. It is well-structured and presents firm tannins.

name: Domaine de Rapatel   c-sy-ra-re
desc_en_short: A richly expressive southern Rhône-style Syrah from Domaine de Rapatel in the Languedoc, bursting with ripe plum, black fruit syrup, and smoky spice, underscored by silky tannins and an alluring peony floral note that makes it a generous, fruit-forward crowd-pleaser.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Abeilles Rouge (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Intense purple color with aromas of red fruit, leather and spice. Complex wine, with flavors of licorice, spice and silky tannins. A food-friendly wine which will perfectly match grilled lamb, pork and assorted cheeses.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Le Vent Rouge (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Intense purple color with aromas of red fruit, leather and spice. Complex wine, with flavors of licorice, spice and silky tannins. A food-friendly wine which will perfectly match grilled lamb, pork and assorted cheeses.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Fees Brunes
desc_en_short: A wonderful combination of the New World & Old World styles as this wine has lots of fresh cherry and black plum fruit flavors against an intense, spicy, mineral background. This wine has a silky texture and a glossy finish. Pairs well with red meats, hearty pasta dishes with garlic and red sauce, barbecue and aged cheeses.

name: Domaine Chante Cigale
desc_en_short: A classic Châteauneuf-du-Pape from Domaine Chante Cigale, this Grenache-led southern Rhône blend delivers a smooth, full-bodied experience of dark fruit and warm spice — perfect for grilled red meats, coq au vin, or a plate of aged cheese.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  La Divine Cote Rotie
desc_en_short: Jean-Luc Colombo's La Divine Côte-Rôtie is a powerfully expressive northern Rhône Syrah, co-fermented with a touch of Viognier for aromatic lift, delivering jammy dark fruit, smoky spice, and remarkable depth from one of the appellation's most celebrated modern producers.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Terres Brulees Cornas
desc_en_short: Rich, concentrated and spicy; persistent aromas of red fruit and licorice add elegance to the structure. This wine will benefit from two to three years’ cellaring.

name: Chateau Bramefant
desc_en_short: A red Bergerac with its fullest potential. Aromas of raspberry, vanilla and slightly spices on the nose. Round and sliky tannins with persistence finish. Food Matching Great with red meat, barbecues or game.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  La Violette Syrah Pays d'Oc
wine_color: A deep and beautiful dark purple color.
desc_en_short: Attractive pale golden colour. Fresh bouquet of crystallized fruits with notes of wild flowers. Delicious tropical fruit flavours in the mouth, combined with a delicate sweetness and a crisp, clean finish.

name: Domaine de Rapatel
desc_en_short: Lovely pure blackcurrant fruit on the nose which is rich and full. The palate is concentrated, rich, ripe and forward. Matches it with pork or poultry whether roasted, braised or with a brown or red wine sauce.

name: Chateau de la Roulerie  Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: From the Loire Valley's Anjou heartland, Château de la Roulerie delivers a classically structured Cabernet Franc with a deep crimson hue, forest-fruit aromatics, and a supple, elegant palate that speaks effortlessly to the grape's natural character.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Le Vent Rouge
desc_en_short: Intense purple color with aromas of red fruit, leather and spice. Complex wine, with flavors of licorice, spice and silky tannins. A food-friendly wine which will perfectly match grilled lamb, pork and assorted cheeses.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Collines de Laure
desc_en_short: Elegant, refined and feminine notes of wild strawberry, raspberry and violet lead way to a balanced finish. Pairs well with heavy pasta dishes, cured meats, sausages, grilled pork tenderloin and barbecue foods.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Abeilles Rouge
desc_en_short: Intense purple color with aromas of red fruit, leather and spice. Complex wine, with flavors of licorice, spice and silky tannins. A food-friendly wine which will perfectly match grilled lamb, pork and assorted cheeses.

name: Domaine de l'Engarran  Rouge
desc_en_short: Half of this wine has been aged in oak barrels. It displays very developed aromas of red fruits, with a note of vanilla. A vin de pays at its best, deserving an AOC ranking. Matches best beef, lamb and pork grilled or with brown sauce.

name: Domaine Chante Cigale  Vieilles Vignes
desc_en_short: Red intense, black cherry colour Black fruits, spicy power and mineral. Concentrated, tannin deep and final very long with blackcurrant fruit. Food Pairing Great meals cooking with sauce.

name: Dominus Estate 2014
wine_color: A dark red, almost deep crimson in color.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Cabernet Franc And 7% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: Dominus Estate 2014 is a benchmark Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon from Christian Moueix's storied Yountville estate, blending power and finesse with extraordinary aging potential — earning 97 points from The Wine Advocate and 98 from James Suckling.

name: Chateau Haut-Brion  1er Grand Cru Classe 1997
style: Merlot, 34% Cabernet Sauvignon, 30 Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: One of Bordeaux's most storied First Growths, Château Haut-Brion 1997 delivers a hauntingly complex blend of ripe dark berries, damp earth, and smouldering oak, framed by the estate's signature tannins — simultaneously firm and silky — with a finish that lingers beautifully.

name: Cristo Di Campobello  Rosso IGP
wine_color: Deep ruby red color with a purple rim around the edge of the glass
desc_en_short: Wine of deep ruby ​​color with a purple rim around the edge of the glass. Aromatic bouquet of wine has a fruity character. Tone mashed ripe red berry bouquet open and balsamic notes of mint and complete it. Round and fragrant wine has a soft, caressing the palate taste with fruity notes and rounded tannins. The wine will be an excellent combination with meat dishes, mature cheeses, vegetable dishes, dishes with herbs.

name: Monchiero Carbone  Barbera d'Alba MonBirone DOC
wine_color: Deep, with intense shades of ruby-red enhanced by purplish hues.
desc_en_short: Great power showing on entry, with an alcoholic content that ensures initial smoothness immediately balanced out by an acidity which softens the fruity pulp. The finish is long and fresh, providing a nice balance between the fruit and the oak.

name: Cristo Di Campobello  Adenzia DOC
desc_en_short:
“Very wide-ranging spectrum of aromas,
with notes of sour cherries and forest fruits,
together with delicious hints of vanilla.
Caressing and spicy, with firm, but graceful
tannins. A wine that can be cellared
for up to 10 years.”
Riccardo Cotarella

name: Feudi Del Pisciotto  Valentino Merlot
desc_en_short: A wine of great elegance combined with remarkable structure and power. It offers cherry and spice on the nose with chewy tannins, dried prune and bright berry fruit bursts. Serve with lamb dishes.

name: Feudi Del Pisciotto  Giambattista Valli Cerasuolo di Vittoria DOCG
desc_en_short: Cerasuolo di Vittoria is Sicily's only DOCG wine, and Feudi del Pisciotto's benchmark blend of Nero d'Avola and Frappato delivers ripe cherry, cedar, and dried herbs in a beautifully structured, medium-bodied red that earned Gambero Rosso's coveted Tre Bicchieri recognition.

name: Rocca Di Frassinello  Le Sughere DOC
desc_en_short: It is the second highest Rocca di Frassinello label, bidding to reach the maximum level of the first. A wine of great substance, in which Sangioveto and the international grape varieties of Cabernet and Merlot fuse for an ideal Italian-French creation. Its fifth vintage (2008) was classified as one of Wine Spectator’s Top 100 wines.

name: Cristo Di Campobello  Lu Patri DOC
desc_en_short: Still red wine, full bodied and intense, elegant and soft, round, with enveloping tannins and pleasant balsamic and spicy scents, aged in barrels

name: Edi Simcic  Duet
desc_en_short: It is reminiscent of blackberries, red cherries and a little of pepper. A wine of medium body and a more complex character of robust reds from the Goriška Brda region holding a soft texture and nice length, it has an ageing potential of up to five years.

name: Marchesi Di Barolo  Barbaresco Serragrilli DOCG (Single Vineyard)
wine_color: Garnet red colour with ruby reflections.
desc_en_short: Garnet red colour with ruby reflections. An intense and persistent aroma with clean scents of fruit, dog roses and spices.  The flavor is full, elegant and full-bodied, but at the same time, harmonious and balanced, with sweet tannin, never too much in evidence.

name: Castellare Di Castellina  I Sodi di San Niccolo'
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

Full-bodied, with firm yet fine-grained tannins, I Sodi di San Niccolò is a rich and elegant wine that offers aromas of ripe cherries, dark berries, and currants which are complemented by notes of vanilla, leather, and cedar. On the palate, this wine is full and rich with high aging potential.

name: Nicolis  Ambrosan Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOC
desc_en_short: Princely wine, full bodied, elegant and vigorous. The colour is an intense garnet red. The favour is dry and generous, powerful and delicate. Its fragrances remind to ripe fruits, autumn leaves and leather. Wine with a “three-dimensional” tasting progression, where the management of the alcohol content in harmony with the important structure and aromatic richness agree in a elegant power.

name: Edi Simcic  Kolos
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red colour. The nose is intense, with dark red and black fruit with roasted and spicy notes. Blackcurrant, tobacco, blackberry, smoke and even resin are sensed most frequently.  It is a very individual wine, a right choice for those who love intense and opulent wines. Suitable for long maturation.

name: Rocca Di Frassinello  Baffonero DOC
desc_en_short: Baffonero takes its name from a 100% Merlot vineyard. It was one of the first vineyards to be planted at Rocca di Frassinello. The company was born from a joint venture between Castellare di Castellina and Domaines Baron de Rothschild-Lafite, the most famous chateau in the world. The Baffonero vineyard lies below the winery designed by Renzo Piano, on terrain with perfect exposure.

name: Chateau Gruaud Larose  2007
style: Cabernet Sauvignon 57% Merlot 31% Cabernet Franc 7.5% Petit Verdot 3% Malbec 1.5%
desc_en_short: Deep, red colour. The nose presents overtones of Kirsch, stone fruits, toast, cashew nuts, spices. Frank attack, tannic and in harmony with the nose. Hints of dark chocolate. Fresh and minty finish. Great length. It can be enjoyed now but can also be kept for several years. (2011)

name: Terrazas  Altos Del Plata Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Enjoy spicy hints of thyme and peppery herbs typical of Cabs, this dark-hued, garnet colored wine is elegant and concentrated, with lots of structure and outstanding tannins.

name: Cheval des Andes
wine_color: deep red color with purple shades.
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

Intense red color with purple shades. The nose is subtle, whispered and precise, but at the same time wide and enveloping. It reveals delicate fresh aromas such as violet and pepper in harmony with warmer notes of raspberry and black fruits. On the palate, it represents an elegant expression of Cheval des Andes in a warm vintage. Its full-body, manifested from the mouth entry, is accompanied by very fine tannins that converge in a tense finish with marked acidity and freshness.

name: Geoff Merrill  Pimpala Road Shiraz
desc_en_short: A generous, easy-drinking McLaren Vale Shiraz from Geoff Merrill, delivering vibrant blood-red colour, aromatic dried herbs, mulberry, and coffee spice, with fruit-driven palate weight balanced by fine tannins and clean acidity — seriously satisfying at its price point.

name: Geoff Merrill  Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve Premium
desc_en_short: A bold cross-regional Cabernet Sauvignon blending Coonawarra and McLaren Vale fruit, aged 28 months in American oak to deliver layered aromatics of mint, violet, and black olive with firm, structured tannins and a clean, fruit-driven finish.

name: Geoff Merrill  Reserve Shiraz
desc_en_short: The nose begins with hints of barnyard and creamy notes then opens up with dried herbs, savoury meats and rich developed fruit. The palate has a hint of menthol coming through which is quickly overtaken by fleshy fruit and dark chocolate flavour and texture.

name: La Croix de Beaucaillou St Julien
style: Cabernet Sauvignon And The Rest Mostly Merlot With 2% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: 93 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Effectively a wine with its own dedicated portion of the Ducru Beaucaillou vineyard, this is structured and firm. It's concentrated with dark plum fruits and full of powerful tannins that go right through from start to finish. It certainly needs to age, so don't drink before 2022. "

name: Chateau Lynch Bages  AOC Pauillac 2000
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 16% Merlot, 11% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
The wine of Château Lynch-Bages is part of the lineage of the great Pauillac wines. Blended mostly from Cabernet Sauvignon, it combines structure and finesse, elegance and longevity. It is further distinguished by its opulence. Generous right from its youth, it develops more flavours and greater complexity as it matures.

The affirmation of the Lynch-Bages style came with the arrival of Jean-Charles Cazes to head the estate in 1934. An innovative winemaker, emblematic of a new generation of owners willing to break with tradition and taking risks to ensure truly ripe harvests, he was known for often being the last to harvest in Pauillac. From 1945 onwards, the fame of the château emerged thanks to a series of great vintages. Some, despite being considered difficult to grow in Bordeaux, are particularly successful at Lynch-Bages. His wines are characterized by their deep colour, their tannic structure, their controlled concentration and elegant sensuality. The vintages vinified by André Cazes, and after him Jean-Michel Cazes, confirm this trend.

The style of the wines has refined over the years, gaining suppleness and softness, whilst their consistency has been established over time. Then as now, Château Lynch-Bages has been characterised by its extraordinary qualitative homogeneity. Powerful, elegant and open, vintage after vintage, the wine has acquired greater accuracy, adding distinction to the hedonistic character that made its reputation.

name: Chateau Siran  Margaux
style: Merlot, 43% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Petit Verdot And 1% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short:
HISTORY

On September 14th 1428, Guilhem de Siran took the feudal oath at the hands of the prior Sainte Croix de Bordeaux in their nearby Macau Church.

The property at times bore the name of Saint-Siran in honour of a holy Abbott originating from Burgundy, who after several pilgrimages to Rome came back to Gaulle and settled in Toulouse at the time of the Franc king, Clotaire II. 

Later, by the end of the 17th century, the estate already produced a wine, which in the 18th century enjoyed a great reputation in the period when the Miailhe family benefited from a Royal concession and occupied the profession of broker.

In the 19th century, on 14 January 1859 to be precise, the chateau became the property of the same Miailhe family.

Their ancestor, Leo Barbier, bought the estate for 100 000 francs from the Count and Countess of Toulouse-Lautrec, the grandparents of the famous painter of paris night life Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.

Subsequently, the family’s descendants followed one another in full respect of the family tradition.

In 2007, the family’s fifth generation, represented by Edouard Miailhe, become involved in the management of the estate.

Chateau Siran is one of the rare Bordeaux chateaux to belong to the same family for nearly 150 years.

name: S De Siran  2nd label of Chateau Siran Margaux
desc_en_short:
S de Siran, is considered to be the cadet of Château Siran. Coming from the same gravel plateau as Château Siran, S is the result of a rigorous selection of younger vines. Vinified in the same way, it is distinguished by a predominantly Merlot blend that gives it immediate charm.

Both fine and complex, S de Siran is a seductive wine, much appreciated by wine lovers. It is one of the classics of the appellation and can be drunk young or aged for 5 to 10 years.

name: Domaine Faiveley  Bourgogne Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: A beautiful ruby colour. This wine has pleasant, fresh, red fruit aromas on the nose, which we find again on the palate. It has rich and very ripe substance, with fine round tannins. It's a very well-structured and pleasing wine.

name: Domaine Faiveley  Pommard
desc_en_short: Domaine Faiveley's Pommard is a classically structured Burgundian Pinot Noir, delivering dark fruit, spice, and smoky oak on a powerful yet refined palate — a compelling village-level expression with genuine cellaring potential.

name: Chateau Tournefeuille  Lalande-de-Pomerol
desc_en_short: Chateau Tournefeuille is Creamy, red fruit nose and palate. Juicy attack but light and a touch hollow. Chewy finish.

name: Angelo Negro  Angelin Langhe DOC
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red colour with orange highlights with ageing. Fresh bouquet with hints of rose, blackberry and blackcurrant. Soft flavour, rightly tannic, persistent and well balanced.

name: Angelo Negro  Cascinotta Barbaresco DOCG. Reserve
desc_en_short: Garnet red color classic, very intense. Its aroma is definite, recalls the scents of red fruit, spices and citrus. The taste is well-balanced, elegant tannins without excessive harshness, aftertaste with soft, spicy and minty.

name: Bartolo Mascarello  Barbera D’Alba DOC
desc_en_short: Lovely, musky, charming fragrance here: this has a lilting, fragrant nose with plenty of black fruits and lovely cassis, hints of licorice here, no oak whatsoever. The palate is all berries and has bright acidity, soft and fleshy, really supple and balanced. Charming and energised.

name: Bartolo Mascarello  Barolo DOCG
desc_en_short: A living legend of traditional Barolo, Bartolo Mascarello's flagship wine blends fruit from four celebrated Barolo crus — Cannubi, San Lorenzo, Rue, and Rocche di La Morra — into a wine of extraordinary purity, composure, and generational soul.

name: Bartolo Mascarello  Nebbiolo Langhe DOC
desc_en_short: From one of Barolo's most revered families, this Langhe Nebbiolo by Bartolo Mascarello offers a luminous, perfumed expression of the Langhe — silky red fruit, lifted cherry, and a firm, elegant backbone that punches well above its entry-level status.

name: Casanova di Neri  Brunello di Montalcino Cerretalto DOCG 2016
wine_color: A very young and brilliant ruby red.
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

The Cerretalto is the synthesis of intuition, passion and vision, characteristics that have been a continual expression of Casanova di Neri. An extraordinary concentration of mineral in the soil imparts an unique impression only in certain vintages and only thanks to a Sangiovese grape from small, straggly bunches. With this decisive contribution of human dedication, love for the work of the earth and great attention in the cellar can a wine reach exceptional quality, personality and unique style that fully expresses the territory of its origin.

name: Conti Zecca  Nero Rosso del Salento I.G.t.
wine_color: Intense ruby red colour with pleasant garnet highlights
desc_en_short: Soft and harmonic with matured tannins in a rich and well-structured body. Persistent finish.

name: Conti Zecca  Primitivo Santo Stefano
desc_en_short: Conti Zecca's Primitivo Santo Stefano is a richly built red from Puglia, blending 85% Primitivo with complementary local varieties to deliver deep ruby colour, ripe dark fruit, warm spice, and a velvety, full-bodied palate with serious structure.

name: Feudo Maccari  Maharis IGT
desc_en_short: Maharis offers a ruby red color with purple highlights. On the nose balsamic notes mix with cocoa and coffee. In the mouth, balsamic notes return from the bouquet, with soft tannins that envelop the palate. The finish exhibits spicy, smoky notes that make this wine both pleasant and unforgettable.

name: La Carraia  Fobiano IGT
desc_en_short: The Fobiano proud excellence of the company, is an important and fascinating wine, fine and smooth, enhanced by a perfect dense texture and soft tannins. It offers complex and harmonious sensations, characterized by notes of berries and a variety of spices and balsamic scents. Perfect with roasts and tenderloin with black truffle.

name: Massolino  Nebbiolo DOC
desc_en_short: Garnet red Bouquet is delicate and pleasant, the predominant notes are of raspberry and violet, with the imposition of secondary perfumes very similar to those of Barolo as it ages. Flavour is a complete and temptingly harmonious wine the elegance of which makes up for its lesser structure compared with that of Barolo.

name: Massolino  Barolo Parussi DOCG
desc_en_short: Massolino's single-vineyard Barolo Parussi from Castiglione Falletto is a benchmark expression of traditional Nebbiolo — dense and structured, with ethereal aromas of sweet spice, tobacco, and sandalwood layered over a long, firm finish that rewards patience and cellaring.

name: Massolino  Barolo Parafada DOCG
desc_en_short: From a single 1.13-hectare parcel in Serralunga d'Alba, Massolino's Parafada Barolo draws on 55-year-old Nebbiolo vines and south-facing ridge exposure to deliver a wine of commanding structure, layered complexity, and the brooding mineral depth that defines this storied Piedmontese commune.

name: Petra  Hebo Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Petra's Hebo Toscana IGT draws on ancient Etruscan heritage and the legacy of Elisa Bonaparte Baciocchi, blending Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Sangiovese into a structured, approachable Tuscan red with supple tannins and warm oak-kissed depth.

name: Pietradolce  Archineri Etna Rosso DOC
desc_en_short:
Archineri Etna Rosso is a name that evokes the territory as well as the traditions of Etna. This wine is made from Nerello Mascalese grapes from a single 90-year-old pre-phylloxera vineyard, located in the Contrada Rampante at 850 meters above sea level. The soils, sandy and rich in volcanic rock, together with the cool microclimate, endow this wine with a unique character.
The harvest takes place in the second half of October. The crushing and destemming is followed by a maceration of approximately 18 days in raw cement tulip tanks. Aging takes place in oak barrels for 14 months, followed by bottle maturation. The result is a wine with a fresh and varied aroma, and a palate with a fine, finessed fragrance.

name: Podere Sapaio  Bolgheri Volpolo
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Petit Verdot, 10% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Podere Sapaio specializes in Bordeaux varieties. Owner Massimo Piccin has been making stellar wines from vines occupying 60 windswept acres of Bolgheri’s clay-loam soils since 1999. In what is perhaps the toniest corner of Tuscany, Volpolo is the organically farmed overachiever that stands out for its simply ridiculous price-to-quality ratio.The way we secured this wine speaks to its quality: For our Wine Folly club, we collaborate with Folly’s James Beard Award–winning founder, sommelier Madeline Puckette. She’d be right at home on our judging panel—she’s a tough critic, and she absolutely nailed this recommendation. Pour a glass and you’ll see why The Wine Advocate said Sapaio’s wines “almost always hit that enviable sweet spot that sees good winemaking happily married to territory-driven personality.” That spot-on style is why they’ve won 10 Tre Bicchieri awards (Italy’s top wine honor) in the last 11 years. The 2019 Volpolo is gorgeously complex and aromatic, with floral notes layered on fresh blue fruit and herbs—the perfect accompaniment to a generous plate of Prosciutto di Parma or burrata lightly drizzled with extra virgin olive oil. When dinner comes around, slice up a grilled porterhouse and pour yourself a second glass.

name: Tedeschi  Capitel Nicalo Valpolicella Superiore DOC
desc_en_short: Good body, good structure, lively acidity and alcohol content well balanced with tannins. The after taste confirms the notes in the bouquet. A complex and elegant wine.

name: Tenuta Sette Ponti  Oreno
desc_en_short: Ruby red with violet hues. Intense and broad aromatics, where notes of succulent red fruits initially emerge and then give way to spicy characters of licorice and roasted coffee. Powerful and structured, with velvety tannins in balance with a vibrant, crisp character. Finish of remarkable length and savoriness.

name: Cantina Terlano  Monticol Riserva DOC
desc_en_short: The Pinot Noir presents itself as a multifaceted wine on the nose, where the delicate primary fruit aromas of wild strawberries and blackberries blend with restrained aromas of tobacco and flint, and notes of white field mushrooms. Well balanced with a mineral elegance that makes it dance on the palate. This red wine has a long and exciting finish.

name: Tua Rita  Perlato del Bosco Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: Scented texture designed with notes of wild fruits, vegetable undergrowth and fine spices. The taste is well-structured, rich in extract, with smooth tannins. Durable in terms of persistence.

name: Zenato  Cormi  IGT
desc_en_short: Cormì indicates not only the unity of two varieties Corvina and Merlot, but also stands as an abbreviation for “Cor – Cuore”: the Cormì is a wine born from the hearth before than the earth.

name: Cannonball  California Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Elegant and expressive. An exciting revival of a classic style. Our Cabernet has the best characteristics of traditional California and old world Bordeaux.

Intense fruit aromas of black cherry, plum accented by vanilla, caramel and rich toasted oak. Full on the palate with good concentration and considerable structure on the finish.

name: Cannonball  California Merlot
wine_color: The crimson color alone tempts all the senses.
desc_en_short:
Enticing and impressive.

Aromas of fresh huckleberry, pomegranate and nuances of toasty oak. Medium-full bodied with classic Bordeaux proportions, wonderful concentration with juicy flavors of raspberry, ripe plum and baking spices with a long, lingering finish.

name: Azahara  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Juicy dark berries, black cherry and liquorice notes are balanced by a well- structured body and a silky, lingering finish. Ideal with sticky pork buns, lamb cutlets and Szechuan pepper beef.

name: Kangarilla Road  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This wine is deep purple in color and consists of a spicy and multilayered herbaceous nose with hints of sweet rhubarb and dark berries. The intense, velvety palate shows plums, blackcurrants and dates with nuances of cinnamon, coffee and dark chocolate and fine chalky tannins. Pair with strong cheese, pasta wild game and red meat.

name: Kangarilla Road  Shiraz
desc_en_short: An aromatic wine with hints of delicate floral notes reminiscent of freesias together with enticing sweet red berry conserve and glimpses of geranium. On the palate is a delicious kaleidoscope of red currants, black cherries, macerated strawberries with caramelised beetroot and nasturtiums. The elegant tannin profile elongates the palate encouraging these flavours to linger.

name: Michel Rolland (Rolland Collection)  Clos de los Siete
style: Malbec, 18% Merlot, 13% Cabernet Sauvignon, 8% Syrah, 3 % Petit Verdot, 4% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short: Michel Rolland's landmark Mendoza project, Clos de los Siete is a Malbec-dominant blend sourced from seven estate wineries, delivering opulent dark fruit, chocolate, and baking spice in a generously full-bodied, crowd-pleasing package that rewards both immediate drinking and the cellar.

name: Altivo  Vineyard Selection Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Intense and bright red colour. High-toned aromas and flavors of spiced plum, cherries and herbs. Bright and fresh, with harmonious acidity framing and lifting the wine's intense fruit. Finishes with dusty, firm-edged tannins and good length.

name: Altivo  Barrel Selection Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Dark red. High-toned aromas and flavors of spiced plum, dark berries, mocha and herbs. Bright and fresh, with harmonious acidity framing and lifting the wine's fairly intense fruit. Finishes with dusty, firm-edged tannins and good length.

name: Altivo  Barrel Selection Malbec
desc_en_short: This wine is Bright, medium ruby-red. Aroma Black Cherry, Cassis, Nuts, Blackberry and Cocoa, A mid season ripener, it can bring very deep color, ample tannin, and a particular plum-like flavor component to add complexity to claret blends. Food Pairing casseroles, stews, or pastas with tomato sauce.

name: Carta Vieja  Merlot
desc_en_short: Medium tannin red wines This type is a multi-purpose universal wine in agreement for many different Caucasian courses gets, buffets and socializing. There are red wines the best choice for cheese tray. Chicken, turkey, pork, barbecued food, casseroles, garlic. If the wine has spicy aromas and dark shades, it is also suitable for the herd and sheep.

name: Vina El Principal  El Principal
desc_en_short: The season was characterized by a cold spring and normal rainfall according to the historical average and 20% higher compared to the previous season. The summer recorded moderate temperatures for the months of December and January followed by temperatures 3ºC below the previous season during the month of March and April. This harvest, with slow ripening and good acidity grapes, allowed us to craft elegant and balanced wines. The grapes were handpicked in prime condition from April 10th. The clusters and grains were selected and transported gravitationally into the stainless-steel tanks.

name: Michel Rolland (Rolland Collection)  Chateau Bertineau Saint Vincent
wine_color: Intense ruby colour with carmine hues.
desc_en_short:
Intense ruby colour with carmine hues. Delicately toasted nose with black fruit aromas emerging with aeration.
The palate is fleshy, well structured, and full-bodied. Aromatic finish characterised by pleasant toasted notes.

name: Michel Rolland (Rolland Collection)  Chateau Rolland Maillet
desc_en_short: Bright ruby colour. A rich red fruit nose with a touch of vanilla and a hint of liquorice. Beautiful harmony of fine tannins and complex bouquet. Long, refreshing finish.

name: Michel Rolland (Rolland Collection)  Chateau Le Bon Pasteur
desc_en_short: Pure ruby red colour. Subtle, floral, peppery nose with notes of leather and spice. Rounded and harmonious on the palate, with ripe fruit and delicate wood/vanilla. nice acid/alcohol balance giving it an almost mineral freshness on the finish.

name: L'Enclos du Chateau de Saint Pey
brand: L'Enclos du Chateau de Saint Pey
desc_en_short: Beautiful ruby ​​with purple reflections. It impresses with its frank and net nose, great maturity to brioche and a fine. The mouth appears soft and creamy, combining power and finesse. A beautiful distinctive wine, marked by its terroir.

name: Chateau Tourtirac  Castillon Cotes de Bordeaux
wine_color: The wine is intense cherry-ruby color.
desc_en_short: The wine is intense cherry-ruby color.The taste of the wine is characterized by a good structure and intense fruity notes.The wine has an expressive berry flavor, which clearly traced notes of cranberry.The wine goes well with all meat dishes, it can be fed to the roast beef and warm appetizers of pork.

name: Chateau La Garde  Pessac Leognan
