desc_en_short: Powerful and revealing intense colour, the red wines of Chateau La Garde Pessac-Leognan. are well-structured and concentrated and ideal for ageing. Round, supple and alluring, they reflect the elegance and finesse of the terroir and today feature among the elite of the Pessac-Leognan appellation.

name: Diane De Belgrave  Second vin du Château Belgrave
desc_en_short: Attractive deep red in colour. Generously ripe fruit notes on the nose are accompanied by subtle, well-integrated hints of mature character. The wine is well balanced on the palate, showing attractive depth and elegance, rounded character that evolves to reveal youthful tannins on the finish that will soften with bottle age. A very attractive second wine.

name: Barton&Guestier  Saint-Emilion
desc_en_short: Intense cherry red color. Seductive bouquet dominated by hints of black and red fruits (blackberry, black cherry, strawberry jam). Delicious and elegant on the palate with silky tannins. A warm and fruit driven aftertaste.

name: Gallician  Prestige Rouge
desc_en_short: Beautiful red color with purple reflections. Complex nose combining the notes of fruits and spices. Good structure in mouth with notes of ripe fruit embellished with peppery notes and cinnamon. Tannins well-balance with a good length in the mouth. Perfect drink with red meat, game and cheese.

name: Yvon Mau  Merlot
wine_color: An intense red robe with flashes of deep crimson.
desc_en_short: This Merlot boasts an intense red robe with flashes of deep crimson. The nose is elegant and expansive, with prominent red fruit aromas. Supple yet ample on the palate, and undeniably rich. This is a thoroughly enjoyable Merlot and a perfect partner for red meats, poultry and cheese platters.

name: Yvon Mau  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A classic Cabernet Sauvignon with a resplendent purple robe. The nose combines lively red fruit aromas (blackcurrant, cherry) with a subtle touch of vanilla. Well-balanced on the palate, with great maturity of flavour and a tannic structure which is dense yet silky-smooth. A delicious partner for red meats, barbecues and soft cheeses.

name: Coli  "Villa Montignana" Chianti Classico Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: A lively ruby-red colour, which will turn to garnet with ageing. Produces tears in the glass. Intense and persistent flavour, fine, ethereal and ample, reminding sometimes the scent of violets, in addition to that of cherry and bramble. Elegant wine, suited for ageing. Dry and warm taste with a pleasant austerity. Sapid, plenty of structure, a modicum of tannins, it will turn velvety with ageing. Persistent aftertaste.

name: Zeni  Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico Vigne Alte DOC
wine_color: Deep ruby red with a garnet red tinge
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red with a garnet red tinge. Stylish, elegant, with notes of fruit preserved in alcohol and hints of cocoa and spices.

name: Longo  Chianti DOCG
desc_en_short: Longo Chianti DOCG is a structured, full-bodied Sangiovese from Tuscany crafted by a house with over sixty years of Italian winemaking heritage — delivering rich, harmonious red fruit, firm tannins, and vibrant acidity that make it a natural partner for the table.

name: Pianirossi  Sidus DOC Montecucco Rosso
wine_color: It has a bright red colour with violet nuances.
desc_en_short: It has a bright red colour with violet nuances. The perfume is very straightforward on frutty, with touches of cherry and wild berries. Soft tannins enhance the delicacy and length of the wine. Well balanced and fresh in the mouth it is a most enjoyable wine.

name: Pianirossi  Maremma Toscana IGT Red
style: Petit Verdot 40%, Montepulciano 30% And Cabernet Sauvignon 30%
desc_en_short: Deep red in color, its bouquet is that of elegance and complexity, with notable traces of blackberry, strawberry, spices, and balsamic notes. Mouth-filling and rich, the label's well-bred tannins lead to notable persistence. This wine possesses an excellent ageing capacity.

name: Ascheri  Fontanelle Barbera D'Alba DOC
wine_color: Classic dark cherry and ripe raspberry fruit
desc_en_short: Brooding black bruiser of a wine with fleshy black fruit, sour black cherry, tar, toasty oak and smoky spice aromas. Full-bodied Italian red wine and smooth. Pair this single-vineyard Barbera wine with grilled pork chops. Barbera D’Alba food pairings: antipasto, beef, chicken, pizza, pasta Bolognese.

name: Ascheri  Nebbiolo D'Alba DOC
wine_color: Ruby red colour with garnet reflections.
desc_en_short: From the talented Matteo Ascheri, this Nebbiolo d'Alba DOC delivers classic Piedmontese character — ruby-garnet in colour with a violet-kissed nose, a velvety, harmonious palate, and the kind of refined balance that makes Nebbiolo one of Italy's most compelling red varieties.

name: Monte Faustino  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Riserva DOC
style: Corvina And Corvinone Veronese, 20% Rondinella And 10% Sangiovese Croatina And Oseleta
desc_en_short: Full body red color verging on garnet red after the ageing process. Has a strong and persistent scent of ripe red fruit, plum, cherry, marasca and almond. Full-bodied, intense and elegant, it clearly reminds us of our olfactory sensations, exalting the essense of vanilla, coffee and chocolate. It goes well with wild game, mixed grills, roasts and mature cheeses.

name: Monte Faustino  Valpolicella Classico Superiore Ripasso DOC
style: Corvina And Corvinone Veronese, 25% Rondinella,5% Croatina And Oseleta
desc_en_short: Full and intense ruby-red colour. Has an elegant scent of ripe red fruit, with evident fragrances of cherry and marasca. Persistent, warm and harmonic, with a velvety structure, it reminds us of red fruits and spiced scents.

name: Monte Faustino  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOC
wine_color: Full ruby red colour verging on garnet red after the ageing process.
style: Corvina And Corvinone Veronese, 20% Rondinella, 10% Sangiovese Croatina And Oseleta
desc_en_short: Full ruby red colour verging on garnet red after the ageing process. Has a strong and persistent scent of ripe red fruit, plum, cherry, marasca and almond. Full-bodied, intense and elegant, it clearly reminds us of our olfactory sensations, exalting the essences of vanilla, coffee and chocolate.

name: Danese  Cabernet IGT
desc_en_short: This ruby-colored wine has aromas that include raspberry and violets. Flavors of cherry and plum lead to a soft velvety finish. This graceful wine is multifaceted. It can be enjoyed by itself but is excellent with appetizers and main courses. The wine pairs with Brie, smoked salmon, roast beef, leg of lamb, duck and grilled swordfish.

name: Danese  Bardolino DOC
desc_en_short: Danese Bardolino is a wine with cherry color and a delicate aroma of red fruit. In the mouth, light, balanced, fluent. Fruity character of this wine is underlined touch of sweetness, but it niepozbawiaj?cym freshness and vivacity. Suitable for pizza, lasagna, baked fish.

name: Danese  Pinot Nero IGT
desc_en_short: A charming Veneto Pinot Nero from Danese, delivering a bright garnet pour with an elegant, fragrant bouquet of cherry, raspberry, and blackcurrant — silky, light-to-medium in body, and effortlessly approachable for everyday drinking.

name: Danese  Chianti DOCG
desc_en_short: This D.O.C.G. Chianti is bright ruby red, offering inviting aromas of black cherries with typical sangiovese's spicy notes. On the palate, this Chianti is fresh and easygoing, with soft tannins, refreshing acidity and a persistent finish.

name: Danese   Montepulciano D'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red with slight violet highlights with delicious aromas of black cherries, strawberries, and herbs. It's full-bodied and robust, fresh plums on the palate, nicely balanced by food-friendly acidity and soft tannins.

name: Marques de Murrieta  Gran Reserva
desc_en_short: A benchmark Gran Reserva from one of Rioja's most storied estates, Marqués de Murrieta's Ygay-grown Tempranillo delivers a decade-plus of cellar evolution: brick-hued, full-bodied, and layered with mellow dark fruit, warm spice, and the house's signature long-lived elegance.

name: Marques de Murrieta  Reserva
desc_en_short: Tangible proof of elegance, balance and constancy characteristic of the Marques de Murrieta Winery and its surrounding vineyards situated in the Ygay Estate, it is a red reserva wine with a balanced aging of two years in new and partly new American oak barrels and a year and a half in bottle. The result is an elegant wine that combines complexity and fineness, summing up the best attributes of our identity and actuality. Marqués de Murrieta is more than a brand in the international market, it represents age-old wisdom expressed in one of the most recognized wines of Spain. With our daily work, respect and love for our land, the selection of the best grapes and the attention to detail throughout its almost four years of production, Marqués de Murrieta is a safe and constant value of the best quality.

name: Marques de Murrieta  Castillo Ygay Gran Reserva Especial
desc_en_short:
96 points in Wine Advocate - Parker - "It has good depth and concentration, still young and lively with fine tannins and a backbone of freshness that lifts it up. It will develop for a very long time in bottle. This is a great classical Rioja for the long haul."

95 points in James Suckling - "A special Rioja that’s traditional, but not old-fashioned. Dusty, licorice and spice nose with red fruit. A cool and elegant wine, in spite of the concentration. Long, firm finish. Expands with aeration. From vines planted in 1945. Drink or hold."

94 points Wine Spectator - "Black cherry, plum, clove, cocoa and mineral flavors are rich and harmonious in this polished red. Well-integrated tannins and balsamic acidity keep this balanced. Shows focus and depth, but remains very fresh. Tempranillo and Mazuelo."

name: Marques de Murrieta  Dalmau
desc_en_short:
94 points in Wine Advocate - "The more-modern red of the portfolio is the 2013 Dalmau Reserva, a blend of 71% Tempranillo, 15% Cabernet Sauvignon and 14% Graciano from one single vineyard within the Ygay estate, the Pago Canajas. It's balsamic, herbal, clean, serious and complex. The palate is very balanced, with refined, fine-grained tannins and a nice core of acidity. This is a very good, serious vintage of Dalmau."

93 points in Wine AEnthusiast - "Sturdy aromas of licorice, black pepper and wild berry fruits are highly encouraging. In the mouth, high acidity reflective of a cool year is the dominant component, meaning this has long-term aging potential. Flavors of dried cheese, vanilla and chocolate come straight from the barrel, while balsamic berry, plum and currant notes carry over to a well-oaked finish. Drink from 2020–2034."

92 points in Wine Spectator - "Sleek and dense, this ripe red shows blackberry and plum compote flavors, with dark chocolate and black pepper accents. Firm tannins and sweet-tart acidity keep this focused. A fruit-driven, modern style. Drink now through 2026."

name: Michel Rolland (Rolland Collection)  R&G Ribera del Duero
wine_color: A bright, medium-high, crimson-coloured robe with a garnet rim.
desc_en_short: This is a big wine made from 25-40 year old vines. It’s bold and ripe on the palate with black cherry and plum flavors,  a chewy texture and fine, firm tannins, finishing very dry.  While this wine is approachable now, it will be better with another year or two in bottle. It’s a blend of 85% Tempranillo and 15% Merlot.

name: Baigorri  Maceracion Carbonica
wine_color: Expressive and intense cherry color with violet reflections.
desc_en_short: Expressive and intense cherry color with violet reflections. Clean and bright., It has a fragrant, direct, very expressive nose, with a juicy ripe black fruit accompanied by pleasant spicy, floral notes, light balsamic and menthol., The palate is fresh, extremely fruity, meaty and sweet. Good attack, medium body, good acidity and tannic sensations. It has a drying period and a long finish. A lush red wine.

name: Baigorri  Crianza
wine_color: Intense cherry color came from upper middle layer
desc_en_short: Baigorri Crianza from Rioja is a hand-selected Tempranillo-led blend aged 14 months in French and American oak, delivering an elegant, silky palate of dark fruit, subtle dairy notes, and classic Riojan structure — a compelling everyday red with real character.

name: Baigorri  Reserva
desc_en_short: Baigorri Reserva is a richly concentrated Rioja Tempranillo crafted entirely by gravity flow at one of the appellation's most architecturally striking wineries. Expect dark cherry depth, spice-laced black fruit, and a long, elegant finish shaped by careful aging in French oak.

name: Baigorri  Garnacha
wine_color: Bright, intense cherry and cherry trim.
desc_en_short: Notes that serious? Mouth and red fruit with great complexity and harmony of colors. The palate is unctuous, elegant envelope and is expressed with good ? A long and persistent in mineral palate. Food Pairing White meat, poultry, seafood and grilled fish (hake, cod, ...).

name: Baigorri  de Garage
wine_color: Dark cherry red colour with garnet rim.
desc_en_short: A rare, gravity-made Tempranillo from Bodegas Baigorri in Rioja Alavesa, Baigorri de Garage is a hand-harvested, single-varietal gem from old low-yield vines — rich with stewed fruit, chocolate, and toasted oak, yet refined by elegantly structured tannins and a long, complex finish.

name: Lealtanza  Crianza
wine_color: Intense, deep ruby red with garnet highlights.
desc_en_short: Its entry is fresh and it maintains that freshness on the palate along its tasting. It is round, with a very long aftertaste and clear memory of black fruits such as blackberries and blackcurrant that remind in the aftertaste. It allows a wide variety of meat dishes such as stews, lamb, game and generally meats with strong flavors.

name: Lealtanza  Reserva
desc_en_short: Its aromatic power, good balance and easy tannins define it as a classic.

name: Solar Viejo  Reserva
desc_en_short: Blend of Tempranillo and Graciano aged for at least 12 months in barrels of French and American oak barrels and long bottle aging. Intense cherry color and little progress due to its great tannic and careful production method. Aromas well integrated with notes of coffee, caramel and vanilla and ripe fruit greedy. After mild agitation nose becomes more complex appearing black licorice, spicy notes and mineral hints. Good structure on the palate, full of fruit and life, nice tannin, resulting in a tasty and elegant.

name: Solar Viejo  Orube
desc_en_short: Aged in French and American oak barrels over a period of 12 months. Big aromas, with ripe fruit dominating, but also chocolate, coffee and spices. On the palate, it is powerful but well balanced by attractive and elegant tannins. Long, intense, pleasant aftertaste.

name: Delheim  Pinotage
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red colour. Aromas of black cherry, plum and red berry fruit, backed by dark chocolate and floral notes. The palate is rich, with juicy mulberry and black cherry flavours, backed by a savoury element on the finish.

name: Bay Bridge  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Bay Bridge California Cabernet Sauvignon is an approachable, fruit-forward everyday red delivering bright raspberry and tart cherry aromas with a soft, easy-drinking palate of sweet red fruits — a no-fuss bottle ideal for casual gatherings and weeknight barbecues.

name: Bay Bridge  Merlot
desc_en_short: The nose hinted at strawberry and a nutty warmth. Simple, sweet flavor profile with apple peel, pear, green grapes and very mild tannins. Would make a lovely "wine o'clock" wine but wouldn't pair it for dinner. Let breathe for a while before enjoying.

name: Long Lake  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Rich color with notes of blackberry, raspberry and vanilla. Tannins are soft and layered. This wine pairs well with both aged cheddar and Gouda cheeses. For the main course try it along with leg of lamb, flank steak or pasta in a marinara sauce.

name: Long Lake  Merlot
desc_en_short:
“Dark ruby-colored wine that offers aromas of cherry, blackberry and a hint of vanilla; flavors include plum and
blueberry; smooth tannins support a long silky finish.”

name: Long Lake  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short:
“This ruby-colored wine has aromas of raspberry and violet with a hint of spice. Flavors of cherry and plum
lead to a soft velvety finish.”

name: Rock Brook  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Rich notes of black cherry, ripe plum and cassis. This wine has supple mouth yet defined structure which is interlaced with flavors of cocoa and subtle notes of tobacco. This wine pairs well with prosciutto-wrapped lamb roast, Filet Mignon with a baby Portobello mushroom sauce or a hearty stew on a cold night. Dry Jack and aged Gouda are perfect cheeses for this wine.

name: Rock Brook  Merlot
desc_en_short: Rockbrook Merlot offers notes of raspberry and strawberry jellies, vanilla, coconut and caramel. On the palate it is light-bodied, with a young but soft tannic structure that leads to a short finish of berry fruit. This wine pairs well with mushroom-stuffed pork chops, classic Italian lasagna and a Roman-style chicken. Gruyere and Camembert Cheeses enhance the flavors of this wine.

name: Rock Brook  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Delicate, medium bodied wine with bright aromas of bramble fruit. Rich raspberry and plum flavors are complemented by subtle oak spice notes and soft tannins. Pair this Shiraz with grilled lamb with garlic and Rosemary, your favorite vegetable stew, or with some sweet and tangy barbecued baby back ribs.

name: Dona Sol  Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Verdot, Mixed Varietals
desc_en_short: A dark ruby-red Cabernet Sauvignon filled with aromas of black cherry and currant. Flavors of raspberry,white pepper and hints of vanilla and spice come through on the palate. Nice tannins and a medium finish make this wine enjoyable on any occasion. Food Pair this wine with beef, lamb, and pork. Medium-soft cheeses and chocolate desserts also pair nicely.

name: Dona Sol  Merlot
desc_en_short: Doña Sol Merlot from California delivers generous ripe fruit aromas of wild berries, raspberry, and vanilla, carrying through to a fruit-forward palate with an approachable, smooth finish — an easy-drinking red ideal for everyday occasions.

name: Crane Lake  Sangiovese
desc_en_short: This wine was a deep raspberry red color. A mix of dark berry aromas fill the nose, including black cherry, blackberry, and black currant. Subtle sweet honey and vanilla aromas are also present. Some tannins are present, but this is an overall sweet and light fruity wine. Possible lingering vanilla and wood flavors but very subtle if present at all.

name: Crane Lake  Petite Sirah
desc_en_short: Crane Lake Petite Sirah this wine is from the inky dark color to the bouquet loaded with tons of blackberry fruit and a hint of exotic spice; it fills your mouth with jammy fruit balanced by velvety soft tannins. Perfect for your next big party.

name: Estrella  Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Ruby Cabernet, Petite Sirah, Mixed Redspetite Sirah, Mixed Reds
desc_en_short: Fruit forward Cabernet with rich flavors of black cherry, currant, and raspberry and hints of vanilla and white pepper. With light tannins and a smooth finish this Cabernet lingers just enough to make you want another sip. food pairing This Cabernet Sauvignon pairs well with marinated tri-tip, chicken with pasta in red sauce, and bitter dark chocolates.

name: Estrella  Merlot
style: Merlot, Muscat, Ruby Cabernet, Mixed Varietals
desc_en_short: This ruby colored Merlot has raspberry jam aromas with a subtle hint of spice. Layers of vanilla, plum and fig are revealed that linger ever so slightly on the palate. This wine pairs well with roasted rack of lamb and roasted potatoes. Creamy cheeses pair well with Merlot that can be enjoyed on any occasion.

name: Estrella  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Estrella Shiraz This wine has black fruit aromas unfold in the bouquet. Rich plum, and blackberry accompanied by pepper and hints of vanilla. Smooth finish and light tannins. Food pairing with Estrella Shiraz This wine pairs well with pork dishes with mushroom glaze.

name: Forest Ville  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Forest Ville Cabernet Sauvignon is an approachable California red brimming with black cherry, currant, and blackberry fruit, layered with warm spice and a mocha-tinged finish — an easygoing, crowd-pleasing bottle suited to a wide range of occasions.

name: Forest Ville  Merlot
desc_en_short: Forest Ville Merlot This wine is Deep red colour with plum aromas. Rich fruit flavours of ripe plum, cherry and currents. Well balanced with a long lingering finish of oak with soft tannins. Food pairing with pastas in a cream sauce, beef, and roasted vegetables. Also pairs well with creamy cheeses.

name: Forest Ville  Shiraz
style: Shiraz, Petite Sirah, Malbec, Mixed Varietals
desc_en_short: This Shiraz is a medium-bodied red wine that is filled with aromas of jammy fruit, cherry, and black pepper. Soft tannins and hints of oak, spice, and vanilla lead to a smooth, soft finish. Food Pairing Perfect to pair with grilled veggies, red meats, and chicken. Soft creamy cheeses and chocolate also pair well.

name: Grove Ridge  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Grove Ridge Cabernet Sauvignon opens with extreme deepened hues and vibrant colors. Aromas include a romantic fusion of black currant, dry herbs and slight earthiness. Dark berries and cherries accompanied by subtle spice leave a smooth finish.

name: Grove Ridge  Merlot
desc_en_short: This wine begins with a deep garnet color followed by the inviting aromas of dark chocolate, tobacco, and violets. Velvety black cherries and plum accompanied by black pepper spice leave this wine with a medium finish.

name: Alexander Valley  Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The Alexander Valley Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon has great texture and structure with a medium mouthfeel. There are aromas of dark plum, cherry, cassis, warm barrel spice, vanilla and dark chocolate. In the glass there are concentrated flavors of cherry, cassis, blackberry, plum, spice, tobacco and chocolate.

name: Alexander Valley  Vineyards Merlot
desc_en_short: On the nose, this cab is pure darkness. Intense blackberry and cassis, with mocha, caramel and a hint of rose petal. Dense on the palate with focused cassis and plum fruit, highlighted by mocha, toast and chestnut. Much darker and deeper than the Blueline merlot and cabernet franc. Tinges of black cherry soda and loam carry the hedonistic finish

name: Alexander Valley  Vineyards 'Sin Zin' Zinfandel
desc_en_short: The Alexander Valley Vineyards 'Sin Zin' Zinfandel is Grape Varietal 100% Zinfandel  with aromas of black plum, black cherry, vanilla and oak. There are rich flavors of plum and black cherry along with a spicy finish. This wine has a full mouthfeel and opulent style.

name: Bond  Matriarch
desc_en_short: Bond Matriarch is a lush, exuberant Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon blend from the acclaimed Bond estate, weaving white chocolate, espresso roast, and peppery spice into a richly textured, opulent package that rewards patience.

name: Bond  Melbury
desc_en_short: Bond Melbury is a hillside Cabernet Sauvignon from one of Napa Valley's most celebrated single-estate portfolios, delivering tightly coiled energy with vibrant red fruit, mocha, tobacco, and a distinctive mineral edge — built for patient cellaring and remarkable longevity.

name: Bond  St. Eden
desc_en_short: Dark almost black. Dense aromas of cassis, tobacco and dark fruit. Taste is a lovely balance of fruit, cassis, coffee and earth with ripe tannins, i guess this is what is labelled a brooding wine. Long long taste. A wow wine in the making! Had this at a quick tasting at Hedonism wines. Love this place! Still havent come across anywhere else you can sample such superior wines to satisfy your curiosity!

name: Bond  Vecina
desc_en_short: Deep ruby. Brooding, superripe, distinctly cabernet aromas of blackberry, cassis, violet and espresso. Sweet, densely packed and thick, with powerful flavors of crushed cassis and tobacco lifted by violet and licorice. Almost youthfully gritty today and in need of bottle aging to show its underlying shape. The huge tannins coat the front teeth and saturate the entire palate.

name: Bond  Pluribus
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot And Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Bond Pluribus is a flamboyantly mineral Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon from one of the valley's most coveted hillside single-vineyard estates, delivering brooding cassis, violet, and exotic herb complexity with a powerful yet harmonious structure reminiscent of a great St-Julien cru.

name: Bond  Quella
desc_en_short: Saturated ruby. Musky aromas of blue and black fruits, truffle, tobacco and loam, all lifted by an ineffable mineral perfume. Lush, suave and sweet, with juicy acidity framing the black cherry, dark chocolate and mineral flavors. The long, rising finish features very ripe, fine-grained tannins and sneaky intensity of flavor.

name: Buccella  Merlot
desc_en_short: Typical Buccella Merlot, which means it's one of the best you can find for the vintage (anywhere in the world!!!). Nose is voluptuous blackberry and raspberry liqueur intermingled with tobacco smoke and leather, hints of Saigon cinnamon and nutmeg, definite dark cocoa powder. Mouth is med-heavy with more of the same, serious acidity to buttress it along with substantial tannins.

name: Buccella  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Our Cabernet Sauvignon is crafted from thoughtfully cultivated small vineyards in Napa Valley, primarily in Oakville, Yountville and Coombsville. Low yields and great clonal pedigree, combined with meticulous farming within a variety of cooler appellations, are essential to producing our Cabernet Sauvignon. We believe it is this blend of concentrated ripe fruit that results in our wine’s unique character, complexity, depth and balance.

name: Cain  Cuvee NV9
style: Merlot, Cab Franc, Cabernet, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: On the nose there is a good complexity with notes of black cherry, black currant, cedar, cinnamon, Christmas spice, leather, and cloves. In the mouth this wine has a bite and is slightly tart with a medium to full body, a silky to coarse texture. There flavors of black cherry, raspberry, and leather. Berries linger on the long finish. Overall great complexity and good integration

name: Chateau Montelena  'Estate' Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Deep garnet-purple with brilliant opacity, indicating excellent aging potential.
desc_en_short: A Napa Valley icon from Calistoga, Chateau Montelena's Estate Cabernet Sauvignon delivers classic restraint and commanding depth — structured, age-worthy, and unmistakably shaped by the mountain-influenced terroir that made this historic estate famous.

name: Domaine Georg Rafael  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The wine is an inky ruby purple in color. Classic aromas of black currant, eucalyptus and black cherry are initially expressed. With time in the glass, complex notes of violets, blackberry, cedar, graphite, tobacco and earth are revealed. The long finish is accentuated by heady black cherry juiciness. Elegant structure will allow the wine to stand up on its own

name: Francis Coppola  Director's Cut Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: From Francis Ford Coppola's acclaimed Director's Cut label, this Sonoma County Pinot Noir delivers a spice-driven, velvety experience — layers of blackberry, wild strawberry, cardamom, and cherry pie wrapped in supple tannins and a whisper of French oak.

name: Gemstone  Red Blend Facets (Cabernet/Merlot/Cab Franc/Petit)
desc_en_short: Gemstone Red Blend Facets This wine is Bright, with ripe, vivid red berry and black cherry flavors. Medium- to full-bodied, turning delicate and elegant while displaying depth and persistence, firming nicely on the finish.

name: Gemstone  "Ten" Proprietary Red (Cabernet/Petit Verdot)
desc_en_short: The superb Gemstone Proprietary Red is from the cooler Oakville / Yountville sector of Napa. It exhibits a dense ruby/purple color as well as a beautiful bouquet of subtle new oak interwoven with black currants, smoke, licorice, and a hint of spring flowers. The wine is full-bodied, with excellent density, admirable balance, and fine purity, a hallmark of this estate. It should drink nicely for two decades.

name: Gemstone  Proprietary Red (Cabernet/Petit Verdot/Merlot)
desc_en_short: Gemstone Proprietary Red This must be the finest bottle that this winery has ever produced!!! A beautiful bouquet of ripe blue and black fruits layered with crushed stones, exotic spice, and elegant oak. On the palate full-bodied, rich and elegant, with a seductive finish.

name: Gnarly Head  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Gnarly Head Cabernet Sauvignon This wine is Our dark, bold Cabernet has solid tannins and jammy fruit, with aromas and flavors of black cherry, currant, dried cranberry and black peppercorn followed by a trio of clove, earth and light toast.

name: Gnarly Head  Merlot
desc_en_short: Gnarly Head Merlot is a boldly fruit-driven California red packed with concentrated black cherry, blackberry, and ripe plum, backed by lush tannins and a warming hint of sweet herbs and spice — far from the shy, soft Merlot of reputation.

name: Gnarly Head  Old Vine Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Sourced from gnarly, head-trained old vines aged 35–80 years in Lodi, California, this bold Zinfandel delivers concentrated dark berry fruit layered with vanilla, plum, pepper, and toasted coconut — a richly spiced, full-bodied red built for the grill.

name: Grgich Hills  Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Dark purple-black in glass. Clean nose, showing moderately intense aromas of kirsch, raspberries and licorice. Medium-bodied on the palate, with low-to-medium acidity, medium ripe tannins and flavors which mirror the nose. The middle is a bit thin, but the mouth texture compensates with its silkiness. The finish is medium in length and fairly smooth.

name: Grgich Hills  Merlot
desc_en_short: From Napa Valley's biodynamic pioneer Grgich Hills, this full-bodied Merlot delivers creamy red and black plum with rose petal aromatics, warming spice, and a richly satisfying finish framed by vanilla and toasted oak.

name: Levy & McClellan  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Nose was elegant, notes of plum, blueberry and coffee are noticeable. Good balanced overall, with some heat on the tail end and a little salty nature on the mid-palate. There's a lot of secondary flavors coming through already, coffee, truffle and some earthy characteristics.

name: Lewis  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Enticing, deep-fruited aromas of black currant, berry and chocolate are stippled with cedar, clove and cinnamon oak spices. The palate centers on opulent core fruit that swirls around a defined structure of supple tannins. With complex undertones of truffle, black pepper and briar, this interplay finally winds down to a long chocolaty finish

name: Lewis  Mason's Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Lewis Mason's Cabernet Sauvignon is a pure, joyful expression of 100% Napa Valley Cabernet, bursting with olallieberry fruit, Mexican chocolate, and toasty oak spice, with creamy texture and supple tannins that make it irresistible from the first pour.

name: Lewis  Napa Valley Merlot
desc_en_short: A supple texture wraps around a complex and dense core, with aromas of currant, mocha and fresh coffee bean leading to layered flavors of plum, spicy espresso and dill.

name: Lewis  Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This blend of 98% Cabernet Sauvignon and 2% Petit Verdot is powerfully aromatic. Sweet black currant and boysenberry flavors gradually take the backseat to a more muscular mid-palate framed with sinewy tannins and baker's chocolate.

name: Lewis  Napa Valley Cuvee L
desc_en_short: Smooth, rich and creamy, with mocha-lace plum and black cherry fruit that's elegant, stylish, full-bodied and complex, ending with a long, firm, concentrated finish. Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc.

name: McManis  Merlot
wine_color: Bright purple hues highlighted with medium ruby color.
desc_en_short: Our McManis Family Vineyards Merlot has bright purple hues highlighted with medium ruby color. Ripe Blackberry aromas are surrounded by a bouquet of cream and a hint of baking spices. Our Merlot, as with previous vintages, is juicy and concentrated with a mix of black fruit flavors and a vanilla creamy texture - contributed through oak aging. The wine is succulent with a toasty finish.

name: McManis  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: A bright, fruit-forward California Pinot Noir from four generations of McManis family farming, delivering fresh strawberry, cherry, and blueberry flavors with a smooth, vanilla-kissed finish that makes it one of the Central Valley's most approachable everyday reds.

name: Pahlmeyer  Proprietary Red
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot ,Cabernet Franc, Malbec, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Pahlmeyer Proprietary Red is a benchmark Napa Valley Bordeaux-style blend — brilliant purple, layered with wildflower, cassis, huckleberry, and cardamom — delivering the elegance and power that have defined this estate since its very first vintage.

name: Pahlmeyer  Merlot
desc_en_short: This is a concentrated wine with extractive notes of dusty cocoa, black cherry and generous spice accented with cassis.  It is perfectly balanced and the flavors are seamlessly integrated.  The tannins are big, dark and supple and the finish goes on and on.

name: Chateau L'Argenteyre
wine_color: Wine beautiful garnet color with purple hues.
style: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc And Malbec
desc_en_short: Rounded, full of ripe tannins, good sense of structure, scope and generosity of the wine, which skillfully interwoven with elegant sophistication. Long aftertaste pleases persistent fruity splendor. The wine is excellent with meat dishes, game, poultry, cheeses, sausages.

name: Spottswoode  Estate Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
98 points in Robert Parker Wine Advocate

Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2014 Cabernet Sauvignon has a drop-dead gorgeous nose of Sichuan pepper, hoisin, peppered salami and fertile loam over a core of blackberry preserves and redcurrant jelly with touches of kirsch and pencil shavings. Medium to full-bodied and concentrated yet still maintaining that wonderful purity and elegance that is the signature of this estate, it has layer upon layer of earthy nuances and a very long finish.

name: Whitehall Lane  Merlot
style: Merlot, 8% Cabernet Sauvignon, 5% Malbec, 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Candied black cherries and pomegranates burst out of this wine aromatically, coupled with graphite, cocoa dust, fresh tobacco leaf, cherry cola, baked croissant, and toasted vanilla. On the palate, this Merlot has fine, firm tannins alongside red currants, strawberry rhubarb pie, raspberry coulis, toasted walnuts, leather, and spice. It is supple in texture and shows attractive depth on the finish. Enjoy right now and through 2026 with proper cellaring.

name: Whitehall Lane  Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Malbec, Petite Verdot
desc_en_short: This wine is is loaded with bright, vibrant fruit and has exceptional body to match. The aromas and flavors of blackberry, currant, black cherry and toasted oak meld exquisitely with ample mid palate weight, a slimy mouth-feel and luxurious tannins that add good length to the finish.

name: Castellare Di Castellina  Poggio ai Merli IGT
wine_color: Deep and vibrant purple, clear, brilliant and beautiful texture.
desc_en_short: Castellare di Castellina's Poggio ai Merli is a pure Merlot from the heart of Tuscany — elegantly structured, richly fruited, and shaped by hillside vineyards that rival the finest single-varietal Merlots produced anywhere in Italy.

name: Mysterious  Reserva Merlot
desc_en_short: Our Reserva Merlot a has an intense ruby red. It is a fine sample of a complex wine with dry fruits and truffle.In mouth is Spicy and humid soil taste. Its tannins are mellow and soft with a pleasant and silky aftertaste. A great match to pasta, lightly spiced red meats, and soft cheeses.

name: Mysterious  Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A richly concentrated Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon from the Central Valley, delivering ripe dark fruits layered with notes of hazelnut, chocolate, and oak-kissed spice — full-bodied with polished, elegant tannins that make it a natural partner for grilled red meats and aged cheeses.

name: Mysterious  Reserva Syrah
desc_en_short: Our Syrah has a violet dark colour. It is a sophisticated wine with notes of cherry liquor, spices and a soft touch of toasted oak. It is full-bodied and with a well balanced acidity. Its ripe tannins, ripe fruits and oak join is together to offer a perfect finish. Prefect with spicy foods, red meats and mature cheeses

name: Conde Del Sur  Carmenere
desc_en_short: Our Carménère has an intense dark-violet color. The wine features aromas of fresh red fruit, hints of plums, jam and spices. It is tannins are sweet and velvety. It matches soft, red meats, poultry and soft cheeses.

name: Mysterious  Merlot
desc_en_short: Our Merlot has a bright ruby–violet color. The wine has intense with abundant notes of ripe red fruits, plum and pepper hints. Its tannins are sweet and velvety. It has a long and lingering finish. Ideal as a company for roast beef, pork, pasta and fresh cheese.

name: Mysterious  Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: A rich and concentrated ruby-violet colour.
desc_en_short: Our Cabernet Sauvignon has a rich and concentrated ruby-violet colour. The smell has Blackcurrant and black cherries. Elegant with good balance. Its tannins are soft and mature. A great choice to match with red meats, herby dishes or mature cheeses.

name: SilverStone  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Our Winemaker has chosen to use oak barrels just enough to enhance the flavors of his Cabernet, in the respect of the special character in varietal. This requires careful attention to fermentation and to aging. Each wine is tasted repeatedly to ensure the harmonized flavors. Silverstone wines are widely recognized for offering outstanding quality.

name: Bouchon  Superior Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Oak barrels are used just enough to enhance the flavors of the Cabernet Sauvignon. This requires careful attention to fermentation and to aging. It is the right balance between varietal intensity and the vanilla and spice flavors which oak aging.

name: Bouchon  Superior Merlot
desc_en_short: Bouchon Superior Merlot is a carefully crafted California red that strikes a precise balance between ripe varietal fruit and the warm vanilla and spice complexity of measured oak ageing — a full-bodied, food-friendly Merlot built for the table.

name: Moute  Premium Red Selection
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 3 Bottles.

A special blend of finest fresh fruits, bright red in color. The wine is very easy to drink with medium sweet and smooth tannin. This made Moute Special Red Selection perfect to enjoy as an aperitif and also an ideal companion for spicy or grilled foods.

name: Moute  Special Red Selection
desc_en_short: MOUTE Premium Red Selection is a fruit- forward wine, fresh on the palate and brims with red fruits characters. which stands out distinctively. It has smooth tannin with nice body. It is great to enjoy by itself with a platter of cheeses or seasoned grilled meat.

name: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2002
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc, 4% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: A benchmark expression of Margaux's celebrated terroir, Château Rauzan-Gassies 2002 delivers a classically structured Cabernet Sauvignon-led blend with beautifully mature aromatics, fine-grained tannins, and the density to reward patient cellaring or confident opening today.

name: Chateau Haut Bailly  Grand Cru Classe 2013
desc_en_short: Château Haut-Bailly 2013 is a benchmark Pessac-Léognan Grand Cru Classé de Graves, weaving Cabernet Sauvignon's structured depth with Merlot's supple richness into a wine of remarkable elegance, silky tannins, and layered complexity built for long cellaring.

name: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)  Reserve Speciale Medoc
desc_en_short: Crafted by the legendary house of Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite), this Médoc Réserve Spéciale blends hand-selected Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot from the appellation's finest vineyards, delivering a refined, classically structured Bordeaux with effortless elegance.

name: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)  Reserve Speciale Bordeaux Rouge
desc_en_short: Crafted by the house behind Château Lafite Rothschild, this approachable Bordeaux Rouge blends 60% Merlot with 40% Cabernet Sauvignon, sourcing fruit from the finest terroirs across the Gironde — including Entre-Deux-Mers — to deliver classic Bordeaux balance in every glass.

name: Chateau Lafite-Rothschild  2015
wine_color: Very dark color, with purple glints, indicating that the wine is still very much in its youth.
desc_en_short: A restrained yet aristocratic expression of one of Bordeaux’s greatest estates, the 2015 vintage from Lafite shows both pedigree and finesse—Cabernet Sauvignon dominance, elegant tannic structure and the hallmark graphite‑cedar signature of Pauillac.

name: J. Bouchon  Block Series Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: J. Bouchon's Block Series Cabernet Sauvignon from Chile's Rapel Valley delivers an intense, full-bodied red layered with dark fruit, vanilla, tobacco, and chocolate — a structured, age-worthy wine built for the table and made to impress.

name: J. Bouchon  Mingre
desc_en_short: From J. Bouchon's prized Mingre estate in Rapel Valley, this hand-harvested blend of Carmenère, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Syrah delivers ripe fruit complexity, toasted oak, and elegantly rounded tannins shaped by up to 18 months in French oak barrels.

name: J. Bouchon  Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva
desc_en_short: Deep bright violaceous red. Pleasant red fruits aromas with a hints of spicy notes as pepper and cumin. It has also some herbal aromas like tobacco. It is a fruity wine with elegant tannins and toasted notes at the end. It is very pleasant in the mouth with a good structure and balance, long ending. Enjoy with all kind of red meats, lamb, steak, rabbit, barbecues, and ripe cheese.

name: Dominus Estate  Napanook 2011
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Petit Verdot And 8% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short:
91 points Vinous

"The 2011 Napanook is deep, rich and intense for the year. Plums, mocha, spices, licorice all flesh out in an inviting wine to drink now and over the next few years. The 2011 has no hard edges or greenness, but the medium-bodied structure suggests it is best enjoyed sooner rather than later. The blend is 83% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Petit Verdot and 8% Cabernet Franc. (AG)"

name: Dominus Estate  Napanook 2018
desc_en_short: Napanook 2018 from Dominus Estate is a compelling Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon with striking aromas of petrichor, dark earth, and iron, framed by firm, finely grippy tannins and a vibrant finish — the product of a near-perfect growing season.

name: Dominus Estate  2013
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Petit Verdot, And 4% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

To celebrate the 30th vintage of Dominus as well as an exceptional year for Napa Valley, the 2013 label dons a special portrait of Christian Moueix by William Kentridge. Kentridge is a South African artist internationally known for his prints, drawings, animations and more recently, stage design for opera.

name: Dominus Estate 2001
style: Cabernet Sauvignon 81%, Cabernet Franc 10%, Merlot 4%, Petit Verdot 5%
desc_en_short:
2001 was characterized by an early bloom and long growing season that yielded grapes of exceptional maturity. The low rainfall brought stress to the vines, contributing to the intensity and complexity of the fruit.

The 2001 vintage has a dark ruby color with a luxuriant nose of licorice, exotic spices, Bing cherries and an essence of roses. This wine has the unique ability to be rich and complex while possessing a smooth and silky texture. The evolution of flavor develops like a crescendo into an intense finish of cloves and aromatic cassis.

The 2001 blend includes 81% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Cabernet Franc, 4% Merlot and 5% Petit Verdot.

This elegant wine is truly a classic, and will benefit from years of aging. We recommend decanting the wine prior to serving, to allow it to develop its full potential. This is especially important when serving young Dominus wines.

name: Dominus Estate 2015
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Cabernet Franc, And 3% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: Dominus Estate 2015 is a seductive Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon of remarkable complexity, weaving deep cherry, warm citrus, and marzipan aromas across a weightless frame of finely polished tannins — a benchmark expression of the Yountville estate's singular terroir.

name: Dominus Estate 2018
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Cabernet Franc, 5% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
The Dominus 2018 exemplifies the finest qualities of Cabernet Sauvignon from an ideal vintage. The intriguing nose offers a depth of aromas including lavender, Asian spices and cedar. Soft, supple tannins buoy layers of dark earth and cocoa. The wine is racy yet refined with a long elegant finish.

The 2018 vintage is composed of 89% Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Cabernet Franc, 5% Petit Verdot

We recommend decanting the wine prior to serving, to allow it to develop its full potential. This is especially important when serving young Dominus wines.

name: Harlan Estate  The Maiden 2013
desc_en_short: 95 points in James Suckling - "The purity of black fruit, black currants and blackberry is impressive, yet it remains subdued. Floral, ripe tobacco. Turns to spices such as cloves and Cameroon green pepper. Full-bodied, tight and compressed. Powerful yet polished and refined. The best Maiden ever. A blend of mostly cabernet sauvignon and merlot."

name: Harlan Estate  The Maiden 2014
desc_en_short: 97 points in James Suckling - "Incredible floral and walnut undertones with a bright berry and currant character. Very aromatic and refined. Full body, very fine tannins and a bright finish. Medium to full body, integrated tannins and a long, fresh finish. Very linear and focused. This is one for the cellar but so fine now."

name: Peter Michael  Pinot Noir Le Moulin Rouge
desc_en_short: Leading with intense aromas of wild strawberry, plum, violet and red cherry, the 2013 Le Moulin Rouge follows with hints of Earl Grey tea. Opening further, the bouquet reveals additional aromas such as plum, elderberry, graphite with clove and cinnamon in the background. Intense in the mouth, the wine blends richness and delicacy as the flavors stretch to a long earthy and fruit-filled finish. This beautiful wine drinks well young yet will age for a decade.

name: Peter Michael  Pinot Noir Ma Danseuse
wine_color: Red ruby color and bright maroon tinge.
desc_en_short: 93 points in Decanter - "Peter Michael’s steep Seaview Estate vineyards are on the reverse-slope of the first ridgeline in from the Pacific, with vine material from Burgundy. The plummy fruit, rich earth, rose and spice of this cuvée evoke the Côte d’Or: ample and authoritative. Lofty alcohol, but its vivid fruit tones avoid torrefaction."

name: Twomey  Merlot Napa Valley
desc_en_short: 92 points in Wilfred Wong of Wine.com - "Stand up Merlot and show yourself! Over the course of the last three decades, Merlot has flourished in places beyond the Right Bank of Bordeaux. But many experts have found it difficult to describe the attributes of a New World Merlot. The 2016 Twomey by Silver Oak is excellent Merlot that underscores this issue. TASTING NOTES: The wine is showy with black fruit, boysenberries, and oak. Certainly not attributes one would use with Pomerol or Saint-Émilion, but perfectly happy in the Napa Valley. Pair its New World flavors with grilled tri-tip."

name: Staglin Family  Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 8% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc And 3% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

After a cold and wet beginning, the 2005 vintage developed into a wonderfully moderate growing season that had plenty of sun and some decent hot temperatures, but contained no really aggressive heat spikes. This helped the grapes to mature very evenly and deeply with beautifully ripe flavors and rich, round tannins and allowed us to pick the vineyard calmly over several weeks when each block had reached its peak.

This wine jumps from the glass with an animated nose of flowers, black cherries and ripe plums liberally inflected with aromas of cedar shavings, cigar box, wet river rocks and graphite. It cascades across the palate revealing rich layers of black cherries, Crème de cassis and blueberries intermixed with generous hints of black tea and cardamom, leading to a reverberant exit of spiced plums and kola nuts followed by a lengthy mouth coating finish. While drinking well now, it will benefit from and open up more fully with some additional time in bottle and should continue to develop more weight and complexity over the next 10+ years.

name: Grosset  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Delicately fragrant red cherry florals, a burst of primal mulberry and strawberry flavours and a velvety smoothness give the wine a surprising immediacy. Looking again there are hints of complexity: on the nose, light, briary notes, some darker berry fruits; a richness and concentration, wild blackberry characters which flesh out the palate: and importantly, fine, gentle tannins. It has precision and balance on a light, tight frame.

name: Heritage  Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: The wine shows sparkling garnet color
desc_en_short: The grapes for this wine were grown by our neighbours, Peter & Anita Frazer, whose low-yielding vineyard produces fruit of intense richness & varietal character. The Cabernet Sauvignon is a blockbuster of a wine with rich dark fruit and balanced soft oak tannins, produced from 12 months ageing in American oak barriques.

name: Fox Creek  Shadow's Run Shiraz & Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Shiraz, 23% Cabernet Sauvignon And 9% Other Varieties.
desc_en_short: A soft rich balanced blend of blackcurrant, red cherry and blood plum fruit flavours, complemented by a milk chocolate, cherry and cream mid palate.

name: Fox Creek  JSM ( Shiraz - Cabernet Sauvignon - Cabernet Franc)
style: Shiraz, 20% Cabernet Sauvignon And 4% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short: Fox Creek's JSM is a masterfully blended McLaren Vale red honouring James Stanley Malpas, weaving together Shiraz richness, Cabernet Sauvignon structure, and Cabernet Franc's aromatic lift into a full-bodied, multi-layered wine defined by dark cherry, ripe red berries, and beautifully integrated smoky oak.

name: Fermoy Estate  Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
wine_color: Rich plum red with black tints.
desc_en_short: The medium-weighted palate unfolds in layers of fruit, savoury herbs, dark chocolate, and subtle oak spice. A soft and juicy mid-palate is supported by a framework of powder-fine tannins which add structure and length.

name: Montgras  Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A wine that surprises with a deep, ruby colour and full of blackberry and ripe currant aromas, complemented by subtle hints of black pepper and mint. Well-integrated oak completes a beautiful and complex aromatic profile. It’s loaded with flavours of cherries, blackberries, and ripe plums. Combined with hints of cedar and toast from the oak ageing, this wine is juicy, powerful, with a long, pleasant finish. It has ripe and soft tannins that give strong support and also soft and creamy texture.

name: Montgras  Reserva Carmenere
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red, this wine shows complex aromas of fresh ripe currant and blackberries with spicy notes surrounded by subtle touches of vanilla and mocha from the oak ageing. Vibrant core of ripe blackberry, plums and spice. Nicely balanced and deep, yet well structured, ending with a long, complex finish.

name: Montgras  Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon - Syrah
wine_color: Deep ruby red with purple notes.
desc_en_short: Firm and focused. Rich and ripe tannins give the structure to this wine full of notes of black fruit and cedar. Powerful wine but with an elegant texture and a long pleasant finish.

name: Echeverria  Signatura 1 Syrah
wine_color: Ruby red with deep amber gleams.
desc_en_short: This outstanding Syrah combines aromas of ripe raspberries, blueberries and blackberries with scents of dark chocolate and black pepper. Delicate notes of eucalyptus and spices add complexity to the palate. This rich and luscious wine offers a great structure, deep concentrated flavors and a smooth silky palate, with a long and persistent aftertaste.

name: Chateau Branon  2010
desc_en_short: "Once again in 2010, notes of mocha, espresso roast, chocolate, creme de cassis and scorched earth soar from this opaque purple-colored wine. It is aged in 100% new oak, but that is hardly noticeable given the wine’s sensational richness and extravagant fruit. This wine is classic, full-bodied and intense. It's just a shame that less than 8,000 bottles are usually made. This wine is still backward, but very full, rich, and impressively pure in texture. Give it another 5-8 years of cellaring and drink it over the following 20+ years."

name: Chateau Carbonnieux  Rouge Pessac-Leognan
desc_en_short: 91 points Robert Parker's - Wine Advocate "A classic Pessac-Leognan, the 2009 Carbonnieux possesses aromas of sweet black currants and cherries intermixed with hints of roasted herbs, unsmoked cigar tobacco, charcoal and licorice. Medium to full-bodied with more concentration than many vintages, this surprisingly fleshy effort has more poundage and glycerin than this normally light-styled Bordeaux has offered in the past. Harmonious sweet tannins and low acidity give the wine a fleshy mouthfeel and immediate appeal, but most of its aromatic complexity will not emerge for another 5-7 years. It should keep for two decades or more."

name: Chateau Ferran
desc_en_short: Opaque black dark crimson color with a deep dark crimson red hue. The nose exhibits good aromatic lift with scents of blackcurrant and black cherries followed by some cedar tobacco, subtle earth and spice. Medium to full bodied wine, rich blackcurrant and black cherry over a background of toasty cedar, earth and spices on the palate. Dry finish with solid firm and fine grained tannin.

name: Chateau Haut-Brion  1er Grand Cru Classe 2001
style: Merlot, 36% Cabernet Sauvignon And 12% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: "Haut-Brion's 2001, which was bottled late (the end of September, 2003), possesses an unmistakable nobility as well as a burgeoning complexity. Plum/purple to the rim, this blend of 52% Merlot, 36% Cabernet Sauvignon, and 12% Cabernet Franc is playing it close to the vest, having closed down considerably after bottling. Nevertheless, it reveals pure notes of sweet and sour cherries, black currants, licorice, smoke, and crushed stones. Medium-bodied with excellent purity, firm tannin, and an angular, structured finish, it requires 5-7 years of cellaring. Anticipated maturity: 2009-2020+." Robert Parker, Wine Advocate , June 2004

name: Chateau Le Thil Comte Clary
desc_en_short: A hidden gem from the Graves appellation, Château Le Thil Comte Clary is a Merlot-led Bordeaux earning 91–93 points from Robert Parker, crafted by legendary consultant Stéphane Derenoncourt with opulent dark fruit, smoke, and silky depth that rewards a decade or more of cellaring.

name: Chateau Latour-Martillac 2010
desc_en_short: 90 points in Robert Parker's - Wine Advocate. "Abundant notes of spicy oak, elegant black currants and rich fruitiness along with hints of forest floor and damp earth are followed by a medium to full-bodied wine with sweet tannin and the classic Pessac-Leognan/Graves characteristics of tobacco leaf and smoke. Deep fruit, moderate tannin and a long finish give this wine enough potential to last for up to two decades or more. (90+)"

name: Chateau Malartic Lagraviere
desc_en_short: 96 Points in James Suckling "I love the deep and complex nose, in which the cassis and mint of cabernet sauvignon are beautifully married to the more generous blackberry of ripe merlot and the vanilla and toasty notes from the oak are marvelously integrated. On the palate it creeps up on you slowly; the first impression is ripe yet delicate, then the fine-grained tannins charge through and light up the sky. Very long finish. Drink or hold."

name: Chateau Olivier  Grand Cru Classe 2009
desc_en_short: "This is nicely packed with espresso, roasted tobacco, dark fig paste and currant reduction notes, all pushed by a long, charcoal-tinged finish. Fresh acidity is buried from start to finish, too. Best from 2014 through 2024."

name: Clos Marsalette  Pessac-Leognan
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 45% Merlot And 5% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short: A fresh, elegant style, with a lively mesquite and sanguine spine that cuts through the silk-textured damson plum, cherry and blackberry fruit. The long, mineral-tinged finish glides on with allure and grace. Best from 2014 through 2028.

name: Chateau d’Issan  2018
desc_en_short: The final blend took place in mid-January with an obvious, well-balanced selection. The 2018 vintage of Château d’Issan has intensity. The precision of the Merlot fruit is offering a great attack on the palate. It moves on to become more profound thanks to the Cabernet in this great vintage, reminiscent of 2016.

name: Chateau Lascombes  2011
wine_color: The dark, beautifully deep color displays brilliant purple hues.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 45% Merlot, And The Rest Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

The dark, beautifully deep color displays brilliant purple hues. After swirling, a subtle nose of spices, black fruits and licorice comes through, enveloped by subtle toasty notes with roasted coffee beans. The palate, after a supple entry, is explosive whereas the discreet oak comes through subtly in the background, leaving the way for the fruit to come to the forefront. The 2005 vintage is structured around a perfect balance of freshness, power, roundness, smoothness and very elegant tannins, which together make up an ideal harmony.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2005
wine_color: Deep purple color with black reflections
desc_en_short: One of the most celebrated wines of the legendary 2005 Bordeaux vintage, Château Palmer's Margaux earns 97 points from The Wine Advocate for its breathtaking concentration, seamless harmony of fruit, tannin, and acidity, and a projected drinking window that stretches beyond 2045.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2008
style: Merlot, 41% Cabernet Sauvignon And 8% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: 94 points in The Wine Advocate - "A stunning success for the vintage, and possibly the Margaux of the year, this wine, which achieved 13.5% natural alcohol, is a blend of 51% Merlot, 41% Cabernet Sauvignon and 8% Petit Verdot. Loads of barbecue smoke, licorice, incense, blackberry, new saddle leather and forest floor notes jump from the glass of this dense, purple-colored wine. Extraordinarily intense and full-bodied, with plenty of tannin, but not the formidable structure of the 2010, this is going to be one of the longest-lived wines of 2008. It is full, rich, layered, and should be reasonably approachable with 3-4 years of bottle age, and will also keep for 30+ years."

name: Carruades De Lafite 2011
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 39% Merlot, 3.5% Cabernet Franc, 2.5% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Château Lafite Rothschild’s second wine, Carruades de Lafite presents similar characteristics to the Grand Vin, but with its own personality linked to a higher proportion of Merlot and to specific plots that are used to produce Carruades. The name comes from the Carruades plateau, a group of plots acquired in 1845 just next to the vines on the Château hilltop.

name: Chateau Grand Puy Ducasse  5ème Cru Classé de Pauillac 2009
wine_color: Intense color with ruby and purple hues.
desc_en_short: A Grand Cru Classé from one of Pauillac's most storied châteaux, the 2009 Grand Puy Ducasse delivers intense black currant, anise, and toasted oak on a deeply structured yet silky palate — a benchmark expression from a legendary Bordeaux vintage.

name: Chateau Grand Puy Ducasse  5ème Cru Classé de Pauillac 2010
desc_en_short: "This blend of 60% Cabernet Sauvignon and 40% Merlot is an up-front, seductively styled Pauillac (one of the more forward and evolved wines from this appellation in 2010). Deep purple, with exceptionally subtle texture and oodles of cassis fruit as well as hints of mocha and white chocolate, it is an elegant wine, but the overall impression is one of considerable flesh, fat and succulence. It will be hard to resist now, but can be cellared for another 15+ years."

name: Chateau Duhart Milon Rothschild 2012
wine_color: Intense colour with hints of purple.
desc_en_short: Château Duhart-Milon’s grand vin is often described as a model of the Pauillac appellation. The broker Guillaume Lawton noted as early as 1815 that “it is very robust, with a fine colour, and quite pronounced sappiness” (he describes the “sappiness” of the Médoc’s premiers crus as “something like the odour given off by finest sealing wax when it is burned”).

name: Echo de Lynch Bages AOC Pauillac 2010
desc_en_short: Echo de Lynch-Bages 2010 is dense and richly seductive, with a terrific finish. Like its big brother, Echo de Lynch-Bages displays the characteristic taste, aromas and length of Pauillac wines. As an echo of the first wine, it receives the same care and attention from the vine to the cellars. It is the result of a selection of Lynch-Bages' youngest vines and specific plots which represent between 25 to 40 % of the harvest depending on the vintage. Echo de Lynch-Bages is round, soft and seductive in its youth with outstanding potential for bottle age.

name: Chateau Certan De May  Pomerol 2010
desc_en_short: 98 point in Wine Spectator -  "Shows stunning depth and drive, with a deep well of blackberry and plum sauce and a lush structure. Superlong, with spice and anise echoing on. A tremendous young wine in the making."

name: Chateau Certan De May  Pomerol 2012
style: Merlot, 4% Cabernet Sauvignon And 16% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: 92 points in James Suckling - "An attractive sample with lovely floral and berry character. Citrus acidity. Medium-to-full body. The wine builds on the palate with very polished tannins. Delicately fruity with pretty depth."

name: Chateau Clinet  2011
desc_en_short: 95 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "Clinet has produced a blockbuster wine, even in the lighter, less consistent vintage of 2011. It reveals a dense purple color as well as an abundance of black cherry, black currant and blackberry fruit intermixed with licorice, incense and a touch of camphor. Full-bodied, opulent and fleshy with a substantial finish, this showy, dramatic 2011 should drink well for 15-20 years. Brilliant!"

name: Clos Rene  Pomerol 2019
wine_color: The color is a healthy dark ruby/purple.
desc_en_short: This medium-bodied wine is filled with black cherries and cocoa raspberry with soft, easy-to-like textures and an oaky finish.

name: Chateau Canon  2007
wine_color: The color is a healthy dark ruby/purple.
desc_en_short: The strongest effort from Canon since 1982 and before 2009, the 2007 (75% Merlot and 25% Cabernet Franc) exhibits a dark ruby/purple color along with a beautiful bouquet of crushed rocks, boysenberries, blueberries, black raspberries, and licorice. The soft tannins, classic feel and texture, and medium to full-bodied, lengthy finish with no hard edges make for an enjoyable, potentially complex wine to drink over the next 15 years.

name: Chateau Canon  2019
wine_color: The color is a healthy dark ruby/purple.
desc_en_short: Barely opened, it escapes from the bottle like a sweet summer scent... Ripe and expressive, bursting with life, the wine plunges into the glass in which bright notes of red fruit, lush strawberries and raspberries, spin around each other. A few more swirls of the glass and the fruit intensifies even further, allowing aromas of morello cherry burst forth. There is this constant sensation of sapidity, so smooth and tasty. The wine palpitates. Intense and sappy, throughout the tasting it preserves this juicy character which is characteristic of the vintage. It speaks to us of the mastery achieved in a year that was nevertheless hot and dry. It brings movement over the palate and invigorates the body. This is a generous yet precise Canon, which combines consistency with fluidity.

name: Chateau Figeac  2018
desc_en_short: 100 points Wine Enthusiast - "With its rich swathe of Cabernet Sauvignon, this wine has density and immense structure balanced by stunning black fruits that give impressive promise. This powerful wine is probably the greatest ever produced from this estate. Drink from 2027. "

name: Chateau Pontet-Canet  AOC Pauillac 2011
desc_en_short: 96 points in Wine Enthusiast - "So smooth, this is a rich, grandiose wine. Although it is full of black currant fruits and spice flavors, the texture is most impressive. Dusty tannins are integrated with juicy fruits seamlessly. The purest fruit flavors are allied to linear tannins in a precise yet generous way. The wine is evolving beautifully, but do not drink before 2020. "

name: Chateau Quinault L' Enclos  2009
desc_en_short: Château Quinault L'Enclos 2009 is a deeply expressive Saint-Émilion delivering intense black fruit aromas laced with floral and mineral nuances, supported by a lively palate of ample, well-integrated tannins and a refreshingly fruit-driven finish.

name: Chateau Rol Valentin  2010
desc_en_short: Rounded and ripe, with dark blackberry and boysenberry flavors melded with ganache, melted black licorice and Black Forest cake. Lush, but with a lovely smoldering charcoal hint to keep this honest on the finish. Best from 2014 through 2025.

name: Chateau Haut-Beausejour
wine_color: A deep color and harmonious composition.
desc_en_short: Born from the union of two historic Médoc estates under the stewardship of Champagne Louis Roederer's Jean-Claude Rouzaud, Château Haut-Beauséjour is a compelling Saint-Estèphe Cru Bourgeois — structured, dark-fruited, and unmistakably expressive of its prestigious appellation.

name: Chateau Lafon-Rochet  2016
style: Merlot, 67% Cabernet Sauvignon, 2% Petit Verdot And 6% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Dark ruby-red. Deep, pure, perfumed aromas of black fruits, cured tobacco and black tea. Brawny and a bit chunky on the palate with a minty quality to the black fruit and flint flavors. Finishes with big, chewy tannins and a persistent note of cassis. Shows a creamy texture and plenty of palate weight but seems a little unrefined presently.

name: Chateau Montrose  2008
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Château Montrose 2008 is a commanding Saint-Estèphe Grand Cru Classé, built on a backbone of Cabernet Sauvignon with seamless tannins, dark fruit depth, and a finish of remarkable precision — a benchmark vintage for one of Bordeaux's most storied estates.

name: Chateau Bolaire  (Bordeaux Superieur)
style: Petit Verdot, 35% Merlot And 25% Cabernet Sauvignon.
desc_en_short: This medium bodied wine offers a lot of freshness, spice and cassis ending with hints of pepper and slightly green tints in the finish.

name: Chateau D'Arche
style: Cabernet Sauvignon 45%, Merlot 40%, Cabernet Franc 5%, Petit Verdot 5%, Carmenère 5%
desc_en_short: On the red ruby of good intensity with shades ranging from black to purple in the glass edge. Elegant, noble and complex, with great finesse with aromas of red berries. Charming, both flexible and strong. A wine with a long and intense final and that delights the taste.

name: Chateau Feret Lambert  (Bordeaux Superieur)
desc_en_short: Earth, licorice and Christmas fruitcake as well as a lush texture make for a very appealing and charming generic Bordeaux. There is slightly more structure here than most of the wines from this humble appellation possess, but that is a sign that it is probably capable of lasting more than 1-3 years. This is more proof that Bordeaux can still offer tremendous value.

name: Domaine Du Pegau  Chateauneuf du Pape Reserve
desc_en_short: Domaine du Pégau's Cuvée Réservée is a benchmark Châteauneuf-du-Pape, blending old-vine Grenache with Syrah and Mourvèdre into a wine of impressive depth and elegance — layered with wild herb, dark cherry, and spice on a silky, full-bodied frame.

name: Domaine Du Pegau  Chateauneuf du Pape Laurence
wine_color: Garnet color with brick-red glints in the glass.
desc_en_short: The Cuvee Laurence opens to garnet color with brick-red glints in the glass. On the nose, scents of garrigue, moving after several years of aging with aromas of stone fruits (plums), leather, fur and underbush. The development provides complex and spicier notes on the palate.

name: Domaine Du Pegau  Chateauneuf du Pape da Capo 2016
wine_color: The color is a healthy dark ruby/purple.
brand: Domaine Du Pegau  Chateauneuf du Pape da Capo
desc_en_short: 99 points in The Wine Advocate. As impressive as the Cuvée Réservée is, the 2016 Châteauneuf du Pape Cuvée da Capo brings an extra level of intensity. Turn that volume up to 11 or even 12. Waves of black cherries, plums and chocolate wash across the full-bodied, velvety palate, lingering nearly forever on the finish. As big and bold as it is, it remains breathtakingly elegant and fine. It should evolve gracefully through at least 2040.

name: Galardi Terra di Lavoro  Terra di Lavoro
desc_en_short: Galardi "Terra di Lavoro" is a wine of great structure and prestige achieved by the blend of Aglianico and Piedirosso, aged in new oak barrels for twelve months. The years from 1994 to date have seen a steady growth in the attention of experts and the public. In early enthusiastic ratings leading American expert, Robert Parker, Daniel Thomases, James Suckling and Stephen Tanzer, were added to those of the most authoritative international critics. In the national context they have attracted particular satisfaction the flattering recognition of Gambero Rosso, the Italian Sommelier Association, L'Espresso, Alessandro Masnaghetti and Luca Maroni. Up to Luigi Veronelli who has repeatedly ranked the Terra di Lavoro best Italian wine ever.

name: Montevetrano  Colli Di Salerno Rosso
desc_en_short: Deep ruby-red in color, aromas of blackberries and spices complement undertones of black currants, licorice, tobacco, earth, and leather. On the palate, Montevetrano is full-bodied, yet elegant with fine-grained tannins and a rich, silky texture. Pair this wine with roasted beef, demi glaces, black truffle ravioli, and beef Wellington.

name: Aristocratico  Valpolicella Ripasso DOC
desc_en_short: A rich, structured Valpolicella Ripasso DOC from the storied hills between Verona and Lake Garda, Aristocratico passes base Valpolicella over the dried Amarone grape skins to deliver layers of ripe red fruit, warming spice, and impressive depth at an accessible price.

name: Quintarelli Giuseppe  Amarone della Valpolicella Classico 2000
desc_en_short: Giuseppe Quintarelli's 2000 Amarone della Valpolicella Classico is a masterwork of restraint and depth — earning 96 points from James Suckling — weaving plum, lemon rind, and endless layers of silky fruit into one of the most refined expressions this legendary Valpolicella estate has ever produced.

name: Quintarelli Giuseppe  Amarone Selezione della Valpolicella Classico 2000
desc_en_short: 94 points in The Wine Advocate - "The 2000 Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Selezione Giuseppe Quintarelli is a selection that spent an additional two years in cask than the straight 2000 Amarone. Dusty red cherries, mint, crushed flowers and licorice are some of notes that are woven together in this delicate Amarone. The Giuseppe Quintarelli comes across as a touch forward, with slightly oxidative aromas and flavors from the extended time in barrel. As good as this is, in 2000 I prefer the straight Amarone. My sense is that the fruit will begin drying out here over the next few years.Anticipated maturity: 2012-2020."

name: Musella  Amarone della Valpolicella
desc_en_short: Cherry bark and spice blend in the typical pleasure of Valpolicella wines and find in Musella a sincere interpretation balance, which goes straight to the heart.

name: Tasca d'Almerita  Lamuri
desc_en_short: Intense ruby-red in color, Lamùri offers lush aromas of black cherry, black fruits, vanilla, tobacco, and wild herbs. On the palate, velvety tannins and refreshing acidity make for an elegant, expressive, crowd-pleasing wine.

name: Tasca D'Almerita  Rosso Del Conte
desc_en_short: Deep ruby-red in color, this wine offers enticing aromas of Marasca cherries and herbs with undertones of vanilla and tobacco. On the palate, silky tannins and a rich body culminate in a long, flavorful finish.

name: Te Mata  Estate Syrah Estatethorpe
style: Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon And 15% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short: Soft pale gold, Estate Vineyards Chardonnay  shows ripe citrus, clover honey and nectarines with incredible concentration, persistence and length. The purity and balance of its stonefruit palate is the signature of this wine.

name: Te Mata  Estate Merlot / Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Merlot, 40% Cabernet Sauvignon And 15% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short: Soft pale gold, Estate Vineyards Chardonnay  shows ripe citrus, clover honey and nectarines with incredible concentration, persistence and length. The purity and balance of its stonefruit palate is the signature of this wine.

name: Ata Rangi  Celebre
desc_en_short: The Nose is Toasty raspberry Syrah notes, plums and blackberry aromas, plenty of oak. On The Palate Delicious! With a strong core of fruit in contrast to a fine, medium tannin structure, medium+ acidity, plum, plum jam and black berry fruits.

name: Dry River  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: From early tastings immediately prior to bottling through to its en primeur release in 2010 this wine has shown a very positive and continuing evolution. The colour retains its vibrant ruby and purple lights that proceed right to its edges. The nose has a distinctive perfumed lift which is underpinned by softer longiflorum lily scents, musky spice, black olive and an earthy, forest floor character. A layered nose complements the palate and its flavour profile, which displays minerality, red and black fruits, black olive, dried sage and hints of aromatic spices. The wine has a long spreading palate that is lengthy and slightly textured with a viscosity that contributes to the overall suppleness and elegance of the wine. A wine with what I perceive to have a good long future ahead of it. I recommend re-evaluating its progress in 4 years.

name: Dry River  Syrah
desc_en_short: Library stock. Dark ruby-red, still youthful. This is elegant in presentation, but fully vibrant and lively with plenty of red berry, plum and peppery fruit, unfolding floral perfumes with savoury secondary elements emerging, along with nuances of earth and minerals. Fine and elegant, but with a sense of sinewy fruit, piquant acid liveliness and peppery, savoury, secondary fruit. Spicy black and red berries, earth and the beginnings of leather, yet rich in fruit sweetness, juxtaposed to brisk acidity and firm tannin line.

name: Tenuta dell'Ornellaia  Ornellaia 2010 "La Celebrazione" Bolgheri DOC Superiore
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 39% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc, 4% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short:
A celebratory logo, exclusively designed for Ornellaia 2010 and silkscreened in gold and ivory, gives a unique distinctiveness to each and every bottle of this vintage.

Winemaker's Notes

“The 2010 vintage was among the coolest and latest-ripening in recent years and yielded one of the most elegant expressions of Ornellaia. A deep ruby hue announces remarkable complexity on the nose, releasing heady fragrances of dark wild berry, pungent spice, and smooth pipe tobacco. The palate is finesse par excellence, with silky tannins and bright, clean-edged fruit, crowned with a finish boasting impressively racy tannins.”

Axel Heinz – May 2012

name: Le Macchiole  Paleo Rosso
desc_en_short: First produced in 1989, this incredible wine is the symbol of the winery, and it truly epitomizes Bolgheri. At first, the wine was a classic Bordeaux blend but became a Cabernet Franc monovarietal in 2001; since then, it has been a huge success. The name "paleo" refers to a wild herb found on the Tuscan coast, and it symbolizes a strong local identity and the will to reach all goals.

name: Poggio Di Sotto  Brunello Di Montalcino DOCG
wine_color: Ruby red tending to garnet red.
desc_en_short: Poggio di Sotto is one of Montalcino's most revered estates, producing a Brunello of rare elegance — 100% Sangiovese with luminous ruby depth, bright cherry, balsamic, and baking spice, framed by firm, age-worthy tannins that whisper of Burgundy rather than shout.

name: Castello Colle Massari  Grattamacco  Bolgheri Superiore DOC
desc_en_short: Grattamacco Bolgheri Superiore is one of Tuscany's iconic Super-Tuscan estates, blending Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Sangiovese from coastal hillside vineyards into a wine of striking complexity — layered with blackcurrant, cedar, wild strawberry, rosemary, and a silky, structured finish.

name: Grattamacco  Bolgheri Rosso DOC
style: Cabernet Sauvignon - 20% Cabernet Franc - 10% Merlot - 10% Sangiovese
desc_en_short: Piermario Meletti Cavallari has always been an enophile. He was very content in his wine store in Bergamo but knew that he had a further calling, so he set out to find a vineyard that he could make his own. When he saw Grattamacco he knew immediately that he had found the right place, so he settled in and began producing wine. The 1982 Grattamacco was Cavallari's debut, and his subsequent wines have built him a well-deserved reputation as one of Bolgheri's greatest producers. With the help of Claudio Tipa and consultant Maurizio Castelli, Cavallari is now consistently producing impressive Super Tuscans: his evocative Bolgheri Rosso is an opulent 50/50 blend of sangiovese and cabernet sauvignon. He also makes a Bolgheri Bianco, a crisp, clean wine made from vermentino. Grattamacco has managed to keep its prices down because it has remained less conspicuous than its neighbors Sassicaia, Ornellaia, and Antinori despite its outstanding wines.

name: Miguel Torres  Hemisferio Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A classic Chilean Cabernet Sauvignon from Miguel Torres, the Hemisferio delivers intense aromas of wild berries, spice, and liquorice with a backbone of supple fruit tannins and earthy leather notes — approachable, expressive, and built for the table.

name: Miguel Torres  Hemisferio Camenere
desc_en_short: Intense ruby colour. Aroma of red fruits with pleasing spicy notes. Elegant on the palate with sweet tannins that yield hints of toast and leather. Long and pleasant finish.

name: Miguel Torres  Tormenta Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Torres Tormenta Organic Cabernet Sauvignon is an intense ruby colour with the spicy, liquorice and blackcurrant aromas characteristic of the grape variety. In the mouth, the wine has a firm backbone with smooth, tightly-knit fruit and tannins and long elegant finish.

name: Miguel Torres  Tormenta Camenere
