desc_en_short: An IMO-certified organic Carménère from Miguel Torres Chile, Tormenta delivers classic dark-cherry depth with earthy, forest-floor complexity, rounded coffee and leather notes, and silky tannins — a textbook expression of this distinctly Chilean variety at an accessible everyday price.

name: Louis Max  Bourgogne Pinot Noir Beaucharme AOC
desc_en_short: A plump wine with a lot of fruit and a delicat note of wood. Good persistance, harmonious and well balanced. To serve with grilled or roasted red meats, poultry and cheese.

name: Louis Max  Gevrey Chambertin Les Azerottes AOC
desc_en_short: Full-bodied and powerful in the mouth, it has a very good structure and voluptuous tannins, with a very long finish. Goes well with all red meats, especially strong flavored meats like game, but can also be served with fishes in red sauce. Also pairs well with strong flavored soft cheeses.

name: Louis Max  Nuits Saint Georges Les Lievres AOC
wine_color: Beautiful ruby red robe, brilliant and clear.
desc_en_short: Louis Max's Nuits-Saint-Georges Les Lièvres is a beautifully balanced village-level Burgundy, offering silky tannins, red berry depth, and a lingering oaky vanilla finish — a textbook expression of Pinot Noir from the marl and limestone soils of the Côte de Nuits.

name: Louis Max  Vosne Romanee AOC
wine_color: Very elegant cherry-red hue, with violet tints
desc_en_short: On the nose, you can detect aromas of cherry and small red fruit, quite intense and very pleasant. An extremely delicate wine. On the palate, you will discover red fruit, fatness and silky tannins. The fine wines of Vosne Romanée can be cast in the role of showing to their advantage roasts, game meat with sauce, and fine cheeses.

name: Glenbrook  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The deep ruby red color with aromas of berries and cedar are the characteristics of this vintage varietal. It is a medium-bodied wine with just a hint of oak that is smooth, fruity and ready to drink.

name: Glenbrook  Merlot
desc_en_short: Our vintage Merlot is a beautiful deep ruby red color. This medium-bodied wine carries a cedar vanilla overlay to the ripe currant and plum flavors. The light tannins flow smooth, spicy and supple.

name: Dominus Estate  2009
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Cabernet Franc, And 4% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
The Dominus 2009 exemplifies the finest qualities of Cabernet Sauvignon from an ideal vintage. The nose, at once powerful yet restrained, is dense and filled with pure dark berry fruit and hints of sandalwood. On the palate is a harmonious blend of fresh plum and focused minerality with tannins that are firm, round and elegant. Spherical in quality, this wine is complete from start to finish. A sublime vintage.

The 2009 vintage is composed of 86% Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Cabernet Franc, and 4% Petit Verdot.

We recommend decanting the wine prior to serving, to allow it to develop its full potential. This is especially important when serving young Dominus wines.

name: Cornerstone  Merlot
desc_en_short: Complex and expressive nose of raspberries, plums and berries Excellent rich fruit flavours;full and long finish

name: Granducato  Chianti Docg
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red. Fruity with hints of blueberry and raspberry. Harmonious,fresh on the palate, with soft and round tannins

name: Mt Monster  Cabernet
desc_en_short: Deep purple in colour. Classic aromas of lifted blackcurrant, blackberry and mint on the nose. Flavours follow through of sweet berry- fruit accented by fresh muddled mint. Elegant, structured palate with big velvety tannins.

name: Mt Monster  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Ripe blackberry and plum fruits on the nose with floral notes. Varietal fruit-driven palate, with cherry/berry fruit and spice flavours. Soft tannins compliment the fruit with mouth-filling generous finish.

name: Jip Jip Rocks  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Jip Jip Rocks Shiraz from South Australia delivers a generous, supple mouthful of ripe plum, blackberry and mocha, lifted by spice, cedar and cinnamon aromas and framed by fine-grained, well-integrated oak tannins with a satisfying lingering finish.

name: Milton Park  Shiraz
desc_en_short: The nose is quite elegant showing cool climate like characters and plenty of Shiraz spiciness. The palate is medium weighted with rich confection like jubey  fruit

name: Terra Barossa  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Terra Barossa Cabemet Sauvignon has aromas of green bean, dried herbs, and dusty cedar like oak. The palate has a lively blackcurrant character on the front palate. This fruity character is balanced by spicy, chocolatey oak. The wine has varietal grainy tannins which are persistent well after the wine has left the mouth.

name: Terra Barossa  Shiraz
wine_color: Deep red with a purple hue on release.
desc_en_short: Lighter in style than usual, the wine offers aromas of sweet berry fruits, plums, pepper and spice. There is rich fruit on the palate displaying plums, blackberry and sweet spice from the subtle oak. Nice soft tannins are accompanied by great length of fruit flavour.

name: Radio Boca  Tempranillo
desc_en_short: Juicy and mouth-watering red wine with aromas of fleshy ripe purple plums and sweet blackberries. Full-bodied. Reminds me of Californian Zinfandel. Smooth and luscious. Great with meat lovers pizza.

name: Chateau Les Sapins Degaillou  Bordeaux
desc_en_short: Chateau Les Sapins de Gaillou has a beautiful deep red colour. The nose reveals red fruits notes. On the palate, this wine is supple and has a round structure, giving a pleasant and long finish.

name: Chateau Grand-Puy-Lacoste  2008
wine_color: dark and very intense, ruby colour
desc_en_short: The 2008 Grand-Puy-Lacoste presents an intense ruby red color. On the nose, it offers blackberries aromas dominated by the cassis. In the mouth, this wine has a great aromatic attack with a lot of texture and fruits. Its breed is evident in the splendid length of the finish. Its shows already great balance and style, but it will need time to age to express all its charm.

name: Kookaburra  Laughing Red Shiraz (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Kookaburra’s head Laughing red is a rich, dark purple wine with abundant flavours of blackburry, blueberry and boysenberry

name: Mar Y Sol  Selection C (Camenere) (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Fine aromas of red fruits and spices. This medium bodied wine is intense red and elegant and smooth on palate. The Carmenere, Chile Rsquo;s emblematic and exciting varietal, has a long finish and is best enjoyed between 16-18 degree Celsius

name: Mar Y Sol  Selection M (Merlot) (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Generous aromas of red berries with hints of chocolate On the palate this deliciously fruity wine is well-rounded with soft tannins A medium-bodied Merlot which is loved around the world for its velvety texture has a long finish and is best enjoyed between 16-18 degree celsius

name: Mar Y Sol  Chilean Red (4 L)
desc_en_short: Mar Y Sol's Chilean Carmenère-Merlot blend delivers easy-drinking charm in an impressive 4-litre format — think ripe red fruits, gentle spice, and a smooth, approachable palate that's perfectly suited for sharing around the table.

name: Mcguigan  Shortlist Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: McGuigan Shortlist Cabernet Sauvignon is a richly structured South Eastern Australian red bursting with blackcurrant, plum, and a signature wild mint freshness — layered with integrated oak for a complex, rewarding finish that suits the boldest cuts of beef.

name: Mcguigan  Shortlist Shiraz
desc_en_short: A rich perfume of savoury mulberry, plum and cherry aromas with hints of spicy cinnamon. Wonderful Shiraz flavours of plum, liquorice and pepper spice. A lovely integration of vanillin oak adds to the luscious mouth feel and enhances the long, fine finish

name: Tempus Two  Varietal Cabernet Merlot
desc_en_short: This well-balanced wine blends chocolate, tannin and cigar box characters of Cabernet Sauvignon with rich berry fruit flavours of Merlot.

name: Tempus Two  Varietal Shiraz
desc_en_short: Lifted spice, pepper, and cinnamon balanced with plum and blackberry richness. Hunter Valley style delivers more earthy and spicy characters than styles coming from the Barossa. A soft, full-bodied style with blackberry jam flavours

name: Duckhorn  Vineyards The Discussion Napa Valley
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc Cooperage
desc_en_short: Duckhorn Vineyards' The Discussion is a benchmark Napa Valley Bordeaux blend from six estate vineyards, weaving Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot into a beautifully structured wine of savory herbs, red fruit, and cedar-laced minerality aged 24 months in French oak.

name: Nickel & Nickel  C.C. Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon (Wine)
desc_en_short: This is a remarkable vintage for this vineyard. The C.C. Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon is elegantly perfumed with delicate floral notes mixed with ripe, red raspberries. These characteristics are reflected on the palate with flavors of raspberry and cherry, blended with a hint of licorice and signature Rutherford dust. Vanilla and toast from the French oak add warmth and flavor, while the wine’s lively acidity allows the flavors to linger on the palate. Soft and supple, yet generously rich, this wine is one that pops from start to finish.

name: Nickel & Nickel  State Ranch Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: From a 23-acre single vineyard in Yountville, this 100% Cabernet Sauvignon from Nickel & Nickel delivers rich layers of cassis, blackberry, and chocolate with a supple, mineral-driven finish — a benchmark expression of Napa Valley's single-vineyard philosophy.

name: Tempus Two  Pewter Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon of real authority, Tempus Two Pewter delivers concentrated cassis, plum, and liquorice lifted by spearmint and spice, with 15 months in French oak barriques shaping its fine, elegant tannin structure.

name: Tempus Two  Pewter Vine Vale Shiraz
desc_en_short: A wine with intense plum, pepper and cassis aromas combined with a rich, flavoursome palate with supple tannins.

name: Vina Maipo  Bi-Varietal Cabernet Sauvignon & Merlot
desc_en_short: Vina Maipo Bi-Varietal Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot offers intense ruby red, with violet hues. Candied fruits, especially red plums, with chocolate notes. Harmonic tannins, medium body and good aftertaste.

name: Vina Maipo  Bi-Varietal Syrah & Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Bright dark ruby red, with violet hues with fruit aromas, with nice intensity, combined with oak. Round, tasty and full-bodied wine, enjoy with all kind of meat and spicy food.

name: Vina Maipo  Vitral Reserva Syrah
wine_color: A bright dark ruby red wine
desc_en_short: It is a bright dark ruby red wine, and has attractive aromas of dark plums, blackberries, chocolate, and soft hints of vanilla. It is a rounded wine with soft tannins and a mouth-filling texture.

name: Vina Maipo  Vitral Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: 87 Points in The Wine Advocate Robert Parker. It is an intense dark ruby red wine, and has attractive aromas of red cherries and black with a touch of toasted oak. It is elegant and concentrated, with hints of chocolate and berry. It is also a full structured wine with a long nice finish.

name: Concha Y Toro  Gran Reserva Serie Riberas Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: From Concha y Toro's Gran Reserva Serie Riberas, this Rapel Valley Cabernet Sauvignon delivers a sinewy, structured palate of dark plum, morello cherry, and cassis, lifted by graphite, white pepper, and a finish touched with anise and black olive.

name: Concha Y Toro  Gran Reserva Serie Riberas Merlot
desc_en_short: There is a nice balance of earth and fruit qualities on the nose of this wine, with aromas like tree bark, plum, salami and blackberry.  It’s also nicely balanced on the palate, offering cherry, plum and chocolate flavors.  The acidity is outstanding and really makes this wine stand out.  That acidity is one of the traits often found in Maule Valley merlot.  The mouth feel is slightly astringent, but still nice.  It finishes with tangy cherry flavors.  There’s a nice old world quality to this wine, but it still has plenty of fruit for the new world fans.

name: Chateau Vendome  Prestige Rouge (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

An opulent Merlot with good tannin structure. Intense aromas of sweet dark fruits, such as blackberries, cassis and cherries. Ideal with Pasta Red Sauce, Beef, Lamb.

name: Chateau Malbec  AOC Cotes de Bordeaux
desc_en_short: A classic Côtes de Bordeaux red blending Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Malbec, delivering aromas of blackcurrant, plum, and red berries with harmonious oak, a light body, and silky concentration — versatile enough to enjoy solo or alongside a wide range of meat dishes.

name: Chateau du Bousquet  AOC Cotes de Bourg
style: Merlot, 30% Cabernet Sauvignon, And A Bit Of Malbec
desc_en_short: A characterful Côtes de Bourg red blending 65% Merlot with Cabernet Sauvignon and Malbec, Château du Bousquet delivers a full-bodied palate of black fruits and ripe cherry, anchored by elegant, terroir-driven tannins and a beautifully balanced finish.

name: Chateau Ferrande Graves Rouge AOC
desc_en_short: Château Ferrande is a distinguished red. Its deep red colour hides aromas of dark fruit, liquorice, nuts, and a hint of cocoa. Initial elegance gives way to a full body, with soft tannins and notes of ripe fruit. The finish is lively with mentholated notes.

name: Chateau d'Arcins  AOC Haut-Medoc
desc_en_short: A magnificent deep color, almost black and an intense set of aromas, instantly establishing its pedigree. The attack is full and well-round, leading to a rich palate of black fruits flavours against a refreshing, elegant minerality. An excellent tannic structure, indicating good ageing potential. A good match for country pates, lamb, duck, good cuts of beef, game, dishes served in sauce and mature cheeses.

name: Chateau Latour Camblanes  AOC Cotes de Bordeaux
desc_en_short: An attractive deep red colour. The nose is elegant and refined, while the palate is also elegant and well-rounded, backed up by luscious, molten tannins. Subtle flavours of oak provide good balance. The finish is long and elegant. Superb served with charcuterie, poultry, caramelised pork, grilled meats, spicy dishes and mature cheeses.

name: Mazzacorana  Cabernet Sauvignon Trentino DOC
desc_en_short: A ruby red wine with an intense bouquet, it distinguishes itself in its pleasant structure and elegant tannins. Served with red meats, roasts, game and mature cheeses.

name: Mazzacorana  Pinot Nero Trentino DOC
desc_en_short: A delicately complex wine with an intense fragrance, it is dry with a pleasant slightly bitter after taste. Ideal to serve with cold meats, tasty first courses, red and white roast meats.

name: Braida  Bricco dell'Uccellone 2012
wine_color: Intense ruby red with purple hues.
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red with purple hues. Notes of red berries, mint and vanilla. The bouquet is rich, aromatic and complex with a remarkable intensity and multilayered concentration. The wine is generous, voluptuous and full-bodied with a multidimensional structure, perfectly balanced between the grape characteristics and high quality oak, with a persistent long finish. Heavy meat dishes, roasts, also seasoned meat dishes and aged cheeses.

name: Braida  Bricco dell'Uccellone (1.5 L)
wine_color: Intense ruby red with purple hues.
desc_en_short: Braida's iconic Bricco dell'Uccellone is the wine that put Barbera on the fine-wine map — a magnum of intense ruby depth, layering wild red berries, mint, and vanilla over a voluptuous, oak-kissed frame with extraordinary concentration and a long, lingering finish.

name: Braida  IL Baciale Monferrato Rosso Doc
wine_color: Intense ruby red with purple hues.
style: Barbera, 20% Pinot Nero, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon E 10% Merlot.
desc_en_short: A signature Braida blend of Barbera, Pinot Nero, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot from Monferrato, Il Baciale delivers warm plum richness, black pepper spice, and a lingering cinnamon finish — elegant, generous, and unmistakably Piedmontese in character.

name: Braida  IL Baciale Monferrato Rosso Doc (1.5 L)
wine_color: Intense ruby red with purple hues.
style: Barbera, 20% Pinot Nero, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon E 10% Merlot.
desc_en_short: Il Baciale is Braida's signature Monferrato Rosso, blending Barbera's vivid fruit and acidity with the structure of Pinot Nero, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot — a rich, warming red with plum, black pepper, and cinnamon on a pleasingly persistent finish.

name: Braida  Barbera Montebruna
desc_en_short: Braida's Montebruna is a benchmark Barbera d'Asti, delivering a vibrant violet-ruby colour, lush full-bodied richness, and signature high acidity balanced by ripe fruit — an everyday Piedmontese classic that drinks beautifully with hearty Italian fare.

name: Winzer Krems  Bluer Zweigelt
desc_en_short: Dark rubyred with violett rims, well-defined, fruity, juvenile red wine with a beautiful cherry fruit and a bit of sour cherry and red currant. Smooth tannins, velvety structure, stays long on the palate, has a considerable potential.

name: Hay Maker  Merlot
desc_en_short: Plum and cherries, mocha spice and a touch of mint. The red fruit flavours continue on the palate. Medium bodied with well structured tannins.

name: Mudhouse  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Deep red fruit notes with a hint of spice. Generous flavours of cherry and currant combine with subtle oak. The silky dry tannins lead to a generous fruitful finish.

name: Chakana  Malbec
desc_en_short: Its aroma is fresh red with violet hints. In the palate, Malbec has ripe plum and red berries and spice, very intense. Perfect drink with Grilled meats, duck, and goat.

name: Arrigoni  Rigoletto Montepulciano D'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: The wine has a deep red color, soft and smooth on the palate. Pairing with pasta meat sauce, grilled red meats and baked red meats.

name: Arrigoni  IL Tosco Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: The wine has typical ruby red colour, at first winy, then with typical grassy, intense and persistent notes. Dry, warm, full-bodied, pleasurably tannic and harmonic. Good combination with roasted meat, mature cheese and savoury and tasty dishes.

name: Arrigoni  Nabucco Chianti DOCG
desc_en_short: The wine has ruby red color. Striking fragrance of raspberry and sweet-smelling violet. Great with grilled meat, roasts and Tuscan pecorino cheese.

name: Arrigoni  Il Barbiere Vino Rosso d'Italia
desc_en_short: Typical ruby red colour, at first winy, then with typical grassy, intense and persistent notes. Dry, warm, full-bodied, pleasurably tannic and harmonic. Good combination with roasted meat, mature cheese and savoury and tasty dishes.

name: Trappolini  Raggio di Sole Rosso Lazio IGT
desc_en_short: A rich, fruit-driven red from Trappolini in Lazio, blending Merlot and Sangiovese into a smooth, full-bodied wine bursting with wild berries, ripe cherry, and mature blueberry — elegant, rounded, and built for the Italian table.

name: Tenuta San Guido  Guidalberto 2020
desc_en_short: A full-bodied wine of intense red fruit flavor and and elegantly supple texture supported by ripe, silky tannins. The Merlot in the blend is expressed in sweet black fruit with overall aromas of ripe, concentrated berries offset by restrained spicy oak notes.

name: Bodegas Valduero  Crianza
desc_en_short: Bodegas Valduero's Ribera del Duero Crianza is a Gold Medal-winning, 100% Tempranillo aged 15 months in oak and a further year in bottle — a wine of genuine depth, dark fruit complexity, and balsamic spice that punches well above its Crianza classification.

name: Bodegas Valduero  Una Cepa
desc_en_short: Dark cherry red. A great complexity and extraordinary intensity of aromas. Aromas of fruit and oak combine, showing notes of mature, red fruit, leather and vanilla. Very well structured and balanced, the integration of alcohol and acidity is excellent and the retronasal finish is very different to the classic Valduero style. This is due to the grapes.

name: bodegas Valduero  Reserva
wine_color: Aromas on the nose show notes of coffee, tobacco and oak.
desc_en_short: The deep, bright purple colour is overwhelming. Aromas on the nose show notes of coffee, tobacco and oak. On the palate, it is rich and full with seriously powerful tannins. A loyal reflection of our vineyard’s own “terroir”. The ideal serving temperature should be between 17ºC and 19ºC. Its flavours suit well all types of game, the famous roast baby lamb and cured cheeses.

name: bodegas Valduero  Gran Reserva
desc_en_short:
Vinification

This wine is only made in exceptional vintages and with a very limited production that is never greater than 10.000 bottles. A surprising profusion of aromas and flavours, due to the very particular selection of grapes from our oldest vines, all over 70 years old. A meticulous picking by hand allows us to maintain the grapes in perfect condition and retain all their primary aromas. 48 months of ageing in barrels of 6 different types of oak, added to the silence and peace of our cellar with its natural conditions of humidity and temperature, end up tracing the singular character of this Gran Reserva.

name: Antica Napa valley  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Its deep purple color is followed by inviting aromas of blackberries, red currants, cassis and chocolate. On the palate the wine is rich, savory and full bodied finishing with firm, silky tannins and a long persistence.

name: Southern Land  Mclaren Vale Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A richly structured McLaren Vale Cabernet Sauvignon from Southern Land, offering lifted aromas of blackberry, mulberry, and mint alongside a palate of ripe red berry fruits, fine tannins, and beautifully integrated oak — a classic Australian red with excellent balance and style.

name: Southern Land  Mclaren Vale Shiraz
desc_en_short: Dark red tingers of purple. The aroma displays lifted fresh berry fruits including blackberry, rasberry and mulberries with hints of spice. The palate displays red berry fruits and fine, tannins which provide a structured wine. with generous fruits characters. Balanced by integrated oak and which come together to produce a wine with great balance and style.

name: Harvest Mile  Dry Red (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

These leading Australian winemakers have produce a drink with find luscious blackberry and licorice flavours and a long smooth finish.

name: Sol De Chile  Merlot (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

From Chilean multiple award winning Maule Valley De Aguirre family winery, an easy drinking fruit forward red. Light enough to enjoy with grilled sh or fowl yet with enough backbone to complement burgers or ne cuts of beef. Black cherry and a hint of mint from a blend of cabernet, merlot and carmenere plus a dash of blackberry make this a refreshing value-for- money palate pleaser. Serve slightly chilled.

name: Laughing Sun  Emotion Red (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

A fruit wine blended with Shiraz and rich mulberries. A sensory delight with great depthof colour, and a hint of blackcurrant on the nose. Velvety, ripe and full-bodied on the palate with a juicy fruit finish.

name: Xanadu  DJL Shiraz
desc_en_short: A full-bodied, yet restrained Shiraz offering ample depth with plenty of inky ripe forest fruits; blackberries, redcurrants and spice. The ripe fruit, fine tannins and savoury elements combine to produce a generous wine with a solid structure and a wonderful persistence of fruit.

name: Xanadu  DJL Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Full bodied and generous the palate is packed full of brambly berry fruits and cassis characters, with underlying mocha and savoury notes. The lovely dense fruit is supported by supple tannins, bright acidity and a warm, lingering finish.

name: One Glass  Cabernet Sauvignon IGT (100 ml)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 24 Bottles.

Oneglass is the creation of Advertime a Verona based Italian communications agency. It is a labour of love for those who want to drink a single serving of wine without compromising on quality whilst staying ahead of the crowd. Oneglass is safe, The polylaminate packaging is safe and ensures the characteristics of the wine.

name: Chateau La Lagune  3em Cru Classe 2008
wine_color: The color is a healthy dark ruby.
desc_en_short: The hedonistic, rich, opulent, velvet-textured 1989 displays a moderately dark ruby color, a big, intense bouquet of ripe plums and prunes, a richly concentrated, oaky fruitiness, medium to full body, plenty of glycerine, and soft tannins. This sensual, alluring wine will drink well for the next 10-15 years.

name: Monteverro  Tinata IGT
wine_color: Deep dark black cherry with hints of purple on the rim.
desc_en_short:
92 Points in James Suckling - "Plenty of dried berries, cherries and hints of lemon rind aromas and flavors. Full to medium body, firm tannins and a bright finish. Beautiful Rhone blend as always. Drink or hold."

91 Points in Wine Spectator - "A meaty version, with plum, blackberry, leather and licorice aromas and flavors. Hints of black pepper enter the fray, while the aftertaste remains long, showing good grip. Syrah and Grenache."

91 Points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2012 Tinata is 70% Syrah and 30% Grenache. This wine pushes the boundaries and is almost too much of a good thing. Its hugely rich and extracted style will not appeal to everyone. Dark fruit, pressed blackberry, prune and dried plums characterize the wine's opulent bouquet. Beyond those fruity tones are heavy notes of spice, tar and tobacco. I'd suggest giving this wine another year or two."

name: Palliser  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Deep red in color. A rich and dense nose displaying dark cherry, spice and subtle mushroom characters. Ripe intense red and dark berry fruit aromas and subtle spicy oak. The taste is of concentrated ripe red fruits and fine grained tannins. The tannins give texture and persistence while the berry flavors linger. It's succulent and beautifully textured on the palate with lovely mid palate weight and fine, supple tannins. It's youthful and well flavored with a lingering delicious finish. A stylish Pinot that's sure to mature gracefully.

name: Caliterra  Carmenere Tributo (Gran Reserva)
desc_en_short: Deep purplish-reddish in colour, Tributo Carmenere exhibits great intensity on the nose. It opens with aromas of black fruits complemented by a soft hint of black pepper, clove, roasted red pepper and tarragon. The palate features very delicate with smooth tannins, along with vibrant acidity and remarkable volume, all of which foretell good aging potential.

name: Tenute Silvio Nardi  Brunello di Montalcino DOCG
wine_color: Intense ruby red colour with garnet highlights.
desc_en_short: 94 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "Beautifully polished and bright, the Tenute Silvio Nardi 2015 Brunello di Montalcino offers a textbook rendition from this slightly warm vintage. The wine sketches out classic lines with a generous and full array of Sangiovese aromas. These range from wild fruit and dried cherry to tilled earth, cola and balsam herb. There's a pretty note of blue flower or lilac as well for added elegance. The finish is smooth with integrated tannins and balanced acidity. All the elements work harmoniously here and would be nicely accentuated by a spezzatino di maiale, or pork shoulder slow-cooked with tomato, shallots, red wine and peas."

name: Tenute Silvio Nardi  Rosso di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short: An approachable and young wine that expresses the tipicity of Sangiovese from Montalcino. A brilliant red for an easy Italian way of life. Fresh, pure and clean on the palate with a pleasant fruitiness.

name: Tenute Silvio Nardi  Turan Sant'Antimo DOC
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red colour. Clean, intense and complex aroma, rich in spicy overtones, which accompany a floral note enriched with ripe red fruit. Mellow first entry on the palate followed by a confident structure supported by the right level of acidity and the strong presence of supple, mild and enveloping tannins with a few hints of youthfulness. Well-balanced, easy-drinking wine. Possible wine to lay down.

name: Mastroberardino  Villa dei Misteri 2002
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: The Villa dei Misteri project was born in 1996 when the Archaeological Superintendence of Pompeii invited Mastroberardino to reintroduce viticulture in the ancient town of Pompeii. The archaeological excavations, the botanical studies and the research on casts of vine roots and their supporting stakes (“captured” for ever by the great eruption of AD 79) confirmed that vines were grown within Ancient Pompeii’s city walls in the gardens around the beautiful Roman villas.

name: Chateau Calon Segur  3eme Cru Classe 2019
desc_en_short: The vintage 2019 was born under favorable auspices. The dry and warm summer conditions remind us of the Great Vintage 2018. The hydric pressure allowed us to reach remarkable levels of maturity on each one of our varieties. With an exceptional sanitary state, the merlots were collected from September 24thto 28th and the entirety of Cabernets, Sauvignon and Franc as well as the Petit Verdot between September 30th and October 9th.This vintage offers once more a complex aromatic palette, floral and fruity, with a freshness going along with silky, refined and elegant tannins. A new vintage at competition with 2016 and 2018…

name: Chateau Cos D'Estournel  2eme Cru Classe 1985
desc_en_short: 93 points in The Wine Advocate - "The 1985 from cask could have been a lighter version of the 1982 and 1953 vintages. Forward, with a fabulously scented bouquet of pain grille and concentrated red and black fruits (especially black cherries), it is rich, lush, long, and medium to full-bodied. Very fragrant, with gobs of sweet black fruits, minerals, and spice in both its flavors and aromatics, this is one of the most forward wines from Cos."

name: Chateau Ausone 1er Grand Cru Classe A 2004
desc_en_short: "One of the vintage’s most compelling wines (what’s new about that?), Alain Vauthier’s beloved 2004 Ausone has closed down considerably since I tasted it out of barrel, but it remains among the most concentrated wines of the vintage. Furthermore, along with Petrus, it will probably be the longest-lived. A dense purple color is accompanied by a celestial perfume of blue and black fruits, wet stones, flowers, and incense. On the palate, the wine exhibits exceptional power and concentration, but this historic terroir has also provided a surreal lightness to the wine’s impression. Beautiful flavors, sensational depth, and abundant structure suggest this 2004 will not be close to full maturity for 8-10 years. It should last for four decades."

name: Château Croizet-Bages 2020
desc_en_short: Château Croizet-Bages 2020 is a classic Fifth Growth Pauillac from the celebrated Bages plateau, delivering a fruit-forward, polished Cabernet-led blend with the depth and structure that makes this historic Quié family estate a reliable and rewarding address in the Médoc.

name: Chateau Grand Puy Lacoste  5eme Cru Classe 1990
desc_en_short: "Along with the 1982, 2000, and 2005, the 1990 is one of those monumental Grand Puy Lacostes that you can’t have enough of. Still inky/blue/purple-colored to the rim, it boasts a gorgeously sweet, pure nose of creme de cassis, spring flowers, and a hint of wet rocks. The wine is full-bodied, plush, and expansive with impressive levels of glycerin and purity as well as an endearing texture. This 1990 is evolving at a glacial pace, but the sweetness of the tannins and low acidity ensure a delicious treat whenever a bottle is opened. It should evolve for another 20-25 years."

name: Chateau Lafleur  Pomerol 1997
desc_en_short: Château Lafleur is one of Pomerol's most cerebral and sought-after wines — a tiny-production, Cabernet Franc-dominant masterpiece from the Guinaudeau family, combining extraordinary depth and intensity with a restrained elegance that sets it apart from every other right bank estate.

name: Chateau Olivier  Grand Cru Classe 1995
style: De Cabernet Sauvignon, 45% Merlot,10% De Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: The fine, fresh nose is reminiscent of liquorice and cocoa. A supple attack on the palate, followed by a dense mid-palate and ripe fruit. Elegant throughout with a rich, generous structure.

name: Innovate  Shiraz Cabernet
desc_en_short: This Shiraz Cabernet is a deep crimson in color. A dynamic aroma of rich dark cherry and liquorice mixed with soft blackcurrant notes. A medium-bodies palate is displayed with dark cherry and complemented by soft blackcurrant flavourings for a soft and velvety finish.

name: Innovate  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This Cabernet Sauvignon is a beautiful bright red color. The wine is fragrant and displays an intense aroma of cherry and blackberry. The palate shows fruit flavours of dark berries, cherry and black currant. A juicy and soft finish wine of a mid-weight.

name: Innovate  Shiraz
wine_color: This Shiraz is a vibrant red colour with violet notes.
desc_en_short: Innovate Shiraz from South Eastern Australia delivers a fruit-forward burst of cherry, blackberry, and blueberry laced with liquorice and fresh spice, finishing soft and juicy — an easy-drinking, crowd-pleasing red built for everyday enjoyment.

name: Infinitum  Shiraz
wine_color: This Shiraz is deep red in colour with violet notes.
desc_en_short:
This Shiraz is deep red in colour with violet notes. The wine shows ripe red berries and sophisticated French oak vanillin. The wine is soft, full of flavour and complexity. Cherry and strawberry fruit is carried through the palate, followed by smooth tannin, providing
excellent balance and length.

name: Infinitum  Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: This Cabernet Sauvignon is a beautiful crimson red colour.
desc_en_short: This Cabernet Sauvignon is a beautiful crimson red colour. The wine displays an intense aroma of black currant and plum, complemented by fresh spices, derived from oak maturation. The palate shows fruit flavours of dark berries, plum and black currant, supported by subtle cedar oak. Ripe fruit flavour persists with a long, soft finish.

name: Chateau des Perligues
desc_en_short: This is an immediately attractive wine. Merlot is the Main grapes with a little beat Of Cabernet It has a ripe, juicy character, balanced by firm, dry tannins. Graves always got this feminine, soft and elegant Wines that are enjoyable young. I would suggest this with Grilled Salmon or Poultry Roasted

name: Chateau Du Pavillon
wine_color: Deep red colour robe with purple.
desc_en_short: The deep red colour robe with purple reflections reveals a full-bodied wine. Very well-balanced, it has aromas of ripe red fruits, a delicate hint of spice and a long finish. Serve at room temperature.

name: Sena  2012
wine_color: A dark ruby-red color with violet highlights.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Carmenere, 12% Malbec, 10% Merlot, 5% Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère, Malbec, Merlot, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Seña 2012 is a landmark Bordeaux-style blend from Chile's Aconcagua Valley, earning 99 points from James Suckling for its extraordinary fruit density, polished tannins, and rare balance of Chilean terroir expression with first-growth Bordeaux structure.

name: Sycamore Lane  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Sycamore Lane California Cabernet Sauvignon exhibits an enticing aroma of fresh red cherries and sweet oak vanilla with a hint of varietal herbal tones. The medium-bodied, juicy, cherry- like flavors are supported and enhanced by moderate tannins and a toasty wood character. This graceful, flavorful Cabernet Sauvignon can be enjoyed now and makes an enjoyable accompaniment to roast chicken, steaks, roasts, lamb, game and mildly seasoned pastas.

name: Sycamore Lane  Merlot
desc_en_short: Sycamore Lane Merlot displays fresh, cherry-like varietal aromas, with hints of tobacco and herbal spice. Medium-bodied, with a smooth texture and soft tannins, it boasts rich, lingering flavors of cherries and plums. Enjoy this fine wine as an excellent accompaniment to a wide range of foods, especially chicken, beef, lamb, game, and tomato-based pastas.

name: Buena Vista  The Count Founder's Red
style: Merlot, 25% Zinfandel, 12% Petite Sirah, 11% Syrah, 4.5% Petit Verdot, 3% Carignane, 2.5% Cinsault& 2% Valdiguie
desc_en_short: Our 2013 vintage of The Count - Founder’s Red Wine offers seductively teasing aromas of rich dark chocolate, nutmeg and a subtle hint of cinnamon. Dark fruit flavors swathe the palate of this nicely structured, well-balanced wine that culminates in a long, dense finish that sails on and on. This immediately enjoyable wine will continue to evolve in the bottle over the next two to three years. Try it alongside barbequed beef or country-style pork ribs.

name: Red Bank  Shiraz "The Long Paddock"
desc_en_short: A deep magenta colour with tinges of crimson with vibrant aromas of dark plum and fruits of the forest with savoury notes of tar and anise. The palate is fleshy and generous with dark berry fruit and spice flavours. Its sweet fruit appeal is complemented by fine-grained tannins and juicy finish. The dash of Sangiovese adds a distinct savoury edge to the final blend. Enjoy with a bowl of hearty Italian beef ragu. Suitable for vegans and vegetarians.

name: Red Bank  Shiraz "The Anvil" Beechworth
desc_en_short: Deep, black red colour. Aromas of concentrated blueberry and ripe plums with fine milk chocolate and spicy French oak. A finely tuned wine, with rich, silky texture and sweet, spicy, coffee mid-palate.

name: Chateau Tour du Mont  Haut-Medoc AOC
style: Cabernet Sauvignon Cabernet Franc Petit Verdot Merlot
desc_en_short: Château Tour du Mont is a classic Haut-Médoc expression blending Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot into a full-bodied red with ripe, generous fruit, peppery spice, smooth tannins, and a lingering vanilla finish that rewards the table.

name: Chateau La Taniere  Haut-Medoc AOC
desc_en_short: Wonderfully fruity flavors reminiscent of black currants and cherries. It tastes young and juicy, but acts thanks to its soft tannins simultaneously fine and elegant.

name: Chateau Tour Saint Vincent  Cru Bourgeois
wine_color: Dark red colour with violet hints.
desc_en_short: "A rich and smooth wine, this is packed with black fruits that are touched with smoky tannins from the wood aging. It’s full, fruity and structured on the palate. It will age over at least 5–6 years, but, with its rich texture, it will be drinkable soon."

name: Chateau de Tourteyron  Medoc Cru Bourgeois
wine_color: Dark red colour with violet hints.
desc_en_short: Rich, powerful and well rounded flavor with a perfect balance between fruit, spice and soft tannins.

name: Chateau Lafitte Marcellin  (Premieres Cotes de Bordeaux)
wine_color: Ruby red color with purple hues.
desc_en_short: Ruby red color with purple hues. Aromas of cassis and bergamot. Soft palate with a fruity attack revealing more assertive tannins on the finish. Enjoy it as an aperitif with a plate of cheese or charcuterie. It goes well with red meats, game.

name: Chateau Clairac  (Premieres Cotes de Blayes)
desc_en_short: A brilliant color dark red. It exudes a charming nose with aromas of red fruits, prunes and spices. In the mouth, we find this very fruity with notes of cherry and light oak. The tannins are fine and elegant and finish has a beautiful freshness.

name: Chateau Grand Meziere  (Cotes de Castillon)
style: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon And Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Its youth a dark red color with the aroma of ripe fruit, over the years, the character of wine, full-bodied bouquet, hints at a slightly spicy note. It goes perfectly with grilled steak, duck breast or duck confit, but also with poultry or lamb, of hard cheese.

name: Chateau Petrus  1982
desc_en_short: Château Pétrus 1982 is one of the most celebrated vintages ever produced from Pomerol's legendary blue-clay plateau — a near-mythical Merlot-dominant wine of extraordinary concentration, complexity, and age-worthy depth that defines the pinnacle of Bordeaux.

name: Finca La Celia  La Celia Heritage Malbec
wine_color: Visually presents a purple red color, with dense legs.
desc_en_short: Begins In the mouth the wine has sweet attack, firm structure, balanced tannins, alcohol and acidity. It has a persistent finish.

name: Chateau Mouton Rothschild  2004 (Premiers Crus)
wine_color: A strong, dark and deep colour.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon 69% Merlot 15% Cabernet Franc 13% Petit Verdot 3%
desc_en_short: The wine has a strong, dark and deep colour, while the nose displays subtle complexity on fruity notes of black cherry, candied quince and liquorice with touches of cold smoke, revealing very well-integrated oak. The attack is rich and full, with precise, refined tannins that elegantly enfold mocha flavours and toasted notes, leading into a close-knit and flavourful finish with attractive, very fresh length.

name: Chateau Haut-Brion  1er Grand Cru Classe 2007
desc_en_short:
Château Haut-Brion is a First Growth in the Bordeaux Wine Official Classification of 1855. It is located in Pessac, Graves just one mile (2 km) from the city of Bordeaux. The vineyard consists of 109 acres (441,000 m²) producing 12,000 to 15,000 cases of wine each year. Located in the Graves region, it was the only non-Médoc estate to be included in the 1855 classification.

The cultivation of the vineyard of the château Haut-Brion in the middle of town with jealous care, its ability to age more than its neighbours – up to about twenty years, or even more, the men working under the lead of Jean Delmas, the modern cuvier, the artisitcally lead winemaking…. All this contributes to the success of a domainn, producing the greatest red wines and rare white wines.
Average age of vines is 30 years.

Château Bahans Haut-Brion, although a second wine, has the same treatment throughout as Château Haut-Brion. Grown on the same land as Château Haut-Brion, Château Bahans Haut-Brion, profits from the same planting and harvest techniques, and has the advantage of the same rigorous selection and thoroughness in vinification as the "Grand Vin".

name: Viu Manent  Viu 1
desc_en_short: Viu 1 is made from the best Malbec grapes in Block 4 of Viu Manent's San Carlos vineyard located near Cunaco in the Colchagua Valley. This block was planted more than 100 years ago at a density of 4,464 plants per hectare. It yields a tiny crop of very concentrated Malbec indeed.

name: Viu Manent  El Incidente Carmenere
desc_en_short: Intense deep violet in color. The elegant nose is complex, with aromas of black fruits and very pronounced notes of black pepper. The palate stands out for its freshness and elegance

name: Viu Manent  Rayuela Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A deep, dark ruby-red in color, with a nose marked by elegant and intense aromas of red fruit, cassis, and berries, accompanied by subtle toasted notes. On the palate this wine is moderately concentrated, with tannins that are notable but ripe and well rounded at the same time. Presents a good balance of tannins, acidity, and oak that leads to a fresh and pleasing finish.

name: Auka  Malbec
desc_en_short: Deep red colour with a touch of violet. The nose offers intense aromas of fruits such as cherries and plums combined with vanilla, chocolate and coffee. Medium bodied, The finish is harmonic

name: Silverado Vineyards  Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley
desc_en_short: Plum, spice, earth, dried herb and sweet oak aromas. Medium body with well-integrated fruit, spice and oak flavors. Balanced acidity and tannin give a long finish with flavors that linger.

name: Silverado Vineyards  MT. George Vineyard Merlot "Napa Valley"
desc_en_short: Bright, ripe cherry aromas interlaced with dried and fresh herb notes. On the palate, medium to full body with spicy berry flavors. Balanced acidity and tannin lead to a long finish.

name: Angove  The Medhyk Shiraz
desc_en_short: Shiraz was carefully sourced from unique old vine vineyards across McLaren Vale’s diverse terroir. Vigilant monitoring and selection of only the best barrels ensures each bottle of The Medhyk exhibits complexity, richness and velvety length.

name: Angove  Family Crest Mclaren Vale Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Deep red with purple hues. Spice, pepper, red cherry and black chocolate aromas precede a palate of dark chocolate and liquorice, red cherry/raspberry with mouth-filling presence and soft lingering tannins.

James Halliday Australian Wine Companion 2015 - 92 Points

name: Angove  Vineyard Select Mclaren Vale Shiraz
desc_en_short: Deep inky purple. Morello cherries, bright raspberry and vanillin aromas come to the fore on the nose with the spice from deft oak use underlying the palate of ripe plums and blackberry.

name: Angove  Butterfly Ridge Shiraz Cabernet
wine_color: Vibrant red with some purple hues
desc_en_short: Vibrant red with some purple hues. Aromas of red berry fruit and plums with a hint of wood. On the palate the wine shows vibrant mouth-filling fruit with cherry and plum, good length, a touch of wood and a soft full finish.

name: Angove  Butterfly Ridge Merlot Cabernet
desc_en_short: Angove's Butterfly Ridge Merlot Cabernet from South Australia is an approachable, fruit-forward red offering juicy layers of black cherry, mulberry, and plum with a soft, full palate and satisfying length — perfect for everyday drinking and relaxed outdoor dining.

name: Angove  Studio Series Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Dark red in colour with some purple hues. Aromas of red berry integrate perfectly with red pepper notes with a gentle touch of oak. The rich mouth filling palate has flavours of berries and plums.

name: Chateau Branas Grand Poujeaux  Moulis
desc_en_short: Chateau Branas Grand Poujeaux is a blend of 50% Merlot, 45% Cabernet Sauvignon and the rest Petit Verdot. A big-time wine, opaque purple in color, with loads of cassis, smoke, incense and licorice as well as an earthiness reminiscent of a St.-Estephe, this wine is full-bodied and long, with sweet tannin and an overall classic constitution.

name: Chateau Andron-Blanquet  St.Estephe AOC
desc_en_short: Beautiful garnet colour. To the nose, the bouquet is very fruity, creamy with subtle notes of vanilla. The Palate is flashy, velvety with fine tannins. Flavourful persistant finish. This vintage develops the power of a Saint-Estephe while retaining finesse and elegance.

name: Zonin  "Ventiterre" Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
It is an extremely versatile Cabernet. In its youth, it can be appreciated as a full and generous wine to be drunk throughout a meal, especially when the menu contains highly savoury dishes, such as polenta or other maincourse preparations of rural tradition.

Pleasant bouquet, full and richly nuanced. Dry flavour and sturdy body that shows fine breeding. It has a balanced, full and persistent taste with a lightly grassy background.

name: Domaine Naturaliste  Discovery Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Domaine Naturaliste's Discovery Cabernet Sauvignon is a textbook expression of Margaret River at its most approachable — fragrant with cassis and red cherry, then smooth and generous on the palate with silky tannins and a finish of ripe plum and bright berry fruit.

name: Valle Reale  Montepulciano D'Abruzzo
desc_en_short: Bright ruby-red in color, this youthful red offers explosive aromas of blueberries, cherries, licorice, and sweet spices. On the palate, it is medium-bodied with plentiful acidity and a pleasant finish. This wine can be served before a meal, but it pairs well with meatballs, tomato sauces, eggplant parmigiana, and risotto ai funghi.

name: Valle Reale  Vigneto Sant'Eusanio Montepulciano D'Abruzzo
desc_en_short: Montepulciano d'Abruzzo Sant’Eusanio ripen, making it a unique wine. It is an uncompromising expression of the mountain Montepulciano and speaks a dynamic lingo of acidity and freshness, in sharp contrast to the dialectics of body and structure found in more traditional wines obtained with the same grapes cultivated in the coastal zone of the region.

name: Ottosoldi  Barbera del Monferrato DOC
desc_en_short: This is a classic barbera with ripe fruit, minerals and fresh mushrooms. Medium- to full-bodied, firm and racy. A wine with beautiful fruit and depth. The firmness bring you back.

name: Renieri  Brunello di Montalcino Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: Underbrush, spiced plum and French oak aromas drift out of the glass. On the taut palate, close-grained, compacted tannins give firm support to dried cherry, star anise and espresso. It closes on a note of powdered sage. Give the tannins a few more years to unclench then drink to capture the remaining fruit richness.

name: Joel Gott  California Zinfandel
desc_en_short: A richly fruited California Zinfandel from winemaking royalty Joel Gott, delivering brambleberry, plum, and spice with velvety tannins and a long, satisfying finish — classic Sunshine State character at a remarkable price.

name: Berton vineyards  Head over Heels Shiraz
desc_en_short: This Shiraz offers an abundance of expressive aromas, predominantly of blackberry and plums along with toasty sweet oak. A generous and concentrated palate offers flavours of blackberry, black cherry and plum. Complex oak characters of coffee, vanilla and caramel complement the full fruit flavours and create a long rich and satisfying finish. Perfectly matched with a cheese platter or creamy pasta dish.

name: Ca' Momi  Rosso di Napa Valley
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel, Merlot & Petite Syrah
desc_en_short: 88 Points-Wine Enthusiast and Silver Medal Winner of the 2016 San Francisco International Wine Competition!. This freestyle red blend rocks its own style without pretension or snobbishness. Aromas of ripe blueberries, subtle campfire smoke, and that blackberry patch down the road put summer vacation in your glass. Intense plum, blackberry pie, and toasty spice mingle on the palate, with moderate tannins providing structure through the finish.

name: Ca' Momi  Napa Valley Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Our Napa Valley Zinfandel holds traditional aromas of fleshy plums and black berry pie, while offering a lighter than typical body with food friendly structure.  This fruity burst of flavor transitions into a relaxed finish of soft spices. With savory and fruity flavors on the palate, our zinfandel has characteristics largely compatible with American and Italian food.  Pair with pork chops, mushroom risotto, or spaghetti & meatballs!

name: Chateau La Gravelle  Bordeaux Rouge
wine_color: Dark ruby red color with violets tints
desc_en_short: Dark ruby red color with violets tints, the wine releases an elegant bouquet of strawberry, rapsberry and cherry blossom. On the palate, it is smooth and round, showing a certain complexity of fruit and spices - over a long and persistent finish.

name: Speri  Amarone Valpolicella Classico Vigneto Monte Sant' Urbano DOCG
desc_en_short: Undisputedly symbolic of the Speri company, the Amarone Monte Sant’Urbano is a superb example of a fine, classic wine. It is an extraordinary wine with great complexity and a vigorous structure which has always been top for its elegance and quality. After carefully selecting the best bunches from the prestigious Monte Sant’Urbano vineyard, the grapes are left to dry for a long period (3-4 months depending on the vintage year). This creates a wine with plenty of structure and softness which will certainly age well.

name: Delas  Domaine des Grands Chemins Crozes-Hermitage
wine_color: The color is deep, garnet color with violet hues.
desc_en_short: 92 Point By Robert Parker "Delightful red and black cherry fruit bounces through, flecked with anise details and a light black tea hint. A fine chalky edge guides the finish while the fruit plays out. Drink now through 2022."

name: Danzante  Chianti DOCG
desc_en_short: Deep ruby colour. The aroma is intense with elegant floral notes, particularly sweet violets, followed by fruity fragrances of dried plum and dark cherry. Concludes with spicy nuances of roasted espresso bean, notes of vanilla, and black liquorice. The palate shows excellent structure and balance with delicate, soft tannins. The finish is long, with an aftertaste of wild berries

name: Terrazas  Altos Del Plata Malbec
desc_en_short: Young, vibrant and balanced, this deep red wine with purplish shades boasts ripe red fruits such as raspberry, blackberry and plum. A fresh floral profile of lavender and spicy peppery notes testify as to the wild aspect of the variety. A very expressive and pleasant wine.

name: Cape Mentelle  Marmaduke Shiraz
desc_en_short: Cape Mentelle's Marmaduke Shiraz is a fruit-forward, crowd-pleasing red from Margaret River's acclaimed Crossroads vineyard, delivering generous ripe berry, cracked pepper, and warm spice in an approachable, generously textured style.

name: Slent  Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
desc_en_short: Ruby red in colour. Raspberry, plum and smoky oak and earthy aromas. Medium to full bodied, dry; black berry and sweet oak flavours with notable tannins and a touch of spice to finish. Serve with grilled steak and sautéed mushrooms, grilled tuna, liver and onions

name: Chateau Latour  2008
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: 96 points in The Wine Advocate - "Very deep garnet-purple colored, the 2008 Latour has a youthfully subdued nose revealing notes of red plums and mulberries with underlying suggestions of damp earth, iron ore, pencil lead and dried Provencal herbs. The palate is superbly structured with firm, tight-knit grainy tannins and crisp acid supporting the muscular fruit, finishing long and savory."

name: Chateau Margaux  1er Cru Classe 1998
desc_en_short:
It’s difficult to summarise in a few lines, the long and passionate history of the estate, it could be entitled “Once upon a time Château Margaux”. 

Known since the XII century, it was called “La Mothe de Margaux” (the Margaux mound) and, at that time, it didn’t have any vines. The old name didn’t happen by chance; in a flat region like the Médoc, the slightest “mound” was easily distinguished and the greatest wines are always produced on sloping land that ensures good drainage. 

In 1152, Aquitaine fell to the advance of England until 1453 and so Bordeaux wines benefited Made from this new market. Bordeaux “claret” was adopted as a table wine by Richard the Lion Heart, King of England in the XII century. 

The successive owners of “La Mothe de Margaux” were, of course, important lords but we had to wait for the arrival of the Lestonnac family to set up the estate as we know it today. Pierre de Lestonnac succeeded, in the ten years Made from 1572 to 1582, in completely restructuring the property as well as the vineyard and anticipated the general evolution of the Médoc that had started to abandon cereal growing in favour of vines. 

At the end of the XVII century, Château Margaux occupied 265 hectares, land that wouldn’t be divided again. A third of the estate was dedicated to vines, which is still the case today. 

England and Holland drank “claret”, a pale wine that didn’t age well. Château Margaux became the epitome for the art of wine-making and the hierarchy between the different Bordeaux growths was already being drawn up. 

Château Margaux was born.

name: Chateau Mouton Rothschild  1996 (Premiers Crus)
wine_color: Deeply coloured, the wine is an attractive purple-red.
desc_en_short: Château Mouton Rothschild 1996 is a monumental Pauillac Premier Cru Classé, offering an opulent core of black cherry, blackberry, cedarwood, and fresh mint, underpinned by silky, refined tannins and a depth of flavour that rewards decades of patient cellaring.

name: Kendall Jackson  Avant Red Blend
style: Merlot, 22% Syrah, 9%cabernet Sauvignon, 9%malbec, 7% Petite Sirah, 3% Carignan And Other
desc_en_short: The Kendall-Jackson Avant Red has a distinctive flavor profile with rich, silky and smooth textures. It has a fruit-forward taste with enticing aromas of ripe raspberry and bold black cherry, complemented by hints of spice and dark chocolate to deliver a smooth, lingering finish.

name: Duckhorn  Napa Valley 'Three Palms Vineyard' Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Merlot; Cooperage: 100% French Oak, 80% New Oak, 20% Neutral
desc_en_short: A rare expression of Three Palms Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon, this Duckhorn Napa Valley showpiece delivers layered aromas of marionberry, garam masala, and flint alongside a rich, fleshy mid-palate of blackberry, dark chocolate, and wet stone — a thought-provoking tour de force from one of California's most iconic sites.

name: Alpha & Omega  "TWO" Napa Valley  Red Blended
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Petit Verdot, 18% Merlot, 4% Malbec, 3% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short: II is the culmination of the two worlds, the Alpha and the Omega, the Old World and the New World. Our two winemakers, Jean Hoefliger and Michel Rolland, worked to create a wine that is not only opulent, fruit-forward and generous, but also has the backbone of European acidity and elegance. A reflection of both worlds, II is a wine that is built to be approachable, both in taste and price, and consumed early.

name: Ferraris  Ruchè di Castagnole Monferrato "Classic" DOCG
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Ruchè Clasic is obtained from grapes coming from the best-exposed vineyards, which means the southwest side of the hills. Because a heavy pruning, these vineyards never produce more then seven tons per hectare. Fermentation is done in 54-hectoliter temperature-controlled French oak vats for 15 to 20 days, according to the quality of the grapes at the time of pressing. A controlled temperature of 23 degrees enables the fermentation time to be lengthened and to keep the must in contact with skins for longer. During this period, the skins give the must more structure, tannin and color. This is important, particularly for Ruchè, whose precise aromas are its main characteristic. Once fermentation is finished, the wine rests for six months in the same vats where malolactic fermentation also takes place, perfect containers because they allow the exchange of oxygen necessary for a quicker maturation of the wine and for developing more elegant scents without imparting too much oak flavor.

name: Ferraris  Ruchè di Castagnole Monferrato "Opera Prima" DOCG
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: The Ruchè di Castagnole Monferrato DOCG Opera Prima is the product of a single vineyard, and that vineyard is nurtured like no other on the estate. “I wanted to dedicate this wine to my grandfather Martino, ” Luca relates, “and see that it stands up to years of cellaring.” The vineyard here is steep, late in ripening, with loose calcareous soil that is poor in nutrients, restraining the vine’s vigor. Grapes are hand harvested and rigorously selected. The juice ferments in large oak barrels. The wine then ages in 500 liter oak tonneaux (mixed new and old) over twenty-four months, with continual tasting. This long process assures that the colors stabilize and the tannins soften. The wine then bottle ages an additional year. “My goal is that this wine should stand with a good Barolo,” Luca says, “and it is priced accordingly.” The nose is peppery spice and a garden of flowers, the palate ripe raspberry and cherry, medium to full bodied, tannins are soft and acidity stimulating, reminiscent of a fine red Burgundy, with a fully ripe finish.

name: Ferraris  Barbera D' Alba " Del Martin" DOCG
desc_en_short: The Barbera d’Asti DOCG “del Martin” is produced from grapes sourced from four different vineyards. Like Ruchè, this wine is fermented in French oak barrels at a controlled environment for about 15 days. It is transferred to stainless steel vats for about a month to allow for malolactic fermentation, then put in 25-hectoliter French oak casks where it rests for about 6 months. Sharpening in casks results in a soft and perfumed wine – lively, deep and persistent. Both dry and rich, Barbera d’Asti is a full-bodied wine that pairs well with many meat-based dishes such as pasta with meat sauces, cold cuts or grilled meats.

name: Ferraris  Barbera D' Asti  Superiore " La Regina" DOCG
wine_color: Intense ruby red with light garnet reflections.
desc_en_short:
The grapes that compose this magnificent wine come entirely from a vineyard called Castlet located in the municipality of Montemagno. Its vines are very old so they produce a few small clusters whose juices are very concentrated. We personally select all the clusters before fermentation in 25-hectoliter French oak barrels that lasts about 25 days.

After fermentation is finished, it is placed in smaller 500-liters oak barrels where malolactic fermentation and sharpening take place naturally. Here, the wine rests for about 18 months. It is bottled without any filtration and left for about 6 months before release. With big personality and power, it is ideal as a pairing for meat courses or cheese. lts body, structure and high acidity allow this wine to age 10 to 15 years.

name: Ferraris  Ruchè di Castagnole Monferrato "Bric D' Bianc" DOCG
desc_en_short: From a single prized hillside in Piedmont's Castagnole Monferrato, Ferraris' Bric d'Bianc is a benchmark expression of Ruchè DOCG — a rare, intensely aromatic native variety delivering vivid rose-petal fragrance, fresh cherry fruit, and a velvety, balanced palate built for the table.

name: Chateau Poncharac
desc_en_short: Château Poncharac is an approachable Bordeaux red offering a garnet-bright appearance, an inviting nose of fresh red fruits, and a supple, well-rounded palate — a classic, food-friendly expression of the Bordeaux blend tradition at an everyday price.

name: Chateau De Chateauneuf
desc_en_short: This wine has a deep ruby colour and offers a rich nose with an intense concentration of black fruits aromas. The mouth is structured and powerful with an aromatic ending of ripe fruit. Perfect drink with grilled red meats, poultry or cheese with character.

name: Chateau La Rose Moutauran
desc_en_short: Attractive deep red colour - young, rich and vibrant. A powerful nose with lots of ripe berry fruit and just a hint of toastiness. Full-bodied - particularly for a Bordeaux Rouge - but also very soft and supple with juicy blackberry fruit. Well rounded with fine, harmonious tannins and a long finish.

name: San Valley  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Deep, impressive ruby-red colour, which suggests concentrated grapes harvested at theright moment. It's nose is governed by pleasant notes of plum, raspberry and sweet spices, a very structured, balanced, long and elegant Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: San Valley  Merlot
desc_en_short: Full bodied, elegant wine with a fruit from Maule Valley – Single Vineyard. Attractive red colour with violets hints. The nose is very complex, with abundant red and black fruit and some herbal and spicy tones, accompanied by vanilla and coffee notes. Round and well structured mouth. Soft and velvety tannins. Tasty and juicy, good structure and balance.

name: Pian delle Vigne By Antinori  Brunello Di Montalcino "Vignaferrovia" Riserva DOCG
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Tenuta Guado al Tasso By Antinori  Matarocchio Bolgheri IGT
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Batasiolo  Barolo Brunate DOCG
wine_color: Intense garnet red color with delicate orange highlights.
desc_en_short: Intense and persistent with pleasing flavors of dried fruits, stewed prunes. Spices and aromas of roasting complete the olfactory range. The palate is full-bodied, tannic and balanced in the sensations of freshness, full, and very persistent. Ideal in combination with dishes based on red meats, game, roasts and cheeses and cured meats. Because of its pleasant softness, it can be considered a “Barolo for every meal.”

name: Apothic  Red
style: Zinfandel, Merlot, Syrah And Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Inspired by the "Apotheca", a mysterious place where wine was blended and stored in 13th century Europe, Apothic Red offers a truly unique wine experience.  A masterful blend of rich Zinfandel, smooth Merlot, flavorful Syrah and bold Cabernet Sauvignon creates layers of dark red fruit complemented by hints of vanilla and mocha.

name: Yalumba  Individuals Galway Vintage Traditional Shiraz
desc_en_short: This Shiraz shows all the hallmarks of a traditional Barossa Red. It is deep in colour with crimson hues. There are aromas of mulberries, black forest cake and liquorice allsorts that speak of its varietal and regional origins. The palate is ripe and generous with flavours of mulberries, dark chocolate and hints of beetroot. It finishes with cocoa powder like tannins that give evenness and generosity to the wine.

name: Domaine Albert Mann  Pinot Noir Clos De La Faille
desc_en_short: Bright red. Sour cherry, flint and botanical herbs on the nose. Juicy,  vibrant red fruit flavors are spiced up by hints of pepper and herbs. The finish is long and bright, with mountingly drying tannins. The first vintage of this wine was the 2001 (The vines were planted in 1998). The vinyard is a continuationof the Hengst, and the marl - limestone - sandstone soils are so iron - rich and red you'd think you were standing in Barossa. Aged in 10% new oak only, a good choice as the Hengst gives fairly big, tannic wines on its own.

name: Altera  Syrah
desc_en_short: Intense aroma of red berries - blackcurrants, raspberries and strawberries. Full and compelling with soft ripe tannins and a fruity rich palate. Delicious!

name: La Croix Barton  Bordeaux Rouge
desc_en_short: This is a lush, richly fruity red with inviting aromatics. The taste is well-balanced, elegant tannins and feel is different pipraid and spices. Serve at 16-18 °C. Foods pairing with red meat, especially grilled or roasted meats and stronger cheeses. Easy drinking and authentically.

name: Jean Luc Thunevin  Domaine Virginie Thunevin
desc_en_short: A touch airy at the core of damson plum and cherry pit notes, with slightly perky acidity holding the finish together.

name: Clos Saint Jacques St-Georges St.Emilion
style: Merlot10% Cabernet Franc10% Cabernet Sauvignon10% Malbec
desc_en_short: Beautiful dark fruit, cherry, plum, currant and spicy wood on the nose. A coordinating Palate with deep balance, smoothness and mild tannin to a long finish. Very enjoyable.

name: Chateau Fleur Haut Gaussens
style: Merlot 5% Cabernet Franc 5% Cabernet Sauvignon 5% Malbec
desc_en_short: This cru represents a beautiful garnet colour. Intense, the nose displays pure black fruits aromas such as cassis, blackberry and cherry. On the palate the oak is delicately integrated giving an extraordinary velvety mouthful. A powerful balanced tannic structure.

name: Chateau Teyssier  'Pezat' (Bordeaux Superieur)
desc_en_short: Good dark red.  Pure, slightly medicinal aromas of cherry and licorice, with good floral lift.  Moderately sweet and juicy, with good energy and early sex appeal to is dark berry, dark chocolate and herbal flavors.  Turns slightly tart with air, and the building tannins become a tad dry, but this youthfully medicinal wine offers good intensity and balance.

name: Chateau Sigognac
desc_en_short: Dark, extremely dry. Subtle aroma opens up to a cocoa and slight leather. Notes of cedar and black pepper with rich black berry fruit, a smooth body and fine tannins. Nothing is overstated, just incredibly drinkable red.

name: Domaine De L'A
desc_en_short: Soft, succulent wine with deep rich flavours with firm, velvety tannins. Medium bodied red with roundness, supple texture with good density and mid palate weight.

name: Chateau De Musset  Cuvee Compostelle Lalande de Pomerol
desc_en_short: The wine shows a complex, mellow taste with a creamy texture, notes of black berries and fruits, perfectly balanced acidity and a long rich, elegant finish.

name: Chateau  Monregard La Croix
desc_en_short: A dark purple in colour. Fragrant aromas of liquorice, coffee, and plummy red fruits. On the palate, medium-bodied and ripe with supple cherry fruit flavours and a juicy texture. The tannins are firm and the finish lingering. Great with roast turkey and all the trimmings.

name: Chateau Bonalgue Pomerol
desc_en_short: Pleasant red berry nose. Some oak derivation but seems more integrated here. The palate is marked by tannin and highish acidity so typical of the vintage and yet you have fruit and corpulence a medium bodied palate with a medium finish.

name: Clos Du Clocher
desc_en_short: Sweet, round, ripe and polished with ample plum and chocolate.

name: Chateau Le Gay  Manoir De Gay
desc_en_short: Manoir de Gay is a silky, mid-weight Pomerol built on grace. Dried cherries, crushed flowers, spices and sweet tobacco come forward in attractive, open-knit wine that should drink nicely with minimal cellaring. Features a dark fruit profile, with black currant, steeped blackberry and black cherry notes wound together singed anise accents. A very solid second wine.

name: Chateau Grand Pey Lescours  St.Emillion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: A rounded and classy Merlot - dominated blend, offering a soft, plump - feeling palate of ripe bramble and plum, with mature pruney notes and hints of earth and pine forest on the nose.

name: Chateau Tour Saint Christophe  Les Terasses St.Emillion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: A richly textured Saint-Émilion Grand Cru from Château Tour Saint Christophe, this 90% Merlot blend is whole-berry fermented in barrel, delivering seductive layers of cherry liqueur, licorice, coffee, and red raspberry framed by polished tannins and a spicy, round finish.

name: Jean Luc Thunevin  Esprit De Valandraud St.Emillion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: A rich, intense and fruit forward wine, sensitively elaborated from a delicate backbone of silky smooth tannins – with layers of complex red and black berry fruits, a nose of sweet spicey vanilla, and a long finish.

name: Jean Luc Thunevin  Clos Badon Thunevin St.Emillion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Supple, well crafted, fresh St.Emilion Grand Cru with plush tannins and wonderful approachability. Gorgeous texture with softness and a delicious drinkability. Lifted, elegant with good mid palate fruit.

name: Jean Luc Thunevin  Chateau Valandraud St.Emillion Premier Grand Cru Classe
style: 65 % Merlot 25% Cabernet Franc 5% Cabernet Sauvignon 4% Malbec 1% Carmenere
desc_en_short: Lush, rich and silky, with layers of dark chocolate coated black cherry and plum, with truffle in the nose get you going. The intensity of plush, ripe fruit on the palate is even better. This is a vintage full that produced by a complete wine that combines intense fruit, ageing controlled husbandry on a large, controlled and structured.

name: Phillippe Alliet  Chinon
desc_en_short: 91 points in Wine Wine Spectator - "Lovely cherry pit, damson plum and violet notes stream through, picking up light savory and olive details along the way. The fresh finish features an iron echo. Very pure from start to finish. Drink now through 2020."

name: Phillippe Alliet  L'Huisserie Chinon
desc_en_short: From one of the most impressive producers of Chinon, Domaine Alliet, the Huisserie vineyard is located uphill, on a premier slope in Cravant-les-Côteaux. The soil is composed of yellow limestone (tuffeau) on the surface and clay and flint below. The grapes ripen perfectly in this south facing vineyard. The nose is full, complex and defining a pure and elegant profile with notes of red berries, light pepper and forest trees. The taste is medium bodied, refreshing and refined with firm tannins. It can be paired with game dishes, beef stew and strong cheeses. This amazing wine could be cellared for more than ten years. However, you can drink it sooner by decanting for 45 minutes before serving.

name: Domaine Guiberteau  Saumur Rouge
desc_en_short: Fresh, cherry fruit on the nose, with hints of blackberry, and wild black hedgerow fruits. It has suppleness and a savoury character in its favour on the palate, some rather wild and interesting fruits, ripe and showing nice concentration, textured yet fresh. Good energy here. This is impressive for a domaine cuv?e, but this is a very good vintage overall.

name: Clos Des Papes  Chateauneuf Du Pape Rouge
desc_en_short: Vivid ruby - red. Potent raspberry, potpourri and garriguescents expand with air, picking up smoke and mineral nuances and a hint of olive. Sweet and seamless in texture, offering intense cassis and red berry compote flavors and a touch of licorice. Blends richness and vivacity smoothly, finishing spicy, focused and very long, with dusty tannins adding grip.

name: Domaine Marcoux  Chateauneuf Du Pape Rouge
desc_en_short: Vivid red. Intense red fruit and floral scents are complicated by suggestions of allspice, smoky minerals and garrigue. Vibrant raspberry and bitter cherry flavors show superb clarity and very good depth, picking up a bit of lavender pastille and an exotic blood orange nuance with aeration. Juicy acidity adds spine and lift; fine-grained tannins shape a strikingly long, focused finish that leaves behind sweet floral pastille and red berry notes

name: Domaine Marcoux  Chateauneuf Du Pape Rouge Vieilles Vigne
desc_en_short: Dark purple. Heady, complex scents of red and dark berry preserves, Asian spices, cola and smoky minerals. Densely packed but lively, offering sweet black raspberry and cherry liqueur flavors braced by a hint of blood orange. Shows terrific power and focus on the finish, which features silky tannins and an exotic floral nuance. One of the stars of the vintage, for sure.

name: Clusel - Roch  Classique
desc_en_short: From the small yet revered Côte-Rôtie appellation in the northern Rhône, Clusel-Roch's Classique marries 96% Syrah with a whisper of Viognier to deliver a brooding, full-bodied red brimming with dark cherry, tar, and subtle oak — a serious wine from a quietly exceptional estate.

name: Clusel - Roch  Vialliere
desc_en_short: The main features of Cote - Rotie wines from the land in "Vialliere" are a good structure, a nose of red and black fruits, very spicy and long-lasting in the mouth. These are wines to be served with very tasty red meat, mushrooms or cheese, young or once they have aged for a few years.

name: Clusel - Roch  Les Grandes Places
desc_en_short: The main features of Cote - Rotie wines from the land in "Grandes Places" are a strong structure, a nose of black fruits, a little bit rough too, very spicy and long - lasting in the mouth. These are wines to be served with game or very tasty red meat, once they have aged for a few years.

name: Domaine Brusset  Les Hauts De Montmirail
desc_en_short: There is an appealing swirl of rose flowers and black berries, a fine blackberry jam, on the nose. This has a nicely lush palate, swoops along on rolling black fruit, with classy tannins that provide momentum. The balance is good. There is lots to enjoy here, and depth also. It will retain its freshness as it ages.

name: Clos Des Fees  Vieilles Vignes Rouge
desc_en_short: Aged without racking for 12 months in one-year and two-year old barrels, as well as traditional cement tanks. Bottled after fining for 2 months in tanks. A naturally powerful wine, with no excess, but extremely aromatic. The silkiness of the tannins makes it enjoyable young, but it will show its full potential after aging in the bottle for at least 3 years. Ideal years cellaring: 5 to 10 year.

name: Casa Silva  Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The nose is scented with blackcurrant leaves and liquorice. The palate is opulent with cassis, blackberry, spicy oak and chocolate. The tannins are supple and well integrated, leading to a lovely, balanced wine.

name: Casa Silva  Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Dark red with violet hues. Elegant aromas of red fruit and spices. With a round structure and nicely balance on the palate. Notes of chocolate, black cherries and dried plums. Good concentration, persistent while soft tannins lead to a good finish.

name: Casa Silva  Syrah
desc_en_short: Intense black ruby colour. Powerful on the nose, with aromas of ripe fruits and cinnamon with hints of spices. Juicy on the palate, with black fruit notes, well balanced, with very good acidity and firm tannins that lead to a powerful finish.

name: Casa Silva  Gran Reserva Carmenere
desc_en_short: Bright and intense ruby red.On the nose, aromas of black cherries and plums with hints of spices. On the palate, flavoursome: round, powerful, with sweet soft tannins and balanced acidity. Long finish.

name: Casa Silva  Gran Reserva Range Quinta Red
desc_en_short: On the nose, red fruits, pepper and coffee in perfect harmony with French oak, leaving hints of chocolate Ripe, powerful, great body, notes of dark chocolate Soft sweet tannins which lead into a very long finish

name: Chateau De Grissac
desc_en_short: Displays some aromas of cherry and red currant; well-balanced, clean and fruity. Pleasant and easy to drink. Perfect with spicy roasted meats.

name: Cornerstone  Grand Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: An elegant nose of mature, weathered black fruits of great concentration.  A voluptuous wine full of supple tannins, sweet wild fruits and lightly charred plums. The finish is elegant and the sweet, spicy black fruits and smoky toasted undertones are enjoyed long after the wine is finished.

name: Cornerstone  Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Intense ruby colour. Delicate on the nose, slightly spiced with notes of blackforest fruits and cherries. Round and powerful on the palate, firm tannins andnotes of blackberries. Long and elegant finish.

name: Morambro Creek  Cabernet sauvignon
desc_en_short: Deep purple in colour. A rich elegant nose of cassis with overtones of vanilla and coffee. Lush, ripe palate dominated by black fruits, cherry and chocolate. Full bodied with savory, integrated fruit tannins and persistent finish.

name: Morambro Creek  Shiraz
wine_color: Deep inky black & purple in colour.
desc_en_short: Deep inky black & purple in colour. The nose is perfumed with violet, blackberry, vanilla and spice with a touch of earth and liquorice over white pepper in the background. Expansive palate, smooth lush ripe back fruits nicely balanced oak, plenty of concentration with a long finish.

name: Thorn-Clarke   Shotfire Ridge Shiraz
desc_en_short: Deep red with purple tints.  Rich and concentrated dark fruits, with charry oak and mocha notes.  The palate shows dense plum and mulberry with dark chocolate and savoury oak tannins.  The wine is intense, balanced and shows great length on the palate.

name: Thorn-Clarke   Shotfire Ridge Cabernet Sauvignon & Shiraz
wine_color: Deep red in colour with brick hues on release.
desc_en_short: Deep red in colour with brick hues on release. Leafy cabernet varietal cabernet is balanced by ripe plum, licorice and slight eucalyptus characters on the nose.
