Upfront dark fruits and long grainy tannins dominate the palate in addition maturation on French oak adds spice and cedar like characters. The wine has a distinct acid backbone which gives the wine long persistence.

name: Thorn-Clarke   William Randell Barossa Valley Shiraz
desc_en_short: Deep red with purple hues.  Lifted blackberry and cassis on the nose.  A rich brooding wine with layers of dark chocolate, plum and spiced fruit cake.  Stylish mocha oak notes with a long balanced tannin on the finish

name: Sally's Paddock
wine_color: Ruby Violet colour with a tinge of purple.
desc_en_short: A classic Victoria Cabernet blend from Sally's Paddock, this ruby-violet wine layers fresh berry fruit, cigar box, rose, and violet over a fine, balanced palate with lingering savoury complexity and fine-grained tannins — built with quiet confidence to age beautifully for decades.

name: Stefano Antonucci  Moschio Da Monte DOC
desc_en_short: Another Santa Barbara redwine with ruby red colored. Blended between Montepulciano and Sangiovese, made in stainless steel over a period of 20 days and is left to mature in barriques for 18 months. Tannins are smooth and elegant, thanks to the important and smooth structure. Its freshness promises full harmony in the evolution; very long and persistent. Breaks out with a luxurious bouquet of violet and black berry fruit, spiced and vegetable

name: Weingut Gottardi  Pinot Nero Mazzo Doc
desc_en_short: From the sun-drenched slopes of Trentino-Alto Adige, Weingut Gottardi's Pinot Nero Mazzo is a beautifully fragrant, silky-textured Pinot Nero offering pure sweet cherry, delicate herbs, and an almost ethereal lightness reminiscent of Alpine meadows.

name: Montevetrano  Montevetrano Rosso Core IGT
desc_en_short: Fully saturated purple-ruby; this is a very deep color for Aglianico. Very grapey, expressive fruit aromas on the opulent nose. Then more refined on the palate, where herbal, sweet spice and blueberry nectar flavors are supported by a solid tannic spine and lively peppery acidity. Finishes long and juicy. I think a couple of years in the cellar will help this develop further and blossom into something more. My score would have been even higher if this Aglianico’s color had not been so dark.

name: Montevetrano  Montevetrano Rosso Igt
desc_en_short: This dark, compact red boasts cassis, blackberry reduction, cedar and grilled herb notes on a full frame, with assertive woody tannins marking the spicy finish. This is a racy and beautiful red with spices, dark fruits and a smoky, light vanilla undertone. It's full-bodied but super polished. Very fine tannins. Flavors go on for minutes. A beauty now but much better in 2015 when the tannins soften.

name: Meroi  Ros Di Buri Doc
desc_en_short: The wine has an intense ruby red color. The taste of wine a deep, rich, enveloping, it feels soft fruit tones on a background of light balsamic and spicy shades, pleasant freshness and velvety tannins. The finish is long, expressive. The complex bouquet of the wine shows elegant blend of aromas of dark red fruit, blackberry, cherry, complemented by hints of spicy vanilla, roasted coffee beans, tobacco and fresh mint.

name: Meroi  Vigna Dominin Merlot Doc
desc_en_short: Rich, dark ruby with violet sealed. Exciting nose with rich notes of blackberry , elderberry, in the background slightly cloves. Round and smooth in approach and opens with catchy, ultra fine tannins, in the back course emphasizes earthy notes , a lot of pressure in the final.

name: Produttori Del Barbaresco  Barbaresco Rio Sordo Riserva Docg
desc_en_short: Produttori del Barbaresco's single-vineyard Rio Sordo Riserva is a powerful, brooding expression of 100% Nebbiolo — delivering dark red cherries, tobacco, menthol, and licorice with the structure and intensity to reward many years of careful cellaring.

name: Roberto Voerzio  Barbera D'Alba Cerreto Doc
wine_color: A bright and exciting red with clementine
desc_en_short: A bright and exciting red with clementine, dark berry and lemon aromas and flavors. Full body, silky tannins and a long and flavorful finish. Excellent Barbera

name: Roberto Voerzio  Langhe Nebbiolo S.Francesco Fontanazza Doc
desc_en_short: The marvellous is the finest vintage of Voerzio Langhe Nebbiolo we have ever tasted-indeed we have never seen this wine so pretty or so beautifully balanced. Packed full of red fruit, pressed roses, limestone-like minerality and an abundance of perfume, the wine is gracefully lifted but none-the-less grounded by its tannins, which this year are very fine and more rounded than in past vintages. Despite this being the neatest Langhe from Voerzio.

name: Marchesi Di Gresy  Merlot Da Solo Monferrato Rosso DOC
wine_color: Deep ruby red with violet hues.
desc_en_short: Marchesi di Gresy's 'Da Solo' Merlot from Monferrato is a richly textured, single-varietal expression aged thirty months in French barriques, delivering layers of ripe cherry, plum, black pepper, and leather with a supple, full-bodied finish.

name: Marchesi Di Gresy  Martinenga Barbaresco DOCG
wine_color: Bright garnet red with light orange reflections.
desc_en_short: Bright garnet red with light orange reflections. Intense notes of plum and cherry sinuously blend with balsamic nuances of mint, tea leaves, dried flowers and gold-leaf tobacco. Complexity and persistent aftertaste. Ideal with red meat, white meat richly seasoned and mature cheeses

name: Marchesi Di Gresy  Camp Gros Barbaresco Riserva DOCG
wine_color: Vivid, bright , garnet red with orange reflections.
desc_en_short: 95 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate -"I love the tension and the glossy elegance here. The 2013 Barbaresco Riserva Camp Gros Martinenga is silky, bright and buoyant. It is complete and shows a lot of depth. It offers fresh acidity, and while it has a lean approach, it definitely has impressive length. This wine should evolve nicely over the next 10-20 years."

name: Marchesi Di Gresy  Gaiun Barbaresco DOCG
wine_color: Brilliant garnet red with orange hues.
desc_en_short: 93 points in Wine Advocate -"Beautifully polished and tight, the 2013 Barbaresco Gaiun Martinenga impresses with its elegance and its seamless presentation of aromas. The wine glides over the palate with silky intensity, imparting flavors of cassis, dried cherry, forest bramble and white truffle along the way. This is a classic expression from the heart of the Barbaresco appellation."

name: Paolo Scavino  Barolo Docg
desc_en_short: A this red is marked by sweet cherry, strawberry, licorice and spice flavors. The tannins are evenly matched and offer support, even as they expand on the long finish. Shows excellent potential.

name: Paolo Scavino  Barolo Carobric DOCG
desc_en_short:
95 points in James Suckling - "Very fresh and creamy on the nose. The palate is full of strawberries and fresh roses. Medium to full body and ultra-fine tannins that are integrated and polished. Lightly chewy on the finish. Give it three to four years to soften."

94 points in Wine Spectator - "A high-pitched, aromatic Barolo, sporting floral, spice and berry flavors, backed by a solid line of tannins. Tobacco and mineral accents show on the finish."

93 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Intensely fragrant, this opens with stunning aromas of iris, violet, perfumed berry and a whiff of botanical herb. Linear and refined, the focused palate offers red cherry, strawberry, white pepper and a hint of star anise framed in taut refined tannins and bright acidity. It shows great tension and energy. Drink 2023–2035."

name: Paolo Scavino  Barolo Bric Del Fiasc Docg
desc_en_short:
96 points in James Suckling - "The redcurrant-compote character really pops out here, before dried cranberries, licorice and spice box all come to the fore. Tannic and very expansive, sweeping through a whole array of red berries via linear acidity and wrapping itself up in a long finish. Drink in 2023.

95 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "From the Scavino family’s home-turf vineyard, the 2015 Barolo Bric dël Fiasc (with fruit from Castiglione Falletto) delivers structure, firmness and power. This is a classic interpretation of a historic cru, and the wine offers linear, crisp lines. Fruit from this site was fermented separately for the first time to make this wine in 1978. The family had long recognized the consistently superior quality of the fruit from this location, and they saw its special potential. Enrico Scavino told me about the rush of adrenaline and pride that washed over him when he first tasted this wine with his peers Gaja and Conterno during those Golden Years of the past and saw the enthusiasm their eyes. This is the go-to Barolo if you want to taste classic Scavino.

95 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Woodland berry, wild herbs and rose mingle with whiffs of eucalyptus and coffee bean on this focused red. On the linear, full-bodied palate, firm, close-grained tannins accompany dried cherry, licorice and an almost salty mineral note before a tight, mouthdrying finish.

95 points in Wine Spectator - "The sweetness from ripe plum and cherry fruit offsets the broad swath of tannins. Energetic and focused, with leather, soy, iron and tobacco accents supporting the fruit. Feels balanced, but needs time for all the elements to integrate. Better than previously reviewed. Best from 2023 through 2045. 880 cases made."

name: Tenuta Mara  Maramia Igt
desc_en_short: Full-bodied and rich immediately reminding us of Romagna and Sangiovese. A hint of wild strawberries and ginger, with balsamic notes and a subtle almond finish.

name: Tenuta delle Terre Nere  Etna Rosso Calderara Sottana DOC
desc_en_short: Our Calderara Sottana is a single vineyard wine produced only from vineyards between 50-100 years old. Of all our single vineyard wines it is perhaps the most complete: much like a wide angle lens encompasses the most ample panorama, so Calderara seems to contain and display the widest spectrum of flavors, bouquets, nuances. Floral and spicy, leathery and aromatic, it delivers a wonderful filling sensation on the palate, yet stepping lightly. Don Peppino, whose devotion to Calderara led him to work our vineyards for seventy years, best describes the wines of Calderara: they are “creamy”, he says. And he’s right. Poultry, red meats, game, pasta, pecorino and bread.

name: San Leonardo  Terre Di San Leonardo
wine_color: Brilliant ruby red with attractive depth.
desc_en_short: 91 points in Wine Advocate - "The 2015 Terre di San Leonardo gives us a sneak peek of the fruit intensity and exuberance that is associated with this lovely vintage. This is an accessible and food-friendly blend of Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Carménère selected from across the San Leonardo estate. This wine offers immediate tones of black cherry, spice and blackberry. This is a very fruit-driven vintage that can be consumed within the next 5 years."

name: San Leonardo  San Leonardo Igt
wine_color: Intense ruby red with garnet highlights
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red with garnet highlights. A wine of remarkable intensity on the nose, which layers bell peppers and wild berries over a background note of vanilla. The palate is full, warm and impressively rounded, with intense aromatics that linger on the palate.

name: Bibi Graetz  Soffocone Toscana Rosso Igt
desc_en_short: A red with dried dark fruits such as cherries and berries. Medium body, bright acidity and a clean and crisp finish. Always a delicious red.

name: Bibi Graetz  Colore Rosso IGT 2008
desc_en_short: This is a phenomenal, tiny-production red made mostly from colorino and canaiolo grapes. It has an amazing density and richness but remains bright and velvety in texture. It has such intense flavours of dark cherry and spice, with hints of chocolate. Very long finish. It's just about ready to drink now. Superb.

name: Bibi Graetz  Colore Rosso Igt 2010
desc_en_short: Bibi Graetz's Colore is a rare Tuscan IGT of extraordinary depth, blending Sangiovese, Canaiolo, and Colorino from old vines near Montalcino into a richly textured, powerful red with dark berry fruit, chili spice, and a long, chewy finish.

name: Petrolo  Boggina Toscana Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: This is a radically different wine that shows precision and dark focus. The BogginAnfora feels fuzzy and foggy in comparison with a broader aromatic presentation, although both wines offer considerable charm. Here, the aromas are delivered straight to your senses with power and determination. The mouthfeel is richly layered with sweet cherry and spice.

name: Petrolo  Campolusso Toscana Rosso Igt
desc_en_short: A cabernet sauvignon with fabulous purity and fineness but a dense center palate with amazing silky tannins. It reminds me of a top Diamond Creek from Napa with its mountain cab style and hot-stone and iodine undertones. It's full-bodied with mind blowing integrity and polish. A wonderful expression of cabernet in central Tuscany. Only 600 bottles made.

name: Petrolo  Galatrona Toscana Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: 98 points in James Suckling - "Aromas of blackberries, black olives, green olive, and violets. It’s really aromatic. Full-bodied, yet so precise and polished with creamy, layered tannins that caress your palate. It’s extremely persistent and goes on for minutes. Only 40% new wood. Really balanced. All about purity and complexity from organically grown grapes."

name: Castello Di Ama  Vigneto Bellavista DOCG
desc_en_short: The 2018 Chianti Classico Gran Selezione Vigneto Bellavista marries Sangiovese and Malvasia Nera, a combination that works so well. The Bellavista is a powerful, vertical wine endowed with explosive and tremendous energy. Like all the top wines, it needs the better part of a decade to show all it's got. Gravel, smoke, leather, licorice and scorched earth.

name: Castello Di Ama  Vigneto La Casuccia DOCG
desc_en_short: A benchmark single-vineyard Chianti Classico Gran Selezione from Castello di Ama, La Casuccia delivers a compelling marriage of Sangiovese structure and Merlot richness — layered with wild cherry, tobacco, and liquorice across an elegant, deeply balanced palate.

name: Podere IL Carnasciale  Carnasciale IGT
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: The Rosso Carnasciale is an intense full-bodied red wine, produced from Caberlot grape and aged for 22 months in barrique and big oak barrels. Rich and intense at nose, with scents of red berries and spices, the wine is powerful, smooth and velvety, with vigorous tannins

name: Podere Il Carnasciale  Ottantadue DOC
desc_en_short: “Ottantadue” by Podere Il Carnasciale is an intense and juicy red wine from Sangiovese grapes, vinified in concrete vats and anged in steel tanks. The aromatic profile evokes hints of cherries, red fruits, pepper, aromatic and Mediterranean spices. The taste is smooth, rich, fruity, fresh, savory and round

name: Podere IL Carnasciale  IL Caberlot IGT
desc_en_short: Il Caberlot is a stunning wine. It’s not the most immediate or explosive Il Caberlot, but it’s such a tremendous example of this wine. The bouquet alone is mesmerizing. Crushed herbs, rose petal, mint, blood orange, incense and sweet pipe tobacco all build in the glass. Imagine Cheval Blanc, but with a good dose of Tuscan sun. Readers who can find the 2018 should not hesitate; it is magical.

name: Le Ragnaie  Chianti Colli Senesi DOCG
desc_en_short: The grapes come from the highest part of the Ragnaie vineyard, above the 600 meter threshold that the government slaps on Brunello and Rosso di Montalcino production. Thus the grapes must be declassified. This appears to have more in common with Burgundy upon first glance and sniff than Tuscany. The structure and fruit though tell a different story. This is very sexy with an alluring nose of red cassis and sour cherries. The palate continues with radiance and bright fruit wrapped around a tight skeletal structure.

name: Le Ragnaie  Rosso Di Montalcino DOC
desc_en_short: Sweet tobacco, anise, crushed flowers and savory herbs lift out of the glass. Rosso di Montalcino. Fine tannins support the fruit beautifully in an aromatically lifted, expressive Rosso endowed with gorgeous depth and lovely overall balance.

name: Le Ragnaie  Brunello Di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short: Riccardo Campinoti's Le Ragnaie Brunello di Montalcino is a hauntingly floral, terroir-driven expression of Sangiovese — fermented in cement and aged 36 months in large neutral Slavonian oak botti, delivering silky tannins, pressed roses, earthy depth, and remarkable elegance for the cellar.

name: Le Ragnaie  Brunello Di Montalcino Fornace DOCG
desc_en_short:
The Brunello di Montalcino Fornace emerges from a site next to Mastrojanni's Schiena d'Asino. The Fornace shows the warmth and breath of Castelnuovo in its dark fruit. Hints of licorice, mocha, tobacco, spices and leather develop in the glass as the wine opens up. This is an especially big, full-bodied Brunello with tons of depth. At times the alcohol is a bit noticeable, no doubt a reflection of the year in this southern part of Montalcino.

Vinification:
Oak: 36 months in large 25hL Slavonian vats.

name: Le Ragnaie  Brunello Di Montalcino V.V. DOCG
desc_en_short: The ethereal Brunello di Montalcino Ragnaie V.V. sees fruit sourced from older vines from vineyards located almost at the bull’s eye center of the appellation, roughly equidistant between Montalcino and Tavernelle. Under 3,000 bottles were produced. Like the base Brunello, this wine first goes into cement vats to undergo fermentation and this step has added much in terms of the wine’s aromatic profile. Subdued notes of pressed flower, dusty earth, ash and crushed mineral render a feminine and elegant expression. This wine is simply fantastic and among my favorite of the year. Drink: 2017-2027.

name: Siro Pacenti  Brunello Di Montalcino Vecchie Vigne DOCG 2016
desc_en_short: Crafted from Siro Pacenti’s oldest Sangiovese vines—planted in the early 1980s—Vecchie Vigne embodies the philosophy of Giancarlo Pacenti: blending deep-rooted tradition with precision viticulture and modern cellar techniques. The 2016 vintage, marked by near-perfect growing conditions, is hailed as one of the greatest in recent Brunello history. This wine represents not only terroir, but time—an homage to heritage and the patient craft of aging.

name: Uccelliera  Rosso Di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short:
92 points in James Suckling - "A red with juicy fruit, hints of chocolate and some cedar. Medium body, fine tannins and a savory finish."

90 points in Wine Spectator - "Dense, with beefy tannins backing the cherry, leather and earth flavors. The firm yet juicy finish shows tobacco and iron accents."

name: Trinoro  Le Cupole Rosso Toscana Igt
style: Cabernet Franc 27% Merlot17% Cabernet Sauvigon 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: A grape not normally associated with the mainstay of Italian wine, this bottle represents the dizzying heights that the Cabernet Franc grape can reach when made by a truly great producer. A beautifully hedonistic nose displaying Morello cherries, some roasted herbs and exotic spice notes - who needs a Yuletide candle when this wine imparts such an exquisite Christmas bouquet. Tremendously complex even at this early juncture, balanced with an impressive structure and a warm lingering finish. The cold Winter nights were made for this wine.

name: Trinoro  Magnacosta Rosso Toscana Igt
desc_en_short: A wonderful example of what can be achieved when Cabernet Franc has the opportunity fully to ripen-old vine fruit intensity prevails throughout. This is deeply coloured, a rich, ruby-cherry. The nose is again high-toned, consistent with the vintage - dark fruit and wood smoke, toasted oak and roasting coffee on the nose, with some herbal refreshment. The palate is rich and rounded, still gaining complexity from extended lees contact, complemented by pepper, wild herbs and crunchy minerals. The structure is firm and grippy, adding an attractive edgy quality and has a long, controlled finish.

name: Trinoro  Palazzi Rosso Toscana Igt
desc_en_short: A pure expression of Merlot, the 2011 Palazzi is loaded tight with soft notes of overripe fruit and strawberry. This wine does not deliver the same focused intensity as the others and the jammy fruit will prove over-the-top for most.

name: Tenuta Di Ghizzano  Verenoso Doc
wine_color: Dense ruby with some violet reflections
desc_en_short: The color is a dense ruby with some violet reflections indicating the presence of Cabernet Sauvignon. The aroma has two sides to it, one with fruity scents of raspberry, red plumb and currant, while the other has accents that are almost mineral. The flavor has thick and eager tannins and while the wine is still very young, it is already clear it will age in an amazing way, revealing all its elegance. The finish is long and fruity. Try it with roasted meat, served at 18 degree.

name: Tenuta Di Ghizzano  Nambrot Doc
wine_color: Dense ruby with some violet hues
desc_en_short: The Nambrot is the richest and darkest of these offerings from Ghizzano. A plush, concentrated wine, the Nambrot reveals a dense, extroverted expression of black cherries, grilled herbs, leather and earthiness. Here too, the wine comes across as rather young and in need of bottle age, but its future appears quite promising.

name: Le Salette  I Progni Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore Doc
style: Corvina And Corvinone 30% Rondinella 5% Croatina And Molinara
desc_en_short: Floral and spice notes lace this fresh, accessible red, featuring flavors of ripe cherry and fresh earth, accented by a hint of cigar box. Bright and tangy, with an aromatic finish.

name: Le Salette  Ca'Carnocchio Veronese Igt
style: Corvina And Corvinon 10% Rondinella 5% Croatina 5% Oseleta
desc_en_short: Sweet oak spice and mocha notes accent this silky, medium-bodied red, with flavors of black cherry puree, fig bread and light graphite lingering on the juicy finish. Stylish and very drinkable. Corvina, Oseleta, Rondinella and others.

name: Le Salette  Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico DOCG
style: Corvina And Corvinone; 30% Rondinella, Oseleta And Dindarella
desc_en_short:
Vineyards : La Marega vineyard, located in Fumane, in the heart of Valpolicella Classica

Wine making : Careful selection of grapes during manual harvest, followed by natural drying process for approximately 4 months.

Wine aging : 36 months in Slavonian oak cask (70%) and barrique (30%), 8 months in bottle. Long lasting wine, could be enjoyed for 25 years.

Wine pairing : Roasted, grilled meat, game, aged cheese, risotto with amarone or red chicory.

Wine serving temperature : 18°C/ 64°F. Best to open one hour ahead of serving

name: Le Salette  Pergole Vece Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico DOCG
style: Corvina And Corvinone; 20% Rondinella And Oseleta
desc_en_short: Le Salette's Pergole Vece is a single-vineyard Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOCG produced only in exceptional harvest years, crafted from hand-selected Corvina, Corvinone, Rondinella, and Oseleta grapes dried for six months before a long barrel ageing that delivers remarkable depth, finesse, and grip.

name: Bolla  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This elegant wine is soft, dry and well-balanced with flavors of black cherry, plum, blackberry, vanilla and subtle herbs.  This is a fragrant, fully mature Cabernet with an Italian accent everyone loves. Pair it with roasted red meats, rich pastas, and grilled vegetables.

name: Blue Nun  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Blue Nun Cabernet Sauvignon is grown in the Languedoc region of France, which is renowned for its healthy Cabernet Sauvignon grapes. The attractive characteristics of this area have produced this smooth, full-bodied red wine with fruity and spicy notes.

name: Blue Nun  Merlot
desc_en_short: Blue Nun Merlot is a smooth, full-bodied red wine with fruity notes of black currant and plum-spicy ﬂavour. On the palate the Blue Nun Merlot develops a firework of aromas of red fruits. Best enjoyed at room temperature with red meat, stews, pasta or rich soups and excellent with cheese.

name: Albert Bichot  Nuits Saint Georges 1er Cru "Chateau Gris" Monopole
desc_en_short:
These are delectable wines with beautiful, very intense red colour. Depending on the area, a wide range of aromas and favours are represented: fresh fruit, red fruit (raspberry, cherry) and notes of mild spices. Freshness and balance are perceptible on the palate, and the tannins are round, soft and elegant. The delectable aspect of this vintage is already perceptible, allowing these wines to be enjoyed without having to wait.

The Château Gris castle was built in the 18th century in the middle of its 3.5 ha (8.6 acre) walled vineyard. After the vineyards were destroyed by phylloxera, the roof of the castle was covered with grey slate although tiles are the traditional material used in Burgundy. The people of Nuits-Saint-Georges therefore began to refer to it as Château Gris (grey castle) and the name stuck. Further to a court ruling in the 1920s, the name “Château Gris” was allowed to prevail over the name of the place (lieu-dit) "Les Crots" where the vines are planted. The vines are planted on terraces that cling to the slope at an altitude of 280 metres. The plots of land at the foot of the castle produce Nuits-Saint-Georges Premier Cru “Château Gris” red, while those at higher altitudes are planted with Chardonnay grapes and entitled to produce the white Nuits-Saint-Georges “Les Terrasses”.

name: Benjamin Le-roux  Vosne-Romanee
desc_en_short: A beautifully crafted village-level Vosne-Romanée from Benjamin Leroux, offering an overtly floral nose laced with spice, sandalwood, and dark pinot fruit — sleek, seductively textured, and impressively well-balanced for its classification.

name: Domaine Arnoux-Lachaux  Bourgogne Pinot Fin
desc_en_short: Elegant Pinot Noir from Burgundy, France — fresh red fruits, delicate floral notes, and silky tannins. Perfect with light meats, poultry, and fine dining.

name: Philippe Pacalet  Moulin a Vent
desc_en_short: This Moulin à Vent lives up to its reputation as “fruity like Beaujolais and charming like Burgundy.” The pink granite terroir imparts very specific flavors into the wine -mineral, fruit (cherry) and some floral notes (violet, rose). The palate, which is rich and elegant, yet fresh, is very well integrated and beautifully structured. Although enjoyable in its youth it shows a great aging potential.

name: Philippe Pacalet  Gevrey-Chambertin
desc_en_short: This is also exuberantly fresh with its assortment of red currant, plum, and violet aromas that are liberally interwoven with notes of forest floor and earth. While there is more volume and concentration to the medium-bodied flavors it remains wonderfully vibrant with ample minerality to the mouth coating, powerful and moderately firm finish. This is an excellent Gevrey villages and highly recommended.

name: Poupille - Cotes de Castillon
desc_en_short: Biodynamic a deep ruby   precedes a very expressive nose with notes of cassis, blackberry, spice, cedar, on a gently woody base.The palate is soft, all in roundness characteristic of a good Merlot harvested at maturity. The tannins are present, silky and balancedstructure. Beautiful long finish.

name: Chateau LauLan - Cotes de Bordeaux
desc_en_short: The nose reveals notes of leather and black fruits associated with a few empyreumatic notes. The palate is quite fleshy. In themouth it expresses notes of cream of blackberry, raspberry, strawberry and a hint of fresh plum, spices as well as a few slight roasted note. Tannins are well built. Good length. The finish is slightly dry

name: Bernard Magrez  La Reference Cepage Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Bernard Magrez, the owner of Domaine d’Oustric in Languedoc, presents his 100% Cabernet Sauvignon Oustric. The vineyard is located on an exceptional terroir enjoying an ideal sun exposure bringing an optimum maturity and a typical character to the vines.

name: Bernard Magrez  La Reference Cepage Merlot Languedoc ( Oustric )
desc_en_short: From Bernard Magrez's Domaine d'Oustric in the sun-drenched Languedoc, this 100% Merlot delivers a round, fruit-forward character shaped by exceptional terroir and ideal solar exposure — an approachable, expressive red with real southern French charm.

name: Chateau Falfas   Le Chevalier
desc_en_short: Made from these robust and healthy grapes, the wines of Falfas are therefore the pure reflection of the typicity of the terroir, without any external contribution. Manual harvesting done at the highest degree of maturity of the grapes, followed by vinification with indigenous yeasts and careful aging, ensure quality and excellent development in bottles for many years.

name: Chateau Reynon - Rouge - Cadillac
desc_en_short: Chateau Reynon Rouge has a deep color and subdued aromas with licorice black-currant and smoky nuances; the flavors are velvety, elegant and powerful. They have an exceptional style that privileges the freshness of the fruit concentrated by the "noble rot", strength, balance and subtlety of the flavors.

name: Clos Floridene Grand Vin de Graves - Rouge
desc_en_short: Clos Floridène Rouge is Denis Dubourdieu's benchmark Graves red — a precise, aromatic blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Merlot delivering vibrant blackberry, cherry, plum, and cedar with the signature elegance and freshness that made Dubourdieu a legend in Bordeaux.

name: Chateau Le Puy  Emilien (1.5 L)
grape_variety: Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec
desc_en_short: The robe is garnet red. The nose is fruity, with ripe red fruit aromas dominated by blackcurrant and redcurrant, accented with roasted almond notes and occasional hints of mushrooms and undergrowth. The palate is well-rounded, full-bodied and precise, with velvety tannins paving the way for a finish is long and enjoyably complex.

name: Chateau Le Puy  Barthelemy
wine_color: The robe is a deep, enticing purple
desc_en_short: The robe is a deep, enticing purple, while the nose boasts a rich array of aromas which seem to evoke a basket of perfectly ripe grapes. The palate is luxurious and complex, balancing great depth of flavour with a silky lightness of touch. The finish is seductive with a hint of mystery, inviting you to plunge further into this entrancing enigma.

name: Sieur d'Arques  L'Oracle - Rouge
desc_en_short: L'Oracle Rouge offers an intense nose of red fruits, raspberry, strawberry. The Grenache blended with Merlot combines supple tannins with a fruity Finish. This wine will be highly appreciated on a terrace served with a nice piece of Grilled meat as well as around Asia snack and also Thai main dishes.

name: Domaine Mur-Mur-Ium  Ventoux Cuvee Anne
desc_en_short:
The nose is both very powerful and complex with little cooked fruit aromas, with spicies notes, a touch of coffee and chocolate flavors and a liquorish hint.
The taste is harmonious and reveals an explosion of blackcurrent and cherry marmelade, kirsched, spicies notes, Provences aromatic herbs, rosemary, liquorish and chocolate flavors which are coming  to fully integrate with the tannins of the oak . The Finish is also very complex, harmonious and lively in a powerful style.

name: Domaine Mur-Mur-Ium  Grenache - Grandiose
desc_en_short: The result is a full intense mature grenache  with spiciness, wild ‘guarrigue’ herbs and liquorice  and lasting  cooked-fruits flavors. The natural sweetness is just pointing  delicatly in the mouth and contributes to cover the alcohol and to inhance the intensity, complexity  as well as the length of the after-taste.

name: Domaine Mur-Mur-Ium  Syrah - Sublime
desc_en_short: Deep dark velvet color with shinning hints. Very intense and explosing nose with fragrances of  spring flower,  blackberries, cassis, toasted coffee and  chocolate notes. The mouth reveals a complex texture, full-bodied with spicies, pepper,  liquorice and chocolate notes in the back-ground. The finish is long lasting with finesse and silky tannins fruit-driven. Drink this complex textured wine over the next 3 to 5 years although it may last longer

name: Domaine de la Mordorée  Lirac La Dame Rousse Rouge
desc_en_short: Grenache and Syrah are in equal proportions in the blend. This cuvée, with its velvety tannins, has a lovely freshness and foral notes on the finish.

name: Domaine Giraud  Chateauneuf du Pape - Les Grenaches de Pierre
desc_en_short:
96 points Wine Spectator

Densely packed yet silky and refined in feel, giving it an elegant, almost airy sense as the kirsch, cherry puree and damson plum notes sail through, with seamlessly inlaid black licorice, incense and black tea details. Features a nice mineral hint that lingers at the end, adding length and pulling you back for another sip. Best from 2023.

name: Domaine Giraud  Chateauneuf du Pape - Les Gallimardes - Rouge
desc_en_short: 95 points Wine Spectator - "Offers inviting red currant and cassis flavors up front, layered with licorice root, fruitcake spices and charred mesquite. Though big-boned, this shows grace and polish, balance and finely cut texture. Reveals iron shavings and crushed herbes de Provence, which add a refreshing savory edge through a finish that goes on and on. Beautiful. Grenache and Syrah. Drink now through 2038."

name: Pago De Cirsus  Vendimia Seleccionada
wine_color: Dark ripe cherry colour with violet tones.
desc_en_short: The second variety on the estate to be picked is usually Tempranillo, the others come later. The varieties tend to be in excellent sanitary condition with no disease due to the terroir and privileged conditions on the estate. Grapes ripen at an optimum rate due to the lack of rain in the harvesting months in most years, wines are usually of excellent quality.

name: Friedrich Becker  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Pinot Noir from one of the best producer in Germany. Nose of red berry, black cherry, roasted coffee and liquorice. On the palate, good delicious fruit and concentration with lively acid. Smooth body with moderate tannin. Good middle long finish.

name: Domaine Des Roches Neuves  (Thierry Germain) La Marginale
desc_en_short: 100% Cabernet Franc from one of the best producer in the Loire Valley, if not in France. Thierry Germain, the proprietor and winemaker, is great practitioner Biodynamic principle. The wine has a deep color, intense yet elegant nose, great concentration, beautiful structure and a super long finish. It shows very well the greatness that Cabernet Franc can achieve.

name: Jean Michel Gerin  La Champine
desc_en_short:
An entry level 100% Syrah from a top producer in Côte Rôtie. The grapes come from vines grown on Micaschiste and Granit soils on hillsides nearby Ampuls. This is a very vibrant, delicious and elegant wine offering beautiful nose of red berries and liquorice with a hint of fine leather bag and cedar. Very delicious ripe fruits on the
palate with smooth velvet body and a good long lingering finish.

name: Santa Duc  Les Plans
desc_en_short: An easy drinking delicious southern Rhône wine to be enjoyed with friends. The wine offer beautiful aromas of red berries, find herbs, roasted coffee and dark chocolate. Smooth and round body with good concentration. Very enjoying and long finish.

name: Pas de L’Escalette  Les Clapas Rouge
desc_en_short: Terrasses du Larzac Les Clapas is a beautiful, medium-bodied, elegant effort that offers lots of spice, dried flowers, violets and licorice in its Provencal, savory profile. It has good mid-palate density and a great finish, and should evolve nicely for 4-5 years, probably longer.

name: La Stoppa  Trebbiolo Rosso
desc_en_short: A classic traditional wine of Colli Piacentini, “Hills of Piacenza”, located at the western end of Emilia Romagna from the local grapes, Barbera and Bonarda. The wine is light, fruity and very enjoying. Annual production 20,000 bottles.

name: Buondonno  Chianti Classico
desc_en_short: The colour is an intense ruby red, the fragrance has aromas of ripe red fruits with hints of spices and vanilla. The tannins are sweet and persistent.

name: Sato  Central Otago Pinot Noir "L'Insolite"
desc_en_short: Nice suppleness at the attack. Good amount of sweet and velvety tannin and moderate alcohol give the wine medium body but greatly integrated charming red fruits tastes of cherry and cassis and bright and pure acidity bring the solid frame work in the taste at the end. Very fine texture and Umami.

name: Auka   Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Auka Cabernet Sauvignon from Mendoza delivers a deep garnet pour with a plum and raspberry nose, followed by a fresh, creamy palate with silky tannins and a long, satisfying finish — a classic Argentine red built for the table.

name: Auka   Malbec Reserve
wine_color: Deep red colour with a touch of violet.
desc_en_short: Deep red colour with a touch of violet. The nose offers intense aromas of fruits such as cherries and plums combined with vanilla, chocolate and coffee. Full bodied, well balanced and elegant on the palate with soft, sweet tannins. The finish is harmonic.

name: Cornerstone  Classic French Red
desc_en_short: Bright ruby red color for this wine, fine and delicate with hints of red fruits, creamy and sweet, a nice wine to drink on the fruit

name: Chateau Le Pin  1985
desc_en_short: Le Pin is about delicacy and aromatics, instead of power. The wine posses layers of kinky dark cherry, plums, coconut, orange, flower and vanilla that makes it truly unique. The decadent wine feels great in your mouth.

name: Chateau Le Pin  1993
desc_en_short: This micro-estate is easy to criticize given the absurd prices (- per case!) the 500 or so cases fetch in the auction markets. Le Pin is one of the most exotic, concentrated, flashy wines of Bordeaux, but when it is selling at six times the price of wines such as Clinet, La Conseillante, L'Evangile, and La Fleur de Gay, readers are justified in thinking that some wine buyers have lost their sense of reality. The 1993 reveals the evolved dark plum/garnet color of Le Pin, as well as an exotic, kinky, oaky, herb, coffee, jammy, black-cherry-scented nose. The exaggerated aromatics are followed by a not-surprisingly decadent, delicious, low acid, medium-bodied wine crammed with fruit. Those of us who can remember as children gorging ourselves on lavishly rich banana splits, hot fudge sundaes, etc., will no doubt appreciate that in wine terms, this is what Le Pin offers.

name: Domaine De La Romanee Conti  1989
desc_en_short: dark cherries colour. all muddled together in a rich, warmly inviting fragrance. Quite lovely. The palate was delicious and drinking very nicely, with soft tannins and a touch of juicy acidity framing matured flavours of dark cherries, plums and blackberries, with earthy shades as a backdrop. The finish faded just a tad, drifting off with a charming kiss of warm Chinese herbs

name: Delas  Cotes Du Ventoux
desc_en_short: Its colour is a deep ruby red, showing garnet reflections while young. With its predominately berry-fruit bouquet, this wine shows the full aromatic power of these two noble grape varieties whilst retaining the freshness imparted by well-controlled wine making.

name: Delas  Saint Joseph Les Challeys Rouge
desc_en_short: A ruby red colour. A seductively fruity nose (raspberries, strawberries and blackcurrants), with a delicate hint of wood. On the palate this wine has good volume, and shows grippy tannins that are the true reflection of its genuine terroir.

name: Delas  Gigondas "Les Reinages"
desc_en_short: The colour is a deep garnet red. In its youth it reveals black cherry aromas which will evolve towards notes of woodland and spices. On the palate, this is a warm, heady wine whose texture is well-rounded and silky. The finish is perfectly balanced.

name: Delas  Chateauneuf du pape "Haute Pierre"
desc_en_short: The colour is a deep garnet red. To the nose, the "Haute Pierre" cuvée is characterised by strong spicy aromas, which show a rich, powerful body wrapped around with a more delicate yet tightly knit tannic framework. Rich and unctuous on the palate, the finish reveals some intense, liquorice like flavours.

name: Delas  Hermitage "Domaine des Tourettes"
wine_color: The colour shows brilliant, deep red hues.
desc_en_short: The colour shows brilliant, deep red hues. The nose is powerful and complex, expressing blackberries, spices and leather. On the palate, "Domaine des Tourettes" is firm but silky, with a tightly-knit tannic structure that is the hallmark of wines that have a great future.

name: Villa Maria  Cellar Selection Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: This Cellar Selection Pinot Noir displays a fragrant bouquet of dried herbs, red cherries and subtle smoky notes. On the palate the wine is concentrated with juicy red berry fruit flavours, integrated acidity and fine grainy tannins. Serving with lamb, duck and wild game, or beetroot and feta salad.

name: Chateau Les Garelles  Bordeaux Superieur Red
desc_en_short: This is a rare and elegant bordeaux made from 100% organically grown grapes. The nose reveals a floral fruity chracter with a touch of spices. The body is mild and lean with refreshing acid. The finish is fine and very pleasant.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Rednoz MMXIV
desc_en_short: A blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and the rare variety,Egiodola. Expressive nose of black fruits, cassis, blueberry andwhite pepper. Savoury attack on the palate with refreshing ripe acid.Good mouthfeel with velvet tannin and long red berry finish.

name: Terres Dorées (Jean Paul Brun)  Côte de Brouilly
desc_en_short: 91 points in The Wine Advocate - Robert Parker, "The 2013 Cote de Brouilly comes from south to southeast-facing vines on granite soils. The is great expression here on the nose, with red cherries, bergamot and fresh strawberry scents that unfurl in the glass, gaining vigor all the time. There is even a hint of star anise with time. The palate is medium-bodied with a candied opening, fresh and lively with licorice notes lingering in the mouth. This is showing beautifully and should continue to evolve over the next few years. This is a delight."

name: Pas de L’Escalette  Les Petits Pas
desc_en_short: This is a blend of 50% Grenache, 30% Syrah, 20% Carignan from wines grown on very rocky soil at high elevation. The wines is refreshing and lively with nose of red berry, black fruits and fine spices. On the palate, the wine is soft with moderate tannin and a good ling lingering finish. A wine to be enjoyed with friends and a good meal.

name: Dr. Burklin Wolf  Pinot Noir Trocken Deutscher Qualitatswein
desc_en_short: Delicate scent of wild berries with light spice aromas supported by a discreet wood note. Slender, transparent finesse on the palate; Berry compote and red apples characterize the elegant, lively fruit body. Fine seasoning and precise acidity in the finish.

name: Heitz Cellar  Zinfandel Ink Grade Vineyard
desc_en_short: From Heitz Cellar's estate Ink Grade Vineyard in Napa Valley, this 100% Zinfandel delivers vibrant raspberry and black cherry aromas woven with sweet anise and cracked black pepper — a supple, elegantly balanced expression of one of California's most storied Zinfandel sites.

name: Leeuwin Estate  Prelude Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Leeuwin Estate's Prelude Vineyards Cabernet Sauvignon from Margaret River opens with a perfumed array of red cherries, Satsuma plum, violets, and bay leaf, then unfolds on the palate with vibrant red fruit, powdery tannins, and a distinctive graphite-mineral thread through a lingering finish.

name: Poderi Luigi Einaudi  Dogliani DOCG
desc_en_short: In the Dogliani area this traditional wine reaches its maximal tipicity: of a ruby red colour, which tends toward violet with a rich fruity bouquet, full bodied with an intense aroma of undergrowth and a pleasantly tannic taste, with a slight final almond note, typical of this wine.

name: Millhade  Atlantique Merlot IGP
desc_en_short: Gérard Milhade's pure-Merlot IGP Atlantique is a plush, approachable Bordeaux red bursting with blueberry, blackcurrant, and black cherry fruit — a crowd-pleasing expression of the grape that defines Saint-Émilion and Pomerol, crafted for everyday enjoyment without sacrificing depth.

name: Cantavida  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: It is an elegant and complex wine, presenting a deep ruby colour, and black pepper and cherry aromas. It has an attractive palate, with ripe tannins and juicy fruit.

name: Casarena Single Vineyard Owen Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Grapes go through a double hand selection of clusters and berries. After a careful destemming, the fruit performs a cold maceration with whole berries. To assure a maximum aromatic expression, we start with a natural alcoholic fermentation at low temperatures. In oak barrels, the wine experiments a spontaneous malolactic fermentation and it is naturally clarified.

name: Maycas Del Limari  Sumaq Reserva Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Refined texture and complex flavors of cherries and raspberries, notable structure and freshness. It is exuberant, fine and delicate.It has character, with concentrated notes of cherry and raspberry.

name: Maycas Del Limari  Sumaq Reserva Shiraz
desc_en_short: Fresh, young, of medium density, crisp minerality and long finishing.Intense aromas of blackberries and blueberries, as well as toasted notes, chocolate and pepper.

name: Maycas Del Limari  San Julian Pinot Noir
desc_en_short:
92 points in Decanter - "I remember visiting this blustery, arid vineyard before it was planted – winemaker Marcelo Papa was excited even then. Limarí is sunny, but while this is a muscular, dark-fruited, effusive style of Pinot, it’s also fine-textured, graceful, grippy and savoury. Think: Chile’s answer to Central Otago." - 
Tasted by Peter Richards MW

name: Canicatti  Aquilae Nero d’Avola
wine_color: Deep and bright ruby red, with strong violet hints.
desc_en_short: A noble expression of Nero d’Avola of this territory, with amazing Harmony of its fruity notes and pleasant soft tannins. The nose is confirmed by the first taste, revealing a wine with good structure, soft and pleasant, with lively and well-balanced soft tannins. Excellent with rigatoni pasta with red tuna stew with mint, or a tasty oven-cooked fillet of baby black pork from the Nebrodi region of Sicily and pistachios from Bronte. Also outstanding with a rich goulash of wild boar or aged cheese from Ragusa.

name: Canicatti  Aquilae Syrah
wine_color: Bright and deep ruby red, with violet highlights;
desc_en_short: A vine, representing the typical characteristics of our territory: distinctive fruity notes like cherry and strawberry and nuances of spicy notes, harmonic, smooth, well-balanced and refreshing tannins. tasty lasagne with ragout, barbecued pork sausages, tuna steaks with almonds, oven-baked mutton, tripe and sauce, saltimbocca alla romana (sautéed slices of veal with ham and sage), salted cod with olives and capers. Syrah is also perfect with pungent, matured cheeses.

name: Canicatti  Scialo (Nero d’Avola & Syrah)
wine_color: Very intense ruby red with purple hints;
desc_en_short: A bold yet approachable Sicilian blend of Nero d'Avola and Syrah from Canicattì, delivering ripe red fruit, warming spice, and softly rounded tannins shaped by careful oak ageing — an expressive wine built for the table.

name: Palo Alto  Reserva II Merlot
desc_en_short: A wine of intense color with violet hues, with notes of red fruit and great elegance. In the mouth it is smooth and its acidity enhances the fruity flavors, giving a long, pleasant finish.

name: Churchview  Estate Cabernet & Merlot
wine_color: A brilliant claret red with a ruby hue.
desc_en_short: The Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot are all estate grown fruit.  The Cabernet Sauvignon came from the block next to the big dam and the Merlot from the Southern end of the property high on the hill.  This vintage has produced a wine with complex aromatics.  Bright and vibrant fruits of plums and blueberries, Peppermint trees and Eucalyptus are married with coastal heath all interwoven with the fruit.  Oak use sits quietly in the background adding subtle spice.

name: Howard Park  Flint Rock Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Howard Park's Flint Rock Pinot Noir draws on the Great Southern's three flagship sub-regions — Mt Barker, Porongurup, and Frankland River — to deliver a vibrant, mineral-driven red brimming with poached rhubarb, red cherry, smoked strawberry, and a lingering thread of savoury spice.

name: Cà Maiol  Giome Benaco Bresciano DOC
desc_en_short: Cà Maiol's Giomè is a beautifully crafted Benaco Bresciano DOC blend from the shores of Lake Garda, uniting indigenous Groppello with Marzemino, Barbera, and Sangiovese for a fresh, balanced red with real regional character and approachable everyday appeal.

name: Fontana di Papa  Roma DOC Rosso
wine_color: A ruby red color and purple hues.
desc_en_short: Roma is a doc red wine with a ruby red color and purple hues, which deepen with age. Rich notes of red berry aromas are woven together with the sensation of spice. The taste is full and soft, marked by freshness and evolving tannins. The possible food combinations range from pasta dishes with meat sauces to grilled meats.

name: Xanadu  Exmoor Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The wine exhibits vibrant, characteristic aromas of ripe blackcurrants, berry fruits, and dark plums entwined with hints of spicy, toasty oak. The generous palate is packed full of jubey forest fruits, cassis and chocolate characters. Full bodied, the attractive fleshy fruits fit into a structure supported by supple tannins, a solid acid backbone and a persistent berry fruit finish. Perfectly approachable in its youth, this wine will comfortably cellar for several years.

name: Xanadu  Exmoor Shiraz
desc_en_short: Deep red with garnet hues. Blackberries and raspberries with fragrant floral notes spiced with hints of liquorice, tar and subtle toasty oak influences. A full-bodied, yet controlled, Shiraz displays ample depth with plenty of inky forest fruits; blackberries, redcurrants and spice. The ripe fruit and savoury elements combine together with supple tannins and a fine acid backbone providing structure to this well balanced wine, finishing with a lovely persistence of fruit. Perfectly approachable in its youth, this wine will comfortably cellar for several years.

name: Little Yering  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Little Yering Shiraz from Yering Station captures the cool-climate elegance of the Yarra Valley — vibrant dark berry fruit layered with pepper spice and subtle oak, delivering a polished, medium-bodied red with genuine freshness and finesse.

name: Yering Station  Yarra Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A beautifully structured Yarra Valley Cabernet Sauvignon from Yering Station, built around a dense core of dark berry fruits with layers of coffee, chocolate, and rich spice woven through firm, tightly wound tannins.

name: Yering Station  Yarra Valley Shiraz Viognier
style: Shiraz With A Small Percentage Of Viognier
desc_en_short: A refined cool-climate blend of Shiraz and Viognier with vibrant dark berries, lifted florals, and silky texture—aromatic, structured, and elegantly balanced.

name: Cono Sur  Tocornal Camenere
wine_color: A deep ruby red color with violet reflections
desc_en_short: Our Tocornal Carmenere is a deep ruby red color with violet reflections. Red fruits, plum and blueberry aromas mingle with soft spice hints in the nose. The palate is soft, balanced and round with an excellent persistence. Serve it with pastas and fresh cheeses.

name: Cono Sur  Single Vineyard Pinot Noir
wine_color: A clean, bright and intense ruby-red color.
desc_en_short: A clean, bright and intense ruby-red color. This elegant Pinot Noir expresses notes of raspberry, sour cherry, plum forest berries and tobacco on the nose. On the palate It is juicy and full with smooth tannins and great acidity. A fine wine that is best accompanied by red meat, poultry, duck and aged cheeses.

name: Gapsted  Hidden Story Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Aroma of rich blackberry, blackcurrant and violets, lead to a palate of wonderful balance, rich bursts of fruit, soft tannins and a smooth finish

name: Gapsted  Hidden Story Shiraz
desc_en_short: Gapsted Hidden Story Shiraz delivers dark, brooding fruit with rich blackberry and cherry aromas framed by classic pepper spice, leading to a beautifully balanced palate of subtle oak and fine spice with a silky, lingering finish.

name: Buronga Hill Estate  Grande Reserve Shiraz
desc_en_short: Mouthwatering bramble, cassis and plum with a lick of spice Rich and mouth filling with warming black fruit and a peppery edge.

name: Gapsted  Snowy Creek Classic Dry Red
desc_en_short: Cabernet Merlot Shiraz. This wine is ripe blood plum in colour. The nose displays aromas of dark plum and blackcurrent. These aromas lead to a palate of spicy fruit flavours. This is a mouth-filling wine with a smooth lingering finish.

name: Gapsted  Fruity Dolcetto Syrah
desc_en_short: This wine displays a rich ruby red colour. The nose shows rich, ripe berry fruit aromas. These aromas lead to a luscious palate brimming with fresh, sweet red berry fruit flavours, balanced with a brilliant frizzante tingle and a soft lingering finish.

name: Tumblestick Ridge  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Aroma is Rich dark cherry and blackberry with subtle hins of cinnamon and vanilla. This Wine is Charming flavours of cherry highlight this wine with a subtle oak influence of chocolate and vanilla. A full flavoured wine with a rich finish. An ideal partner for red meat dishes, especially succulent roast dinners.

name: Astrolabe  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: “The 2020 Marlborough Pinot Noir is a silky, supple little thing, with red apple skins, strawberry, red cherry and hints of exotic spice (sumac, nutmeg, cinnamon, etc.) on the palate. The finish is firm and a little chewy (not a pejorative comment), but what this offers is classy and complete. 13.5% alcohol, sealed under screw cap. Drink date 2023-2030.”

name: Sacha Lichine  Le Coq Rouge
desc_en_short: A selection of grapes from the Hérault region, South of France, between Pezenas ans Béziers. Grenache and Syrah. Notes of red fruits, strawberries and cherries. Round, crunchy, good lenght and great freshness. Ideal with a generous helping of vintage Rolling Stones, “I am the little red rooster too lazy to crow for days!”.

name: Le Coste  Rosso
wine_color: Deep ruby red with purple reflect.
style: Sangiovese 10% Blened With Local Varieties Ciliegilo, Cannaiolo, Vaiano And Colorino
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red with purple reflect. Cherry nose with tones of herbs; Very fresh, Earthy. In the mouth It is generous, good freshness and body. Long final with red fruits and herbs.

name: Le Coste  Vino Rosso
wine_color: Pale red ruby with maroon shades.
desc_en_short: A hauntingly beautiful expression of Greghetto from Le Coste's prized cru above Lago di Bolsena — pale ruby in the glass, this Lazio natural wine is lean and tensile, with aromatics of wild red berries, citrus peel, and spice, and a silky, saline finish.

name: Henry Pelle  Le Carroir Rouge
desc_en_short: Purity, structure and finesse. The potential of this unique terroir in the northernquarter of the appellation of Menetou-Salon Morogues was recognized and plantedby Henry Pellé as long ago as 1976. For here, in the “lieu dit” known locally as“Le Carroir”, is silex or “flint”: a light sandy terroir pebble-dashed with flintstones.The nose shows the typical cool climate Pinot Noir but with concentration,elegance and structure. It’s enjoyable when young but will improve greatly withyears of cellaring.

name: Henry Pelle  Les Cris Rouge
desc_en_short: From a storied single parcel planted by Henry Pellé in 1967, Les Cris Rouge is a beautifully structured Loire Valley Pinot Noir — dense yet fresh, with fine tannins and genuine depth that reward the dinner table.

name: Jean Marc Burgaud  Morgon Côte du Py
desc_en_short: 94 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2019 Morgon Côte du Py has turned out beautifully, delivering an inviting nose of smoky black cherries, cassis and licorice. Medium to full-bodied, bright and lively, it's deep and concentrated, with a fleshy core of fruit underpinned by tangy acids. This is another of Burgaud's real successes this year."

name: Les Bertrand  Morgon Coup d’canon
desc_en_short: notes of raspberry, strawberry and spices! good gamay. On the palate, the attack is all in finesse, but the tannins quickly offer a light astringency, pleasant enough in the mouth. The typical gamay aromas make their appearance and gently envelop the palate.

name: Les Bertrand  Fleurie Coup de foudre
desc_en_short: Light and delicious Beaujolais from old vines of more than 60 years old. Yann Bertrand, a rising star from Beaujolais, had delivered again a lovely red that is very enjoying and pleasing. Beautiful fresh nose of red fruits and flowers with a touch of earthiness. On the palate, the wine shows plenty of delicious fruit with great structure. The finish is long and enjoying.

name: Les Bertrand  Morgon Coup de foudre
desc_en_short: Les Bertrand Morgon Coup de Foudre is a seductive single-cru Beaujolais from the volcanic soils of Morgon, delivering ripe cherry and plum on the nose with a surprisingly structured palate, generous roundness, and a long, lingering finish.

name: Terres Dorées (Jean Paul Brun)  Saint Amour
desc_en_short: Robert Parker, “The 2014 Saint-Amour has a delicate but pretty redcurrant and strawberry-scented bouquet, less extravagant than its peers but natural and well defined. The palate is medium-bodied with crisp acidity, pure red cherries and redcurrant fruit, harmonious with a precise and quite intellectual finish. This is a superb offering from Jean-Paul Brun.”

name: Alienor  Grand Vin Bordeaux Blend
desc_en_short: Bordeaux blend is considerably more tannic and aloof. Almost equal parts Merlot and Cabernet Franc, it's very deeply flavored in black and red currants, licorice and dusty Asian spices, while lots of new French oak adds a sturdy framework.

name: Amuse Bouche  2019
desc_en_short: This wine as boasting flavors of sweet black cherries and ripe plums with underlying aromas of chocolate, coffee bean, red licorice and exotic spice box.

name: Antica Terra  'Obelin' Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: It has a very pure nose with dark berries, touches of truffle oil and walnut complementing the fruit, very detailed with wilted rose petal scents emerging with time. The palate is medium-bodied with sappy redcurrant and raspberry, the tannins a little.

name: Antica Terra  'Antikythera' Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Bright violet color. An explosively perfumed bouquet evokes an array of ripe red and dark berry, floral pastille and incense scents, along with suggestions of cola, mocha and smoky minerals. Conveys a compelling blend of richness and vivacity on the palate, offering deeply concentrated black raspberry, cherry liqueur, spicecake and candied lavender flavors that spread out on the back half. Showy but also impeccably balanced, finishing with slowly arriving velvety tannins and remarkable clarity and cling. A star of this superb vintage, which isn't short of standout wines.

name: Arietta  Variation One
desc_en_short: This wine is surprisingly bright and fresh on the palate, with flavors of red cherries, roasted meat, and orange liqueur and chocolate. It continues to open and reveal notes of campfire, baked fruits, and wet gravel. Tannins are dry and firm, helping to bolster the broad, expansive impression.

name: Au Sommet  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Bright, saturated red-ruby. Pure but restrained aromas of currant, espresso and minerals complemented by mint and licorice nuances. Chewy, deep and mouthcoating, with noteworthy energy to its subtly expanding flavors of brambly mountain berries, rocky minerality and spices.

name: Bacio Divino  Napa Valley 2013
desc_en_short: Rich black current and cherry aromas exude from this glass, the fruit on the palate is framed nicely by the sweet cigar box spice of the oak. This is a full-bodied wine with an exceptionally long, yet elegant, finish. The fine silky tannins of the valley floor are very evident.

name: Bacio Divino  'Janzen' Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer Missouri Hopper 2013
desc_en_short: From the storied Beckstoffer Missouri Hopper vineyard in Oakville, this 100% Cabernet Sauvignon from Bacio Divino delivers an intense rush of tar, asphalt, and dark blackberry, underpinned by chewy, polished tannins and the structured tension of a genuinely age-worthy Napa classic.

name: Bacio Divino  'Janzen' Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon Cloudy’s Vineyard 2012
desc_en_short: The 2012 Janzen Cloudy's Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon, which comes from the Dutch Henry Canyon area near both the Switchback and Hourglass Vineyards and sits at a 400-foot elevation, is certainly another stunner. It’s rare to see two Cabernet Sauvignons that eclipse anything from the Beckstoffer To Kalon Vineyard, but I think Jenzen has done that in 2012. One hundred percent Cabernet Sauvignon, the Cloudy’s Vineyard is opaque purple and displays richness and intensity in its notes of lead pencil shavings intermixed with cedar wood, fruitcake, blackcurrant and blackberry fruit. A wine of extraordinary intensity and a long finish, it should drink well for 20-25 years.

name: Bacio Divino  'Janzen' Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon Beckstoffer To Kalon 2013
desc_en_short: This is a big wine from a stellar vineyard in the heart of Oakville, sizable on the palate in billowy tannin, tobacco, black plum and milk chocolate. Full bodied in every way, it has a smooth, velvety nature that should soften further in time, allowing for a finish of compost and tea.

name: Black Oak  Merlot
desc_en_short: Black Oak Merlot from Sonoma County delivers a plush, fruit-forward experience with aromas of cocoa and ripe blueberry, leading into layers of fresh plum, strawberry jam, and black cherry — a consistently smooth, crowd-pleasing red with a polished finish.

name: Capture  Alliance Red
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc
grape_variety: Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Malbec
desc_en_short: Alliance is a Bordeaux Left-Bank style blend, an approachable wine that is ready to drink at release. It offers a nose of lavender and dried flowers, and a palate of chocolate and both red and black fruits, with a round, juicy mid-palate and a lingering finish. The Alliance cuvee is most like a red Pessac-Léognan style of wine, driven by our most aromatic lots of Merlot and Cabernet Franc, and Cabernet Sauvignon as a base for structure and weight.

name: Capture  Harmonie Red
style: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, Malbec
desc_en_short: Harmonie is the purest, most elegant and well-balanced Bordeaux-style blend we could craft, incorporating fruit from each block on the estate. It is a rich blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. Harmonie offers a nose of black cherries, dark chocolate, huckleberry and roses, with ripe tannins and a minerality on the palate that reminds us why we love mountain fruit. Rich and full-bodied, we expect this to drink well at release and for up to 20 years.

name: Capture  Revelation Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Révélation is our signature wine, a true Pauillac-inspired Cabernet Sauvignon that immediately offers graphite, pencil shavings, ripe blackberries and cassis on the nose. The tannins in this 2009 cuvee are ripe and round, defying its youth. The palate has espresso and dark chocolate notes, intense minerality, and the new French oak already well integrated. This intense yet elegant wine will age effortlessly for 20 years or more. The Cabernet Sauvignon is blended with small amounts of Merlot and Cabernet Franc to further its dimension and depth.

name: Cherry Tart  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Cherry Tart Pinot Noir jumps from the glass with aromas of raspberry, nutmeg, sandalwood and light smokiness, lifted by a floral note. Silky and delicate up front, with ripe acidity framing the rich, sweet flavors of red berries, red cherry and earth. Offers good fat without excess weight, finishing with a fine dusting of tannins and very good length.

name: Cherry Pie  Pinot Noir Stanley Ranch
desc_en_short: Deep and concentrated. It shows tons of textural richness in its ripe red fruit aromas, there is no shortage of lush overt fruit this year. Big, rich flavors dominate this wine. It changes and opens in the glass enormously, although it disappears so fast. It's only by hiding an open bottle for several hours that you will truly discover the evolution.

name: Cirq  Treehouse Russian River Valley Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Moderate reddish purple color in the glass. Lovely, effusive aromas of black cherry, black raspberry, vanilla and spice. The wine offers a pleasant marriage of fruit oak and an enticing texture. Very soft and approachable, with mid weight layered flavors of black cherry, raspberry, Damsel plum, and boysenberry fruits. Excellent harmony with a lasting, berry-driven finish with a kiss of oak.

name: Coattails  Willamette Valley Pinot Noir
wine_color: Moderately dark reddish-purple color in the glass.
desc_en_short: Moderately dark reddish-purple color in the glass. Rather shy but pleasing aromas of black cherries, spice and dried rose petals. Delicious black cherry and plum fruit front and center that is on the big, riper side for this cool Oregon vintage, reflecting the warmer vineyard site. Displays the spice that Francois Frères oak is known for. Soft in the mouth with supple tannins and well-integrated oak and acidity. A charming Pinot that is very enticing. Very good.

name: Corra  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Aromas of blackberry jam, cassis, dusty raspberries, dark cocoa and baked cherry pie all swirl and combine in the glass to create an interesting and evocative aroma profile in this very ripe Napa Cabernet.  Touches of citrus zest, cinnamon, black pepper and a touch of sweet earth add slightly deeper base notes to the aromas. At entry, the wine is fresh and laden with dark cherry and blackberry flavors.  Soft tannins are evident at entry and throughout the palate impression, with a bright acidity noted at the finish as the fresh cherry flavors fade.

name: Coup de Foudre  Cabernet Sauvigon
desc_en_short: A powerful Calistoga estate Cabernet Sauvignon from Coup de Foudre, layering cassis, dark berry preserve, and sage over a creamy mid-palate, with 18 months of barrel aging in premium French cooperages delivering deep structure and a long, tannic finish.

name: Coup de Foudre  Cuvee 37.2
style: Merlot, Cabernet Franc And Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Coup de Foudre Cuvee 37.2 is Seductive notes of kirsch, licorice, lavender and lots of juicy fruits characterize this velvety-textured, opulent Merlot that cascades over the palate with no hard edges.

name: Coup de Foudre  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Coup de Foudre Pinot Noir Sweet smell of strawberry, a touch of tea and some earthy undertones. Medium body with minimal acidity, a hint of chocolate under the cherry and strawberry notes.

name: Crocker & Starr  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Crocker & Starr  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is possesses some obvious minerality, a boatload of tannins, and more austerity. Nevertheless, it is packed and stacked with black fruits given the fact that it is 100% Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Crocker & Starr  'Stone Place' Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: One hundred percent Cabernet Sauvignon aged 20 months in French oak, this 500- to 550-case cuvee from the organically managed Stone Place Vineyard is a dense ruby/purple color, with a classic nose of unsmoked cigar tobacco intermixed with blackberries, licorice, subtle barbecue smoke, and cassis. A gorgeous, full-bodied texture, excellent purity, and well-integrated acidity, wood, and tannin all make for a thrilling wine to drink over the next 15-20+ years

name: Drew Family Cellars  Mcdougal Ranch Vineyards Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: From Drew Family Cellars' acclaimed single-vineyard program, this McDougal Ranch Pinot Noir delivers a fragrant, spice-laden expression of coastal California fruit — think dusty raspberry, dried strawberry, and layers of cardamom and white pepper on a silky, medium-bodied frame.

name: Drew Family Cellar  Gatekeepers Anderson Valley Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Drew Family Cellars' Gatekeepers Anderson Valley Pinot Noir is a chiseled, medium-bodied coastal California blend drawing on three Mendocino appellations — Anderson Valley, Yorkville Highlands, and Mendocino Ridge — to deliver lifted red fruits, forest mushrooms, dried florals, and a compelling river-stone minerality.

name: Drew Family Cellars  Ornbaun Syrah 2008
desc_en_short: The Ornbaun offers notes of chocolate, boysenberry, licorice, black cherry, fennel and spice. The nose has aromas of dark stone fruit, floral spice and fresh white pepper with a core of ripe red plums. The flavors are seductive with wild berry fruits with black cherries and mocha notes with hints of Carpaccio. The structure has terrific balance with firm tannins making for a long and consistent finish.

name: Drew Family Cellars  Ornbaun Syrah 2012
desc_en_short: A cool-climate Mendocino Ridge blend of Syrah, Zinfandel, and Viognier from the celebrated Perli and Valenti vineyards, the Drew Family Cellars Ornbaun delivers brooding blackberry, crushed pepper, and mocha on a full-bodied frame with polished structure and a long, lingering finish.

name: Drew Family Cellars  Valenti Vineyard Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Aromas of cranberry, raspberry, forest floor, burnt oak and sandalwood. Follows up on the palate with more of the same with the addition of vanilla. Medium bodied with very smooth textures. Finish was medium in length and has high acidity like most pinot noirs. Good and delightful wine.

name: Fisher  Cameron Napa Valley Fisher Red
desc_en_short: Opulent red cherry aromas mingled with raspberry cedar and dark chocolate all clamor for immediate attention. This wine is brimming with youthful exuberance of bright, ripe, red fruit and has a mid palate so unctuous and layered with fine-grain tannins one wants nothing more but another sip. The wine has serious concentration with a focus and clarity that magnifies blueberry, cherry fruit and finishes with smooth lingering flavors of chocolate and toffee.

name: Fisher  Coach 'Insignia' Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Coach Insignia boasts deep garnet color with opulent aromas of black cherry, blackberries and candied violet. The palate is full, showing plum and casis, accented by layer of espresso-like fine grain tannin. With time in the glass the wine continues to open, evolving to express further nuanced aromas of tobacco leaf and dark cacao powder.

name: Frank Family  Carneros Pinot Noir
wine_color: light ruby red in the glass.
desc_en_short: Frank Family Carneros Pinot Noir is light ruby red in the glass. This has an earthy nose, with notes that pop with aromas of baking spices, especially cinnamon. The palate offers bright, fresh flavors of Rainier cherries and vanilla, and a round mouthfeel.

name: Frank Family  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Merlot, 4% Petit Verdot And 1% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Opens with rich scents of black fruit and cedar. This wine is fruit-forward with intense cassis, plum and blackberry flavors, it's balanced with notes of tobacco, spice, and a solid structure for length on the palate, finishing with a touch of dark chocolate.

name: Frank Family  Napa Valley Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Frank Family Napa Valley Zinfandel is garnet in color, and opens with aromas of raspberries, vanilla, and earthy dried herbs. Medium-bodied on the palate with an abundance of fresh fruit and black pepper flavors on the entry, this wine is round, silky, and finishes with flavors of ripe blackberries.

name: Frank Family  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon (1.5 L)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot And Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: The dense dark plum/purple-tinged 2007 Cabernet Sauvignon Napa is composed of 89% Cabernet Sauvignon, 9% Merlot and 2% Petit Verdot. The fragrant bouquet of blueberries and flowers is followed by admirable complexity, sweet tannins, a medium to full-bodied, graceful mouthfeel and no hard edges.

name: Frank Family  Napa Valley Reserve Rutherford Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, Merlot
desc_en_short: Frank Family's Rutherford Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon draws from storied Napa vineyards including the hand-terraced Winston Hill and the sprawling Benjamin Vineyard, delivering a deeply structured, opaque garnet wine laced with blackberry, dark cherry, cloves, and that unmistakable Rutherford dust minerality.

name: Frank Family  Napa Valley Winston Hill Rutherford
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Frank Family’s flagship Winston Hill wine is deep purple in the glass. The nose bursts with notes of dark fruit and cocoa, and the palate is gorgeously balanced. The wine has an amazing amount of finesse amidst its ripe fruit and soft tannins and tastes like velvet with a never-ending finish.

name: Green Hills  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A full bodied, fruit-forward wine with flavors of ripe blackberry and dark cherry is boosted by hints of smoky mocha and oaken vanilla. Well-integrated tannins and a rich-round finish completes the balanced wine.

name: Kapcsandy Family Winery  Napa Valley Endre (Bordeaux Blend)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Kapcsandy Family Winery's Endre is an elegant Napa Valley Bordeaux blend built on the celebrated State Lane Vineyard, offering aromatic complexity of bouquet garni, red and black currants, and loamy earth with a refined, silky texture that rewards those who seek grace over sheer power.

name: Kapcsandy Family Winery  Estate Cuvee State Lane Vineyard
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, And Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: a dense ruby/purple color as well as a gorgeous nose of chocolate-covered black cherries and hints of cedar and licorice, medium to full body, superb richness and weight, and moderate tannins.

name: Kesner  Vadim's Watch Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Bright opulent cherry cola on the nose with spicy notes of cassis and white pepper on the palate. Velvety tannins and a very long finish make this an elegant, sophisticated wine with old world sensibilities.

name: Layer Cake  Cabernet Sauvignon - Alexander Valley
desc_en_short: The Layer Cake Cabernet Sauvignon truly expresses the depth and complexity of the grape. Perfumed with violets and wild berries, it shows strong varietal characters and rich, ripe plum fruit. Seamless and elegant, this wine shows big black fruit on the palette, fine grain soft tannins and a long coffee chocolate finish.

name: Layer Cake  Pinot Noir - Monterey
desc_en_short: The Layer Cake Pinot Noir has expressive notes of Raspberry, pomegranate, cranberry, are supported by dried tea leaf and tobacco on the nose. The palate is layered texturally and has rich, pronounced blackberries and ripe plum.  Soft, fine grained tannins and smoky dark chocolate stay through the finish.

name: Levy & McClellan  Lazy Monkey Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Intense berry almost candy-like aromas. The palate is meaty with oak accents. The finish is loaded with tannins. This is a young wine that will age beautifully.

name: Levy & McClellan  Ampersand Napa Valley Red Bland
desc_en_short: It boasts an inky/purple color along with notes of crème de cassis, blackberries, subtle barbecue smoke and graphite. Full-bodied with sweet tannin and the vintage hallmarks of lusciousness, extravagant richness and depth without being heavy or tiring, this fabulous effort is one of the more drinkable wines from Levy & McClellan to date.

name: Lillian  Syrah
desc_en_short: Lillian is not particularly Syrah-like. It doesn’t scream out the usual cocktail of blackberries, bacon fat, and lavender. It always feels a bit more about the people and the places than the varietal. The wines are lavish, but there is refined rocky quality in them that defies description.

name: Merryvale  Carneros Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Deep ruby in color with notes of red cherries, earth and orange rind in the aroma. Medium density, with intense fruit flavors and strong floral notes. A soft and delicate palate resolves into smooth velvety tannins. As this wine evolves, further floral flavors will emerge along with notes of tobacco.

name: Merryvale  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
91 points in Wine Enthusiast - "This well-made wine offers an experience of supple, smooth and hearty dark fruit, with a moderate amount of toasted oak. Blended with 13% Merlot, 6% Malbec and 4% Cabernet Franc, it is earthy and robust in sage, dried herb and violet."

90 points in James Suckling - "This offers a wealth of ripe, redder fruit with plums and mulberries on the nose and palate. The texture is supple to start and then firms up through the redcurrant-flavored finish."

90 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "A blend of 77% Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc and 5% Malbec aged for 22 months in 50% new French oak, the 2016 Cabernet Sauvignon is very deep purple-black in color and scented of warm cassis, baked plums and black cherry compote with hints of tar, sautéed herbs and tilled soil. The palate is full-bodied, with a good solid frame of ripe, grainy tannins and just enough freshness to support the muscular fruit, finishing on a juicy note. 4,000 cases produced."

name: Merryvale  Profile Red 2014 (Napa Valley)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Petit Verdot, 5% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short:
94 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate

A proprietary blend of their best lots, in this case 85% Cabernet Sauvignon and the rest Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. This is a big-time winner... Rich, inky purple-colored, with sweet crème de cassis, blueberry, forest floor and spice box, the wine is full-bodied and opulent, with a voluptuous texture, sweet tannin, and a long finish of close to 40-45 seconds. This is a beauty... Drink it over the next 15+ years.

93 points in Wine Spectator

Aromatically complex, firm, dense and chewy on the palate, with taut dark berry, crushed rock, licorice, anise and cedar notes. Ends long and persistent. Built to age. Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. Best from 2020 through 2034.

92 points in Wine Enthusiast

This big bold Bordeaux-inspired blend combines 85% Cabernet Sauvignon with 10% Petit Verdot and 5% Cabernet Franc. It offers a layering of dusty sage and crushed rock around tight-grained tannin that presents as soft and structured on the palate. The integrated fruit is a welcome mix of cassis and red currant.

name: Miura Vinyard  Monterey County Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Miura Pinot Noir is full of raspberries, stewed strawberries, and pink roses on the nose, balanced out with an earthy minerality, fresh herbs, and slight chocolate toasty oak notes. This is a light bodied wine, with a gentle tannin/acid structure. This wine is slightly off dry, and paired exceptionally well with my Thanksgiving feast, which included Turkey with Cranberry sauce, Stuffing, Roasted Brussels Sprouts and Mushrooms.

name: Mt. Brave  'Mt. Veeder' Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
