style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc And Malbec
desc_en_short: A mountain-grown Napa Cabernet from Mt. Veeder, this Mt. Brave bottling layers black and red berry fruit with hints of herb, Asian spice, espresso, and floral lift — delivering serious Napa structure with surprising elegance and a long, satisfying finish.

name: Peay Vineyards  'Estate La Bruma' Syrah
desc_en_short: Bright ruby. Heady, exotically perfumed bouquet of blackberry, cherry-cola, licorice and incense, with a note of violet in the background. Sweet, ripe, silky and expansive, with a nervy spine of acidity providing focus to the sweet red and dark berry compote flavors. Sexy and approachable already but this seamless, very long Syrah has the depth to age.

name: Peay Vineyards  'Estate Scallop Shelf' Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Bright red. Explosively perfumed aromas of candied red fruits, potpourri, blood orange and Asian spices, with a smoky overtone. Incisive raspberry, cherry and rose pastille flavors show an alluring sweetness buffered by zesty mineral and spice notes. Silky, focused pinot with excellent back-end cut and finishing power.

name: Realm Cellars  'The Bard' Napa Valley
desc_en_short: The flagship of Realm’s portfolio, The Bard is the Cabernet Sauvignon-dominated Proprietary Blend we’ve made since 2003. It’s our calling card, and we hope it invites people to explore deeper into the Realm portfolio of wines. We consider The Bard to be the most dynamic expression of Napa Valley: a blend of grapes from Coombsville to Calistoga, from the east to the west sides, from the hillsides to the valley floor. Dense, weighty, and concentrated, The Bard always punches above its weight, and with multiple dimensions coming together in harmony, there is more than meets the eye in this complex wine. This is the wine that we like to see on wine lists and at fine wine shops. Outstanding vineyards such as Beckstoffer To Kalon, Beckstoffer Bourn, Blair, Houyi, Larkmead, Moonracer Estate, Farella Estate, Orchard and Bettinelli Upper Range have all found a place in the wine. While the composition of The Bard varies from year to year, Cabernet Sauvignon typically comprises over 70% of the blend, joined by lesser percentages of Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot. From time to time, we honor growers with a special edition of The Bard, such as The Bard Blair Special Edition, which is bottled as a single-vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon highlighting one facet of our flagship wine. This edition is sourced from Blair Vineyard, which sits between Three Palms and Larkmead Vineyards in Calistoga.

name: Reference Book  Napa Valley Red Wine
desc_en_short: Deep color. Open, expansive, modern nose features leather, plum, cassis, minerals, earth, and new oak. Follows through flawlessly on the palate; sweet, seductive, and velvety. This is a complex, layered, chocolaty wine with particularly wonderful acidity. It is drinking beautifully right now, especially with aeration. Above all, the finish is extra long, consistent, delicious.

name: Revana  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2007
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc And Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: Revana's estate-grown 2007 Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon from St. Helena is a benchmark blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot — earning 97 points and the #4 spot on Wine Spectator's Top 100 Wines of 2010, with a supple, polished texture built for both pleasure and cellaring.

name: Sinatra Family Estate  'Nothing but the best' Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Bright red-ruby. Ripe, soil-driven aromas of cherry, loam, licorice, minerals, bitter chocolate and flowers. A suave, juicy midweight with no excess fat to its pliant flavors of black cherry and flowers. Boasts excellent definition and balance. Finishes with firm but suave tannins and lovely persistence. Classy wine.

name: Sinatra Family Estate  'Come Fly with me' Calistoga Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A serious Calistoga Cabernet Sauvignon earning 93 points from Robert Parker, the Sinatra Family Estate 'Come Fly with Me' delivers opulent blueberry, scorched earth, and mocha complexity — a full-bodied Napa classic built for the cellar.

name: Staglin Family Vineyard  'Salus' Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 18% Merlot 3% Cabernet Franc, 3% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: 2018 was yet another superb growing season despite some of the challenges we faced with periods of high heat and low humidity. Another warm and dry winter lead to what is becoming the normal ‘early’ budbreak which was primed and boosted by fortuitously timed February rains. The return to warm and dry early spring pushed us through flower and fruit set before the cool spell that affected others, so we saw healthy and normal yields. Then the heat train returned and was indeed full steam ahead throughout the summer, accelerating ripeness and maturity to give us the earliest harvest in the last 12 years. The nose of focused and driven dark red and black fruits is made complex and intriguing by an overlay of earth and herbs – think tilled soil and wet, leafless wintertime trees with a sprinkle of freshly torn tobacco, pinched camphor leaves and Tellicherry peppercorns. The crystalline and concentrated palate of ripe cherries and bursting black raspberries cascades along a chiseled path of fine granulated tannins given texture and touch by notes of espresso, cocoa nibs and hazelnut butter. A bit tightly wound at present, this fine-grained gem will appreciate a brief stint in your cellar, or your decanter.

name: Staglin Family Vineyard  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon 2008 (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Staglin Cabernet. But it is one of the successes of the vintage, showing how a great winery rises over vintage limitations. Feels lush and dramatic in the mouth, with lush, smooth tannins housing classic Cabernet flavors of black currants, plums, green olives and dark chocolate, accented with spicy, smoky oak.

name: Staglin Family Vineyard  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: An archetypal, old-world Sauvignon nose laden with classic aromas of cassis and black cherry redolent with violet-lifted black olives and green peppercorns rising out of an earthy bed of resonant loam and pure humus spiced by a tease of pimento, cedar and bay leaf cascades onto a rich and vibrant palate of anise highlighted blackcurrants and peppered plums speckled with shavings of dark chocolate and cocoa nibs energized by tingly notes of powdered minerals and a fresh acidity that also gives life and length to the well formed tannins.

name: Staglin Family Vineyard  'Ineo' Proprietary Red Rutherford 2008
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, And Merlot
desc_en_short: An elegant style, with complex aromatics of ripe plum, blackberry, floral, mocha and espresso. Firm and full-bodied, with smooth, fine-grained tannins that hold the flavors for a long, lingering, layered finish.

name: Starmont  Carneros Merlot
desc_en_short: This wine is aromas of strawberry, blackberry, milk chocolate, fresh rosemary, and red plum. On the palate it starts soft and round, shows sweet fruits and lusciousness on the mid-palate, and has well balanced acidity and tannins with a long fi nish that resolves nicely.

name: Starmont  Carneros Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: This Wine is a medium garnet color and delivers aromas of red cherry, strawberry, green tea and floral notes. The palate is round and soft, with refreshing acidity, and the volume and weight of a wine in balance. The finish features fine tannins, additional complexity, and some subtle earthy notes. The depth and structure of this wine are a reflection of great terroir and intensive farming methods.

name: Starmont  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: dark red in color, with black and purple hues.
desc_en_short: 92 points in James Suckling - "Aromas of spearmint, plum and suede. Full-bodied with soft tannins. Black-fruited with bright acidity and a hint of hot paprika. Nice length."

name: The Great Flyte  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Cassis, cherry, and cedar characters are evident in the aroma. Its structure provides a firm backbone for the luscious fruit flavors.

name: The Journal  Napa Valley Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Vin Perdu is a creative blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and Petite Verdot. Floral, peppery, spicy, meaty notes, good acidity and attractive freshness and purity. It has impressive complex flavors of dark berries, cassis, pepper and cedar.

name: Vita Nova  Santa Barbara Merlot
desc_en_short: Smooth and spicy, with yellow bell pepper and red cherry notes that are elegant and polished on the finish.

name: Z88.88 Napa Valley Red Wine
desc_en_short: Z88.88 exhibits a beautiful perfume of scorched earth, chocolate, espresso beans, creme de cassis, plums and Asian spices. Full-bodied, deep and just beginning to evolve, with formidable tannins in the finish.

name: Finca Flichman  'Tanguero' Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Wine attractive ruby-red color. The wine has a delicate, harmonious flavor with hints of ripe red fruit, jam and spices. Taste wine elegant, balanced, with fruity notes of black currant, raspberry and blackberry, with good structure and a long finish. The wine will be the perfect game meat dishes (especially - beef) and fish on the grill.

name: Finca Flichman  'Tanguero' Malbec
desc_en_short: This Malbec has an intense red colour and red fruit aromas. Plums and cherries are complemented by a touch of oak. On the palate, this wine has plum and raspberry flavours with an elegant, soft finish.

name: Finca Flichman  'Misterio' Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: High in color, tannin, and extract, Cabernet Sauvignon expresses notes of blackberry, cassis, plum, currant, spice, and tobacco. In Bordeaux and elsewhere in the Old World you'll find the more earthy, tannic side of Cabernet, where it's typically blended to soften tannins and add complexity. In warmer regions like California and Australia, you can typically expect more ripe fruit flavors upfront.

name: Finca Flichman  'Misterio' Malbec
desc_en_short: A generous, fruit-forward Mendoza Malbec from one of Argentina's most storied estates, Finca Flichman's 'Misterio' delivers plush plum and jammy berry character with herbal undertones — an approachable, full-bodied red built for the grill.

name: Finca Flichman  'Reserva' Malbec
desc_en_short: The Filchman Reserva Malbec is deep violet with blue shades. It shows complex aromas of violets, cherries and sour cherries in oak. Flavors are concentrated, with black berry fruits, ripe plums and tobacco leaves. It has a complex finish with remarkable sweet tannins and long lasting afftertaste.

name: Aldridge  'Abbott Peak' Shiraz Merlot
desc_en_short: Cherry red colour with lighter hues at the rim and inviting aromas of ripe black berry fruit with chocolate vanillin oak on the nose. A long and velvety mouthful of sweet plummy and red berry fruit integrated with lingering soft tannins. A perfect match to supper dishes such as bangers and mash or home made burgers or lasagne, but equally at home accompanying roast red meats or cold meat platters.

name: Peppercorn Lane  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Deep Red with Purple Hues. Aromas of blackberry, spearmint and pepper supported with cherry oak. Mint and ripe raspberry fruit flavourscomplemented with toasty oak and a delicate mulberry and silky smooth finish.

name: Hundred Acre  Ancient Way Shiraz 2006
desc_en_short: Glass-staining ruby. Intense, spice-accented aromas of cassis, violet and smoky minerals show distinct superripeness and power. Spicy, deep dark berry compote and floral pastille flavors offer excellent focus and vivacity for their richness, with a peppery flourish adding energy. The impressively long floral, smoky finish features building tannins and a strong licorice nuance.

name: Hundred Acre  Ancient Way Shiraz 2007
desc_en_short: Inky purple. Superripe aromas of cassis, cherry preserves and dark chocolate, with complicating notes of licorice and mint. Densely packed and chewy, offering palate-coating black and blue fruit flavors that show serious depth and building sweetness. A hint of smoked meat comes up on the long, clinging finish, which is framed by broad, pliant tannins.

name: Layer Cake  Shiraz
desc_en_short: The aromas of cocoa, warm spice and dark fruit are very powerful from the first whiff. In the mouth, the wine is layered with rich blackberry, dark cherries and hints of dark, creamy chocolate ganache. The finish lingers on, hanging on your palette while the fruit and spice flavors slowly change and fade.

name: Mollydooker  ' Two Left Feet' Shiraz Cabernet Merlot
desc_en_short: Two Left Feet is the wine that I look forward to seeing in the bottle each year. It always exceeds expectations; it is magical how well it comes together. Shiraz, Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon work together brilliantly! The combination brings complexity and depth to this wine. Rich fruit and luscious flavours dance upon creamy mouth-feel and firm structure. Perfectly balanced and intense this wine is exciting and already very drinkable.

name: Mollydooker  'Gigglepot' Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Gigglepot is a gorgeous wine which is distinctly Cabernet, from the intensity of dark fruits to the direct tannins and fresh acidity. Completely balanced in every way, it has layers and layers of sweet fruit rolling over dark chocolate and a rich creamy palate. It ends with anise spice and lingering coffee flavours. Stunning!

name: Mollydooker  'Blue Eyed Boy' Shiraz
desc_en_short: Upon smelling this wine, your senses are immediately drawn in by a bouquet of deep blueberry, rich plum and coffee. These prominent fruit flavours are closely followed by chocolate and lustrous licorice spice with creamy vanilla constantly weaving its way through. This beautifully balanced wine is a classic representation of our Blue Eyed Boy: truly a vibrant, ripe, and indulgent experience.

name: Mollydooker  'Carnival of Love' Shiraz - McLaren Vale
desc_en_short: Intense in colour, flavour and aroma, our 2021 Carnival of Love Shiraz captivates the palate from the first sip. Powerful yet delicate, lifted aromas of red cherry, blackberry and turkish delight evolve, while subtle hints of mocha linger. Infectious chocolate cherry, fresh plum and liquorice add to the complexity, while creating a seamless structure and lingering finish.

name: Guido Manara  Rosso del Veneto IGT
wine_color: Ruby red with violet tints, almost impenetrable.
desc_en_short: Vineyard sited at 250 meters above sea-level at the heart of the Valpolicella Classico region and with a sountherly exposure. This particular wine has been dedicated to the father of the three brothers who currently run the winery.

name: Manara  Recioto della Valpolicella DOC Classico "Moronalto"
desc_en_short: This unique vineyard takes its name from being sited at the top of the hill above Moron, a locality of Negrar at the hearth of the Valpolicella Classico region.

name: Manara  Postera Amarone della Valpolicella Classico DOC
desc_en_short: 88 points in Wine Enthusiast - "This opens with ripe black-skinned fruit, vanilla and mocha aromas. The grainy palate delivers prune, espresso and clove alongside assertive tannins. "

name: San Filippo  Brunello di Montalcino DOCG
wine_color: The colour is ruby red with a slight tendency to garnet.
desc_en_short:
97 points in Wine Spectator - "Plenty of balsamic aromas preview this red, settling into a core of macerated cherry and plum fruit, framed by juniper, thyme, Scotch broom, tar and iodine. Racy and harmonious, with a solid layer of tannins underneath. Best from 2024 through 2047.

96 points in James Suckling - "A serene and intensely structured Brunello with cherry, cedar, walnut and dry-earth aromas with some burnt-lemon undertones. Full-bodied, yet with very fine tannins that are extremely polished and beautiful. Goes on for minutes. A gorgeous young wine."

93 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The San Filippo 2016 Brunello di Montalcino offers a slightly exotic personality with smoked cedar, mahogany or teak followed by dark fruit, pressed blackberry and plum. The wine ages in large oak cask for two years. This is a robustly textured and muscular Brunello with full-bodied intensity that transcends both the bouquet and the mouthfeel. There's a lot going on, especially in terms of the wine's smokiness and spiciness, and there is good acidity and tannic structure to frame it all."

name: Garzon Cabernet Franc Reserva
desc_en_short: An expressive and elegant Cabernet Franc aromatic, smooth, and beautifully balanced.

name: Chateau Roquefort  Rouge Grand Vin de Bordeaux
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ

name: Chateau Julien  Haut-Medoc
desc_en_short: The ruby color and the aromas of the Château Julien confirm the elegance and complexity of this wine, and the aromas of ripe fruit blend with the floral scent of the linden, with silky tannins on the palate.

name: Santi  Amarone Valpolicella Santi DOCG
desc_en_short: This Amarone is characterized by a dark red color. The nose opens with an elegant and ethereal bouquet of dried grapes and plum, enriched by pleasant spicy notes of cloves and cinnamon. The palate is warm, pleasantly full and vigorous. The wine features an elegant base of peach and toasted almonds that long in the mouth. Perfect with red meat and game, it is ideal in combination with seasoned cheeses.

name: Villa Cavarena by Allegrini  Amarone Della Valpolicella
desc_en_short: The characteristic hints of cherries and pepper are particularly enjoyable in this wine, followed by subtle nuances of officinal herbs. Dry and well-balanced. The traditional acidic note combines well with the softness of the fruit to form a satisfying contrast and produce a supple, feisty wine.

name: Aristocratico  Amarone della Valpolicella
desc_en_short: Inviting and sweet-fried fragrance of raisins, moreller, blackberries and dark chocolate. Full, great taste with deep, marmalade fruit of forest berries, cocoa, some licorice, mashed potatoes and melted chocolate. Long, warm finish.

name: Buondonno  Toscana Rosso
desc_en_short: A lively, fruit-forward Tuscan red from Buondonno, blending 85% Sangiovese with 15% Syrah for a wine that balances classic Chianti character — bright florals, fresh cherry, and gentle tannins — with just enough structure for the table yet enough charm for casual warm-weather drinking.

name: Cascina Zerbetta  Barbera del Monferrato
desc_en_short: A bright, fruit-forward Barbera del Monferrato from Cascina Zerbetta, crafted from younger-vine fruit with a short maceration and brief oak ageing to preserve vivid floral aromas, juicy acidity, and silky tannins — effortlessly drinkable year-round.

name: La Stoppa  Barbera Della Stoppa
desc_en_short: 100% Barbera, from older vines, aged one year in used barrels. From vines aged 25-45 years on stony clay-limestone soils. Macerated with skins for 30 days and fermented using only indigenous yeasts; the wine does not go through malolactic fermentation.

name: Russiz Superiore  Merlot DOC Collio
wine_color: Deep red colour with garnet tones.
desc_en_short: It colour is intense red with light garnet highlights. The nose is fresh and fruity, presenting characteristics aromas of forest fruit conserve, brandied cherries and raspberries in harmony  with a background of vanilla. A round and full-bodied taste, which perfectly corresponds with that perceived on the nose. It offers a persistent and long aftertaste.

name: Stefano Antonucci  Mossone IGT
desc_en_short: Lively vibrant ruby red. Intense and warm with aroma of marasca and blackberry, balsamic nuances of licorice and well blended tertiary hints. Notes of red mature fruit, vanilla coffe and chocolate. Warm and well bodied with soft and balanced tannins.

name: Tenute Nicosia  Fondo Filara Etna Rosso DOC
wine_color: Ruby red with garnet highlights due to ageing
desc_en_short: The famous native Nerello Mascalese and Nerello Cappuccio grapes grown on high-elevation volcanic slopes of Mount Etna produce a rich and complex wine with a great minerality and flavoursome aromas such as red fruit, herbs, spices and liquorice. On the palate, this volcanic wine is well-balanced, with refined tannins and a long balsamic finish.

name: Montesecondo  Sangiovese
desc_en_short: Montesecondo represents the purest expression of the Sangiovese grape that this earth produces. The aging process occurs in cement tanks, allowing the grapes tannin to soften, leaving space for the fruit to express itself and giving light to the wine. The grapes, 100% Sangiovese, come from our younger vines with a planting density of 6250 plants per hectare.

name: Domaine Des Roches Neuves  (Thierry Germain) Les Roches
desc_en_short: Hand-harvest 100% Cabernet Franc from 25+ years old vines by one of the best producer in the Loire Valley, if not in France. The wine has deep beautiful color. The nose reveals the typical character of the grape variety with juicy red fruits and loads of herbs and green pepper. On the palate, the wine is very vibrant with delicious fruit and ripe acid. The body is smooth with great pleasant finish.

name: Innovate  Merlot
desc_en_short: Ideal vintage conditions have provided a wine with intense plum hues and a full flavoured finish. Perfect with pasta, pizza, roast lamb, and Asian Dishes.

name: Castello Banfi  Rosso Di Montalcino DOC
wine_color: Intense ruby red with violet reflections.
desc_en_short: A super-classic of Montalcino and Banfi. A wine able to match the elegance and solidity of its elder counterpart with a freshness and directness that make it one of the most versitile wines within Banfi’s offer. Very enjoyable when released, it is also suitable for a long aging.

name: Biondi Santi  Sassoalloro Toscana Rosso
wine_color: A bright ruby red color with wide purple reflections.
desc_en_short: A bright ruby red color with wide purple reflections. The smell is fresh, innovative, fruity and intense. It has remarkable mammola aromas. The taste is soft, round, velvety and elegant with a long-lived palate. It is very persistent.

name: Planeta  Santa Cecilia Nero d'Avola DOC
desc_en_short: The compact ripe fruit and balsamic notes on the palate dissolve in a sweet and vigorous manner to accompany tannins of dense texture but also open and calibrated to the structure of this wine of deep baritone tones. Traces of graphite confer elements of a high tasting lineage while cleverly elicited wild blackberry and cherry maintain the wine on a register of rigorous style and taste.

name: Chateau La Gaffeliere  1er Grand Cru Classe B 2008
desc_en_short: 93 points in Wine Advocate, Robert Parker - A beautiful deep purple color as well as sweet aromas of incense, charcoal, black fruits, and a hint of black truffles are found in this deep, medium to full-bodied 2008. With pure fruit, good acids, and finely grained, ripe, well-integrated tannins, this impressively endowed, yet unevolved offering may compete with La Gaffeliere’s fabulous 2005, and should age for 20-25 years. Range: 91-93+

name: Chateau Pavie  1er Grand Cru Classe A
desc_en_short: Chateau Pavie's large production has made it more easily available than many other red Bordeaux. It is one of the best-known St. Emilions, vinified in a slightly lighter, more elegant style. With moderate red currant fruit in the nose, plus earth and spice, it can be peppery, spicy, or even leafy with hints of red cherries. Like other wineries in the côtes of St. Emilion, Chateau Pavie makes firm wines that are restrained and austere when young. The occasionally severe tannins mature with age into a fine sinewy structure. The better vintages are deep, intense, and concentrated. They mature 7-20 years after the vintage.

name: Chateau Cheval Blanc 1er Grand Cru Classe A 1995
wine_color: The colour is a very deep ruby-red with some signs of ageing on the rim.
desc_en_short: Chateau Cheval Blanc 1995 is a benchmark Saint-Émilion Premier Grand Cru Classé A, blending 53% Cabernet Franc and 47% Merlot into a deeply complex, opulent wine of remarkable balance — rich with ripe black fruit, roasted nuances, and a finish of extraordinary length.

name: Chateau Pape Clement  2019
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes :

Chateau Pape Clement is one of the brightest stars in the extensive range of vineyards Bernard Magrez owns worldwide. Based in Bordeaux, this great owner has made quality his personal battle. Hence, the care lavished on this land, the exceptional qualities of which have made Pessac's reputation for over seven centuries.

Planted in 1300, the estate is the oldest planted vineyard in the region, when it was presented to Bertrand de Goth upon his appointment as archbishop of Bordeaux, by his brother, Berald. It received its name from Bertrand's papal name, Clement V; on his election in 1306 he gave the estate to his successor as archbishop, Cardinal Arnaud de Canteloup. Bertrand, who would later move the papacy to Avignon near Châteauneuf-du-Pape, planted this original vineyard with red wine grapes.

name: Chateau La Mission Haut-Brion  Grand Cru Classe 2004
desc_en_short: Château La Mission Haut-Brion 2004 is a bewitching Pessac-Léognan Grand Cru Classé, weaving Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, and Cabernet Franc into a silky, complex tapestry of dark fruit, Havana cigar, cedar, and chocolate — generous and seamless from first sip to lingering finish.

name: Bret Brothers  Morgon  Fleurie “Grand Pre”
desc_en_short: This magnificent parcel, located at the heart of 14 hectares of organic vines, at mid-slope, looks at the rising sun. The granite soils are not humid like the clays of the Mâconnais, and yet they are full of life. Such a delicate perfume is emitted from from this lovingly-worked plot. For all seasoned gamay-lovers, or those who simply wish to rediscover this great cru – considered up until the 2nd World War as a jewel of Burgundy.

name: Domaine Thibault Liger-Belair  Bourgogne Rouge “les Grands Chaillots”
desc_en_short: Juicy style with vibrant fruit. A purple hue in the glass, focused red berry character along with powerful structure. This will keep developing well for two to three years.

name: Domaine Thibault Liger-Belair  Moulin-a-vent “les Perelles”
desc_en_short: Domaine Thibault Liger-Belair have purchased eight prime parcels of vines in Moulin-a-Vent. The grapes were sold off in 2008 because they felt it took more than just one year working with the vines to get them to perform. 'My objective was not to buy a domaine, but to buy vineyards in different spots. What is very important for me', says Liger-Belair,'is to showcase the difference between each type of granite and each exposure.' Two refrigerated trucks a day delivered fruit to be pressed in Nuits-Saint-Georges (all destemmed in the 2009 vintage and only gently pumped over to 'infuse', never punched down) and raised in used barriques.

name: Domaine Thibault Liger-Belair  Moulin-a-vent “les Vieilles Vignes”
desc_en_short: This Moulin à Vent cuvée comes from seven plots on granite soil, with vines aged from 65 to 85 years. Dense purple black in colour, with just a whiff of oak on the nose alongside the superbly concentrated fruit. This is a wine of impressive density.

name: Poderi Aldo Conterno  Barolo Bussia DOCG
desc_en_short: Poderi Aldo Conterno's Barolo Bussia DOCG is a benchmark Nebbiolo from the celebrated Bussia cru in Monforte d'Alba, delivering dark fruit, dried roses, iron, and tar with deep, structured tannins that reward patience and cellaring.

name: Passopisciaro  Contrada Chiappemacine IGT
desc_en_short: “Perfumed berry, fragrant blue flower, cake spice and leather are just some of the alluring scents you find on this firmly structured red. The elegant, full-bodied palate offers red cherry, raspberry, clove, menthol and licorice alongside a backbone of tightly wound but refined tannins and bright acidity. Give this a few more years to fully develop. Drink 2019–2025.” — Wine Enthusiast, 93 points

name: Uccelliera  Brunello di Montalcino Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short:
The Brunello di Montalcino is a fleshy and meaty wine that carries its weight and concentration with grace. The wine oozes personality with a long succession of fruit, herbal and dark spice sensations that leave a lasting impression. Fruit is harvested from the Castelnuovo dell’Abate area and is aged in oak for 36 months.

Vinification:
Maturation in Slavonian and French oak barrels for a minimum of 24 months, in special vintages up to 36 months. Bottle ageing for a minimum of 6 months before released for sale.

name: Chanson Pere & Fils  Givry
desc_en_short: Deep ruby colour. Refreshing aromas of cherries mixed with liquorice and spices. Well-crafted and well-structured. Sappy and round with well-integrated tannins. Generous and fruity aftertaste. Pairing with cooked pork meats, pâté, pie, grilled or roasted meat, fowles and "fromages à pâte pressée".

name: De Bortoli  Windy Peak Shiraz
desc_en_short: Deep red with purple edge. Ripe dark fruit aromas with fragrance, spice, plum and black pepper. Plump dark fruits, concentrated, gently layered flavours, fine tannin, soft finish.

name: De Bortoli  Windy Peak Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Deep red with purple edge. Gently leafy, bright fruit, violets, black current. Rich, sweet dark and red fruits, layered tannins, concentrated, lengthy leafy flavours, balanced acidity.

name: De Bortoli  Harvest Diary Shiraz Cabernet
desc_en_short: De Bortoli's Harvest Diary Shiraz Cabernet is an approachable, fruit-driven red from South Eastern Australia, layering ripe cherry, dark plum, and spicy notes with a touch of vanilla oak and silky tannins — an easy-going crowd-pleaser for everyday dining.

name: Jacob's Creek  Classic Grenache Shiraz (750 ml)
desc_en_short: A lively, medium bodied wine showcasing bright berry flavours, subtle toasty oak and a long, fruit-driven finish

name: Jacob's Creek  Winemaker's Selection Shiraz Cabernet
wine_color: Medium to deep red with purple hues
desc_en_short: Jacob's Creek Winemaker's Selection Shiraz Cabernet is a smooth, medium-bodied Australian blend crafted with softer tannins and subtle oak, delivering an approachable, food-friendly style designed to complement a wide range of cuisines with ease.

name: Graffigna  Centenario Malbec  (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Graffigna is a premium wine from one of the best regions in Argentina - San Juan. Extreme temperature and altitude differences slow down the ripening process and produce fruit-driven reds with lovely purity. Graffigna Malbec takes you to the land of passion, complexity and elegance.

name: J. Bouchon  Carmenere Reserva
desc_en_short: The wine has a brilliant deep red color with purple reflections. aroma of wine tones of ripe fruit surrounded by shades of grass, green pepper and soft notes of dark chocolate. The wine has a very pleasant, well-balanced and structured taste with notes of ripe fruit, coffee and dark chocolate.

name: Campogiovanni  Rosso Di Montalcino DOC
desc_en_short: Ruby in appearance, a medium-bodied wine with fragrances of cherry, blackberry, and cedarwood. Crisp and lively, with a silky texture and a seemingly endless finish. Perfect with meat-sauced pastas with mushroom or truffles, dishes of pork or sauced veal.

name: Prunotto  Monpertone Monferrato Rosso DOC
wine_color: Deep ruby red in color with purple highlights
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red in color with purple highlights, richly fruity aromas of plums and cherries with notes of violets, coffee, and spices. The palate is ample, dense, full with soft tannins, elegant and long. It is an excellent match with meat dishes, pot-au-feu, and fresh cheeses.

name: Prunotto  Barbaresco DOCG
desc_en_short: Garnet red in color, of good tonal intensity, complex in aroma with notes of red fruit and spices, full and velvety on the palate with a long finish and aftertaste. Its structured and full-bodied character make it an excellent match for meat dishes and for cheese. Serve at a temperature of 17°

name: Prunotto  Barolo DOCG
wine_color: Garnet red in color with ample
desc_en_short: Prunotto's Barolo DOCG is a classic expression of Nebbiolo from Piedmont, offering complex aromas of violet and ripe berry fruit with a full-bodied, velvety palate shaped by careful skin fermentation and aging in French oak — a benchmark Barolo built for the table.

name: Prunotto  Bussia Barolo DOCG
wine_color: An intense garnet red in color with ruby highlights.
desc_en_short: Barolo Bussia is intensely ruby red with light garnet hues. The nose is complex and precise: notes of red oranges and pink pepper lead to hints of small wild berries and roots. The palate is full and fruity with excellent structure and silky tannins accompanied by extraordinary freshness. The wine closes with a persistent finish that echoes aromas perceived on the nose.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Pignolo DOC
desc_en_short: The grapes, collected in shallow trays are placed in special, well-ventilated drying lofts. As they dry naturally at very low temperatures for about 20 days, their juices become quite concentrated. This is followed by destemming and fermentation on the skins for about three weeks. Starting from the following spring, the Pignolo wine starts a long refining process in barriques that lasts close to 5 years. The aging process is completed in the bottle for a period not less than 2 years. It is wine for a long aging that, in big vintages, may exceed 20 years duration; it is a wine worthy of the finest red meat dishes of the haute cuisine.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Roncaccio Cabernet IGT
desc_en_short: The grapes are destemmed and brought to automatic and temperature controlled stainless steel tanks; the fermentation on the skins lasts about two weeks, while the ageing from the following spring, continues in seasoned oak barrels. It marries well with red and white meat, noble poultry and wild game; hard and long aged cheeses.

name: Eugenio Collavini  More IGT
wine_color: Ruby red, thick and intense, with a deep violet rim.
desc_en_short: Ruby red, thick and intense, with a deep violet rim. The nose is complex, fruity and spicy, with a clear hint of forest fruit, tobacco e licorice. The mouthfeel is rich, full bodied, aromatic and persistent, with an abundance of soft and tender tannins.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Merlot Dal Pic DOC
wine_color: Deep ruby, still tinged with purple at the rim.
desc_en_short: Deep ruby, still tinged with purple at the rim. Complex, intensely concentrated fragrances. Distinct perceptions of forest fruits, spice and liquorice. The rich, fruit-led weave on the palate fuses with the warmth and softness of a great wine to close on sweet, velvety tannins that enhance the persistence of the after-aroma. Perfect partnerings are with red meats, furred game and mature cow's or goat's milk cheeses.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Forresco Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: Deep, strong, ruby-red, almost impenetrable. The nose discloses an absolute complexity, with precise and intense hints of currant, wild blackberry and plum. The smell power extends involving the palate with a series of balsamic and spicy sensations of a rare complexity. The gently strong tannins close with a never-ending aftertaste.

name: Louis Jadot  Pommard
desc_en_short: Louis Jadot Pommard is a firm, fill bodied wine that is nevertheless exceptionally round and generous, with a soft, fruity depth of character and a bouquet suggestive of raspberries. The cuisine capable of honouring Pommard wine has to be quite spicy with a strong flavour : hare, pheasant, entrecôte steak in wine, or cheeses like Epoisses, Livarot, Pont l'Evêque. ...

name: Louis Jadot  Beaune Bressandes Premier Cru
desc_en_short: This Premier Cru is an elegant wine, quite full in body with red fruit aromas, spices and vanilla notes. It will perfectly accompany delicate meat dishes as well as most cheeses.  This wine can be drunk after five years and will easily age 10-15 years in good cellaring conditions.

name: Louis Jadot  Beaune Premier Cru
desc_en_short: Louis Jadot's Beaune Premier Cru is a classically structured Burgundian Pinot Noir, blending fruit from multiple celebrated Beaune crus into an elegantly textured wine of red and black fruit character, warming spice, and genuine aging potential.

name: Louis Jadot  Mercurey
desc_en_short: Louis Jadot Mercurey is a deeply colored, very soft wine that is medium bodied and fruity yet rich, straightforward in character, and intended for youthful. It will be an excellent partner for grilled and roast meats, meat cooked in sauce, mildly flavored game and cheeses.

name: Louis Jadot  Cote De Beaune Villages
desc_en_short: It is a young and fruity wine, with aromas of red fruits, and cherries. With a delicate structure and soft tannins, it will perfectly match with light dishes (hot entrées, white and red meat in light sauce), wine sauce dishes (« meurette » eggs, chicken) and white cheeses (not too strong)

name: Allegrini  La Grola IGT
desc_en_short: This wine is rich and deeply saturated with an inky black color. The bouquet revs up slowly with black prune and plum followed by spice, tar, road paving and cured meat. The effect is extra thick and dense. In the mouth, La Grola displays syrupy richness with both savory and slightly sweet mahogany spice.

name: Chateau Haut-Batailley  2010
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot And 5% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short:
“Château Haut-Batailley is a magnificent property that has always produced great wines. We're particularly happy
that it has passed between two families who have friendly relations and know each other well,” said Jean-Charles
Cazes, general manager of the family-owned group. “This acquisition will strengthen our presence in Pauillac with
the aim of undertaking a project distinct from Lynch-Bages. In order to respect the estate’s identity and the
integrity of its vineyard, the property will be managed independently and have its own dedicated team of technical
experts.”

name: Domaine Alain Voge  Les Peyrouses
desc_en_short: This is a great entry level 100% Syrah from a top producer in Cornas. The wine is inky red with elegant nose of ripe black fruits, plum black raspberry, licorice and spice. The acid is refreshing with multi-layers of flavours. The finish is long and lingering.

name: Santa Duc  Gigondas Aux Lieux-Dits
desc_en_short: “Offering more texture and richness than the Les Hautes Garrigues, the 2013 Gigondas Aux Lieux Dits has terrific Provencal character in its sweet black cherries, peppery herbs, leather and garrigue aromas and flavors. Medium to full-bodied, ripe, textured and thoroughly enjoyable, it has solid mid-palate depth and a great finish. Drink it anytime over the coming decade.”

name: Fundacao Abreu Callado  Infinitum Grande Reserva
desc_en_short: Deep red color, intense aroma, good quality, complex, dominated by the structure and the fruit of the Alicante Bouschet very well combined with  oral notes of the Touriga Nacional. The ageing in wood barrels becomes evident, increasing the complexity of this wine. In the mouth is rich, structuralized and surprisingly long.

name: Herdade Do Gamito  Terras Do Crato
style: Trincadeira, Aragonez, Merlot, Alicante Bouschet And Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: It possesses a ruby color, an aroma with notes of ripe red fruit, which is elaborate and intense, revealing a balanced palate, soft tannins, and good persistence.

name: Herdade Do Peso  Peso Colheita
desc_en_short: A richly structured Portuguese red from Herdade do Peso, blending Aragonez, Alicante Bouschet, and Alfrocheiro into a deeply coloured, aromatic wine with spicy, floral, and smoky complexity, finishing long and satisfying.

name: Herdade Do Peso  Reserva
desc_en_short: Herdade do Peso Reserva is a rich, full-bodied Portuguese red brimming with dark forest fruits and wild herb character, delivering elegantly structured tannins and a long, complex finish that rewards every sip.

name: Quinta Dos Carvalhais  Colheita
desc_en_short: Quinta dos Carvalhais Colheita from the Dão region of Portugal delivers bright ruby elegance, weaving black and red fruit with a signature minty freshness, subtle forest-floor earthiness, and gently integrated oak into a smooth, well-balanced red of genuine character.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Botani "Garnacha
wine_color: Very bright, clean, intense cherry colour with a ruby rim
desc_en_short: Very bright, clean, intense cherry colour with a ruby rim. Deep, rich aromas of red fruit, liquorice, balsam, violet, cocoa, some dim smokey nuances and hints of spices and dry earth. Fresh and well-balanced, with a very precise acidity and a round, smooth body. Loads of red fruit underpinned by some elegant mineral notes and touches of balsam and underbush. Long, pleasant finish.

name: Comenge Winery  Biberius "Roble"
desc_en_short: 100% Tempranillo, aged five months in barrel. Talcumy nose, arguably a touch confected, with floral notes and something a little ashy and dry. Primary fruit on the palate, with a lean, juicy character. It's a fruit-driven, Beaujolais style, elegant.

name: Comenge Winery  Comenge "Crianza"
desc_en_short: Comenge Crianza is a vibrant, fruit-forward Ribera del Duero Tempranillo bursting with red currant, wild strawberry, and balsamic notes, underpinned by vanilla and sweet spice from careful oak aging — fresh, structured, and endlessly drinkable.

name: Comenge Winery  Comenge "Reserva"
desc_en_short: The mouth is soft and wide, but without being opulent, showing throughout its journey the great quality of its tannins, very fine and sweet. Aromatically it is somewhat less fruity and more spicy; We find again ripe red fruit but also vanilla, caramel, scrub and licorice, adding complexity to the whole. The aftertaste is very long and silky, leaving a fresh sensation that invites you to drink.

name: Beronia Winery  Beronia "Crianza"
desc_en_short: This Beronia Crianza shows an intense cherry colour. Attractive nose with red fruits and floral aromas in perfect harmony with mineral and cocoa notes. A balanced and sweet palate with the fruit standing out over a base of chocolate and coffee from the time spent in American oak.

name: Beronia Winery  Beronia Tempranillo Especial
desc_en_short: Intense and deep cherry colour with high intensity. An unusual nose with red fruits and notes of chocolate, cocoa, liquorice and cinnamon from the American oak. Shows a harmonious palate with the cherry dominating. Well integrated oak after 9 months in barrel. Round and fresh, ideal for those looking for something different.

name: Beronia Winery  Beronia "Reserva"
desc_en_short: Beronia Reserva Egives a intense ruby red colour. It shows an attractive nose with candied fruits and plum marmalade in perfect harmony with sweet aromas such as chocolate. On the palate meaty and fruity. The characteristic notes of the Tempranillo variety, cherry and strawberry accompanied by liquorice, dominate and fill the mouth. The balanced acidity and silky tannins guarantee a long and elegant wine.

name: Otto Bestue Winery  Finca Rableros
desc_en_short: Red cherry colour of medium intensity with violet hues. Clean and intensive red ripe fruit over a spicy/vanilla touch from the American and French oak ageing during a few months. Fruity, matured and elegant with a great ?nish on the palate.

name: El Seque Winery  Monastrell By Artadi
food_matching: Charcuterie, Salmon, Mushroom Dishes, Soft Cheese
desc_en_short: Cheerful and Mediterranean, with a mature fruit profile and balsamic freshness.

name: El Seque Winery  El Seque
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short: Powerful balsamic notes, mature fruit, unctuous: a fleshy wine that satisfies the identity of the Monastrell variety from the old vineyards of El Sequé.

name: Vicente Gandia Winery  Puerto De Alicante Shiraz
desc_en_short: This delicious Shiraz has an attractive cherry red colour with garnet iridescences. Its bouquet reveals a combination of deep aromas of wild fruits and violets, enveloped in light toasted notes. On the palate it is warm, with smooth tannins and a spicy finish, and a balsamic aftertaste with blueberry hints.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Tarima Red (Organic)
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Tarima made with Organic Grapes is product of some of the younger estate grown vineyards. Similarly to the vineyards in La Mancha, due to the climate and soils, we farm everything organically, but the certification process is costly and time consuming.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Tarima Hill
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short: Tarima Hill is a complex, elegant, varietal expression of the most authentic clones of Monastrell in the world.

name: Anibal De Otero Winery  Anibal De Otero (Crianza)
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Intense varietal aromas, dominated by red fruits (cherry and cassis) and black (blackberry), and tones of broom and wild herbs.

name: Torello Winery  Raimonda Reserva
desc_en_short: The grapes are harvested manually at their optimum ripeness and transported to the presses in less than 15 minutes after being harvested in order to avoid any early oxidation or fermentation.

name: Matsu (Vintae) Winery  Matsu El Pícaro
wine_color: A great robe and a profound color
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: This wine has a great robe and a profound color, an expression of its young age. It has an intense aroma in which one can find dark fruits such as blackberries and blueberries, mineral notes also appear, creating this fresh wine with complexity. In the mouth, again this wine dominates the fruitful sensations, perceived as a wine with body; though at the same time its leaves pleasant lickerish sensations, contributed by the maturity of the grapes from which this wine is made.

name: Matsu (Vintae) Winery  Matsu El Recio
desc_en_short: This is a corpulent wine also having a lot of finesse, with an intense nose having notes of chocolate, black fruits and vanilla. In the mouth the taste is striking, being predominantly round and silky, very unctuous with subtle hints of the glycerine. Touches of fruits linger in the after taste as do mineral notes. This is a full body wine yet at the same time very easy to drink.

name: Matsu (Vintae) Winery  Matsu El Viejo
desc_en_short: A deep cherry color, high lamina, with violet colored notes in its border. Thanks to the barrel aging the wine acquired a very intense nose with mature black fruit aromas, well integrated with the toasted, spiced and smoked notes. Corpulent in the mouth with very mature and round tannins that give its sweetness. In the long and persistent aftertaste appear once again mature fruit perfectly assembled with the roasted character of the wood.

name: Almaviva  2012
wine_color: Deep, intense and attractive ruby red color.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 24% Carménère, 8% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot And 1% Merlot.
desc_en_short:
The premium French-Chilean wine, Made from a blend of classic Bordeaux varieties, in which Cabernet Sauvignon predominates, Almaviva is the result of a felicitous encounter between two cultures.

Almaviva 2012

Made from a blend of classic Bordeaux varieties, in which Cabernet Sauvignon predominates, Almaviva is an exceptionally elegant and complex wine. Deep, intense and attractive ruby red color. The bouquet is pure and forward, revealing clean aromas of blackberries, blackcurrant and licorice, associated with subtle notes of vanilla, dark chocolate, incense and spices.

name: De Bardos  Épica "Roble"
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: It is a tasty and persistent wine as a result of the perfect balance achieved between acidity and ripe tannins.

name: De Bardos  Romántica "Crianza"
wine_color: Deep cherry red colour, with a violet rim and deep robe.
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Deep cherry red colour, with a violet rim and deep robe. Full of fruit and licorice, combined with notes of aging. Full bodied on thepalate, silky and pleasant with a perfectly polished tannin and an agreeable finish, leaving an aftertaste reminiscent of black fruit and undergrowth.

name: De Bardos  Mítica "Reserva"
wine_color: Violet cherry black with a very deep robe.
desc_en_short: Violet cherry black with a very deep robe. Complex and attractive aroma with the predominance of black fruit, chocolate and fine French oak wood. Fleshy and powerful, unfolding on the palate to reveal the strong personality of this Tinta del País variety, produced from very old vines. Sweet and elegant tannin.

name: Hacienda Lopez De Haro  Tempranillo
desc_en_short: Very pleasant wine with a seet attack, followed by a nice acidity and ripe tannins, wich provides it with a long and pleasant aftertaste

name: Hacienda Lopez De Haro  Crianza
wine_color: Deep red cherry colour with roof tile tones
desc_en_short: Smooth and velvety wine with sweet and ripe tanning that make it a pleasant and easy-drinking wine with a long aftertaste

name: Hacienda Lopez De Haro  Reserva
wine_color: Medium-high depth wine, ruby red colour with roof tile rim, which denotes its long barrel ageing and its peaceful bottle ageing.
desc_en_short: Powerful on the nose with primary aromas of ripe fruit accompanied by complex spicy and balsamic notes and a slight touch of vanilla. Balanced on the palate, it is a round and unctuous wine with ripe and sweet tannins, providing the wine with a long aftertaste: an elegant Rioja classic.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Wrongo Dongo
desc_en_short: Wrongo Dongo is a bold, characterful Monastrell from Jorge Ordóñez Winery, grown on ancient limestone soils in southern Spain. Expect rich dark fruit, earthy depth, and a touch of French oak in a wine that punches well above its price point.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Madam Bobalu
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Winemaking : Fermentation in stainless steel tanks by indigenous yeast. Malolactic fermentation in tank.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Venta Morales
desc_en_short: Venta Morales is project between Jorge Ordóñez and Rafael Cañizares with the goal of producing the highest quality entry level wine possible from young leased vineyards planted near Casa de los Pinos that the partners control. Dry farmed and planted on trellis, the Tempranillo is vinified in stainless steel in order to retain the freshness and aromatic fruit of the local clones of Tempranillo.

name: Otto Bestue Winery  Navateros "Crianza"
wine_color: Red cherry colour of medium intensity.
desc_en_short: Red cherry colour of medium intensity. Clean and intensive red ripe fruits aroma over a spicy/vanilla and toasted notes from the american oak ageing during 8 months. Friendly and creamy palate, fresh feeling in mouth thanks to the soft tannins, allowing to perceive ripen berries flavours over a noted vanilla toasted notes. Paring with starters, meats, cheese, pastas and desserts

name: Otto Bestue Winery  Bestué "Joven"
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red color. Estate grown Syrah and Garnacha brings ripe cherry and black pepper aromas. On the palate it is expressive and velvet like with hints of delicate toast notes due to its time spent in the barrel.

name: Otto Bestue Winery  Bestué Santa Sabina "Reserva"
wine_color: Intense red cherry colour with garnet highlights.
desc_en_short: Intense red cherry colour with garnet highlights. Concentrated aromas with ripe cherry and plum fruits supported by spices and toasted overtones from the oak ageing. Structured, balanced and fleshy with a broad and embracing finish.

name: Teso La Monja Winery  Romanico
desc_en_short: Romanico by Teso La Monja is an expressive, fruit-forward Toro red crafted from old-vine Tinta de Toro, aged six months in French oak for a fresh, balanced, and approachable expression of one of Spain's most characterful appellations.

name: Vigneti del Salento  Negroamaro Vigne Vecchie IGP
wine_color: Deep ruby red with garnet red reflections.
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red with garnet red reflections. Intense and complex aroma with spicy hints of tobacco and leather, and fruity notes of berries. To the mouth, it is impressive and robust, with well-trained tannins and a special smoothness, that make the wine persistent. Good with rich first courses, red meats and seasoned cheeses.

name: Chateau Montrose  2009
wine_color: Deep and dense, dark color with dark ruby tints.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 29% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

Deep and dense, dark color with dark ruby tints. The nose is complex with morello, core of cherry and blackberry. It delivers notes of citron and spices (saffron). Aromas of redcurrant, cassis, morello, cocoa and liquorice develop on the palate. Supple and long-lasting finish on neat, coated and very precise tannins. Complex, balanced and harmonious wine. The tasting reveals very homogeneous, soft and silky. Incredibly long finish.

name: Jean Michel Gerin  Saint Joseph
desc_en_short: Beautiful nose of red fruits, cherry, roasted coffee and very fine oak. On the palate, very fine and elegant. Bright acid with superb balance. Smooth velvet body with good long finish.

name: Cono Sur  Ocio Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Cono Sur's prestige Pinot Noir from Casablanca Valley, Ocio delivers an elegant depth of ruby fruit, white flowers, and violet aromas, with a silky, richly textured palate shaped by Chile's cool-climate terroir — a benchmark expression of the variety in South America.

name: Cono Sur  Silencio Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A wine with an intense ruby red coloring that features delicious aromas of red fruits, berries, violet and cassis, along with beautifully integrated oak and hints of tobacco and ash. The palate has a great balance and concentration with smooth, seductive tannins and a long finish. A lively wine, complex and original.

name: Chateau St. Jean  "Cinq Cepages" Sonoma Country Red Blend
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, 3% Cabernet Franc, 3% Malbec And 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Chateau St. Jean's flagship Bordeaux-style blend draws from elite Sonoma County vineyards — Knights Valley, Moon Mountain, and Dry Creek among them — delivering a lush, full-bodied red layered with dark currant, milk chocolate, and lavender, framed by beautifully polished tannins.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Mephisto MMXIII
desc_en_short: This is a fantastic red from a white wine region which requires a lot of effort and patience to get the right ripeness. The wine is aged in amphora and used barrel for 15 months. Generous, round, red and black berries with notes of white pepper on the nose. On the palate, the wine is dense yet delicate and elegant with great delicious finish.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Ange MMXV
desc_en_short: This is one of the most sought-after wine from Fred of Domaine de l’Ecu with tiny production. It’s a 100% Pinot Noir from Loire with great finess and complexity. Intense yet delicate nose of blackberry, violet and fine spices. The body is smooth with velvetly tannin. Long and very plesant finish.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Invictus MMXV
desc_en_short: Domaine de l'Ecu's flagship Cabernet Franc, macerated eight months in amphora to yield a hauntingly complex Loire red — layers of black fruit, wild berry, menthol, camphor, and bitter cacao converging on a palate that is both powerful and elegantly refined.

name: Chateau St. Jean  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Chateau St. Jean's California Cabernet Sauvignon delivers a lush cascade of blackberry, fresh plum, and black cherry fruit, layered with chocolate and black tea notes, all wrapped in a well-structured, juicy frame with a full, lingering finish.

name: Masseria Li Veli  Primitivo Montecoco Salento IGT
wine_color: Dense ruby red with a purplish rim
desc_en_short: Ruby red in colour with bright violet shimmer. On the nose it is strongly intense, rich and elegant, with red and black berries, plums, sweet spices, brushwood and Mediterranean scrub. On the palate it is a big flavor with a sweet and fat start followed by a dense and long tannins. Fruity, long and spiced aftertaste.

name: Masseria Li Veli  Pezzo Morgana Salice Salentino DOC Riserva
desc_en_short: A single-vineyard Salice Salentino Riserva from Masseria Li Veli, where century-old bush vines of Negroamaro yield a richly structured, velvety wine layered with prune, cherry jam, white pepper, and a long finish of raisins and toasted almond.

name: Ricasoli  Casalferro IGT (Merlot)
wine_color: Intense ruby red tending towards garnet as it ages.
desc_en_short: Casalferro was first produced in 1993  when Francesco Ricasoli became president of the company. A pure Merlot produced only during the best years, Casalferro is obtained from the vineyard of the same name located at 400 meters above sea level and facing south. The brown clay loam soil with little organic content contributes to the exclusive personality of this great Chianti Merlot.

name: Col Solare 2013
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 6% Cabernet Franc, 4% Merlot, 2% Syrah
desc_en_short: Col Solare is the partnership between two influential wine producers who are recognized leaders in their respective regions: Tuscany’s Marchesi Antinori and Washington State’s Chateau Ste. Michelle. Col Solare, Italian for “shining hill,” realizes the partners’ mission to unite two unique viticultural and winemaking cultures to produce an ultra-luxury, limited production Cabernet Sauvignon-based wine.

name: Jean Foillard  Fleurie
desc_en_short: The Fleurie has a rounded, sensual bouquet of raspberry coulis and blueberry scents interlaced with rose petals. The palate is medium-bodied with an effervescent orange zest opening, superb acidity and an energetic, tensile finish that is concentrated and precise. This is a Fleurie from the very top drawer.

name: Le Salette  La Marega Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico DOCG
style: Corvina And Corvinone,30% Rondinella,oseleta And Dindarella
desc_en_short:
Vineyards : La Marega vineyard, located in Fumane, in the heart of Valpolicella Classica

Wine making : Careful selection of grapes during manual harvest, followed by natural drying process for approximately 4 months.

Wine aging : 36 months in Slavonian oak cask (70%) and barrique (30%), 8 months in bottle. Long lasting wine, could be enjoyed for 25 years.

Wine pairing : Roasted, grilled meat, game, aged cheese, risotto with amarone or red chicory.

Wine serving temperature : 18°C/ 64°F. Best to open one hour ahead of serving

name: Pieropan  Amarone Della Valpolicella DOC
wine_color: Brilliant and intense ruby red in colour.
style: Corvina, 35% Corvinone, Rondinella, Croatina , 5% From Old Traditional Valpolicella Varieties
desc_en_short: Brilliant and intense ruby red in colour. Characterful wine a heady perfume of black cherries, blackberries and plums. On the palate it is complex and rounded, whit a powerful structure supporting the fruit and a lovely freshness on the finish. A wine with plenty of character whit the potential to age well. It makes an excellent partner for game dishes, grilled or braised meat, powerfully flavoured and mature cheeses. It is also ideal served among friends at the end of the meal.

name: Domaine Attilon  Pinot Noir Rouge IGP
desc_en_short: The Vintage 2013 was the first harvest of this grape variety which the estate produces a wine 100% Pinot Black. The younger vines produce nice tannins that soften over time. Tasting lightly robe, cherry aromas Raspberry delight the palate with soft tannins and freshness. A slightly spicy finish Medium Bodied.

name: Chateau Meyre Gallen De Margaux
desc_en_short: One of the first Organic Margaux, Gallen de Chateau Meyre is a premium produced, only two hectares. "Enclos Gallen is made in the tradition of classic Margaux wines, complexity, finesse which is in perfect harmony with its structure, aging brings out the powerful aromas and elegant flavors.

name: Chateau Ferriere  2013
style: Cabernet Sauvignon 65%, Merlot 30 % And Cabernet Franc 5 %,
desc_en_short: Château Ferrière 2013 is the Médoc's smallest Grand Cru Classé — just 8 hectares in the heart of Margaux — delivering elegant, silky Bordeaux with fresh blackcurrant, plum, and polished tannins at a price that punches well above its weight.

name: Chateau Couhins  2010
desc_en_short: Edouard Gasqueton who also Owned Chateau Calon Segar managed Chateau Couhins Cru Classe de Graves in 1959 Today Mr Adre Lurton Managed. This is a beautifully textured velvety wine with generous plum flavors range from cassis Spices to blackberries Soft tannins it perfectly embodies the elegance of the great wines of Graves.

name: Chateau Latour-Martillac  2005
style: Cabernet Sauvignon 60%, Merlot 35% And Petit Verdot 5%
desc_en_short:
The 2005 vintage mostly owes its exceptional quality to the drought that went on during the whole year, apart from april. This dry and mild weather had been ideal and led to a fast and homogeneous blooming in early June. The vine gave us berries that were not only sweet and colored, but also with an excellent acidity level, thus helping the expression of ripe fruits and silky tannins.

The beautiful weather we had during the harvest allowed us to pick the red berries in the best of conditions. The yields were lower than usual, mainly because of the small size of the Cabernet Sauvignon from the graves soils. It’s the crossing of several favourable events that made the different elements of this vintage higher in quality: the sweetness, color, acidity, aromas, tannins…

name: Chateau La Fleur  Saint Emilion Grand Cru 2011
desc_en_short: This comes from vines average 50 years of age this Saint Emilion remains one of the top values plays in Bordeaux wine reaching 14.5%alcohal,Chateau La Fleur shows licorice black cherry jam aromas soft round texture Saint Emilion a sweet black raspberry finish Medium to Full Bodied . Wine spectator

name: Chateau Larmande  Saint Emilion Grand Cru Classe 2012
desc_en_short: Very good wines here at Chateau Larmande this estate Since 1585 which makes it one of the Oldest in the appellation Claire Thomas-Heard runs the estate, 25 hectares.

name: Chateau Fonplegade  Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2012
desc_en_short: The Vintage 2012 Chateau Fonplegade a major success for the vintage, possesses a dense purple color with sweet blueberry, black raspberry with a hint of spring flowers, sweet tannins a medium to full bodied mouth feel, excellent fruit, texture, opulence and richness. Enlisted the services of world-renowned Oenologist Michel Rolland

name: Prios Maximus Crianza  2010
desc_en_short: Its color is dark red, ruby meniscus. It has a warm appearance and an unctuous tear. Its bouquet is intense and balsamic. Highlights are aromas of red fruits, spicy nuances, cocoa and white flowers. On the palate, this wine is well-rounded, exhibiting fruit nuances with a silky finish.

name: Chateau Ducru Beaucaillou  2012
desc_en_short: Château Ducru Beaucaillou 2012 is a benchmark Saint-Julien from one of the Médoc's most storied Second Growths, blending 91% Cabernet Sauvignon with 9% Merlot into a wine of commanding structure, mineral precision, and effortless elegance with a notably long finish.

name: Tenuta dell'Ornellaia  Ornellaia Bolgheri DOC ‘L’Essenza’ (Artist Label)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 32% Merlot, 20% Petit Verdot, 14% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short:
The Brazilian artist Ernesto Neto has been chosen to interpret the character ‘L’Essenza’ (The Essence) of the Ornellaia 2014 vintage. For the ninth edition of the project Vendemmia d’Artista he has created a work of art for the estate, customized a limited series of bottles in large format, and designed a label that, expressing the vintage character, will be inserted in each Ornellaia case containing 6 bottles of 750ml.

Inspiration

Central to the current presentation is Neto’s exploration of shamanism as science, the natural world and its phenomena, and community based crafts. In 2014, Neto and members of the Huni Kuin embarked on a series of artistic exchanges that investigate the rituals and shamanistic traditions. The Huni Kuin’s spiritual life, their desire for healing in harmony with nature, and the wisdom and serenity they draw from their deep connection with the energy of the planet, introduced into Neto’s work a new awareness about nature strenght and its dynamics. Drawing inspiration from these traditions, medicines and customs, his new body of work speaks of internal transformation, and adds layers of meaning to his inquiry into connectivity as a social and ecological concern.

name: Chateau Grand-Puy-Lacoste  2009
desc_en_short: 95 points Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "Performing better from bottle than it did from cask (and comparable to their wines 2005, 2000, 1990 and 1982), this is a great classic from Xavier Borie’s estate situated on the back roads west of the town of Pauillac. Its dense ruby/purple color is followed by hints of spring flowers, crushed rocks, black currants, cedar and earth/underbrush. Precise and elegant as well as backward and foreboding, it should put on weight in the bottle and evolve for two decades. Very concentrated as well as velvety-textured, it is a beauty of finesse, balance, purity and nobility. It will benefit from 5-7 more years of bottle age."

name: Domaine Joseph Roty Marsannay Les Ouzeloy
desc_en_short: From 80+ year old vines.A subtle application of toast presently sits atop black cherry, plum and warm earth aromas that precede the supple and more refined medium-bodied flavors that possess ample amounts of dry extract as well as fine volume, all wrapped in a sappy and unusually persistent and mildly woody finish.

name: Domaine Joseph Roty  Gevrey-Chambertin Premier Cru Les Fontenys 2011
desc_en_short: From one of Burgundy's most revered cult domaines, this Les Fontenys Premier Cru delivers richly layered red and dark berry intensity with lush mineral depth, fine structural tension, and a beautifully balanced, mildly austere finish — a benchmark expression of Gevrey-Chambertin.

name: Domaine Joseph Roty  Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru Tres Vieilles Vignes
desc_en_short: From one of Burgundy's most revered cult domaines, this Charmes-Chambertin Grand Cru Très Vieilles Vignes from Domaine Joseph Roty delivers a powerfully concentrated yet elegantly structured Pinot Noir, with cool red and dark currant aromatics, subtle oak, and a hauntingly persistent finish built for the long cellar.

name: Domaine Raspail-Ay  Gigondas
desc_en_short: Domaine Raspail-Ay's Gigondas is a beautifully crafted southern Rhône blend of Grenache, Syrah, and Mourvèdre — generous and richly fruited yet refined, with supple tannins shaped by extended ageing in ancient oak foudres and demi-muids.

name: Domaine de Mus  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: A rare and charming Old World Pinot Noir from the Hérault in the Languedoc, Domaine de Mus delivers fragrant strawberry, sweet cherry, and garrigue aromatics with an elegantly textured, smooth palate — exceptional value from one of southern France's most transparent producers.

name: Caricature  Old Vine Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Deep purple color. Aromas of sweet tobacco, wild berries, vanilla, and gingerbread with a velvety, crisp, fruity medium-full body and an engaging, medium-length boysenberry jam, nutella, and black licorice finish with chewy tannins and moderate oak flavor. A lip smacking zin that hits all the right notes.

name: Caricature  Red Wine
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel, Petit Sirah, Sangiovese And Tannat
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, Sangiovese, Tannat
desc_en_short: A bold California red blend led by Cabernet Sauvignon with Zinfandel, Petite Sirah, Sangiovese, and Tannat, delivering ripe blackberry, cherry, and plum fruit layered with spicy oak and a lush, jammy finish — an easygoing crowd-pleaser for any table.

name: Henschke  Hill Of Grace Shiraz, Eden Valley
desc_en_short: Deep ruby with ruby hues. Ethereal and exotic aromas of blackberry and blood plum with five-spice; star anise, clove, fennel seed, cinnamon and black pepper, and more subtle hints of bay leaf and crushed flowering herbs. The palate is plush, deep, complex and powerful, with a core of supple blackberry and blueberry fruit laden with spice and pepper, and beautifully balanced by fine acidity resolving into a long and elegant finish of rolling, velvety tannins.

name: Henschke  Cyril Henschke Cabernet Sauvignon, Eden Valley
desc_en_short: Deep ruby with garnet hues. Lovely complex aromas of cassis, red currant and mulberry interwoven with anise, oregano, thyme, violets and tobacco leaf. The palate delivers layers of vibrant and pure black currant and plum, balanced by hints of cedar and vanilla pod. Lively acidity and fine-grained tannins provide a long, defined, mouth-coating finish.

name: Rockford  Rifle Range Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Rockford Rifle Range Cabernet Sauvignon is a richly structured Barossa red drawn from old-vine parcels along Rifle Range Road, where heavy 'Biscay' clay soils deliver deep, earthy flavours and cellar-worthy depth — a compelling expression of a grape variety with deep roots in the valley.

name: Rockford  Moppa Springs Grenache Shiraz Mataro
desc_en_short: Moppa Springs, Ebenezer and Kalimna are some of the driest areas in the Barossa, where green vines grow on one side of the fence and ripened wheat on the other. This hard country is cold, wet and frosty during pruning - then hot, dry and dusty during harvest: the kind of tough conditions that ensure Grenache, Mataro and Shiraz give their best. These varieties and the families who grow them earned the right to represent the Barossa in this traditional blend by surviving for more than 150 years when others could not.

name: Rockford  Frugal Farmer
desc_en_short: Rockford's Frugal Farmer is a characterful Barossa Valley Grenache and Mataro blend delivering delicate floral and mineral layers, bright red fruits of cherry and raspberry, and a dry, spice-driven finish laced with black pepper and saddle leather.

name: Yalumba  Rare & Fine The Caley Cabernet & Shiraz
style: Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon And Barossa Shiraz
desc_en_short: The Caley is the pinnacle of a long winemaking journey of excellence, that rightfully honours one of Yalumba’s most adventurous sons. A blend of Coonawarra Cabernet Sauvignon and Barossa Shiraz, The Caley is a classic marriage of two noble varieties and two great Australian wine regions.

name: Yalumba  Rare & Fine The Octavius Old Vine Shiraz
desc_en_short: One of Australia's most celebrated Shirazes, Yalumba The Octavius Old Vine Shiraz draws from some of the world's oldest vines across the Barossa and Eden Valley, matured in both fine French oak and Yalumba's own coopered American octave barrels for a wine of extraordinary depth and character.

name: Yalumba  Rare & Fine The Signature Cabernet Sauvignon & Shiraz
desc_en_short: It is with great pleasure we release our 55th iteration of Yalumba The Signature Cabernet Sauvignon & Shiraz – a superb 2013 vintage that honours Andrew Murphy. We raise a glass of this wine to celebrate Murph’s years of service, commencing in the Cellar he rose to Cellar Manager, qualified as a Winemaker, was promoted to Operations Manager in 1992 and today is Director of Wine.

name: Yalumba  Rare & Fine Collection The Menzies Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Full depth in colour with a plum red hue.
desc_en_short: Full depth in colour with a plum red hue. The bouquet leads with violet and lilac floral notes to the tangy counterpoint of seaspray and pepper. The palate is rich and powerful; red fruits and dark chocolate on a robust tannin framework. The finish is long, complex and well worth contemplating. A char-grilled rib-eye on the bone is an excellent food accompaniment.

name: Yalumba  Distinguished Sites The Cigar Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: This wine is plum red in colour and medium to full depth in hue.
desc_en_short: The Cigar; a name coined by Coonawarra Vignerons to describe the unique cigar-shaped strip of rich red terra rossa soil. Home to some of Australia’s most famous vineyards, the secret of Coonawarra lies in the intimate bond between the terra rossa soil, limestone layers, pure artisan water and a long cool ripening season. Fortunate to be part of this iconic place, Yalumba salutes the region’s pioneers and those privileged to inherit its future.

name: Domaine Joseph Roty  Gevrey-Chambertin
desc_en_short: Mild wood influence frames very fresh red and blue pinot fruit, earth and mineral-infused aromas that are very Gevrey in character that give way to voluminous and cool middle weight flavors that . possess fine dry extract that imparts a lovely sense of volume as well as buffers the moderately firm tannins on the persistent and toasty finish.

name: Chateau Maucaillou  2009
desc_en_short: This has a well defined red-berried nose with just a hint of apricot and orange sorbet...very Margaux like and it improves with aeration. The palate however, is delectable from the start: beautiful balance at the core of which are filigree tannins and a supremely well poised red-berried finish. This is a superb Maucaillou.

name: Bodega Volcanes de Chile  Parinacota
desc_en_short: The aromas on this Carignan-Syrah blend are gritty and suggest asphalt, smoked meat and dark berry notes. It feels electric and tight on the palate, yet controlled, with rubbery tannins and plenty of herb, pepper, spice and licorice notes to go with the oak-infused berry flavor.

name: Chateau Du Lort  AOC Bordeaux Superieur
wine_color: A deep crimson colour with good concentration.
desc_en_short: Working in harmony with nature and the vineyard has allowed us to produce some very pleasing wines: well-coloured and full of fruit, with fine tannins and delightful flavours.

name: Chateau Montlabert  AOC Sant Emillion Grand Cru
wine_color: Crimson in colour with a delicate shimmer.
desc_en_short: Château Montlabert's Saint-Émilion Grand Cru is a classically structured Merlot-Cabernet Franc blend aged 14 months in French oak with bâtonnage, delivering powerful dark fruit, spice, and exceptional cellaring potential from one of Bordeaux's most celebrated appellations.

name: Domaine de Fa  Beaujolais en Besset
desc_en_short: The Graillot family recently acquired 5 hectares of vines in the cru of Saint Amour (in the climat of Côte de Besset) from which this charming, juicy Beaujolais is produced - alongside a full St-Amour. It's organic to boot.

name: Domaine de Fa  Fleurie roche Guillon
desc_en_short: A Fleurie from the legendary Graillot family known for their ability to produce some of the most age-worthy and delicious Syrah from Northern Rhône. The Fleurie Roche Guillon comes from a single vineyard with soil of crushed granite and clay. The site is one of the highest vinyard in Fleurie with steep west-facing slope. The Graillot brothers use whole cluster fermentation with a semi-carbonic maceration. The wine is then aged in old foudre for 1 - 3 years.

name: Jean Foillard  Morgon Classique
desc_en_short: The Gamay lover can only be delighted by the wines of Jean Foillard. This true passionate was able to raise high the quality of each one of his cuvees, always with the perfect mastery of the fruit. This is the generous side of the fruit that typifies the best his Morgon coming from his younger vines. A little delicacy with a pretty freshness to be enjoyed now !

name: Jean Foillard  Morgon Cote du Py
desc_en_short: Jean Foillard's Morgon Côte du Py is a benchmark natural Beaujolais from one of the appellation's most celebrated domaines — pure, floral, and earthy Gamay grown on volcanic schist soils, delivering a silky, expressive red with rare depth and elegance.

name: Jean Foillard  Morgon Cuvée 3.14
desc_en_short:
Morgon Cuvée 3.14

Grapes from one hundred-year-old vines are used to make this fine, no nonsense, silky, deep, and authentic Morgon. Jean Foillard didn’t become a legend without earning his stripes

Jean Foillard

Jean Foillard and his wife Agnes became the proprietors of Jean’s family vineyard in 1980. The 35-acre domaine has parcels outside of Villié-Morgan in the prestigious Beaujolais appellations of Morgon and Fleurie. Jean was influenced early in his career by the traditionalist vigneron techniques championed by Jules Chauvet, the late, highly influential Beaujolais negociant who believed in natural winemaking. As Chauvet advocated, Foillard carefully tends his old vines, banning all herbicides and pesticides, harvesting late and taking a very minimalist approach in the cellar. The domaine wins compliments from reviewers. Wine Advocate has noted that the domaine’s wines “are wonderful, life-affirming expressions of Beaujolais…If you are still under the misguided belief that Beaujolais cannot make world class wine, then you have not tasted the wines from Jean Foillard.”

name: Les Bertrand  Fleurie Coup d’folie
desc_en_short: This cuvee made of 100% Gamay showcases aromas of red cherries, raspberry coulis, strawberry jam, yeast and a touch of volatility. The palate has sharp acidity, decent concentration, ripe and round tannins, and good length.

name: Les Bertrand  Fleurie Cuvée du Chaos
desc_en_short: 100% Gamay from 80-110 year old vines grown on granitic sand. Organic farming. Carbonic maceration a froid with native yeast and without SO2 for 17-20 days. 7-9 month aging 225-liter in used barrels (minimum 10 years old)

name: Les Bertrand  Morgon Bio Dynamite
desc_en_short: 100% Gamay from 80-100 year old vines.  Organic farming. Carbonic maceration a froid with native yeast and without SO2 for 17-20 days. 7-9 month aging 225-liter in used barrels (minimum 10 years old)

name: Terres Dorées (Jean Paul Brun)  Bourgogne Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Bright ruby-red. Fresh and energetic on the nose, displaying fresh raspberry and cherry flavors and a zesty mineral overtone. In a lithe, precise style with good focus to its bitter cherry and red berry flavors. A spine of juicy acidity lifts the fruit and carries it through a long, seamless finish that leaves a subtle white pepper note behind...

name: Viu Manent  Vibo Punta del Viento
wine_color: Intense ruby red with a mahogany red hue.
desc_en_short:
Tasting Notes

Purplish ruby red in color. Very complex and elegant on the nose with pronounced personality, primarily recalling red fruits. The palate is very fresh, vibrant, and juicy with a long finish.

name: Terre del Vulcano  Lava Aglianico Beneventano IGT
desc_en_short: Ruby red with violet rim, complexe and intense fragrance. aromas of red fruit ,slightly spicy, with a vanilla essence. Well structured in the mouth , with soft tannins and a long after taste.

name: Wolf Blass  Blass Shiraz
desc_en_short: Bold and spicy, Shiraz is the ultimate in dark berry opulence. Deeply aromatic, plush and filled with flavour, Shiraz displays both refined elegance and powerful fruit, giving it the versatility to suit the richest red meat dishes, and the soft lushness to complement a wide range of flavoursome foods.

name: Wolf Blass  Blass Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Blass Reserve Release Cabernet Sauvignon is a smooth, rich red wine with black cassis, mulberry leaf and eucalypt aromas, and plush, plummy flavours. The classic match with lamb, Cabernet Sauvignon is delicious paired with grilled and roasted red meats, hearty pasta dishes or aged hard cheese.
