name: Wolf Blass  Blass Reserve Shiraz
desc_en_short: Blass Reserve Release Shiraz is a smooth, rich red wine with an aromatic nose of black cherry and blueberry, with velvety tannins and a long palate.

name: Wolf Blass  Presidents Selection Gold Label Year of the Dog Shiraz
desc_en_short: Wolf Blass President's Selection Gold Label ‘Year of the Dog’ Shiraz is a rich red wine with aromas of blueberry and blackberry, and a full-bodied palate with generous layers of dark fruits enhanced with creamy oak and plush, velvety tannins. Shiraz pairs well with grilled, roast and barbecued red meats, dark fruit sauces, Mexican, Turkish and Chinese spices, and smoky flavours.

name: Wolf Blass  Presidents Selection Gold Label Year of the Dog Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Wolf Blass President’s Selection Gold Label ‘Year of the Dog’ Cabernet Sauvignon has lifted, varietal cassis aromas, enhanced with notes of bay leaf and mocha. A medium to full bodied red wine with structured, yet finely grained tannins. Cabernet Sauvignon pairs well with red meats, hearty pasta dishes, Cheddar cheese, broccoli, fennel, rosemary and mint. Wolf Blass President’s Selection Gold Label Cabernet Sauvignon is great with seared wagyu, or stir fried beef.

name: Beringer  Private Reserve Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
#24 on James Suckling Top 100 Wines in the World 2018

The brothers Frederick and Jacob Beringer established Beringer in 1876 in the belief that Napa could be a premier wine-growing region like Germany’s Rhine River Valley, from which they hailed. The brothers quickly made Beringer famous for producing world-class wines, a legacy that continues to this day and reaches its finest expression in our Private Reserve series.

To make these small-production wines, fifth-generation winemaker Mark Beringer chooses the best lots from our reserve vineyards in the Napa Valley, each demonstrating a different aspect of Napa’s prized terroir. Beringer’s Private Reserve wines have become famous as one of the truest expressions of a given vintage.

WINEMAKING NOTE

Beringer’s reserve vineyards offer Cabernet Sauvignon of such quality that a minimalist approach to winemaking has long defined this special blend. Each vineyard is vinified separately, and tailored pump-over techniques are used for optimal extraction. The wine is aged for 20 months in hand-selected, custom-toasted barrels of French Nevers oak (85% new) before assemblage, where winemaker Mark Beringer prioritizes the expression of vintage and our vineyards’ unique terroir.

name: Poker Hill  Shiraz / Merlot
wine_color: This is a well-rounded blend of noble red cultivars.
desc_en_short: This is a well-rounded blend of noble red cultivars. Ripe berry aromas on the nose are followed by smooth soft fruitiness on the palate and a gentle dry finish. Easy to drink & excellent value for-money.

name: Backstage  Napa Valley Cabernet sauvignon
wine_color: This is a well-rounded blend of noble red cultivars.
desc_en_short: The result is deep, rich, intense flavors of ripe blackberries, and aromas of chocolate perfume. Wonderfully balanced tannins melt on your tongue from oak barrel aging (100% new oak). There are also interesting flavors of dark fruit and coffee bean, exciting the palate. The finish is simultaneously smooth and rich – at the same time. Enjoy this luxurious wine.

name: Mount Riley  Merlot Malbec
desc_en_short: Mount Riley's Estate Range (pictured right) is great quality and value. Each wine in this range is fresh with pure, vibrant fruit flavours and aromas.

name: Mount Riley  Syrah
desc_en_short: Mount Riley's Estate Range (pictured right) is great quality and value. Each wine in this range is fresh with pure, vibrant fruit flavours and aromas.

name: Vega Sicilia  Macon Clasico
desc_en_short: Macán Clásico is the pure expression of Rioja Tempranillo grapes with a modern production reinforcing its elegance and a careful ageing to enhance its fineness. 2013 was a complex year where extensive selection was carried out. Sober vintage; fresh, pleasant and elegant.

name: Sierra Cantabria  Seleccion
desc_en_short: A carbonic maceration Tempranillo from La Rioja, young and direct, with all the guarantees of a Sierra Cantabria wine. A Picota cherry colour, clean and bright, it displays aromas of well-ripened red and black fruits with notes of liquorice. The nose is intense and persistent. On the palate, it shows plenty of body and ripe tannins, fresh, silky, well-balanced and fruit-forward.

name: Vega Sicilia  Valbuena 5°
desc_en_short: Vega Sicilia's Valbuena 5° is a landmark Ribera del Duero red — a Tinto Fino and Merlot blend aged five years before release — delivering extraordinary complexity with fine-grained tannins, vivid acidity, and layers of dark fruit, balsamic herbs, and spice that reward both immediate pleasure and long cellaring.

name: Dominio de Pingus  Psi
desc_en_short: Fresh and classy nose of cherries, currants and raspberries with hints of pepper. Full body, beautiful and fine-grained tannins and a long, flavorful finish. Delivers the Pingus magic! Drink now or hold.

name: Vega Sicilia  Unico
style: Tempranillo / Tinto Fino / Tinta Roriz / Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
98 Points by James Suckling

Very ripe with plum, spice and dried-flower aromas, as well as chocolate, fresh flowers and sandalwood. Coffee and hints of meat. Sort of decadent. Full-bodied with round, creamy tannins and an intense, juicy feel. Unique cedar and walnut undertones. So delicious now, but one for the future, too.

96 Points by Wine Advocate

The Único released in 2021, 10 years after the harvest, is the 2011 Único, selected from 40 of their 210 hectares of vineyards. 2011 is a concentrated and ripe vintage, and they selected 95% Tinto Fino (Tempranillo) and 5% Cabernet Sauvignon that were cooled in a cold room for 24 hours before being sorted; the bunches and grapes macerated at 9 to 10 degrees Celsius for three to four days, and then it was inoculated with a pied de cuve to ferment with pumping overs. Malolactic was in stainless steel, and the wine was put through a long aging, 10 years between oak and bottle, using new and used French and American oak barrels and 20,000-liter oak vats. For Vega Sicilia, 2011 was a fresher year than 2010, not the common idea about those vintages in Ribera del Duero. The wine has a developed nose with some notes of ripe black fruit, meat and underbrush, somewhat herbal and perfumed. There is something about the nose of the Únicos that I cannot quite describe but is quite distinct, and it's in this vintage and also in the Reserva Especial. 88,288 bottles, 3,505 magnums, 318 double magnums, 60 Imperial and 3 Salmanazar were produced. The wine was bottled in June 2017.

95 Points by Wine Spectator

This concentrated, harmonious red packs in a lot of flavor, with plum, mountain herb, leather and spice notes woven together with cedar and vivid mineral elements tracing along the finish. The tannins are nicely integrated, with good balance and finesse overall. Tinto Fino and Cabernet Sauvignon. Drink now through 2031.

name: Penfolds  Grange 2013 Aevum Limited Edition Decanter
wine_color: Opaque black core, dark red rim.
desc_en_short: This limited edition Penfolds Aevum Crystal Decanter with the 100pt Grange 2013 was released as part of a collaboration between Penfolds and Saint-Louis, who has been making handcrafted crystal artefacts in France since 1586. It is the first time that Saint-Louise had collaborated with a global brand outside of Europe. The decanter accompanies the 750ml, 2013 Grange. Hand-blown by Saint-Louis master craftsmen, each decanter is artistically designed to delicately aerate the wine.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2018
desc_en_short: 100 points in The Decanter - "Beautifully rich even on the nose, this makes you smile from the first moment. On the palate things are intense and concentrated, as you might expect with an 11hl/ha yield (mildew-related). Upfront flavours major on big bitter chocolate with touches of smoke and grilled cedar, lots of savoury fruits and touches of reduction. Extremely impressive how layered and textured it is, though it really needs decades to reveal itself. There is the seductive floral edge of Palmer as it opens in the glass, but this is a muscular wine that needs time. 79% new oak. No Alter Ego in 2018. Bottled July 2020 after one year in barrel and a second year in larger Stockinger barrels for 20% of the crop to soften the oak influence. It's extremely hard for top estates to deliver consistency and innovation over decades; it really is like a sports team in that way, and this is a standout success in what was an extremely challenging year for Palmer."

name: Marchesi Di Barolo  Barolo DOCG Cannubi (Single Vineyard)
wine_color: Garnet-red in color with ruby reflections.
desc_en_short: The colour is ruby with garnet red hues. The aroma is intense, with clear scents of rose, vanilla, spices and roasted nuts and a vague hint of absinthe. It is a robust wine, with good body, full and elegant taste, soft and enveloping tannins. Pleasant spicy and woody notes that merge perfectly together.

name: Ferraton Pere & Fils  Cotes-du-Rhone "Samorens" Rouge
desc_en_short: Ruby red with aromas of ripe, red fruits. A nicely structured palate is marked by notes of blackberries, raspberries, blueberries and licorice. There are hints of spices and herbs in the finish.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2018
wine_color: A dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints.
desc_en_short: "The Beaujolais-Villages Nouveau exhibits the same intense colour as the Beaujolais Nouveau. The wines have a dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints. The nose is very expressive with aromas of blackberry, licorice and blueberry. The palate is full, rather generous, and on these same fruity notes. Some slight acidity brings an agreeable freshness. The Beaujolais Nouveau 2018 is very flattering and can be enjoyed with pleasure as an aperitif, with cold meats, or simple dishes of regional specialties"

name: Ferraton Pere & Fils  Cote-Rotie Lieu-dit “Montmain”
desc_en_short: Very deep, smooth and elegant wine, with notes of red fruits. Beautiful minerality. Very tense and very long wine.

name: Ferraton Pere & Fils  Ermitage "Le Meal"
desc_en_short: With its clear, intense ruby colour, the Ermitage "Le Méal" 2014 of Ferraton Père & Fils reveals fragrances of black fruit with subtle hints of leather. The tannins are well present on the palate and delicately woody. The wine shows off great amplitude, a beautiful structure and great keeping potential.

name: Les Allées de Cantemerle Haut-Médoc
desc_en_short: The approachable second wine of the famed Cinquième Grand Cru Classé Château Cantemerle, Les Allées de Cantemerle delivers classic Haut-Médoc character — supple red-fruit aromatics, polished tannins, and an easy elegance that makes it perfect for the dinner table tonight.

name: Chateau De Haut Coulon  Cadillac Cotes De Bordeaux
desc_en_short:
“Château Haut Coulon is a deep, red colour with superb richness of flavour, excellent
concentration and smooth, molten tannins to give power and elegance on the palate. A
very stylish wine of exceptional quality. The vines grow on chalky clay slopes, reaching
an advanced stage of ripeness; yields are carefully managed not to exceed 40 hl per
ha, giving a smooth, intensely-flavoured wine with superb length on the finish - black
fruit flavours underpinned by a note of liquorice. A distinctive, memorable wine; a
pleasure to drink now, and will keep well for many years to come.”

name: Chateau Fonreaud   Listrac-Medoc
desc_en_short: 91 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Spicy new wood flavors dominate this otherwise strongly fruity wine. The tension between the two promises a rich, full and ripe wine for the future. There is enough weight, acidity, blackberry fruit and richness to balance out the wood aging. Give this dense wine until 2018."

name: Maison Virginie  Syrah Pays D'OC
desc_en_short: Good, deep red colour. A subtle mix of violets, black berry fruits and spices on the nose. Silky-smooth and rounded on the attack, and good length on the finish, hinting at mocha and cocoa.

name: Maison Virginie  Merlot Pays D'OC
desc_en_short: Good, intense red colour with hints of garnet. Red fruits on the nose, with hints of toasted vanilla. Supple, full-bodied and smooth on the palate. A long finish with echoes of red berries.

name: First Press  Napa Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Full bodied and firmly structured with rich, complex layers, this Cabernet Sauvignon exhibits aromas of black liquorice, blackberries and plums. Flavors of vanilla and soft, silky tannins carry through to the palate for a long, lingering finish.

name: Sand Point  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Vibrant in color, opens with an appealing aroma of bright berry. Smooth tannins support the core flavors of fresh cherry and ripe berry, which are intertwined with spice from oak aging. As a full-bodied wine, it is easy to enjoy for any occasion.

name: Sand Point  Merlot
desc_en_short: Focused raspberry fruit and vanilla aromas merge with dark berry flavors and ripe cherry. The approachable opening merges with a cocoa powder note and smooth tannins from twelve months of French oak aging to create a concentrated wine.

name: Sand Point  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Sand Point Pinot Noir from California's Central Coast delivers an approachable, fruit-forward style brimming with ripe strawberry and cherry cola, lifted by a whisper of soft spice from French and American oak aging — smooth, balanced, and effortlessly enjoyable.

name: Clau de Nell  Cabernet Franc 2013
desc_en_short: As it begins to unwind it releases striking aromas of black raspberries and wild forest berries which come together beautifully with dried violets, tobacco, smoldering ash and a touch of white pepper. On the palate this is medium to full-bodied and firmly structured with fine, silky tannins and remarkable overall balance and precision.

name: Clau de Nell  Cuvee Violette 2013
desc_en_short: A velvet-textured blend of cabernet franc from 40-year-old vines and cabernet sauvignon from 60-year-old vines, this has a cool, foresty feel in the 2013 vintage. It ripened to figgy richness and plummy sweetness without losing its bright edge of acidity. Healthy and fresh, this should develop complexity as it ages.

name: Uccelliera  Rapace Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Andrea Cortonesi’s Rapace blends Sangiovese with Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. There’s a lot of action in the nose with layers of sugar beet, chopped herbs, coffee-vanilla, cola, medicinal qualities and cherry preserves. It wins high marks for its mouthfeel, too, which is well structured.

name: Chateau de Goelane  Bordeaux Superieur
desc_en_short: A Gold Medal Bordeaux Supérieur from Château de Goélane, this Merlot-led blend delivers ripe black cherry, jammy berry fruit, and warm toasty notes in a soft, approachable style that punches well above its everyday price point.

name: Folie de Chauvin  Saint-Emilion Grand Cru Classe
desc_en_short: The history of Château Chauvin began in 1852 during the division of the great stronghold of Corbin, giving birth to multiple properties, including Chauvin which was then acquired by Jean Fourcaud-Laussac. The latter, who had just offered what would become the Cheval Blanc castle, did considerable work on both areas. From 1891 until 2014, three generations of the family Ondet succeed on the property, bringing all their determination to make a great wine, multiplying the investments. At the first grading of the Crus in 1954, Chauvin is selected among the 80 classified crus of Saint-Emilion, out of nearly 1000 listed crus. Since then, Chauvin maintains his position at each revision of the ranking. In 2014, a new page is written when Sylvie CAZES and her children acquire the Château. They wish to continue the work done by the Ondet family while giving them the best assets to succeed: restructuring of wine-making methods and wine making, material investments, drainage of the entire vineyard, environmental commitment, etc. To translate the new impetus of the property and the values ??dear to Sylvie, her children and her teams, a new visual identity was created from a label of the castle of 1929. To this label was added a symbol illustrating the word “chauvinist” Cupid, god of Love, proudly displays a banner representing the emblematic lion of Saint-Emilion, his land he flies over with a benevolent look. It is to represent the attachment to the terroir of Saint-Emilion that this symbol appears on the label of Château Chauvin, from the vintage 2014. Folie de Chauvin is the second wine of Château Chauvin.

name: Chateau Desmirail  AOC Margaux 3EME Grand Cru Classe 2015
desc_en_short:
As everybody knows, the summer 2015 was really good in the Bordeaux region.

At Margaux, we have been particularly lucky: a welcoming rain arrived just at the right moment to contribute to a wonderful maturity for the grapes.

Thus ended up in superb grapes when picking time started the 21st of September (with Merlots on “Desmirail” plot.

Into three days, these superb and prolific Merlots were harvested. The one ha spot with Petits-Verdots has been harvested by a wonderful day, the 1st of October.

As this fine weather still continuing, we let Cabernets Sauvignons maturing. Six days after Merlots, from the 2nd to the 9th of October, they were picked up. It turns out that they were really nice, but a bit less prolific (in quantity) than Merlots.

This year can be distinguished by relatively high degrees and a nice tannic density. Another year finishing by 5, after the famous 45, 55, 75, 85, 95 and 2005, which makes it different from its elders by its richness in tannins and degrees.

name: Chateau Desmirail  AOC Margaux 3EME Grand Cru Classe 2015 Premium Box Set
desc_en_short:
1 X Chateau Desmirail  Aoc Margaux 3EME Grand Cru Classe 2015
1 X Premium Wine Box
2 X Crystal Wine Glass

name: Monthelie  1ER Cru Le Clou Des Chenes
desc_en_short: A compelling Premier Cru Pinot Noir from Monthélie, Le Clou des Chênes delivers an aromatic tapestry of peony, violet, cinnamon, and leather, with a refined palate that balances bright acidity against silky tannins in a long, lingering finish.

name: Good  Chianti DOCG
desc_en_short: Ruby-red color, rich bouquet with hints of wild berries. Dry and slightly tannic, medium-body.

name: Complicated  Red Blend
wine_color: Color is medium burgundy with a deep violet hue.
desc_en_short: Color is medium burgundy with a deep violet hue. Aromas of bright raspberries, red cherries, and strawberries jump out of the glass. Black tea and dark chocolate emerge as the wine opens.  Super-ripe raspberry and bright red cherry make for a seductive first sip. This racy Central Coast blend has notes of cocoa and well-integrated French Oak. The wine is opulent yet balanced. The finish lingers with flavors of cassis and dried plums.

name: Famille Perrin  Coudoulet de Beaucastel AOP Cote de Rhone Rouge
desc_en_short: This is an absolutely fantastic showing as a second wine. This wine starts off with aromas of raspberry liquor, sandalwood and herbs de Provence. Balanced and poised, showing some nice weight on the mid-palate, the wine dances between dark and red fruits with a lovely texture. Enjoy this outstanding CDR over the next decade.

name: Famille Perrin  Gigondas “La Gille”
desc_en_short: From one of the Southern Rhône's most celebrated estates, this Gigondas 'La Gille' from Famille Perrin delivers a silky, polished expression of 90% Grenache — rich with kirsch, cardamom, dried earth, and spice box complexity, finishing with velvety well-integrated tannins.

name: Chateau De Beaucastel  Chateauneuf de Pape
style: Mourvèdre ; 30% Grenache ; 10% Counoise ; 10% Syrah ; 5% Cinsault ; 15% Vaccarèse, Terret Noir, Muscardin, Clairette, Picpoul, Picardan, Bourboulenc, Roussanne ; 5% Roussanne, Bourboulenc
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

The Chateau de Beaucastel Chateauneuf-du-Pape opens up to near black in color in the glass. On the nose, the wine is very delicate and powerful at the same time, red fruit, black currants, blackberries, spices, thyme and lavender. The bouquet is very elegant, rich and round. Figs, cherries, black currants and stewed fruit, all with a great acidity. The tannins are present but very delicate. Chateau de Beaucastel has long been considered as one of the greatest wines in France. It is famously known for its elegance, balance and ageing potential. Beaucastel has an exceptional terroir at the northern limit of the appellation of Chateauneuf-du-Pape, exposed to the mistral wind. All thirteen varieties of the appellation have been grown organically since the sixties.

name: Maison Legrand  Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
desc_en_short: A classic Bordeaux blend from Maison Legrand, this Cabernet Sauvignon–Merlot delivers deep red fruit character, smooth tannins, and a satisfying, full-bodied palate — an approachable everyday red with genuine Bordeaux heritage and impressive length.

name: Grand Plessis  Pays d'oc Rouge
desc_en_short: This wine comes vineyards in Southern France, in the up and coming region of Pays d’oc The stony planteaus, the unstoppable winds mixed with hot weather contribute the flavors of this fruit-rich wine. Serve at room temperature,it will marry well with Roasted red meats, BBQ or with a ion of cheeses

name: Duc de Bithynie  Pays d'Oc Rouge
desc_en_short: A rich, full-bodied Pays d'Oc Shiraz from the sun-drenched Languedoc, Duc de Bithynie delivers a generous wall of dark cherry and blackcurrant fruit, lifted by warming spice and a touch of vanilla — an expressive southern French red at an accessible price.

name: Mawleau  Bordeaux Red
desc_en_short: This wine is ruby red color. The smell with strawberry, plum and toast. taste of raspberries and cassis.

name: Toppel  Bordeaux Rouge
desc_en_short: A classic Bordeaux Rouge from Toppel, blending Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot into an approachable, fruit-driven red with aromas of cherry, raspberry, and vanilla — smooth, charming, and perfectly suited to the dinner table.

name: Chateau Haut-Brion  1er Grand Cru Classe 2008
desc_en_short:
Château Haut-Brion is a First Growth in the Bordeaux Wine Official Classification of 1855. It is located in Pessac, Graves just one mile (2 km) from the city of Bordeaux. The vineyard consists of 109 acres (441,000 m²) producing 12,000 to 15,000 cases of wine each year. Located in the Graves region, it was the only non-Médoc estate to be included in the 1855 classification.

The cultivation of the vineyard of the château Haut-Brion in the middle of town with jealous care, its ability to age more than its neighbours – up to about twenty years, or even more, the men working under the lead of Jean Delmas, the modern cuvier, the artisitcally lead winemaking…. All this contributes to the success of a domainn, producing the greatest red wines and rare white wines.
Average age of vines is 30 years.

Château Bahans Haut-Brion, although a second wine, has the same treatment throughout as Château Haut-Brion. Grown on the same land as Château Haut-Brion, Château Bahans Haut-Brion, profits from the same planting and harvest techniques, and has the advantage of the same rigorous selection and thoroughness in vinification as the "Grand Vin".
