name: Chateau Margaux  1er Cru Classe 2004
desc_en_short: Château Margaux 2004 is a landmark First Growth from the Margaux appellation in Bordeaux, delivering a classically structured blend of Cabernet Sauvignon-led depth with silky, age-worthy elegance — a wine shaped by nearly nine centuries of viticultural heritage on one of the Médoc's most storied estates.

name: Botter  Valpolicella
desc_en_short: A ruby red wine of medium intensity, clear and lively. Vinous, delicate and characteristic bouquet, the wine is dry and balanced on the palate, with soft tannins which enhance its structure.

name: Botter  Bardolino
desc_en_short: This wine is brick red colour. aroma of black pepper stand out in the bouquet, nice scents of small red fruits. on the palate delicate and fresh on the palate, sublime plum notes.

name: Botter  Chianti Classico Rosso DOCG
desc_en_short: Aged in oak barrels for at least 12 months. Deep ruby red colour, intense and persistent. This wine is characterized by fruity notes of cherry, followed by delicate spicy notes of black pepper. On the mouth is full, harmonious, dry, sapid flavour, slightly tannic.

name: Capo Zafferano  Primitivo IGT
wine_color: A dark, ruby-red colour with violet highlights.
desc_en_short: A dark, ruby-red colour with violet highlights. Intense and fragrant bouquet with a rich variety of sensations. Pleasant, harmonic and velvety taste with a long and delicate aftertaste.

name: Capo Zafferano  Primitivo Di Manduria D.O.C.
desc_en_short: Intense purple colour, tending towards amber with ageing. This wine has a very solid structure due to the elevated alcohol and the balance between the soft tannins and acidity.

name: Capo Zafferano  Negroamaro IGT Salento
desc_en_short: From an ancient grape of PUGLIA the heel of the Italian boot!! Bold ruby-red color with red plum and spice. Supple, rounded tannins make it a good choice for sipping.

name: Game of Thrones  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This wine is ruby red color. The nose of blackcurrant, briar and Tahitian vanilla all interwoven through extended aging in the finest French oak barrels. The palate of intensely pleasurable finish ,delivers the caress of smooth tannins with a touch of cocoa.

name: Game of Thrones  Red Blend
desc_en_short: This wine is ruby red color. The nose of dark bing cherry, mulberry, vanilla and mocha aromas. The palate of soft, juicy black fruit combines with chewy tannins to provide a full, rich palate.

name: Capo Zafferano  Nero D'Avola IGT Terre Siciliane
desc_en_short: Capo Zafferano's Nero d'Avola IGT Terre Siciliane delivers deep purple intensity with vibrant blueberry and blackberry fruit, lifted by a warm spicy edge and nicely rounded tannins — a generous, easy-drinking red from the sun-drenched soils of Sicily.

name: El Regajal  Seleccion Especial
wine_color: intense cherry colour with violet edges and some purples hues.
style: Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot And Petit Verdot.
grape_variety: Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: From a butterfly reserve in Aranjuez, El Regajal Selección Especial blends Tempranillo, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Merlot, and Petit Verdot into a richly textured, full-bodied red — aged 15 months in French oak and bottled unfiltered for authentic, expressive character.

name: Mountain View  Amador County Zinfandel
desc_en_short: The Amador County region is ideal for growing excellent quality Zinfandel fruit and the Clockspring Vineyard is located in the heart of the growing area. This fruit has proven to be very pleasing for the past 30 years and displays wonderful balance, deep spicy flavors and a pleasing finish.

name: Forever Blend  Apasionado Cabernet Sauvignon Carmenere
desc_en_short: This is an intense, complex wine with aromas and flavors of black cherries, blueberries, strawberries, casis, red and green bell pepper, hazelnut, vanilla, leather and toasted. In the palate it has a very good structure, with mature tannins, fresh black fruit, and a smoky, spicy character. A great match for red meats, lamb chops, grilled vegetables, strong and maturecheese.

name: Forever Blend  Apasionado Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
desc_en_short: This blend has a deep ruby red. Its aromas remind us of red ripe fruit with intense notes of peppery jam. In the palate is soft, fresh and well balanced, with soft tannins. It is a great option to combine with barbecued red meats, pasta and tomato based sauces and mature cheeses.

name: Boscarelli  Prugnolo Rosso di Montepulciano
desc_en_short: Bright and pure, with cherry, strawberry and light earth flavors allied to a firm, balanced structure. Not built for the long haul, but appealing for the fruit and liveliness. Drink now through 2021.

name: Boscarelli  Cortona Merlot
desc_en_short: This wine is ruby red color. nose of Cherry/plum. on the palate Fruity, red bell pepper, cherry. paired well with cheeses and meats.

name: Boscarelli  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano
style: Sangiovese Prugnolo Gentile, With The Remainder Colorino, Canaiolo And Mammolo.
desc_en_short: Clear crimson color. Nose of cherries, field flowers, spice and vanilla. Black cherries, Good depth and balanced acidity. Medium bodied and medium finish.

name: Boscarelli  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva
style: Sangiovese Prugnolo Gentile Grapes And 12% Colorino.
desc_en_short: Exotic spice, pressed violet and woodland-berry aromas create an inviting bouquet. The linear elegant palate delivers tart cherry, strawberry, licorice and white pepper while bright acidity and firm refined tannins provide balance and support. A note of orange zest closes the finish. It's still young so give it time to fully blossom.

name: Boscarelli  dei Boscarelli I.G.T.
style: Merlot, 10% Cabernet Sauvignon And 10% Petit Verdot.
grape_variety: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, Montepulciano, Sangiovese
desc_en_short: A Tuscan IGT of serious ambition, Boscarelli dei Boscarelli blends 80% Merlot with Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot, aged up to 18 months in French oak and four years in bottle — delivering a structured, violet-hued red of remarkable depth and ageing potential.

name: Bodega Volcanes de Chile  Igneo
desc_en_short: Bright violet-red. Complex and expressive with floral notes that intermingle with stewed red and black fruits, figs, dried fruit and earthy notes as well as subtle hints of spice and menthol. Persistent and dense with powerful tannins that are at the same time ripe and supple.

name: Mountain View  Central Coast Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Mountain View's Central Coast Cabernet Sauvignon draws on Northern Paso Robles fruit to deliver ripe, mature berry flavors with warm spice and a toasted oak finish — a full-bodied, food-friendly Cabernet built to enjoy now or cellar for years ahead.

name: Antigal  Estimulo Malbec
desc_en_short: Antigal's Estimulo Malbec from Mendoza is a silky, approachable expression of Argentina's flagship grape, offering luscious black cherry, currant, and peppery spice on a smooth, Merlot-like frame with a long, satisfying finish.

name: Antigal  One La Dolores Vineyard Malbec
desc_en_short: Very intense, deep, vivid color red. On the nose of Smoked, cinnamon, vanilla, mocha and caramel, lots of fruit such as cherries, plum jam and black fruits. The Palate shows a sweet and silky entrance, with excellent structure and long finish

name: Chateau Gloria  Saint Julien 2013
style: Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Château Gloria 2013 delivers the classic allure of Saint-Julien — a deep violet pour with jammy red fruits, licorice, and vanilla on the nose, followed by silky, precisely structured tannins that unfold with exceptional elegance and lingering length.

name: Stony Bank  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: From the ancient riverbeds of Marlborough's Wairau Valley, this elegant Pinot Noir delivers bright strawberry and red cherry aromatics, layered with delicate clove, nutmeg, and savoury oak — finishing with a lingering, moreish warmth that invites another glass.

name: Leeuwin Estate  Art Series Shiraz
desc_en_short:
92 points in Wine Spectator - "Elegant, detailed and juicy, with rich and velvety kirsch, red licorice and raspberry coulis flavors that fold into notes of black tea, chocolate, sage and clove. The elements linger on the long, expressive finish. Drink now through 2026."

90 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "Crisper and more medium-bodied than most vintages, the 2013 Art Series Shiraz boasts peppery accents to its raspberry and cherry fruit. It's taut and silky, finishing with hints of black olive and espresso."

name: Friedrich Becker  Kammerberg Pinot Noir Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Intense juicy red plum, strawberry, pear, wax apple and medium wet stone notes. High acidity, low fine grained tannins and medium low body. Med long finish on fresh red fruits and materials with hint of tea leaves and liquorice.

name: Rawson's Retreat  Private Release Shiraz Cabernet
wine_color: Deep dense red with purple hues.
desc_en_short: Sweet juicy fruits with soft silky tannins coat the tongue and mouth. Blackcurrant fruit with hints of spice complete a soft rounded medium weight wine with good length.

name: Grayson Cellars  Zinfandel
desc_en_short: Grayson Cellars Zinfandel delivers bold, sun-ripened California character — layers of bramble, blackberry, and vanilla spice crafted by veteran Napa winemaker Larry Levin, offering exceptional quality and depth at an everyday price point.

name: Grayson Cellars  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: The Grayson Pinot Noir exhibits a rich color. The aromas are exotic in raspberry and plum with a mix of cherry, violets, and a hint of sandalwood. Flavorful and silky in the mouth with good body, this wine has good texture and a lingering finish with a hint of toasted French oak.

name: Grayson Cellars  Merlot
desc_en_short: Grayson Cellars Merlot delivers Napa Valley craftsmanship at an approachable price — a sumptuous, full-bodied red bursting with black cherry preserves, currant, and white chocolate, rounded out by rich dark fruits and a lush, oak-kissed finish.

name: Grayson Cellars  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Grayson Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon delivers Napa Valley craftsmanship at an everyday price — a dark ruby, full-bodied red brimming with blackberry, raspberry, and black pepper, rounded out by a soft, lingering finish touched with toasted French oak.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Bourgogne Hautes Cotes de Beaune
desc_en_short: From the organically farmed vineyards of Domaine Jean Fery & Fils in Échevronne, this Bourgogne Hautes-Côtes de Beaune Pinot Noir delivers bright, crunchy red fruits with vibrant acidity, a whisper of oak, and silky-soft tannins — a textbook expression of lighter-hillside Burgundy.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Savigny-Les-Beaune "Sous la Cabotte" Rouge
wine_color: Deep cherry color, purple with garnet hues.
desc_en_short: From a certified organic family domaine in Échevronne, this Savigny-lès-Beaune Village Pinot Noir delivers a classic Burgundian profile — deep cherry colour, violet-tinged aromatics, lush red and black fruit, and a silky, fleshy palate with beautiful roundness and effortless elegance.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Morey-Saint-Denis
desc_en_short: This Morey-Saint-Denis has charmed us by its great depth. Long, racy, feminine, this great Burgundy wine is a true nugget to taste over a dozen years. We will appreciate right now its balance and its quality of tannins after decanting a good hour.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Vosne-Romanee "Aux Ravioles"
desc_en_short: Beautiful, steady and brilliant robe The concentration of mellowness dominates the tannins. The acidity is present. This fleshy wine, with a very good persistence is very aromatic its typicity highlights cherry and strawberry flavors.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Vosne-Romanee "Aux Reas"
desc_en_short: Beautiful, steady and brilliant robe The concentration of mellowness dominates the tannins. The acidity is present. This fleshy wine, with a very good persistence is very aromatic its typicity highlights cherry and strawberry flavors.

name: La Spinetta   Barbera d'Asti "Ca Di Pian" DOCG
desc_en_short: This wine is ruby red with purple reflections. aromas of blueberry, wet earth and a hint of orange peel. Full body with bright acidity and lots of intensity but balanced and silky-textured, an ultra-fine Barbera that combines richness with finesse

name: La Spinetta   Monferrato Rosso " Pin "DOC
desc_en_short: This wine is dark red. Nose of a fruity and savory red with shaved chocolate, minerals and hints of leather. the palate has a juicy and dark berry Barbera entrance that is perfectly completed by Nebbiolo length and elegance.

name: La Spinetta   Barbaresco "Gallina" DOCG
desc_en_short: The wine excels in terms of texture and intensity. Candied cherry and blackberry syrup emerge from the nose with dark spice, leather and moist chewing tobacco. The wine is polished and fine in terms of texture and elegant tertiary notes are already showing beautifully. This is a standout Barbaresco.

name: La Spinetta   Barolo "Campe" DOCG
desc_en_short: 97 Point by James Suckling "The pure fruit aromas are mind-blowing with meat, fresh flowers, citrus fruit and sliced strawberries. Full body, ultra-fine tannins and a fabulous texture. Super subtle fruit and finesse. Wow. Drink in 2020 but so entrancing now."

name: Livon  Collio Merlot DOC
desc_en_short: A ruby red color, it has a fruity bouquet recalling raspberries, blueberries, liquorice and spices. On the palate it is soft, full-bodied, with a long finish.

name: Livon  Collio Refosco dal Peduncolo DOC
wine_color: It is garnet red with violet reflections
desc_en_short: Livon's Collio Refosco dal Peduncolo is a characterful red from Friuli's celebrated Collio DOC, offering an expressive bouquet of blackberries, forest fruits, and herbal notes, with a full-bodied, gently tannic palate and a long, vinous finish.

name: Livon  Collio Cabernet Sauvignon DOC
wine_color: Intense red ruby color with violet edges
desc_en_short: Intense red ruby color with violet edges, it has a slightly herbaceous aroma, recalling raspberries and blackberries. Tasty, pleasant, slightly tannic, full-bodied with a long finish.

name: Livon  Tiareblu Grand Cru IGT
wine_color: Its color is bright red with garnet reflections.
desc_en_short: Its color is bright red with garnet reflections. On the nose it is intense, full and fragrant, recalling raspberries and blackberries. On the palate it is dry, full-bodied, tannic, harmonic, tasty, with a very long finish.

name: Livon  Montefalco Sagrantino Rosso DOCG
wine_color: The wine has a deep, intense garnet red color.
desc_en_short: From Livon's Fattoria Colsanto estate in Umbria's Montefalco DOCG, this 100% Sagrantino delivers a commanding garnet-red presence with aromas of tobacco, red berries, and warm spice, underpinned by the grape's signature powerful yet refined tannins.

name: Nugan  Third Generation Shiraz
desc_en_short: This is a lovely full bodied style of Shiraz and is bursting with ripe berry fruit. Spices and black pepper, with subtle tannins and a long, smooth finish

name: Nugan  Scruffy's Riverina Shiraz
desc_en_short: Dark purple. Spicy blackcurrant and cherry aromas are complemented by Asian spices and floral oils. Lively and precise on the palate, offering gently sweet, incisive dark fruit flavors and a hint of spicecake. Finishes on a gentle tannic note, with very good clarity and an echo of candied flowers.

name: Nugan  Stomper's Riverina Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A rich, fruit-driven Riverina Cabernet Sauvignon from the three-generation Nugan family, bursting with blackberry, cassis, and a signature mint-and-lavender lift — dense, lively, and built for the table.

name: Capo Zafferano  Appassimento IGT
wine_color: A warm red/black colour with deep core.
desc_en_short: A warm red/black colour with deep core. A seductive open and sultry aroma with plums, cassis, currant, Italian herbs and cocoa. Mouth-filling, broad and creamy in taste with lush dark cherry fruit, sultry cassis, raisins, figs, cara

name: Danese  Merlot IGT
desc_en_short: An intense ruby red color. Intense bouquet with fruity overtones. Tastes warm and dry. Has a full, gentle, and persistent finish.

name: Ronan by Clinet  Pur Cab Bordeaux AOC
desc_en_short: This is an excellent wine. It is mellow on first taste but with a long after taste that is fresh but with striking undertones of berries and a hint of spice

name: Chateau Carignan (Cadillac Cotes de Bordeaux)
wine_color: Intense dark red color and brilliance.
desc_en_short: Intense dark red color and brilliance. The nose is complex with a wide range of aromas. Long and fleshy mouth with a tannic structure, concentrated flavors of black fruit, cassis, blackberries, cocoa and spices and very well balanced in the mouth.

name: Redentore  Merlot
desc_en_short: A velvety Veneto Merlot from Redentore, bursting with raspberries, violet, and cherry, shaped by meticulous low-yield viticulture, wild-yeast fermentation, and careful barrique maturation — silky, generous, and built to age gracefully for up to fifteen years.

name: Redentore  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Intense ruby colour, presents intense scents of berries, spices and vanilla. Irresistibly smooth and round, with the right level of pleasant velvety tannins.

name: Santa Carolina  Cellar Selection Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The Santa Carolina Cellar Selection Cabernet Sauvignon from the traditionally rich Chilean winery Santa Carolina offers in the bouquet notes of ripe red fruits, which harmonise nicely with a fine spice. A sweet touch with vanilla and roasted aromas. Stir from use French and American oak ago when removing this red wine.

name: Livio Felluga  Vertigo IGT
wine_color: Intense deep ruby red with lively hues on the edge.
desc_en_short: A bold Friulian blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon from the legendary Livio Felluga estate, Vertigo IGT delivers layers of dark berry, sweet spice, and forest floor, wrapped in plush, well-balanced tannins and a long, intensely fruity finish.

name: Livio Felluga  Refosco dal Peduncolo DOC
wine_color: intense ruby red, almost impenetrable with lively violet hues.
desc_en_short: intense ruby red, almost impenetrable with lively violet hues. notes of red fruit with strong presence of small black berries integrated into forest understory, raw meat, sweet spices. full, mouth-filling, soft, good structure, dense tannins integrated into a presence of sweet fruit. Good fluidity balanced with a pleasant acidity and freshness; fruity aftertaste and intensely spicy.

name: Grazie Mille  Nero d'Avola
desc_en_short: The wine's deep, concentrated red colour is a prelude to a nose dominated by red and black fruits, with hits of oriental spice and balsamic scents to finish the aromatic bouquet. In the mouth, the silky texture becomes vibrant with smoothed out tannins and freshness which gives rhythm to the taste progression culminating in a finish which ripples with ripe fruitiness and spice.

name: Wente Vineyards  Wente Riva Ranch Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: “Our Riva Ranch Single Vineyard Pinot Noir is a true and elegant expression of Monterey’s finest grapes. Our signature Pinot Noir comes from our estate grown, single vineyard in Arroyo Seco and showcases beautiful aromas and flavors of cherry and red apple with notes of black tea. The wine’s bright natural acidity give way to a long, smooth finish.” - Karl D. Wente, Fifth Generation Winemaker

name: George Wyndham  I am George  Shiraz (750 ml)
desc_en_short: A bold, full-bodied Australian Shiraz inspired by the rogue pioneer himself — George Wyndham — delivering intense red fruits, ripe plum, liquorice, chocolate mint, and cedar in a wine as fearless and characterful as the man behind the legacy.

name: Almaviva  2014
wine_color: Deep, intense and attractive ruby red color.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 22% Carmenère, 8% Cabernet Franc And 2% Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Almaviva 2014 is a landmark Bordeaux-style blend from Chile's Maipo Valley, born from the celebrated partnership between Baron Philippe de Rothschild and Concha y Toro, delivering layered complexity of dark fruit, spice, and fine-grained tannins in an exceptionally elegant structure.

name: Almaviva  2015
wine_color: Deep, intense and attractive ruby red color.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 24% Carmenere, 5% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Almaviva 2015 is a landmark Maipo Valley blend from Chile's celebrated Rothschild-Concha y Toro partnership, combining Cabernet Sauvignon with Carmenère, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot into a wine of remarkable depth, elegance, and complexity.

name: Almaviva  2016
wine_color: Deep, intense and attractive ruby red color.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 24% Carmenere, 8% Cabernet Franc And 2% Peitit Verdot.
desc_en_short:
Almaviva  2016

Made from a blend of classic Bordeaux varieties, in which Cabernet Sauvignon predominates, Almaviva is an exceptionally elegant and complex wine. Deep, intense and attractive ruby red color. The bouquet is pure and forward, revealing clean aromas of blackberries, blackcurrant and licorice, associated with subtle notes of vanilla, dark chocolate, incense and spices.

name: Bolla  Le Poiane Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore
desc_en_short: Bolla Le Poiane Valpolicella Ripasso Classico Superiore is crafted by refermenting Corvina, Corvinone, and Rondinella on spent Amarone skins, producing a richly layered red brimming with black cherry, black pepper, and warming spice — a genuine step up in depth from a classic Valpolicella.

name: Chateau Deyrem Valentin  Margaux
desc_en_short: "Deyrem Valentin is an old Bordeaux property, with an history that dates back to 1730. It is a rather small family owned property for the Margaux appellation with 13 hectares, located slightly north of the Margaux village and appellation. It has belonged to the Sorge family since 1928. Jean Sorge has been running the estate with help of his two daughters, especially Christelle who is now managing the estate. In short, this property is a small, focused, family operation, who in some vintages can eclipse far more exalted names."

name: Ogier  Lou Camine Lirac
desc_en_short: Deep red cherry colour. Bouquet of ripe red fruits with hints of leather and mild spices. Complex and mineral character. Full bodied with fresh aromas - very elegant, silky and attractive tannins with a long finish on vanilla notes.

name: Ogier  Saint-Joseph Baligant
wine_color: Dark ruby colour with bluish highlights.
desc_en_short: Ogier's Saint-Joseph Baligant delivers a striking display of dark fruit intensity — blackcurrant, blueberry, and Morello cherry — underpinned by pencil-lead minerality and leather nuance, with a bold, persistent Syrah palate that balances tartness with real complexity.

name: Tenuta dell'Ornellaia  Ornellaia Bolgheri DOC "Il Carisma" (Artist Label)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Merlot, 17% Cabernet Franc, 7% Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
The desire to nurture the Estate’s exceptional qualities has shaped Ornellaia’s philosophy since the beginning. Ornellaia is a cuvée of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc & Petit Verdot and the faithful expression of unique terroir developed in harmony with nature.

Review

98 points in James Suckling "The blackberry and blueberry aromas with fresh sage and bay-leaf character are impressive. Stone, graphite and mineral undertones. Full-bodied and silky and refined tannins. Dusty. Elegance and polish. Shows greatness in strength and refinement. A dialed-in, dialed-back Ornellaia. Drink in 2022."

name: Chateau Canteloube  Graves Rouge
desc_en_short: Subtle ruby-red colour, very elegant  on the nose, both fruity (raspberries) and floral with hints of violet and iris. on the palate,  Soft, velvety well -balanced and elegant. It has a very long, fruity aftertaste.

name: John Duval  Eligo Shiraz
desc_en_short: Dark purple-red in colour. Concentrated black and blue fruits with hints of earth, nutmeg and spicy, savoury oak. Layers of rich, silky dark fruits with some earthy savouriness, smoked meat and liquorice. A long, generous and lively palate defined by polished and persistent tannins.

name: John Duval  Plexus Shiraz Grenache Mourvédre
desc_en_short: The Shiraz was sourced from old vineyards in the Tanunda, Krondorf, and Ebenezer districts, Grenache from the Tanunda and Ebenezer region, and Mourvèdre from the Light Pass region. A true reflection of Barossa’s soil and climate, Plexus expresses complex aromas and flavors combining red and dark fruits with savory notes. The palate is framed by youthful fine tannins and subtle savory French oak adds structure and complexity.

name: Batasiolo  Langhe Nebbiolo "Sfuje" DOC
desc_en_short: A wine of intense ruby red color, more or less, and with garnet according to aging. The nose shows intense and delicate aromas of ripe fruit that evolve into spicy notes with subtle floral nuances. The palate is full-bodied, tannic and pleasantly cool. Good intensity and persistence are other good features. Perfect pairing with pasta dishes, risotto, white and red meats, and medium-aged cheeses .

name: Batasiolo  Barbera d' Alba "Rigina" DOC
wine_color: Intense ruby red with garnet reflections.
desc_en_short: Batasiolo's Barbera d'Alba 'Rigina' DOC is a richly coloured, oak-touched red from Piedmont that balances the grape's signature bright acidity with warm, ripe fruit and a full, harmonious palate — an everyday Italian classic with genuine character.

name: Batasiolo  Barolo "Com'Eravamo" DOCG
desc_en_short: Intens and persistent on the nose with aroma of red fruits.

name: Le Mortelle By Antinori  Botrosecco Cabernet DOC
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Fattoria Aldobrandesca By Antinori  Vie Cave, Malbec IGT
brand: Fattoria Aldobrandesca By Antinori  Vie Cave
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ

name: La Braccesca By Antinori  Bramasole Cortona Syrah DOC
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ

name: "Tormaresca" By Antinori  Trentangeli Castel Del Monte DOC
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Allegrini  Amarone Classico Reserva Fieramonte DOCG
desc_en_short: The wine is a beautifully bright, intense and compact ruby colour, with very lively highlights. The nose opens slowly, dominated by red, pulpy fruit that is reminiscent of the cherries that ripen on the highest hills in the Valpolicella in July, flanked by the same aromatic herbs that sprout from the area's dry stone walls to finally reveal a deep note of spices that range from black pepper to cloves. The palate is striking for the fullness of the mouthfeel that emphasizes powerfulness without losing verve and agility. No noticeable sugars, but well-defined non-aggressive tannins that decisively caress the palate, accompanied by a fresh, vivacious acidity that lengthens and slows the mouthfeel. The dry and feisty finish gives rise to a subtle mineral note that promises to fully express itself in the coming years. This is an Amarone that preserves its bond with the past but takes a confident leap towards the future.

name: Louis Max  Natura Nostrum Languedoc Rouge Bio
wine_color: Deep dark red in colour, with purple reflections.
desc_en_short: Deep dark red in colour, with purple reflections. Aromas of black berries (blueberry, blackberry) and cherry. In the mouth, this wine is round and well- balanced, with a long finish.

name: Louis Max Pinot Noir "Haute Vallee"
wine_color: intense dark red ruby in colour.
desc_en_short: This wine is intense dark red ruby in colour. Aromas of small black fruits, liquorice and spices. This wine is complex, rounded and full of flavor.

name: Louis Max  Brouilly
wine_color: Beautiful garnet red robe with purple hints.
desc_en_short: From the granitic slopes of Brouilly — Beaujolais' most celebrated cru — Louis Max crafts a vibrant, fruit-forward Gamay bursting with cherry, strawberry, and fresh grape aromas, finishing smooth and generous on the palate.

name: Louis Max  Mercurey Vignes Du Domaine
desc_en_short: Lively ruby red color, very clear and brilliant. Delicate aromas of cherry and strawberry, with a touch of praline. In the mouth, very feminine and elegant, good structure and fine tannins.

name: Alois Lageder  Riff Merlot Cabernet DOC
wine_color: Wine beautiful ruby ​​color with garnet rim.
desc_en_short: Wine beautiful ruby ​​color with garnet rim. Wine sounds aromas of ripe fruit, flowers with light spicy notes. An elegant wine with a deep, rich fruit flavors, well integrated tannins and soft acidity. The wine is well served as an aperitif, as well as meat dishes and various cheeses.

name: Damilano  Barolo "Lecinquevigne" DOCG
desc_en_short: Damilano is one of the oldest wineries in Barolo. The family business dates back to 1890 when Giuseppe Borgogno started cultivating and producing wine from the grapes from his own vineyards. Giuseppe  improved the general quality of the vinification system and of the wines, turning the winery into a “jewel” of the Langhe area. In 1997 Giuseppe passed the winery on to his grandchildren Paolo, Mario and Guido. Together, they are working to keep and improve the level of the quality of the Damilano wines.

name: Damilano  Barolo "Cannubi" Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: Barolo Riserva Cannubi “1752” was born with the 2008 harvest, when the Damilano family decided to relaunch the historic core of its Cannubi vineyards located in the highest and centermost part of the hill. It is a small plot of about 2 hectares of Nebbiolo vines, currently between 30 and 50 years of age.

name: Falesco  Vitiano Rosso IGP
desc_en_short: Falesco's Vitiano Rosso is a bold, fruit-driven blend of Sangiovese, Merlot, and Cabernet Sauvignon from Umbria, delivering deep ruby colour, rich polyphenols, and vibrant acidity in a versatile, immediately enjoyable style.

name: Falesco  Vitiano Cabernet IGP
wine_color: intense red color with violet reflections.
desc_en_short: The Vitiano Cabernet Sauvignon has an intense red color with violet reflections. On the nose, the aroma has varietal features which are well balanced with the sweetness of the wood. The taste is strong, smooth pleasant with a rich final.

name: Falesco  Tellus Shiraz IGP
wine_color: intense red color with violet reflections.
desc_en_short: Intense colour with violet reflections, the bouquet is exalted for its hints of fresh fruit and cherry with spicy notes that blend with great balance and elegance to those of vanilla and sweet data from the wood. The taste is enveloping, silky, with soft tannins and a rich finish and persistent.

name: Cotarella  Montiano Merlot IGP
desc_en_short: Its color expresses a magnificent deep ruby. Appears to have a full aristocratic roundness and softness, with quite elegant, agreeable and lingering flavours.

name: Famiglia Cotarella  Brunello Di Montalcino DOCG "Le Macioche"
wine_color: A ruby red wine concentrated and brilliant.
desc_en_short: A ruby red wine concentrated and brilliant. On the nose, it has notes of withered wild plum and dehydrated cherry. It has earthy aroma and notes of fresh juniper underwood, dried flowers and white musk. The taste releases an evolution for the presence of elegant, silky and rich tannins. Clean, deep and sapid with a long lasting finishing. Unique and recognizable for tone and frankness.

name: Fattoria di Fiorano  Fioranello Rosso
grape_variety: Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc, Pecorino
desc_en_short: From the volcanic soils south of Rome, Fioranello Rosso blends Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc into a warm, full-bodied red brimming with ripe fruit, jam, chocolate, and hot spices, underscored by a distinctive mineral vein from the agro-Roman terroir.

name: Fattoria di Fiorano  Fiorano Rosso
wine_color: Clear, ruby red with some orange reflections.
desc_en_short: Clear, ruby red with some orange reflections. The nose is intense, complex, with hints of ripe red fruit and jam On the palate it is warm, soft, round and sapid. Fiorano Rosso is a full-bodied wine, robust with a mineral vein, typical of the agro-Roman volcanic soil.

name: Gianfranco Fino  Primitivo Di Manduria DOC
desc_en_short: Gianfranco Fino's Primitivo di Manduria DOC is a powerhouse of southern Italian winemaking — dense, enveloping, and deeply expressive of Puglia's sun-scorched terroir, delivering layers of dark fruit, complexity, and a long, commanding finish.

name: Jermann  Red Angel Pinot Nero Venezia DOC
wine_color: It has a fine ruby red colour.
desc_en_short: It has a fine ruby red colour. Its aroma is heady, well-orchestrated, and slightly herbaceous. The Pinot Nero variety stands out with elegant finesse. Its taste is delicate, elegant, and full-bodied, and it is slightly sweet and balanced.

name: Jermann  Blau & Blau DOC
desc_en_short: Rather intense ruby red color; vinous, well balanced nose, with herbaceous notes and nuances of berry fruit and underbrush. Dry on the palate, elegant, medium to full body, well balanced. Ideal with Friulian cuisine.

name: Mastroberardino  Radici Taurasi Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short:
93 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Underbrush, red fruit, dark spice and a whiff of menthol are some of the aromas that come together on this. The firmly structured elegant palate offers ripe plum, red cherry, licorice and tobacco framed in youthfully austere fine grained tannins that need time to unwind." - KERIN O’KEEFE

93 points in Wine Spectator - "Lovely hints of spice box, graphite and violet accent the pure black currant and black cherry fruit in this harmonious, full-bodied red. There's good density to this focused version, with savory wild herb and tarry mineral details showing on the creamy, lingering finish. Drink now through 2030."

93 points in James Suckling - "Black-walnut, blackberry and black-olive aromas follow through to a full body, round and chewy tannins and a flavorful finish. Very rich and intense. Give it a year or two to come around still."

91 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2012 Taurasi Radici is still in the process of integrating, and the oak notes are heavy-handed at the moment. Under that sweet spice and toast, you definitely get a clear glimpse of the pretty fruit below. Morello cherry and dried blackberry give substance and fiber to the core of this robust red wine. Much of this vintage rides on the oak, however. I'd suggest waiting a couple more years before popping the cork."

name: Monteverro  Verruzzo IGT
desc_en_short: You’re going to fall hard for the wine’s knockout nose of red roses, drippy summer black plums, crushed fresh lavender, and wild strawberries. So soft, supple, and gulpable

name: Monteverro  Terra Di Monteverro IGT
wine_color: Dark cherry with touches of Ferrari red on the rim.
desc_en_short: 90 points in James Suckling - "A bright and fruity red with fine tannins and pretty, clean fruit. Medium body. Cherry, floral and citrus undertones at the finish. Delicious."

name: Monteverro  Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: Even though the defining stylistic feature of this wine comes from Burgundy, it is 100% Tuscan. The influence of the sea breeze and cool nights make it possible to produce this white wine in selected parcels, which ties in with the great role models with its elegant, silky texture, and its freshness and finesse. It owes its golden yellow colour, complexity and notes of caramel and toasted bread to ageing in barriques and concrete eggs, and its aromas of lemon, pear, quince and pineapple, of almonds and ripe apple to the ideal climatic conditions. As great lovers of Chardonnay, the production of this white wine in small quantities (approx. 5,000 bottles per vintage) is something close to our hearts.

name: Rapitala by Giv  "Solinero" Syrah IGT
desc_en_short: Rapitalà 'Solinero' is a concentrated Sicilian Syrah sourced from a tight selection of just over three hectares, bottling the volcanic intensity of the island's sun into a deep, spice-laden red with powerful structure and elegantly polished tannins.

name: Finca La Celia  Pioneer Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Garnet red color, deep ruby reflections.
desc_en_short: Garnet red color, deep ruby reflections. The oak aging makes this wine`s intense nose and mouth stay in equilibrium: mocha, caramel, vanilla. Wine of a firm structure, typical of the variety, with good concentration and smoothness. Finish is long and very elegant.

name: Finca La Celia  Pioneer Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Red, deep intense, ruby reflections. Complex, highlighting the fruit, especially fresh black fruit: black cherries, blackberries, spicy with contribution of graphite (mineral). All this in combination with vanilla, mocha, delivered by the barrel aging. Very smooth texture, sweet tannins, elegant aftertaste.

name: Finca La Celia  La Celia Elite Malbec
wine_color: Deep red color with violet hues.
desc_en_short: Deep red color with violet hues. Aroma of ripe fruit with elegant floral contribution (violet) and species, balsamic and complex notes. Aging in oak has achieved in this wine an exquisite combination, black and red fruit prevail in equilibrium with notes of vanilla, mocha, cloves. The mouth entry is sweet, good weight in the middle palate and great length. e tannic structure is excellent, prevailing soft and silky tannins

name: Mount Langi Ghiran  Hollow Shiraz
wine_color: In the glass appears dark color with a purple tinge.
desc_en_short: Mount Langi Ghiran's Hollow Shiraz is a cool-climate Victorian red brimming with blueberry, ripe cherry, and dark chocolate aromas, followed by a juicy, silky palate laced with coconut, cracked black pepper, and vibrant spice — a compelling introduction to the Grampians appellation.

name: Yering Station  Yarra Valley Pinot Noir
wine_color: Bright ruby with soft garnet hues.
desc_en_short: An elegant cool-climate Pinot Noir with vibrant red berries, silky tannins, and subtle spice—refined, balanced, and beautifully food-friendly.

name: Yering Station  Yarra Valley Reserve Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: From one of the Yarra Valley's founding estates, this Reserve Pinot Noir delivers layered red berry complexity, fine-grained tannins, and elegantly integrated French oak — a cool-climate expression of genuine depth, precision, and age-worthy finesse.

name: Yering Station  Yarra Valley Reserve Cabernet
desc_en_short: A 96-point James Halliday Cabernet Sauvignon from Yering Station's Yarra Valley Reserve tier, this 100% Cabernet delivers seamlessly integrated oak, perfectly ripe tannins, and a compelling interplay of dark currants, florals, and cedar spice — built for both immediate pleasure and graceful long-term cellaring.

name: Paul Jaboulet  Chateauneuf du Pape "Les Cèdres" Red
desc_en_short: Dense and powerful with a lot of spices on the nose. The palate is beautifully enriched with red fruit flavours.

name: Kairos  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: This wine is ruby red. exotic aroma and flavour, the real clincher is the palate, intense, incisive, and yet round the wine finishes dry.

name: Domain De Baronaques  "Rouges" By Baron Phillippe De Rothschild
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: D De Dauzac By Chateau Dauzac
desc_en_short: "D de Dauzac is an AOC Bordeaux wine. Derived from terroirs outside of Margaux, its specifications meet the same standards for virtuous and respectful wine-making that are applied at Château Dauzac. Cabernet Sauvignon (55%) and Merlot (44%) grapes grow on clay and gravel soil. Fermentation in stainless steel vats is followed by one year of ageing in vats and barrels. In 2016, D de Dauzac was vegan, i.e. it was free of products of animal origin. The property innovated by replacing traditional egg white with a plant paste in the fining phase."

name: Chateau De Camensac  Haut Medoc Grand Cru Classe
wine_color: The robe is garnet and bright.
desc_en_short: A crisp, elegant Haut-Médoc that emphasizes freshness and drinkability.

name: Les Brulieres De Beychevelle By Chateau Beychevelle
desc_en_short: The third wine of the famous Chateau Beychevelle, this wine boasts aromas of cassis, blackberries, anise and black pepper. Elegant and bold fruit gives way to a powerful mid-palate with quality tannins and a spicy yet chocolaty finish.

name: Frank Phelan  "Le 2nd Vin De Chateau Phelan Segur"
desc_en_short: "Frank Phélan associates indulgent fruit, intense and compelling, with an elegant structure of silky tannins. It undergoes 14 months’ ageing. Its roundness and suppleness allow it to be enjoyed from a young age."

name: Chateau Le Marquis De Calon Segur  "Le 2nd Vin De Chateau Calon Segur" 2018
desc_en_short: The second wine of the legendary Château Calon Ségur, Le Marquis de Calon Ségur 2018 delivers the ripe, seductive character of the vintage — lush blackcurrant and red plum fruits intertwined with tobacco and cedary spice in an elegantly balanced Saint-Estèphe.

name: Chateau Lilian Ladouys  Saint-Estephe 2015
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short:
When tasted, Lilian Ladouys always reveals a rich and crisp structure with ripe tannins and refined oak which melts into an explosion of fruit. It has the opulence and length of a Saint-Estèphe fine wine. Thanks to the appellation’s limestone-clay subsoils, its power is balanced out by a wonderful sensation of freshness.

Our top wine is matured for an average of 14 months in our superb barrel store (40-60% new oak depending on the vintage). Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot make up the majority of the blend, with the proportions varying from one year to the next. They are supplemented by Petit Verdot and Cabernet Franc. The estate’s wines go into gravity-fed vats and undergo vinification with a partially gravity-based system, which is more sensitive to the integrity and subtleties of the grapes and the wine.

name: Connetable Talbot  "Le 2nd Vin De Chateau Talbot"
wine_color: Its dense and deep ruby colour
desc_en_short: Chateau Talbot develops a nose of great richness, with a clever marriage of fruity and floral aromas (black and violet fruits). Extensive on the palate with a smooth attack, the wine reveals richness and great complexity, before a finish with beautiful length, in harmony with silky tannins.

name: Chateau Batailley  5Em Cru Classe
desc_en_short: Tasted at the Batailley vertical tasting the château, the 2010 Batailley may well have been the best wine in a tasting that encompassed three centuries of winemaking at the estate. The nose offers outstanding delineation and mineralité. It positively fizzes in the glass with all that coiled-up energy, ladling out vivid blackberry and cedar aromas. The palate is medium-bodied, but it is the detail and precision that achieves a level that makes the 2010 a benchmark for the Pauillac estate. It sashays towards a tensile, tar and graphite-tinged finish that lingers in the mouth. This is destined for long-term aging insofar that its quality will not be widely appreciated for many years. Tasted April 2016.

name: Chateau Dauzac  5Em Cru Classe 2008
wine_color: It has a dark and very deep colour.
desc_en_short: 91 points in Wine Advocate - "A copious display of fruits, ripe fruits, both red and black, with liquorice, camphor, smoke and grilling with spices that explodes in the glass for this full-bodied and generous 2008—to be enjoyed for the next 15 years. I rarely praise Dauzac, but this wine is certainly one of the forgotten of the vintage that deserves a score of 90 after bottling."

name: Chateau Dauzac  5Em Cru Classe 2012
desc_en_short: Château Dauzac's 2012 Margaux delivers a classically structured Bordeaux with dark fruit, licorice, and polished tannins — a fifth-growth Cru Classé that rewards both the cellar and the dinner table with effortless elegance.

name: Chateau Kirwan 2019
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 36% Merlot, 2% Cabernet Franc And 4% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: 97 points Wine Enthusiast - "With its new cellars, the estate is performing at top speed and this vintage keeps up the fine track record. Firm tannins and beautifully perfumed fruit are blending together to give a wine that has style as well as structured fruitiness, with all the elegance of great Margaux. Think long-term aging for this wine." Barrel Sample: 95-97

name: Charmes De Kirwan "Le 2nd Vin De Chateau Kirwan"
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 40% Merlot, 10% Cabernet Franc, 7% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: A deep ruby colour, almost as black as the grapes it comes from such that first impressions are of blackberry, blackcurrant and black cherry. On the palate, this wonderful basket of ripe fruit combines with a delicate oaky note for added complexity. The wine is round, full and fresh in the mouth, supported by a lovely tannic structure that makes for enchanting spicy notes in the finale.

name: Chateau De Pressac  Grand Cru Classe
style: Merlot, 18% Cabernet Franc, 9% Cabernet Sauvignon, 2.5% Pressac (Malbec), 1.5% Carmenère
desc_en_short: 89 points in Wine Enthusiast - "From a Grand Cru estate, this second wine shows the same rich fruit and generous structure as the winery's first wine. It's just softer with an approachable character and generous black fruits that will enable it to mature relatively quickly. Drink from 2020."

name: Clos La Gaffelière  Saint-Emilion Grand Cru (Second wine of château La Gaffelière)
wine_color: Medium to deep garnet-purple in color.
desc_en_short:
The second wine of château La Gaffelière

Born in 1985, Clos is produced mainly from the young vines. The blending is Merlot and cabernet franc, whose percentage differs according to the quality of the vintage. It is a “wine for pleasure” with a 10 years ‘potential of ageing. The work in the plots of Clos is the equal to the actions in the parcels for the first label : pruning, cover, de-leafing, green harvest, hand-picking. In the cellar, the same technical gestures pace the successive stages of vinification. Unlike its brother, this wine ages only in one-year French oak barrels during 10 to 12 months. Clos La Gaffelière has now a firm and recognized identity . First, it was exclusively proposed to private customers. Bordeaux negociants start to be interested in the vintage since 2000. It is now sold as a future wine to professionals. On specific foreign markets, Clos is sold under the label DAME GAFFELIERE.

name: Les Jardins De Soutard  Grand Cru "Le 2nd Chateau Soutard"
wine_color: Ruby red, with purplish reflection in youth.
desc_en_short: A very elegant style, along with a pleasant and long finish. A very well-balanced and traditonal style St.Emilion.

name: Chateau Grand Corbin  Grandcru Classe
desc_en_short: Château Grand Corbin Grand Cru Classé is a rich, Merlot-dominant Saint-Émilion from a terroir bordering Pomerol, delivering ebony-dark depth, peppery spice, silky tannins, and a smoky, meaty character that lingers with vibrant freshness on the finish.

name: Chateau Trotte Vielle  1Er Grand Cru Classe B
style: Merlot, 49% Cabernet Franc And 2% Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: 89 points in Wine Advocate "The 2013 Trottevieille has a light, slightly earthy, woodland-scented bouquet with fine definition. It might lack a bit of vigor, but there is charm here and a sense of personality. The palate is medium-bodied with crisp and perhaps slightly obtrusive tannin that should be abraded down with time. This Saint Emilion is nicely balanced, nonchalant and carefree with a smudged cherry and redcurrant finish. This is perfectly satisfying for the vintage and should give up to a decade's worth of drinking pleasure."

name: Chateau D'Arcole  Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Château d’Arcole is deep purple in colour. The nose is characterised by intense aromas of red fruits (blackcurrant, blackberry), and warm toasted bread and vanilla notes. The palate is rich and elegant with silky tannins. It can be appreciated for its fruit when young, but its robust structure will allow it to age in the cellar for several years.

name: Chateau du Domaine De L'Eglise
desc_en_short: It is in 1589 that the name is mentioned for the first time in the „Vieux Papiers du Libournais“, which makes Domaine de l’Eglise the oldest estate on Pomerols famous plateau. Originally property of the church, it was a hospice for people with a disease that were thus kept out of the city of Libourne. The estate was secularised in the 18th century. Domaine de l’Eglise, as the name is indicating, lies next to Pomerols church, close to Château Petrus. The round, smooth and fruity Domaine de l’Eglise has been among the most popular ones from Pomerol for many years

name: Chateau Nenin Pomerol  2014
desc_en_short: 92 points in Wine Advocate - "The 2014 Nenin was a bit of a whipcracker when I tasted it from barrel, so I was intrigued to find whether it would replicate that performance now in bottle. The bouquet is very well defined, perhaps more minerally and taut than previous vintages with truffle-tinged red berry fruit unfurling in the glass. There is also a potent tang of the sea (kelp or oyster shell perhaps). The palate is very well balanced, supple in the mouth, but it exerts a pleasant grip in the mouth and much more purity than vintages tasted over the 1990s and 2000s. This builds on that promise in barrel and is really quite a lovely Pomerol deserving of its newly designed label."

name: Chateau Latour-Martillac  2014
desc_en_short: A beautifully crafted Pessac-Léognan red from the Graves, Château Latour-Martillac 2014 offers intense blackberry, warm gravel minerality, and supple ripe tannins — an approachable yet serious Cru Classé de Graves that rewards both early drinking and short-term cellaring.

name: Chateau Olivier  Grand Cru Classe 2014
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 41% Merlot And 4% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: 91 points in Wine Advocate "The 2014 Olivier was one of the very pleasant surprises, to wit, a vastly improved wine compared to its showing in barrel. It has a perfumed bouquet with fine purity, focused with mineral/cold stone scents filtering through the melange of red and black fruit. The palate is well balanced with supple tannin, a keen line of acidity and well-integrated oak. This displays more substance than recent vintages with a lovely allspice and cedar note towards the finish. I would give this a couple of years in bottle and then enjoy over the next 15-18 years. Tasted twice with consistent notes."

name: Wolf Blass  Platinum Label Barossa Shiraz
desc_en_short: Complex and opulent, with the fine, layered structure, elegance and finesse we have come to expect of the Medlands Vineyard. The palate is laden with pure, rich, dark berry flavours, given tight focus with fine, spicy French oak. A sleek, silky texture, definitive tannin line, and lingering finish give rise to a wine of grace, stature and presence.

name: Vega Sicilia  Valbuena 5° 2007
desc_en_short: 92 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2007 Valbuena is rounded and warmer than the 2006 with lush dark berry fruits interlaced with scents of espresso and bay leaf. The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannins, crisp acidity with a composed, focused finish of black cherries, raspberry, cedar and mocha. The 2007 has great precision and focus. It is more feminine and assured than the 2006, but one senses that it is holding something back to charm consumers in five or six year's time. This is very impressive. Drink 2017-2030."

name: Chateau Picard  Cru Bourgeois Saint-Estephe
wine_color: A deep color and harmonious composition.
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

In 1992, Jean-Claude Rouzaud, oenologist and Board Chairman of Champagne Louis Roederer, acquired and combined two Cru Bourgeois vineyards in the heart of the Medoc's prestigious Saint-Estèphe appellation: Château Picard and Château Beauséjour. Together, these properties make up what is now called Château Haut-Beauséjour.

name: Yalumba  Samuel's Collection Barossa Grenache Shiraz Mataro
desc_en_short:
91 points in James Suckling

Cherry red in colour and wonderfully aromatic, displaying clove, strawberry, mint, rhubarb and curry leaf. A silky wine with a juicy palate of raspberry and cherry with svelte tannins, making this wine highly drinkable.

Enjoy with vitello tonnato or homemade pita crisps and baba ganoush.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2019
wine_color: A dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints.
desc_en_short: "The Beaujolais-Villages Nouveau exhibits the same intense colour as the Beaujolais Nouveau. The wines are all colourful, rather concentrated, with a delicious mix of red fruits and black fruits. The Beaujolais Nouveau 2019 is clearly a Beaujolais with character, reflecting an excellent vintage where the weather conditions were ideal. You should all have a lot of fun".

name: G.D. Vajra  Barolo Bricco delle Viole DOCG
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

Aldo Vaira’s wines are characterised by pristine flavours and clearly defined perfumes. These characters are attributable to the position of his vineyards at about 400 metres above sea level in the village of Vergne in the commune of Barolo. G.D. Vajra was established in 1972 and named after Aldo’s father, Giuseppe Domenico. Aldo has been gradually increasing the area under vine to 60 hectares, of which 10 are Nebbiolo for Barolo, located in such strategic spots as Bricco delle Viole, Fossati, La Volta and Coste di Vergne. A traditionalist, Aldo adheres to old-style winemaking methods, though blends these with new techniques, such as temperature controlled fermentation, to produce such superbly elegant wines.

name: G.D. Vajra  Barbera D'Alba Superiore DOC
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

Red with violet hues, this wine offers a rich range of complex aromas, with notes of red fruits, dry hay, flowers, licorice, and incense. A rich Barbera d'Alba with a subtle mineral texture and incredible depth.

name: G.D. Vajra  Dolcett D'Alba Coste & Fossati DOC
wine_color: Vibrant purple color, deep and brilliant.
desc_en_short: The Dolcetto Coste & Fossati is characterized by a fascinating vibrant purple color, deep and brilliant. A symphony of red fruits, sour cherry, enveloping notes of licorice and menthol. Lively, complex and silky tannins, for a Dolcetto, which aging in the bottle, will reveal a surprising freshness.

name: Chateau d'Agassac  AOC Haut Médoc
wine_color: A fine red colour with violet tints
desc_en_short: The Château d’Agassac, the premium wine, is crafted from the oldest wines and the very best terroirs of deep gravely soil. It is the very epitome of a modern Médoc, powerful and with a strong backbone but at the same time beautifully balanced and fruity, with smooth tannins. Although made for cellaring, it will delight connoisseurs of medium aged wines who appreciate fullness, fruitiness and balance. It is one of the Haut-Médoc’s best-reviewed and most award-winning wines.

name: Castello di Albola Chianti Classico Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: Castello di Albola's Chianti Classico Riserva is a benchmark expression of 100% Sangiovese, sourced from eight select estate vineyards at altitude and aged nearly three years — including fourteen months in oak — delivering concentrated black fruit, cut flowers, and silky, structured tannins.

name: Wirra Wirra  RSW Shiraz
wine_color: Deep plum with a crimson rim.
desc_en_short: We named this wine after Robert Strangways Wigley, a noted South Australian eccentric and state cricketer who established Wirra Wirra back in 1894. Each vintage we take pride in producing a flagship shiraz that befits McLaren Vale’s reputation as a first class producer of this varietal and home to some of the oldest shiraz vines in the world.

name: Moulin de Duhart  2 ème Vin de Chateau Duhart Milon Rothschild
desc_en_short: The approachable second wine of Château Duhart-Milon Rothschild, Moulin de Duhart draws from younger Pauillac vines to deliver a polished, Merlot-led Bordeaux blend with classic Left Bank character — ready to enjoy sooner than its celebrated grand vin sibling.

name: Vasse Felix  Icon Range Tom Cullity Cabernet Sauvignon Malbec
wine_color: Deep maroon with a brick and purple tint.
desc_en_short: Named for Vasse Felix's visionary founder, Tom Cullity is Margaret River's most compelling flagship red — a 76% Cabernet Sauvignon, 20% Malbec, and 4% Petit Verdot blend grown from the estate's oldest vines, earning 99 points from James Suckling for its extraordinary finesse, depth, and regional authority.

name: Wirra Wirra  Scrubby Rise Shiraz
wine_color: Deep scarlet with a clear, bright edge color.
desc_en_short: Deep scarlet with a clear, bright edge color. The nose of Passionfruit, gooseberry and citrus all leap out of the glass in a bouquet that is vibrant, fresh and varietal. The palate is loaded with bright, juicy lime and passionfruit, staying clean and crisp through to a finish with satisfying freshness and length.

name: Wirra Wirra  1894 Adelaide Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Deep plum with brilliant crimson hue.
desc_en_short: Wirra Wirra's 1894 Cabernet Sauvignon is a vibrant, fruit-forward expression from Adelaide Hills, offering generous aromas of plum, mulberry, and blackberry with a bright, juicy palate that delivers approachable richness and charm in every glass.

name: Wirra Wirra  Church Block
wine_color: Deep plum with a scarlet edge color.
desc_en_short: Wirra Wirra's Church Block is a McLaren Vale classic — a Cabernet Sauvignon, Shiraz, and Merlot blend delivering fragrant red and black fruits, rich plum, polished leather, and fine sandy tannins with a fresh cedar finish.

name: Chateau Latour 2015
style: 97.1% Cabernet Sauvignon, 2.6% Merlot And 0.3% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: A majestic First Growth from Pauillac in 2015, Château Latour delivers a blend dominated by Cabernet Sauvignon that evidences both the power and finesse of its terroir, built to age for decades.

name: De Stefani  Solèr
desc_en_short: “Solèr” is a word of the Venetian dialect and means loft, barn. Historically it was used by the grapes grower to dry their best grapes. From this old tradition part of the grapes are naturally dried, resulting in a great smoothness with liquorice notes.

name: De Stefani  Kreda (Single Vineyard)
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: The word "kreda" is a local dialect word and means clay. These Refosco dal peduncolo rosso vines grow in a clay soil, that gives a strong body and a firm personality to the wine.

name: Tor  Kenward Proprietary Red Oakville
style: Cabernet Franc, 44% Petit Verdot And 12% Cabernet Sauvignon
grape_variety: Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
95 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2014 Proprietary Red from Oakville is 44% Cabernet Franc, 44% Petit Verdot and 12% Cabernet Sauvignon. This is a fabulous wine and a creative blend from Kenward. With a fabulous nose of forest floor, white flowers, licorice, incense, blackcurrant and blueberry fruit, this deep, sumptuous, full-bodied wine has fabulous intensity, low acidity and finely grained, integrated tannins. There is not much of it, but it is a beauty. It can be drunk now or cellared for another two decades. Tor Kenward is using his vast experience in the wine industry and impressive palate to find exceptional terroirs and produce fascinating wines that merit serious attention. His winemaking guru is Jeff Ames, who makes his own wines under the Rudius label...Kenward has an impressive array of 2014 reds, all of them showing as well as, or better, than I had predicted in my range of scores last year."

96 points in James Suckling - "A red with walnuts, cocoa, currants and spices. Medium-to full-bodied, very intense and linear. Lovely length and beauty. Such finesse. 44% petit verdot (Vine Hill), 44% cabernet franc (To Kolan) and 12% cabernet franc (To Kolan). So right now but will be glorious with bottle age."

name: La Rioja Alta Gran Reserva 890 (Wooden Case)
wine_color: Its medium garnet red color, with an incipient iodine tinge on the rim of the glass.
desc_en_short: The 2010 Gran Reserva 890 stands out for its medium garnet red color, with an incipient iodine tinge on the rim of the glass. The nose reveals the characteristic notes of Rioja classicism: cherry jam, black plum compote, tobacco leaf, cinnamon, vanilla, pepper and chocolate powder. The refinement of its tannins and its gentle freshness lend this wine an elegant and pleasant mouthfeel. Classic Rioja bouquet, broad, complex, round and with an elegant finish. This wine has a long life ahead of it.

name: The Standish  Barossa Valley Single Vineyard Shiraz
desc_en_short: A dry-grown, organically farmed single vineyard Shiraz from the western edge of the Barossa Valley, crafted with foot stomping and aged in French oak — delivering intensely concentrated dark fruit, chocolatey tannins, and beautifully integrated structure.

name: Domaine Philippe Charlopin-Parizot  Charmes Chambertin Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Deep ruby color. Very primary aroma of blackberry, cassis and violet. Then densely packed and surprisingly sweet and pliant, showing a subbtle saline character and full ripeness to the dark berry and mineral flavors. This wine displays sexy vinosity and more lift in the early going than the clos de Vougeot.  A rich, thick, very long Charmes-Chambertin with serious concentration.

name: Chateau Petrus  2012
desc_en_short:
Chateau Petrus Winery

Little known 50 years ago, this château has seen the rise of a myth about the uniqueness of its wine. The wine’s inimatibility is due to many factors, first of all, an exceptional terroir - 40 meters above sea level, the highest point of the appellation - with a layer of heavy clay soil and an iron subsoil. These are ideal conditions for the expression of the Merlot grape. With such a special terroir, the approach in the vineyard and cellar is traditional and respectful.

The work done in the vineyard is fastidious - severe pruning in the winter, regular ploughing, crop-thinning, de-leafing, manicuring the clusters in the summer - and allows the perfect ripening of the fruit. The grape are manually harvested within two afternoons and sorted before crush.

Fermentation is carried out gently, without any overextraction, in temperature-controlled concrete tanks. The blend, very often pure Merlot, is defined in December and the young wine is aged in 100% new oak barrels.

This property made famous by Madame Edmond Loubat and then by Monsieur Jean-Pierre Moueix, culminates at 130 feet on the plateau of Pomerol. Ets Jean-Pierre Moueix is responsible for the cultivation, vinification and aging as well as the export distribution of Petrus wines.

name: Giuseppe Cortese  Barbera D'Alba
desc_en_short: Intense and velvety vinous perfum. Dry flavour and full body. Deep purplish colour, almost impenetrable red.

name: Giuseppe Cortese  Barbaresco Rabaja
desc_en_short: Barbaresco Rabajà is our most important wine and has an intense and ethereal perfume with fresh notes that evolve into scents of spices, tobacco and brushwood notes as it ages. A dry, full and robust flavour with a rich and harmonious structure; garnet red colour.

name: Giuseppe Cortese  Barbaresco Riserva Rabaja
desc_en_short: The winery’s signature wine; produced exclusively in the most classic vintages, it reaches the highest expression of the Nebbiolo variety, in terms of complexity and longevity, in the Rabajà vineyard. This wine is a selection from a small part of Rabajà and is only made in the best, classic years. It has considerable structure, elegance and great capacity for evolution.

name: Travaglini Gattinara  Nebbiolo
desc_en_short: 89 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Aromas of coconut, dark-skinned berry and exotic spice come together on this. The taut linear palate offers dried cherry, star anise, sage and a hint of espresso alongside brisk acidity and tight close-grained tannins that grip the close." - KERIN O’KEEFE

name: Travaglini Gattinara  Riserva Nebbiolo
desc_en_short:
Winemaking

Crushed and macerated for about 15 days in stain-less steel tanks at controlled temperature. The wine is aged for 4 years. 3 years in oak casks of different origin and sizes, then rests in the bottle for 8 months

name: Travaglini Gattinara  IL Sogno
desc_en_short: 92 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Baking-spice, prune and wild herb aromas lead the nose on this brawny red. Concentrated but elegant, the structured full-bodied palate doles out raspberry compote, cherry marinated in spirits and licorice alongside fine-grained tannins."

name: Berton vineyards  Outback Jack Shiraz Merlot
wine_color: Dark purple color with ruby ​​highlights.  More: https://winestyleonline.com
desc_en_short: Berton Vineyards Outback Jack Shiraz Merlot is a crowd-pleasing Australian red that blends the bold spice of Shiraz with the soft, rounded fruit of Merlot, delivering ripe berries, chocolate, and vanilla in an approachable, velvety style.

name: Cordero Di Montezemolo  Barolo Bricco Gattera DOCG (Single Vineyard)
desc_en_short:
Intense garnet red color. Warm and
mature nose with notes of jam, raspberry,
licorice, cherry and camphor. Soft
mouth of remarkable structure with fine
tannins and persistence.

name: Maxville  Zinfandel California
desc_en_short: Light ruby red in color. Black cherry fruit intertwined with pepper and spice notes, Medium body, easy drink and a tasty finish.

name: Sutil  Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Sutil Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon from Chile delivers inviting aromas of strawberry, raspberry, and plum layered with cinnamon and vanilla spice. The palate is well-balanced with nicely integrated tannins, making it an approachable yet satisfying expression of Chilean Cabernet.

name: Sutil  Reserve Carmenere
desc_en_short: Our Sutil Reserve Carmenère displays elegant aromas of ripe black fruits such as cherries and blueberries along with delicate smoky and toasted notes. The wine is very smooth and creamy on the palate with well-rounded tannins and good persistence.

name: Sutil  Reserve Merlot
desc_en_short: A refreshing wine with fruity aromas and a spicy touch recalling black pepper. Well balanced on the palate with a smooth, pleasing finish.

name: Copperstone Creek  Shiraz
desc_en_short: A classic Shiraz produced by Warburn Estates from the warm Riverina vineyards on the northern side of the Murray River in New South Wales. The label depicts the local fish found in the Murray River and the wine delivers a powerful aromatic aroma of fruitcake and plums. On the palate there are powerful lifted notes of spice and mint. A polished example of Australia`s redolent, signature grape.

name: La Belle Angele  Merlot
desc_en_short: This wine has a nice dark colour. It exhales delicious scents of red fruits and dried tomato with spicy hints. Rich and round, with smooth tannins, it has delicate aromas of cherry and pepper on the palate as well as notes reminiscent of sour cherry flan.

name: Kressmann Bordeaux 'Monopole' Rouge AOC
desc_en_short: The perfect balance of fruit and oak character acquired during ageing. Immediately rounded and powerful, the silky tannins on the finish reflect the ripeness of fruit underpinned by perfectly balanced oak.

name: Ceretto  Barbaresco "Bernadot" BIO DOCG
desc_en_short: This beautiful vineyard, located below the village of Treiso, towards the Pertinace hamlet, has been considered one of the best of the commune for more than a century. It is thought to be the natural continuation of the Nerve, which has the same orientation and position of the land. The vineyard is enclosed in a natural amphitheater and this formation creates a special microclimate very favourable to the vines, which is not affected by considerable height (400 meters in the upper-most part). Ceretto works 4.8 hectares of this cru biodynamically, which year after year gives us more and more expressive wines, extremely pleasing on the palate and remarkably dynamic.

name: Ceretto  Barolo "Brunate" BIO DOCG
wine_color: It has a garnet color with wide and deep orange reflections.
desc_en_short: There is a carnival of flowers on the nose, accompanied by ethereal accents, in the generous vintages, or by a range of citrus notes, in the fresher years. In its youth, the wine is instilled with a fruit that seems sweet and whole, the tannins are able to enliven the mouthfeel and restore tension, without removing smoothness from its taste. It is the development, then, that makes the picture precious, painting the whole with autumnal tones and whiffs of smokiness. There is an aura of pure hedonism, which pervades the summit of this hill.

name: Ceretto  Barolo "Prapo" BIO DOCG
desc_en_short: his vineyard, located half-way between the hamlet of Baudana and the village of Serralunga d'Alba, is without a doubt one of the best exposed plots of the eastern side of the town. The orientation is South / South-East and the altitude is between 270 meters and 380 meters. The soils (conformations of Lequio), have a high percentage of silt and clay (over 30%) and this feature means the wines produced in the area have a distinct and rare punchiness. Ceretto owns 2.4 hectares (of the 8.5 hectares of the total sub-zone) featuring a high average age of the vines, planted in the '70s. Compared to the western side of the appellation, the Prapò vineyard has a gap in the harvest period, which in some years may exceed 10 days; this allows the grapes to mature slowly and exhibit good polyphenolics.

name: Ceretto  Barolo "Bricco Rocche"  DOCG
wine_color: It has a garnet color with wide and deep orange reflections.
desc_en_short: This Castiglione Falletto vineyard is the smallest geographic area within the Barolo specification and comprises just over 1 hectare. It is the most prestigious part of what was once called La Serra and is nestled between the Villero and the Rocche (rock face) of Castiglione, which represents the best of the top parts; it can be considered a monopole as the whole parcel is the exclusive property of the Ceretto family. The height of the vineyard is optimum, going from 350 to 370 meters above sea level, with southeast to southwest exposure. The earth (sandstone of Diano) reinforce the ideal sense of balance, suggested the geographic location, and see good percentages of sand, silt and clay.

name: Tenuta Luisa  Edmida Venezia Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red in colour with violet nuances, this wine reveals aromas of fruit with notes of raspberry and blueberry.

name: Tenuta Luisa  Isonzo Refosco Del Peduncolo Friuli DOC
desc_en_short: Ancient native variety of Friuli and very popular across the entire region. Garnet red in colour tending to violet. Concentrated aromas and pleasant hints of wild blackberries and undergrowth. Spicy, typically firm tannins, frank with a sustained, pleasant aftertaste. With the right ageing, it gets finer and mellow. The wine embodies the typical character of the variety and a strong regional identity.

name: Arnaldo Caprai  Montefalco Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: Sensationally intense, with notes of wild flowers, violet and red berry jam. Full bodied, rich, dry with a long finish and delicate hint of spice.

name: Arnaldo Caprai  Montefalco Rosso Riserva DOC
desc_en_short: Bouquet of wild cherries preserved in spirits, chocolate, violets, vanilla and exotic spices. Full bodied and round, perfectly balanced with vibrant, velvety tannins.

name: Arrigoni  La Bisbetica Provincia Di Pavia IGT
desc_en_short: Wine made from grapes Barbera has an intense ruby red color, clear and bright, and his scent is intense, fruity with hints of cherry and violet. The flavor is dry, fruity, full-bodied and slightly acidic. It 'a wine suitable for robust dishes and meats in general, is great on mixed boiled meats.

name: Clos du Gravillas  Sous les Cailloux
style: Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Carignan, Grenache, Counoise, Terret Gris And Mourvèdre
desc_en_short: Sous les Cailloux des Grillons, supple, red fruit, lively, Natural red wine. Sous Les Cailloux is a frank and fresh wine with red fruit, fluidity and a touch of tannin. Short skin time for this blend of at least 7 varietals, one year's ageing in tank only! It is bursting with bramble and blackberry flavours. There's a savoury edge which is unsurprising given the savoury notes given to wine by Syrah and Mourvedre. A touch of eucalyptus finishes this wine off nicely. In the mouth it's silky, without overpowering tannins.

name: Clos du Gravillas  RDV sur la Lune
grape_variety: Carignan, Grenache, Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Mourvèdre
desc_en_short: An opaque-purple in colour. On the nose aromas of black cherries, blueberries and figs. On the palate, fresh and smooth with notes of sweet spices and red fruits. Silky in texture with a solid mineral backbone. The finish is long and crisp. Recommended for those of a carniverous disposition! Try with roast saddle of hare with beetroot, ragout of lamb with spring vegetables or daube de boeuf a la Gardiane with orange peel and black olives.

name: Chateau HYOT  AOP Castillon Cotes de Bordeaux
desc_en_short: Château Hyot's Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux is a ripe, mineral-driven Right Bank blend delivering layers of dark blackberry, blackcurrant, and toasted oak, grounded by sandy-gravelly terroir that lends the wine its signature stony freshness and authentic Bordeaux character.

name: Chateau Fourney  AOC Saint Emilion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Château Fourney delivers a classic Saint-Émilion Grand Cru experience — generous ripe cherry and raspberry fruit from Merlot-led vines on the limestone plateau, framed by subtly toasted oak and the polished structure that makes the 2016 vintage one of Bordeaux's most celebrated recent releases.

name: Chateau Le Dauphin D'Olivier  AOC Pessac-Leognan (Seconds Vins)
desc_en_short: This wine is made from 50% Merlot and 50% Cabernet Sauvignon, the red wines of Pessac-Léognan make a good compromise between marked tannins and the greediness of the fruit. We thus find red and ripe fruits, and empyreumatic notes.

name: Wolf Blass  Red Label Shiraz Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Wolf Blass Red Label blends ripe, plush Shiraz with the structure of Cabernet Sauvignon for a smooth, fruit-driven Australian red that's approachable on release and built for everyday enjoyment.

name: Wolf Blass  Red Label Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot
wine_color: Dark purple with a crimson rim
desc_en_short: Wolf Blass Red Label blends Cabernet Sauvignon's structured dark-fruit length with Merlot's plush, plummy mid-palate, delivering a generous, fruit-driven red with soft tannins and easy everyday appeal — excellent value from one of Australia's most celebrated wineries.

name: Tenuta di Campriano Buccia Nera  Chianti Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: At the palate it is very soft, followed by a good sense of volume that fills the mouth well. Tannins are present but enveloping and warm sustained by good acidity that lets predict a good aging potential. Good persistence and length that completes the tasting leaving the mouth pleasantly dry.

name: Chateau Vieux Gerget  Bordeaux Rouge
desc_en_short: A clean, soft-fruited Bordeaux Rouge from Jean da Fré's biodynamic estate at St Laurent du Bois, blending Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Cabernet Franc into an approachable, unoaked claret that lets the grape character speak for itself.

name: Tenuta Di Valgiano  Palistorti Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: Excellent concentration, which is already visible in its deep ruby colour with crimson reflections, an indication of youth. The intense bouquet is reminiscent of spices and ripe fruit. Rich and full bodied on the palate with intense fruity aromas which give the wine its excellent enduring characteristics. The fresh structure is supported by the good content of mature, balanced tannins. A very pleasant wine that gives immediate pleasure and can improve over the next seven years.

name: Tenuta Di Valgiano  Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: From the biodynamic estate of Tenuta di Valgiano in Tuscany, this elegant Rosso DOC blends Sangiovese with Syrah and Merlot into a refined, medium-bodied red with fragrant ripe fruit, spice, and mineral depth, finishing with silky tannins and a long, delicious aftertaste.

name: Hunky Dory  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: A BioGro-certified organic Pinot Noir from Marlborough's Hunky Dory, offering red cherry, plum, and vanilla aromas with a silky, fruit-forward palate shaped by gentle French oak — an approachable, vegan-friendly red built for easy everyday enjoyment.

name: J. Bouchon  Canto Norte Maule Valley
desc_en_short: 85 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Standard plum and berry aromas are lightly spicy and lightly green. This Merlot-led blend feels peppy and snappy, but not all that structured or serious. Flavors of lean berry fruits, red bell pepper and tomato leaf wrap up on a lighter-framed finish." - MICHAEL SCHACHNER

name: J. Bouchon  Canto Sur Maule Valley
desc_en_short: A vibrant, unoaked blend of Carmenere, Carignan, and País from J. Bouchon's historic Maule Valley estates, delivering juicy plum and raspberry fruit laced with earthy, herbal spice — a pure, expressive snapshot of Chile's interior dry-land terroir.

name: J. Bouchon  Pais Viejo Maule Valley
food_matching: Charcuterie, Salmon, Mushroom Dishes, Soft Cheese
desc_en_short:
91 points in James Suckling - "Fresh raspberries, cranberries, citrus and orange peel with some fresh-herb undertones. Light body, fine tannins, lovely, bright acidity and a fruity finish. Drink now."

85 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Tea notes blend with spiced cherry and raspberry aromas on this ode to the Mission grape. A light, racy palate is acidic and clampy, something that's normal for País. Flavors of currant, pie cherry and red herbal tea play out on a hard finish." - MICHAEL SCHACHNER

name: J. Bouchon  Pais Salvaje Maule Valley
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short:
92 points in James Suckling - "An unfiltered, very floral país that shows lots of hyacinth, fresh rose petals, blueberry muffin and nutmeg. Not only does this have great balance and tension between the fruit and acidity, but the fruit sits evenly across a firm bed of tannins that keep this chewy, quite structured but elegant. Drink now. "

91 points in Wine Advocate - "The just-bottled 2018 País Salvaje was fermented with full clusters but without carbonic maceration, a change compared with the 2017, where part of the wine underwent carbonic maceration. It fermented in concrete and was bottled in August 2018, some four months after the harvest. 2018 seems like a great vintage in Maule (and in a great part of Chile), depending on yields and irrigation, of course. This is juicy, fresh and with more depth and complexity. It has more weight, more precision and very good freshness. This is really impressive."

name: Santa Ema  Select Terroir Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red. Intense yet delicate with aromas of red and black fruits such as plums, blackberries, and raspberries with a light touch of toast. Well rounded with very good balance and persistence. Red meats, well-seasoned dishes, stews, and cheeses.

name: Twisted  Cabernet Sauvignon
