desc_en_short: This Cabernet Sauvignon has lively aromas of blackberry and black cherry with underlying notes of violet and black peppercorn. Featuring plush tannins, flavors of blackberry and black currant are complemented by a hint of earth, followed by spice on the finish.

name: Twisted  Old Vine Zinfandel
desc_en_short: This Old Vine Zinfandel is medium-bodied with aromas of black cherry, red currant, blackberry bramble and a hint of spice. Concentrated ripe fruit, dark berry flavors and black pepper carry through to the palate while nicely balanced acidity and plush tannins lead to a lingering finish.

name: San Polo  Brunello di Montalcino Podernovi DOCG
desc_en_short: “Aromas of forest floor, grilled herb, camphor and pipe tobacco mingle on the nose of this full-bodied red. The firm, elegantly structured palate offers juicy Marasca cherry, red currant, licorice and coffee bean. Tightly wound, fine-grained tannins and fresh acidity grip the close and lend an ageworthy structure. Drink 2026–2041. Trinchero Family Estates. Cellar Selection.” —Kerin O’Keefe

name: Chateau Pierre de Montignac  Medoc Cru Burgeois
desc_en_short: A Cru Bourgeois Médoc built on ripe Merlot and Cabernet, Château Pierre de Montignac delivers generous blackberry fruit, toasty oak, and a crisp, dry finish — a characterful everyday Bordeaux earning 88 points from Wine Enthusiast.

name: Le Haut Medoc De Haut Bages Liberal
desc_en_short: Nice and fresh nose of red and black fuits. The wine is tender, round and very pleasant to drink. The balance is reached and offers a clean finish full of fruits. The riped tannins make the wine very smooth.

name: Chateau Dallau  Bordeaux Superieur
desc_en_short: 88 points in Wine Enthusiast - "This estate in the northern vineyards of Bordeaux is planted to a blend of 75% Merlot and the two Cabernets. The wine has structure as well as rich berry fruits. Its tannins mark it out as still young, and this potentially ripe, warm wine should be drunk from 2019." - ROGER VOSS

name: Chateau Laroque  Les Tours Saint-Emilion Grand Cru
style: Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc And 1% Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Vinification

Plot by plot vinification in small capacity concrete and stainless steel vats. Gentle extraction via a mix of punching down of cap and pump-overs. Protective macerations aiming for more flesh and aromatic intensity.

name: Tenuta delle Terre Nere  Etna Rosso Prephylloxera La Vigna Di Don Peppino DOC
desc_en_short: In front and to the right of our cellar in Calderara Sottana there are two parcels, in the midst of a larger vineyard that have survived phylloxera. They, therefore, are over 130 years old and stand on their original rootstock. In 2006 I decided to vinify the grapes from those parcels separately. 2006 was a splendid vintage, rather on the monumental side. These parcels yielded a wine of such unearthly finesse that, although the wine from the neighboring old vines was a real beauty, the Prephylloxera, displaying a very similar character, seemed to feed from heavenly pastures: the quintessence of Calderara. It is a bit shier and will need more time than its younger sibling. I rarely advice decanting a wine, but in this case I do. Its elegance is measured, its authority understated, its sophistication effortless. A grand wine. I suggest many savoury fine courses in very moderate quantities. Allow the wine to grow as the dinner does.

name: Cecilia Beretta Merlot IGT
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red in colour, with lovely aromas of red berry fruits dusted with spice and hints of herbs. A soft, supple, medium to full bodied wine, that is dry with forward fruit, and smooth, velvety tannins. Grippy acidity with a hint of capsicum. Notes of milk chocolate on the the medium, long and lingering finish.

name: Cecilia Beretta  Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso DOC
desc_en_short: 88 points in Wine Enthusiast - "A blend of 60% Corvina, 20% Rondinella, 10% Corvinone and 10% Negrara, this offers delicate aromas suggesting black-skinned berry and cooking spice. The firm palate evokes blackberry jam, tobacco and green pepper alongside smooth tannins. Enjoy through 2021." - KERIN O’KEEFE

name: Cecilia Beretta  Picàie IGT
wine_color: Deep ruby red color with purple highlights
desc_en_short: A rich Veneto IGT from Cecilia Beretta, blending Corvina, Cabernet Sauvignon, and Merlot through a partial appassimento process — delivering plush cherry fruit, vanilla-laced spice, and a supple, mouth-filling structure that pairs beautifully with red meats and aged cheeses.

name: Cecilia Beretta  Amarone della Valpolicella DOCG
desc_en_short: A vigorous, full-bodied deep ruby red wine. Vibrant fragrances of currants, blackberries and sweet almonds on the nose, with notes of vanilla. Warm and rich, with silky tannins and a long and harmonic finish. Excellent with grilled red meat, powerful game stews and aged, rich cheeses. To be served at 18° C.

name: Somerton  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Dark red with purple hues in color. Aroma of blackcurrant and cedar with soft vanilla. This wine displays blackcurrant and cherry flavours, with soft integrated tannins and vanillan oak.

name: Gapsted  Hidden Story Merlot
desc_en_short: This wine is a deep garnet colour. The nose displays luscious ripe blackberry aromas. These aromas lead to a fleshy palate showing plum and dark berry fruit flavours balanced with subtle spice. The soft tannins lead to a smooth, velvety finish. Pairing with rare roast beef with parsnip puree, forest foraged mushroom soup or tuna mornay.

name: Wild & Wilder  The Opportunist Shiraz
desc_en_short: Light and just luscious enough to surround all its of its spicy, cumin-edged acidity in sour cherry and plum-pit flavors, as cool as a forest floor.

name: Wild & Wilder  The Pugilist Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A punchy Barossa Cabernet Sauvignon from Wild & Wilder, leading with sweet ripe cherry fruit before giving way to earthy, savoury depth, toasted spices, and dried herb character — a crowd-pleasing red that pulls no punches.

name: Wild & Wilder  The Exhibitionist Merlot
desc_en_short: A bold, fruit-driven Barossa Merlot from Wild & Wilder, bursting with youthful berry aromas, a deep purple hue, and firm structure that signals serious quality beneath its easygoing label.

name: Wild & Wilder  The Unforgettable GSM
desc_en_short: The Unforgettable is a generous blend of 3 varieties, all of whom are long-term friends that know the benefits of teamwork. Working in cahoots, they produce a wine with succulent red berry fruit with hints of spice and chocolate. A clever, friendly wine that is indeed truly Unforgettable.

name: Tenute Del Cerro  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano DOCG
desc_en_short: Cheery and little red fruit at the nose. Elegant and bold at the palate with a long lasting finish. Roasted meat dishes and seasoned cheeses are the perfect matchings.

name: Tenute Del Cerro  Vino Nobile di Montepulciano Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: Intense red fruit at the nose followed by a full-bodied structure on the palate. The long finish reflects the wine's fruity perfumes. To serve in large glasses at 18° C. Excellent for roasted or red rich meat, aged cheeses.

name: Agricola Querciabella  Turpino IGT
desc_en_short:
Turpino is a ‘mosaic’ of Cabernet Franc, Syrah and Merlot grown by Querciabella in Maremma, on Tuscany’s southern coast.
Surrounded by a vigorous nature, the vineyards in Alberese are influenced by the proximity to the Tyrrhenian sea and benefit from a significant temperature range that guarantees a good phenolic maturation of the grapes while retaining balanced levels of natural fruit acidity.

After gentle de-stemming, the grapes are transferred into three and five-ton oak fermenters, where they undergo a brief period of cold maceration in preparation for a slow and natural fermentation process which is prompted by the presence of indigenous yeast.  The completion of the alcoholic fermentation leads to a post-fermentation maceration, during which daily tastings serve to track tannin development and stability. The wine is then separated from the skins by draining the tank by means of gravity flow. Only the resulting ‘free run’ is used when the wine is racked into fine and extra-fine grained French oak barriques, up to 30% new (tight grain for Cabernet Franc; tight-to-medium grain for Syrah and Merlot).

Following 18 months of maturation, the final blend is made and moved into cement tanks for an integration period of 6 to 8 months before bottling.

Elegance and finesse trump muscle in Turpino: inviting floral nose and youthful ruby colour lead the way to delicate purity of fruit, roundness and depth, accompanied by fine and silky tannins. Initially bottled as an estate reserve wine – the vintage was 2007 – 2010 was the first Turpino to be officially released for worldwide distribution in spring 2012. It is solely produced in the best vintages.

name: Cantine Russo  Luce di Lava Etna Rosso
desc_en_short: Brilliant ruby red color, it is characterized by an olfactory vivacity and an harmonious structure. The delicate aromas are those of berries and sourcherry. The flavor is fruity and full-bodied, with a great freshness. At tasting structure and balance are perceived, characteristics that make it pleasant and unique.

name: Vina Pedrosa  Cepa Gavilan
desc_en_short: The wines from this vintage, which was classified as excellent, have a good colour intensity, significant fruity notes on the nose and a high tannic potential in the mouth, with sweet tannins that indicate the good phenolic ripening of the berries.

name: Finca Sobreno  Crianza
wine_color: Deep-red cherry colour with purple tones at the edges.
desc_en_short: Deep-red cherry colour with purple tones at the edges. Intense aroma, good combination of black berries with toasted nuances from the oak. Balsamic and spicy underscore. Potent bouquet, meaty with very fine and ripe tannins. Long and persistent aftertaste.

name: Finca Sobreno  Reserva Seleccion Especial
wine_color: Deep cherry red, clean and bright.
desc_en_short: Deep cherry red, clean and bright. Good aromatic intensity with notes of ripe red fruits over a base of elegant balsamic. In the mouth is tasty, mellow, fresh and with fine nuances of sweet fruit. It has volume and the tannins are wel integrated and polished. In the afterstaste, touches of very ripe fruit and nuances of liquor appear making it last in the palate.

name: Artero  Tempranillo
desc_en_short: Brilliant crimson hue with an inviting nose of fragrant violets, pomegranate and redcurrant. Lovely dusty tannins and a round, velvety mouthfeel. Harmonious and easy drinking, with good weight, flavour intensity and balance.

name: Artero  Crianza
wine_color: Intense, brilliant and clean ruby colour.
desc_en_short: Artero Crianza is a brave assembly of two early varieties such as Merlot and Tempranillo at 50% growing under La Mancha merciless sun which requires special care in the maturation process of these two breeds. It comes from the selection of own vineyards of 35 years that in these lands can be considered old.

name: Artero  Reserva
wine_color: Dark cherry colour with a surrounding outline of cherry red.
desc_en_short: Dark cherry colour with a surrounding outline of cherry red. It shows a balanced nose, with pleasant toasted notes. Clean aromas of cherry, plum, raisin, bay leaves and eucalyptus. On the palate it is silky, with ripe fruit flavours along with notes of spices, coffee, and a bit of vanilla and cinnamon. The tannins melt and the finish is persistent.

name: Castelli del Grevepesa  Clemente VII Chianti Classico DOCG
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red colour. Bouquet with strong aromas of forest fruits well combined with toasted notes of vanilla and spices. The flavour displays perfect harmony with significant sweet tannins that give it a velvety flavour with considerable fullness of body.

name: Castelli del Grevepesa  Panzano Gran Selezione Chianti Classico DOCG Gran Selezione
wine_color: Very intense ruby red in colour.
desc_en_short: Sangiovese selection from the Panzano area, famous since time immemorial for the quality of its wines. South of the village, the hills slope down to form what has for centuries been known as the “Conca d’Oro” (Golden Basin). The medium-high altitude (300-450 m above sea level), together with the exceptional exposure to the sun and the land particularly rich in clay and limestone, create the conditions for the finest quality winegrowing. Very intense ruby red in colour. It has an intense and complex aroma with notes of violet and hints of spices. Full-bodied, sapid flavour with elegant and velvety tannins.

name: Castelli del Grevepesa  Clemente VII Gran Selezione Chianti Classico DOCG Gran Selezione
wine_color: Intense and bright ruby red colour.
desc_en_short: Intense and bright ruby red colour. Complex and deep fragrance with ripe fruit aroma in perfect harmony with spicy notes. Elegant and balanced flavour, rich with noble tannins that work easily with the essences of wood.

name: Maison de Grand Esprit  L'Etre Magique Bordeaux
desc_en_short: This 2016 bordeaux has a supple, juicy palate loaded with succulent berry flavors infused with warm, gentle spice. This classic blend is exceptionally inviting.

name: Maison de Grand Esprit  L'Etre Magique Bourgogne
desc_en_short: Ruby red, bright and berry laden best describes our sumptuous bourgogne from the sublime 2016 vintage. Juicy and well-balanced with subtle tannins and a sweet sensation, this wine is a match made in heaven for coq au vin, beef bourguignon and creamy camembert cheese.

name: Maison de Grand Esprit  La Mysteriale Chateauneuf du Pape
wine_color: Deep and intense garnet Red Colour
desc_en_short: This classic Rhone blend offers structure, length and a rich depth of fruit, reminiscent of a warm, sunny summer. Rich and structured, this wine will be perfect for cellaring thanks to a huge vintage. With Ripe red fruits flavours and a hint of pepper, the mouth is dense with a big amount of soft tannins and some freshness at the finale.

name: Cuatro Mill  Coneana Edicion Limitada
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Deep ruby with purple color, Red and Black berries fruitiness with raspberries, cherry, strawberries, blue berries, black currents, along with aroma earthiness, with medium-high layer, with a lot of aromatic intensity, highlighting the nuances of spices and roasted, with perfection long finish.

name: Sterling  Vintner S Collection Merlot
desc_en_short: The Sterling Vintner’s Collection Merlot boasts vivid aromas of fresh mixedberry jam, red cherry, milk chocolate and baked spice. The wine is round and with good weight and generous flavors of blackberry bramble, sweet toasted oak and mocha. The wine is full-bodied with great concentration, silky tannins and a lengthy finish.

name: Sterling  Vintner Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Winemaking Notes

At our newly renovated reserve winery, each lot is kept separate until the final blending, allowing for the selection of the most expressive and unique barrels to combine in the final blend. Each of these lots aged for 16 months in a combination of French, European and American oak barrels. Once ready, the barrels are carefully evaluated and only those reflecting the true hallmarks of the Napa Valley are selected for the final Napa Valley blend.

name: Beaulieu Vineyard  California Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: For more than a century our Cabernet Sauvignon has defined the unique character of california. This elegant wine express notes of black cherry, rasberry and warm spice.

name: Beaulieu Vineyard  Tapestry Red
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 11% Merlot, 7% Malbec, 4% Cabernet Franc And 3% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Our 2015 Tapestry is a true reflection of the exceptional 2015 growing season with its expressive, vibrant aromas and flavors, along with incredible structure, layered with an underscore of bright acidity that makes this wine incredibly approachable. This is a wine that shows the artistry of blending five Bordeaux-heritage grape varieties grown within the Napa Valley, which contribute layer-upon-layer of flavor complexity. Cabernet Sauvignon imparts a generous core of juicy wild blackberry, dark blueberry cobbler, and cassis, while the Merlot shows a brighter, riper dark cherry fruit character. The Merlot also softens the tannins and adds plushness and texture on the generous and pleasing mouthfeel. Malbec contributed dark plum and briary blackberry notes, while the Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot completed the blend with broad nuances of violet, wild sage, and anise seed. Well integrated notes of graham cracker crust and gingerbread also tantalize your senses from the toasted oak spices – having been aged in new French oak barrels – which heighten the aromas and linger on the finish. Amazingly food friendly.

name: Beaulieu Vineyard  Georges De Latour Private Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 4% Merlot, 3% Petit Verdot And 3% Malbec
desc_en_short: The 2015 vintage influenced our signature Georges de Latour Private Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon by crafting a wine small in yield, but mighty in concentration, depth and elegance. The bouquet shows beautiful freshness with a cascade of red and dark berry fruit notes followed by hints of rose petal and violet. Rich, with a full-bodied structure on the palate, the wine is complex and expressive, revealing layers of blackcurrant, bright raspberry, dark cherry and cassis, followed by hints of cedar, cinnamon, clove and mocha. Plush tannins support the expansive palate, while impeccably balanced acidity adds vibrancy and freshness. Well integrated notes of vanilla and toasted oak spices - from aging in new French oak barrels - heighten the aromas and linger on the finish. To enjoy this wine at its full potential, we recommend at least five years of bottle aging; however if you can’t wait, decant before serving.

name: Beaulieu Vineyard  Rarity Rutherford Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon Magnum (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: The Beaulieu Vineyard 2013 Rarity delivers massive power and weight, yet with uncommon elegance and suppleness. The wine’s profuse aromas of blackberry, cassis, dark chocolate and violet are mirrored by the opulent flavors that explode on the palate. Seamlessly integrated vanilla and oak spice nuances, from barrel fermentation and aging in entirely new barrels, add even more complexity to the layered Cabernet Sauvignon expression. “Rutherford Dust” tannins contribute texture, while bright acidity keeps its fresh, purity of focus. This is a wine that will age for decades.

name: Brancaia  Cabernet Sauvignon Maremma DOC
desc_en_short: From Brancaia's coastal Maremma estate in Tuscany, this 100% Cabernet Sauvignon spends 12 months in oak to deliver a smooth, velvety texture with a lasting finish — an approachable yet characterful expression of one of Italy's most exciting wine regions.

name: Chateau Kirwan  K De Kirwan
style: Merlot 27% Cabernet Sauvignon 10% Cabernet Franc 10% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: K de Kirwan is the approachable second wine of Château Kirwan, a Margaux Third Grand Cru Classé, offering ripe black cherry and berry fruit with a fine oak touch, medium body, and a pleasantly spiced finish — elegant Bordeaux character at a more accessible price point.

name: Château Larrivet Haut Brion  Le Bordeaux de Rouge
desc_en_short: "As an introduction to the Château Larrivet Haut-Brion range, this complex and powerful wine has silky tannins. Well balanced and round, it will be greatly appreciated paired with red meats or ripened cheeses. Can be enjoyed now or in the next 3 to 5 years."

name: Pauillac de Lynch Bages 2016
desc_en_short: Deep color, with finely wooded aromas of red fruits and spices. The mouth is well rounded with silky tannins. Very nice freshness, with elegant and suave finish. Serve with red meat, lamb, game or stews.

name: M. Chapoutier  Cotes du Rhone Bio
desc_en_short: Very intense garnet red. Open and precise on the nose, with red fruit aromas. Honest and delicious on the entry. Rich, full-bodied with silky tannins, showing a beautiful structure and ending with a fruity and elegant finish.

name: M. Chapoutier  Les Varonniers
desc_en_short:
92 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "A smoking Crozes Hermitage, the 2012 Crozes Hermitage les Varonniers sports a vibrant purple color to go with notes of black cherries, bouquet garni and ground pepper. Medium to full-bodied, soft, fleshy and beautifully textured, is has enough underlying tannin to keep it drinking nicely through 2022 or so. It's worth noting that at a recent 2003 retrospective, this was firing on all cylinders and bested more than a few more expensive Hermitage."

92 points in Wine Spectator - "This has ample toast, but the core of raspberry, plum and blackberry fruit is wonderfully melded with savory, iron and anise notes. A graphite edge lends racy feel through the finish, with a tarry backdrop. Rock-solid. Drink now through 2020. "

name: M. Chapoutier  Ermitage Le Méal
wine_color: Deep garnet red with purple lights during its youth.
desc_en_short:
Vinification

The harvest, totally destemmed, is vinified in a small cement vat. High temperature maceration enables a good extraction of grape potential, to obtain soft and stable tannins, compulsory to keep the wine for a very long time. Only the free-run juice is used in this single vineyard.

name: M. Chapoutier  Croix De Bois Chateauneuf du Pape
desc_en_short: 97 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "Not yet bottled, the 2016 Chateauneuf du Pape Croix de Bois looks to be the star of Chapoutier's Southern Rhône collection. Cracked pepper, licorice and black raspberry notes sing loudly in this full-bodied, supple, creamy-textured beauty. There's a hint of warmth on the lingering, mouthwatering finish, which may limit its ageability, but this is so sexy and lush now, who could resist?"

name: M. Chapoutier  Chateauneuf du Pape Barbe Rac
desc_en_short: 91/100 Vinous - "Ruby-red. Bright, high-pitched red and dark berries on the nose, with a complex array of floral and spice qualities gaining strength with air. Lively, focused and alluringly sweet, with deep but spirited raspberry and cherry flavors and a nervy mineral spine. The finish leaves spice and floral notes behind, along with a hint of rose pastille."

name: M. Chapoutier  Ermitage Les Greffieux
desc_en_short: M. Chapoutier's Les Greffieux is a benchmark single-vineyard Hermitage Syrah, drawn from granite-rich soils on the famed Hermitage hill and vinified with extraordinary care — destemmed, long-macerated, and free-run juice only — to deliver a wine of rare depth and elegance.

name: Familia Fernandez  El Vinculo Crianza
wine_color: Very intense picota cherry red colour, clear and shiny.
desc_en_short: A Tempranillo from La Mancha brimming with freshness. This wine from Castile-La Mancha—the result of a project where a lot of effort was made to seek out good and old vines—is aged in American oak barrels, which are favoured by the wineries of Familia Fernández Rivera.

name: Familia Fernandez  Tinto Pesquera Crianza
wine_color: Clear and shiny appearance. Cherry-red colour with a violet rim.
desc_en_short: A must-try red wine to fully understand the DO Ribera del Duero. The character of Familia Fernández Rivera is embodied by this forthright wine, brimming with fruit at its best, delicate wood notes and elegant tannins.

name: Tinto Pesquera Reserva Ribera Del Duero D.O.
desc_en_short: A structured and cellar-worthy Ribera del Duero Reserva—dense black fruit, firm tannic backbone, and layered oak complexity, reflecting the classic power-driven style of Pesquera.

name: Vall Llach  Embruix Priorat
style: Carignan, Grenache, Cabernet, Merlot And Syrah
desc_en_short: 88 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Floral blueberry and boysenberry aromas are forward and slightly exotic, with notes of leather and dried cheese. This is chunky, heavy and a touch flat, with grabbing, cheek-scrubbing tannins. Ripe berry flavors are earthy and show a touch of chocolate, while the finish is baked, ripe, jammy and tannic. Drink through 2018."

name: C.V.N.E.  Imperial Reserva
wine_color: Intense body of cherry color with beautiful purple highlights.
desc_en_short:
WINEMAKING:

Made from a selection of the best grapes from our Rioja Alta vineyards that are hand harvested. Before starting the alcoholic fermentation, the bunches of grapes were cooled down and kept at a low temperature for some hours. The fermentation took place in French oak vats. During the second fermentation, the acidity of the wine decreases. The wine was then aged in both American and French oak casks for two years, followed by another two years in bottle prior to its release in the market

name: C.V.N.E.  Imperial Gran Reserva
desc_en_short:
WINEMAKING:

This wine is produced from grapes harvested in vineyards that are over 20 years old in the area around Villalba and Haro in Rioja Alta. They are bush pruned, with low yields, and hand harvested. Only the healthiest and ripest grapes are selected, and following destalking, the grapes are cold macerated prior to a cold temperature fermentation. Following a long maceration to achieve optimum colour and structure, the wine goes through a malolactic fermentation, to refine the wine, and to leave it with the necessary acidity to complete its American and French oak maturation, and subsequent bottle ageing prior to its release to the market.

name: Juvé & Camps  Casa Vella d'Espiells Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva
desc_en_short: From the storied Penedès estate of Juvé & Camps, this Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva delivers a rich, opulent palate of ripe red fruits, toasted oak, and roasted peppers, with a long, spice-laced finish that rewards those who appreciate structured Spanish reds.

name: Bodegas Piqueras  Gold Label
desc_en_short:
Red wine of medium to full red cherry-crimson with subtle and elegant notes of vanilla, spicy notes and wild herbs of the desert that surrounds the vineyards. This soft and fruity red wine combines either alone or with tapas, with grilled, roasted or fried dishes, grilled red meats, rice and pasta dishes, salty sausages (ham, chorizo, etc.) and semi-Cured Cheese.

Awards:

  • GOLD – Citadelles Du Vin 2019 (2016 vintage)
  • SILVER – Concours Mondial Bruxelles 2019 (2016 vintage)
  • BRONZE – Decanter 2019 (2016 vintage)
  • BRONZE – International Wine Challenge (IWC) 2019 (2016 vintage)
  • GOLD – Singapore Awards 2019 (2016 vintage)

name: Konyari Sessio
desc_en_short: Konyari Sessio is produced in 2009. It is well fermented from Merlot grapes, thus featuring a fruity aroma. This Hungarian red wine goes great with grilled meat.

name: Bodegas San Roman  Prima
style: Tinta De Toro, 15% Garnacha, From Vines Aged Between 15-50 Years Old
desc_en_short: Bodegas y Vinedos San Roman is a family owned winery that was founded by iconic winemaker Mariano Garcia in 1998 as Bodegas y Vinedos Maurodos. His vision was to produce world class wines which balanced freshness and longevity in the bottle against the renowned power of the region's wines. The vineyards are planted mainly with Tinta de Toro, a local clone of Tempranillo that has adapted to the local region. In general the vines offer smaller berries and bunches than Tempranillo in other regions, and yields wines that offer deep colors, intense aromas and robust structure. Prima, their entry level wine, has started to incorporate a higher percentage of Garnacha in the blend and is now aged partially in large wooden vats as opposed to barrels.

name: Bodegas Mauro  Castilla Y Leon
desc_en_short: A plush red, with an iron backbone. Ripe plum and currant flavors mingle with toasty and espresso notes, backed by well-integrated tannins and balsamic acidity. Has good density and balance, in the modern style. Tempranillo with Syrah.

name: Bodegas LAN  A Mano Rioja Edicion Limitada
wine_color: Ripe cherry red, very deeply coloured and bright.
style: Tempranillo, 10% Graciano And 5% Mazuelo From A Selection Of 35 To 40 Year Old Vines In The El Rincón Parcel.
desc_en_short: Viticulture and craftsmanship come together to give origin to this daring wine, which is sourced from carefully hand-selected vines of very low production located in the El Rincón parcel. A hand-made wine, a limited edition that is a faithful reflection of the terroir that it comes from.

name: Bodegas San Alejandro  Pablo Old Vine Garnacha
wine_color: Intense ruby red with purple highlights.
desc_en_short: Pablo Old Vine Garnacha, intense ruby red with purple highlights. With aromas of lifted perfumed, violet and fresh fruit. Lush blackberry and cherry flavors cram the mid palate with an underlying spicy pepperiness, that delivers a punch of juiciness that will leave the palate stunned.

name: Renieri  Brunello di Montalcino DOCG 2017
desc_en_short: The principal grape variety at Renieri is obviously Sangiovese. Blends of these varieties make up two different IGT wines whose highly-respected quality prove that Sangiovese is not the only grape that flourishes in the Montalcino zone. In addition to these IGT wines, an important niche is reserved for Rosso di Montalcino, a wine distinguished from Brunello, its elder brother, by its hallmark early approachability, the result of a less complex ageing process. The local soils are largely volcanic, with strata of schistous limestone and rock. Classic to the area are soils made up of the reddish terra rossa, clays, and calcareous tufa.

name: Confidences De Prieure-Linchine  2014  "Le 2nd Vin De Chateau Prieure-Lichine"
wine_color: It has a dark garnet color, drawing on purple in its youth.
desc_en_short: The 2014 Prieure-Lichine has a reserved, slightly tertiary/gravel-tinged bouquet that takes time to develop the fruit behind it. The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannin, a gentle grip in the mouth, but attenuating slightly towards the finish that just needs to develop a little more frisson. Probably best suited for short-term drinking rather than long-term, but you never know. Mar 2017, www.robertparker.com

name: La Spinetta  Barbera d' Alba Gallina DOC
desc_en_short:
Dense ruby red in color. Aromas of blueberry, shaved-dark-chocolate and spice. A generous and rich Barbera with loads of character, full and very
fresh, with a juicy, fruity and feminine finish. Perfect with poultry, red meat, all types of cheeses.

name: La Spinetta  Barbaresco Starderi DOCG
desc_en_short: Dense red in color. Soaring aromatics, bright red stone fruit and huge beams of tannin dark cherries, plums and raspberry. Classic bright red fruit notes typical of Starderi are matched by equally characteristic, imposing tannins that need time to soften. Ideal with grilled food, sauced and elaborate red meat and game

name: La Spinetta  Barbaresco Valeirano DOCG
desc_en_short:
Dense red in color. Exotic, rather Barolo-like perfume of truffle and marzipan. Plush, seamless and very rich, showing a note of mentholl, fnishes
with substantial toothdusting tannins. Ideal with grilled food, sauced and elaborate red meat and game.

name: Caldora  Montepulciano d'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: Ruby red with garnet reflections. Intense, persistent and fruity (red fruits, "marasca", plum), with hints of vanilla. Full-bodied, Tannic and well balanced, intense and quite persistent. Ready to drink. Best Served with Salami, rich main courses, meat and cheese.

name: Reserve Saint Dominique  Chateauneuf du pape
wine_color: A beautiful ruby colour robe with dark purple hues.
desc_en_short: A richly layered Châteauneuf-du-Pape led by 80% Grenache, Reserve Saint Dominique delivers crushed raspberries, blackberry liqueur, and sun-drenched garrigue on the nose, followed by a full-bodied, opulent palate with fleshy tannins and a long, spice-laced finish.

name: Velenosi  Rosso Piceno DOC Circum
desc_en_short: Fresh and fruity character with dry and light aromatic aftertaste. Light tannins.

name: Chateau Loudenne  Loudenne Les Jardins Bordeaux Rouge Bio
desc_en_short: Red colour, intense, carmine highlights. Blackcurrant aromas, black fruit aromas, blackberry aromas. Fruity, soft tannin, long length.

name: Chateau Loudenne  Les Folies Bordeaux Rouge
desc_en_short: Pleasantly intense, characterised by red berries, especially strawberry, with slightly woody and vanilla notes. Pairing with beef, veal, game (deer,venison), poultry.

name: Chateau Loudenne  Médoc Cru Bourgeois Rouge
desc_en_short:
Dense purple core and a lighter ruby rim. Some evolution and harmony on the nose , pureb dark fruit notes like cassis ,plum, tobacco and fine wood.Dense
medium weight,still youthful but ripe texture with rounded tannin,some herbal spiciness, sage, tobacco,leaf and savoury dark fruit with a pure rather long
finish. Still a bit youthful on the finish needing some more time to soften. Pairing with beef, lamb, game (deer, venison), Poultry.

name: "Tormaresca" By Antinori  Neprica Cabernet Sauvignon IGT
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ

name: Domaine de la Vieille Julienne  Chateauneuf du Pape Reserve
desc_en_short: Very old vines, low yields and natural approach make the bases, but it's in the microclimate of the north facing terroir of slopes that it'll forge his character.

name: Domaine de la Vieille Julienne  Chateauneuf du Pape "Les Trois Sources"
desc_en_short: Located on a mild terroir of slopes, between "lieu-dit Clavin" and "les Hauts-lieux" the grenache is perfectly at home there with this mosaic of safres's sands, pebbles and red clays, producing a perfect balance of power and finesse.

name: Domaine de la Vieille Julienne  Chateauneuf du Pape "Les Hauts-Lieux"
desc_en_short: This is the highest elevation and the most sheltered part of the terroir of slopes. Marlstone soils and shallow safres covered with quartzite pebbles are entirely suitable for mourvedre. Under the tense tannins, wines are vigorous with huge elegance.

name: Domaine Duseigneur  Catarina Chateauneuf du Pape
desc_en_short: An exceptionally long period of drought during spring and summer. Water stress has resulted in grapes in the most affected plots not maturing as expected. The fruit, picked at early maturity, gave wines with high acidity and moderate alcohol levels. Surprisingly, a balance on the fruit is achieved, with fresh and elegant tannins.

name: Chateau Maucoil  Privilège Chateauneuf du Pape
style: Grenache (50%) Syrah (15%) Mourvèdre (12%), Cinsault (8%) Clairette And Bourboulenc (5%) Etc.
desc_en_short: Château Maucoil's Privilège is a benchmark Châteauneuf-du-Pape — a Grenache-led blend delivering deep ruby intensity, layers of black fruit, garrigue, and fine spice, with polished tannins and exceptional length that reward both the cellar and the dinner table.

name: Chateau Maucoil  Tradition Chateauneuf du Pape
wine_color: Strong ruby red hue with a beautiful shine.
desc_en_short: Strong ruby red hue with a beautiful shine. Very fine on the nose with superb black fruit and spicy notes. Delightful and intense on the palate, with lovely balance and great elegance, from the moment it is bottled.

name: Domaine des Senechaux  Chateauneuf du Pape Rouge
desc_en_short:
The ancient vineyard of Châteauneuf-du-Pape became world famous when the Popes settled in Avignon in 1350. It later became the first French appellation d’origine contrôlée in 1933 under the influence of Baron Le Roy.

Lying in the heart of this illustrious appellation, the 14th-century Domaine des Sénéchaux is among the region’s oldest wineries. It gets its name from one of the estate’s principal plots, located in the “Bois Sénéchaux” neighbourhood.

name: Chateau Ducru Beaucaillou  2018
desc_en_short:
100 Point by Wine Enthusiast

Vintage 2018 was generous to the style of Ducru-Beaucaillou. The rich character of wines from this estate is enhanced by the ripeness and concentration of this wine. At the same time it keeps an amazing freshness that comes out of the acidity. This wine will go down in the annals of this historic estate. It is not likely to approach drinkability before 2028.

name: Otterbrook Mill  Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Medium plum red, hints of violet with good depth.
desc_en_short: Medium plum red, hints of violet with good depth. Lifted red fruits, complexed with spicy notes of toasted oak. Blackberry and plum fruit flavours dominate upfront. It then leads with some spicy notes of cinnamon and clove. The soft acid and ripe tannins result in a smooth medium to full bodied wine. The length is generous and the finish is persistent. Enjoy with hearty red meat dishes such as lamb or beef.

name: Tenuta San Guido  Sassicaia 2016
wine_color: An intense, concentrated and deep ruby color.
desc_en_short:
Winemaking notes:

Selection of grapes through a sorting table. Soft pressing and destemming of grapes in order not to break the skins of the berries. Subsequent alcoholic fermentation in stainless steel vats at a controlled temperature of around 28 ° - 30 ° C (without the addition of external yeasts). The macerations lasted about 13-15 for both Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon. Pumpovers and frequent délestages have favored the aromatic extraction over the tannic one. The malolactic fermentation was carried out in stainless steel tanks and was completed by the end of November.

Ageing:

At the end of malolactic fermentation, the wine was transferred to French oak barriques (one third new wood and the rest, first and second passage) where it rested for 24 months of aging period which is in compliance with the production regulations. During this time the various masses have been kept separated according to the vineyard of origin. The blending occurred shortly before the preparation for bottling and subsequent refinement phase in glass before marketing

name: Vicus Orbis  Varietal Plus Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: A rich and concentrated ruby-violet color.
desc_en_short: Our Cabernet Sauvignon has a rich and concentrated ruby-violet color. Aromas of blackcurrant and black cherries. Elegant with good balance. Its tannins are soft and mature. A great choice to match with red meats, herby dishes or mature cheeses.

name: Vicus Orbis  Varietal Plus Carmenere
desc_en_short: Our Carmenere has an intense dark-violet color. The wine features aromas of fresh red fruit, hints of plums, jam and spices. Its tannins are sweet and velvety. Matches soft red meats, poultry and soft cheeses.

name: Vicus Orbis  Varietal Plus Merlot
desc_en_short: Our Merlot has a bright ruby-violet color. The wine has intense notes of ripe red fruits, plum and pepper hints. Its tannins are sweet and velvety. Has a long and lingering finish. Ideal as a company for roast beef, pork, pasta and fresh cheese.

name: Vicus Orbis  Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Our Cabernet Sauvignon Reserva has an intense red ruby color. It is a good sample of a complex wine, aromas of ripe fruits with hints of hazelnut and chocolate. It is a powerful and concentrated wine with elegant tannins. It matches fantastic with red meats, beef, spicy food and mature cheeses.

name: Vicus Orbis  Reserva Carmenere
desc_en_short: Our Carmenere Reserva has an intense dark red color. Elegant and fruity, with touches of berries, ripe plums, chocolate and pepper notes. It is well balanced between the fruit and oak. We call it round and silky. Perfect for pasta, mature cheeses and poultry.

name: Vicus Orbis  Reserva Merlot
desc_en_short: Our Merlot Reserva has an intense red dark color. It is a complex wine with aromas of dry fruits and truffle. In mouth is spicy and an ellegant. Its tannins are soft with a pleasant and silky aftertaste. A great match with pasta, lightly spiced red meats and soft cheeses.

name: Vicus Orbis  Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Our Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon is an intense and complex wine with aromas of black cherries, cassis, red pepper, hazelnut and toast vanilla. In mouth feels a very good structure, with mature tannins and a smoky character. A great match for red meats, lamb chops, grilled vegetables, strong and mature cheese.

name: Vicus Orbis  Gran Reserva Carmenere
desc_en_short: This Gran Reserva Carmenere, is an intense wine with deep red and blue color. The spicy bouquet is typical of the variety, revealing notes of pepper, black fruit and a hint of chocolate as the result of the barrel aging process. It is gentle and easy to drink, with a very pleasant aftertaste. Great choice for spicy food, meat, pasta or chesses.

name: Vicus Orbis  Gran Reserva Merlot
desc_en_short: Our Merlot Gran Reserva, has a deep purple color with notes of black berry, vanilla and toast tobacco. With a very warm mouth structure and an excellent aftertaste. A great match for red meats, poultry, pasta, lamb chops, strong and mature cheese.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2020
wine_color: A dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints.
desc_en_short:
"What a beautiful vintage...
The tasting of the wines that have just been racked gives us reason to rejoice. All the wines have a nice colour with dark blue tints which we like.
They have an intense aromatic expression with a character this year of small black fruits such as blackberry and blackcurrant.
The tannic structure is fine; they are more fleshy than light, in brief: they should please and are the precursors of other very nice wines to keep from this 2020 vintage".

name: Poderi Luigi Einaudi  Barolo Cannubi (Single Vineyards) DOCG
desc_en_short: " Produced in the famous Cannubi vineyard in Barolo, it has a typical garnet red color with orange refections. Nice expressive nose with balsamic notes and sweet spices, whose complexity is then assured by delicate aromas of blackberries and wild strawberries, mint and violet. The entry to the palate is striking, solid and compact, followed by a solid and refined structure that turns into a more slender and discreet style in the finish, where refined and moderately astringent tannins meet. The gray-whitish marls of the Cannubi have given the wine a great elegance and a pleasant mineral note. It is a wine that reveals an open character that brings together discretion, class and renement, the expression of a land historically recognized for its qualities. Although easy to interpret, it will be possible to start drinking as early as 2020, it has a good aging capacity that will bring it without problems until 2030. It is suitable for a refined cuisine oriented to tasty dishes and enriched with truffles and noble red meats with slow cooking ". (Dogliani, June 2017 - Paolo Basso - "Best Sommelier of the World" in 2013)

name: Chateau Duhart Milon Rothschild 2016
desc_en_short: Château Duhart-Milon’s grand vin is often described as a model of the Pauillac appellation. The broker Guillaume Lawton noted as early as 1815 that “it is very robust, with a fine colour, and quite pronounced sappiness” (he describes the “sappiness” of the Médoc’s premiers crus as “something like the odour given off by finest sealing wax when it is burned”).

name: Uccelliera  Brunello di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short: The Uccelliera estate was at once part of neighboring Ciacci Piccolomini until 1986, when winemaker Andrea Cortonesi purchased it from his friends and former employers. After refining his trade as cellar master for Ciacci, Andrea ventured out on his own with the formation of Uccelliera. His first vintage was 1991 with the production of a mere 500 bottles! The wines have quickly become cult favorites amongst the cognoscenti. Tucked away in the southeast corner of the appellation in Castelnuovo dell’Abate, the soil here is loose and stony which when coupled with a warm microclimate gives the wines of Uccelliera a rich and ripe expression, vintage after vintage. Two hectares adjacent to Ciacci’s famous ‘Pianrosso’ vineyard were recently added to this boutique estate, bringing the total to a mere six hectares. Andrea Cortonesi is tireless in his approach to winemaking, with all vineyard work done exclusively by hand.

name: Tenuta di Biserno  Lodovico IGT
style: Cabernet Franc, 10% Petit Verdot And Merlot
grape_variety: Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot, Merlot, Pecorino
desc_en_short: Lodovico by Tenuta di Biserno is a commanding Cabernet Franc-led Tuscan IGT of extraordinary complexity — layered with forest fruit, blackcurrant, and Mediterranean herbs, offering a full-bodied palate of silky tannins, vibrant acidity, and remarkable length built for the long haul.

name: Tenuta di Biserno  Biserno di Biserno IGT Toscana
style: Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot And Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Biserno is a so ly textured wine with enormous richness, plushness and so ness. Bouquet opens to profound depth with thick layers of dark fruit, sweet spice, chocolate, tar and camphor ash. Biserno is a large-frame, full-bodied blend of Cabernet Franc, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon and Petit Verdot. is vintage delivers enormous precision, grace and sharpness; however, the lasting impression it leaves is one of power, opulence and irresistible concentration. is wine speaks generously to all the senses, and to your heart.

name: Pian dell'Orino  Piandorino IGT
desc_en_short: The 2014 Piandorino, the estate's entry-level Sangiovese, is fabulous. Bright, punchy and forward, with plenty of Pian dell'Orino's signature finesse, the 2014is absolutely delicious today. It should drink nicely for another few years at a minimum.

name: Pian dell'Orino  Rosso di Montalcino DOC
desc_en_short: 94 points in Wine Advocate - "Here's a bit of breaking news. When I went to the winery to taste this wine, it was geared up to be classified as a Brunello di Montalcino. The idea was to use the best fruit that could be obtained from the Bassolino vineyard in this difficult vintage. Only 3,000 bottles plus a few magnums were made. Just hours after my tasting, I got an email from proprietor Caroline Pobitzer saying that the Brunello I had tasted, would in fact be declassified as Rosso. In effect, the 2014 Rosso di Montalcino Bassolino has the DNA and the pedigree of a Brunello, but the qualities of the vintage make the wine lean on impact and ephemeral in terms of its bouquet. It's all about grace and poise without that distinctive brawn you get in Brunello. But if your palate veers toward the light, elegant and fragile side of the Sangiovese spectrum, you should scoop up as many bottles as possible because this wine speaks directly to those tastes. The wine is beautifully balanced and carefully acidic in all the right spots."

name: Pian dell'Orino  Brunello di Montalcino Vigneti del Versante DOCG
desc_en_short: 95 points in Wine Advocate - "The 2013 Brunello di Montalcino Vigneti del Versante exhibits an immediate sense of depth and complexity. Winemaking saw minimal movement or pump-overs because Jan Hendrik Erbach tends to keep his wines in reduction for a long as possible in order to slow down their evolution. This is especially important in an immediate and accessible vintage like 2013. This expression is profound and precise with sharply etched aromas of wild berry, licorice, lavender and lightly roasted almond. Violets flood over the palate, backed by silky fine texture."

name: Pian dell'Orino  Brunello di Montalcino Bassolino di Sopra DOCG
desc_en_short: 95 points in Wine Advocate - "Brunello di Montalcino Vigneti del Versante exhibits an immediate sense of depth and complexity. Winemaking saw minimal movement or pump-overs because Jan Hendrik Erbach tends to keep his wines in reduction for a long as possible in order to slow down their evolution. This is especially important in an immediate and accessible vintage like 2013. This expression is profound and precise with sharply etched aromas of wild berry, licorice, lavender and lightly roasted almond. Violets flood over the palate, backed by silky fine texture."

name: Rocca di Montegrossi  Geremia IGT
desc_en_short: A powerful, intense wine that also displays elegance and balance, bringing out the character of the terroir. Intense ruby, with violet nail, and with complex aromas that bring to mind sour cherries, currants and other wild berry fruit, mingled with licorice and vanilla. A wine of great structure and complexity, which is soft and velvety, thanks to its richness and the perfect ripeness of the tannins.

name: Rocca di Montegrossi  Chianti Classico Gran Selezione DOCG Vigneto San Marcellino
desc_en_short: This wine is produced only in top great vintages, using the finest grapes selected from the San Marcellino vineyard that surrounds the Church of San Marcellino in Monti in Chianti: An area of about 7 hectares where Sangiovese (1.5 hectares of which are 50 years old) are joined by 0.9 hectares of Pugnitello, an old indigenous Tuscan grape that perfectly complements Sangiovese, bringing out its color, structure and aromas. Since 2006 the San Marcellino cuvee has included about 5% Pugnitello. The wine ages for about 24 months in medium toast barriques from Allier. It is bottled unfiltered to preserve its elegance and freshness, and aged in bottle for at least 24 months prior to release. Deep ruby, with an ample, complex, and enveloping bouquet featuring fruit, in particular raspberry, and violets mingling with spice and minerality. San Marcellino displays beautiful structure, with vibrant, elegant tannins accompanied by harmonious savory accents. It’s an extremely well balanced, persistent wine.

name: Bret Brothers  Glou de Bret
desc_en_short: Glou de Jeff is finished. Long live Glou des Bret! This cuvée, with intense red fruit, comes from a parcel in Chénas, one of the 10 Beaujolais Crus, on deep, sandy soils. The 100% whole cluster carbonic fermentation renders it gourmandand refreshing. 2018: serve slightly chilled (around 10°C) for pure enjoyment!

name: Bret Brothers  Beaujolais-Lantignie
desc_en_short: From the hillside village of Lantignié in Beaujolais, Bret Brothers coaxes a darkly expressive Gamay from pink granite and blue sandstone soils — structured, concentrated, and built with enough depth to reward a little patience in the cellar.

name: Bret Brothers  Julienas Climat "la Bottiere"
desc_en_short: Juliénas is one of the northernmost Crus of the Beaujolais. Bottière is a beautiful terroir! This is a throwback to classic Beaujolais from another era. Fermented with 100% whole clusters, carbonic fermentation, and a slow press. The sugars finished in Burgundian barrel. An illuminated, bright wine, with delicate aromas that invite one to taste its nectar. 2018, a huge favorite!

name: Chateau Figeac  2015
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 29% Merlot And 28% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: 97 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The recent leaps and bounds in improvements that have occurred at this great estate, equating to a dramatic increase in intensity and complexity—without compromising the husky, soft-spoken, sultry voice that is Figeac—is a monumental achievement. Kudos to Frederic Faye and his team for so beautifully expressing what was clearly an extraordinary vintage at Chateau Figeac! Blended of 29% Merlot, 43% Cabernet Sauvignon and 28% Cabernet Franc, the deep garnet-purple colored 2015 Figeac reveals vibrant black cherries, cassis, red currants, black plums and licorice notes with touches of cigar boxes, bouquet garni, potpourri, damp soil and black pepper. Medium-bodied, delicately crafted and with nuanced, quietly intense layers of vivacious red and black fruits, the palate features a solid frame of polished, rounded tannins and seamless freshness, finishing long and minerally."

name: Chateau Montrose  2014
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot, 8% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Main characteristics of the vintage

The weather in winter was mild, with temperatures generally above zero. A considerable amount of rain fell during the early part of the year, until May, renewing water reserves in the soil. Conditions in spring were good for the vine cycle. Mild weather in April encouraged rapid and even vegetation growth across all the grape varieties, while flowering took place evenly in perfect conditions starting on June 5th. July was cooler than the average, and as expected veraison occurred later than usual during a wet August. After slowing in August, the vine cycle picked up again at the end of the month in hot and dry weather which lasted until mid-October. Temperatures often in excess of 30°C, a “miraculous” amount of sunshine and the hydric stress resulting from these exceptional climatic conditions helped the grapes to ripen evenly. 20 mm of rainfall on September 17 and 18th came at just the right time to ensure perfect balance.

Fine weather overall and cool nights marked an untroubled start to the harvest in mid-September, with a crop in perfect health. Quality was assured, but in the quest for perfect ripeness the pickers went through certain parcels four to six times. In the winery, dense and deep colours started to emerge as soon as pumping-over started. The alcohol level was a little high but the balance was good.

Tastings at the end of the maceration period suggested that the wines would be excellent. The wines from different parcels were kept separate when the wines were run off, while careful selection of the press wines in barrels created many opportunities for future blending.

name: Chateau Musar  Red 2009
desc_en_short:
"Mid-crimson. Light, sweet start. For the moment it’s a little simple. Bright, ripe red fruit. Slightly burnt edge. Lots of tannins. Quite dry and youthful on the finish. Much longer bottle age needed. By far the most youthful wine in this vertical tasting" - Jancis Robinson, March 2018

"Musar only releases its grand vin when it’s ready to drink – there are violets and ripe red berry fruit from Cinsault; spice, liquorice and burly backbone from Carignan, blackcurrant, blackberry and silky elegance from Cabernet Sauvignon. It’s ready to drink, yes but there’s no rush" - Jonathan Ray, The Spectator Magazine, April 2016

name: Chateau Musar  Red 2011
desc_en_short:
Bright ruby. Heady, rich and gamey on the nose. Very hedonistic and accessible with real density and lifted slight gaminess. An attractive singed character on top of very ripe fruit. Great balance and freshness (but not excessive acidity) on the finish. Very neat on the end. Something rather wild and Romany about this. Already accessible even if I’m sure it will develop even more complex tertiary aromas – Jancis Robinson, March 2018

I can’t recall a vintage of Chateau Musar I’ve enjoyed more. The 2010 is tiny in quantity, but marked by a purity of rich, figgy, elegant red fruit and a seductive finish in the palate – Will Lyons, The Sunday Times Magazine, 5th April 2020

name: Cantine Leonardo Da Vinci  Da Vinci I Capolavori Chianti DOCG
desc_en_short: Ripe grapes are left on the skins for about 10-12 days. Fermentation takes place at controlled temperatures of 27-28°C. Pumping-over is performed frequently for a short while, and the saignée or "bleeding off" technique is used to increase the richness of noble polyphenols. Once removed from the skins, wine is kept in steel containers to complete malolactic fermentation. Then wine is aged in French and American oak barrels for 10 months.

name: Chateau Clinet  2013
desc_en_short: 91 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2013 Clinet was one of the better wines that I tasted from barrel. Indeed both Robert Parker and I scored this Pomerol around the same mark and now it is in bottle, it has fulfilled my expectations as a delicious, easy-going, but still well-crafted wine from Ronan Laborde. It has a delicate but precise bouquet that gains intensity in the glass, cassis and a touch of wild mint, ground pepper emerging with time. The palate is medium-bodied with slightly grainy tannin that need another 12-18 months to soften, however there is adequate fruit underneath with a linear, slightly sappy finish. Enjoy this over the next 10-12 years."

name: Chateau Clinet  2014
desc_en_short: 91 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2014 Clinet was a wine that perplexed when I tasted it from barrel and as a consequence, it was one that I went back and retasted three or four times during that primeur campaign. Now in bottle, the bouquet has improved and developed more fruit concentration, armed with red plum, wild strawberry and blueberry scents. The palate is medium-bodied and quite refined, certainly not as opulent as other vintages from the estate, perhaps just missing a persistence on the angular finish. It is not a bad Clinet by a long stretch, it just feels a little constricted, especially compared to say the 2010 or 2015. I tasted this on three occasions, drawing the same conclusion each time. "

name: Chateau Clinet  2017
desc_en_short: Château Clinet 2017 is a seductive Pomerol built on 92% Merlot, delivering concentrated red and black fruits, floral lift, and a mineral-edged finish underpinned by a supple, granular tannic structure that rewards patience and commands the table.

name: Chateau Pontet-Canet  AOC Pauillac 2012
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc And 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: 93 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "Deep garnet in color, the 2012 Pontet-Canet gives up a profound earthy/savory nose, revealing notes of tilled soil, woodsmoke, mossy tree bark, fungi and bouquet garni with a core of raspberry preserves, boysenberries and dried cherries plus a hint of warm cassis. Medium-bodied, it has a firm grainy texture and a softly spoken, savory character in the mouth, finishing with lingering oolong tea and dried herbs notes."

name: Chateau Pontet-Canet  AOC Pauillac 2014
wine_color: Deep garnet with a hint of purple to the color
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot And 5% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Château Pontet-Canet 2014 is a magnificent Pauillac from one of Bordeaux's most celebrated biodynamic estates, earning 98 points from James Suckling for its breathtaking complexity, seamless structure, and an extraordinarily long, layered finish.

name: Chateau Pontet-Canet  AOC Pauillac 2015
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 30% Merlot And The Rest Cabernet Franc And Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Château Pontet-Canet's 2015 Pauillac is a biodynamic Cinquième Cru Classé of extraordinary depth, earning 98 points from James Suckling for its floral perfume, dense dark fruit, and ultra-fine tannins — a benchmark Bordeaux built for decades of cellaring.

name: Domaine de Bachellery  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: A rare find in budget-friendly Old World Pinot Noir, Domaine de Bachellery delivers fragrant delicacy and smooth, sappy red cherry fruit in a pure, elegant style — no harsh edges, supremely drinkable, and outstanding value for the price.

name: Roccolo Grassi  Valpolicella Superiore
desc_en_short: Roccolo Grassi Valpolicella Superiore is made from a combination of fresh grapes and slightly dried grapes in equal percentage. The slight dehydration of the grapes lasts 20 days (percentage amount of grapes and number of days may vary depending on the vintage) in order to alter the peel/pulp ratio and therefore obtain a fresh fruit with a slightly higher concentration and rich with the noble components of the peel. This is followed by a 20-month aging in wood , assembling and bottling. A section of the vineyard is designated exclusively to growing grapes for Valpollicella Superiore. Grapes for Amarone are not selected from this area. This allows for better concentration , as well as exceptional complexity and finesse of aroma.

name: Tenuta Belguardo  Belguardo Serrata
desc_en_short: 90 points in James Suckling -"Show fresh red plums, cedar, nutmeg, orange rind and citrus. Medium body, fresh acidity and a bright, tangy finish. Drink Now.

name: Mount Langi Ghiran  Cliff Edge Cabernet Merlot
desc_en_short: Bright blackberry, blackcurrant and cassis from the Cabernet Sauvignon are complimented by juicy plum fruits and black cherry notes from the Merlot. This classic Bordeaux blend displays perfumed florals, cedar and spiced dark chocolate. Fine, silky tannins with a backbone of acidity creates a powerful wine full of body and finesse. Drinking well now but this wine will continue to improve with age, cellar well over the next 10+ years.

name: Mount Langi Ghiran  Talus Shiraz
wine_color: Vibrant, dense crimson with a purple hue.
desc_en_short: Talus Shiraz showcases a distinctive minerality with silky tannins and pure fruit that combine to create a divine balance of power and elegance.

name: Domaine Robert Groffier Pere & Fils  Bonnes Mares Grand Cru 2015
desc_en_short: The Bonnes Mares offers a very dense ruby color. The nose is complex and very refined, it opens with notes of red fruits such as thin raspberry, cherry... Black fruit aromas are also present. On the palate it is fine, nice, wine gradually unfolds and reveals its incomparable texture, but it also reveals present tannins. The aromatic richness is developped on a very long finish. The production of Groffier Estate, well noted by the tasters, will offer you finesse and length.

name: Domaine Robert Groffier Pere & Fils  Chambertin Clos de Beze Grand Cru
desc_en_short: "Chambertin Clos-de-Bèze Grand Cru contains less whole-bunch fruit, at 10%, and is matured entirely in new oak. This was the only cuvée to demonstrate a little reduction on the nose, though it’s nothing to worry about at this stage, as there is plenty of intense blackberry and wild strawberry fruit laced with incense. The palate is medium-bodied with supple, saturated tannins and touches of fresh fig and blood orange toward the vibrant finish. This is, strangely, more approachable than the Les Amoureuses at the moment, but the class is here from start to finish. Superb."

name: Dugat-Py  Charmes Chambertin Grand Cru
desc_en_short: 90-92 points in Wine Advocate - "Utilizing around 40% whole bunch fruit, the 2014 Charmes Chambertin Grand Cru has a comparatively rich bouquet with layers of macerated red cherry fruit mixed with blueberry, the new oak coming through in pronounced fashion. The palate is sweet on the entry with grainy tannin, red cherries and wild strawberry, as well as a touch of orange rind with a spice note towards the structured finish that is Mazoyères-like in style. Give this a decade in bottle."

name: Dugat-Py  Mazis Chambertin Grand Cru
desc_en_short: 96 points in Vinous - "(90% vendange entier; from vines averaging 70 years of age):Healthy red-ruby. Wild, complex aromas of blackberry, blueberry, faded rose, white pepper and truffley underbrush. Less silky and accessible today than the Mazoyères owing to its strong saline minerality; this is a deeper wine but much less explosive today. The tannins here are tougher than those of the Mazoyères and will require a good eight to ten years of cellaring, but the very long, palate-staining finish suggests that this wine will be superb."

name: Maison Leroy  Fixin 2009
desc_en_short: 100% Pinot Noir from the Maison Leroy, the family’s négociant business, drawn from plots of land that Lalou Bize-Leroy and her team have pampered for decades... Biodynamics have reigned supreme in every Leroy vineyard for a very long time indeed.

name: Maison Leroy  Fixin 2014
desc_en_short:
Superior to its appellation, this wine is powerful wihile maintaining a nice freshness. Expressing fresh red berry and earthy aromas on the nose. The wine is unique, yet gives a classy and elegant fexture with velvet tannins. Mineral and earthy notes on the palate: very well--baiance with a fruity finish.
Food pairing with beef, Veal, Gome [deer, venison), Poultry.

name: Domaine Gros Frère et Soeur  Echezeaux Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Echézeaux is an usually large Grand Cru comprised of 11 different lieux-dits with wide variations in soil, exposure and elevation. The lieu-dit of Les Loachausses is owned entirely by the Gros family. As evidenced by the wines of Gros Frere et Soeur, Loachausses gives all the power and concentration that you could expect from a great grand cru.

name: Valdubon  Honoris de Valdubon
desc_en_short: Honoris was born as the maximum expression of the union of their best old vines of Tempranillo and Merlot, a special elaboration and careful aging. The unhurried ageing offered by French wood gives aroma and structure and the wines are enriched with spicy tones at the same time as the palate becomes more rounded. The mouthfeel is full-bodied but soft, full of ripe tannins. Well balanced with a long and intense finish.

name: Bodega Volcanes de Chile  Tectonia Carmenere
desc_en_short: This wine is Deep violet. Presents aromas of tobacco, roasted coffee and graphite, accompanied by black fruits and spicy notes, typical of Carménère. flavors of black cherry, blackberry and cassis; notes of black pepper, nutmeg, chocolate and subtle touches of menthol surface. Soft and tasty, with well structured tannins, and very elegant. Long and velvety finish.

name: Bodega Volcanes de Chile  Reserva Carmenere
desc_en_short: Aromas of herbal tea, dried beef, black olive and spiced plum are correct for Carmenère. On the palate, this is full in body but shows tartaric burn. Generic black-fruit flavors of cherry, plum and blackberry finish flush and with some heat.

name: Chateau Roland La Garde  Tradition
wine_color: A deep and brilliant ruby color.
desc_en_short: Château Roland La Garde Tradition is a classic Côtes de Blaye red led by 80% Merlot, offering red-fruit aromas, gentle tannins, and easy-drinking harmony — a versatile everyday Bordeaux that can cellar comfortably for up to a decade.

name: Friedrich Becker  Sankt Paul Pinot Noir Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Full-bodied, fresh and fruity, this is a velvety textured, finesse-full and elegant wine; it has great intensity and length, but not too much alcohol. The fruit is very natural here and the low sulfur dosage gives it an extra vitality and salubriousness.

name: Friedrich Becker  Heydenreich Pinot Noir Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Top selection from the situation "Heydenreich". Grown on very barren limestone soil. Traditionally fermented in open fermentation stands and matured in barrels of the best French and Palatine oak. Filled without filtration.Violet and spice with some stem and earth. Palate is bright but has good structure as well. Good length and flow.

name: Klumpp  Spätburgunder
desc_en_short: A refreshingly honest Baden Spätburgunder from the family estate of Weingut Klumpp, delivering ripe black cherry, raspberry, and plum with an animating juiciness and a cool, crisp-dry finish — Pinot Noir at its most unpretentious and satisfying.

name: Klumpp  Rothenberg Spatburgunder
desc_en_short: 55-year-old vines, compact gypsum keuper and clay, lowest yields: the ultimate fruits of the stone. Like woolly mammoths, the sticks suck minerals from the compacted soil. Pointed fruit sweetness, profound minerality and present roasted aromas literally flow into one another. Unbelievably dense, long-lasting material with notes of black cherry, plum, chocolate, tobacco, dried herbs and delicate peppery spices. Full of juice and strength, at the same time velvety and stony. Blessed with the inner calm of ancient vines

name: La Biòca  Ricciaia Dolcetto d’Alba Superiore DOC
desc_en_short:
Ruby red in colour. Intense, with vinous features, berries, spices, balsamic on aromas. The palate is soft and fleshy on the palate, it shows acidity and
cohesive tannins, pleasantly bitter. Pairings with vegetable appetizers, cold cuts, red meats, risotto, mushrooms and legumes.

name: La Biòca  Ronchi Barbaresco DOCG
desc_en_short:
Ruby red in colour. Intense, with vinous features, berries, spices, balsamic on aromas. The palate is soft and fleshy on the palate, it shows acidity and
cohesive tannins, pleasantly bitter. Pairings with vegetable appetizers, cold cuts, red meats, risotto, mushrooms and legumes.

name: La Biòca  Aculei Barolo DOCG
desc_en_short: Granate red in colour. Intensive and characteristic aromas. The palate is dry, harmonious, full body. The Barolo is ideal to combine with truffle-based dishes, meat dishes, first courses based on porcini mushrooms, seasoned cheeses and is also perfect in combination with dry pastries or chocolate.

name: La Biòca  Monvigliero Barolo DOCG
desc_en_short:
Red granate in colour. intense and characteristic on aromas. The palate is dry, full and harmonious. Goes well with rise (in particular
risotti), game meat, aged / spicy cheeses.

name: Montesecondo  Chianti Classico DOCG
desc_en_short: The Chianti Classico Montesecondo represents the territorial expression of three native vines; sangiovese, canaiolo and colorino which are assembled at the harvest. The aging, partly in medium sized casks and partly in cement basins, confers softness and balance to the wine. The majority of the grapes are picked from older vines with a planting density of 3300 plants per hectare in order to fully capture the complexity and length that the fruit of such plants confers.

name: Perticaia  Umbria Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: Lively and balanced, with a soft, fruity finish. It goes very well with hors d'oeuvres of cold meats and cheeses, but also with cereal soups and light first courses.

name: Perticaia  Montefalco Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: Good structure and elegant tannins, with a good freshness. Wine for the whole meal, good with tasty soups, first courses with meat ragout, seasoned cheeses

name: Perticaia  Montefalco Rosso Riserva DOC
desc_en_short: Full and elegant, balanced by velvety tannins. Excellent with red meats and roasts, but also with cured meats and mature cheeses.

name: Perticaia  Montefalco Sagrantino DOCG
wine_color: Intense ruby red with garnet nuances
desc_en_short: Very full and persistent, but with silky, well-balanced tannins. Important acidity. Goes well with grilled meats with good fat content, game and stews.

name: Rochester  Reserve Shiraz Viognier
wine_color: A beautiful dark ruby red colour.
desc_en_short: A beautiful dark ruby red colour. Ripe red fruit on the nose with a delicious touch of spice. A smooth, creamy attack leading to a well-structured body with a vein of silky tannins.

name: Mascota Vineyards  La Mascota Shiraz
wine_color: A dark black colour with a great intensity and concentration.
desc_en_short: A dark black colour with a great intensity and concentration. Aromas of blackberries, tobacco and dried fruits. Powerful palate of dark chocolate, prunes and liquorice, complemented with delicate spicy hints. Ideal to combine with red meat dishes, spicy food and hard cheeses.

name: Mascota Vineyards  Grand Mascota Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Gran Mascota Cabernet Sauvignon presents aromas evoking cassis and black pepper. A wine with great structure and a long finish.

name: Mascota Vineyards  Dark Bat Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Dark garner color, intense aromas of coffee, blackberry and dark fruit. Flavourful and epressive tastes, smooth and smoky with hints of dark chocolate.

name: Mascota Vineyards  Big Bat Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: From Mendoza's sun-drenched vineyards, Mascota Vineyards Big Bat Cabernet Sauvignon is a bold, full-bodied red bursting with blackcurrant, dark fruit, and black pepper — a wine with commanding structure and an elegantly long finish built for serious red meat occasions.

name: Valdubon  Crianza
desc_en_short:
Valdubón Crianza is made with Tinta del País (Tempranillo) grapes from vines older than 40 years. The original vineyards of Valdubón Crianza are found in different areas of Ribera del Duero, with Roa, Pardilla and Milagros being their main origins.

A maturation control is carried out on all the plots that supply Valdubón, establishing the optimal harvest date for each vineyard. The evolution of the Baumé degree, acidity, tannin and color is controlled. On the basis of the results obtained, those vines that stand out for providing grapes with a high concentration of fruit and high phenolic load are chosen for Valdubon Crianza, which ensure good aging potential.

The cut grape is transferred to the winery as soon as possible, being ground before 10 am. since its collection. The harvest takes place between the months of September and October depending on the weather. Valdubón begins to cut at the ideal time to guarantee an optimal sanitary state and a good acidity-sugar balance.

name: Valdubon  Reserva
desc_en_short: Valdubón Reserva is made entirely with the Tinta del País grape (Tempranillo). The original vineyards of Valdubón are distributed by different terms of Ribera del Duero, their main origins being the terms of Roa, Pardilla and Milagros. The vines selected to make Valdubón Reserva are those that are older than 30 years and stand out for providing a highly concentrated grape with exceptional aromatic potential.

name: Bouchard Pere & Fils  Garvey Chambertin
desc_en_short: Bouchard Père & Fils' Gevrey-Chambertin Village draws on 17 parcels spread across the appellation, delivering a beautifully detailed Pinot Noir with sappy red fruit, fine-grained tannins, and the mineral lift that defines this storied Côte de Nuits village.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mapu Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Deep ruby red colour, with violet and bright tones
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red colour, with violet and bright tones. It has a very fresh nose, with a lot of fruit, with notes of small red fruits, such as blueberries, black plums, berries, sour cherries, mixed with some notes of black pepper, with notes of cedar and vanilla that come from the guard in wood. The attack is intense, with a good structure, good volume, elegant, soft tannins, and the aromas of small red fruits are repeated. The end of the mouth is long, with good acidity which gives it high persistence.

name: Altano  Vinho Tinto Douro DOC
style: Touriga Franca, Tinta Roriz, Tinta Barroca.
desc_en_short: Deep, crimson colour. This Altano red reveals scented floral aromas and focused, fresh fruit, reflecting the very good year in which Touriga Franca shone. Simultaneously full and silky on the palate, well defined red fruit flavours come to the fore, enveloped in soft, ripe tannins and spicy notes. Generous, well-structured and elegant.

name: San Filippo  Brunello di Montalcino Lo Scorno
desc_en_short: The colour is ruby red; to the nose the perfume is clean and intense. Reminiscent of cherries preserved in alcohol, enhanced by spicy notes. To the palate it offers a good body, full and balanced with silky tannins. Good persistence that harks back to the first olfactory notes.

name: San Filippo  Brunello di Montalcino Riserva Le Lucere
wine_color: The colour is ruby red with nuances tending to garnet.
desc_en_short:
99 points in James Suckling - "The opulence and decadence is really something here with dried fruit, figs, meat and black truffles on the nose and palate. It’s full-bodied, layered and creamy with intense, round tannins and a finish that lasts for minutes. Best after 2022, but already a joy to taste."

97 points in Wine Spectator - "Floral, black cherry, black currant, spice, earth and mineral flavors abound in this appealing red. Smooth and lively, offers excellent balance and a lingering aftertaste, with a complex finish that is resonant and promising. Best from 2024 through 2047."

94 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate - "The 2015 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva le Lucére reveals rich and well-concentrated fruit with blackberry, prune and plum. The bouquet also has a moment of scorched earth or toasted oak that is quite developed and, to my palate, subtracts from the purity of the fruit. The oak is heavily applied (and I am reminded of American oak). This Riserva ages in barrique, tonneau and botte grande for two years and fruit is drawn from an east-facing vineyard with clay galestro and alberese soils. It is only made in the best years. There are soft cherry notes on the finish."

name: Rawen  Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This specially selected wine has been aged for 12 months in American and French oak barrels. Its brick red tones are complemented by wonderful and elegant aromas of red fruits. In the mouth it is a wine with great body, concentrated and with velvet tannins. Excellent with all red meat dishes.

name: Chateau Fondarzac  Bordeaux Superieur
desc_en_short: This red Bordeaux is a lovely, brilliant, young color, with a really fresh, fruity bouquet. It is crisp and flavourful on the palate as well as full-bodied and soft. Its spicy, green-pepper aromas follow through in a nice, fruity aftertaste. A Bordeaux to enjoy with white meat stews, roast chicken, cold buffets, and most medium-flavouredcheeses.

name: San Marco  Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Intense cabernet of deep ruby red colour
desc_en_short: Intense cabernet of deep ruby red colour showing a nice combination of black and red fruits on the nose and the palate. Well structured, with very good balance and persistence.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mouton Cadet Reserve Saint-Estephe
wine_color: A deep crimson with a slight purple hue.
desc_en_short: A deep crimson with a slight purple hue. The nose opens on expressive blackcurrant and bilberry aromas with a touch of toast, joined with airing by leather and black fruit notes. From a round and rich attack on bilberry and blackcurrant flavours, the midpalate reveals the powerful yet refined tannins of a great terroir. The leather note returns on the finish, along with mild spice, especially nutmeg, and a hint of truffle.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mouton Cadet Reserve Margaux
wine_color: An intense garnet red with a slight crimson hue.
desc_en_short: An intense garnet red with a slight crimson hue. The nose opens on blackcurrant and blackberry aromas, followed with airing by touches of mocha, black pepper and vanilla. From a powerful attack on structured and delicate tannins, the midpalate reveals blackcurrant and mocha flavours, while the finish is marked by elegant tannins and rich black fruit, mocha, vanilla and pepper flavours with a hint of violet.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mouton Cadet Reserve Pessac-Leognan
wine_color: A deep red with an attractive carmine hue.
desc_en_short: A deep red with an attractive carmine hue. The nose opens on ripe red fruit aromas joined with airing by subtle mild spice and vanilla notes. A remarkably full and substantial attack leads into a mid-palate on intense red and black fruit flavours underpinned by firm tannins that mellow on the finish, making way for delicate notes of mocha and toasted almond.

name: Chateau Montrose  2017
wine_color: Deep ruby with violet hues, indicating fruit density and excellent aging potential
desc_en_short:
Château Montrose 2017 is a vintage forged through challenge. Despite the unpredictability of weather in that year, the château's team succeeded in crafting a wine that remains true to Saint-Estèphe’s character—powerful, deep, and composed.

This vintage expresses itself through firm structure, refined yet authoritative tannins, and an unmistakable presence. It’s a wine that speaks in quiet strength—what you might call “a warrior in a dark suit,” revealing its complexity gradually with time in the bottle.

name: Bodega Norton  Coleccion Cabernet Sauvignon
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short: Deep red ruby. Aromas of blackberries and red peppers, with notes of eucalyptus and cinnamon. Elegant on the palate, good body, round and consistent

name: Pike & Joyce  Vue De Nord Pinot Noir
style: Pinot Noir (100% Adelaide Hills Fruit. Estate Grown Single Vineyard Wine.)
