food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short: Dark cherries and stewed strawberries dominate the aroma on the first swirl. With some time in the glass and a few more swirls, the wine opens up with forest floor, charry oak and spice notes developing.

name: Charles Melton  La Belle Mere SGM
desc_en_short: Bright medium depth hue, perfumed whole bunch with a touch of stemmy forest floor complexity, almost a hint of fine boned pinot, lovely round attack in to the mouth. Bright sweet flavours with lovely balanced tannin and acidity. Sufficient tannic structure to cellar mid-term.

name: Charles Melton  The Father In Law Shiraz
style: Shiraz (92% Barossa Valley And 8% Clare Valley)
desc_en_short: Deep crimson but bright colour. Clean, dark Marella jube nose. Black fruits more than red. A very light touch of Lyndoch graphite or gunmetal but with our cellar style sweet fruit perfume mixed in. Lovely deep texture with a mix of plum sweetness and herby extension of the palate. On second look, even a touch of sweet grilled meats.

name: Eleve  Syrah
wine_color: Bright ruby in colour, with lovely hints of purple.
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short:
Bright ruby in colour, with lovely hints of purple. Aromas of black current and blackberry, with a touch of violet and
liquorice. A bold wine, with a dense and juicy palate. Silky tannins support the lingering finish

name: Paxton AAA Shiraz Grenache
wine_color: Bright crimson red with a purple hue.
desc_en_short: Paxton AAA is a sun-drenched McLaren Vale blend of Shiraz and Grenache sourced from the estate's celebrated Gateway and Jones Block vineyards — an approachable, fruit-forward red that wears its premium origins lightly and delivers genuine everyday pleasure.

name: Paxton Quandong Farm Shiraz
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Quandong Farm Shiraz is a single vineyard wine that aims to highlight the intensity and brightness of fruit grown using biodynamic techniques. Our farming practices are designed to produce wines of intensity, but also with layers of texture, flavour and interest for the consumer. We think this wine exhibits these characteristics and provides both concentration and flavour and a certain delicacy, rather than simple raw power.

name: Elderton  ‘E Series’ Shiraz Cabernet
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Deep purple. Aromas of plum, cherry, and cassis. On the palate notes of plum, cherry, cassis and hints of vanilla. Mid to full bodied, classic Australian blend.

name: Elderton  Ode To Lorraine Cab/Shiraz/Merlot
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short: Medium garnet-purple in color, The nose presents slowly evolving cassis and plum preserves notes, mulberries and prunes with an incense and cedar undercurrent. The medium-bodied palate has nice freshness and a very soft and elegant texture through the long finish.

name: Mount Mary  Pinot Noir
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese
desc_en_short:
Vines average age 27yo, hand-picked, bunch-sorted on vibrating tables, open-fermented with cultured yeast, 14 days on skins, matured in French barriques (25-30% new). Glorious colour; the bouquet has the complexity you expect from a 20+yo Burgundy with aromas of field and forest floor. The palate is utterly exceptional, with perfect balance and length. The multitude of flavours swirl and dance - red tree fruits, red cherry foremost, plums close behind, thence to field and forest floor, capturing wild raspberry and strawberry. Sam Middleton thinks this will be one of the all-time greats of Mount Mary, and I'm sure he is right.

Wine Award

- James Halliday 99 Points!

- The Wine Front 95 Point

- James Suckling.com 93 Point

name: Domaine Du Vieux  Telegraphe Chateauneuf Du Pape Rouge
style: Grenache, 15% Mourvedre, 15% Syrah, 5% Cinsault, Clairette, Etc.
desc_en_short:
Domaine du Vieux Télégraphe Châteauneuf-du-Pape Rouge is a benchmark wine of the Southern Rhône, renowned for expressing the power and identity of the La Crau plateau. The vineyards lie on a high, stony terrace covered with large rounded stones (galets roulés), which store heat during the day and release it at night, allowing for optimal grape ripening and remarkable concentration.

The wine is predominantly based on Grenache, complemented by Mourvèdre and Syrah, sourced from old vines. Aromatically complex, it reveals layers of dark fruits, dried herbs, spice, leather, and mineral earth. On the palate, it is structured and commanding yet balanced, with firm tannins and impressive length—built for graceful ageing.

name: Domaine Du Vieux  Telegraphe Les Pallières Terrasse Du Diable Gigondas AOC
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short: The Châteauneuf-du-Pape red 2016 du Vieux Télégraphe is located on the terroir of Crau which marks the wines of a very particular minerality. Le Vieux Télégraphe 2016 presents elegant notes of black tea infusions, liquorice and freshness. Full-bodied but silky, Vieux Télégraphe wine is more powerful and richer than Piedlong, but it is just as elegant and fine.

name: Pierre Gaillard  Saint-Joseph Rouge
desc_en_short: With good structure and silky tannins, this is as open and friendly as the grower himself--primed for instant drinking appeal. The high elevation of the vineyards sings through on the palate, lifting the wine's textured layers of black cherry, floral notes and sweet brown spices. The twist of freshness on the vibrant and intense finish is particularly well captured. On current showing this is quite possibly our favourite vintage shipped for some time.

name: Pierre Gaillard  Cote-Rotie AOC
desc_en_short: Located on the south/southwest facing slopes of Ampuis, this wine comes from two different plots. One gives structured wines when the other plot offers more supple and aromatic wines: This wine combines structure and aromas! The palate is silky, fruity with very present tannins but without any astringency.

name: Villalta  Amarone Della Valpolicella Classico
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red colour with an intense, full and rich bouquet. Rounded on the palate with classic black cherry flavours and a long, complex finish. Ideal with roasts, game and cheese, but also a great wine to sip slowly in company.

name: Poggio Antico  Rosso Di Montalcino DOC
desc_en_short: Raspberries and chestnuts with mushroom and earth undertones. It's full-bodied with fine, chewy tannins and lively acidity. Vibrant and fleshy on the palate. Pure and balanced with a long, savory finish. Excellent for the category.

name: Poggio Antico  Brunello Di Montalcino DOCG
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short:
97 Point by James Suckling "This understated Brunello delivers dried cherries, cumin, terracotta, rust and bark. The full-bodied palate presents an intricately detailed tapestry of finely interwoven tannins, interspersed with compressed, vibrant cherries and gilded in colorful, gleaming acidity. The finish is vivacious and polished and very long. Drink from 2024."

95 Point by Robert Parker's Wine Advocate "Poggio Antico brings us a classic expression of Sangiovese in its 2015 Brunello di Montalcino. The warm vintage has shaped more density and volume in the fruit, but fundamentally this wine holds tight to the bright and fresh taste profile that is characteristic of Brunello. The key is the acidity that remains an integral and important element in the fundamental architecture of this wine. That natural crispness serves to underline lively fruit flavors of wild cherry and pressed violets. Background tones of earth and black licorice also appear. The team at Poggio Antico, located at one of the highest altitudes in the appellation (from 500 to 550 meters above sea level), has worked well to preserve the cool climate characteristics in this very warm and sunny vintage. Some 36,000 bottles were made. This wine went into bottle in August 2018 and hit the market in January 2020."

94 Point by Wine Spectator "Cherry, plum, earth, wild scrub and salty flavors are the hallmarks of this dense, hefty red. An iron note becomes more prominent as this evolves on the palate. Well-balanced, with the ripe fruit and saline elements lingering on the finish. Best from 2023 through 2043."

92 Point by Wine Enthusiast "Forest floor, mature red berry, dried tobacco leaf and balsamic whiffs of camphor come together on this. It’s firm and concentrated, delivering dried black cherry, licorice and coffee bean framed in velvety tannins. Drink 2022–2027."

name: Mount Mary  Quintet
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 20% Cabernet Franc, 6% Malbec, 4% Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Mount Mary Quintet is the Yarra Valley's definitive Bordeaux blend — a masterwork of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Malbec, and Petit Verdot aged in French oak, earning 97 points from James Halliday and an Exceptional classification from Langton's.

name: Arnaud Mortet  Gevrey-Chambertin AOC 2018
desc_en_short: The Gevrey Chambertin plot in Arnaud stretches eastward to the Grand Garden. The wine is more elegant and delicate with floral and fruity aromas. The entrance is very smooth, which can be described by a piece of cream that melts in the mouth. The following is the fragrance of flowers combined with red currant and cherry, sweet and delicious. Fruity floral fragrance, long-lasting balance, soft and harmonious, with a mineral aftertaste. Dominated by fruity flavors, you can drink happily when you are young, but at the same time you can feel good aging strength. Through time, the overall wine is more balanced.

name: Bodega Norton  Coleccion Malbec
wine_color: Deep red color, with violet hints.
desc_en_short: Bodega Norton's Colección Malbec delivers everything Mendoza does best — a deep violet-hued red brimming with ripe dark fruit, sweet spice, and silky tannins that make every glass an effortless pleasure from Argentina's benchmark Malbec producer.

name: Hardys  Crest Shiraz
wine_color: A wine with enchanting deep ruby core and a bright crimson rim.
desc_en_short: A wine with enchanting deep ruby core and a bright crimson rim. It emanates Intense, red fruits and confectionery flavors with a hint of vanilla. The drink showcases good fruit intensity of raspberries and strawberries, complementary oak, and supporting background tannins. You must savour it with grilled and barbecued foods.

name: Blankiet Estate  Prince of Hearts 2015
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot And Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short:
One of the six “Napa Valley Super-seconds” according to Robert Parker and Antonio Galloni. A Bordeaux blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc from barrels not culled for the flagship cuvees.

Prince of Hearts remains one of the very finest values in artisan Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon. (Anotnio Galloni)

name: Blankiet Estate  Prince of Hearts 2016
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 38% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, And The Remainder Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: The 2016 ‘Prince Of Hearts’ Red is absolutely fabulous. Composed of 54% Cabernet Sauvignon, 38% Merlot, 5% Cabernet Franc, and the remainder Petit Verdot, all aged 18 months in 50% new French oak.

name: Blankiet Estate  Prince of Music 2018
style: 48.8% Merlot, 48.3% Cabernet Sauvignon, 1.7% Cabernet Franc And 1.2% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short: The 2018 ‘Prince Of Music’ Red is a Bordeaux blend Cabernet driven (over 72%). The remaining is mostly Merlot (25%) and fractions of Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot that impart freshness and color in the blend, The wine is aged in 19 months in oak (new and used). An example of full-body Napa red; Approachable in youth yet with good aging potential.

name: Faust Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
desc_en_short:
94 Point by James Suckling

Very attractive aromas of blackcurrants, black olives and dark leather with some cedar. It’s full-bodied with firm, silky tannins and a refined, polished finish. Shows finesse and focus. Grows on the palate. Really delicious now, but will improve with age. Drink or hold.

92 Point by Wine Enthusiast

Very attractive aromas of blackcurrants, black olives and dark leather with some cedar. It’s full-bodied with firm, silky tannins and a refined, polished finish. Shows finesse and focus. Grows on the palate. Really delicious now, but will improve with age. Drink or hold.

92 Point by Wine Spectator

Distinctive, with sweet bay leaf, sassafras and a sanguine note all taking the lead, while a core of gently mulled red currant and blackberry fruit follows. Shows a nice herbaceous/brambly energy through the finish. Drink now through 2028.

name: Flowers Camp Meeting Ridge Pinot Noir 2017
desc_en_short:
94 Points by Wine Spectator

Offers a rich and lusciously spicy aroma, with flavors to match, as well as a deep core of cherry compote, berry, currant and red plum accents that glide across the palate. Unctuous midpalate, featuring a long, cream-filled finish. Drink now through 2026.

name: Flowers Russian River 2019
desc_en_short:
94 Points by Wine Spectator

Offers a rich and lusciously spicy aroma, with flavors to match, as well as a deep core of cherry compote, berry, currant and red plum accents that glide across the palate. Unctuous midpalate, featuring a long, cream-filled finish. Drink now through 2026.

name: Flowers Sea View Ridge Pinot Noir 2017
desc_en_short:
93 Points by Wine Advocate

The 2017 Pinot Noir Seaview Ridge is pale to medium ruby with aromas of lush black cherries, baked cranberries, orange peel, warm dusty earth and rhubarb with hints of Earl Grey tea and a lovely spicy undercurrent. Very spicy in the mouth, it's light to medium-bodied and silky with seamlessly woven grainy tannins and a long, nuanced finish.

92 Points by Wine Enthusiast

This is a feral, earthy and layered wine from the famous coastal site, woven with compost, black tea and savory cardamom character. The fruit is tart and intriguing, a mix of pomegranate, rhubarb and wild strawberry that match well with the accents and grippy texture.

name: Flowers Sonoma Coast Pinot Noir 2018
desc_en_short:
91 Points by Wine Enthusiast

This complex wine is thick in tannin and structure, with nuanced underlying elegance. Textured, it offers dried herb, clove, wild strawberry and a twist of blood orange on the palate, with acidity interwoven within the integrated oak.

name: Forman Cabernet Sauvignon 2018
desc_en_short:
96 Points by Vinous

“The 2018 Cabernet Sauvignon is absolutely impeccable. Best of all, it won't require years in the cellar to be enjoyable. In fact, it is quite expressive today. Juicy dark cherry, plum, mocha, spice, leather and cinnamon are some of the many notes that flesh out in the glass. Silky and supple, with no hard edges, Ric Forman's 2018 is a thing of beauty. The 2018 is a bit more open in the early going than Forman fans are likely to expect.”

name: Château La Grande Roche Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 15% Cabernet Franc, 5% Petite Verdot, 2% Merlot
desc_en_short:
A wonderfully deep color leads into expectations of an impressive wine. Medoc or Napa? (Hard to tell). All of the spiciness of Bordeaux, yet lusciousness of Napa make this wine so intriguing. Great extract, super finish.

Chateau La Grande Roche is such a delicious wine. A burst of sweet red cherry, red plum, mocha, spice, licorice and leather race out of the glass. Exuberant and juicy, yet very much medium in body, this is a wine of pure and total pleasure. All the elements come together in a mid-weight Cabernet Sauvignon that hits all the right notes. The Grand Roche is the second selection from the Forman Cabernet, and a great value to boot.

name: Tobias Pauli Vineyard Cabernet Sauvignon 2017
desc_en_short: With a deep rich color... beautiful aromas of ripe blackberry, cassis and mulberry delight the nose. On the palate, expressive and expansive crushed black cherry, cassis, black pepper and savory spices swirl. Intertwined and structured, smooth tannins showcase the balance and finesse of the acid and fruit. Vibrant, expressive, the rich, red, rocky volcanic soils of this Pauli Howell Mountain Vineyard Estate show off harmony of tannins, fruit, structure, and expression for a very complex wine.

name: Bouchard Père & Fils  La Vignee Pinot Noir AOC
desc_en_short: A graceful entry point into Burgundy from one of the Côte d'Or's most storied négociants, Bouchard Père & Fils La Vignée delivers classic Pinot Noir charm — pale ruby in colour with delicate red fruit, silky texture, and the kind of effortless balance that makes Burgundy irresistible.

name: Domaine Nicolas Boiron  Côtes du Rhône Rouge AOC
desc_en_short: An intense red color. This wine with delicate aromatic notes. Structured and soft tannins. Well balanced, it can be drunk young but has a good cellar potential. Good with cooked pork meats, red meats and cheese will perfectly match

name: Chateau Lamothe Bergeron  Haut-Medoc
desc_en_short: After a particularly wet winter and spring, magnificent weather settled in from the end of June through to the autumn. In these exceptional conditions, the colour change of the grapes was rapid and even. Each plot of vines was harvested as it reached just the right ripeness. The wines boast lovely complex aromas with perfectly ripe red and black fruit hints. They combine structure and roundness, along with the nicely lingering length on the palate that is characteristic of the great vintages. 55% Cabernet Sauvignon, 45% Merlot.

name: Chateau Lamothe Bergeron  Demoiselles de Bergeron Haut-Medoc
desc_en_short:
The Demoiselles de Bergeron Haut-Médoc from Château Lamothe-Bergeron is a red wine from the Haut-Médoc region of Bordeaux. This wine is a blend of 3 grape varieties which are Cabernet Sauvignon, Cabernet Franc and Merlot. 
On the palate this red wine is a powerful wine with a beautiful balance between acidity and tannins. This wine usually goes well with beef, lamb or game.

name: M. Chapoutier  Belleruche Cotes-du-Rhone
desc_en_short: Pretty dark berries, chocolate, tar and some grilled meat on the nose and palate. It's full-bodied with round, lightly chewy tannins. Delivers lots of typical Rhone flavors and goodness... - James Suckling

name: M. Chapoutier  Pays d'Oc Red
desc_en_short: Intense aromas of complex dark spicy red berries delicate floral touch. Powerful on the palate concentrated and structured attack with a tinge of silky tannins. Red fruit aromas.

name: Chateau Tour Prignac  Grande Reserve Medoc
desc_en_short: This wine's deep red colour speaks volumes. A dense, powerful nose reveals aromas of rich oak and cherry liqueur. The full-bodied mouthfeel is provided by smooth tannins, bringing distinguished notes of Havana cigars and chocolate. The finish is remarkably long.

name: Les Coteaux  Cotes du Rhone Red
desc_en_short:
The heart of the wine is lusciously fruity and unoaked with a touch of complexity interwoven from 20% matured for a minimum of 22 months in a combination of new and old French oak barrels.

Instantly appealing tones of warm fully ripe southern Rhône fruit, lifted by nuances of oak, which flow into layers of supple and smooth textures and roll forward to a full-flavored sumptuous finish.

name: Santa Julia  Malbec
desc_en_short: A pretty, smooth and approachable Malbec with partial and subtle oak aging, leaving the emphasis on the spice, damson and black cherry flavours. Enjoy with pasta or try with oriental dishes.

name: Zuccardi  Q Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Varietal wines, distinct blends from select vineyards, which come from the best parts of mendoza. Each batch is harvested separately at different times, with the goal of achieving elegance and excellence in the wine. A refined and savory red featuring notes of white pepper, cherry and crushed red plum flavors.

name: Col d'Orcia  Toscana Spezieri Rosso
wine_color: Deep ruby red with violet hues.
desc_en_short: Spezieri Toscana Rosso IGT by Col d 'Orcia presents a deep ruby red and purple reflections in the glass as it unfolds its fruity bouquet. This enchants with the aromas of ripe cherries and wild berries, which are accompanied by a spiciness that has its origin in oak aging. This red wine cuvée from Tuscany is soft on the palate and pleasant with ripe tannins. The reverberation is persistent and fruity.

name: Canti Estate  Barolo DOCG 2014
desc_en_short: Garnet red with orange reflexes. Intense and elegant aroma of ripe fruits, with spiced undertones and leather inklings. Dry, full, strong, severe but velvety. Harmonious with a slight taste of licorice. It is particularly suitable to accompany roast meats, game and tasty meat dishes.

name: Herdade de Sao Miguel  Colheita Seleccionada
desc_en_short: The nose is fresh and pronounced with concentrated red fruits and notes of vanilla and toasted oak. On the palate, it is silky with a core of strawberry fruit combined.

name: Harlan Estate  The Maiden 2016
desc_en_short: 94 point by points Wine Advocate "Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2016 The Maiden is a little closed to begin, giving way to notes of crushed blackberries, fresh blackcurrants, warm plums and black pepper with hints of tobacco, charcoal, menthol and underbrush. Full-bodied, the palate is taut and muscular, packed with tightly wound layers of black fruits and savory sparks, framed by ripe, grainy tannins and finishing on a lingering earthy note."

name: Benjamin Le-roux  Gevrey Chambertin
desc_en_short: This is another important cuvée for Ben and it demonstrates his ability to capture the essence of a village’s character with, it seems, almost minimum effort. Everything was de-stemmed this year and, yes, it’s immediate and authentic, but also delivers more complexity than is at first evident. Notes of lavender and sweet peony, and a more schoolmasterly structure. Drink 2022-2028.

name: Chateau Margaux  2012
desc_en_short: 96 points in Robert Parker's Wine Advocate. "Tasted blind at the 2012 Southwold tasting, the 2012 Château Margaux has a taut, linear, pencil lead-infused bouquet with pure blackberry and boysenberry scents, an undercurrent of tobacco that surfaces after five minutes in the glass. The palate is medium-bodied with fine tannin, crisp acidity, a life-affirming sense of balance with well-integrated new oak towards the finish. I concur with Robert Parker that his has become more structured and masculine in bottle, yet there is pedigree here from start to finish, a sense of effortlessness that is seductive. This is a top-class wine from the late Paul Pontallier and his team. Tasted January 2016."

name: Chateau Moulin Riche  Saint-Julien (375 ml)
desc_en_short:
Chateau Moulin Riche is a sophisticated red blend with mouth filling flavor. Marked by aromas of licorice and chocolate accompanied by subtle oak, this elegant wine makes a fantastic addition to any fine dining experience.

On the nose, ripe blueberries, black currants, dried violets, cigar box, as well as tar and light pipe smoke. Full-bodied, medium-plus intensity, with a velvety, almost creamy texture.

name: Chateau Le Crock  Cru Bourgeois Supérieur St-Estèphe (375ml)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petit Verdot, Cabernet-franc
desc_en_short: Classified among the top Crus Bourgeois in the Médoc hence the title Cru Bourgeois Exceptionnel, Château le Crock offers deeply coloured wines with delicate fruity bouquets. The full-bodied, fleshy structure becomes more elegant as the years go by, giving complex, racy wines. The sturdy tannins and the exceptional ageing potential are characteristic of the Saint Estèphe appellation. The grape varieties vary by vintage but are around 50% Cabernet Sauvignon, 35% Merlot, 10% Cabernet Franc and 5% Petit Verdot.

name: Sandro Fay  Valtellina Superiore DOC "Costa Bassa" (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Costa Bassa means ‘lower slopes’. In this case, between 400-500 metres, with the fruit (100% Chiavennasca) all sourced from the Valgella sub-zone. Similar ferment/maceration time to the ‘Tei’, then 12 months in large-format oak (45 hectolitres Slavonian). More juicy and fragrant than the Rosso, with hints of wild strawberry, liquorice and dark berries; great structure, precise acidity, savoury tannin and the distinct minerality that characterises these wines

name: Zymn  "60 20 20" Cabernet (375 ml)
wine_color: Red tending to deep purple, and to garnet with ageing; glycerine-rich
desc_en_short: Red tending to deep purple, and to garnet with ageing; glycerine-rich. On nose, wild red berryfruit, blueberry, redcurrant, wild blackberry, musk and spices. On palate enters with immediately-appealing richness; austere, complex, long-lingering, and well-balanced, with pronounced tannins and form structure. Offers aromatic impressions of prune marmalade and wild red berry. Lengthy fi nish, with delicate hints of black pepper, country herbs, and clay earth.

name: Chateau Beau Site  Saint-Estephe Red (375 ml)
wine_color: Garnet red wine orangey red rim
desc_en_short: Chateau Beau-Site is a historic Chateau that dates back to the 18th century. The name  Beau Site can be translated to a beautiful site. Part of its beauty comes from its stellar views of the Gironde estuary. Since 1955, the vineyard had been owned by the well-known, popular and powerful Casteja family.  This Cru Bourgeois is famous for delivering outstanding value and offering wines that can be enjoyed without extended cellaring.

name: Chateau Brane Cantenac  Margaux (375 ml)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Carmenère, Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: This is classic Brane-Cantenac down the line: austere at first, almost aloof, but very well defined and over time it starts revealing lovely tobacco-stained black fruit. The palate is very well balanced with raspberry and wild strawberry on the entry, perhaps more red fruit than I was anticipating. Veins of undergrowth and cedar are in situ on this very well-balanced, reserved and classic Margaux boasting a long and persistent finish that feels satisfying, reassuring even. Not a Margaux for those that seek tons of fruit, it is nonetheless a very terroir-expressive wine that will repay those who know that this cru demands preferably 12-15 years in the cellar. Henri Lurton never wavers from his style of Margaux and it pays dividends here on this great wine for those with patience.

name: Tenuta Argentiera  'Poggio ai Ginepri' Bolgheri Rosso (375 ml)
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: Tenuta Argentiera's Poggio ai Ginepri is a classic Bolgheri DOC blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, and Petit Verdot — offering a generous, fruit-driven character with well-defined structure, a beautifully soft texture, and a remarkably clean, lingering finish.

name: Chateau d’Issan  2016 (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Medium to deep garnet-purple colored. A very fine, quite sophisticated and pure bouquet with black cherries, cedar and violet aromas, perfumed and sensual. The 2016 expresses the exquisite bouquet typical of Margaux, featuring cassis, plums and earth with an undercurrent of bay leaves and tobacco.

name: Chateau Brown  2014 (375 ml)
desc_en_short: It's building on the promise it showed in barrel. It has a ripe and generous bouquet with upfront cedar-infused black fruit. This property is always a little feisty in its youth and this 2014 is no different, though it needs 3-4 years to fully assimilate the new oak. The palate is medium-bodied with crisp tannin, delicious black fruit laced with tobacco and spices, gently fanning out towards the finish that offers commendable substance and length. A Pessac-Léognan property that I feel is undervalued in the marketplace, this Château Brown comes recommended and should drink well for 15-20 years.

name: Aurore de Dauzac  Margaux (375 ml)
wine_color: In the glass, the wine sits a deep, dark ruby with purple highlights and a crimson rim.
desc_en_short:
In the glass, the wine sits a deep, dark ruby with purple highlights and a crimson rim. The nose is classic Margaux, overflowing with cassis, blueberry and raspberry fruits enhanced with subtle notes of vanilla, tobacco and violets. On the palate, the wine is generous and concentrated with firm, ripe tannins and a gentle acidity.

The rich intensity of fruit flavors cascade across the mid-palate and flow into a long, ripe finish which stays with you long after the wine is gone. The 2015 Aurore de Dauzac will please lovers of classic Bordeuax, but if you like the fruit intensity and richness of California Cabs, there is weight and persistence to impress.

name: Les Volets  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: This Cabernet Sauvignon has a remarkable freshness. Probably because the vineyard has a sea view. Enjoy the cooling sea breeze. In your mouth the blackcurrants burst. Crackling fruit, some cedar, some mint. Juicy and easy drinking. Tannins very controlled and completely wrapped by its fruitiness. Spicy drinker. This young Cabernet lad combines very well with roast beef or lamb from the oven. Old Gouda cheese to finish. For vegetarians, a well-filled portobello from the oven with goat cheese and extra thyme is an excellent option.

name: Les Volets  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Bright ruby red fruits with upfront aromas of freshly picked raspberries and an underlying savoury messiness. Fleshy red fruits continue to the palate and are joined by the fin tannins and juicy acidity.

name: The Last Stand  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Premium quality fruit and mature vines have produced a wine with great balance, length and fruit intensity. This attractively fruity Shiraz in a cooler-climate style has concentrated mulberry and soft plummy fruit flavours and smooth savoury tannins. This is a fresh Shiraz which is developing beautifully!

name: Caricature  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Rich aromas of black cherry and vanilla ﬁll the glass of our Cabernet Sauvignon. Inviting flavors of dark fruit with hints of licorice and chocolate make the wine delightfully appealing. A bit of French and American oak aging adds an additional layer to this fresh and approachable wine.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mouton Cadet Selection Bordeaux Rouge
wine_color: A deep red with an attractive carmine hue.
desc_en_short: From a full-bodied attack on delicate, fresh black fruit, a clean-cut yet refined tannic structure emerges on the midpalate to carry the black fruit flavours into a finish where they are joined by the coffee notes found on the nose.

name: Penfolds  Bin 150 Marananga Shiraz
desc_en_short:
Bin 150 Marananga Shiraz is a sub-regional expression that is unmistakably Penfolds in character. Conceived from the ancient soils of Marananga, which lie very close to the centre of the Barossa Valley floor – slightly to the North West, where warm dry conditions and rich red soil provide the backbone to some of the region’s best-known wines. Each release delivers a contemporary shiraz alternative, framed by a mix of oaks; French and American, old and new – crafted in accordance with the traditional Penfolds method.

Awards.

  • 96 Points - Andrew Caillard MW
  • 96 Points - Nick Stock - James Suckling
  • 96 Points - Ray Jordan
  • 95 Points - Joe Czerwinski (Robert Parker Wine Advocate)
  • 94 Points - Tony Love

name: Penfolds  Magill Estate Shiraz 2019
desc_en_short:
The single-vineyard Magill Estate Shiraz is intrinsically linked to Penfolds beginnings. Sourced from the Magill vineyard on the edge of Adelaide’s eastern suburbs (just eight kilometres from the city’s CBD), fruit is crushed, fermented and matured on-site at the original winery, established in 1844. Magill Estate Shiraz, first produced in 1983, is an elegant, medium-weight style with velvety texture and fine tannins, matured in both French and American oak. It is a sleek, contemporary wine, yet crafted the original way: hand-picked, vinified in open fermenters and then basket pressed to complete fermentation in barrel.

Awards.

  • 98 Points - Huon Hooke

  • 96 Points - Tyson Stelzer

  • 96 Points - Nick Stock, Jamessuckling.com

  • 96 Points - James Halliday

  • 95 Points - Josh Raynolds

name: Penfolds  802.A Superblend Cabernet Sauvignon Shiraz 2018
desc_en_short:
One Superblend. Two Interpretations. Superblend 802.A and Superblend 802.B represent two unique interpretations of the iconic Australian blend of cabernet sauvignon and shiraz, sourced from unique parcels destined for Penfolds flagships.

The Superblend 802.A components were aged separately in new American oak hogsheads for 22 months prior to being blended. The cabernet sauvignon makes its structural presence felt comprising 68% of the blend, while the 32% shiraz contribution adds generosity. Unashamedly bold, immediately Penfolds. 

Awards.

  • 99 Points - Livets Goda Magazine

  • 98 Points - James Halliday

  • 98 Points - Tyson Stelzer

  • 97 Points - Andrew Caillard

  • 96 Points - Josh Raynolds

name: Penfolds  G4
desc_en_short: Four exceptional Grange vintages connected to each other by a rolling power of two, creating a unique experience of layered complexity and richness. The blend energetically entwines Grange DNA from the exceptional 2002, 2004, 2008 and 2016 vintages, to create a completely unique and rare expression of Penfolds flagship that fully animates and integrates the strengths of each Grange vintage. Deep crimson colour, with a richly concentrated, expansive and beautifully balanced palate of dense blackberry and black cherry, grilled nut complexity and a fresh integrated acidity. Finish firm and solid with liquorice chocolate notes. Fresh and juicy despite the near two-decade maturation period of the oldest vintage. Peak drinking: 2025-2080

name: Hardys  The Chronicles Reserve Merlot
wine_color: Moderate crimson in colour with tinges of purple.
desc_en_short: Moderate crimson in colour with tinges of purple. Aromas of intense, rich dark berry and vanilla pod with a hint of clove spice. Fruit driven flavours of dark berry fruits, rich plum, blackcurrant and cherry with subtle hints of chocolate, mocha and spice and oak.

name: Hardys  The Chronicles Reserve Shiraz
desc_en_short: Crimson purple edge with a dark ruby red hue Lifted aromatics of blueberry and mulberry with hints of black pepper. Coffee bean and milk chocolate have been layered in the background. Bright, fresh notes of plum, red currant, hints of baking spice. Tannins are quite supple, soft and approachable, with a more than generous mouthfeel. The plushness of the wine is balanced by the bright acidity which carries through to the finish.

name: Bracken Ridge  Shiraz
desc_en_short: This wine is deep red color. A combination of the fruit aromas of plum and blackberry with spice, pepper and cinnamon which then follows through onto the palate. This is a well-rounded and fruity wine featuring the rich flavours of ripe plum, blackberry jam and spices. This is balanced with vanilla and caramel flavours to result in a wine with good depth and intensity of flavour.

name: B.R.Cohn  Silver Label Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A bold, rich Cabernet with aromas of cassis, black cherry, mint and violet combine with a bouquet of pungent oak, anise and warm vanilla. On the palate, lush cherry, caramel, and clove are wrapped in smooth tannins and a long juicy finish.

name: B.R.Cohn  Silver Label Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: The aromatics suggest cherry, currant, vanilla and anise. On the palate there is a mixture of red raspberry and Bing cherry with underlying mocha, cinnamon and nutmeg notes which mingle in the natural acidity we look forward to in these cooler climate regions of the North Coast.

name: Cable Bay  Syrah
desc_en_short: Vibrant, fresh and layered with charisma, this partial whole bunch ferment Syrah bounces with blueberry, rose, cherry, red peppercorn and earthy spice. The palate is both intense and delicate, has lovely body, with supple juicy fruit and spice paving the way to great textural mouth feel and well-founded tannin structure. Waiheke Syrah at its most refined and beautiful.

name: Cable Bay  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Savoury aromas of cherry wood, gun-smoke, rose petal, campari and dried herbs integrate with underlying earthy tones. The site where this Pinot was grown is expressed wonderfully, especially on the palate; a delicate minerally texture has ensued from the river-stone built soils, and a distinct salinity reflects close proximity to the ocean. The palate is vibrant and poised with wonderful balance and a distinguished tannin structure. A gem from a fantastic vintage for the Awatere Valley.

name: Belvento by Petra  Sangiovese Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: After bunch selection and picking from 12 year old vines, this Sangiovese ferments in the cellars and matures for a minimum of 12 months in large traditional oak casks. Bright, transparent ruby red color, and a bouquet of plums, black cherries, balsamic notes of eucalyptus and black pepper. The mouthfeel is juicy with delicate tannins and a smooth finish

name: Uggiano  Brunello di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short:
Warm and ripe on the nose with black fruits, savoury, meaty characters, mocha and spice. The palate has ripe black plum and sweet spice characters with notes of toasty oak. The firm structure is balanced by the richness and intensity of the fruit, and vibrant acidity gives a sustained and balanced finish.

name: Zuccardi  "Tito" Malbec/Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Violet color with deep blue tints.
style: Malbec With 15% Cabernet Sauvignon And 5% Ancellotta.
desc_en_short: Violet color with deep blue tints. On the nose it has black and red fruits: blackberry, plum, strawberry, cherry with delicate notes of herbs, ginger and black pepper. In the mouth it has a silky entrance with nice and juicy tannins, perceiving the aromatic complexity and with a long and deep end of mouth.

name: Feudi di San Gregorio  Taurasi DOCG
desc_en_short: This ruby red wine with a garnet-coloured tinge is a beautiful sample of Taurasi wine whose flavour profile boasts fragrances of sour cherry, marasca cherry, cinnamon, nutmeg, vanilla and anise seed. Whereas in the mouth it is full-bodied, elegant and warm, and characterised by mellow, inviting tannins. It is a wine that is unique in its taste and closes with a heavily persistent finish.

name: Isole e Olena  Chianti Classico (375 ml)
desc_en_short: Made with 83% Sangiovese, 15% Canaiolo and 2% Syrah, this lovely, delicious red races out of the gate with enticing scents of perfumed berries, blue flowers, forest floor and baking spice. Smooth and savory, the juicy palate features ripe Morello cherry, crushed raspberry, white pepper and star anise alongside polished tannins. It's already drinking beautifully but will also offer several years of sheer pleasure.

name: Dominio de Punctum  Viento Aliseo Tempranillo Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: This blend of Tempranillo and Petit Verdot is a beautiful ruby red in colour. The nose is pronounced with aromas of blackberries and hints of violets. The palate is full and smooth with notes of blackberries, redcurrants and a touch of sweet spice. Well integrated tannins add structure to the wine which finishes long and fruity.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2016
wine_color: Deep purple color with black reflections
desc_en_short: 100 points in The Wine Enthusiast - "Powerful tannins and hugely rich fruit balance together in this superb wine. The velvet texture belies the power behind the concentrated, ripe black-fruit flavor, with vibrant acidity giving ample lift. The wine’s structure will ensure aging for many years. Drink from 2024."

name: Kaiken  Disobedience by Francis Mallmann Red Blend
wine_color: Intensely ruby red with subtle purple hues.
desc_en_short: Intensely ruby red with subtle purple hues. Complex, with aromas of red fruits laced with sweet spices and graphite notes, against a gentle backdrop of nuts. The palate is sweet, who soft and silky tannins that are beautifully perceived, and a long, fruity aftertaste. Notes of dark chocolate on the finish.

name: Wolf Blass  House of The Dragon Cabernet Sauvignon Shiraz (Label A)
desc_en_short: A formidable bold blend that brings to life the crimson majesty of a dragon’s fire. Rich in dark fruit with hints of leather and spice, the elegant structure of Cabernet Sauvignon combines with the brooding fruit depth of shiraz in a full-bodied balance of intensity and character. Best enjoyed while watching dragons soar.

name: Pre-order - Joseph Drouhin  Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2022
wine_color: Dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints.
desc_en_short: Dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints. Very expressive with aromas of blackberry, licorice and blueberry. The palate is full, rather generous, with these same fruity notes. Some slight acidity brings an agreeable freshness.

name: San Pedro  Gato Negro Carmenere
desc_en_short: Ripe fruity and fresh aromas like blackberry and blackcurrant blended with notable spices notes, tobacco and vanilla hints. Velvety wine, medium-bodied, pleasant finish. It is different and surprises the consumer with its first impression. Perfect with spiced food like Mexican and Thai; Duck, game meets or cheeses.

name: Almaviva  2017
wine_color: Deep, intense and attractive ruby red color
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 23% Carmenère, 5% Cabernet Franc, 5% Petit Verdot, 2% Merlot
desc_en_short: Almaviva 2017 is a landmark Chilean Bordeaux-style blend from the Maipo Valley, born from an exceptionally warm, drought-stressed vintage that delivered remarkable concentration, purity of fruit, and a seamless balance of power and elegance with outstanding long-term cellaring potential.

name: Zenato  Podere Prospero Bolgheri Rosso
desc_en_short: Podere Prospero's Bolgheri Rosso is a full-bodied and elegant red wine, produced from a Bordeaux blend of Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot. The rich olfactory baggage is composed of elegant notes of berries, cherry, plum and sweet spices, black pepper, hints of cocoa and balsamic memories. On tasting it reveals a refined and important structure, enveloping, velvety and with perfectly integrated tannins

name: Odfjell  Aliara
desc_en_short: Odfjell Aliara is a bold Maipo Valley blend of Carignan, Malbec, and Syrah, delivering an intoxicating sweep of dried fruit, jasmine, and roses on the nose, followed by a sophisticated palate layered with chocolate, coffee, and tobacco, finishing long and plush.

name: Odfjell  Odfjell 2016
desc_en_short: Bright ruby red, has a display of pleasant aromas of blueberries and black fruits such as plum, and cherry liqueur is very present. The palate is blackberry jam and chocolate. Its tannins are very intense, persistent and velvety providing a long finish.

name: 2Naturkinder  Black Betty
desc_en_short: 2Naturkinder‘s Black Betty was named after the first lamb born in the vineyard. The wine is made mainly from Domina grapes, pressed by foot, fermented and matured in big used oak barrels. It is fresh and summery with a hint of strawberry and black currant. Stony and a bit herbal too.

name: 2Naturkinder  Grosse Wanderlust
desc_en_short: Wine made with rare Regent varietal. Relatively thick skin, robust and its fungus-resistance make organic farming possible. Dark, black fruit on the nose with hint of cedar. Chalky, chewy tannins, bit of wet forest floor, more black fruits on the palate. Black pepper, mint, and bit of holiday spices toward finish.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Nuits-Saint-Georges "les Allots"
desc_en_short:
The Domaine Jean Fery et Fils is a Domaine of nearly 14 Hectares in Burgundy. Reflecting the diversity of the region, the Domaine cultivates a mosaic of appellations, a true palette of tastes on both red and white wines from the Cote d'Or : from Gevrey-Chambertin, from the Cote de Nuits to the Puligny-Montrachet, from the Cote de Beaune.

They never hesitate to innovate the new techniques or equipment such as “new barrels, if they can prove to be beneficial to the wine ; quality is priceless” The vineyards are farmed according to the principles of organic farming (the domaine has been certified by ECOCERT since 2011), which requires a great deal of dedicatioins and physical labor. Everyone who works at the Domaine are linked by a passion for wine, for nature, and for winetasting. Their method is to please one another and themselves. They do this by proposing wines, of which they are proud, and by working together in a joyful atmosphere. This is a Domaine which places its confidence in nature, in people, and their competence.

name: Domaine de La Pousse d’Or  Chambolle-Musigny
desc_en_short: The Pousse d'Or domaine at Volnay was established in 1954. Its vineyards are anything but ordinary, consisting as they do mainly of premier and grand crus in the villages of Morey-Saint-Denis, Chambolle-Musigny, Corton, Pommard, Volnay Puligny-Montrachet and Santenay. The domaine's 18 hectares yield 90,000 bottles annually and are managed in a spirit of respect for terroir. Le Domaine de la Pousse d'Or can be traced back to the Dukes of Burgundy and the year 1100. Since 1997, its new owner Patrick Landanger has invested considerable resources both in the vineyards themselves and in the arrangements for vinification and elevage. In pursuit of ever-higher quality, he is animated by profound respect for his terroirs and this guides his ambition to share his passion for the great wines of Burgundy with the world at large.

name: Castello Romitorio  Toscano Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: A bold yet elegant Tuscan blend of Syrah and Petit Verdot from the celebrated Castello Romitorio estate in Montalcino, delivering ripe dark fruits, earthy complexity, and a juicy, round finish that promises even greater rewards with a little cellaring.

name: Castello Romitorio  Brunello Di Montalcino DOCG
desc_en_short: This expression of Brunello is very polite and slightly snobbish in the primary profile which sweetly gives notes of pomegranate, rhubarb, drops of bergamot and chamomile flower. Bright ruby red. On the nose ripe cherries and rich blackberry, some light leather and noble spices on the finish. Enters with beautiful density on the palate, filling and elegant, with fine texture and hearty red fruit, lays softly over the tongue, viscous and long. Full bodied, fine grained, velvety tannins and a finale perfectly in line with the fresh Mediterranean vintage.

name: Castello Romitorio  Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: Showing richness, dark fruit, bold cherry and blackberry, the Castello Romitorio 2015 Brunello di Montalcino Riserva (with exactly 7,456 bottles made) embraces the exuberant character of the vintage, its warmth and its sunshine. If you seek a time capsule of 2015, I suggest that you put this bottle somewhere safe. The tannins are polished and chiseled, and at its core the wine is overflowing with blackberry preserves, cherry confit and plum.

name: Anura  Legato Merlot Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A classic blend of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. Full of ripe blackberry aromas combined with cooked plum and anise undertones. A soft, rich mid palate of blueberry and hint of orange peel. Lingering touch of cloves, dark chocolate and spice on the finish. Pair with grilled meats, venison, poultry, BBQ and rich stews.

name: Pour Le Vin A La Carte Vin de Pays d Oc Syrah
desc_en_short: A generous Vin de Pays d'Oc Syrah from Pour Le Vin, delivering ripe blackberry and blueberry fruit with a satisfying kick of black peppercorn on the finish — a crowd-pleasing southern French red that punches well above its price point.

name: Tenuta dell'Ornellaia  Ornellaia Bolgheri DOC "Il Vigore" (Artist Label) 2019
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Merlot, 4% Petit Verdot, 3% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: In their interpretation of the character of Ornellaia 2019 “Il Vigore”, the artists focused their project on the theme of metamorphosis, the cyclicity of nature and its transformation, as well as on the relationship between man and earth. These concepts are expressed in a project that evolves from the design conceived for the 750 ml label to the sculptures of the large 6L and 9L formats. Using all five senses, the artists invite us to reflect on the endless creative possibilities of nature. This concept is expressed by the sense of touch in the design created for the labels of the Double Magnums (3L), with the relief created using tiny grains of earth from the Ornellaia vineyards, expressing the direct link between man and nature through tactile sensation. The Salmanazar represents the final evolution of this process, where the bottle seems to give birth to creatures and floral elements with voluptuous shapes. Lastly, the video introduces movement and sound to represent a further phase of this transformation combining art, life and nature.

name: Baron d’Estours  AOC Saint-Estèphe
desc_en_short: This is the second label from the Cru Bourgeous Chateau d'Estours in St. Estephe, Bordeaux. Made with a blend of Cabernet Sauvignon, Mrelot and Cabernet Franc grapes, this bottle showcases the deep yet approachable style of Bordeaux red.

name: Chateau de L'Hospital  AOC Graves Rouge (Organic)
desc_en_short: Complex cuvée made up primarily of Merlot with minor amounts of Cabernet Sauvignon, Petit Verdot, and Malbec. The nose is seductive of roasted cocoa and mocha, as well as capsicum, blueberry juice, and rosehip. Delicate sweetness on the palate, textured with fine-grained tannin, and with good length.

name: Domaine Lafage  Authentique Cotes Du Roussillon
desc_en_short: 50% Carignan, 40% Syrah, 10% Grenache, the blend gives a perfectly structured wine. Fresh of strawberry gives way to an ample and balanced mouth, finely spiced, endowed with fine tannins.

name: Grand Bateau AOC Bordeaux Merlot Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Vinified by matching traditional winemaking with modern techniques, this wine is expressive of ripe red fruits with touches of spice and new oak that is harmonious and seductive.

name: La Pleiade Heathcote Shiraz
desc_en_short: Intense bouquet of fresh blackberries, liquorice and black cherries which are followed by some black plum, vanillin cedar, earthy dried herb notes and pepper. Rich blackberry and liquorice fruits have an opulent and expansive feel over a back drop of scorched earth, dried herbs, vanillin cedar and spicy leather. Ripe chewy tannins provide a robust framework. Excellent concentration and power with a long sturdy finish.

name: Loredan Gasparini  Cabernet Sauvignon Montello e Colli Asolani
desc_en_short: Fruit compote, spices and tobacco skilfully plays with your sense of smell. Subsequently, outstanding nuances of black cherry, black plum and black pepper will resolutely and consciously convince your senses of taste. A strong body and dominant acidity result in the fruity red wine, which, balanced with fine tannins in the mouth, shows a lot of character and class.

name: Ph. Bouchard & C AOC Cotes Du Rhone
desc_en_short: Earthy aromas of violets, stony garrigue and saddle leather. Pretty complex for what it is. On the other hand, palate showed a light texture, good acidity and a decent structure with a nice persistence.

name: Poderi Dal Nespoli  Prugneto Romagna DOC Sangiovese Superiore
desc_en_short: This historic estate, almost a century old, proudly ascended to the Top 5 Emilia-Romagna properties as listed by Decanter, a prestigious British publication. Known for its Sangioveses, Poderi dal Nespoli signs a Prugneto that honours this reputation quite well. Notes of ripe fruits and a charming intensity make this a fine pairing for grilled fare.

name: San Simone  Prestige Merlot Friuli DOC Grave
desc_en_short: The Merlot Friuli Grave Doc is a red wine that certainly draws an essential part of its quality from the particular soil in which it is grown. In the western area of the Doc Grave, in the municipality of Azzano Decimo, characterized by a soil with an important geomorphological history, of alluvial origin, calcareous, rich in minerals and affected by a clayey component veined with sandy sediments. This extraordinary start-value is followed by meticulous processing, which leads this excellent grape to become a wine, with a typical ruby red color, which certainly cannot be forgotten once tasted. If the harmonic delicacy placidly caresses the palate during the sip, the pleasantly acidic connotation of Merlot – Friuli Grave Doc allows the latter to release a significant aromatic persistence on the palate.

name: Tournon  Victoria Shiraz
desc_en_short:
A Shiraz that’s coming from the cooler sites in
Victoria, making a wine that is balanced between
fruit and spice flavors.

name: Vetrere  Kemelios Salento Rosso IGP
wine_color: Deep red color with violet hues.
desc_en_short: Kemelios is a benchmark Negroamaro from Salento, crafted by Puglia's Vetrere estate, offering a richly textured palate of morello cherry, sweet spice, and Mediterranean herbs underpinned by silky tannins and a long, balsamic finish.

name: Pa Road  Marlborough Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Pa Road brings Marlborough's cool-climate elegance to Pinot Noir, delivering a silky, light-bodied red brimming with red berry fruit, gentle earthy depth, and the fine-boned freshness that has made New Zealand's most celebrated white-wine region an increasingly exciting source for Burgundy's noble grape.

name: Dame de Bouard  Montagne Saint-Emilion
style: Merlot, 30% Cabernet Franc And 10% Cabernet Sauvignon.
desc_en_short: The second wine from Chateau Clos de Bouard, Dame de Bouard, is a wine that is easy to drink but not lacking subtlety. The weather for the 2016 vintage - a remarkable year-plays a large hand in the expression of the quality of the plots selected for this second wine. The plots of land are mostly Cabernet Sauvignon, which gives the wine its body. Stunning for a second wine.

name: Tenuta dell'Ornellaia  Ornellaia Vendemmia d'Artista Solare 2017
wine_color: he intense and dark colour heralds a wine of beautiful
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 10% Petit Verdot And 9% Cabernet Franc.
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
For this 2017 Ornellaia Artist Series Label the artist Tomas Saraceno invites us to reflect on the impact of our actions on the planet as he interprets the character “Solare” (radiant). For this twelfth edition of the project Vendemmia d’Artista he has created a work of art for the estate and designed a label that expresses the vintage character.

Special Labels

As with every edition, the artist Tomás Saraceno has created a collection of large formats: 100 Double Magnums (3L), 10 Imperials (6L), and a unique Salmanazar (9L). Tomás Saraceno has also designed the special label for the 0.750 format: a single bottle with artist’s label in each case of Ornellaia 2017. This is the central theme of this project where the interaction between man and the artwork generates an immediate connection with the entangled web of relations that extend across micro and macro scales, all the way to the sun. Through the act of touch, he invites us to poetically and collectively rethink the way we inhabit the world; this interdisciplinary artistic endeavour propels our common imaginary beyond its own individuality. The Salmanazar is an evolution of the concept. Reminiscent of an atomic structure, the glass spheres of PNEUMA 4.21×105 compose also magnificent cloud-like formations, of perhaps a floating city one whose size and shape is never fixed, and which displaces our conventional notions of boundaries and territories. The floating sculpture is reminiscent of forms, that as Saraceno imagines, might be able to float, filled only with sun warming, free from fossil fuels. The sculpture thereby takes inspiration from the reciprocal alliance drawn between the sun and living systems inhabited by humans and non-humans, in an invitation to a practice of care and renewed attention to the planet’s most important source of energy.

name: Penfolds  Bin 2 Twin Pack with Wine Opener
desc_en_short:
The original Bin 2 was a traditional Australian Burgundy style a generous, medium-bodied wine based on shiraz shot with the aromatics and muscular strength or Mataro (Mourvedre)

In the Pack

2 X Penfolds Bin 2
1 X Penfolds Wine Opener

name: Masseria Borgo Dei Trulli Salice Salentino DOP (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Blackcurrants, vanilla and chocolate aroma. Velvety, elegant and complex; Well-balanced, persistent finish.

name: E'Got  Merlot Sangiovese (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Intense bouquet, vinous, delicate scent with violet sensations. Harmonic taste, rightly tannic, with Harmonic taste & rightly tannic. Pairing with roasted and grilled meats.

name: Kobe Wine  Extra Red (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
The strong astringency and body of Cabernet Sauvignon and the soft astringency and gorgeous aroma of Merlot are beautifully harmonized and complex. Features a graceful harmony of the gorgeous aroma of Merlot and the body of
Cabernet Sauvignon.

name: Bodegas Valduero  Tierra Alta En 2 Maderas
desc_en_short: Intense, vivid, high-layer garnet. With fruity, balsamic and spicy aromas with details of cumin, cloves and nutmeg. A very well structured wine, friendly and with nerve in the mouth. It says goodbye with an important aftertaste.

name: Valtravieso  Finca Santa Maria
wine_color: Ruby red color with violet tones.
desc_en_short: Ruby red color with violet tones. Aromas of red berries and violet floral overtones. Pleasant on the palate with great texture, volume and melted tannin. A wine with good length and a spicy aftertaste.

name: Penfolds  Bin 600 California Collection Cabernet Shiraz
desc_en_short: Bin 600 is intrinsically linked to Penfolds beginning in California, a narrative that now spans three decades. In 1998, Penfolds imported a heritage selection of vine cuttings from South Australia’s esteemed Kalimna and Magill Estate vineyards and planted them in Californian soil. The original name of the Camatta Hills vineyard was called Creston “600” Ranch, a special place in the Penfolds California timeline for it serves as a reference point to the start of our American journey.

name: Le Clos du Serres  Sainte-Pauline Terrasses du Larzac
wine_color: Dark ruby, purple reflections, delicate bright rim.
desc_en_short: Dark ruby, purple reflections, delicate bright rim. Youthful, delicately reductive bouquet, fine herbal savouriness, dark berry fruit, a hint of cherries, mineral touch. Medium body, fine cherries, ripe tannins, fresh style, a touch of fruit extract on the finish, strawberries in the salty aftertaste, good development potential.

name: Le Clos du Serres  Saint-Jean Terrasses du Larzac
desc_en_short: This wine is ruby red color. Its freshness and its notes of red berries are its signature. The mouth is supple, greedy, on a final of fresh cherry, spices.

name: Santa Ana  Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve
wine_color: Deep ruby red with violet highlights.
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Cabernet Sauvignon Reserve has a deep ruby red with violet highlights. Tinged with fruity aromas reminiscent of red and black currant, with touches of green peppercorn and a mi of spices. Well-balanced and round in the mouth, with ripe tannins and a lingering finish.

name: 9 Lives Reserve Epic Merlot
desc_en_short: A momentous feeling of epicness is here! drink in glory with 9 Lives merlot, with ripe red fruit aroma and spicy white pepper notes. A ruby red wine with a medium body, elegant tannins and long, fruity finish.

name: Alto Las Rocas Tempranillo Syrah
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short: It's color is deep ruby red, which turns garnet red over time. Its aroma has woody aromas and shades of wild berries, its taste is licorice and ripe red fruits. Easy-drinking, balanced wine, with medium persistence and a strong fruity

name: Bertani  Secco Vintage IGT
desc_en_short: A ruby-red colour with garnet highlights and a richly aromatic nose, with intense notes of fruit jam and spices.

name: Pessac-Leognan Grand Vi Gravesn De 2019
desc_en_short: Open nose, full of peppery and  fruity spices, reminiscent of Cabernet Sauvignon.Very beautiful shiny appearance, bordeaux. On the palate, roundness .a nice fruity, fresh and very pure finish.

name: Chateau Grand Pey Lescours Saint-Emilion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: The wine is dark purple, red in the glass with a nose full of ripe plum and prune notes, hints of cedar wood, spice. The palate is round, fleshy with flavours of bramble and plum gentle tannins.

name: Chateau Lady Laroze  Saint-Emilion Grand Cru 2015
desc_en_short: Château Lady Laroze Saint-Émilion Grand Cru 2015 is a graceful Right Bank Bordeaux built on Merlot-led softness, offering fresh red berry fruit, gentle herbal notes, and a smooth, harmonious palate with beautifully integrated dusty tannins.

name: Chateau Chapelle de Potensac Médoc
desc_en_short: An attractive nose with red fruit and an array of red flowers that lead to a palate that has red fruit at its core and a fresh, attractive set of polished, vibrant tannins. Fresh finish ( JS.)

name: Chateau Serilhan Saint-Estephe 2015
desc_en_short: A classic Saint-Estèphe from Château Sérilhan, the 2015 vintage delivers firm, silky tannins with blackberry, blackcurrant, and cedar aromas — a structured, food-friendly Bordeaux red with genuine Left Bank character at an accessible price.

name: Naudin Père & Fils  Gevrey - Chambertin
desc_en_short: Its robe is characterised by its deep garnet hue color. The aromatic expression of its nose is very revealing of the great village of the Côte de Nuits. The animal notes are balanced with the finesse of this wine. It opens  quickly on rich melted tannins, a very ripe fruit, spices and a background of liquorice.

name: Remy Ferbras Plan De Dieu Cotes Du Rhone Villages
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ
desc_en_short: A deep garnet color with deep purple hints. An explosive bouquet of ripe and cooked fruits with notes of fig. The mouth is ample and dense with soft rounded tannins.

name: Duckhorn  Decoy Limited Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Elegantly structured and impeccably balanced, this gorgeous Cabernet Sauvignon displays voluptuous dark fruit aromas of blackberry and black cherry, with hints of lavender and rustic savory spice. The rich berry notes are echoed on the palate, where silky, fine-grained tannins and enlivening acidity carry the flavors to a lush, lingering finish.

name: Duckhorn  Decoy Limited Red Wine
style: Merlot, 15% Cabernet Sauvignon, 14% Malbec, 7% Petite Verdot, 6% Zinfandel
desc_en_short: A plush, full-bodied Napa and Sonoma Coast red blend anchored by silky Merlot, the Duckhorn Decoy Limited delivers layers of cassis, black raspberry, and sweet Rainier cherry framed by rich tannins and warm French oak spice — a luxurious expression from one of California's most storied wine families.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Nizza Cipressi DOCG
desc_en_short: Michele Chiarlo Nizza Cipressi Barbera is a bright ruby red color. Surprising in its clarity and elegance with hints of violet, blackberries, raspberries, and spicy sweet notes. Full, well-structured, harmonious; an impressive wine with its fresh softness and final savory and round flavor.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Langhe Il Principe DOC
desc_en_short: The Nebbiolo for Il Principe come from vineyards in Barbaresco and Vezza d’Alba in the hillsides of the Roero area. The soil of Barbaresco is bluish-grey calcareous-clay marl that is poor in organic substances but rich in manganese and potassium. The Roero vineyards have loose sandy soil. Following fermentation, the Nebbiolo is left to refine in large vats for a year. Il Principe showcases typical varietal flavors and characteristics, as well as the influence of the Roero terroir. This classic and pleasant Nebbiolo has excellent character and is suited to medium aging.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Barbaresco Asili DOCG
desc_en_short: Asili is a prestigious and historic Geographical Indication of the Barbaresco DOCG, a designation that limits vinification to four municipal districts in Langhe, including Alba, Barbaresco, Neive and Treiso. A terroir known for elegance, the vineyard turns 360° around the eponymous hamlet. The soil is calceareous marl and has a bluish color due to the high content of magnesium and calcium. The vines are thinned of excess bunches at the end of summer, leaving 5-6 bunches per vine on average. Hand harvested grapes are fermented on the skins in oak vats and then aged for 18 months in average sized oak casks before refinement in the bottle.

name: Michele Chiarlo  Barbaresco Faset DOCG
desc_en_short: Garnet in color, this aristocratic wine offers notes of small red fruits, dried rose petals, and fine spices with an elegant mineral touch. A well-structured and elegant wine with fine tannins

name: Jeff Carrel  Grenache Under My Skin
desc_en_short: Jeff Carrel's 'Under My Skin' is a deeply concentrated Grenache that pours like purple ink, delivering a seductive cream of dark fruits layered with spice, and finishing with a chewy, intensely flavoured grip that lingers long on the palate.

name: Jeff Carrel  Un Jour Je Serai Une Icone Syrah
wine_color: A deep dark colour to charm.
desc_en_short: A deep dark colour to charm. Captivating aromas to seduce. Velvety taste to nourish. cherries with some dark berries, the spices a bit weak. Good juice, good tanins.

name: Promis Qous  Red Wine California
style: Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon, Grenache, Petite Sirah
desc_en_short: Show off your promiscuous side with PromisQous Red. It is a red blend with Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Zinfindale, Serah, and varietal reds. Ripe red fruits and berries make PromisQous Red a sweet and full bodied drink. Try it at your next grill or cook out.

name: Maison Bouey  Lestruelle (Bordeaux AOC)
desc_en_short: Maison Bouey's Lestruelle is a richly expressive Bordeaux AOC red, blending 90% Merlot with 10% Cabernet Sauvignon to deliver an intense nose of blackberries and blackcurrant, a fleshy, gourmet palate, and satisfying complexity at an accessible price.

name: Maison Bouey  Cheval de Lune (Bordeaux AOC)
desc_en_short: Maison Bouey Cheval De Lune is a medium-bodied wine with a deep ruby color. On the nose, it has aromas of black cherry, blackberry, and cassis, along with hints of vanilla and spice. On the palate, the wine is rich and fruity, with flavors of black cherry, plum, and a touch of chocolate. The tannins are firm but well-integrated, giving the wine a smooth and velvety mouthfeel.

name: F. Jeantet  Cotes du Rhone Villages "Plan De Dieu"
desc_en_short: This wine praised by the press is a real basket of juicy red fruit, the bouquet unveils warm spice and liquorice nuances in an intense flavour. Beautiful depth on the palate is balanced with great freshness for a palatable and light juice, offering delicious, persistent aromas of tapenade and liquorice.

name: Cartlidge & Browne  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red color. Earthy, raspberry like aromas, nondescript ripe fruit and herb flavors The palate of rounded texture make this a serviceable house wine.

name: Cartlidge & Browne  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: A classic California Cabernet Sauvignon from Cartlidge & Browne, delivering aromas of black currant, cherry, cedar, and licorice with plush tannins and a smooth, satisfying finish — a versatile red built for the grill.

name: Rib Shack  Vintage Blend Red
desc_en_short: A bold South African blend of Pinotage and Shiraz built for the barbecue, delivering aromas of chocolate and smoke over a core of dark berry fruit, with a full, round palate softened by sweet, approachable tannins.

name: Aromo  Barrel Selection The Blend
desc_en_short: After a careful selection of grapes, Aromo Barrel Selection was born in the heart of our vineyards in the Maule Valley. Deep ruby red color with blue reflects and intense aromas of wild fruits and spices in harmony with notes of tobacco, smoke and vanilla are the result of its peaceful maturing in French oak barrels.

name: Chateau Gloria  Esprit de Gloria Saint-Julien
wine_color: Dark cherries and plums explode in the glass
desc_en_short: A wonderful, harmoni- ous bouquet of copious blackber- ry, briary, cedar and tabacco notes that just feels so effortless. The very harmonious palate offers pure black fruit laced with graphite. Displaying moderate weight and fine acidity, and quite linear and focused on the finish.

name: Penfolds  Bin 149 Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Penfolds Bin 149 Cabernet Sauvignon seeks out Northern Hemisphere excellence via meticulous vineyard and block selection, reinforced by flagship-worthy South Australian cabernet sauvignon.

name: Penfolds  Quantum Bin 98 Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Penfolds Quantum Bin 98 is the culmination of a 20-year collaboration between Northern and Southern hemispheres. The flagship wine of our California Collection, Quantum is a true wine of the world, unbound by country, vine, or time. A powerful expression of the Penfolds blending style, Quantum is made with carefully selected grapes sought out for their intense flavor and well-structured tannins. The result is a wine that defies convention and expectation, offering equal parts grace and complexity.

name: Frescobaldi  Terre More Maremma Cabernet DOC (Cabernet Sauvignon)
wine_color: A beautifully intense and radiant ruby-red colour.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon And Cabernet Franc Grapes, With Small Quantities Of Merlot And Syrah
desc_en_short: A beautifully intense and radiant ruby-red colour. The nose reveals intense fruity notes of berries and cherry, as well as light hints of plum. After these, Mediterranean hints and delicate tertiary notes of vanilla and lightly toasted coffee emerge. The tannins are velvety-smooth. It is delightfully fresh and soft when tasted. The finish is long and persistent.

name: Chateau La Grave Figeac Saint-Emilion 2019
desc_en_short: Aged for 15 months in new oak barrels ,vats, amphorae and15 hectolitre tuns. This wine is one that needs to be decanted and left to breathe for 1hr30 – 2 hours before drinking, as it undergoes a special bottling process without oxygen. With its deep red colour, this wine sets itself out from the crowd by its lingering aromas and taste on the palate; round and supple, rich and creamy.

name: Chateau Soudars Haut-Medoc 2018
wine_color: Its presentation is very pleasing cherry color.
desc_en_short: Soudars 2018 is a pleasing, airy wine. Its presentation is very pleasing cherry color and an expressive nose with hints of redcurrant and raspberry. raspberry. The palate is delicate, with plenty of roundness and a smooth tannic structure. On the finish, greedy, sapid fruity notes, a real pleasure throughout the tasting. throughout the tasting.

name: Chateau Haute Brande Bordeaux 2018
wine_color: Ruby red coloured with coppery reflections.
desc_en_short: Ruby red coloured with coppery reflections. On the nose, spicy and wild aromas are present. On the palate, the wine shows a good structure with soft tannins. A character wine that expresses a fresh attack with notes of red fruit.

name: Pico Maccario  Barbera d'Asti Lavignone (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Barbera d’Asti Lavignone by Pico Maccario is a complex and structured red wine. During the years, it became one of the most important and prestigious wines of the cellar. It is produced with 100% Barbera grapes, cultivated on hills full of minerals, due to the ancient presence of lakes.

name: Pico Maccario  Tre Roveri Nizza DOCG (Barbera d'Asti Superiore) (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Pico Maccario's flagship Barbera, sourced from the prized Vignone cru in Mombaruzzo, delivers a sumptuously layered Nizza DOCG with ripe dark fruit, vanilla, and a silky, long-lingering finish — a benchmark expression of Piedmont's most beloved red grape.

name: Pico Maccario  Barbaresco DOCG (750 ml)
desc_en_short: This Barbaresco DOCG from the Piedmontese winery Pico Maccario comes from 100% Nebbiolo grapes from the hills located at 250-260 m usl, on soils of calcareous-sandy origin. The bunches collected during the harvest are carefully selected and then subjected to the crushing-destemming phase, then maceration for a duration of at least 15 days. The final phase of aging requires the stay in Slavonian oak barrels of 25 hl and 35 hl for about 10 months with further 12 months in the bottle.

name: Pico Maccario  Barolo (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Ruby with garnet reflections. Intense and precise, with aromas of vanilla, dark cherry, blackberry, spices, and rose. Dry, velvety, and smooth on the palate with a weight, power, and boldness that carries through to a persistent finish.

name: Fattoria Mantellassi  Querciolaia Maremma Alicante
desc_en_short:
Alicante was one of the first grape varieties planted in the Fattoria Mantellassi. Found throughout Spain, where it is known as Granaxa, and in France as Grénage, this variety has many biotypes.
It probably arrived in the Magliano in Toscana and Scansano hillsides during the Spanish occupation in 1600. First produced in 1977, Querciolaia is a wine with a long cellar life and excellent organoleptic characteristics. It is widely appreciated for its composite bouquet and its warm, unfussy, smooth and velvety palate.

name: Basilisco Teodosio Aglianico del Vulture DOC 2015
desc_en_short: From the volcanic slopes of Monte Vulture in Basilicata, Basilisco's Teodosio Aglianico del Vulture DOC is a 100% organic expression of one of southern Italy's most noble red grapes — brooding, mineral-driven, and built for the table.

name: Chateau Paloumey  Haut Medoc 2015
desc_en_short: From a grand estate, whose owners also have vines in Margaux and Moulis, this wine is well proportioned and dense. Rich tannins and concentration are just part of what will become a generous, full wine. With great black-currant fruit and acidity to match, this structured wine will need to age. Drink from 2024,92 Points Wine Enthusiast

name: Alexander Valley  Vineyards Homestead Red Blend
style: Merlot, 32% Zinfandel, 8% Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Grenache, 6% Mourvedre, 3% Syrah
desc_en_short: This dark purple wine has complex aromas of black cherry, spice, plum, cassis, blueberry, oak and vanilla. This is a medium bodied wine with spicy flavors of berry, plum, cherry, oak and vanilla. This is a lush, juicy wine with nice balance and a long structured finish.

name: Cakebread  Merlot
desc_en_short: Deep ruby in color, the Merlot opens with a medley of ripe fruit flavors including plum, blackberry, and black cherry. A symphony of additional notes emerge including violet, crushed stone, and vanilla. Across the palate, the wine is velvety and fullbodied with concentrated and rich flavors of blackberry and plum. Bright acidity supports the wine, showcasingnotes of minerality, herbs, and florals. Fine, persistent tannins drive the long black cherry finish of this deeply flavorful and elegant wine.

name: Cakebread  Two Creeks Vineyard Anderson Valley Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Cakebread's Two Creeks Vineyard Pinot Noir draws from cool-climate Anderson Valley estate blocks to deliver bright red cherry, wild strawberry, and baking spice complexity, crafted with night-harvest freshness, gentle fermentation, and ten months in French oak.

name: Domaine de Pellehaut  Harmonie De Gascogne Rouge
desc_en_short: With a ruby ​​red color, this wine with a nose of black fruits and violets, offers us a voluptuous mouth, with notes of perfectly ripe red fruits, and supple tannins. With a very finesse structure, it will go wonderfully with red meat.

name: Cakebread  Benchland Select Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Benchland Select is a classic Napa Valley cabernet sauvignon expression of dark fruit, roundness, texture and a lingering finish. Aromas of dark blackberry, boysenberry and mocha lead onto the palate, where concentrated flavors of ripe blackberry and fig dance with firm tannins for a rich blackberry and dark chocolate finish. Pair with hearty stews, steaks on the grill, or fire-roasted vegetables.

name: Cakebread  Dancing Bear Ranch Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Sourced from Cakebread's estate Dancing Bear Ranch on the rugged volcanic slopes of Howell Mountain, this powerful Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon is defined by intense mountain fruit concentration, iron-rich soils, and 22 months in predominantly new French oak — a benchmark expression of high-altitude Napa winemaking.

name: Cakebread  Bakestone Cellars Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: From legendary Californian producer Cakebread, comes their second label, Bakestone Cellars. A pair of wines offering their trademark freshness, concentration and complexity from select premier vineyards around Northern California.

name: Georges Duboeuf  Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2023
desc_en_short: Georges Duboeuf Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2023 is the world's most celebrated young wine — a vibrant, fruit-bursting Gamay released just weeks after harvest, brimming with fresh raspberry, cherry, and floral charm that makes every pour feel like a global celebration.

name: Georges Duboeuf  Beaujolais Nouveau 2023
wine_color: brilliant garnet color with purple reflections.
desc_en_short: Beaujolais Nouveau is a celebration of the first wine of the harvest and a regional French tradition that goes back generations that Georges Duboeuf was the first to share with American wine drinkers. This fresh and fruity wine is bottled only a few weeks after harvest and is meant to be enjoyed immediately upon release. Beaujolais Nouveau is the most eagerly anticipated wine event of the year and best enjoyed in the company of friends, family, and loved ones.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2023
wine_color: Dark red colour, deep, with bluish tints.
desc_en_short: Joseph Drouhin's Beaujolais Villages Nouveau 2023 bursts with fresh blackberry, blueberry, and a hint of liquorice — a vibrant, lightly structured Gamay made to celebrate the new harvest, best enjoyed young, lively, and slightly chilled.

name: Plump Harvest  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Complex aroma of blackcurrant, anise, cracked pepper, dried herbs with
subtle hints of earthy notes. A wine full of densely layered, mouth filling
flavours of baking spice, dark chocolate, plums and rhubarb enveloped
in a firm yet inviting tannin structure. The meticulous use of French oak
complements the fruit derived flavours and leads to an everlasting finish.

name: The Noble Tread  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Lifted aromas of vanilla and spicy oak are exhibited in this
Cabernet Sauvignon. Deep flavours of blackcurrant and mulberry fruit, followed
by hints of nutmeg, lingering chocolate oak and balanced tannin, lead to an
elegant finish. Beautifully paired with slow roasted lamb or rich duck dishes.

name: Trinity Reserve  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
A medium-bodied red with a savoury elegance and structure displaying rich
characters of dark red berries, blackcurrant and mulberry fruit with aromatic
hints of mint and violets. The palate lingers with cassis fruit and chocolate.

name: The Mathematician  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
The Mathematician is a result of carefully placing natural variables and wine-making constants
in the formula of making wine. 2016 was a relatively dry season with consistent temperatures from
January onwards which allowed for a slow but ideal ripening season. The fruit was handpicked
