once the grapes reached optimum flavour and tannin ripeness with perfect balance of sugars and
natural acidity. Fermentation lasted twelve-days, during which hand plunging was carried out
four times a day. A 30-day post ferment maceration was carried out to achieve a level of tannin
structure for the maturation phase of 24 months which was carried out in 100% new French oak.

name: Ace Of Cups  Merlot
desc_en_short:
Rich aroma of black cherry and cassis with hint of vanillin.
Flavours of dark chocolate and plums are in abundance on the palate. The finish
is smooth and long lasting. Pair with slow cooked stews or mushroom risotto.

name: Fat Tree  Merlot
desc_en_short: Fat Tree Merlot is an easygoing, approachable red from South Eastern Australia, delivering soft, fruit-forward charm that's perfect for relaxed everyday drinking — the kind of bottle you reach for when good company and good times are all that matter.

name: The Observatory  Shiraz
desc_en_short:
Lifted aromas of ripe red currants, cherries, spice and white pepper are evident on
the nose. Flavours of cedar, plum and elegant oak with silky texture are carried
by the solid tannin structure on the palate. The finish is long and lingering

name: Dashing Jack  Shiraz
desc_en_short: A bold Barossa Valley Shiraz from Dashing Jack, delivering rich blackberry, chocolate, and cedar aromas with a juicy, full palate, firm tannins, and a lingering finish underpinned by subtle French oak.

name: The Bucks  Shiraz
desc_en_short: A approachable Barossa Valley Shiraz delivering classic dark fruit character — ripe cherry, plum, and blackberry layered with vanilla sweetness and gentle spice, finishing long with smooth, polished tannins. An everyday red that punches well above its price point.

name: Maddox Flat  Shiraz
desc_en_short: A serious Barossa Valley Shiraz built for the long haul — fruit handpicked at peak ripeness, then given 30 days of post-ferment maceration and 24 months in French oak to develop the deep, structured character this celebrated region does best.

name: Distinction Point  Shiraz
desc_en_short:
Distinction Point was made from fruit carefully selected from smaller sections of our premium
low yielding vineyards. Adequate winter rainfall, relatively dry conditions during flowering and
bunch set gave good start to the vines. Warm weather from January onwards till harvest formed
perfect conditions for the grapes to ripen at an ideal pace. The grapes were hand-picked at optimum
flavour ripeness and fermented in open vats for 10 days. The ferment was hand-plunged 4 times a
day, followed by maceration up to 20 days to build structure. The wine was matured in French oak
barrels for 24 months. This wine is typical of the region, depicting intense varietal character.

name: Red Beast  Shiraz
desc_en_short:
A classic Barossa Valley Shiraz in every way with deep crimson hue featuring
sweet blueberry, cassis, blackberry flavours and solid French oak characters.
Impressive firm structure and balance with complex spicy oak flavours on the finish.
It will develop further and reward with careful cellaring for the next 5 years.

name: Rickety Jims  Shiraz
desc_en_short:
This classy deep red wine fills the glass with aromas reminiscent of rich red berries
and dark bitter chocolate. Dark plums enhanced with cassis, anise and pepper
mingle on the Full-bodied palate. Creamy tannins and fresh acidity leads to an
everlasting finish. Drink this premium drop now or cellar it up to 5 years.

name: Calix  Shiraz
desc_en_short:
Dark red with purple hue. This robust McLaren Vale Shiraz displays blackberries,
chocolate and cedar notes on the nose. The palate is full and juicy with firm tannins
and long finish. Pair with slow cooked lamb shoulder or spaghetti bolognese.

name: Harris & Son  Shiraz
wine_color: This classy deep red wine fills the glass
desc_en_short:
This classy deep red wine fills the glass with aromas reminiscent of rich red berries
and dark bitter chocolate. Dark plums enhanced with cassis, anise and pepper
mingle on the Full-bodied palate. Creamy tannins and fresh acidity leads to an
everlasting finish. Drink this premium drop now or cellar it up to 5 years.

name: Angelique  Shiraz
desc_en_short:
Pronounced aromas of mocha, blackberry and toasty oak.
Concentrated flavours of black cherry with a subtle hint of baking spice lead
to the lingering, full and smooth finish. Best when served with rich foods
such as tomato based pastas, roast beef or a porcini mushroom risotto.

name: The Blind Pig  Shiraz
wine_color: This classy deep red wine fills the glass
desc_en_short:
This classy deep red wine fills the glass with aromas reminiscent of rich red berries
and dark bitter chocolate. Dark plums enhanced with cassis, anise and pepper mingle
on the medium to Full-bodied palate. Soft tannins and complex acidity lead to an
overall perception of a smooth, rich red wine, with a nice persistence of flavour.

name: Corte Rugolin  Amarone Monte Danieli DOCG
desc_en_short: This Amarone Riserva, the highlight of the Corte Rugolin range, is obtained from a selection of the best grapes in a small vineyard with an excellent solar exposure. The grapes are processed using the 'appassimento' method for approximately three months, producing a garnet-red wine with an intense bouquet of cooked fruit, dried plums, cherries macerated in alcohol, tobacco and various spices, including ginger. Uncork a few hours before drinking and serve at 18-20°C.

name: Tedeschi  La Fabriseria Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Riserva 2015
desc_en_short: "The Tedeschi family's top wine is their 2015 Amarone della Valpolicella Classico Riserva la Fabriseria. The wine is a careful blend of 40% Corvina, 40% Corvinone, 15% Rondinella and 5% Oseleta, all aged in oak for 48 months. The appassimento process has produced a powerful and muscular wine that opens with thick layers of black fruits, plums, dried cherries, spices, mesquite smoke, iron and sweet rum cake. With only 2,500 bottles made, this full-bodied blockbuster wine is a lesson in all the beautiful excesses that extreme Amarone has to offer." - WINE ADVOCATE

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mouton Cadet Vin Bio
desc_en_short: This red wine vintage is fruity, rounded and delicious. The nose is marked by an explosion of red fruits. After aeration, we note a charming nose of very ripe red and black fruits. On the palate, it is generous and with good complexity with the arrival of black fruit and sweet spice flavours that linger to give length and sensuality to the finish. Best served lightly chilled for the best tasting.

name: Toro De Piedra  Grand Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

This Cabernet Sauvignon is made with grapes from Finca Lolol "flat" area and give a full ruby ​​red colour. Dry and full in body with an Intense nose of strawberry, vanilla and fresh oak. On the palate this wine is round and well over, with vanilla, chocolate and liquorice flavours into a long finish.

name: Toro De Piedra  Grand Reserve Merlot
desc_en_short: Toro De Piedra Grand Reserve Merlot is a richly expressive Chilean red offering dark ruby depth, aromas of ripe strawberry, roasted red pepper, and chocolate, with a soft, well-structured palate and a juicy, satisfying finish.

name: Sichel  AOC Bordeaux Red
desc_en_short: Sirius has a dark colour with ruby tints.The nose, finely roasted, evokes warm scents of spices, dried figs, black berries and blackcurrant. The round palate, warm and powerful, translates well the attention to perfection. The material is rich and suave on the attack, accompanied by expressive fruit, on well-balanced and perfectly well-coated tannins which confer beautiful length to this wine. One can find with pleasure balance and freshness which are proof of the origin of this wine : a very fine Bordeaux.

name: Sirius  AOC Bordeaux Red by Maison Sichel
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

The dark color, with garnet highlights, is extended by an expressive nose with notes of perfectly ripe fruit, blackcurrant and blackberry, sweet spices and an elegant touch of lightly toasted wood. On the palate, the delicious tannins are coated in a fleshy and silky matter giving it balance and remarkable length. Certainly a proud ambassador of the Great Wines of Bordeaux

name: Sichel  Margaux
wine_color: Endowed with a beautiful intense ruby color
desc_en_short: Endowed with a beautiful intense ruby color, this Margaux delivers a pleasant bouquet of spicy notes and black fruits. In the mouth the wine is concentrated, generous without being capricious, very expressive, supported by high quality tannins which sign a persistent finish. An elegant, expressive Grand Vin of great distinction, the product of an exceptional terroir and crafted with care. A great match for a fine cut of grilled meat or a well-garnished cheese board, but whatever the case over any informal meal.

name: Bertinga  Toscana IGT
desc_en_short:
The mouth is powerful and tight. It is a vintage less sunny and therefore less broad but which does not lack
seriousness. The firm tannins guarantee the structure. The wine is straight and traceable, the tannins are soft on the
palate and tight until the finish. The aromas are floral and subtle, they evoke anise, bergamot, wild thyme.

name: Bertinga  Punta di Adine Rosso Tuscany IGT
wine_color: The color is an elegant and delicate garnet red.
desc_en_short: A pure, site-expressive Sangiovese from Bertinga, aged in concrete and large Austrian oak for 18 months, delivering mineral tension, dark fruit, and a firm chiselled structure that speaks unmistakably of Tuscan terroir.

name: Bertinga  Volta di Bertinga Tuscany IGT
desc_en_short: Powerful and dynamic on the palate supported by saline acidity. As the wine decants in the glass it shows refreshing floral flavors of violet, juniper wood and menthol. The power is very well balanced by the acidity that leads to a fresh and tasty finish with notes of liquorice.

name: Vintae  La Fosca del Priorat D.O.Q. Priorat
wine_color: Intense ruby red with deep edges.
style: Mainly Garnacha With Small Amounts Of Cariñena, Merlot And Cabernet Sauvignon.
desc_en_short: Intense ruby red with deep edges. Interesting bouquet where the Garnacha varietal characteristics are perfectly combine with mineral and oaky touch. Rich and tasty wine, with great balance, elegance and harmony. Right amount of acidity emphasizes its drinkability and leave pleasant aftertaste.

name: Seven Hills  Cabernet Sauvignon Walla Walla Valley
wine_color: This Cabernet has a striking Garnet color.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 7% Petit Verdot, 7% Malbec, 5% Syrah,  1% Carménère,1% Petite Syrah
desc_en_short:
This Cabernet has a striking Garnet color. Pronounced aromatics of red cherries, black raspberry, and black
tea, with hints of fresh herbs, cedar box, and earth. Medium plus body wine with lush texture, firm tannins,
and balanced acidity shows flavors of cherries, raspberry, dark chocolate, baking spice, and vanilla bean
with a touch of dried herbs. A classic Walla Walla Cabernet Sauvignon that makes your soul smile.

name: Double Canyon  Columbia Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Garnet in color, with pronounced aromas of black cherries dusted with cocoa powder and baking spices with hints of plums and dried earth. Medium body with flavors of black raspberries and currants supported by firm but elegant tannins that carry through the finish with lingering flavors of fruit leather. Drink now through 5 years.

name: Chateau Pichon  Longueville Baron 2017
desc_en_short: 96 points Wine Enthusiast - "This wine is both weighty and stylish. Its power comes from luscious black fruits that are juicy and powerful. Expect this wine to age well and drink from 2024."

name: Angove  Lost Farm Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: The vibrant purple with red hue hint immediately of the vibrancy of Lost Farm Pinot Noir. The nose is lifted, aromatic and full of cherries and red fruits leading to a palate of red berries, cherries, spice and deft oak. The delicate, silky tannin structure carries the wine through the mid palate giving a long seductive finish.

name: Borgogno  No Name Red (Nebbiolo)
wine_color: Ruby red color with purple highlights.
desc_en_short: Ruby red color with purple highlights. Ethereal, persistent with violet, rose, fresh fruits and spicy hints on the nose. A dry, harmonius, velvety, full-bodied wine, austere and generous wine.

name: Serra Ferdinandea  Rosso IGT
wine_color: Yellow color slightly tinged with sea green.
desc_en_short: Distant lands come together and complete one another. After his decade of experience in Sicily as Planeta’s oenologist, Florent Dumeau decided to blend two quite different but so very complementary varieties; This wine is all about its bouquet, a combination of fragrances and unusual scents. Wood is used masterfully to enhance the perfumes and prepare this white for happy aging.

name: Catena Zapata  Catena Adrianna Fortune Terrae Malbec
food_matching: Red Meat, Grilled Steak, Lamb, Hard Cheese, BBQ

name: Castello di Albola  Acciaola Toscana Red
desc_en_short: Acciaiolo is a sumptuous interpretation of the expressive power of the soils around the Castello di Albola. From a single vineyard of old vines, a rigorous selection of Cabernet Sauvignon grapes lends character and elegance, while a small portion of Sangiovese outlines the most authentic nuances. The name is a homage to the Acciaiuoli Family. The wine is a precious wine with a strong and graceful design, a soft and supple body, a seductive bouquet.

name: Altano  Tinto Reserva Douro Red DOC
desc_en_short: Deep, crimson colour. This Altano red reveals scented floral aromas and focused, fresh fruit. Simultaneously full and silky on the palate, well-defined red fruit flavours come to the fore, enveloped in soft, ripe tannins and spicy notes. Generous, well-structured and elegant.

name: Langmeil  Jackaman's Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Jackaman’s vineyard is home to Langmeil’s finest and rarest Cabernet Sauvignon, planted in the 1960s during the Cabernet revolution in the Barossa. This vineyard was lovingly tended by the colourful Barossan Arthur Jackaman, a World War II paratrooper, boxer and butcher who in retirement passed his small plot into Langmeil’s care.

name: Chateau Grand Lartigues St.Emilion Gran Cru AOC
desc_en_short: Deep red color. The Nose of black fruits with licorice notes is highlighted by subtle oak aromas. In the mouth, Silky, nice and refined. Well balanced with light tannins, this wine has a real personality and imposes its finesse and elegance.

name: Chateau Moulin de la Bridane Saint-Julien AOC
desc_en_short: Château Moulin de la Bridane has a bright robe which shows a good maturity and a nose with charming raspberry, flowers and spices aromas. The mouth has perfect round tannins, with a nice and balanced woody note, giving a feeling of fullness.

name: Chateau Du Grand Soussan Margaux AOC
desc_en_short: With its deep garnet red color with purple hints. This wine offers a charming bouquet of concentrated black fruits (blackberry, elderberry) combined with spicy notes (cedar, pepper). The round and silky texture shows a nice ripeness.

name: Chateau Saint-Yzans Médoc AOC
desc_en_short: Deep garnet color with violet hues. It reveals an explosive nose of ripe fruits with notes of blackberries and currants. The palate is greedy and fleshy for a complex wine.

name: Chateau Franc-Maillet Le Secret de Franc Maillet Pomerol AOC
desc_en_short: Deep garnet color with violet hues. Offers an expressive and charming nose, mixing ripe black fruits and sweet spices with a perfectly controlled woody taste. The mouth is dense and generous.

name: Caleo Nero d'Avola Sicilia DOC
desc_en_short: Intense red colour. The bouquet is slightly spicy and fruity with notes of blackberries, blueberries and mulberries. The finish is rounded and fruity with well integrated tannins

name: Pian delle Querce Rosso di Montalcino DOC
desc_en_short: Red ruby with violet tint. Berries including blueberries, blackberries and raspberries, over more subtle notes of wildflowers and sweet spices. On the palate the wine is elegant with well-balanced tannins, vibrant acidity and a smooth texture.

name: Vite Colte Dolcetto d'Alba "Roccabella" DOC
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red. Expansive and rich, with fruit laden aromas, especially of cherry. Dry, velvet textured multi layered flavours carry through to a pleasantly bitterish finish.

name: Bindi Surgadi I COLLI Classico Reserva DOCG
desc_en_short: Deep, intense red colour with violet highlights. Pleasant and fruity bouquet red Plum, Blackberry, Baking spices, Mesquite. Dry, and round on the palate. The finish is full-bodied with soft tannins and good acidity.

name: Castello Monaci  Artas Primitivo Salento IGT
desc_en_short: Artas has a bright and intense ruby ​​red color; well pronounced, complex and ethereal fragrance. On the nose it presents marked hints of wild berries in perfect harmony with sweet balsamic notes and aroma of roasted coffee. The flavor is full, warm, soft, very enveloping, with sweet and elegant tannins. Closes with a pleasant background of red fruit.

name: Henschke  The Wheelwright Shiraz, Eden Valley
desc_en_short: Medium garnet with crimson hues. Lifted aromas of red plum, red currant, blue and black berries, rose hip and black pepper, with notes of bay leaf, sage, crushed flowering herbs, anise and hints of cedar. The palate is rich and plush, deep and concentrated with layers of spicy red cherry and red currant, interwoven with anise and vanilla. Balanced acidity gives freshness and poise, finishing with elegant, velvety, fine-grained tannins for a long fruit-driven finish.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2002
wine_color: Deep purple color with black reflections
desc_en_short: Château Palmer's 2002 Margaux is a brooding, cellar-worthy Bordeaux earning 94 points from Wine Enthusiast, delivering layered aromatics of black currant, plum, menthol, and licorice across a dense, full-bodied frame built for the long haul.

name: Tarapaca  Etiqueta Negra Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Intense red in color with violet highlights
desc_en_short: A wine with aromas of raspberries and cherries that provide freshness, along with underlying notes of tobacco, plum and cassis. After aging for 18 months in French oak barrels, the wine acquires spicy notes of cloves, liquorice, red peppers and vanilla. On the palate it is tasty and balanced, with marked notes of cherry, blackberry and blackcurrant, which are typical of a wine which originates in sandy soil. The tannins are round and present due to the gravel and angular stones of the soil. The mineral soils of volcanic origin impart a long finish.

name: Tarapaca  Etiqueta Azul Red Blend
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Syrah, Petit Verdot, Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: This blend expresses the perfect combination of the climate and soil in the Tarapacá Estate. The aromas of raspberry and cherry from the Cabernet Sauvignon give freshness to the wine alongside its notes of tobacco, plum and cassis. The Syrah, which comes from an area near the Maipo River, presents aromas of cherry and blackberry, as well as floral notes and subtle hints of black olive. The Cabernet Sauvignon from the Mirador series adds some acidity thanks to its sandy soils that contain angular stones and gravel. Smooth and balanced, with a great finish thanks to its mineral soils of volcanic origin, the Syrah adds body and minerality. The Petit Verdot and the Cabernet Franc, which are in the Piedemonte series, add volume and maturity. Serve between 16-18ºC

name: Chateau La Croix Montlabert  St. Emilion Grand Cru
desc_en_short: This is so different to its big brother Château Montlabert – much less austere and more feminine. A blend of 80% Merlot and 20% Cabernet Franc, it has fine spice notes as well as gentle black fruit. So elegant and full of finesse – a real find.

name: Dark Knight  Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Dark Knight Pinot Noir effortlessly glows in shades of scarlet and ruby red, while offering plush essences of rich forest berries driven by underlying dark plum characters. A luxurious mouth feel can be expected with a velvety smooth tannin structure. Perfectly compliments Mediterranean foods. Enjoy at present or allow to develop for a few years.

name: Odd Neighbours  Shiraz
desc_en_short: Classic Shiraz in every way with a deep crimson hue featuring sweet blueberry, cassis, blackberry, and solid oak characters. Impressive firm tannin structure with complex spicy oak flavours on the finish. It will develop further and reward with careful cellaring for the next 5 years.

name: Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2000
brand: Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande
desc_en_short: 96 points Decanter - "Of all the 2000s tasted in the line-up, this was the one that was most evolved, with melted tannins and exotic saffron spice notes. It’s a beautiful wine, very classic Pauillac, full of tertiary hints of truffle, soft menthol and undergrowth - signatures of an older Bordeaux wine that is wonderful to drink now. It’s probably the most perfect of the five for cracking open over the next few years but may not have the staying power of the others. Interesting to note how much higher the pH is here (3.85) than Leoville (3.5) considering it’s practically next door. 10% Petit Verdot completes the blend.

name: Chateau Hosanna  Pomerol
desc_en_short:
Château Hosanna, a jewel-like vineyard of just 4.5 hectares, is located in the heart of Pomerol’s central plateau, adjacent to some of the most illustrious crus of the appellation: Château Lafleur to the north; Château Petrus to the east; Château La Fleur-Pétrus to the west; Vieux Château Certan to the south.

The vineyard of Château Hosanna has a long and rich history. Prior to its purchase by Ets. Jean-Pierre Moueix in 1999, Hosanna was known as Château Certan Giraud, considered one of the premier crus of Pomerol since the 1950’s. It was originally part of the de May family estate, who settled on Pomerol’s plateau in the 16th century and planted one of the appellation’s first vineyards there.

Only the highest plateau parcels of its previous incarnation were selected to form Château Hosanna. The vineyard enjoys a terroir of red gravel and clay on “crasse de fer” which is known for producing wines of great elegance, complexity, and power. Old Cabernet Franc vines, a significant portion of which date back to 1956, contribute a unique complexity to the cru.

A marriage of intensity, purity and balance, its silky touch has led some to describe Hosanna as the feminine counterpart to Trotanoy

name: Chateau La Violette  Pomerol
desc_en_short: Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, La Violette sails out of the glass with expressive scents of baked plums, blueberry preserves and blackberry pie plus suggestions of spice cake, chocolate box and powdered cinnamon. Medium to full-bodied, the palate delivers mouth-coating black fruits with a firm, fine-grained frame and long, fragrant finish. 2022 - 2042

name: Chateau L'Evangile  Pomerol 2018
desc_en_short: It is impossible not to mention the mildew problem, when we had been working so hard to build a viticulture without residues and with high environmental responsibility. Thanks to extremely meticulous work, our team was able to restore ideal conditions in the vineyard before ripening. The effect of the heat was even stronger here than on the other bank, with ripening blocked for some young vines at the end of summer. We were saved by the 25 mm of rain on 7 September. Our greatest pride in 2018, even if our heart is still beating for Merlot. The excellent quality of our Cabernet Franc.

name: Chateau Plince  Pomerol
desc_en_short: Deep garnet-purple colored, the 2019 Plince rolls out of the glass wearing a lot of woody/cedar scents, before offering up notes of baked plums, blackberry pie and stewed black cherries with wafts of chargrill and tilled soil in the background. Medium to full-bodied, the palate has appealing freshness and nice, ripe grape tannins with a chewy component from the obvious wood, finishing savory.

name: Chateau Trotanoy  Pomerol 2017
wine_color: Medium to deep garnet-purple in color.
desc_en_short:
Located in the Pomerol appellation, Trotanoy vineyard spread on 7.20 hectares. 

The soil at the highest point of exposure contains a good proportion of gravel, becoming progressively more dominated by clay as the elevation declines.
Under this clay is a subsoil of red gravel and an impermeable layer of hard, iron-rich soil known as “crasse de fer.” This soil diversity brings power, depth and complexity to the wine. 

Grape varieties are composed of 90% Merlot and 10% Cabernet Franc.

name: Chateau Gracia  Saint-Emilion
desc_en_short: Château Gracia is located in Saint-Émilion. This winery has produced some of the most highly regarded wines from Bordeaux, such as the 2010 Château Gracia, which has received very high scores from international reviewers. With just five hectares of land, Château Gracia is as small-scale as it is successful, proof that quality in the wine world is not measured by size.

name: Chateau Grand Mayne  Saint-Emilion
desc_en_short: Château Grand Mayne is a great vessel in a sea of vines in the heart of the Saint-Émilion appellation. Established in the 15th century, the property did not produce wine until the 17th century. In the 18th century, the Laveau family elevated the vineyard and estate to the top of the appellation. In 1934, the Nony family took over the wine estate and undertook major renovations. Today, the Nony family, still at the helm of Château Grand Mayne continues to produce spectacular Bordeaux wines.

name: Chateau Magrez Fombrauge  Saint-Emilion
wine_color: A very attractive deep colour. A superb dark red hue with purple tones.
desc_en_short: A very attractive deep colour. A superb dark red hue with purple tones. ​More nuanced and fresher in its fruit expression than the Fombrauge Grand Cru Classé. Spicy, fruity and tannic but nuanced. Long and tannic. An elegant wine.

name: Chateau Puy Blanquet  Saint-Emilion 2015
desc_en_short: The 2015 Château Puy Blanquet is another top-quality Saint-Emilion in the vintage. A blend of 75% Merlot and the rest Cabernet Franc and Cabernet Sauvignon, this full-bodied, ripe, sexy beauty boasts terrific notes of cherries, crème de cassis, chocolate, and hints of charcoal. It has present tannin, yet they’re sweet and integrated, solid mid-palate depth and a great finish, all making for one seriously delicious 2015 to drink over the coming 10-15 years.

name: Chateau Rocheyron  Saint-Emilion
desc_en_short: Château Rocheyron is an elegant wine that skilfully combines an explosion of red fruit and extreme finesse with fine-grained tannins, expressing this wine’s excellent terroir on St.-Émilion’s limestone plateau. A noble, distinguished, very well-balanced wine that can be appreciated over several decades.

name: Clos de L'Oratoire  Saint-Emilion
desc_en_short: 93 points Decanter - "Deep plum colour, this has the rich texture and multi-layered dried herbs and spice feel that you often get with Clos de l'Oratoire. Juicy damson fruits come in through the mid palate and this is big and confident, and well balanced by slate minerality through the finish. Drinking Window 2024 - 2040"

name: Clos La Madeleine  Saint-Emilion
wine_color: Medium to deep garnet-purple in color
desc_en_short:
Clos La Madeleine, a jewel-like vineyard of just 2.3 hectares, is located on the southfacing plateau and terraces of Saint-Émilion, nestled in the vineyard of Château BélairMonange. The estate was acquired by Ets. Jean-Pierre Moueix in September 2017.

The Magdelaine sector has been home to the leading wines of Saint-Émilion since vines were first planted here in the 6th century. Clos La Madeleine, a privileged enclave in this propitious hillside, exemplifies the elegance and minerality characteristic of these well-exposed limestone parcels.

The vineyard of Clos La Madeleine, planted on limestone bedrock covered, in some areas, by just 50 cm of clay, is managed with attentive care throughout the year (ploughing, selective cover-cropping, leaf thinning, green harvesting). A manual harvest followed by two thorough sortings ensure that only those grapes which have achieved optimal maturity are selected. Fermentation takes place in small stainlesssteel tanks; the wine is then aged in French oak barrels for 16 to 18 months.

Mr Hubert de Bouard de Laforest acted as consulting oenologist for Clos La Madeleine from 2006 until the 2016 harvest. The Ets. Jean-Pierre Moueix technical teams took over full management of the property following the acquisition.

The wines of Clos La Madeleine, charming, elegant, with a remarkable mineral streak, embody the distinction of this noble terroir.

Starting with the 2022 vintage, the vineyard of Clos La Madeleine was integrated into Château Bélair-Monange.

name: Chateau Cap de Faugeres (Castillon Cotes de Bordeaux)
style: Merlot, 10% Cabernet Franc And 5% Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: From Silvio Denz's 46-hectare estate in Castillon Côtes de Bordeaux, this Merlot-dominant blend delivers rich black fruit, warming spice, and earthy clay-limestone character — a serious Right Bank red offering remarkable quality for its appellation.

name: Marcelo Pelleriti  Signature Malbec
desc_en_short: Marcelo Pelleriti is the first Latin American winemaker to ever score a perfect 100 Parker Points. He has more than 30 years of winemaking experience between Bordeaux and Argentina. And he certainly knows a thing or two about creating first-class wine in the Malbec capital of the world, Mendoza. This is a ripe and fruity wine, with notes of black fruit, red berries and jam. Try it with sirloin steak.

name: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)  Saga R Pauillac
desc_en_short:
Saga R Pauillac is a beautiful expression of the power and elegance of this great Bordeaux appellation. It comes from some of the best vineyards in Pauillac. The blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, aged for 12 months in oak barrels, results in a complex and well-structured wine with toasty and spicy notes. A long-lasting wine that will reveal its secrets over time.

In Pauillac, under the pebbles that cover the soil and create an almost white landscape, the different layers of sediment are the very secret of a unique terroir that produces complex and elegant wines.

name: Los Vascos Cromas Gran Reserva Cabernet Franc
wine_color: This wine is a beautiful, elegant, and crystalline ruby red color.
desc_en_short: This wine is a beautiful, elegant, and crystalline ruby red color. Red fruit-scented nose of ripe raspberries and fresh strawberries with the signature herbal and floral aromas of this variety. Rounding up this complexity are notes of orange peel and graphite, both of them, elegant and subtle contributions from the barrel. On the palate, this interesting medium-bodied wine offers a smooth attack, marked by an intense and refreshing acidity. Its firm yet pleasant tannins open for a persistent finish.

name: Duckhorn  "Paraduxx" Proprietary Red Blend
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Petite Sirah, 10% Zinfandel, 8% Petit Verdot, 8% Syrah, 2% Grenache, 2% Malbec
desc_en_short: This alluring Cabernet Sauvignon-driven blend draws you in with luxurious aromas of ripe red berries, cassis, violet, leather and cocoa powder. On the palate, the entry is silky and concentrated, with supple tannins framing the rich, red fruit flavors as they build to a long-lasting finish with hints of savory spice.

name: Duckhorn  "Howell Mountain" Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The nose offers an explosion of dark mountain fruit with decadent aromas of raspberry-filled chocolates, black currant, mulberry and huckleberry jam, as well as more savory notes of cedar and spice. On the palate, firm mountain tannins underscore this wine’s opulence and ageability, framing the blackberry, fig and black currant flavors, with bright underlying acidity providing poise and finesse to the long, layered finish.

name: Antinori  Solaia IGT 2018
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Juris  Pinot Noir Reserve
desc_en_short:
"JURIS" is also the name for the family estate Stiegelmar in Gols, for a more precise name and for elimination of future confusion. The family as germ-cell, in the last centuries always has been our refuge of energy. This structure remained alive until today's time. Axel und Herta Stiegelmar has led the winery on the highest level of Austrian estates. Two aspects are responsible for this: One of them is the consistency and strength in all wine categories, offering regularly high quality with dry white wines, highly profiled red wines and sweet wines.

JURIS comprises about 18 ha (2/3 for red wines and 1/3 for white wines) of vineyards, which are situated all over the wine-region of Gols. Gols is located in the wine region Burgenland between Vienna and Budapest in the warm Pannonian climate with permeable soils of gravel and sand. Caused by the geologic conditions in our area, a great number of the grape varieties growing in Austria, are also planted in our estate. It has however crystallised, that the family of the Pinot-varieties is cultivated very often. JURIS strive to produce wines with character and style that are well balanced and possess complexity, aging potential, and a certain elegance.

The highlight of father - Georg Stiegelmar - was the international rewards of the "Robert Mondavi World Wine Trophy" for the Winemaker of the year 1995 (International Wine & Spirit Competition) in London.

name: Juris  Tricata
desc_en_short: Strong ruby ​​garnet, violet reflections, broader ocher edge brightening. Fine spice nuances, ripe heart cherries and plums, nougat and candied orange zest, delicate fig touch in the background. Very powerful, dried plums, firm tannins, lively acidity, delicate nutty tone on the finish, red berry-lemon finish, with a future.

name: Dana Estates  Onda Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 2% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: The 2019 Onda Cabernet Sauvignon opens with aromas of blackberries, baking spice, and plum tart. Intermingled with the fruit are notes of coffee and a hint of graphite. Rich fruit with dense flavors of black cherries, plums, and currants layer with graphite and a briny minerality. The velvety mid-palate transitions to flavors of black truffle, brioche, and blackberry on the finish. The predominantly hillside provenance of the grapes lend a broad mouth coating tannin backbone. The touch of Cabernet Franc brings complexity with hints of mountain sage and lilacs. The Petit Verdot brings depth to the tannins and a hint of blueberries. While inviting now, this wine will grow in complexity as it continues to age.

name: Elizabeth Spencer  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: This wine displays a rich, dark garnet hue in the glass.
desc_en_short: This wine displays a rich, dark garnet hue in the glass.  Aromas of classic cassis, fennel pollen, tobacco, and violets are enhanced by a dusty tannin typical of Rutherford.  The palate expresses notes of dark, ripe fruits on the entry and finishes with an elegant structure, integrated acidity, and a lingering finish.

name: Alpha & Omega  Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 3% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot, 1% Merlot
desc_en_short: Violets, blackberries, cherry pits, worn leather, matchboxes, dusty soil on the nose. Boysenberry, currant, anise, rose, espresso bean, elegant French oak, broad on the palate while being both balanced and powerful.

name: Alpha & Omega  Napa Valley Proprietary Red Blend
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 10% Merlot, 7% Cabernet Franc, 4% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: On the nose, concentrated small berries, gooseberries, red currants, Mirabelle plum jam, cedar, violet candies, underbrush, cassis, coffee grinds, red velvet cakes, sea salt caramels, and licorice powder. On the palate, silky, soft, round entrance, evolving on elegant tannins, notes of fresh cantaloupe, juicy pear, wild strawberry, watermelon, hint of Espelette pepper, blackberry, cherry, hint of fennel, bitter orange zest, tomato stem, ripe nectarine, grenadine, lavender, and pork roast.

name: Joel Gott  "Gott" Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: The GOTT Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon has aromas of blueberries, plum and roasted cherry pie with notes of baking spices and toasted oak. The wine opens with blue fruit flavors followed by soft, velvety tannins and a hint of chocolate on the mid-palate, which are balanced by an elegant structure and long finish.

name: Joel Gott  "Palisades" California Red Blended
style: Zinfandel, Cabernet Sauvignon, Petite Sirah, Malbec, Merlot
desc_en_short: The Joel Gott Palisades Red Wine has aromas of brambleberries, cherries and plum with notes of cola and graham cracker crust. On the palate, roasted blue fruit flavors lead to smooth tannins and subtle acidity on the mid-palate with notes of spice on the long, delicate finish.

name: Far Niente  "Bella Union" Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon,, 13% Merlot, 8% Malbec, 3% Petit Verdot, 1% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: Bella Union Napa Valley Cabernet possesses beautiful and intriguing aromas of dark plum, black cherry, hints of clove and barrel spice. The palate is well-structured with velvety tannins complemented by generous layers of fruit flavors of blackberry, fig and raspberry preserves that give way to a melting finish.

name: Belle Glos  "Dairyman Vineyard" Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Deep garnet in color with abundant aromas of sun-warmed black cherry, raspberry compote, and dark chocolate followed by hints of cedar and black currant. Bold and rich tones layered with flavors of fresh strawberry cobbler and bramble accompanied by notes of cinnamon and nutmeg. This wine has rich tannins, nice concentration, depth, and natural acidity that expresses the authenticity of a Sonoma County Pinot Noir.

name: Merk  Pinot Noir Dry
desc_en_short: A perfect Pinot Noir, developed by extreme yield reduction and intensive hand work on the vine. Carried by blackberry and caramel aromas, scent reminds something of smoked meat.

name: Merk  Dornfelder
desc_en_short: The black and red Dornfelder impresses with aromas of black Currants and sour cherries, it smells slightly of pepper.

name: Kaiken  Indomito Cabernet Franc
wine_color: Intense red colour, medium depth and purple hues.
desc_en_short:
A medium-bodied Cabernet Franc with soft and ripe tannins. It has a natural and
very balanced acidity with a good structure. The flavours of red berries combine with herbal
and spicy hints of black pepper and liquorice. It delivers a long, persistent finish with a
pleasant mouthfeel of freshness and elegance.

name: Kaiken  Indomito Malbec
wine_color: Intense red colour, medium depth and purple hues.
desc_en_short:
It is a structured wine with fine and ripe tannins. Its balanced acidity delivers
freshness and a vibrant palate. It stands out for its long, persistent finish, leaving a smooth
and elegant feeling in the mouth.

name: Abbotts & Delaunay  Metayage Pinot Noir IGP Pay D'Oc
wine_color: Lovely crimson shade within a light colour typical of the grape variety.
desc_en_short:
Round, velvety and well-balanced on entry to the palate, with a nice acid structure
responsible for the finesse and elegance of the Pinot Noir. It finishes with elegant, fresh and
spicy tannins and a lovely luscious sweetness.

name: Edouard Delaunay Septembre Bourgogne Pinot Noir Aoc
desc_en_short: Edouard Delaunay's Septembre Bourgogne Pinot Noir is a textbook expression of village-level Burgundy — bright cherry and redcurrant aromas, silky-fresh palate, and a whisper of oak spice that keeps everything in elegant balance.

name: Louis Jadot  Nuits Saint Georges
desc_en_short: Maison Louis Jadot produces a deeply coloured powerful, fullbodied Nuits-Saint-Georges of intense colour. It develops ripe, robust fruit flavours and nuances of oak in the bouquet. It will accompany red wine sauces, marinated or roasted game, medium tasting cheeses.

name: Castelli del Grevepesa  UN-IO BIO Nobile di Montepulciano DOCG
desc_en_short: Ruby red, with purple hues. Wide and powerful bouquet, with nuances of red fruits. Powerful and harmonious, good texture and flavor, with a pleasant tannic note.

name: Maturana Wines  Reserva Privada Carmenere
desc_en_short:
Bright and intense ruby ​​red. On the nose, aromas of black cherries and plums, with hints
of spices. On the palate, round fruity, powerful, with soft and sweet tannins,
balanced acidity. Final length.

name: Agua Santa  Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Our smooth Cabernet Sauvignon shows intense juicy berry flavours with delicate floral hints and a pleasing round finish enjoyed on its own or paired with beef and hearty pasta dishes.

name: Agua Santa  Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon is the product of producer Luis Felipe Edwards. The famous brand was established in 1976. The name is taken after its founder, Luis Felipe Edwards. This is the most important winery in Chile. With annual wine production reaching more than 2.5 million barrels/year. The diverse and rich products of Luis Felipe Edwards have been present in over 85 countries around the world.

name: Sato  La Ferme de Sato Sur Les Nuages (Pinot Noir)
desc_en_short: Capsicum and green notes together with red fruits, great freshness and medium tannins.

name: Sato  Pinot Noir Northburn
desc_en_short: Ruby red colour. Aroma of raspberry, cherry, dry fruits, mushroo, Manuka honey. The palate of leather and some exotic spices some violet, herbes and earthy cool air.

name: Massolino  Barbaresco DOCG
desc_en_short:
Barbaresco is without doubt another feather in the cap of Italian winemaking. For us, it represents a dream come true.

The soil in the Barbaresco production zone offers us a very special expression of the Nebbiolo grape. These vineyards yield delicate and elegant wines with exceptional balance and finesse. The resulting expression is highly alluring and captivating.

Barbaresco is without doubt another feather in the cap of Italian winemaking and, as far as we are concerned, it represents an extraordinary project that had been in our minds for years. At long last, at the end of 2018, we were lucky enough to find some perfectly located vineyards, giving us the chance to fulfil our long-cherished dream.

name: Ca' Momi  Napa Valley Pinot  Noir
desc_en_short: Our Napa Valley Pinot Noir captivates with enticing aromas of ripe raspberries, cherry, earthiness, vanilla and baking spices. On the palate, there are flavors of Bing cherry, raspberries and rhubarb pie, along with nutmeg and clove. This wine has balanced tannins and acidity, with an elegant mouthfeel that leads to a satisfying finish that leaves you craving another sip.

name: Framingham  Nobody's Hero Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Matured in French oak barriques and seduced by the steady thrum of the bassline, our Pinot Noir delivers a lush, rounded palate with vibrant red fruit vibes, and a lick of gentle oak and dark chocolate.

name: Chateau la Croix D'Hourquet  AOP Bordeaux Rouge
wine_color: Deep ruby (รูบี้เข้ม)
desc_en_short: ลองลิ้มรสไวน์บอร์โดซ์ที่ให้รสผลไม้สดและเครื่องเทศอ่อน ๆ แบบเป็นกันเอง

name: Olek Bondonio  Barbaresco Roncagliette DOCG
desc_en_short: Barbaresco Roncagliette from the well-known Olek Bondonio - Cascina La Berchialla winery is a must-have label for lovers of artisanal Langhe. A true institution that is made from only Nebbiolo grapes harvested by hand and vinified with only indigenous yeasts, aging proceeds in oak barrels for more than 20 months. The intense ruby red color reveals toasted aromas that accompany a sip of great elegance and that you will remember for a long, long time. Intense ruby red. Full, elegant, territorial, gritty and with excellent persistence. Broad, rich, notes of red fruits meet roasted sensations.

name: Olek Bondonio  Langhe Nebbiolo DOC
desc_en_short: Visual examination presents itself with a ruby red dress, slightly tending to the grenade. The nose propagates fruity and floral perfumes, in which the classic violet emerges, combined with nuances that recall the tar. In the mouth it is of medium body full tending, with a very well tamed tannin, which lengthens the sip in the final. A bottle that allows you to appreciate the unique features of Nebbiolo from a young age: complex, intense and rightly tannic, the Langhe Doc of the Olek Bondonio farm fermented with indigenous yeasts in vitrified concrete tanks, and then refine for a period of 18 months In large oak barrels. A great quality entrée, capable of making one of the thousand faces of the best known and renowned grape of all Piedmont known.

name: Olek Bondonio  Barbera D’asti DOCG
desc_en_short: From 30-year-old Piedmontese vines, Olek Bondonio's Barbera d'Asti DOCG is a broad-shouldered, energetic red that balances vivid acidity and ripe dark fruit with genuine elegance — a textbook expression of one of Italy's most characterful indigenous grapes.

name: Olek Bondonio  Vino Rosso
desc_en_short: 100% barbera from a small vineyard that Olek recently acquired in Castagnole delle Lanze (Barbera d'Asti aerea). The soil here is very rich in limestone and chalk. Maceration with minimal pumps over, in stainless steel tank, with the purpose of delivering a sharp, crunchy and minerally driven barbera, opposed to the more opulent style of his barbera d'Alba. Olek decided to go out as vino rosso instead of barbera d'Asti for less confusion, considering is already got a lable of Barbera d'Asti. Polish champion snowboarder Olek Bondonio has quietly established a cult following from his old farmhouse in Barbaresco. He farms three and a half hectares amongst the region's top crus, utilising indigenous yeast fermentation and minimal intervention.barrels. A great quality entrée, capable of making one of the thousand faces of the best known and renowned grape of all Piedmont known.

name: Daou  Bodyguard
wine_color: It displays a dark purple hue.
desc_en_short: The 2021 Bodyguard is the latest masterwork from Winemaker Daniel Daou. Bold and brooding, it displays a dark purple hue. Aromas of ripe black and blue fruits, berry jam, tobacco and maple syrup reveal trailing scents of pepper, campfire and chocolate-covered red fruit. The palate entry is big and broad, displaying rich flavors of freshly crushed berries, cured meat and spice. Concentrated dark fruit flavors extend into a sleek, lengthy finish.

name: Daou  Soul of A Lion
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 13% Cabernet Franc And 7% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: The 2021 vintage displays remarkable intensity in the glass with dark, inky ruby-purple hues. Abundant fruit aromas of black cherry, blackberry, blueberry jam and black currant are interwoven with accents of baking spices, sage and graphite. A voluminous entry introduces sumptuous layers of chocolate-covered blueberry, tobacco, mocha, vanilla and toasted oak. The mouthfeel is concentrated and elegant, with round, vibrant tannins that carry into a commanding finish. A wine of immense staying power that will evolve favorably for many years to come.

name: Mud House  Sub Region Series Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Located at the narrowing of the upper Wairau Valley with lovely north-facing aspects. The coolness of the area combined with the airflow created by the river allows a longer, slower ripening season. The combination of the river stone and clay soils deliver mineral acidity and tannins with tension.

name: Craggy Range  Sophia Gimblett Gravels, Hawke’s Bay
desc_en_short: Deep, garnet red. An openness rarely seen in this wine owing to a perfect summer of heat and dry days. Subtle notes of wild thyme and sage seamlessly blend with plum, fruit cake and brioche. The mid-palate suppleness and sweetness are already so enticing and sure to appeal to loyal followers of this wine. A delicious release.

name: Craggy Range  Syrah Gimblett Gravels Vineyard, Hawke’s Bay
wine_color: Dark burgundy with a vibrant purple hue.
brand: Craggy Range  Syrah Gimblett Gravels Vineyard
desc_en_short: Dark burgundy with a vibrant purple hue. Immediately the nose shows all the hallmarks of the variety on these soils. Olive tapenade, mulberries, and spicy, gamey notes are all in abundance. The palate has prominent ripe tannins and an intensity that speaks to a warm vintage. Medium to full-bodied, the unique savoury and fruit balance is sure to entice all flavours of Syrah from the Gimblett Gravels.

name: Chateau Latour  2011
wine_color: In the glass, the crimson color of the wine is deep and intense.
desc_en_short: Château Latour 2011 is a commanding Pauillac First Growth built on 84.5% Cabernet Sauvignon, delivering deep crimson intensity, elegant floral and dark fruit aromas, and a suave, structured palate that promises exceptional longevity.

name: Chateau Latour  Les Forts de Latour Pauillac
desc_en_short: Intense ruby-red color. Fruity, fresh, ripe nose with undertones of peony and spices. On the palate, the wine is velvety, with full-bodied, silky tannins leading into a precise, concentrated, very long finish.

name: Les Griffons De Pichon Baron  "2nd Vin De Pichon-Longueville Baron" 2016
wine_color: A dark, intense and almost opaque colour.
desc_en_short:
Les Griffons de Pichon Baron is one of the second wines of the property. Created since the 2012 vintage, it has
a pure and direct character.
The grapes which make up this wine's blend come primarily from gravelly plots of land near the Gironde
estuary, a good environment for Cabernet-Sauvignon.
Les Griffons offers a vigorous and fresh tasting experience, full-bodied and clean, overflowing with energy.
It can be laid down in the cellar for over 20 years or enjoyed right away.

name: Chateau Le Roc de Cambes  Cotes de Bourg
desc_en_short: The 2016 Roc de Cambes has turned out beautifully, unwinding in the glass with rich aromas of cassis and cherries mingled with a rich patina of dark chocolate, spices and cigar wrapper. Full-bodied, deep and muscular, its ample, concentrated core is framed by powdery tannins and impressively lively acids. While it's unavoidably marked by its time in 100% new wood, it's the best integrated "great" vintage of Roc de Cambes I can remember tasting at such an early stage. Include it in a blind tasting a decade from now and watch it slay plenty of heavyweight Right Bank names.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2010
wine_color: Deep purple color with black reflections
desc_en_short: 2010 is a heavenly vintage. In terms of quality, it benefited from exceptionally favorable weather. After a late start to the growing season that protected the vines from spring frosts, budding took place evenly in April. By late May, the quality potential also proved to be excellent. Fertilization was greatly hampered by a cold, wet period in June that caused an uneven spread of flowering and led to a significant amount of coulure, dashing hopes of a large crop.

name: Mr.Riggs  J.F.R. McLaren Vale Shiraz
wine_color: Deep dark red black tinged hue.
desc_en_short: This McLaren Vale Shiraz was the first wine Ben Riggs ever made under the Mr. Riggs moniker. First made in 2001, it wasn’t until the 2018 vintage that we decided on a name fitting of this powerful McLaren Vale Shiraz. The initials J.F.R. (John Frederick Riggs) are for Bens’ late father, the reason he makes wine.

name: Heim  Pinot Noir Imperial
wine_color: Ruby-red robe. It is a real red wine.
desc_en_short: Ruby-red robe. It is a real red wine. Fine nose, with intense cherry and blackcurrant notes. The silky tannins of this wine enhance its balance.

name: Spy Valley  Envoy Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: Alluring aromas of Cherry, nutmeg and strawberry. Firm, fine grained tannins support a gentle, fruity structure. Concentrated red berries and subtle earthy notes.

name: Church Road   Tom Syrah
wine_color: Deep red with a vibrant purple hue.
desc_en_short:
A wine of great depth, the fruit expresses as ripe berry and black plum, with top notes of violet, lavender, liquorice and anise. The vibrant fruit is tempered by darker complexities evoking warm earth, new leather, cedar, cacao and savoury roasted notes, along with an underlying minerality typical of this vineyard.

The palate is fine, full and long with a silky tannin structure that gives an overall impression of elegance, completeness and restrained power.

name: Church Road  1 Single Vineyard Redstone Syrah
desc_en_short:
This Syrah is built around a core of brambly, dark berry fruit, carrying lifted aromatic notes of violet, lavender and warm spice. It is complemented by underlying complexities redolent of new leather and smoky roasted notes, with subtle undertones of toasted oak and a minerality typical of this vineyard. 

The palate is fine and long with a polished tannin structure and gentle mid-palate flesh combining to produce a very even and seamless mouthfeel.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mapu Tierra Sagrada Almaule Pais
desc_en_short: Beautiful pale cherry red colour. Very intense Wild red berries: cherries, Chilean guava and black cherries Soft herbal notes of sage and wildflowers (pennyroyal & mint). Starts out very refreshing Juicy acidity inviting for another sip Very smooth, pleasant structure. This wine reveals all the charm and expression of the País grape variety in the Secano Costero of the Maule Valley.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mapu Tierra Sagrada Vigno Carignan
wine_color: Lovely, brilliant, intense ruby red colour with purple highlights
desc_en_short: Lovely, brilliant, intense ruby red colour with purple highlights. Very intense Wild red berries (rosehip and Chilean guava), plum and cherry Nicely integrated notes of coffee and black tobacco Fresh and juicy Delicious acidity on the palate, refreshing and rich, with a good sensation of volume Long and very persistent finish. The wine reveals the potent, elegant character of Chilean Carignan from the coastal dryland vineyards of the Maule Valley (Secano Costero).

name: Tua Rita  Rosso dei Notri IGT
desc_en_short: On the nose a nice array of floral sensations and crunchy red fruit, followed by spicy tones and vegetal traits. The mouth is directed by brilliant freshness, with lively and proportionate tannins.

name: Tua Rita  Lodano Rosso IGT
desc_en_short: Lodano Rosso is a blend of Petit Verdot and Merlot that is seamlessly integrated with its dark fruits, blackberries and plums, nicely rounded off by smoke and tobacco from French oak and a smaller proportion of American oak. The Merlot comes from the winery's famous old vines, and the contemporary concentration and richness of the Lodano can be found in this wine and, incidentally, in the winery's entire portfolio.

name: Tua Rita  Redigaffi IGT
desc_en_short: Redigaffi offers luscious layers of blueberry jam, ripe plum and blackberry, followed by voluptuous notes of dark chocolate, licorice, black pepper, vanilla and incense. Full-bodied and lush on the palate with polished tannins and an extralong finish.

name: Luigi Bosca  De Sangre Cabernet France
desc_en_short: It features pleasant notes characteristic of this variety that are reminiscent of liquorice, spices, pink pepper and a little bit of black fruit, which are perfectly blended thanks to its barrel aging process. It is compact and robust in the mouth, as well as highly concentrated and smooth. A highly acid and firm wine of balanced texture and great roundness, featuring a long and persistent finish, black fruit and a mildly spicy aftertaste.

name: Luigi Bosca  Paraíso
wine_color: A bright and deep violet red wine.
desc_en_short: Paraíso, the winery’s most important wine, is a bright and deep violet red wine. Its aromas are intense, balanced and elegant, with a highly accurate yet complex fruity expression. Its delicate notes are reminiscent of red fruits and spices.

name: Domaine Jaume  Clos Des Echalas AOP
desc_en_short:
A powerful nose of cooked red fruits and spices leads to a well-developed, full palate with blackcurrant and blueberry aromas and toasted notes.

A long finish with velvety tannins and a touch of black pepper.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Baron Henri AOC Medoc
wine_color: dense purple red in the glass.
desc_en_short: The powerful Baron Henri Médoc Baron Philippe de Rothschild glows with dense purple red in the glass. To the nose, this Baron Philippe de Rothschild red wine presents all sorts of black currants, mulberries, blackberries and blueberries. As if that were not already impressive, the aging in small wooden barrels adds other aromas such as oriental spices, cocoa bean and toasted barrique.

name: Louis Latour  Moulin-A-Vent Les Michelons
desc_en_short: Moulin-à-Vent is one of the 10 individual Cru's in the Beaujolais that constitute the highest ranking wines of the area due to their complexity and greater potential for ageing. The appellation of Moulin-à-Vent straddles the communes of Romanèche-Thorins and Chénas, taking its name from the old windmill in the heart of the vineyards. "Les Michelons" is a single vineyard chosen by Maison Louis Latour for its ideal southerly exposure and gently inclined slope. The wine has a remarkably deep richness of bouquet and intense savour requiring some ageing to reveal its full potential. Of the 10 Crus, it is the one with the most complexity.

name: Louis Latour  Les Epenots Pommard 1er Cru
desc_en_short: The village of Pommard is comfortably sandwiched between the town of Beaune and the village of Volnay. In contrast to the wines of its close neighbours, those of Pommard tend to be fuller, more tannic and expansive in the mouth, similar to those of the Côte de Nuits. This area was named "Epenots", coming from "épine" (thorn or prickle), as a result of the natural vegetation of the area which was bush-like and thorny. The "Epenots" is solid and firm in its youth and needs time to mature and mellow out before revealing its full glory.

name: Louis Latour  Nuits Saint Georges Damodes 1er Cru
desc_en_short: "Les Damodes" is situated on the northern part of the Nuits-Saint-Georges appellation, just to the south of the premier cru appellations of Vosne-Romanée. The vineyard name "Les Damodes" comes from "Dame" meaning lady. Legend says that there were fairies that inhabited this rocky hillside above the village of Nuits-Saint-Georges, once covered by quarries and woods! But more likely it was the presence of rocky forms that looked like tall ladies in long dresses that gave the parcel its name. Known locally as "Les Dames Hautes" - "hautes" (meaning tall), hence the pronounciation has become "damaudes" then "damodes". Planted on a parcel with an easterly exposure, the vines grow on poor, limestone soils. Elegance and finesse perfectly characterize this wine.

name: Louis Latour  Vosne-Romanee Chaumes 1er Cru
desc_en_short: Vosne-Romanée, famous over the world for its Grand Crus, also produces some Premier Crus of an outstanding quality. "Les Chaumes" is located underneath the plot of "Aux Malconsorts" on the same altitude as the village of Vosne-Romanée and North of Nuits-Saint-Georges. The iron-based soil is ideal for growing Pinot Noir. The grapes reach their maximum maturity and offers wonderfully aromatic wines. The term "Chaumes" has the same origin as "Charmes", it indicates that it was unplanted land before becoming a vineyard.

name: Louis Latour  Corton Les Perrieres Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Located on the hill of the Corton Grand Crus at an altitude of 273 meters in an old stone quarry, the "Perrières" parcel of vines has a perfect south-easterly exposition. Our Cuverie Corton Grancey is embedded in this terroir. There are brown and red clay soils which produce a delicious and intense wine. The well-aged vines are managed in a traditional way by Domaine Louis Latour. Severe pruning allows a later harvest and ensures a good level of maturity and richness in the grapes.

name: Louis Latour  Chateau Corton Grancey Grand Cru
desc_en_short: "Grancey" was the name of the last owners of the château situated on the road of Corton, before the Latour family bought it in 1891. This wine, produced by Maison Louis Latour, is unique and exclusive. It is a blend of five areas of Domaine Latour Corton Grand Cru: Bressandes, Perrières, Grèves, Clos du Roi, and Chaumes, the proportions of which vary depending on the vintage. The average age of the vines is over 40 years. After aging individually, only the best barrels are assembled to create the Château Corton Grancey. It is a wine that is produced only if the grapes are of a perfect maturity, vintages judged inferior are systematically declassified.

name: Segno Librandi Cirò Rosso Classico DOC
desc_en_short:
Segno is a culmination of three decades of work in the Cirò DOC spanning four estates with a profound interest and understanding of our territory. This is our Segno.

Made from single-variety Gaglioppo grapes: classic, original and approachable at the same time.

name: Donnafugata  Contrada Marchesa Etna Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: Light ruby red in color, Etna Rosso Doc Contrada Marchesa presents a fragrant bouquet with fruity notes of raspberry and cherry, balsamic hints and aromatic herbs nuances (rosemary and thyme) which go together with the spicy notes of cinnamon and forest floor. On the palate, it stands out for its great balance and fine tannic texture that makes it an icon of volcanic elegance

name: Donnafugata  Fragore Contrada Etna Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: This sensational wine from the Sicilian tradition of Donnafugata has a light ruby red color. The scent is broad and tells of a deep bouquet with spicy hints. Above all the sweet tobacco and nutmeg as well as floral with the distinct violet, followed by notes of berries such as currant that blend with balsamic and mineral shades of flint. The taste offers an extraordinary complexity and elegance characterized by distinct minerality and important tannins; the finish is of remarkable persistence.

name: Donnafugata  D&G Cuordilava Etna Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: Donnafugata's Cuordilava Etna Rosso is a volcanic-born Nerello Mascalese from the ancient slopes of Mount Etna, delivering a captivating interplay of red fruit, cinnamon spice, lavender, and striking mineral depth — a wine that truly speaks the language of lava.

name: Bodega Aleanna El Enemigo As Bravas Malbec
desc_en_short: El Enemigo As Bravas Malbec 2016 unfurls a spectrum of aromas with ripe black fruits such as blackberries and plums taking center stage, interwoven with hints of spices and an underlying mineral character reminiscent of wet stones. On the palate, it is powerful and full-bodied, offering a robust yet refined texture. Its mature tannins and extended finish ensure that this red wine is a distinctive choice for those in pursuit of intense and well-defined flavors.

name: Domaine Thibault Liger-Belair  Nuits Saint Georges La Charmotte
desc_en_short: This Nuits Saint Georges La Charmotte, with perfect harmony, releases aromas of red fruits (cherry, raspberry, redcurrant) combined with floral notes (rose, violet), bringing elegance, freshness and power to the whole. Velvety and distinguished texture in this Nuits located on the Vosne side. We find spicier tones in La Charmotte, whose fresh and powdery fruit fills the mouth with agility.

name: Dry Creek Vineyard  Heritage Cabernet
desc_en_short: The Dry Creek Valley is an undiscovered gem, producing some of the finest Cabernet Sauvignon in California. Primarily known for Zinfandel, the valley has almost as much Cabernet Sauvignon planted. This lush and elegant Cabernet Sauvignon initially displays aromas of plum, cranberry, and black truffle, followed by nutmeg, black pepper and thyme. A first taste of the full-bodied wine reveals flavors of black cherry, black currant and espresso. Hints of florals and fine leather bolster its richness, while firm tannins provide structure. The broad palate and soft edges make this Cabernet approachable in its youth while also perfect for aging.

name: Dry Creek Vineyard  Old Vine Zinfandel
desc_en_short: For this bottling of ry Creek Vineyard Old Vine Zinfandel, the vines average more than 100 years in age! This vintage presents alluring aromatics of blackberry, boysenberry and fresh raspberry with notes of cocoa powder, cardamom, toasty cedar and nutmeg. On the palate, brambly layers of black cherry, blackberry and boysenberry come forward with nuances of coriander, marzipan and mocha. The wine is complex, with bright acidity and impeccable balance. The tannins are structured but soft, and lend a round, rich mouthfeel.

name: Martin Ray  Cabernet Napa & Sonoma
desc_en_short: Classic and ripe with deep blue and purple fruit, notes of currant, fresh blackberry, bramble, and peppercorn. Interlaced with wet stone and earth, over touches of elderflower and vanilla with fervent, yet silky integrated tannins.

name: Martin Ray  Mount Veeder Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley
desc_en_short: Rich elderberry and cassis, with notes of savory evergreen and fennel buds. Black cherry throughout, with leather, chicory root, cocoa powder, and graphite. Taut and precise, with a distinctive minerality over a savory finish that contrasts the deep, dark fruit.

name: Two Hands  Brave Faces GMS Barossa Valley
desc_en_short:
What a difference a couple of generations can make. In the mid 1980s South Australia’s old Grenache, Mourvèdre and Shiraz vines were being removed due to a lack of demand. Brave Faces is a tribute to the men and women that loyally tended their vineyards, allowing them to remain intact today.

“Brave faces face the boardroom, the oak stained walls fall silent, they leave lined with defeat, and they got those tears in their eyes, well it makes no sense to me.” Brave Faces MIDNIGHT OIL, 1981

name: Two Hands  Bella's Garden Shiraz Barossa
desc_en_short: A blend of our finest Shiraz barrels from across the Barossa Valley region. This is a sumptuous wine, defined by its aromatic complexity and finesse. Predominately grown in the Red/Brown earth of the Barossa’s western ranges, the soil profile creates masculine tannins and richness through the palate. Lower yield limiting soils provide a large fruit concentration. This label’s colour reflects the red soils of the Barossa’s western ranges where all the best Two Hands vineyards are located.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2017
desc_en_short: 98 points James Suckling - "Very perfumed and subtle with dried flowers and citrus, as well as blue fruit. Full-bodied with wonderfully diffused, integrated tannins that just run over the edges of the wine. It’s extremely polished and very, very long. Fresh and bright. Energetic finish. A thoughtful wine. A blend of 54% merlot, 42% cabernet sauvignon and 4% petit verdot. Drink after 2023."

name: Pietradolce  Contrada Rampante Etna Rosso
desc_en_short: "Fresh and dried cranberries, lemon peel, fresh mushrooms and bark. Smoky. It’s medium-bodied with firm yet fine, silky tannins and intense, juicy flavors. Long finish. Delicious."

name: Pietradolce  Contrada Santo Spirito Etna Rosso
desc_en_short:
Santo Spirito Etna Rosso is a wine obtained from Nerello Mascalese grapes from a pre-phylloxera vineyard that was brought to light and restored during land reclamation work. This vineyard is located in the highest part of the Contrada Santo Spirito at 900 meters above sea level. It is a very windy promontory, with marked temperature variations and sandy soils, with abundant volcanic rock.
The harvest takes place in the second half of October. The crushing and destemming is followed by a maceration of approximately 18 days in raw cement tulip tanks. The 14-month aging in oak barrels is followed by maturation in the bottle. The result is a wine with an ample bouquet, which alternates spicy notes with red berries. The taste is vibrant, with distinctive elegance and personality.

name: Grand Napa Vineyards  Oakville Cabernet sauvignon
desc_en_short: Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon showcases a deep red hue and an aromatic blend of intense blueberry, subtle graphite, and a hint of vanilla on the nose. The palate is a smooth, full-bodied, and elegant experience with balanced acidity, while structured tannins create a bold yet refined character. The finish is enduring, focused, and graced by a return of fresh strawberry notes, leaving a powerful and memorable impression.

name: Intipalka  N1 Gran Reserva
desc_en_short: A complex nose shows notes of mulberries, and blueberries followed by tobacco and vanilla. Full-bodied with notes of mulberry, cedar, and cassis. Great oak integration supported by acidity and a lovely finish.

name: Intipalka  Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon Petit Verdot
desc_en_short: A full-bodied, high acid wine with a bouquet of blackberries, mulberries, and herbal notes balanced with hints of vanilla and cedar. Great round tannins and a long, complex finish.

name: Intipalka  Malbec
desc_en_short: An opaque, deep, dark ruby color with notes of mulberry, cassis, grass, and vanilla. A full-bodied wine with rich sweet mulberry notes on the palate followed by oak notes of cassis, cedar, and vanilla and a long finish.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Pentavarietal
grape_variety: Tannat, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Noir, Tempranillo
desc_en_short:
The best plots of our Los Cerros de San Juan vineyard, the oldest plants, the most precise cultural care, seeking excellence. Conceived and produced in our wonderful facilities that show the most modern of the industry with the greatest wealth of Uruguayan winemaking history.
Our historic “Pentavarietal” with the selection of the best barrels of Tannat, Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Pinot Noir and Tempranillo.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Maderos Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Very intense red color with violet tints.
desc_en_short:
One of the varieties with the most history in the world of wine. Produced in Italian tulips that allow micro-oxygenation throughout the fermentation process and accelerate the maturation of this great wine.
Very intense red color with violet tints. On the nose, aromas that taste of red fruits, pepper, sweet pepper, cassis and the subtlety of oak. On the palate it presents important textures, firm, ripe tannins, sensations of spices, complexed with the right presence of oak, filling the mouth with pleasant sensations. A special wine, with great aging potential.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Maderos Cabernet Franc
wine_color: Deep red in color with violet hues.
desc_en_short: This captivating variety, for many years relegated by the fame of Cabernet Sauvignon, is now beginning to exploit its full potential. Produced in Italian tulips that allow micro-oxygenation throughout the fermentation process and accelerate the maturation of this great wine. Deep red in color with violet hues. On the nose it presents aromas of red fruits and spices such as sweet pepper, eucalyptus, cassis and the subtlety of oak. On the palate it presents soft tannins, sensations of spices, it is fruity, complex with the right presence of oak, filling the mouth with pleasant sensations. A different wine, with great aging potential.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Cuna De Piedra Reserve Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Between sandy loam and clay soils with abundant amounts of calcium carbonate, at our Finca Los Cerros, with intense work in each plant, we seek the excellence of this, the star red grape in the world. Of intense ruby ​​red color. Spicy aromas of pepper, red fruits such as strawberries, blueberries and a touch of licorice. With present but amalgamated tannins, complex, with pleasant smoky notes of cedar.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Cuna De Piedra Reserve Tannat
wine_color: It is the purest expression of the variety, with striking colours and nuances.
desc_en_short: It is the purest expression of the variety, with striking colours and nuances, aromas of red and black fruits, spices, good concentration and persistence.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Cuna De Piedra Estate Marselan
wine_color: Deep red in color with blue hues.
desc_en_short:
Our vineyard is determined by the rocky nature of the mountains, with excellent drainage, which delimit the region.

On the nose it presents sweet aromas, red fruits and minerals. On the palate, soft tannins merge with flavors of ripe red fruits, spices, with great volume and a long finish.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Cuna De Piedra Estate Tannat
wine_color: This wine is a pure expression of the varietal, with striking colours and nuances.
desc_en_short: This wine is a pure expression of the varietal, with striking colours and nuances, aromas of red and black fruits, and spices. In the mouth it is concentrated, powerful, with great persistence and a very pleasant aftertaste.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Goleta Corte 2C Cabernet Sauvignon - Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: A Bordeaux-inspired blend from Los Cerros de San Juan, this Cabernet Sauvignon and Cabernet Franc marriage balances the robustness of the Sauvignon with the subtle elegance of the Franc, aged in oak for complexity and shaped by Uruguay's mineral-rich terroir.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Goleta Corte 2M Marselan-Merlot
desc_en_short: This new 2M red grape blend, the product of crossing Marselan and the always considered Merlot, is a blend of French origin that found its wonderful habitat in Los Cerros de San Juan. Structure and delicacy, the best way to present this wine that will surely leave its mark on whoever enjoys it. Fruity, gently spiced, young and with the personality that only exceptional vintages can provide. In addition to the complexity that its contact with oak provides. Excellent pairing with lean meats and vegetables, stewed meals and tasty cheeses.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Goleta Corte 2T Tannat-Tempranillo
desc_en_short: Tannat, although of French origin, is more Uruguayan than mate, combined with Tempranillo or Tempranilla from La Rioja in Spain, they give this exquisite 2T Cut wine. It has a very intense Bordeaux red color, good body and structure. Added to the complexity provided by the oak, it is mineral, fresh and intense. These two varieties with a lot of personality make this blend an ideal option to pair with classic Uruguayan meat cuts and accompany a meeting with friends.

name: Le Clos du Serres  Le Clos Du Les Maros
desc_en_short:
The soft Grenache with its hints of blackberries, blackcurrants and a touch of grated chocolate, is a perfect foil for the sharper, slightly liquorice notes so characteristic of Carignan.
In the mouth, full, well balanced tannins end on a rich, slightly candied note reminiscent of cherries and blackcurrant.

name: Le Clos du Serres  Le Clos Du Serres Le Palas
desc_en_short: The roundness of grenache and its notes of crushed strawberries, the spice and nervousness of syrah, the freshness of carignan. The sunset exposure gives a dense substance in the mouth but endowed with mineral power. Very nice wine to keep for more than 10 years.

name: Le Clos du Serres  L'Humeur Vagabonde
desc_en_short: A full and balanced wine with a long aging potential, endowed with a beautiful mineral power, peppery notes, fleur-de-lys. Gastronomic complicities: To decant. Serve at 17°C with a nice grilled meat on the barbecue, entrecote, Aubrac beef rib. Laying down: wine with great aging potential for 10 years and beyond.

name: Cellier Des Princes  Chateauneuf Du pape Rouge - Biologique
brand: Cellier Des Princes  Chateauneuf Du pape Rouge
desc_en_short: This cuvée made with organic grapes has been produced with respect for the environment. The wine is ruby-red in color, with an intense nose of blackberries and spices. Fruity and powerful on the palate, with elegant tannins and long aromatic persistence.

name: Domaine de la Mordorée  "Lirac La Reine des Bois" Rouge
desc_en_short: A wine that has been emblematic of the Domaine since its creation. A wine for ageing and with character, which will seduce you with its balance, complexity and depth, mingled with aromas of ripe red and black fruits. A wine to be enjoyed both young and with a few years’ cellaring.

name: Domaine de la Mordorée  Chateauneuf-du-Pape Cuvee de "La Reine des Bois"
desc_en_short: This historic cuvée stands out for its density, beautiful concentration, ripe fruit aromas and power on the palate. A wine for laying down.

name: Domaine de la Mordorée  Vin de France "La Remise" Rouge "Sans Sulfites"
desc_en_short: This cuvée, vinified and aged without sulfites, retains all the crispness and deliciousness of the main grape variety: Marselan.

name: L'Archetipo  Aglianico IGP Salento
wine_color: Ruby red colour with purple red reflex.
desc_en_short: Ruby red colour with purple red reflex; fine and elegant nose, fruity and grassy. Full body, tannic, very persi-stent and fresh. Pairing with braised pork or lamb, meat or vegetal structured main courses. Cheeses and cold cuts charcuterie.

name: I Vigneri  Etna Rosso DOC
desc_en_short: I Vigneri Etna Rosso is a pure, ancient and genuine wine. Winemaking is carried out in the Palmento, as has always been done on Mt. Etna, without refrigeration equipment and no aging in wood. Vineyard cultivation is done by hand using natural products. During winemaking, refrigeration and biotechnologies are not used. Transfer and bottling are carried out according to the phases of the moon.

name: I Vigneri  Palmento & Anfora
wine_color: Cherry red, tending towards dark garnet.
desc_en_short: Cherry red, tending towards dark garnet. The aromas that develop on the nose reveal an olfactory range that is initially floral and fruity, and then turns towards typically tertiary nuances, in which the spices are more enveloping. It enters the mouth with a balanced sip, in which the tannic component is well dominated, enclosed in good acidity.

name: Chateau Grand Puy Ducasse  5ème Cru Classé de Pauillac 2018
desc_en_short: The 2018 Grand-Puy-Ducasse is deep garnet-purple in color and has quite a lot of cedar/oak on the nose to begin, opening out to a core of warm black and red currants, stewed plums and mulberries with touches of pencil shavings, fried herbs, lavender and tapenade. Medium to full-bodied, the palate gives a firm, grainy frame with some chew from the oak and fresh, crunchy red and black fruit, finishing savory.

name: Echo de Lynch Bages AOC Pauillac 2020
brand: Echo de Lynch Bages AOC Pauillac
desc_en_short: Echo de Lynch-Bages 2020 displays vibrant ruby purple in the glass with pure and lifted aromas of fresh redcurrant and raspberry. The palate unfolds with well-rounded tannins on a fresh and elegant finish.

name: Chateau Ormes De Pez Saint Estephe
desc_en_short: "Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, the 2017 Ormes de Pez features black cherries and cassis notions over a core of fragrant earth, stewed tea and tobacco plus a waft of forest floor. Medium-bodied, the palate is packed with juicy black fruit with a grainy texture and long, mineral-tinged finish."

name: Chateau Cantenac Brown 2020
food_matching: Pasta, Pizza, Roasted Chicken, Pork, Medium Cheese

name: Monemvasia	 Voltes Red
desc_en_short: A fresh wine made in stainless steel, from Agiorgitiko and Mavroudi varieties, with a name inspired by the twisting uphill pathway leading to the Upper Town of Monemvasia, called Voltes.

name: Fontanafredda  Barbera Briccotondo DOC
wine_color: A ruby-red wine with purple highlights.
desc_en_short: This is a ruby-red wine with purple highlights.
