name: Chateau de la Maltroye Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru "la Boudriotte"
desc_en_short:
Chateau de la Maltroye was founded in 1941 and situated in Chassagne-Montrachet in the south of the Cote d'Or. The impressive château building is easily recognizable by its 18th-century diamond-patterned glazed tiles roof. Domaine is now in the hands of Jean-Pierre Cornut, the third generation. 

Maltroye is one of the largest domains in Chassagne with 15 hectares of land, 13 of which are in Chassagne and 2 are in Santenay, with 70% of the production comprising Premier Cru wine. Around 70,000 bottles are produced each year (60% Chardonnay and 40% Pinot Noir).

name: Domaine De La Romanee Conti  2021
desc_en_short: The 2021 Romanée-Conti Grand Cru is the most integrated and complex—that's to say, hard to describe—wine in the range. Wafting from the glass with scents of sweet red berries, exotic spices, espresso roast, rose petals and violets, with only subtle hints of the coniferous bass-notes that mark out many of the other cuvées this year, it's full-bodied, pure and seamless, with an exquisitely suave, harmonious palate that effortless integrates vibrant acids, melting tannins and intense retronasal perfume. Concluding with a mouthwateringly saline finish, this is a wine that will delight, even enchant, Burgundy purists.

name: Chateau Canon  2021
wine_color: The color is a healthy dark ruby/purple.
desc_en_short: The 2021 Canon shows just how magical this site is. Vertical and explosive in feel, with tons of pure power, it impresses with its intensity, drive and super-classic profile. Bright saline notes and vibrant tannins give the 2021 a feeling of energy that only gains momentum with time in the glass. It's not an easy Canon, like the 2015 or 2018, but it is incredibly expressive. It is the sort of wine that only truly emerges with time in bottle. I would be thrilled to own it. Canon must surely be one of the great relative values in first-class wine. Wow. Tasted two times.

name: Chateau Laroque  Saint-Emilion Grand Cru Classe
desc_en_short: A richly structured Saint-Émilion Grand Cru Classé built on 89% Merlot, Château Laroque's 2015 delivers a deep, dark concentration of black fruits, fleshy tannins, and a signature mineral finish that lifts the entire palate with effortless elegance.

name: Zeni  Marogne Valpolicella Superiore Ripasso
desc_en_short: Deep ruby red in color. Vinous, full-bodied, with hints of black cherry and well-ripened fruit. Rounded and velvety on the palate.

name: Renacer Malbec
desc_en_short:
The wine has a deep bright red
color. Aromas of wild berries
such as raspberry, strawberry and
blueberry mingled with earthy and
spicy notes. In the mouth, the wine
is juicy and fruity, with round
tannins, balanced acidity and a
long finish.

name: Renacer Punto Final Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Bright ruby red. Fresh fruit
aromas like plums, berries, and
cherries, combined with spicy
notes of pepper, green pepper,
and eucalyptus. The French oak
provides smooth notes of vanilla,
chocolate, and cinnamon.

name: Renacer Punto Final Malbec
wine_color: A deep violet colours with red hues.
desc_en_short:
Renacer Punto Final Malbec
pours a deep violet colours with
red hues. Strong floral tones of
violet and rose combined with red
fruits such as blackcurrant and
raspberry

name: Wild Bresco Merlot
desc_en_short:
Aromatics of ripe plums and dark
cherry fruits with sweet vanilla rise
from the glass and are the focus on the
nose. These flavours are mimicked on
the palate finishing with fine soft and
subtle tannins.

name: Castelli Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Castelli Estate's Cabernet Sauvignon delivers a lush core of sweet blackberry fruit wrapped in seductive mocha and dark chocolate nuances — a full-bodied Australian red that rewards both the curious newcomer and the seasoned collector alike.

name: Castelli Il Liris Red
desc_en_short:
Putting his farming knowledge to use, Sam planted a small
vineyard in his hometown and began making wine for their
household in the traditional way; by hand from start to finish
where the method of maceration is ‘grape-stomping’ – by foot. All
local grape growers make their own wine for their household, and
once a year in San Giorgio a Liri, there is a festival where locals
buy a glass, hang it around their necks and spend the day visiting
all the other growers to taste their homemade wines. With this as
the backdrop to his early years,you could say that wine was in his
blood.

name: Pirramimma Icon War Horse
desc_en_short:
This bright and vibrant wine
exhibits a bouquet of red rose, spicy
raspberry, pomegranate, and red
cherry, with hints of subtle nutty
cedary oak. With the palate
delivering raspberry puree, dried
cranberry, red currant, and nutmeg,
intermingled with Christmas
pudding and spices.

name: Pirramimma Ironstone Old Bush Vine Grenache
desc_en_short: Pirramimma's Ironstone Old Bush Vine Grenache is a vivid, aromatic red from McLaren Vale's oldest family estate, bursting with spicy raspberry, pomegranate, and red cherry, layered with dried cranberry, nutmeg, and warming Christmas spice on a silky, medium-bodied palate.

name: Karl’S Scepter Bastet
desc_en_short:
Our method of intensifying
red wines through regular
use of a hand plunger during
fermentation, is proven
to increase fruit intensity,
mouthfeel and overall body as
well as deepen colour. You’ll
see that this wine is intense
dark red berry fruit dominant,
with great structure, well
integrated oak and a lengthy
fruit driven finish

name: Three Dark Horses Sgt
desc_en_short:
Dark fruits and chocolate notes
of Shiraz, with the red fruits
and spice of Grenache are
complemented by the floralness
and delicacy of Touriga.

name: Three Dark Horses Preservative Free Shiraz
desc_en_short:
Opens with briary fruits, subtle
spice and musk, then draws you in
with dark berry flavours and firm
yet elegant tannins.

name: Three Dark Horses Basket Pressed Shiraz
wine_color: Purple in appearance with a lovely garnet hue.
desc_en_short:
Purple in appearance with a
lovely garnet hue. Varietal aromas
of dark berries and vanilla,
with spice and chocolate playing
a supporting role. Flavours of
plum, blackberry conserve, mellow
spice and a touch of earthiness on
the pallet which rolls into a long
lasting finish.

name: Three Dark Horses Grenache
desc_en_short: A McLaren Vale Grenache that delivers trademark spice alongside bright strawberry and raspberry aromatics, building to a medium-to-full-bodied palate cushioned by fine, sandy tannins — a crowd-pleasing expression of one of Australia's most exciting red varieties.

name: Laura Hartwig Selección Del Viticultor Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_color: Bright red wine with medium intensity.
desc_en_short:
Bright red wine with medium intensity. The nose is complex
and in harmony with notes of plum, chocolate, and fresh
herbs. Mediumbodied, structured, silky tannins, with a great
juicy focus and a finish full of flavors.

name: Laura Hartwig Laluca Merlot
desc_en_short: A vibrant Colchagua Valley Merlot from Laura Hartwig, offering ripe blackberry and plum aromas lifted by wildflower notes and a touch of earth, finishing fresh and juicy with a soft, approachable structure perfect for everyday enjoyment.

name: Laura Hartwig Laluca Malbec
desc_en_short:
Deep violet color. Aromatic notes of red and floral
fruits such as plums and violets. In the mouth, it
presents a great structure, and medium body, with
fine and velvety tannins accompanied by vibrant
and gastronomic acidity. Highlighted red fruit
flavors bring a great finish.

name: Domaine Tortochot Bourgogne Pinot Noir “Fine Sélection”
desc_en_short: A charming village-level Burgundy from Domaine Tortochot, this Bourgogne Pinot Noir delivers bright red cherry, strawberry, and cranberry aromas lifted by spicy pepper, with a silky texture rounded by subtle vanilla and cinnamon from French oak aging.

name: Domaine Tortochot Gevrey-Chambertin “Les Jeunes Rois”
wine_color: Deep ruby red with ripe cherry
desc_en_short: A village-level Gevrey-Chambertin from the respected Domaine Tortochot, "Les Jeunes Rois" delivers classic Côte de Nuits character — ripe cherry, raspberry, and peppery spice framed by silky tannins and a savory, game-inflected finish.

name: Domaine Tortochot Gevrey-Chambertin Vieilles Vignes
desc_en_short:
Deep ruby red with aromas of
mushrooms, raspberries, orange
zest, and tea leaves, a mediumbodied, juicy palate with fine
tannins, and a silky, savory finish.

name: Domaine Gérard Duplessis Gevrey-Chambertin 1Er Cru Les Champeaux
desc_en_short: From one of Gevrey-Chambertin's respected domaines, Les Champeaux 1er Cru delivers classic Côte de Nuits character — deep ruby fruit, subtle spice, and floral lift, underpinned by firm yet polished tannins and a long, savory finish.

name: Domaine David Duband Bourgogne Hautes Côtes De Nuits Rouge “Louis Auguste”
desc_en_short:
Deep ruby red with ripe cherry
and raspberry aromas, peppery
spice and cinnamon, firm tannins,
balanced acidity, and a savory,
game-friendly finish.

name: Henri Jouan Chambolle-Musigny
desc_en_short:
Medium ruby red with aromas
of red cherries, raspberries, floral
notes, and a silky palate with fine
tannins and refreshing acidity.

name: Domaine Anne Et Hervé Sigaut Chambolle-Musigny 1Er Cru Les Sentiers Vieilles Vignes
desc_en_short:
Medium ruby with aromas of
poached plum, cassis, floral and
earthy spice, a silky, vibrant palate
with integrated oak and a savory
mineral finish.

name: Maison Bouey Louis Arcadie Médoc Médoc Contrôlée
style: Subtle Blend Of Merlot And Cabernet Sauvignon.
desc_en_short:
Elegant and concentrated
fruity nose. Its dense and
generous mouth offers a frank
attack on the fruit. It evolves on
supple tannins with a finish of
good length.

name: Maison Bouey Celestin Bordeaux A.O.C. Rouge
style: Subtle Blend Of Merlot And Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
This vintage shows an intense
garnet bright colour. Very well
balanced and structured with
fruity fresh flavours and fine
tannins. The finish is long with
fruity aroma.

name: Bodegas Nodus Capellana Tempranillo D.O. Utiel Requena
desc_en_short:
The wine is a deep red color
with a complex aroma from
Cabernet Sauvignon and
Tempranillo grapes. Aged in
American oak, it offers rich,
well-balanced flavors with a
harmonious blend of fruit and
oak notes.

name: Bodegas Nodus Capellana Tinto De Autor D.O. Utiel Requena
desc_en_short:
The wine has a deep red color
with complex aromas of fruit
and oak. On the palate, it offers
rich, well-balanced flavors,
seamlessly blending fruity notes
with the subtle influence of
American oak.

name: Bodegas Nodus Chavalote Tinto D.O. Valencia
desc_en_short:
This organic young red wine
has a deep ruby hue with fresh
aromas of red berries and a
touch of oak. On the palate, it
is vibrant and well-balanced.
A short time in oak adds
subtle hints of vanilla, roasted
flavors, and coconut.

name: Miguel Domecq Entrechuelos Tercer Año
wine_color: An intense, opaque ruby red color.
style: Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, Tintilla De Rota
desc_en_short: A bold yet approachable Spanish red blend from Miguel Domecq, weaving Syrah, Merlot, Cabernet Sauvignon, and the rare Tintilla de Rota into a generous, oak-kissed wine layered with ripe red fruit, cinnamon, cocoa, and cedar spice.

name: Wines N’ Roses Highway To Hell Monastrell
wine_color: Cherry red with violet hues at the rim.
desc_en_short:
Cherry red with violet hues at
the rim, this wine has an intense
aroma of ripe red and black
fruits, with balsamic, licorice,
and minty notes. On the palate, it
is full and fresh, with a rounded
mouthfeel, balanced fruitiness,
and a light, smooth finish

name: Bodegas Valoria Viña Valoria Tempranillo Rioja D.O.
wine_color: Cherry red color with garnet undertones.

name: Askaneli Saperavi Qvevri
desc_en_short:
This intense dark ruby wine
is adorned with sophisticated
aromas of blackberry, black
pepper, and sour cherry. The
beauty of the wine is especially
emphasized by its impeccable
balance of higher acidity, full
body, and prolonged velvety
finish

name: Askaneli Kindzmarauli Red
desc_en_short: This exquisite Georgian wine showcases a deep ruby color and a bouquet of ripe berries and cherries, complemented by hints of blackberries. Enjoy a smooth, velvety texture with balanced sweetness and lingering fruity notes. Perfect for any occasion.

name: Askaneli Saperavi Red
desc_en_short:
A classic dry red wine, the
Askaneli Saperavi boasts a
robust profile with aromas
of blackberry, black pepper,
and sour cherry. It offers a
refreshing acidity, rich tannins,
and a medium velvety finish,
making it perfect for pairing
with hearty red meats or root
vegetables.

name: Roodeberg 1949
desc_en_short:
This deep, ruby coloured,
concentrated red blend shows
prominent aromas of dark
cherry, blackcurrant and dried
herbs. On the palate Cinnamon,
sweet spice and ripe, juicy dark
fruit together with a firm
tannin structure, ensures good
length and an enduring finish.

name: Arione Barolo D.O.C.G.
style: Nebbiolo, Subvarieties Of Lampia, Rosé, Michet
desc_en_short:
Garnet red with orange nuances.
Intense bouquet of violet and rose
flowers. Dry, full-body, robust,
austere, and velvety.

name: Arione Barbaresco D.O.C.G.
style: Nebbiolo, Subvarieties Of Lampia, Rosé, Michet
desc_en_short:
Garnet red with orange nuances.
Intense bouquet of cherry and violet.
Dry, full-bodied, tannic, and velvety

name: Arione Barbera D’Asti D.O.C.G.
wine_color: Bright ruby-red when young, garnet red tones when aged.
desc_en_short:
Bright ruby-red when young,
garnet red tones when aged. Winy
and intense with hints of withered
flowers. Dry, round taste, tannic and
softer with aging

name: Arione Dolcetto D’Alba D.O.C.G.
wine_color: Intense ruby red with violet nuances in the foam.
desc_en_short:
Intense ruby red with violet nuances
in the foam. Pleasant and fruity
bouquet. Dry, slightly bitter, tannic,
and harmonious.

name: Arione Bonarada Dell’Olteprò Pavese Frizzante D.O.C.
Bera Basarin Barbaresco Riserva
desc_en_short: Forest floor, leather, scorched earth and grilled herb aromas shape the nose. Firmly structured, the palate offers licorice, dried cherry.

name: Bera Rabajà Barbaresco D.O.C.G. Riserva
desc_en_short:
The smell of an elegant bouquet,
composite and ethereal with
aromas of violet, red fruit jam,
spices like pepper and vanilla.
Elegant, dry, balanced, good
structure, and tannins.

name: Bera Barbaresco D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Characteristic aromas that are
ethereal, pleasing, and intense
with a taste that is full, dry, harsh
but velvety and harmonious.

name: Bera Barolo D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Bright garnet red color. Ethereal
and spicy, very persistent, with
light notes of vanilla, cocoa,
coffee, licorice and hints of truffle.
On the palate it is dry and full and
well balanced.

name: Bera Dolcetto D’Alba D.O.C.
wine_color: Ruby red with violet and blackberry reflections.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red with violet and blackberry reflections.
Winey, pleasant, and characteristic. Dry, pleasantly
bitterish, moderately acid, and harmonious with a
good body

name: Bera Barbera D’Asti Superiore
desc_en_short:
A wine with strong vinous and fruity notes, reminiscent
of raspberries and blackberries, finishing with a hint of
light spice, very enveloping and fresh on the palate. Its long
persistence allows it to be paired with fairly structured
dishes, such as a risotto with meat sauce or a second course
of meat or game.

name: Bera Brachetto Piemonte D.O.C.
style: Red Grape Varieties Authorized By The Denomination Langhe
desc_en_short:
Aromatic and fragrant perfume, with a fruity
character. Tastes like sparkling wine, sweet, delicate,
and soft, with aromatic persistence.

name: Po’ Rosso Selezione Premium
desc_en_short: Po' Rosso Selezione Premium is a smooth, fruit-forward Italian red from Piedmont, offering inviting aromas of pomegranate, ripe red fruits, and vanilla with a soft, well-balanced palate and a gently woody character that lingers elegantly on the finish.

name: Cantine Di Ora “Amicale” Rosso Veneto I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red color with delicate and
vinous bouquet characterized by
intense raspberry and black cherry
aroma. In the mouth, it is fullbodied, soft, and velvety, with hints
of spices and chocolate thanks to the
slow aging in tonneaux.

name: Cantine Di Ora “Amicale” Limited Edition Corvina Verona I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Intense ruby red color and
bouquet with fruity and intense
aromas with hints of cherry.
Full and enveloping on the
palate, with hints of blueberries
and marked plum notes.

name: Le Morette Bardolino D.O.C. Classico
desc_en_short:
Light-bright rose in colour
with a fragrant, fresh, and
fruity flavour. It has a dry
taste, full of balance and
with delicate spicy notes,
it is endowed with good
persistence.

name: Le Morette Serai Rosso Veronese I.G.T.
wine_color: Deep ruby color with purple shades.
desc_en_short:
Deep ruby color with purple
shades. With fruity bouquet
reminiscent of cherry, plum
and berries; at palate it is
balanced, medium bodied,
fresh and soft, with enveloping
structure.

name: Le Morette Perseo Veneto Rosso I.G.T.
desc_en_short: Le Morette Perseo is a richly structured Veneto Rosso I.G.T. blending Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon into a full-bodied red with deep ruby colour, aromas of roasted notes and red fruit, and a long, persistently flavourful finish.

name: Terre Di Rai Cabernet Sauvignon Tre Venezie I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red with pomegranate-colored
highlights. Notes reminding of berries
such as dewberry, strawberry, and
raspberry. Full-bodied with soft tannins
and a final fruity taste

name: Terre Di Rai Cabernet Franc Tre Venezie I.G.T
desc_en_short: A graceful 100% Cabernet Franc from the Tre Venezie IGT zone, Terre Di Rai delivers ruby-red elegance with aromas of oriental spice, cinnamon, and a signature herbal lift — soft in tannin, complex on the palate, and built for easy, rewarding drinking.

name: Terre Di Rai Merlot Tre Venezie I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Ruby-red with violet highlights. It
reminds of cherries, mixed berries with
some hints of cinnamon. Full, soft body
with a final fruity taste.

name: Terre Di Rai 931 Appassimento Veneto Rosso Passito I.G.T.
desc_en_short: A richly expressive Veneto Rosso Passito from Terre Di Rai, crafted via appassimento to concentrate flavours of ripe plum, raisin, and dark chocolate, with gentle oak aging adding layers of spice for a harmonious, mature finish.

name: Tinazzi Tenuta Valleselle Aureum Acinum Amarone Della Valpolicella D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Intense, deep red. Elegant,
with hints of mature red fruit,
especially cherries and marasca
cherries. Spicy hints and a finale
of chocolate and liquorice. A wine
of great structure and elegance,
with the right balance between
tannicity and softness

name: Tinazzi Tenuta Valleselle Rovertondo Valpolicella Ripasso D.O.P. Superiore
desc_en_short: A richly expressive Valpolicella Ripasso Superiore from Tinazzi's Tenuta Valleselle estate, double-fermented over Amarone skins to deliver concentrated flavours of plum and sour cherry, laced with warming spice and a persistent, elegant finish.

name: Tinazzi Opera N°3 Vino Rosso
style: Nero D’avola, Corvina, Corvina Veronese, Primitivo
desc_en_short:
Opaque, intense red. Mature red
fruits with a cloak of enveloping
spicy notes and hints of chocolate
and liquorice. Great strength,
balance and persistence.

name: Tinazzi Tenuta Valleselle Ripa Magna Corvina Verona I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Deep red. Ample and characteristic
bouquet, with hints of spices and
ripe red fruit. Full, velvety taste
with good persistence and just
the right level of tannins. Very
drinkable.

name: Tinazzi Tenuta Valleselle Pieve San Vito Bardolino D.O.P. Classico
desc_en_short:
Bright deep red. Delicate hints
of cherry and rose with slightly
spicy notes. Flavoursome and
harmonious with medium
persistence.

name: Tinazzi Tenuta Valleselle Introl Della Torre Merlot Veneto I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Intense, deep red. Intense and
harmonious, with fruit and spices
and a slight hint of herbs. Fullbodied and elegant with just the
right level of tannins and a long
finale.

name: Tinazzi Valpolicella Ripasso D.O.P. Superiore
desc_en_short: Aromas Fruity bouquet, in which plum and cherry stand out, enhanced by spicy hints and a light balsamic vein. Strong flavour. Balanced, soft tannins. Good persistence

name: Poderi Campopian Marziale Amarone Della Valpolicella D.O.P. Classico Riserva
wine_color: Deep ruby red with garnet hints.
desc_en_short:
Deep ruby red with garnet hints.
Overripe red fruits aromas, spices
and toasting. Balanced on the
palate thanks to the alcohol content
and fine tannins. Very pleasant to
drink.

name: Poderi Campopian Lunante Valpolicella Ripasso D.O.P. Classico Superiore
desc_en_short:
Bright red in colour. Fruity notes
o f cherry and plum stand out on
the nose, completed by spicy notes
o f vanilla and cacao. Rich and
intense on the palate, persistent in
the finale.

name: Poderi Campopian Reguso Valpolicella D.O.P. Classico Superiore
desc_en_short:
Bright red in colour. Cherry and
blackberry dominate the bouquet
of red fruit. The taste is pleasing,
intense and balanced.

name: Tenuta Del Principe Sereso Riserva Romagna D.O.C.Sangiovese Superiore
desc_en_short:
Fruity scents, complemented by soft tertiary notes
of vanilla, licorice, and cocoa. The wine’s complex
aromas are reflected on the palate, showcasing
vibrant youth with noticeable acidity and sharp but
pleasant tannins. The wine’s balance leans towards
its more “hard” characteristics, and its significant
alcohol content suggests excellent potential for
aging and development in the bottle.

name: Tenuta Del Principe Larone Rosso Rubicone I.G.P.
desc_en_short: A richly layered red from Emilia-Romagna, Tenuta Del Principe's Larone Rosso delivers a sweeter-astringent character with aromas of plum, tobacco, vanilla, and smoked dark berries — an expressive Italian everyday red with surprising depth and complexity.

name: Stella Del Sud Favara Rosso Terre Siciliane I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Rich reddish-purple color and
the juicy aroma of mature fruit,
especially black mulberry. On the
palate, the wine offers a delightful
combination of cherry sweetness
and the lively taste of mature
pomegranate. It also features
well-defined tannins, a surprising
persistence, and a clear freshness.

name: Stella Del Sud Ummari Syrah Vendemmia Tardiva
desc_en_short:
Dark berries, strawberry and
cherry jam, prunes and plums
with hints of pepper, chocolate,
licorice and balsamic. Powerful
and intense wine with a rich,
almost black color and creamy
texture. Made from a late harvest
and a 30-day maceration, it
extracts maximum dyes, tannins,
and flavors from the grape skins.

name: Potente Rosso Rubicone Appassimento
wine_color: A deep ruby red color with violet reflections.
desc_en_short: A deeply expressive Italian appassimento-style blend of Merlot and Syrah from Rubicone, delivering lush cherry, blackberry, and candied fruit with warming spice, silky structure, and a long, sweetly concentrated finish that lingers beautifully.

name: Sir Maiale Sangiovese Rubicone Appassimento
desc_en_short:
Aromas of sweet wood, spices,
ripe red fruits, and violet lead to
a velvety palate of plum, black
cherry jam, and a balsamic touch.
Refined tannins add depth and a
long, elegant finish.

name: Sir Maiale Rosso Passito
desc_en_short: Sir Maiale Rosso Passito is a rich, fruit-driven Montepulciano d'Abruzzo from Puglia, offering lush aromas of dark berries, plum, and vanilla with a smooth, juicy palate and a lingering, velvet-soft finish.

name: Sir Maiale Primitivo Appassimento
desc_en_short: Sir Maiale's Primitivo Appassimento from Abruzzo delivers a luscious, full-bodied red built on partially dried Primitivo grapes, layering prune, cherry jam, tobacco, and a long cocoa-and-vanilla finish into something genuinely indulgent.

name: Sir Maiale Negroamaro Appassimento
desc_en_short:
Deep purple red with complex
aromas of spices, ripe fruits, and
cherry jam. Full-bodied, balanced,
and rich in fine tannins, it offers a
long, pleasant finish.

name: Reguta Giuseppe E Luigi Temporale I.G.P.
wine_color: Ruby red color with purple nuances, tending to garnet with aging.
desc_en_short: A polished Bordeaux-style blend from Friuli-Venezia Giulia, Reguta's Temporale IGP weaves together 60% Cabernet Sauvignon and 40% Merlot into a full-bodied, fruit-forward red with ripe blueberry, blackberry, and warm vanilla-oak complexity — elegant, persistent, and built for the table.

name: Reguta Giuseppe & Luigi Schioppettino Tre Venezie I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Clear ruby red, with an intense and
lasting perfume. In addition, the
aroma of cherry, blueberry, and
nutmeg is noticeable. Mediumbodied in taste, quite tannic for
sweet win

name: Reguta Giuseppe & Luigi Malbech Tre Venezie I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Beautiful dark ruby. The aroma
of wine combines fresh berry
shades with noted of vanilla,
chocolate and toast. Full and soft
taste, excellent balance and perfect
structure.

name: Reguta Merlot Tre Venezie I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Ruby-red. Delicate when young,
pleasant with aging. Dry taste,
sapid, full-bodied with tannins,
and harmonious.

name: Reguta Pinot Nero Tre Venezie I.G.P.
Reguta Tazzelenghe Tre Venezie I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red tending to garnet.
Intense, fruity, and spicy notes after
aging. Strong wine with marked
tannins and sourness which are its
most important characteristics.

name: Monnalisa Sangiovese Di Romagna D.O.C. Superiore
wine_color: This wine has a warm red-purple color with amaranth shades.
desc_en_short:
This wine has a warm red-purple
color with amaranth shades. It
offers fruity aromas with a hint
of spices and crisp cherries. On
the palate, it is fresh, lively, and
persistent with a vertical structure.

name: Monnalisa Montepulciano D’Abruzzo D.O.C.
wine_color: This wine has an intense red color with violet and purple hues.
desc_en_short: A vibrant Montepulciano d'Abruzzo from the sun-drenched hills of central Italy, Monnalisa delivers ripe red fruit, black pepper spice, and a creamy, mineral-driven palate shaped by the cooling influence of the nearby Adriatic Sea.

name: Monnalisa Toscana I.G.T. Rosso
wine_color: This wine has an intense ruby red color with warm violet hints.
desc_en_short:
This wine has an intense ruby
red color with warm violet hints.
It features a complex bouquet of
ripe cherries, vanilla, and aged
whiskey. On the palate, it is soft
and round, with a persistent body
and structured woody notes from
oak barrel aging.

name: Abbadia Ardenga Brunello Di Montalcino D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Abbadia Ardenga, a winery
which is part of the history of
Brunello di Montalcino, is extremely
special and definitely worth visiting,
not only for its products but also for its
outstanding charm. The estate has a
very long history, having once belonged
to the powerful Piccolomini family,
whose members included Pope Pius II,
responsible for the construction of the
town of Pienza, a masterpiece of the
Renaissance.

name: Abbadia Ardenga Brunello Di Montalcino Riserva D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Abbadia Ardenga, a winery
which is part of the history of
Brunello di Montalcino, is extremely
special and definitely worth visiting,
not only for its products but also for its
outstanding charm. The estate has a
very long history, having once belonged
to the powerful Piccolomini family,
whose members included Pope Pius II,
responsible for the construction of the
town of Pienza, a masterpiece of the
Renaiss

name: Abbadia Ardenga Vigna Piaggia Brunello Di Montalcino D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Abbadia Ardenga, a winery
which is part of the history of
Brunello di Montalcino, is extremely
special and definitely worth visiting,
not only for its products but also for its
outstanding charm. The estate has a
very long history, having once belonged
to the powerful Piccolomini family,
whose members included Pope Pius II,
responsible for the construction of the
town of Pienza, a masterpiece of the
Renaissance.

name: Abbadia Ardenga Rosso Di Montalcino D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short: From one of Montalcino's most historically rooted estates, Abbadia Ardenga's Rosso di Montalcino offers the elegance of Sangiovese Grosso in a more approachable style — vibrant red fruit, earthy depth, and the classic structure that makes this appellation so compelling.

name: Astrale Chianti Riserva D.O.C.G
wine_color: Deep dark red black tinged core with a dark red hue.
desc_en_short:
Deep dark red black tinged core
with a dark red hue. Ripe red to
black currant aromas mix with
dusty earth, dried herb, tobacco
and spice notes. Medium bodied
the palate has an earthy flavour
profile of ripe red currants,
spicy cedar, dried herbs and light
tobacco. Good fresh acidity with
slightly dryish tannins and a
rustic yet savoury aftertaste.

name: Bulichella Hide Syrah Costa Toscana I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
“A very impressive syrah from Suvereto. It offers plenty of black and blue fruit, with
dark chocolate, licorice and hints of balsamic, smoke and meat. Full-bodied and
broad-shouldered, yet so fine and silky that it almost feels weightless. Super-polished
tannins that run the whole length of the wine. Shows mineral complexity. Very
long, tense and powerful. Drink or hold.”

name: Bulichella Montecristo Suvereto D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Bold and complex, hints of red
berries, cocoa, and coffee. Full and
harmonious, smooth tannins with
a long finish

name: Bulichella Coldipietrerosse Suvereto D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Very pronounced with aromas
of dark fruits, red currants,
blueberries, hints of cocoa, and
tobacco. Full, smooth, and elegant
with a long, persistent finish.

name: Bulichella Rubino Costa Toscana Rosso I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Bold and aromatic with hints
of red berries. Smooth, light
tannin structure with a lingering
aftertaste.

name: Castelvecchio Il Castelvecchio Chianti Colli Fiorentini D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Deep ruby red. Very intense, with
hints of ripe red berries and black
flowers, a little spicy. Moderately
dry as soft tannins and good
persistence, acquiring a velvety
texture with ageing in bottle.

name: Castelvecchio Orme In Rosso Rosso Toscano I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Deep ruby red.. Mature red
and dark berries, intense, very
fragrant with balsamic notes
and hints of herbs. Full bodied,
fruity with spicy hints, light
savoury and mineral, elegant body
and harmonious tannins, good
persistence in the aftertaste.

name: Castelvecchio Numero Otto Canaiolo Rosso Toscano I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red. Very fruity, variegated,
fresh, and floral with aromas of
violet. Medium-bodied. Tannic
structure with light balsamic hints
and smooth and silky tannins
not aggressive or intrusive,
characteristics of this particular
wine

name: Loacker Valdifalco Morellino Di Scansano D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Intense purple red. To the nose rich
with red fruits, ripe black cherry,
blackberry and blackcurrant. It
opens up and offers ethereal scents
after a little while. Tannins are
strong. Long, warm and soft
finish.

name: Loacker Valdifalco Maremma Toscana Syrah Lodolaia D.O.C.
desc_en_short: Loacker's Lodolaia is a Maremma Toscana Syrah of genuine character — ruby-red and aromatic, with dark spice, graphite, and a touch of vanilla weaving through a structured yet harmonious palate that rewards both the curious and the committed.

name: Loacker Corte Pavone Rosso Di Montalcino D.O.C.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red. Ethereal notes together
with violet, forest floor, licorice,
plum, spices and tobacco. Lively
acidity and strong yet silky
tannins. Pleasant final, long, dry
and persistent

name: Loacker Corte Pavone Brunello Di Montalcino D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Bright ruby red, in the nose aromas
of eucalyptus, liquorice, raspberry
and black pepper. Well integrated
tannins with a nice acidity.
A Brunello with tremendous
juiciness. The allrounder with
durability.

name: Loacker Falko Rosso Toscana Rosso I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red. The nose is very neat
and clean: red fruits with a bit
of spices and hints of eucalyptus.
Good dry tannins.

name: Poliziano Rosso Di Montepulciano D.O.C.
desc_en_short:
This Rosso di Montepulciano is
characterized by a ruby red color.
The nose opens with hints of red
fruits, enriched by pleasant spicy
notes. On the palate it is young,
full-bodied and pleasantly fruity

name: Poliziano Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
This Nobile di Montepulciano
is characterized by a clear ruby
red color. The nose opens with
hints of mulberry and plums,
enriched with pleasant spicy notes
of cinchona and tobacco. On the
palate it is balanced, with smooth
tannins and good freshness

name: Poliziano Chianti Colli Senesi D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Ruby in colour. The nose is rich
and expressive; in particular,
the hints of red fruits and spicy
notes stand out. On the palate it
is energetic, incisive and full of
satisfaction

name: Poliziano Le Stanze Del Poliziano Toscana I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red, the nose expresses
beautiful notes of cherry, black
cherry, oriental spices. On the
palate it is fresh, enveloping,
characterized by a tannic texture
of impeccable texture. Good
persistence.

name: Poliziano Asinone Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Red berry, chopped herb, toast and
a whiff of French oak are some
of the aromas that take shape in
the glass. The taut, elegant palate
offers bright wild cherry, licorice
and vanilla alongside tightly
wound, finegrained tannins that
leave a firm finish. Give this time
to unwind and fully develop

name: Poliziano Le Caggiole Vino Nobile Di Montepulciano D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short: From one of Montepulciano's most storied estates, Poliziano Le Caggiole is a single-vineyard Vino Nobile that delivers classic Sangiovese character — fragrant red fruit, polished tannins, and a spice-laced finish with genuine depth and persistence.

name: Lohsa Morellino Di Scansano D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Intense ruby red color. The
olfactory profile is dominated
by aromas of cherry, morello
cherry, violet, thyme and vanilla.
The sip is warm, enjoyable and
harmonious, of great pleasantness
and persistence.

name: Tenuta Moraia Perpiero Rosso Toscana I.G.T.
wine_color: The colour is an intense, lively ruby with purple hues.
grape_variety: Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese, Cabernet Franc, Pecorino
desc_en_short: A modern Tuscan blend from the wild coastal Maremma, Tenuta Moraia's Perpiero weaves Cabernet Sauvignon, Sangiovese, and Cabernet Franc into a velvety, fruit-driven red alive with black cherry, blueberry, and warm Mediterranean spice.

name: Tenuta Moraia Apricaia Toscana I.G.T.
style: Cabernet Sauvignon Merlot And Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short:
The fruity essences of morello
cherry, strawberry and
blueberry stand out, framed
by the delicious harmonies of
chocolate. In every sip, Apricaia
reveals its wonderful complexity
and elegance. Intense licorice
and mineral notes caress the
palate, while a smooth and silky
tannic texture accompanies the
finish.

name: Valiano Poggio Teo Chianti Classico Bio D.O.C.G.
wine_color: Intense ruby red colour with garnet hues.
desc_en_short:
Intense ruby red colour with garnet
hues. Gentle embrace of lavender
and white musk, warmed by the
prosperous reminiscences of red
cherry, agapanthus flowers and
pepper. The ferrous touch of the vine
of origin gives the wine roundness.

name: Valiano Poggio Teo Chianti Classico Riserva Bio D.O.C.G.
desc_en_short:
Enchanting ruby red colour, with
elegant purple reflections. The nose
intones red cherries and blackberries,
and aromatic herbs. The sip amazes
with its freshness and fullness. The
old vine adds a mineral and savoury
trait, with sweetness and roundness
of the fruit.

name: Valiano Pecchero Cabernet Franc Toscana I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Preciuos ruby red colour. The
fruity bouquet offers marvellous
harmonies of plum and mint,
supported by the exotic texture
of toasted coffee. On the palate,
mint and sweet spice merge into
an enveloping finish. The elegant
tannins and the great structure
give the wine a wonderful ageing
potential.

name: Valiano San Lazzaro Chianti Classico Gran Selezione
wine_color: It proudly shows a superb ruby red colour, enriched by precious purple hues.
desc_en_short:
It proudly shows a superb ruby red
colour, enriched by precious purple
hues. Its delicious fruity bouquet
offers sumptuous aromas of black
cherry, raspberry and vanilla. The
soft tannic texture gives the wine
an enchanting persistence, which
gently leads to a pleasant savoury
note.

name: Feudi Bizantini Il Rabdomante Montepulciano D’Abruzzo D.O.P.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red with garnet reflections,
intense and persistent fragrance;
the bouquet is intense, fruity,
persistent, with notes of dried
flowers, spice, licorice, and
marasca cherries. The palate is
stylish, velvety, almost creamy,
and compact with a tannic
structure that blends nicely with
the alcoholic component. Great
structure, complex, elegant, well
balanced with a long aftertaste.

name: Feudi Bizantini Passofino Montepulciano D’Abruzzo D.O.P.
wine_color: A ruby red color with garnet reflections.

name: Vasu Vasu Primo Bacio- Unforgettable
wine_color: An intense deep ruby red wine.
style: Red Blend. Montepulciano D’abruzzo And Merlot
desc_en_short:
An intense deep ruby red wine
with aromas of ripe fruit, wild
cherry, dried plums, pepper, and
blueberries. The palate is fullbodied, complex, and balanced,
with a pleasant touch of sweetness
from partially dried grapes that
enhance its rich aromatic profile
and structure.

name: Vasu Vasu Montepulciano D’Abruzzo D.O.C.
desc_en_short:
Ruby red with violet undertones.
Intense bouquet of ripe red fruit.
Rich in fruit, lively, and finely
framed by oak spices.

name: Nativ Segreti Irpinia Rosso D.O.C.
desc_en_short:
Intense ruby red. Wellstructured on the palate; hints
of plums, chocolate, currant,
blackberries, cherries, and
spices.

name: Nativ Eremo San Quirico Irpinia Campi Taurasini D.O.C.
desc_en_short:
The wine is very concentrated, the
palate is dense. On the nose, it has
aromas of ripe red fruits, spice,
and Maiatica cherry. Barrels
support aromas without covering
them

name: Nativ Eremo San Quirico Gold Irpinia Campi Taurasini D.O.C.
desc_en_short: A concentrated Aglianico from Campania's Irpinia hills, this Nativ bottling delivers dense, fruit-driven depth — ripe cherry, Maiatica cherry, and warming spice framed by thoughtful barrel ageing that amplifies rather than overwhelms the variety's natural character.

name: Nativ Bicento Irpinia Campi Taurasini D.O.C.
desc_en_short: A pure expression of Aglianico from Campania's volcanic Irpinia hills, Nativ Bicento Irpinia Campi Taurasini delivers a dense, velvety palate layered with ripe plums, licorice, rhubarb, warming spice, and earthy tobacco — a serious southern Italian red at an accessible price.

name: Nativ Velluto Rosso Irpinia Aglianico I.G.T.
wine_color: Red color with intense violet nuances.
desc_en_short:
Red color with intense violet
nuances. Hints of red fruits
pervade the nose, with notes of
spices and chocolate. The palate is
soft and well-balanced.

name: Nativ Suadens Rosso Campania Rosso I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
Fresh, well-balanced, and
structured. Soft and fruity on the
palate, with notes of Maiatica
cherries, plums, blue raspberries,
chestnuts, nuts.

name: Nativ Adamocampania Piedirosso
desc_en_short:
Lush, layered scent of sweet dark
forest fruit, violets, vanilla and
cocoa. Powerful, full, lively and
satiny in taste with sweet cherries,
blueberries, raspberries covered
with milk chocolate and mocha.
Endless layers.

name: Boccantino Primitivo Da Uve Leggermente Appassite Salento I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
With its ruby red color and its
complex bouquet is characterized
by intense and fine aromas, that
go from mature fruit to spicy notes

name: Boccantino Nero Di Troia Primitivo
desc_en_short:
Cherries and tobacco on the nose,
round, soft and with a velvety
mouth feel. It is a classic southern
Italian red.

name: Boccantino Primitivo Susumaniello Salento I.G.T.
wine_color: Dark red color with purple hints.
desc_en_short:
Dark red color with purple hints.
Complex bouquet with red fruits
aroma and spicy notes. In the
mouth it is warm and intense

name: Masseria La Volpe Uno “1” Riserva Premium Edition Primitivo Di Manduria D.O.C.
wine_color: The color is dark ruby red.
desc_en_short: A bold Primitivo di Manduria Riserva from Masseria La Volpe, this premium edition delivers layers of ripe plum, dark cherry, licorice, and vanilla, perfectly balanced with soft tannins and a remarkably long, spice-laced finish.

name: Masseria La Volpe Uno “1” Primitivo Di Manduria D.O.C.
desc_en_short:
Intense ruby red color with a
bouquet of mature fruits and
spicy notes. On the mouth, it is
delicate and well-balanced.

name: Montemajor Equinox Aglianico Piedirosso Campania Rosso I.G.T.
wine_color: The wine has a ruby red color.
desc_en_short:
The wine has a ruby red color,
with a good structure and a lick
of freshness. Intense and complex
with floral and fruity notes of
cherry, red fruits, and spices.
Wellbodied, balanced and round
with a harmonious taste

name: Montemajor Quattronotti Appassimento Puglia Negroamaro I.G.T.
wine_color: Red ruby is loaded with purple
desc_en_short:
Red ruby is loaded with purple,
complex intense, and persistent
aroma with hints of red berries.
Powerful and fruity taste with
hints of licorice, blueberry, and
currant.

name: Montemajor Fletris Appassimento Puglia Primitivo I.G.T.
desc_en_short:
The dry heat of southern
Italy gives life to an excellent
maturation of the Primitivo
grapes which develop berries with
spicy notes, with a bewitching
structure. The wine has a complex
bouquet of red fruits, raisins and
morello cherries

name: Montemajor Campo Del Re Primitivo Merlot Puglia Rosso I.G.T.
desc_en_short: Ruby to purple color, the taste is persistent. On the nose, it has an intense and complex flavor with hints of wild berries.

name: Tagaro Passo Del Sud Zinfandel Puglia I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Deep red with ruby reflections.
Fragrance is intense and fruity
with well-balanced notes of
jam and spices. Taste full, soft
and persistent, as the fragrance
sensations, wisely balanced tannic.

name: Tagaro Passo Del Sud Negroamaro Primitivo Puglia I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Deep red with ruby reflections.
Fragrance is intense and persistent
and spices. Taste soft and persistent
with pleasant notes of blueberry
and blackberry, with a soft, sweet,
and well balanced tannin.

name: Tagaro Pintataro Nero Di Troia Puglia I.G.P.
wine_color: A red wine with an intense red color with violet hues
desc_en_short:
A red wine with an intense red
color with violet hues. Its aroma is
intense and fruity, with sweet and
spicy notes. Long-lasting soft taste
and skillfully balanced tannins.

name: Tagaro Pintataro Aglianico Puglia I.G.P.
wine_color: Red wine with distinct ruby hues.
desc_en_short:
Red wine with distinct ruby
hues. Its aroma is intense and
long-lasting, with subtle notes
of red fruits and spices. Soft and
embracing taste, with pleasant
cranberry and blackberry notes,
soft, sweet, and balanced tannins.

name: Tagaro Verdazzo Verdeca Puglia I.G.P.
desc_en_short:
Very aromatic white wines. This
Verdazzo gives off strong scents
of sun-baked white fruits such as
lychee and gooseberry. The taste
is full, soft, and creamy with some
refined acidity that gives the wine
some freshness.

name: Tagaro Muso Rosso Collection Primitivo Di Manduria D.O.P.
wine_color: Deep red with ruby red reflections.
desc_en_short:
The premium red wine color is
deep red with ruby red reflections.
Full and characterful red fruits
mixed with spicy notes. The wine
has a somewhat jammy character.

name: Tagaro Sei Caselle Salice Salentino D.O.P.
desc_en_short:
Red with ruby reflections. Full
and characteristic with red fruits
mixed with spiced notes

name: Tagaro Mancinello Nero Di Troia Puglia I.G.P.
desc_en_short: Masseria Tagaro's Mancinello showcases Nero di Troia, Puglia's noble indigenous red grape, delivering a medium-bodied wine with dark fruit, warm spice, and earthy character — a compelling expression of southern Italy's viticultural heritage at an approachable price.

desc_en_short: Ruby red color. fruits and subtle vanilla notes that rehaussent the complexity of the bouquet. on the palate full bodied, rich and well structured, requiring several years of ageing.

name: Chateau Gloria  Saint-Julien 2022
desc_en_short: Cassis, spicy oak, exotic blue fruits, and chocolate notes all emerge from the 2022 Château Gloria, a concentrated yet beautifully balanced, medium to full-bodied effort from this team. It has terrific purity, a chalky sense of minerality, ample tannins, and a great finish.

name: Chateau Gazin  Pomerol 2020
desc_en_short: I continue to absolutely love the wines from this Pomerol chateau, and their Grand Vin always brings a richness and depth that makes it a joy to drink. Coming from a larger vineyard near Petrus, La Fleur Petrus, and Le Gay, the dense purple hue of the 2020 Chateau Gazin is followed by a rocking bouquet of ripe black cherries, currants, melted chocolate, roasted herbs, and earth.

name: Chateau Ducru Beaucaillou  2021
desc_en_short:
Chateau Ducru Beaucaillou Winery

Château Ducru Beaucaillou is named after the beautiful, large stones found in its unique wine-growing terroir. This exceptional ecosystem produces fine, elegant, tasty wines with a long finish - in short, archetypical Saint-Julien wines.

Perched on an exceptional site with incomparable views over the Gironde estuary, in the center of a hundred-year-old park, Ducru-Beaucaillou is a majestic, Victorian-style castle, which has, over time, become one of the great symbols of the Médoc. Unusual for Bordeaux, it is built directly above the barrel cellars, enveloping its owners, who have lived here for over sixty years.

Today, the estate is managed by the company Jean Eugène Borie SA, which is owned by Mrs Borie, her daughter Sabine Coiffe and her son Bruno-Eugène, CEO since 2003, the third generation of the Borie family to head the estate. There are very close links between this estate and the five families who have been its successive owners.

name: Chateau Les Maurins Aop Bordeaux
desc_en_short: Smooth and seamlessly structured with ripe black fruits and fine chalky tannins. It’s a bright as a button with lively fruit f.lavours extending to a very long finish.

name: J. Lohr Carol Vineyards St. Helena Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short:
Carol’s Vineyard enjoys gravelly, sandy loam soils and a Bordeaux-like climate suited to producing luxury-quality
Cabernet. Classically dark in color, this complex single-vineyard wine displays notes of cherry and black
plum with a toasted oak bouquet - a perfect pairing for grilled rib eye steak or pasta with mushroom cream sauce.

name: J. Lohr Cuvee Pau
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Cabernet Franc And 5% Merlot
desc_en_short: Inspired by the compositions traditionally used in the acclaimed winegrowing regions of Pauillac. Free from varietal percentage restrictions, our winemakers blend each wine to its maximum artistic expression of flavor.

name: J. Lohr Los Osos Merlot
desc_en_short:
Intense and complex bouquet of red, black and blueberries intermixed with notes of Crème de Cassis, plum, cedar and a hint of cigar box. Full-bodied, the palate is reminiscent of the nose, with a creamy texture and a great intensity. The luscious tannins, the intense aromatic complexity and its opulence create a flamboyant yet 
harmonious ensemble, leading to a very long, complex and smooth finish.

name: J. Lohr Pure Paso Proprietary Red Wine
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Petite Sirah, 2% Malbec, 2% Saint Macaire, 1% Merlot
desc_en_short:
Sustainably grown and produced, this superb Chardonnay layers inviting aromas of blossoms, peach, and necThis Pure Paso Proprietary Red Wine pays tribute to J. Lohr’s history of sustainable grape growing and winemak-ing in Paso Robles by showcasing our most popular varietal, Cabernet Sauvignon, in a blend with the unctuous Petite Sirah grape, in honor of our first bottling from 1974. A duality of flavors entwining savory characters and overt blackberry notes in the J. Lohr house-style, Pure Paso.

Savory varietal notes of Cabernet Sauvignon are layered with the dark fruit character of Petite Sirah. The bouquet of cocoa powder, caramel, and anise works in harmony with the black cherry fruit signature of this wine. Bright and focused on the palate, with a firm and appetizing finish.tarine with fresh flavors of citrus, apple, and cream. A light touch of oak on the long finish completes an authentic classic.

name: Morlet Coeur De Vallee Oakville Cabernet Sauvignon 2016
desc_en_short: Intense and complex bouquet of red, black and blueberries intermixed with notes of cassis, Quesch plum, blond tobacco and a hint of black pepper. Full-bodied, the palate is reminiscent of the nose, with a creamy texture, richness, powerful mid-palate and beautiful depth. The silky tannins and complex aromas create a harmonious ensemble, leading to a very long and smooth finish. This collectible wine will age gracefully for decades.

name: Santa Helena Gran Reserva Cabernet Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Good structure in the mouth with smooth, ripe tannins that give way to a long and pleasant finish.

name: Chateau Margaux 2006
desc_en_short:
The 1995 vintage of this wine was ranked #2 on the Wine Spectator's Top 10 Wines of 1998

This wine has an extraordinary aromatic finesse, a tannic richness and a particularly dense and tight-knit texture. The finish is very long, fresh and lively, a little bit firm but already packed with flavor. Such balance is a brilliant expression of Chateau Margaux's noble terroir.

name: Chateau Mouton Rothschild  2006 (Premiers Crus)
wine_color: An intense garnet hue with glittering highlights.
desc_en_short: The wine is an attractive, intense and dark cherry red. With Cabernet Sauvignon predominant, the blend of Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2006 expresses a complex and intense array of aromas, combining fruit (bilberry) and milky notes with the toasted aromas (blond tobacco, incense, toasted hazelnut) of judicious oak. The precise and harmonious attack is prolonged by fresh and crisp, richly flavoured tannins, while the palate is full, creamy and powerful. Chateau Mouton Rothschild 2006 is in the line of the great classics produced by the estate.

name: Chateau Pouget Margaux
desc_en_short: A distinguished Margaux Grand Cru Classé (1855) from the legendary 2000 vintage — elegant blackcurrant, cedar, and truffle notes with silky tannins and a long, refined finish. A timeless Bordeaux for collectors.

name: Mantellassi San Giuseppe Morellino Di Scansano Maremma

style: Corvina Veronese 70%, Rondinella 20%, Molinara And Other Indigenous Varieties 10%.

The wine is obtained by going over again, once only, the premium Valpolicella Classico over the same quantity of Amarone marc. As a result, an authentic local wine is produced which elegantly exhibits a delightfully complex fruity aroma and spicy tones complemented with a good acidity and just the right alcohol content.

name: Orin Swift Eight Years in the Desert red

name: Chateau Cheval Blanc 1er Grand Cru Classe A 2014
desc_en_short: At one time I thought the 1986 was better than the 1985, but the open-knit charm and currant exotic personality fo the 1985 makes a more persuasive case for it than for the more reserved, tannic, and backward 1986. The 1986 still has a youthful dark ruby saturated color with no amber at the edge. The wine possesses a developing bouquet that offers up weedy tobacco, juxtaposed with sweet black berry, raspberry, and cherry fruit. The new oak that was so obvious in the wine's youth has moved to the background, offering more of a cedary character than raw wood. Medium to full-bodied, and moderately tannic, this is a delineated Cheval Blanc with more of a Medoc personality than typical St.-Emilion opulence. The wine is rich, intense, and well-made, but still requiring a few more years of bottle age.

name: Marquis De Lascombes Margaux 2016 (Second wine of Château Lascombes)
desc_en_short:
The Marquis de Lascombes is the elegant second wine of Château Lascombes, a prestigious Deuxième Cru Classé (Second Growth) from the 1855 Bordeaux Classification. The estate’s history stretches back to the 17th century, named after its original owner, the Knight Antoine de Lascombes. Over centuries, the château has become a beacon of Margaux sophistication, producing wines that balance strength, sensuality, and finesse.

Crafted from the same terroirs as the Grand Vin but sourced from younger vines and parcels selected for approachability, Marquis de Lascombes 2016 captures the estate’s essence in a more youthful and vibrant form. The exceptional 2016 vintage — known for its perfect ripening conditions and refined tannins — delivers purity, structure, and Margaux’s signature floral charm in a wine ready to enchant both connoisseurs and newcomers alike.

name: Coppi Senatore Primitivo Gioia del Colle
wine_color: Deep ruby red with garnet reflections, showing excellent concentration.
appellation: Primitivo di Gioia del Colle DOC
desc_en_short: Coppi's flagship 'Senatore' is a benchmark expression of Primitivo from the prized Gioia del Colle subzone in Puglia, delivering a refined, terroir-driven take on southern Italy's most characterful red grape — structured, soulful, and built to impress.

name: Argiolas Korem Bovale Isola Dei Nuraghi IGT
wine_color: Deep, intense ruby red with excellent saturation and clarity, reflecting concentration and maturity.
desc_en_short: Argiolas Korem is a flagship expression from one of Sardinia's most celebrated family wineries, blending indigenous Bovale Sardo, Carignano, and Cannonau grapes into a richly textured, Mediterranean red with genuine depth and character.

name: Barefoot Merlot
desc_en_short: Barefoot Cellars Merlot is a luscious wine with alluring flavors of boysenberry and split cherries followed by hints of silky chocolate for a decadent finish.

name: Continuum 2021
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 35% Cabernet Franc, 11% Merlot, And 9% Petit Verdot,
desc_en_short: A vintage set apart for its perseverance and resilience, the 2021 Continuum is one of refined concentration – a resounding expression of both measured intensity and enduring vibrancy. This is a multi-layered magnificent vintage that reveals floral notes, with black cherry and wild foraged mixed berries throughout. One can perceive the chemise, sage, and bay giving a gorgeous savory expression, reflective of the natural environment that surrounds the Sage Mountain Vineyard. 2021 is a wine of incredible complexity and nuance – a wine for the ages.

name: Louis M.Martini Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 4% Merlot, 3% Petit Verdot, 3% Cabernet Franc, 1% Malbec
desc_en_short: Classic and well-structured, this Cabernet Sauvignon brims with soft and approachable notes of black plum and wisps of fennel on the nose. Layers of dark cherry and cassis are unscored by hints of black licorice and a gravelly earthiness. The oak is well-integrated, imparting notes of sweet aromatics, resin and a bit of torn mint on the long finish.

name: J. Christopher Volcanique Pinot Noir
wine_color: Bright ruby red with translucent clarity.
desc_en_short: The Volcanique cuvée is a selection of outstanding barrels from vineyards J. Christopher works with in the Dundee Hills. The wine showcases the savory quality, the fruit purity, and the fine-grained texture that characterizes the deep, red volcanic clay of these hills. The 2019 is an excellent example, with its delicately floral fruit aromas, silky texture and structural finesse. As with all of their wines, it has the depth and structure to age gracefully for many years.

name: Xige Estate Year of the Snake Limited Edition (With package)
desc_en_short: A limited Lunar New Year collector’s release—structured Ningxia Cabernet expression presented in a ceremonial gift package, combining mountain-grown intensity with symbolic design.

desc_en_short: Gérard Bertrand's Autrement Merlot from the sun-drenched Languedoc is an organically farmed, half-bottle gem delivering soft, aromatic fruit, silky mellow tannins, and a lingering chocolate-tinged finish — effortlessly approachable and beautifully expressive of its southern French terroir.

name: Clos Pegase Cabernet Sauvignon Napa Valley

name: Cosentino Winery The Zinfandel , Lodi

name: Avignonesi Vino Nobile di Montepulciano DOCG
wine_color: Produced by Avignonesi, this Vino Nobile di Montepulciano represents one of Tuscany’s historic noble wines. The estate is renowned for its commitment to terroir-driven winemaking and organic viticulture, with vineyards rooted in clay-limestone soils that
desc_en_short: Avignonesi's Vino Nobile di Montepulciano is a benchmark expression of Prugnolo Gentile from one of Tuscany's most respected organic estates — layering ripe cherry, earthy complexity, and refined structure into a wine that is classically noble yet effortlessly modern.

desc_en_short: Pian di Conte is Talenti's crown jewel — a Brunello di Montalcino Riserva crafted from a rigorous selection of Sangiovese Grosso, aged in large Slavonian oak casks to produce a wine of commanding structure, remarkable depth, and exceptional cellar potential.

name: Talenti Brunello di Montalcino “Piero” DOCG
desc_en_short:
This is quite a remarkable wine that prompts a vision of looking out over a vast orchard of
glistening red cherries and red plums, weighing down gnarled, bark-scented trunks. Beneath the
fragant canopy, luscious clay soils are interspersed with ferrous deposits and fresh grass stirs.
Viscous layers of pure red fruit pour into the palate, soaking the mouth from top to bottom in
profuse layers of spices and orange zest. The tannins have the muscle of a bodybuilder, but the
acidity dances through the mouth like a ballerina. The finish is limitless. - James Suckling.

name: Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande 2021
brand: Chateau Pichon Longueville Comtesse de Lalande
desc_en_short:
Château Pichon Comtesse, long admired for its grace and depth, traces its lineage to the 17th century, but took its modern shape under the guidance of Virginie de Pichon Longueville in the 1800s. With time, it gained renown for producing one of Pauillac’s most elegantly styled second growths.

In 2021, a cool and challenging vintage tested the mettle of Bordeaux’s vineyards. The team at Pichon Comtesse responded with rigor—meticulous vineyard work, selective harvesting, and gentle extraction—to express the terroir’s finesse.

The result is a wine of restraint and beauty, echoing the château’s historic emphasis on charm over power. This vintage reaffirms the estate’s role as Pauillac’s poetic counterpoint to its more muscular peers.

name: Chateau Montrose 2021
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Merlot, 6% Cabernet Franc, 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Château Montrose rises along the banks of the Gironde in the Saint-Estèphe appellation, famed for its gravely soils and cool winds. Since 2006, under the stewardship of the Bouygues family, Montrose has undergone extensive renovations, emphasizing sustainability and precision.

The 2021 vintage was marked by early frost and cool conditions, requiring exacting vineyard management and strict fruit selection. The estate’s commitment to organic principles and low yields ensured that only the finest berries were used.

Montrose 2021 reveals the château’s mastery in crafting restrained yet expressive wines that balance power with poise—offering a glimpse into the soul of Saint-Estèphe’s terroir, shaped by stone, wind, and generations of vision.

name: Chateau Pichon  Longueville Baron 2018
desc_en_short: A towering Second Growth Pauillac from one of Bordeaux's most celebrated estates, the Château Pichon Baron 2018 delivers the appellation's signature power and structure — 78% Cabernet Sauvignon layered with Merlot richness, shaped by an exceptional growing season and aged in 80% new French oak.

name: Chateau Rauzan-Ségla  Margaux 2019
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 35.5% Merlot, 2% Petit Verdot, 0.5% Cabernet Franc
desc_en_short: The 2019 vintage is alluring because of its discreet elegance. It is as if the winemaker sensed the appeal of revealing its photo in black and white while leaving a tantalizing graininess. It emits an aura of mystery, a veil of modesty that creates a gentle and cocooning atmosphere that accounts for its charm. The fruit seems to develop smoothly on the palate before reaching an uplifting finale. It has a lot of class. Vibrancy, too. Aromas of morello cherry, iris and rosemary. The fresh fig confers an aromatic hint that seems to last for ever and it has the texture of all great Margaux wines, between power and sophistication. A great Rauzan.

name: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2021
style: Cabernet Sauvignon,  Merlot, Cabernet Franc, Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Château Rauzan-Gassies, a historic Second Growth in Margaux, traces its lineage to the once-unified Rauzan estate. Since 1946, it has been under the care of the Quié family, who also manage Château Croizet-Bages in Pauillac.

The estate’s gravel-rich soils and classic Left Bank grape mix yield a wine that mirrors its terroir’s delicacy. While overshadowed for decades by more prominent names, Rauzan-Gassies has quietly refined its style through modern viticulture and cellar upgrades.

The 2021 vintage—cool, challenging, and late—favored the elegant signature of Margaux. Rauzan-Gassies 2021 is a testament to subtlety: a wine of floral lift, finesse, and quiet charm, exemplifying how restraint can reveal terroir with honesty and grace.

name: Château Gruaud Larose 2018
wine_color: A medium to deep garnet-purple color.
desc_en_short:
Situated on one of Saint‑Julien’s highest gravel‑plateaus and classified as a Deuxième Grand Cru Classé in 1855, Château Gruaud Larose has, under the Merlaut family’s stewardship since 1997, embarked on a bold journey of reinvention. Emphasis has been placed on terroir‑respecting viticulture, increasing vine age, and upgrading cellar practices to express the estate’s latent power with finesse.

The 2018 vintage stands as a landmark in this transformation. After a tumultuous spring of wet weather that threatened vine health, hot, dry conditions arrived in July and carried through to harvest, enabling full ripeness and concentration. The wine was matured in French oak (with circa 80% new barrels) for 18‑24 months, showcasing the estate’s modern precision.

Today Gruaud Larose’s nickname “Golden Rose” reflects not only its distinctive label but the gold‑standard revival of its style: gravel‑driven, Cabernet‑led, terroir‑rich Bordeaux that marries tradition and modern energy.

name: Château Lascombes 2019
desc_en_short:
Since its classification as a Deuxième Grand Cru Classé in 1855, Château Lascombes has stood on the gravel‑rich plateau of Margaux, its vines and cellars progressively refined across centuries. The estate’s soil‑driven identity and commitment to precision have prepared it for an era of renaissance under renewed investment and expert stewardship.

The 2019 vintage arrived on the heels of meticulous vineyard work: leaf‑thinning, manual harvest in crates, cold maceration and extended vatting to draw out structure and aromatic breadth. Maturation in barrels (about 60% new oak) over 18‑20 months added comprehensiveness without sacrificing vibrancy.

In this wine you sense both power and finesse: the hallmark gravel framing Cabernet‑dominated intensity, tempered by Merlot’s supple plushness and Petit Verdot’s spice lift. Château Lascombes 2019 bridges tradition and modern ambition, destined for a long life in cellar.

name: Chateau Palmer  Margaux 2021
style: Merlot, 41% Cabernet Sauvignon And 3% Petit Verdot.
desc_en_short:
Château Palmer, one of Margaux’s most revered Third Growths, is known for its perfumed depth, velvety structure, and pioneering approach. Its 2021 vintage tells a story of resilience. Biodynamically farmed since 2014, Palmer’s vines faced one of Bordeaux’s most challenging growing seasons in recent memory—marked by spring frost and cool, wet conditions.

Despite these pressures, the vineyard team, led by Thomas Duroux, exercised precision and patience, allowing the grapes to ripen slowly. Harvested later than usual, the fruit achieved excellent aromatic intensity, naturally balanced sugars, and fresh acidity. Merlot played a surprisingly central role in the final blend—an echo of historical Palmer cuvées.

The resulting wine is not about weight but elegance. It exhibits a floral-tinged transparency, clear fruit expression, and a minerality that channels the gravel soils of Margaux. This 2021 shows Palmer’s commitment to terroir and truth, embodying what the château calls “Palmer beyond vintage.”

name: Chateau Calon Segur  3eme Cru Classe 2021
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 11% Cabernet Franc, 7% Merlot, 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Château Calon-Ségur, one of Saint-Estèphe’s most historic estates, derives its name from the 18th-century Marquis de Ségur, who famously declared, “I make wine at Lafite and Latour, but my heart is at Calon.” The heart emblem remains proudly on every label to this day.

The 2021 vintage was shaped by climatic adversity, with mildew and cool conditions testing even the best vineyards. At Calon-Ségur, the deep gravel and clay soils, coupled with meticulous organic-conversion viticulture and selective harvest, allowed the team to deliver a wine of clarity and classical structure.

With Cabernet Sauvignon at its core, the 2021 reflects the château’s return to its traditional roots—defined by tension, purity, and age-worthy balance. It’s a vintage that harks back to Bordeaux’s cooler eras, and will quietly impress for decades to come.

name: Château D'Issan 2019
desc_en_short: A wine of regal lineage from Margaux's storied Château d'Issan, the 2019 vintage delivers a classically proportioned blend of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot — finespun in texture, deeply aromatic, and poised with the quiet authority that has defined this estate for centuries.

name: Chateau Pontet-Canet  AOC Pauillac 2017
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 31% Merlot, 4% Cabernet Franc And 1% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Château Pontet-Canet is a pioneer, the first major Bordeaux estate to fully embrace biodynamic viticulture. Under the vision of Alfred Tesseron, the vineyard is treated as a living garden, worked by horses rather than tractors to avoid compacting the soil. The 2017 vintage was a challenge, as frost severely reduced yields, but the grapes that survived produced a wine of startling clarity and definition.

Because of the reduced crop, the selection was draconian. The wine was aged partly in new oak and partly in custom concrete amphorae, a technique used to preserve the fruit's energy without masking it with wood flavors. The result is a Pontet-Canet that differs from the massive vintages of the past; it is linear, precise, and incredibly fragrant.

This wine is a whisper of the terroir. It speaks of the limestone and gravel deep beneath the vines. It is not a wine of force, but of resonance. Drinking Pontet-Canet 2017 is a spiritual experience for the palate, connecting the drinker directly to the health and vitality of the ecosystem from which it came.

name: Chateau Grand-Puy-Lacoste  2018
desc_en_short: Château Grand-Puy-Lacoste 2018 is a benchmark Pauillac from a stellar Bordeaux vintage — a powerful yet elegant blend of 78% Cabernet Sauvignon and 22% Merlot delivering ripe black fruits, liquorice, and remarkable mineral depth with exceptional long-term ageing potential.

name: Château Haut Batailley 2009
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot And 5% Cabernet Franc.
desc_en_short:
Château Haut-Batailley is marked by the "Tour l'Aspic," a tower that stands guard over the vineyards at the southern entrance to Pauillac. In 2009, the estate was still owned by the Borie family (of Grand-Puy-Lacoste), before being sold to the Cazes family in 2017. This vintage represents the culmination of the Borie era in a year that Robert Parker famously celebrated for its richness and opulence.

The 2009 vintage was a "dream" year in Bordeaux, characterized by warm days and cool nights that allowed for perfect ripening. Haut-Batailley, typically a more elegant and lighter style of Pauillac, took on a new dimension of weight and texture in this year. The resulting wine is fleshy and seductive, with the structure of Pauillac wrapped in layers of velvet.

Now fully mature, the 2009 is a window into the past. It offers the rare pleasure of a "ready" Classified Growth from a legendary year. It is a wine of comfort and generosity, perfect for a long dinner where the bottle can be savored slowly as it reveals notes of forest floor, spice, and sweet, resolved fruit.

name: Château Batailley 1996
style: Cabernet Sauvignon, 25% Merlot, 3% Cabernet Franc, 2% Petit Verdot
desc_en_short:
Château Batailley is one of the oldest estates in the Médoc, its name derived from the "Battle" took place on this ground in 1453 during the Hundred Years' War, effectively reclaiming the region for France. The wine produced here has always been a reflection of this history: sturdy, resilient, and unapologetically traditional. The 1996 vintage is a classic example of this "old school" style.

1996 was a year that favored the Cabernet Sauvignon grape immensely, producing wines with high acidity and firm tannins—wines built for the very long haul. Batailley, which was never one to chase modern trends of over-ripeness, produced a wine that was austere in its youth but has now blossomed into a beautiful expression of mature Claret.

Drinking Batailley 1996 today is an education in patience. The primary fruit has faded, replaced by the glorious "tertiary" aromas of pencil shavings, tobacco, and wet earth. It is a savory, intellectual wine that demands food to show its best. It is the taste of a bygone era, a "Lion in Winter" that still commands respect.

name: Château Haut-Bages Liberal 2020
desc_en_short:
Château Haut-Bages Liberal is named after the Liberal family, who founded the estate in the 18th century, and its terroir is nothing short of exceptional. Half of the vineyard lies adjacent to Château Latour, and the other half sits on the limestone-rich plateau of Bages. Today, the estate is run by Claire Villars-Lurton, a fierce advocate for agro-ecology and biodynamics, having achieved organic certification in 2019 and full biodynamic certification shortly after.

The 2020 vintage is a testament to the vitality of these farming methods. In a year of intense heat, the living soils and deep root systems allowed the vines to self-regulate, producing grapes of immense freshness. The influence of the limestone is palpable in the wine, giving it a "chalky" tannic grip and a saline finish that distinguishes it from its more clay-heavy neighbors.

This is a wine that feels "unfiltered" in its expression of place. It eschews heavy makeup or excessive oak in favor of a raw, energetic beauty. It is a Pauillac for purists—structured, saline, and vibrating with life—proving that the greatest luxury in wine is a healthy, living vineyard.

name: Château Rauzan-Gassies 2018
desc_en_short: "Medium to deep garnet-purple colored, the 2018 Rauzan-Gassies rocks up with flamboyant notions of kirsch, blackberry preserves, warm cassis and Chinese five spice with touches of black tea, red roses and menthol plus a waft of molten chocolate. Medium to full-bodied with a firm frame of ripe, fine-grained tannins and fantastic freshness, it has a solid core of rich fruit, finishing long with perfumed red and black fruit layers."

name: Viticcio Morellino di Scansano DOCG
desc_en_short: This Morellino is made from the best Sangiovese grapes with an addition of Merlot and Cabernet Sauvignon. In the mouth, its refreshing character combines with great persistence, while its warmth underlines a wonderful softness. With aging, it grows in style and elegance.

name: Piccini 1882 Puglia Appassimento

name: Schramsberg  Blanc de Noirs
desc_en_short:
Blanc de Noirs (white Made from black) is the counterpart to Blanc de Blancs (white Made from white). Made primarily Made from the red grape Pinot Noir, this is a complex, medium-bodied, brut sparkling wine. Schramsberg pioneered the Blanc de Noirs style in the United States, releasing the first such American sparkler in 1967. The key to producing this complex Blanc de Noirs is our vast and varied focus on diverse cool-climate vineyards. Pinot Noir Made from Carneros and Anderson Valley combine with fruit Made from low-yielding Sonoma and Marin coastal vineyards to develop a sparkling wine with a breadth of fruitful aroma and flavor. Select Chardonnay lots give zest and backbone to the blend.

Making a white wine Made from a red grape requires great care ??? hand-picked fruit, early morning harvest, optimal fruit maturity and delicate pressing. A balance of bright flavors, crisp acidity and minimal tannins is achieved. Barrel and malolactic fermentation of particular lots add richness and body. Some two years of yeast contact in the bottle harmonizes all the elements together in a mature, toasty style. The youthful fruit character of the wine will caramelize and soften with additional age in the bottle. With proper storage, this sparkling wine will be delicious for many years, even a couple of decades to come.

Schramsberg Blanc de Noirs is particularly well-suited to serve with a variety of foods, including soft and nutty cheeses, macadamia nut-crusted halibut, and pork tenderloin with fresh rosemary and lemon thyme.

name: Schramsberg  Mirabelle Brut Rose
desc_en_short: Mirabelle Brut Rose is a specially crafted blend of Pinot Noir and Chardonnay Made from Schramsberg select cool-climate vineyards in Carneros, Anderson Valley, and the Sonoma and Marin coastal areas of Northern California. Pinot Noir lots, including a few fermented with skin contact, provide brightness of berry fruit and body, while Chardonnay lots lend length and zest to the palate. Additional flavor depth and aromatic complexity results Made from the blending of base wine lots aged in barrels and tanks for one or more years. The finished Brut Rose exhibits fresh, elegant and toasty aromas that lead into lively and delicious fruit flavors on the palate.

name: Louis Roederer  Brut Premier
style: Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, And 20% Pinot Meunier
desc_en_short:
YESTERDAY’S DISCOVERIES, TODAY’S TREASURES

After the upheavals of the early 1900s, particularly the First World War that destroyed more than half of the Louis Roederer estate, Léon Olry Roederer reconstructed the vineyards. He decided to buy grapes to ensure the continuity of the House during this difficult period and, at the same time, created a multi-vintage wine that would have a consistent flavour, whatever the harvest year. It is now called Brut Premier.

A SIGNATURE BLEND

A blend of 40% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, and 20% Pinot Meunier, Brut Premier comprises wine matured in oak tuns produced from three Champagne grape varieties that originate from more than fifty different crus. It is aged for 3 years in Louis Roederer’s cellars and left for 6 months after dégorgement (disgorging).

A GREAT CLASSIC THAT RESONATES WITH CONTEMPORARY TASTE

Striking a perfect balance between youthfulness and maturity, seduction and character, vinosity and freshness, Brut Premier is a champagne that is harmonious and structured, elegant and lively, with a unique exuberancy. Its structured texture, richness, and length are distinctly winey. It is a full, complex wine that is both rich and powerful, whilst remaining a great classic.

name: Louis Roederer  Rose Vintage 2015
wine_color: Pink hue with attractive golden tints.
desc_en_short:
A SUNNY TERROIR

In order for grapes to be used in the creation of a great rosé champagne, they have to attain perfect maturity, which is sometimes difficult to achieve in the changeable Champagne climate. This is why Louis Roederer decided to invest in the vineyards at Cumières, where the shallow calcareous clay soil, which is on south-facing slopes bathed in the light reflected from the banks of the river Marne, enables the grapes to attain optimum phenolic maturity.

A SIGNATURE BLEND

A blend of 70% Pinot Noir and 30% Chardonnay, 20% of which is wine matured in oak tuns without malolactic fermentation, the Brut Rosé cuvée is aged for four years in Roederer’s cellars and left for 6 months after dégorgement (disgorging) to attain perfect maturity.

AN EXCEPTIONAL FRUITINESS

The wine has fruity aromas of wild red berries, followed by floral notes, and the sugary and spicy fragrance of zest; and the aromas of dried fruit and cocoa result from the wine’s vinifying in oak tuns. Rich and full-bodied, Brut Rosé exalts the maturity of the fruit. A sparkling wine with an initial impression of freshness, it opens smoothly with almost exotic notes, combined with the pure minerality of the Chardonnay grapes.

A Champagne House is eventually judged on the quality of its Brut Non Vintage. It is in the making of such a wine that the true Art of Champagne blending reveals itself.

This is an art in which the House of Veuve Clicquot excels. Our Brut Yellow Label reflects the superb vineyards we own and the consistent nature of our House style.

The predominance of Pinot Noir provides the structure that is so typically Clicquot, while a touch of Pinot Meunier rounds out the blend. Chardonnay adds the elegance and finesse essential in a perfectly balanced wine.

name: Veuve Clicquot  Vintage 2008
desc_en_short:
Winemaker's Notes

Its clear, brilliant, gold color lights up in the delicate tumult of fine bubbles produced by its persistent and remarkable effervescence. The nose is fresh, refined and elegant. Fragrances of citrus fruit and stone fruits (peach, apricot) appear first, which are then enriched by delicate, warm notes of sweet pastries, (almonds, Mirabelle plum tart): a subtle alliance of freshness and fullness. On the palate, the frank lively and pure attack moves into a powerful, structured palate, delicately chiseled from the minerality of Champagnes' chalky terroir. The generosity of the Pinot Noir's fruitiness resonates harmoniously with the freshness of the light candied citrus fruit aromas (lemon) which are embellished in the finish with delicate hints of toasted notes and dried fruit (apricots). Vintage 2008 is the perfect combination of power, freshness and finesse, and ends with an incredibly long finish.
