Keen observation, respect for nature, pragmatic creativity, technical innovation, the courage of his convictions, and patience were the instruments serving his vision. He constantly mastered and incorporated all its components and the stages of its production, from the vineyards themselves to the pressing and clarification of the wines and their preservation.

name: Dom Perignon  Rose Vintage with Gift Box
desc_en_short: The beginning of winter was particularly rigorous in 2009. The Champagne region saw intermittent snowfall, and temperatures remained quite low. Spring was warm but rainy. The weather did not encourage flowering and there was a threat of mildew. The summer, despite stormy periods that raised concerns that the health of the vines might suffer, was dominated by sunshine, especially in August. The weather remained hot, dry and very sunny for five consecutive weeks. On September 4 a hailstorm hit the vineyards in Hautvillers, Verzenay and Chouilly. The summery weather returned the very next day, however, and the grapes continued to ripen in complete serenity. The harvest thus began on September 12 under absolutely idyllic conditions. The grapes showed exceptional health and their maturity, underlined by a wonderful aromatic expression, was superlative.

name: Monsoon Valley  Brut Blanc de Blancs
desc_en_short: A well-balanced sparkling wine, from smooth texture to refreshing note of grapefruit and lemon, follow by a firm oaky finish. Genuine sparkling fizz of this label deploy by the original champagne method.

name: Monsoon Valley  Sparkling Extra Sec Rose
desc_en_short: The bright orange salmon sparkling is used the same production method as Champagne. It starts with the aroma of red berries and toast perfectly, leaving the long finish in the palate and a little tannin at the end.

name: Trappolini  Glera Brut Veneto IGT
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with green hues. Fine and quite persistent perlage. Fruity on the nose with white flower scents. Fresh and smooth. Excellent as aperitif wine as well as with seafood.

name: Bellavista  Gran Cuvee Rose Brut (1.5 L)
wine_color: An enchantingly elegant pale pink colour
desc_en_short: Bellavista Rosé has a pale and lively mousse, while its perlage consists of small, densely-packed and persistent bubbles. It has an enchantingly elegant pale pink colour that over time takes on aristocratic antique rose hues. We are overwhelmed by its bouquet that starts off with faint sensations of white peach as its intense yet mellow character reveals the pleasing fragrances of wild strawberries, citrus fruit, golden delicious apples, and dog rose, with a lingering hint of toasted bread. Austere, yet very classy, the flavour develops with a pleasingly dry sensation, yet devoid of all sharpness. The freshness is supported by the wine’s grace. Harmonious notes feature an elegant undertone of blackcurrant and sweet almond, and there is a clear sensation of small wood berries.

name: Bellavista  Cuvee Brut
wine_color: Bright yellow in colour and luminous with obvious glints of green.
desc_en_short: The flavour is dry, exceptionally elegant and pleasing with an aristocratic background of jam and incense that is particularly persistent. It has body yet is wrapped in a silky texture and exceptional energy.

name: Pierlant  Blanc de Blancs Brut
wine_color: White wine, with a fine mousse.
desc_en_short: This wine is 100% Blanc de Blancs and produced with the following white grapes: Chardonnay, Colombard, Ugni Blanc (Trebbiano) & Gros Manseng harvested from: Bordeaux, Charentes and the Loire Valley. The wine has an ABV of 11%.

name: Chandon  Brut Summer 2016 Limited Edition
desc_en_short: Chandon has created a summer limited edition bottle inspired by great times and sunny moments. This Chardonnay led Méthode Traditionnelle sparkling is a fresh and elegant aperitif style wine, with a soft, generous palate and a crisp finish.

name: Lambrini  Blush
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

An exciting new lively pink frizzante premium perry wine alternative created exclusively for Thailand. With an alcohol content of 7.5% and best served at 2-­‐4 degrees, Lambrini Blush is great to drink on its own whilst relaxing and chaVng with friends at any Cme, day or night and it shares the same characterisCc quality of its bianco sister, Lambrini Original, as being a wonderful drink to compliment all foods especially Thai and spicy.

name: Chambrini
desc_en_short: Chambrini has been created exclusively for Thailand and provides an affordable and enjoyable Champagne alternaCve. Best served at 2-­‐4 degrees and with an alcohol content of 10%, Chambrini is the drink of choice for all celebraCons such as weddings, birthdays, banquets or any special get together with friends and it pairs superbly well with all foods.

name: Laurent Perrier  Brut Millesime 2015
desc_en_short:
Laurent Perrier Brut Millesime 2015

The Vintage is the choice of an exceptional year from which only a selection of the Chardonnay and Pinot Noir Grands Crus will enter into a future iteration of Grand Siècle. It is a rare and outstanding wine that expresses the character of the year in the Laurent-Perrier style. The wine is white gold in color with a fine sparkle. A flowery nose of great complexity, with notes of citrus and white peaches. A wine that is very present with a lively attack and great finesse with good minerality and notes of grapefruit on the finish.

The Vintage 2015 pairs well with seafood and noble fish as well as with poultry or veal. This wine sublimates hard pressed cheeses such as a young Comté or a Beaufort.

name: Laurent Perrier  Grand Siecle
wine_color: A fine bead, giving off delicate aromas. A bright yellow colour and an extremely refined texture.
desc_en_short:
Perfect harmony

Because of its perfect balance between power and delicacy, and between aromatic intensity and standout freshness,Grand Siècle by Laurent-Perrier is open to multiple food pairings. It naturally accompanies the most refined foods and dishes. It magnifies the taste experience of a noble fish such as turbot, and pairs admirably with sea/land combinations such as chicken with crawfish or truffled scallops.

The recommended serving temperature is 10°C and tulip-shaped wine glasses are to be preferred to flutes to ensure maximum pleasure from the sensory encounter with this great Cuvée.

name: Laurent Perrier  Alexandra Rose
desc_en_short:
A Never Ending Passion

It is named after a woman: Alexandra. In 1982, Bernard de Nonancourt created an outstanding cuvée of vintage rosé champagne – the perfect expression of his driving passion, and the fruit of his great experience.

Exceptionally, the new cuvée epitomised every aspect of the champagne maker’s art: Laurent-Perrier’s unique know-how, careful tending of the vineyards, ceaseless dedication, the best of the natural world, and the best crus in Champagne at the peak of perfect ripeness. Conditions such as these come together only in the greatest years.

In 1987, after five years of unhurried ageing in the chalk cellars of Tourssur-Marne, the wine had reached perfection. That same year, Alexandra, Bernard de Nonancourt’s elder daughter, was to marry. The cuvée could only be named for one of the two daughters, and the upcoming family event dictated the choice: Alexandra.

To this day, Bernard de Nonancourt’s original vision continues to stimulate the excellence deployed by the entire House during the creation of this great cuvée. It stands as the symbol of an infinite passion for wine, and the signature of a style and a spirit unrivalled in Champagne.

name: Tenuta Sant ' Anna  Prosecco Millesimato Brut DOC
wine_color: Straw-yellow color with pale green glints. Exuberant foam characterized by minuscule bubbles.
desc_en_short: Straw-yellow color with pale green glints. Exuberant foam characterized by minuscule bubbles. Fresh bouquet initially of acacia flowers which gives way to aromas redolent of white peach and rennet. In the mouth it is surprisingly cool and vigorous, lively with a creamy perlage of fruity notes that titillate the palate exquisitely. An excellent aperitif, it may be served with all courses based on fish, from appetizers to light risottos or second-course fried dishes. It should be served at a temperature of 6-8°C.

name: Tenuta Sant ' Anna  Prosecco Extra Dry
wine_color: Straw-colored yellow of medium intensity. In the glass, it is characterized by a crown of dense and particulate foam that forms for a considerable amount of time with tiny bubbles.
desc_en_short: Straw-colored yellow of medium intensity. In the glass, it is characterized by a crown of dense and particulate foam that forms for a considerable amount of time with tiny bubbles. To the nose it evokes the scent of acacia, peach and pear flowers. It is easy and pleasant to taste, initially cool and soft on the palate, giving way to fruity traces and an agreeable touch of sapidity. Very versatile, particularly good as an aperitif with appetizers and starters in general, based on cheese and light cold cuts. It should be served cool, at a temperature of between 6-8° C.

name: Champagne Agrapart  Grand Cru Venus
desc_en_short: A Champagne with a fruity delicacy. A multitude of aromas, of white truffles, of roasting. Rested on the lees for 5 years and turned manually. Disgorgement 60 days before being commercialized. No dosage of liqueur and 50mg/liter of SO2.

name: Champagne Agrapart  Premier Cru 7 Crus
desc_en_short:
A fresh Champagne with a good energy, ideal for the aperitif. Cépage Chardonnay 90% et Pinot noir 10%,From the Chardonnay grape variety, this blend from 7 villages is representative of our domain. A full malolactic fermentation. Rested on the lees for 3 years and was turned manually. Disgorgement 60 days before being commercialized. 
Dosage of liqueur limited to 7g of sugar/liter and the SO2 at 50mg/liter.

name: Champagne Agrapart  Grand Cru Terriors
desc_en_short: The NV Extra Brut Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Terroirs is brisk, salivating and full of energy. Lemon peel, white flowers, mint and white pepper are some of the signatures. Lifted and precise, the Terroirs shows the linear style that is typical of the Agrapart Champagnes.

name: Champagne Agrapart  Grand Cru Mineral
desc_en_short: True to its vintage, this is forward and fruity, showing an ample ripeness. At the same time, it's underlined by a piercing core of chalky minerality, turning more tense and pointed on the long, fragrant finish. It's an excellent version of this cuvee, and a fine successor to the brilliant 2008.

name: Champagne Agrapart  Grand Cru Avizoise
desc_en_short: From 50+ year old Chardonnay vines in the best part of the coteaux d'Avize, the Extra Brut Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru l'Avizoise offers an absolutely clear, fresh, discreetly aromatic and elegant bouquet of ripe apples, ultra ripe pears, dates, limes, chalk dust, iodine and some hints of licorice. Grown on calcareous argil, fermented in demi-muids (malolactic included) the wine was kept on the lees for more than five years and disgorged manually with a dosage of five grams per liter. It comes along as full-bodied yet pure, very fine and persistent Champagne with good concentration; it has a firm mineral structure and an almost Burgundian character. The length is really terrific. This is serious Champagne for the next 4-6 years.

name: Champagne Charles Collin  Brut Blanc De Noir
desc_en_short: Slight orange and amber hints in appearance which is very typical of Pinot Noir. On the nose, this champagne has amazingly rich aromas of white-fleshed fruits such as pear or grapefruit. In the mouth the wine is rich, powerful, very similar to biting into a ripe fruit, and there is a lovely long harmonious finish, very well balanced and precise in style.

name: Champagne Charles Collin  Brut Rose
desc_en_short: Deep orangy colour. Clean, profound nose of ripe red fruits (strawbery, cherry). A hormonious, full, fleshy rose with crunchy fruit. Focused aromas highlighted by savoury freshness. An enjoyable rose suitable for any occasion.

name: Champagne Egly - Ouriet  Grand Cru Brut
desc_en_short: The NV Brut Grand Cru Tradition, Egly-Ouriet's entry-level Champagne, is terrific. Rich, burnished and beautifully expressive, the Grand Cru Tradition flows across the palate with succulent yellow stone fruits, spices, dried flowers and rosemary. The broad, resonant style is hugely appealing and so typical of the Egly-Ouriet house style. This is a great showing. The Grand Cru Tradition is 70% Pinot Noir and 30% Chardonnay, all from sites in Ambonnay, Bouzy and Verzenay. Tiny amphitheatre shaped lieu-dit of vines planted in 1946. The essence of Pinot Noir. The NV Brut Blanc de Noirs Grand Cru Les Crayères Vieilles Vignes is one of the more refined, polished wines I have ever tasted from Francis Egly. Everything is simply in the right place. Mirabelle plum, hard candy, flowers, mint and chalk are all beautifully delineated in a super-classy, polished Champagne that showcases the Egly-Ouriet style at its very best. Lifted, gracious and precise, the Vieilles Vignes is simply magnificent. The 25% new oak is totally integrated, even at this early stage. A blend of vintages that could not possibly be more complementary and display a surprising ageing that will give a great deal of satisfaction for over a decade.

name: Champagne Egly - Ouriet  Grand Cru Extra Brut Vp
desc_en_short: A magnificient piano symphony of Chardonnay and Pinot Noir blended with different vintages to achieve this sublime Champagne aged for over 7 years.

name: Champagne Egly - Ouriet  Grand Cru Brut Rose
desc_en_short: 60% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, with a small addition of Ambonnay Rouge, drawn from cask. A bouquet of roses and small red berries announces the wine's subtle, delicate perfume. The mouth shows more red fruit with a smooth, almost buttery quality; the density and complexity here are unparalleled. White pepper and wet stones follow on a lengthy, lively finish. A superb ros?.

name: Champagne Egly - Ouriet  Grand Cru Millessime
desc_en_short: 106 months on lees, honey and butterscotch aroma. Abricot brioche - smells like a patisserie in the best way! Full and rich but so fresh, deeply, richly flavoured with toasty breadth.

name: Champagne Egly - Ouriet  Grand Cru Blanc De Noirs Vv
desc_en_short: A total rock star wine, the NV Grand Cru Blanc de Noirs Les Crayeres VV emerges from the old - vine Crayeres lieu - dit in Ambonnay. Rich, deep and explosive in the glass, the Crayeres boasts superb intensity and richness, with all of the weight of these 70+ year - old vines and 60 months of sur - lie aging the glass. Wild flowers, honey, red berries, smoke, licorice, game and chalk are pushed forward in a warm, resonant Champagne that captures the essence of Ambonnay. Slightly Oxidative notes from the 64 months the wine spent on its lees add character, while a touch of oak is barely noticeable and only in the wine's overall feel.

name: Champagne  Autreau  Premier Cru Brut Rose
desc_en_short:
This champagne is based on the daintiness and the elegance of the Chardonnay (85 %) together with the colour of the red grapes (Pinot Noir 15%) from the champagne area. This pink, warm and solid wine is a “Gourmet Champagne”.

It accompanies wonderfully the desserts.

name: Champagne  Autreau  Grand Cru Brut Blanc De Blanc
wine_color: Bright gold and Almond green glints
desc_en_short:
100 % Chardonnay Grand Cru from the White Hillside. The lemon yellow colour with bright gold and almond green glints is typical of the Chardonnay.

The nose is a combination of ripe citrus fruits with a buttery overtone and flowery finish.

name: Sperone  Prosecco DOC Arduini Spumante Brut
desc_en_short: A lovely, delicate Prosecco; pale lemon in colour with light gren reflections. The palate is light and fresh with a soft, creamy mousse and notes of green apple, pear and white flowers with a fresh, citrus acidity. The fruity notes linger on the finish, perfect as an aperitif!

name: Tosti  Prosecco DOC Extra Dry
desc_en_short: Light straw yellow with sparkling reflections Gentle and fresh. The delicate aromatic note blends with the fruity notes Mellow and lively. A well balanced match of the typical aroma and the slightly bitterish note. The aftertaste is pleasant and clear.

name: Taittinger  Comtes Rose 2006
desc_en_short: Taittinger's 2006 Comtes de Champagne Rosé has come along nicely over the last six months. Intensely perfumed, Pinot-inflected aromatics carry through the mid-palate and finish as the 2006 shows off its depth and pure energy. Veins of chalky minerality give the red berry and cranberry flavors an extra kick of energy. The 2006 is both powerful and delicate at the same, with crystalline precision and fabulous depth. Hints of orange peel, mint, cinnamon and cranberry add further shades of nuance on the complete, beautifully articulated finish.

name: Taittinger  Brut Vintage 2012
desc_en_short: Taittinger  Brut Vintage 2012 is a fine, delicate, airy, elegant champagne that presents a beautiful balance of aromatic intensity and freshness. The nose is defined by intense citrus fruit aromas of mandarin zest. Next emerges floral and delicate aromas of lime flowers. In the mouth, the attack is full of freshness and strength, dominated by the citrus fruits. There then follows a certain fullness, with flavors of pear and raisins, with a complex finish embellished with notes of licorice.

name: Taittinger  Comtes Blanc de Blancs 2007
desc_en_short: Taittinger is a Champagne house founded in 1734 in Reims. However it wasn’t until 1932 that the Taittinger family purchased the estate and renamed it after their family. Pierre Taittinger was a cavalry officer in World War I who returned from the war and fell in love with the Champagne region. He was able to buy the vineyards in 1932 and was soon buying more land. Today Taittinger Champagne owns 752 acres of vineyards, making it one of the largest in the region. The estate’s flagship wines are the Comtes de Champagne, made of 100% Chardonnay, and Comtes de Champagne Rose, made of 100% Pinot Noir. Taittinger is also noteworthy for its program of commissioning internationally acclaimed artists to make labels.

name: Antica Fratta  Essence Brut Franciacorta Docg
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with ample and rather complex, with scents of ripe fruit. Full and well articulated, fragrant, intense, balanced flavour and with good persistence. Very fine and persistent, creamy mousse.

name: Antica Fratta  Essence Nature Franciacorta Docg
desc_en_short: Intense yellow with highlights veering towards gold reflexes with notes of fruit and hints of tropical fruit. Involving , hints of spice and dried fruit. Fine and persistent, soft, delicate and creamy mousse.

name: Antica Fratta  Quintessence Extra Brut' Fta Docg
desc_en_short: Intense yellow with highlights veering towards gold reflexes with notes of fruit and hints of tropical fruit. Involving , elegant and persistent structure and evolution full of dry and tropical fruit. Fine and persistent, soft, delicate and creamy mousse.

name: Bortolomiol  Filanda Rose' Brut Millesimato Riserva DOCG
desc_en_short: Great sparkling wine maker that he was, Giuliano Bortolomiol made his first rosé in the early 1970s. Today his daughters Maria Elena, Elvira, Luisa and Giuliana together with their mother Ottavia presenta wonderful sparkling rosé, the Filanda Rosé. They have decided to dedicate this wine to the women who worked in the Valdobbiadene silk mills, women who with their hard work contributed so greatly to the development of the area. A homage from women to women, proudly pink with a splendid mousse.

name: Chandon  Brut Summer 2017 Limited Edition
style: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir And Pinot Meunier Grapes
desc_en_short: Chandon has created a summer limited edition bottle inspired by great times and sunny moments. This chardonnay led méthode traditionnelle sparkling is a fresh and elegant aperitif style wine, with a soft, generous palate and a crisp finish.

name: Chandon  Rose Summer 2017 Limited Edition
wine_color: A striking rose petal pink hue of medium intensity with delicate bead and persistent mousse.
desc_en_short: Chandon has created a summer limited edition bottle inspired by great times and sunny moments. A pinot noir led sparkling wine, chandon brut rosé celebrates the high quality pinot noir vineyards of our corner of australia alongside the complexity deriving from our french heritage and the méthode traditionnelle.

name: Champagne Philipponnat  Clos des Goisses Extra Brut Rose
wine_color: Very pale pink, persistent bead, very fine foam.
desc_en_short:
A legendary wine much appreciated by collectors, Clos des Goisses Juste Rosé is unanimously applauded by the most distinguished wine-critics.

This vintage was marked by contrasts: frost and dryness in winter, rainfall and warmth during the growing season, and a harvest of hot, particularly dry weather. It imparts a pleasant surprising quality to this powerful, intense, and exceedingly generous win.

name: Piper-Heidsieck  Cuvee Brut (3 L)
wine_color: A clear, golden Champagne robe par excellence. Delicate and fine bubbles resulting from an extended maturation time.
desc_en_short:
PIPER-HEIDSIECK Cuvée Brut is a classic, structured, full-bodied and bursting with fruit Champagne. The blend is composed of a majority of Pinots Noirs, incorporating more than 100 crus from around the Champagne region and Pinots Meuniers from the Grande et Petite Montagne de Reims region.

desc_en_short:
PIPER-HEIDSIECK Cuvée Brut is a classic, structured, full-bodied and bursting with fruit Champagne. The blend is composed of a majority of Pinots Noirs, incorporating more than 100 crus from around the Champagne region and Pinots Meuniers from the Grande et Petite Montagne de Reims region.
