name: Piper-Heidsieck  Cuvee Sublime (750 ml)
wine_color: This sumptuous delicacy is draped in gilt glistening with tiny flecks of pure gold.
desc_en_short: This sumptuous delicacy is draped in gilt glistening with tiny flecks of pure gold. Here you have a seductive Don Juan's smile that entices you with its classical charm, the intricate gold details of the Palace of Versailles, the joy of a rustic picnic with friends on a sunny day, and the comforting softness of a cashmere sweater warming you up on a windy seaside.

name: Piper-Heidsieck  2008 Vintage Brut (750 ml)
wine_color: This is a free-spirited wine. The glistening, billowing folds of its golden cloak transport us through space and time, both of which seem to be extended by this wine’s complexity
desc_en_short: A velvety softness - as if brushing against a rose petal - envelops the mouth. Then a delicately sensual and ripe freshness sweeps across your palate, demonstrating this champagne’s liberated character. And to complete this idyllic sensation comes a saltiness accentuated by notes of peppery spices and plums.

name: Sieur d'Arques  Premiere Bulle No.1 - Brut Sleeve (750 ml)
desc_en_short: The open and bright attack with a pleasant sensation of smoothness provided by the bubbles. The aromas of white fruit share those with delicate dried fruit, toast, and toasted brioche. Trendy and feminine with its fuchsia bubble dress. The wine is light, fruity, worthy of the greatest bubbles. A youthful effervescence perfectly suited to your festive occasions. Perfect as an aperitif, it happily accompanies your sofa but also your fish bowl.

name: Sieur d'Arques  Premiere Bulle No.1 - Brut (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: The open and bright attack with a pleasant sensation of smoothness provided by the bubbles. The aromas of white fruit share those with delicate dried fruit, toast, and toasted brioche. Trendy and feminine with its fuchsia bubble dress. The wine is light, fruity, worthy of the greatest bubbles. A youthful effervescence perfectly suited to your festive occasions.  Perfect as an aperitif, it happily accompanies your sofa but also your fish bowl.

name: Sieur d'Arques  Premiere Bulle Rose No.1 - Brut
wine_color: A salmon rose robe with copper and silver nuances
desc_en_short: A salmon rose robe with copper and silver nuances. The very fine bubbles form a creamy string.  The nose offers a fruity base, lightly smoked with citrus fruit aromas plus a zest of orange, gooseberry, raspberry and peach. On aeration, the notes of ‘English sweets’ gives it a lovely extra dimension. In mouth, flavours of red fruits, freesia and a finish once again dominated by a refreshing zest.

name: Sieur d'Arques  Coeur de Bulle - Sweet
desc_en_short: Pale yellow. Nose – attractive in a sweet lighter alcohol style. Taste is very crisp and fruity. Due to a combination of good acidity balance an sparkle together with a delicate natural sweetness it is very easy to drink. Fresh, peachy.

name: Domaine Champalou  Vouvray Brut
wine_color: A pale straw in colour with excellent bubble formation.
desc_en_short: A pale straw in colour with excellent bubble formation. Floral and aromatic on the nose with notes of peach, melon and sweet hay. The palate is honeyed and round with excellent acidity and a long finish. Try with a seafood risotto, Gateau de Pithiviers (feuillette with almond filling), or a simple bowl of strawberries.

name: Schloss Vaux  Cuvee Vaux Sekt Brut
desc_en_short: This sparkling blend is crafted for the contemporary connoisseur from a blend of Pinot Blanc, Pinot Noir and Riesling. Our "marriage" of the rich creamy finesse of the Pinot varietals with Riesling's bright and refreshing acidity produces a perpetually stunning taste sensation.

name: Blue Nun  Finest Sparkling
desc_en_short: A long lasting sparkle in harmony with perfect fruit characteristics and inviting aromas of peach and mango with a trace of tropical fruit. Light and refreshing, perfect as an aperitif.

name: Le Champagne Francoise Bedel & Fils  Origin'elle
desc_en_short: this is ample and broad, showing warm, ripe flavors of tangerine apricot, guava and mango. Fresh acidity keeps it lively and kinetic on the palate, providing definition and cut underneath the richness.

name: Robert Moncuit  Champagne Extra Brut Blanc de Blanc Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with golden reflections. Nice and fine notes of white peach and lemon, with a finale that recalls the yeast and bread crust. Taste is Fresh, elegant, refined, creamy, intense, with a nice minerality.

name: Champagne Marguet  Extra Brut Element 11 Grand Cru
desc_en_short: shows a straw yellow color with notes of citrus and candied fruit. The taste is of medium intensity and structure, with a pleasant freshness and a determined persistence.

name: Dhondt-Grellet  Dans Un Premier Temps Brut
desc_en_short: The NV Brut Dans un Premier Temps is delicious. Soft, open and gracious, the Dans un Premier Temps shows its soft curves and resonant personality to great effect. There is good creaminess and up-front richness to the fruit, while the flavors retain striking freshness and aromatic lift throughout.

name: Benoît Déhu  "Cuvée la Rue des Noyers"
desc_en_short: Quality sparkling Pinot Meunier from la Vallée de la Marne. Stony minerality and delicious yellow and dried fruits with a foamy, silky texture. Multi-layered complex wine that has a depth and structure to age for many years.

name: Charles Dufour  Bistrotage (Les Istantanes)
style: Chardonnay, 45% Pinot Noir And 5% Of Pinot Blanc.
desc_en_short: Charles Dufour had a first traditionalist approach to viticulture and then leave almost immediately to organic farming space. His Champagne they reveal immense authenticity able to reflect the terroir character of the Cote des Bars. The Champagne Bristrotage (Les Istantanes) translates a series of specimens of his first Champagne, obtained from the harvest in 2009 with the addition of "vin de reserve" from 1988 to 2008 by the assembly of the 50% Chardonnay, 45% Pinot Noir and 5% of Pinot Blac, Fermented in oak barrels with 18 months aging on the less. Minerality and pure power.

name: Charles Dufour  La Pulpe et le Grain
desc_en_short: Champagne Dufour La Pulpe et le Grain: It belongs to the Charles Dufour winery, located in Landreville. This champagne is composed of a variety of 100% Pinot noir grape. The soil on which this champagne is made is clay-calcareous. The winemaking is done according to the traditional method; finally, its aging is carried out in barrels for 24 months and later in the bottle 4 years.

name: Charles Dufour  La Sauvage
desc_en_short: Champagne Dufour La Sauvage: It belongs to the Charles Dufour winery, located in Landreville. This champagne is composed of a variety of 100% Chardonnay grape. Scent-wise is clearly complex and promises much more than the one-dimensional flavor delivers.

name: Charles Dufour  Bulles de Comptoir 4 “Vinorama”
desc_en_short: Charles Dufour had a traditionalist approach to viticulture and then switched to an organic farming space. His Champagne reveals immense authenticity, able to reflect the character of the terroir of the Côte des Bars. Champagne Bulles de Comptoir # 4 Vinorama consists of an assemblage of Pinot Noir grapes, Chardonnay and a touch of Pinot Blanc, collected in 2013 from the base with the addition of "vin de réserve" from 2010 and 2011. No sulfites are added to this Champagne Extra Brut. Disgorged in January 2016 in limited quantities in 4 different labels.

name: Charles Dufour  La Chevetre Chardonnay Brut Nature
desc_en_short: From the Côte de Bar region in Champagne, this cuvée is named after the place name of the parcel of clay limestone soil.  Indegenous fermentations (both primary and Malo-lactic) in 228 liter barrels that had previous held 5 wines.  Stirring of the lees twice over the winter.  22 months on the lees, zero dosage. Approx. 700 bottles produced per year

name: Charles Dufour  Le Champs du Clos Pinot Blanc Brut Nature
desc_en_short: From the Côte de Bar region in Champagne, this cuvée is named after the place name of the parcel of clay limestone soil.  Indegenous fermentations (both primary and Malo-lactic) in Fiberglass tanks.  Stirring of the lees twice over the winter.  Zero dosage. Approx. 1,700 bottles produced per year.

name: Francis Boulard  Les Murgiers Brut Nature
desc_en_short: Attractive nose of dried fruit, white fruit and citrus flowery hints. The champagne is forward in the mouth with powerful aromatic flavours. A broad and expressive champagne. Serve at 10 °C (50°F) as an aperitif, with starters such as fish, tarts and pates, prosciutto hams (culatello, pata negra), poultry and white meats.

name: Francis Boulard  Vieilles Vignes Blanc de Blanc
desc_en_short: Nose of white flowers and citrus. The champagne is supple, fine and round in the mouth, well supported by good freshness and a touch of minerality. Serve at 10 °C (50°F) as an aperitif, with oysters and other shellfish, fine fish “en papillote”, freshwater fish as well as sushis et sashimis.

name: Francis Boulard  Les Rachais Extra Brut
desc_en_short: Rich nose of fully ripe white fruit, citrus, pastries and of dried fruit with a slight hint of honey. In the mouth, the wine is mouth filling, with a fine texture. Powerful and long. Serve at 10 °C (50°F) as an aperitif, or at table with fish, poultry and white meats. The wine shows at its best after several minutes of aeration.

name: Chartogne-Taillet  Cuvee Saint Anne Brut
desc_en_short: 90 points in Wine Spectator - "An elegant aperitif, with a fine, creamy mousse and vibrant acidity enlivening the delicate flavors of black cherry, chalky mineral, creamed apple, pastry and lemon zest. Disgorged February 2014. Drink now through 2019."

name: Chartogne-Taillet  Champagne Fiacre Taillet
desc_en_short: This Champagne is blended from two vineyards located close to each other, called Le Chemin de Reims et Les Orizeaux. Their calcareous and sandy soils create a wine of remarkable precision and finesse. Enjoy this Champagne as an aperitif as well as an accompaniment to a meal.

name: Roses de Jeanne  Cote de Val Vilaine
desc_en_short: The fundamental features of this little producer are organic agriculture and a limited production, for a complex and inimitable product. The Champagne Lieux Dits Côte de Val Vilaine is 100% Pinot Noirs, a real Blanc de Noirs, from the same-name parcel and a maturation of 24 months on dregs. Very low dosage.

name: Roses de Jeanne  Cote de Bechalin
desc_en_short: Born from a unique parcel of the “Côte de Béchalin” named place, this Blanc de Noirs (made from Pinot Noir) is balanced between roundness and remarkable tension. Its nose, displaying notes of almonds, nougat, pear, Golden delicious apple and white flowers, captivates by its richness and complexity. This dry white displays a complex and intense nose featuring empyreumatic, floral and fruity aromas. On the palate, its lively acidity and broad texture precede a long finish.

name: Roses de Jeanne  Les Ursules Blanc de Noirs 2012
desc_en_short: 94 points in Vinous, Antonio Galloni - "The 2012 Blanc de Noirs Les Ursules is another knockout. Here it is the freshness and energy of Pinot Noir that makes the strongest impression. White orchard fruit, flowers, white pepper and mint give the Ursules its distinctly high-toned personality. The interplay between the richness of the Pinot Noir and inherent tension that characterizes all of these wines is dazzling. Scents of orchard fruit, spice, herb and flowers infuse the creamy, voluptuous layered finish. Disgorged: April 2016. No dosage."

name: Roses de Jeanne  La Haute Lemblé
desc_en_short: The fundamental features of this little producer are organic agriculture and a limited production, for a complex and inimitable product. The Champagne Lieux Dits La Haute Lemblé is 100% Chardonnay, a real Blanc de Blancs, from the same-name parcel and a maturation of 42 months on dregs. After fermentation, the wine is not filtered, but purified naturally.

name: Roses de Jeanne  La Presle
desc_en_short: The fundamental features of this little producer are organic agriculture and a limited production, for a complex and inimitable product. The Champagne Lieux Dits Presle is 100% Pinot Noir, coming from a single parcel of 0.25 hectares and 10 different types of Pinot Noir. No dosage (Brut Nature) for this rich, aromatic and expressive Champagne Blanc de Noirs.

name: Roses de Jeanne  La Bolorée
desc_en_short: “The Bolorée opens up in the glass to reveal exceptional depth, power and intensity. Historically, the Bolorée has needed a few years in bottle after release to show at its best. I expect that to be the case here as well. There is real thrust to the white orchard fruit, citrus, slate and floral notes, but readers need to be patient. The heady, explosive finish hints at a very bright future. La Bolorée, Bouchard’s old-vine Pinot Blanc, is one of the hardest wines anywhere in the world to track down. Those fortunate enough to find it are in for a real treat.”

name: Roses de Jeanne  Les Ursules Blanc de Noirs 2012 (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: 94 points in Vinous, Antonio Galloni - "The 2012 Blanc de Noirs Les Ursules is another knockout. Here it is the freshness and energy of Pinot Noir that makes the strongest impression. White orchard fruit, flowers, white pepper and mint give the Ursules its distinctly high-toned personality. The interplay between the richness of the Pinot Noir and inherent tension that characterizes all of these wines is dazzling. Scents of orchard fruit, spice, herb and flowers infuse the creamy, voluptuous layered finish. Disgorged: April 2016. No dosage."

name: Champagne Marguet  Extra Brut Element 11 Grand Cru (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Shows a straw yellow color with notes of citrus and candied fruit. The taste is of medium intensity and structure, with a pleasant freshness and a determined persistence.

name: Champagne Marguet  Ambonnay Grand Cru Extra Brut 2010
wine_color: A light-straw color with golden highlights.
desc_en_short: The taste of champagne reveals an elegant, fresh, rich fruit range, in which the notes of a pear, apple and orange peel are felt. A clean, long-lasting, balanced aftertaste.

name: Champagne Marguet  Avize & Cramant 2014 Grand Cru
desc_en_short: Champagne Marguet  Avize & Cramant 2014 Grand Cru made from 100% Chardonnay from grapes grown in the eponymous villages classified  100% Grand Cru in the renowned Côte des Blancs.

name: Champagne Marguet  Les Crayeres Grand Cru 2014
desc_en_short: Benoit Marguet is one of the vanguard in Champagne, pushing for quality in the vineyard and winery no matter how difficult the process. Starting with the 2008 harvest, he began setting aside and bottling separately the wine from his best vineyard plots. This Champagne is powerful and rich in attack on a beautiful mineral finish.

name: Champagne Marguet  La Grande Ruelle Grand Cru 2012
desc_en_short: Champagne Marguet La Grande Ruelle Grand Cru is another of the large plots of the Ambonnay Grand Cru on the Mountain of Reims, vinified and bottled separately as Benoit Marguet's champagne parcel from the 2012 vintage. Made from 100 % Pinot Noir. Use of biodynamic practices in both the vineyard and the processing.

name: Champagne Marguet  Le Parc Grand Cru 2014
desc_en_short: The Champagne Le Parc 2014 by Marguet is 100% Chardonnay from vineyards located in the same-name lieu-dit, planted in 1982 in Ambonnay, classified as 100% Grand Cru in the renowed Montagne de Reims. Le Parc 2014 fermented and refined for over 9 months in barrels of different sizes, indigenous yeasts, 4 more years in bottles on its yeasts, low levels of sulfur and no final dosage. Energetic Champagne with fineness and complexity. Limited production of 1,962 bottles.

name: Champagne Marguet  Sapience Brut Nature Vintage 2007 Premier Cru
desc_en_short: The Cuvée Sapience is the first exceptional champagne certified AB. It is a blend of 50% Chardonnay from the village of Trépail, 25% from Pinot Noir d'Ambonnay and 25% from Pinot Meunier de Cumières.

name: J-M Seleque Champagne  Solessence Extra Brut
desc_en_short: Solessence is our philosophy : ploughing of soils, strict pruning, control of yields, favoring the natural balance, singlevineyard winemaking, respect for the life and the wine by sustainable practices.

name: J-M Seleque Champagne  Solessence - Brut Nature
desc_en_short: Solessence is our philosophy : ploughing of soils, strict pruning, control of yields, favoring the natural balance, singlevineyard winemaking, respect for the life and the wine by sustainable practices.

name: J-M Seleque Champagne  Solessence - Extra Brut (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Solessence is our philosophy : ploughing of soils, strict pruning, control of yields, favoring the natural balance, singlevineyard winemaking, respect for the life and the wine by sustainable practices.

name: J-M Seleque Champagne  Solistes - Meunier 2013 - Extra Brut 1er Cru
desc_en_short: Les Solistes are wines from typical vineyards which give us a very significant caracter of their terroir.

name: J-M Seleque Champagne  Partition 2013 - Extra Brut
desc_en_short: The Champagne Extra Brut Partition 2013 by J-M Sélèque is 72% Chardonnay, 14% Meunier and 14% Pinot Noir, coming from 7 parcels (lieux-dits) in 7 different villages in Vallée de la Marne and Côte des Blancs: Pierry, Moussy, Epernay, Mardeuil, Dizy, Boursault and Vertus. Vinification and fermentation of single parcels, 100% in oak barrels with no malolactic fermentation. Refinement from over 48 months for this structured and complex Champagne Extra Brut. Annual production of 1,500 bottles.

name: Emmanuel Brochet  "Le Mont Benoit" Extra Brut
desc_en_short: All Cuvée Emmanuel Brochet born and mature in wood for over a year.This Champagne, Le Mont Benoit is made from 37% Meunier grapes, from 39% Pinot Noir grapes and the remaining 24% from Chardonnay grapes, an Extra Brut whose grapes come only from classification Premier Cru vineyards (20% collected in 2012 and 80% collected in 2013). Flavor long, intense and rich carry the palate to taste one of absolute pleasure stadium

name: Emmanuel Brochet  Haut Meunier Extra Brut
desc_en_short: The Champagne Les Hauts Meuniers of Emmanuel Brochet is a Blanc de Noirs made from 100% of Meunier from vines planted in 1962 from a single parcel ( lieux-dit ) in the highest part of Montbenoît. No dosage for this stylish Champagne Extra Brut.

name: Emmanuel Brochet  Haut Chardonnay 2011 Extra Brut
desc_en_short: Champagne Les Hauts Chardonnays Emmanuel Brochet is a Blanc de Blancs from vines planted in 1962 from a single parcel (lieux-dit) in the highest part of Montbenoît. Dosage 2 g / l for this fantastic Champagne Extra Brut.

name: Dhondt-Grellet  Les Terres Fines Blanc de Blancs Extra Brut - Premier Cru
desc_en_short: Made out of carefully selected crus, this 100 % Chardonnay is a pure and transparent reserve wine. It's note is fresh and elegant. Its exotic-fruit aromas and its incredible freshness give it thick foam. Ideal for aperitif or to be paired with fishes or seafood.

name: Dhondt-Grellet  Prestige Du Moulin Blanc de Blancs Brut
desc_en_short: This 100 % Chardonnay is made of Grands Cru of Côte des Blancs (best champagne – vineyard area) : Cramant. Its golden- color appearance goes along with wine delicate and regular bubbles. The elegant fragrance goes along with wine delicate and regular bubbles. The tasting will reveal the seduction, the unique elegance of this champagne.

name: Dhondt-Grellet  Lebateaumillesime Extra Brut Grand Cru Blanc de Blancs
desc_en_short: The nose reveals aromas of ripe fleshy fruits togethers with stronger floral notes (orange blossom, linden flowers). The wine will confirm its top-of-the-range ranking once in your mouth and the years would even amplify its character : Ageing wine. The gastronomy cuvée : this champagne is ideal to be paired with shellfish and pan-fried foie gras.

name: Georges Laval  Cumieres Premier Cru Brut Nature
style: Chardonnay 40%, Pinot Meunier 30% And Pinot Noir 30%
desc_en_short: This is the third most highly rated Champagne Brut Nature – Zero wine (based on critic scores): the 2011 vintage was given a score of 92 by Vinous Antonio Galloni.

name: Georges Laval  Cumieres Premier Cru Brut Nature Rose
desc_en_short: This Champagne Rose wine has received good scores from various critics. This is among the highest-priced Champagne Rose wine. The price has been stable over the past year. Above average in popularity among wines from this region.

name: Francoise Bedel & Fils  Dis, “Vin Secret”
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

Sumptuous effervescence with a delicate bead of fine bubbles. The color is antique gold. The wine is limpid and sparking. The wine's maturity comes to the fore with a combination of dried fruits and spicy undercurrent, and confirmed after aeration by vague suggestions of tropical fruits. It is full and round with nice apple's freshness and citrus aromas. The final reveals maturity, giving the wine a great length.

name: Francoise Bedel & Fils  Entre Ciel & Terre
desc_en_short: A champagne whose subtle combination of vinosity and freshness gives it great appeal. This champagne would go well with seafood or fish in a sour sauce.

name: Francoise Bedel & Fils  L'Ame de la Terre 2004
desc_en_short: Twice fruity and vinous, this champagne keeps an appreciated freshness. It can perfectly opens the meal with amuse-bouche : saumon, caviar, shellfish.

name: Francoise Bedel & Fils  Comme Autrefois
style: Pinot Noir, 40 Pinot Meunier And 20% Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This reserve is vinified completely in oak casks and bottled directly with a traditional cork in a square bottle ring, and left to age on its lees for at least 10 years. A vinous wine, harmonious and with a great fineness, on a large aromatic palette of reds fruits and acidulated freshness.

name: R. Pouillon & Fils  Cuvee de Reserve Brut
desc_en_short: This is a blend of crus from all of Pouillon’s holdings, its assemblage mirroring the composition of the estate with 70% pinot noir and 15% each of chardonnay and pinot meunier. 85% is fermented in tank, 15% in oak. This is richly textured and silky, displaying aromas of lemon grass, strawberry and brioche.

name: R. Pouillon & Fils  Cuvee de Reserve Brut (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: This is a blend of crus from all of Pouillon’s holdings, its assemblage mirroring the composition of the estate with 70% pinot noir and 15% each of chardonnay and pinot meunier. 85% is fermented in tank, 15% in oak. This is richly textured and silky, displaying aromas of lemon grass, strawberry and brioche.

name: R. Pouillon & fils  Blanc de Blancs Brut
desc_en_short: This chardonnay cuvée comes from Pouillon’s holdings in Mareuil-sur-Aÿ and Tauxières-Mutry. It is full-bodied and rich in texture. Bright apple, Bartlett pear and five-spice solidify the core of the aromatic spectrum. The base is 2013 with 40% reserve wine from 2012 aged in 500L barrels. In total, there is about 60% oak aging on this wine. The wine is aged sur latte for 36 months prior to disgorgement. 7 grams MCR.

name: R. Pouillon & fils  Rosé de Maceration Brut
desc_en_short: This wine is 100% pinot noir from the premier cru Mareuil-sur-Aÿ. Fabrice macerates the juice on the skins for up to 12 hours before it is pressed and fermented in enamel. Then 20% of the juice is raised in neutral barrel and the rest is blended with the previous year's wine which was in barrel for 12 months. Doing so allows Fabrice to balance the tannins which naturally come from saignée rosé with the mellowness which comes from a year in neutral barrel. "You must smell the color," says Fabrice. This blend is 80% 2013 and 20% 2012 with 7 grams MCR.

name: R. Pouillon  Blanchiens Brut Nature 2011
desc_en_short: -The Champagne Les Blanchiens 2011 by Fabrice Pouillon is a blend of 50% Chardonnay and 50% Pinot Noir from the same-name parcel (lieu-dit) located in Mareuil-sur-Aÿ, a village classified as Premier Cru in Vallée de la Marne.

name: Marie Courtin  Resonance
desc_en_short: It is extremely fresh, lively, delicate with a natural balance of taught, racy acidity and underlying richness and texture. This Champagnes cuts and yet softens with creamy mushroom notes and ripe stone fruits. A Champagne that cleans the palate rather than laying heavy on it. It is wine that needs some oxygen to fully come alive and a couple of hours after releasing the cork, the wine opens up and shows depth of flavour and complexity alongside its zingy freshness. A lovely apero, it also matches very well with some smoked salmon, some salty snacks or a light fish mousseline as an appetiser.

name: Marie Courtin  Efflorescence
desc_en_short: Marie-Courtin's have always been singular, multi-dimensional Champagnes with penetrating concentration married to a silky elegance. With each passing year, the wines have grown increasingly refined and precise. The 2011 takes things to a new level. In the nervy 2013 vintage, the wood aging really pays off. The 2011 Efflorescence assumes a beautiful depth that's animated by the racy backbone and seamless melding of tactile chalky minerality, herbs and crisp stone fruits.

name: Lilbert Fils Champagne  Perle
desc_en_short: Good depth and authority with complex mushroomy and ripe yellow fruits. Super intense salinity. While it has good depth and very generous on the palate, it was really the underlying tension and length that we adored.

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Murmure Brut Nature 1er Cru
desc_en_short: Vergnon Champagne, five generations and almost two centuries in the same winery. Located in the heart of the Côte des Blancs, the Vergnon House elaborates its Champagnes exclusively from grape harvested on vineyards located in Mesnil-sur-Oger, Oger and Avize, all classified Grand Cru and exclusively planted in the Chardonnay variety.

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Extra Brut Grand Cru
desc_en_short: This Champagne is a blend of grape harvested on the Grands Crus plots of Mesnil-sur-Oger, Oger and Avize. The House’s vineyards are exclusively located in grand cru territories and from several years. This Wine is a crystal gold with green and silver hues in color. The notes of almond, orgeat and grapefruit aromas. After a few moments, the second attack to the nose is more mineral and salty, with touches of vanilla and grilled brioche bread with a finish on dried flowers and honey. The attack to the palate is very mineral and salted, with a creamy expression.  A lingering finish with a chalky note, proof of the authenticity of the region’s calcareous soils. Will perfectly fit as an aperitif, with caviar toasts but also on a seafood platter. Will also fit with sushi, smoked salmon carpaccio, or lobster medallion. To be served around 8 to 10°C.

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Extra Brut Grand Cru (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: This Champagne is a blend of grape harvested on the Grands Crus plots of Mesnil-sur-Oger, Oger and Avize. The House’s vineyards are exclusively located in grand cru territories and from several years. This Wine is a crystal gold with green and silver hues in color. The notes of almond, orgeat and grapefruit aromas. After a few moments, the second attack to the nose is more mineral and salty, with touches of vanilla and grilled brioche bread with a finish on dried flowers and honey. The attack to the palate is very mineral and salted, with a creamy expression.  A lingering finish with a chalky note, proof of the authenticity of the region’s calcareous soils. Will perfectly fit as an aperitif, with caviar toasts but also on a seafood platter. Will also fit with sushi, smoked salmon carpaccio, or lobster medallion. To be served around 8 to 10°C.

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Rosemotion Extra Brut
style: This Champagne Is A Blend Exclusively From The Grand Cru Plots Of Avize For White Wine And Mailly Champagne For Red.
desc_en_short: This Champagne is a blend exclusively from the Grand Cru plots of Avize for white wine and Mailly Champagne for red. This wine is a tender rose petal in color. The first nose sensation is on red berries like wild strawberry or redcurrant followed by touches of grapefruit. The second sense is on strawberries, saffron and biscuits. Great minerality. The palate confirms the nose’s perceptions red berries and citruses. Will fit perfectly as an aperitif with foie gras toasts, dried duck breast or even better with parmesan cubes soaked in balsamic vinegar of Modena. To be served around 8 to 10°C

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Brut Nature Grand Cru O.G 2010
desc_en_short: "This is from Oger, but can't be labelled so because Christoph doesn't have a carnet de pressoir for it. In tank for 9 months, no malolactic. There's some Chardonnay musque in the parcel. Complex, taut, fruity lemon, apple and herb characters with some fine nut and wax notes. Quite powerful with real complexity, and a slightly savoury edge with good structure and focus."

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Expression Millesime 2008
desc_en_short: This Champagne is a blend of grape harvested exclusively on the Grands Crus territories of Mesnil-sur-Oger and Oger, and from a single year. The first aromas are white fruits, wheat, spices like ginger. Following up are touches of brioche with dried fruits and orange zests. To the palate, expression of white fruits, honey, biscuits/boudoirs, finely grilled brioche bread and candied citruses. The creamy effervescence feels perfect in mouth. Will be perfect as an aperitif but also on a seafood platter or with bass filets, grilled salmon with olive oil from the first press.

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Renonance Extra Brut Millesime 2008
desc_en_short: The colour is a green yellow with light golden hues. On the nose is candied citruses with a touch of vanilla as a first impression followed by notes of chalk, fresh leather, almond and spices, all of which are typical traits of a calcareous soil, the Chardonnay variety and the many months spent in cellar. To the palate, expressions of honey, biscuits/boudoirs, and finely grilled brioche with candied citruses. Perfect as an aperitif but also with a seafood platter or with bass or grilled salmon with olive oil.

name: J.L Vergnon Champagne  Confidence Brut Nature 2009
desc_en_short: This wine is a beautiful golden shade with light green hues. Aromas of pastries, vanilla, candied pear, acacia honey, white pepper followed by touches of acid apple and finely wooden orange blossom. To the palate is a grilled brioche, pecans and touches of oak wood brought with the vinification in barrels. Lingering finish with fine notes of fresh hazelnut, Menton lemon and ginger. Ideal with a seafood platter (urchins, Marennes oysters).

name: Nathalie Falmet  Cuvée Brut
desc_en_short: 91 points in The Wine Advocate - "The NV Brut is made of 50% Pinot Noir, 30% Chardonnay (both 2011) and 20% Reserve (from a Soléra started in 2009). Its refined aromas of bright fruits migrate to a very light and delicate first palate. This champagne is dry (dosage: seven grams per liter) and firmly structured, but really fine and elegant, and provided with a good length and subtle mineral flavors."

name: Nathalie Falmet  Brut Nature
desc_en_short: 91 points in The Wine Advocate - "Nathalie Falmet's NV Brut Nature is a 100% Pinot Noir sourced in one particular vintage from old vines in Rouvres-les-Vignes. The wine I tasted was the 2011, which was kept on the lees for the second fermentation for three years. As always, it is not declared as a vintage because Nathalie wants "to be free" when to disgorge her wines. The (2011) Brut Nature has a dark white golden color with a reddish hue. Very clear and full-flavored red berry flavors on the nose, this is a full yet very delicate and refined, complex and elegant Champagne with a nice purity and length, and a salty finish. Really excellent. Rating: 91+"

name: Nathalie Falmet  Le Val Cornet 2011
desc_en_short: 94 points in The Wine Advocate - "Half-each Meunier and Pinot; all-2010; and matured in older casks, Falmet’s single-vineyard NV Brut Le Val Cornet Disg. 5/2012 is nothing short of revelatory in its polish, transparency and complexity! (Bear in mind that, like me, you will almost certainly never have tasted a wine from within 20 or 25 miles of this one, as we’re talking about an almost entirely overlooked sector of a Champagne region, the Bar, that has only since the turn of the millennium begun to attract attention for estate-bottling.) A greenhouse-like profusion of leafing and flowering things on the nose is joined by scents of apple and red raspberry subtly shadowed by their high-toned distilled counterparts. Almost weightlessly buoyant, seductively silken and infectiously juicy in its apple and raspberry manifestations, this amazing libation simultaneously suggests hazelnut cream, almond paste and walnut oil, resulting in an uncanny counterpoint with its lively fruit acids. Crunch of berry seeds and legume sprouts lend invigoration to a chalk suffused finish in which salinity and savor of oyster liquor spell “Umami” and “Kimmeridgian” in caps, and it takes real effort to disengage the salivary glands, much less resist the next sip. I’m only guessing when I suggest that this will be worth following for at least several more years. But don’t miss out on some now! (As soon as I had finished my sample, I went on-line and bought some of this amazing value in Champagne, in part just to re-taste and make sure it was really this good.) "

name: Nathalie Falmet  Cuvée Brut (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: 91 points in The Wine Advocate - "The NV Brut is made of 50% Pinot Noir, 30% Chardonnay (both 2011) and 20% Reserve (from a Soléra started in 2009). Its refined aromas of bright fruits migrate to a very light and delicate first palate. This champagne is dry (dosage: seven grams per liter) and firmly structured, but really fine and elegant, and provided with a good length and subtle mineral flavors."

name: Nathalie Falmet  Brut Nature (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: 91 points in The Wine Advocate - "Nathalie Falmet's NV Brut Nature is a 100% Pinot Noir sourced in one particular vintage from old vines in Rouvres-les-Vignes. The wine I tasted was the 2011, which was kept on the lees for the second fermentation for three years. As always, it is not declared as a vintage because Nathalie wants "to be free" when to disgorge her wines. The (2011) Brut Nature has a dark white golden color with a reddish hue. Very clear and full-flavored red berry flavors on the nose, this is a full yet very delicate and refined, complex and elegant Champagne with a nice purity and length, and a salty finish. Really excellent. Rating: 91+"

name: Nathalie Falmet  Parcelle ZH 302 Extra Brut
desc_en_short: Nathalie Falmet  Parcelle ZH 302 is a 100% Pinot Meunier from the lieu-dit Le Val Cornet. Based entirely on a specific vintage and vinified in 350 liter oak barrels for nine months, the 2010 is the first release of this single vineyard champagne; the sample I tasted with Nathalie in Château de Pierry was disgorged after 48 months with no dosage. It is fruity and spicy on the nose, with sweet cherry flavors on both nose and palate. Full-bodied, aromatic and well structured, this is a very dry, pure and delicate champagne with an impressive intensity in the mouth, whereas the finish is subtle again but full of tension.

name: Christophe Mignon  Brut Nature Pur Meunier
desc_en_short: 93 points in Vinous, Antonio Galloni - "A wine of real finesse and nuance, Mignon's NV Brut Nature Blanc de Noirs Pur Meunier is exquisite. Rich, layered and vinous, but never heavy, the Blanc de Noirs Pur Meunier speaks to grace above all else. The flavors are distinctly floral and savory, while the fruit lies more in the background. Hints of dried pear, brioche, dried herbs and flowers meld into the gracious, mid-weight finish. This is an especially understated wine from Christophe Mignon. The current release is equal parts 2013 and 2012 vintages, bottled with no dosage. Disgorged: February 2016."

name: Christophe Mignon  Pur Meunier Extra Brut
desc_en_short: This Champagne, either with no sugar dosage or discreetly dosed, is elegant, refined and indulgent, with notes of spices, pear and dried fruit. Select the level of dryness to complement the accompanyind dish.

name: Christophe Mignon  Cuvee Coup de Foudre Nature
desc_en_short: A structured wine, delicate, yet wrapped up with a certain power, a well-balanced Champagne with pleasant hints of dried fruit mixed with notes of vanilla, smoky and spicy flavours.

name: Christophe Mignon  Rose
desc_en_short: A deep raspberry robe. Lively, fresh and elegant, this champagne has a candid attack and delicate bubbles, it will marvellously accompany caramel flavours. A slight and pleasant acidity and a wonderfully persistent finish.

name: Christophe Mignon  Rose De Saignee
desc_en_short: A soft and elegant rosé in its pure Meunier incarnation, with a crimson robe, raspberry, strawberry and grapefruit flavours. On the palate is revealed a lively wine, fruity, with a persistent stream of bubbles and a long mineral finish.

name: Christophe Mignon  Brut Nature (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: 93 points in Vinous, Antonio Galloni - "A wine of real finesse and nuance, Mignon's NV Brut Nature Blanc de Noirs Pur Meunier is exquisite. Rich, layered and vinous, but never heavy, the Blanc de Noirs Pur Meunier speaks to grace above all else. The flavors are distinctly floral and savory, while the fruit lies more in the background. Hints of dried pear, brioche, dried herbs and flowers meld into the gracious, mid-weight finish. This is an especially understated wine from Christophe Mignon. The current release is equal parts 2013 and 2012 vintages, bottled with no dosage. Disgorged: February 2016."

name: Bereche et Fils  Champagne Brut Reserve
desc_en_short: An supremely elegant Champagne with a fruity bouquet of soft apple, apricot and red berry. Beautiful and simple with fine acidity and lively, appley fruit on the palate with a clean, fresh finish.

name: Bereche et Fils  Champagne Campania Remensis Rose
desc_en_short: "Extremely pale pink. A fragrant, mineral-tinged bouquet evokes wild red berries, blood orange, jasmine and white pepper, with a hint of smokiness in the background. Dry, focused and light on its feet, offering tangy strawberry and citrus zest flavors that put on weight with air. Shows outstanding clarity and lift on a finish that leaves chalky mineral and floral notes in its wake. As graceful a pink Champagne as you're likely to find, but it doesn't lack at all for flavor depth or intensity."

name: Bereche et Fils  Champagne Reflet D'Antan
desc_en_short: The Reflet D’Antan Bereche et Fils – Champagne Brut is amazingly delicious. At once rich yet weightless, it embodies a sense of pure aesthetic beauty that is hard to do justice to with mere words. Deep, burnished overtones develop in the glass, giving the wine additional volume, yet the Reflet d’Antan remains gracious and impeccably polished. Hints of almond, spice and orange peel add elements of exoticism. Bérèche’s Reflet d’Antan remains one of the most unique and compelling wines in Champagne.

name: Bereche et Fils  Champagne Brut Reserve (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: An supremely elegant Champagne with a fruity bouquet of soft apple, apricot and red berry. Beautiful and simple with fine acidity and lively, appley fruit on the palate with a clean, fresh finish

name: Bereche et Fils  Champagne Campania Remensis Rose (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: "Extremely pale pink. A fragrant, mineral-tinged bouquet evokes wild red berries, blood orange, jasmine and white pepper, with a hint of smokiness in the background. Dry, focused and light on its feet, offering tangy strawberry and citrus zest flavors that put on weight with air. Shows outstanding clarity and lift on a finish that leaves chalky mineral and floral notes in its wake. As graceful a pink Champagne as you're likely to find, but it doesn't lack at all for flavor depth or intensity."

name: Bereche et Fils  Cote Grand Cru 2007
style: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay And Pinot Meunier
desc_en_short: Limestone and salinity to the nose great depth of aroma while revealing the austerity of the terroir. Compact and precise wine, long mineral finish.

name: Suenen Champagne  Brut Reserve
desc_en_short: Golden yellow color. Mineral structure, accompanied by notes of dried fruits (pistachios, grilled almonds) and linden blossom. soft and fresh flavor with a creamy effervescence. The mineral fabric chalky brings a great delicacy with notes of dried fruit. The finish is smooth, very persistent and delicate.

name: Suenen Champagne  Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Extra-Brut
desc_en_short: Golden yellow color. clean and delicate bouquet. Rich in the mouth with fleshy fruits aroma of roasted nuts and hints of yeast. Fresh, elegant and balanced, with a long and creamy.

name: Suenen Champagne  Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru Extra-Brut (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Golden yellow color. clean and delicate bouquet. Rich in the mouth with fleshy fruits aroma of roasted nuts and hints of yeast. Fresh, elegant and balanced, with a long and creamy.

name: Suenen Champagne  Rose Brut
desc_en_short: This rose Champagne evolves from a raspberry color with a tint with a hint of salmon. On the nose notes of strawberries, raspberries, currants, blackberries, currants, cherries and black cherries. The predominant feeling is fresh. The fruity notes dominate the palate. The wine combines a beautiful structure to the freshness. Attack decided in the mouth which then fades into a symphony of aromas; kind and final round.

name: Suenen Champagne  Millesime 2010 Blanc de Blanc Grand cru
desc_en_short: An intensity that is found in the mouth, all in lightness and elegance, with a very nice velvety texture. Very ripe citrus fruits, dried fruits and fresh bread, with chalky notes. A whiteness of extra-raw whiteness completely integrated, which finishes on a long acidulated finish and harmonious, dense and salivating.

name: Robert Moncuit Champagne  Millesime 2008 Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru (Magnum)  (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: The Moncuit family produces all 'Blanc de Blancs' Champagne, meaning 100% Chardonnay. Their vines are tended without the use of pesticides and herbicides. The fruit is hand-harvested and sorted, with each parcel vinified separately to optimize the outcome of blending. All of the wines are fermented and raised in tank, the goal being contact with the lees. The malos happen naturally, they don't filter or chapitalize. The base wine for this Brut is 2010 with about 20% reserve from 2009. Approximately 30% of the cuvée is aged in oak. This is the only wine in his range that sees any oak so as not to mask the beautiful chalkiness of the Mesnil soils. Made with 8g dosage.

name: Robert Moncuit Champagne  Millesime 2008 Bouteille Cuvee Les Chetillons
desc_en_short: A family-run estate with organic vineyards, Champagne Robert Moncuit has a five generation history. Alex Moncuit started the vineyard in 1889, and in 1928 his grandson Robert created his first cuvée and Champagne Robert Moncuit was born. Robert continued to produce this exceptional Champagne until his death in 1987. His daughter Francoise took over the estate, and her son Pierre has been winemaker since 2000. Until 2000 all the wine was sold in France. The estate has 8 hectares under vine in Le Mesnil-sur-Oger which is the same renowned village where Krug's famous 'Clos du Mesnil' vineyard designate is made, and the Le Mesnil-sur-Oger is where the Salon family first realized and then convinced the world that this area was beautifully suited for Champagne made from 100% Chardonnay.

name: Robert Moncuit Champagne  Millesime 2008 Cuvee Les Chetillons (Magnum)  (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: 93 points in Wine Advocate - Launched for the first time, the 2008 Grand Cru Les Chétillons (Magnum) is 100% unfiltered Chardonnay with no dosage from the corresponding lieu-dit in Mesnil-sur-Oger in which Pierre Amillet holds two hectares. "This terroir has a very poor soil with only 20 centimeters of top soil over the chalky subsoil," he says. The vines were planted in 1956. Poured from the Magnum, the wine shows deep and very clear flavors of yellow apples, lemon and orange aromas. Still very young, this is a pure and very mineral Champagne full of finesse, vibration and length that will benefit from some months (not to mention years) of bottle aging. A great character.

name: David Léclapart  Cuvée l’Amateur
desc_en_short: L’Amateur serves as an introduction to the personality of David’s wines. It is made from 100% Chardonnay, blended from five different parcels in Trépail, and is vinified only in enameled vat with no dosage. L’Amateur has a distinctive clarity and energy that comes from a core of acidity combined with crisp citrus and apple fruit.

name: David Léclapart  Cuvée l’Artiste
desc_en_short: Golden yellow color intense and brilliant, with fine and persistent. Expressive nose, opens on notes of ripe fruit, citrus, butter, smoked. On the palate, it develops with great momentum and mineral acid. full and well-balanced body. The grand finale, long, on a note slightly bittering and bold closure, almost saline.

name: David Léclapart  Cuvée I'Apotre
desc_en_short: Golden yellow color intense and brilliant, with fine and persistent. On the nose, it opens up a range of yellow and white fruit complex (golden apple, white peach), fresh herbs, touch of liquorice and butter and nuances of grapefruit and orange. On the palate, it produces full-bodied and round and with clear mineral and sour track footprint. The finish is illuminated by a light smoky traces of great elegance, balance and persistence.

name: David Léclapart  Cuvée l’Astre
desc_en_short: “The sky originates, the earth nourishes and refines the man” – Bernard de Clairvaux – This phrase is at the base of the biodynamic philosophy of David Léclapart. Biodynamics is the only type of agricultural crop that, with the help of the farmer, combining the forces of heaven and earth. The vineyard’s soil is covered with different species of grass to replenish a graded structure that creates a new living space. The principles that govern his work in the cellar are identical to those in the vineyard: accuracy, respect for life and its rhythms, search for purity. For this the use of the barrel is primordial. For the pleasure of the body and spirit, David Léclapart vinified without any vintages assembly, so that the climate graven Wine contours and stimulate our knowledge. Champagne L’Astre David Leclapart is made from 100% Pinot Noir of Trépail village classified Premier Cru.

name: Savart Champagne  L'Ouverture
desc_en_short: This is a 100% pinot noir Champagne from the area in Ecueil. Soil is domaintly sand and the shows a refined red-fruited-ness.

name: Savart Champagne  L'Accomplie
desc_en_short: 92 points in Wine Advocate - This is a Premier Cru plot witha blend of 80/20 Pinot Noir / Chardonnay. A large portion of the Pinot noir is made of old vines (Selection Massle) with the base vintage from 2012. Aged in 50% 500 Lite barrels and the rest in stainless steel, this wine has classically pure with very clean fruits. Rather muted upon the first pop, the weight of the wine grows and turns into a expressive dance of minerals after 45 minutes in the bottle. This has all the great hall mark of a great wine.

name: Savart Champagne  Bulle De Rose
style: Pinot Noir, 10% Chardonnay And 8% Red Wine.
desc_en_short: This fine and elegant rose shows of the typicity of the pinot-noir with fruit-forward red fruits. This based on the 2012 vintage and has a silky texture and a lovely purity of red-fruit flavor. It finishes with succulent depth and a long, lilting fragrance, enlivened by the racy acidity of the vintage.

name: Savart Champagne  Dame De Coeur
desc_en_short: This is the last vintage of this single-vineyard, 100-percent chardonnay champagne to be called La Dame de Coeur, and as of 2013, it will be labeled with the name of the parcel, Le Mont des Chrétiens. It’s well-balanced as a non-dosé, its rich, ripe flavors of stone fruit and citrus feeling lively and focused without being austere. True to its vintage, it remains relatively closed for the moment, but it should develop more complexity and length with post-disgorgement age.

name: Savart Champagne  L'Expression
desc_en_short: Unlike previous editions of Expression, this is pinot noir sourced from five different parcels in Ecueil, all with vines over sixty years old. This is one of the top wines of Savart and it sits nicely on the pyramid with its lively structure is complemented by a vivid, concentrated depth of fruit, feeling broad in build and dark in flavor.

name: Savart Champagne  L'Expression Rose
style: Pinot Noir (Over 60yrs Old Vines) Blended With 5% Still Wine.
desc_en_short: Lovely complexity of spices, raspberry and salinity. The inner perfume is hauntingly seductive and the soft delicate oak adds a great touch to the overall structure of the wine. Never overpowering, the depth from the old vines (over 60 years old) shines through. The wine is full of purity with excellent underlying mineral tension. As vinous as a Champagne could offer.

name: Nua Lambrusco Emilia Rosso
desc_en_short: Lambrusco di Sorbara Contessa Matilde is rather pale ruby red in colour. This Lambrusco di Sorbara has a special freshness, a rich aroma with hints of violets. Dry and full-bodied with a fruity aroma, it is an excellent accompaniment to cold cuts, first courses with a meat sauce and fried dishes. Try it with fish crudités.

name: Cavicchioli  Rose Spumante
desc_en_short: Cavicchioli 1928 Rosé Spumante Dolce features, when poured and tasted, white and evanescent foam; fine and lingering perlage; bright and pale pink “candy” color; fresh and fruity aroma; sweet, slightly spicy and aromatic taste with red fruit notes with a lingering aftertaste; alcohol 9.5%.

name: Dream Line  Vulcano Premium Sparkling Wine
wine_color: Reddish orange color with amber highlights, accompanied by an attractive effect similar to a flare golden color along with a slow, steady release of small bubbles.
desc_en_short: An author´s white wine, clear, bright with an attractive bursting effect of bronze colour in conjunction with the slow release of small bubbles. Fine and persistent perlage. A clean nose, appetising and lightly fruity. Sparkling in the mouth, fruity, semisweet, fresh and slightly acidic. The first taste is very pleasant, faintly reminiscent of French Champagne and Spanish Cava. Serve cold. Between 8-10 C.

name: Gapsted  Alpine Road Prosecco
desc_en_short: This wine displays a pale straw colour with vibrant green glints. The nose shows fresh aromas of apple, quince and pear, leading to riper flavours of stewed apple, quince paste, cantaloupe and loquat and a fresh crisp palate. Made using the Charmat method to allow better retention of the mousse, a finer bead and the intensity of fruit characters to shine on the nose and palate.

name: Somerton  Sparkling Brut
desc_en_short: This wine displays a pale straw colour with a clean fruity aroma and a fresh crisp palate, the tropical fruit characters enhanced by a fine effervescence.

name: Passion Pop  Original
desc_en_short: A sparkling that’s overloaded with sweet passion fruit flavours, it’s the perfect choice when looking for an easy drink. Enjoy anytime you feel like something a little sweeter.

name: Passion Pop  Pink
desc_en_short: A vibrant and luscious wine, brimming with fresh naturally sweet red berry fruit flavours balanced with a brilliant frizzante tingle leading to a soft lingering tannin finish.

name: Passion Pop  Watermelon
food_matching: Oysters, Caviar, Fried Foods, Appetizers, Celebration
desc_en_short: Delicate watermelon shows on the palate, infused with touches of lime and mint. Delivered with a refreshing sparkling finish.

name: Fleury  Cépages Blancs Extra Brut
desc_en_short: This lovely, bone-dry Champagne has evolved nicely with the years of bottle age. Aromas of gingerbread and hazelnut complement the citrus aromas. Great for celebrations, but also wonderful with rich fish dishes like poached halibut.

name: Champagne Val'Frison  Cuvée Gouston Brut Nature
desc_en_short:
A Blanc de Noirs Champagne made from 100% Pinot Noir with zero dosage.
The grapes grown organically on the famous Kimmeridgian soil result in a wine
that is light and elegant and, at the same time, intense and persistent with
aromas of red fruits, toast and fresh vegetal notes. This is great champagne
with great finest.

name: Champagne Val'Frison  Cuvee Elion Rose
desc_en_short: A very complex and unique rose from this fine small grower Champagne. Intense fruit nose of blackberry and cassis meets with herbal nose of black pepper, rosemarie and thyme. On the palate, the wine is soft and juicy with delicious fruit supported by vegetal character and great mineral. It’s savoury with very fine bubble.

name: Ruppert Leroy  Les Cognaux
desc_en_short: 100% Pinot Noir. Organic. Clay-Limestone with a majority of gray clay. Elevage in tank and in barrels sur lie for 6 months, then 2 years in bottle ‘sur lattes’. Bottled brut nature. Expressive and balanced with aromas of raspberry and strawberry, floral notes of rose, peony, and stone fruit. Fresh and gourmand in the mouth with a nice tension. Very long mineral finish.

name: Ruppert Leroy  Martin Fontaine
desc_en_short: 100% Chardonnay. Organic. Clay-Limestone with a majority of white limestone. Elevage in barrels sur lie for 6 months, then 2 years in bottle ‘sur lattes’. Disgorged in May 2013, bottled brut nature. Elegant and complex wine with aromas of white pepper, white flowers, and white fruit. Notes of ripe lemon. Good tension and a straightforward and powerful first flavor, which finishes with finesse and a long beautiful minerality

name: Belleville  Sparkling Brut (Fruit wine blend)
wine_color: Bright golden colour with green hues.
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Aromas of citrus and candied peel with hints of tropical fruits and orange blossom, combined with persistent bubbles and a stylish crisp finish.

name: G.H. Mumm  Cordon Rouge Brut (375 ml)
wine_color: This champagne is a brightly sparkling, light golden yellow liquid with an abundance of fine and elegant bubbles.
desc_en_short: This champagne is a brightly sparkling, light golden yellow liquid with an abundance of fine and elegant bubbles. The nose reveals initial aromas of ripe fresh fruit (white and yellow peaches, apricots), tropical notes (lychee and pineapple). It then opens up with the fragrance of vanilla before developing notes of milky caramel, breadcrumbs and yeast, culminating in aromas of dried fruit and honey. An explosion of freshness in the mouth, followed by strong persistence. The complex aromas of fresh fruit and caramel perpetuate the intensity. Ideal as an aperitif and beyond, Mumm Cordon Rouge works as well as an accompaniment to white meat, as it does to fish or fine cured meats (Italian ham, smoked duck breast).

name: G.H. Mumm  Cordon Rouge Brut (3 L)
wine_color: This champagne is a brightly sparkling, light golden yellow liquid with an abundance of fine and elegant bubbles.
desc_en_short: This champagne is a brightly sparkling, light golden yellow liquid with an abundance of fine and elegant bubbles. The nose reveals initial aromas of ripe fresh fruit (white and yellow peaches, apricots), tropical notes (lychee and pineapple). It then opens up with the fragrance of vanilla before developing notes of milky caramel, breadcrumbs and yeast, culminating in aromas of dried fruit and honey. An explosion of freshness in the mouth, followed by strong persistence. The complex aromas of fresh fruit and caramel perpetuate the intensity. Ideal as an aperitif and beyond, Mumm Cordon Rouge works as well as an accompaniment to white meat, as it does to fish or fine cured meats (Italian ham, smoked duck breast).

name: G.H. Mumm  Grand Cordon Rosé (750 ml)
wine_color: The pale salmon-pink robe with glints of orange glows invitingly, animated by a lively stream of bubbles.
desc_en_short:
Mumm Rosé is made from the same rich palette of terroirs as that of Cordon Rouge. More than 120 crus, representing all the diversity of the Champagne region of France, are perfectly blended to ensure a consistent quality and style each year.

Embodying a unique personality for a rosé champagne, Mumm Rosé has the strength and structure of Pinot Noir, the signature grape of Maison Mumm, balanced with the elegance of Chardonnay and the fruitiness of Meunier. A proportion of red wine brings intensity and notes of forest fruits to this luminous cuvée to create a rosé that is at once elegant, light, intense, and fresh.

Light-hearted Mumm Rosé reveals its charms as an apéritif, but the bright berry notes also complement a wide range of dishes, including simple seasonal starters such as seafood, fresh cheeses and salmon marinated with fresh cranberries.

Mumm Rosé champagne conjures visions of sunny days and spontaneous meet-ups. Its radiant personality recalls roof-top barbecues and leisurely brunches when friends linger to chat, laugh, and welcome the GoldenHour, watching the afternoon light melt into sunset.

name: G.H. Mumm  Blanc de Noirs (750 ml)
wine_color: Deep yellow in color with golden glints.
desc_en_short: This Cuvee is produced exclusively with Pinot Noir from Verzenay, the first vineyard acquired by Georges Hermann Mumm in 1840 and one of the 17 villages in the Champagne winegrowing region ranked as a Grand Cru. Blanc de Noirs bottles are distinctive for their narrow neck. which allows the wine to develop more slowly, and a capsule decorated with a picture of the Moulin de Verzenay, the House's distinctive reception centre.

name: G.H. Mumm  Blanc de Blancs (750 ml)
wine_color: A pure, luminous colour sparkling with fine, delicate bubbles.
desc_en_short:
The Blanc de Blancs Mumm de Cramant is a rare wine, dating back to 1882. It is crafted according to the finest champagne-making tradition, using the very best Chardonnay grapes selected from Cramant, a Grand Cru terroir from the legendary Côtes des Blancs.
Its unique label illustrates Maison Mumm's special know-how. Indeed, tradition required that each bottle presented to friends of the House be accompanied by a visiting card that was carefully folded at the corner, to indicate that the bottle was handed over in person.

name: Champagne Pehu Simonet Face Nord  Extra Brut Grand Cru
wine_color: Light colours and subtle effervescence introduce the characteristic note of the Pehu-Simonet house.
desc_en_short: Powerful, hinting at raspberries as well as delicious richness. There are white peach and pink grapefruits flavours, but the yeast and the layers of structured toast are just as intriguing. The final is a play on richness and structure.

name: Concha Y Toro  Sunrise Sparkling Brut
desc_en_short: Greenish yellow, bright. Intense, with notes of fruit, yeast and mineral. Sparkling, fresh, persistent and balanced. Food matching with appetizers, light meals and desserts.

name: Jacob's Creek  Sparkling Moscato (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
A light and refreshingly sweet wine, perfect for any social occasions. Tropical and zesty with peach and pear.

Award : GOLD, New World Wine Awards 2017

name: Schloss Vaux  Rheingauer Riesling Sekt Brut
wine_color: Pale straw, with lustrous shades of green
desc_en_short: Schloss VAUX Riesling Sekt is the best what you can made from a grape. Of course we know and love many other wines but the characteristic of Rheingau Riesling ist for a sparkling just wonderful. You have that hint of minerality in nose and mouth. You have also ripe fruits of the Riesling such as melones, apricotes and peaches. And you have the wonderful finish and length based on the acidity without having any aggressiv and bitter aspects.

name: Schloss Vaux  Steinberg Riesling Sekt Brut
desc_en_short: Maybe one of the most famous sites in the Rheingau. It is a monopol site owned by the wine estate: Staatsweingüter Kloster Eberbach. This estate is delivering us since generations best grapes out of the Steinberger for an excellent Riesling Sekt. The terroir is magnificant: Rolling hills with a moderate cool climat and grey slate are the main factors for this wonderful wines from the side. The climate is always a reason for a long hanging time, creating a high physiolocial rippness with still having a nice acidty structure.

name: Jacob's Creek  Sparkling Reserve Chardonnay Pinot Noir (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Gentle pressing using air bag presses ensured a wine with elegance, finesse and delicate flavour. Full malolactic fermentation added a soft creamy texture to the palate.

name: Casali Viticulturi  Lambrusco Amabile Frizzante Dell’Emilia IGT
desc_en_short: An original “sweet” wine, well calibrated, full-bodied with sweet sensations balanced with the freshness of the wine. Pleasant at the end of a meal with dry pastries, bilberry, strawberry and plum jam tarts, chestnut desserts.

name: De Bortoli  DB Family Selection Brut
desc_en_short: Very pale straw colour. Clean citrus and floral notes are complexed with fresh cream and bread dough aromas. The fine bubbles provide a creamy texture, while the delicate acidity balances the fresh fruit.

name: Charles De Cazanove “Tete De Cuvee” Champagne Brut Aoc
desc_en_short: The fine bubbles form a large string against a golden background. A fruity nose and delicious, persistent barley sugar and brioche flavours. A very lively wine.

name: Charles De Cazanove Brut Rose Aoc
style: Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier And Chardonnay.
desc_en_short: A delicate pink salmon colour. A very fruity, powerful nose (cherries, strawberries) aftertaste. A delicious, structured, complex attack, followed by a very fruity finish accompanied by vanilla notes.

name: G.H. Mumm  Cordon Rouge Brut (1.5 L)
wine_color: This champagne is a brightly sparkling, light golden yellow liquid with an abundance of fine and elegant bubbles.
desc_en_short: This champagne is a brightly sparkling, light golden yellow liquid with an abundance of fine and elegant bubbles. The nose reveals initial aromas of ripe fresh fruit (white and yellow peaches, apricots), tropical notes (lychee and pineapple). It then opens up with the fragrance of vanilla before developing notes of milky caramel, breadcrumbs and yeast, culminating in aromas of dried fruit and honey. An explosion of freshness in the mouth, followed by strong persistence. The complex aromas of fresh fruit and caramel perpetuate the intensity. Ideal as an aperitif and beyond, Mumm Cordon Rouge works as well as an accompaniment to white meat, as it does to fish or fine cured meats (Italian ham, smoked duck breast).

name: G.H. Mumm  Grand Cordon (750 ml)
wine_color: Exuberant bubbles and a brilliant, golden colour testify to the vibrancy of this champagne.
desc_en_short:
Maison Mumm unveiled its revolutionary bottle Grand Cordon at a glittering party in Paris.

Breaking with convention, the bottle has no front label : The G.H. Mumm signature and eagle emblem are printed in gold directly on the glass. Another striking feature of the design is its shape, which necessitated a whole series of innovations to the traditional champagne production process.

The most eye-catching feature of the Mumm Grand Cordon bottle is its reinterpretation of the famous Cordon Rouge red sash, transformed into a genuine red ribbon, which – in a feat of technology – is actually indented in the glass.

Mumm Grand Cordon was created by award-winning designer Ross Lovegrove.

name: Prunotto  Moscato D'Asti
wine_color: An intense straw yellow in color
desc_en_short: An intense straw yellow in color, the wine shows a musky nose with additional notes of hawthorn and acacia honey. On the palate it is full, dense, vigorous, and elegant with a fresh, balanced, and pleasurable finish. Serveing with fresh fruit (excellent with strawberries, peaches, and berry fruit in an infusion), fruitcake, cookies and sweet biscuits or other types of dry pastry.

name: Chartogne-Taillet  Chemin de Reims
wine_color: Deep gold in colour with amber glints with persistency bubbles
desc_en_short: The Chemin de Reims is a varietal Chardonnay, it is fascinantly concentrated in bouquet, shows subtle smoky notes, clear fruit In the mouth it presents fresh, pure and gripping, is wonderfully powerful and precise, enormously sustainable.

name: La Esperanza Winery  Noche y Día Brut Nature
wine_color: Pale yellow, bright, with medium size bubbles
desc_en_short: Cava Brut Nature shows a classic style, fresh and crisp, perfect for any time. Pale yellow, bright, with medium size bubbles, subsequently long, lingering, pleasant. Very nice, powerful and fruity aromas, typical of the second fermentation in the bottle.

name: Torello Winery  Torelló Brut Reserva
wine_color: Pale yellow, bright, with medium size bubbles
desc_en_short: White fruit well-integrated with carbonic, acacia flower, fine lees, herbs, citrus fruit, ginger and mineral, great texture and an aniseed and saline finish.

name: Torello Winery  Rosé Pal-Lid Brut Reserva
desc_en_short: Pale and bright color. Aging aromas, hints of warm bread, retound and fruity on the palate.

name: Torello Winery  Special Edition Brut Reserva
wine_color: Bright, pale straw with lime hints
desc_en_short: Bright, pale straw with lime hints. Floral and white fr uit aromas, like ripe apple, pear and melon with fine hints of brioche and anise. Velvety texture with fine and persistent bubbles. Easy drinking Cava!

name: Torello Winery  Torelló 225 Gran Reserva
desc_en_short: Light yellow-green. Delicate nose with white-fleshed fruit overtones, a trace of flowers and soft toast. The palate shows seductive volume, refined, soft texture and exquisite freshness. A precise, persistent wine.

name: Dom Perignon  P2 1998
wine_color: GLISTENING COLOUR WITH LIGHT AMBER HIGHLIGHTS.
desc_en_short:
The uniqueness of Dom Pérignon vintages lies in the way they evolve - not steadily in a linear way but through successive windows of expression. These privileged points in time are called “Plénitudes” - captured moments when the wine sings higher and stronger.

P2 is the Second Plénitude of Dom Pérignon Vintage, the result of 16 years of elaboration. The opposing and complementary elements of the assemblage resound for an increasingly sharp intensity. The energy of the wine is at its peak.

name: Dream Line  Glaciar Premium Sparkling Wine
wine_color: Clear, bright with an attractive bursting effect of bronze colour in conjunction with the slow release of small bubbles.
style: Through A Blened Of A Variety Of Native Grapes From The Region Of The Mediterranean Sea
desc_en_short: An author´s white wine, clear, bright with an attractive bursting effect of bronze colour in conjunction with the slow release of small bubbles. Fine and persistent perlage. A clean nose, appetising and lightly fruity. Sparkling in the mouth, fruity, semi-sweet, fresh and slightly acidic. The first taste is very pleasant, faintly reminiscent of French Champagne and Spanish Cava.

name: Dream Line  Rose Premium Sparkling Wine
wine_color: Translucent rose wine with vibrant and alluring purple hues. When the bottle is turned the “silver Rose cloud” is released throughout the bottle.
style: Through A Blened Of A Variety Of Native Grapes From The Region Of The Mediterranean Sea
desc_en_short: Translucent rose wine with vibrant and alluring purple hues. When the bottle is turned the “silver Rose cloud” is released throughout the bottle. The fragrance is clean, fresh, fruity and floral, reminding one of violets and tropical fruits. With a long and intense flavor that is fresh, pleasant, spicy and sweet. The aftertaste is fruity and of fresh acidity.

name: Fleury  Fleur de l’Europe Brut Nature
desc_en_short: This Bio-Dynamic Champagne. An aroma of citrus, pear, mint and a touch of vanilla and is deliciously creamy and full in mouth. Delicious as a luxurious aperitif, with dishes with cream and white truffle.

name: Chandon  Seafolly Limited Edition Brut (750 ml)
style: Chardonnay, Pinot Noir And Pinot Meunier Grapes
desc_en_short: Chandon and Seafolly have come together to create the ultimate Limited Edition Chandon Seafolly Summer Bottle - the must have Summer accessory for the Australian Summer. Inspired by a sense of fun and vibrancy synonymous with both Chandon & Seafolly, the collaborative design brings the spirit of summer to life. The Chandon Brut NV features the 'Palm Beach' print design, inspired by a stroll along a palm lined beach. Summer starts with Chandon & Seafolly!

name: Chandon  Seafolly Limited Edition Rose (750 ml)
wine_color: A striking rose petal pink hue of medium intensity with delicate bead and persistent mousse.
desc_en_short: Chandon and Seafolly have come together to create the ultimate Limited Edition Chandon Seafolly Summer Bottle - the must have Summer accessory for the Australian Summer. Inspired by a sense of fun and vibrancy synonymous with both Chandon & Seafolly, the collaborative design brings the spirit of summer to life. The Chandon Rose NV features Modern Love, a playful pink floral print featuring the vibrant botanical blooms of a coastal garden wraps. Summer starts with Chandon & Seafolly!

name: Lanson Champagne  Rose Label Brut Rose
wine_color: A beautifully pure, soft pink colour
desc_en_short: A beautifully pure, soft pink colour with aromas of roses and delicate notes of red berries, together with fresh red fruit flavours.

name: Nicolas Feuillatte  Blanc de Blancs Millésime
wine_color: Attractive pale gold in appearance tinged with delicate turquoise glints. A joyful formation of delicate bubbles pirouettes in the glass with natural grace.
desc_en_short: A delicate bead forms a regular, pirouetting stream of bubbles. The wine is bright and delicately golden in appearance, tinged with silver-green. Elegant and graceful, this Champagne is initially underpinned on the palate by bucolic, springtime notes of fresh flowers and angelica. name: Pol Roger  Cuvée Sir Winston Churchill 2012
wine_color: The wine displays a mid golden yellow colour and continuous stream of delicate bubbles.
desc_en_short: Champagne Pol Roger created their Prestige Cuvée in homage to Sir Winston Churchill mindful of the qualities that he sought in his champagne : robustness, a full-bodied character and relative maturity. The exact blend is a closely guarded family secret but it is undeniable that the composition would meet with the approval of the man to whom it is dedicated : "My tastes are simple, I am easily satisfied with the best". Pinot Noir predominates, providing structure, breadth and robustness whilst Chardonnay contributes elegance, finesse and subtlety. Composed exclusively of grapes sourced from Grands Crus Pinot Noir and Chardonnay vineyards which were already under vine during Churchill's lifetime. Cuvée Sir Winston Churchill is only made in the very best vintages and is always released later than the other vintage dated Champagnes from Pol Roger, marking Churchill's appreciation for older wines.

name: Louis Roederer  Brut Premier (375 ml)
style: Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, And 20% Pinot Meunier
desc_en_short:
YESTERDAY’S DISCOVERIES, TODAY’S TREASURES

After the upheavals of the early 1900s, particularly the First World War that destroyed more than half of the Louis Roederer estate, Léon Olry Roederer reconstructed the vineyards. He decided to buy grapes to ensure the continuity of the House during this difficult period and, at the same time, created a multi-vintage wine that would have a consistent flavour, whatever the harvest year. It is now called Brut Premier.

A SIGNATURE BLEND

A blend of 40% Pinot Noir, 40% Chardonnay, and 20% Pinot Meunier, Brut Premier comprises wine matured in oak tuns produced from three Champagne grape varieties that originate from more than fifty different crus. It is aged for 3 years in Louis Roederer’s cellars and left for 6 months after dégorgement (disgorging).

A GREAT CLASSIC THAT RESONATES WITH CONTEMPORARY TASTE

Striking a perfect balance between youthfulness and maturity, seduction and character, vinosity and freshness, Brut Premier is a champagne that is harmonious and structured, elegant and lively, with a unique exuberancy. Its structured texture, richness, and length are distinctly winey. It is a full, complex wine that is both rich and powerful, whilst remaining a great classic.

desc_en_short:
Winery Information

Despite being relatively new,Champagne Vouette et Sorbee is one of the most sought after producers in Champagne.Monsieur Gautherot is a perfectionist who seeks nothing but the best. He got his vines from some of the best sources, Anselm Selosse and Vincent Dauvissat Chablis The domaine is very rare as they are certified biodynamic viticulture. Furthermore,he keeps his own cows to produce manure as he believe it helps in controlling the quality. The domaine is named after the terroir, Vouette vineyard and Sorbee vineyard. Terroir driven,in other words. I could go on but the best thing is to try it yourself and see why they become such a sensation among connoisseurs.

Past recognitions include

- Vouette et Sorbee is one of the most beautiful and distinctive champagnes: Wine Advocate
- One of Champagne’s most sought-after producers : Peter Liem
