This fully sparkling wine can stand alone as a delightful aperitif or be paired with classics such as shellfish and smoked fish, or delicate pasta dishes. Serve cold at 5-7° C.

name: Bisol & Figli  Rive di Guia Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore DOCG
wine_color: Straw yellow with light flecks of green, embellished by a fine, but rich and persistent, perlage.
desc_en_short:
The standard bearer for the quality of Bisol Prosecco Superiore. It is named after a man who dedicated his entire life to this area: Aurelio Bisol, who was known affectionately as "Relio".

In his honour, we have selected grapes from our finest vineyards on the steepest slopes, where cultivation and harvesting has to be carried out by hand, demanding all of the tenacity and passion of what is known in Italy as "heroic viticulture".

name: Navaro Lopez  Divino Oro Semi Seco
wine_color: Pale yellow with greenish reflections, fine bubbles with continuous rosary and crown shape.
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with greenish reflections, fine bubbles with continuous rosary and crown shape. Its intense aromas of ripe apple and tropical fruits stand out. In the mouth, a well-balanced acidity is appreciated with the alcoholic content and in the retro-nasal it reminds us of fruit aromas.

name: Bella Conchi  Brut Seleccion
wine_color: Brilliant green and gold color Elegant with fine bubbles.
desc_en_short: Brilliant green and gold color Elegant with fine bubbles. Good intensity with fruit aromas and toasted nuances. Fresh, warm, pleasant and round, with a long finish.

name: Charles Heidsieck  The Brut Reserve (1.5 L)
wine_color: The Brut Réserve boasts a deep golden hue. Delicate, vivacious and long-lasting bubbles are the result of a long, slow maturing process in chalk cellars.
desc_en_short:
IT IS WITH BRUT RÉSERVE that the House has expresses the quintessence of its style. Particularly recognisable, this cuvée is the fruit of a unique blend that can be summarised with one equation: 60/40/10.

60: The number of crus gone into a blend that is precise, stringent and tailor-made. The wines produced that year, a third for each varietal (Meunier, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir), are vinified cru by cru, varietal by varietal, in stainless steel vats.

40: A high proportion of 40% reserve wines, equally divided between Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, to ensure the fine complexity and indulgence of the Brut Réserve.

10: The average age of the reserve wines, an exception in Champagne. Taken from the best crus from the best years, the wines placed in reserve are kept in vats for between 5 and 15 years, if not more, to develop finesse and their aromatic range.

name: Charles Heidsieck  The Brut Reserve (375 ml)
wine_color: The Brut Réserve boasts a deep golden hue. Delicate, vivacious and long-lasting bubbles are the result of a long, slow maturing process in chalk cellars.
desc_en_short:
IT IS WITH BRUT RÉSERVE that the House has expresses the quintessence of its style. Particularly recognisable, this cuvée is the fruit of a unique blend that can be summarised with one equation: 60/40/10.

60: The number of crus gone into a blend that is precise, stringent and tailor-made. The wines produced that year, a third for each varietal (Meunier, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir), are vinified cru by cru, varietal by varietal, in stainless steel vats.

40: A high proportion of 40% reserve wines, equally divided between Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, to ensure the fine complexity and indulgence of the Brut Réserve.

10: The average age of the reserve wines, an exception in Champagne. Taken from the best crus from the best years, the wines placed in reserve are kept in vats for between 5 and 15 years, if not more, to develop finesse and their aromatic range.

name: Charles Heidsieck  Rose Reserve
wine_color: A sophisticated powdery pink robe with luminous glints of wild rose. Delicate, vivacious bubbles are the result of an ageing period of over 48 months
desc_en_short:
LIKE THE BRUT RÉSERVE, the Rosé Réserve is the result of meticulous attention and stands out for its unconventional character.

COMPLEXITY : 80% of the year’s wines are composed of equal portions of Meunier, Chardonnay and Pinot Noir, while the 20% of reserve wines are made up of 50% Pinot Noir and 50% Chardonnay. Each are vinified cru by cru, varietal by varietal, in stainless steel vats.

PRÉCISION : To ensure the ideal balance of freshness and elegance on one hand and structure and complexity on the other, the Cellar Master bides by a House principle, intentionally selecting reserve wines that are younger than those of the Brut Réserve. The red reserve wines, from the leading Pinot Noir terroirs, date from up to 5 years before the last harvest.

GENEROSITY : 5 to 6% of wines vinified in red provide tannins and the fragrance of red fruits, a base upon which the Cellar Master will subtly develop a full-bodied, voluptuous rosé.

name: Charles Heidsieck  Millesime 2006 Vintage Brut
wine_color: The intense golden robe sparkles brightly with a delicate and vivacious effervescence.
desc_en_short:
A VINTAGE WITH AN ASSERTIVE PERSONALITY CHARACTERCHAMPAGNE Ȧ LA PERSONNALITÉ

Charming from the very first sip, the Vintage Brut 2006 expresses more freshness and grace than its predecessor, the Vintage Brut 2005. This distinctive aromatic profile confirms the very ‘raison d’être’ of a vintage wine, the expression of one particular year. The fruit of a year characterized by a generous acidity, this vintage presents excellent ageing potential. Matured for almost ten years in the unique thousand-year-old chalk cellars, this ideal classic fully reveals its complex character and takes its place amongst the most celebrated Champagnes.

name: Charles Heidsieck  Blanc Des Millenaires Millesime 2006 Vintage
wine_color: A shimmering golden robe highlighted by delicate effervescence
desc_en_short:
A VARIATION ON GREAT CHARDONNAYS

Only Chardonnay is used in the blend of this exceptionally textured cuvée. From amongst the fabulous range offered by the Champagne region, 5 major Crus from the Côte des Blancs have been meticulously chosen for their ability to evolve as well as for their ability to express their full richness once fully mature: Oger for its unctuousness and structure, Mesnil-sur-Oger for balance, Avize for its minerality, Cramant for its complexity and Vertus for its freshness and floral notes.

name: Charles Heidsieck  Millesime 2005 Vintage Rose
wine_color: An elegant pearly pink robe with a delicate, joyful effervescence.
desc_en_short:
A CLASSIC BEAUTY ACCORDING TO THE CHAMPAGNE TRADITION.

The 2005 Rosé took its time to mature: thanks to the sunlight during the year, it developed a generous angular structure that, over the years, became full-bodied and radiant. A er more than 10 years on the lees, the wine has today fulfilled its promise, redolent and powerful with excellent ageing potential.

name: Joseph Perrier Champagne  Cuvee Royale Brut Rose
style: Chardonnay, 70% Pinot Noir And 5% Pinot Meunier
desc_en_short:
This champagne has a special place in the history of the House. It is from a family plot of Pinot Noir in Cumières that this precious red wine comes, giving our blend an unique personality.

First you will find red fruits, with wild violet and liqourice notes to follow. Ripe yet racy, with beautiful length. Fine and full on the palate, with a touch of mint on the finish.

With its strong personality based upon a vinous and robust fruity heart combined fresh fragrances, this wine is perfect as a summer aperitif, or as a partner to white meats, and desserts that are not too sweet.

name: Maison de Grand Esprit  La Mysteriale Champagne Cuvee Brut
desc_en_short:
WINEMAKING

Harvested by hand, the grapes are brought to the winery where they are pressed with a strict selection of juice. The first fermentation is completed at low temperature and controlled. The second fermentation occurs in bottle with a minimum of 15 months maturation on lees. The Champagne is disgorged and dosed with the final additives and sugar.

name: Champagne Drappier  Millesime Exception 2013
desc_en_short: Millesime d'Exception 2013 from Maison Drappier perfectly mirrors this remarkable year. Sourced from sustainable farming, with very few sulfur, this cuvée unveils a slighly creamy palate.  A floral touch testifies to the high proportion of Chardonnay while the depth of the Pinot Noir is expressed in the form of red fruits and appealing bitter notes.

name: Veuve Clicquot  Vintage 2012
wine_color: Bright yellow color Refined gold hints
desc_en_short: In 1810, Madame Clicquot invented the first Vintage Champagne, in 2012 Veuve Clicquot declared the 66th vintage of the Maison. With grapes exclusively from Grands and Premiers Crus, Pinot Noir dominates the blend (51%) and provides the structure that is so typically Clicquot, followed by Chardonnay (34%) that adds finesse and elegance essential in a perfectly balanced wine, and then Meunier (15%) that rounds out the blend. The uniqueness of the Vintage 2012 lies in the addition of 11% of wines aged in large wooden casks (foudres), bringing strength and aromatic intensity. The cask-aged wines act as spices to the blend, bringing very lightly woody, vanilla and toasted aromas.

name: Champagne Charles Orban  Cuvee Speciale Millesime
desc_en_short: A golden yellow colour. Delicious brioche and toasted oak aromas with hints of pears. A fresh, intense attack, dominated by peaches and brioche, with subtle notes of caramel.

name: Champagne Charles Orban  Brut Rose
wine_color: A deep salmon colour, pretty string of bubbles.
desc_en_short: A deep salmon colour, pretty string of bubbles. An elegant nose dominated by notes of peaches, roses and peonies. Lively on the palate, with initial apricot aromas and a red berry finish.

name: Champagne Palmer  Blanc de Blancs
desc_en_short:
This Blanc de Blancs cuvée of incomparable purity is based on Chardonnay, mainly from the magnificent vineyards of Trépail and Villers-Marmery.

These Premiers Crus from the Montagne de Reims area, recognised for their elegance and freshness, are blended in a perfect accord with delicately fruity Chardonnay from the Côte de Sézanne.

This crystalline champagne exudes subtle aromas of citrus fruit, white flowers and almonds. Fresh and silky on the palate, it unrolls with finesse on beautiful mineral notes that are typical of these chalky soils.

name: Champagne Palmer  Rose Reserve
desc_en_short:
Palmer & Co has created a rosé combining exceptional fruitiness and delicate notes of spice. At the heart of the blend lies a unique Solera of Pinot Noir, a perpetual reserve of several decades reflecting the House’s celebrated expertise.

The intense nose is dominated by the energising aroma of wild strawberries with tantalising light notes of red and black currants in the background, overlaying very delicate notes of vanilla and cinnamon spice.

Fresh and full-bodied on the palate, it is drawn out in finely tannic, succulent bubbles in the same register of fruity elegance.

name: Champagne Palmer  Blanc de Noirs
desc_en_short:
A perfect balance between the Pinot Noir and Pinot Meunier varieties, this elite blend of growths from the Montagne de Reims area, the Côte des Bars and the Marne Valley offers a contemporary expression of a Blanc de Noirs.

The fruity structure of the Pinots is expressed with surprising freshness.

The nose offers the delicate aromas of peach and apricot sustained by the tonic qualities of pomelo and currants, offering an optimum balance between intensity of aromas and refinement.

name: Champagne Palmer  Brut Vintage 2009
desc_en_short:
Palmer & Co Vintage is a subtle association of the memory of an exceptional year in terms of climate and the inimitable Palmer & Co style.

Exclusively made up of Premiers and Grands Crus from the Montagne de Reims area, Palmer & Co Vintage is a champagne of rare complexity that is also very seductive in its elegance.

The aromas are expressed with intensity in a register of crisp fruit, citrus and light notes of toasted brioche and hazelnut. Ample and sophisticated on the palate, it strikes a fine and perfect balance between power and freshness.

name: Champagne Palmer  Amazone de Palmer with Gift Box
desc_en_short:
Paying true homage to the amazing potential of reserve wines, Amazone de Palmer is a rare cuvée created from a selection of the best wines produced by the House in its most successful years.

With its exclusive selection of Grands and Premiers Crus, extensive ageing in our cellars, manual riddling and the stunning oval shape of its bottle, Amazone de Palmer is definitely a champagne of great distinction.

name: Louis Roederer  Brut Nature Vintage 2012
wine_color: Golden yellow hue flecked with green.
style: Pinot Noir, 20% Chardonnay, And 25% Pinot Meunier (The Grapes Are Grown Exclusively In The Coteaux De Cumières. Zero Dosage.)
desc_en_short: "The 2012 vintage gave us the very best material: juicy, concentrated grapes with unusual levels of maturity resulting in rich, full-bodied wines worthy of the greatest vintages in Champagne." - Jean-Baptiste Lécaillon, Cellar Master

name: Philipponnat Royal  Cuvee 1522
wine_color: Deep, bright gold in colour. Fine bubbles form a persistent ring.
desc_en_short:
The name of Cuvée 1522 is a tribute to the year when the Philipponnat family settled in the village of Ay, in the heart of the Champagne wine-growing area. The family’s ancestors can be traced back in time through the House archives right back to the first, Apvril le Philipponnat, who from 1522 owned vines in “Le Léon”, between Ay and Dizy.

2007 is an exceptional vintage marked by an early harvest thanks to a particularly mild winter and warm spring. The grape harvest started in late August in sunny summer weather, yielding generous, high quality clusters. This vintage is notable for its magnificent aging potential.

name: Philipponnat Royal  Cuvee 1522 Rose
wine_color: Slightly coppery pink, fine, fast bubbles.
desc_en_short:
The antique engraving featured on 1522 and 1522 Rosé cuvées depicts the village of Ay, seat of the Philipponnat family, in the 17th century. Several members of the Philipponnat family were Royal Mayors of Ay.

2008 was marked by a cool summer. The harvest nonetheless produced exceptional wines with fine concentration thanks to a helping hand from warm and sunny weather conditions in September.

name: Champagne Philipponnat  Blanc De Noirs Extra Brut
wine_color: Intense golden colour with the pink glints typical of Pinot Noir grapes.
desc_en_short: The ultimate expression of the Champagne region’s finest terroirs, in particular Ay, Mareuil-sur-Ay and Côte des Blancs (exclusively Premier and Grand Cru plots), Philipponnat’s vintage cuvées reflect each harvest’s distinctive character: they are produced from a selection of the finest grapes from a single year’s harvest. Each one has its own style, but they all have one thing in common: their elegant vinosity. The wines used to blend them are made using first-press juice and vinified using traditional methods, partly in wooden casks, with no malolactic fermentation. They are given even greater complexity through extended aging on lees in bottles in the cellar for six years or more.

name: Champagne Philipponnat  Clos des Goisses Extra Brut
wine_color: A bright colour with lovely effervescence
desc_en_short: The 2013 vintage of Clos des Goisses is a blend of 85% Pinot Noir and 15% Chardonnay. The harvest started late, with good grape maturity, producing a fresh and elegant vintage reminiscent of a time before global warming. Aged on lees for an extra eight years at a constant temperature of 12°C in the House’s historic cellars in Mareuil-sur-Ay. The very low dosage (4.25 g/litre) gives full expression to this exceptional vineyard’s vinosity and minerality.

name: Alba Luna  Prosecco DOC
desc_en_short: Aromas of pear. Delicious and subtle, with citrus notes. Young and enjoyable. Enjoy with aperitif, cheese, fish, seafood.

name: Louis Roederer  Blanc de Blancs 2011
wine_color: Golden yellow hue flecked with green.
desc_en_short: In the mouth, the attack is typically Chardonnay—it is smooth and delicate, and markedly sweet. Slightly sweetened floral notes and white fruit and dried fruit notes are combined with the almost chalky minerality of the Côte des Blancs. The texture has notes of sugared almond, a sensation that is strengthened by a soft effervescence that envelops the mouth. This is followed by an impression of finesse, elegance, and freshness, strengthened by suggestions of fresh mint and basil.

name: Champagne Gremillet  Selection Brut
wine_color: A pretty pal golden yellow in color rippling with fine, persistent bubbles. Bright, luminous and limpid.
desc_en_short:
A worthy ambassador of the House, a perfect reflection of its style, it is selected by more than 50 embassies around the world. A classic on which the house intends to be judged.

TO OBSERVE

A pretty pal golden yellow in color rippling with fine, persistent bubbles. Bright, luminous and limpid.

TO BREATH

The nose evokes happiness – a lively alliance of deliciousfloral and fruity notes, of acacia, hawthorn, peach, pear and apricot

TO APPRECIATE

The taste is pleasant and refreeshing with a nice balance of acidity and maturity. The same fruit components ans deliciousness of the nose are foundagain on the palate, with toasted and spiced notes.

name: Champagne Gremillet  Cuvee Brut Prestige Organic
wine_color: Very pretty golden colour with ocre glints that reflect its extreme luminosity. Bright, limpid with a rim of fine, creamy bubbles.
desc_en_short:
Independent family of winegrowers, our estate is situated in a small village 180 kilometres south from Paris and 45 kilometres from Troyes, the historic capital of Champagne.

TO OBSERVE

Very pretty golden colour with ocre glints that reflect its extreme luminosity. Bright, limpid with a rim of fine, creamy bubbles.

TO BREATH

Just like a breath of fresh air, the nose is instantly delicate and pleasant with aromas of undergrowth. It is reminiscent of a beautiful summer morning with all the scents of the garden. The fruit is ripe and sun-drenched with fine, menthol vegetal notes.

TO APPRECIATE

The taste is rich and luscious with perfect harmony between vivacity and mellowness. The Brut dosage is ideal for such a perfect marriage. With such a voluptuous finish how could it be anything less than noble.

name: Champagne Gremillet  Brut Millesime
wine_color: Attractive golden yellow color, bright and sparkling. Fine, vigorous bubbles.
desc_en_short:
“I like to emphasize the special character of an exceptional harvest while remaining true to the house’s style”. On the palate, the wine is full-bodied and voluptuous, provoking gasps of pleasure, thanks to a good balance between its delicate sparkle and subtle, caressing blend of fruity and floral flavours. The lingering aftertaste leaves a delicious memory

TO OBSERVE

Attractive golden yellow color, bright and sparkling. Fine, vigorous bubbles.

TO BREATH

The nose speaks to us, it is talkative, it tells us a beautiful summer, in the laughter of the harvesters and harvesters, with baskets of ripe fruit and loads of flowers.

TO APPRECIATE

The mouth is round and greedy, it comes to you oh !… and ah! … pleasure, thanks to a beautiful balance between the finesse of the bubble, the aromatic fruits, flowers and the subtlety of the dosage which is a caress.

name: Champagne Victoire  Brut Prestige
wine_color: A golden-yellow hue in the glass
desc_en_short:
The historic wine cellar is recognized by Unesco, as oldest in all Champagne region and now operates as a museum.

An intense robe with golden glints, the Victoire Brut Prestige Champagne NV has a wonderfully fresh aftertaste with a smell of lemon liqueur and fresh peas. A fresh taste with wonderful acidity with notes of orange jam and candied fruit.

name: Champagne Louise Marie Bennezon  Brut Tradition
wine_color: A pale gold color tinged with light green reflections. Reveal a generous effervescence.
style: Pinot Meunier (70%), Pinot Noir (20%) And A Touch Of Chardonnay (10%)
desc_en_short:
This cuvée is the result of a strong blend of Pinot Meunier (70%), Pinot noir (20%) and a touch of Chardonnay (10%). The blend of pinot and chardonnay brings suppleness and youth.

With a rather discreet nose, the palate is invigorating and supple, with a nice freshness.

Our champagne is at the same time powerful, round and definitely balanced.

name: Champagne Louise Marie Bennezon  Rose
wine_color: A very pretty pale pink color, of a great limpidity with sparkling shards and brilliant reflections. The bubbles are delicate and form beautiful harmonious rosaries.
style: Meunier – 20% Pinot – 40% Chardonnay – 10% Meunier Red (Including 30% Of Reserve Wine).
desc_en_short:
This cuvee is the complex association of very high quality grapes from old vines giving a more concentrated, and more intense wine.

It is composed of Pinot Meunier, Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and wine hills Champagne to bring the color of our champagne rosé.

Fresh, supple, our rosé champagne surprises with its aromas of red berries freshly picked, slight hints of cherry, sour cherry with a delicious hint of the famous pink biscuit of Reims.

It is a very pleasant taste.

name: Champagne Florence Duchêne  Brut Réserve
desc_en_short:
Brut Réserve belongs to champagne collection of Champagne Florence Duchêne. The flask has a minimum ageing of 5 years old and is available only on demand.

Tasting notes:

Apple, nut and truffle nose. Crisp and fresh with a lovely mousse and delicate texture. Pleasant, but quite simple for the category

name: Luc Belaire  Luxe Rose
desc_en_short: Belaire Luxe Rosé epitomizes the qualities that have made the wines in our range so popular: classic taste, superb drinkability, and striking, stylish packaging. Luxe Rosé is an extraordinary wine from grape to glass, tailor-made to please crowds, anytime of year.

name: Luc Belaire  Rare Luxe
desc_en_short: Indulge in True French Luxury. Produced in Burgundy, France from 100% Chardonnay grapes. Blended with a special dosage of Chardonnay from Chablis and aged for six months in Burgundy oak casks. Packaged in a luxurious white & gold bottle.

name: Luc Belaire  Rare Luxe - Fantome
desc_en_short: Belaire Luxe is packaged in an opulent white and gold bottle, perfectly complementing the rich yet refreshing cuvée within. Notes of apricot, honeysuckle and brioche are perfectly balanced in this stunning addition to the Belaire range, which can be sipped chilled or over ice, with fresh fruit as the perfect pairing. But things get even more exciting with this Fantome edition, which features a luminescent label that glows at the press of a button. Perfect for impressing while celebrating in dark places such as nightclubs, lounges, restaurants or romantic cabins.

name: Luc Belaire  Rare Rose - Fantome
desc_en_short: The glowing Fantôme (French for “phantom”) editions of our signature Gold, Rosé, Luxe, and Luxe Rosé cuvées feature luminescent labels that light up at the press of a button. The Fantôme is ideal for celebratory moments after dark and is available by the bottle or by the glass in nightclubs, lounges and restaurants.

name: Luc Belaire  Rare Luxe - Fantome (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Belaire Luxe is packaged in an opulent white and gold bottle, perfectly complementing the rich yet refreshing cuvée within. Notes of apricot, honeysuckle and brioche are perfectly balanced in this stunning addition to the Belaire range, which can be sipped chilled or over ice, with fresh fruit as the perfect pairing. But things get even more exciting with this Fantome edition, which features a luminescent label that glows at the press of a button. Perfect for impressing while celebrating in dark places such as nightclubs, lounges, restaurants or romantic cabins.

name: Luc Belaire  Rare Rose - Fantome (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: The glowing Fantôme (French for “phantom”) editions of our signature Gold, Rosé, Luxe, and Luxe Rosé cuvées feature luminescent labels that light up at the press of a button. The Fantôme is ideal for celebratory moments after dark and is available by the bottle or by the glass in nightclubs, lounges and restaurants.

name: Bottega  MIABI Pinot Nero Spumante Brut
wine_color: Straw-yellow, bright, fine and persistent perlage.
desc_en_short: Elegance, refinement and constant research for quality unite Japan with Italy and are an expression of their respective cultures. BOTTEGA - MIABI is an extreme synthesis that combines the Japanese decorative technique, called "dyed obi", with an Italian Pinot Noir wine, made sparkling through the long Charmat method, which enhances its complexity and its sensory profile.

name: Dom Perignon  P2 2004
wine_color: GLISTENING COLOUR WITH LIGHT AMBER HIGHLIGHTS.
desc_en_short: Dom Pérignon Vintage 2006 Plénitude 2 reveals a soft, warm and reassuring sweet bouquet, rich in subtle nuances. Its aromatic profile boasts a remarkable finesse with floral and mineral tones. This composition rapidly unfolds to reveal delicate notes of wild peach, citron, calisson and mocha, creating a unique and memorable experience on the nose.

name: Champagne Egly - Ouriet 1Er Cru Vignes De Vrigny
desc_en_short:
Similar vinification as the VP Extra Brut but sourced exclusively from old Vrigny classified 1er Cru Pinot Meunier vines. A blend of 50% harvest 2015, 30% harvest 2014 and 20% harvest 2013 Dosage 2 gr per liter.


Lush and creamy in texture, with flavors of white peach, pastry, espresso crème and saffron, enlivened by a firm frame of citrusy acidity. Well-knit and expressive, offering a clean-cut finish of fleur de sel (salt crystals) and blanched almond. Disgorged July 2016.

name: Diamour  Blanc De Blancs Vin Mousseux
desc_en_short: The golden yellow colour of this Blanc de Blancs and its delicate bubbles highlight the finesse of its effervescence. Its fruity nose with notes of yellow fruit, peach and apricot, gives way to a pleasant and soft palate. This Blanc de Blancs is perfect for aperitifs served with cheese toasts.

name: Billecart Salmon  Brut Reserve (3 L)
wine_color: With reflections of straw yellow, this cuvée is recognisable by the finesse of its slowly rising bubbles and its persistent and plentiful mousse.
style: Pinot Noir, Chardonnay And Pinot Meunier
desc_en_short: The Brut Réserve is a light, fine and harmonious champagne. It is made up of a blend of Pinot Noir, Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier from three different years and sourced from the best sites in the Champagne region.

name: Billecart Salmon  Cuvee Louis Blanc de Blancs Millesime 2007
wine_color: It has a crystalline appearance with a yellow gold hue, displaying a luminous and sparkling sheen effervescence.
desc_en_short: This cuvée was named in tribute to Louis, Elisabeth Salmon’s brother, who was passionate about oenology and highly involved in from the earliest creation of the House. Originating from the best parcels of the Côte des Blancs, the Blanc de Blancs vintage is impressed with a purity and minerality.

name: Billecart Salmon  Cuvee Nicolas Francois Brut 2006
wine_color: A beautiful golden yellow, glinting with bright sparkles. The glittering, crystalline appearance is set off by an eruption of finely chiselled bubbles.
desc_en_short: 97 Point by Wine Advocate "This is a beautifully ripe and rich yet pure champagne with ripe fruit flavors intermixed with chalky notes and brioche/nougat flavors. The palate is intense and concentrated in its rich fruit and substantial depth but also tight, highly elegant and perfectly balanced. The typical finesse of Billecart-Salmon is palatable as well as amazingly pure, with the persistent structure of a great Champagne. The 2006 already drinks dangerously well, but there is no need to hurry, this will go a long way."

name: Billecart Salmon  Cuvee 200 Bicentenary (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: One of Champagne’s finest houses, Billecart-Salmon, lauded for its elegance and consistent quality, turns 200 this year. In addition to festivities hosted around the globe, the house has created the rare ‘Cuvée 200.’ It is truly a Champagne fit for a celebration – but few will be able to get their hands on it.

name: Billecart Salmon  Brut Rose (3 L)
wine_color: A pale yet radiant pink colour adorned with warm glints of gold.
style: Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier And Pinot Noir
desc_en_short: 92 points in Wine spectator. The production secrets and the vinification method of this cuvée go back to the origins of the House of Billecart-Salmon and have been handed down for seven generations. The Brut Rosé is a blend of Chardonnay, Pinot Meunier and Pinot Noir vinified as red wine.

name: Veuve Clicquot x K-Way
style: 50 To 55% Pinot Noir, 15 To 20% Meunier, 28 To 33% Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Fifteen years ago, Veuve Clicquot created the innovative isothermal ice jacket, which was designed to keep champagne cooler for longer while you’re out and about. Today that jacket has been reimagined by K-Way.

Known for its fashion-forward waterpoof outerwear, K-Way has worked with legendary champagne house Veuve Clicquot to create a limited edition ice jacket that’s tailor-made to fit a standard bottle of Veuve Clicquot champagne.

name: Danzante  Prosecco Extra Dry
desc_en_short: Danzante reflects both the beauty of the most elegant of the arts and the passion of Italian winemaking. This extra dry sparkling wine wine shows the harmony and light touch of inspired ballet along with the freshness and character of the soils it comes from.  This wine is noteworthy for its fine and persistent perlage and lively mousse. The bouquet is intensely fruity and the wine is pleasantly fresh and balanced in the mouth.

name: Canevel  Valdobbiadene Prosecco Superiore Brut DOCG
wine_color: Pale straw in colour, bright and lively with abundant froth and a fine, elegant perlage.
desc_en_short: Reference point of Canevel production, it is a dry and silky sparkling wine, with delicate aromas of Golden apple and spices. Canevel sparkling wines are characterized by thin and elegant bubbles like silk (Setàge).

name: Bottega  Rose Gold Magnifico Set
desc_en_short:
Bottega Gold Magnifico Set

1 X Bottega Prosecco Rose Gold Brut

1 X Crystal glass high-teach lead free ( Made in Italy)

name: Dom Perignon 2010 (No Box)
wine_color: Glistening Colour With Light Amber Highlights.
desc_en_short: 2010. Winter was rigorous, spring dry and late. After a particularly sunny decade, such freshness was surprising. Summer was hot, but not excessively so. Then, two days of diluvian rain brought this ideal trajectory to a halt. In just a few days, botrytis mold developed on the grapes, mainly on the pinot noir.

name: Pommery  Royal Blue Sky
style: Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, And About One-third Chardonnay.
desc_en_short: The fruit of a new Pommery experience, a traditional champagne-based assemblage, where pinot noir, pinot meunier and chardonnay, blended with the sugar, open up towards a happy moment. Sharing the experience in glasses, which are round like Pommery champagne bubbles and in which ice cubes.

name: Pommery  Cuvee Louise Brut Nature
wine_color: Yellow shades and slightly green reflections.
style: Pinot Noir And About One-third Chardonnay.
desc_en_short: 97 Point by James Suckling "A creamy and refined 2004 with a very reserved and tight palate of ultra fine tannins that lend the wine beautiful creaminess and finesse. Subtly floral, offering lightly cooked apples and lemons. Flavorful, yet always hiding behind the fine bubbles. Drink now."

name: Dom Perignon 2012 (No Box)
wine_color: Glistening Colour With Light Amber Highlights.
desc_en_short: A year full of paradoxes for winemaking, 2012 gave birth to a great vintage, surmounting multiple challenges. Nature proved unpredictable and implacable as a series of climate events descended upon the vineyards: frost in the winter and spring, torrential rains, hailstorms, and cold spells while the vines were flowering, plus intense heat waves over the summer

name: Sieur d'Arques  Cremant Aguila Sleeve Brut Millesime 2014 (750 ml)
wine_color: The robe presents a rice pale yellow
desc_en_short: The robe presents a rice pale yellow accomponied by a fine mouse foming a stream of continuous bubbles. Delicate aroma of white fowers and fruitl. weakly dosed, this Cremant presents a rounded mouth witth a beautiful freshnness, all in subtle. The lemon frish is at the some time long and well-balancoed, punctuated by spicy notes.

name: Krug  Grande Cuvee 168 eme Edition (750 ml)
wine_color: A light golden colour and fine, vivacious bubbles, holding a promise of pleasure.
desc_en_short: Krug's NV Grande Cuvée 168ème Édition is a classic in the making, wafting from the glass with aromas of dried fruits, pear, toasted nuts, orange zest, honeycomb and freshly baked bread. Medium to full-bodied, generous but incisive, it's deep and elegantly fleshy, with a beautifully refined mousse and an enveloping core of fruit that's complemented by the characteristic Krug patina of nutty complexity imparted by barrel fermentation.

name: Dom Ruinart Blanc de Blanc 2009
wine_color: To the eye, one sees an intense golden color with almond green reflections.
desc_en_short: Dom Ruinart Blanc de Blancs 2009, as much in the aromas as in the textures, is a fleshy and crunchy wine. To the eye, one sees an intense golden color with almond green reflections. On the nose, one recognizes a fruity register that evokes lemon, apricot and brugnon. Notes of white flowers, fresh almond paste, calisson d'Aix evoke the maturity of the vintage The whole presents to the palate a beautiful balance, both tasty and lively, but with a long and subtle finish. It is the effect of the combination of silky acidity, the freshness of the stone fruits, and a surprising sapidity.

name: Piper-Heidsieck  2014 Vintage Brut (750 ml)
wine_color: The golden, crystaline bubbles of this lush intage glow in the glass.
desc_en_short: This Crystalline and voluptuous champagne Vintage 2014 from Maison Piper-Heidsieck is just exceptional ! It is elaborated from a blend composed with 18 Crus (45% Chardonnay, 55% Pinot Noir). This superb vintage 2014 offers a marvelous aromatic concentration. The elegance of Chardonnay combined with the power of Pinot Noir offer a rich and perfectly balanced champagne.

name: Judith Beck  Pet Nat
grape_variety: Zweigelt, Blaufränkisch, St. Laurent, Pinot Noir, Merlot, Welschriesling, Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine is Beautiful gold / orange. The bright aroma of the wine is filled with expressive shades of sour cherries. The taste of the wine is fresh, lively, with soft tannins, juicy cherry tones and elegant spiciness in the aftertaste

name: Cinzano  Pro-Spritz Spumante Dry
desc_en_short: Designed by Cinzano’s enologists to guarantee the Aperol Spritz experience, this tailor-made dry sparkling wine blend is fresh, fizzy, delicate and fruity, with mostly apple and pear aromas. Intended to be enjoyed young and well-chilled in Aperol Spritz, or even in cocktails with complementary fruits, Cinzano Pro-Spritz is perfect for sharing with friends.

name: Torresella  Prosecco DOC Extra Dry
food_matching: Oysters, Caviar, Fried Foods, Appetizers, Celebration

name: Torresella  Prosecco Rose DOC
food_matching: Oysters, Caviar, Fried Foods, Appetizers, Celebration

name: Torti Casaleggio Spumante Bianco Extra Dry
desc_en_short: Pinot Nero & Chardonnay grapes are used where the sparkling is obtained during a long Charmat method. Straw yellow with brilliant reflections, pleasant aroma, fruity, crisp that is excellent as aperitif or enjoyed the entire meal.

name: Val Doca  Prosecco DOC Treviso Extra Dry
desc_en_short: The fine expression flourishes of white fruit and wisteria flowers with a soft and welcoming palate accompanied by balanced acidity.

name: Val Doca  Prosecco Brut DOC Treviso
desc_en_short: Elegant Prosecco with bright straw colour, fine bubbles, delicate and fruity aroma of citrus fruits and flowers, fresh and juicy fruit flavour. Very nice as an aperitif and pairs excellent with most fish dishes.

name: Woolshed  Sparkling Brut
desc_en_short: An easy-drinking and dry sparkling wine from Australia. Light fresh notes of citrus, white flowers and orchard fruit with a refreshing acidity. Pair with fish, shellfish, cold cuts and cheeses or drink as an aperitif.

name: Champagne Jerome Dehours  Les Vignes De La Vallee Brut
wine_color: The color is a golden yellow with light glints.
desc_en_short: Time highlight the sapidity of this wine for a generous and ample cuvée with a great aromatic persistence. The color is a golden yellow with light glints. The nose and the palate have more butter and toasted notes than its younger. It also bring almond, dried fruit and honey aroma.

name: Champagne Jerome Dehours  Brut Nature
desc_en_short: The Domaine predominantly produces Pinot Meunier in addition to Pinot Noir and Chardonnay. The Pinot Meunier varietal is best suited to this cooler area of Champagne and is a favourite of the Marne Valley. Dehours' Champagnes are eagerly sought after by Champagne enthusiasts for their renowned "Meunier style"; bold, flavourful and showing a clear terroir-orientated approach. The "Brut Nature" is fully aged on lees, and clarified by natural decanting, without filtration or fining. It is an experimental, 100% Pinot Meunier cuvée that uses a high proportion of reserve wine from a perpetual reserve started in 1998. But most importantly, it is made using naturally selected yeasts (from Champagne Dehours' own vineyard) for the second fermentation in bottle. This, above all else, enhances the identity of the Marne Valley terroir. It is Ideal as an aperitif, with hard cheeses. But most important of all is the serving temperature. The golden rule is never below 12°C. Serve in large white wine glasses to allow the wine to express itself.

name: Champagne Jerome Dehours  Millesime 2013
desc_en_short: With his vintages, Jerome Dehours wants to express the vintage year, no matter what the weather circumstances were. For him, vintage is not about waiting for a 'great' year. The blend is different every year. Made of very ripe grapes - picking started only early October - Dehours produced this blend in 2013 with meunier from Cerseuil and Port à Binson, and chardonnay from lieux-dit Brisefer. Nice dry blend with over six years of aging in cellar.

name: Champagne Laurent Bernard  La Cle des Sept Arpents Extra Brut 2017
desc_en_short: The Bénard-Pitois family began their Champagne adventure in 1878 and have been improving the cultivation of the soil and the vine as well as the quality of the wine ever since. Michelle and Laurent Bénard-Pitois, who are third generation of wine farmers, considered organic farming already in the 1990's and carried out the first tests followed by ECOCERT. In 2009 the conversion took off and has reached 2.5 hectares cultivated according to the AB specifications today. Since 2012, the work with the wine has obtained organic certification.

name: Champagne Salima et Alain Cordeuil  Clair Obscur Zero Dosage 2013
desc_en_short: Rich and fresh attack. Creamy effervescence. Pulpy and full-bodied fruity, underlined by lemony acidity and grapefruit. Mid-palate orchestrated by a marl-limestone minerality which confers frankness, iodized salinity, tactile scope and length on the palate. Together expressing youth, marked by a beautiful concentration. Slender, compact and concentrated finish foreshadowing a promising future.

name: Kobe Wine  Apple Sparking Wine (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
A blend of  Kobe’s white wine (Chardonnay)  
and apple juice from Japan. Sweet and Sour from the apple with fresh aroma.

name: Kobe Wine  Plum Sparkling Wine (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
A blend of  Kobe’s white wine (Chardonnay)  
and plum from Japan. A refreshing acidity with slightly sweet taste.

name: Kobe Wine  Peach Sparkling Wine (500 ml)
food_matching: Oysters, Caviar, Fried Foods, Appetizers, Celebration
desc_en_short:
A blend of  Kobe’s white wine (Chardonnay)  
and peach juice from Japan. Elegant and freshness from Peach with pleasant aroma of peach.

name: Huguenot Tassin Champagne Cuvée "Les Fioles"
desc_en_short: Pale gold color with light green reflections, Lemon, grapefruit, white flowers and butter. Citrus nd white fruit,straight and long acid line that supports a nice minerality. Beautiful richness. Long finish on white and yellow fruits.

name: Huguenot Tassin Champagne Signature Brut Cuvée
desc_en_short: Pale gold color. Fluid, luminous appearance. Fine bubbles, persistent collar Lemon, green apple, yellow peach, dried-fruits. Fresh and supple attack. Creamy, melted effervescence. Long round and fruity finish.

name: Philipponnat Royal  Cuvee 1522 Magnum (1.5 L)
wine_color: Deep, bright gold in colour. Fine bubbles form a persistent ring.
desc_en_short:
The name of Cuvée 1522 is a tribute to the year when the Philipponnat family settled in the village of Ay, in the heart of the Champagne wine-growing area. The family’s ancestors can be traced back in time through the House archives right back to the first, Apvril le Philipponnat, who from 1522 owned vines in “Le Léon”, between Ay and Dizy.

Philipponnat Cuvee 1522 2009 Vintage Champagne is a blend of Pinot Noir, from Le Leon in Ay and Chardonnay from Mesnil-sur-Oger. The wines are vinified in wooden barrels without malolactic fermentation and is aged for 8 years, allowing complexity to develop whilst maintaing freshness.

name: V8+  Prosecco Brut Berto DOC
wine_color: In the glass it shows off a beautiful pale straw yellow color, with a fine and persistent perlage.
desc_en_short: Elegant, fruity, harmonious prosecco in its driest version, an ideal wine for a fried fish or a gourmet pizza. Sparkling wine created with the Martinotti method, Brut is the prosecco with the lowest residual sugar, making it suitable for any sweet or savory occasion.

name: Soar  Prosecco
desc_en_short:
Floral and tropical fruit aromas with a touch of honeycomb.
The palate is light and spritzy with a flavoursome and crisp finish. Pairs beautifully with
a charcuterie grazing platter, prosciutto wrapped cantaloupe or lightly fragrant salads.

name: Donnavale  Prosecco
desc_en_short:
Floral and tropical fruit aromas with a touch of honeycomb. The palate is light
and spritzy with a flavoursome and crisp finish. Pairs beautifully with a charcuterie
grazing platter, prosciutto wrapped cantaloupe or lightly fragrant salads.

name: Kissing Bridge  Prosecco
desc_en_short: Floral and tropical fruit aromas. Flavoursome, spritzy palate with a crisp finish. Pairs beautifully with a charcuterie platter or light and fragrant salads.

name: Champagne Gardet  Tradition Brut
desc_en_short: Expressive, with white stone fruit and a dominant freshness. The soft, velvety character of the Meuniers balances the straightforwardness of the Pinot Noirs. A fine minerality is present on the finish, with a fine balance between aromas, taste and length.

name: Champagne Gardet  Blanc de Noirs Brut Premier Cru
desc_en_short: The aromas on the palate are consistent. Notes of fresh, stewed fruit (yellow and red fruit) and great liveliness. Powerful, round and fresh on the finish.

name: Ferrari  Missoni Limited Edition Set
wine_color: Its faintly golden colour is deep and enlivened by a fine, luminous perlage.
desc_en_short:
Three colour variations of the iconic Missoni pattern embellish a bottle with an opaque black background, which contains all the harmony and elegance of mountain-grown Chardonnay from the 2018 vintage, giving rise to a Trentodoc of great character.

This collectible Blanc de Blancs, from grapes cultivated according to sustainable methods, is a fine and precise sparkling wine that conveys all the personality of the Italian style for which these two brands are global ambassadors.

name: Moet & Chandon  Brut Imperial Mini (200 ml) (Limited Edition 2023 Box Set) (Pack 6)
wine_color: An elegant golden straw yellow with green highlights.
style: The Body Of Pinot Noir: 30 To 40%the Suppleness Of Pinot Meunier: 30 To 40%the Finesse Of Chardonnay: 20 To 30%
desc_en_short:
This Limited Edition Box comes with 6 mini-bottles (200ml) and 6 gold mini-flutes.

Moet Imperial is the House iconic champagne. Created in 1869, it embodies Moet and Chandon unique style, a style distinguished by its bright fruitiness, its seductive palate and its elegant maturity.

name: Cosmopolitan Diva  Sparkling Peach
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 12 Bottles.

Cosmopolitan Diva Sparkling is delightfully crisp and fruity peach fusion sparkling. Its aromas reveal delicious hints of fresh peach fruits, mixed with complexity and elegance of vanilla and white flowers.

name: Monfort  Trento DOC Cuvee 85 Brut
desc_en_short: In 1985 Lorenzo Simoni,started to refine the first bottles in his cellar. That date has been imprinted in the trentodoc Monfort Cuvee 85 Brut,as evidence of how far this sparkling wine cellar's commitment to the classic method is. The "recipe" was also taken from that time: not only more Chardonnay, but also a small percentage of Pinot noir: a touch of elegance inside a vartex of freshness and savoury.

name: Monfort  Trento DOC Rose Brut
desc_en_short: It is distinguished by its intense and complex bouquet, with notes of minerals, fruitier hints of strawberry and red apple and a softness of taste that rich, persistent and well balanced. The delicate, old pink colour is a sign of authenticity, with a creamy white foam and a fine, persistent perlage.

name: Chanson du Vent  Sparkling
desc_en_short: Pale straw in colour, this Tasmanian Sparkling exhibits aromas of apples and citrus along with a bready note. Refreshing acidity adds drive to a generous mid-palate with an everlasting long finish.

name: Veuve Clicquot  Vintage 2015
wine_color: The colour is a shining, beautiful yellow hue.
desc_en_short: In 1810, Madame Clicquot invented the first Vintage Champagne, in 2012 Veuve Clicquot declared the 66th vintage of the Maison. With grapes exclusively from Grands and Premiers Crus, Pinot Noir dominates the blend (51%) and provides the structure that is so typically Clicquot, followed by Chardonnay (34%) that adds finesse and elegance essential in a perfectly balanced wine, and then Meunier (15%) that rounds out the blend. The uniqueness of the Vintage 2012 lies in the addition of 11% of wines aged in large wooden casks (foudres), bringing strength and aromatic intensity. The cask-aged wines act as spices to the blend, bringing very lightly woody, vanilla and toasted aromas.

name: Mare Santo  Cuvee Prestige
wine_color: light yellow with green reflections, continuous perlage.
style: 50 % Rebula – Autochthonous Variety From Goriška Brda, 50 % Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Mare Santo Cuvée prestige is a mixture of Rebula and Chardonnay. Rebula is an old grape variety from Goriška Brda, which gives the wine distinctive flavour, while Chardonnay gives it softness and fullness. Mare Santo Rosé is produced from the best grapes, the Pinot Noir grapes. The grapes come from Goriška Brda and harvested manually. The best that Brda can offer

name: Mare Santo  Rose
desc_en_short: Our grapes ripen on high-quality soil on the green hills of Goriška Brda in a small private winery with heritage and tradition where warm Mediterranean air and cold Alpine wind mix. They caress and lash the grapes together with an authentic technique and recipe which is how it acquires its characteristic flavor.

name: Dom Perignon  P2 Rose
wine_color: A really strong pink colour with hints of cherry and raspberry.
desc_en_short: The Dom Perignon Rose P2 Vintage 2000 has two sides, expressing both warmth and coolness. The seductiveness of black cherries, dried figs and roses contrasts with deeper notes of nutmeg and cocoa powder, culminating in a finish of toastiness, smoke and ash. On the palate, the start is impressive is dominated by the consistency and integrated balance of all the different facets. The mouthfeel unfolds with suppleness and a round, even full-bodied sensation. The surprising finish tightens and then slackens, sappy and acidic, revealing notes of spices and dried citrus.

name: Krug  Champagne Brut 2006 (750 ml)
wine_color: At first sight, the intense golden colour promises round generosity.
desc_en_short:
At the House of Krug, every Krug Vintage celebrates the distinct character of a particular year. A Krug Vintage is a blend of the most expressive wines from a single year enhanced by a stay of over ten years in the cellars. Every Krug Vintage is different: it is the Music of the year, captured by Krug.

Krug 2006 is a story of indulgence, roundness and elegance, nicknamed “Capricious Indulgence” by the House.

name: Ca' Momi  Sparkling Brut California
desc_en_short: Our brut sparkling wine has vibrant aromas of Meyer lemon, Bosc pear, green apple, and a hint of vanilla. On the palate, this wine is a symphony of flavors, including bright lemon, creamy butter, and ripe honey crisp apple. It has a luxurious, rich mouthfeel and a long finish. Whether you are celebrating a special occasion or simply enjoying a glass with friends, this is the perfect choice to elevate any moment and celebrate life every day.

name: Martinotti  Prosecco Spumante Brut
wine_color: Bright straw yellow in colour with lime green reflections.
desc_en_short:
A fresh and gently fruity fizz from north-east 
Italy with citrus and green apple aromas, ripe 
grapey fruit characters and a zesty finish.

name: Champagne Telmont  Reserve Brut
desc_en_short: Réserve Brut is the result of a subtle marriage of three grape varieties. It is a blend of seven distinct years, together beautifully balanced, a perfect harmony of richness, fruitiness and freshness. A genuine expression of terroir, a tribute to the excellence and singularity of each year’s harvest.

name: Champagne Telmont  Reserve Rose
wine_color: Raspberry pink with a fading reflection of sunset
desc_en_short: This exquisite blend of grapes, stemming from four different harvests, showcases its strong personality through a symphony of fruits and a full-bodied, elegant presence. Singular in its expression of terroir, a revelation of the variety that nature offers from one year to the next. Réserve Rosé evokes romance and harmony.

name: Champagne Duval Leroy Blanc De Blance Grand Cru Brut
wine_color: Its golden yellow color bears fine lines of bubbles.
desc_en_short: Duval-Leroy's Blanc de Blancs Grand Cru is made from the exceptional terroirs of 6 villages in the Côte des Blancs (Le Mesnil sur Oger, Oger, Avize, Cramant, Chouilly, Oiry). This champagne is presented in a prestigious bottle whose dark colour prevents any changes to the aromas resulting from its exposure to light.

name: Champagne Vollereaux   Celebration Ice
desc_en_short:
In 1933, Vollereaux Champagne moved into Pierry, a Premier Cru vineyard in the heart of the Champagne region. Historically, the village is known for the work of Friar Jean Oudart (1654-1742), who devoted his life to growing grapes there and promoting the wine of Champagne to the world. The place is also associated with other prestigious figures.

That is why we wanted to produce a vintage from our parcels located along this flank. The Celebration wine expresses the soul of our terroir with a blend of 40% Pinot Noir, 30% Chardonnay and 30% Meunier from the 2012 harvest. Six years of aging in our cellars have given it a full body with aromas of brioche, peaches in syrup and pineapple. The finesse that typifies all the wines we craft is well represented.

name: Champagne Colin  Parallele Vertus Premier Cru Extra Brut Blanc de Blancs
desc_en_short:
The nose initially bursts with notes of ripe wheat and fresh a more floral journey with aromas of aniseed, bergamot and green tea. Rich and dense finished with softly buttery and indulgent notes, marzipan and candied citrus. 

The salty character makes its mark in the mouth with a hint of liquorice. The wine's sharpness floods in with citrus fruits that pop in the mouth. lt finishes on bitter orange and citrus peel elevated by a delicately woody and tannic feel.

name: Champagne Colin  Extravertu Vertus Premier Cru Extra Dry Blanc de Blancs
desc_en_short:
Aniseed and dried flower notes provide a subtle introduction on the nose. ln cornes a woody scent bursting with speculoos, marzipan and very ripe pears. This makes way for a surprising mature aroma with notes of lemon and orange peel with candied citrus fruit in the background 

lts earthy and sharp flavour hits the palate first. They are the perfect compliment to the silky smooth extra-dry dosage with a delicious balance of saltiness and bitterness. Candied citrus and tropical fruit corne together with notes of mirabelle plum, grapefruit and bergamot. lt leaves a wonderfully lingering, intense and strong taste on the palate.

name: Champagne H.Blin  Blanc de Noirs Brut
wine_color: A pale golden colour, fine bubbles.
desc_en_short: Floral, with a touch of fresh butter. Dominant notes of apple, pear, and brioche. Fresh and lively on the finish.

name: Barons de Rothschild  Brut Magnum (1.5 L)
wine_color: bright, clear, pale gold tints woven with very fine bubbles
desc_en_short: This magnum of Brut Champagne from the Barons de Rothschild is the perfect champagne to discover the style of the Barons de Rothschild! An excellent blend of 60% Chardonnay and 40% Pinot Noir. The reserve wines, accounting for 40% of the total, guarantee a great aromatic complexity and aging potential. Aromas of citrus, brioche, peach, and white fruits wrap around the palate, leaving a creamy and delicate impression.

name: Barons de Rothschild  Rose Ritz
desc_en_short: Discover the elegance of Barons de Rothschild Ritz Reserve Brut Rosé. Crafted with precision, this sparkling wine embodies the legacy of the Rothschild family and the luxury of the Ritz Paris. With a delicate pink hue, it offers notes of red berries, citrus, and a touch of floral elegance. The result is a refined effervescence and a crisp, refreshing finish that encapsulates the essence of celebration and sophistication. Elevate your sparkling wine experience with this exquisite expression of craftsmanship and the union of two iconic brands.

name: Barons de Rothschild  Rose
wine_color: pale pink hue with salmon tints and fine bubbles
desc_en_short: Pure and refined, this Rosé Champagne expresses with distinction the approach taken by the Rothschild family in the elaboration of its wines: the commitment to perfection and consistency, with a spirit of refinement and excellence that are the focus of the greatest attention

name: Barons de Rothschild  Rare Collection Blanc de Blanc
wine_color: Pale gold colour with crystalline hues.
desc_en_short: Barons de Rothschild Rare Collection Blanc de Blancs 2012 Magnum with Luxury Box is produced in very limited quantities and benefits from the same care as the Rothschild Family’s finest wines. As soon as the Champagne House was created in 2005, the Rothschild family settled in Champagne with nothing but excellence as their ambition. Less than a year later, the creation of an exceptional cuvée placed under the sign of a great vintage, like the wines of their greatest Châteaux, completed its foundations.

name: Otello Ceci For The Future Bolledichardonnay
wine_color: Bright straw yellow with a slight golden reflection and fine perlage
desc_en_short: From our land, the original Chardonnay “Bolledichardonnay” packaged in the new 100% recyclable aluminum bottle, a symbol of the “For the future” project by Cantine Ceci: an innovative initiative that demonstrates the real concrete commitment to a more responsible production.

name: Massottina Calmaggiore Prosecco Brut DOC
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with brilliant clarity and a persistent, refined perlage.
desc_en_short: An elegant and refreshing Prosecco from the heart of Veneto, Massottina Calmaggiore Brut DOC expresses the finesse and aromatic charm of the Glera grape. With fine bubbles and a lively structure, it's a perfect celebration of Italian craftsmanship and festive spirit.

name: Champagne Philipponnat Blanc De Noirs Extra Brut  2016
wine_color: Intense golden colour with the pink glints typical of Pinot Noir grapes.
desc_en_short: The ultimate expression of the Champagne region’s finest terroirs, in particular Ay, Mareuil-sur-Ay and Côte des Blancs (exclusively Premier and Grand Cru plots), Philipponnat’s vintage cuvées reflect each harvest’s distinctive character: they are produced from a selection of the finest grapes from a single year’s harvest. Each one has its own style, but they all have one thing in common: their elegant vinosity. The wines used to blend them are made using first-press juice and vinified using traditional methods, partly in wooden casks, with no malolactic fermentation. They are given even greater complexity through extended aging on lees in bottles in the cellar for six years or more.

name: Champagne Philipponnat Clos des Goisses Extra Brut 2012
wine_color: Bright gold, with fine, delicate froth mousse.
desc_en_short: Aromas of bread dough, mandarin, strawberry, raspberry and light dry earth follow through to a full body with lightly candied fruit, phenolic tension and a clear, bright finish. Mineral. Pure. Dry and layered at the end with a note of chalk. No malo. 61% pinot noir and 39% chardonnay. Drink now.

name: Champagne Philipponnat Clos des Goisses Extra Brut 2010 (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short:
Quo non ascendet? (‘What heights will it not scale?’) Like the Grands Vins of other regions, Clos des Goisses has been produced every year since 1988. Its sequence of vintages, which vary in character, deserve to be preserved. It always undergoes a strict selection process, the volume produced rarely exceeding half of the vineyard’s theoretical potential.

Quite simply the most potent of all Champagne wines while retaining the mineral freshness of its unrivalled pure chalk hillside, Clos des Goisses is on a par with the best Burgundy reds for pairing with game, truffles, morel mushrooms and washed-rind cheeses.

name: Champagne Philipponnat Clos des Goisses Extra Brut Rose 2009
desc_en_short:
A legendary wine much appreciated by collectors, Clos des Goisses Juste Rosé is unanimously applauded by the most distinguished wine-critics.

This vintage was marked by contrasts: frost and dryness in winter, rainfall and warmth during the growing season, and a harvest of hot, particularly dry weather. It imparts a pleasant surprising quality to this powerful, intense, and exceedingly generous win.

name: Champagne Philipponnat Mareuil-sur-Ay Extra Brut 2014
desc_en_short:
The village of Mareuil-sur-Ay, at the heart of which lies the Philipponnat Champagne house, nestles so closely along the Marne canal that it looks as if it has always been there.

And this might well be the case: the first traces of civilisation date back to the time of the Gauls! Just before the Romans, who were wine enthusiasts, realised that the slopes of the Champagne hills might be suitable for growing vines. Since then, the people of Mareuil-sur-Ay have added a church, a château, dwellings and Champagne houses.

name: Champagne Philipponnat Le Leon Grand Cru Extra Brut 2014
desc_en_short:
Le Léon is one of the same trio of exceptional plot-based cuvées and is the most precise expression of the Ay terroir, the most chalky of the Pinot Noir crus, which makes the resulting wine remarkably unpretentious.

Apvril Le Philipponnat owned vines at Le Léon, between Ay and Dizy, in as early as 1522. Along with the Clos des Goisses, this plot is the birthplace of the Philipponnat vineyards.

name: Champagne Philipponnat "Les Cintres" Extra Brut 2009
desc_en_short: In exceptional years, a limited-quantity edition emerges from the heart of Clos des Goisses. It comes from two adjoining Pinot Noir plots: Les Petits Cintres and Les Grands Cintres. These are the oldest-planted and best-exposed plots on the entire Les Goisses hill. Vinified entirely in wooden barrels without malolactic fermentation, this cuvée is deliberately crafted in limited quantities, and is produced using just a third of the harvest volume to avoid weakening the classic cuvée.

name: Champagne Chavost Assemblage Brut Nature (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short:
Our estate was created in 1946 by the will of our elders, winegrowers of Chavot-Courcourt.

Chavost is the ancestral name of the village, which formerly was located between the Saint-Martin Church and the Mount Felix hill, upon which a castle was established.

Our ancestors have given us their strong collective values, solidarity, sharing, and the love of our lands. Now more than ever, we put all our forces in common to grow high quality grapes, giving us the chance to elaborate unique wines of Champagne.

Our commitment in preserving the environment, our land and the excellence of our wines, is expanding along with a deep conviction. In harmony with our philosophy and values, we decided to produce and launch a new range of wines :

Thanks to a mastered vinification, that does not include added sulfites, the range « Et sans sulfites ajoutés ! » ( meaning « No added sulphites ! »), is composed of a singular and atypical wines. It comes in addition to the traditional range.

name: Champagne Chavost Assemblage Brut Nature (Double Magnum) (3 L)
desc_en_short:
Our estate was created in 1946 by the will of our elders, winegrowers of Chavot-Courcourt.

Our ancestors have given us their strong collective values, solidarity, sharing, and the love of our lands. Now more than ever, we put all our forces in common to grow high quality grapes, giving us the chance to elaborate unique wines of Champagne.

Our commitment in preserving the environment, our land and the excellence of our wines, is expanding along with a deep conviction. In harmony with our philosophy and values, we decided to produce and launch a new range of wines :

Thanks to a mastered vinification, that does not include added sulfites, the range « Et sans sulfites ajoutés ! » ( meaning « No added sulphites ! »), is composed of a singular and atypical wines. It comes in addition to the traditional range.

Champagne Caze-Thibaut Les Fourches
desc_en_short:
The tradition is long and the history is strong. They deserve to be told...Shaped over the centuries by 10 generations of winegrowers, Maison Cazé-Thibaut has seen the birth of men and women, all devoted to their land and their profession in the beautiful Marne Valley. Roger Caze was the first to market bottles of Champagne. A fine winemaker, his fame was such that he worked for the winegrowers of the surrounding villages as well as for Champagne Caze, which he created in 1953.
Within the Maison Cazé, the works follow one another and complement each other but never contradict each other. Today, Fabien perpetuates this work passion in order to create precise and elegant wines in which the notion of terrior is obviously essential.

The ambition of the Coessens house is to make discover through its wines all the richness of an exceptionally rare terroir. name: Champagne Remi Leroy Blanc de Blancs
desc_en_short: Rémi Leroy, based in Meurville in the Côte des Bar, took over his family's 9ha estate and now vinifies about a third of the grapes under his own label. With 70% of his vineyards planted with Pinot Noir, and the rest divided between Chardonnay and Pinot Meunier (with increasing Chardonnay), his approach combines traditional methods with minimal intervention. Rémi’s wines are crafted with natural yeasts and very low SO2 additions, resulting in balanced, age-worthy Champagnes that showcase the unique terroir of the Aube region.

desc_en_short: The Rousseaux family has been cultivating their Grand Cru vineyards in Verzenay since the late 18th century. The initial wines, marketed in the early 20th century under Paul Rousseaux, were expanded by Michel, who refined their production methods. In 1976, Denis and his wife Laurence (niece of the renowned football coach Albert Batteux) established the Rousseaux-Batteux brand. Today, Adrien, the fourth generation, continues to craft their wines with a commitment to tradition.

name: Champagne J.M. Goulard La Charme Vendange
desc_en_short:
J.M. GOULARD was founded by Paul GOULARD, a dedicated farmer and wine-grower known for his caring and generous nature. His son, Jean-Marie GOULARD, joined him in working the family estate. In 1978, Jean-Marie and his wife Martine established their own estate, focusing on producing high-quality champagne using traditional viticulture methods. They continued the legacy of their ancestors, who were gardeners and farmers, by meticulously tending to their crops.

The couple's three sons—Sébastien, Sylvain, and Damien—grew up with a deep appreciation for the champagne industry, often meeting with connoisseurs of J.M. GOULARD. In 2012, Damien took over the operations, driven by a commitment to uphold his parents' traditions and explore the unique terroir of the Massif de St Thierry in their wines.

name: Louis Roederer  Rose Vintage 2017
wine_color: Lovely pink hue with light copper tints. Steady flow of fine bubbles
desc_en_short: 2017 was a year of living dangerously! An exceptionally warm and dry winter and spring, but the latter brought severe frosts from 17 to 29 April, setting the sorry record for 12 nights of frost. These were followed by a dull, wet and not particularly hot summer, which ended in an almost tropical (hot and humid) spell at the end of August. This sudden change led to a significant increase in grey rot on the ripening Pinot noir and Meunier grapes. The harvest was fast-paced and completed very quickly demanding very precise and methodical selection work of an unprecedented level even for Roederer

From its beginnings as a grower-producer, Gremillet has focused on crafting Champagnes that balance approachability with precision, combining modern winemaking with regional identity.

wine_color: Brilliant straw yellow with a green shimmer.
desc_en_short: Brilliant straw yellow with a green shimmer. Quite pronounced and expressive aroma with flowery and somewhat spicy notes. Rich flavoured in the mouth, with a slight smokiness at the back and a good, fresh finish.

name: Alois Lageder  Chardonnay Alto Adige DOC
wine_color: Brilliant, straw-yellow colour with light green hints
desc_en_short: Brilliant, straw-yellow colour with light green hints; the aroma is delicate with pronounced notes of subtropical fruit; quite intense flavour and a good, mediumbodied structure, coupled with lively acidity.

name: Alois Lageder  "RAIN" Riesling Alto Adige DOC
wine_color: Brilliant straw-yellow colour with a light green shimmer.
desc_en_short: Brilliant straw-yellow colour with a light green shimmer. Quite pronounced varietal aroma with refined fruity notes (peach, pear). Dry, medium-bodied, well balanced, grapey flavour with a crisp, refreshing finish and persistent aftertaste. The lively acidity is well integrated in the wine’s fruit structure. When properly cellared, this wine may be kept for at least 3 - 5 years.

name: Alois Lageder  Sauvignon Alto Adige DOC
wine_color: Brilliant, light yellowish color with a green tint.
desc_en_short: Brilliant, light yellowish color with a green tint. Very fresh, quite pronounced, grapey aroma with notes of ripe subtropical fruit, gooseberry and elderflowers. Similar palate with a good intensity. Medium to full-bodied, clean, very dry with a deliciously fresh aftertaste.

name: Alois Lageder  The Terroir Selections PORER Pinot Grigio (Biodynamic)
wine_color: Brilliant straw-yellow colour with a green shimmer.
desc_en_short: Brilliant straw-yellow colour with a green shimmer. Very aromatic, opulent, uplifted varietal aroma paired with pronounced mineral notes and elegant oak spice. Clean, grapey, full-bodied flavour, quite soft and creamy, refined and with a fresh finish. Remarkably long and aroma- tic on the palate. Under proper storage conditions, this wine may be cellared for 4 to 6 years. Suggested foods with starters, pâtés and terrines, cold meat, all kinds of fish and seafood, white meat and poultry.

name: Cantina Di Montalcino  Vermentino Poggio del Sasso
desc_en_short: Straw-yellow in colour, on the nose it is characterized by fragrant and balanced blossom hints, intense aromas of varietal origin like elderflower. Ageing will underline flint. Rich, full and rounded in the mouth, savoury, fairly acid, reliable and long-living, balanced.

name: Callia  Alta Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Bright yellow, tinged with olive. Very intense nose, with marked fruity notes reminiscent of pineapple and tropical fruits, typical of Chardonnay varietals from warm regions. Well-balanced, refreshing mouth-feel. The fruity presence perceived in the nose in also felt in the mouth, leaving a fresh and pleasant aftertaste.

name: Signos  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Bright yellow, with greenish tints. Nose of great aromatic intensity, with aromas typical of this variety when grown in warm areas, most noticeably, pineapple, banana and tropical fruit. Crispy, gentle and balanced mouth-feel, leaving a sweet and pleasant aftertaste.

name: Killka  Chardonnay
wine_color: Greenish Yellow Colour With Golden Hues

name: Paso El Portillo  Tempranillo Selected White
wine_color: The bright yellow shows some greenish reflexes.
desc_en_short: The bright yellow shows some greenish reflexes. Filmily nose with aromas of citrus and tropical fruits, pleasant freshness on the palate, very harmonious with fine glaze.

name: Bodegas Salentein  Portillo Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Yellow wine with greenish tints. Subtle aromas reminiscent of fruits, such as apple and banana, with mineral notes. Crispy and balanced palate, with a good acid line and a long finish. Ideal for white meat, fish, sushi, tamales and pasta with soft sauces.

name: Gustave Lorentz  Pinot Blanc Reserve
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Pinot Blanc Reserve is light gold-yellow in color, with an intense, fresh nose of citrus fruits, refined complexity. The expressive, charming and approachable aromas carry through to the palate. This wine is balanced, light and fruity with a dry, elegant finish.

name: Gustave Lorentz  Riesling Reserve
desc_en_short: Riesling Reserve, both manly acidity and enchanting by its very delicate bouquet. Young, fresh and fruity, well-balanced nervous but the palace.

name: Gustave Lorentz  Gewurztraminer Reserve
desc_en_short: Gustave Lorentz Gewurztraminer Reserve has aromas of roses, exotic fruits and spices. This vintage is lovely in her youth but also has an aging potential May-July years.

name: Chateau Mas Neuf  Rhone Paradox Blanc
wine_color: Clear, Pale Yellow With Green Highlights
desc_en_short: Clear, pale yellow with green highlights. Expressive on the nose, revealing aromas of fresh fruit (white peach, pear, citrus) and white flowers. Tight on the palate, with notes of white fruit, gingerbread and floral hints.

name: Torres  Waltraud Riesling
desc_en_short: Voluptuous aroma of orange blossom and jasmine with fresh fruit notes (quince and pineapple) and Mediterranean forest over a background of honey and fennel. The palate is full and silky, with an elegant balance between acidity and sugar; it also allows appreciation of the noble character of late harvests.

name: Torres  Gran Vina Sol Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Chardonnay and Parellada are harmoniously blended after careful fermentation of a percentage in Limousin oak barrels, thus retaining the character of each variety. The result is a magnificent, intense wine.

name: Torres  Mas Rabell White
desc_en_short: Beautiful pale gold colour. Fine notes of fruit (apple) with delicate notes of wild herbs (fennel). The palate is silky with a dry elegance.

name: Torres  San Valentin Parellada
desc_en_short: Clear pale yellow colour, with enticing aromas of fresh grapes, together with other fruits (ripe bananas, quince ) and flowers (acacia with hints of roses and rosemary). Voluptuous and slightly sweet on the palate.

name: Torres  Vina Brava Parellada / Garnacha Blanca
desc_en_short: Parellada and Garnacha Blanca varieties offer fresh and elegant aromas of apple and pineapple.

name: Lindeman's  Bin 95 Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A reliable wine made in an unoaked style, which highlights the variety's distinctive, fresh herbaceous and tropical fruit aromas and flavours.

name: Springfield Estate  Special Cuvee
desc_en_short: This wine originates from 23-year-old vines rooted in sand rock formations in the estates riverine area. It is a richly concentrated wine from the estate's prime site for Sauvignon Blanc. Treated tenderly in the cellar with minimal intervention, the full expression of the terroir has been allowed, and the resultant complex, sensuous combination of passion fruit and nettles, minerality gives a full mouthfeel with stylish length. Will mature beautifully for 2-4 years.

name: Louis Latour  Chablis 1er Cru Montmains
wine_color: A pale yellow color with green hues.
desc_en_short: A pale yellow color with green hues. Its nose shows aromas of citrus fruits and honey. Its fresh and round palate reveals notes of lemon and honey.

name: Attems  Sauvignon Blanc Friuli IGT
wine_color: A sparkling gold-yellow tone with subtle greenish highlights.
desc_en_short: Attems Sauvignon Blanc boasts a quite distinctive, very complex bouquet. In colour it appears a straw yellow, typically with greenish highlights. Its palate exhibits crisp, tangy acidity and full flavours. Attems Sauvignon Blanc’s crisp, refreshing character renders it delicious as an aperitif, but it partners with foods as well, with poultry and similar light meats, and with fish that is grilled or sautéed with potatoes, asparagus, or mild vegetables, and first courses with cheese-based sauces.

name: Attems  Pinot Grigio Friuli DOC
desc_en_short: This Pinot Grigio is characterised by a straw-yellow colour. Its bouquet is marked by a impressive fruitiness, and the palate demonstrates all of the amazing qualities of the Collio: superb weight and viscosity, mineral-edged, savoury, tangy, and lively.

name: Rosemount Estate  Chardonnay Semillon
desc_en_short: A fresh and fruity wine with a slightly sharper finish than some of the others. This doesn't have a ton of Chardonnay character and almost no Semillon character, but it's pretty inoffensive, full of smooth apricot and yellow apple flavor with a slightly bitter bite at the end. You don't get a mouthful of oak chips here: the profile is just bright, juicy fruit. This wine would be right at home with puff pastry hors d'oeuvres, and it could handle a cheese plate, too.

name: Two Oceans  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 3 Bottles.

This medium-bodied wine is straw-yellow in colour with an excellent balance between summer fruit, sweetness and acid, rounded off with well-integrated oak. Enjoy lightly chilled. Excellent paired with pasta, poultry and fish dishes served with creamy sauces.

name: Fairview  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Pale straw colour in the glass. Aromas of orange peel and citrus blossom with hints of honey pod leading to a creamy texture on the palate with soft 
acidity. The mouth feel is medium-bodied with a little oak regime.

name: Fairview  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Fresh fig notes accompanied by bright citrus aromas on the nose. Grapefruit and subtle guava fill the palate and linger on the finish. The acidity gives good length and the mouthfeel is full, rich and textured.

name: Fairview  Darling Chenin Blanc
desc_en_short: Intense fruit aromas with jasmine notes on the nose. Opulent pear and tropical fruit continue on the palate with well-integrated freshness. The lees contact adds fuller mouthfeel and length.

name: Jeseph Mellot  Sancerre "La Chatellenie"
desc_en_short: Pale gold in colour with green highlights. Expressive nose with notes of citrus and mango. Soft and delicate on the palate at first revealing great harmony. Remarkable length with a citrusy finish. A fine, delicate wine typical of its flint-rich terroir.

name: La Capra  by Fairview Chenin Blanc
desc_en_short: Fresh fruit on the nose, lead by white fruit and tropical notes. The palate is well-balanced with clean, refreshing acidity whilst showing good mouth feel and texture.

name: La Capra  by Fairview Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Tropical and passion fruit aromas with fresh pineapple on the nose. Smooth, rounded mouthfeel with a well – balanced acidity and a lingering after taste.

name: Altivo  Classic Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Golden yellow in color. Bright peach and pineapple, citrus aroma, mouth feel pleasant fruit acidity, long aftertaste. Ideal with fish, grilled white meat, and pasta.

name: Louis Latour  Ardeche Chardonnay Cotaux de l'Ardeche IGP
desc_en_short: A pale yellow color. Its nose of intense candied lemon, develops itself on notes of citrus marmalade, acacia, and thyme. The mouthfeel, very fresh, offers a nice tension where aromas of candied lemon and white flowers are revealed. It is a long wine, which finishes in roundness with a light salinity.

name: Pala  Silenzi Bianco Isola Dei Nuraghi IGT
desc_en_short: it's a pale straw colour with greenish reflections, its taste is predominately vegetables notes, fresh and of a good intensity. Perfect drinks with fish and lightly seasoned foods.

name: Ruffino  La Solatia Chardonnay Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: 90 points in Wine spectator. The impressive structure of this white wine is a perfect territorial expression of the Chardonnay cultivated on the La Solatia Estate. The taste is full and lush with notes of exotic fruit, but it is also elegant and pleasantly fragrant, thanks to a well-defined acidic note. The aftertaste is truly intriguing, reminiscent of dried figs and sage.

name: Ruffino  Lumina Pinot Grigio Venezia Giulia IGT
desc_en_short: On the palate is tasty and harmonious, fragrant and medium-bodied. It is characterised by fruity notes and the aromatic persistence is very long-lived with scents of sage and freshly baked bread.

name: Ruffino  Libaio Chardonnay Toscana IGT
desc_en_short: 85 points in Wine spectator. The taste is fragrant with hints of golden apple, sage and figs. The wine is harmonious with its pleasant roundness well balanced by a lively freshness. The finish is very aromatic and persistent, reminding the orange peel.

name: Ruffino  Orvieto Classico DOC
style: Grechetto 40%, Procanico 20%, Other White Varietals (Verdello, Canaiolo Bianco) 40%.
desc_en_short: The taste is lightly sweet and smooth thanks to the balance between structure, acidity and fruity notes. The aftertaste is long and fragrant, with neat hits of fresh almond due to the chalky soil of the Orvieto production area.

name: Umani Ronchi  Plenio Verdicchio Dei Castelli di Jesi DOC
wine_color: Deep straw yellow with golden tints.
desc_en_short: 89 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Plenio Riserva is a beautiful expression of Verdicchio (one third of the wine is aged in oak) with floral aromas of honeysuckle and yellow rose and candy-like tones of butterscotch and dried apricot. The wine finishes with soft, creamy fruit nuances and a touch of sassy spice."

name: Umani Ronchi  Vellodoro Pecorino Terre Di Chieti DOC
desc_en_short: Pecorino is an indigenous grape of Abbruzzo. It shows nice minerality as most of Italian whites, good acidity and nice citrus fruits. Low alcohol make it refreshinng and easy to drink.

name: Gerard Bertrand  Cigalus Blanc
wine_color: Golden yellow color, bright and clear.
