desc_en_short: Golden yellow color, bright and clear. Intense nose and ripe citrus complex (grapefruit) peach white, honey, dried fruit with a toasted note. Full and silky mouth, ripe, ample with notes vanilla, toast, butter and exotic fruits. Good length in the mouth.

name: Haras de Pirque By Antinori  Sauvignon Albaclara
Springfield Estate  Methode Ancienne Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Springfield Estate Méthode Ancienne Chardonnay is in the ancient style of Burgundy, rarely is this technique with wild yeast and no fining/filtration used in the new world. Thus, a wine of distinctive and classical character, it will develop slowly and is made to last (we hope) a lifetime. Tropical fruit nuances layered by lime and cream – a big wine with classical character!

name: Springfield Estate  Wild Yeast Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This Chardonnay, fermented with native yeast present in the vineyard, abounds with flavours of pineapple and pear drops. Immensely complex aromas of pineapple and pear mingling with nutty, yeasty cookie dough notes from extended lees ageing. The palate structure is firm, crisp and grippy. Drink with roasted or barbecued sea bass, trout or tuna.

name: Springfield Estate  Life from Stone Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This single vineyard originates from the rockiest soil on the estate, with resultant struggling vines and huge concentration. Brilliant greenish in appearance, this is a dramatic wine full of ripe red peppers and passion fruit. It will mature to perfection within one year, into flavours of mineral and flint (gun smoke).

name: Castello Banfi  Fumaio IGT White
desc_en_short: This wine is Banfi’s excellent interpretation of youthful white wines.The Chardonnay imparts roundness, while the Sauvignon Blanc adds character to this fresh and easy-to-drink wine. Ideal as an aperitif oras a perfect partner of fish dishes.

name: Gerard Bertrand  Naturalys Chardonnay
wine_color: Bright yellow hue, with slight green tones.
desc_en_short: The palate remains smooth and unctuous (notes of vanilla, exotic fruits) with a finish marked by a beautiful liveliness and a good length.

name: 88th Drop  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Sourced from Australia’s premium vineyards, this light straw colour wine is fruit driven and displays ripe stone fruit and toasty oak aromas. A fresh palate of buttery ferment characters, creamy yeast and vanillin oak, finishing long, soft and well rounded. Goes well with sea foods, light cheeses, barbequed chicken, skewers and salads.

name: Robertson Winery  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The balance of the fresh citrus fruits and rich melon characters give the wine a full rounded palate that combines well with the subtle creaminess and nuttiness of the gentle oak. The natural acidity follows through to a fresh and clean finish. Enjoy now with seafood, salmon, roast chicken, Thai-food and pork.

name: Robertson Winery  Gewurztraminer "Special Late Harvest"
desc_en_short: Full bodied wine with honeysuckle and rose petals in bouquet. Rich and smooth with beautifully balanced sugar and acid give an extra interest by a touch of honeyed botrytis. An uncomplicated wine ideal with fresh fruit based desserts and mild soft cheeses.

name: Robertson Winery  Sauvignon Blanc "Retreat"
desc_en_short: Retreat, a single vineyard with well-weathered shale soils is the source of this Sauvignon Blanc. It is situated on a south-facing slope in the Riviersonderend mountain range at an altitude of 350 metres above sea level. During summer this vineyard is cooled in the afternoons by southern ocean sea breezes, enabling an extended ripening season This results in good quality fruit, with concentrated flavours and Gne acidity. The farm has been owned by the De Wet family since 1896, one of Robertson Winery’s 35 member families.

name: Robertson Winery  Chardonnay "Kings River"
desc_en_short: Carefully judged vineyard selection has provided a solid fruit foundation for this Chardonnay. Fruit was sourced from a premium block on the Kings River farm that is owned by the Colyn family since 1880, one of Robertson Winery’s 35 member families. The well-weathered deep Karoo soil on this farm with its generous lime content adds an underlying richness and complexity to this unique wine.

name: Tyrrell's  Sauvignon Blanc "Moore's Creek"
wine_color: Pale with a lime green hue.
desc_en_short: This popular varietal is sourced from a number of premium grape growing regions around south eastern Australia. The grapes were crushed in their respective regions before the being brought to the Hunter Valley where the wines were fermented. Following a cool fermentation in stainless steel vessels using aromatic yeasts to maximize the grape’s fragrant qualities, the wine was quickly filtered and blended to retain its fresh sherbet fruit flavours.

name: Tyrrell's  Chardonnay "Moore's Creek"
wine_color: Pale with a lime green hue.
desc_en_short: Grapes were harvested at different times during the picking season. Some were harvested early to retain clean, fresh acid characteristics. Other chardonnay grapes were harvested later in the season at optimum ripeness to create a rich full bodied flavour. Once cold settled, the juice was transferred to stainless steel tanks for fermentation. Portions of the blend were matured in small French oak barrels to further enhance complexity.

name: Tyrrell's  Semillon "Old Winery"
desc_en_short: The Old Winery Semillon is pale in colour and has floral aromas on the nose. With its soft lemon/lime citrus flavours, lighter freshher structure and clean refreshing finish, this attractive wine style is a great alternative to sauvignon blanc or riesling.

name: Stone Bay  Sauvignon Blanc (Marlborough)
desc_en_short: A swirl of the glass produces sparkling hues of pale straw and sublime Sauvignon Blanc aromas of gooseberry, citrus and hints of passionfruit. The palate is fruit driven with lovely herbal, citrus and tropical flavours producing a long clean finish which is fresh and crisp. Fabulous to share with friends.

name: Yalumba  Organic Chardonnay
wine_color: Pale straw in colour with green hues
desc_en_short: Pale straw in colour with green hues, the Yalumba Organic Chardonnay 2011 has aromas of peach, melon and ripe stone fruits, which are complemented by a touch of funk from the wild yeast fermented characters. The palate is a beautiful layering of distinct flavours starting with stone fruits and hints of lemon rind, leading to a creamy custard apple finish.

name: Santa Ana  Chardonnay
wine_color: A bright yellow colour with subtle green hints.
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Chardonnay has a bright yellow colour with subtle green hints. Tropical fruits aromas, such as pineapple and banana. Smooth and full with a balanced finish. Ideal as aperitif or to match with fish, fowl and pasta.

name: Santa Ana  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: A bright yellow colour with subtle green hints.
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Sauvignon Blanc is bright yellow in colour with green hues. Crispy, herbal and refreshing in the mouth. Very well balanced on the finish. Ideal as aperitif or to match with white meats, seafood dishes and cheeses.

name: Mascota Vineyards  La Mascota Chardonnay
wine_color: Light yellow colour with distinctive green hues
desc_en_short: This is a complex and well-balanced chardonnay, showcasing light yellow colour with distinctive green hues. The aromas of pears and pineapples are enhanced with a subtle layer of sweet vanilla from barrel ageing. The rich and round mouth-feel ends with a long, crisp and clean finish. Ideal to combine with grilled chicken, fresh salmon, lobster or light pasta dishes.

name: Santa Ana  Viognier Reserve
wine_color: A bright golden colour with green hues.
desc_en_short: Santa Ana Viognier Reserve has a bright golden colour with green hues. Aromas of stone fruits with an alluring complexity of toasted bread and vanilla notes. Rich and full palate with a hint of sweetness balanced by a racy acidity on the finish. The perfect accompaniment to Sushi, Oriental dishes, spicy chicken and Indian curries.

name: Twin Islands  Sauvignon Blanc Marlborough
desc_en_short: Pale straw in colour. The nose oflively fragrance combines passionfruit, grapefruit and fresh mint. The palate is crisp and intense showing citrus flavours with hints of fresh coriander which lead to a mouth-watering and zesty finish.

name: Antares  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Pale lemon yellow with greenish highlights
desc_en_short: Pale lemon yellow with greenish highlights. Antares Sauvignon Blanc is a fresh young wine. It offers aromas of mint, melon and pineapple with refreshing citrus notes of lime and grapefruit. The palate is soft and fruity with a medium body and a well balanced acidity. Food Pairing with fish, salads or chicken with mild herbs.

name: Antares  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Our pale yellow Antares Chardonnay stands out for the intensity of its aromas of tropical fruits and apples. The acidity is well-balanced on the palate and the overall result is light, fresh, crisp and fruity Chardonnay. Food Pairing Fish with a mild sauce or shellfish. Pasta and quiches are also ideal accompaniments for this wine.

name: Two Vines  Chardonnay Columbia Crest
desc_en_short: This lighter style Chardonnay is fresh and vibrant with bright apple and pear aromas coupled with hints of toasted coconut and lemon zest. Crisp fruit flavors are accented by nuances of toasty oak and balanced by creaminess on the palate.

name: Planeta  La Segreta Bianco DOC Sicilia
wine_color: A clear yellow with slight greenish reflections.
desc_en_short: A clear yellow with slight greenish reflections. large and exuberant olfactory impact. Aromas of citrus, pineapple, white peach well balanced between them. Fresh and balanced, successful balance between acidity, flavor and volume, never excessive. Final full and aromatic.

name: Beringer  Founders Estate Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This Chardonnay has a perfect combination of pear, apple and ripe tropical fruit flavours, with a hint of citrus. It will perfectly complement a grilled chicken or fish, or stand up to a rich risotto with its ripe, clean flavours and lingering finish.

name: Millaman  Condor Chardonny
desc_en_short: Deliciously fresh, very young wine. Pale yellow color. Well-balanced, dry white wine. Crisp aromas of green apple, ripe melon and succulent tropical pineapple, with a smooth and creamy finish. Excellent as an aperitif or with creamy pasta dishes and dishes based on fish or poultry.

name: Churchview  Silverleaf Semillon Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
Fresh and vibrant, with sweet apple and pear alongside ripe lemon. A hint of
texture, combined with fresh and lingering acidity, makes this a mouthwatering
wine.

name: Wolf Blass  Bilyara Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Bilyara Chardonnay is a rich, soft wine, with characteristic Chardonnay flavours of white peach and melon. The palate is medium-bodied, soft and lingering, with a hint of restrained oak. Great with a Chicken Caesar Salad or Pumpkin and Leek Tortellini with Sage Burnt Butter Sauce.

name: Cape Zebra  Chenin Blanc
desc_en_short:
An abundantly fruity, delightfully refreshing wine brimming with ripe flavours of white pear and apricot with a hint of granadilla. Pairing with oysters, seared tuna; pasta with 
a rich gorgonzola sauce and quiche.

name: Vidal  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Enticing aromas of citrus and stone fruit combine with integrated oak and an underlying nuttiness on the palate. Fruit driven, vibrant and well balanced, this wine is ideal on its own or served with fresh seasonal produce.

name: Santa Carolina  Sauvignon Blanc Semillon "Vistana"
desc_en_short: This wine fresh addition of fruit, mainly fruit and lime, lemon aroma tropical; good wine entrance structure, acidity and pleasant, is Chile's Central Valley classic white wine. With limes, lemons and a variety of tropical fruit aromas. Slightly acidic taste, is a typical representative of the Chilean Central Valley areas of high-quality wine.

name: Santa Carolina  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Lemon yellow with greenish highlights. Aromas of melon and pineapple with citrus notes of lime and grapefruit. The palate is soft and fruity with medium body and well balanced acidity.

name: Santa Carolina  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Light lemon colour; Vanilla, slightly tropical aromas and flavours with subdued apple notes; Dry, medium-bodied, with well balanced acidiy and a tangy lemon finish

name: Santa Carolina  Chardonnay Reserva
desc_en_short: Pale straw colour; light toasty notes with peach and apple fruit; medium-bodied with toasty, tropical fruit flavours. Enjoy drinks with grilled chicken, fish, veggies or creamy pasta.

name: Santa Carolina  Sauvignon Blanc Reserva
desc_en_short: Bright, pale lemon-green colour; aromas of gooseberry, lemon and honey comb; dry, fresh acidity and light to medium-bodied; flavours of gooseberry, white pepper, melon and lime; medium finish.

name: Santa Carolina  Ekun Organic Chardonnay Viognier
desc_en_short: Ekun – which means respect in Mapudungún – represents Santa Carolina’s strong commitment to sustainability and the environment. Each of the varieties in this range is made with limited production organic grapes: a fresh, floral Chardonnay Viognier blend with pleasant tropical hues.

name: Cantine Ivam  Barone di Bernaj Catarratto Sicilia IGT
desc_en_short: Yellow with green reflections, intense aroma of yellow flowers (gorse),white fruits with a note of minerals and citrus fruit. Persistent flower with a touch of fresh fruit, bitter almond and nutmeg. Goes well with fish dishes. Serve at a temperature of 10° - 12° C.

name: Cantine Ivam  Barone di Bernaj Alcamo Bianco DOC
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with slight green reflections; intense aroma, dry and persistent on the palate. Goes well with fish, shell fish and fresh cheeses. Serve at a temperature of 8° C opened at the last minute.

name: Cantine Ivam  Inzolia Tralci Sicilia IGT
desc_en_short: Straw yellow in color with a slightly aromatic. Fresh and harmonious taste. Suitable for delicate hors d'oeuvres accompanied by noble meats and fish first courses of the island cuisine and Italian. Serve at a temperature of 10-12 ° C.

name: Vecchia Cantina  Campaltino Toscana Bianco IGT
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with greenish glares, delicate and continuous, with aroma of fruit and white flowers. Balanced and continuous, with good harmony between alcohol and acidity.

name: Rocca Delle Macie  Orvieto Classico DOC
style: Trebbiano Toscano, 20% Verdello, 20% Grechetto And Drupeggio, And 10% Malvasia Toscana
desc_en_short: Defined by Italian poet Gabriele D’Annunzio as 'Italian sunshine in a bottle', Orvieto has been lauded by poets, artists and illustrious individuals since ancient times. When Pinturicchio painted in Orvieto, he stipulated in his contract that they supply him with “as much wine as he could drink”, and so it comes as no surprise that Orvieto is one of the most popular Italian white wines around the world. Rocca delle Macìe's Orvieto Classico is made on selected estates from grapes harvested in the historic production zone.

name: Rothbury  Semillon / Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Light, pale straw in colour, with a tinge of citrus. A wonderfully fragrant nose of snow peas, guava and a little passionfruit. On the palate the wine is medium bodied with an extra degree of complexity from oak maturation whilst maintaining the crisp, citrus flavours which gives the wine freshness and length.

name: Rothbury  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Straw colour with green hues. A nose of roasted nuts and salted cashew, stonefruits and dusty integrated oak. More cashew flavours on the palate, white melon, buttery, honeyed fruit characters, balanced oak, butterscotch and nectarine.

name: Lindeman's  Bin 65 Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Bin 65 Chardonnay is full flavored with creamy tropical fruit characters of pineapple, melon and white peach with a long soft oak finish. This wine has well balanced, fresh acidity with a nutty oak character reflecting the gentle oak treatment and creamy texture from the partial malolactic fermentation. A medium bodied wine with a long full flavored soft finish.

name: Lindeman's  Premier Selection Semillon / Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Lindeman's Premier Selection Chardonnay makes the most of Lindeman's winemaking experience and extensive vineyard holdings across Australia. By sourcing fruit from a number of regions, Lindeman's winemakers have been able to craft wines that are of outstanding quality with each and every vintage.

name: Discovery Point  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Tangy and rich with a pungent aroma and a savouriness to the flavour from partial wild yeast fermentation and extended yeast lees aging. It's rich and dry with grapefruit, apple and lime and a stonefruit richness to the full, fat finish. A very enjoyable full-bodied style.

name: Bolla  Soave Classico DOC
desc_en_short: Soave means “soft” in Italian, and the soft floral bouquet and clean pear and lemon flavors help this wine live up to its name.  A delicate almond aftertaste makes it the perfect quaff to lighter fare like grilled seafood, chicken, fish-based pastas, and entrée salads. It also makes a perfect aperitif.

name: Masi  Soave "Levarie" Classico DOC
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Soave Levarìe is an evergreen white wine, delicate and original, made with the traditional grapes of the Soave Classico region Garganega and Trebbiano in an area with volcanic soil and a mild climate.

name: Citra  Pinot Grigio "Terre Siciliane"
desc_en_short: Bright straw gold. Delicate and pleasing with floral and fruit scents. Dry, light and crisp on the palate. Highly versatile. A wonderful aperitif and equally splendid with appetizers, salads, grilled shrimp, chicken, sushi and fresh seafood dishes. Enjoy well chilled.

name: Citra  Trebbiano D'Abruzzo Doc
desc_en_short: Straw gold with delicate greenish tints. Fresh and pleasant, with lingering citrus notes. Full, crisp, dry and harmonious. An  ideal companion to cold appetizers and hors d’oeuvres, as well as veal dishes and pork entrées. Serve slightly chilled.

name: Masseria Altemura  Fiano
wine_color: Light straw color with green hues.
desc_en_short: Light straw color with green hues. Aromatic withapricot, nectarine, gardenia, and honey notes. Dry, medium bodied, crisp and reveals youthful apricots, stone minerals, and a rich texture that leads to a refreshing finish. Food matching with linguini and clams, caprese salad, simple pasta dishes.

name: Danzante  Pinot Grigio
wine_color: A bouquet of fruity and citrus notes of citron are accompanied by fine floral accents.
desc_en_short: A bouquet of fruity and citrus notes of citron are accompanied by fine floral accents. The nose possesses both the crisp qualities of green apples and the sweetness of ripe apricots. In the mouth, rich and persistent notes of ripe summer fruits lead the way for lingering and fresh citrusy finish.

name: La Gioiosa Etamorasa  Pinot Grigio Veneto IGT
desc_en_short: Very bright pale straw yellow. Aroma predominantly of fruity and flowery fragrances reminiscent of the countryside in summer. A dry, round and flavour some taste, with a fruity, warm and well balanced finish.

name: Corvo  Bianco
wine_color: bright straw yellow with clear greenish hints.
desc_en_short: Corvo Bianco, a classic Sicilian wine, is produced from Sicilian vines cultivated on warm, sunny hills. Mediterranean and rich in the island’s scents it is a harmonious, versatile white wine with lots of character. Almost 200 years since it was first bottled, Corvo Bianco has become a quality, every day wine thanks to its constant presence on the tables of the Italians and its ability to reinvent itself.

name: Valfieri  Gavi Di Gavi DOCG
desc_en_short: Very light straw colour. Fine, intense nose. Very dry and crisp. Excellent with seafood, appetisers, and first courses with fish sauces. Server at 10° C.

name: La Campagne  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A soft, green apple scented Chardonnay which demonstrates its unoaked nature with plenty of fruit on the palate. Whilst the grapes are grown in the relatively hot climate of southern France, modern production techniques have ensured this wine has a lively refreshing finish.

name: La Campagne  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: An excellent example of this hugely popular grape variety. A quick sniff and the explosion of gooseberry aromas quickly identifies this as a classic Sauvignon Blanc. Backed up by crisp acidity on the palate and this is everything you'd expect and want from a Sauvignon.

name: Jean D'alibert  Sauvignon "Domaine Des Fees"
desc_en_short: Crystal colour, with pale green-yellow hints. Fruity on the nose, notes of citrus fruits and broom add complexity to the first impression. On the palate, a fresh attack balanced by roundness and a soft floral finish.

name: Chateau Du Pin  Blanc
desc_en_short: Fresh, flavorful with pronounced fruity notes. Excellent with fish and seafood.

name: Chateau La Louviere  Blanc 2000
desc_en_short: Chateau La Louviere is now one of the most renowned properties in Pessac-Léognan producing exceptionally high-quality reds and whites that remain very fairly priced. The property has a long and illustrious history and possesses a very handsome château that dates back to 1795. It has been owned by André Lurton since 1965.

name: Chateau Olivier  Grand Cru Classe 2002
desc_en_short: The nose is most seductive with aromas of toast and pollen enhanced by a hint of citrus. After a lively entry on the palate, typical of this vintage, a clean, fresh finish demonstrates brilliantly the perfect balance between the Sémillon and Sauvignon, the hallmark of this great Graves terroir.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Vaudon  Chablis "Premier Cru"
desc_en_short: "A dry and brisk wine, typical of Chablis. Brilliant yellow-green colour. The aromas are reminiscent of lemon, citrus, asparagus...On the palate, the first sip offers is clear-cut and fresh impression, with a nice texture. Long on the aftertaste, with fruity as well as mineral flavours; becomes slightly honeyed when the wine is more evolved".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Meursault
desc_en_short: "A refined wine, well appreciated in the whole world. A beautiful golden colour and a great aromatic palette: honey, linden flower ("tilleul"), hazelnut butter, sometimes even chamomile or hawthorn. On the palate, a silky roundness. Long on the aftertaste, with flavours of yellow plum and gingerbread".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Meursault Perrieres Premier Cru
desc_en_short: "A complex and generous wine, with a rare elegance. The colour is extraordinarily luminous. On the nose, a palette of interesting and varied aromas: syrup, grilled almond, preserved fruit. In the mouth, a silky and ample texture which does not exclude freshness or lightness. Long on the palate, with flavours recalling grilled bread and fruit jam. Always a consummate example of a white Burgundy, this wine is perfection!".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Chassagne Montrachet Blanc
desc_en_short: "A generous and elegant wine. Light golden colour. Intense nose of flower, brioche and candied lemon aromas, evolving towards nuances of grilled hazelnut and spice as the wine matures. On the palate, the wine is straightforward, with a nice texture and finesse. It has a long aftertaste where floral and gingerbread notes dominate".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Chassagne Montrachet "Marquis De Laguiche" Premier Cru
desc_en_short: "This is a wonderful occasion to savour a great wine.Admirable light golden colour. Intense and elegant aromas come to the fore : hawthorn, apricot notes, evolving towards hints of blond tobacco. As the wine ages, there are nuances of dried fruit and rare spices. A silky texture and a subtle touch of tannin give a true personality to the wine. Remarkable aftertaste. A great white Burgundy!".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Puligny Montrachet
wine_color: The colour is pure and bright, with light glints of white gold.
desc_en_short: "A wine of great finesse, distinguished and elegant. The colour is pure and bright, with light glints of white gold. The aromas evoke trees in bloom and white flesh fruit, like white peaches. With age, the aromas evolve towards almond and lightly grilled dried fruit. On the palate, there is a sensation of fresh silkiness. Long and persistent in the aftertaste, ending on an exceptional wealth of flavors, both floral and fruity".

name: Joseph Drouhin  Corton Charlemagne Grand Cru
desc_en_short: One of the greatest wines of Burgundy, to be tasted with awe and reverence. It has an intense golden hue. On the nose, there are some subtle tones of rose, fresh almond, citrus, honey, exotic wood and spice. Majestic and well balanced on the palate. Generous and lively at the same time. Intense and complex aftertaste. All the aromas mingle and linger for quite a long time afterwards. A wine of undeniable majesty.

name: Joseph Drouhin  Saint Veran
wine_color: Its golden hue, its greenish reflection and its refreshing taste.
desc_en_short: "A wine that smiles and makes you smile!  It is stylistically close to Pouilly-Fuissé, with its golden hue, its greenish reflection and its refreshing taste. The aromas are reminiscent of the ripe Chardonnay grape, with subtle notes of musk. A pleasant roundness coats the palate".

name: Sauvion  Muscadet Plaisir De Vigne
desc_en_short: Beautifully crisp, very mineral, and has a lovely flor sherry character (which, incidentally comes from the yeast). It's absolutely perfect for oysters.

name: Sauvion  Muscadet Reserve "Sevre et Maine Sur Lie"
desc_en_short: Pale gold with greenish highlights. Expressive, fruity, fresh nose. Harmonious palate with aromas of ripe fruit and good acidity. A natural, consumer-friendly wine displaying good persistency. Serve well-chilled. Drinking well now with oysters.

name: Henri Bourgeois  Les Bonnes Bouches Sancerre Blanc
desc_en_short: Delicate nose with aromas of white flesh fruits and citrus, this Sancerre is highlighted by its typicity and its great expression of the Sauvignon grape.“Les Bonnes Bouches” is a wine of exotic fruit and citrus aromas; subtle yet powerful. Its persistence and harmony find their origin in the exposition and quality of the terroir.

name: Henri Bourgeois  En Travetin Pouilly Fume
desc_en_short:
The aromatic, floral and smoked nature of the Sauvignon grape variety is the most dominant aspect of this charming wine. 
It displays its elegance, fruitiness and roundness and is very persistent in the mouth. Serve at about 10°C.

name: Alsace Willm  Gewurztraminer Reserve
desc_en_short: Golden yellow hints. Nice aromatic intensity and exotic fruits. Light, round, well-balanced, good persistence, finishing on spicy notes.

name: Alsace Willm  Riesling Reserve
desc_en_short: Pale, yellow with golden hints. Nice aromatic intensity, citrus and white flowers notes. Straight forward, fresh, good acidity, good persistence, citrus notes.

name: Leon Beyer  Gewurztraminer
desc_en_short: Full-bodied and well-structured, is probably the best-known Alsace wine. Its intense bouquet displays rich aromas of fruit, flowers and spices. Powerful and seductive, sometimes slightly sweet, it can often age well.

name: Leon Beyer  Riesling
desc_en_short: Riesling is dry, refined and delicately fruity, with an elegant bouquet of mineral or floral notes. Acknowledged as one of the finest white varietals in the world.

name: Leon Beyer  Riesling Cuvee Des Comtes D'Eguisheim
desc_en_short:
89 point in Robert Parker Wine Advocate. Mothball, peach, peach pit, and petrol rise from the glass of 2001 Riesling Comtes D'Eguisheim, another
relatively young Riesling (by Beyer standards, at any rate) that is already exhibiting considerable development, but in the case of vintage 2001, such early aromatic evolution is not unusual. Subtly creamy in texture, quite full and rich, with pit fruit, herbal and fusil complexities, this finishes with breadth and satisfaction, and will I suspect be at its be st over the next two or three years.

name: Nederburg  Winemaster's Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Brilliant with greenish tinges. Melon and herbaceous nuances with fresh gooseberries and a hint of green figs. Distinctive gooseberry and herbaceous flavours support a balanced palate with a pleasant lingering finish.

name: Prego  Trebbiano d'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: A light and delicate white wine. Fruity bouquet with aromas of apple and a taste that is crispy and refreshing. A delightful aperitif or with snake, appetizers and spicy dishes.

name: Prego  Pinot Grigio IGT Venezie
desc_en_short: Lovely floral aroma with masses of fresh fruit flavours on the palate and a rush of citrus acidity, making it perfectly balanced and totally refreshing. Perfect with robust pasta dishes and pizza.

name: Schloss Vollrads  Kabinett Trocken Riesling (375 ml)
desc_en_short: This is an elegant and delicate Riesling. Demonstrating aromas of ripe fruit such as apple and white peach this wine is accompanied by lively acidity.This wine conveys the complex minerality of our vineyards. The subtle sweetness brings a delightful harmony to the wine. This Vollrads’ Riesling is ideal as an accompaniment to grilled fish or poultry, various cheeses or can be enjoyed just by itself.

name: Schloss Vollrads  Qualitatswein Trocken Riesling (375 ml)
desc_en_short: This dry Riesling is a prime example for the variety as well as for its vintage. It has an inviting floral bouquet, subtle minerality, and complex fruit and is finished in a dry style. You can enjoy this wine to accompany food, with friends, or simply by yourself to unwind.

name: Schloss Vollrads  Kabinett Halbtrocken
desc_en_short: 87 points in Wine Spectator. This wine pairs great with Asian cuisine like Sushi or Sashimi. The wine has perfect balance of acidity and natural sweetness and has the right characteristics to stand up to such exciting dishes. On the other hand it a mild cheese can also create an interesting combination

name: Schloss Vollrads  Volratz 1573 Riesling
desc_en_short: The “Volratz 1573” is a refreshing, dry Rheingau Riesling with a crisp and mineral character showing fruits of apricots and peaches.

name: E.Guigal  Saint Joseph Blanc AOC
desc_en_short: Powerful and complex nose. Strong notes of white flowers. Delicate oak aromas. Exceptionally fresh and fruity. Round and powerful on the palate.

name: Umberto Cesari  Iove Chardonnay / Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: iove Chardonnay Pinot Grigio is a fresh and pleasant blend, set apart thanks to its intriguing bouquet of yellow tropical fruits. A great conversation wine.

name: Le Petit  Chat-en-Oeuf Blanc (185 ml)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 24 Bottles.

Scrumptious dry white wonderfully aromatic and mouth-filling. A floral and stone fruit nose followed by soft apricots and cream on the palate, building to a fresh lemon finish. The wine is clean, balanced and refreshing.

name: Opera Prima  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Chardonnay is bright and clean color, with an attractive tonality. Its aroma is fresh on the nose, with a complex summary of tropical fruits. On the mouth is tasty, with a good compensation on the nose and good memories of the obtain sensations in the olfactory phase.

name: Terra Antica  Chardonnay / Vermentinu
wine_color: Golden colour with shades of green.
desc_en_short: A wine with fairly bold golden colour with shades of green, becoming translucent towards the edge of the glass. Fresh with an aromatic structure typical of the both grapes, hazelnuts, almonds, green apples and pears. On the palate, same fruity flavours as in the nose. The wine has a nice length with a lovely minty zestiness and a hazelnut finish. Finesse and elegance can be found in this wine throughout the tasting.

name: PKNT  Chardonnay
wine_color: Straw yellow color wine with golden notes.
desc_en_short: Ripe pineapple and tropical fruit flavors mingle in this soft, full-bodied wine. Ideal on its own or with smoked salmon or other fish dishes.

name: PKNT  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
Expressive and aromatic on the nose with herbaceous overtones and something of tropical and citrus fruit. In the mouth the herbaceous dominates, it has a balanced acidity and is rich and silky, of medium body and good persistence. This crisp fresh dr y wine can be drunk on its own or enjoyed with most
seafood, or light dishes.

name: Grand Cape  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Expressive fruits flavors as pineapple, and green apple, with a hint of herbs. Medium bodied wine, beautifully balanced with a crisp and refreshing finish. Bright texture resulting in a wine with complexity. Ideal to pair with simply cooked to creamy dishes as fish or chicken.

name: Pigmentum  Ugni Blanc / Colombard
desc_en_short: A clear, pale colour along with hints of tropical fruit, grapefruit, and lime blossom on the nose. These two grape varieties mesh together wonderfully to make a wine that is full of flavour and extremely pleasant as an aperitif. Best enjoyed well-chilled as an aperitif with starters such as stuffed avocado, or with brochettes, shrimp salad, cheese, and desserts such as mango carpaccio.

name: Norfolk Rise  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: The wine is fresh and fruity with ripe pear and lemon sherbet flavours balanced by a delicate and soft mineral finish. A true “Pinot Grigio” style – fresh, fruity and lively!. A perfect accompaniment for cheese, fresh salads and seafood. Suggested serving temperature of 7-10°C.

name: Norfolk Rise  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Brilliant pale straw with a green hue.
desc_en_short: Clean and crisp with freshly cut grass and passionfruit flavours. Beautifully balanced with a refreshing mineral acidity giving a lingering finish. Food suggestions with asian food, seafood, cheese and summer salads.

name: Regis de Valliere  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Displays very developed and sophisticated aromas of grapefruit, citrus ans white flowers. Crisp and powerful. Long finish of buttered toast. Definitely a vin de pays at its best, deserving an AOC ranking. This full-bodied white wine pairs well with grilled fish, as well as with medium-spicy Thai curries.

name: Chateau de la Roulerie  Les Terrasses
desc_en_short: A golden coloured wine with brillant hints has an aromatic complexity expressed by exotic fruits. Balance, power and concentration culminate in the long after- taste.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Amour de Dieu
wine_color: Golden yellow, characteristic of a great Condrieu
desc_en_short: Rich, powerful and aromatic on the palate with a long and elegant finish; intense, yet well balanced, with a fresh, pleasing acidity

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  La Violette Viognier
desc_en_short: A brilliant, light straw color with intense aromas of acacia, yellow peaches and exotic fruits. Very elegant and harmonious.Its freshness allows the fruit to fully develop. A seductive wine to be enjoyed with appetizers and hors d’oeuvres.

name: Chateau de la Roulerie  (500 ml)
desc_en_short: The bouquet gradually reveals its measure with at first ginger bread,honey, flowery and vegetal aromas. White fruits and citrus fruits (grapefruit) appear to settle and last. A slight hint of woody vanilla in the end.

name: Jean-Luc Colombo  Les Abeilles Blanc
desc_en_short: Light straw color with floral aromas and fruity bouquet. Complex wine, crisp and well balanced. A food-friendly wine which perfectly matches grilled lamb, pork and assorted cheeses.

name: A. Scherer  Pinot Blanc
desc_en_short: This Pinot Blanc, with its extremely flowery and aromatic nose, offers both elegance and intensity. Relatively supple in mouth, its lingers on a long finish and displays a well-balanced structure. Medium-dry, this wine can be appreciated equally alone (as aperitif) as with food.

name: Domaine de l'Engarran  Blanc
desc_en_short: Displays very developed and sophisticated aromas of grapefruit, citrus ans white flowers. Crisp and powerful. Long finish of buttered toast. Definitely a vin de pays at its best, deserving an AOC ranking. This full-bodied white wine pairs well with grilled fish, as well as with medium-spicy Thai curries.

name: A. Scherer  Riesling
desc_en_short: This vineyard located at the feet of the “Trois Chateaux” enchanting castle ruins produces some of the best Alsace wines since 1750. Alsacian Riesling, unlike its sweet German version, is dry and acidic, therefore going down very well with seafood. It displays harmony between its delicate fruitiness, its minerality and its fine acidity.

name: Chateau d'Arricaud
desc_en_short: The Graves region is synonym with top quality Bordeaux white wines.This vintage is fruity and firm with aromas of acacia tree and hint of citrus. Dry with nicely balanced acidity.

name: A. Scherer  Tokay Pinot Gris
desc_en_short: On the nose, flowery with orange blossom and white peach. On the palate, medium to full-bodied and delicate in texture with notes of citrus and pear. Powerful and round wine with complex flavors. This particular Pinot Gris is elegant and fresh with a persistent finish.

name: Cristo Di Campobello  Laluci DOC
desc_en_short: Aromas of yellow and white flowers, white peach, pear and green apple, mineral and citrus notes form a bright bouquet of this wine. The wine has a balanced taste with refreshing acidity and pleasant hints of ripe fruit. In the finish mineral notes. Wine is a wonderful aperitif. It is recommended to drink with seafood, fish dishes (especially fish, grilled), vegetables and poultry.

name: Cloudy Bay  Te Koko
desc_en_short:
Vineyard

The grapes for our Te Koko were sourced from six of our sauvignon blanc vineyards located within the Rapaura, Brancott and Renwick sub-regions.

The soils are predominantly free draining gravels requiring irrigation during the growing season. the season A warm spring emerged from an unusually wet winter, providing the perfect conditions for rapid spring growth. Warm conditions continued and flowering occurred a week earlier than average in late November. Rainfall in November and December allowed for a high level of fruit set and strong bunch growth through January.

These ideal conditions lead to heavy crops and therefore vineyards were ruthlessly thinned in late January to maximise fruit quality and advance ripening harvest Batches of fruit from our selected vineyards were picked according to their flavour profile and ranged from 21.8 to 23.3 Brix.

The harvest of sauvignon blanc destined for our Te Koko took just over a week, commencing on the 5th of April from the stonier, warmer blocks around the winery. vinification Our grapes were harvested in the cool of evening to preserve fruit flavour and loaded immediately into our presses. After settling the juice for a period of three days, the juice was racked directly to French oak barrel (around 8% new).

The wild fermentation was typically slow and took about 8 months to complete. Fresh acidity was tempered by partial malolactic fermentation.

A pH of 3.31, 6.7 g/L titratable acidity, 3.65 g/L residual sugar and an alcohol of 13.5%.

name: Cape Mentelle  Semillon Sauvignon
desc_en_short: Cape Mentelle takes a minimal approach towards this classic Margaret River blend. The aim is to preserve as much fruit intensity and regional character as possible, whilst providing a full flavoured distinctive white wine. The style accentuates the fresh fruit characters of both varieties with the added complexity and palate weight offered by a small portion of barrel fermentation.

name: Katnook  Founder's Block Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Brilliant straw yellow with vibrant aromas of melon and peach and subtle caramel and smokey oak tones. A fresh and lively palate with rich flavours of melon and peach and a hint of grapefuit. Barrel maturation has imparted a silky, slightly creamy mouthfeel and subtle oak underscore which extends through a lingering finish.

name: Geoff Merrill  Sauvignon Blanc Premium
desc_en_short: This wine is Fragrant aromatics reminiscent of grapefruit, bitter lemon, currant, guava, nettle and sweet herbs. Acidity is fresh and juicy but by no means tart, and helps to promote a signature dry, stony mineral finish.

name: Domaine Faiveley  Chablis
desc_en_short: A brilliant pale yellow colour. The elegant nose has fruity scents. The attack is frank and bold. This balanced wine has the same array of mineral and citrus-fruit aromas on the palate as on the nose. The finish has good length.

name: Domaine Faiveley  Pouilly Fuisse
desc_en_short: Pale yellow colour. The nose is fresh and elegant with varied white flower and citrus fruit aromas. This wine is very expressive and round on the palate giving a nice sensation of freshness. It has beautiful liveliness and very long-lasting aromas which make it a very pleasurable fine wine.

name: Azahara  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: A crisp, vibrant Pinot Grigio with Nashi pear, lemon zest and subtle ginger notes. Textural and creamy mouthfeel, balanced by bright acidity and a refreshing, clean finish. Perfect with seafood Tostadas, Vietnamese prawn curry and Middle Eastern dishes.

name: Haha  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Soft golden colour with light green hues
desc_en_short:
Haha Sauvignon Blanc has been described as intensely aromatic on the nose, with a powerfully expressed palate that is juicy and flavoursome, offering layers of gorgeous flavours.

Recommended by Cuisine Magazine, Dec 2017 as a Best Buy, it is looking very smart. It has moved into the stone fruit flavour spectrum,with ripe peach and Mirabelle plum flavours prominent, along with some suggestions of tropical fruit. Attractive ripe acidity plays a big role, the finish is long and balanced. Excellent value.

name: Altivo  Vineyard Selection Chardonnay
desc_en_short: On the nose, this cab is pure darkness. Intense blackberry and cassis, with mocha, caramel and a hint of rose petal. Dense on the palate with focused cassis and plum fruit, highlighted by mocha, toast and chestnut. Much darker and deeper than the Blueline merlot and cabernet franc. Tinges of black cherry soda and loam carry the hedonistic finish

name: Altivo  Vineyard Selection Torrontes
desc_en_short: Very pale, bright yellow. Pure lemon, spring flowers and mint on the nose. Supple and juicy, with a hint of sweetness counterpointed by fresh acidity. An easy going style of Torrontes. Ideal as an aperitif. Also with regional Argentina food: locro, empanadas salteñas and barbecue with sweetbreads, blood sausage and grilled vegetables. Serve at 6-8 ºC.

name: Altivo  Barrel Selection Chardonnay
desc_en_short: On the nose, this cab is pure darkness. Intense blackberry and cassis, with mocha, caramel and a hint of rose petal. Dense on the palate with focused cassis and plum fruit, highlighted by mocha, toast and chestnut. Much darker and deeper than the Blueline merlot and cabernet franc. Tinges of black cherry soda and loam carry the hedonistic finish

name: Carta Vieja  Limited Release Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Yellow pale with green notes, bright.
desc_en_short: Yellow pale with green notes, bright. Intense aroma to pineapple, grapefruit with slight herbaceous, anise and asparagus notes. Complex on the palate, with mandarin orange notes and some mineral-like supported in a vibrant and fresh acidity that carry to a pleasant nd refreshing finish.

name: Carta Vieja  Chardonnay
wine_color: Bright yellow color with fine green tints.
desc_en_short: Bright yellow color with fine green tints. Elegant and Fresh aroma of ripe tropical fruits. Pear apricot and passion fruit fragrances are emphasized and merge with soft notes of vanilla. Voluminous mouth, creamy and elegant texture with an excellent balance between sweetness and acidity.

name: Carta Vieja  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Bright yellow color with green reflections.
desc_en_short: Bright yellow color with green reflections. Fresh, clean and intense nose. White currant, fresh herb and lime aroma are highlighted, with asparagus and mineral notes. Big balance and texture and a long elegant finish.

name: Michel Rolland (Rolland Collection)  Chateau La Grande Clotte
desc_en_short: Full bodied, with a dense mouthfeel of dried pineapple and honey. Long finish.

name: Yvon Mau  Colombard Chardonnay
wine_color: A positively radiant pale yellow robe.
desc_en_short: This Colombard Chardonnay has a positively radiant pale yellow robe, with a rich, intense nose dominated by citrus aromas and a hint of orange flower. This elegant aromatic display continues in the mid-palate, with great freshness and impressive length of flavour. This is a classic, easy-drinking wine, perfect as an aperitif and just as good with fish or seafood dishes.

name: Danese  Chardonnay IGT
desc_en_short: Pale lemon in color, this wine has aromas of citrus fruits and fresh pears, which give way to subtle herbal and almond notes. On the palate, this youthful wine is pure and clean with crisp acidity and a lingering finish.This wine would be a great match for light salads and vegetable antipasti or pasta and fish dishes.

name: Danese  Pinot Bianco IGT
wine_color: Straw yellow with light gold highlights.
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with light gold highlights. White fruits, slight florals and herbs on the nose. Quite dry with fruit palate and slight bitterness.

name: Danese  Soave Classico DOC
wine_color: Brillian straw yellow with greenish highlights
desc_en_short: Fresh aromas of apple, pear and almond balance clean minerality and a hint of fresh herb. Crisp and refreshing on the palate, the flavors and aromas build toward a harmonious and lingering finish. Ideal as an aperitif, Soave Classico matches well with a wide array of dishes, from hors d'oeuvres and fresh fish to white meats and young cheeses.

name: Danese  Pinot Grigio IGT
wine_color: Bright yellow with lightly golden tones.
desc_en_short: The colour is bright yellow with lightly golden tones. The nose is intense with ripe yellow fruit notes of fresh apricot & peach. The palate is full in both body and flavour, delicately smooth, well-balanced and long-lasting. Ideal with hors d'oeuvre and all seafood and shellfish.

name: Freixenet  Mia Blanco (Macabeo/Parellada/Moscatel/Xarel-lo)
desc_en_short: Wine of yellow-green colour of bolder shade with dazing sweet floral aroma, mainly of muscari, flowering lilac and fruity tones of pulp of litchi, enriched by honey-spicy perception. Taste of this wine is attractive and fruit with sweet fruitiness of overripe tropical fruit, mainly pineapple, enriched by harmonious acids and gentle spiciness with general elegance and delicious honey-fruity aftertaste.

name: Bay Bridge  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The first taste was tartness, almost like a lemon.  It was very crisp and citrus-like, almost like a grapefruit.  Overall, a very mellow fruit flavor, while also being a bolder white wine.

name: Long Lake  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
“This light straw-colored wine has aromas of pear, melon, and vanilla. Flavors include citrus and butterscotch.
It is well-balanced and structured with a silky smooth finish.”

name: Dona Sol  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Doña Sol Chardonnay is a light straw-colored wine that contains refreshing fresh fruit with hints of melon and vanilla. On the palate, fresh fruit hints of pear and apples are evident as it ends with a short smooth crisp finish. This wine pairs well with seafood (light & heavy), shellfish, pork, cheese, and poultry.

name: Oak Vineyards  Chardonnay
style: Chardonnay, French Colombard, Proprietors Dry White
desc_en_short: This light straw-colored Oak Vineyards Chardonnay expresses smokey aromatics with nuances of apple and lemon zest that continue onto the palate where they flourish into citrus, orange blossom, and smoked oak flavors until meeting a crisp, medium finish.

name: Crane Lake  Gewurztraminer
desc_en_short: Pale straw to bright yellow hue. Aromas of white flowers, pineapple, peaches, lychee and jasmine with a hint of sweet bell pepper. Off dry with floral flavors of rose water and orange blossom along with golden pineapple, peach puree and mango.

name: Crane Lake  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Aromas of apple sauce, almond cookie, and honeycomb with a soft, dry-yet-fruity medium body and a tangy tropical citrus and delicate spice finish. Nicely nuanced with good acidity for the table.

name: Estrella  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A light golden wine with intense aromas highlighting tangy grapefruit with layers of fresh cut grass, and a light asparagus flavor characteristic of this variety. The full-bodied finish lingers on the palate revealing a refreshing hint of lemon zest. Pair this wine with herb-roasted chicken or linguine with clams to really showcase its appeal. This wine also pairs well with spicy Asian cuisine. Best served chilled.

name: Estrella  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: Estrella River Pinot Grigio is ripe with green apple and citrus flavors, with just a touch of honey. With its crisp smooth finish, this wine is perfect for any occasion. Best served chilled. Pinot Grigio pairs well with any type of fish, as well as pasta dishes with a light sauce.

name: Forest Ville  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine has intense aromas of vanilla, apple, pear and some hints of floral and citrus. A crisp clean wine that ends in a smooth and refreshing finish is perfect for any occasion.

name: Forest Ville  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Aromas of grapefruit, guava, and green pepper with a silky, fruity-yet-dry medium body and a round, juicy lime, green pear, and grass accented finish. Nice flavor, balance, and varietal character.

name: Grove Ridge  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Golden silver color. Aromas of apple pie with dulce de leche and coconut gelato with a silky, dry-yet-fruity medium body and a tangy, brown spice, vanilla and pineapple-lemon sorbet driven finish. A solid sipping chardonnay.

name: Coastal Ridge  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: It has a simple, unsophisticated bouquet fairly tight and lacks complexity.  It’s pretty much just citrus and oak on the nose. The palate brings apple,  melon and citrus flavors with decent acidity. The finish is citrus and melon.

name: Alexander Valley  Vineyards Chardonnay
desc_en_short: There are aromas of apple, pear, fresh fruit, pineapple, vanilla, slight butterscotch, toasted oak and a little minerality in the glass. The wine has good fruit and palate weight with a rich mouth-feel. There are tropical flavors of apple, pear, citrus, peach and apricot in the glass with nice balance and a very long aftertaste.

name: Calera  'Mt. Harlan' Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The mouthfeel is silky but with tension; quince and honeydew rind add structure and depth. This wine is bright, deep and rich yet restrained, and will age beautifully for many years to come.

name: Calera  'Central Coast' Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Beautiful ripe peach, star fruit and pink rose notes waft from this smooth and flavorful. Flavors of tropical fruits, honey crisp apple, nectarine, honeydew melon and hints of sweet oak accent the soft, velvety texture and continue through a delicious, lingering round, bright finish.

name: Gnarly Head  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Gnarly Head Chardonnay raises the bar for this classic varietal. This Chardonnay is a juicy, full-bodied wine that explodes with bright citrusy aromas of lemon zest, honeydew melon and just a hint of toasty oak. Big bold flavors of citrus and apple with a touch of vanilla ensure a perfect match with a range of cuisine, including chicken curry, grilled shrimp and spaghetti carbonara.

name: Grgich Hills  Fume Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale bright yellow. Aromas of lemon drop, grapefruit peel, white flowers and saline minerality, with a ripe pineapple quality emerging with air. Scented and fairly rich in the mouth, with an enticing sugar/acid balance to the concentrated tropical fruit, pineapple and lemon drop flavors. Finishes juicy and persistent, with a repeating note of pineapple. Plenty of flavor here.

name: Honig  Rutherford Sauvignon Blanc
style: Estate Sauvignon Blanc, Estate Semillon, Estate Muscat
desc_en_short: Summer fruit aromas and flavors (white peach, melon and lychee) are highlighted by lemon bar, vanilla and toasty oak. This rich, complex and refreshing Sauvignon Blanc on the palate with comforting ripe melon and accenting herbs will prove delightful with a wide variety of menus, ranging from simple pastas to the complex curries of south Asia.

name: Kongsgaard  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: From the Hudson and Hyde Vineyards is spectacular, with notes of creme fraiche, orange marmalade, honeyed citrus and crushed rock as well as white currants and flowers. Gorgeously full-bodied, with great freshness and acidity, this beauty will be released early next year.

name: Lewis  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Napa Valley Chardonnay. Creamy pear, lime and caramel apple fruit baskets in brioche, clove and sweet mineral spices. Loads of tree-ripened fruit form a dense, silky core rooted in natural acidity that gives the wine balance and sound structure.

name: McManis  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The McManis Family Vineyards Chardonnay is light golden straw in color. Bright fruit aromas of Pear, Melon and Peach are accompanied by a bouquet of Vanilla, Hazelnut, and a hint of buttered popcorn. The wine is rich, creamy and full of sweet Pear, Banana and toasted oak flavors.

name: Pahlmeyer  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Opens with aromas of bright citrus zest, fleshy crane melon and notes of graham cracker.  The unctuous mouth feel leads with an elegant restraint and swath of slate that crescendo with flavors of fresh cider apples, juicy lychee and warming cardamom. The intense and silky finish lingers with spicy, earthy notes of white lily and lightly toasted almond.

name: Pine Ridge  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Tropical fruit aromas of peach and nectarine are delicately woven with lemon zest, vanilla and toast on the nose. This medium to full-bodied Chardonnay is teeming with a vibrant array of citrus flavors, bright acidity and a creamy, silky texture that gives way to a subtle toasty component.

name: Shafer  Red Shoulder Ranch Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The 2016 offers alluring, energetic aromas and flavors of honeysuckle, kiwi, apricot, citrus zest, pineapple, and toasted almond – a dazzling, juicy bowl of exotic fruit held together with flinty structure, pleasing minerality, and refreshing acidity.

name: Spottswoode  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
94 points in Wine Advocate

The 2018 Sauvignon Blanc bursts from the glass with notes of lemon tart, key lime pie and orange blossoms with nuances of acacia honey, baking bread, fresh grapefruit and crushed stones. Medium-bodied, the palate has fantastically intense citrus and mineral notes, framed by great freshness and a silken texture, finishing very long and perfumed.

94 points in Wilfred Wong of Wine.com

The 2018 Spottswoode Sauvignon Blanc shows outstanding focus and clarity. TASTING NOTES: This wine shows lovely and persistent dried fruit and earth in its aromas and flavors. Enjoy this wine with Ahi tuna in a mix with arugula, perfectly-ripened heirloom tomatoes, and well-massaged kale.

93 points in James Suckling

A very aromatic white with notes of gooseberries and currant leaves. Fresh green apples. Crispy, but balanced with limes and lemons, as well as some crushed stones. Fresh and fruity on the finish. Lively. A benchmark. Drink now.

92 points in Wine Spectator

L2mon meringue, spice and grapefruit flavors reveal whiffs of lanolin and spice lingering in the background, as well candied ginger and floral details. Balances focus and intensity, with a light body and fresh, juicy acidity.

91 points in Wine Enthusiast

This wine opens in a nutty flourish of earthiness and floral apple blossom before exposing complex waves of Meyer lemon, green apple and fig. Intensely high toned, it is crisp and dry, with plenty of bite and texture.

name: Whitehall Lane  Sauvignon Blanc (Screw Cap)
desc_en_short: The Sauvignon Blanc is full of zest with loads of citrusy lemon, lime and grapefruit aromas and flavors. It is nicely balanced with some tropical notes of pineapple and kiwi. This is a refreshing wine with a clean finish.

name: Whitehall Lane  Carneros Chardonnay (Screw Cap)
desc_en_short: This wine has a brilliant golden color and enticing aromas of honey, poached pear and all spice. These aromas meld with flavors of baked apple and citrus notes that are beautifully framed by toasted oak and butterscotch. It is nicely balanced with ample weight and a lengthy clean finish.

name: Mysterious  Reserva Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: A light yellow color with greenish tones.
desc_en_short: Our Reserva Sauvignon Blanc has a yellow color with greenish tones. A complex nose dominated by pineapple and gooseberry. The mouth follows the nose with a superb mouth feeling and richness. The acidity provides the skeleton and gives the wine focus. The end of mouth extends with lime and minerals. It matches appetizers, fresh or cooked seafood, such as oysters, scalops, and salmon

name: Mysterious  Reserva Chardonnay
wine_color: A bright and golden yellow color.
desc_en_short: Our Reserva Chardonnay has a bright and golden yellow color. Intenses smell of banana, pineapple and hints of vanilla. Balanced and unctuous. It has a great persistence and a fresh harmony. Great with fish, seafood and creamy pasta dishes

name: Mysterious  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: A light yellow color with greenish tones.
desc_en_short: Our Sauvignon Blanc has a light yellow color with greenish tones. Its prominent aromas of lime, grapefruit and gooseberry fruit blend harmoniously with floral notes. In the mouth is crispy, refreshing and long. It matches appetizers, ceviche, seafood and green salads.

name: Mysterious  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Our Chardonnay has a bright yellow color. It is prominent aromas of banana, ripe peach and tropical fruit. In the mouth is balanced with predominance of fruits from the Tropics. It has a great persistence and a fresh harmony. It matches appetizers, green salads, seafood, poultry and young cheeses.

name: SilverStone  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: A yellow color with greenish tones.
desc_en_short:
It is an outstanding classic & elegant dry white wine with a fresh, slightly herbaceous character. It has earth and flintstone nose with
green apple and lush vanilla flavors; smooth with a long crisp finish. Superb when served with shellfish,seasoned poultry dishes, or by itself.

name: Bouchon  Superior Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A supple full-flavored Chardonnay. Straw gold color; bright citrus and pineapple aromas, rich texture and a long, creamy finish. Our winemakers selected grapes from the finest growing regions in California and personally supervise the vinification and careful aging of the wine until it is perfected and bottled.

name: Moute  Premium White Selection
style: Finest Fresh Fruits; Apples, Pears, And Toasted Meg-nut.
desc_en_short: A special blend of finest fresh fruits; apples, pears, and toasted meg-nut. It is smooth and soft, fruit-forward, fresh. on the palate and brims with fresh fruits character. lt is perfect to enjoy sipping by itself and also a great paring with fish dishes and other seafood.

name: Caldora  Trebbiano d'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: Deep, bright, straw yellow. Quite intense and persistent, fruity with notes of yellow fruit (medlar and peach) and white flowers (orange blossom). Full-bodied, well-balanced, intense and persistent. Best served with: Starters and light main courses, white meat and young cheeses. Fantastic with fish.

name: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite)  Reserve Speciale Bordeaux Blanc
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with green glints.
desc_en_short: Like the Réserve Spéciale Bordeaux Rouge, the Réserve Spéciale Bordeaux Blanc is made from a selection of wines from the best terroirs in Bordeaux. Tastings are carried out all over the Bordeaux region to find the most successful wines of the year with a view to creating blends in the tradition of the finest Bordeaux that favour balance over woodiness. The wines selected are mainly from the Entre-Deux-Mers.

name: J. Bouchon  Sauvignon Blanc Reserva
wine_color: It is clean and bright pale yellow, with some green notes.
desc_en_short: It is clean and bright pale yellow, with some green notes. It present a high intensity, with nice aromas of citric fruits like grapefruit mixed with some tropical fruits notes, which gives a pleasant freshness on the nose. It is very fresh and yong, with a good body and acidity. Its large ending invites to continue enjoying it. Enjoy with any kind of fish whether grilled, baked or row and seafood in all variations goes very well with this kind of wine, combining the fresh and mineral nose from the food and the wine in perfect harmony.

name: J. Bouchon  Chardonnay Reserva
desc_en_short: Pale bright yellow. It presents tropical aromas like ripe bananas and pineapples with some sweet notes of honey. It's very fruity in mouth and also has a very good body and acidity that gives a pleasant freshness to the wine. This chardonnay is an ideal partner for cooked fish and seafood with sauce, like salmon or scallops with sauce. Also pastas cooked with creamy sauces goes very well with this wine.

name: Grosset  Springvale Riesling
desc_en_short: Grosset Springvale Riesling from the Clare Valley sub-region of Watervale, takes its name from the Springvale Road vineyard located in the highest part of Watervale. Jeff Grosset's six hectare vineyard produces a wine full of ethereal aromatics, fragrant lemongrass and freshly squeezed lime. Pure lemon flavours over wet pebbles show on the palate that is accented by the wonderful minerality that is the signature of Grosset.

name: Grosset  Polish Hill Riesling
desc_en_short: Jeff Grosset's Rieslings are amongst the most sought after in Australia. The Polish Hill is superb with intense lingering citrus flavours lively natural acidity and a crisp dry finish. The remarkable think about Jeff's Rieslings are their phenomenal ability to age so very gracefully and will reward the very patient.

name: Torbreck  Semillon Woodcutter's
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with green hues.
desc_en_short:
Medium bodied with a pristine lemon hue this youthful Semillon offers delicate scents of calamansi, limestone, candle wax, and toasted brioche. The copper-pink skins of this robust, age-old ‘Madeira Clone’ flesh out the
palate, lending notes of almond kernels, soft pineapple, roasted cashew and white peach. Underlying notes of citrus oil and minerals maintain the wines freshness whilst a crisp spine of razor-like acidity neatly lace together the finish.

name: Fox Creek  Shadow's Run Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Light golden in color. Rich aromas of lemongrass, pineapple, lemon juice and nectarine. A well-balanced taste of wine felt notes of peach, apricot, pineapple and mango. The finish is soft.

name: Fermoy Estate  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with green tints.
desc_en_short: The palate displays punchy lime juice, passion fruit and blackcurrant leaf notes, with a subtle, savoury oak spice and textured mouth feel adding complexity and interest. A mouth-watering and refreshing lime acid line runs through the wine providing drive and length to the finish.

name: Montgras  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Pale straw yellow colour with green notes.
desc_en_short: Pale straw yellow colour with green notes. Citric notes with touches of passion fruit and subtle herbs. Tangy and crispy. Fresh, juicy green apple notes combined with citrus and mineral flavours, with a vibrant acidity that makes the wine linger on the finish. Ideal to enjoy as an appetizer, to accompany salads or fresh seafood.

name: Montgras  Reserva Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Deep straw yellow. Pineapple and peach notes combined with hints of honey in a subtle cedar and toasty framework. White peaches combined with intense notes of pineapple and pear, within a solid acidity structure that doesn’t damage the texture and creaminess of this Chardonnay. Ideal to partner with simple dishes, of creamy texture such as green fettucini with creamy salmon sauce or a seafood stew.

name: Echeverria  Sauvignon Blanc Late Harvest (375 ml)
style: Sauvignon Blanc Estate Single Vineyard Grapes, From Ungrafted Selected Clones Of Pre-phylloxera French Rootstock.
desc_en_short: Golden yellow. Complex nose with clear overtones of mature peaches, apricots and honey, with a delicate background of botrytis. Marked notes of quince jam and creamy honeyed flavors are enlivened by a good level of acidity. Rich, intense and full bodied, with a long and elegant finish where fruits and botrytis express their identity in full harmony.

name: Louis Michel  Chablis
desc_en_short: This wine should be aired or carafed before tasting. It will reveal notes of white fruit such as peach, with a mineral structure. In the mouth, a stony sensation complements this pure, rounded wine. Serve between 12 and 14˚c.

name: Louis Michel  Chablis Premier Cru Montee Tonnerre
desc_en_short: This wine presents a perfect balance between fresh minerality and very ripe fruit. The mouth is warm, delicious and salty, with a spicy cinnamon finish. Serve between 12 and 14˚c and air or carafe the wine before tasting.

name: Louis Michel  Chablis Premier Cru Montmain
desc_en_short: A blend of confit blackberry and fresh sea breeze notes: spicy floral, toasted almond, confit lemon and apple. Energetic and chalky in the mouth, this wine is pure and true. Serve between 12 and 14˚c and air or carafe the wine before tasting.

name: Maison Verget  Bourgogne Grand Elevage
desc_en_short: The Wine Advocate Verget's Grand Élevage label provides a home for declassified parcels from Guffens-Verget's best vineyard plots. The lion's share of the 2017 Bourgogne hails from Guffens' Pierreclos vineyards on clay soils. The balance comes from the neighbouring village, Bussières, from vines on a gentle, southeast-facing slope where the shallow soil is clay and limestone and very stony. The wine was vinified in barrel with 10% new oak; the fermentations ended in early December, and the wine's maturation continued for seven months with bâtonnage. It's a bright and chiselled, fresh white Burgundy that balances fleshy ripe stone fruit and zippy acidity with gentle minerality and a soft, mouth-filling texture.

name: Maison Verget  St.Veran Terroirs Davaye
desc_en_short: A pure chardonnay with delicious notes of orchard fruit (peach, pear) balanced by tangy hints of candied lemon and grapefruit. This Saint-Véran will go perfectly with your white meat dishes as well as your cheese.

name: Maison Verget  Chablis Terres De Pierres
desc_en_short: Mâcon Villages Terres de Pierres has a clean but light bouquet that feels just a little anonymous compared to its peers. But with aeration it develops some attractive tertiary notes. The palate is clean and fresh, nicely balanced with well-judged acidity, leading to a harmonious and taut, refreshing finish.

name: Maison Verget  Chablis Fourchaume 1er Cru
desc_en_short: An appealingly layered green fruit nose that displays solid if not truly special amounts of Chablis character precedes good richness and mid-palate concentration that retains a good sense of focus and underlying tension on the relatively powerful and citrusy finish.

name: Maison Verget  Chablis Cote de Leghet 1er Cru
desc_en_short: This 1er Cru is regular for its richness and minerality in recent vintages. The favorable exposure allows him to reach maturity each year. In 2009, to keep the minerality, we have selected free run juice which are the most Acid and give great wines. In 2009, the Côte de Léchet, has a extremely fruity nose (yellow fruit) and a straight and fresh mouth.

name: Maison Verget  Chablis Bougros Cote de Bouqueyreaud Grand Cru
desc_en_short: For this wine, the best grapes of the plot “Grand Cru Bougros” have been selected. This wine has the “Bougros” wines density features with an extra minerality and precision thanks to the drastic selection in the vineyard and press.

name: Maison Verget  Chablis Cuvee De La Butte
desc_en_short: This wine is produced from a parcel situated in the village of Chablis close to the Premier Cru vineyard of "Les Butteaux". It has a south-eastern exposure with a calcareous soil and a very abrupt slope. The yields are low. A Chablis showing excellent typicity. Opulent on the palate yet refreshing with mineral and tropical fruit notes. Quite seductive.

name: Maison Verget  Puligny-Montrachet Sous le Puits
desc_en_short: From the highest altitude premier cru in Puligny, this has a classic nose of lemon oil, preserved citrus, white flowers and chal.

name: Maison Verget  Chablis Vaillons 1er Cru
desc_en_short: This wine from the central part of the appellation Vaillons has a flexible attack which grows with nice amplitude and an accurate final. Due to the rather high altitude of this plot, the grapes have kept a good acidity that gives to the wine this precision that we seek in our wines.

name: Domaine Alain Chabanon  Trelans
desc_en_short: Delicate candied fruit aromas with an original, lively style, this wine is intensely fresh.

name: Tasca D'Almerita  Leone
style: Catarratto (52%), Pinot Bianco (19%), Sauvignon (15%) And Traminer Aromatico (14%).
desc_en_short: A blend of four varieties of white grapes grown in the high hills, at an altitude up to 900 metres above sea level. A wine that is amazing for its aromatic intensity, acidity, freshness, and that over the years has come to represent a “type” all its own.

name: Te Mata  Estate Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Estate Vineyards Chardonnay has the aromas of white meadow flowers, French vanilla and floral, juicy Hawke’s Bay peaches. Bright light gold, the palate unfurls with a balance of rock melon, sweet lemon, candied lime and complexing notes of biscuit, stone fruit and grilled nuts. A pure chardonnay with lovely length and a crisp clean finish.

name: Te Mata  Estate Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Intense tropical, passion fruit aromas, bright and aromatic, underlined by a hint of balsamic oak. The wine is all-around shrill and bright and fragrant, with passion fruit and spice galore.

name: Main Divide by Pegasus Bay  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: On release the wine light lemon/straw colour. The aromas and flavours suggest citrus fruits, apricot, yellow fleshed peach and mango with complexing savoury overtones of oatmeal, toast, grilled mushrooms and vanilla pod. It is powerful and creamy on the palate but an underlying spine of natural minerality and acidity keep it tight and focused and help draw out the lingering after flavours.

name: Main Divide by Pegasus Bay  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: The aromas and flavours suggest citrus fruits, greengage, gooseberry and passionfruit with a hint of Turkish musk and freshly crushed thyme. It has a harmonious texture, being soft and generous but yet it finishes with zesty minerality and refreshing crispness. While ready to drink on release it can be expected to develop a range of other fascinating nuances with careful cellaring over 3 – 5 years and live well beyond.

name: Felton Road  Chardonnay Elms
desc_en_short: A vibrant nose of citrus blossom and white peach with hints of stone and earth. The palate begins with texture and lithe intensity; fresh, but with a serious undercurrent of minerality, then moves into growing complexity, combining tension and stones with a rewarding richness. There is significant length to this wine, reflecting the extended elevage on lees.

name: Felton Road  Chardonnay Bannockburn
desc_en_short: White peach, elderflower and wet stones abound on the nose. The delicate subtlety and remarkable harmony of the wine is instantly appealing with no one feature urging for attention. The integration of fruit and complexing winemaking characters like freshly baked bread and mineral provides intrigue and great persistence. A delicious celebration of our Chardonnay vineyards in a glass.

name: Felton Road  Riesling Bannockburn
desc_en_short: Aromas of lychee and bright tropical fruit abound on the nose supported with ginger and cardamom. The palate leads with a mouth coating sweetness that’s immediately tempered by luxurious fruit and a vibrant acidity. A classically balanced wine of sweet fruit journeying to a well-proportioned mouth-watering freshness. The crisp and zesty finish offers a surprisingly drying sensation.

name: Ata Rangi  Chardonnay Craighall
desc_en_short: Sourced from old Mendoza clone vines, this flagship Chardonnay from Ata Rangi shows plenty of savoury complexity and layered fruits on the nose and palate. There's peach nougat and a nutty thread here, some sweet melon fruit and a lithe, juicy and pleasantly grippy, tangy finish.

name: Ata Rangi  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Medium-bodied, with plenty of crisp lemon meringue, lime and green apple flavors and an appealing fleshy texture. Mineral and peach details gain momentum, presenting a long, spice- and floral-spiked finish.

name: Dry River  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Dry River Chardonnay has ripe apple and apricot aromas with nuances of toast, cashews, orange blossom and a whiff of honey comb. Very crisp on the medium bodied palate, there’s plenty of taut fruit and some silkiness to the texture with a long minerally finish.

name: Dry River  Gewurztraminer
desc_en_short: Candied fruit aromas of pineapple, mango and tangerine all speak of concentration and purity. The palate continues building from entry to finish – supple and sappy but refined, pure and long to the end.

name: Dry River  Riesling
desc_en_short: Aromatically there is a mêlée of fruit aromas that include stone fruit, Granny Smith apple and citrus. A citrusy crispness defines the palate with firm acidity. Richness in the form of midpalate weight is all from fruit extract rather than sugar.

name: Martinborough  Vineyard Riesling Manu
desc_en_short: Medium/ dry in style with a ginger spice character coming from a very mild botrytis influence. Aromas of orange and grapefruit accompany the ginger on the nose, whilst the palate shows layers of suppleness, generosity and concentration. This style of wine is crafted to be enjoyed young but will cellar well for up to five years.

name: Fromm Winery  Chardonnay La strada
desc_en_short: A powerful yet elegant Chardonnay from the heavy clay slopes of Marlborough’s Brancott Valley. Ripe Meyer Lemons and grapefruit in the first instance followed by cleansing flintstone minerality and a brioche and almond savouriness. The palate is full and fiercely focussed, showing deep citrus fruit, mouth-watering phenolics and tasty acidity. Power, elegance and complexity all combining for a seductive moreish wine. A Chardonnay that is full of tension yet possessing a seamless flow.

name: Umani Ronchi  Maximo Marche Bianco DOC (375 ml)
wine_color: A magnificent golden colour streaked with amber tints.
desc_en_short: A magnificent golden colour streaked with amber tints. On the nose it expresses distinct scents of honey, apricot and peach, followed by aromas of ripe fig, candied fruit and citrus. Rich in the mouth, where the elegant acidity fluidifies the sweetness, soft and balanced with clean, refreshing persistence, and notes of candied fruit and honey continually running through it.

name: Miguel Torres  Hemisferio Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A fresh, floral wine with fruity body and a silken palate of great finnesse. Displays intriguing notes of exotic fruits (passion fruit, grapefruit). Its silky palate is exquisitely intense, with a good acidic structure and a prolonged, joyous finish.

name: Miguel Torres  Tormenta Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A wine of intense aromatic intensity, characterised by tropical notes (passion fruit and mango) with citric and mineral hints. On the palate the wine has a fresh and full-bodied mouth-feel giving way to more flavours of passion fruit, lime, gooseberry and grapefruit. The finish is very long and satisfying.

name: Louis Max  Chablis St Jean AOC
wine_color: Fine white gold with green tints, combining limpidity and brilliance.
desc_en_short: It possesses a certain vivacity and is evolving towards hints of lemon. This is a wine with a lot of freshness. Food Pairing with fish with sauce, Oysters, seafood, Charcuterie, Goat's cheese.

name: Louis Max  Pouilly Fuisse Vieilles Vignes AOC
wine_color: An attractive golden yellow hue, with green tinges.
desc_en_short: Good first impression in the mouth, a well-balanced wine with fatness and plenty of freshness. It will go very well with shellfish, frogs, quenelles, white meat, grilled fish and goat's cheese.

name: Louis Max  Meursault l'or Blanc AOC
wine_color: Beautiful gold yellow robe, with green reflections.
desc_en_short: Rich and lively in the mouth, it has a good balance between unctuousness and freshness. Well-structured, this is a wine made to mature for several years. Goes well with veal or delicate poultry dishes, grilled seafood and fishes. Can also be paired with foie-gras and cheeses

name: Louis Max  Puligny Montrachet AOC
wine_color: Gold yellow in colour, clear and brilliant.
desc_en_short: Gold yellow in colour, clear and brilliant. In the nose, beautiful aromas of white flowers, fern, exotic fruits and marzipan. Subtle acidity in the mouth, this is a very well -balanced wine, with an intense and long finish. Pairs well with white meats in sauce, grilled fish and seafood platters.

name: Louis Max  Chassagne Montrachet 1er CRU Morgeot Blanc AOC
wine_color: Very fine white-gold hue, both limpid and brilliant.
desc_en_short: Very fine white-gold hue, both limpid and brilliant. On the nose, white fruit and white flower aromas are present, together with almonds and vanilla. The palate is composed of aromas of very ripe fruit, white flowers associated with touches of almonds and vanilla. This type of wine should be reserved for gastronomy of exceptional refinement: foie gras, starters and fish in cream sauce, rich charcuterie, and with certain white meat dishes in sauce.

name: Cornerstone  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Fresh, appealing aroma of apricots and minerals Crunchy white fruits with a subtle honey backbone on the palate A fresh and clean finish

name: Cornerstone  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Intense aroma with hints of peach and banana, also floral and citric notes Refreshing and exotic on the palate with an elegant finish

name: Mt Monster   Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Bright straw colour, with lime green hue. Aromas of melon, peach and citrus fruit. Similar flavours on the palate with a crisp finish.

name: Jip Jip Rocks  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale light straw with clear hue. A perfumed nose of grapefruit and citrus peel with hints of fresh cut grass. The palate is clean and zesty, with abundant tropical and citrus fruit flavours.

name: Milton Park  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The wine has a pale yellow colour. The wine has dominant peach aromas with a hint of pineapple juice on the nose. The palate has intense peach and pineapple characters. The mid palate is soft and creamy.

name: Kookaburra  Laughing White Chardonnay (Fruit wine blend)
wine_color: Medium bodied, dry, quite pleasant delivering fresh yellow
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Kookaburra’s head Laughing white Subtle nose of plums. Medium bodied, dry, quite pleasant delivering fresh yellow, a bit plummy fruit with a floral note. Great with seafood in Hua Hin.

name: Mar Y Sol  Chilean White (4 L)
