desc_en_short: Wonderful aromas of citrus and tropical fruits. On the palate the fruitiness is balanced by mild acidity and minerality just what one should expect from a fine and well-assembled fruity white grapes.

name: Mcguigan  Private Bin Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Apricot and rich stone fruit flavours with some white peach and a touch of honey. Round wine brimming with tropical fruit and melon flavours, balanced with a touch of caramel oak. The finish is clean and crisp with a delicate lingering presence

name: Tempus Two  Varietal Chardonay
desc_en_short: Stone fruits of white peach and nectarine with a touch of quince. Subtle and integrated French oak and barrel-ferment characters are also apparent. Concentrated primary fruit characters of white peach and nectarine, with subtle French oak and barrel ferment characters

name: Vina Maipo  Bi-Varietal Sauvignon Blanc & Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Pale-yellow colored wine with greenish tinge, the characteristic aroma of peach, apple and citrus scent. Easy-sweet taste wine.

name: Vina Maipo  Vitral Reserva Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: 87 points in Wine Spectator. It is bright yellow in colour and has a fresh and highly expressive aroma with gooseberry and citric notes. It is an elegant, rounded and well-bodied wine with a fresh and sharp balance.

name: Concha Y Toro  Gran Reserva Serie Riberas Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Powerful citrus and melon aromas dominate the nose, but it also reveals some floral and peach too.  The palate brings a luxuriously-creamy mouthfeel and rich lemon, melon, apple, peach and mineral flavors.  The mineral really comes out on the finish.

name: Chateau Vendome  Prestige Blanc (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

An elegant and minerally Sauvignon Blanc. Pure grassy aromas with notes of quince and peach. Ideal with Salads, Chicken, Sushi

name: Famille Castel  Juracon
desc_en_short: My prime concern was to find a good balance of sweetness and acidity. This is a perfect wine for anyone on our export markets who likes a sweet wine with an edge of crispness to it.

name: Mazzacorana  Chardonnay Trentino DOC
desc_en_short: A dry wine, harmonious and fruity, characterized by a pleasant lasting taste. Excellent as an aperetif, ideal served with starters, first courses of vegetable and fish dishes.

name: Mazzacorana  Pinot Grigio Trentino DOC
desc_en_short: A delicately complex wine with an intense fragrance , it is dry with a pleasant slightly bitter after taste. Ideal to serve with cold meats, tasty first courses, red and white roast meats.

name: Winzer Krems  Gruner Veltliner
desc_en_short: Green yellow, fine, spicy, fruity and classic Loess-soilVeltliner with characteristic peppery finish

name: Winzer Krems  Kllermeister Private  Gruner Veltliner
desc_en_short: Brilliant chartreuse, classical fruity bouquet, strong, rich nuanced taste with lively acidity, impressions of fine, peppery Veltliner flavor on the palate; a complex, very typical Grüner Veltliner of a loess soil. Very good to bright meat (chicken, calf, rabbit) or baked carp, as well as to bright inwards (sweetbread!) and cold fish starters; also goes well with Austrian classical dishes such as Viennese Schnitzel and roast pork.

name: Hay Maker  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale straw, lifted aromas of blackcurrant bud, guava and grapefruit. A lively palate with fresh flavours of nettles and tropical fruit with a flinty elegance.

name: Mudhouse  Reisling
desc_en_short: This wine shows lovely purity on the palate. The citrus and floral notes mix with fresh green apple. The slightly sweet approach gives way to a lovely crisp, bright fresh nose of elderflower, fresh citrus with a background of nectarine.

name: Mudhouse  Pinot Gris
desc_en_short: Delicate aromas of quince, honeysuckle and freshly cut pear. The front palate is luscious with flavours of nectarine and spicy pear. The smooth palate finishes with a hint of mouthwatering minerality.

name: Castello Banfi  Centine Bianco
wine_color: It has a light straw yellow color.
desc_en_short:
Very fruity, with the typical varietal notes of Pinot Grigio, well combined with those of Sauvignon Blanc and Chardonnay. Notes of pear, apricot, lime and tomato leaves. The palate is dry, with good acidity well balanced by a large softness.Ideal for accompanying the entire meal and in particular matches
perfectly first courses and fresh fish dishes.

name: Gallo Family Vineyards  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Fresh citrus ﬂavors of lemon, lime and grapefruit layered with fresh green apple that are as refreshing as they are distinctive. Paring with Salads or fresh vegetables, grilled seafood, or chicken risotto

name: Trappolini  Raggio di Sole Bianco Lazio IGT
wine_color: Pale yellow with hints of gold.
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with hints of gold. Fine and intense on the nose with mineral scents, peach and white flower flavors. Well balanced and with a good acidity. Light appetizers, sea food and white meats.

name: Fattoria Mantellassi  Lucumone Vermentino DOC
desc_en_short: Citrus freshness, green apple, well balanced acidity and mineral all combined with a robust structure. Vermentino is excellent with seafood pasta, calamari, and simply prepared white fish.

name: Bodegas Valduero  Garcia Viadero
wine_color: Pale straw colour, due to the absence of oxidation.
desc_en_short: Pale straw colour, due to the absence of oxidation. Fruit aromas with notes of pineapple and grapefruit, typical of Albillo. Well balanced, with a light acidic touch. Serve well chilled. An ideal accompaniment to fish, grilled vegetables and mediterranean salads.

name: Sutter Home  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Crisp and fresh, our Chardonnay wine boasts an impressive lineup of flavors, leaving a lasting palate impression. Smooth, rich, and creamy tones combine with fresh fruit flavors for a long and luxurious aftertaste. It makes an ideal match for seafood or poultry, veal or pork chops, cream sauce pastas, and cheeses.

name: Sutter Home  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Lively and inviting, this is a great all-purpose wine. Fresh honeydew melon, grapefruit, and passion fruit aromas beg you to continue sipping, because there's more. Yes, a bit of spice to end it all, and your choice is affirmed. Very food friendly, this wine pairs beautifully with shellfish, herb-roasted chicken, Caesar salad, mild cheeses, and vegetarian fare. A Sauvignon Blanc wine like no other.

name: Antica Napa valley  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The elegance of the Antica Napa Valley Chardonnay is obvious in its crisp, orange blossom, fresh pear, mineral-laced, medium bodied style. This wine has superb aromatic presence with impressive purity of fruit. This is a lovely, delicately oaked, flavorful Chardonnay.

name: Southern Land  Mclaren Vale Moscato
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with green hues. The aroma of tropical fruits with boiled candy notes. The palate displays a fresh burst of tropical fruit flavours. Nice a crisp acid a luscious sweet fruits finish.

name: Southern Land  Mclaren Vale Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with green hues. The aroma of white peach, apple and lime zest with a subtle oak notes. The palate display fresh flavors of nashi pear and apple are balanced by a hint of creaminess, flowing through the mid-palate and lingering on the finely textured finish.

name: Harvest Mile  Fresh White (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

These leading Australian winemakers have produced a drink with a blend of fresh clean citrus and a passion fruit/kiwi flavour with a zesty finish.

name: Sol De Chile  Sauvignon Blanc (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Chile’s multiple award winning De Aguirre family winery employs its traditional skill in presenting this refreshingly light, food friendly white wine. Grapes selected from choice sauvignon blanc vineyards oer hints of pineapple and passion fruit avors with balanced acidity.

name: Laughing Sun  Emotion White (Fruit wine blend)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

A fruit wine blended with Australian Chardonnay and passion fruit. Aromatic on the nose, the palate displays distinct notes of tropical fruit, with a soft, rounded finish.

name: One Glass  Pinot Grigio IGT (100 ml)
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 24 Bottles.

Oneglass is the creation of Advertime a Verona based Italian communications agency. It is a labour of love for those who want to drink a single serving of wine without compromising on quality whilst staying ahead of the crowd. Oneglass is safe, The polylaminate packaging is safe and ensures the characteristics of the wine.

name: Torres  SL Verdeo Rueda DO
wine_color: Beautiful pale yellow color, flecked with green tints.
desc_en_short: Beautiful pale yellow color, flecked with green tints. Characterized by distinct notes of tropical fruit accompanied by citrus and a touch of fennel. Its intense nose adds to its freshness and elegance, with a lingering finish in the mouth, once again noting the green fruit so typical of the Verdejo variety. Ideal as an aperitif, it also goes perfectly with shellfish and fresh fish in exotic sauces.

name: Vesevo  Falanghina IGT
desc_en_short: Perfumes of white flowers and white melon with mineral notes provide a backdrop to the full, ripe palate and lift the finish. An elegant wine, with a touch of honey on the finish. Low temperature fermentation has retained the fresh, crisp and aromatic quality of the wine but still allows its character to shine through. Serve with fish, white meats and poultry.

name: Taha  by Tahuna Hawke's Bay Blanc (Sauvignon Blanc)
desc_en_short: The Taha by Tahuna Hawkes Bay Blanc is a fresh and fragrant wine with intense ripe tropical, passionfruit and gooseberry aromas that follow onto the palate. A great aperitif or seafood wine made for drinking young. Recommended serving temperature 6-8°C.

name: Innovate  Chardonnay
wine_color: This Chardonnay is a pastel straw-like gold with hues of green.
desc_en_short: This Chardonnay is a pastel straw-like gold with hues of green. The wine displays an exquisite aroma of fresh fruit flavours including peach, lemon and citrus. A light spice is carried to the palate, with a velvety feel from peach and citrus flavours for a lingering finish.

name: Nickel & Nickel  Truchard Carneros Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The 2013 Nickel & Nickel Truchard Vineyard Chardonnay offers aromas of tropical fruits, vanilla accented by minerality expressive of this vineyard. Pineapple, peach and fig notes offer a mouthful of flavor and blend exquisitely with the spice and toast from the French oak. The naturally creamy texture and balanced acidity of this wine add weight and richness to the midpalate, carrying the fruit through to a long, lingering finish.

name: Sycamore Lane  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Sycamore Lane Chardonnay displays fresh apple, pear and peach aromas enriched by toasty, buttery tones imparted by partial malolactic fermentation and wood aging. The wine’s smooth, round texture and creamy apple, citrus and peach flavors are balanced by crisp acidity, making this Chardonnay an ideal match for any seafood or poultry dish, as well as veal or pork chops, cream sauce pastas and both mild and hearty cheeses.

name: Domaine Georg Rafael  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The wine is a light straw color. It exhibits wonderful aromas and flavors of apple, pear, honey, almonds, melon and green olive with a medium-bodied creamy texture. Mineral notes, pineapple, mango and lemon make for a memorable finish. Easily age worthy for 6-8 years. Pairs well with poached or grilled seafood, shrimp or crab with spicy aioli, baby greens tossed in citrus honey vinaigrette, avocados, fruit salsa, shaved fennel, tangerines and triple cream cheeses.

name: Forest Ville  Riesling
desc_en_short: Sweet floral aromas with flavors of honey, melon and apricot. A sweet and balanced wine that is enjoyable and refreshing.

name: Red Bank  Pinot Grigio "The Long Paddock"
wine_color: Pale straw in colour with tints of green.
desc_en_short:
Pale straw in colour with tints of green. Lifted aromas of fresh Corella pears and Pink Lady apples with hints of rose petal and musk. Flavours of ripe pear and fresh peaches provide generous fruit flesh in the mid palate which is nicely balanced by a refreshing pink grapefruit acidity on the finish. This Pinot Grigio has more fruit
generosity than you expect yet still finishes crisp and fresh in the expected Grigio style. Best drinking now to maintain its fresh appeal. Suitable for vegans and vegetarians.

name: Viu Manent  Estate Collection Reserva Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Greenish-yellow in color with intense citrus and tropical aromas such as passion fruit, white fruits, and white pear. Fresh, fruity, and refreshing on the palate with a long finish.

name: Viu Manent  Rayuela Gran Reserva Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Greenish-yellow in color. The nose shows an intense and complex combination of aromas of white and exotic fruits, floral notes, hazelnut, and toffee. The creamy palate is well balanced, fresh, and fruity, with subtle toasted notes that lend complexity that draws out to an intense, elegant, and persistent finish..

name: Viu Manent  Secreto Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Greenish-yellow in color. Its intense aromas recall citrus notes of mandarin orange and grapefruit, as well as white fruits, asparagus, and tomato leaf. The fresh palate is deep and saline due to the vineyard’s proximity to the cold Pacific Ocean. Ideal with fresh shellfish, cold soups such as gazpacho, ceviche, or sashimi.

name: Auka  Chardonnay
wine_color: Brilliant, clear, straw yellow colour with green reflexions.
desc_en_short: Brilliant, clear, straw yellow colour with green reflexions. Fruity flavours like Melons, Pears and Pineapple with a touch of Honey on the Nose. The mouth feel is elegant and soft with fresh fruits on the palate and well balanced acidity.

name: Silverado Vineyards  Miller Ranch Sauvignon Blanc "Napa Valley"
desc_en_short: Attractive aroma of ripe grapefruit and honeydew melon, with spice and floral notes. Medium body, medium acidity with juicy fruit flavors.

name: Silverado Vineyards  Carneros Chardonnay "Napa Valley"
desc_en_short: Aromas of poached pear and baked apples. Medium body, sweet fruit flavor notes, silky texture and mineral backbone from entry through the finish.

name: Angove  Butterfly Ridge Colombard Chardonnay
wine_color: A pale straw yellow with appealing green hues.
desc_en_short: A pale straw yellow with appealing green hues. Lifted tropical and citrus aromas precede a medium to full palate with lemony citrus, passionfruit and peach flavours.

name: Angove  Butterfly Ridge Riesling Gewurztraminer
wine_color: Pale straw in colour with green hues.
desc_en_short: Pale straw in colour with green hues. Distinctive floral characters from the Riesling are lifted by the aromatically precocious Gewurtztraminer. The palate delivers lime, citrus, rose petal and spice with a clean, medium approachable finish. This wine is accompaniment to many spicy foods, fish dishes and on a warm summers afternoon with friends.

name: Angove  Studio Series Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Pale yellow with attractive green hues.
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with attractive green hues. Ripe tropical characters leap from the glass with some lime and lemon aromas following. Clean crisp flavours of tropical fruits abound with some light gooseberry/herbaceous notes and a clean finish.

name: Zonin  "Ventiterre" Chardonnay
wine_color: Pale straw-yellow with greenish refl ections.
desc_en_short:
A pleasant light aperitif, it matches well with appetizers, especially if fish-based or vol-auvents. Excellent also with delicately flavoured pasta or rice dishes.

The bouquet is intense yet refined, with fresh hints of peach and pineapple. The flavour is attractively fresh and elegant and enchantingly harmonious.

name: Domaine Naturaliste  Discovery Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A verve expression of our cool climate Chardonnay from the south of Margaret River. Chardonnay is harvested at moderate ripeness to retain freshness and natural balance. Fermentation in seasoned French oak adds complexity and generosity of texture without compromising the  purity of the aromatics. The embodiment of spring. Perfume, texture, delicacy. Approachable and rewarding.

name: Valle Reale  Trebbiano d'Abruzzo DOC
desc_en_short: Concentrated and elegant. Combines bright fruit with delicate aromas of white flowers and flint. Pair this wine with grilled vegetables and rustic pasta courses like Spaghetti alla Carbonara as well as roasted poultry, sharp cheeses, and cured meats.

name: Ottosoldi  Gavi DOCG
wine_color: The wine is light straw color with light greenish reflections.
desc_en_short: This is a dense, intense Gavi with dried-lemon and grapefruit aromas and flavors. Minerals, too. Full-bodied and very rich. Lots of bitter lemon on the finish.

name: Trimbach  Riesling Cuvee Frederic Emile
desc_en_short: Aromas of stainless and sliced apple with hints of melons, lemons and spices. Full-bodied, very tight and lean with a gorgeous salinity. Almost a white pepper character. A triumph. A beauty. So dry and intense. Amazing. Drink or hold.

name: Finca Flichman  Aberdeen Angus Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A characteristic flavor of the Chardonnay grape with elements of pineapple and banana. The structure is soft with a slight touch of wood in the aftertaste. Pairing with pasta, salads, pies, white meat.

name: Ca' Momi  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine strikes the perfect balance between indulgence and refreshment. Delicate mandarin orange zest aromas open into plush pineapple and pears. The palate is pure pleasure—decadent citrus cream poured over fresh pear crostata with a subtle hint of clove. Restrained oak gives a warm vanilla glow and softness, while the finely tuned acidity lifts and balances the richness all the way through the leisurely finish. Pair with creamy sauces, buttery pasta, or fresh scallops.

name: Wairau River  Pinot Gris
desc_en_short: Light straw with a complex nose of baked pear and quince. Rich, floral and fleshy with mouthfilling stone-fruit, pear and spice flavors. The pure age of these vines give the wine texture and palate weight.

name: Chateau La Gravelle  Bordeaux Blanc
desc_en_short: The taste of wine is very fresh,lively soft, full fruity flavor,well balanced,witha lingering fresh finish. White Bordeaux blaend is a term Wine-Searcher uses to gather together wines blended from the three classic white-wine grapes of Bordeaux: Semillon, Sauvignon Blanc and Muscadelle. In this blend, Sauvignon brings its trademark grassy aromas, while Semillon adds a touch of complexity and a wax, honeyed not. Muscadelle, the lesser-known of three varieties, contributes grapey aromas.

name: Chanson Pere & Fils  Pouilly Fuisse
desc_en_short: Pale yellow colour. Very fresh floral fragrances mixed with aromas of green apple. Deep and well structured. Very pure fruit. Delicate minerality and tense acidity. Long and refreshing finish. Pairing with fish, cooked pork meat, white meat and some goat cheeses.

name: Cape Mentelle  Georgiana Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Georgiana is a fresh, vibrant expression of Margaret River Sauvignon Blanc. Every effort is utilised in the vineyard and the winery to promote the clean aromatics and punchy citrus characters of this variety. Georgiana is distinctively textural on the palate, with bright and refreshing acidity providing balance to create the perfect summer white.

name: Kendall Jackson  Avant Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This refreshing Chardonnay erupts with captivating layers of pineapple, bright green apple and fresh Meyer lemon, juicy pear and wildflowers. It shows refreshing acidity and sleek mineral notes which are balanced by a rounded mid-palate and a long, pure fruit finish.

name: Kendall Jackson  Vintner's Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Luscious honeysuckle, ripe pear and fresh lemongrass intertwined in this medium-bodied Sauvignon Blanc. Hints of fresh tropical grapefruit complement the subtle mineral quality while added layers of fig and honeysuckle round out this crisp, aromatic wine.

name: Xanadu  DJL Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The wine offers a fine boned quartz-like structure complimented by a lovely creamy/marshmallow texture derived from lees stirring. Taut, yet opulent, the intense fruit and bright acidity combine to focus the wine perfectly to a crisp, lingering fruit finish.

name: San Valley  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Bright, clean and clear yellow in colour.
desc_en_short: This Sauvignon Blanc always winner its the perfect reflect of our compromise with the quality, bright, clean and clear yellow in colour. Fine, intense floral aromas stand out on the nose, mingled with citrus notes of grapefruit and subtle touches of green apple. Floral and fruit notes remerge on the palate, accompanied by a balanced acidity and unique freshness that makes it a pleasing all-occasion wine.

name: Barton&Guestier  Reserve Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Straw gold yellow. Fine and elegant nose mixing white fruit aromas (pear, quince) with vanilla notes. Fruit driven on the palate, the attack is fresh, followed by a round and supple texture. Flattering oaky notes appear on the aftertaste.

name: Apothic  White
desc_en_short: The wines of Apothic are truly unique in style and taste.  Apothic White blends Chardonnay, Riesling and Pinot Grigio for a medium-bodied wine with vibrant layers of flavor.  Riesling lends Apothic White its floral notes and firm acidity.  Chardonnay adds texture and body, while Pinot Grigio contributes refreshing flavors of peach and apricot leading to a crisp, balanced finish.

name: Gallo Family Vineyards  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: Gallo Family Vineyards' Pinot Grigio brings together refreshing crispness with bright flavors - fresh green apple, white peach and citrus. Paring with fresh fruit salad, grilled sea bass or mildly spiced Asian recipes.

name: Domaine Albert Mann  Riesling Grand Cru Schlossberg L'Epicentre
desc_en_short: Vivid gold-tinged yellow. The aromatic nose combines mango, peach, white flowers, lime and crushed stone. The wine is rich, spicy and broad in the mouth, but with nicely focused mineral and tropical fruit flavors. Drinking it is much like sucking on wet stones. It's especially impressive on the palate, where it lasts and lasts with beautifully harmonious acidity. A wine of outstanding acid/sugar balance, not unlike some great Mosel late-harvest Rieslings. In fact, the "Epicentre" moniker refers to a wine made with a blend of late-harvest grapes (A mix of both SGN and VT level) and normally harvested grapes for maximum refinement and balance.

name: Domaine Albert Mann  Gewurtraminer
desc_en_short: Bright yellow. Very pure nose of smoky bacon fat, balsamic herbs, ginger and mango. Powerful but ripe and fine - grained, this large - scaled Gewurz stays light and lively thnaks to zippy acidity. Finishes long, round and off - dry, with a strong pineapple fruitiness. a knockout entry - level  Gewurztraminer made from mainly young vines.

name: Domaine Albert Mann  Riesling
desc_en_short: Riesling Tradition Albert Mann, classic, fruity, clean, Organic riesling. This Riesling from the Albert Mann estate is a Natural 'vin de fruit' from Alsace. It has an attractive musky nose and a tranquil palate with ripe pear and apple offset by cleansing notes of mandarin, citrus and lime. Very easy lip smacking Organic Riesling from Alsace, one of those bottles which make you think, 'I must drink more Riesling' and for the price is very good naturally made Alsace wine. Seafood, salads, aperitif, excellent stuff.

name: Domaine Albert Mann  Pinot Gris Grand Cru Hengst
desc_en_short: Medium golden yellow. Pineapple, apple, mango and custard on the nose. Sweet and fruit - driven, but with lively acidity contributing a refined mouthfeel to the tropical fruit and custard flavors. Strikes me as fresher and deeper than the other Pinot Gris bottlings offered by Mann in this vintage. The three parcels used to make this wine grow on the side of the Hengst closest to Wettolshiem, which is higher up and very gravelly, partly explaining this wine's elegant personality.

name: Domaine Albert Mann  Gewurtraminer Grand Cru Furstentum
desc_en_short: Yellow - green color. Precise aromas of caramelized tropical fruits, minerals, spring flowers and while pepper. At once pliant and firm, showing terrific inner - mouth energy to its perfumed floral and exotic fruit flavors. Nicely integrated acidity gives this wine a steely spine and a lovely sugar/acid balance. Finishes firm, delicate and long. This is made from roughly 45 - year - old vines.

name: Domaine Albert Mann  Riesling Grand Cru Schlossberg
desc_en_short: Beautiful bottle with a great aromatic complexity, dominance of fruits, citrus fruits underline by a fine minerality. Wine of gastronomy. Good potential for ageing.

name: Altera  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Golden colour. In the nose, the wine is powerful both floral and fruity with notes of fresh bread and spices. In the mouth, it is ample and unctuous.

name: La Croix Barton  Bordeaux Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale yellow in color, bright and clear, very aromatic, with a hint of green plants, fruit, melon and minerality. The taste is fresh, crisp and direct. Serve at a temperature of 6-8 degrees. Ideally suited as an aperitif, dishes with fish dishes, seafood or white meat dishes.

name: Chateau Latour-Martillac  2012
desc_en_short: Lively fruit with wonderful energy and fresh acidity. Palate offers nectarines and pomelo fruits along with lemongrass. A balanced, elegant white with lifted and focused flavours.

name: Domaine Daniel Etienne Dafaix  Vieilles Vigne Chablis
desc_en_short:
"The richness almost insolent of this Chablis makes an ideal wine for aperitif, an excellent companion of the fish pâtés, oysters, plates of seafood. This Chablis can flirt with a roasted andouillette or snails of Burgundy with Chablis and butter persillade. 
This cuvée is sourced from vines the age of which is between 45 and 70 years. A wine of exceptional concentration for a village level appellation, this wine is always a true expression of the kimmeridgian soils that make Chablis so distinctive. Aged for thirty months before release, Defaix’s old vines Chablis is richly dense with a classic “pierre a fusil” bouquet and long mineral-infused finish."

name: Domaine Daniel Etienne Dafaix  Vaillon Premier Cru Chablis
desc_en_short:
The fruity and spicy from the terroir comes but slowly ! roundy powerful in mouth as a buttered brioche, with Mirabelle accents and jammed apple. Perfect pairing with
beautiful fish.

name: Domaine Daniel Etienne Dafaix  Cote De Lachet Premier Cru Chablis
desc_en_short: This wine starts to reveal its poor soil and its traditional mineral notes. The fatness gives a buttered end with surmatured fruits. Perfect pairing with Bresse chicken or veal with cream and morels.

name: Domaine Daniel Etienne Dafaix  Les Lys Premier Cru Chablis
desc_en_short: Deep yellow. Open nose of candied lemon, fresh mushroom over a mineral background. Wonderful silky entry framed by fat. Tenser mid-palate and finish imparting freshness. Long and harmonious across the palate. Ready to drink now.

name: Domaine Daniel Etienne Dafaix  Les Grenouilles Grand Cru Chablis
desc_en_short: A jewel of Chablis ! We exploit this rare climate since 2002. Good exposition, this vine planted in 1960 produces a wine of great rarity and exceptional sensuality. Only five owners exploit this smallest grand cru surface in Chablis. This Chablis Grand Cru is fat, round and lovely, a great delicacy. It is splendid with caviar osci?tre. I am lucky to vinify the wine of this very old vine (1960) and benefit from its qualities due to his age which, in a quarry of winemaker gives rejoicing over the total.

name: Domaine Guiberteau  Saumur Blanc
desc_en_short: A very pure fruit character aromatically here, the nose very primary still, with Chenin notes of perfumed pear and apple. The palate shows a beautiful core of acidity, with a great minerally tension to it as well, wrapped up in a supple texture, running into a very energy-charged finish. This is great stuff, in what is clearly a super vintage.

name: Domaine Guiberteau  Les Moulins Saumur Blanc
desc_en_short: Superb quality through and through with a fantastic combination of Chablis-like acidity and minerality layered over the richer chenin blanc fruit. The richer elements of the fruit really bring this to life and lift this way beyond the standard Saumur of the same vintage, with floral notes and apple with a touch of wax. No fat or flab on this - excellent.

name: Domaine Guiberteau  Clos De Guichaux Saumur Blanc
desc_en_short: A very pure, white-stone character on the nose, framed beautifully by some fresh, matchsticky reduction. This is immediately very convincing. The palate is super, lightly mineral, rich in pear and white peach fruit, a marker of the vintage, though it is superbly reductive also. It builds into a great, grippy finish, with a really mineral frame here, very long and taut, but textured too. This is nothing short of stunning.

name: Domaine Huet  Le Haut Lieu Sec
desc_en_short: Vouvray Le Haut-Lieu Sec, which is still a baby on the nose, showing concentrated, almost tropical fruit flavors (pineapples, lemons) on the clear and fresh nose. Round and fruity on the palate, this medium to full-bodied, very elegant and persistent wine shows ripe and concentrated fruit, a delicately yeasty texture with a very fine grip, and is followed by a long, intense finish packed with minerals and stimulating dashes of lemon juice and limestone minerals. There is an excellent purity of fruit and a structure giving minerality here.

name: Domaine Huet  Le Haut Lieu Moelleux 2018
wine_color: Yellow color with light brown accents
desc_en_short: 93 points in Wine Spectator - "Round and harmonious, with a suave texture and notes of ripe Bosc pear, white peach and elderflower. Shows hints of brioche and glaze, while the acidity cuts through, giving this balance and vibrancy. Drink now through 2033."

name: Domaine Huet  Le Mont Moelleux 1ere Trie 2016
wine_color: Yellow color with light brown accents
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

For many insiders, the argument over Vouvray’s greatest vineyard comes down to two sites: Le Mont and Clos du Bourg. With less clay and more stone than Le Haut-Lieu, Le Mont yields young wines of intense minerality. With age, the wines develop great length and finesse.

name: Domaine Huet  Le Mont Moelleux
wine_color: The color is golden yellow, the wine is dense.
desc_en_short: The color is golden yellow, the wine is dense. The nose reveals sweet fragrances of exotic fruits, such as mango and pineapple. The attack is pure and nervous despite a high wealth. Gourmet, we find in the mouth notes of exotic fruits, including mango dancing with bitter almond. Gradually, power emerges in the mouth, we find the alliance of the trio - terroir, grape variety and vintage.

name: Domaine Marcoux  Chateauneuf De Pape Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale chartreuse. Lively citrus fruit, floral and herb scents carry a zesty mineral overtone. Dry and incisive on the palate, offering fresh lime, green apple and tangerine flavors that put on weight with air. Shows very good clarity on the finish, which lingers with strong, stony intensity.

name: Clos Des Fees  Vieilles Vignes Blanc
desc_en_short: Aging on lees for 5 to 8 months. Fining and filtering prior to bottling in the spring. This rich and powerful wine has an amazing impression of sweetness, even though it is dry. Delicious right when it is bottled, it shuts down for at least 2 years and starts to open up after 3 to 6 years after the harvest.

name: Radio Boca  Verdejo
desc_en_short: Tune yourself into the latest broadcast of a 100% Spanish wine. This delicious Verdejo is a mouth full of big juicy fruit. Juicy green apple, sweet juicy peach and an exciting hint of citrus peel will have you talking non stop.

name: Kuen Hof Peter Pliger  Eisacktaler Veltliner Doc
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: The flavours are exotic fruits, white pepper and smoked. In the mouth the wine is fruity-agile, delicate-soft but dynamic.

name: Kuen Hof Peter Pliger  Eisacktaler Sylvaner Doc
desc_en_short: Flavours are pure of medical herbs and white peach. The structure is fine, elegant and agile.

name: Kuen Hof Peter Pliger  Eisacktaler Gewurztraminer Doc
desc_en_short: This Veltliber has a golden-green color and very typical aromas of wild flowers, green apple, medicinal herbs and slightly smoky accents that intensify with age. The mouthfeel is taut, with an excellent impact and a robust acidity which holds up the bold structure. The finish is elegant, warm and persistent.

name: Schiopetto  Friulano Collio Doc
desc_en_short: A very mineral white with slate and sliced-green-pear character. Full to medium body with good acidity and a light apple-pur?e aftertaste. Finesse here.

name: Schiopetto  Sauvignon Collio Doc
desc_en_short: The sliced-apple and mineral character with lime and flint character. Some almond, too. Full body with bright acidity and a long, flavorful finish. As sauvignon should be from Collio.

name: Schiopetto  Pinot Grigio Collio Doc
desc_en_short: A flinty, mineral white with pear and green apple skin. Full body with bright acidity and a clean finish. This is a pinot grigio with wonderful subtlety and finesse.

name: Schiopetto  Mario Schiopetto Igt
wine_color: Pale yellow tones with golden reflexes
desc_en_short: Pale yellow tones with golden reflexes. Elegant and delicate nose at first glance with ripe fruit flavors then followed instead by sweet notes of almond and custard. Elegant on the palate, yet warm and full-bodied, all is balanced by notes of fruit, pear and quince over all, with fresh and intense final. Good minerality.

name: Meroi  Pinot Grigio Doc
desc_en_short: The wine shows a complex, well-balanced, harmonious taste with hints of white flowers and fruit, refreshing acidity and a long finish, with nuances of rubble. The wine is bright, fresh flavor, composed of fruity, notes of lemon, orange peel, mint nuances and sea breeze.

name: Meroi  Sauvignon Doc
desc_en_short: The wine has a bright straw-yellow color. The wine shows a complex, well-balanced, harmonious taste with hints of white flowers and fruit, refreshing acidity and a long finish, with nuances of rubble. It is bright, fresh flavor, composed of fruity, notes of lemon, orange peel, mint nuances and sea breeze.

name: Meroi  Chardonnay Doc
desc_en_short: The wine is straw-yellow color with golden reflections. Very expressive, juicy wine with moderate acidity, the palate is dominated by notes of tropical fruits on a background of subtle mineral tones. The finish is long, persistent. Intense and expressive aroma of wine is filled with notes of exotic fruits, banana, pineapple, ripe apples, complemented by nuances of white flowers.

name: Marchesi Di Gresy  Langhe Chardonnay Doc
desc_en_short: Bright straw yellow, intense aromas with sweet notes, reminiscent of apple, bananas and citrus fruit. Mouthfilling, harmonious, flavoursome, persistent, with a lingering aftertaste which reminds us of the sensations found in the bouquet.

name: Marchesi Di Gresy  Langhe Sauvignon Doc
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with greenish reflections. Fine and extremely intense aromas, reminiscent of vegetables, spring peas, finely cut grass and tomato leaves but also fruity with grapefruit and peach over all with full, harmonious, flavoursome and persistent.

name: San Leonardo  Vette Di San Leonardo Igt
desc_en_short: Straw-yellow color with greenish highlights. This wine has an aromatic fragrance with typical hints of white peach, green peppercorn over a pleasing note of sage. The palate is dry, enjoyably acidulous, full-bodied, with great mineral complexity and polish.

name: Bibi Graetz  Bugia Toscana Bianco Igt
wine_color: Pale yellow color with golden highlights
desc_en_short: From Ansonica produced from vines over 80 years of age grown on the island of Giglio, the lie is a lovely pale yellow color with golden highlights timid. The nose smells coming of yellow flowers, honey, herbs and mineral notes. In the mouth it is tasty, fruity, fresh and balanced.

name: Pieropan  Soave Classico Doc
wine_color: Brilliant straw yellow color with greenish hints
desc_en_short: Brilliant straw yellow color with greenish hints. Perfume. The delicate nose is reminiscent of almond blossoms and marzipan. Good depth of fruit on the palate, nicely balance by a zingy acidity that enhances its long length.

name: Pieropan  Soave Classico La Rocca Doc
wine_color: Brilliant and intense yellow with garden hints
desc_en_short: Brilliant and intense yellow with garden hints. Characterful wine, reminiscent of exotic fruits and nuts on the nose. Soft and persistent on the palate with hints of spice.

name: Bolla  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: One sip will express why this varietal has become so popular within the last few years.  From its beautiful pale straw color to its amazing crisp and lively taste of lemons, limes, peaches and melons, this light, dry wine is infinitely satisfying.  Pair our Pinot Grigio with seafood, white meat, sauced pastas and grilled vegetables. It also makes an ideal aperitif.

name: Blue Nun  Rivaner
desc_en_short: Cultivated in the Rhine region, the fully ripe, golden grapes are harvested, then de-stemmed and gently pressed. With a mineral taste and refreshing acidity with its playful finesse of a slight residual sweetness.

name: Pio Cesare  L'Altro Langhe Chardonnay DOC
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with greenish tints
desc_en_short:
L’Altro is a vibrant and contemporary Chardonnay, showcasing white peach, pear, and floral notes alongside hints of vanilla and minerality from Langhe’s calcareous soils.

With a balanced structure and clean acidity, this wine pairs beautifully with seafood, poultry, or simply enjoyed as a refined aperitivo. It’s a Chardonnay for both casual sipping and elevated food pairings.

name: Beringer  Main & Vine Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Full of lush fruit flavors and aromas, The bright citrus perfectly offsets the honeyed apricot, culminating in a smooth, delicious wine with a lasting finish.

name: Les heritiers du Comtes Lafon  Macon-Uchizy “les Maranches”
desc_en_short: The Mâcon-Uchizy hails from a high altitude site, exposed full south, and there are some Chardonnay musqué clones in the vineyards here which contribute an exotic top-note of lychee to a bouquet of white peach and tangerine. On the palate the wine is juicy, nicely concentrated and focussed, with gentle minerality.

name: Les heritiers du Comtes Lafon  Macon-Bussieres "Le Monsard"
desc_en_short: Le Monsard is an early-ripening terroir located below one of the distinctive cap-rocks which define the geology of the Mâconnais, and it has produced a beautiful bottling in 2015. Apple, pear, confit citrus and almond cream lead into an ample palate with great minerality and cut, which keeps things precise through the finish.

name: Les heritiers du Comtes Lafon  Macon-Milly-Lamartine “Clos du Four”
desc_en_short: Bright lemon-yellow. Ripe peach and brown spice aromas. gives cut and shape to the wine's silky, thick texture. Tactile, concentrated, structured wine with a very long, chewy, reverberating finish.

name: Les heritiers du Comtes Lafon  Vire-Clesse
desc_en_short: This reveals a complex bouquet of poached pear, citrus zest, juicy apple and white flowers, leading into a glossy palate underpinned by lovely minerality and acidity. Delicious stuff.

name: Domaine Michel Lafarge  Bourgogne Aligote "Raisins Dores"
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: The wine is bottled as Bourgogne Aligoté; only in Bouzeron, in the Chalonnaise, does it get its own appellation. We expect aligoté to be immensely crisp with acidity — which is why it’s essential in a Kir, combined with cassis — even sometimes fairly arid with acidity’s drying quality, but this example leavens the intense vibrancy and nervosity with a lovely supple, moderately dense texture and tasty flavors of lemon curd and roasted lemon, subtly wedded to cloves, dried rosemary and limestone. A beguiling jasmine and honeysuckle aspect gets matters off to a good start.

name: Domaine Philippe Colin  Chassagne-Montrachet 1er "les Vergers
desc_en_short: One of Chassagne-Montrachet’s most elegant and luxurious wines, this complex bottling strikes a brilliant balance between the mineral character of Les Chaumées (derived from the higher chalk content in the soils) and the powerful, spicy character of Les Chenevottes (derived from higher clay content). Ripe fruit and slight flint aromatics deceive, as they guide to a palate that is broader, deeply expressive and full bodied with pure fruit and chalk, rounding out with a long mineral-tinged finish that has a hint of smoke and spice.

name: Domaine Philippe Colin  Chevalier-Montrachet Grand Cru
desc_en_short:
The Domaine Philippe COLIN was born in 2004. It now exploits 11.5 ha of vines around the village of Chassagne Montrachet. The white wines and the red wines are declined in 28 different appellations, some of which represent very small vintages, allowing you to discover all the diversity and richness of the terroirs. Soil work and reasoned phytosanitary control are the main priorities. The wines are aged in oak barrels for 12 to 15 months and are bottled after light filtration.

Philippe Colin has set himself up in modern premises in the industrial zone of Chassagne Montrachet with his share of the Colin-Deleger vineyards, which he has supplemented by some negociant cuvees. The label reflects a new generation approach to his attractive wines. The Philippe Colin style is for elegance and subtlety rather than weight and power.

name: Domaine Philippe Colin  Saint-Aubin 1er Cru "le Charmois"
desc_en_short: Demonstrative of its terroir, this wine displays richly with refined Asian pear, wet stone and slight oak flavors, creating a powerful yet ethereal impression after its lengthy and dry finish.

name: Albert Bichot  Pouilly-Fuisse "le Clos"
desc_en_short: This Pouilly-Fuissé "Le Clos" has smoky notes followed by very fine aromas of white flowers and linden blossom. The palate is round and supple with fantastic balance between roundness and vivacity. This expressive, rich, full-flavoured wine has a long, refreshing finish. This wine is a beautiful match for fish, seafood and white meats in sauce, or full-flavoured cheeses.

name: Albert Bichot  Domaine Long-Depaquit  Chablis 1er Cru "les Vaucopins"
desc_en_short: This wine features an expressive, rather powerful nose that is predominantly mineral. Milk caramel notes combine with elegant, refined nuances of oak. A hint of sucrosity on the palate with flavours of candied fruit, apricot, and quince. This beautiful, full-bodied wine finishes on a generous, slightly acidic note.

name: Albert Bichot  Puligny-Montrachet
desc_en_short: Very subtle nose featuring notes of flowers (hawthorn), dried fruit and nuts (almond, apricot), which open up to scents of candied fruit. Round and structured on the palate, this wine boasts remarkable harmony. The finish is long and refreshing.

name: Bret Brothers  Macon-Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The elder citizens of Chardonnay, located not far from Tournus, will tell you that their village provided the name for thefamous Burgundian varietal. All that is certain is that the word “Chardonnay” comes from the Latin “Cardus” which means“thistle,” the spikey plants that grow particularly well on limestone soils. Chardonnay is a village with excellent limestone. Amagnificent wine, with an explosive bouquet, indulgent, guided by the natural energy of the terroir.

name: Bret Brothers  Macon-Villages  Cuvee "Terroirs du Maconnais"
desc_en_short:
It is extremely difficult for a négociant to only source organic grapes.

The Brets’ domaine, La Soufrandière, has been certified biodynamic since its early days. For the wines made from purchased grapes, not only have the brothers been unimpeachably transparent as to what was organic/biodynamic or not, but, like the menu in a farm to table restaurant, they have always, and without solicitation, named the farmer.

Their honesty and extremely high standards have led the brothers to make most of their negociant wines from verifiably organic fruit for quite a few years (the proportion was 80% organic in 2017.)

And we are very proud to announce that as of the 2018 vintage, all the fruit for every Bret Brothers wine is now either certified organic or in the process of certification.

name: Bret Brothers  Pouilly-Fuisse Climat  "les Crays"
desc_en_short:
It is extremely difficult for a négociant to only source organic grapes.

The Brets’ domaine, La Soufrandière, has been certified biodynamic since its early days. For the wines made from purchased grapes, not only have the brothers been unimpeachably transparent as to what was organic/biodynamic or not, but, like the menu in a farm to table restaurant, they have always, and without solicitation, named the farmer.

Their honesty and extremely high standards have led the brothers to make most of their negociant wines from verifiably organic fruit for quite a few years (the proportion was 80% organic in 2018.)

And we are very proud to announce that as of the 2019 vintage, all the fruit for every Bret Brothers wine is now either certified organic or in the process of certification.

name: Clos Floridene Grand Vin de Graves - Blanc
desc_en_short: Clos Floridene Blanc has the particularities of white wines produced on great calcareous soils:green-gold color, intense aroma with fruity notes of white peach, lemon, grapefruit, toasted and grilled nuances. Powerful and fresh flavors of fruit at its best, with the density and structure of a great white wine. Aging potential of at least 10 years.

name: Chateau Cantegril - Sauternes (500 ml)
desc_en_short: This sweet wine offers good concentration of sweetness with floral and honeysuckle flavours. Not complex but there is freshness and purity of delicate flavours to enjoy young.

name: Sieur d'Arques  L'Oracle - Blanc
desc_en_short: L'Oracle Blanc is a blend of Chardonnay and Viognier which will delight you with its fruity nose of white peaches, apricots and citrus. The mouthfeel is rich and supple. This wine will sublime your appetite on summer time along with fresh meals like seafood salad or wild sea bass on a bed of fennel.

name: Les Vinobles Gayrel S.A.S  Mauzac Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine is Beautiful yellow Color, an aromatic nose dominated by the Sauvignon in retro-olfaction. On the palate, roundness, fat and liveliness and white flesh fruit. A final clean and fresh.

name: Domaine Mur-Mur-Ium Roussanne
wine_color: Fine deep yellow color with green hints
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: Fine deep yellow color with green hints. Powerful nose with white flowers aromas of acacia  and some complex aromas with gentle notes of fennel, melon, honey, peach and spiciness.Fat and very rich taste with a  mouth full of  white flowers notes as well aswith  honey and vanilia toasted  touches very  well integrated and balance with the fruits  to create some powerful and  perfectly balance harmony lasting flavors.The after-taste is also very long and with complexity and lasting flavors very much in consistency with the one enjoyed in the nose and the mouth.

name: Domaine Mur-Mur-Ium Viognier
desc_en_short: This Viognier bottle reveals both a high level of maturity of the grapes with flavors and taste of exotic fruits, white peach and abricot flavors; as well as, to keep some  freshness , liveliness  and some little mineral character.  This is the combination of maturity and freshness by harvesting one vineyard earlier  with less maturity to favor the minerality and the other one 2 weeks later to favor the complexity, the more mature exotic and ethyol aromas.

name: Domaine Giraud  Chateauneuf du Pape - Les Gallimardes - Blanc
desc_en_short: Chateauneuf du Pape les Gallimardes Blanc offers classic notes of pear, white peach, citrus rind and salty minerality on the nose. Medium-bodied, fresh and crisp, yet still with solid texture, it is high class stuff and will have at least 2-4 years of prime drinking.

name: Domaine Josmeyer  Alsace Dream
desc_en_short: The nose is intense with hints of stone fruit and minerality. On the palate, this wine is  round, creamy and reveals a character of Riesling along with the long-lasting acidity. Overall, this wine structure seems to be fleshy but dry.

name: Domaine Josmeyer  Mise Du Printemps Pinot Blanc
desc_en_short: "A certain faint spiciness hovers over everything, recalling honeysuckle. The textured palate is fresh and equally pepper-spiced. This has freshness and verve, a certain ease and tons of lemony crispness. If you wanted to hold a party to welcome summer, this would be the perfect wine."

name: Van Volxem  Saar Riesling
desc_en_short: Saar Riesling with its almost tropical flavors. Full-bodied, very juicy and elegant on the palate this is fruit intense and very elegant wine with a persistent taste of slate and ripe peaches. An impressive entry-level quality.

name: Axel Pauly  Generations Riesling
desc_en_short: Refreshing floral nose with apples and apricots. On the palate enjoyable play between sweetness and acidity with a touch of mineral. Pleasant finish.

name: Pierre Luneau-Papin  "La Grange" Vieilles Vignes
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Beautiful mineral nose with lemon and grapefruit. On the palate, very light and refreshing with delicious fruit and lively acid. Light body with smooth texture. Good long mineral finish that cleanse the palate.

name: Marc Kreydenweiss  Wiebelsberg Grand Cru Riesling
desc_en_short: This wine is fine and elegant, with a good minerality and dryness. Well balanced, the palate is round and rich. Also we appreciate its freshness. The pink sandstone soil brings a lot of delicacy and make the grapes ripe and full of sun. It’s one of our favorite gastronomical wines, to reserve for fish and sea food dishes. The fine salinity makes it even better to enjoy with food. It’s a wine for ageing, to keep for 20 years in the cellar. Dry wine.

name: Denavolo  Dinavolino
style: Malvasia Di Candia Aromatica, Ortrugo, Marsanne
desc_en_short: A very good and serious entry level orange wine from Denavolo made from an odd combination of Malvasia, Ortuga and Marsanne with time on skins varying from 4-7 months depending on vintage. Intensely aromatic nose of ripe fruit. Elegant and refreshing palate of rose petal, Turkish Delight, and herbs. The tannins bring elegance to the aromatic nature of the grape and ends with a honeyed finish.

name: Sato  Central Otago Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Very bright vivrant golden colour. Nose of pure ripe fruits such as citrus, stone fruits and apple together with nuts, almond and brioche, and some floral notes kicks in. Clean but complex. Saline taste followed by splashing, pristine citrus fruits. Great fruity tastes together with hint of roasted almond. Refreshing cleanness and crispness of lively acidity leads the long finish, ending with brine like salty minerality. This is a full body chardonnay but the nice integration of all the flavour elements gives the wines even liner direction. A nice food wine.

name: St.Paul's  Pinot Bianco Plotzner DOC
desc_en_short: 92 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Elegantly understated but enticing, this has aromas of white stone fruit, crushed herb and a whiff of Alpine wildflower. The savory palate boasts great finesse, delivering ripe pear, apple and creamy white peach set against crisp acidity. A mineral note suggesting tangy oyster shell marks the close." - KERIN O’KEEFE

name: Auka  Chardonnay Reserva
wine_color: Brilliant, clear, straw yellow colour with green reflexions.
desc_en_short: Brilliant, clear, straw yellow colour with green reflexions. Fruity flavours like Melons, Pears and Pineapple with a touch of Honey on the Nose. The mouth feel is elegant and soft with fresh fruits on the palate and well balanced acidity, with a long lasting finish.

name: Cornerstone  Classic French White
desc_en_short: Nose citrus, grapefruit, hint of peach and pineapple with the Gros Manseng. Good acid support, balanced residual sugar 4g. Good roundness in the finish provided by the Gros Manseng.

name: Delas  Cotes Du Rhone Saint Esprit Blanc
wine_color: A golden straw hue with green tinges.
desc_en_short: The colour has a golden straw hue with green tinges. The main aromas are reminiscent of white flowers and yellow fruit, enhanced by touches of exotic and citrus fruit. On the palate, the wine is alert, seductively suave and fresh.

name: Heitz Cellar  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Elegantly assertive aromas of honeysuckle, white peach and lemon zest hint at the clean, refreshing nature of the palate. With just a touch of sweetness from French oak barrels, a well-balanced acidity and a slight creaminess, this Chardonnay is stunning. Enjoy the long, lingering finish

name: Astrolabe  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Pale straw color with green highlights.
desc_en_short: Pale straw color with green highlights. Powerful gooseberry, white currant, red capsicum, passionfruit and lime peel aromas. Medium-bodied, with strong flavors of makrut lime, passionfruit, lemongrass and a refreshingly smooth, dry and persistent finish.

name: Villa Maria  Cellar Selection Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Bright, very pale straw-yellow colour with green hues.
desc_en_short: A pure expression of Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc, bursting with aromas of passionfruit, melon, bell peppers and fresh herbs. The palate is powerful and juicy, displaying vibrant grapefruit notes with fantastic mid-palate weight, and lively integrated acidity. Serving with fresh pan fried fish or sautéed scallops with grilled seasonal vegetables.

name: Villa Maria  Private Bin Gewurztraminer
desc_en_short: This wine shows delicate and classic varietal aromas of rose petal, quince and ginger spice. The palate reveals similar flavours, delivered with a seamless texture and balance. This wine complements many food dishes including Asian and Indian cuisine.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Granite
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: The Gneiss, showing clear and ripegolden pears and citrus flavors on the nose with aromatic herbs and adelicate iodine minerality. In contrast, the clear palate is marked by apronounced acidity and a persistent salty and animating taste followedby ripe and succulent fruit flavors of honeydew melon. This is animpressive, quite complex Muscadet with a great aging potential.

name: Van Volxem  Rotschiefer Riesling Kabinett
desc_en_short: Charming like a summer breeze. This off-dry Riesling kabinett comes from vines grown on steep red slate slopes. It offers the intense aroma, ripe tropical fruit and pungent minerality, typical for this iron-rich red stony soil. The perfect balance between sweetness, acidity and minerality gives the wine its animated mouth-feel that seems to dance vibrantly on your palate.

name: Mas des Chimères  Muscat Petits Grains
wine_color: Light straw in color with bright yellow highlights.
desc_en_short: Very beautiful nose of yellow fruits and flowers. On the palate, very light and elegant with refreshing acid. Ripe and delicious fruits with a pleasant nutty finish.

name: Silverlake  S Series Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
*Made from Australian Grapes and handcrafted in Thailand.

Simply as it is. A refreshing unwooded Chardonnay of abundant character. Pale straw in color, the bouquet shows citrus fruit ending with a precise balance.

name: Dr. Burklin Wolf  Riesling Trocken Deutscher Qualitatswein
desc_en_short: Fresh, elegant nose with apple and lime with light floral notes. Juicy acid, fine minerality, slim, lively and uncomplicated.

name: Dr. Burklin Wolf  Wachenheimer Riesling Trocken Deutscher Qualitatswein
desc_en_short: Fresh scent of apples and peach combined with a floral note. In the mouth aromas of mango and peach combined with a clear minerality for an expressive yet elegant fruit body.

name: Henschke  Julius Riesling, Eden Valley
desc_en_short: Pale straw with green hues. Fragrant aromas of citrus blossom, white rose petals, lime zest and Kaffir lime leaf, with hints of lemongrass and green peppercorn. A pure and mineral palate with concentrated ripe lime and slate-like acidity with laser focus, balanced by a fine, long, textural finish.

name: Leeuwin Estate  Prelude Vineyards Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The nose is bright and concentrated with subtle complexity, featuring lime, golden pear and white peach. Aromatic sweet spices of cinnamon and nutmeg with deeper tones of sesame, cashew and nougat provide depth and layers. Elevated jasmine floral notes enhance the purity and varietal expression. Definitively modern Leeuwin Estate Chardonnay; the palate exudes vibrancy with delicate textures. The intensity of pear, lime and lemon across the palate is threaded with a finite acid spine that is laced with spice and savoury notes, leading to a seamless and elegant finish.

name: Millhade  Atlantique Sauvignon Blanc IGP
desc_en_short: Pale yellow colour. Very expressive nose with notes of citrus, grapefruits and lemon. Lively and fresh attack. Extremely well balanced. To be served as an aperitif or with sea food.

name: Domaine Naudin-Ferrand  "Le Clou 34" Vin de France Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine is an atypical aligot, hence the choice to sell it under a label of “Vin de France”: exuberant in the nose, with notes of fruit of passion and blackcurrant flower as intense as surprising, It is fat to attack and of good length. The mouth is powerful, expressive. Very aromatic but totally unclassifiable, everything that one does not expect in a Burgundy Aligoté!

name: Palo Alto  Reserva Sauvingnon Blanc
desc_en_short: Of bright greenish yellow color and intensely aromatic, this Sauvignon Blanc stands out for its citrus notes, herbs and white peaches. On the palate it is fresh and balanced. Its vibrant acidity provides a very attractive persistence and juiciness.

name: Howard Park  Flint Rock Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Delicate and subtle fruit notes of honeydew melon, yellow flesh peach and lemon zest layered with nutmeal and lemon curd in a “mille-feuille” way. The palate is focused and shaped by the savouy mineral texture and a fine line of acidity, typical of this cooler climate.

name: Cà Maiol  Lugana Frankie DOC
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with greenish reflex. Clean with a clear identity on the nose with perfumes of green apple, lime and wild thyme. On opening releases aroma of oats and white pepper. Pleasant and soft on the palate equilibrium with all its components, with a mineral finish. Pairing with Shellfish and seafood, which can also be as a condiment in a plate of pasta or risotto; slighty fatty boiled fish.

name: Primosic  Chardonnay Gmajne Single Vineyard DOC
wine_color: Intense straw-yellow colour with golden glares.
desc_en_short: Intense straw-yellow colour with golden glares. The nose is complex, fruity, with delicate hints of exotic fruit, vanilla, dried fruit, and a mineral background. The palate is warm, balanced, elegant, spicy and fruity, mineral, with a good alcoholic perception and a persistent finish.

name: Primosic  Pinot Grigio Murno Single Vineyard DOC
desc_en_short: Straw-yellow in colour with “copper” highlights. Quite high in alcohol, elegant body, average fixed acidity. Full, but delicate aroma, hint of freshly baked bread, with almond flavours after ageing.

name: Angelo Negro  Serra Lupini Roero Arneis DOC
wine_color: Light yellow straw with greenish highlights.
desc_en_short: The Roero Arneis “Serra Lupini” of Negro Angelo e Figli shows an intense straw yellow color. It has a floral and fruited bouquet,  with notes of peach and pear and acacia flowers and tropical fruits scents. The taste is soft, persistent, with a sapid and mineral final. It is perfect if drunk fresh as aperitif or in combination with white meat, vegetables and aging cheeses.

name: Xanadu  Exmoor Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: The vibrant bouquet exhibits intense guava and passionfruit characters, with dried herbs and hints of lemon sherbet in the background. Medium bodied, the lively palate offers freshly squeezed citrus flavours combined with passionfruit, tropical fruits and a touch of spice. An easy drinking ‘Classic’ Margaret River wine style with wonderful purity – fruit driven, honest and lip-smacking with crisp acidity and a clean refreshing finish.

name: Yering Station  Yarra Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
The proud definition of our house style. These wines are produced from vineyards that are carefully managed by Yering Station’s team to ensure they reflect, and continue to reflect, Yarra Valley’s hallmark characters.

Classic in style, this wine displays a tight mineral backbone overlaid with opulent stone fruit creaminess. The center is richly complex, with a typical Yarra Valley long and lingering finish.

name: Cono Sur  Bicicleta Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: A bright and clean greenish-yellow coloring.
desc_en_short: Elegant, expressive and dressed in a green-yellow coloring, this Sauvignon Blanc impresses with its citrus notes of grapefruit and green apple, which mingle in with herbal hints. In mouth, its freshness and balance stand out in particular, along with its citric notes and pleasant mineral ending.

name: Gapsted  Snowy Creek  Classcic Dry White
desc_en_short: This wine is pale green in colour. The nose displays aromas of tropical fruit with hints of melon, passionfruit and lime. These aromas lead to a palate of luscious tropical fruit, fresh melon and apricot flavours. This wine has a fresh and delicate finish.

name: Gapsted  Waterstone Bridge Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine displays a light green colour, similar to fresh cut hay. The nose shows aromas of stonefruit and melon. These aromas lead to a palate with elegant flavours of white peach, melon and limey citrus. These flavours are beautifully balanced by subtle oak and a soft, clean finish which lingers on the palate

name: Gapsted   Moscato
desc_en_short: This wine displays a pale gold colour. The nose shows intense aromas of tropical fruit and melon. These aromas lead to a palate bursting with passionfruit, citrus and crushed grape flavours. The finish is fruity and refreshing with a zesty spritz. Excellent with a fresh fruit platter, also try with Thai green curry.

name: Bodega Volcanes de Chile  Reserva Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine is Green hues color. nose is A citrus nose with delightful minerality, enfolded with light notes of herbs, salt and white pepper. palate is Notes of lemon and lemon zest; white flowers and minerals.  Tones of herbs and white pepper.  A very fruity, tasty and elegant wine.

name: Marc Kreydenweiss Clos Rebberg Riesling
desc_en_short: This wine is fine and elegant, with a good minerality and dryness. Well balanced, the palate is round and rich. Also we appreciate its freshness. The pink sandstone soil brings a lot of delicacy and make the grapes ripe and full of sun. It’s one of our favorite gastronomical wines, to reserve for fish and sea food dishes. The fine salinity makes it even better to enjoy with food. It’s a wine for ageing, to keep for 20 years in the cellar. Dry wine.

name: Marc Kreydenweiss  Moenchberg Grand Cru Pinot Gris
desc_en_short: The marl and sandstone soil composed by glacial deposits give rise to a dry pinot gris, pure, powerful and full, with a fantastic length. Note that in 1097, the Benedictine Abbey of Altdorf had already chosen this south-facing hill to cultivate their vines.

name: Marc Kreydenweiss  Kastelberg Grand Cru Riesling
desc_en_short: The wine is fine and elegant, with a good minerality and dryness. Well balanced, the palate is round and rich. It is fresh, the pink sandstone soil brings a lot of delicacy and makes the grapes ripe. It is one of the finest gastronomical wine that pairs great with fish and seafood. A wine for aging, to keep for 20 years in the cellar.

name: Fattoria Le Pupille  Poggio Argentato Toscana IGT
grape_variety: Sauvignon Blanc, Petit Manseng, Gewürztraminer, Sémillon
desc_en_short: Bright yellow with greenish tints. On the nose, prevalence of white flowers and notes of cut grass evolve in mineral tones. Fresh and persistent in the mouth. Perfect for aperitifs, crustacea, raw fish, white meats and fresh cheeses, as well as with vegetable based first courses.

name: Sacha Lichine  La Poule Blanche
desc_en_short: This wine combines the best of French winemaking Know-How with modern winemaking technology. Skin-contact before pressing. Alcoholic fermentation at low temperature (14-15°). Oak ageing for 20%. Fruity nose of peach, grapefruit, bananas and mango. The palate is well balanced. A wonderful delicately wooded finish. Ideal with a rocket and parmesan salad or seafood linguine. Serve chilled at 12 °C.

name: Le Coste  Bianco
desc_en_short: A blend of Procanico, Malvasia and Vermentino. It’s pressed right away and aged for one year in old barrels. This vintage retains a little spritz upon opening, which caries a wonderful array of aromatics. Vibrant, delicious wine.

name: Le Coste  Vino Bianco
style: Procanico 20% Blended With Local Varieties Vermentino, Malvasia, Petino, Romanesco, Greco Antico And Ansonia
food_matching: Rich Seafood, Spiced Dishes, Asian Cuisine, Aged Cheese
desc_en_short: Made with 80% Chardonnay and 20% Friulano, this amber-colored wine boast more fruits richness than many other wines from the orange wine movement. Loaded with ripe apricot, candied citrus zest, dried herbs and crushed stone, this is brightened by lively acidity on the palate. A perfect introduction to the genre.

name: Friedrich Becker  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A prima donna which set high claim to the soil quality. Our aim is to bring out the typical, livingly acidity and compare with high ripeness. Thus link breed and elegance. Chardonnay is basically used for our sparkling wines. Suitable musts are even placed in new oak barrels.

name: Eric Morgat  Fides
desc_en_short: Pale yellow, bright and clear. Nose of pear and citrus, accompanied by intense mineral touches, accents of dried fruit On the palate round and creamy, beautiful balance between suavity and freshness, a great mineral tension, a lot of depth.

name: Henry Pelle  Le Carroir Blanc
desc_en_short: Purity, structure and finesse. The potential of this unique terroir in the northern quarter of the appellation of Menetou-Salon Morogues was recognized and planted by Henry Pellé as long ago as 1976. For here, in the “lieu dit” known locally as “Le Carroir”, is silex or “flint”: a light sandy terroir pebble-dashed with flintstones. Such terroirs are now world famous for imbuing Sauvignon blanc with a purity of flavor matched to structure, substance and a long finish. Such wines can be enjoyed young but are often even better three or more years after their release.

name: Henry Pelle  Les Blanchais Blanc
desc_en_short: The perfect combination of the different areas of the Menetou-Salon region. ‘Les bornés’, which means ‘clay soil’ in Berrichon —the local dia- lect— is an aromatic wine. The nose is reminiscent of the grape variety and the taste is full, rich and tender. A truly pleasurable wine that will reach its fullest potential in 2 to 3 years.

name: Capture  Les Pioniers Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale yellow. Pungent, sexy aromas of lemon, nectarine, white grapefruit, crushed mint, anise and spring flowers. Supple, juicy and penetrating, with a musky complexity to the citrus zest and ripe grapefruit flavors. Conveys a tactile impression of extract without weight. Vibrant and well-delineated sauvignon with excellent balancing acidity. The brisk, persistent, palate-dusting finish shows a refreshing touch of bitterness. This is excellent.

name: Frank Family  Carneros Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Frank Family Carneros Chardonnay has a pale yellow straw color. Aromas of white flowers, stone fruit, lemon zest, and a hint of vanilla, lead to a rich and enveloping palate of lychee fruit and toasted almonds, with bright, mouth-watering acidity.

name: Freemark Abbey  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Light greenish straw in color, our chardonnay expresses fruit aroma of ripe pineapple, ripe banana, guava, apricot, peach and tropical fruit cocktail. Adding to the complexity, the oak aging is fairly integrated adding spice like nutmeg, light toast, and the nuance of angel food cake. This wine has great viscosity, depth and an intriguing long finish. The flavors are lively on the palate with pear, citrus, lemonlime, green apple and fleshy peach. This wine shows great complexity, creaminess, and elegance to compliment many foods.

name: Layer Cake  Virgin Chardonnay - Monterey
desc_en_short: The nose is reminiscent of Meyer lemons, preserved then diced up later in the year, wet stones and lime blossoms waft in and out as well. The wine builds in body and texture as it sits in your mouth. Layers of Kaffir lime, guava, and pineapple pour in at first, and then the light creamy texture of whipped lemon curd fills in.

name: Peay Vineyards  'Estate' Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Pale gold. Intricate bouquet of lemon, tangerine, melon, peach pit, sweet butter and talc-y minerals. Vibrant and medium-bodied, with citrus and orchard fruit flavors deepened by buttered toast and marzipan. Finishes on a bright mineral note, with excellent length.

name: Staglin Family Vineyard  Napa Valley Chardonnay 2010 (375 ml)
desc_en_short: The pale gold color of the Staglin Chardonnay appears to almost sparkle and dance with dissolved jewels. The expressive nose of yellow peaches and lemon oil is lifted by floral notes of jasmine and honeysuckle with hints of mandarin orange marmalade, toffee and a sprinkle of gunpowder floating about. Balancing this is a creamy and finely textured palate that reverberates with a tight coil of liquid minerals and lively acidity that gives this wine gorgeous length and exciting complexity.

name: Staglin Family Vineyard  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Wonderfully energetic and admirably concentrated, the 2017 Staglin Chardonnay expresses an alluring citrus spectrum of ripe Lisbon and Meyer lemon that evolves to reveal delightful Bosc and Green Anjou pear notes with highlights of wintergreen and honeysuckle and mineralized by a pinch of Maldon salt and bow rosin. Simultaneously crystalline and creamy, this lissome wine delights from beginning to end.

name: Starmont  Carneros Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine is pale gold in color, with aromas of ripe apples, citrus, Asian pear, butterscotch and vanilla bean with fresh mineral notes. The wine’s soft entry leads to a mid-palate with medium body and acidity and plenty of volume. Flavors of apple and pear, along with citrus notes and subtle oak lead to a refreshing, medium length finish.

name: Starmont  Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine is aromas of grapefruit, kaffir lime and jasmine. A crisp and delicious entry leads to a bright and fleshy mid-palate, good acidity and structure showcasing flavors of citrus, guava and mang. The finish is moderately long, clean and refreshing.

name: Finca Flichman  'Tanguero' Chardonnay
wine_color: Golden straw color with greenish highlights.
desc_en_short: Golden straw color with greenish highlights. The fresh scent of citrus, green apple and subtle notes of nuts. Well-balanced, light, refreshing wine with a slight acidity and fruity notes. Bright refreshing aftertaste.The wine will be an excellent aperitif and goes well with fish dishes, ideal for baked in foil walleye.

name: Finca Flichman  'Misterio' Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Greenish yellow color. White plums, asparagus and a hint of vanilla at the nose. Round, fresh and persistent flavor. It matches fishes, pasta and white meats.

name: Finca Flichman  'Reserva' Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The Reserva wines, single selected varietals, come exclusively from Finca Flichman´s vineyards in Barrancas and Tupungato, high altitudes that express Argentina´s unique terroir.

name: Claymore Wines  "Joshua Tree" Clare Valley Riesling
desc_en_short: The aromatics of this wine are so vibrant - jumping out of the glass. A beautiful, appealing perfume full of floral notes and orange blossom with touches of freshly zested limes. The Palate gives good fruit weight and a gentle acidic mouth feel full of clean citrus flavours. This lovely textured Riesling can be enjoyed with fresh seafood.

name: La Playa  'Estate Series' Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A delicate pale gold. On the nose, aromas of lemon, fresh pineapple with hints of lavender. It is a bright well balanced wine with a clean minerality and touch of lime on the finish.

name: Dreissigacker  Organic Riesling
desc_en_short: This clear, refreshing and racy Riesling is a great introduction to the whole range of Dreissigacker, a fantastic and one of the hottest family own winery in Germany. The nose is fragrant and fresh with ripe fruit aromas of apples, peaches and sweet pears plus a soft touch of wild white flowers. On the palate, the wine is light and elegant, yet with intensity and a piquant taste that ends with a delicious salty finish. It’s a very charming wine with great finesse that will simply put a smile on anybody’s face.

name: Villa Wolf  Gewürztraminer
desc_en_short: Villa Wolf Gewürztraminer is clean, fruity and wonderfully light on its feet, showing off the aromatic charm of the variety without being heavy or ponderous. It has a deliciously juicy texture and a delightfully delicate aroma of spice and fresh roses. It’s very refreshing to drink on its own and makes a perfect accompaniment to spicy Asian cuisine.

name: Pierre Luneau-Papin  Folle Blanche
desc_en_short: Refreshing nose of lemon and flowers. The wine is light and crips with very good mineral. Perfect for aperitif or with fresh oyster.

name: Josef Leitz  Eins-Zwei-Dry Riesling
desc_en_short:
Refreshing and fruity nose with nutty nuance. Lively acid, salty mineral and good concentration with good long finish.

Jancis Robinson, “Leitz has found a formula for his dry estate wine that makes me forgive its corny title. With its successful combination of catchy name, fresh fruit, moderate acidity and ample body it serves to raise the profile of dry German Riesling and that has to be a good thing.”

name: Josef Leitz  Dragonstone Riesling
desc_en_short: While Johannes’ dry wines solidied his reputation in Germany and throughout Europe, no other wine made him as popular in the US as did Dragonstone. Coming from the Rüdesheimer Drachenstein, the pure quartzite soil, being a silicate, lends a saltiness to the orange citrus-avored wine which buers the acidity and counterbalances the palpable sugar.

name: Josef Leitz  Magic Mountain Riesling Dry
desc_en_short: Jancis Robinson, “I used to think that the name Magic Mountain was just another corny marketing ploy, but recently learned to my amazement that local schnapps producer Underberg had registered the appellation of Zauberberg as a trade mark. Whatever they may turn out under that brand cannot rival the quality of the wine which dare not speak its name. A pure and cool minerality adds a touch of sophistication to the generous expression of fresh pear and grapefruit for a dry Riesling deserving of Erste Lage (Premier Cru) status.”

name: Josef Leitz  Berg Roseneck Riesling
desc_en_short: A rich nose with elegant ripe hints of exotic fruits, such as passion fruit, mango, lychee and physalis welcomes you in the first moment. There´s a scent of herbs and lime that seems to fall in love with the wild yeast aromatic of this delicious masterpiece. On the palate you will find a very airy middle section which keeps this refreshing and modern styled Spätlese in balance with an enthralling and fascinating acidity. The mineral impact gives us the feeling of licking pebbles and this Spätlese seems to be more dry styled than it is. Due to it´s youth, the BERG ROSENECK Spätlese of this vintage is a the very beginning of it´s long journey. As a food recommendation for this wine, we suggest mixed sushi, hotate no sashimi, grilled clams with Asian vegetables, or strong cheese.

name: Josef Leitz  Berg Schlossberg Riesling
desc_en_short: 96 points in James Suckling, “Slightly exotic as always this is at once sleek, succulent and seriously mineral. Then the silky finish lifts off like a rocket bound for the outer solar system. Another of the great 2016s from Leitz. Drink now and for many years to come..”

name: Knipser  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: light straw-yellow and delicate green reflections. Perfectly balanced between maturity and green freshness, the bouquet presents itself. A lot of green and yellow gooseberry, fresh peach, elderberry blossom and mineral-citric notes set the tone. On the palate the clove Sauvignon Blanc delights with crisp freshness, without the fruit acid striking over the strings. A medium weight body and mineral notes provide plenty of power and strength.

name: Russiz Superiore  Sauvignon DOC Collio
wine_color: Straw yellow in color with green tints.
desc_en_short: Straw yellow in colour with green highlights. The nose fantastic, intense and elegant vegetal and floral overtones can be perceived such as sage and fresh bell pepper, acacia blossom and grapefruit. In the mouth, a freshness and richness of flavour marry together splendidly. Structured and well-balanced, velvety with good extract and a long finish.

name: Domaine Des Roches Neuves  (Thierry Germain)  Insolite
desc_en_short: 100% Chenin Blanc from a top biodynamic producer in the Loire valley. This wine offers real concentration and complexity, pear, peach and white flowers (rose and acacia). After swirling, the wine reveals fragrance of jasmine and citrus supplemented by chamomile and rhubarb. The mouth has great character, elegantly intense, fruity (sensation of biting into Chenin still standing), clear and precise. It is a complex and elegant wine with great potential.

name: Innovate  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A classic Sauvignon Blanc exhibits a medium straw green colour with a citrus and melon palate, and is an ideal accompaniment with seafood or spicy Asian dishes.

name: De Bortoli  Harvest Diary Semillon Chardonnay
wine_color: Pale straw with lively green hues colour.
desc_en_short: Pale straw with lively green hues colour. Citrus and tropical notes are prominent complement with a hint of oak. This fresh zesty wine is balanced by a creamy mid palate whilst exhibiting up front citrus lemon, stone and tropical fruit flavour. Finishing with subtle oak. Perfect with sauteed field mushrooms with creamy polenta or oysters naturale.

name: Jacob's Creek  Classic Semillon Chardonnay (750 ml)
desc_en_short:
A generous take on a classic blend, with the acidity from the Chardonnay beautifully balanced by the Semillon’s tight structure.

Award : GOLD, Perth Royal Wine Show 2018

name: Jacob's Creek  Cool Harvest Unoaked Chardonnay (750 ml)
desc_en_short: This is a classic unoaked Chardonnay, with fresh zesty lemon flavours that showcase the value of cool harvesting.

name: Jacob's Creek  Winemaker's Selection Chardonnay
