desc_en_short: Our Winemaker’s Selection range offers great tasting wines that have been created to be approachable wines that complement a wide variety of foods with Chinese taste preferences in mind.

name: Graffigna  Centenario Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The Graffigna Centenario range transmits the true expression of each variety, with deep aromas, flavors and great concentration.

name: G7  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Bright, clean yellow color. Aromas of peaches, pears and apricots complemented with citrus notes. A voluminous and tasty wine, full of fruit and freshness.

name: G7  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Bright, clean yellow color with greenish gleams.
desc_en_short: Bright, clean yellow color with greenish gleams. Aromas of citrus herbs and grapefruit. A fresh and crisp wine that leaves memories of stone fruits.

name: Greywacke  Late Harvest Riesling (375 ml)
desc_en_short: A wine of intense aromatics – exotic honeysuckle blossom, candied lemon and vanilla custard, infused with a hint of cloves. The luscious palate has a marmalade-like combination of lemons and limes mingled with the richness of honeyed apricots and a dollop of crème caramel. Silky, succulent and harmonious – finishing with a lively citrusy crispness.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Pinot Grigio Canlungo IGT
wine_color: Intense Straw Yellow With Interesting Copper Highlights.
desc_en_short: Intense straw yellow with interesting copper highlights. The nose offers flowery and characteristic sensations with hints of citrus fruits. In the mouth it is well balanced, silky and savoury and elegance is the main feature. Serving with all fish-based starters, pasta, rice or vegetable soups, boiled fish, eggs or cold white meats.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Chardonnay Del Sassi Cavi DOC
desc_en_short: Slightly pale straw yellow ushers in absinthe-like florality and tropical fruits. Fresh, aroma-rich and well balanced in the mouth. A wine to enjoy as an aperitif, or with fish or egg dishes. Sparkling or fresh Chardonnays are perfect with seafood starters. Barrique-aged versions can also be served with white meats, lobster or beef pâté.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Collio Broy DOC
desc_en_short: All three varietals are then blended together and fermented part in steel part in barrique. This results is a classic white wine vinification with a short maceration. This wine pairs well with the dishes of the haute cuisine, oven-roasted fish or velvety sauces, risottos with truffles, medium aged cheeses, shrimp and “toc in braide” (polenta made with milk and melted cheese sauce covering) topped with foie gras.

name: Eugenio Collavini  Bianco Chardonnay Ribolla Gialla IGT
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: The grapes are picked up separately and set on drying trays to undergo a one-week of concentration in our drying lofts at controlled temperature and moisture. and fruitiness presence. Deep straw yellow. Rich and soft withe wine, with a well balanced freshness and fruitness presence. Elegant body, clean and tasty, with a good aromatic content. Smooth and pleasant, fairly long on the finish.

name: Elena Walch  Muller-Thurgau Vigneti Delle Dolomiti I.G.T.
desc_en_short: Our Müller Thurgau is persuasive with light straw yellow color, pleasant aromas, discreet aromas of herbs, some nutmeg as well as slight notes of apricot. Enjoyable freshness, youthful acidity and delicate structure characterize the palate. A very drinkable aperitif wine and an uncomplicated companion for light dishes.

name: Elena Walch  Gewurztraminer Kastelaz
desc_en_short: The Gewürztraminer Vigna “Kastelaz” is an international benchmark for the variety. With a rich, golden yellow color and a beguilingly complex bouquet both elegant and mineral, with aromas of roses and lychee as well as subtle acacia honey. On the palate, the wine is convincing and complex with an elegant structure, stimulating acidity, harmonious-spicy freshness and a delicate, vibrant finish. A wine with finesse and character!

name: Elena Walch  Riesling Alto Adige Vigna Castel Ringberg DOC
desc_en_short: Our Riesling Vigna "Castel Ringberg” entices in clear fresh straw yellow. Aromas of white peaches, a hint of citrus fruits, fresh spicy and mineral notes dominate the bouquet. Brisk freshness as well as tangy acidity unfurl on the palate combined with mineral structure, filigreed elegance and a fresh finish.

name: Merryvale  Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Seen as a pale yellow in the glass
desc_en_short: Seen as a pale yellow in the glass, with fresh aromas of grapefruit, lime, mandarin and melon. A sip brings a sweet beginning and a tartness to the mid-palate balanced with good acidity and weight. Pronounced flavors of citrus and stone fruit mix with subtlehints of spice. The finish is clean and refreshing, long in length with mineral notes.

name: Merryvale  Carneros Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A vibrant gold color, this wine is alive with aromas of ripe, sweet pear, pineapple, popcorn, golden delicious apple, toffee, and vanilla bean. The acidity is well framed by the flavor and texture of the wine. Naturally sweet flavors and aromatics are accented by complex barrel notes, leading to a lengthy, sophisticated finish.

name: Terres Dorées (Jean Paul Brun)  Beaujolais Blanc
desc_en_short: Refreshing and fruity nose accompanied by mineral scent. On the palate, delicious ripe fruits, spicy mineral, and a touch of honey. Refreshing acid with long elegant finish.

name: Terra Franca  White
desc_en_short: It has a citrus-yellow colour and an intense fruity bouquet with a prevalence of tropical aromas of banana, peach and passion fruit. On the palate it has an excellent freshness and a fruity, elegant and lingering aroma.

name: Quinta Do Carvalhais  Encruzado
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Quinta dos Carvalhais Encruzado 2015 has a bright citrus yellow colour and a subtle flavour, characteristic of the Encruzado grape variety. Notes of minerals, white fruit such as melon and pear, floral shades and a refreshing plant-based touch stand out. It has a complex bouquet that marries exceptionally with the aroma of French oak acquired during 6 months in the barrel. It is fresh, balanced and harmonious in the mouth, its vibrant acidity combining well with touches of French oak to deliver a long and delicate finish.

name: Herdade Do Peso  Vinha Do Monte White
desc_en_short: It has a yellow citrus hue an intense and elegant fruity bouquet, with a prevalence of pear and white flowers. Its palate is harmonious, well-balanced and fresh, typical of fine Vidigueira white wines.

name: Morgadio Da Torre  Alvarinho Vinho Verde
desc_en_short: Citrine-yellow colour with greenish tints. An intense aroma with notes of ripe tropical fruit, yellow-fleshed fruit and jasmine blossom. Excellent mouthfeel with volume and amplitude. A lively and well-integrated acidity. A gastronomic wine with a firm and persistent finish.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Botani "Dry Muscat"
desc_en_short: Pale straw color. Fresh, fragrant and mature, brimming with the aroma of Muscat grape, apple, mandarin orange and a pinch of wilted flowers. On the palate it is fruity and dry, with notes of citrus and a gentle finish.

name: Comenge Winery  Comenge "Verdejo"
wine_color: Straw yellow with green hues, clean and bright
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with green hues, clean and bright. Intense varietal aroma, very expressive, with a highlighted aroma of citric fruit, fennel, dried grass and thyme. The palate is serious, dry, tasty and fresh, with volume, balance and good persistence. A nice and subtle bitterness which lengthens the wine and leaves a very elegant aftertaste on the palate and the whole character of the old vineyards.

name: Beronia Winery  Beronia "White" V
desc_en_short: This Viura shows a bright yellow colour with green tones. On the nose intense and fresh with fruit aromas such as apple and mango standing out over a base of citrus which gives freshness. On the palate fresh, very fruity with great volume. Balanced with a long and persistent finish.

name: Otto Bestue Winery  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Pale lemon yellow colour. Fresh aromas of apple, white fowers and citrus fruits. Intense and rich favours

name: Vicente Gandia Winery  Puerto De Alicante Seleccion
desc_en_short: This brilliant Chardonnay has an outstanding pale yellow colour. On the nose its intense aromas comprises of a mixture between tropical fruit and ripe apple. In the mouth it is very fresh with a good balance between acidity and fruit. The lengthy mouth-watering finish is marked by peach.

name: Jorge Ordonez Winery  Tarima Blanco (Organic)
desc_en_short: Tarima Blanco is a unique white wine produced from three of Spain's most important indigenous white grapes. Merseguera is indigenous to this part of Spain.

name: Torello Winery  Malvarel-Lo
wine_color: Pale golden colour with green tones.
desc_en_short: Melon, peach and tropical fruit aromas share the bouquet on this Malvasia-Xarello blend. A crisp, citrusy palate is lean, while tangerine, lime and melon flavors finish bright, with a moderate level of stony minerality.

name: Torello Winery  Crisalys
wine_color: Pale yellow, bright, with medium size bubbles
desc_en_short: A young white wine, fresh, light and fruity. Xarel.lo from our vines in Can Martí. The grapes are harvested manually at their optimum ripeness and transported to the presses in less than 15 minutes after being harvested in order to avoid any early oxidation or fermentation.

name: Otto Bestue Winery  Navateros Chardonnay
wine_color: Pale yellow colour, with green notes.
desc_en_short: Pale yellow colour, with green notes. Complex and intense pineapple, peach and tropical flavours such as passion fruits and banana aroma. Fresh and creamy feeling in mounth, thank to a balanced acidity. Fruity aftertaste with pineapple notes. Paring with starts, salads, pasta, sushi, fish or white meats.

name: Otto Bestue Winery  Bestué Marina
desc_en_short: Bright yellow color. Very intense to the nose with a complex aromatic structure that delivers nuances of honey, lychees, white rose petals and orange blossom. On the palate, it offers a strict floral quality accompanied by subtle flavors of fresh fruit. Best serve as aperitif or paired with Asian dished, smoked food and foie.

name: Paco Y Lola Winery  Paco & Lola
wine_color: Straw yellow colour with greenish, clear and bright tones.
desc_en_short: Straw yellow colour with greenish, clear and bright tones. Medium-high, citric notes (grapefruit and mandarin) and white flowers, acacia and orange blossom, with a sweet tropical background, intense aroma of lychees and melon. Fresh, citrus, intense and fruity mouth. Elegant, round and balanced.

name: Cono Sur  Tocornal Chardonnay
wine_color: Beautiful, young yellow colour with golden hints.
desc_en_short: Beautiful, young yellow colour with golden hints. Exuberant and complex, it conveys refreshing citrus aromas, fruity notes of white peaches, along with mineral hints. In the mouth complex fruity flavours mingle in with lovely mineral notes. A young and fresh wine, very balanced, with a great acidity.

name: Cono Sur  Bicicleta Chardonnay
wine_color: A beautiful, young yellow coloring with golden hints.
desc_en_short: This Chardonnay has a beautiful, young yellow coloring with golden hints. Exuberant and complex, this wine conveys refreshing citrus aromas, fruity notes of white peaches and mineral hints. In mouth, complex fruity flavors mingle in with lovely mineral notes. Our Bicicleta Chardonnay is a young and fresh wine, very balanced, with a great acidity.

name: Chateau St. Jean  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine has flavours of nectarine, apple, pineapple, hazelnut and spice. Lees ageing adds a creaminess and complexity giving a rich mouth feel and long finish. Match this with creamy parmesan risotto or buttery roast chicken.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Gneiss
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: Beautiful nose of apple, pear, melon and citrus. Very dry on the palate yet very pure and clean. Middle body with smooth texture. Salty mineral coming at mid palate with delicious fruit. Good middle long finish.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Janus
desc_en_short: Elegant nose with pronounced iodine and mineral notes, notes of green algae, citrus fruits, lime and Buddha's hand zest. Frank attack, demonstrative wine, relatively powerful that develops beautiful bitters and flexibility in the middle of the mouth, notes of fruit from the orchard, citrus zest. Final on citrus and iodine. A wine raised in concrete vats, vinified without added So2 that definitely leaves the beaten track of Chardonnay.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Marguerite
desc_en_short: Nose mixing mineral notes and very marked maritime notes, kelp, iodine, citrus notes, root notes, gentian. The attack is clear and straight, the wine shows a large volume in the middle of the mouth, fine acidity on notes of lime; very saline notes, great freshness and beautiful finish.

name: Domaine de L’Ecu  Taurus
desc_en_short: This is the result when 2 artists goes wild. Guy and Fred of Domaine de l’Ecu are great practitioners of biodynamic wine-making and they sure let loose with their top cuvées which come in eye-catching labels and wax-covered neck. The Taurus has so much energy and liveliness in it. The seducing nose of apple, melon and fine cedar woods. On the palate, very complex flavours of delicious fruits, super smooth body with nice texture, refreshing acid and superb balance. The finish is out of this world, minutes-long and very enjoying.

name: Gallo Family Vineyards  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Our Chardonnay is a real people-pleaser. And it keeps those people on their toes with delightfully unexpected notes: citrus, rich fruit, vanilla and a dash of oak. When it's seafood night, our Chardonnay is ready for the pour. But don't stop at buttery salmon and seafood salads. This medium-bodied wine - and its lush texture - complement poultry and cream sauces, too.

name: Masseria Li Veli  Askos Verdeca
wine_color: Bright yellow color with green shades
desc_en_short: Bright yellow color with green shades. Intense fruity on the nose, with scent of tropical fruit, citrus, pear and fresh spices. On the palate it is full, well balanced with a good acidity. Fruity, mineral and mildly spicy aftertaste.

name: Eric Morgat  Litus
desc_en_short: Contemporary style of Chenin Blanc from a very traditional region of Savennières with super low yield. Only 5,000 bottles are produced each year. The Litus has more fruit to offer than the more austere Fidès yet still very complex - complexity withgrace. Beautiful and very pleasing nose. On the palate, the wine keeps revealing new flavours as the golden yellow juice flows over the palate, perfectly ripe fruits, honey, herbs and delicate mineral. Super long elegant finish.

name: Senorio de Nava  Verdejo Blanco 2012
wine_color: light yellow with pale gold and pale greenish reflections.
desc_en_short: Light yellow with pale gold and pale greenish reflections. On nose moderate citrus, tree fruit, minerals and hints of herbs. On the palate dry, medium-bodied, fresh acidity, good balanced, and rich texture. Moderate citrus, tree fruit and herbs with a bitter note that lingers.

name: Etienne Sauzet  Bourgogne Blanc
desc_en_short: An expressive nose of floral, citrus and pear aromas introduces solidly well-concentrated middle weight flavors that possess good energy on the utterly delicious, clean and agreeably dry and focused finish. This is quite good in the context of the appellation and recommended.

name: Etienne Sauzet  Puligny-Montrachet
desc_en_short: This is also quite expressive with a pretty blend of acacia blossom, white peach and various dried yellow fleshed fruit scents. The supple and very round medium-bodied flavors possess a suave mouth feel yet retain reasonably good precision on the delicious finish that offers good depth and persistence.

name: Etienne Sauzet  Puligny-Montrachet 1er Cru Hameau de Blagny
desc_en_short: Notably ripe aromas of dried apricot, peach and mango. There is excellent volume to the rich, delicious and extract-rich flavors that possess a seductive texture, all wrapped in a complex, balanced and solidly long finish.

name: Etienne Sauzet  Bienvenues-Batard-Montrachet Grand Cru 2014
desc_en_short: A restrained but highly complex nose features notes of ripe, pure and elegant honeysuckle, pear, apple and soft spice aromas that are trimmed in just enough wood to notice. There is excellent concentration to the equally refined and relatively powerful medium weight flavors that possess a highly seductive mouth feel before culminating in a saline and gorgeously persistent finish. Excellent upside development potential.

name: Etienne Sauzet  Le Montrachet Grand Cru
desc_en_short: A notably ripe and overtly exotic nose of mostly dried yellow orchard fruit, spice and subtle floral nuances introduces succulent and unctuously-textured big-bodied flavors that also coat the palate with dry extract on the explosively long and intense finish.

name: Domaine de Mus  Roussanne Vermentino
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: Brilliant light color. Expressive on the nose, aromas dominated with orange blossom and lemon notes. Fresh and complex on the palate, with citrus acidulous notes, a pleasant length.

name: Caricature  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Delightfully fruity and refreshing, Caricature Chardonnay is a vibrant, pleasing wine. A lovely tropical aroma fills the glass and carries through to the palate where it joins crisp apple notes. Six months of French and American oak aging balance the fruit flavors by adding a bit of spice to the smooth and silky finish. It is a versatile Chardonnay that is great to sip or pair with a meal.

name: Rockford  White Frontignac
desc_en_short: Very yellow light colour. Aroma of passion fruit and peach is a stronger grapefruit element. The palate sweet taste Sour fruit, passion fruit and acidity.

name: Terre del Vulcano  Lava Falanghina Beneventano DOC
desc_en_short: Bright straw yellow. Intense aroma, quite persistent, fruity. Medium-bodied, well balanced, quite intense and persistent. Best Served with: Easy to drink, great as aperitif, matches light main courses, white meat, young cheeses, ideal with fish.

name: Wolf Blass  Blass Chardonnay
desc_en_short: From fresh and unoaked to the sophisticated complexity of elegant, barrel fermented styles, Chardonnay is one of the world's most loved white wines. With an array of fruit flavours from citrus to orchard and stone fruits, Chardonnay is a delight served with rich creamy pasta, seafood, chicken, roast turkey or pork.

name: Beringer  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Winemaker Notes

Beringer’s Napa Valley Chardonnay is a vibrant, contemporary version of this much loved varietal, crafted to serve well as an aperitif on its own or as a faithful companion to a wide variety of foods and menus. Carefully selected lots from several of Napa’s coolest growing regions are blended to offer a wonderful expression of Napa Valley.

Surprisingly plush and creamy, aromas and flavors of tart citrus lead with hints of white pear, delicious apple and a bit of lemon meringue and toasted almonds. Balanced, with moderate acidity, the brightness of the Chardonnay fruit shines through.

Testing Nose.

Surprisingly plush and creamy, aromas and flavors of tart citrus lead with hints of white pear, delicious apple and a bit of lemon meringue and toasted almonds. Balanced, with moderate acidity, the brightness of the Chardonnay fruit shines through.

name: Poker Hill  Sauvignon Blanc / Semilon
desc_en_short: This fresh, full-bodied blend of noble cultivars is inviting and fresh. Fruitiness on the palate, is followed by a crisp, clean finish. An easy drinking appetizer or to lounge around the pool with.

name: Finca de los Arandinos  Viero
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Beautiful pale gold colour. Complex and changeable nose that gains in intensity. Firstly it shows certain herbaceous and fennel hints with green apple peels and slight camomile and honey. Then it gets more serious and consistently mineral, what makes of this wine, something really special. The mouth is consistent rich and with delicate texture. There is an important ripeness that is balanced with the freshness of the fruit and a nice and soft bitterness that shows a generous length and consistency to this wine.

name: Maison Virginie  Chardonnay Pays D'OC
desc_en_short: Good golden colour with shimmering reflections. A complex range of aromas, subtly mixing citrus with tropical fruits, oak and toasty richness.

name: F.X. Pichler  Grüner Veltliner Loibner
desc_en_short: The name LOIBEN (for the area of the cadastral communities Oberloiben and Unterloiben) is the designation of origin of this Wachau DAC village wine. The vineyards are situated on the plains of the Loibner basin, with light and warm soils made of alluvial Danube sand and gravel.

name: Ferraton Pere & Fils  Condrieu "Les Mandouls"
desc_en_short: Clean and crisp, the 2015 Condrieu Les Mandouls (it's named after an almond tree) gives up notes of tangerine, citrus blossom and crushed rocks, and is clean, tight and nicely focused on the palate. It needs a year in bottle, but is outstanding.

name: Cherry Tart  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Abundant floral and white fruit aromas jump from the glass; lychee nut, honeysuckle, and peach marmalade. Incredibly rich and textured, with loads of caramelized pear, pineapple and exotic marmalade notes, this sexy beast of a Chardonnay has brilliant delineation and stunning length along with undeniable minerality.

name: Pierre Luneau-Papin  "L" D’OR 2012
style: Melon De Bourgogne, Old Vines Of More Than 45 Years Old
desc_en_short: This wine spent around 10 months on its lees. Beautiful and refreshing nose of apricot, citrus and spices. On the palate, lively acid and elegant with delicious fruits. A lot of mineral, good complexity and well balance. Good long mineral finish.

name: Philippe Pacalet  Meursault
desc_en_short: Meursault is a quite a heavy and “hot” wine. In the nose apple, pear with citrus aromas. On the palate quite dense ripe fruit, the acidity is fine, but the quite high alcohol content is also present in the finish.

name: First Press  Napa Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Elegantly structured, this medium bodied Chardonnay has aromas of lemon, spice, melon and a touch of vanilla. Flavors of yellow apples and pears lead to a textured, well balanced finish.

name: Sand Point  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Two styles of Chardonnay come together to create a balance between crisp apple notes and tropical fruit. Layered within these aromas and flavors are hints of pear and a vanilla character that lead to a cream soda finish. Overall, it is a wine with vibrancy and richness.

name: Sand Point  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A fresh and fragrant Sauvignon Blanc that opens with honeydew melon and Meyer lemon aromas. With juicy citrus-melon flavors, a round mouthfeel and crisp finish, it is an easy drinking wine.

name: Leonce Bocquet  Chablis
wine_color: Beautiful yellow color with green reflections
desc_en_short: the wine is vinified with the traditional Burgundian process. it is aged in stainiess steel during 12 to 18 months to bind fresh-ness and maturity. A maturing in bottle follows for 12 months to improve the balance of the wine, to benefit from the slow and natural oxidation which helps the wine to open and to develop its aromas.

name: Botter  Soave
wine_color: Straw yellow colour tending towards greenish tinged
desc_en_short: Straw yellow colour tending towards greenish reflections. This wine has a vinous, intense, characteristic bouquet. It is as classic dry wine Italian white with a creamy nutty taste.

name: Botter  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: Straw yellow color. Large and fresh bouquet with apple notes. On the palate it is clean and fresh with typical mineral taste. Ideal as an aperitif and with any fish courses.

name: Game of Thrones  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine is greenish yellow color. Enticing aromas of stone fruit and white blossoms lead to a rich, creamy. The palate of peaches, apricots, tangerine, Meyer lemon, baking spices and honey, balanced by mouth-watering acidity.

name: Capo Zafferano  Grillo IGT Terre Siciliane
desc_en_short: From an ancient grape of Sicily! Straw- yellow with green highlights. Scent of apricots and honey. Crisp acidity with a very pleasing finish of exotic fruit

name: Egon Muller  Scharzhofberger Riesling Kabinett
desc_en_short: 92 Point By Wine Spectator "An elegant style, featuring green peach, apple and pear flavors that are minerally and fresh-tasting. The savory finish has notes of citrus peel and juniper berry that are complex and lingering. Drink now through 2020."

name: Domaine Bonneau du Martray  Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru
desc_en_short: As I wrote earlier this year, Bonneau du Martray's 2020 Corton-Charlemagne Grand Cru unwinds in the glass with aromas of crisp Anjou pear, peach and nectarine mingled with white flowers, clear honey, nutmeg, mint and fresh bread. Medium to full-bodied, satiny and layered, it's bright and concentrated, with terrific depth at the core and a long, saline finish. Seamless, intense and complete, this elegant, precise white Burgundy is built for the cellar

name: Good  Pinot Grigio Delle Venezie DOC
desc_en_short: Bright yellow color, elegant and dry. Floral notes and fresh flavors. Refreshing crisp finish. This stylish wine is ideal on its own, with creamy pasta sauces, fish dishes and white meats.

name: Louis Moreau  Chablis
desc_en_short: Fruity and vivid wine showing a nice golden color and a floral notes on the nose with hints of white fruit (apple, pear) typical of Chablis terroir. Good attack in mouth with mineral and fresh notes, combined with a nice balance on the palate.

name: Rawson's Retreat  Private Release Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Pale straw in colour. Lifted aromas of rock melon meld on the nose with notes of freshly peeled yellow peach. An instantly approachable wine. The creamy mid palate is supported by a tropical fruit core resulting in a wine that is structured to please.

name: Grayson Cellars  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The Grayson Chardonnay is brilliantly ripe and shows bright, brisk acidity and good minerality with notes of pineapple and apricot. The palate offers green apple fruit with a crisp finish showing gentle hints of apple pie and vanilla flavors.

name: La Spinetta   Chardonnay "Lidia" DOC
wine_color: yellow straw color with slightly green reflections
desc_en_short: It has a rich and complex bouquet, with white flowers, apple, pineapple and scents and citrus scents and vanilla and spiced notes on final. The taste is sapid and elegant, pleasant, fresh and sapid, with mineral and spiced notes on final.

name: Livon  Collio Friulano DOC
wine_color: It is straw yellow color with greenish reflections.
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: It is straw yellow color with greenish reflections. The bouquet is delicate and recalls almonds. On the palate it is tasty, medium-bodied, harmonic, it leaves the palate dry.

name: Livio Felluga  Sharis Bianco DOC
desc_en_short: bright yellow with golden reflections. Elegant notes of white and yellow flowers: jasmine, lily of the valley, golden lily and mimosa with fresh hints of lime, cherry plum and Golden apple. Lemon custard in the finish. palate of Lively, balanced and enveloping. Pleasant presence of ripe white fruit, loquat, white cherry, gooseberry and kiwi. Balsamic notes at the close and good persistence with citrus aftertaste.

name: Livio Felluga  Chardonnay DOC
desc_en_short: Straw yellow colour enriched by a refined scent that is characteristic and recalls herbs, orange skin, green citrus fruits, apple, apricot, biscuits, shortcrust pastry, yellow flowers, saffron and maraschino. Its taste is absolutely fruity and enchanting. It is characterized by sourness and freshness where you can easily recognize pineapple, pine nut and aromatic herbs.

name: Livio Felluga  Sauvignon DOC
desc_en_short: Sauvignon Colli Orientali del Friuli DOC has a pale yellow colour with green hues. The scent is marked: you can easily recognize fruity and vegetal aromas of great personality, such as litchies, elderberry, black currant, star fruit, wild sage, asparagus, lime, passion fruit, pink pepper. In the mouth it is fresh and the fruit evolves towards more pleasantly mineral hints, while maintaining a slight citrus aftertaste. We suggest to serve the wine at a temperature of 12-14 °C.

name: Livio Felluga  Illivio DOC
wine_color: The color is an intense straw yellow.
desc_en_short: The color is an intense straw yellow. The nose is intense, complex, elegant and embracing; with notes of quince, caramel, raisin, papaya, candied citrus, linden honey, Mediterranean maquis and roasted pine nuts. The palate is elegant and balanced; intriguing fusion of fruity notes mirabelle plum and medlar and buttery notes of panna cotta and cashew that fade into mineral sensations of flint and hints of nori seaweed.

name: Livio Felluga  Terre Alte DOC
wine_color: The intense straw yellow colour is the expression of a great wine.
desc_en_short: The intense straw yellow colour is the expression of a great wine. Its perfume is intense, complex and unique. It is characterized by tropical fruits like mango, passion fruit, avocado, Golden apple, vanilla, pistachio nut, lemon balm, grapefruit skin, almond. The taste is powerful, savoury, soft and structured. It recalls fruits and spices and it closes with interesting, elegant and persistent sensations that turn to balsamic.

name: Nugan  Third Generation Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Vibrant, pronounced soft stone fruit aromas with a green nettle undertone. A round mouthfeel with crisp lemon flavours and a hint of butter on the finish which balances nicely. Very fresh flavours with a soft and creamy baked lemon lingering finish. Perfect with poultry and seafood dishes.

name: Nugan  Bossy Boots' King Valley Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale straw in appearance with youthful greenish hues. Fresh, lifted aromas of lime and gooseberry followed by zesty palate of lime, grapefruit and tropical fruit with mineral accents and a crisp dry finish.

name: Ronan by Clinet  Bordeaux AOC Blanc
desc_en_short: A bright golden hue, as a pleasant introduction to a fine wine. Hints of yuzu, grapefruit, white flowers, passion fruit , a succession of  aromas, all promising freshness, elegance and complexity. Flavours of citrus, white-fleshed fruits and warm spices fill the mouth. Ronan By Clinet White is fleshy yet crisp and clean.

name: Redentore  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: Intense straw yellow colour. At the nose it has an elegant fruity aroma, with nuts and toasted almonds hints. At the taste it is elegant and fresh, with an excellent balanced minerality.

name: Santa Carolina  Cellar Selection Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This fresh Sauvignon Blanc from Chile is redolent of mint, melon and pineapple, wonderfully complemented by notes of lime and grapefruit. The Santa Carolina Cellar Selection Sauvignon Blanc is light, soft, fruity and medium-bodied on the palate, with balanced acidity.

name: Santa Carolina  Cellar Selection Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This Chardonnay from Chile is redolent of ripe tropical fruit such as melon and mango, complemented by fine citrus notes. On the palate, the wine shows a creamy structure, a stimulating, well-balanced acidity as well as a pleasant, prolonged finish.

name: Grazie Mille  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: The wine's bright straw yellow colour sets the scene for refined and delicate citrus scents, with distinct hints of green apples and pear. In the mouth, taste evolves into freshness, making this wine highly drinkable, and savory notes which make it so easy to pair with foods, and then finishes with the fragrant aroma of yellow-fleshed fruits.

name: Etienne Sauzet  Bienvenues-Batard-Montrachet Grand Cru 2015
desc_en_short: A restrained but highly complex nose features notes of ripe, pure and elegant honeysuckle, pear, apple and soft spice aromas that are trimmed in just enough wood to notice. There is excellent concentration to the equally refined and relatively powerful medium weight flavors that possess a highly seductive mouth feel before culminating in a saline and gorgeously persistent finish. Excellent upside development potential.

name: Ogier  Chateauneuf du Pape Clos de l'Oratoire des Papes Blanc
wine_color: The colour is a beautiful golden yellow with glints of green.
desc_en_short: The colour is a beautiful golden yellow with glints of green. The nose expresses the specificity of this wine, with aromas of white fruit (apple, pear), orange blossom, aniseed and lemon and woody undertones. The palate has much presence, is very fruity, with finesse, breadth and sweetness, but retaining a good balance of freshness. Ideal with fish, crayfish, pike 'quenelles' with with 'Nantua' sauce, spicy dishes, etc.

name: Batasiolo  Roero Arneis DOC
wine_color: Straw yellow with light green tinges, clear and bright.
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with light green tinges, clear and bright. The nose is fresh and fruity with typical notes of ripe pear and white flowers, mineral, good intensity and persistence. In the mouth is dry, pleasantly bitter with distinct mineral notes..

name: Batasiolo  Chardonnay "La Promessa" Langhe DOC
wine_color: Intens straw-yellow color, limpid and brilliant.
desc_en_short: Intens straw-yellow color, limpid and brilliant. Very rich bouquet with suggestions of tropical fruit. Well balanced, wide-ranging, dry with a breath of fan-shaped aroma.

name: Louis Max  Chardonnay "Les Terres Froides"  Languedoc Roussillon
desc_en_short: Intense pale gold robe Aromas of fresh grapes, exotic fruits and apple. This wine is lively, fresh and shows good minerality. This wine is perfect as an aperitif, it will also pair well with fish, shellfish and sushi.

name: Louis Max  Bourgogne Chardonnay Beaucharme
wine_color: Yellow gold brilliant robe, with beautiful green reflections.
desc_en_short: Yellow gold brilliant robe, with beautiful green reflections. A nose bursting with fresh fruits aromas, with notes honey and acacia. Well-balanced and round in the mouth, with the same fresh fruits flavors, and a lengthy finish.

name: Louis Max  Macon Villages
wine_color: Beautiful brilliant yellow robe, with green hints.
desc_en_short: Beautiful brilliant yellow robe, with green hints. Fresh fruits in the nose, especially citrus note (grapefruit lemon) with a powerful floral aroma. Dry and fresh, with a lot of fruit flavors bursting in the mouth, this is a well-balanced wine, with a good length.

name: Louis Max  Rully Les Planteneys
wine_color: Beautiful brilliant gold robe, with green reflections.
desc_en_short: Beautiful brilliant yellow robe, with green hints. Fresh fruits in the nose, especially citrus note (grapefruit lemon) with a powerful floral aroma. Dry and fresh, with a lot of fruit flavors bursting in the mouth, this is a well-balanced wine, with a good length.

name: Alois Lageder  Pinot Bianco "Haberle" DOC
wine_color: Brilliant straw-yellow colour with a green shimmer.
desc_en_short: Straw-yellow colour with a green shimmer. On the nose, fruity aromas of apples and peaches combine with very well-integrated oak spice. Elegant and medium bodied with a round and fresh, mouth-watering finish. When cellared well, this wine may be kept for three to five years.

name: Alois Lageder  Chardonnay "Gaun" DOC
wine_color: clear, bright gold-yellow with a green shimmer.
desc_en_short: This wine is clear, bright gold-yellow with a green shimmer. slightly aromatic, pronounced bouquet, fruity (apricot, mango) butter notes. medium bodied, lively, juicy, retrained opulent, dry.

name: Alois Lageder  Riff Pinot Grigio DOC
wine_color: Brilliant straw-yellow color with a green tint.
desc_en_short: Brilliant straw-yellow color with a green tint. Fine, fruity (apples, peaches), forward varietal aromas. Pronounced, clean, and elegant flavor. Light to medium-bodied with a fresh mouth-watering finish. Dry and crisp. As an aperitif or pair with salads, starters (fish, meat or vegetables), pâtés and terrines, fish and shellfish, pasta, risotto, poultry, white meat and mushrooms.

name: Damilano  Langhe Arneis DOC
desc_en_short: Straw yellow in color, the bouquet is delicate, fresh, fruity The palate is dry, fresh and elegantly harmonic with moderate acidity.

name: Fattoria di Fiorano  Fioranello Bianco
desc_en_short: Fioranello Bianco looks like a brilliant wine, with a straw yellow color and golden reflections. Consistent, with a very intense nose, fruity notes of citrus and exotic fruit, and floral like broom and orange blossom. On the palate it is dry, fresh, acid at the right point and characterized by a flavor and a minerality typical of the territory, persistent in the mouth, firm but at the same time harmonious and elegant.

name: Jermann  Traminer Aromatico DOC
wine_color: It has a rather intense and brilliant golden, straw-yellow colour
desc_en_short: It has a rather intense and brilliant golden, straw-yellow colour; its aroma is intense yet delicate, aromatic and fruity. Its taste is crisp, well-bodied, and balanced, with a slightly bitterish aftertaste characteristic of this wine.

name: Jermann  Vinnae Ribolla Gialla IGT
style: Ribolla Gialla, 5% Riesling Renano, 5% Local Grape
desc_en_short: It has a bright, pale straw shade and fruit aromas with a mineral undertone. On the palate it is dry, fresh and tangy with the unassuming elegance of an authentic country wine.

name: Mastroberardino  Radici Fiano di Avellino DOCG
desc_en_short: Straw-yellow in color with aromas of pear, pineapple, acacia, toasted nut, honey and spring flowers. On the palate, this wine has excellent acidity, yet fine smoothness, with a hint of toasted almond in the finish.

name: Monteverro  Vermentino IGT
wine_color: Pale grey with hints of mercury on the rim
desc_en_short: Vermentino is the white vine variety par excellence of the Tuscan coast, it is used to make fresh, fruity white wines with fine minerality, and with the fragrance of summer grasses and blossoms, quince and pear. For us, our Vermentino, aged exclusively in steel, is an expression of Italy’s joie de vivre - a light, delicate white wine, particularly well suited as an apéritif or to accompany seafood.

name: Paul Jaboulet  Chateauneuf du Pape "Les Cèdres" White
desc_en_short: Pale yellow color, with intense tears. On the nose emerge fruity and floral aromas, Leaving a distinctive anise aftertaste. In the mouth it feels full, with a balanced freshness and round taste.

name: Craggy Range  Riesling Te Muna Road Vineyard
desc_en_short: Pale straw with green hues. Lifted aromatics of lime, fragrant peach and citrus blossom. The precise fruit profile of ripe citrus combined with nervy acidity creates an elegant and soft mouth feel.

name: Kairos  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine is pale yellow. Intense citrus, passionfruit and honeysuckle aromas  richly layered, dry clean on the finish. Complex weight wine.

name: Argento  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: Delicate, floral aromas and tropical fruits. Light and clean on the palate with ripe pineapple and peach flavours, notes of sweet spice lead into a bright crisp finish. Perfect with Creamy pasta dishes, grilled shrimp or as an aperitif.

name: Yalumba  Samuel's Collection Eden Valley Roussanne
desc_en_short:
92 points in James Halliday

Straw green in colour. Aromas are reminiscent of walking through wild flowers; camomile, lavender, wild rose and the suggestion of a nearby bee hive. The palate is silky yet defined, with white fleshed peach, vanilla custard and cumquat layered over fresh grapefruit acidity and a fine almond meal texture with lingering hints of honeycomb. 

Enjoy with wild mushroom and thyme risotto or pumpkin and ricotta ravioli with burnt butter and sage sauce.

name: Wirra Wirra  1894 Adelaide Chardonnay
wine_color: A pale straw with green hues color.
desc_en_short: A pale straw with green hues color. Aroma of fresh peach, pear and citrus blossom. The palate of youthful and varietal chardonnay nectarines, white peaches and citrus fruits fill.

name: Wirra Wirra  The Lost Watch Riesling
wine_color: Delicate pale straw with gold and green hints.
desc_en_short: Delicate pale straw with gold and green hints. The nose leads with lemon and lime, adding notes of mandarin and orange blossom along the way. The palate is generous with fruit and pithy citrus, the wine maintains precise focus the whole length of the palate, right through to the long, mineral finish.

name: Schloss Vollrads  Kabinett Feinherb
wine_color: Pale lemon yellow with light green reflections.
desc_en_short: Pale lemon yellow with light green reflections. Fruity nose of white peach, apricot and some white flowers complemented by some honeysuckle and steely minerality. Light body with almost no impression of alcohol. Perfect balance between sweetness and acidity. Fruity and floral on the palate with white stone fruit, honey and some metallic impression that only contributes to the freshness.

name: Wirra Wirra  Scrubby Rise Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Bright, pale and clear with green highlights color.
desc_en_short: Bright, pale and clear with green highlights color. The nose of Passionfruit, gooseberry and citrus all leap out of the glass in a bouquet that is vibrant, fresh and varietal. The palate is loaded with bright, juicy lime and passionfruit, staying clean and crisp through to a finish with satisfying freshness and length.

name: Giuseppe Cortese  Langhe Chardonnay Scapulin
wine_color: Intense straw yellow with gold shadows
desc_en_short: The maturing of "Scapulin" in small barrels makes the mineral and fruity bouquet intense and complex. It is distinguished by its class and balance.

name: Conti Zecca  Luna IGP Bianco del Salento
desc_en_short: Bright yellow gold color. Intense aroma with notes of exotic fruit and vanilla. The palate is rich, savoury, with a persistent finish. Goes well with fish dishes and shellfish

name: Sutil  Reserve Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine evokes pleasing tropical fruit aromas such as banana and pineapple, along with delicate floral notes. Good balance between a lush mouthfeel and refreshing acidity.

name: Sutil  Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Outstanding fresh fruit such as pineapple and green apple along with the light touch of citrus characteristic of the variety. Balanced acidity provides freshness and persistence.

name: Copperstone Creek  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Light golden hues, this wine immediately invites you to experience the abundance of tropical, peach and citrus flavours evident on the nose. The palate won`t disappoint either, showing generous flavours of peaches, pears, mango, citrus and apple. The wine finishes long and fruity with the stone fruit flavours lingering on the tongue. This is a typical easy drinking Aussie Chardonnay sourced from the sunny Riverina area.

name: La Belle Angele  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine has a lovely pale yellow colour. With its delicate aromas of blackcurrant leaf and gooseberry, it is elegant, refreshing and aromatic.

name: Kressmann Bordeaux 'Monopole' Blanc AOC
desc_en_short: Kressmann Monopole white attracts consumers with its pale yellow colour tinged with bright green glints and tropical fruit bouquet and lemon notes. On the palate, lively character and elegance combine to create a well-structured wine, with a delicious, fresh finish.

name: Ceretto  Langhe Arneis Blange BIO DOC
wine_color: A clear straw-yellow color and a light perlage.
desc_en_short: The Blangè of Ceretto is a white obtained form Arneis grapes, with a clear straw-yellow color and a light perlage. The perfume is delicate and fuited, with notes of withe fruits , like apple and and pear particularly. The Blangè is excellent as aperitif; it copmbines perfectly with light starters, veal with tuna sauce, fresh cheeses. Besides, it is perfect if combined with sushi and sashimi.

name: Tenuta Luisa  Edmida Venezia Bianco IGT
desc_en_short: Straw yellow in colour, this wine reveals aromas of flowers and fruit with notes of green apple and lime blossoms.

name: Tenuta Luisa  Giulia Ribolla Venezia IGT
wine_color: Straw yellowStraw yellow in colour with greenish tints.
desc_en_short: Straw yellow in colour with greenish tints. It reveals a pleasant and delicate bouquet with floral notes of acacia blossoms. It has a distinctly dry, slightly citrus flavour.

name: Arnaldo Caprai  Grecante Colli Martini Grechetto DOC
desc_en_short: Intense perfumes of exotic fruit and yellow peach, floral notes of freesia and hawthorn, pleasing chalkiness on the finish. Full, fresh taste with a long persistence.

name: Tenuta Di Valgiano  Palistorti Bianco IGT
desc_en_short: Ten per cent of the Vermentino is fermented in barriques and the remainder in stainless steel at 10° C to preserve the intense and fruity aroma with a hint of pink grapefruit and leeches. It is pleasantly fresh on the palate and the acidity is balanced by considerable body. A warm but harmonious wine with ample aftertaste. A structured white in Mediterranean style, but with aromatic dignity and exceptional quality.

name: Hunky Dory  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Hunky Dory Sauvignon Blanc is a crisp Marlborough style of wine offering tropical fruit notes lined with fresh gooseberry and lime flavours. This wine has a crisp fresh lingering finish. Hunky Dory Sauvignon Blanc is designed for casual dining and can be enjoyed as a refreshing aperitif. It is excellent with salads, seafood (especially oysters) risottos.

name: Twisted  Pinot Grigio
wine_color: Straw yellow colour with coppery hues.
desc_en_short: This Pinot Grigio is a refreshing medium-‐bodied wine with delicate floral aromas of white peach, nectarine and hints of lime. Lush stone fruit flavors are enhanced by balanced acidity and a clean finish.

name: Twisted  Chardonnay
wine_color: Straw yellow colour with green hues.
desc_en_short: This Chardonnay is a medium-bodied wine, offering aromas of refreshing citrus, honeydew melon and hints of soft, toasty oak. Crisp flavors of lemon zest, apple and touches of honey and vanilla provide a full mouthfeel, leading to a rich, juicy finish.

name: Fantinel  "Borgo Tesis” Pinot Grigio DOC
wine_color: Varyingly dark straw-yellow with a copper rim
desc_en_short: Delicately coppery, bright white. The nose reveals a mixture of floral fragrances. Zesty mouthfeel and a good body. This refined wine displays balance and authenticity, like the land of its origin.

name: Fantinel  "Borgo Tesis” Verduzzo Friulano Dolce DOC
wine_color: Attractively fruity, splendid golden white wine
desc_en_short: Attractively fruity, splendid golden white wine with delicate tones of acacia blossom and a well-structured, slightly tannic palate. This is one of Friuli’s oldest grapes, the perfect dessert wine.

name: Cecilia Beretta Pinot Grigio delle Venezie Luna
wine_color: A beautiful, vibrant and lively colour.
desc_en_short: A pleasant, balanced, harmonious and fruity wine of good structure, with floral notes and hints of pear and apricot. As an aperitif or with starters, delicate first cou rse dishes, fish, white meat. To be served cold at 10-12° C

name: Conti Zecca  Donna Marzia Vermentino Bianco
desc_en_short: Bright and luminous cherry pink in colour. Delicate and pleasantly fruity aroma. Fresh, harmonious and well-structured. Paring with Italian and seafood appetisers, first courses in general, fish soup, baked fish and white meats. Savoury and elegant with a pleasant almond after-taste. Goes excellently with fish-based first and second course dishes and shellfish.

name: Wild & Wilder  The Courtesan Riesling
desc_en_short: Capturing all the mouthwatering lime and elderflower character one expects from great Riesling the Courtesan has a voluptuous palate hinting at grapefruit ripe melon and quince.

name: Wild & Wilder  The Sophisticat Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A crisp, tangy white wine with enticing floral bouquet, hints of elderflower, gooseberry and blackcurrant leaf. The palate is youthful, pithy and bright with mouthwatering grapefruit, gooseberry and grapefruit leading through to a long, refreshing finish.

name: Anselmi  San Vincenzo IGT
desc_en_short: An expressive white, creamy and lightly juicy throughout, offering flavors of blood orange granita, fresh tarragon, yellow peach and mineral, set in a light-bodied frame. The finish is juicy. Pairing with mussels sautée and other rich seafood preparations.

name: Anselmi  Capitel Croce IGT
desc_en_short: Light floral and fresh herb notes accent the flavors of white cherry, ground white pepper, apricot and orange zest. Light-bodied and fresh, with a hint of almond on the finish.

name: Navaro Lopez  Don Aurelio Verdejo
wine_color: Pale yellow color with greenish hues, clean and bright.
desc_en_short: Pale yellow color with greenish hues, clean and bright. On the nose its notes of white fruit (pear) and tropical fruit stand out, as well as balsamic vegetable notes. Citrus nuances and floral notes reappear on the palate.

name: Beaulieu Vineyard  California Chardonnay
desc_en_short: A bright notes of Meyer lemon and honey-crisp apple mingle with quince preserve and warm, spiced pear. Subtle nuances of honeysuckle and sweet almond are slowly revealed as you swirl the wine in your glass. On the palate, the full, beautifully balanced flavors mirror the aromas and then culminate in a crisp and creamy, lemon-custard finish.

name: Beringer  Private Reserve Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
WINEMAKING NOTE

Each Chardonnay lot is kept separate throughout the aging process for this flagship wine. Aftersending the fruit directly to press, the juice is fermented in 100 % French oak barrels for 10 months to enhance the natural richness in the wine. Weekly lees stirring enhanced the toasty notes and integrated the oak flavors for an overall balance. The wine is barrel fermented, and all the wine was put through malolactic fermentation to encourage a lush creaminess. After ten months aging, the most expressive lots are chosen and blended to create a richly layered wine

name: Brancaia  Sauvignon Viognier "IL Bianco"
desc_en_short: Brancaia IL BIANCO is a blend of Sauvignon Blanc with some Viognier. It is a fresh white wine with a fruity bouquet. Not having accomplished the malolactic fermentation, this wine shows a fresh acidity. It matures for 5 months on yeasts.

name: Château Larrivet Haut Brion  Le Bordeaux de Blanc
desc_en_short: "Crisp and perfumed as well as herbaceous, this is a fruity wine with lively acidity and a clean, bright aftertaste. Grapefruit and lemon flavors dominate this ready-to-drink wine."

name: M. Chapoutier  Le Petite Ruche Blanc
wine_color: Pale yellow with green lights, limpid and brilliant.
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with green lights, limpid and brilliant. Green apple, very floral, exotic fruits, citrus aromas. The attack is supple with a lot of freshness, very aromatic (floral, candied fruits).

name: M. Chapoutier  Le Granits Saints-Joseph
desc_en_short:
95 points in Wine Advocate - "Another blockbuster that savvy readers need to buy up, the 2012 Saint Joseph les Granits Blanc is a drop-dead gorgeous wine that offers up tons of crushed rock-like minerality, stone fruits, white peach and buttered citrus to go with a full-bodied, decadent, yet also elegant and focused style on the palate. Count me a fan, and while it's a great drink now, it will have an easy 15+ years of evolution."

92/100 Vinous - "Bright gold. White peach, poached pear, honey and smoky minerals on the deeply perfumed nose. Round and supple on the palate, with very good depth and clarity to the flavors of peach nectar, Meyer lemon, flowers and sweet butter. A leesy nuance builds with air and carries through a long, broad finish that repeats the floral and mineral notes. The blend of power and vivacity here is quite suave."

name: Royal Tokaji  Late Harvest (500 ml)
style: Furmint, Hrslevel, Muscat, Other Native Varietals
desc_en_short: Our Late Harvest has pale gold colour with delicate citrus and spicy aromas. Light and refreshing on the palate with hints of white peach and honey. It has an excellent acid balance, a smooth, silky texture and a clean, long, crisp finish. Serve at 12°C on its own or with foie gras. Also ideal with aromatic and spicy Asian cuisine and fresh fruits..

name: Royal Tokaji  5 Puttonyos Aszu Blue Label (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
A delightful nose of honey and peaches, delicate and graceful on the palate with traces of citrus fruit and spice. Very elegant and perfectly balances with a refreshing crisp long finish.

Enjoy at this young age or cellar for future enjoyment as the wine matures. Sip on its own as an aperitif, serve with fruit based desserts or hard cheeses or enjoy this mouth watering wine on its own instead of a dessert. Serving temperature 10° - 13°C.

name: Royal Tokaji  6 Puttonyos Aszu Gold Label (500 ml)
desc_en_short:
Rich intense nose with hints of grapefruit and spice. Full flavoured with citrus, peach and apricot fruit and a fine balance of sweetness and acidity and a long, crisp finish.

Enjoy at this young age or cellar for future enjoyment as the wine matures. Sip on its own as an aperitif, serve with fruit based desserts or hard cheeses or enjoy this mouth watering wine on its own instead of a dessert. Serving temperature 10˚ - 13˚C.

name: Dr Loosen  Blue Slate Riesling Kabinett
desc_en_short: This classic Mosel Kabinett is harvested from higher-elevation parcels owned by Dr. Loosen in the villages of Bernkastel, Graach and Wehlen. The wine is bright and pure with the vibrant white peach fruit and a floral, flinty minerality that is so typical from blue slate. A plush attack on the mid-palate leads to a deliciously firm, delicate finish. This wine makes an elegant aperitif and is an excellent match for seafood, spicy Asian cuisine and lighter dishes

name: Marques de Caceres  Albarino Deusa Nai
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Bright yellow straw colour. Fresh and floral bouquet with notes of citrus fruit and a depth of green apples. Crisp, and luscious in the mouth with a pleasant minerality and a vibrant, long-lasting finish.

name: Chateau Loudenne  White Bordeaux AOC
wine_color: Straw yellow colour, pale, green highlights.
desc_en_short: Straw yellow colour, pale, green highlights. Fine, intense, white flowers aromas, citrus aromas, peach aromas. Vibrant, powerful, peach hints, notes de noisette grillée, slight oak hints, fine tannin, good intensity, long length.

name: Chateau Loudenne  Les Folies Bordeaux Blanc
desc_en_short: Very pale, vibrant yellow color. Powerful citrus fruit, especially grapefruit and lemon. Frank palate characterized by intensity and crispness. Long finish  with citrus notes. Pairing with Pork, Vegetarian,  Poultry, Appetizers and snacks, Lean fish.

name: Chateau Loudenne  Loudenne Les Jardins Bordeaux Blancs Bio
wine_color: Golden yellow colour, limpid, golden highlights.
desc_en_short: Golden yellow colour, limpid, golden highlights. Fresh, boxwood aromas, citrus aromas. Fresh, fruit hints, very smooth on the palate.

name: Domaine des Senechaux  Chateauneuf du Pape Blanc
wine_color: Pale yellow with hints of green.
desc_en_short: The ancient vineyard of Châteauneuf-du-Pape became world famous when the Popes settled in Avignon in 1350. It later became the first French appellation d’origine in 1933 under the influence of Baron Le Roy. The Cazes family completes its range of quality vineyards by acquiring the Domaine des Sénéchaux located in the heart of prestigious Châteauneuf-du-Pape appellation.

name: Tenuta Luisa  Pinot Grigio DOC
desc_en_short: Bright straw-yellow color. The bouquet is reminiscent of crusty bread, acacia blossoms and ripe tropical fruits. On the palate it is fruity, silky, soft and round with an elegant long lasting finish. Perfect as an aperitif or with light pasta dishes, starters, ham, fresh cheese, white meat, eggs, vegetable dishes and seafood

name: Tenuta Luisa  Sauvignon DOC
desc_en_short: Its color is golden yellow. To the nose the bouquet is very fine and typical, recalls: sage, pepper and tomato leaf. It is a wine of great structure and at the same time offering excellent acidity.

name: Tenuta Luisa  Desiderium IGT
wine_color: At the sight of straw yellow with golden reflections.
desc_en_short: At the sight of straw yellow with golden reflections. On the nose it present slight vanilla and citrus notes. On the mouth it is structured, full bodied with a persistent aftertaste.

name: Vicus Orbis  Varietal Plus Chardonnay
wine_color: A bright and golden yellow color.
desc_en_short: Our Chardonnay has a bright and golden yellow color. Intense aromas of banana, pineapple and hints of vanilla. It has a great persistence and a fresh harmony. Great with fish, seafood and creamy pasta dishes.

name: Vicus Orbis  Varietal Plus Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Our Sauvignon Blanc has an intense yellow color. The wine features aromas of gooseberries fruit, with hints of peach and lemon. The finish is crispy and fresh with good balance. It matches appetizers, fresh or cooked seafood green salads.

name: La Soufrandiere  Macon-Vinzelles  "le Clos de Grand Pere"
desc_en_short:
Our MÂCON-VINZELLES « Le CLOS DE GRAND PÈRE » is our Pouilly-Vinzelles La Soufrandière’s younger brother and comes from a plot belonging to our maternal Grand-Father. The vines – aged 50 on average- lay on the lower part of the Pouilly-Vinzelles slope.

They form a very old « clos » on a rocky vein of hard limestone. The terroir is asserting itself. The 2007 is not as rich as the 2006 but is full of fruit and elegance. Merci Grand-Père !

name: La Soufrandiere  Saint-Veran "la Bonnode"
desc_en_short: Neighbor to “Combe DesRoches,” “La Bonnode” is a superb parcel of 2 hectares, facing east at the foot of the Roche de Vergisson. The vines are mostly bordered by old brush: a sheltered, isolated situation that allows us to biodynamically cultivate the vines with ease. Working in this parcel, we can see across the Saône Valley all the way to the Mont Blanc in the distance to the east.

name: La Soufrandiere  Saint-Veran "la Combe DesRoches"
desc_en_short: We acquired this beautiful parcel of about 1.5 hectares in 2016. Located at the foot of the Roche de Vergisson, on the north-facing hillside of a stunning valley, its soils of marl and clay are ideal for Chardonnay. The grapes achieve lovely ripeness despite this cooler terroir. A terroir for the future.

name: La Soufrandiere  Pouilly-Vinzelles  “la Soufrandiere”
desc_en_short: The Pouilly-Vinzelles appellation contrôlée has only 50 ha under vines (123 acres) in comparison to neighbouring POUILLY-FUISSÉ’s 750 ha (1850 acres). Isn’t it its singularity and richness? It goes without saying that this great white Burgundy wine is a full expression of a mature Chardonnay from Southern Mâconnais. Our wine is a blend of our « young vines » (23 to 48 years old) in the « Les Quarts », simply rechristened as a village AOC Pouilly-Vinzelles La Soufrandière. They are all facing south-east, in the middle part of the slope of clay and limestone. The soils are ploughed and vineyard work is carried out by hand to avoid tamping down the soil. The soil is really alive without any additives. The word « Terroir » really makes sense! The expression of fruit is seductive, full of charm.

name: La Soufrandiere  Pouilly-Vinzelles Climat “les Longeays”
desc_en_short: As for our vines in the Climat « Les Quarts », our plot « Les Longeays » faces South-East in mid-slope, but the soil is deeper. That character gives early maturity to the grapes here, year after year. Great ageing potential!

name: Domaine des Remizières  Crozes-Hermitage Blanc cuvée Particuière
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: Made from 100% Marsanne that was aged ten months in a combination of foudre and demi-muids. It’s a wine that offers crisp citrus blossom, mint and honeyed minerality in a medium-bodied, juicy, refreshing, yet length style.

name: Domaine Hubert Brochard  Domaine Brochard Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Sauvignon Blanc Les Carisannes shows classic aromas and flavors of citrus, fresh herbs, and minerals. This Vin de Pays du Val de Loire is lighter in weight and texture than Sancerre but its fresh and fruity character make it a delicious wine for warm-weather refreshment and simple food pairings.

name: Roccolo Grassi  Soave La Broia
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: A wine featuring nice aromatic complexity, powerful, fine, enjoyable freshness and minerality. Mineral notes , white flowers, peach are perceived on the nose. In the mouth Soave La Broia is fresh, tasty, and white flowers and fruit are present yet again.

name: Xanadu  Stevens Road Chardonny
desc_en_short: 97 points by James Halliday AM - Wine Critic - "Whole-bunch pressed, wild-fermented in French barriques (25% new), no mlf, matured for 9 months. Its Reserve sibling has the complexity that this adroitly sidesteps, contesting its own ground with feline grace, every part of its body precisely shaped and weighted, leaving the palate with an airy freshness that will never tire you."

name: Domaine des Bernadins  Muscat de Beaumes de Venise Blanc (375 ml)
style: Muscat à Petits Grains Blancs : 75 % Muscat à Petits Grains Noirs : 25 %
desc_en_short: Butterscotch, glazed fruits aroma. The palate is rich and runs with surprising freshness after the opening. There is a note of quince paste on the aftertaste, also herbes de Provence.

name: Domaine des Bernadins  Muscat de Beaumes de Venise Blanc
style: Muscat à Petits Grains Blancs : 75 % Muscat à Petits Grains Noirs : 25 %
desc_en_short: Butterscotch, glazed fruits aroma. The palate is rich and runs with surprising freshness after the opening. There is a note of quince paste on the aftertaste, also herbes de Provence.

name: Domaine Jacques Prieur  Montrachet Grand Cru Blanc
wine_color: Luminous green gold and scintillating silver reflections.
desc_en_short:
TERROIR

Very sunny, located halfway up the slope, with perfect drainage. East-by-Southeast sun exposure. Thin, stony, sodium-rich soil. White marl outcrops.

VINIFICATION & AGEING

Whole bunches of grapes were handpicked into small crates and pressed in a pneumatic winepress. The juice was cold settled after pressing for 12-14 hours under temperature-controlled conditions. Alcoholic fermentation and ageing took place entirely in oak barrels. 100% malolactic fermentation Duration of barrel ageing : 21 months

name: Domaine Fontaine-Gagnard  Criots Batard Montrachet
desc_en_short:
92 points vinous.com

"The 2020 Criots-Bâtard-Montrachet Grand Cru was picked on the first day of the harvest. It has a well defined, quite stony, austere bouquet that will benefit from 3-4 years in bottle. The palate is powerful on the entry with orange rind and apricot notes, quite spicy with good weight on the finish that leaves the mouth tingling on the aftertaste for 45+ seconds .Very fine."

name: Domaine Fontaine-Gagnard  Le Montrachet
desc_en_short: The 2022 Montrachet Grand Cru is the only cuvée in two one-year-old barrels. I don't think it needs new oak. There is real energy and complexity here, orange pith and lemon verbena, touches of lemon curd. The palate is beautifully balanced with great depth and power, far more than the Bâtard-Montrachet. It has a beguiling length and precision, velvety smooth, with a hint of walnut on the finish. Divine.

name: Domaine Ponsot  Corton Charlemagne
wine_color: Pale gold when young, with glints of green
desc_en_short: Corton-Charlemagne's powerful bouquet, its richness and distinguished character present a remarkable acidity, perfectly controlled by a well-rounded opulence on the palate, that should be paired with noble, delicate dishes, which are also powerful and aromatic. Natural candidates would be foie gras, whose slight bitterness will be framed by the wine's minerality and power, or, more classically, crustaceans, such as lobster, crayfish or crab, whose delicate yet flavourful flesh produces a spectacular harmony... Poultry and veal in white sauce also make a delicious combination, as do blue cheeses. Serving temperatures: 12 to 14°C.

name: Domaine Leflaive  Batard Montrachet Grand Cru
desc_en_short: The 2022 Bâtard-Montrachet Grand Cru is more muscular than the Bienvenues, exhibiting notes of sweet orchard fruit and peach mingled with clear honey, toasted nuts and flowers. Full-bodied, satiny and textural, with good depth and grip, it's more layered and powerful.

name: Domaine Leflaive  Chevalier Montrachet Grand Cru
desc_en_short:
WINE MAKING

Biodynamic.
Manual harvesting with grape sorting and optimisation of choice of date through parcel-by-parcel ripeness monitoring.

name: Alphonse Mellot  La Moussiere Sancerre Blanc
wine_color: Very fine gold colour with a green sheen.
desc_en_short: Predominantly honest in a welcoming balance, it reflects a pretty grape, a fine harvest in the singing and laughter of the men and women pickers. It tells us of work well done in the divine order and Nature's kindness. It is fair, and all one expected and to cap it all there is happiness there.

name: Alphonse Mellot  La Demoiselle Sancerre Blanc
desc_en_short: La Demoiselle, a cuvee from a deep flinty clay terroir on the peak of Sancerre, in the heart of the appellation. This Biodynamic Sauvignon with a distinctly creamy character. This is deep and rich, with flavours of pink grapefruit, gunflint and oak. Serve at ten degrees with shellfish.

name: Klumpp  Grauburgunder
desc_en_short: Pinot gris redefined: firm, vital, full of apricot whispers. Refreshingly quiet, silky, elegant, completely degreased. Ripe yellow pear, quince jelly, a little cavaillon melon: a sip into the pulp puts a smile on your face! Wonderfully energetic, uncompromisingly stimulating, extremely tasty to drink. A subtle salty kick lurks in the juicy finish

name: La Biòca  Cyrogrillo Langhe Rossesse Bianco DOC
desc_en_short:
Straw yellow with greenish reflections in color. characteristic, fruity on aromas. The palate is dry, soft and harmonious. Good as an aperitif, it goes well with
shellfish, fish in general and with medium-aged cheeses.

name: Perticaia  Umbria Grechetto IGT
wine_color: Straw yellow with typical golden reflections.
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with typical golden reflections in colour. Recall fruits such as yellow peaches, apricots, and camomile, embellished with hints of citrus aromas. The palate is an optimum structure with a tannin finish and taste intensity. Food pairing excellenty accompanies first courses of sauces, pizzas, soups and fresh, soft cheese.

name: Perticaia  Del Posto Spoleto DOC
wine_color: Intense straw yellow with golden reflections
desc_en_short: Intense straw yellow with golden reflections in colour. Wine of great complexity and finesse. Intense citrus scents with floral notes and acacia flowers, chamomile, honey and flint. During the aging in bottle it acquires hints of hydrocarbons. Wide and very sapid. Great acidic structure well balanced with the other scents. It goes well with tasty cold cuts, fish soups, first courses such as spaghetti carbonara or tagliatelle with truffles, white meats and grilled vegetables. Excellent also with cheese.

name: Rochester  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Medium,full-bodied Chardonnay in the Chablis Style, This is a fruit driven wine.Redolent of flavors of citrus and stone fruit,with hints of minerality Yellow green in colour. Citrus and vanilla on nose and palate. Crisp and elegant with a long finish with subtle hins of wood.

name: Rhanleigh  Chenin Blanc
desc_en_short: Yellow lime green colour. Guava with hints of fresh straw on nose. Rich,racy and full on middle palate with great finish.

name: Leeuwin Estate  Art Series Chardonnay
desc_en_short: 97 points in Wine Advocate - "The 2021 Art Series Chardonnay leads with a distinctly floral nose: jasmine and white garden rose, wisteria and lemon blossom. The season was a challenging one in Margaret River, defined by the rainfall, which was constant. The temperatures were modest (not cool, as plenty of rain might suggest),and given that the region is so diverse in terms of distances between vineyard areas, this created quite a patchwork of outcomes for producers. On the palate, the wine is powerful and savory—it leans heavily on exotic dry spice and cracked honeycomb, with hints of salted butter on fresh white bread, beeswax and salted pink grapefruit. Stylistically, it is not dissimilar to the 2017; however, the dovetailing of acid and fruit feels seamless and well matched here. The wine is piercing and structural, tightly coiled and almost rigid, in the best of ways. It's an impressive wine, one that, at this stage of its life, is defined by its penetrating acid line. Sealed under screw cap."

name: Leeuwin Estate  Art Series Riesling
desc_en_short:
90 points in Wine Enthusiast - "Tasted blind, this wasn't particularly different from the other Rieslings in its flight, which were predominantly South Australian. It's got those same wet stone and citrus tendencies and is made in the same medium-bodied, dry, high-acid style. There's a touch of pineapple as well, plus a long, dry crisp finish.

90 points in Wine Advocate - "From 40-year-old original plantings, the 2015 Riesling Art Series is very pretty on the nose with honeysuckle, peach blossom and lime cordial notes, as well as a touch of anise. Light-bodied and dry, with great intensity, this wine has approachable softness and great length."

93 points in James Suckling - "This is a long time favorite for Australian riesling with stone, flint and spice character. Lemon, lime. Medium to full body, fruity and crisp. A beauty as always. Fresh. Super peppermint at finish. Screw cap. Drink now or hold."

name: Leeuwin Estate  Art Series Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A lively fruit spectrum of lemon, lime curd, guava and quince meet with heightened floral notes, compleing thyme and sweet spice. A tight, yet finely tetured and layered palate, bright lemon and lime dominate throughout with hints of white nectarine. A tight line of natural acidity gives definition and is complementary to the length of concentrated fruit.

name: Leeuwin Estate  Siblings Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Bright and floral with a myriad of primary fruits, that features white peach, green melon, just plucked passionfruit, lime zest and lemon curd. The perfumed floral lift is noted with subtle elderflower and white jasmine. Nuances of a touch of nettle, vanilla and cardamom pod creates both depth and complexity. Finely focussed, the palate opens to soft and supple middle and is underpinned by a taught and fresh finish. Layers of lemon, lime, guava, fig, quince and green apple feature throughout with delicate floral and savoury notes laced between. Overall a youthful and vibrant blend.

name: Valdubon  Verdejo
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short:
Valdubón Verdejo is made entirely with Verdejo grape. The original vineyards are found in different areas of the DO Rueda, the main plantations being located in the terms of La Seca, Olmedo and Ventosa.

Valdubón Verdejo is made with part of grapes fermented in a traditional way in stainless steel tanks and part of grapes fermented in barrels. Trellised vines with an average age of 12 years and with a pressing yield of less than 72% were chosen for the tank production. For its part, for the fermentation in barrels, old dry-land vines older than 25 years and with a glass conduction system were selected, obtaining the must with a maximum yield of 60%.

In both cases, a strict monitoring of ripening was carried out, focusing efforts on controlling yields and ripening to ensure that the fruit was collected in perfect condition.

name: Bouchard Pere & Fils  Pouilly Fuisse
desc_en_short: Delicate bouquet with fruit and floral notes. A very perfumed, silky and elegant wine. To be drunk preferably in its youth for its freshness. Pair with Freshwater fish, shellfish, pâtés et terrines.

name: Kimi  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine is elegant example exhibiting aromas of lime juice, kiwi and blackcurrant over a layer of tropical fruits. Juicy and crisp with soft structure packed with green herb, lime and nectarine flavours. A perfect accompaniment to fresh oysters but equally enjoyable with all seafood, chicken and Asian dishes or simply on its own with friends.

name: Valley of Spies  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Elegant mineral and tropical avours combine with crisp acidity to make a very balanced and delicious wine.

name: William Fevre  Chablis AOC
desc_en_short: Combining lovely fruitiness with an attractive freshness and characteristic minerality, Chablis is a wine region with global renown. Domaine William Fèvre’s vineyards sit on Kimmeridgian subsoil and enjoy ideal exposures for the production of a very fine wine.

name: Castelli del Grevepesa  Elianto Vermentino Toscana IGT
wine_color: Deep, bright yellow with green hues
desc_en_short: Deep, bright yellow with green hues, intense fragrance of white flowers, elegant aroma with pleasant, intense fruity notes of white peach. Balanced and well-structured flavour, sapid, evident mineral, tangy and persistent notes with a pleasant hint of almond.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mapu Gran Reserva Chardonnay
wine_color: Glittering yellow with muted green highlights in colour
desc_en_short: Glittering yellow with muted green highlights in colour. The intense nose reveals pear, lychee and peach aromas as well as lightly toasted hazelnut notes that come from time spent in used French oak barrels. The powerful attack leads into a substantial, rich and succulent mid-palate, while the long finish reveals good acidity on fruit flavours, especially lychee, and delicate notes of oak.

name: Bodega Norton  Barrel Select Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Greenish yellow with golden hues. Aromas of green apples and tropical fruit. Complexity given by notes of vanilla, coconut, toast and a smoked touch.

name: Pike & Joyce  Separe Gruner Veltliner
style: Gruner Veltliner (100% Adelaide Hills Gi – Estate Grown Single Vineyard Wine. )
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: A crisp and dry white wine with stone fruit and typical Gruner peppery/rocket-like notes. Texture, soft acid and fruit richness on the finish adds length and structure.

name: Elderton  ‘E Series’ Chardonnay
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short: Elderton E Series Chardonnay is a medium bodied, crisp, subtle wine. Medium straw, light gold color. Aromas of peach, melon, and mango. A deliciously rich, balanced and uncomplicated Chardonnay.

name: Mount Mary  Chardonnay
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish
desc_en_short:
Gold in colour, it’s not a shy Chardonnay by half: welcome to Flavour Country. Nectarine, white flowers, fresh mint, honey and pecans, and just a pleasant amount of struck match complexity. Glossy and glycerol, sizzled butter and nuts, yet fresh and floral, flinty elements at play, grapefruity acidity, long, rich and nutty to close, yet curiously fine throughout. Love this. Real Chardonnay. I reckon it’s pretty good drinking ’round about now, too.

96 POINTS - WINE FRONT!

name: Artero  Macabeo Verdejo
wine_color: Pale lemon colour with brass metallic tints.
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Pale lemon color with brass metallic tints. Intense fruit aroma combining apricot, pear and citrus fruits with floral notes. Ample, fresh with a rich flavor. Bal- anced and persistent. Excellent acidity.

name: Flowers Camp Meeting Ridge Chardonnay 2018
desc_en_short:
92 Points by Wine Advocate

The 2018 Chardonnay Camp Meeting Ridge has pretty aromas of flint, roasted almonds, white peaches and beeswax. The palate is light-bodied, fresh and gently savory with a long, delicate finish.

90 Points by Wine Spectator

Fruity, featuring honeydew melon and quince paste flavors that are richly spiced. Pear tart and pastry notes linger on the finish, with accents of preserved citrus.

name: Flowers Sonoma Coast Chardonnay 2018
desc_en_short:
93 Points Wine Enthusiast

Bursting with fresh, salty acidity, this appellation wine conjures the coast from which it comes, offering beguilingly soft layers of elegant richness. Apple, pear, nutmeg and a whiff of lemon meringue play well on the palate, with plenty of length and breadth to impress.

92 Points Wine Spectator

Lithe and juicy, featuring well-framed flavors of pear, apple and ripe melon, packed with fresh acidity. Pastry and allspice notes show on the engaging finish, accented by hints of dried savory. Drink now through 2024.

90 Points Wine Advocate

The 2018 Chardonnay Sonoma Coast has pretty aromas of white peach, candle smoke, toast and flinty touches with an uplift of floral perfume. The palate is light-bodied and fresh with restrained fruits and a mineral-driven finish.

name: Forman Chardonnay 2020
desc_en_short: The first impression with both aromatics and flavor is fresh, stony and a touch reserved. One can tell more is to come. Deeper notes of pear, green apple and a touch of citrus emerge. No wood up front, only fresh yeasty fermentation/fruit aromas are present at first. The wine seriously evolves with aeration and a little warming in the glass. The first sip, and wow, this is the sappy fruity freshness I am always so eager to achieve. One sip begs another; no heaviness or blunt over-ripeness here. Maybe a touch of barrel in the background but definitely only as an additional aroma/flavor, never dominating, only enhancing. What a wonderful food accompaniment.

name: Bouchard Père & Fils  La Vignee Chardonnay AOC
wine_color: Pale gold colour with green shades.
desc_en_short: Pale gold colour with green shades. Very aromatic bouquet marrying candied citrus, white fruits and flowers. Fresh, round and silky to the palate. Pairing with Snails - Seafood - Fried fish.

name: Tobias Lexi's Estate Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Crafted from 100% Sauvignon Blanc, off the family’s estate vineyards in Mendocino, the cool climate is reflective throughout this wine. On the nose, a brightness of citrus, green apple, and tropical fruit lead into subtle hints of vanilla. The wine bursts on the palate, notes of white peach, ripe honeydew melon, fresh green apple, passion fruit, and Meyer lemon unfold with a creamy mouth-feel leading into a long, lasting, finish.

name: Masi  Modello Pinot Grigio delle Venezie
desc_en_short: A delicate wine, full of floral notes, with a crisp acidity which makes it fresh and pleasing. ideal as an aperitif, perfect with antipasti, risottos and pastas with light sauces. This wine gets on marvellously with fish, white meats and vegetable dishes.

name: Woolshed  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Peach, nectarine and pineapple aromas, and hints of nutmeg. Rich and creamy, with ripe fruit-salad flavours, filling the mouth with impressions of peach, custard-apple, cream and pie crust.

name: Woolshed  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Very pale straw with a fresh lime green tinge
