desc_en_short: Very pale straw with a fresh lime green tinge. Herbaceous with fresh rocket and coriander leaf and with lime and kiwifruit aromas. Delicious, savoury and fruity with lemongrass, lime, feijoa and kiwifruit. Light bodied and zingy.

name: Santa Julia  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: This Pinot Grigio has delightful, ripe fruit aromas of pears, apple, melon, and some tropical notes of pineapple and banana. It has good balance, nice acidity, and a long, fresh finish.

name: Les Volets  Chardonnay
wine_color: The wine is bright yellow with greenish tints.
desc_en_short: Bright acidity gives way to green apple and brioche notes. Older oak barrels have added texture and given a toasted hazlenut twist. For those looking for a high quality Chardonnay, this punches well above its weight.

name: The Last Stand  Chardonnay
wine_color: The wine is light straw color with light greenish-golden highlights.
desc_en_short: This always shows prominent tangerine notes on the nose, and this vintage also shows intense pineapple, lime and hints of spice. Refreshingly unoaked, citrus and white peach flavours combine with a zesty fresh acidity and a clean, bright finish.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mouton Cadet Selection Bordeaux Blanc
desc_en_short: The nose is elegant and fresh, expressing citrus and tropical Sauvignon freshness and rich Semillon fruit. Soft pear, grass and citrus flavors dominate the palate with light mineral flavor and a vibrant, refreshing finish.

name: Wynns  Coonawarra  Estate Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Wynns Coonawarra Estate Chardonnay demonstrates that Coonawarra offers a suitable environments for both fine whites as well a premium red wines. The long ripening season from Coonawarra’s cool southerly climate produces Chardonnay with excellent varietal character. Poached pear and stone fruit characters balance the soft natural acidity. Underlying complex barrel ferment characters present an elegant, beautifully balanced Chardonnay that will continue to develop with short-term cellaring.

name: Lindeman's  Gentleman Collection Chardonnay
wine_color: Pale to gold straw in colour.
desc_en_short: Pale to gold straw in colour. Fresh aromas of stone fruit, fruit salad, honey dew and cantaloupe with a hint of toasty oak. Medium bodied palate; peach and nectarine with a hint of nutty oak, creamy, soft and flavoursome with balanced acidity.

name: B.R.Cohn  Silver Label Chardonnay Russian River Valley
desc_en_short: Bright citrus, stone fruit and tropical melon notes are surrounded by a creamy, toasted oak finish. Bright acidity and a smooth mouthfeel are a dynamic duo on the palate.

name: Cable Bay  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Brioche, lemon blossom, fresh nectarine and a 'struck match' flintiness embellish the nose. Fine phenolic texture and a mineral acidity form the building blocks of a charming palate. Impressive fruit concentration and creamy mid-palate weight create a wonderful generous mouthfeel, defined and focused by the aforementioned structure to provide a wine with incredible presence and persistence.

name: San Pedro  Gato Negro Moscato
desc_en_short: Intense flowery and citrus aromas with sweet tones. Sweet with a pleasant acidity that balances and gives freshness to it, aromas that remind of ripe peaches and apricots leading to a pleasant final persistence.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Meursault "Narvaux"
desc_en_short:
The Domaine Jean Fery et Fils is a Domaine of nearly 14 Hectares in Burgundy. Reflecting the diversity of the region, the Domaine cultivates a mosaic of appellations, a true palette of tastes on both red and white wines from the Cote d'Or : from Gevrey-Chambertin, from the Cote de Nuits to the Puligny-Montrachet, from the Cote de Beaune.

They never hesitate to innovate the new techniques or equipment such as “new barrels, if they can prove to be beneficial to the wine ; quality is priceless” The vineyards are farmed according to the principles of organic farming (the domaine has been certified by ECOCERT since 2011), which requires a great deal of dedicatioins and physical labor. Everyone who works at the Domaine are linked by a passion for wine, for nature, and for winetasting. Their method is to please one another and themselves. They do this by proposing wines, of which they are proud, and by working together in a joyful atmosphere. This is a Domaine which places its confidence in nature, in people, and their competence.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Meursault 1er Cru "Les Boucheres"
desc_en_short:
DOMAINE JEAN FÉRY & FILS is a family-run winery located in the beautiful village of Échevronne between Beaune and Nuits-Saint- Georges. The vineyards span over 14 hectares (34 acres) from the north to the south of Burgundy in famous appellations.

Jean-Louis took over his parents'estate in 1988 and made his childhood dream come true: providing the family estate with the means to develop further by performing the necessary construction work and investments while purchasing new vineyards. He now dedicates all his time to the vineyards. The vineyards are farmed according the principles of organic farming (they have been certified by ECOCERT since 2011), which requires a great deal of dedication and physical labor. Jean-Louis organizes the work of the laborers in every plot of the estate all year long. His unwavering love for Burgundy’s terroirs leads him to constantly acquire new vineyards in order to enrich the estate’s range of growing areas... and to give everyone pleasure...

The estate is now in the hands of Jean-Louis’s sons, Frédéric and Laurent Féry.

name: Domaine Jean Fery & Fils  Puligny-Montrachet "les Nosroyes"
desc_en_short: The village of Puligny-Montrachet is known throughout the world for its great white wines from the Chardonnay grape variety. It is in particular the cradle of the Grands Crus Montrachet, Chevalier-Montrachet, Bâtard- Montrachet and Bienvenues-Bâtard-Montrachet.

name: Bret Brothers  Pouilly-Fuisse Cuvee "Terres de Vergisson"
desc_en_short: Our Pouilly-Fuissé « Terres de Vergisson » comes from the undoubtedly most mineral village of the Appellation. Oh yes, one more Pouilly-Fuissé on top of the other two we produce in this fine sector. Let yourselves be guided by the mineral tension of the wine, almost a vibrant tension as if it was echoing the rocky circus sheltered by the Roches de Solutré and Vergisson. 2008 is an honest seducer. Fruit, minerality… A great wine.

Torresella  Pinot Grigio Venezia Doc
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese

name: Birchgrove  Bird'S Block Cuvee "Elegant White" (Fruit Wine)
Jump Yards  Cellar Blend Cool White (Fruit Wine)
Outstation Vineyards  Semillon Sauvignon Blanc
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish

name: Voyager Estate  Sauvignon Blanc Semillon
desc_en_short:
An extended warm and dry period
following reasonable winter rains and an early bud burst.
The season experienced warmer-than-usual temperatures,
promoting even and early ripening. Harvesting commenced
early and finished before Easter. The white varieties were picked
with great ripeness, fruit flavour, and vibrant acidity.

food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish

name: Terranoble  Gran Reserva Las Dichas Chardonnay Casablanca Valley
food_matching: Lobster, Creamy Pasta, Roasted Chicken, Rich Fish

name: Anura  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A Sauvignon Blanc with mineral, grassy, green fig tones combined with pineapple, lemon, and granadilla, grapefruit flavours. This wine has a fresh, crispy acidity, which is supported by well-rounded juicy, refreshing palate. Beautifully paired with canapes, salads, seafood, poultry, sushi and fresh fruits.

name: Pour Le Vin  Avoir la Pêche Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Expressive Chardonnay with the perfect balance of density, texture and freshness. The result is very pure and bright, with an attractive orange blossom nose and a harmonious, rich and peachy palate.

name: Antech  IGP Pays d OC Chardonnay
desc_en_short: The Limoux area is an ideal place to produce beautiful Chardonnay, with climate alternateing between cool and summer heat, the clay/limestone soil, the height and age of the vineyards and expert wine-making skills all contribute to this vivid expression. Fresh and clean on the pallet a bouquet of white flowers and tropical fruits, this Chardonnay is full of flavour and satisfaction.

name: Chauvet Freres  AOP Pouilly Fuisse
desc_en_short: Contains fruity nose of peach and lemon mixed with lighter notes of jasmine and acacia. Mineral and buttery touches subtly complete this palette. The mineral tension, coming from the best limestone terroirs, forms the backbone of the wine. Around it the fructification and the roundness of the Pouilly clay soils are articulated. Wide and fresh attack, continues in a salty finish.

name: Terra Costantino  De Aetna Etna Bianco
desc_en_short: Made of Carricante 80%, Catarratto 15%, Minnella 5%, this blend is an inviting, delicately fragranced, medium-bodied white wine with a yellow hue featuring supple aromas and flavors of fresh citrus and savory herbs. Pairs well with fish or fowl, risotto and a range of international cuisines.

name: Tournon  Victoria Viognier Marsanne
desc_en_short:
A classic northern Rhone style white wine with
uplifting flavors of orange blossom, stone fruits, and
herbal finish.

name: Pa Road  Marlborough Sauvignon Blanc
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese

name: Masseria Borgo Dei Trulli  Ficheto Bianco Puglia IGP (750 ml)
desc_en_short: Aromas of citrus fruit, peaches and acacia flowers in perfect balance with the sweet and spicy notes of vanilla. Subtle and vibrant and elegant, characterized by mineral sensations and light notes of tropical fruit. Paring with pasta dishes with fish, white meat & on its own.

name: E'Got  Trebbiano Chardonnay (750 ml)
wine_color: Clear, straw yellow in color with a hint of green.
desc_en_short: Fresh scent, pleasant and delicately fruity aroma. Fresh taste, harmonic, slips down easily. Goes well with light first dishes, fish courses and cold dishes.

name: Kobe Wine  Extra White (750 ml)
desc_en_short: A slightly dry wine aged in French Oak barrels with spicy accents like white pepper and lemon peel. It has an aromas of apple and tropical fruits, white flowers.

name: Anakena  Nuna Chardonnay
wine_color: Clear and bright with a beautiful pale straw colour.
desc_en_short: An intensity aromatic and highly refreshing wine that opens with notes of mango, melon and honey with vanilla notes. The palate is rich smooth and balanced.

name: Penfolds  Yattarna Bin 144 Chardonnay
wine_color: Very pale, vibrant, glistening straw with green hues
desc_en_short:
Launched in 1998 with the 1995 vintage, Yattarna is the result of one of the most comprehensive, focused and highly publicised wine development projects ever conducted in Australia. The aspiration and independence of ind across generations of Penfolds winemakers inspired the ambition to create a white wine that would set the standard for ultra-fine Australian chardonnay Very pale straw colour. Bright aromatic fruit underlayed with mineral notes and layered, textural oak.

Awards.

  • 97 Points - Wine Advocate
  • 97 point - Decanter
  • 95 Points - James Suckling
  • 95 point - Vinous

name: Bodegas Granbazan  Contrapunto Albarino
wine_color: Pale, limpid and bright yellow color.
desc_en_short: Pale, limpid and bright yellow color. Medium high aromatic intensity, fresh and lively, the nose shows tropical and citrus notes of orange peel, in turn it is slightly floral with hints of fresh grass.In the mouth it is tasty and electric, its slight sweetness harmonizes the nervous acidity. It is a light-bodied wine with a smooth and pleasant finish of medium persistence.

name: Cuatro Mill  Discolo Blanco
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Yellow color, with aromatic complexity, reminiscent of pineapple, with slight nuances of spices and roasted, in the mouth the freshness of fruits again appears with a lot of volume, the main characteristic.

name: Glenbrook  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Our Sauvignon Blanc opens with a slightly creamy yet tart mouth feel. The ripe flavors of pineapples, limes, kiwis, and melon culminate before finishing with a crisp fresh peeled tangerine zest.

name: Alto Las Rocas Verdejo Sauvignon Blanc
food_matching: Seafood, Oysters, Salad, Light Fish, Goat Cheese
desc_en_short: Clean and bright, pale yellow with hints of green. Medium intensity, with clear tropical aromas such as pineapple and mango,notes of green apple with an aniseed aftertaste. a strong fruity character.

name: Bertani  Le Quaiare Lugana DOC
desc_en_short: Fresh and crisp, mineral-driven, single-vineyard Lugana. It boasts subtle aromas of wild honeyand blanched white pear,  complex finish.

name: Naudin Père & Fils  Chablis
desc_en_short: It's remarkably aromatic, with flavours of mango, peach and citrus. It has a freshness which is great with seafood.

name: Duckhorn  Decoy Limited Sonoma Coast Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Graceful, pure and polished, this enticing Chardonnay offers tantalizing aromas of green apple, nectarine and candied citrus, with fragrant hints of roasted nuts and acacia blossoms. On the palate, it is rich and lushly textured, with a flowing elegance that frames the fresh citrus and stone fruit flavors, while carrying the wine to a long, silky finish.

name: Cartlidge & Browne  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This wine is light gold appearance with aromas of straw, lemon, and oak tones of sweet caramel and hazelnut. The palate is full and rounded yet crisp and fresh with flavours of pear, melon and light citrus tones. Try with seafood, grilled chicken or pork, or pasta with creamy sauce.

name: Domaine de la Motte  Chablis Premier Cru 'Vau Ligneau'
desc_en_short: Pale straw yellow. Light butterscotch and peaches on the nose. angerine, sweet citrus and really mineral and toast flavours on the palate, plenty of fresh acidity, Long lingering finish.

name: Domaine de la Motte  Chablis Premier Cru 'Beauroy'
desc_en_short: Pale straw yellow. A rich, rounded style, this has aromas of buttered toast yet with classic mineral tones, and fresh lemon on the finish.

name: Domaine de Pellehaut  Harmonie De Gascogne Blanc
wine_color: Clear in color, limpid with a green tint
desc_en_short: Clear in color, limpid with a green tint, this wine reveals notes of exotic fruits such as mango and passion fruit. On the palate, the liveliness of passion awakens our taste buds, counterbalanced by the sweetness of apricot. It will delight you with its natural balance. It will go wonderfully with your seafood and white meat dishes.

name: Bouchard Père & Fils  Reserve Chardonnay AOC
wine_color: Pale gold colour with green shades.
desc_en_short: This very solid Burgundian chardonnay has a generous body that's well filled out with lemon curd character. Bright apple and pear notes develop on the nose with a little aeration in the glass. Nice balance of creaminess and lemony freshness at the forthright finish.

name: Albert Bichot  Domaine Long-Depaquit  Chablis 1er Cru "Les Vaillons"
desc_en_short: Very precise floral notes on the nose followed by subtle notes of oak and fresh fruit. Good structure on the palate. This wine is tangy, well balanced and already showing the lovely fullness one would expect from a Premier Cru. A combination of linden blossom and almond give way to a long, rounded finish.

name: Albert Bichot  Domaine Long-Depaquit  Chablis 1er Cru "Fourchaume"
desc_en_short:
This wine has a bouquet of both mineral and floral. It is also amazing due to its fat aspect associated with good acidity on the finish.

This wine eminently suitable for seafood (seafood, fish and Saint-Jacques) and the sausage brioche, snails and
white meats.

name: La Chablisienne  Chablis 1er Cru Vaillons
wine_color: Pale yellow in colour, limpid and brilliant with some silver reflections.
desc_en_short:
Pale yellow in colour, limpid and brilliant with some silver reflections.
Discreet and fine on the nose. Delicate floral notes (lily, lilac) as well as vanilla notes appear after a few seconds.
Full and rich in the mouth. Nicely fruity and very juicy.
Notes of lemon and zest appear in retro-olfaction bringing energy, freshness and a beautiful aromatic persistence.
The whole is balanced, fine and mineral with good aging potential.

name: La Chablisienne  Chablis Le Finage
desc_en_short: Pale gold in color, Le Finage Chablis is fairly discreet on the nose at first, revealing notes of sweet spices (vanilla). After opening, more fruity aromas appear (pear juice) with slight vegetal and lemon hints. The palate is fresh with well-balanced acidity. The whole is simple and rich with great energy.

name: William Fevre  Chablis Premier Cru Vaillons
desc_en_short: Pronounced nose of fruit and flowers, with lovely freshness and a few mineral touches. Generous palate, with lovely roundness.

name: Domaine Moreau Naudet  Chablis
desc_en_short: As always, the estate Chablis is considerably more compact and intense than the wine above. Mixed citrus, smoky flint, iodine and crushed seashells mingle on the gorgeous nose before the palate gets going with its depth charge of flavour and multi-layered texture. The intensity is off the charts this year, so get ready for waves of racy, stony flavour tapering to a powerful, salty close.

name: Domaine Moreau Naudet  Les Pargues Chablis Vieilles Vignes
desc_en_short: Mimi's beloved very old vines which produced a pitifully small yield in 2020. This is fuller again, a deep gold colour, and quite a lot of mid-palate richness, a real mouthful, with energy and mineral to balance and give impressive length.

name: Domaine Moreau Naudet  Vaillons Chablis Premier Cru
desc_en_short: The most forward nose – quite vibrant. Mineral, direct, I love the dimensions of flavour in this wine. A small grain from the citrus bitters, long too this wine. That’s really excellent, beautifully complex wine.

name: Domaine Julien Brocard  Montee De Tonnerre Chablis Premier Cru
desc_en_short: Subtle, smoky notes of crushed salt and limestone lend a mineral backdrop to concentrated notes of orange peel and white grapefruit in this wine. Deep in extraction yet chiseled and steely, it's a ripe expression of Chablis balanced by a refreshingly stony, briny lift. It's at peak now through 2026 but should hold further.

name: Domaine Julien Brocard  La Boissonneuse Chablis
desc_en_short: Sourced from biodynamically grown grapes, this single-vineyard Chablis highlights penetrating white-peach and grapefruit flavors accented by wisps of smoke and incense. While concentrated and voluminous in mouthfeel, it's cut by steely edges of acidity and a zesty lime-pith finish. The wine drinks well young and should maintain peak through 2027.

name: Domaine Julien Brocard  Le 7eme Chablis
desc_en_short: This is the “natural” Chablis of the range, produced from biodynamic grapes and aged without filtering, the addition of sulfites and yeasts, or fines. One of Domaine’s original biodynamic plots, it has an exceptional terroir and southeast orientation. 7th can only be produced if the grapes are in perfect health at the time of harvest. It is a dessert in itself, full of elegance, offering a very pure expression of the fruit with a nose of baked apples and bergamot accompanied by vanilla and mineral notes; on the palate, baked apples, lemon zest, mint, and cinnamon.

name: Caldera Lake  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Aromatic expressions of stone fruit and apple with hints of herb and
mineral characters are present. Flavours of honeysuckle, white nectarine are
supported by the creamy mouth-feel and lingering finish. Pair with spiced
barbecue chicken, pork chops with apple sauce or sautéed mushrooms.

name: Ardent Hills  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Attractive lemon curd and white flower notes dominate the bouquet.
Nougat, lemon barley and mealy notes are evident with beautifully balanced
oak on the palate. Hints of minerality are perceptible and will continue to
evolve. A fine Chardonnay – tightly structured with crisp acidity.

name: Oakwood Estate  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Attractive lemon curd and white flower notes dominate the bouquet.
Nougat, lemon barley and mealy notes are evident with beautifully balanced
oak on the palate. Hints of minerality are perceptible and will continue to
evolve. A fine Chardonnay – tightly structured with crisp acidity.

name: From The Valley  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Attractive lemon curd and white flower notes dominate the bouquet.
Nougat, lemon barley and mealy notes are evident with beautifully balanced
oak on the palate. Hints of minerality are perceptible and will continue
to evolve. A fine Chardonnay – tightly structured with crisp acidity.

name: Three Trails  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short:
Light and refreshing, this Pinot Grigio delights with aromas of ripe pear,
apple and refreshing herbaceous characters.
The crisp, citrus taste is followed by a clean and long zesty finish.
Server this drop with grilled chicken or shellfish dishes.

name: Caldera Lake  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short:
This Pinot Grigio has fresh tropical and herbaceous flavours blending
with mineral zestiest. The palate is crisp and clean, full of passion
fruit, lemon grass with refreshing acidity and nice lively finish.

name: Fleurieu Plains  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short:
Lifted aromas of juicy ripe pear and green apple. The palate is rich, displaying
flavours of honeysuckle and lemon with a crisp, zesty and refreshing
finish. Pair with fish tacos, roast chicken or mushroom risotto.

name: Ardent Hills  Pinot Grigio
desc_en_short: Lifted aromas of juicy ripe pear and green apple are present. The palate is rich, displaying flavours of honeysuckle and lemon with a crisp and refreshing finish. Pair with fish tacos, roast chicken or mushroom risotto.

name: Highground Vineyards  Riesling
desc_en_short:
Elevated lemon-blossom and musky floral notes accompany sweet scents of kaffir lime
in this Riesling. The refined palate exhibits a taut line of acidity, and slate minerality,
tying it all together for a long finish. Beautifully paired with delicate seafood dishes.

name: Bramblewood  Riesling
desc_en_short:
Light pale green in colour. This Riesling is showcasing abundant
grapefruit, cinnamon and rose petal characters. Medium-bodied
palate with intense citrus characters and a clean crisp finish.

name: Highground Vineyards  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
This Sauvignon Blanc opens with a nose of white grapefruit
zest and bold, grassy, herbaceous aromas. The palate is filled with
tropical flavours of kiwi fruit and passionfruit, accompanied by snow
pea and a mineral-like acidity. The finish is clean and crisp

name: Pier  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
Intense and lively tropical fruit aromas.
The flavours are of green apple and pineapple with a hint of snow pea.
A zesty finish which is refreshing and lingers long.

name: Three Trails  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
Lifted aromas of pineapple and honeysuckle are in abundance. The palate comprises
of refreshing minerality with flavours of green apple, lychee and passionfruit pulp.
The finish is lightly textured, with a gentle sherbet acidity and lingering flavours.

name: Saint Trifon  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
Intense aromas of passionfruit, pineapple and citrus zest. The palate is dry
yet fruity with flavours of lychee, green apple and a hint of herbaceous
notes. The wine is vibrant and fresh, with a zesty lingering finish.

name: Domaine Nathalie & Gilles  Fevre Chablis Grand Cru Les Preuses
desc_en_short:
The wines are harmonious and generous, but if they are kept the cellar a few years, you will be able to fully appreciate their subtleties and complexities.

 

According to maturity, perfect with scallops, grilled lobster, crawfish, or in sauce fine fish, but also with poultry or white meats in cream sauce.

name: Domaine Guy Robin & Fils  Vieilles Vignes Chablis Grand Cru 'Valmur'
desc_en_short: Aromas of lemon zest, spices, chalk dust, lime zest. Refined, vibrant, with a core of ripe white fruit. Estate vines sit at the forest line, planted by the family in the 1950s and 1960s. Pure Kimmeridgian soils are called "millefeuille", or many layered, with white clay and fossilized oyster shells.

name: Domaine Guy Robin & Fils  Vieilles Vignes Chablis Grand Cru 'Les Clos'
desc_en_short: Aromas of lemon zest, spices, chalk dust, lime zest. Refined, vibrant, with a core of ripe white fruit. Estate vines sit at the forest line, planted by the family in the 1950s and 1960s. Pure Kimmeridgian soils are called "millefeuille", or many layered, with white clay and fossilized oyster shells.

name: Rochester  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Aromas of granadilla, cut grass and guava, follow through to the palate, with flavours of lime and ripe figs.  Finishes with a crisp and fruity aftertaste.

name: Escarpment  Chardonnay Martinborough
desc_en_short:
Complex citrus and stone fruit notes of grapefruit and nectarine balanced
by tertiary aromas of lifted spiced ginger and hazelnut, with a gunflint
minerality. The palate shows great cleansing acidity and a warm mouthfeel
yet retaining and edgy focus of line and length. A perfect match to shellfish
and seafood entrées, and roasted poultry dishes.
Escarpment Martinborough Chardonnay will age gracefully over the next
few years, but is immediately accessible as a young wine.

name: Miguel Torres  Las Mulas Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale yellow color. Aromas reminiscent of ripe tropical fruits, with touches of citrus fruit. It is silky on the palate, with good acidic structure and a long finish.

name: Toro De Piedra  Reserve Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

This wine is Expressive herbaceous notes of gooseberry, apple, and freshly cut grass. Medium bodied with a fresh acidity to a plesant finish.

name: Toro De Piedra  Grand Reserve Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Yellow with golden reflections. Intense nose of pineapple, almond blossom, pear and vanilla. Very aromatic, full in body and dry, with a long finish of exotic fruit on the palate.

name: Sirius  AOC Bordeaux White by Maison Sichel
wine_color: Beautiful pale gold color with green reflections.
desc_en_short:
*Minimum Qty Allowed in Shopping Cart 6 Bottles.

Beautiful pale gold color with green reflections. An aromatic white wine, where the Sauvignon seduces the nose with its scents of white flowers, citrus fruits and lychee while the Sémillon brings a round and unctuous body, enhanced by a nice refreshing acidity. The balanced and persistent finish, more mineral and accompanied by light toasted and grilled notes. A delicate and complex wine. To be consumed chilled with a seafood platter, fish or simply as an aperitif.

name: Thomson Estate  Stony Row Riesling
desc_en_short: Citrus aromas with white flowers and passionfruit. This refreshing wine has medium body and rich fruit flavours of lemon, lime, passionfruit and white peach, which is balanced by fresh acidity and a rich mouth feel.

name: Fraser Gallop Estate Margaret River Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Light straw. A fresh and zippy Chardonnay with aromas of lemongrass and citrus fruits with hints of coconut husk. Nicely balanced flavours of green pear and vanilla cream on the palate.

name: Vite Colte  Gavi  "Aureliana" DOCG
desc_en_short: Straw yellow with greenish hints. Lively fruitiness and floral notes, as well as anise and fresh hay. Balanced, with the just right level of crisp acidity and redolent of ripe fruit.

name: Royal Harvest  Riesling
desc_en_short: This Eden Valley Riesling opens on strong lemon and orchid fruit aromas, complemented by a lift of white flowers and lime peel. The fleshy and complex palate carries through to a long, clean, dry finish.

name: Kessler-Zink  Riesling
desc_en_short: Light bodied whitewine with a fruity and well balanced structure of sweetness and acidity. Flavours of green apple and also pineapple gives the Kabinett the fresh and delight appearance Very light and easy to drink.

name: Phelps Creek  Chardonnay
wine_color: A light yellow and gold hue
desc_en_short: A light yellow and gold hue, aromas of citrus, apple and white melon. The cool climate cultivation results in beautiful acid balance, while volcanic soils add spice and mineral elements. A well rounded, balanced wine.

name: Phelps Creek  Gewurztraminer
wine_color: A light yellow and gold hue
desc_en_short: This is a brooding wine for the variety, with aromas of flower petal and herb. The flavors are center focused with a zip of acidity through the middle. Once it opens up there are plenty of interesting things happening, with the acidity driving it.

name: Phelps Creek  Riesling
desc_en_short: This wine is balanced by racy acidity with notes of lemon, apple, and honeysuckle. Pairs delightfully with veal, pork, poultry, and fish, but is especially amazing with Thai and spicy Chinese dishes.

name: Phelps Creek  Pinot Gris
desc_en_short: Stainless fermentation results in wine with beautifully bright acidity, balanced with sweet notes of green apple and pear laced with a hint of lavender and thyme on the nose. Structured to age and develop further intensity in the bottle.

name: Domaines Barons de Rothschild (Lafite) Saga R Bordeaux Blanc
desc_en_short:
Saga R Bordeaux Blanc mostly consists of Sauvignon Blanc, a grape variety renowned for its incomparable crispness. A small proportion of Sémillon is added to the blend and contributes to its silky mouthfeel.

This blend combines citrus and candied lemon notes with delicate mineral notes. Aged on the lees, it is a round wine with a refreshing finish that Jacques and André particularly appreciate:

name: Alpaca  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Clean pale-yellow in colour. In nose, tropical aromas such as peach, pineapple and banana hints combined exquisitely with sweet vanilla notes. In palate the fresh-fruit sensation is enhanced by the wine’s perfect acidity, which balances sweetness and gives a long pleasing finish.

name: Los Vascos Chagual Reserva Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Displays of passion fruit, lychee and pineapple, lemon peel, and subtle herbal hints of green chili and tomato leaf. The palate is juicy, with a good balance between volume and acidity.

name: Juris  Golser Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
"JURIS" is also the name for the family estate Stiegelmar in Gols, for a more precise name and for elimination of future confusion. The family as germ-cell, in the last centuries always has been our refuge of energy. This structure remained alive until today's time. Axel und Herta Stiegelmar has led the winery on the highest level of Austrian estates. Two aspects are responsible for this: One of them is the consistency and strength in all wine categories, offering regularly high quality with dry white wines, highly profiled red wines and sweet wines.

JURIS comprises about 18 ha (2/3 for red wines and 1/3 for white wines) of vineyards, which are situated all over the wine-region of Gols. Gols is located in the wine region Burgenland between Vienna and Budapest in the warm Pannonian climate with permeable soils of gravel and sand. Caused by the geologic conditions in our area, a great number of the grape varieties growing in Austria, are also planted in our estate. It has however crystallised, that the family of the Pinot-varieties is cultivated very often. JURIS strive to produce wines with character and style that are well balanced and possess complexity, aging potential, and a certain elegance.

The highlight of father - Georg Stiegelmar - was the international rewards of the "Robert Mondavi World Wine Trophy" for the Winemaker of the year 1995 (International Wine & Spirit Competition) in London.

name: Juris  Chardonnay Ried Altenberg
desc_en_short: Medium yellow-green, silver reflections, delicate vanilla, fine herbal spice, with ripe yellow tropical fruit, nuances of mandarin and blossom honey, complex, white peach, subtle fruit sweetness, a touch of nougat and lemony minerality in the finish.

name: Rainer Wess  Gruner Veltliner Alte Reben Krems Reserve
Balthasar Ress  Von Unserm  Riesling Trocken
desc_en_short: “Von Unserm” Rheingau Riesling dry presents itself in a bright, clear yellow with greenish reflections in the glass. The nose is initially captivated by exotic aromas of kiwi and passion fruit. These are complemented by classic Riesling aromas such as red apple and a hint of apricot. The fine combination of exotic fruits continues on the palate. Here yellow fruits such as ripe pears meet delicate, spicy herbal aromas, gooseberries and green apples.

name: Balthasar Ress  Hattenheim Nussbrunnen  Riesling Kabinett
desc_en_short: Hattenheim Nussbrunnen Cabinet presents itself in a clear yellow with golden reflections. The nose is initially dominated by clear notes of ripeness, which are complemented by fine, vegetal hints, fresh lime and some raisins. On the palate is fresh and elegant with a soft acidity. The delicate interplay of yellow fruits and spicy herbs harmoniously rounds off the taste of the finely matured cabinet.

name: Balthasar Ress  Rudesheim Berg Rottland Riesling Spatlese
Balthasar Ress  Rudesheim Berg Rottland Riesling GG Trocken
Balthasar Ress  Oestrich Doosberg  Riesling Auslese
Max Ferd. Richter  Multheimer Sonnenlay Riesling Zeppelin
Max Ferd. Richter  Weissburgunder Pinot Blanc Trocken
Max Ferd. Richter  Graacher Himmelreich Riesling Auslese
Brendel  "Noble One" Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: There is no cleaner portrayal of the Chardonnay grape than that of the Burgundian style. This inspired us to create Noble One, an unoaked and mineral-driven expression made with only the finest Chardonnay. The result is a wine as good as the intentions of the people who made it. Crafted from organic Chardonnay grapes grown in cooler weather sites around Napa Valley, this wine carries outstanding minerality and fresh unadulterated characteristics that leave you wanting more.

name: Napa Cellars  Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Aromas of fresh apple, mandarin, butterscotch, honey, and vanilla. A soft mouthfeel supports flavors of ripe pears with hints of lemon zest. Balanced, medium acidity with a creamy finish pulls together this well balanced, full-bodied Chardonnay.

This is the perfect wine to pair with a brie or gouda cheese plate drizzled with local honey and hazelnut.

name: Elizabeth Spencer  Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: A beautiful floral expression of the variety, with jasmine and orange blossom turning to lily as the aromas grow in the glass, evoking visions of a summer meadow.  In the mouth, the wine is gorgeously juicy, orange citrus-driven, focused, cleansing, and immensely refreshing.  This bottling is relatively light-bodied but with a breadth afforded by the Semillon element, and it lingers a while and perfumes the finish with the same floral intensity as it started.  It's lovely, early-summer drinking and one that will pair equally well with summer foods as it will delight on its own as a start-the-evening wine.

name: Joel Gott  California "Unoaked" Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Unoaked California Chardonnay has aromas of pear, sweet-tart apple and mango with notes of citrus and honeysuckle. On the palate, the wine opens with bright fruit flavors, followed by crisp minerality on the mid-palate and a long, clean balanced finish.

name: Joel Gott  California Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: California Sauvignon Blanc has aromas of white peach, honeydew melon, guava, and passionfruit with citrus notes. On the palate, the wine opens with tropical fruit flavors followed by crisp, refreshing acidity on the mid-palate and notes of tangerine and grapefruit on the long, clean balanced finish.

name: Alpha & Omega  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short: On the nose cotton, apricot, crème brûlée, fresh peach, bay leaf, chalk, brioche, wet clay, powder sugar, red Velvet cake, pear compote, orange peel. On the palate silky entrance, round evolution lifted by integrated acidity in a balanced palate, notes of white raspberry, green strawberry, litchi, vanilla bean, finished on a hint of caramel.

name: Alpha & Omega  "TWO" Napa Valley Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Straw yellow with a touch of lime green.
desc_en_short: Translucent straw yellow with a touch of lime green. Aromas of lemongrass, lime and green apples are accented by notes of orange blossoms and dry herbs. Flavors of honeydew melon and grapefruit are complemented by balanced acidity.

name: Black Stallion Estate  Napa Valley Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Black Stallion Estate Winery Chardonnay opens with aromas of yellow apple, crème brûlée and hints of
apricot, pear and oak. The flavors are tantalizing notes of citrus, dried apricot, and pineapple. The
Chardonnay from Los Carneros provides the bright acidity, citrus notes, and lean backbone of the wine, and
the Chardonnay from the warmer growing regions contributes riper, fuller-bodied character. Vanilla
aromatics from oak and floral perfume from the fruit precede ripe fruit flavors balanced with bright acidity
and a rich mid-palate weight creating a multi-layered, complex wine with a lingering finish. Sip this wine on
its own or pair alongside aged cheeses, fresh salad, shellfish or grilled seafood

name: Nik Weis  Schiefer Riesling VDP.ESTATE WINES (GUTSWEINE)
Richland  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Light straw in colour, this fruit driven Chardonnay displays ripe stone fruit and toasty oak aromas. A fresh palate of buttery ferment characters, creamy yeast and vanillan oak, finishing long, soft and well rounded. Excellent to drink now or cellar for the next two to five years.

name: Abbotts & Delaunay  Metayage Chardonnay IGP Pay D'Oc
desc_en_short: Light, pale golden hue. Lovely expressive nose of Chardonnay grown at high altitude, fresh and taut with mineral notes of pebbles and lemon and a touch of slightly smoked toasted hazelnut. On entry to the palate, the wine shows fullness with a nice acidic edge that creates a lovely freshness and a pineapple finish.

name: Edouard Delaunay Septembre Bourgogne Chardonnay Aoc
desc_en_short: Superb pale gold in colour. Expressive nose redolent of citrus, lemon and orange blossoms along with a hint of barley sugar and white chocolate. Fresh and taut on the palate, revealing notes of melted butter, frangipane and hazelnut.

name: Agua Santa  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: This wine has well-balanced acidity that gives freshness and persistence on the palate. Goes well with – Seafood, salads as an aperitif.

name: Agua Santa  Gran Reserva Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Snowmelt rivers flow down from the peaks of the Andes Mountains through Chile’s valleys. Agua Santa wines are inspired by the care and respect we have for this valuable resource, which every day contributes to the growth of our vines and motivates our passion to produce wines of the highest quality.

name: Massolino  Langhe DOC Chardonnay
wine_color: More or less bright straw yellow depending on the vintage.
desc_en_short:
Chardonnay is undoubtedly one of the most popular
international varieties in the world and this is Massolino's
interpretation of this noble grape.
We also devote meticulous attention to our Langhe DOC Chardonnay, from
tending the vines to scrupulous vinification. This wine represented a challenge
for us. Yet in the Langa region, traditionally the home of full-bodied reds,
Chardonnay has succeeded in finding a second home. Rich, exciting and suitable
for long ageing.

name: Framingham  True Nature Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short:
This wine is crafted from ripe, clean fruit carefully harvested from the stony soil vineyards of Conders Bend Road in the Wairau Valley.  Sustainably grown and naturally low yielding, these older vines produce concentrated flavours.

The use of seasoned oak barriques and Cuve fermenter create a complex wine that exhibits generous layers of flavour and texture.

name: Messenez Family  Chateau M Grand Vin Villes Vignes Chardonnay
wine_color: The wine has a clear, sparkling straw yellow color.
desc_en_short: The wine has complex aromas of ripe fruits such as apples, pears, citrus, combined with delicate white floral aromas and a bit of vanilla and honey. The wine's taste is full and balanced with cool acidity and a long, lingering aftertaste.

name: Bosquet des Papes Chateauneuf-du-Pape Tradition Blanc
desc_en_short: A blend of Clairette, Grenache Blanc, Grenache Gris and Bourboulenc, aged partially in barriques and demi-muids. It opens with fragrant aromas of spring blossom, honeysuckle, ripe pear, lemon peel, white peach, pineapple and a dash of vanilla. Medium to full-bodied, displaying great precision and moderate levels of soft acidity, it concludes with a bright finish.

name: Heim  Riesling Imperial
desc_en_short: Pale yellow color. Riesling, dry, racy, delicately fruity, offers a bouquet of great finesse with sometimes mineral or lemon nuances. Recognized as one of the best white grape varieties in the world, it is a gourmet wine par excellence. On the palate, the frank acidity also makes it suitable for tasting during meals. A very nice balance between the fruit and the acidity.

name: Clay Creek Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This Chardonnay is medium-bodied with complex structure and balanced acidity. Aromas of peach, ripe, vanilla and toasted hazelnut give way to flavors of honeydew, pineapple, and graham cracker. The finish is rich and juicy.

name: Beau Reve De Tradition  Blanc Bordeaux Aoc
Church Road  Grand Reserve Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Fresh, zesty citrus and citrus blossom notes come to the fore this year with riper, richer stone fruit underlying and providing extra depth. The fruit is overlaid with complexities of roasted nuts, toasted brioche and a hint of smoky struck flint.

This is a full-bodied Chardonnay balanced by gentle, fresh acidity and a spine of slate-like minerality.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Mapu Tierra Sagrada Chardonnay
wine_color: Brilliant yellow with medium colour intensity and subtle green highlights.
desc_en_short:
Brilliant yellow with medium colour intensity and
subtle green highlights.
Very intense and refreshing with aromas of
grapefruit, pineapple and quince, mingled with
notes of tropical fruit (melon and guava) and hints
of marzipan imparted by ageing in French oak
barrel.
The potent attack gives way to a rich mid palate
with good volume, good acidity, with fruity notes
such as grapefruit culminating in a long finish with
subtle toasty nuances.

name: Baron Philippe de Rothschild  Baronne Charlotte AOC Graves
desc_en_short: In the glass, the Baronne Charlotte Graves blanc from Baron Philippe de Rothschild presents a brilliant shimmering pale yellow color. In the glass, this white wine from Baron Philippe de Rothschild offers aromas of star fruit, mangoes, pineapple, gallia melon and papayas, complemented by black tea, oriental spices and gingerbread spice. On the palate, Baronne Charlotte Graves blanc from Baron Philippe de Rothschild opens wonderfully dry, grippy and aromatic.

name: Louis Latour  Puligny-Montrachet Chalumeaux 1er
wine_color: A shiny pale yellow coloured hue.
desc_en_short: Home of some of the world's most extraordinary Chardonnays including the famous Montrachet, Puligny-Montrachet is the geographical middleman of the white wine villages, bordered by Meursault to the north and by Chassagne-Montrachet to the south. Located just next to the vineyard "Les Truffières", almost at the top of the hill, the vines "Les Chalumeaux" grow high up on limestone and marl soil with an ideal south-easterly exposure, catching as much sunlight as the day-time permits. These vineyards have belonged to the Chalumeau family (or whom exloited the parcel), hence its name.

name: Louis Latour  Batard-Montrachet Grand Cru
wine_color: A bright hue with yellow gold nuances.
desc_en_short: The Grand Cru vineyard of Bâtard-Montrachet lies between the picturesque villages of Puligny-Montrachet and Chassagne-Montrachet, home to the world's greatest white wines. Only a small country lane separates this 11.86 hectare vineyard from the great Montrachet itself. Its gentle easterly-facing slope is made up of a deep, rich, gravelly soil which has a limestone base, world renowned for the production of high quality Chardonnay.

name: Louis Latour  Chevalier-Montrachet Grand Cru
wine_color: The wine is bright gold in colour
desc_en_short: Chevalier-Montrachet sits higher up the same hillside as the Montrachet appellation. In 1913 Domaine Louis Latour purchased this 0,51 hectare vineyard from the widow of Léonce Bocquet, who initiated renovations of a part of the Clos Vougeot Château. This vineyard carries the name "Les Demoiselles" in hommage to the daughters of an early 19th century Beaune General, Adèle and Julie Voillot, who were the owners of the vineyard and who died without marrying.

name: Primosic  Ribolla Gialla "Think Yellow"
desc_en_short:
“Think Yellow”: a fresh, sunny and young
label for the grape variety that we love the most, the
Ribolla Gialla. It is an indigenous variety, fermented in
stainless steel in order to enhance its primary
characteristics, acidity and freshness.

name: Primosic  Klin Colio Bianco DOC
desc_en_short: Full bodied, with balanced acidity and in harmony with refined and intriguing toasted undertones. Distinct focus on its uniqueness and belonging.

name: Primosic  Collio Chardonnay Reserva
desc_en_short: Intensity, structure, aromas and elegance in a high-profile international grape variety. A powerful wine, obtained from the historic vines of the Gmajne vineyard, capable of giving life to unique wines, suitable for long aging.

name: Dry Creek Vineyard  Fume Blanc
desc_en_short: Since 1972, we have produced Fumé Blanc — a wine at the heart and soul of our family winery. Modeled after the classic wines from the Loire Valley in France, our stainless steel fermented Fumé Blanc is crisp, balanced and immediately drinkable. Our Fumé Blanc emanates the classic Dry Creek Vineyard “house” style of Sauvignon Blanc. Aromatics of lemon, lime and grapefruit leap forward from the glass with both fruit and floral nuances of nectarine, peach, jasmine and orange blossom. On the palate, the wine is intense and bright with grapefruit, tangerine and passionfruit. Underlying minerality and hints of pineapple, guava and ginger contribute to this wine’s refreshing, crisp finish.

name: Angeline Vineyards  California Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Fresh notes of Bosc pear, lemon zest, touches of pineapple, and subtle vanilla on the finish.

name: Two Hands  The Boy Riesling Eden Valley
desc_en_short:
The Boy is the epitome of an Eden Valley Riesling with it’s exotic aromatics. Sourced from a 108 year old, dry grown vineyard to the north on Mengler’s Hill.

“So you walk and walk and walk and finally you find a special place with a special vineyard. You walk some more and you taste and you’re excited…108 year old Riesling vines perched high atop the Eden Valley with an intensity you have never experienced before..…you have found “The Boy” – Michael Twelftree”

name: F.X. Pichler  Grüner Veltliner Klostersatz
desc_en_short:
The Ried Klostersatz is, as the name suggests, one of the oldest vineyards in the Wachau to be cultivated by the monks of Bavarian and Salzburg monasteries.
It is a vineyard with a remarkably deep soil composition situated in the Loibner basin, within the majestic curve of the Danube river between Dürnstein and Oberloiben. The topsoil is characterized by fine sand particles, which indicate a slow flow rate during the deposition. The underlying gravel, on the other hand, was deposited at a high flow rate. The high degree of rounding of the pebbles is evidence of a long transport route from the Alps.

name: F.X. Pichler  Grüner Veltliner Kellerberg
desc_en_short: The Kellerberg is an internationally critically acclaimed vineyard site par excellence. This vineyard has steep inclines and barren bedrock terraces. It faces due south to south-east and forms an outlet of a tributary valley with an exceptional microclimate. The Dürnsteiner Kellerberg is blessed with early morning sunshine, with much of the site profiting from much-needed shade from the early afternoon rays during the summer months. The latter has a huge benefit on drawing out the ripening of the grapes. At night, cool air currents from the surrounding woodlands help to retain aromatic freshness and provide complex texture and finely nuanced minerality, with tropical and seductive aromas. In autumn, diurnal temperature differences between warm days and cool nights are a significant factor during maturation process and ensure that the grapes retain their aromas.

name: Noble Vines  "242" Lodi  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Noble Vines Sauvignon Blanc is named for block 242 of our home vineyard in the San Bernabe AVA of Monterey. This cool location along the central coast of California – similar to the climate of Marlborough, New Zealand – produces bright citrus notes found in this wine. The loamy hillside soils of block 242 are heavy and vigorous, allowing the vines to grow protective canopies to shade the fruit from the afternoon sun, resulting in Sauvignon Blanc with brilliant aromatics and balanced acidity. The primary vine stock in this wine is Sauvignon Blanc 1, which originated in Bordeaux, France and has adapted well to California.

name: Grand Napa Vineyards  Los Carneros Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Grand Napa Vineyards hand-selects this fresh and elegant Chardonnay from only the finest grapes. On the palate the wine is crisp and balanced with a good texture, offering notes of apricot and peach.

name: Intipalka  Sauvignon Blanc
desc_en_short: Pale yellow with green edges. Fresh Jalapeño, cassis leaf and sour lime aromas. The palate is same as aromas with touches of Jalapeño, tart lemon lime and under ripe herbs.

name: Intipalka  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Pale yellow color. Green strawberry, gooseberry, lime zest and lemon aromas. Lemon oil, pink grapefruits, cassis leaft and lime custard flavour.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Maderos Blend de Blancs
desc_en_short: Perceive citrus, honey, white fruits and apricot aromas. In the mouth the wine has elegant first impact and it opens up in the middle of the palate with the same fruity and honeyed flavors that we identified in the nose. It's fresh graceful with a lot of personality. It truly refects our terroir, a place for wines with great aging potential.

name: Los Cerros De San Juan  Cuna De Piedra Reserve Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Our Chardonnay grapes give us fresh juices, with good natural acidity, citrus fruits that, after their time in oak, gain in volume and complexity in the mouth.

name: Cellier Des Princes  Cotes du Rhone Selection Selection Blanc
wine_color: A yellow gold colour with some green reflections.
desc_en_short: This wine is clear and brilliant and shows a yellow gold colour with some green reflections. The vinification at low temperature enhances the aromatic finesse and brings some floral elegance with acacias flowers. The wines exhibits a perfect balance between freshness, fruit aromas such as apricot and acidity.

name: Domaine De Rochebin  Bourgogne Aligote
desc_en_short: As the name suggests, this wine is made from the Aligoté grape variety. Pale gold in color, it is very perfectly tasteful with a fruity (apple, lemon) and floral (acacia) bouquet. On the palate, it is delicious, energetic and stimulates the taste buds.

name: Domaine De Rochebin  Macon Villages
desc_en_short: Apple and citrus predominate on the palate along with a hint of pear, steely minerality. A refreshing citric acidity matches the roundness on the palate with fresh fruits flavors lingering on the palate.

name: Domaine De Rochebin  Macon IGE
wine_color: Gold color, intense, straw yellow reflections.
desc_en_short: Gold color, intense, straw yellow reflections. A nose marked by red fruits and gourmandise. Round, lemon notes, peach notes, supple on the palate.

name: Domaine de la Mordorée  "Lirac La Reine des Bois" Blanc
desc_en_short: Produced from old vines, this cuvée will seduce you with its aromas of fruit and white flowers. A rich, mineral wine with complexity and length on the palate.

name: Sato  La Ferme de Sato Le Chant du Vent
desc_en_short:
The Sato Chant du Vent Chardonnay is sourced from across the three blocks planted by Yoshiaki and Kyoko Sato on their small vineyard in the shade of Mt. Pisa.

"Chant du Vent" translates to "Song of the Wind", which refers to the whistling noise created by the wind as it hurtles through the vineyard posts. The Satos want this wine, along with the Sur Les Nuages Pinot Noir, to represent their whole farm, so in a way, this is the Siren Song of the Sato vineyard.

It's a richly yet mineral-driven Chardonnay with plenty of weight and flavour. It will drink well now but also reward mid-term cellaring.

name: Sato  La Ferme de Sato Schisteux
desc_en_short: Block 2, where Chenin Blanc is planted, has schist rocks or gravels at the most among the blocks. This is one of the big reasons we chose this block for Chenin. We believe schist gives the flavor and taste to the grapes. Indeed, our Chenin Blanc is “made from schist = Schisteux”.

name: Monemvasia	 300 White
desc_en_short: Bright yellow-green color, rich aromas with elements of quince, citrus, grapefruit and minerality on the palate. Excellent balance between the crisp acidity and the well-structured body. Pleasant long finish.

name: Monemvasia	 Kydonitsa
desc_en_short: Yellow-green color, unique aromas of tropical fruits, bergamot, apple geranium and quince, distinctive of the rare indigenous variety. Full body, freshness, pleasant acidity, magnificent long finish.

name: Fontanafredda  Derthona Timorasso Colli Tortonesi DOC
wine_color: The gold color that blends with its greenish reflections.
desc_en_short: The gold color that blends with its greenish reflections. On the noose the bouquet is aromatic and reminiscent of exotic fruits, as well as white pulp fruit. In the mouth it is pleasantly fresh, enveloping and harmonious, with a long gustatory persistence.

name: Casarena Single Vineyard Owen Chardonnay
wine_color: Bright yellow, clean with greenish hues.
desc_en_short: The manual harvest was carried out in three different stages in order to increase the aromatic complexity of the wine. Then, a double cluster selection was carried out. In the winery, a pre fermentation maceration at low temperature was done. The fermentation was done using indigenous yeasts, 50% of the must in French oak barrels and the rest in stainless steel tanks. The malolactic fermentation was done in barrels, then batonnage works were performed to keep the lees in suspension and gain volume and weight in the mouth. This wine has different components to preserve the freshness and bring unctuousness and complexity.

name: Chateau de la Maltroye  Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru "Les Chenevottes"
desc_en_short: Ripe aromas of citrus confit, essence of pear and a similar hint of rosemary oil. The supple and rounded medium-bodied flavors possess excellent verve and delineation on the very dry and equally austere finale that is fairly tightly wound so at least some patience should beneficial.

name: Domaines Albert Bichot  Secret de Famille Bourgogne Cote d'Or Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
This wine has a bouquet of both mineral and floral. It is also amazing due to its fat aspect associated with good acidity on the finish.

This wine eminently suitable for seafood (seafood, fish and Saint-Jacques) and the sausage brioche, snails and
white meats.

name: Domaines Albert Bichot  Saint-Veran
desc_en_short: Delicate nose with notes of white flowers combined with scents of ripe fruit (peach, pear) and sometimes fresh almond. On the palate, this wine features pleasing roundness enhanced by lovely minerality. Well balanced, structured and generous, it boasts a refreshing finish.

name: Domaines Albert Bichot  Pouilly Fuisse
desc_en_short: The nose is extremely fresh and features scents of white-fleshed fruit and spices underpinned by a discrete hint of vanilla and oak. The palate boasts lovely minerality and perfect balance between vivacity and roundness. Highly aromatic and very pleasing finish.

name: Joseph Mellot Sancerre La Grande Chatlaine
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with brilliant reflections.
desc_en_short: A refined and mineral-driven Sauvignon Blanc with vibrant citrus, white peach, and flinty complexity—an elegant expression of classic Sancerre terroir.

name: Karthäuserhof  Eitelsbacher Alte Reben
desc_en_short:
The wine shows the typical flavors and mouthfeel of 
the unique combination of Devonian slate and iron 
in the soil: intense nose, very mineral and spicy, 
white stone fruit, crisp pear and hints of citrus. 
Velvet and extremely juicy on the tongue, 
invigoration acidity without any sharpness. Made to 
last but also wonderful to drink now

name: Marchile Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: A pale yellow hue with green reflections.
style: Sauvignon Blanc (โซวีญง บล็อง)
desc_en_short: Crisp and refreshing Sauvignon Blanc from Maule Valley, Chile—bright citrus, grapefruit, and fresh-cut grass aromas. A lively white wine with zesty acidity, perfect for seafood, salads, and light dishes.

name: Concha Y Toro  Terrunyo Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Bright greenish tones, slightly pale yellow.
desc_en_short: Bright greenish tones, slightly pale yellow. Delicate freshness and minerality. A nice combination of blackcurrant, lime, white flowers, asparagus, limestone, marine and saline notes. Saline, mineral, and crunchy acidity. Very fresh and juicy. It perfectly defines the year. A charming wine.

name: Tornatore  Etna Bianco Pietrarizzo
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with intense greenish reflections
desc_en_short: Intense straw yellow with faint greenish reflections at the sight; pleasant hints of exotic fruit and especially grapefruit and white peach mark the nose of this wine, which shows its true identity on the palate with a very pleasant savoriness and freshness complemented by an extraordinary complexity and sweetness of taste.

name: Fly By  Chardonnay
desc_en_short: This bottling is complex, with aromas of fresh Fuji apple, bosc pear, citrus, mango, and toasty oak notes on the nose. The flavors on the palate are crisp, apricot, yellow plum, dried bay leaf, lemon cream, and mineral-layered throughout the finish. pair with grilled sea bass

name: District Series Russian River Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Smooth & relaxed, this elegant wine coats the palate with peaches, poached pears, butter & toast without overdoing any of them. Great layering & creaminess are balanced by a touch of lemony acidity

name: Alain Gautheron Chablis
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with subtle greenish glints—bright and luminous.
desc_en_short: Alain Gautheron's Chablis is a classic expression of northern Burgundy terroir—pure, mineral-driven, and elegantly crisp. Crafted by a fifth-generation winemaking family in the heart of Chablis, this wine showcases the timeless beauty of Chardonnay grown on ancient Kimmeridgian soils.

name: Mission Estate Gewurztraminer
desc_en_short: This Estate Gewurztraminer is a classic example that has floral aromas of Turkish delight and a palate that is rich and full.  This is the perfect match for spicy oriental cuisine.

name: Domaine Henri Boillot Puligny-Montrachet 1er Cru "Clos de la Mouchere" Monopole
desc_en_short: Henri is the 5th generation of the Boillot family. His son Guillaume joined the domaine a few years ago. In 2005 Henri Boillot bought out the shares of his brother and sister, and put his own name to his father’s domaine. The Domaine is now located in Meursault, consisting of 15 hectares split between white and red. Henri Boillot uses “lutte raisonne” meaning without using chemicals on the soil. White grapes are whole-bunch pressed, vinified without any batonage. The elevage is in 350L barrels, balance between new barrels and one year old barrels (never more). After fermentation the wine goes into the barrel, either new or one year old barrel. No racking, fining or filtering. The wines are bottled after 18 months in barrel and are generally described as pure, rich, accurate, powerful and brilliant.

name: Domaine Pierre Girardin Puligny-Montrachet 1er Cru "Les Pucelles" (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Pierre Girardin is the 13th generation of his family to make wine in Burgundy. This brilliant yet youthful winegrower grew up learning in the vines and cellar of his father, Vincent Girardin. Pierre’s viticulture is organic, moving toward full certification. He follows the lunar calendar for every action and uses next-level pure compost from the family farm.

desc_en_short: "La Romanée" is a small Premier Cru vineyard located on the high slopes just south of the Chassagne-Montrachet village. The soil is light, pebbly, and calcareous. The vineyard's excellent exposure contributes to producing wines that are both rich and mineral-driven.

name: Domaine Vincent Dancer Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Morgeot - Blanc
desc_en_short: Morgeot is a large Premier Cru in Chassagne-Montrachet with deep, clay, and limestone soils. The specific parcel used by Domaine Vincent Dancer was replanted in 2012 at a high density. The terroir is known for producing wines that are powerful, rich, and structured.

name: Domaine Vincent Dancer Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Tête du Clos - Blanc
desc_en_short: Domaine Vincent Dancer is a highly respected Burgundy producer. The Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Tête du Clos is one of its most sought-after cuvées, coming from a small parcel within the Premier Cru of Morgeot.

name: Domaine Vincent Dancer Meursault 1er Cru Perrieres
desc_en_short: Domaine Vincent Dancer is a highly respected Burgundy producer, known for its terroir-driven, minimalist winemaking style. The Meursault 1er Cru 'Les Perrières' is one of the most highly sought-after wines from the domaine.

name: Domaine Hubert Lamy Chassagne-Montrachet 1er Cru Les Chaumees
desc_en_short:
The Lamy family has been working vines in Saint-Aubin since 1640. Created in 1973 and is now run by ambitious Olivier, who worked at Meo-Camuzet before taking over in 1996 from his father, Hubert. Olivier studied winemaking and commerce, and has been very keen in expanding the family business. He makes wines from several appellations in Burgundy and is always seeking to improve the quality by experimenting in both the vineyard and winery; to try and capture greater expressions of individual terroirs.

Olivier seeks to make stylish wines that are refined and racy, highlighting the mineral character of Burgundy. Yields are kept low and during harvest, grapes are sorted in cellar. Vinification is traditional and the wines are matured in oak casks (20-30% new) for 12 months before light filtration and bottling. Olivier has begun using 600-lt tonneaux rather than all 225-litre barriques. He feels this protects the purity of the fruit without overoaking. Today, the majority of Lamy's production is raised in these larger casks.

name: Domaine Vincent Pinard Sancerre - Grand Chemarin (Magnum) (1.5 L)
desc_en_short: Domaine Vincent Pinard is located in Bue at the heart of the Sancerre region. The way of working at this century’s-old family estate is very traditional. And work philosophy takes a natural, organic approach and respects the terroirs and consequently the environment. The estate’s 17 hectares are mainly located on the hills of Bue, a famed winegrowing village that boasts limestone and clay-limestone terroirs. The village does not use any herbicides, insecticides or anti-rot treatments, etc. Most of the work in the vineyards are done by hand (including harvesting). And have chosen to limit yields and produce small quantities of grapes (few grapes per vine stock). In order to do so, prune short, disbud and thin the clusters (green harvest). The grapes are handpicked and we select the finest grapes at the sorting table. Loire

name: Domaine Jean-Pierre Guyon Morey-Saint-Denis "la Bidaude" - Blanc
desc_en_short:
Domaine Jean-Pierre Guyon moved towards organic viticulture during the 2000s. To bring clarity to our techniques of viticulture and vinification, we engaged in the process of ECOCERT accreditation in 2009, becoming certified in 2012. 

As the harvest approaches, we taste the grapes in our different plots regularly, to decide on picking dates. This permits us to judge their ripeness. When the moment comes, the pickers advance, secateurs in hand, to pick the fruit which has been nurtured and cherished throughout the year.

name: Domaine Sylvain Pataille Marsannay "le Chapitre" - Blanc
desc_en_short: Domaine Sylvain Pataille is a relatively new estate in Marsannay – the estate was established by Sylvain in the late 1990s and the first vintage was 1999. Sylvain Pataille is an exciting young grower in Marsannay. He trained as an oenologist in Bordeaux, and still consults to 15 or so domaines in Burgundy. He began in 2001 with 4 ha and now has 14 ha mainly en fermage, which are undergoing conversion to biodynamic cultivation. He makes white from aligote and a selection of chardonnay rose, whose skin turns pink when ripe, as well as rose and red. He aims for very low yields in the reds of 35 hl/ha.

The preparations are biodynamic to stimulate the soils of brown clay, crushed marble, and ferrous soils. Some very steep slopes can be plowed by horse.

The palate is fresh and lively with a
delicate white peach and lime flavours
that come together with balanced acid
and a zesty spritz.

zest, green apple, subtle mineral,
white peach and anise, spicy hints
Medium-bodied, saline acidity,
concentrated, structured with

desc_en_short:
Domaine du Pelican is the Jura property, owned and operated by Guillaume d'Angerville proprietor of the famous Domaine Marquis d'Angerville in Burgundy. After being served a Jura Chardonnay in Paris, Guillaume decided to search for vineyards in the Jura and eventually he put together just under 15 hectares of vineyards in Montigny-les-Arsures in Arbois.

The estate is managed by Guillaume’s Volnay Regisseur and partner in Domaine du Pelican Francois Duvivier, who runs a team permanently based in the Jura. The vines are between Arbois and Montigny. Vitally all 15 hectares are within 2km of each other, the same as in Volnay, this allows the estate to grow the vineyards bio-dynamically.

name: Three Dark Horses Chardonnay
desc_en_short:
Three Dark Horses is the new project for former Coriole winemaker
Matt Broomhead. After vintages in southern Italy (2007) and the Rhone
Valley he returned to McLaren Vale in late 2009 and, with his father Alan,
buys quality grapes, thanks to the long experience they both have in the
region. The third dark horse is Matt’s grandfather, a vintage regular. But
things are changing. In Nov ‘17 the business acquired a 5ha vineyard
in McLaren Vale, and will build an onsite winery. They are expanding
the plantings with grenache blanc, clairette and touriga nacional, and
reworking some of the shiraz vines planted in 1964.

desc_en_short: Sustainably grown and produced, this superb Chardonnay layers inviting aromas of blossoms, peach, and nectarine with fresh flavors of citrus, apple, and cream. A light touch of oak on the long finish completes an authentic classic.

name: Santa Helena Gran Reserva Chardonnay
desc_en_short: Predominated by fresh fruit like peaches, along with hints of nuts and toast. A Full bodied, but refreshing and creamy with good acidity that ref.lects the aging.

name: Famille Masse Rully 1er Cru Les Deux Terres
desc_en_short:
In the world of the Côte Chalonnaise, the name Rully is often regarded as the epitome of Chardonnay that shines with both elegance and freshness. Les Deux Terres—meaning “Two Soils”—refers to a vineyard that reflects the unique character of two distinct terroirs: limestone and clay. This harmony of soils gives the wine a balance of structure and finesse, making it a refined interpretation of Rully.

Winemaking: Chardonnay grapes undergo slow fermentation to preserve freshness and fruit purity, followed by partial aging in French oak to enhance balance and depth, while retaining the natural charm and approachability that define Rully

Character: Bursting with zesty lemon and crisp green apple, lifted by a clear thread of limestone minerality. The style is linear and precise, delivering a clean, pure, and straightforward expression—ideal for Chardonnay lovers who prefer terroir-driven clarity over oak richness.

“Pure Chardonnay elegance, mineral-driven and bright.” – Vinous

name: Garofoli Supera Verdicchio Di Matelica

name: Speri Soave Classico DOC
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with greenish highlights.
desc_en_short:
Speri is a historic family estate based in Veneto, best known internationally for its benchmark Valpolicella wines, yet its philosophy of terroir-driven viticulture extends naturally to white wines as well.

The Soave Classico DOC represents Speri’s interpretation of one of Veneto’s most classical white wine appellations—crafted with restraint, precision, and a clear emphasis on freshness rather than overt ripeness. Rooted in traditional hillside vineyards, this wine reflects the estate’s belief that elegance and balance are the true markers of longevity and regional identity.

name: Kessler-Zink Winemaker Seletion Chardonnay Silvaner
desc_en_short:
Our Cuvée Blanc brings together the fresh clarity of Silvaner and the
structure and elegance of Chardonnay. Gentle pressing and
temperature-controlled fermentation preserve purity and aromatics,
followed by a short period on fine lees to enhance texture and
complexity. The result is a harmonious wine that reflects the mineral
character and vitality of Rheinhessen, offering both approachability
and depth.

name: Dohlmuhle Chardonnay Trocken
desc_en_short:
This Chardonnay highlights the varietal’s classic elegance – ripe fruit,
balanced acidity and a refined structure. With its moderate richness
and 13 % alcohol, it offers both immediate drinking pleasure and
versatility at the table. Pairs beautifully with poultry, pasta in cream
sauces, seafood or mild cheeses.

name: Elena Walch Sauvignon Alto Adige DOC
wine_color: Deep yellow colour with green hints
desc_en_short: Our Sauvignon captivates with its deep yellow colour with green hints and aromatic bouquet of ripe gooseberries, papaya and elderberries as well as fine notes of herbs. Juicy acidity, elegant structure and an inviting finish characterize the palate.

name: Weingut Robert Weil  Riesling Rheingau Kabinett
wine_color: Pale lemon with green reflections, bright and crystalline in appearance.
desc_en_short:
Crafted by Weingut Robert Weil, this Riesling Kabinett captures the essence of Rheingau with precision and grace. Sourced from steep, south-facing vineyards along the Rhine, the wine reflects a balance that defines great Kabinett: lightness without simplicity, sweetness held in perfect check by vibrant acidity.

On the nose, you’ll find crisp green apple, white peach, and citrus blossom, accented by a subtle slate minerality. The palate is fresh and finely textured, with delicate sweetness woven seamlessly into a lively, mouthwatering structure. The finish is clean, elegant, and quietly persistent—inviting another sip rather than demanding attention.

This is a Riesling designed for real drinking: versatile at the table, refreshing on its own, and effortlessly expressive of place. Serve well-chilled to highlight its clarity and lift.

name: Las Condes  Sauvignon Blanc
wine_color: Pale straw yellow with green reflections.
desc_en_short: A crisp, refreshing Sauvignon Blanc with bright citrus, green fruit, and clean acidity—fresh, lively, and easy to enjoy.

name: Albert Bichot Chablis
desc_en_short: A classic mineral-driven Chablis with crisp citrus, green apple, and vibrant acidity—fresh, precise, and unmistakably Burgundian.

name: Albert Bichot Domaine Long-Depaquit Chablis 1Er Cru “Les Lys”
wine_color: Pale gold with luminous green reflections.
desc_en_short:
The “Les Lys” Premier Cru Climat is located on the left bank of the Serein river, overlooking the villages of Chablis and Milly.
Our plot is located mid-slope, at the heart of the appellation. Its atypical east-northeastern exposure plays an important role in the expression of this wine. This is a cool area where the grapes ripen gradually and slowly, yielding vivacious wines abounding with finesse.

name: Albert Bichot Domaine Long-Depaquit Chablis Grand Cru “Bougros”
wine_color: Pale gold with luminous green reflections.
desc_en_short:
Our plot in the "Bougros" Climat, located in the westernmost part of the Grand Crus, benefits from the afternoon sun due to its south-western exposure.

The planting density of the vines is higher than the average of 8,000 vines/ha, which forces them to compete with one another and plunge their roots deeper down into the soil.

The calcareous clay soil, which contains a higher proportion of clay than the other Grand Crus, benefits from a considerable groundwater reserve that yields highly expressive wines that boast remarkable structure and impressive cellaring potential

name: Albert Bichot Bourgogne Chardonnay “Origines”
wine_color: Pale gold with bright green reflections.
desc_en_short:
Burgundy has historically been one of the oldest terroirs of reference for Chardonnay wines.

Our ‘Origines’ cuvée is crafted from grapes hailing from a mosaic of plots that overlie calcareous clay soil, with varying exposure and altitude. The diversity of these terroirs along with careful vinification and ageing allow the Chardonnay grape to produce an aromatic, fresh, round wine.

name: Albert Bichot Domaine Du Pavillon Meursault
desc_en_short:
Located at the very heart of the Côte de Beaune, Meursault is one of Burgundy's flagship villages and among its most celebrated It is cited as being the capital of Burgundy's great white wines. The diversity in the soil type and depth and the nature of the slope has a significant influence on the wines. Though they are always magnificently opulent, some may feature varying expressions of minerality.

Such is the case of our Meursault Domaine du Pavillon, a wine crafted from grapes hailing from 3 plots with very different, though complementary characteristics.
